title: Do Equity and Options Markets Agree about Volatility?
abstract: We derive tight pricing kernel restrictions from options with same‐day expiration (“0DTEs”). These restrictions concern the volatility of small and frequent asset price moves that the equity and options markets must agree on in a frictionless economy. Their violation leads to pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, characterized by nontrivial reward‐to‐risk ratios over arbitrarily short horizons and achieved by a combined position in 0DTEs and the underlying asset. Empirically, we find no evidence of feasible pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, as transaction costs, estimation risk, and short‐term volatility risk prevent investors from taking advantage of small and infrequent disagreements about volatility between equity and options markets.
summary: 本文利用与股票同日到期的期权（0DTE）推导出严格的定价核限制条件，这些条件要求在一个无摩擦经济中，权益市场和期权市场对资产价格小幅和频繁波动的波动率必须达成一致。违反这些限制会导致伪套利机会，其特征是在任意短时期内具有非平凡的风险回报比，并通过持有0DTE和标的资产的组合来实现。实证结果表明，由于交易成本、估计风险和短期波动风险的存在，投资者无法利用权益与期权市场之间关于波动率的微小且不频繁的分歧，因此未发现可行的伪套利机会。
ai_comment: 本文从期权定价的微观结构出发，创新性地利用0DTE期权研究了权益与期权市场的波动率一致性，并考虑了现实摩擦对套利的阻碍，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Sovereign Default and the Decline in Interest Rates*
abstract: Sovereign debt yields have undergone a historic decline over the last half century. Standard explanations, including aging populations and increases in asset demand from abroad, encounter difficulties when confronted with the full range of evidence. We propose an explanation based on a decline in inflation and default risk. We show that a model with sovereign default captures the decline in interest rates, the stability of equity valuation ratios, and the reduction in investment and output growth. Calibrations of the model post-COVID suggest that sovereign default risk may have returned.
summary: 本文研究了过去半个世纪主权债务收益率的历史性下降。标准解释（如人口老龄化和来自国外的资产需求增加）难以完全解释全部证据。我们提出一个基于通货膨胀和违约风险下降的解释。我们证明，一个包含主权违约的模型能够捕捉利率的下降、股权估值比率的稳定以及投资和产出增长的减少。模型在COVID后的校准表明，主权违约风险可能已经回归。
ai_comment: 本文用一个统一的主权违约模型解释了利率长期下降、股权估值稳定和经济增长放缓等多个现象，视角独特且富有解释力。

title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
summary: 本文利用巴西的雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息，研究了并购对目标公司员工收入的影响。发现并购导致员工收入大幅且持续下降，这种负面效应主要集中在离职员工身上，短期表现为失业，长期表现为工资下降。低技能、管理者和年长员工受到的影响更大。作者认为并购后存在显著的劳动力重新配置成本，包括企业特定工资溢价损失、匹配效率低下和行业特定人力资本折旧，员工最终转向被认为生产率和就业价值更低的企业。
ai_comment: 使用详尽的行政数据揭示了并购对员工收入的长期负面影响，特别是区分了离职与留任员工的差异，并识别了低技能、管理者和年长员工等脆弱群体，为并购的劳动力市场后果提供了细致证据。

title: The Dark Side of Liquid Bonds in Fire Sales
abstract: We investigate which bonds investors should sell when they need to raise cash quickly. Our model shows that the intuitive strategy of selling the most liquid bonds can backfire. In over-the-counter markets, liquid bonds trade fastest, but when many investors simultaneously sell the same liquid, widely held bonds while buying capital is scarce, their prices fall the most. Individual investors do not fully internalize how their sales amplify the liquidation losses of others, making the outcome privately optimal but collectively inefficient. We test these predictions using property and casualty insurers around major natural catastrophes and find that insurers sell liquid bonds first, only partially avoid crowded bonds, and that liquid bonds experience the largest price declines during fire sales. The overlap in liquid holdings thus emerges as a key source of systemic risk that should receive greater weight in regulation and risk measurement. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: C. Scheuch is grateful for financial support from the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [Grant DOC 23-G16]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03670 .
summary: 该论文研究了投资者在需要快速筹集现金时应出售哪些债券。模型显示，出售最流动债券的策略可能适得其反：在场外市场中，尽管流动债券交易最快，但当众多投资者同时抛售相同且广泛持有的流动债券而购买资本稀缺时，其价格跌幅最大。个体投资者未充分内化其销售对其他投资者清算损失的放大效应，导致结果私人最优但集体无效率。利用重大自然灾害前后财产与意外伤害保险公司的数据进行实证检验，发现保险公司优先出售流动债券，仅部分避免拥挤债券，且流动债券在抛售中价格下降最大。因此，流动持有重叠成为系统性风险的关键来源，应在监管和风险衡量中予以重视。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了流动债券在抛售中的流动性悖论，为系统性风险提供了新视角；巧用自然灾害作为外生冲击进行因果识别，实证与理论结合紧密。

title: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
abstract: This paper quantifies how investors’ portfolio demand responds to price changes at long horizons versus short horizons. Using investor trades – changes in portfolios – at different horizons, I first present reduced-form evidence that elasticities increase significantly over time. I then propose a dynamic demand system via a parsimonious partial-adjustment model that recovers the full term structure of elasticities while mitigating long-horizon identification challenges. The estimates imply that price impacts are three times larger at quarterly horizons than in the long-run equilibrium. The model produces a novel, stock-level measure of long-term reversal that avoids the noise of long-horizon return regressions.
summary: 本文量化了投资者投资组合需求对价格变化的响应在长期与短期的差异。利用不同时间跨度下的投资者交易数据（投资组合变化），首先通过简化证据表明弹性随时间显著增大。随后提出一个动态需求系统，采用简约的部分调整模型，在缓解长期识别挑战的同时恢复弹性的完整期限结构。估计结果显示，季度价格影响是长期均衡的三倍。该模型还产生了一种新颖的股票层面长期反转度量，避免了长区间收益回归的噪声。
ai_comment: 本文通过动态需求系统创新性地分离了短期与长期弹性，并利用交易数据直接估计，为资产定价中的长期反转现象提供了新的度量方法，具有实证贡献。

title: Private equity for pension plans? Evaluating private equity performance from an investor’s perspective
abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether public pension plans could benefit from changing their allocation to PE. Plans invest in PE funds with higher than average risk-adjusted performance. This is mainly due to access to successful managers, not superior selection skill. Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and “alpha”, we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
summary: 本文利用投资者特定随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）的表现，并检验公共养老金计划是否能通过调整PE配置获益。研究发现，养老金计划投资的PE基金具有高于平均风险调整表现，这主要归功于接触成功的基金管理人，而非计划自身的选择能力。通过将PE回报分解为风险补偿和“alpha”，发现部分计划通过承担更高风险获得了更高的PE回报，但其风险调整后回报并未更高，甚至更低，这与计划内部存在的代理问题相一致。
ai_comment: 本文从投资者视角出发，使用随机贴现因子评估PE表现，克服了传统方法的局限；同时揭示了养老金计划内部代理问题对投资绩效的影响，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Nonstationary Experimental Design Under Structured Trends
abstract: Experimentation is increasingly used across domains such as healthcare and online platforms to inform decision making, with a central goal often being the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE). However, in many real-world settings, treatment effects, or even the treatments themselves, evolve over time, making classical experimental designs, which assume stationarity, less effective or even misleading. This paper studies nonstationary experimental design under structured trends, addressing two key objectives: (i) accurately estimating the dynamic treatment effect and (ii) minimizing regret (e.g., revenue or welfare loss) during the experiment. We propose a flexible design framework that can be tailored to achieve Pareto-optimal tradeoff between the two objectives. We further analyze how time-varying noise levels affect this tradeoff. Additionally, we establish asymptotic normality of the estimators and show that different trend orders yield different convergence rates, enabling efficient statistical tests for the existence of high-order trends. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: D. Simchi-Levi and C. Wang were partially supported by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Data Science Lab and the MIT-IBM partnership in artificial intelligence. Z. Zheng was partially supported by the National Science Foundation Division of Mathematical Sciences [AwardDMS-2220537] and the Avenir Public Welfare Foundation. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03329 .
summary: 本文研究在结构趋势下的非平稳实验设计，核心目标有两个：准确估计动态处理效应（平均处理效应随时间变化），以及最小化实验期间的遗憾（如收入或福利损失）。作者提出一个灵活的设计框架，能够针对这两个目标实现帕累托最优的权衡。进一步分析了时变噪声水平如何影响这一权衡，并建立了估计量的渐近正态性，证明不同趋势阶数会产生不同的收敛速率，从而能够进行高效的高阶趋势存在性统计检验。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将非平稳性与结构趋势引入实验设计，同时优化估计精度与遗憾，并提供了完整的理论性质，对平台和医疗等动态环境下的实验具有重要指导意义。

title: Strategic communication among banks
abstract: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.
summary: 本文利用国际银行在公司收购中的咨询活动作为其私人信息来源，基于监管数据研究银行网络如何促进信息流动并影响市场结果。研究发现，与目标公司顾问关系密切的银行（而非收购方顾问）会在交易公告前交易目标股票并获得利润，这种交易行为与更高的收购溢价相关，但不会影响交易的成功率。由于有联系的银行只与目标股东的激励一致（由目标顾问代表），证据表明经济激励决定了哪些银行与谁分享信息。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的监管数据，揭示了银行网络中信息流动的动机和方向，为内幕交易和并购定价提供了新的视角。

title: Scalable Bundle Recommendations: A Large-Scale Field Experiment
abstract: We develop an end-to-end, scalable machine learning framework for designing bundle recommendations in a high-dimensional choice setting. We leverage historical purchases and consideration sets determined from clickstream data to generate dense representations (embeddings) of products. We impose minimal structure on these embeddings and develop heuristics for complementarity and substitutability among products. Subsequently, we use the heuristics to create multiple bundle recommendations for each of 4,500 focal products and test their performance using a field experiment with a large retailer. We use the experimental data to optimize the recommendation design policy with offline policy learning. Our optimized policy is robust across product categories, generalizes well to the retailer’s entire assortment, and provides an expected improvement of 35% ([Formula: see text] per 100 visits) in revenue from bundle recommendations over the baseline policy. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01864 .
summary: 这篇论文开发了一个可扩展的端到端机器学习框架，用于在高维选择环境下设计捆绑推荐。通过利用历史购买数据和从点击流数据中确定的考虑集，生成产品的密集表示（嵌入），并施加最小结构，开发了产品互补性和替代性的启发式规则。随后，为4500个焦点产品创建多个捆绑推荐，并在大型零售商的现场实验中测试其性能。利用实验数据通过离线策略学习优化推荐设计策略。优化后的策略在产品类别间具有鲁棒性，能很好地推广到零售商的整个品类，与基线策略相比，预期收入提高35%（每100次访问增加特定收入）。
ai_comment: 该研究通过结合嵌入、启发式规则与离线策略学习，提出了一个实用的捆绑推荐框架，大规模现场实验验证了其有效性，具有重要的商业应用价值。

title: Cross-Border Investments in Private Firms: The Benefits of Comparability for Foreign Investors
abstract: We examine whether the mandated convergence of local German Generally Accepted Accounting Principles with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) increases investment by foreign equity investors in German private firms. Exploiting a large-sample quasi-experimental setting, we document an average foreign ownership increase of 2%–8% in firms affected by the accounting reform compared with our unaffected control firms. Based on our identification strategy, using both the unique setting and accounting system comparability (that is, the comparability of cash flows in the next period), we show that increased comparability can minimize challenges faced by investors in private firms. We also find that those investors more familiar with IFRS benefit more from the increased accounting comparability. In addition, the effect is stronger for firms with higher proprietary costs before the mandatory accounting comparability increase. Our findings are robust to alternative matching procedures and a placebo test. We provide evidence for ongoing discussions on the costs of separate accounting standards for private firms. We show significant benefits when private firms’ accounting becomes more (and not less) comparable to that of public firms. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: K. D. Allee acknowledges the support of the Doyle Z. Williams Chair in Professional Accounting at the Sam M. Walton College of Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08765 .
summary: 本文利用德国一般公认会计原则（GAAP）强制与国际财务报告准则（IFRS）趋同的准实验场景，研究会计准则可比性对私营企业外国股权投资的影响。研究发现，受会计改革影响的德国私营企业，其外国所有权平均增长2%-8%，而控制组企业无显著变化。通过独特的识别策略和会计系统可比性（即未来期间现金流可比性）指标，作者证明可比性提升能减少外国投资者面临的信息障碍。此外，更熟悉IFRS的投资者从可比性提高中获益更多，且对于改革前专有成本较高的企业，这一效应更强。研究结论在多种匹配方法和安慰剂测试中保持稳健。本文为关于私营企业单独会计准则成本的讨论提供了实证证据，表明私营企业会计与上市公司会计更具可比性时能带来显著收益。
ai_comment: 本文利用德国独特的准自然实验，为会计准则可比性促进跨境投资提供了因果证据，并揭示了投资者熟悉度和企业专有成本等异质性效应，对会计与金融交叉领域有重要贡献。

title: Discrete Pricing in Multiobject Auctions with Unit Demand and Wealth Effects
abstract: We study an auction model for selling multiple heterogeneous objects, in which (i) each agent gets at most one object and has utility functions that accommodate wealth effects, and (ii) prices are adjusted discretely via some prefixed increment. A Walrasian equilibrium may not exist in the discrete price setting. We instead propose a novel equilibrium concept, tight equilibrium, that is compatible with discrete prices. A descending-price auction, requiring only partial demand information and featuring a clear price discovery process, is constructed to yield a tight equilibrium. Tight equilibrium ensures efficiency and generalizes the well-known minimum price equilibrium in the continuous price setting to the discrete price setting. We estimate the deviation bound on prices between tight equilibrium and minimum price equilibrium, which depends on the magnitude of wealth effects, the increment size, and the number of objects. Based on this result, we introduce a notion of approximate incentive compatibility and show that our auction is both efficient and approximately incentive compatible. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Funding: Y. Zhou gratefully acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72394391], the Grant-in-aid for Research Activity, Japan Society for the Promotion of Science [Grants 26H01960 and 22H00062], the Nagoya University Kitankai Fund (2024), and JST ERATO [Grant JPMJER2301].
summary: 本文研究了多物品拍卖中的离散定价问题，其中每个竞拍者最多只能获得一个物品，且效用函数具有财富效应。由于离散价格下瓦尔拉斯均衡可能不存在，作者提出了一种新的均衡概念——紧均衡（tight equilibrium），该概念与离散价格兼容。他们构建了一个降序拍卖机制，仅需部分需求信息，具有清晰的价格发现过程，并能实现紧均衡。紧均衡保证了效率，并将连续价格下的最小价格均衡推广到离散价格情形。作者估计了紧均衡与最小价格均衡之间的价格偏差界，该偏差取决于财富效应的大小、价格增量以及物品数量。基于此，他们引入了近似激励相容的概念，并证明该拍卖机制既是有效的，也是近似激励相容的。
ai_comment: 本文在离散价格拍卖理论中提出了紧均衡这一新概念，并设计了可执行的降序拍卖机制，兼具效率与近似激励相容性，为实际拍卖设计提供了新思路。

title: Executive Tweets
abstract: We explore the tweeting behavior of S&P 1500 firms’ chief executive officers and chief financial officers and its market reactions from 2011 to 2018. Executives post a variety of content on Twitter, with slightly less than half of their tweets relating to business matters. We find that most executive tweets do not elicit market reactions. However, the subset of executive tweets about financial information appears to be associated with market reactions incremental to the responses to firm-issued tweets. These reactions coincide with increases in trading volume and retail investor activity. To assess whether market responses are driven by new information or by changes in perceived credibility, we develop an innovative machine-learning-based measure of content similarity between executive and firm tweets. We find stronger investor reactions when executive financial tweets are more similar to prior firm tweets, consistent with the perceived credibility mechanism. At the same time, executive financial tweets also generate market reactions in the absence of firm disclosures, supporting the new information mechanism. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work is supported by a grant from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project GRF 15502618]. This works was supported by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2019-0292]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05510 .
summary: 本文研究了2011年至2018年间S&P 1500公司CEO和CFO的推文行为及其市场反应。高管在Twitter上发布多种内容，其中略少于一半的推文涉及商业事项。研究发现，大多数高管推文并未引发市场反应，但关于财务信息的高管推文似乎与市场反应相关联，且这种反应是公司推文反应之外的增量。这些反应伴随着交易量和散户投资者活动的增加。为了评估市场反应是由新信息驱动还是由感知可信度变化驱动，作者开发了一种基于机器学习的创新度量，衡量高管推文与公司推文的内容相似度。结果发现，当高管财务推文与公司先前推文更相似时，投资者反应更强，这与感知可信度机制一致；同时，在公司未进行披露的情况下，高管财务推文也产生了市场反应，支持了新信息机制。
ai_comment: 该研究创新地利用机器学习度量内容相似度，区分了信息机制与可信度机制，为社交媒体信息披露的经济后果提供了新证据。

title: Voting Choice
abstract: Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22)
summary: 该论文研究基金投票中出现的“投票选择权”（pass-through voting）现象，即基金投资者可以选择将投票权委托给基金或自行投票。作者构建了一个理论框架，分析投票选择权的影响：它既能反映投资者的异质性偏好，又会改变投票的信息含量，这两种力量可能相互冲突。当投资者利益一致时，投票选择权可以改善信息聚合并提高投资者福利；但当存在偏好异质性或信息获取成本时，投票选择权可能弱化知情投票，从而降低投资者福利。
ai_comment: 该论文首次系统分析了投票选择权的经济后果，揭示了其作为信息聚合机制的双刃剑效应，对基金治理实践具有重要启示。

title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)
summary: 该论文构建了一个关于生成式AI的社会学习模型，强调数据与AI之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响AI生产力，进而影响AI的采用以及未来数据的构成（AI生成 vs 人类生成）与质量。通过校准到合成训练循环的证据，模型预测出驼峰型的劳动力动态——短期内劳动力被替代，但随着数据质量恶化，替代部分逆转。模型还揭示了一种Grossman-Stiglitz式的外部性：AI采用者免费搭乘了提供新颖信息的人类生成行为，而这些信息正是AI赖以运作的基础。在竞争市场中，应当对AI征税以纠正数据质量外部性；但在集中的AI行业中，过度纠正反而使补贴成为最优政策。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入数据-AI反馈循环，将数据质量内生化为影响AI生产率的关键因素，并揭示了市场结构对最优政策的非线性影响，为理解AI的经济效应提供了新视角。

title: The Uneven Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Entrepreneurial Performance: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Kenya
abstract: Scalable and low-cost artificial intelligence (AI) assistance has the potential to improve firm decision making and economic performance, particularly in emerging markets. However, running a business involves a wide range of open-ended problems, making it unclear whether and how recent advances in AI can help business owners around the world make better decisions. In a field experiment with Kenyan entrepreneurs, we evaluated the impact of AI advice on small business revenues and profits by randomizing access to a GPT-4-powered AI business assistant. Although we are unable to reject the null hypothesis of no average treatment effect on firm revenues and profits, we find that the effect for entrepreneurs who were low performing at baseline is over 0.20-standard-deviations lower than for initial high performers. Subsample analyses show that low performers did nearly 10% worse because of the AI assistant, whereas high performers may have benefited by over 15%. This differential impact does not appear to result from differences in the questions posed to the AI or the advice that it provided but rather, from the advice that entrepreneurs chose to implement. More broadly, these results show that generative AI is already capable of impacting real-world business performance—although in uneven and sometimes unexpected ways. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by the Weiss Fund, Harvard Business School, Berkeley Haas, the Cora Jane Flood Endowment at Berkeley Haas, the Agency Fund, the South Park Common Social Impact Fellowship, and the Digital Data Design Institute at Harvard. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06909 .
summary: 通过一项在肯尼亚企业家中的实地实验，本文评估了由GPT-4驱动的AI商业助手对小企业收入和利润的影响。实验随机分配AI助手的使用权限，发现平均处理效应不显著，但初始绩效低的企业家因AI助手收入降低近10%，而初始绩效高的企业家可能受益超过15%。差异并非源于向AI提出的问题或AI提供的建议不同，而是源于企业家选择实施的具体建议。结果表明，生成式AI已能影响现实商业绩效，但影响不均衡，且可能产生意想不到的负面效果。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实地随机对照实验揭示了生成式AI对企业家绩效的异质性影响，强调了实施环节的关键作用，挑战了AI能够普遍提升决策质量的假设。

title: Vertical Patient Streaming in Emergency Departments
abstract: Tackling hospital emergency department (ED) overcrowding is a paramount challenge for healthcare systems. To combat this issue, an innovative approach is to identify patients who can be served vertically (i.e., in a seated position) and route them to a dedicated area termed the vertical processing pathway (VPP). Successfully implementing this design requires understanding which patients should be routed to the VPP and when. Currently, the decision to leverage the VPP is made in an ad hoc fashion. To assist our partner hospital and other EDs in capturing the value of the VPP, we develop a machine learning model that provides personalized risk scores predicting whether each arriving patient needs an ED bed. We use these scores as input to a stochastic patient flow model and analytically characterize the optimal VPP policy that minimizes length of stay. We then combine our results to derive an interpretable VPP patient streaming protocol suitable for implementation in practice and conduct a before-and-after experiment in which we leverage empirical analyses to evaluate the impact of integrating it into practice. The implemented protocol led to an 11-minute (4.2%) reduction in ED length of stay in our partner hospital without any adverse effect on quality-of-care outcomes. This effect was statistically significant and remained robust after controlling for various confounding factors and potential sources of endogeneity. Our VPP protocol can also be utilized in other EDs, offering operational improvements without requiring additional resources. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Funding: S. Saghafian received financial support from the NSF [Grant CMMI-15 62645], “Data-Driven Management of Post-Transplant Medications,” which partially enabled this work, as well as funding and support from the Harvard Data Science Initiative and the Harvard Mossavar-Rahmani Center for Business and Government. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07517 .
summary: 针对医院急诊室（ED）过度拥挤的挑战，本文提出一种垂直患者分流方法，将可坐姿接受治疗的患者引导至专用区域（垂直处理通道，VPP）。为辅助决策，开发了机器学习模型为每位到达患者提供是否需要床位的个性化风险评分。将该评分输入随机患者流模型，解析刻画最小化住院时间的最优VPP策略。结合结果导出可解释的VPP患者分流协议，并通过前后对照实验评估其实际效果。实施后，合作医院急诊室住院时间平均减少11分钟（4.2%），且未对护理质量产生负面影响，该效应在控制混杂因素和内生性后依然稳健。该协议可推广至其他急诊室，无需额外资源即可改进运营。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将机器学习预测与随机优化结合，设计出可解释、可落地的患者分流协议，并通过实际实验验证了显著效果，为医疗运营管理提供了数据驱动的新范式。

title: Corporate Green Pledges
abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)
summary: 本文通过使用大语言模型分类新闻文章并进行人工验证，构建了美国上市公司具有时间戳的脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）的新数据集。研究发现，宣布绿色承诺的公司无论在行业内还是跨行业，通常比未宣布的公司规模更大、碳排放更密集（更“棕色”）。绿色承诺显著提升了股票价格，这与碳溢价的降低一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度的大幅下降。这些效应在棕色行业中最强。因此，绿色承诺看起来可信，向投资者传达了相关的新信息，并为脱碳提供了有意义的财务激励。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用大语言模型从新闻中提取企业绿色承诺，提供了关于此类承诺可信度及市场反应的直接证据，对理解企业环保行动的经济动机有重要贡献。

title: Carbon VIX: Carbon price uncertainty and decarbonization investments
abstract: We study the effects of carbon price uncertainty on firms’ decisions to decarbonize their operations. We first use information on the pricing of options on emission allowances in the European Emissions Trading System to create the Carbon VIX, a market-based high-frequency measure of carbon price uncertainty. Carbon price uncertainty is high, varies substantially over time, and experiences persistent shocks around major climate policy events. To explore the effects of carbon price uncertainty on expected aggregate decarbonization investments, we analyze its effect on the stock returns of firms that help other businesses decarbonize. To identify these “carbon solution providers”, we extract common types of decarbonization investments from a large survey of firms, and then identify companies that offer the associated goods and services. We find that the stock returns of these carbon solution providers vary positively with carbon prices, but negatively with carbon price uncertainty. The effect of increases in carbon price uncertainty on our proxy for expected decarbonization investments is economically large and of similar magnitude as the effect of declines in carbon prices. These findings support predictions from real options theory that firms may delay investments in decarbonization when faced with uncertainty about the future costs of emissions.
summary: 本文研究碳价格不确定性对企业脱碳投资决策的影响。作者利用欧洲排放交易体系中排放配额期权的定价信息，构建了一个基于市场的高频指标——Carbon VIX，用以衡量碳价格不确定性。研究发现，碳价格不确定性水平较高、随时间大幅波动，并在重大气候政策事件期间受到持续冲击。为探究碳价格不确定性对预期总脱碳投资的影响，作者分析了其对帮助其他企业脱碳的“碳解决方案提供商”股票收益的影响。通过企业调查提取常见的脱碳投资类型，进而识别提供相关商品和服务的公司。结果表明，这些碳解决方案提供商的股票收益与碳价格正相关，与碳价格不确定性负相关。碳价格不确定性上升对预期脱碳投资代理变量的影响在经济意义上显著，其规模与碳价格下降的影响相当。这些发现支持了实物期权理论的预测，即当面临未来排放成本的不确定性时，企业可能会推迟脱碳投资。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地构建了高频碳价格不确定性指标Carbon VIX，并实证检验了其对脱碳投资的负向影响，为理解气候政策不确定性对企业低碳转型的制约提供了新证据。

title: Financial Reporting Effects of the 1934 Securities Exchange Act
abstract: We document financial reporting effects of the 1934 Securities Exchange Act. Specifically, we find strong evidence that the act made the accounting of similar firms more similar. In contrast, we find no evidence that the act made the accounting of differing firms more similar. Together, these findings suggest that the act increased accounting comparability but not accounting uniformity. Further, the act increased information spillovers from earnings news released during bellwether firms’ earnings announcements to other firms within the same industry. We investigate possible mechanisms by which the act affected comparability and spillovers, and we identify the Securities and Exchange Commission’s financial reporting instructions and its financial reviews and comment letter process as the most likely drivers. Overall, our results provide evidence that the act improved financial reporting through increased accounting comparability and increased information spillovers, two features of accounting standards associated with numerous benefits for firms, investors, and capital markets. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from European School of Management and Technology Berlin and The Ohio State University. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06043 .
summary: 本文研究1934年《证券交易法》对财务报告的影响。通过实证分析发现，该法案显著提高了相似公司之间会计的相似性（会计可比性），但并未使不同公司的会计趋同（会计统一性）。此外，该法案增强了龙头企业盈利公告的信息溢出效应，即其盈利新闻对同行业其他公司的影响更大。通过机制分析，作者识别出美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的财务报告指令及其财务审查和意见函流程是推动可比性和溢出效应最可能的因素。总体而言，法案通过提升会计可比性和信息溢出改善了财务报告质量，这些特征与公司、投资者和资本市场的诸多益处相关。
ai_comment: 本文利用历史自然实验，首次系统量化了1934年《证券交易法》对财务报告可比性和信息溢出效应的因果影响，为理解监管如何塑造会计信息质量提供了重要实证证据。

title: Investor expertise and private investment selection
abstract: Institutional and individual investors evaluate private market opportunities systematically differently, even facing identical choices. In a survey experiment, 593 institutional and 445 individual investors assess venture capital fund profiles with independently randomized GP characteristics. Institutions heavily weight past fund performance, consistent with risk-averse investor demand calibrated to VC markets. Individuals largely ignore performance, favoring educational credentials instead. A follow-up experiment identifies two independent mechanisms: individuals lack awareness that VC performance persists and discount quality signals for funds they perceive as inaccessible. Performance-based selection alone reduces individuals’ expected returns by approximately 7%, accounting for 20% of the return gap with professionals.
summary: 本文通过一项调查实验，研究了机构投资者和个人投资者在评估私募市场机会时的系统性差异。实验让593名机构投资者和445名个人投资者评估风险投资基金简介，其中GP特征随机独立变化。结果显示，机构投资者高度重视基金过往业绩，这与风险厌恶型投资者在VC市场中的需求一致；而个人投资者则基本忽略业绩，更偏好教育资质。后续实验识别出两个独立机制：个人投资者缺乏对VC业绩持续性的认知，并对他们认为难以接触的基金的质量信号打折扣。仅基于业绩的选择会使个人投资者的预期收益降低约7%，这占其与专业人士收益差距的20%。
ai_comment: 该论文通过精心设计的调查实验，揭示了个人投资者在私募投资中的行为偏差，并量化了其造成的收益损失，对理解投资者异质性和市场效率有重要贡献。

title: The Sound We Haven’t Heard Before: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
abstract: This Commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship.” It shares the paper’s core position, that journals should govern artificial intelligence openly rather than leave it to the shadows, but it questions the premise that rising submission volume poses an existential threat. The safeguard is human judgment. Our shared fatigue with derivative, repetitive work is a sensor more discerning than any AI detector, because a model trained on what we have already rewarded cannot produce the novelty that our community prizes. The threat to a journal like Management Science is thus more contained than the original alarm implies, provided AI remains a non-final input and humans retain ownership of novelty and contribution. One test should govern any AI workflow: does it ask more of human judgment, or less? This paper was accepted by Christoph Loch, commentary.
summary: 这篇评论回应了“Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”一文。它同意期刊应公开治理人工智能而非任其暗箱操作，但质疑了投稿量增长构成生存威胁的前提。作者认为人的判断是守护者，而AI无法产生新颖性，因为模型基于已有奖励的训练无法创造学界珍视的新颖性。因此，对Management Science这类期刊的威胁比原警告所暗示的更有限，前提是AI保持非最终输入且人类保留对新颖性和贡献的所有权。关键测试是：任何人工智能工作流是否要求更多的人类判断，还是更少。
ai_comment: 提出了一个简单但深刻的测试标准——AI工作流是否增加人类判断的需求，为AI在学术评审中的角色提供了清晰的边界。

title: The Economic Consequences of CEO Compensation Lawsuits
abstract: This paper studies shareholder derivative lawsuits related to CEO compensation. We document that compensation lawsuits are more likely to be filed against firms with higher CEO pay, especially in the presence of poor firm performance. Firms reduce the level of CEO compensation after lawsuits, which leads to CEO departures and declines in CEO effort provisions, and consequently, results in deteriorated firm performance. Interestingly, compensation lawsuits accompanied by low support in the preceding Say‐on‐Pay votes, which likely capture the quality of pay practices, are associated with even higher pay cuts, but do not harm firm performance or lead to departures of talented CEOs, supporting the idea that suboptimal pay and deteriorated performance after compensation lawsuits are driven by the lack of a sophisticated understanding of CEO pay by plaintiff shareholders.
summary: 本文研究了与CEO薪酬相关的股东派生诉讼的经济后果。研究发现，诉讼更可能发生在CEO薪酬较高且公司业绩较差的情况下。诉讼后，企业会降低CEO薪酬水平，导致CEO离职和努力程度下降，进而损害公司业绩。有趣的是，当诉讼前“Say‐on‐Pay”投票支持率较低（反映薪酬实践质量较差）时，薪酬削减幅度更大，但不会损害公司业绩或导致有才能的CEO离职。这一结果支持了以下观点：诉讼后出现的次优薪酬和业绩恶化，是由于原告股东对CEO薪酬缺乏深入理解所致。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分不同诉讼情境（尤其是Say‐on‐Pay投票支持率的高低），揭示了股东诉讼对CEO薪酬和公司绩效的异质性影响，为理解股东干预的有效性提供了新的视角。

title: Bank Run, Interrupted: Modeling Deposit Withdrawals with Generative AI
abstract: I study depositor behavior in panic-driven bank runs using an LLM-based survey simulation. I build a representative population of synthetic agents by assigning demographic attributes, expose them to a viral panic post, and randomize bank communication interventions. I validate model responses against human benchmarks and then generate systematic message variants that vary tone, strength, and content within the validated design space. I then include the estimated withdrawal propensities into a contagion model, which maps network nodes to depositor personas and propagates withdrawals through a single layer proximity network. Direct, personalized bank communications with strong reassurances and explicit survival clauses substantially reduce withdrawal intent. This framework offers an efficient, inexpensive method for testing crisis messages and projecting how runs may unfold under alternative communication strategies. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06807 .
summary: 本研究利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的调查模拟来研究恐慌驱动的银行挤兑中储户的提款行为。研究者构建了一个具有代表性的人口统计特征的合成代理人群体，让他们接触一条病毒性恐慌帖子，并对银行沟通干预进行随机化处理。模型响应通过与人类基准进行验证，之后在验证的设计空间内生成系统性的消息变体（语气、强度、内容）。然后将估计的提款倾向纳入一个传染模型，该模型将网络节点映射到储户角色，并通过单层邻近网络传播提款。主要发现是：直接、个性化的银行沟通，带有强烈保证和明确生存条款，能显著降低提款意图。该框架为测试危机信息以及预测不同沟通策略下挤兑如何展开提供了一种高效、低成本的方法。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地结合生成式AI与网络传染模型，为银行危机沟通策略提供低成本、可量化的测试方法，具有重要的实践价值。

title: All Clear for Takeoff: Evidence from Airports on the Effects of Infrastructure Privatization
abstract: We study privatization and corporate ownership in transportation infrastructure, focusing on global airports. Privatization in general does not improve performance. However, private equity (PE) ownership has strong and persistent positive effects on efficiency, volume, and quality, with positive externalities for the local economy. We address selection using close auctions where PE and non-PE firms bid. PE funds expand physical capacity and encourage larger planes while adding low-cost carriers and international routes. They are especially effective in countries with more corruption or state-owned flag carriers. In contrast, the poorer performance of non-PE acquirers may reflect private benefits and historical state ties. (JEL G32, G38, L32, R42, H54)
summary: 本文研究交通基础设施的私有化和公司所有权，以全球机场为样本。总体而言，私有化并未改善绩效，但私募股权（PE）所有权对效率、运量和服务质量有持续显著的正面影响，并对当地经济产生正外部性。作者利用PE与非PE企业参与竞标的接近拍卖解决选择偏差问题。PE基金扩大物理容量、鼓励使用大型飞机，同时引入低成本航空公司和国际航线。这些效应在腐败更严重或拥有国有旗舰航空公司的国家尤为突出。相比之下，非PE收购方的较差表现可能反映了私人收益和历史国有关联。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细的拍卖数据识别了不同私有化主体的异质性效果，突出了私募股权在基础设施领域的独特作用，为政策制定提供了重要参考。

title: Reaching for influence: Do banks use loans to establish political connections?
abstract: Using close elections as an empirical setting, this paper examines the drivers and consequences of politically motivated lending by U.S. banks, with a special focus on resulting benefits. We first show that firms with ties to members of Congress receive more favorable loan terms, despite no observable improvements in performance or default risk. The effect is especially pronounced among banks facing regulatory challenges — such as FDIC enforcement actions, corporate misconduct investigations, or low Community Reinvestment Act ratings — which also lend more frequently to connected firms, suggesting that these institutions have a heightened demand for political influence. Crucially, we find that politically motivated lending produces tangible future benefits for banks, including reduced misconduct penalties and easier approval for mergers and acquisitions. These findings provide evidence of a quid pro quo dynamic: banks extend preferential credit to firms with political connections and, in turn, receive regulatory advantages.
summary: 本文利用美国国会选举中选情接近的选举作为实证场景，考察银行出于政治动机发放贷款的驱动因素与后果，重点关注银行由此获得的收益。研究发现，与国会议员存在关联的企业获得了更优惠的贷款条款，尽管这些企业的业绩或违约风险并未显著改善。这一效应在面临监管挑战的银行中尤为突出，例如受到FDIC执法行动、公司不当行为调查或《社区再投资法》评级较低的银行，它们向关联企业放贷更为频繁，表明这些机构对政治影响力的需求更高。关键的是，政治动机贷款为银行带来了切实的未来收益，包括减少不当行为处罚和更容易获得并购批准。这些证据揭示了互惠动态：银行向具有政治关联的企业提供优惠信贷，并以此换取监管优势。
ai_comment: 论文利用选举外生冲击识别因果，为银行政治游说的动机和收益提供了新颖证据，揭示了银行-政府关系中的隐性利益交换。

title: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
abstract: There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38
summary: 本文研究银团贷款市场中两种主要机构投资者——贷款抵押债券（CLOs）和贷款共同基金——之间的互动机制。CLOs是封闭式基金，而贷款共同基金是开放式基金，可随时赎回。作者探讨CLOs是否提供套利资本以增强贷款基金的韧性。研究发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模赎回时，CLOs通过par-building交易提供流动性，起到减震器作用。然而，这种流动性仅适用于符合par-build条件的贷款，导致不符合条件的贷款可能引发火售。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了CLOs作为减震器在贷款基金流动性危机中的关键作用，但同时也指出了其流动性供给的局限性，对理解金融体系脆弱性具有重要意义。

title: Board connections, firm profitability, and product market actions
abstract: A firm’s gross margin increases by 0.8 p.p.after forming a new direct board connection to a product market peer. Gross margin also rises by 0.4 p.p.after a connection is formed to a peer indirectly through a third intermediate firm. Further, using barcode-level data of 2.7 million products, we show that new board connections are related to higher consumer good prices, a greater tendency for market allocation, and slower new product introductions. The effects are stronger when the newly connected peers share corporate customers or have similar business descriptions and hold when controlling for other inter-firm relationships.
summary: 论文研究董事会联系对公司盈利能力和产品市场行为的影响。利用产品市场同行间的直接或间接董事会联系数据，发现当公司与同行新建立直接董事会联系后，毛利率提高0.8个百分点；通过第三方间接建立联系后，毛利率提高0.4个百分点。进一步基于270万产品的条码级数据，发现新的董事会联系与更高的消费品价格、更大的市场配置倾向以及更慢的新产品推出速度相关。这些效应在联系对象共享企业客户或业务描述相似时更强，且在控制其他企业间关系后依然显著。
ai_comment: 本文利用细颗粒度的产品数据揭示了董事会联系影响产品市场行为的传导机制，为董事会的经济后果提供了新的实证证据。

title: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
abstract: We show that institutional portfolio rebalancing across asset classes plays a key role in transmitting monetary shocks to the stock market. Around FOMC announcements, ceteris paribus, a stock with 10-percentage-point higher ownership by rebalancing institutions experiences an additional 3.7-basis-point loss following a 10-basis-point surprise rate hike. We corroborate our mechanism by exploiting within-firm variations for dual shares, showing stronger price reactions at quarter- and month-ends when rebalancing is more imminent, and presenting placebo tests contrasting rebalancing institutions with other institutions. A concluding calibration suggests rebalancing could contribute roughly one-third to two-thirds of the aggregate stock market excess return response to monetary shocks.
summary: 本文研究机构投资者跨资产类别的投资组合再平衡在货币政策冲击向股票市场传导中的作用。基于FOMC公告事件，通过截面分析发现，在其他条件相同的情况下，加息10个基点使再平衡机构持股比例高10个百分点的股票额外损失3.7个基点。利用同一公司不同股份类型（如A股和H股）的差异验证机制，发现当再平衡更紧迫时（如季度末和月末）价格反应更强，并通过对比再平衡机构与其他机构进行安慰剂检验。校准结果表明，再平衡可以解释货币冲击对股票市场超额收益总体反应的大约三分之一到三分之二。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细的截面数据识别出机构再平衡渠道，并利用双重股份及时间效应进行因果检验，为货币政策传导机制提供了微观基础。

title: Aggregate corporate savings, economic uncertainty, and future stock returns
abstract: I document robust U.S. and international evidence that aggregate corporate cash savings negatively forecast future excess market returns, with economic uncertainty an important driver of this relation. In a calibrated neoclassical dynamic model featuring precautionary savings, I show that fixed financing costs, firm exit, and an uncertainty-driven time-varying price of risk are crucial to replicating this return predictability. The model further implies that the well-known positive return predictive power of aggregate accruals is largely attributable to aggregate cash savings, and the data support this implication.
summary: 本文通过美国和国际数据证明了企业总体现金储蓄对未来超额市场收益具有负向预测能力，而经济不确定性是这一关系的重要驱动因素。基于预防性储蓄的校准新古典动态模型表明，固定融资成本、企业退出以及由不确定性驱动的时变风险价格对于复制这种回报可预测性至关重要。模型进一步指出，总体应计项目的正向回报预测能力主要归因于总体现金储蓄，且数据支持这一推论。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将企业现金储蓄与市场回报预测联系起来，并突出了经济不确定性的核心作用，为理解资产定价提供了新视角。

title: Model Aggregation for Risk Evaluation and Robust Optimization
abstract: We introduce a new approach for prudent risk evaluation based on stochastic dominance, and it is called the model aggregation (MA) approach. In contrast to the classic worst case risk (WR) approach, the MA approach produces not only a robust value of risk evaluation but also a robust distributional model, independent of any specific risk measure. The MA risk evaluation can be computed through explicit formulas in the lattice theory of stochastic dominance, and under some standard assumptions, the MA robust optimization admits a convex program reformulation. The MA approach for Wasserstein and mean-variance uncertainty sets admits explicit formulas for the obtained robust models. Via an equivalence property between the MA and WR approaches, new axiomatic characterizations are obtained for the value at risk and the expected shortfall (also known as conditional value at risk). The new approach is illustrated with various risk measures and examples from portfolio optimization. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: This research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 12371476, 71921001, 71671176, 71871208], the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grants CRC-2022-00141, RGPIN-2024-03728, RGPAS-2018-522590, RGPIN-2018-03823], and the Society of Actuaries Center of Actuarial Excellence Research Grant. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03523 .
summary: 本文提出了一种基于随机占优的模型聚合（MA）方法用于审慎风险评估。与经典的最坏情况风险（WR）方法不同，MA方法不仅提供风险评估的稳健值，还得到一个不依赖任何特定风险度量的稳健分布模型。MA风险评估可通过随机占优的格论显式公式计算，在标准假设下，MA稳健优化可重构为凸规划问题。对于Wasserstein和均值-方差不确定集，MA方法给出了所得稳健模型的显式公式。通过MA与WR方法之间的等价性，获得了VaR和期望损失（条件VaR）的新公理化刻画。该方法通过多种风险度量和组合优化实例进行了说明。
ai_comment: 该文通过引入模型聚合方法，将随机占优理论应用于稳健风险评估，并建立了与最坏情况风险方法的等价性，为VaR和ES提供了新的公理化基础。

title: Too Good to Be True: Look-Ahead Bias in Empirical Options Research
abstract: Numerous trading strategies examined in options research exhibit remarkably high mean returns and Sharpe ratios. We show some of these seemingly “good deals” are due to look-ahead biases. These biases stem from using information unavailable at the portfolio formation time to filter out observations suspected of being noisy or erroneous. Our results suggest that elevated Sharpe ratios may serve as potential indicators of such look-ahead biases. Furthermore, deviating from previous literature findings, we show that illiquidity is not strongly priced in stock options and that only a small set of stock characteristics are in fact associated with option expected returns. (JEL G12, G14, G17)
summary: 本文指出，期权实证研究中大量交易策略呈现出异常高的平均收益和夏普比率，部分原因是前瞻偏差（look-ahead bias）所致：这些偏差源于在投资组合形成时使用了当时不可得的信息来筛选观测值。研究表明，过高的夏普比率可能作为前瞻偏差的潜在指标。此外，与以往文献结论不同，本文发现股票期权的流动性溢价并不显著，且仅少数股票特征与期权预期收益相关。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了期权策略高收益表象下隐藏的前瞻偏差风险，对实证研究的方法论有警示意义，同时修正了关于流动性定价的传统认知。

title: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
abstract: We estimate the causal effect of online sports betting on households’ investment, spending, and debt management decisions using household transaction data and a staggered difference-in-differences framework. Following legalization, sports betting spreads quickly, with both the number of participants and frequency of bets increasing over time. This increase does not displace other gambling or consumption but significantly reduces savings, as risky bets crowd out positive expected value investments. These effects concentrate among frequent bettors and low-savings households. Our findings highlight the potential adverse effects of online sports betting on vulnerable households.
summary: 本文使用家庭交易数据和交错双重差分框架，估计在线体育博彩合法化对家庭投资、支出和债务管理决策的因果效应。研究发现，合法化后体育博彩迅速普及，参与者和投注频率增加，但这并未替代其他赌博或消费，而是显著减少了储蓄，因为风险投注挤出了正期望值的投资。这种效应主要集中在频繁投注者和低储蓄家庭中，强调了在线体育博彩对脆弱家庭的潜在不利影响。
ai_comment: 该研究利用微观交易数据揭示了在线体育博彩对家庭储蓄的挤出效应，为政策制定提供了重要实证依据。

title: Wealth Inequality and Safe Asset Demand
abstract: We study how wealth inequality shapes safe-asset demand in heterogeneous-agent economies. Asset bubbles arise when agents face sufficiently high probabilities of falling into extreme poverty. In such cases, assets insulated from idiosyncratic risk become infinitely large relative to agents' wealth ex-post, which makes them infinitely valuable ex-ante. This mechanism is fundamentally different from classic rational bubbles, generates bubbles even under stationary wealth distributions, and requires no aggregate uncertainty or growth. Using this insight, we revisit the pricing of aggregate assets in standard heterogeneous-agent economies, and show that prior analyses may be incomplete due to overlooked possibility of transversality condition violation.
summary: 本文研究财富不平等如何塑造异质代理人经济体中的安全资产需求。当代理人面临陷入极端贫困的概率足够高时，资产泡沫就会出现。在这种情况下，免受异质风险影响的资产在事后变得相对于代理人财富无穷大，从而在事前具有无限价值。这一机制与经典理性泡沫根本不同，即使在稳态财富分布下也能产生泡沫，并且不需要聚合不确定性或增长。利用这一洞见，本文重新审视了标准异质代理人经济中聚合资产的定价，并指出由于可能忽视横截条件违反，以往的分析可能不完整。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入极端贫困概率这一新维度，为理解安全资产需求和资产泡沫提供了新颖的机制，并对现有异质代理人经济中的资产定价理论提出了重要修正。

title: Government Funding Costs Under Financial Repression
abstract: We study the equilibrium effects of financial repression on government funding costs in an endowment economy with limited asset market participation. We show how a broad set of repression policies operates through a wedge in the Euler equation responsive to government size or by affecting fiscal redistribution between agents. Repression intensity is captured by a policy feedback rule that depends positively on net government spending. When fiscal policy is profligate and monetary policy accommodates, we show that such a repression policy raises bond values, reduces the inflationary cost of unfunded fiscal expansions, and lowers bond risk premia. Repression is not a free lunch for bondholders---they pay a lower inflation tax but also earn lower future real returns. When monetary policy does not accommodate fiscal policy, repression can provide stopgap funding for deficits, allowing the central bank to retain control over inflation while making government debt a hedge for fiscal inflation.
summary: 本文在禀赋经济中研究金融压抑对政府融资成本的均衡影响，模型假设有限资产市场参与。研究表明，一系列压抑政策通过影响欧拉方程中的楔子或改变代理人之间的财政再分配发挥作用，而压抑强度由正向依赖净政府支出的政策反馈规则刻画。当财政政策挥霍且货币政策适应时，金融压抑会提高债券价值、降低无资金支持的财政扩张引起的通胀成本，并降低债券风险溢价。然而，压抑并非免费午餐：债券持有人支付较低的通胀税，但未来实际回报也较低。当货币政策不配合财政政策时，金融压抑可为财政赤字提供临时融资，使央行保持对通胀的控制，同时使政府债务成为财政通胀的对冲工具。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地刻画了金融压抑作为财政货币政策协调机制的作用，并揭示了其对债券持有人福利的权衡，为理解非常规财政干预提供了理论框架。

title: Fragmentation of Shareholder Power
abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
summary: 本文研究资产管理行业向定制化组合、基金 proliferation（基金数量激增）和治理权力分散的趋势，这些趋势部分由投资者偏好的异质性驱动。作者构建了一个评估这些权衡的框架，发现基金 proliferation 并不必然削弱公司治理：当资产管理者的激励更强且专业基金的组合更集中时，可以抵消碎片化效应，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能使资产管理者在竞争中获得新的维度——通过分散治理和采用“转递投票”（pass-through voting）将控制权让渡给投资者，而不内部化相关的治理成本。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了基金 proliferation 对治理的双重效应，并强调投资者偏好异质性的关键作用，丰富了公司治理与资产管理交叉领域的理论。

title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
summary: 该研究利用Understanding America Study数据，对比开始使用GLP-1药物减肥的女性与匹配的想用但未使用的女性，评估体重减轻对婚姻和劳动力市场结果的影响。结果显示，经过六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的婚姻/同居率上升29个百分点，基线未就业女性的就业率上升27个百分点。然而，已有伴侣关系未出现解体，已就业女性也未表现出向上的工作流动性。这表明，女性肥胖惩罚的部分效应体现在新匹配的形成过程中，而不仅仅通过健康或现有生产力渠道。
ai_comment: 通过精准的对照设计，该研究揭示了肥胖惩罚在社会经济结果中的新机制，即主要影响新关系形成而非现有关系，为政策干预提供了重要依据。

title: Openness, Integration, and the International Monetary Order
abstract: This paper develops a calibrated general-equilibrium model to study how different configurations of trade and financial policy reshape the hierarchy of global currencies—and the U.S. dollar's position at its anchor. Currency safety and anchor status arise endogenously from each economy's 'effective size'—the weight its domestic shocks carry in setting world prices. Tariffs reduce this effective size on the goods side; capital controls do the same on the financial side. A unifying result emerges: The economy that maintains the deepest integration with the global trading network retains the largest safety premium and gains anchor status. We use this framework to evaluate the effects of three policy levers for Europe that affect the effective size of the euro: internal harmonization and enlargement, trade openness, and capital-account openness. The stakes are large: In our model, shifts in currencies' safety can redirect global capital flows and alter sovereign borrowing costs by hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
summary: 本文通过构建一个校准的一般均衡模型，研究贸易和金融政策的差异化配置如何重塑全球货币等级体系以及美元在其中的锚定地位。模型内生决定货币的安全性和锚定地位：每个经济体的“有效规模”（即其国内冲击在设定世界价格时的权重）是关键因素——关税会降低商品侧的有效规模，资本管制则降低金融侧的有效规模。核心结论是：与全球贸易网络保持最深度融合的经济体将获得最大的安全溢价并成为锚定货币。该框架被用于评估影响欧元有效规模的三种政策杠杆：内部协调与扩大、贸易开放和资本账户开放的影响。研究表明，货币安全性的变化每年可改变全球资本流动和主权借贷成本达数千亿美元。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将货币安全与锚定地位内生于经济一体化程度，为理解国际货币体系演变提供了统一分析框架，且定量评估了政策干预对欧元地位的影响。

title: The Fragility of Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds
abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.
summary: 本文研究半流动性私人信贷基金的脆弱性。这类基金持有大量非流动性贷款，进行流动性转换，允许投资者按净值每季度赎回，通常上限为5%。研究发现，现金缓冲和合同贷款偿还不足以应对持续5%的季度赎回；当赎回增加时，新资金流入反而下降；净赎回通过出售非流动性贷款、外部借款和延迟支付来解决。这导致战略互补性，即赎回行为给剩余投资者带来清算成本和杠杆成本。贷款清算、杠杆增加和净值通胀进一步放大了当前的挤兑式赎回。总体而言，季度闸门和赎回上限并不能消除半流动性私人信贷基金的挤兑式脆弱性，这提示应谨慎扩大零售投资者对私人信贷市场的准入。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证分析揭示了半流动性私人信贷基金的内在脆弱性，即使有赎回上限等机制，仍可能发生挤兑，对金融监管和零售投资者保护具有重要启示。

title: Dynamic Individuals, Static Neighborhoods: Migration and Earnings Changes in Poor Neighborhoods
abstract: This paper studies migration and earnings dynamics in poor neighborhoods using new administrative data linking residential location and earnings. Out-migration rates are higher in poor neighborhoods than elsewhere, and the majority of people who leave a poor neighborhood move to a richer one. Residents of poor neighborhoods also see significant earnings mobility, with average growth rates similar to richer areas. Estimates based on idiosyncratic, firm-specific pay changes show that increases in earnings are linked to migration to better neighborhoods. This results in the earnings of the cohort who lived in a poor neighborhood at baseline growing more than twice as fast as the earnings of these neighborhoods' contemporaneous residents. Overall, our results highlight an underappreciated reason why poor neighborhoods stay poor: initial residents whose earnings grow tend to move away.
summary: 本文利用新的行政数据（链接居住地与收入），研究了贫困社区的迁移和收入动态。发现贫困社区的迁出率高于其他地区，且大多数离开贫困社区的人迁往更富裕的社区。贫困居民的收入流动性显著，平均收入增长率与富裕地区相似。基于企业特定薪酬变化的估计表明，收入增长与迁往更好社区相关。结果导致基线时居住在贫困社区的人群收入增长速度是同期居民的两倍以上。总体而言，研究揭示了贫困社区持续贫困的一个未被充分认识的原因：收入增长的初始居民倾向于搬离。
ai_comment: 本文创新地指出了贫困社区贫困持续的新机制：收入增长者搬离，而非完全是由于缺乏流动性。利用行政数据的大样本分析增强了结论的可靠性。

title: Leaning Against Inflation Experiences
abstract: A large share of secular variation in real interest rates can be understood as the effect of monetary policy leaning against experience-based long-run inflation expectations. Survey microdata show that adaptive learning from experienced inflation generates highly persistent, slow-moving long-run inflation expectations. When expectations are shaped by experience, central banks cannot anchor them through communication. Instead, when expectations deviate from the inflation target, monetary policy must remain persistently hawkish or dovish to generate realized inflation outcomes that, through agents’ belief updating, gradually pull long-run expectations back toward the target. Consistent with this mechanism, I find a strong positive relationship between experience-based long-run inflation expectations and real interest rates in the U.S., Germany, the U.K., and Japan. Under their subjective expectations, private-sector agents do not anticipate future reversals in inflation and short-term real interest rates. As a result, long-term real interest rates move with experience-based long-run inflation expectations about as much as short-term real interest rates do, consistent with the data. Secular movements in real rates are also accompanied by persistent patterns in interest-rate forecast errors. Overall, the interaction of monetary policy and  learning from experience generates a distinct source of secular real-rate variation, beyond movements in the natural rate of interest.
summary: 本文研究实际利率长期波动的来源，认为其很大程度上源于货币政策对抗基于经验的长期通胀预期。利用调查微观数据，作者发现基于经验通胀的适应性学习导致长期通胀预期高度持久且缓慢变动。当预期由经验塑造时，央行无法通过沟通锚定预期，而必须持续采取鹰派或鸽派政策，通过实际通胀结果逐步将长期预期拉回目标。在美国、德国、英国和日本的数据中，基于经验的长期通胀预期与实际利率之间存在强正相关关系。私人部门在主观预期下并不预期未来通胀和短期实际利率的反转，因此长期实际利率与基于经验的长期通胀预期的变动幅度与短期实际利率相当，且实际利率的长期波动伴随利率预测误差的持续模式。总体而言，货币政策与经验学习的相互作用产生了超越自然利率变动的独立长期实际利率变动来源。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将经验学习引入通胀预期形成机制，揭示了货币政策需持续干预而非依赖沟通来影响预期，为理解长期实际利率波动提供了新视角。

title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.
summary: 该论文研究父母在子女间进行教育投资时，是倾向于补偿弱势子女（compensation）还是强化预期回报更高的子女（reinforcement）。作者利用一项在学生层面随机分配现金转移的实验，使得同一家庭内不同兄弟姐妹获得的转移金额存在外生差异。结果显示，转移提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了显著的负面溢出效应：未受助兄弟姐妹的大学毕业概率降低了3.7个百分点，相对于控制组均值下降了约30%。通过构建一个动态家庭学校教育决策模型来解读这些效应，模型估计表明父母对子女教育结果不平等的厌恶程度有限。分解分析显示，负面溢出主要源于家庭将教育投资从未受助子女向受助子女的替代。
ai_comment: 该研究通过精巧的随机实验设计，识别了父母在子女间投资偏好的因果效应，并揭示了家庭内部教育投资的替代行为，为理解子女间不平等形成提供了新视角。

title: A Practitioner's Guide to Using Large Language Models and Generative AI in Economic History
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are lowering the entry barriers to working with exciting data sources that used to require strong data science skills, such as handwritten ledgers, text, images, or sound recordings. This guide provides an introduction for researchers who are new to LLMs. It sets out a step-by-step workflow for turning a research idea into working code and data, and describes the four main ways of interacting with an LLM: the chat window, editor-integrated assistants, agentic coding tools, and the API. It then works through the decisions a practitioner meets in sequence, beginning with whether an LLM is the right tool and whether the data are allowed to be sent to one, then how to select models, write prompts, manage context limits, and control costs, and finally how to validate, reproduce, document, and correct LLM-generated measures in regression settings. A review of recent research shows how these tools already extract, link, harmonize, and classify historical data at scale. Four worked examples with replication files illustrate the use of LLMs. They classify emotions in paintings, link census records without names, measure newspaper salience and sentiment around the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, and score the emotional delivery of Franklin D. Roosevelt's wartime speeches. The guide also condenses the workflow, the best-practice recommendations, and the preparation of replication packages into summary tables and checklists to aid applied economists.
summary: 这篇论文为经济历史研究者提供了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）和生成式AI的实用指南。它首先介绍了四种与LLM交互的方式：聊天窗口、编辑器集成助手、代理编码工具和API。然后系统性地讨论了实践中的决策流程，包括判断LLM是否合适、数据是否允许发送、模型选择、提示编写、上下文限制、成本控制，以及如何验证、复现、文档化和纠正LLM生成的测量结果（特别是在回归设定中）。回顾了近期研究如何利用这些工具大规模提取、链接、协调和分类历史数据。提供了四个带复现文件的工作示例：分类绘画中的情感、无姓名链接人口普查记录、测量1882年《排华法案》的媒体显著性和情绪、评分罗斯福战时演讲的情感传递。最后总结了工作流程、最佳实践建议和复现包准备的表格与清单，以帮助应用研究者。
ai_comment: 该指南系统性地整合了LLM在经济历史研究中的实践流程，填补了方法空白，且提供的四个完整案例极具启发性和可复制性。

title: AI and the Collapse of the www
abstract: This paper studies market design for generative AI intermediation. AI answer systems can improve user experience while diverting visits that finance publisher content and generate source-level quality signals. I show that an AI platform that underinternalizes future content reproduction retains too little referral traffic and can make costly open-web information subcritical, even with truthful content, accurate answers, and rational users. The mechanism can be self-reinforcing: less source-level measurement weakens conventional search, inducing further AI reliance. Sustainable repair requires replacing displaced revenue and deleted measurement through visitor-replacement royalties, audited provenance, human-information audits, and keystone-topic compensation.
summary: 本文研究生成式AI中介的市场设计问题。AI回答系统在改善用户体验的同时，会分流原本用于资助出版商内容和产生源级质量信号的访问流量。作者证明，一个对未来内容再生产内部化不足的AI平台会保留过少的推荐流量，甚至可能使开放网络的信息生产变得次临界——即使内容真实、答案准确、用户理性。该机制具有自我强化特征：更少的源级测量削弱了传统搜索引擎，反过来促使更多依赖AI。可持续的修复方案包括：通过访客替代版税、审计溯源、人工信息审计和基石主题补偿，来替换被取代的收入和删除的测量。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了生成式AI可能因流量分流而破坏开放网络内容生态的深层机制，并提出了包含版税与审计的修复框架，对平台监管与内容生态可持续发展具有重要启示。

title: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
abstract: I show that the overreaction of the long-term yield forecasts to yield news, evidenced in recent studies, results directly from the overreaction of long-horizon inflation forecasts to inflation news. Motivated by this finding, I study how agents form inflation expectations across forecast horizons. Short-horizon survey forecasts underreact, while long-horizon forecasts overreact to inflation news. To reconcile this behavior, I implement a long-run bias, building on the widely shared intuition that agents conflate transitory with permanent shocks, within a realistic trend-gap inflation model. I embed this bias within a yield curve model. The long-horizon inflation expectations overreaction translates into a long-term yields’ overreaction, generating excess yield sensitivity to news. The model implies a long-term bond risk premium substantially less volatile and cyclical than that implied by predictive regressions or estimates imposing full-information rational expectations.
summary: 本文发现，长期收益率预测对收益率新闻的过度反应直接源于长期通胀预测对通胀新闻的过度反应。短期调查预测对通胀新闻反应不足，而长期预测则过度反应。为调和这一行为，作者在现实趋势-缺口通胀模型中引入长期偏差，基于代理人混淆暂时性与永久性冲击的普遍直觉。将该偏差嵌入收益率曲线模型后，长期通胀预期的过度反应转化为长期收益率的过度反应，导致收益率对新闻的过度敏感。模型暗示长期债券风险溢价的波动性和周期性远低于基于完全信息理性预期假设的预测回归或估计结果。
ai_comment: 该文通过将通胀预期偏差与收益率曲线结合，为长期收益率过度反应提供了新的解释机制，并挑战了传统完全信息理性预期假设。

title: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
abstract: We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps. (JEL Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33)
summary: 研究企业与政府之间的互动：企业可投资于绿色技术，政府可设定排放上限但承诺能力有限。绿色技术投资产生创新溢出，降低后续投资成本，从而在企业和政府之间形成跨期战略互补性，导致均衡多重性。在“绿色均衡”中，企业预期政府会设定上限而投资于绿色技术，进而降低进一步投资成本，使政府愿意实施排放上限；在“棕色均衡”中，企业预期政府不会设定上限而不投资，绿色技术保持高成本，政府因此放弃排放上限。
ai_comment: 该文将政府政策承诺能力与企业投资决策纳入统一分析框架，揭示了绿色转型中政策可信性与企业预期之间的关键战略互补关系，为理解环境政策的多重均衡提供了新视角。

title: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
abstract: We examine the effects of mandatory board gender quotas on unregulated firms that are connected to regulated ones via interlocking directorates. After the introduction of quotas, connected firms significantly increase their share of female directors relative to similar unconnected firms. The spillover effects are substantial — at least as large as the direct effects on regulated firms, challenging previous claims that quotas have no broader impact on women in business. Our results suggest that quotas indirectly broaden the supply of candidates for connected firms, along dimensions that include, but are not limited to, gender.
summary: 本文研究强制性董事会性别配额对未受监管公司的影响，这些公司通过连锁董事与受监管公司相连。研究发现，在配额实施后，与受监管公司有连锁董事关联的未受监管公司，其女性董事比例相对于类似但无关联的公司显著增加。溢出效应显著，至少与对受监管公司的直接影响相当，挑战了之前认为配额对商业界女性没有更广泛影响的观点。结果表明，配额间接扩大了关联公司的候选人供给，维度包括但不限于性别。
ai_comment: 该研究通过连锁董事网络揭示了性别配额的溢出效应，表明政策能通过非直接渠道产生广泛影响，为配额政策的有效性提供了新证据。

title: From Shadow AI to Governed AI Review: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
abstract: This paper was accepted by Christoph Loch, commentary.
summary: 这篇评论文章围绕将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量的主题展开，提出了从不受监管的“影子AI”评审向受适当治理的“管治AI”评审转变的观点。摘要仅表明该文被接受为评论，未提供具体研究方法或实证分析。
ai_comment: 本文精准指出当前AI在学术评审中缺乏治理的问题，呼吁建立规范框架，具有前瞻性和现实指导意义。

title: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
abstract: We show that positive flows to active mutual funds with high recent returns partially reverse at longer horizons. This outcome is robust across a broad range of alternative specifications. Reversal occurs from greater outflows associated with high prior returns, not reduced inflows. We test theories to explain the reversal: investment life cycles, tax loss selling, and a behavioral “disappointment” hypothesis based on investors’ overreaction to positive returns. While both tax loss selling and short investor life cycles can contribute, the evidence supports a role for investor disappointment, whereby investors redeem their capital when return performance fails to meet expectations. (JEL G10, G23)
summary: 本文研究了主动型共同基金在长期视角下的资金流动态，发现具有高近期收益的基金在长期内资金流入会出现部分反转。该结果在多种替代设定下保持稳健。反转主要由高前期收益导致的资金流出增加而非流入减少引起。作者检验了三种理论解释：投资生命周期、税收亏损出售以及基于投资者对正收益过度反应的行为“失望”假说。虽然税收亏损出售和短投资生命周期均有一定贡献，但证据支持投资者失望假说的作用，即当收益表现未达到预期时投资者会赎回资金。
ai_comment: 该论文通过长期视角的实证分析，揭示了资金流反转现象中投资者失望机制的关键作用，为理解基金资金流动态提供了新见解。

title: Climate-Triggered Institutional Price Pressure: Does It Affect Firms’ Cost of Equity? – ERRATUM
abstract: An abstract is not available for this content. As you have access to this content, full HTML content is provided on this page. A PDF of this content is also available in through the ‘Save PDF’ action button.
summary: 由于该论文仅有标题和勘误声明，摘要内容不可用，无法提供详细的研究方法、数据或结论。标题表明论文探讨气候引发的机构价格压力是否影响公司的股权成本。
ai_comment: 论文关注气候风险通过机构投资者行为传导至公司融资成本的机制，是一个新兴且重要的研究视角。

title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
abstract: We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults: simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
summary: 本文在一个定量一般均衡模型中研究最优银行资本要求，该模型中银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险。与标准银行违约风险模型不同，该模型捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行和显著下行风险，从而能够再现“双重违约”（即企业和银行同时高违约）的频率和严重性。因此，最优银行资本要求在降低双重违约频率和限制信贷供给之间进行权衡，其结果高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所得出的水平。
ai_comment: 该文通过引入借款人违约的不可分散风险，更准确地刻画了银行风险特征，并得出了更高的最优资本要求，为监管提供了新视角。

title: ESG and the Stock Market: Is ESG Exposure Systematic?
abstract: We study the relation between firms’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and the aggregate stock market returns. Based on 38 individual ESG measures, we construct a market-level ESG index. With both the traditional predictive regression approach and two recently developed machine-learning methods, we find that the ESG index has strong and positive predictive power on the market both in- and out-of-sample, and both the cash flow and discount rate channels are the economic drivers of predictability. Our results are robust to a number of controls and set-ups. Our novel finding on the significant market-wide impact of the ESG provides support for the economy-wide importance of the ESG risk and for the central role played by governments. This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07169 .
summary: 本文研究企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现与股票市场总回报之间的关系。基于38个单项ESG指标，构建了市场层面的ESG指数。使用传统预测回归方法和两种近期发展的机器学习方法，发现ESG指数对市场回报具有强烈且正向的预测能力，样本内和样本外均成立。现金流渠道和贴现率渠道是预测能力的经济驱动因素。结果在多种控制和设定下保持稳健。这一关于ESG具有显著市场范围影响的新发现，支持了ESG风险在经济全局中的重要性以及政府发挥的核心作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地构建了市场层面的ESG指数，并发现其能预测总体市场回报，为ESG风险的系统性影响提供了实证支持。

title: Trade credit and relationships
abstract: Exploiting transaction-level international trade data, this paper documents that long-term firm-to-firm relationships facilitate the use of trade credit, with the strength of this effect varying with firm size, firms’ payment delays, and multinational affiliate status. Effects also depend on the strength of contract enforcement across countries and the complexity of products traded. Because trade credit can reduce the overall need to borrow from the financial sector, long-term relationships may reduce firms’ credit demand. The destruction of trade relationships, for example, through trade conflicts, may hence increase firms’ leverage.
summary: 利用交易层面的国际贸易数据，本文记录了长期的企业间关系如何促进贸易信贷的使用，并且这种效应的强度因企业规模、支付延迟以及跨国公司子公司身份而异。此外，效果还取决于跨国合同执行力度的强弱和所交易产品的复杂程度。由于贸易信贷可以降低企业对金融部门的总体借贷需求，长期关系可能减少企业的信贷需求。因此，贸易关系的破坏（例如通过贸易冲突）可能增加企业的杠杆率。
ai_comment: 本文利用微观交易数据揭示了企业间关系对贸易信贷的促进作用，并探讨了其对信贷需求和杠杆的宏观影响，为理解贸易冲突的金融后果提供了新视角。

title: Empowering Inclusive Work
abstract: Can AI improve workplace outcomes for workers with disabilities? We examine the relative performance of deaf or hard of hearing (DHH) workers on one of China's largest food-delivery platforms. Pre-AI, DHH workers are slower than non-disabled workers and have worse customer ratings, although they supply more hours to the platform and are less likely to quit. Midway through our data, the platform suddenly introduces an AI-based intelligent outbound calling system designed to improve customer communication for DHH workers. Using a difference-in-differences design comparing DHH and non-disabled workers before and after the AI tool, we find that AI increases the speed and productivity of DHH workers, especially on tasks involving customer interaction; substantially reduces negative customer ratings; and increases labor supply and retention. AI eliminates one-third of the disability hourly pay gap and significantly increases the profitability of DHH workers for the platform.
summary: 本文研究人工智能（AI）是否能够改善残疾工人的工作表现。利用中国最大的食品配送平台的数据，比较聋哑或听力障碍（DHH）工人与非残疾工人的表现。在AI引入前，DHH工人速度较慢、客户评价较差，但工作时间更长且离职率更低。平台中途引入了基于AI的智能外呼系统，旨在改善DHH工人与客户的沟通。采用双重差分法比较AI工具引入前后DHH工人与非残疾工人的差异，发现AI提高了DHH工人的速度和生产率，特别是在涉及客户互动的任务上；显著减少了负面客户评价；增加了劳动供给和留任率。AI消除了三分之一的残疾时薪差距，并显著提高了DHH工人为平台带来的盈利能力。
ai_comment: 该研究利用自然实验和详细的平台数据，为AI对残疾工人包容性就业的积极影响提供了因果证据，具有重要的政策启示。

title: On the Origins of the Multinational Premium
abstract: We study the relationship between management, multinational expansion, and risk premia. We document two facts: firms run by better managers are more likely to become multinationals (MNEs), and risk premia are higher for current and future MNEs than for firms that remain exclusively domestic. We develop a model in which endogenous matching between heterogeneous firms and managers jointly determines selection into foreign direct investment (FDI) and risk premia. Quantitatively, we use the model to examine how corporate taxation and distortions in the market for managerial talent affect multinational activity, firm risk exposure, and financial market outcomes.
summary: 本文研究了企业管理质量、跨国扩张与风险溢价之间的关系。作者发现两个关键事实：由更优秀管理者领导的企业更有可能成为跨国公司（MNEs），并且当前及未来的跨国公司的风险溢价高于始终专注于国内运营的企业。为此，构建了一个理论模型，其中异质性企业与管理者之间的内生匹配共同决定了对外直接投资（FDI）的选择以及企业的风险溢价。在定量分析中，利用该模型考察了公司税收和经理人才市场扭曲对跨国活动、企业风险暴露以及金融市场结果的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过将管理质量纳入跨国企业的风险溢价分析，提供了一个新颖的理论框架，并量化了税收和人才市场扭曲的影响，具有重要的政策与学术意义。

title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
abstract: Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45–60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women’s reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.
summary: 这项研究探讨信息提供如何影响患者对新型医疗模式的接受度，具体关注虚拟共享医疗预约（SMAs），即5-15名患有相同非紧急疾病的患者同时与一名临床医生在线会诊。研究者通过一项预注册的实地实验，覆盖英国超过4000名45-60岁女性，随机将参与者分为三组：仅观看标准描述信息（对照组）、观看先前患者的推荐（患者推荐组）或观看临床医生的推荐（临床医生推荐组）。结果显示，推荐信息使选择SMA的女性比例翻倍以上：在等待6-8周的情况下，对照组有11%选择SMA，而患者推荐组和临床医生推荐组分别为26%和24%。缩短等待时间进一步提升了参与率：当等待时间缩短至一周时，各组选择过SMA的女性比例上升14-19个百分点，推荐组接近40%。处理效应在信息处理能力更强的女性中更大，包括受过大学教育、更年期基础知识更丰富以及信息搜索更广泛的群体。研究发现，女性对SMA的抵触主要源于需求侧障碍，如不熟悉和对其好处的不确定性，而非对群体医疗模式的深层厌恶，而推荐信息足以有效降低这些障碍。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用随机实验，揭示了简单信息干预（如患者或医生推荐）在改变医疗决策中的巨大潜力，为降低创新医疗服务采纳的障碍提供了低成本、可推广的政策启示。

title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge
abstract: Standard measures of inflation, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), are designed to measure changes in the cost of living, not how households perceive price changes under limited attention and imperfect information. This paper introduces Perceived Inflation (PI), an attention-weighted inflation measure derived from a model in which households allocate attention across goods and observe noisy price signals. I construct monthly PI using disaggregated CPI data and attention proxies based on price salience, volatility, media mentions, and search behavior. The resulting PI series is highly correlated with CPI inflation but exhibits greater short-run volatility, especially during the Global Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 recession, and the 2021–22 inflation surge. A state-space version of the index implies a persistent latent attention component and a time-varying PI wedge. Finally, the paper embeds the estimated PI wedge into a heterogeneous-household model to demonstrate how attention-driven distortions in inflation perceptions affect saving and consumption through perceived real returns.
summary: 本文提出一种新的通胀度量——感知通胀（PI），它基于一个有限注意力和不完全信息下的家庭注意力分配模型，通过对不同商品的价格给予注意力权重（基于价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道和搜索行为）来构建。利用美国月度分类CPI数据，作者构建的PI序列与官方CPI高度相关，但短期波动更大，尤其在金融危机、COVID-19衰退和2021-22年通胀飙升期间。状态空间版本显示存在持久性的潜在注意力成分和时变的PI楔子。最后，将估计的PI楔子嵌入异质性家庭模型，证明注意力驱动的通胀感知扭曲通过感知实际回报影响储蓄和消费决策。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将注意力经济学引入通胀测量，揭示了官方CPI与家庭实际感知的差异，对理解通胀预期和消费行为有重要理论和政策启示。

title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes workers’ comparative advantage by altering the tasks they perform and the skills those tasks require. We develop a dynamic task-based model to quantify the general-equilibrium effects of task-specific technical change. Workers have multidimensional skills, choose occupations, and accumulate skills on the job; occupations combine tasks, and productivity depends on how workers’ skills match task requirements. We develop a computationally efficient procedure to estimate the model using panel data and a new database of task-level skill requirements. We apply the model to AI, allowing it to augment, automate, and simplify tasks. We find that AI narrows wage inequality and raises average wages across scenarios ranging from slow to rapid AI progress. The key equalizing force is simplification: by lowering tasks’ skill requirements, AI lets lower-skill workers compete for previously inaccessible jobs. Adoption costs, highest for lower-skill workers, dampen but do not eliminate the decline in inequality.
summary: 本文构建了一个动态任务模型，量化任务特定技术变革（如人工智能）对工人比较优势的均衡效应。模型考虑工人具有多维技能，选择职业并在工作中积累技能；职业由多项任务组成，生产率取决于工人技能与任务要求的匹配。作者利用面板数据和新的任务级技能要求数据库对模型进行估计，并应用于人工智能场景，允许其增强、自动化和简化任务。研究发现，无论AI进步速度如何，AI都会缩小工资不平等并提高平均工资；关键均等化力量是简化效应：通过降低任务技能要求，使低技能工人能够竞争以前无法从事的工作；低技能工人的采用成本会抑制但不会消除不平等的下降。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将AI的简化效应纳入模型，揭示了其降低技能门槛、缩小工资差距的机制，为理解AI对劳动市场的均衡影响提供了新视角。

title: Planning Capital and Discovery-Based Learning-by-Doing: Investment as Staged Discovery in the Hyperscale Era
abstract:
This paper treats frontier investment as staged discovery. Firms invest through sequences of costly inquiry stages before deciding whether and how to realize value. At each stage, a firm may sharpen its diagnostic understanding, choose what question to ask, embody that question in a costly action, and interpret the answer that action produces. The answer changes what the firm knows, what it can do next, and how costly future inquiry will be. Successful histories can also carry over to later related problems, making the firm a better learner beyond the current investment path.
The paper calls the resulting asset planning capital in firm form. Planning capital is the accumulated diagnostic understanding a firm has built through costly inquiry and operation: understanding of technologies, processes, customers, tools, partners, failures, constraints, and opportunities, together with the capacity to keep learning. It becomes valuable because it helps the firm choose what to investigate, make the question answerable, interpret what happened, and carry what it learned into later investment stages. Building on classical investment theory, R&D models, real-options theory, venture-capital models, classical learning-by-doing, the paper develops a model of investment as staged discovery. 
The AI and semiconductor frontier makes this asset visible. Firms are being valued and funded for more than the physical capacity they already own. Chips, fabs, data centers, cloud platforms, power commitments, and model systems matter because they carry traces of accumulated learning and because their use generates more learning. They let firms train models, test demand, expose bottlenecks, improve yields, qualify customers, integrate tools, and discover which complements are missing.
