The current buildout is therefore investment in capacity and in the institutional learning system that makes capacity more valuable over time.
The framework explains why production systems, tool systems, research paths, sovereign capability programs, and infrastructure sponsorship belong in the same analysis. They are different institutional forms through which planning capital is accumulated. The paper treats terminal realization value in reduced form and focuses on the discovery process that precedes it: how institutions build capacity, learn from using it, and turn accumulated diagnostic understanding into an advantage in the next round of investment.
summary: 本文将前沿投资视为分阶段发现过程。企业通过一系列高成本探究阶段进行投资，然后决定是否以及如何实现价值。在每个阶段，企业可以加深诊断性理解、选择要探究的问题、将问题体现在成本高昂的行动中，并解读行动产生的答案。答案会改变企业所知、后续能力和未来探究成本。成功经验还可以延续到后续相关问题，使企业成为更好的学习者。论文将由此产生的资产称为企业形式的“规划资本”，即企业通过高成本探究和运营积累的诊断性理解，包括对技术、流程、客户、工具、合作伙伴、失败、约束和机会的理解，以及持续学习的能力。规划资本之所以有价值，是因为它帮助企业选择要调查的内容、使问题可回答、解释发生的情况、并将所学带入后续投资阶段。论文基于经典投资理论、研发模型、实物期权理论、风险投资模型和经典干中学，构建了投资作为分阶段发现的模型。人工智能和半导体前沿使这一资产变得可见。企业被估值和融资的依据不仅仅是已拥有的物理产能。芯片、晶圆厂、数据中心、云平台、电力承诺和模型系统之所以重要，是因为它们承载了累积学习的痕迹，其使用能产生更多学习。它们让企业训练模型、测试需求、暴露瓶颈、改进良率、验证客户、集成工具、发现缺失的互补品。因此，当前的扩张既是对产能的投资，也是对使产能随时间更有价值的机构学习系统的投资。该框架解释了为什么生产系统、工具系统、研究路径、主权能力项目和基础设施赞助属于同一分析范畴——它们是积累规划资本的不同制度形式。论文以简约形式处理终端实现价值，专注于其前的发现过程：机构如何建立产能、通过使用学习、并将累积的诊断性理解转化为下一轮投资中的优势。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将投资视为分阶段发现过程，提出“规划资本”概念，为理解AI和半导体领域的巨额投资提供了新视角。

title: The Informed Insider: A Leading Measure of Quality
abstract: Product and service quality is fundamental to firm value creation, yet it is well recognized as difficult to observe ex ante. Existing quality proxies are limited in coverage, lack cross-firm comparability, and primarily rely on lagging indicators that capture product or service failures only after they materialize. Exploiting employees’ informational advantage as informed insiders and firsthand observers of firms’ internal operations, we develop and validate a novel, forward-looking measure of firm-year-level product and service quality using over 4.3 million employee reviews on Glassdoor. Leveraging machine learning models trained on a subset of firms with third-party customer satisfaction data, we construct quality indices for S&P 1500 firms spanning 2008 to 2023. The resulting quality measures exhibit meaningful variation across firms and within firms over time. In out-of-sample tests, our quality indices demonstrate strong predictive power for future quality provision, emerging as the single most important predictor relative to firm fundamentals and Glassdoor ratings. We validate our measure by examining its association with alternative quality metrics. We show that our quality measures are useful in predicting important quality-related firm outcomes such as product recalls, brand value, and profitability. We also construct an alternative set of quality measures using a zero-shot prompt-based approach and a supervised fine-tuning approach with GPT models to assess the potential of LLMs and generative AI in capturing firm-level quality provision. Our paper shows the value of employee voices as a powerful, forward-looking, and scalable signal of firm quality provision. The paper offers implications for stakeholders seeking to identify quality-related risks and opportunities before they become externally visible.
summary: 本文利用员工作为知情内部人的信息优势，基于Glassdoor上超过430万条员工评论，开发并验证了一种新颖的、前瞻性的公司年度产品和服务质量衡量指标。通过机器学习模型，使用部分具有第三方客户满意度数据的公司进行训练，构建了2008至2023年间S&P 1500公司的质量指数。该指数在公司和时间维度上均表现出显著差异，并在样本外测试中展现出对未来质量提供的强大预测能力，成为相对于公司基本面和其他Glassdoor评级最重要的预测因子。进一步验证表明，该质量指标与产品召回、品牌价值和盈利能力等重要公司结果相关。此外，还使用GPT模型的零样本提示和监督微调方法构建了备选质量指标，评估了大语言模型和生成式AI在捕捉公司质量方面的潜力。本文展示了员工声音作为公司质量提供的强大、前瞻且可扩展信号的价值，为利益相关者识别质量相关风险和机会提供了启示。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用员工内部信息构建质量衡量指标，填补了现有滞后指标和不可比性的空白，为质量研究提供了新视角。

title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools
abstract: Although use of generative AI tools has quickly become widespread in education settings, emerging evidence suggests that effects on learning will depend on how that use is supported and guided. This paper reports findings from an original national survey of K-12 school principals designed to measure institutional integration of AI in schools through policies, teacher training, guidance for student use, leadership engagement, and the availability of AI-enabled tools. We find that AI use has spread rapidly across schools, largely as a productivity aid. Students mainly use AI for homework help and writing, while educators primarily use it for lesson planning and administrative tasks. The development of teacher training, guidance, and school policies has lagged adoption. We next document two diffusion gaps across schools: First, lower AI integration is associated with a higher share of disadvantaged students (a one standard deviation increase in disadvantage is associated with a 0.07-0.11 SD lower score on an index of AI integration); Second, private and charter schools score 0.23-0.44 SD lower on the AI integration index than traditional public schools. Although several surveyed school-level factors strongly predict AI integration, they do little to explain these gaps. Differences in district size account for roughly one-third of the disadvantage gap between public schools. These findings suggest that the factors associated with greater AI integration differ from those needed to narrow disparities in how schools support and guide AI use.
summary: 本文基于一项对美国K-12学校校长的全国调查，衡量了学校在政策、教师培训、学生使用指导、领导参与和AI工具可用性方面的AI整合程度。研究发现，生成式AI工具在教育领域迅速普及，学生主要用于作业和写作，教师用于备课和行政任务，但教师培训、指导和学校政策的发展滞后于技术采用。存在两个扩散差距：一是较低AI整合与较高比例的弱势学生相关（弱势程度每增加一个标准差，AI整合指数降低0.07-0.11个标准差）；二是私立学校和特许学校的AI整合指数比传统公立学校低0.23-0.44个标准差。尽管一些学校层面的因素能强烈预测AI整合，但它们几乎无法解释这些差距；学区规模差异仅能解释公立学校中约三分之一的弱势差距。这表明促进AI整合的因素与缩小学校在支持和引导AI使用方面差距所需的因素不同。
ai_comment: 该研究通过全国性调查揭示了K-12学校AI整合中的不平等现象，指出弱势学生群体和私立/特许学校面临更低整合水平，且传统因素无法完全解释差距，为政策干预提供了重要依据。

title: Elderly Health and Longevity in the US: Evidence and Implications
abstract: Rising elderly life expectancy is a well-known source of fiscal pressure on Social Security and Medicare – but how have declining mortality and morbidity affected the two programs’ relative finances? Using nearly three decades of Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data (1992-2019), we estimate that these demographic changes raised expected lifetime Social Security spending by over twice as much as expected lifetime Medicare spending: 14% compared to 6%. The slower growth of elderly lifetime health care spending than annuity spending reflects two features of how longevity has increased: the additional 2.4 years of remaining life expectancy were entirely healthy – free of physical or cognitive limitations – while the expected amount of time spent with severe health limitations fell by about 30%, reducing expected lifetime nursing-home and home-health use. We then write down a stylized life-cycle model of a risk-averse retiree facing stochastic mortality and health to illuminate the key forces that affect the optimal allocation of a fixed amount of public funds across Medicare and Social Security.
summary: 本文利用1992-2019年Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey数据，研究美国老年人口预期寿命延长对社会保障（Social Security）和医疗保险（Medicare）财政的影响。发现预期寿命延长2.4年且完全健康（无身体或认知限制），严重健康限制时间下降约30%，导致预期终身社会保障支出增长14%，而医疗保险支出仅增长6%（因养老院和家庭健康护理使用减少）。进一步构建包含随机死亡率和健康状态的退休者生命周期模型，分析如何在两大项目间最优分配固定公共资金。
ai_comment: 通过近三十年微观数据揭示健康寿命延长对社保和医保财政影响的显著差异，并建立理论模型优化资金分配，为老龄化社会政策设计提供新视角。

title: Beta for Alpha: Neural Engagement in Financial Trading
abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings. We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading. Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution. Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance. We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.
summary: 本研究利用可穿戴脑电图（EEG）设备，在真实高风险交易环境中记录专业日间交易员的脑电波活动，构建心理生理学参与度指数（Engagement Index, EI），即β波功率除以α波与θ波功率之和。研究发现，交易执行前后存在明显的尖峰-衰减模式；更成功的交易在执行前30秒内呈现更大的EI尖峰，而基线EI水平对交易绩效无预测能力，甚至呈现负相关。此外，更高的EI与减弱的行为偏差（如整数启发式和处置效应）相关。
ai_comment: 该研究将神经科学方法引入金融决策研究，提供了实时神经活动与交易绩效的直接证据，为理解交易员决策过程开辟了新视角。

title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
abstract: This paper studies the role of foreign exchange and gold reserves in mitigating the US monetary policy spillovers to exchange rates at times of geopolitical fragmentation and de-dollarization. US dollar reserves mitigate depreciation driven by US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller exchange-rate responses, though less strongly than dollar reserves, suggesting novel complementarity between dollar and gold reserves. Moreover, the estimated effects of dollar and gold reserves are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines. These findings are consistent with recent large-scale purchases and sales of gold reserves by emerging economies amid sanctions-related restrictions and geopolitical concerns about access to dollar liquidity. Our results suggest that not only the aggregate volume but also the composition of foreign exchange and gold reserves and access to dollar liquidity facilities are empirically relevant for exchange-rate responses to US monetary shocks. Finally, we exploit cross-country heterogeneity and show that countries with large dollar exposure exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses when dollar and gold reserve holdings are larger.
summary: 本文研究在地缘政治碎片化和去美元化背景下，外汇储备和黄金储备在缓解美国货币政策对汇率溢出效应中的作用。实证发现，美元储备能缓解美国货币紧缩导致的汇率贬值，而非美元储备则无此效果；黄金储备也与较小的汇率响应相关，但效果弱于美元储备，暗示美元与黄金储备之间存在新颖的互补性。此外，这些效应主要集中在没有互换和回购线的国家。结果表明，外汇和黄金储备的总量及构成，以及获取美元流动性设施的途径，对汇率应对美国货币政策冲击具有经验相关性。最后，利用跨国异质性发现，在美元敞口较大的国家，持有更多美元和黄金储备时汇率响应更小。
ai_comment: 论文创新地揭示了黄金储备与美元储备在缓冲美国货币政策溢出中的互补作用，尤其在地缘政治风险加剧时，对新兴经济体储备管理具有重要政策启示。

title: EnsembleIV: Creating Instrumental Variables from Ensemble Learners for Robust Statistical Inference with ML- Generated Variables
abstract: Advances in machine learning have made it easier to extract useful information from both structured and unstructured data. Accordingly, empirical researchers often seek to leverage machine learning for statistical inference and hypothesis testing. We study an increasingly popular practice wherein a supervised machine learning model is trained to predict a certain variable of interest, and the predicted values are subsequently used in regression models as independent variables to draw statistical inferences. However, inevitably, errors in predictions manifest as measurement errors in regression models and lead to estimation biases. In this paper, we design and evaluate a novel approach, termed EnsembleIV, to address the issue. We propose the use of ensemble machine learning techniques to generate the predictions and show that individual learners in the ensemble (after a proposed special-purpose data-driven transformation procedure) can serve as instrumental variables to correct for the measurement error and avoid estimation biases. EnsembleIV’s effectiveness is demonstrated on both synthetic and real data sets for both linear and generalized linear regression models. We also compare EnsembleIV with several alternative bias correction methods and highlight its advantages. Overall, EnsembleIV represents a flexible algorithm that enables empirical researchers to draw robust statistical inferences with independent variables generated via machine learning. This paper was accepted by D.J. Wu, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08999 .
summary: 论文研究了当使用机器学习模型预测的值作为回归模型自变量进行统计推断时，预测误差会引发测量误差并导致估计偏差的问题。作者提出了一种名为EnsembleIV的新方法，利用集成机器学习技术生成预测，并证明集成中的个体学习器经过一种特殊的数据驱动变换后，可以作为工具变量来纠正测量误差，从而避免估计偏差。通过合成数据集和真实数据集在线性回归和广义线性回归模型中验证了EnsembleIV的有效性，并与多种替代偏差修正方法进行了比较，突出了其优势。EnsembleIV提供了一种灵活的算法，使得实证研究者能够利用机器学习生成的变量进行稳健的统计推断。
ai_comment: 针对机器学习预测变量在回归中引入测量误差这一普遍问题提供了严谨的解决方案，方法设计巧妙且实用性强。

title: The Impact of Voluntary Carbon Goal Announcements on Stock Returns
abstract: This study quantifies the impact of voluntary carbon goal announcements on cumulative abnormal stock returns (CAR). Using 188 announcements of U.S. publicly traded firms between 2018 and 2024 across a variety of industries, this event study offers new and economically relevant insights on when and how firms should announce their carbon goals. First, a voluntary carbon goal announcement is associated with 0.65% positive CAR for the main event window (−2,+2), which translates to an increase of about $490 million based on the average market capitalization of firms in our data set. Notably, despite the substantial financial commitments implied by carbon neutrality, this corresponds to an average gain of about $75 in abnormal return per current ton of CO 2 -equivalent emissions. Second, our analysis of announcement-related media coverage using topic modeling reveals that investors respond more positively when the media highlights the expected business impact of the carbon goal. Third, firms with higher current emissions in the scopes they commit to eliminate are evaluated more favorably by the stock market, suggesting that investors value the larger emission reduction volume associated with such commitments. Finally, the positive effects of emphasizing business impact and promising to eliminate higher current emissions diminish over time. We conduct a series of robustness checks to ensure that our results are reliable and unbiased. Overall, this study provides a strong empirical foundation for understanding the consequences of voluntary carbon goal announcements of firms and discusses implications for theory and practice. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08673 .
summary: 本研究量化了自愿碳目标公告对累积异常股票收益（CAR）的影响。基于2018年至2024年间188个美国上市公司在不同行业的公告，采用事件研究法，揭示了企业宣布碳目标的时间和方式的重要经济含义。首先，自愿碳目标公告在主事件窗口（-2,+2）内带来0.65%的正向CAR，按样本平均市值计算约增加4.9亿美元。值得注意的是，尽管碳中和意味着巨大的财务承诺，这相当于每吨当前二氧化碳当量排放产生约75美元的异常收益。其次，通过主题建模分析公告相关的媒体报道，发现当媒体强调碳目标预期的商业影响时，投资者反应更积极。第三，承诺消除当前较高排放范围的企业，股票市场评价更有利，表明投资者看重较大减排量。最后，强调商业影响和承诺消除高排放的正面效应随时间减弱。一系列稳健性检验确保了结果的可靠性。该研究为理解企业自愿碳目标公告的后果提供了坚实的实证基础，并讨论了理论与实践意义。
ai_comment: 该研究通过事件研究法量化了碳目标公告的短期市场收益，并创新性地结合媒体报道主题分析，揭示了投资者偏好商业影响和减排量大的特征，为企业在ESG信息披露策略上提供了实证依据。

title: Second-Tier Stock Exchanges and Growth of Entrepreneurship
abstract: We examine the role of second-tier stock exchanges in an entrepreneurial context from a global perspective. We construct a country-industry-year panel of global venture capitalist (VC)-invested startups, and find a significant increase in entrepreneurial activity following the launch of such markets. A causal interpretation is supported by additional tests for staggered difference-in-differences regressions and interacted regressions based on industry-specific dependence on second-tier stock exchanges. We propose a VC exit mechanism that receives empirical support: the launch of second-tier stock exchanges positively predicts (i) VC investment in startups, (ii) VCs’ valuation of startups, (iii) startups’ patenting records, (iv) startups’ initial public offering (IPO) likelihood, and (v) startups’ IPO valuation. We find that more startups are created in countries with more VC investment after the launch of such markets. We also find that the effect of second-tier stock exchanges on entrepreneurial ventures increases with financial resources, human capital, and intellectual property protection. This paper was accepted by Matt Marx, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: H. Gao acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72472028]. P.-H. Hsu acknowledges research support from the National Science and Technology Council in Taiwan [Grants NSTC 113-2410-H-007-008-MY3 and NSTC 114-2410-H-007-016-MY3], the Mack Institute for Innovation Management of the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, and the E.SUN Academic Award for financial and research support. Y. Wang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72402130]. This work was also supported by the Dalian Commodity Exchange. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08619 .
summary: 该论文从全球视角研究了二级股票交易所（second-tier stock exchanges）对创业活动的影响。作者构建了一个涵盖全球风险投资（VC）支持的初创企业的国家-行业-年度面板数据，发现在二级交易所推出后，创业活动显著增加。为支持因果解释，采用了交错双重差分回归（staggered difference-in-differences）和基于行业对二级交易所依赖程度的交互回归。论文提出了一个VC退出机制，并得到实证支持：二级交易所的推出正向预测（i）VC对初创企业的投资，（ii）VC对初创企业的估值，（iii）初创企业的专利申请记录，（iv）初创企业的首次公开募股（IPO）可能性，以及（v）初创企业的IPO估值。此外，在二级交易所推出后，VC投资更多的国家创造了更多的初创企业。二级交易所对创业企业的影响随着金融资源、人力资本和知识产权保护的增强而增大。
ai_comment: 该论文利用全球面板数据，识别了二级股票交易所促进创业的因果关系，并揭示了VC退出机制，对新兴市场政策有参考价值。

title: Lemon Cycles
abstract: We build a model of endogenous credit cycles arising from the dynamics of adverse selection. Heterogeneous entrepreneurs trade productive assets in an anonymous market subject to financial frictions. Cream-skimming rent-seekers create lemon assets that can be traded. Lemon assets are indistinguishable ex-ante from the productive assets but have no productive value ex-post. The average quality of assets is the key state variable of the economy. High asset prices today attract the creation of more lemons, thereby exacerbating adverse selection and depressing the future reallocation of productive assets and asset prices. Productive and lemon assets therefore exhibit predator-prey dynamics, and the quality of assets evolves endogenously over time. The equilibrium may feature endogenous cycles and chaos, with the credit market freezing and thawing recurrently and with deterministic ups and downs in asset prices and the volume of trades. We show that a social planner has incentives to tax credit market activities in order to reduce lemon assets and to eliminate endogenous cycles. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: F. Dong acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72525004]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07248 .
summary: 本文构建了一个基于逆向选择动态的内生信贷周期模型。模型中，异质企业家在存在金融摩擦的匿名市场上交易生产性资产，而摘奶油式的寻租者会制造可交易的柠檬资产（事前无法与生产性资产区分，但事后无生产性价值）。资产的平均质量是经济的关键状态变量：当前的高资产价格吸引更多柠檬资产的创造，从而加剧逆向选择，抑制未来生产性资产的再配置和资产价格。生产性资产与柠檬资产因此呈现捕食者-猎物动态，资产质量内生演化。均衡可能出现内生周期和混沌，信贷市场周期性冻结和融化，资产价格和交易量呈现确定性涨跌。社会计划者可以通过对信贷市场活动征税来减少柠檬资产并消除内生周期。
ai_comment: 该模型通过捕食者-猎物动力学巧妙地将柠檬资产创造与资产质量内生波动联系起来，揭示了信贷市场周期性和混沌行为的微观基础，并为政策干预提供了明确的理论依据。

title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
abstract: A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
summary: 本文研究美联储贴现窗口（DW）的污名化问题。贴现窗口作为最后贷款人工具，因使用污名化而效果不佳。通过理论和实验方法，发现行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口困难，但引入新的后盾设施有助于缓解污名。该结果与美联储的实际经验一致。
ai_comment: 采用实验方法研究中央银行工具污名化问题，创新性地揭示了行为惯性的阻碍作用，并为新后盾设施的政策价值提供了证据。

title: Consensus? An Examination of Differences in Earnings Information Across Forecast Data Providers
abstract: We compare the earnings information produced by the five largest forecast data providers (FDPs)—Bloomberg, Capital IQ, FactSet, I/B/E/S, and Zacks—and observe substantial differences across FDPs in both forecasted and actual street earnings values, and thus the earnings surprise, for the same firm‐quarter. We provide evidence that differences in the earnings surprise across FDPs for the same firm‐quarter (i.e., “FDP differences”) have economically meaningful implications for price responsiveness and liquidity around earnings announcements. We also find that, for announcements where FDPs disagree about whether the announcing firm missed or beat earnings expectations, investors are more likely to side with higher‐quality FDPs but may not fully impound the implications of FDP quality differences during the announcement window. On average, relative to the other FDPs, I/B/E/S ranks highly in our measure of FDP quality, such that investor reactions are likely to align with I/B/E/S earnings information, validating its use as a representative FDP in academic research. Taken together, our results are consistent with FDPs pursuing differentiated information production strategies that generate capital market frictions when these strategies lead to material FDP differences.
summary: 本文比较了五大预测数据提供商（FDPs）——Bloomberg、Capital IQ、FactSet、I/B/E/S和Zacks——在相同公司-季度中产生的盈利信息，发现它们在预测值、实际street盈利值以及盈利意外方面存在显著差异。研究表明，这些FDP差异对盈利公告期间的价格反应和流动性具有经济意义的影响。当FDPs对公司是否达到或超出盈利预期存在分歧时，投资者更倾向于相信高质量FDPs（如I/B/E/S），但在公告窗口期内可能未能完全反映FDP质量差异的影响。总体而言，结果支持FDPs采用差异化信息生产策略，这些策略在导致实质性差异时会产生资本市场摩擦。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统比较了主要预测数据提供商的盈利信息差异，并揭示了其经济后果，为学术研究中常用I/B/E/S数据的合理性提供了实证支持。

title: Green Investing and Political Behavior
abstract: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies. (JEL D14, H42, G18, P16)
summary: 该论文通过预注册实验检验了绿色投资是否会挤出对公共政策（如气候法规）的政治支持。实验在瑞士一次气候法公投前夕进行，发现提供投资于气候友好型基金的机会并不会减少个人对气候监管的支持（以政治捐款和投票意向衡量）。在英国复现实验得到类似结果。估计否定了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持有微弱的挤入效应。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实地实验（真实公投情境）直接检验了绿色投资与政治支持间的因果关系，结果反驳了常见的挤出担忧，为绿色金融的积极外部性提供了证据。

title: Blended finance
abstract: Blended finance—the use of public and philanthropic funding to crowd in private capital—has emerged as a potential tool for financing sustainable development. Yet little is known about the design of blended finance contracts. We develop a conceptual framework in which development finance institutions (DFIs) allocate concessional capital across projects to maximize societal impact while crowding in private investors. Our framework highlights a trade-off between sustainability impact and the amount of concessionality required to make projects commercially viable and characterizes how DFIs optimally combine different instruments, including concessional debt, junior equity tranches, and risk management facilities. We then provide empirical evidence on blended finance using deal-level data from a major DFI. Consistent with our conceptual framework, projects with higher anticipated sustainability impact receive greater concessionality. Moreover, concessionality is higher in countries with greater political risk and information asymmetries, and these projects are more likely to include risk management provisions. Our findings provide new evidence on how DFIs deploy catalytic capital to mobilize private investment in sustainable development.
summary: 本文研究混合融资——利用公共和慈善资金撬动私人资本以促进可持续发展。作者构建了一个概念框架，其中开发性金融机构（DFIs）跨项目分配优惠资本以最大化社会影响，同时吸引私人投资者。框架揭示了可持续影响与使项目商业可行所需的优惠程度之间的权衡，并描述了DFIs如何最优组合不同工具，包括优惠债务、次级股权和风险管理设施。利用某大型DFI的交易级数据，实证发现：预期可持续影响较高的项目获得更多优惠；政治风险和信息不对称较高的国家中优惠程度更高，且这些项目更可能包含风险管理条款。研究提供了DFIs如何运用催化资本动员私人投资于可持续发展的新证据。
ai_comment: 本文是首篇系统分析混合融资合同设计的研究，结合理论框架和独家实证数据，为理解优惠资本分配的内在权衡提供了重要洞见。

title: Asymmetric thin markets
abstract: Using a new equilibrium representation, I characterize dynamic, nonstationary risk sharing in a complete-information setting among strategic traders submitting demand schedules and heterogeneous in risk aversion. In equilibrium, more risk-averse (smaller) traders diversify more aggressively due to endogenously lower price impact. This creates term structure effects, where smaller traders dynamically hedge the persistent order flow of larger, slower traders and become the marginal pricers at short horizons. When pre-announced security issuances (e.g., bond reopenings) or predictable trades take place, the model generates the gradual, V-shaped price response observed around these events and delivers new predictions about institutional trading.
summary: 该论文提出了一个新的均衡表示，用于刻画在完全信息环境下，策略性交易者提交需求计划且风险厌恶程度异质时的动态非平稳风险分担。均衡结果表明，风险厌恶程度更高（即规模更小）的交易者因内生的较低价格影响而更积极地分散风险，从而产生期限结构效应：小交易者动态对冲大交易者的持续订单流，成为短期边际定价者。当存在预先宣布的证券发行（如债券重开）或可预测交易时，模型能够生成围绕这些事件的渐近V型价格响应，并提供关于机构交易的新预测。
ai_comment: 该模型通过引入交易者风险厌恶异质性和内生价格影响，揭示了薄市场中的动态非对称风险分担机制，并成功解释了证券发行事件中的V型价格响应，理论贡献显著。

title: Do Hedge Funds Strategically Misreport Their Holdings? Evidence from 13F Restatements
abstract: Hedge funds can subsequently amend their originally reported 13F quarterly holdings using restatements. We conduct the first systematic analysis of such filings, which are as common as confidential filings (used by funds to delay holding disclosures) but affect three times as many stocks. Restated holdings are associated with significant abnormal returns, suggesting that some original holdings are strategically misreported to hide funds’ trading intentions and that later restatements facilitate copycat trading and price convergence. We construct a restatement return gap measure to gauge the value added by such restatements and find that a positive return gap is predictive of superior future fund performance. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: S. Cao acknowledges support from the AI Initiative from Capital Markets Research at the University of Maryland. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08833 .
summary: 本文首次系统性地分析了对冲基金通过13F修正报告策略性地错误报告其季度持股的现象。研究发现，修正报告与保密报告同样普遍（用于延迟持股披露），但影响的股票数量是保密报告的三倍。修正后的持股与显著异常收益相关，表明原始持股可能被策略性错误报告以隐藏基金的交易意图，而后续修正则促进了跟风交易和价格收敛。作者构建了一个修正回报差距指标来衡量修正的附加值，并发现正向回报差距可以预测基金未来的优异表现。
ai_comment: 该文首次将13F修正报告作为研究对象，揭示了其在市场信息传递中的重要作用，并构建了具有预测能力的修正回报差距指标。

title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
summary: 该论文通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，研究经验不足的消费者如何学习使用新金融技术。实验发现，接触工资账户促进了账户使用增加、加速了学习过程，并帮助避免常见消费者保护风险。接收电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立对技术的信任，学会独立使用账户且避免非法费用。通过银行账户与移动货币账户的实验变异，研究显示这些积极影响主要集中在移动货币账户，即较新、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。
ai_comment: 该研究通过精心设计的实地实验，清晰展示了消费者从陌生到熟悉新金融技术的动态学习过程，尤其突出了移动货币相对于传统银行的独特优势，为金融科技推广策略提供了实证基础。

title: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
abstract: As the economy has become increasingly knowledge-based, firms’ capability to benefit from external knowledge has grown in importance. We construct a measure of this capability – absorption intensity – from information in firms’ patents. To validate the measure, we exploit the American Inventors Protection Act (AIPA), which exogenously increased patent information availability. A triple-difference design shows that firms with higher absorption intensity experience greater innovation growth when more exposed to the reform. Beyond AIPA, absorption intensity predicts stronger innovation outcomes and firm growth. Our measure offers a tool to study how differences in absorption capability shape returns to external knowledge.
summary: 本文构建了一个衡量企业吸收外部知识能力的指标——吸收强度（absorption intensity），基于企业专利信息。为验证该指标，利用美国发明人保护法案（AIPA）外生地增加了专利信息可用性。三重差分设计表明，吸收强度更高的企业在面对改革时创新增长更大。此外，吸收强度还能预测更强的创新成果和企业增长。该指标为研究吸收能力差异如何影响外部知识回报提供了工具。
ai_comment: 利用外生政策冲击（AIPA）进行三重差分验证，增强了因果识别的可信度，为衡量企业知识吸收能力提供了有效工具。

title: Angels, entrepreneurship, and employment dynamics: Evidence from investor accreditation rules
abstract: This paper examines the effects of a shock to angel finance on entrepreneurial activity. Using U.S. Census data, we estimate the state-level fraction of households that lost accreditation status from Dodd–Frank’s elimination of housing wealth in determining accreditation. A larger reduction in the pool of potential investors reduces angel investment, firm entry, and employment at small entrants. Employment increases at small and young incumbents, suggesting competitive effects. Though we document partial substitution, angel finance appears to complement other capital sources in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Our paper offers insight on the impact of angel finance and where it matters most.
summary: 本文利用美国人口普查数据，研究多德-弗兰克法案取消住房财富作为认定合格投资者资格的条件后，各州失去合格投资者身份的家庭比例对天使投资和创业活动的影响。结果显示，潜在投资者池的减少降低了天使投资、企业进入率以及小型新创企业的就业。同时，小型和年轻在位企业的就业增加，表明存在竞争效应。尽管存在部分替代，但天使投资与创业生态系统中的其他资本来源具有互补性。该研究揭示了天使投资对创业和就业动态的影响及其作用条件。
ai_comment: 利用外生政策冲击识别天使投资对创业和就业的因果效应，并发现竞争效应，为理解天使投资在创业生态系统中的互补角色提供了新证据。

title: Measuring Financial Literacy with the Big Three: Why It Works
abstract: This paper investigates why the widely-used Big Three financial literacy index provides a reliable measure of financial literacy. Using an Item Response Theory framework, we estimate item difficulty and discrimination parameters and conduct a meta analysis to assess the stability of these properties across datasets and countries. Results confirm the scale's validity and reliability, with item characteristics that remain stable across populations and settings. We find no evidence of measurement differences across demographic subgroups or countries. Compared to the longer Big Five scale, the Big Three index performs similarly in measuring financial literacy and predicting financial behaviors.
summary: 本文探讨了广泛使用的Big Three金融素养指数为何能提供可靠的金融素养测量。运用项目反应理论（Item Response Theory）框架，估计了项目的难度和区分度参数，并进行了元分析以评估这些属性在不同数据集和国家间的稳定性。结果证实了该量表的效度和信度，项目特征在人群和环境间保持稳定。未发现不同人口统计子群体或国家间存在测量差异。与更长的Big Five量表相比，Big Three指数在测量金融素养和预测金融行为方面表现相似。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严谨的心理测量学和元分析方法，为Big Three指数的广泛应用提供了坚实的实证支持，并展示了其跨群体和国家的测量不变性，具有方法论贡献。

title: Monopsony Power and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
abstract: This paper studies how labor market power affects the transmission of monetary policy. Using administrative U.S. Census data, we show that firms with high monopsony power—defined as those accounting for over 10 percent of the local wage bill—respond less to monetary policy in terms of their wage bill and employment. We then develop a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous firms and oligopsonistic competition to interpret these findings. Wage stickiness combined with firms’ labor market power is key to generating the heterogeneous responses that we document. Our model highlights two channels through which oligopsony shapes the aggregate effects of monetary policy: partial passthrough and misallocation. Calibrated to U.S. labor markets, the model implies that the decline in labor market power since the 1980s has increased the output response to monetary policy by about 10 percent and accounts for about 15 percent of the estimated flattening of the Phillips curve.
summary: 本文研究劳动力市场垄断势力如何影响货币政策的传导。利用美国人口普查行政数据，发现高垄断势力（占当地工资账单10%以上）的企业在工资和就业方面对货币政策的反应较小。作者构建了一个包含异质性企业和寡头垄断竞争的新凯恩斯模型，以解释这些发现。工资粘性结合企业劳动力市场力量是产生所记录的异质性反应的关键。模型突出了寡头垄断影响货币政策总体效应的两个渠道：部分传导和资源错配。校准至美国劳动力市场后，模型表明自1980年代以来劳动力市场力量的下降使货币政策对产出的响应增加了约10%，并解释了菲利普斯曲线平坦化估计值的约15%。
ai_comment: 本文通过微观数据与宏观模型的结合，量化了劳动力市场力量对货币政策传导的影响，并揭示了其与菲利普斯曲线平坦化的重要关联，具有创新性和政策意义。

title: How Do Financial and Longevity Literacy Affect Annuity Demand?
abstract: Deciding whether to use an annuity to draw down accumulated retirement wealth is among the most complex financial decisions individuals face. It requires reasoning about longevity risk, stochastic income streams, and largely irreversible tradeoffs, often at older ages and with limited opportunities to learn from experience. This paper reviews theoretical, empirical, and experimental research to examine how financial literacy and longevity literacy shape annuitization decisions. While some extensions of the standard lifecycle model can rationalize low annuity demand, their explanatory power depends on individuals’ ability to optimize over a set of complex risks and tradeoffs. Evidence shows that, although financial and longevity literacy are only weakly and inconsistently related to annuity take-up, they are strongly associated with retirement planning, the coherence of annuity valuations, and sensitivity to framing and choice architecture. These patterns suggest that literacy should be understood not as a direct determinant of annuity demand, but as a constraint on the extent to which observed annuitization behavior can be interpreted as revealing true preferences.
summary: 该论文综述了理论、实证和实验研究，探讨金融素养和长寿素养如何影响年金化决策。研究发现，尽管金融素养和长寿素养与年金购买行为之间的直接关联较弱且不一致，但它们与退休规划、年金估值的一致性以及对框架和选择架构的敏感性密切相关。论文提出，素养不应被视为年金需求的直接决定因素，而应视为限制人们将观察到的年金化行为解释为真实偏好表达程度的约束条件。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将素养视为解读年金行为的约束条件而非直接驱动因素，为低年金化之谜提供了新颖的理论视角。

title: Optimal Medical Liability for AI
abstract: I study medical liability when artificial intelligence acts as a doctor rather than as a passive clinical tool. The central object is the legally usable medical record: the inputs, logs, warnings, prescriptions, follow-up instructions, and outcomes on which courts, contracts, insurers, and regulators can condition responsibility. I show that AI medical liability is an institutional design problem under imperfect legal information. If the record separates AI-controllable error from patient nonadherence and natural disease progression, high-powered AI-fault liability implements the standard accident-law ideal. If the record is coarse, the first best may be infeasible: the same transfer that disciplines the AI also insures the patient's hidden action. With joint causation, the relevant object is a marginal-responsibility score rather than a posterior cause label. I characterize the feasible set of liability incentives generated by the record and show when the optimal rule is no liability, strict liability, negligence, a safe harbor, comparative fault, or a continuous warranty. I then study algorithmic defensive design, through which AI developers can design not only medical recommendations but also the record on which future liability depends. Adoption, learning, enterprise liability, insurance, no-fault compensation, and regulation enter as ways to change the record, the liable entity, or the financing of compensation. The framework yields conditional implications rather than a one-size-fits-all rule.
summary: 本文研究当人工智能作为医生（而非被动临床工具）时的医疗责任问题。核心概念是“合法可用的医疗记录”，即法院、合同、保险公司和监管机构可据此划分责任的输入、日志、警告、处方、随访指示和结果。作者表明，在不完美法律信息下，AI医疗责任是一个制度设计问题。如果记录能区分AI可控错误、患者不依从和自然疾病进展，则基于AI过错的高强度责任可实现标准事故法理想；若记录粗糙，则最优可能不可行，因为约束AI的同一转移也保险了患者的隐藏行为。在共同因果关系下，相关对象是边际责任分数而非事后原因标签。论文刻画了记录产生的可行责任激励集，并展示了最优规则何时为无责任、严格责任、过失责任、安全港、比较过失或连续担保。随后研究了算法防御性设计，即AI开发者不仅设计医疗建议，还设计未来责任所依赖的记录。采纳、学习、企业责任、保险、无过错补偿和监管作为改变记录、责任实体或补偿融资的方式进入分析。该框架产生条件性含义而非一刀切规则。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将AI医疗责任纳入制度设计框架，强调法律记录的信息角色，并提供了不同记录精细度下最优责任规则的条件性结论，对AI监管具有理论指导意义。

title: Beliefs and Actions under Government Policy Uncertainty: Evidence from Student Loan Forgiveness
abstract: How does uncertainty about future government policy affect households’ beliefs and subsequent borrowing, spending and debt payment behavior? We study these questions through the lens of student loan forgiveness in the United States, which following electoral promises, was announced in 2022 but never implemented due to judicial rulings. We conduct a customized information provision experiment embedded in a survey eliciting real-time beliefs about future debt forgiveness and repayment, which we link to credit bureau data, employment verification data, and nondurables consumption. Eligible borrowers who are more optimistic about forgiveness reduce payments on student loans by \$40 per month and increase non-durable spending by  $100 per month. We also find some evidence optimistic borrowers may postpone durable spending waiting for uncertainty to resolve. Borrowers  optimistic about future payment pauses make fewer payments on their student loans, reduce payment by $40 per month and are 7.5 percentage points more likely to be delinquent after payments resume. A quantification exercise finds welfare losses from incorrect beliefs can exceed 43 percent of the initial loan balance. Our results provide micro-evidence on the role of policy uncertainty in household decision-making, and have implications for government announcements and commitment policy.
summary: 本文研究政府政策不确定性如何影响家庭的信念及其后的借贷、支出和债务偿还行为，以美国学生贷款减免政策为案例。该政策于2022年宣布但因司法裁决未实施。作者通过嵌入在调查中的定制化信息提供实验，实时获取借款人对未来债务减免和还款的信念，并将其与信用局数据、就业验证数据和非耐用品消费数据相关联。研究发现，对减免更乐观的合格借款人每月学生贷款支付减少40美元，非耐用品支出增加100美元；乐观者可能推迟耐用品支出以等待不确定性解决。对未来还款暂停持乐观态度的借款人支付次数减少，月付降低40美元，且在还款恢复后违约可能性增加7.5个百分点。量化分析表明，错误信念导致的福利损失可超过初始贷款余额的43%。这些结果为政策不确定性在家庭决策中的作用提供了微观证据，并对政府公告和承诺政策具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 本文通过自然实验与调查数据结合，首次量化了政策不确定性对家庭微观行为的因果效应，揭示了信念偏差对福利的显著影响，为政策设计与沟通提供了重要参考。

title: Using Neural Networks to Guide Data-Driven Operational Decisions
abstract: We propose deep neural networks for data-driven stochastic optimization. Using historical data (covariates, decisions, costs), we propose to train a neural network to predict the objective value as a function of both the decision and covariate. After training, for a given covariate, this predicted objective is optimized over the decision variables using gradient-based methods with analytical gradients and Hessians. Performance is characterized by neural network generalization bounds. Comprehensive experiments on newsvendor, personalized assortment pricing, and call center staffing problems demonstrate our method’s strength over existing approaches such as conditional stochastic optimization and analytical approximations, especially when (i) the objective function is unknown, (ii) moderate to large data sets are available, or (iii) the problem structure resists simple parametric approximations. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization and decision analytics. Funding: The research of N. Chen is supported by the UTMM MARC Grant and the IMI Research Grant. The research of J. Milner is supported by NSERC [Grant 453954]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04141 .
summary: 本文提出使用深度神经网络进行数据驱动的随机优化。通过历史数据（协变量、决策、成本），训练一个神经网络来预测作为决策和协变量函数的目标值。训练后，对于给定的协变量，使用基于梯度的方法（具有解析梯度和Hessian矩阵）对决策变量优化预测的目标。性能由神经网络泛化界限表征。在报童问题、个性化定价和呼叫中心人员配置等综合实验中，该方法在以下情况下优于现有方法（如条件随机优化和解析近似）：(i) 目标函数未知时；(ii) 中等至大数据集可用时；(iii) 问题结构难以用简单参数近似时。
ai_comment: 该方法将神经网络嵌入优化框架，适用于目标函数未知的复杂场景，具有理论保证和广泛适用性。

title: The Variance Premium and Seasonal Momentum in Option Returns
abstract: We develop a model-free measure of the variance premium by constructing option portfolios whose returns are highly correlated with realized stock variance. This effectively decomposes returns into realized variance minus implied variance. We apply this decomposition to document a novel quarterly cross-sectional continuation pattern in both realized variance and implied variance of individual stocks. Implied variance underanticipates the seasonality of realized variance, so options that performed well at quarterly lags continue to earn high returns in the future. Quarterly periodicity in realized stock variance only occurs on days with analyst earning revisions, suggesting an informational channel for this pattern. (JEL G12, G13, G40)
summary: 本文开发了一种无模型度量方差溢价的方法，通过构建与已实现股票方差高度相关的期权组合，将收益分解为已实现方差减去隐含方差。利用这一分解，论文在个股的已实现方差和隐含方差中发现了一种新的季度横截面延续模式。隐含方差低估了已实现方差的季节性，导致过去季度表现良好的期权未来继续获得高收益。已实现方差的季度周期性仅出现在分析师盈利修正日，表明该模式存在信息渠道。
ai_comment: 该文提出了一个简洁的方差溢价测度，并揭示了期权收益中的季度季节动量，通过分析师盈利修正提供了信息解释，丰富了行为资产定价文献。

title: Climate Transition Beliefs
abstract: We study an overlooked driver of heterogeneity in green investment behavior: differences in expectations about the long-term trajectory of the energy transition (climate transition beliefs). Drawing on a survey of U.S. retail investors, we document considerable heterogeneity in climate transition beliefs at different long-term horizons. Transition optimism is positively associated with expected green financial performance and preferences for green investments, particularly among investors without strong pro-environmental attitudes. Two preregistered survey experiments provide causal evidence that transition beliefs play a key role in shaping green return expectations and investment decisions. Distinguishing between heterogeneous beliefs and preferences is crucial for a better understanding of the motivations behind green investment behavior. This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability. Funding: This work was supported by the Universität St. Gallen Basic Research Fund [Grant 2130787]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00564 .
summary: 研究了一个被忽视的绿色投资行为异质性的驱动因素：投资者对能源转型长期轨迹的预期差异（即climate transition beliefs）。基于对美国散户投资者的调查，发现不同长期期限下气候转型信念存在显著异质性。转型乐观与预期绿色财务表现和绿色投资偏好正相关，尤其是在没有强烈环保态度的投资者中。两个预先注册的调查实验提供了因果证据，表明转型信念在形成绿色回报预期和投资决策中起关键作用。区分异质性信念和偏好对于更好地理解绿色投资行为背后的动机至关重要。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分信念与偏好，揭示了绿色投资行为中预期异质性的重要作用，并利用实验方法提供了因果证据，对理解可持续投资动机有重要贡献。

title: The AI Democratization Paradox: Evidence from Decentralized Knowledge Communities
abstract: Does AI democratize knowledge production or amplify existing disparities? We investigate this tension by studying the deployment of neural machine translation across more than 100 Wikipedia language communities. Leveraging rich, fine-grained data and exogenous variation from a natural experiment, we uncover the “AI democratization paradox,” where the technology simultaneously drives democratizing and concentrating forces. AI lowered barriers, leading to a substantial increase in content creation across diverse target languages without sacrificing quality or readership. However, the benefits were concentrated: well-resourced communities captured disproportionate gains—three to four times larger than mid-tier editions. Whereas editors actively leveraged AI to address representation gaps, translating female biographies at twice the expected rate, structural constraints still limited the impact in high-need areas. We conclude that technological solutions alone cannot overcome structural inequalities; AI’s distributional impact is contingent on the interplay between technological capabilities and existing social structures. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Funding: This work was supported by the Wikimedia Research & Technology Fund and European Union – NextGenerationEU funds, Component M4.C2, Investment 1.1, PRIN 2022 PNRR, CUP: J53D23015440001. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04717 .
summary: 该论文研究了神经机器翻译在100多个Wikipedia语言社区中的部署，通过利用丰富的细粒度数据和自然实验的外生变化，揭示了“AI民主化悖论”：AI降低了内容创建门槛，导致不同目标语言的内容创作大幅增加，且未牺牲质量或读者群。然而，收益集中在资源丰富的社区，其收益是中端社区的3到4倍。编辑者积极利用AI解决代表性差距，翻译女性传记的比例是预期的两倍，但结构性限制仍然限制了高需求领域的影响。论文结论认为，技术解决方案无法单独克服结构性不平等；AI的分配效应取决于技术能力与现有社会结构之间的相互作用。
ai_comment: 本文通过自然实验设计，提供了AI对知识生产不平等影响的经验证据，揭示了技术赋能与结构性约束之间的张力。

title: Fund Flows, Liquidity, and Asset Prices
abstract: Unexpected fund flows may force mutual funds to liquidate assets, thereby depressing demand for securities that become illiquid during outflows. This paper shows that the liquidity beta on flows—defined as the comovement of a security’s liquidity costs with aggregate fund flow shocks—earns a significant risk premium in corporate bonds using firm-month fixed effects and a granular instrumental variables approach. The liquidity beta varies substantially even among bonds issued by the same firm and is largely driven by the interaction between redemption-driven forced sales and bond-level illiquidity. These findings highlight how fund flow shocks amplify liquidity risk through mutual funds' forced sales, shaping the cross section of expected corporate bond returns. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the University of Melbourne and London Business School. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01690 .
summary: 本文研究共同基金资金流冲击如何通过强制资产清算影响公司债券的流动性风险定价。利用公司-月固定效应和粒度工具变量方法，论文发现证券的流动性成本与总基金流冲击的协同变动（即流动性贝塔）在公司债券中具有显著的风险溢价。同一公司发行的不同债券之间流动性贝塔差异巨大，且主要由赎回驱动的强制销售与债券层面非流动性之间的相互作用驱动。这些结论揭示了基金流冲击通过共同基金强制销售放大流动性风险，进而塑造公司债券预期收益横截面的机制。
ai_comment: 论文从共同基金资金流冲击的角度创新地度量了流动性风险溢价，并利用同一公司内债券的异质性验证了强制销售机制，为流动性定价提供了微观证据。

title: Textual Analysis by Hedge Funds
abstract: Combining hedge funds’ quarterly position information with their access records on the SEC's EDGAR server, we explore whether hedge funds proactively gather and analyze textual information in 10‐K filings related to their stock holdings, and how these behaviors affect their positions. We find that hedge funds adjust their positions according to the textual information in the annual reports they download. Meanwhile, analyzing these reports helps them to generate excess returns. Overall, our evidence suggests that the textual content of annual reports contains crucial company insights, prompting a subset of hedge funds that engage in bulk downloads from the SEC's website to trade based on diligent analysis of 10‐K filings.
summary: 该研究结合对冲基金的季度持仓信息及其在SEC EDGAR服务器上的访问记录，探讨对冲基金是否主动收集和分析与其持股相关的10-K文件中的文本信息，以及这些行为如何影响其持仓。研究发现，对冲基金根据其下载的年度报告中的文本信息调整持仓，同时分析这些报告有助于其产生超额收益。总体而言，年度报告的文本内容包含关键的公司见解，促使一部分对冲基金基于对10-K文件的勤勉分析进行交易。
ai_comment: 该研究通过独特的EDGAR访问记录数据，直接揭示了对冲基金利用公开文本信息进行交易决策的行为，为文本分析在资产定价中的应用提供了有力证据。

title: Artificial Collusion: Examining Supracompetitive Pricing by Q-Learning Algorithms
abstract: We examine concerns that pricing algorithms, employing reinforcement learning, used by competitors would autonomously and systematically learn to collude. Findings of supracompetitive prices with Q-learning have recently raised that alarm. However, a detailed analysis of the inner workings of this algorithm type reveals that it often does not satisfy conditions for what constitutes “autonomous” algorithmic collusion that would be a cartel risk in practice. We find that Q-learning can learn collusive equilibria only on timescales irrelevant to the firm’s objective. Competitors are committed to using the same Q-learning algorithm, starting at the same moment, with the same hyperparameters and action spaces, although it is outperformed by the first alternative pricing rule. This level of synchronization suggests the need for an explicit cartel agreement. Our analysis gives criteria for practically relevant, explicitly and tacitly colluding pricing algorithms that would constitute a threat to competition. Whether autonomous algorithmic collusion is a potential threat to competition remains to be seen. There is not yet reason for competition agencies to be overly suspicious of pricing algorithms, other than of “collusion by algorithm,” in which pricing software is used to implement cartel agreements or is coded with collusive intent. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08557 .
summary: 本文研究了使用强化学习（特别是Q-learning）的定价算法是否会自主、系统地学会合谋，从而产生超竞争价格。尽管有研究认为Q-learning可能导致算法合谋，但详细分析表明，Q-learning只能在与企业目标无关的时间尺度上学会合谋均衡，且需要竞争对手在相同时间、使用相同超参数和动作空间同时启动同一算法，而这种同步性远不如简单的替代定价规则有效，实际上暗示了明确的卡特尔协议。论文提出了评估定价算法是否构成实际竞争威胁的标准，并指出目前竞争机构不应过度怀疑定价算法，除非算法被用于实施卡特尔协议或具有合谋意图，即“算法合谋”尚未构成实质威胁。
ai_comment: 该文澄清了Q-learning算法在合谋上的实际条件限制，为区分算法自主合谋与传统人为合谋提供了重要依据，对反垄断监管具有现实指导意义。

title: Doubly High-Dimensional Contextual Bandits: An Interpretable Model for Joint Assortment-Pricing
abstract: Key challenges in running a business include deciding which products or services to present to consumers (the assortment problem) and how to price products (the pricing problem) to maximize revenue or profit. Instead of considering these problems in isolation, we address assortment-pricing jointly and tackle the intrinsic doubly high dimensionality—both actions and contextual vectors can take continuous value in high-dimensional spaces. We propose a doubly high-dimensional contextual bandit model to formulate this problem. To circumvent the curse of dimensionality, our model is simple, yet flexible, capturing the interaction effects between covariates (context) and actions on the reward via a low-rank representation matrix. The resulting class of models is reasonably expressive while remaining interpretable through latent factors and includes various bandit and pricing models as special cases, making it suitable for applications involving simultaneous multiple decision-making beyond joint assortment-pricing. We develop a computationally tractable procedure that combines an exploration/exploitation protocol with an efficient low-rank matrix estimator. We provide a nonasymptotic instance-dependent regret bound involving dimensions and rank in addition to the time horizon. Simulations on standard bandit and pricing models—special cases of our model—demonstrate that our method yields lower regret than state-of-the-art methods. Real-world assortment-pricing case studies, from an industry-leading instant noodle manufacturer to an emerging beauty start-up, underscore the gains achievable using our method, showing at least three-fold gains in revenue/profit and the interpretability of the latent factor models that are learned. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: Financial support from The Wharton School [Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative Fund], the National Science Foundation [Grants DMS-2311072 and DMS-2515896), and the Office of Naval Research [Grant N00014-21-1-2842] is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08311 .
summary: 本文针对企业同时优化产品品类（assortment）和定价（pricing）以实现收益最大化的问题，提出双重高维上下文老虎机（doubly high-dimensional contextual bandit）模型。该模型应对动作和上下文向量均为连续高维的挑战，通过低秩表示矩阵捕捉协变量与动作对奖励的交互效应，在保持可解释性的同时具备灵活的表达能力，并将多种经典老虎机和定价模型作为特例。开发了结合探索/利用协议与高效低秩矩阵估计的计算方法，提供了依赖维度、秩和时间范围的非渐近遗憾界。在标准老虎机与定价模型的模拟中，该方法比现有方法遗憾更低；来自领先方便面制造商和新兴美妆初创公司的实际案例显示，收入/利润至少提升三倍，且学到的潜在因子模型具有可解释性。
ai_comment: 创新性地将品类与定价联合优化问题建模为双重高维上下文老虎机，低秩结构兼顾了模型表达力与可解释性，实际案例验证了显著的经济收益。

title: Insufficient Sleep and Intraday Financial Decision Making
abstract: Using online lending microdata, I show that sleep has important consequences for household financial outcomes. Insufficient sleep raises default risk, particularly for loan applications made in the morning when the effects of a lack of sleep are strongest. For identification, I apply a spatial regression discontinuity design leveraging exogenous discontinuities in sunset time across time zone boundaries, supplemented by analyses utilizing daylight savings time shifts. The results suggest that a behavioral mechanism behind this effect is increased levels of heuristic thinking in the application process, signaling a lack of deliberation in acquiring additional credit under the conditions of poor sleep. These findings are consistent with laboratory studies demonstrating that sleep loss is associated with lower risk aversion and impulsivity. Overall, this study provides the first evidence of the impact of insufficient sleep on household behavior and welfare in credit markets. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04031 .
summary: 利用在线借贷微观数据，研究睡眠不足对家庭金融决策的影响。通过空间断点回归（利用时区边界日落时间的外生不连续性）和夏令时变更分析进行因果识别，发现睡眠不足显著提高贷款违约风险，尤其在早晨申请的贷款中效应最强。行为机制表明，睡眠不足导致申请人更依赖启发式思维，缺乏审慎考虑，与实验室研究中睡眠损失降低风险厌恶和增加冲动性的结论一致。该研究首次提供了睡眠不足影响家庭信贷市场行为和福利的证据。
ai_comment: 利用时空自然实验（时区边界和夏令时）识别睡眠不足对家庭金融决策的因果效应，为行为金融和家庭金融领域提供了新颖证据。

title: The Debt‐Equity Spread
abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
summary: 本文提出一种衡量债务与股权之间估值差距的新指标——债务-权益利差（DES），定义为实际信用利差与权益隐含信用利差之差。实证发现，DES能够反向预测横截面上股票和债券的未来收益，且这种预测能力相对于现有的错误定价指标是独特的，不能被常见的风险因子所解释。此外，高DES的公司更倾向于发行股权并偿还债务，同时内部人卖出股权的行为也更多。这些结果与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的解释一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用债务与股权之间的定价差异构建了新的错误定价指标，并系统验证了其在资产定价和公司财务决策中的有效性，为理解市场分割提供了有力证据。

title: Measuring Organizational Capital
abstract: Prior research has pointed to differences in organizational capital as a reason for the persistent performance discrepancies among otherwise similar firms. In this paper, we develop and validate a new measure of organizational capital. Based on over a million crowd‐sourced employee reviews scraped from Glassdoor, we construct the measure of organizational capital at the firm‐year level using the word embedding model and ChatGPT‐generated synthetic reviews. Our measure varies over time in accordance with macro trends, and differs both across and within firms, reflecting firm heterogeneity and major internal changes. We validate our measure by testing empirical predictions of the properties of organizational capital discussed in prior literature. Our findings suggest that this measure captures a slowly evolving intangible asset that is significantly associated with firm performance and top management's influence, aligning with the conceptualization of organizational capital by Dessein and Prat. We further showcase applications of our measure in accounting, economics, finance, and management literature. Taken together, the paper provides implications for various stakeholders who are interested in assessing and managing firms' organizational capital.
summary: 该论文开发并验证了一种新的组织资本度量方法，基于Glassdoor上超过一百万条众包员工评价，使用word embedding模型和ChatGPT生成的合成评论，构建了公司-年度层面的组织资本度量。该度量随时间变化符合宏观趋势，在不同公司及公司内部均存在差异，反映了公司异质性和重大内部变化。通过测试已有文献中关于组织资本特性的实证预测，验证了度量的有效性。研究发现该度量捕捉了一种缓慢演变的无形资产，与公司绩效和高管影响力显著相关，与Dessein和Prat提出的组织资本概念一致。论文进一步展示了该度量在会计、经济学、金融学和管理学文献中的应用，为评估和管理公司组织资本的利益相关者提供了启示。
ai_comment: 创新性地结合众包评价与生成式AI构建组织资本度量，验证充分且跨领域应用前景广阔。

title: Firm-to-firm financial linkages and dollar risk transmission
abstract: We study how U.S. dollar fluctuations transmit through domestic supply chains in emerging markets. Large firms borrow in foreign currency and extend trade credit to domestic partners, exposing the supply chain to exchange rate risk. We develop a model where financially constrained suppliers pass through shocks to buyers, while unconstrained firms absorb them. Using quarterly firm-level data from 19 emerging markets, we provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s predictions. We find that even highly exposed firms reduce trade credit only modestly following a depreciation, while accepting large profit losses, suggesting that firm-to-firm credit relationships partially shield downstream firms from financial shocks.
summary: 本文研究美元汇率波动如何通过国内供应链在新兴市场中传导。大企业借入外币并为其国内合作伙伴提供贸易信贷，从而使供应链面临汇率风险。作者构建了一个模型，其中财务受限的供应商将冲击传递给买家，而财务不受限的企业则吸收冲击。利用19个新兴市场的季度企业层面数据，提供了与模型预测一致的实证证据。结果发现，即使高度暴露的企业在货币贬值后也仅适度减少贸易信贷，而承担了较大的利润损失，这表明企业间信贷关系在一定程度上保护了下游企业免受金融冲击。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了企业间金融联系在汇率风险传导中的关键作用，强调贸易信贷作为缓冲机制的重要性，为理解新兴市场供应链韧性提供了新视角。

title: Innovation without Borders? The Geography of Technological Diffusion
abstract: How well does innovation diffuse across geographic boundaries? To shed light on this question, we present a large-scale field experiment involving 3,300 firms across twelve European Union countries. We elicit firms' perceptions of the share of similar firms in their own country that had invested in artificial intelligence (AI), as well as the corresponding share among similar firms in Germany, France, and Italy. We randomly provide half of the sample with accurate information about both domestic and foreign AI investment. We show that firms substantially underestimate competitors' current AI investment, both domestically and abroad, and that they update their expectations about competitors' future AI investment in response to the information treatment. The treatment also causes a statistically significant increase in firms' own expected AI investment rate (p-value < 0.001). We find strong strategic complementarities within borders: a 1 pp increase in the expected share of domestic peers investing in AI raises a firm's own expected AI investment rate by 0.570 pp. These complementarities are absent across borders: the effect of an increase in the expected share of foreign peers investing in AI on a firm's own expected AI investment rate is statistically insignificant. Overall, our evidence shows that innovation diffusion and strategic complementarities in AI investment are much stronger domestically than internationally.
summary: 本文通过一项涉及12个欧盟国家3300家企业的实地实验，研究创新是否跨越地理边界扩散。实验首先调查企业对本国及德国、法国、意大利类似企业已投资人工智能（AI）比例的认知，然后随机向一半样本提供国内外AI投资的真实信息。结果发现，企业显著低估了国内外竞争对手当前的AI投资，且信息干预后企业会更新对竞争对手未来投资的预期，并导致自身预期AI投资率显著增加（p值<0.001）。国内存在强战略互补性：预期国内同行投资比例上升1个百分点，企业自身预期投资率上升0.570个百分点；而跨境互补性统计不显著。结论表明，AI投资的创新扩散和战略互补性在国内远强于国际。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模实地实验量化了创新扩散中的地理边界效应，揭示了国内与跨境战略互补性的显著差异，为理解企业技术采纳行为的本地偏倚提供了新颖且坚实的实证证据。

title: But I Like Doing This! Enjoyable Tasks, Contracting, and Automation
abstract: Workers sometimes enjoy productive tasks and voluntarily devote unpaid time to them. We study O-ring jobs in which firms can either price a complete task bundle or specify paid task floors while workers remain free to add time. For any allocation supported by both hourly contracts, the wage bill is identical: voluntary top-up is not a discount. The contracts differ because paid floors cannot cap attractive tasks below the worker's voluntary supply. This implementability constraint adds a containment motive for automation alongside replacement and scale effects. It also makes payroll measures incomplete: conditional on a common automated set and a common AI technology, jobs with the same payroll footprint can differ in worked time and task mix. Rich salaried bundle pricing removes the hourly-contract distortion.
summary: 本文研究工人在喜欢某些生产性任务时自愿投入无偿时间的现象。分析O型工作（O-ring jobs）中企业的两种合同选择：要么为完整任务包定价，要么设定有偿任务底限而允许工人自由增加时间。在小时合同支持下，任何可实现的分配对应的工资单相同，即自愿补充非折扣。两种合同的区别在于，有偿底限无法将吸引人的任务限制在工人自愿供给以下，这种可实施性约束引入了自动化的遏制动机，与替代效应和规模效应并存。同时，这使得工资单度量不完整：在共同自动化和共同AI技术条件下，相同工资单的工作可能在劳动时间和任务组合上存在差异。丰富的薪资捆绑定价可以消除小时合同的扭曲。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将工人对任务的偏好引入合同设计与自动化决策，揭示了“遏制动机”这一新维度，为理解自动化对劳动市场的影响提供了新视角。

title: Regional Economic Impacts and Emission Responses under Solar Radiation Modification
abstract: Solar Radiation Modification (SRM) has been proposed as a potential tool to limit increases in global or regional temperatures caused by anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions. While previous research has extensively examined the climate system’s response to various SRM strategies, as well as their aggregate economic consequences, the regional distribution of economic impacts has received less attention. In this study, we use NorESM2–DIAM—an Earth System Model coupled to a high-resolution integrated assessment model—to assess the economic impacts, measured in GDP per capita, in an idealised SRM scenario where incoming solar radiation is reduced by 1%. Our results suggest that, relative to a baseline without SRM, most countries experience economic gains under SRM, with only a few countries facing negative impacts. Low-income countries tend to see the largest benefits, reducing global economic inequality relative to the baseline. However, reduced damages and lower inequality are accompanied by higher emissions under SRM, potentially leading to additional adverse effects not captured here. These findings highlight potential trade-offs between economic benefits, reduced inequality, and increased emissions relevant for SRM governance.
summary: 本文利用地球系统模型NorESM2-DIAM（高分辨率综合评估模型耦合），评估了太阳辐射管理（SRM）策略（将入射太阳辐射减少1%）对全球各国人均GDP的经济影响。研究发现，与无SRM基准情景相比，大多数国家在SRM下获得经济收益，仅少数国家遭受负面冲击；低收入国家受益最大，从而降低了全球经济不平等。然而，SRM带来的经济损失减少和更低的全球不平等伴随更高的排放，可能引发未被模型捕捉的额外不利影响。这些结果揭示了SRM治理中经济收益、不平等减少与排放增加之间的潜在权衡。
ai_comment: 该研究首次使用耦合地球系统模型高分辨率评估SRM的区域经济分布，揭示了减少全球不平等与增加排放之间的关键权衡，为SRM治理政策提供了重要参考。

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Field Experiments to Explore Novel Features of Parental Speech and Foster Child Development
abstract: Parents play a critical role in shaping children’s skills during the first years of life. Yet, identifying the contributors to richer learning environments remains difficult due to various unobservable factors. In this paper, we combine field experiments with AI to explore new acoustic features of parental speech. Specifically, we develop a signal processing model that uses more than 600 hours of recorded parent-child interactions combined with assessment data from two home-visiting experiments conducted in the Chicagoland area to identify features of parental speech that map into children’s skills. Our two experiments consist of the same intervention helping parents provide nurturing interactions to their child. We exploit the experimental and natural variation in our data to explore two causal channels and one potential moderator. First, our intervention improves parental speech consistently across the two studies, as measured by acoustic features that are predictive of higher socioemotional skills and adult-child conversational turns. Further, we find that it also increases children’s language skills in both experiments, as well as socioemotional skills in the second experiment. Interestingly, our heterogeneity analyses reveal that some of the interventions’ impacts vary by socioeconomic groups, with patterns across the two experiments suggesting that the mechanisms are context-dependent.
summary: 本研究结合现场实验与人工智能，探索父母言语的新声学特征及其对儿童发展的影响。作者开发了一个信号处理模型，利用超过600小时的亲子互动录音以及芝加哥地区两项家庭访问实验的评估数据，识别与儿童技能相关的父母言语特征。两项实验均采用同一干预措施，帮助父母提供养育互动。通过实验和自然变异，研究探讨了两个因果渠道和一个潜在调节因素。结果表明，干预措施一致改善了父母言语（以预测更高社会情感技能和成人与儿童对话轮次的声学特征衡量），并在两项实验中提高了儿童语言技能，在第二项实验中还提高了社会情感技能。异质性分析显示，部分干预效果因社会经济群体而异，且两项实验的模式表明机制具有情境依赖性。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将AI声学分析与实地实验结合，揭示了父母言语中可干预的细粒度特征，并通过跨实验的异质性分析突出了情境依赖的社会经济差异。

title: Macroeconomic and Fiscal Consequences of Quantitative Easing
abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) has been criticized for helping fuel the post-COVID inflation boom and causing large central bank losses. In this paper, we argue that QE should be evaluated mainly on its ability to achieve core macro-objectives as well for its effects on the consolidated fiscal position of the government and central bank, although central bank losses can matter to the extent that they may weaken central bank credibility. Using a DSGE model with segmented asset markets, we show how QE can provide a sizeable boost to output and inflation in a deep liquidity trap and can reduce public debt substantially. This contrasts to the rise in public debt that occurs under fiscal expansion and makes QE an attractive tool in a high debt environment. There is more reason for caution in using QE in a "shallow" liquidity trap in which the notional interest rate is only slightly negative: QE runs more risk of causing the economy to overheat, especially if forward guidance has a strong element of commitment, and is more likely to generate sizeable central bank losses. Some refinements in strategy, including the use of escape clauses, can help mitigate overheating risks.
summary: 本文旨在评估量化宽松（QE）的宏观经济和财政后果。作者认为，QE应主要基于其实现核心宏观目标的能力以及对政府和中央银行合并财政状况的影响进行评价，尽管中央银行损失可能削弱其信誉。通过采用具有分割资产市场的DSGE模型，文章展示了在深度流动性陷阱中，QE能够显著提振产出和通胀，并大幅减少公共债务。这与财政扩张导致公共债务上升形成对比，使得QE在高债务环境下成为一种有吸引力的工具。然而，在名义利率仅略为负的“浅”流动性陷阱中使用QE需更加谨慎：QE更容易导致经济过热，尤其是在前瞻性指引具有强承诺成分的情况下，并且更可能产生可观的中央银行损失。一些策略改进，包括使用退出条款，有助于缓解过热风险。
ai_comment: 本文从财政整合视角重新审视QE，强调了其在降低公共债务方面的优势，同时指出了浅流动性陷阱下的过热风险与中央行损失问题。

title: What Investment Data Implies about the AI Transition
abstract: The five largest U.S. technology firms spent $380 billion on capital expenditure in 2025 and are forecast to spend roughly double that in 2026. These firms risk bankruptcy unless expected profits grow commensurately. We embed this observation in a two-sector open-economy model with rare productivity booms. We calibrate the boom size to match the observed increase in investment projected through 2027, implying that a boom raises AI-sector productivity by a factor of roughly 2.7. We then calibrate a two-year window of a 50% annual probability of an increase of the same magnitude, generating a range of scenarios consistent with the wide variety of industry forecasts, along with an elevated permanent probability tied to the valuation of the aggregate market. The implied additional cumulative GDP growth ranges from 5 to 58 percentage points by 2030, with AI shares of the economy ranging from 8% to 39%. Long-term annual growth is in expectation approximately 7% but with substantial risk. With risk aversion of 3, and an elasticity of intertemporal substitution equal to 1, the risk-free rate increases by approximately half a percentage point, and the equity premium rises by approximately 3 percentage points.
summary: 本文指出美国五大科技公司在2025年资本支出达3800亿美元，预计2026年翻倍，除非预期利润相应增长，否则这些公司面临破产风险。作者将此观察嵌入一个包含罕见生产率激增的两部门开放经济模型中。通过校准使得激增规模匹配到2027年观察到的投资增长，得出激增使AI部门生产率提高约2.7倍。随后校准一个两年窗口期，每年有50%的概率出现同等幅度的增长，产生一系列与多种行业预测一致的场景，以及一个与整体市场估值相关的永久性概率提升。模型预测到2030年，累计GDP额外增长从5%到58%，AI在经济中的份额从8%到39%。长期年增长率预期约为7%，但存在显著风险。在风险厌恶系数为3、跨期替代弹性为1时，无风险利率上升约0.5个百分点，股权溢价上升约3个百分点。
ai_comment: 该论文通过校准宏观模型，将AI投资、生产率增长与金融市场变量联系起来，提供了量化的增长和风险场景，对理解AI转型的经济影响具有启示意义。

title: Liquidity Support in Financial Institutions
abstract: We document a novel support mechanism in financial institutions—the direct flow channel—through which banks coordinate client investments to stabilize affiliated mutual funds facing severe redemptions. Inflows from banks’ retail and institutional clients offset a sizable share of outflows, mitigating adverse performance effects, forced sales, and redemption spillovers. Support via the direct flow channel is liquidity driven, concentrated in fragile but viable funds, and most pronounced when cash and family support are insufficient, while complementing credit lines when they are available. Importantly, we find no evidence that bank clients incur systematic costs, underscoring the stabilizing role of banks as coordination devices. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05036 .
summary: 本文记录了金融机构中的一种新型支持机制——直接流动渠道，通过该渠道，银行协调零售和机构客户的投资，以稳定面临严重赎回压力的关联共同基金。银行的客户资金流入抵消了相当一部分资金流出，从而减轻了赎回对基金业绩、被迫出售和传染效应的负面影响。直接流动渠道提供的支持是流动性驱动的，集中于脆弱但可行的基金，在现金和家族支持不足时最为显著，并在可获得信贷额度时与之互补。重要的是，没有发现银行客户承担系统性成本的证据，突出了银行作为协调工具的稳定作用。
ai_comment: 该文首次系统性地揭示了银行通过客户资金流入稳定关联基金的直接流动渠道，丰富了流动性支持和金融稳定领域的文献，且实证发现对银行在金融体系中的角色提供了新见解。

title: The Value of Last-Mile Delivery in Online Retail
abstract: Last-mile delivery, the most expensive stage of the shipment process, has become increasingly important in online retail, raising the strategic question of whether firms should outsource it to customers via pickup stations or offer home delivery. In this paper, we examine the economic value of last-mile delivery to inform this high-stakes decision. Partnering with Cainiao, Alibaba’s logistics platform, we exploit a quasi-experiment where home delivery service was sequentially rolled out to pickup stations in 2021. A staggered difference-in-differences design reveals that home delivery significantly increases sales and customer spending on Alibaba’s retail platform. Because last-mile delivery is labor-intensive and capacity constrained, effectively allocating delivery resources is crucial. To address this challenge, we propose a novel operations-aware targeting framework that integrates causal machine learning with constrained optimization to identify and prioritize the most valuable customers. The framework incorporates both capacity and fairness constraints to maximize sales while maintaining equitable service access. We further extend it with routing optimization, enabling value-aware delivery planning that jointly considers sales uplift and spatial efficiency. We demonstrate that the resulting targeting and routing policies significantly improve revenue performance. Taken together, we show that last-mile delivery is not merely a cost center but also a revenue driver. By adopting tailored logistics strategies that balance customer needs with resource constraints, online retailers can unlock substantial value and win the last mile of e-commerce. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03991 .
summary: 本文研究在线零售中最后一公里配送（last-mile delivery）的经济价值，特别是企业应选择外包给顾客自提（pickup stations）还是提供上门配送（home delivery）。通过与阿里巴巴物流平台菜鸟（Cainiao）合作，利用2021年上门配送服务逐步推广到自提点的准实验，采用交错双重差分（staggered difference-in-differences）设计，发现上门配送显著增加了阿里巴巴零售平台的销售额和顾客支出。由于最后一公里配送劳动密集且产能受限，有效分配配送资源至关重要。为此，本文提出一个新颖的运营感知目标框架（operations-aware targeting framework），将因果机器学习（causal machine learning）与约束优化（constrained optimization）相结合，以识别并优先服务最有价值的顾客。该框架融入产能和公平性约束，以在最大化销售额的同时维持公平服务接入。进一步扩展加入路由优化（routing optimization），实现价值感知的配送规划，同时考虑销售提升和空间效率。结果表明，目标定位和路由策略显著改善了收入表现。综上，本文展示最后一公里配送不仅是成本中心，也是收入驱动因素。通过采用适应顾客需求和资源约束的定制化物流策略，在线零售商能够释放巨大价值，赢得电商最后一公里。
ai_comment: 本文的亮点在于利用准实验设计识别了最后一公里配送的因果效应，并创新性地将因果机器学习与运营优化结合，为配送资源分配提供了可落地的决策框架。

title: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
abstract: Using two decades of French administrative data, we find that post‐leveraged buyout (LBO), target firms reduce within‐firm pay gaps while increasing profitability relative to control firms. Employee turnover drives the pay‐gap reduction. In target and control firms alike, turnovers reduce average pay more at the top of the wage distribution than at the bottom because separated employees are paid more—new joiners less—than similar employees, especially among skilled employees. LBOs amplify this effect through increased turnover among managers. Post‐buyout, p90/p10, gender, age, and managers/non‐managers pay gaps decline by 3%, 9%, 21%, and 4% and the employee pool becomes younger.
summary: 基于二十年的法国行政数据，研究发现私募股权杠杆收购（LBO）后，目标公司相对于控制公司缩小了内部薪酬差距，同时提高了盈利能力。薪酬差距的缩小主要由员工流动驱动。在目标公司和控制公司中，离职均导致工资分布顶端的平均薪酬下降幅度大于底端，因为离职员工的薪酬高于类似员工，而新入职员工薪酬更低，尤其在技能员工中。LBO通过增加管理层的流动放大了这一效应。收购后，p90/p10、性别、年龄和管理层与非管理层之间的薪酬差距分别下降3%、9%、21%和4%，员工队伍趋于年轻化。
ai_comment: 利用大规模行政数据深入剖析私募股权对内部薪酬结构的实际影响，揭示了员工流动作为核心机制，并细化了不同维度的薪酬差距变化，为相关研究提供了有力的微观证据。

title: Crypto Value, Factor Pricing, and Market Segmentation
abstract: In the largest data set of crypto assets to date, we uncover a significant value effect based on the active-addresses-to-market-cap ratio. The corresponding novel value factor, together with the crypto market, size, and momentum factors adapted to our sample, forms a four-factor model that explains the cross-sectional return variations better than existing benchmarks. We show that the crypto value premium is plausibly driven by compensation for on-chain activity risk. We also provide the first comprehensive classification of major cryptocurrencies based on their economic functionality. Applying methodologies from international asset pricing, we document significant market segmentation across the token categories, with nonmonotone dynamics and implications for crypto investment strategy and regulation. This paper was accepted by Christoph Loch, finance. Conflict of Interest Statement: L. W. Cong serves as a senior economist and senior economic advisor to Chainlink Labs; G. A. Karolyi serves as an ad hoc consultant to Avantis Investors. Funding: K. Tang’s work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72192802, 72342008]. W. Zhao’s work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72503258], the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [Grant 2025M773717], and the Innovation and Talent Base for Digital Technology and Finance [Grant B21038]. L. W. Cong’s work was supported by the Ripple University Blockchain Research Initiative. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05875 .
summary: 基于迄今为止最大的加密货币数据集，研究发现基于活跃地址数与市值比（active-addresses-to-market-cap ratio）的显著价值效应。构建了一个四因子模型，包含加密货币市场因子、规模因子、动量因子以及新发现的价值因子，该模型比现有基准更好地解释横截面收益差异。证据表明，加密货币价值溢价可能来自对链上活动风险（on-chain activity risk）的补偿。研究首次对主要加密货币进行了基于经济功能的全面分类。应用国际资产定价方法，发现代币类别间存在显著的市场分割（market segmentation），具有非单调的动态特征，并对加密货币投资策略和监管具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 该论文在最大数据集上创新性地提出基于链上活跃度的价值因子，并揭示代币类别间的市场分割现象，为加密货币资产定价研究提供了新视角。

title: Markovian Search with Ex Ante Constraints: Theory and Applications to Socially Aware Algorithmic Hiring
abstract: We study and develop an algorithmic framework for incorporating “ex ante” constraints—constraints on outcomes that hold only on average—into stateful sequential search problems with costly inspection. Our framework encompasses the classical Weitzman’s Pandora’s box and its extensions to joint Markovian scheduling, which model richer processes such as multistage search with multiple layers of inspection. Ex ante constraints are particularly motivated by social considerations in algorithmic hiring, where they can adjust outcome distributions to promote equity and access. Although most work in the algorithmic fairness literature in computer science and economics has focused on incorporating such constraints into machine learning tasks like classification and regression, far less attention has been devoted to operational problems such as sequential search, with their unique intricacies. Our work aims to bridge this gap. Building on the optimality of index-based policies in the unconstrained versions of these problems, we show that optimal policies under a single ex ante constraint (e.g., demographic parity) retain an index-based structure but require (i) dual-based adjustments of the indices and (ii) randomization between two such adjustments via a “tie-breaking rule,” both easy to compute and economically interpretable. We then extend our results to multiple affine constraints by reducing the problem to a variant of the exact Carathéodory problem and providing a polynomial-time algorithm that constructs an optimal randomized dual-adjusted index-based policy satisfying all constraints simultaneously. For general affine and convex constraints, we develop a primal-dual algorithm that randomizes over a polynomial number of dual-based adjustments, yielding a near-feasible, near-optimal policy. These results rely on the key observation that a suitable relaxation of the Lagrange dual function for these constrained problems admits index-based policies akin to those in the unconstrained setting. Finally, through a numerical study, we investigate the implications of imposing socially aware ex ante constraints and their socially desirable outcomes. This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science. Funding: R. Niazadeh’s research was partially supported by the Asness Junior Faculty Fellowship at The University of Chicago Booth School of Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04079 .
summary: 本文建立了一个算法框架，将事前约束（仅平均意义上成立的约束）引入具有成本检查的状态序贯搜索问题。该框架涵盖经典的Weitzman潘多拉盒子及其向联合马尔可夫调度的扩展，可建模多层检查的多阶段搜索。事前约束在算法招聘中尤其重要，可用于调整结果分布以促进公平。作者基于无约束版本中指数策略的最优性，证明在单个事前约束（如人口统计均等）下，最优策略仍保持指数结构，但需要对指数进行对偶调整，并通过“破冰规则”在两种调整之间随机化。对于多个仿射约束，问题被转化为精确Carathéodory问题的一种变体，并给出多项式时间算法构造满足所有约束的最优随机双调整指数策略。对于一般仿射和凸约束，提出一种原始-对偶算法，在多项式数量的双调整结果上随机化，得到近似可行且近似最优的策略。数值研究展示了施加社会意识事前约束的影响及其社会期望的结果。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将事前公平约束引入序贯搜索问题，并证明了指数策略在约束下的可扩展性，为算法招聘中的公平性提供了可计算的理论框架。

title: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
abstract: We study the interplay between a “one person-one vote” political system and a “one share-one vote” corporate governance regime. If shareholders push firms for more prosocial policies, political backlash may arise, undoing these initiatives. If public policy is frictionless, shareholder democracy becomes irrelevant: the political system fully offsets shareholder influence. With public policy frictions, prosocial corporations can mitigate regulatory shortcomings and enhance corporate public goods provision. Nevertheless, shareholder democracy can hurt citizens due to the representation problem: it favors the preferences of the wealthy. Investor diversification, pass-through voting, and corporate greenwashing have important implications for these trade-offs of shareholder democracy. (JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23)
summary: 本文研究“一人一票”政治体制与“一股一票”公司治理之间的相互作用。如果股东推动企业采取更亲社会的政策，可能会引发政治反弹，从而抵消这些倡议。当公共政策无摩擦时，股东民主变得无关紧要：政治体系完全抵消了股东的影响。但在公共政策存在摩擦的情况下，亲社会企业可以弥补监管不足，增加企业公共物品供给。然而，股东民主可能因代表性问题损害公民利益：它偏向富人的偏好。投资者多元化、传递投票和公司漂绿对股东民主的这些权衡具有重要影响。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将政治体制与公司治理相结合，揭示了股东民主可能对普通公民造成的负面影响，为企业社会责任的政治经济学提供了新视角。

title: Dynamic Portfolio Selection and Asset Pricing Under Neo-Additive Probability Weighting
abstract: We study a dynamic portfolio selection problem in which an agent trades a stock and a risk-free asset with the objective of maximizing the rank-dependent utility of their wealth at the terminal time of the investment horizon. Because of time inconsistency, we consider three types of agents, namely precommitted, sophisticated, and naive agents, who differ from each other in whether they are aware of the time inconsistency and whether they have self-control. Assuming a neo-additive probability weighting function, we solve the strategies of these agents. We find that the precommitted agent takes a loss-exit strategy, leading to a positively skewed terminal wealth, and that the sophisticated agent is less willing to participate in the stock market than the precommitted and naive agents. We also study equilibrium asset pricing and find that with a precommitted representative agent, stock returns exhibit a reversal effect, and the initial stock price is lower than in the case of a naive representative agent or a sophisticated representative agent. This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Research Grants Council, University Grants Committee [Grant GRF 14218022]. Y. Sun acknowledges financial support from a start-up fund at Peking University HSBC Business School.
