Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03551 .
summary: 本文研究动态投资组合选择问题，代理人在股票和无风险资产之间交易，以最大化投资期末财富的秩依赖效用。由于时间不一致性，考虑三种类型的代理人：预先承诺、老练和天真，它们在是否意识到时间不一致性以及是否有自我控制方面存在差异。假设新加性概率加权函数，求解这些代理人的策略。结果发现，预先承诺代理人采取损失退出策略，导致终端财富呈正偏态；老练代理人比预先承诺和天真代理人更不愿意参与股票市场。此外，研究均衡资产定价发现，当存在预先承诺的代表性代理人时，股票回报呈现反转效应，且初始股价低于天真或老练代表性代理人的情况。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将行为经济学中的概率加权与时间不一致性引入动态资产定价模型，揭示了不同代理人类型对市场均衡的差异化影响，为理解股票回报反转和参与度提供了新视角。

title: The impact of introducing a (nearly) redundant security: Evidence from Malaysian corporate bonds
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model in which firms issue nearly redundant securities to investor clienteles with participation constraints, with prices and demand determined endogenously in primary and secondary markets. The model characterizes how issuance costs, market frictions, and investor composition shape firms’ funding choices, equilibrium prices, and asset allocations. We test the model’s predictions using data from the Malaysian corporate bond market following the introduction of Islamic bonds. Consistent with the model, issuance decisions reflect trade-offs between collateral and liquidity benefits, Islamic and conventional bonds coexist without crowding out, and the expanded investor base increases access to debt financing.
summary: 我们开发了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业向具有参与约束的投资者客户发行近乎冗余的证券，价格和需求在一级和二级市场中内生决定。该模型刻画了发行成本、市场摩擦和投资者构成如何影响企业的融资选择、均衡价格和资产配置。我们利用马来西亚公司债券市场在引入伊斯兰债券后的数据检验了模型的预测。与模型一致，发行决策反映了抵押品和流动性利益之间的权衡，伊斯兰和传统债券共存而不相互挤出，且扩大的投资者基础增加了债务融资的可获得性。
ai_comment: 该文通过一般均衡模型框架，首次系统分析了近乎冗余证券（伊斯兰债券）引入对公司债券市场的影响，并利用独特数据验证了理论，为理解市场摩擦和投资者客户在融资中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Deep Parametric Portfolio Policies
abstract: We consider parametric portfolio policies of any complexity using deep neural networks to optimize investor utility. Risk aversion acts as an economic regularization mechanism, with higher risk aversion constraining model complexity. Empirically, Deep Parametric Portfolio Policies generate 43-102 basis points higher monthly certainty equivalent returns compared with linear policies. Looking beyond expected returns, nonlinear portfolio policies better capture the complex relationship between investor preferences and firm characteristics but the benefits of using complex models vary with investor preferences. Results hold across different utility functions and remain robust to transaction costs and short-selling restrictions. Overall, economic regularization constrains model complexity much like statistical regularization but emerges endogenously from investor preferences. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00721 .
summary: 本文提出使用深度神经网络构建任意复杂度的参数化投资组合策略，以优化投资者效用。风险厌恶作为一种经济正则化机制，较高的风险厌恶会约束模型复杂度。实证表明，深度参数化组合策略相比线性策略每月产生43-102基点的确定性等价收益提升。除预期收益外，非线性组合策略能更好地捕捉投资者偏好与公司特征之间的复杂关系，但使用复杂模型的收益随投资者偏好而变化。结果在不同效用函数下均成立，并对交易成本和卖空限制保持稳健。总体而言，经济正则化对模型复杂度的约束与统计正则化类似，但内生于投资者偏好。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将风险厌恶作为经济正则化机制，利用深度学习构建非线性组合策略，实证效果显著，为金融机器学习提供了新视角。

title: Dynamic Collusion, Vertical Competition, and Systematic Risk
abstract: This paper empirically investigates how exposures of an industry’s cash flows and stock returns to discount rate shocks are affected by the market concentration of its upstream and downstream industries. In the cross-section of U.S. industries, we find that industries’ cash flows and stock returns are more negatively exposed to fluctuations in the aggregate discount rate if their upstream or downstream industries are more concentrated. These industries also have higher expected stock returns and costs of capital. Our study highlights the role of vertical competition in determining firm risk exposure and expected returns. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: K. C. J. Wei received partial financial support from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project 15510222]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04715 .
summary: 本文实证研究上游和下游行业的市场集中度如何影响行业现金流和股票收益对贴现率冲击的暴露。基于美国行业横截面数据，发现若上游或下游行业更集中，则该行业现金流和股票收益对总贴现率波动的负向暴露更强，且预期股票收益和资本成本更高。结论强调了垂直竞争在决定企业风险暴露和预期收益中的关键作用。
ai_comment: 本文从垂直竞争视角揭示行业集中度对系统性风险的影响，为资产定价中风险暴露的决定因素提供了新证据。

title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework. (JEL D84, G12, G41)
summary: 本文提出了“部分均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变回报外推提供了微观基础：外推信念始终存在，但仅在特定时刻以爆炸性方式显现。论文正式区分了正常时期的冲击和“位移冲击”，并研究它们与外推信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生恒定的外推和动量效应；而在增加不确定性的位移冲击后，PET导致更强且时变的外推，从而引发泡沫和内源性崩溃。该理论在统一框架下解释了正常时期的市场动态和金德尔伯格的泡沫叙事。
ai_comment: 该文通过微观基础化时变外推，将正常时期与泡沫时期统一在一个理论框架中，具有重要的理论创新意义。

title: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes. Using textual analysis of 10-K filings, we identify stocks’ thematic exposures and construct each fund’s thematic concentration index (TCI) from its holdings. High-TCI funds significantly outperform, with a top-minus-bottom decile spread of 4.26% in annualized four-factor alpha. Managers’ thematic expertise is related to their undergraduate field of study. Outperformance arises from superior stock selection rather than theme-related timing, with an informational advantage on firm earnings, particularly in stocks exposed to themes related to managers’ undergraduate training.
summary: 该研究探讨共同基金经理是否通过主题投资策略（即选择受益于特定主题的股票）产生超额收益。利用对10-K文件的文本分析，识别股票的主题暴露，并根据基金持股构建每个基金的主题集中度指数（TCI）。研究发现，高TCI基金显著跑赢市场，最高与最低十分位基金的年化四因子alpha差为4.26%。经理的主题专长与其本科专业领域相关；超额收益源于选股能力而非主题择时，且经理对与其本科专业相关的主题暴露股票具有信息优势，尤其体现在公司盈利预测上。
ai_comment: 该文通过文本分析创新性地衡量基金的主题集中度，并揭示了经理教育背景对选股能力的影响，为理解基金超额收益来源提供了新视角。

title: Selecting and Testing Asset-Pricing Models: A Stepwise Approach
abstract: The asset-pricing literature emphasizes factor models that minimize pricing errors but overlooks unselected candidate factors that could enhance the performance of test assets. This paper proposes a framework for factor model selection and testing by (i) selecting the optimal model that spans the joint efficient frontier of test assets and all candidate factors and (ii) testing pricing performance on both test assets and unselected candidate factors. Our framework updates a baseline model (e.g., capital asset-pricing model) sequentially by adding or removing factors based on asset-pricing tests. Ensuring model selection consistency, our framework utilizes the asset-pricing duality; minimizing cross-sectionally unexplained pricing errors aligns with maximizing the Sharpe ratio of the selected factor model. Empirical evidence shows that workhorse factor models fail asset-pricing tests, whereas our proposed eight-factor model is not rejected and exhibits robust out-of-sample performance. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: G. Feng acknowledges financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant GRF11502023] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72203190]. G. Feng is partially supported by the InnoHK Initiative of the Innovation and Technology Commission of the Hong Kong SAR and the Laboratory for AI-Powered Financial Technologies. The research of W. Lan was supported by the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2022YFA1003702]; the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422020, 72333001, and 12531011]; and the Joint Lab of Data Science and Business Intelligence at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. The research of H. Wang was partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72495123 and 12271012]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07804 .
summary: 本文针对资产定价文献中因子模型选择的问题，提出一个同时考虑测试资产和所有候选因子的框架。该框架通过两步实现：首先选择能够张成测试资产和所有候选因子联合有效前沿的最优因子模型；然后对测试资产和未选中的候选因子进行定价测试。模型选择过程基于资产定价对偶性，即最小化横截面未解释定价误差等价于最大化所选因子模型的夏普比率，并采用顺序更新基线模型（如CAPM）的方式添加或移除因子。实证结果显示，主流工作因子模型未能通过资产定价测试，而本文提出的八因子模型未被拒绝，且具有稳健的样本外表现。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将未选中的候选因子纳入模型选择与测试框架，利用资产定价对偶性保证一致性，实证构建的八因子模型优于主流模型，为因子模型比较提供了新范式。

title: The Real Effect of Sociopolitical Racial/Ethnic Animus: Mutual Fund Manager Performance during AAPI Hate
abstract: During the 2020–2021 “AAPI Hate,” mutual funds led by female managers perceived as East Asian underperformed relative to other female managers. This effect is stronger in states with higher anti-Asian animus, among more actively managed funds, and when these managers hold sole or senior roles. Factors concurrent with COVID-19, including childcare challenges, concerns for overseas families, marketplace and workplace discrimination, and exposure to the Chinese economy, cannot explain the effect. Underperformance is traceable to poor stock picking due to impairments in generating private information. Racial-ethnic animosity, even outside workplace or marketplace, hinders productivity and decision-making in high-skill professions.
summary: 本研究考察了2020-2021年“AAPI仇恨”事件期间，被认为东亚裔的女性共同基金经理的业绩表现。研究发现，与其他人种/族裔的女性经理相比，这些经理的基金业绩显著更差。该效应在反亚裔情绪更高的州、更积极管理的基金以及经理担任唯一或高级职务时更加明显。分析排除了疫情期间的育儿挑战、对海外家人的担忧、市场和职场歧视以及中国经济敞口等竞争性解释。业绩下滑可归因于股票选择能力下降，具体表现为生成私有信息的能力受损。研究结论表明，即使发生在职场或市场之外的社会政治种族/族裔敌意，也会削弱高技能职业的生产率和决策能力。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将社会政治层面的种族敌意与金融市场专业人员的业绩表现联系起来，为行为金融学提供了来自真实世界的新证据，并揭示了偏见通过损害信息生成机制影响决策的具体路径。

title: Beliefs and Stock Market Fluctuations: New Evidence from the Past Seven Decades
abstract: We construct a new long-run series of subjective expected equity returns from an independent equity analysis firm, spanning 1956-2024. These expected returns are strongly positively correlated with the earnings-price ratio, respond negatively to past returns, and predict future returns. These patterns contrast with subjective expectations of individual investors and professional forecasters, which are weakly or negatively correlated with our new measure. Disagreement between sophisticated and individual investors is associated with higher trading volume. Our findings are consistent with a model of heterogeneous beliefs, where naive investors extrapolate past returns, rather than past dividends, while sophisticated investors are close to rational.
summary: 本文基于一家独立股权分析公司1956-2024年的数据，构建了一个新的长期主观预期股票收益序列。研究发现，该主观预期收益与盈利-价格比呈强正相关，对过去市场收益呈负向反应，并能预测未来实际收益。这些特征与个人投资者和专业预测者的主观预期形成鲜明对比，后两者的预期与本文衡量指标的相关性较弱甚至为负。此外，成熟投资者与个人投资者之间的预期分歧与更高的交易量相关。研究结果支持异质信念模型：幼稚投资者倾向于外推过去的市场收益，而成熟投资者则更接近理性。
ai_comment: 该研究构建了长达近70年的主观预期收益序列，为理解投资者预期差异及其对市场波动的影响提供了独特的历史视角，有力支持了异质信念理论。

title: AI for Structural Estimation
abstract: We develop a global method to solve and estimate dynamic equilibrium models that treats prices as pseudo parameters and market clearing as moment conditions, and reduces estimation time from days to minutes. Our approach leverages AI algorithms, software, and hardware, and has three building blocks. First, we extend the state space to include equilibrium prices and model parameters, which allows us to clear markets and estimate parameters by solving the model once. Second, we approximate the mapping between parameters and moments by training neural networks on model-simulated data, which act as closed-form expressions for moment conditions. Third, we use this mapping to estimate parameters by minimizing the distance between the model and data moments, and to find equilibrium prices by targeting a market-clearing imbalance of zero. We also use this mapping to assess identification globally, verifying if the estimation objective function has a unique minimum for each parameter. We illustrate our method by estimating a dynamic general equilibrium model of leverage and investment with three state variables, three controls, endogenous default, costly equity issuance, and non-convex adjustment costs. After four days, the traditional approach does not reach the loss we achieve in under 20 minutes. We build an AI agent that applies our method to new models from natural language prompts.
summary: 本文开发了一种全局方法，用于求解和估计动态均衡模型。该方法将均衡价格视为伪参数、市场出清视为矩条件，从而将传统需要数天的估计时间缩短至几分钟。方法基于AI算法、软件和硬件，包含三个核心部分：一是扩展状态空间，将均衡价格和模型参数纳入其中，使得只需一次性求解模型即可实现市场出清和参数估计；二是通过在模型模拟数据上训练神经网络，逼近参数到矩的映射，该映射充当矩条件的闭式表达式；三是利用该映射，通过最小化模型矩与数据矩之间的距离来估计参数，并通过设定市场出清不平衡为零来寻找均衡价格。此外，该映射还可用于全局识别检验，即验证每个参数的估计目标函数是否存在唯一最小值。作者通过一个具有三个状态变量、三个控制变量、内生违约、昂贵股权发行和非凸调整成本的动态一般均衡模型（杠杆与投资）进行示例：传统方法四天后仍未达到新方法在20分钟内实现的损失水平。文章最后构建了一个AI代理，能够根据自然语言提示将本方法应用于新模型。
ai_comment: 本文利用现代AI技术（神经网络与并行计算）颠覆了传统结构估计的速度瓶颈，并通过全局识别检验提升了方法可靠性；其将自然语言提示引入模型求解的AI代理设计，具有显著的自动化前景。

title: Medicare Home Health Fraud: How Much, Where, and Who?
abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it?  We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
summary: 本文研究Medicare家庭健康服务中的欺诈行为。作者将曾被联邦打击部队（strike force）起诉的家庭健康机构（HHA）定义为欺诈机构，并利用2009-2013年间九个联邦司法辖区（strike force运作区域）的Medicare索赔数据与手工收集的起诉记录，训练机器学习模型，预测其他85个司法辖区中每个HHA若存在打击部队时被起诉的概率。估算结果显示，2008年Medicare家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）来自欺诈HHA。此外，打击部队定位精准：其覆盖的九个辖区仅占家庭健康支出的40%，却包含了65%的欺诈支出。欺诈HHA呈现典型特征：更依赖高转诊量的医生、护理模式异常统一、且服务对象健康状况好于平均水平。
ai_comment: 该研究首次量化了Medicare家庭健康欺诈的规模，并验证了联邦打击部队的靶向有效性，为反欺诈政策提供了实证依据。

title: Deadly Stigma
abstract: How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.
summary: 该研究利用住院医疗环境中体重耻辱感的制度特征，在电子病历中BMI类别被清晰显示给医生，且肥胖在社会中受到严重污名化。通过断点回归设计，利用肥胖临界点处耻辱感离散变化而潜在特征（BMI）连续的特点，发现在该临界点处住院死亡率不连续增加，但患者健康状况并无差异。两种模式表明基于耻辱感的歧视是机制：刚肥胖患者比接近肥胖患者接受更少的诊断努力；通过医生验证的LLM分析临床笔记，发现临界点处污名化语言（如道德评判、削弱患者可信度、刻板印象）增加，尤其来自最具污名化的医生，他们也是死亡率结果的主要驱动。结论表明耻辱感是一种强大的社会力量，可能带来生死攸关的后果。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用医疗系统制度特征识别因果效应，结合LLM分析文本污名化语言，揭示了耻辱感对健康结果的实质性影响。

title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools
abstract: How do the productivity effects of AI evolve across successive generations of tools, and to what extent do task-level gains ultimately translate into final output? We study these questions in the context of software development, using data on more than 100,000 GitHub developers combined with their AI usage telemetry. In a matched event study design, we find that autocomplete, interactive coding agents, and autonomous coding agents each significantly increase coding activity (“commits”), with respective cumulative effects of 40%, 140%, and 180%. These gains, however, attenuate sharply across the production hierarchy: the 180% cumulative effect falls to 50% for the number of projects, and to 30% for actual releases. This pattern is consistent with the weak-link hypothesis: the strong productivity gains from AI are attenuated by human bottlenecks in the production chain, with an estimated elasticity of substitution of 0.25 between AI and human effort, which indicates strong complementarities. We further confirm these results across four major app marketplaces, finding a moderate increase in the number of new apps but no increase in total usage. Large task-level AI productivity gains have therefore translated only partially into shipped and used software thus far.
summary: 该论文研究AI编程工具在不同代际（自动补全、交互式编码代理、自主编码代理）对软件开发生产力的影响。使用超过10万名GitHub开发者数据及其AI使用遥测信息，采用匹配事件研究设计，发现三种工具分别使代码提交（commits）累积增加40%、140%和180%。然而，这些收益在生产层级中显著衰减：项目数量仅增加50%，实际发布（releases）仅增加30%。这一模式符合弱链接假说（weak-link hypothesis），即AI带来的强大生产力增益被生产链中的人类瓶颈所削弱，AI与人类努力的替代弹性估计为0.25，表明强互补性。此外，跨四个主要应用市场的数据证实，新应用数量适度增加，但总使用量未增长。因此，任务层面的AI生产力提升目前仅部分转化为已发布和使用的软件。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模实地数据揭示了AI编程工具在不同代际的显著生产力提升，但更关键的是发现了从任务到最终产出之间的严重衰减，强调了人类瓶颈的制约作用，为评估AI的真实经济影响提供了重要洞见。

title: The Growth and Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Asset Management
abstract: We examine the growth and performance of AI-driven investing. Using investment advisers' regulatory disclosures, labor market data, and fund strategy descriptions, we document that AI-driven investing has grown steadily since the early 2010s and is concentrated among hedge funds. AI hedge funds outperformed non-AI hedge funds in the early years, but this outperformance declined over time, even among early adopters. Contrary to concerns about AI-driven strategy homogeneity, AI hedge funds exhibit lower return comovement than non-AI peers. Our findings highlight both the alpha-generating potential and the limitations of AI as a source of investment performance.
summary: 本文利用投资顾问的监管披露数据、劳动力市场数据以及基金策略描述，系统地研究了人工智能（AI）驱动投资在资产管理行业的增长与表现。研究发现，自2010年代初以来，AI驱动投资稳步增长，且主要集中在对冲基金领域。早期AI对冲基金的业绩显著优于非AI对冲基金，但这一超额收益随时间逐渐下降，即使在早期采用者中也是如此。与市场对AI驱动策略可能导致同质化的担忧相反，AI对冲基金展现出比非AI同行更低的回报联动性。这些发现揭示了AI作为投资绩效来源既具有产生alpha的潜力，也存在局限性。
ai_comment: 该研究基于详实的数据实证了AI对冲基金业绩优势的衰减以及策略的异质性，为理解AI在金融市场的实际应用效果提供了重要经验证据。

title: Geopolitical Fragmentation, Sovereign Debt, and Dollar Dominance
abstract: Countries borrow in dollars because dollar debt markets are deep and liquid. This paper develops a theory of when that dominance becomes fragile because countries have inherited dollar liabilities but increasingly earn yuan-linked revenues. In the model, countries begin with dollar-denominated sovereign debt. Geopolitical fragmentation raises their yuan revenue share through two channels: higher trade barriers with dollar-linked markets shift exports toward yuan-linked markets, and higher costs of using dollars in that trade make yuan settlement more attractive. Governments then face a choice: repay dollar debt using revenues that are less dollar-linked, default, or restructure into yuan. The paper identifies a liquidity spillover from restructuring: dollar-to-yuan restructurings deepen yuan debt markets, lowering refinancing costs and encouraging additional restructurings. The model shows when fragmentation produces limited restructuring and when it triggers a self-reinforcing shift from dollar debt to yuan debt. A cascade requires the liquidity feedback from yuan restructuring to be stronger than the dispersion in countries’ yuan revenue exposure.
summary: 本文构建了一个理论模型，分析地缘政治碎片化如何通过两个渠道——提高与美元关联市场的贸易成本以促使出口转向人民币关联市场，以及增加使用美元进行贸易的成本——提升国家的人民币收入份额，从而动摇美元在主权债务中的主导地位。模型中，国家最初持有美元计价的主权债务；碎片化后，政府面临用与美元关联减少的收入偿还美元债务、违约或重组为人民币债务三种选择。文章识别出重组的流动性溢出效应：从美元到人民币的重组会深化人民币债务市场，降低再融资成本，进而鼓励更多重组。模型展示了碎片化何时导致有限的重组，何时触发从美元债务向人民币债务的自我强化转变，且这一级联效应需要人民币重组的流动性反馈强于各国人民币收入暴露的分散性。
ai_comment: 该理论模型创新性地将流动性溢出效应纳入国际货币主导权分析，为理解地缘政治因素如何通过债务市场自我强化机制挑战美元霸权提供了新视角。

title: Beyond Exposure: Predicting AI Adoption Based on Comparative Advantage
abstract: We document and explain the gap between measures of AI exposure and measures of AI adoption in the workplace. This leads us to propose a new AI adoption index based on comparative advantage. Using the representative German DiWaBe employee survey linked to worker and establishment information, we compare worker-reported AI use to prominent exposure measures and find that the relationship is weak. Motivated by this gap, we develop a framework in which adoption depends not only on technical feasibility (i.e., AI’s absolute advantage measured by exposure) but on profitability (i.e., AI’s comparative (dis)advantage relative to a specific worker), balancing AI productivity against AI user costs and worker productivity against wages. We operationalize this framework at the task level by (i) estimating worker productivity relative to pay, (ii) mapping exposure indices into AI productivity, and (iii) inferring task-specific AI user costs from revealed-preference adoption. The resulting occupation-level index accounts for almost 60% of cross-occupation variation in observed AI adoption, compared to 14% for an exposure-only model. The two approaches diverge substantially for approximately 30% of workers, highlighting that comparative advantage—not exposure alone—is crucial for assessing AI’s labor-market impact.
summary: 本文基于德国DiWaBe员工调查数据，对比了AI暴露度指标与员工自我报告的AI采用情况，发现两者相关性较弱。为解释这一差距，作者提出了基于比较优势的AI采用指数，认为采用取决于盈利能力（即AI相对于特定工人的比较优势），综合考虑AI生产率、用户成本以及工人生产率与工资。在任务层面通过估计工人相对于薪酬的生产率、将暴露度映射为AI生产率、以及从显示偏好推断任务特定AI用户成本来操作化该框架。最终的职业层面指数解释了跨职业AI采用变异的约60%，而仅基于暴露度的模型仅解释14%，表明比较优势而非单纯暴露度对评估AI的劳动力市场影响至关重要。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从比较优势视角重构AI采用度量，突破了传统仅关注技术可行性的局限，为精准评估AI对就业的实际影响提供了更可靠的实证工具。

title: An Unfunded Mandate? Medicaid Continuous Coverage Requirements and State Fiscal Burdens During COVID-19
abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures  emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
summary: 在COVID-19大流行初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月的《家庭第一新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对州医疗补助计划的收入和支出进行了重大调整。这些条款包括将州联邦医疗援助百分比（FMAP）提高6.2个百分点，从而增加了州的收入，但条件是必须遵守持续覆盖要求。后者通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关情况变化而失去资格的个人退出计划，提高了支出。虽然事前预期这些条款将导致相似规模的支出和成本，但事后结果尚未量化。全国范围内，我们估计各州在持续覆盖条款上的成本为1392亿美元，比通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异很大，成本超过收入的程度高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的程度高达人均838美元。联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出的基准参数是决定持续覆盖要求能否被视为未资助的联邦指令的关键因素。
ai_comment: 该论文首次对疫情期间持续覆盖条款的州级财政影响进行了全面量化，揭示了各州负担的巨大差异，并指出现有FMAP公式是决定是否构成未资助指令的关键。

title: How Much and How Fast Do Investors Respond to Equity Premium Changes? Evidence from Wealth Taxation
abstract: Using administrative panel data on Norwegian investors’ portfolios, we document strong but slow portfolio allocation responses to a persistent wealth-tax-induced shock to the equity premium. Short-run responses resemble the modest sensitivity documented using surveys. The longer-run responses are much larger and can be rationalized by moderate risk aversion. We document that equity premium shocks affect stock market entry but not exits, suggesting that entry costs dominate participation costs. Our finding of slow responses supports the asset-pricing literature that uses adjustment frictions to explain important asset-pricing puzzles, and has implications for optimal capital taxation when tax rates differ across assets.
summary: 使用挪威投资者的行政面板数据，本文记录了投资者对持久性财富税冲击导致的股权溢价变化表现出强烈但缓慢的投资组合调整反应。短期反应与调查中记录的适度敏感性相似，而长期反应则大得多，可以通过适度的风险厌恶来合理化。研究还发现股权溢价冲击影响股票市场进入而非退出，表明进入成本主导参与成本。缓慢反应的结果支持使用调整摩擦来解释重要资产定价谜题的文献，并对不同资产税率下的最优资本税具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的行政数据区分了短期和长期反应，并揭示了进入成本的主导作用，为资产定价理论和税收政策提供了新的实证证据。

title: Startups in Africa
abstract: We build new data on startups in Africa to study which types of financing these firms demand, how financing is allocated in practice, and the implications for startup creation and the composition of the sector. We combine a continent-wide founder survey, an incentive-compatible experiment estimating financing preferences, and venture capital (VC) deal records matched to founders’ education and work histories. We find that startups strongly prefer equity over debt, but equity is supplied mainly by foreign investors and flows disproportionately to foreign-connected founders. About 80 percent of VC deals involve a foreign investor, and more than 60 percent of funded founders have studied or worked outside Africa. A simple accounting framework shows that this foreignness reflects three main forces: scarce local equity capital, a thin pool of local entrepreneurs able to access startup finance, and frictions limiting local entrepreneurs’ access to foreign investors. Together, these forces reduce startup creation and tilt the sector toward foreign investors and foreign-connected founders.
summary: 本文通过构建非洲创业公司的新数据，研究这些公司需求的融资类型、融资分配的实际方式以及对创业创造和行业构成的启示。研究者结合了覆盖整个大陆的创始人调查、一个激励相容的实验（用于估计融资偏好），以及匹配创始人教育和工作经历的风险投资（VC）交易记录。研究发现，创业公司强烈偏好股权而非债务，但股权主要由外国投资者提供，并且不成比例地流向有海外背景的创始人。约80%的风险投资交易涉及外国投资者，超过60%获得融资的创始人曾在非洲以外学习或工作。一个简单的会计框架显示，这种外国主导反映了三个主要力量：稀缺的本地股权资本、能够获取创业融资的本土企业家人才库薄弱，以及限制本土企业家接触外国投资者的摩擦。这些力量共同减少了创业公司的创建，并使该行业偏向外国投资者和有海外背景的创始人。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模调查和实验设计，揭示了非洲创业公司融资中外国投资者的主导地位及其对创业生态的影响，为理解新兴市场创业融资提供了实证基础。

title: The Risk-free Rate and the Risk-adjusted Growth Rate
abstract: Several important questions — such as the possibility of debt-rollover without primary surpluses — turn on whether the present value of the aggregate endowment is finite, i.e., whether the economic growth rate under the “risk-neutral” measure, lies below the risk-free rate. It is tempting to argue that the endowment must be finitely valued, since there exist finitely-valued, non-depreciating assets whose cash flows are cointegrated with aggregate output. This paper shows why this argument is incorrect. A remarkable historical episode in which French government bonds were indexed to aggregate growth allows direct measurement of the risk-adjusted growth rate, which is found to exceed the risk-free rate.
summary: 该论文探讨了总禀赋现值是否有限的问题，这与无主要盈余的债务展期可能性等关键议题相关。通常认为，由于存在价值有限且不折旧的资产，其现金流与总产出协整，因此禀赋必然有限估值。本文证明这一论点错误。通过一个历史事件——法国政府债券与总增长挂钩，论文直接测量了风险调整后的经济增长率，发现其超过无风险利率。
ai_comment: 利用历史自然实验直接测量风险调整增长率，为理论辩论提供了实证依据，挑战了传统资产定价直觉。

title: Towards a Methodology for Measuring Rental Property Ownership in the United States
abstract: Roughly one-third of U.S. households rent their homes, yet measuring who owns rental property is difficult: ownership is frequently obscured by LLCs, partnerships, and other intermediary entities that separate legal from economic control. We develop a method that traces ownership through administrative records — combining deeds and property assessments with the Census Bureau's Business Register, IRS Schedule K-1 filings, and SEC filings on REITs — to identify ultimate owners and construct property portfolios across the full landlord size distribution. Applying the method to 11 large CBSAs, we find that individual landlords own a large majority of rental units, though their share varies meaningfully across markets. We also show that the widely used mailing-address aggregation approach both under- and over-states portfolio size in systematic ways. The method is designed to scale to national coverage and to support measurement of landlord identity, portfolio composition, and ownership concentration in U.S. rental markets. We also discuss the method's current limitations and outline directions for refinement and validation.
summary: 该论文旨在解决美国租赁房产所有权难以测量的问题，因为LLC、合伙企业等中介实体常将法律所有权与经济控制权分离。作者开发了一种通过行政记录追溯所有权的方法，综合运用契约、财产评估、美国人口调查局商业登记、IRS Schedule K-1申报表以及美国证券交易委员会关于REITs的文件，以识别最终所有者并构建覆盖全规模分布的房东投资组合。将该方法应用于11个大型核心统计区（CBSAs），结果显示个人房东拥有绝大多数租赁单元，但其市场份额在不同市场间存在显著差异。研究还发现，广泛使用的邮寄地址聚合方法会系统性地高估或低估组合规模。该方法旨在扩展至全国覆盖，支持测量美国租赁市场中房东身份、投资组合构成和所有权集中度，同时讨论了当前局限性并提出了改进与验证方向。
ai_comment: 该研究的亮点在于利用多源行政数据创新性地解决了租赁房产所有权追溯难题，揭示了个人房东的主导地位并指出了传统聚合方法的偏差，为全国范围的分析提供了可扩展的框架。

title: Defining Innovatisation: The Case of NewSpace and the Changing Space Sector
abstract: The space sector has become far more dynamic and innovative, with new actors (e.g., start-ups, venture capital) entering and the ever-growing importance of private firms. In this paper we introduce a novel concept, innovatisation, to understand this phenomenon. Innovatisation describes the transformation of a sector between two modes. In a mode of technological achievements (TA), only technological (not economic) performance matters, primarily for prestige purposes; in innovation, customer preferences, commercial opportunities, and costs become essential. Studying the economics of Apollo and the commercialization attempts of the 1980s, we show how the space sector has long featured a logic of TA. Then, analyzing recent trends, we provide quantitative empirical evidence (e.g., costs) that innovation now shapes the sector, thanks to various driving forces. The driving forces behind the innovatisation process are identified building on Jones (2022) and the disruptive innovation theory.
summary: 本文提出了一个新概念“innovatisation”，用以描述太空部门从“技术成就模式”（TA）向“创新模式”的转变。在TA模式下，只有技术（而非经济）表现重要，主要服务于国家声望；而在创新模式下，客户偏好、商业机会和成本成为关键。通过研究阿波罗时代和1980年代商业化的经济学，文章展示了太空部门长期存在TA逻辑。随后，通过分析近期趋势，提供了成本等方面的定量实证证据，表明当前创新模式已主导该部门，并基于Jones (2022)和颠覆性创新理论识别了驱动innovatisation过程的因素。
ai_comment: 该文提出了一个新颖的概念框架来理解太空产业的转型，并提供了量化证据，有助于解释私营企业日益重要的作用。

title: The Tragedy of Complexity
abstract: Complexity can create value. At the same time, understanding more complex goods requires more of an agent’s attention. We show that equilibrium complexity is generally inefficient when agents face competing demands on their limited attention. Because attention allocation is hump-shaped in complexity, equilibrium complexity is distorted toward intermediate levels: well-understood goods are inefficiently complex, whereas less well-understood goods are oversimplified. We apply our model to financial institutions facing regulatory bodies and CEOs interacting with corporate divisions. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program [Grant 715467].
summary: 本文研究复杂性在注意力有限的经济环境中的均衡效率。复杂性可以创造价值，但理解复杂商品需要更多注意力。当注意力有限时，均衡复杂性通常无效率，因为注意力分配在复杂性上呈驼峰形：对已被充分理解的商品，复杂性过高；对不太被理解的商品，复杂性过低。模型被应用于金融监管机构与银行、CEO与企业部门的互动中。
ai_comment: 该文通过注意力分配的驼峰形机制揭示了复杂性市场失灵的内在逻辑，为理解监管和公司内部复杂性设计提供了新视角。

title: The Interplay Between Product Variety and Customer Retention: Theory and Evidence
abstract: The optimal number of products to offer consumers is one of the core strategic problems that firms face. This is increasingly so in digital markets where many firms offer a large product variety. In these markets, consumers purchase products repeatedly, making customer retention an important aspect for firm performance. In this paper, we study the interplay between these two variables, product variety and customer retention. First, we provide a novel game-theoretic model to analyze this interplay and also determine how the optimal product variety depends on the market environment. Second, we provide suggestive evidence for our theoretical predictions using data for video games from Steam. Our data set allows us to measure the key variables in our game-theoretic model and additionally contains plausible instrumental variables for empirical identification. We show theoretically that investment in product portfolio size and investment in customer retention are substitutes because the former increases demand from switching consumers, whereas the latter increases the repurchase probability of current consumers. We then derive predictions on how market conditions determine a firm’s product variety, for which we find evidence in our empirical analyses: there is (i) a negative relation between product portfolio size and customer retention, (ii) an inverted U-shaped relationship between market value and product variety, and (iii) a positive relation between consumer heterogeneity and product variety. Both our theoretical and empirical results are robust to a wide set of robustness checks. This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG) [Grant 462020252]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00985 .
summary: 本文研究产品种类与客户保留之间的相互作用，这是数字市场中企业面临的核心战略问题。首先，作者构建了一个新颖的博弈论模型来分析两者关系，并探讨最优产品种类如何取决于市场环境。其次，利用Steam平台的视频游戏数据为理论预测提供经验证据，数据集包含关键变量和合理的工具变量。理论表明，产品组合规模投资与客户保留投资是替代关系，因为前者增加转换消费者的需求，后者提高现有消费者的重复购买概率。经验分析发现：产品组合规模与客户保留负相关；市场价值与产品种类呈倒U型关系；消费者异质性与产品种类正相关。理论和实证结果通过多种稳健性检验。该论文被《管理科学》接收，属于商业战略领域。
ai_comment: 通过博弈论模型与实证数据的结合，揭示了产品组合规模与客户保留的替代关系，为企业战略决策提供了新视角。

title: Cash Heterogeneity and the Payout Channel of Monetary Policy
abstract: This paper provides novel empirical evidence that cash‐rich firms have higher equity payouts and higher stock prices in response to expansionary monetary policy surprises. Stock prices rise despite weak cash‐flow, investment, and credit responses to monetary policy. I rationalize the empirical evidence in a heterogeneous‐firm New Keynesian model where firms finance investment with cash and equity issuance. Monetary easing weakens precautionary cash demand, leading cash‐rich firms to optimally allocate excess funds to shareholders. Since payouts are procyclical, cash‐rich firms earn higher returns in expansionary periods. My findings highlight a payout channel through which monetary policy impacts asset prices.
summary: 本文提供了新颖的实证证据，表明在扩张性货币政策冲击下，现金充裕的公司具有更高的股权支付和更高的股价。尽管现金流、投资和信贷对货币政策的反应较弱，但股价仍然上涨。作者在异质性企业新凯恩斯主义模型中合理化这一经验证据，模型中企业用现金和股权发行来为投资融资。货币宽松减弱了预防性现金需求，导致现金充裕的公司将多余资金最优地分配给股东。由于支付是顺周期的，现金充裕的公司在扩张期获得更高的回报。研究结果突出了一个通过货币政策影响资产价格的支付渠道。
ai_comment: 本文从现金异质性角度揭示了货币政策影响资产价格的新渠道，实证与理论建模紧密结合，为货币政策传导机制研究提供了新视角。

title: Detecting Informed Trading Risk from Undercutting Activity
abstract: We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, QIDres$QID^{res}$, the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times −1$-1$. When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by QIDres$QID^{res}$. Unlike prior measures, QIDres$QID^{res}$ is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The QIDres$QID^{res}$ measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.
summary: 本文提出一种简单的知情交易风险度量指标QID^{res}，定义为流动性报价改善与恶化比率的残差乘以-1。当知情交易风险增加时，流动性提供者减少竞争，报价下刺活动降低，这种变化在交易和报价数据中留下痕迹，被QID^{res}捕捉。与已有度量相比，QID^{res}易于构建、可日内计算且与流动性正交。在盈余公告前反映信息不对称程度、预测非计划新闻发布以及识别知情交易溢出效应方面，该指标优于现有主要替代指标。
ai_comment: 该指标简洁高效且正交于流动性，为日内信息不对称度量提供了新工具，具有重要的实证应用价值。

title: Are patents with female inventors under-cited? Evidence from text estimation
abstract: Utilizing leading machine learning techniques to analyze the textual content and quality of patents, we demonstrate that patents with female lead inventors are under-cited relative to what would be expected had the lead inventor been male. Male inventors are the greatest contributors to the undercitation of patents with female inventors, followed by female inventors and male examiners, while female patent examiners appear to be even-handed. Using market reactions to patents suggests no average difference in market value by the inventor’s gender. The results have potential implications for research conclusions that rely on citation-based assessments of patent quality.
summary: 本文利用前沿机器学习技术分析专利的文本内容和质量，发现女性主导发明人的专利被引频次显著低于若发明人为男性时的预期水平。男性发明人是导致女性专利被低估引用的最大贡献者，其次是女性发明人和男性审查员，而女性审查员则表现出公平态度。基于市场对专利的反应分析表明，发明人性别并未导致平均市场价值的差异。该结果对依赖引文评估专利质量的研究结论具有潜在影响。
ai_comment: 通过机器学习从专利文本中剥离质量因素，创新地量化了引用中的性别偏差，并揭示了不同群体贡献的异质性。

title: Investor Reliance on ESG Ratings and Stock Price Performance
abstract: We exploit a quasi-natural experiment, the change in Sustainalytics’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) rating methodology, which reassesses risk and inverts the rating scale, to examine how reliance on ESG ratings impacts stock returns. The change in the ESG rating influences stocks’ returns, but this is due to retail investors’ misinterpretation about the change in the ratings scale. Sophisticated investors, such as 13F institutions and short sellers, take advantage of individual investors’ blind trust in ratings by taking the opposite side of their trades. Our results highlight the potential for blind reliance on ESG ratings that can generate mispricing and inefficiencies, especially among less informed market participants. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Growing Resilient, INclusive and Sustainable (GRINS) [GRINS PE00000018 - CUP H73C22000930001]; European Commission as part of ESG UPTAKE project [101145727]; and Progetti di ricerca di Rilevante Interesse Nazionale (PRIN) as part of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR) [CUP H53D23002190006 and CUP H53D23008390001]. L. Pelizzon thanks the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE and the European Investment Bank Institute for EIBURS Project “ESG-Credit.eu-ESG Factors and Climate Change for Credit Analysis and Rating” for financially sponsoring this research. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08288 .
summary: 本文利用Sustainalytics环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级方法变更这一准自然实验，该变更重新评估风险并反转评级标尺，研究了投资者对ESG评级的依赖如何影响股票回报。研究发现，ESG评级变化会影响股票回报，但这主要是由于散户投资者对评级标尺变化的误解所致。成熟的投资者（如13F机构和卖空者）利用散户对评级的盲目信任，进行反向交易。结果突出了盲目依赖ESG评级可能导致错误定价和低效率，尤其是在信息较少的市场参与者中。
ai_comment: 本文通过准自然实验揭示了ESG评级对市场效率的潜在负面影响，特别是散户投资者的行为偏差，为理解ESG评级的信息价值提供了新视角。

title: Unified Moment-Based Simulation of Multivariate Polynomial Processes and Applications in Financial Engineering
abstract: I propose a general simulation scheme for multivariate polynomial processes, a class of stochastic processes for which the calculation of moments up to a fixed order requires only the computation of matrix exponentials. The methodology is based on the approximate computation of conditional moments given joint moments and on performing random sampling given such conditional moments. The general methodology can be adapted to the simulation of many stochastic models of practical relevance in financial engineering. It turns out to be very useful because it can be applied to stochastic volatility models (e.g., the Jacobi model) and commodity price models (e.g., the Pilipović model), for which semi-analytical European option pricing formulas or exact simulation schemes are not available, rendering it necessary to use approximations. I compare the proposed simulation schemes against various benchmarks and find that the new methodology improves the runtime/accuracy performances with respect to existing methods. This paper was accepted by Ata Baris, stochastic models and simulation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07645 .
summary: 本文提出了一种针对多元多项式过程的通用模拟方案，该类过程具有只需计算矩阵指数即可得到固定阶矩的性质。该方法基于条件矩的近似计算以及根据这些条件矩进行随机抽样。该通用方法可适用于金融工程中许多实际相关的随机模型，例如随机波动率模型（如Jacobi模型）和商品价格模型（如Pilipović模型），这些模型缺乏半解析欧式期权定价公式或精确模拟方案，因此必须使用近似方法。通过与多种基准方法比较，发现新方法在运行时/准确度性能上优于现有方法。
ai_comment: 该研究提供了一个统一的模拟框架，能够高效处理缺乏解析解或精确模拟的随机模型，显著提升了计算效率与精度。

title: The Age Gap in Mortgage Access
abstract: This paper uses a large data set of single family home mortgage applications to study the relationship between borrower age and application outcomes. Conditional on a rich set of observable characteristics, age is positively correlated with rejection probability and coupon rate. The results hold for young borrowers, implying that age, not just old age, is an important determinant of mortgage application outcomes. Empirical tests that exploit COVID-19 suggest that the rejection probability results are partly driven by age-related mortality risk. Survey data suggests that the pricing results are partly driven by insufficient shopping. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08264 .
summary: 本文利用大型单户住宅抵押贷款申请数据集，研究借款人年龄与申请结果之间的关系。在控制一组丰富的可观测特征后，年龄与拒绝概率和票面利率呈正相关，这一结果对年轻借款人也成立，表明年龄（而不仅仅是老年）是抵押贷款申请结果的重要决定因素。利用COVID-19进行的实证检验表明，拒绝概率的结果部分由与年龄相关的死亡风险驱动。调查数据表明，定价结果部分由购物不足驱动。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了年龄（包括年轻年龄）对抵押贷款获取成本的系统性影响，并创新性地通过COVID-19外生冲击和调查数据验证了死亡风险和购物不足两种机制，为理解信贷市场年龄歧视提供了新证据。

title: Cheap Stock Options: Antecedents and Outcomes
abstract: We examine the prevalence, determinants, and consequences of cheap stock. Practitioners have adopted the label “cheap stock” to refer to equity-based compensation granted before a firm’s IPO that uses a share price below the IPO price. Cheap stock grants have drawn regulators’ attention with the Securities and Exchange Commission frequently commenting on issues related to cheap stock when reviewing firms’ IPO registration statements. We find that the average firm’s IPO price is more than five times the exercise price of options issued in the fiscal year before the IPO. This divergence between the IPO price and the exercise price of recently granted options is greater for firms that grant more options, have larger public offerings, and have venture capital backing. Finally, cheap stock options are associated with higher CEO compensation, lower post-IPO investment, lower post-IPO stock returns, and greater IPO underpricing. Collectively, our results illustrate the extent of cheap stock option grants and how these grants influence firms’ post-IPO behavior. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: We thank Deloitte, the Mendoza College of Business, the Danish Finance Institute (DFI), and the Wharton-INSEAD Centre for Global Research and Education for financial support. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06121 .
summary: 本文研究了“低价股票期权”（指公司在IPO前以低于IPO价格的行使价授予的股权激励）的普遍性、决定因素和后果。基于样本发现，平均而言，公司IPO价格是IPO前一年内授予期权行使价的五倍以上。IPO价格与行权价之间的差距在授予更多期权、进行更大规模公开发行以及有风险投资支持的公司中更为显著。此外，低价股票期权与更高的CEO薪酬、更低的IPO后投资、更低的IPO后股票收益以及更大的IPO抑价相关联。这些结果揭示了低价股票期权的普遍程度及其对公司IPO后行为的影响。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统性地探讨了IPO前低价股票期权现象，揭示了其在公司治理和IPO定价中的重要作用，为监管机构提供了实证依据。

title: Intellectual property protection lost and competition: An examination using large language models
abstract: We examine the impact of lost intellectual property protection on innovation, competition, firm performance, and valuation. We consider firms whose ability to protect intellectual property (IP) using patents is weakened following a major Supreme Court decision. We use large language models (LLM) to identify firms’ patent portfolios’ exposure to this decision and find an unequal impact. Large firms gain and small firms lose. Large impacted firms benefit as their sales growth increases and their exposure to lawsuits decreases. Small impacted firms lose as they face increased competition, product-market encroachment, and lower profits and valuations. They increase R&D and nondisclosure agreements.
summary: 本文研究知识产权保护丧失对创新、竞争、公司绩效和估值的影响。以美国最高法院一项大幅削弱企业利用专利保护知识产权能力的判例为背景，利用大型语言模型（LLM）识别企业专利组合受该判例影响的程度。研究发现影响不对称：大企业获益，小企业受损。受冲击的大企业销售增长加快、诉讼风险降低；受冲击的小企业面临加剧的竞争、产品市场侵占、利润和估值下降，同时增加研发投入和非公开协议。
ai_comment: 创新性地使用LLM度量专利组合受法律判决的暴露程度，揭示出知识产权保护变化对不同规模企业的非对称影响，为理解制度冲击的异质性效应提供了新视角。

title: Government debt management and inflation with real and nominal bonds
abstract: Can governments use real bonds such as Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) to tame inflation? We propose a novel framework of optimal debt management with sticky prices and a government issuing nominal and real state-uncontingent bonds. A government debt portfolio with both nominal and real bonds helps completing markets unless the monetary policy stance renders them perfect substitutes. Under Full Commitment, the government borrows with nominal debt and accumulates real assets, to be able to use inflation to smooth taxes. With No Commitment, the government portfolio favors real bonds to strategically prevent future governments from monetizing debt ex-post. Quantitatively, our model with No Commitment is consistent with the small and persistent TIPS share in U.S. data. A higher TIPS share mitigates the commitment friction, and effectively curbs inflation.
summary: 本文研究政府能否通过发行真实债券（如TIPS）来抑制通胀。作者构建了一个包含粘性价格、政府发行名义与真实无意外债券的最优债务管理框架。研究发现，当政府具有完全承诺能力时，会借入名义债务并积累真实资产，以便利用通胀来平滑税收；而当政府缺乏承诺时，其债务组合更倾向于真实债券，以战略性防止未来政府事后对债务进行货币化。定量分析表明，无承诺模型与现实中美国TIPS份额较小且持久的特征一致。提高TIPS份额能够缓解承诺摩擦，有效抑制通胀。
ai_comment: 本文从最优债务管理视角揭示了TIPS在抑制通胀中的战略作用，特别强调了承诺摩擦对政府债务选择的影响，为理解现实中的TIPS份额提供了理论支持。

title: The Sisyphean Pursuit of Evidence for Poverty Traps
abstract: Much of development economics, both micro and macro, posits theories and explores the empirics of poverty traps. A common theory centers around asset-threshold poverty traps in which marginal returns to capital increase sharply over a certain threshold and financial markets are incomplete. This combination leads households above this threshold to prosper while those below continuously fall back, trapped in poverty. Yet in economics, as best as we can tell, far more papers assume such thresholds than empirically demonstrate them. In a key recent exception, Balboni et al. (2022) (hereinafter “BBBGH”) argues that data from Bangladesh identifies clear evidence of such a threshold at slightly above the cost of a cow for recent recipients of a big push transfer program. We apply this analysis to data from seven other similar programs in low-income countries and find no evidence of an asset-threshold poverty trap. We then return to BBBGH and argue that their data do not support the identification of a poverty trap, with the point of disagreement being a log-transformation challenge and a potential geographic confound. In long-term representative rural panel data from Bangladesh and Ghana we find no evidence of divergence away from any particular threshold. While the threshold theory is undoubtedly true for some households, we argue that the pursuit of clear evidence of an asset-threshold poverty trap for a broad population is likely an aspirational goal rendered unachievable by the intersection of a multitude of possible mechanisms as well as heterogeneous agents.
summary: 这篇论文探讨了资产阈值贫困陷阱的实证证据。多数发展经济学研究假设存在资产阈值贫困陷阱，即资本边际回报在某个阈值以上急剧增加，且金融市场不完善，导致阈值以上的家庭繁荣，以下的家庭陷入贫困。然而，大多数论文假设这种阈值而非实证证明。近期Balboni等人（2022，简称BBBGH）声称在孟加拉国一个大推动转移支付项目的数据中发现了阈值证据（略高于一头牛的成本）。作者将BBBGH的分析应用于其他七个低收入国家的类似项目，未发现资产阈值贫困陷阱的证据。重新审视BBBGH后，作者认为其数据不支持贫困陷阱的识别，存在对数转换问题和潜在的地理混淆。此外，来自孟加拉国和加纳的长期代表性农村面板数据也未发现任何特定阈值上的发散证据。论文总结认为，尽管阈值理论对某些家庭成立，但为广泛人口寻找资产阈值贫困陷阱的清晰证据可能是一个无法实现的目标，原因是多种机制和异质性主体的交织。
ai_comment: 该论文通过大规模复制分析，挑战了贫困陷阱实证证据的可靠性，揭示了方法论和数据处理中的关键问题，对发展经济学研究方法具有警示意义。

title: The Price of Protection: Tariff Incidence and Import Collapse under the Infamous Smoot-Hawley Tariff
abstract: Using newly digitized monthly data on the quantities and prices of imports as well as product-level data on tariff rates, we estimate that in the first year after the passage of the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act, imports facing rate increases fell swiftly and dramatically relative to imports not affected by tariffs: for a one-percentage-point increase in the tariff rate, they declined by an average of 4%. We also estimate that the incidence of Smoot-Hawley was almost entirely borne by U.S. importers. Using an open-economy model, we attribute our high measured short-run trade elasticity of greater than 4 to fixed exchange rates that the U.S. maintained with most trade partners in the first 15 months after enactment. Our model also suggests that Smoot-Hawley accounted for 27% of the decline in total US imports in the first year after enactment. Finally, we construct both partial equilibrium and general equilibrium welfare estimates of Smoot-Hawley. Both methods deliver welfare losses of about 0.2% of GDP, reflecting the high measured elasticity of substitution and low US import-GDP ratio.
summary: 本研究利用新数字化的月度进口数量和价格数据以及产品层面的关税税率数据，估计了斯穆特-霍利关税法案通过后第一年的影响。结果显示，面临税率上升的进口相对于未受关税影响的进口迅速且大幅下降：关税税率每增加一个百分点，进口平均下降4%。研究还发现，斯穆特-霍利关税的负担几乎全部由美国进口商承担。通过开放经济模型，将测量到的高短期贸易弹性（大于4）归因于法案实施后前15个月美国与大多数贸易伙伴维持的固定汇率。模型进一步表明，斯穆特-霍利关税占法案通过后第一年美国总进口下降的27%。最后，研究构建了部分均衡和一般均衡福利估计，两种方法均得出福利损失约为GDP的0.2%，反映了高替代弹性与低进口GDP比率。
ai_comment: 该论文利用新颖的月度数据精确估计了斯穆特-霍利关税的短期贸易效应，并揭示了固定汇率制度在高贸易弹性中的关键作用，为历史贸易政策后果提供了量化分析。

title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models
abstract: Large language models trained on unrestricted internet corpora inevitably embed information from the future, introducing lookahead bias that compromises the validity of backtests and causal inference in finance and the social sciences. Point-in-time language models—trained exclusively on text available up to each calendar date—eliminate this leakage by construction, but existing efforts typically produce models that lag substantially behind their unconstrained counterparts. We show that this performance gap can be narrowed through scale. Training decoder-only transformers with up to 4 billion parameters on 1 trillion chronologically filtered tokens from FineWeb, we construct a sequence of monthly model checkpoints spanning 2013–2024. Across a range of common-sense reasoning and language understanding benchmarks, our models approach the performance of leading open-weight models of comparable size (such as Gemma-3-4B and LLaMA-7B) trained on temporally unrestricted data, although a performance gap remains on several tasks. Finally, in a strict out-of-sample economic evaluation task, portfolios built from point-in-time embeddings achieve robust positive Sharpe ratios and perform close to full-sample counterparts that violate temporal validity, indicating that chronologically consistent language models can extract economically meaningful signals without relying on look-ahead bias. We release the complete pipeline—including dataset construction, training infrastructure, and evaluation code—to enable reproducible point-in-time language modeling and to support research applications that require strict temporal validity.
summary: 大型语言模型在无限制互联网语料上训练时，不可避免地嵌入未来信息，引入前瞻偏误，损害金融和社会科学中回测与因果推断的有效性。点时间语言模型——仅训练截止到每个日历日期的文本——从根本上消除了这种信息泄露，但现有努力通常导致模型性能大幅落后于无约束模型。本文通过规模扩展缩小了这一差距：在FineWeb的1万亿时间顺序过滤的token上训练了高达40亿参数的仅解码器变换器，构建了覆盖2013-2024年的月度模型检查点。在一系列常识推理和语言理解基准上，我们的模型接近同等规模领先开源模型（如Gemma-3-4B和LLaMA-7B）在时间无约束数据上训练的性能，尽管在若干任务上仍有差距。最后，在严格的样本外经济评估任务中，基于点时间嵌入构建的投资组合实现了稳健的正夏普比率，且表现接近违反时间有效性的全样本对应物，表明时间一致的语言模型可以在不依赖前瞻偏误的情况下提取有经济意义的信号。我们公开了完整流程——包括数据集构建、训练基础设施和评估代码——以实现可重复的点时间语言建模，并支持需要严格时间有效性的研究应用。
ai_comment: 通过扩大模型规模显著缩小了时间约束语言模型与无约束模型的性能差距，并在严格的金融经济评估中验证了其有效性与无偏性，为因果推断和回测提供了可靠工具。

title: Complex Modern Portfolio Theory
abstract: The literature has long wrestled with the practical usefulness of Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT), and extensive evidence shows its performance decreases rapidly with the number of assets (N ). We present several new and counterintuitive facts about MPT. Most importantly, the performance of MPT in fact increases with N once the number of assets exceeds the number of training observations (T ). This finding holds in a variety of settings: in conjunction with popular portfolio regularization methods, in a variety of asset universes, and when T is large or small.
summary: 文献长期探讨现代投资组合理论（MPT）的实际有用性，大量证据表明其表现随资产数量N增加而迅速下降。本文提出了几个关于MPT的新且反直觉的事实，最重要的是，一旦资产数量超过训练观测数T，MPT的表现实际上会随着N增加而提升。这一发现在多种设置下成立：连同流行的投资组合正则化方法、在多种资产范围内、以及T大或小时都成立。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了传统认知，揭示了MPT在N>T时的表现反转现象，为高维投资组合优化提供了新视角。

title: Will The University Endowment Tax Slow Scientific Progress? Evidence from Elite Economics PhD Programs
abstract: The 2025 university endowment tax hike and other sources of financial pressure may lead the schools that train the most prolific economics researchers to reduce graduate enrollment. Will this affect long-run research output? We use a novel sample of MIT Economics PhD program applicants to estimate the research value-added of eight elite schools. Our estimates mitigate selection bias by controlling for MIT admissions committee rankings—a remarkably strong predictor of long-run research success—and for applicant aspirations as revealed by their application portfolios. While rank controls substantially reduce estimated gaps between elite and non-elite graduates, large differences in value-added remain. Graduates of high-tax and other top-eight schools produce 60-75% more impact-adjusted publications than do comparable graduates from non-top-eight US schools. The elite-school advantage is especially pronounced for top five journal publications. Differences in research success within the elite tier, however, are relatively modest. The out-performance of elite-school PhDs does not appear to be explained by editorial connections or peer effects in elite programs.
summary: 本文研究2025年大学捐赠税上调及其他财务压力是否会导致培养最多经济学研究人才的精英学校减少研究生招生，从而影响长期研究产出。作者利用MIT经济学博士项目申请者的独特样本，估计八所精英学校的研究价值增量。通过控制MIT招生委员会排名（该排名是长期研究成功的强预测因子）以及申请者通过申请组合反映的意愿，缓解了选择偏差。虽然加入排名控制后，精英与非精英毕业生之间的估计差距显著缩小，但价值增量仍存在较大差异。高税收及其他前八名学校的毕业生在影响调整后的出版物数量上比美国非前八名学校的可比毕业生高60-75%，尤其在前五名期刊出版物上的优势更为明显。然而，精英学校内部的研究成功差异相对较小。精英学校博士生的优异表现似乎不能用编辑关系或同伴效应来解释。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用MIT招生委员会排名作为代理变量控制选择性偏差，为估计教育项目的价值增量提供了新方法；其发现对理解精英教育在科研产出中的作用及政策影响具有启示意义。

title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor
abstract: We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含美国所有企业（公有和私有）价值加权股权收益的Broad Market Factor (BMF)，并将其与仅包含公有企业的标准Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF)的差异定义为Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF)。研究发现，IFF不携带风险溢价，且与所有宏观经济代理变量不相关。使用VMF会低估大部分投资组合的CAPM beta和贴现率。在标准因子模型中用BMF替代VMF后，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象消失；跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。统一解释是IFF向VMF添加了未定价风险，扭曲了对定价市场风险暴露的横截面和时间序列估计。
ai_comment: 该论文通过构建包含私有企业的市场因子，揭示了标准市场因子中隐含的未定价风险对资产定价的扭曲，为规模异象和跨期风险收益关系的争议提供了统一解释。方法创新且结论对实证资产定价有重要启示。

title: Comparative Advantage and Openness under Global Fragmentation: Lessons from the Past 65 Years
abstract: This paper asks why openness has been such a strong catalyst for catch-up growth in some regions or countries, while in others openness has been followed by stalled convergence, divergence, or stagnation. We conclude that “openness” in today’s geoeconomically fragmented world is much more than trade intensity or trade integration. Positioning in trade networks, trade fundamentals, human capital, institutional capacity and stability matters for the potential for trade-induced productivity gains. We explore the global heterogeneity across continents between 1960 and 2024, unbalanced panel of up to 145 economies per year and estimate a growth equation using a dynamic approach for countries and years. We build a baseline equation relating real GDP growth to lagged income and growth. We complement the traditional drivers of growth by contorting for positionings variables the world economy: a proxy for economic integration measuring the number of regional trade arrangements ratified by each economy, a commodity dependence indicator; metrics related to export networks geoeconomic vulnerability (GeoV). measure country’s export position with geopolitically distant partnerships; geoeconomic connectivity (GeoC) measuring the degree that trade relationships are across greater spectrum of geopolitics. The GeoC measures external “connectors” positioning that may counterbalance costs of geoeconomic fragmentation by securing access to greeter variety of markets and resources. Notably, the Geoeconomic linkages add an important element of “positioning,” indicating that the more “geopolitically” connected is a country, the greater are the investment-growth links. A greater diverse positioning of countries’ economies improves their capacity to transform investment into output in a more diversified setting. This also indicate a lesser dependent growth on “momentum” by countries’ economy, pointing to a greater shock-absorption capacity, confirming the benefits of diversified structure for growth from investments facing pressures from fragmentation.
summary: 本文探讨为什么开放在某些地区或国家成为追赶增长的强大催化剂，而在其他地区却导致收敛停滞、分化或停滞。研究认为，当今地缘经济碎片化世界中的“开放”远不止贸易强度或贸易一体化，贸易网络定位、贸易基础、人力资本、制度能力和稳定性对于贸易驱动的生产率增长潜力至关重要。基于1960年至2024年跨洲的不平衡面板数据（每年最多145个经济体），采用动态方法估计增长方程，构建了将实际GDP增长与滞后收入和增长率联系起来的基准方程，并加入了经济一体化代理变量（各经济体批准的区域贸易协定数量）、商品依赖指标、出口网络地缘经济脆弱性（GeoV）以及地缘经济连通性（GeoC），后者衡量贸易关系跨地缘政治光谱的程度。研究发现，地缘经济联系增加了重要的“定位”要素：一个国家的地缘政治联系越紧密，投资与增长的关联越强；更多样化的定位提升了国家将投资转化为产出的能力，降低了对“动量”的依赖，增强了冲击吸收能力，证实了面对碎片化压力时多样化结构对投资增长的好处。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入地缘经济脆弱性和连通性等定位变量，为理解开放与增长的异质性关系提供了新视角，强调了贸易网络结构在碎片化时代的关键作用。

title: Preference for Explainable AI
abstract: Participants acted as loan officers deciding whether to approve real $10,000-loans issued by a private U.S. lender using an AI’s default-risk predictions. When explanations revealed that the AI penalized non-White or female borrowers, participants were more likely to override the AI’s profit-maximizing recommendation. When their bonuses depended on repayment, however, they sought predictions but avoided explanations, consistent with willful ignorance; this effect faded when explanations were framed as purely financial or demographics were hidden. A secondary experiment reveals a novel bias: participants failed to reason contingently and undervalued explanations even when these complemented private information and improved decision accuracy.
summary: 通过实验研究贷款决策中对可解释人工智能（AI）的偏好。参与者扮演贷款官员，使用AI的违约风险预测决定是否批准美国私人贷款机构发行的1万美元贷款。当AI的解释显示其惩罚非白人或女性借款人时，参与者更可能推翻AI的利润最大化建议。然而，当参与者的奖金取决于贷款偿还时，他们寻求预测但避免解释，表现出故意无知；当解释被框定为纯粹金融或人口统计信息被隐藏时，这种效应消失。第二个实验揭示了新的认知偏差：参与者未能进行条件推理，即使解释补充了私人信息并提高了决策准确性，他们也低估了其价值。
ai_comment: 该研究通过巧妙实验揭示了AI可解释性在道德与利益间的权衡，发现了故意无知和条件推理失败两种重要偏差，为算法公平性设计提供新视角。

title: The Heterogeneous Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
abstract: How does heterogeneity in banks' interest-rate risk exposure shape monetary policy transmission? We develop a quantitative macroeconomic model of heterogeneous banks to answer this question. We establish an irrelevance result: differences in interest-rate risk exposure between fixed- and variable-rate banking systems matter for transmission only when bank solvency concerns become relevant. Calibrating the model to the euro area, we show that idiosyncratic default risk pushes a substantial share of banks toward the solvency threshold, making heterogeneity quantitatively important. When policy rates rise, fixed-rate banks suffer net interest margin compression---funding costs increase while legacy loan income stays unchanged---eroding capital and triggering sharper deleveraging. The lending elasticity to monetary policy is one-third larger in fixed-rate economies. The effects extend to financial stability: tightening raises bank failure rates in fixed-rate systems while lowering them in variable-rate systems. The results provide a rationale for macroprudential and monetary policy coordination and for monetary policy gradualism.
summary: 本文研究银行利率风险暴露异质性如何影响货币政策传导。作者构建了一个包含异质性银行的定量宏观模型，发现一个无关性结果：固定利率与浮动利率银行系统在利率风险暴露上的差异只有在银行偿付能力问题变得重要时才会显著影响货币政策传导。通过将模型校准至欧元区数据，结果显示特质违约风险迫使大量银行接近偿付能力阈值，从而使异质性具有定量重要性。当政策利率上升时，固定利率银行因净息差压缩（融资成本上升而存量贷款收入不变）导致资本侵蚀，引发更剧烈的去杠杆；固定利率经济体中贷款对货币政策利率的弹性比浮动利率经济体中高出约三分之一。对金融稳定而言，紧缩性货币政策会提高固定利率系统的银行失败率，但同时降低浮动利率系统的失败率。上述结果为宏观审慎政策与货币政策的协调以及货币政策应保持渐进提供了理论依据。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的量化模型揭示了固定利率与浮动利率银行系统在货币政策传导中的不对称性，强调了银行异质性在金融稳定中的作用，为政策协调提供了新的理论支撑。

title: Unlocking Mortgage Lock-In: Equilibrium Effects in a Spatial Housing Ladder Model
abstract: Mortgage borrowers are "locked in": forgoing moves to hold on to low rates. Lock-in reduces both housing supply, through households who do not sell, and demand, through households who do not buy elsewhere, evidenced by a 40% drop in U.S. existing home sales between 2022 and 2024. We show that mortgage lock-in raises net housing demand: missing downsizers stay in larger homes, particularly in expensive areas, demanding more housing and offsetting a third of the aggregate house price decline caused by higher rates. Using individual-level mortgage data, we provide causal evidence that lock-in disproportionately reduces moves down the housing ladder. We design a spatial housing ladder model with long-term mortgages, which generates a distribution of locked-in rates and a causal effect on mobility consistent with the data, and use it to study the equilibrium effects of lock-in. A temporary rate hike causes lock-in, increasing aggregate house prices by 4.4% and rents by 1.5% relative to a counterfactual without lock-in, while mortgage borrowers' mobility falls by 25%. A $10k tax credit to starter-home sellers modestly increases mobility but raises trade-up home prices. We estimate a cost of $650k per marginal move, indicating that demand-based housing policies are poorly targeted responses to lock-in in our model.
summary: 本文研究抵押贷款锁定效应，即借款人为保持低利率而放弃搬家，导致住房供应（不卖房）和需求（不买房）减少，这体现在2022-2024年间美国成屋销售下降40%。研究发现，抵押贷款锁定提高了净住房需求：不愿换小房的家庭留在更大的住房中，尤其是在昂贵地区，这抵消了因利率上升导致的房价下跌的三分之一。利用个人层面抵押贷款数据，本文提供了因果证据表明锁定不成比例地减少了向下换房。作者设计了一个包含长期抵押贷款的空间住房阶梯模型，该模型能生成锁定利率分布并与数据一致的流动性因果效应，并用于研究锁定的均衡效应。临时加息导致锁定，与无锁定反事实相比，整体房价上涨4.4%，租金上涨1.5%，而抵押贷款借款人的流动性下降25%。对首次购房者卖家提供1万美元税收抵免能适度增加流动性，但会推高换房房价。模型估计每次边际搬家的成本为65万美元，表明在锁定情况下，基于需求的住房政策针对性不强。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将空间住房阶梯模型与长期抵押贷款相结合，量化了锁定效应的均衡影响，并揭示出需求方政策在应对锁定时的低效性，为理解当前美国住房市场低迷提供了新视角。

title: The (Lack of) Efficacy of Social Belonging and Growth Mindset Interventions Among College Students
abstract: Using four large-scale experiments across two major Canadian universities, we experimentally evaluate the effects of growth mindset and social belonging interventions on student outcomes. In a sample of nearly 12,000 students, we find no immediate or dynamic effects on student grades and no effect on persistence through university. We further combine survey and administrative data with machine learning methods to explore treatment effect heterogeneity, finding no evidence of meaningful variation in treatment effects across student subgroups. Despite the recent promise of these light-touch interventions, our findings indicate further research is required to identify the contexts in which their benefits generalize.
summary: 通过两所加拿大主要大学的四项大规模实验，本研究评估了成长心态和社交归属干预对大学生成绩和坚持学业的影响。在近12,000名学生样本中，没有发现这些轻触干预对学生成绩（无论是即时还是动态）或大学坚持度有任何影响。结合调查、行政数据和机器学习方法探索处理效应异质性，也未发现任何学生子群中存在有意义的效应差异。尽管近期对这些轻触干预寄予厚望，但研究结果表明需要进一步研究以确定其效益能够推广的情境。
ai_comment: 本研究通过大规模多实验设计，严谨地检验了流行教育干预的有效性，其无效结果对政策实践具有重要警示意义。

title: Industrial Concentration, Property Values, and Municipal Bond Spreads
abstract: This paper shows that the industrial composition of a city's local economy affects its municipal borrowing costs.  In a panel of 1,177 U.S. cities from 2005 to 2022, greater sectoral concentration magnifies default risk and raises bond spreads, especially for cities dominated by industries associated with low property values.  Instrumental variables exploiting national sector-employment trends and regional house-price variation support a causal interpretation. A calibrated model of city default suggests that the observed spread effect understates the gross risk created by concentration, because higher concentration can generate agglomeration benefits that reduce spreads, especially for high-property-value cities.
summary: 论文利用2005至2022年美国1177个城市的面板数据，研究城市经济产业结构集中度对市政债券利差的影响。研究发现，行业集中度显著放大违约风险并推高债券利差，尤其对于以低房产价值行业为主导的城市。通过工具变量方法，利用全国性行业就业趋势和区域房价差异，支持了因果解释。进一步，一个校准的城市违约模型表明，观测到的利差效应实际上低估了集中度产生的总风险，因为更高的集中度可能带来集聚效益，从而降低利差，尤其是对于高房产价值城市。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将产业组织与市政债券定价结合，利用工具变量策略识别因果，并揭示集聚效益对风险溢价的抵消作用，丰富了地方公共金融领域的研究。

title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
summary: 本文研究AI方法应用于大规模投资组合持有数据以改善宏观审慎金融监管。作者构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介的证券级持有数据，该模型整合经济先验，从投资组合的网络结构中学习资产和投资者的潜在表征。应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介，模型在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期））上显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，模型对资产回报横截面变化的解释力是传统方法的10倍以上，并在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。学习到的表征表明，持有网络编码了关于火线销售脆弱性的丰富经济可解释信息。模型是完全归纳式的，即使整个资产类别或投资者被排除在训练之外也能产生信息性估计。作者将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，证明即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，模型的预测信息通过加强政策干预的横截面针对性改善了福利，并展示了预测与结构性知识之间的互补性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将图深度学习与宏观审慎监管结合，利用大规模持有网络数据显著提升了危机预测和系统性风险度量能力，并嵌入政策框架论证了AI对福利的改进。

title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
summary: 该论文利用1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构约120万笔官方贷款和赠款的新数据库，研究国家驱动的跨境贷款。研究发现国际信贷呈现双重、国家依赖的结构：在和平等正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款；而在战争和金融危机等不利状态下，官方债权人大规模介入，这些官方流动由大国驱动、高度补贴，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本被忽视。
ai_comment: 论文通过构建长达两个世纪的官方贷款微观数据库，首次系统揭示了国际信贷中国家融资角色的双重性，对现有国际宏观经济学模型提出了挑战。

title: Credit Supply, Firms, and Earnings Inequality
abstract: We study the distributional consequences of monetary policy-induced credit supply in the German labor market. Firms in relationships with banks that are more exposed to the introduction of negative interest rates in 2014 experience a relative contraction in credit supply, associated with lower average wages. Within firms, initially lower-paid workers are more likely to leave employment, while initially higher-paid workers see a relative decline in wages. Between firms, wages fall by more at initially higher-paying employers. Our results suggest that credit affects the distribution of wages and employment both within and between firms.
summary: 本文利用德国2014年引入负利率政策的准自然实验，研究货币政策引发的信贷供给变化对劳动力市场分配的影响。研究发现，与银行关系更紧密的企业（即受银行信贷收缩影响更大的企业）经历了信贷供给的相对收缩，导致其平均工资下降。在企业内部，初始工资较低的工人更可能离职，而初始工资较高的工人则面临相对工资下降。在企业之间，初始工资较高的雇主其工资下降幅度更大。结果表明，信贷供给通过企业内部和企业间两个渠道影响工资和就业的分布。
ai_comment: 该研究从企业内部和企业间两个维度揭示了货币政策信贷渠道对收入分配的异质性影响，为理解货币政策的分配效应提供了微观证据。

title: California Billionaires: Wealth, Taxes, and Wealth Tax Revenue Estimates
abstract: This paper documents the wealth of California’s billionaires and the taxes they pay. California billionaires’ wealth exceeds $2 trillion today, the equivalent of 50% of California’s GDP. It has grown 144% from 2023 to 2025, fueled by the AI boom. Over the longer run, the real wealth of California’s billionaire class—the 0.0002% richest households—has been multiplied by 30 from 1982 to 2025, while average real family income in California has about doubled. California billionaires pay about 0.2% of their wealth in California income tax ($3.2 billion/year), representing 2.4% of total California income tax revenue on average over 2023-2025. Using Securities and Exchange Commission data from Alphabet, Meta, Oracle, and Nvidia since 2004, we estimate the trajectory of wealth, income, and taxes paid by the top 4 California billionaires—Page, Brin, Zuckerberg, Ellison (through 2020), and Huang (since 2021)—focusing on their business wealth. This group alone holds nearly $1 trillion in business wealth, almost half of total California billionaire wealth. For this group, wealth growth (+322% over 2023-2025) and low taxation (0.04% of wealth in annual California income tax) are more pronounced. The proposed one-off California billionaire tax of 5%, payable over 5 years, is both small relative to California billionaires’ wealth gains and large relative to the taxes they currently pay. We estimate that it could raise about $100 billion, with comparatively minor impacts on income tax revenue. Using empirical estimates of mobility responses to wealth taxation, we find that an annual wealth tax on California billionaires could raise substantial additional revenue even after accounting for income tax losses due to mobility.
summary: 本文记录了加州亿万富翁的财富及其缴纳的税款。加州亿万富翁的财富目前超过2万亿美元，相当于加州GDP的50%，并在AI热潮推动下从2023年到2025年增长了144%。长期来看，从1982年到2025年，加州亿万富翁阶层（最富有的0.0002%家庭）的实际财富增长了30倍，而加州平均实际家庭收入大约翻了一番。加州亿万富翁每年缴纳的加州所得税约占其财富的0.2%（32亿美元），平均占2023-2025年加州所得税总收入的2.4%。利用美国证券交易委员会自2004年以来Alphabet、Meta、Oracle和Nvidia的数据，本文估计了前四大加州亿万富翁——Page、Brin、Zuckerberg、Ellison（截至2020年）和Huang（自2021年起）——的财富、收入和纳税轨迹，重点关注他们的商业财富。仅这一群体就持有近1万亿美元的商业财富，几乎占加州亿万富翁总财富的一半。对于这一群体，财富增长（2023-2025年+322%）和低税率（每年加州所得税占财富的0.04%）更为显著。拟议的一次性加州亿万富翁税率为5%，分5年缴纳，相对于加州亿万富翁的财富增长而言较小，而相对于他们当前缴纳的税款则较大。本文估计该税可筹集约1000亿美元，对所得税收入的影响相对较小。利用流动性对财富税反应的实证估计，本文发现，即使在考虑流动性导致的所得税损失后，对加州亿万富翁征收年度财富税仍可筹集大量额外收入。
ai_comment: 本文利用详实的数据揭示了超级富豪财富激增与税收贡献极低之间的矛盾，为财富税政策提供了有力的实证依据。

title: State Dependence of Monetary Policy During Global Supply Chain Disruptions
abstract: We study how global supply chain disruptions affect monetary policy transmission. Post-pandemic evidence indicates surging transportation costs, goods-market imbalances, and rising prices. We develop a model in which logistical bottlenecks (upstream slack coexisting with downstream shortages) steepen the aggregate supply curve. This convexity amplifies price responses to monetary policy while dampening output effects. Threshold VAR and Local Projection estimates are consistent with this mechanism: during disruptions, contractionary policy reduces prices more at smaller output cost, easing the stabilization trade-off.
summary: 本文研究全球供应链中断如何影响货币政策的传导机制。基于后疫情时代的证据，运输成本飙升、商品市场失衡和价格上涨并存。作者构建了一个模型，其中物流瓶颈（上游闲置与下游短缺并存）使总供给曲线变得陡峭。这种凸性放大了货币政策对价格的反应，同时削弱了对产出的影响。门槛向量自回归（Threshold VAR）和局部投影（Local Projections）的估计结果与这一机制一致：在供应链中断期间，紧缩性货币政策在牺牲较小产出的情况下更有效地降低价格，从而缓解了稳定权衡。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论与实证相结合，揭示了供应链中断下货币政策传导的非线性特征，为理解后疫情时代通胀与产出权衡提供了新视角。

title: How Should Central Banks Respond to Commodity Price Shocks? Optimal Monetary and Exchange Rate Frameworks for Commodity-Exposed Economies
abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
summary: 本文研究了中央银行如何最优应对大宗商品价格冲击，并论证最优货币政策和汇率框架取决于经济体对大宗商品的暴露程度。作者构建了一个包含大宗商品进出口的灵活可解模型，其中国际金融条件可能随大宗商品周期变化，并在存在价格和工资刚性的条件下计算福利最优政策。主要发现：对于大宗商品出口国，稳定国内价格是福利最优的，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致；但对于将大宗商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上“看穿”大宗商品冲击对国内价格的直接和间接影响，这与仅“看穿”直接影响的早期发现和政策实践不同。汇率盯住制能够通过稳定工资和就业提高大宗商品进口国的福利，但并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴和发展中经济体中，由于金融条件与大宗商品周期联系更紧密，政策权衡更为突出，实施最优政策可能面临挑战，因为需要足够的可信度以在名义变量波动加剧时保持通胀预期锚定。
ai_comment: 本文创新地区分了大宗商品出口国与进口国的最优政策差异，并强调政策应“看穿”间接效应，为新兴经济体的政策制定提供了重要启示。

title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles
abstract: We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks —hedger of last resort— halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
summary: 本文利用巴西央行在外汇衍生品市场上的干预作为准自然实验，结合银行信贷（对企业）、银行外债和雇主-雇员三个行政登记数据，研究外汇干预在缓解全球金融溢出效应中的作用。研究发现，在美国缩减恐慌（Taper Tantrum）引发新兴市场汇率动荡后，外债较多的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，导致企业就业下降。随后，巴西央行实施大规模外汇衍生品干预（即“hedger of last resort”），将上述负面效应减半。基于2008-2015年面板数据，利用全球外汇冲击和本地外汇干预的变动，证实了上述结果及其套期保值渠道。然而，该外汇政策也带来了财政成本和道德风险问题。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的高频行政数据和准自然实验方法，首次量化了央行作为外汇衍生品市场“最后做市商”对缓解全球金融冲击的积极作用，同时也揭示了其财政与道德风险代价，为新兴市场外汇干预的有效性提供了新证据。

title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
summary: 本文研究公司债券市场中交易商报价的作用。尽管报价仅具有指示性，但更高的报价质量能降低交易成本并增加交易量。提供高质量报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理存货并吸引非关系客户订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美：最优报价常无法吸引订单，且交易绕过（trade-throughs）现象普遍。尽管如此，报价竞争依然重要，因为客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和游戏，因为更活跃的债券级别报价会带来更多的债券级别交易。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了公司债券市场中报价竞争的非完美性及其对交易价格和订单的影响，强调了报价在谈判中的重要性，挑战了报价为零和博弈的传统观点。

title: Global Capital and Local Assets: House Prices, Quantities, and Elasticities*
abstract: We estimate price elasticities of housing supply for U.S. cities by examining the impact of foreign purchases on housing prices and quantities. After other countries introduced foreign-buyer taxes beginning in 2011, both house prices and quantities increased more in locations with high foreign-born populations. A 1% increase in global capital inflows, instrumented with tax policy changes scaled by immigrant exposure, increased prices and quantities by 3% and 0.5%, respectively, over 2011–2018. We combine these estimates to construct new local supply elasticities. Compared to prior estimates, our elasticities are more inelastic and change cities’ relative rankings.
summary: 本文通过分析外国购房对房价和数量的影响，估计美国城市的住房供给价格弹性。利用2011年起其他国家引入外国买家税的政策外生冲击，以外国出生人口比例作为暴露度，构建工具变量。研究发现，全球资本流入每增加1%，房价和数量分别上升3%和0.5%（2011-2018年）。基于此估计，文章构建了新的地方供给弹性，相较于先前估计更缺乏弹性，并改变了城市的相对排名。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用外生政策变化和移民暴露度识别因果关系，所获弹性估计更符合现实且具有政策参考价值。
