title: Global Capital and Local Assets: House Prices, Quantities, and Elasticities
abstract: We estimate price elasticities of housing supply for U.S. cities by examining the impact of foreign purchases on housing prices and quantities. After other countries introduced foreign-buyer taxes beginning in 2011, both house prices and quantities increased more in locations with high foreign-born populations. An increase in global capital inflows, instrumented with tax policy changes scaled by immigrant exposure, increased prices and quantities over 2011–2018. We combine these estimates to construct new local supply elasticities, which average 0.26 and range from 0.06 to 0.9. Compared to prior estimates, our elasticities are more inelastic and change cities’ relative rankings.
summary: 本文利用外国购买行为对美国城市住房供给的价格弹性进行估计。通过2011年后其他国家引入外国买家税的政策变化，结合移民暴露度构建工具变量，分析全球资本流入对房价和数量的影响。研究发现，在2011-2018年间，全球资本流入的增加导致高移民人口地区的房价和住房数量显著上升。基于这些估计，本文构建了新的地方供给弹性，平均值为0.26，范围从0.06到0.9。与先前估计相比，新弹性值更缺乏弹性，并且改变了城市间的相对排名。
ai_comment: 利用外生政策变化识别供给弹性，提供了更可靠的估计，纠正了传统方法可能存在的偏差。

title: Dirty air and green investments: The impact of pollution information on portfolio allocations
abstract: We study whether access to local pollution information causes investors to make greener portfolio allocations, exploiting the rollout of air quality monitoring stations in India. Using a triple-differences framework on the trading records of 19 million investors, we show that retail investors’ holdings in “brown” stocks become more negatively related to local pollution after a nearby station appears. This effect is more pronounced on “alert” dates when air quality is reported to be harmful. The effect is strongest among tech-savvy investors likely “treated” by real-time pollution data, and younger investors, who may be more sensitive to environmental concerns.
summary: 本文研究当地污染信息获取对投资者绿色投资组合分配的影响。利用印度空气质量监测站逐步铺设的自然实验，基于1900万投资者的交易记录，采用三重差分法分析发现：在监测站出现后，零售投资者持有的“棕色”股票（高污染行业）与当地污染水平的负相关性增强，尤其在空气质量被报告为有害的“警报”日期更为显著。这种效应在可能被实时污染数据“处理”的技术娴熟投资者以及对环境问题更敏感的年轻投资者中最为强烈。
ai_comment: 利用大规模交易数据和自然实验，揭示了环境信息对个人投资者实际资产配置行为的因果影响，为可持续金融决策提供了微观证据。

title: Out of sight, out of mind: Divestments and the global reallocation of pollutive assets
abstract: We document a global reallocation of pollutive assets as a response to investor pressure: large firms facing increased investor pressure divest foreign-located pollutive assets to firms that are less in the limelight. There is no evidence of increased engagement in any other emission reduction activities. We estimate that 369 million metric tons (mt) of CO2e are reallocated via divestments in the post-Paris Agreement period. Our results indicate that investor pressure to decarbonize reshapes the global conglomerate structure of large firms.
summary: 本文研究投资者压力如何导致污染资产的全球重新分配。大型企业为应对日益增加的投资者压力，将其位于国外的污染资产剥离给不太受关注的企业，而并未显著增加其他减排活动。在《巴黎协定》签署后，通过资产剥离重新分配了约3.69亿吨二氧化碳当量。结果表明，投资者去碳化压力重塑了大型企业的全球集团结构。
ai_comment: 本文提供了投资者压力下企业通过资产剥离而非实质性减排来应对的实证证据，揭示了全球碳泄漏的新机制。

title: Investing with Purpose: Evidence from Private Foundations
abstract: We study the asset allocation and investment performance of U.S. private foundations that support the charitable sector. Large foundations generated positive risk‐adjusted returns before 2008, driven by early access to private equity and venture capital funds, but have underperformed since. The median foundation underperforms by more than 100 bps. Foundations with concentrated stock holdings achieve higher returns but assume more risk. Due to the constraints imposed by the 5% minimum spending rule and accommodating monetary policy, foundations increase risk‐taking and reach for yield. Over time, a conservative asset allocation decreases real wealth, reducing charitable giving.
summary: 本文研究美国私人基金会的资产配置和投资表现。大型基金会在2008年前通过早期投资私募股权和风险投资基金获得了正的风险调整后收益，但此后表现不佳。中位数基金会跑输基准超过100个基点。持有集中股票头寸的基金会获得了更高收益，但承担了更大风险。受5%最低支出规则和宽松货币政策的约束，基金会增加了风险承担并追求收益。长期来看，保守的资产配置降低了实际财富，进而减少了慈善捐赠。
ai_comment: 本文利用私人基金会的数据揭示了非营利机构投资行为的独特性，并指出监管政策（如最低支出规则）对投资决策有显著影响，对于理解慈善基金会的可持续性具有重要启示。

title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
abstract: We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
summary: 本文结合基金收益与文本数据，研究基金风险披露的信息含量。通过开发新指标INF，衡量已披露风险对基金收益的解释力。在控制市场风险后，平均INF为55%，进一步排除与基金名称或策略相关的风险后，INF仍达26-29%。发现INF的截面差异源于披露成本与收益的权衡：信息披露较差的基金更易收到SEC意见函并面临资金净流出，而信息含量高的披露能吸引机构资金流入，但业绩压力可能抑制披露意愿。总体而言，基金在透明度与维持竞争优势之间面临权衡。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用文本分析构建INF指标，实证揭示了基金风险披露与资金流动之间的因果关系，为监管和投资者提供了新的信息质量测度。

title: Know Your Users via Image Analytics Before Developing Posts: Data-Driven Optimization Framework to Enhance Social Media Engagement
abstract: Social media platforms are popular for advertisers to promote products to their audience via posts. Developing these posts with the appropriate number of image features is essential as these features enhance informativeness and visual complexity, impacting how users engage with posts. However, the existing literature offers a limited investigation into this topic, primarily examining low-level imagery information while overlooking high-level image features, cross-platform differences arising from different user expectations, and the tradeoffs firms must make in tailoring their strategies. To address this critical gap, we develop an optimization framework for analyzing and publishing social media image posts for different platforms within a firm’s limited budget. This optimization framework is grounded in empirical modeling of the association between image features and social media user engagement, with primary and secondary features identified using deep learning algorithms. We focus on secondary features because they add visual complexity and informativeness, are controllable by designers, and are costly to extract, underscoring the need to assess their value for engagement. We find a nonlinear association between secondary features and engagement that varies across the two platforms. The optimization framework, which models the nonlinear relationship and is tested on realistic scenarios, considers and compares our approach against commonly used strategies that allocate budgets solely based on the user bases of platforms, those that ignore secondary features, and those that do not use duplicate features that can enhance informational richness and context. We present key implications for firms seeking to maximize user engagement on social media platforms. This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: S. Kumar was supported by the Temple Center for International Business Education and Research. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01838 .
summary: 该论文针对企业在社交媒体平台上通过图像帖子推广产品时，如何确定合适的图像特征数量以最大化用户参与度的问题展开研究。现有文献多关注低层次图像信息，忽视了高级图像特征（称为二级特征）、跨平台用户期望差异以及企业在有限预算下的策略权衡。为此，作者开发了一个基于深度学习的优化框架，先利用深度学习算法识别图像的主要和次要特征，再通过实证建模分析二级特征与用户参与度的非线性关系，并发现这种关系因平台而异。该优化框架在真实场景中进行测试，与几种常见策略（如仅按用户基数分配预算、忽略二级特征、不使用重复特征）相比，能更有效地提升用户参与度。研究为企业在社交媒体上最大化用户参与度提供了关键启示。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将深度学习与优化框架结合，关注了图像二级特征的成本与价值，并跨平台验证了非线性关系，为企业社交媒体营销策略提供了数据驱动的决策支持。

title: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
abstract: This paper documents a new stylized fact: the cross‐sectional variation in CEO pay levels has declined precipitously in recent years. We offer one explanation for this decline, namely, firms are increasingly benchmarking CEO compensation to industry peers closest in size, thereby creating pay clusters. Our empirical tests provide support for this explanation and suggest that the rise of industry‐size benchmarking is driven by three institutional factors: the mandatory disclosure of compensation peer groups, proxy advisory influence, and say‐on‐pay regulation. Our findings highlight a consequence of adopting a one‐size‐fits‐all standard in the pay‐setting process.
summary: 本文发现了一个新的事实：近年来CEO薪酬水平的横截面变异显著下降。作者提出的解释是，企业越来越多地将CEO薪酬与规模最接近的行业同行进行基准比较，从而形成了薪酬集群。实证检验支持了这一解释，并表明行业-规模基准的兴起是由三个制度因素驱动的：薪酬参照组的强制披露、代理咨询机构的影响以及薪酬表决权监管。研究结果凸显了在薪酬设定过程中采用一刀切标准的后果。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了CEO薪酬趋同化的新现象及其制度根源，对理解薪酬设定实践和监管影响具有重要价值。

title: Trust, Financial Literacy, and Financial Behaviors: Shaping Retirement Security
abstract: We extend the literature on the importance of trust for financial behaviors by examining trust, financial literacy, and financial behavior related to retirement security. Using the Health and Retirement Study, we show that Trust in Financial Institutions aligns with behaviors supportive of retirement security, while Trust in Government Programs does not. We further document racial/ethnic differences: for White respondents, Trust in Financial Institutions relates positively to retirement outcomes, but not for Blacks or Hispanics. Moreover, Trust in Government Programs among minority households is linked to reduced stockholding and lower wealth accumulation. These findings inform efforts to strengthen retirement security.
summary: 本文基于健康与退休研究（Health and Retirement Study）数据，考察信任、金融素养与退休安全相关金融行为之间的关系。研究发现，对金融机构的信任（Trust in Financial Institutions）与支持退休安全的行为一致，而对政府项目的信任（Trust in Government Programs）则不然。此外，存在显著的种族/民族差异：对于白人受访者，对金融机构的信任与退休结果正相关，但对黑人或西班牙裔受访者则无此关联；少数族裔家庭对政府项目的信任与股票持有减少和财富积累降低相关。这些发现为制定加强退休安全的政策提供了参考。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地区分了两种信任类型，并揭示了信任对退休行为的种族异质性影响，为理解金融决策中的信任机制提供了新视角。

title: Divergence in Climate Change Communication: LLM-Based Evidence from the IPCC and the Press
abstract: Public summaries of IPCC climate assessments lean toward the more severe end of the technical evidence. The pattern appears at two stages: the IPCC’s lead authors and member governments produce the Summary for Policymakers (SPM) from the Technical Summary (TS), and newspapers then cover the SPM. We use LLMs to score about 114,000 matched claim pairs from all six Assessment Reports (1990 to 2023) and ten major US and UK outlets. Both stages systematically shift toward the more severe end of the source while staying inside the IPCC’s accepted scientific ranges. The shift comes mainly from emphasizing higher-impact magnitudes within reported ranges, less from uncertainty compression, and almost none from selecting worst-case emissions scenarios. Left- and right-leaning outlets show similar patterns.
summary: 该论文研究IPCC气候变化评估在传播过程中出现的偏差，发现公众摘要（如决策者摘要SPM和媒体报道）系统性地倾向于技术证据中更严重的一端。研究使用大语言模型（LLMs）对所有六次评估报告（1990-2023年）中的约11.4万个匹配声明对进行评分，并覆盖十家英美主要媒体。结果显示两个阶段均出现系统性偏移：IPCC主要作者和成员国政府从技术摘要（TS）生成SPM时，以及报纸报道SPM时。偏移主要通过在报告范围内强调更高影响幅度来实现，而非通过压缩不确定性或选择最坏排放情景。左翼和右翼媒体的偏移模式相似。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统量化了IPCC报告在传播链中的偏差来源和机制，利用LLM进行大规模配对分析的方法具有创新性。

title: Endogenous Task Bundling, Skills and Automation
abstract: Empirical measures of AI's wage effect typically hold fixed the bundle of activities a worker is paid for at its pre-AI shape. We argue that this assumption hides much of the action. When automation breaks a job apart, firms decide how to recombine the surviving activities; whether they rebundle them into one broad role or split them into specialist roles changes which surviving skills the labour market actually rewards. A skill that played no role in the pre-AI wage can become the dominant component of the post-AI wage, while a skill that anchored the pre-AI wage can disappear from the schedule. We develop an assignment model in which the priced human bundle is endogenous, and we use it to show that a fixed-bundle wage regression can mis-sign the effect of AI exposure. In general, the omitted-redesign bias has no unconditional sign: it is the residual covariance between exposure and role-specific redesign terms. Under explicit sufficient conditions, exposure-correlated unbundling loads specialist comparative-advantage premia onto the exposure coefficient, while exposure-correlated rebundling loads a different, often opposite, omitted term. The sign must therefore be measured from local post-AI partition changes rather than assumed from exposure alone.
summary: 本文质疑实证研究中常用的固定活动包假设（即工人获得报酬的活动集在AI引入前后不变），认为该假设掩盖了自动化对工资结构的关键影响。当自动化分解工作任务后，企业会重新组合剩余活动：要么将其合并为一个宽泛角色，要么拆分为多个专业角色，这改变了劳动力市场对幸存技能的定价。原本在AI前工资中无关紧要的技能可能成为AI后工资的主要组成部分，而原本重要的技能则可能消失。作者构建了一个内生人力活动包的分配模型，证明固定活动包的工资回归会错误估计AI暴露的影响。遗漏再设计偏差的符号无无条件确定性，它取决于暴露与角色特定再设计项的残差协方差。在充分条件下，与暴露相关的去捆绑会将专业化比较优势溢价加载到暴露系数上，而重新捆绑则会加载可能相反的遗漏项。因此，该符号必须从局部后AI的分区变化中测量，而非仅凭暴露假设。
ai_comment: 本文通过提出内生任务捆绑机制，挑战了固定活动包假设，为理解AI对工资的异质性影响提供了新的理论视角。其核心贡献在于揭示了遗漏再设计偏差的存在，并强调了局部后AI分区变化在测量中的重要性。

title: More Paths or More Contrast? A Theory of Experimentation Breadth
abstract: How should an organisation choose the breadth of its experimentation portfolio? Breadth has two distinct margins—the number of paths kept alive, and the degree of contrast among them—and prior research has largely studied them in isolation. We bring them into a single framework and show that they need not move together. Under a fixed experimentation budget, adding paths creates more chances to find a strong direction, but it also dilutes learning across paths and weakens the strongest feasible contrast. When the task is primarily ranking among already-viable alternatives, broader portfolios become more attractive as the budget rises. When paths share common viability uncertainty, and experimental signals track payoff relatedness, however, additional paths partly repeat the same viability test rather than provide independent information. We identify conditions under which testing exactly two sharply contrasting paths is optimal, dominating both a single deep test and broader portfolios. The framework reconciles competing prescriptions—many parallel shots versus a few sharp comparisons—by clarifying when each applies, and shows why empirical measures of breadth should not treat the number of options and their relatedness as separable margins.
summary: 该论文研究了组织如何选择其实验组合的广度，指出广度包含两个不同维度：保持的路径数量和它们之间的对比程度，而以往研究大多孤立地考察它们。作者将这两个维度纳入统一框架，并表明它们并不必然同向变化。在固定实验预算下，增加路径会创造更多找到强方向的机会，但也会稀释跨路径的学习并削弱最强可行对比的强度。当任务主要是对已有可行方案进行排序时，随着预算增加，更广泛的组合变得更具吸引力。然而，当路径共享共同的可行性不确定性，且实验信号与回报的相关性相关时，额外路径部分重复相同的可行性测试而非提供独立信息。作者识别出测试两条尖锐对比路径是最优的条件，这优于单一深度测试和更广泛的组合。该框架调和了竞争性建议（多条平行尝试与少数尖锐对比），阐明了各自适用的情境，并说明为何经验测量不应将选项数量及其相关性视为可分离的维度。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将路径数量和对比程度纳入统一分析框架，揭示了二者并非同向变化，并解释了为何实验广度的两个维度应被联合考虑，为组织实验设计提供了理论指导。

title: The Cost of Intermediary Market Power for Distressed Borrowers
abstract: Distressed firms need urgent financing to preserve operations and avoid inefficient liquidation, but they borrow in concentrated markets shaped by existing-creditor blocking power and a small group of specialized lenders. We show that these borrowers pay exceptionally high loan spreads even after removing compensation for credit risk, liquidity risk, and non-risk loan-making costs. To quantify and decompose lender market power, we develop and estimate a dynamic game-theoretic model of distressed lending with latent demand heterogeneity, endogenous lender participation, creditor blocking power, and tacit collusion sustained by repeated syndication. Using granular facility-level data on debtor-in-possession (DIP) loans and highly speculative loans, we find that lender market power explains 533 bps of risk-adjusted spreads in the DIP loan market and 300 bps in the highly speculative loan market, including about 140 bps from tacit collusion in each market. Lender market power is therefore a major source of financial distress costs, reducing survival-critical liquidity by 16–20% and thereby worsening asset-value destruction.
summary: 本文研究困境企业在融资时面临的贷款市场势力问题。这些企业需要紧急融资以维持运营和避免低效清算，但它们在由现有债权人阻碍和小型专业贷款机构主导的集中市场中借款。研究发现，即使剔除了信用风险、流动性风险和非风险贷款成本，这些借款人仍支付异常高的贷款利差。为了量化并分解贷款市场势力，作者构建并估计了一个包含潜在需求异质性、内生贷款机构参与、债权人阻碍以及通过重复银团贷款维持的默契合谋的动态博弈模型。使用债务人持有占用贷款（DIP）和高度投机贷款的微观数据集，发现贷款市场势力解释了DIP贷款市场中533个基点和高度投机贷款市场中300个基点的风险调整利差，其中各市场约140个基点来自默契合谋。因此，贷款市场势力是金融困境成本的主要来源，减少了16-20%的关键生存流动性，从而加剧了资产价值破坏。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将默契合谋纳入贷款市场势力的分析框架，并利用DIP贷款数据进行了实证量化，揭示了金融困境成本的重要来源，对破产法和金融监管具有启示意义。

title: AlphaPortfolio: Goal-Oriented Investment Management Through Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We adapt attention-based neural networks and reinforcement learning to direct portfolio construction, allowing broader portfolio-management objectives (including non-time-additively separable ones) and in a data-driven way, searching over a much richer policy/strategy space than low-dimensional parametric rules or human-specified strategies. As arguably the first non-text-based, “large” GenAI model in Finance, AlphaPortfolio accommodates long- and short-range path dependence in firm and market states (e.g., using Transformer encoder), cross-asset information, flexible (path-dependent) objectives (incl. Sharpe ratio, which is non-additively separable across periods) for end-to-end (rather than step-by-step) optimizations. In U.S. equities, AlphaPortfolio yields superior out-of-sample performance (e.g., Sharpe ratio above two and risk-adjusted alpha over 13% with monthly rebalancing) robust under various market conditions and economic restrictions (e.g., exclusion of small/illiquid stocks) and over time. The gains come from the direct construction, effective sequence modeling, and cross-asset attention network. We further demonstrate AlphaPortfolio's flexibility to incorporate transaction costs, state interactions, and alternative objectives, before developing a polynomial-feature-sensitivity analysis to uncover key drivers of performance, including their rotation and nonlinearity.
summary: 本文提出AlphaPortfolio，一种基于注意力机制的深度强化学习方法，用于目标导向的投资组合管理。与传统方法不同，AlphaPortfolio能够处理更广泛的投资目标（包括非时间可加可分的目标），通过数据驱动的方式在比低维参数规则或人为指定策略更丰富的策略空间中进行搜索。作为金融领域首个非文本的“大型”生成式AI模型，AlphaPortfolio利用Transformer编码器捕捉公司和市场状态的长期与短期路径依赖，整合跨资产信息，并针对路径依赖的目标（如夏普比率，跨期非可加可分）进行端到端优化。在美国股票市场的实证中，AlphaPortfolio在样本外表现出色（例如，月度再平衡下夏普比率超过2，风险调整后alpha超过13%），在不同市场条件和经济限制（如排除小盘股或非流动性股票）下均保持稳健。其收益来源于直接构建、有效的序列建模和跨资产注意力网络。文章还展示了AlphaPortfolio在纳入交易成本、状态交互和替代目标方面的灵活性，并通过多项式特征敏感性分析揭示了业绩的关键驱动因素及其旋转和非线性特征。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将注意力机制和强化学习结合，提出了一个可处理复杂投资目标和路径依赖的通用投资组合框架，在美国股市上取得了显著的超额收益，为人工智能在量化投资中的应用提供了新范式。

title: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
abstract: We examine how digital disruption affects bank competition using the staggered rollout of 3G mobile networks. 3G expansion increased mobile banking adoption among tech‐savvy households, reducing branch networks—especially in younger counties. Banks' strategies diverged: Less branch‐reliant banks closed branches and competed on price, while more branch‐reliant banks maintained branches but raised spreads. A structural model shows that perceived digital service improvements among younger consumers drove these shifts, reducing welfare for older savers. Counterfactuals demonstrate that subsidizing adoption for older savers can cost‐effectively reduce these disparities, facilitating a smoother digital transition.
summary: 本文利用3G移动网络在不同地区的交错推出作为外生冲击，研究数字中断如何改变银行竞争格局及其对金融包容性的影响。研究发现，3G网络的扩展显著提高了技术娴熟家庭采用移动银行的比例，并导致银行分支网络缩减，这一效应在年轻人口占比较高的县更为明显。银行在竞争策略上出现分化：对分支依赖度较低的银行倾向于关闭分支并转向价格竞争（降低贷款利率或提高存款利率），而对分支依赖度较高的银行则维持分支网络但提高贷款与存款利差。通过结构性模型估计，作者发现年轻消费者对数字服务便利性的感知提升是驱动这些战略调整的关键机制，但这一过程却降低了年长储户的福利，因其更多地依赖传统分支服务。反事实模拟表明，为年长储户采用移动银行提供补贴可以成本有效地缩小数字采用差距，促进更平滑的数字转型。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙利用3G网络交错部署作为准自然实验，识别了数字技术对银行竞争和消费者福利的因果效应，并关注了不同年龄群体的福利分配问题，为政策制定者推动包容性数字转型提供了有意义的参考。

title: Monetary policy transmission through the exchange rate factor structure
abstract: We show that US monetary policy is transmitted internationally through the factor structure of exchange rates. Following an easing of monetary policy, investment funds sell safe and buy risky currencies. Global US banks, similarly, tilt their distribution of foreign loan origination toward currencies with greater systematic currency risk. The effects of monetary policy on currency flows and loans persist for several months and feed into the leverage and real investment decisions of firms and, in particular, those that operate using a high-risk currency. We conclude that the risk factor exposure of currencies is a significant channel through which we can understand the international transmission of US monetary policy.
summary: 本文研究了美国货币政策如何通过汇率的因子结构进行国际传导。具体而言，当美国实施宽松货币政策时，投资基金倾向于卖出安全货币并买入风险货币，而全球性美国银行也将其外汇贷款发放向具有更大系统性货币风险的货币倾斜。这些货币流动和贷款效应持续数月，并进一步影响企业的杠杆率和实际投资决策，尤其是那些使用高风险货币运营的企业。研究结论表明，货币的风险因子暴露是理解美国货币政策国际传导的重要渠道。
ai_comment: 本文从汇率因子结构这一新颖角度切入，揭示了美国货币政策国际传导的微观机制，强调了风险因子暴露的关键作用，为理解跨境资本流动和金融稳定提供了重要启示。

title: Is There a Macro-Announcement Premium?
abstract: The conditional return volatility barely drops at macro-announcements. This is at odds with the notion that high announcement returns are a manifestation of a large announcement premium. We show that models with an announcement premium cannot fully explain the joint patterns of returns and volatility over announcement days. Surprisingly, traditional models, which do not feature such a premium, can. Our estimation results based on a statistical setup indicate that the average announcement return is mostly attributable to the monetary policy surprise and pure small-sample components, which do not average out in-sample; the announcement premium is estimated to be small. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06960 .
summary: 本文研究宏观公告溢价的存在性。摘要指出，条件波动率在宏观公告期间几乎没有下降，这与高公告回报是大量公告溢价的体现的观点相矛盾。作者展示了包含公告溢价的模型无法完全解释公告日回报与波动率的联合模式，而传统的不包含此溢价的模型却能解释。基于统计设定的估计结果表明，平均公告回报主要归因于货币政策意外和纯小样本成分（这些成分在样本内未平均化），公告溢价估计很小。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证挑战了宏观公告溢价的主流观点，强调了传统模型和货币政策意外在解释公告回报中的关键作用，为理解资产定价中的公告效应提供了新视角。

title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
summary: 本文利用中国监管（券商融资）和未监管（影子融资）保证金账户的细粒度数据，研究了零售投资者的保证金交易行为及其价格影响。首先发现，尽管借贷成本高昂，零售投资者仍倾向于杠杆买入股票，这与他们的彩票偏好有关。其次，保证金借款影响交易行为，投资者在接近追加保证金时更可能清算持仓。最后，保证金驱动的交易行为会聚合影响资产价格，并导致冲击在股票间溢出（例如，从彩票股到非彩票股）。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的影子融资数据，揭示了散户杠杆行为背后的彩票偏好机制，并证明了保证金交易对资产价格的系统性影响，为理解新兴市场中散户主导的波动性提供了新视角。

title: Consumption in Asset Returns
abstract: Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
summary: 本文利用金融资产回报中包含的信息来识别消费的随机过程。研究发现，由金融市场所跨越的创新冲击会导致总消费在多个季度内做出持续反应，这种持久成分解释了超过四分之一的消费变化。这些消费冲击具有显著的风险溢价，驱动了股票的大部分时间序列变化以及债券的较小但显著的部分。然而，文中未发现消费的随机波动驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于估计得到的消费过程的标准递归效用模型，在低风险厌恶水平下即可解释股权溢价之谜和无风险利率之谜。
ai_comment: 该论文通过从资产回报中提取消费信息，为消费的持久性成分提供了新证据，并在低风险厌恶下成功解释了经典资产定价谜题，方法独特且结论有力。

title: Operational Proximity and Cross-Border Shareholder Monitoring
abstract: Using US mutual funds' international voting records, we investigate whether proximity to firm operations promotes active monitoring by foreign investors. To identify monitoring effects, we exploit proximity variations arising from actions of existing portfolio firms. We find that after a non-US firm expands operations into the US, US funds cast more dissenting votes at the firm's shareholder meetings, especially in response to poor performance and contentious proposals. The increase in dissent voting is consistent with funds becoming more engaged shareholders as they gain better information. Our findings suggest that cross-border economic activities facilitate the global dissemination of best-practice shareholder activism.
summary: 本文利用美国共同基金的国际投票记录，研究运营距离（即外国投资者与目标公司运营地点的接近程度）是否促进跨境股东监督。为识别监督效应，作者利用现有投资组合公司业务扩张导致运营距离变化的外生变异。研究发现，当非美国公司将业务扩展至美国后，美国基金在该公司股东大会上投更多反对票，尤其是在公司业绩不佳或提案存在争议时。反对票的增加与基金因获得更优信息而成为更积极的股东相一致。结论表明，跨境经济活动有助于全球传播最佳实践的股东积极主义。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用运营距离的外生变化识别因果关系，为跨境经济互动如何促进股东积极主义提供了新颖证据，拓展了公司治理与国际金融的交叉研究。

title: Respecting Improvement in Markets with Indivisible Goods
abstract: A generalized matching problem consists of a set of agents, a set of objects, the agents’ endowments, a set of feasible matchings, and the agents’ preferences over feasible matchings. Respect for improvement means that when the ranking of an agent’s endowment improves in some other agent’s preference (while keeping other preferences unchanged), then this agent weakly benefits from it. Our main result shows across matching applications that on the strict domain, individual rationality, strategy-proofness, and nonbossiness imply respecting improvement. As a consequence for housing markets, we obtain that top trading with fixed tiebreaking and top trading with random tiebreaking satisfy respecting improvement on the weak domain. We further show that several application-based extensions of the top-trading-cycles mechanism (such as for kidney exchange and school choice) satisfy (a weak version of) respecting improvement. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Funding: The author acknowledges financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada under Insight Grant 435-2023-0129 and the Fonds de recherche du Québec under Soutien aux équipes de recherche / Universitaire- nouvelle équipe 367853.
summary: 本文研究不可分割商品市场中的‘尊重改进’性质。在一个广义匹配问题中（包括代理、物品、初始禀赋、可行匹配集和偏好），尊重改进意味着当某个代理的初始禀赋在另一个代理的偏好中排名上升（其他偏好不变）时，该代理不会因此受损。主要结论是：在严格偏好域上，个体理性、策略证明性和非独裁性共同蕴含尊重改进。在住房市场情境下，固定平局打破和随机平局打破的顶部交易机制在弱偏好域上满足尊重改进。此外，顶部交易循环机制的若干扩展（如肾脏交换和学校选择）也满足尊重改进的弱版本。该论文发表于 Management Science，属于市场设计、平台与需求分析方向。
ai_comment: 论文在理论上揭示了经典公理之间的蕴含关系，并验证了实际机制（如TTC及其扩展）的规范性，对市场设计理论有重要贡献。

title: Firm-Level Labor Shortage Exposure
abstract: We extract information from earnings call transcripts to develop a comprehensive and reliable measure of labor shortage exposure. After validating the measure at the state, industry, and firm levels, we show that firms with labor shortage exposures experience lower earnings call CARs, future stock returns and operating performance. Firms respond to labor shortages by substituting labor with capital and R&D investments, and by producing more production-process patents. Such responses help mitigate the negative effects on future performance. Our measure has broad applicability, and our findings provide new insight into labor-capital substitution in imperfectly competitive labor markets. JEL G12, G30, J2
summary: 本文从财报电话会议记录中提取信息，开发了一个全面且可靠的劳动力短缺暴露度量指标。在州、行业和公司层面验证后，发现劳动力短缺暴露较高的公司，其财报电话会议期间的累计异常收益率、未来股票收益和运营绩效都较低。公司通过增加资本和研发投资来替代劳动力，并生产更多生产过程相关专利来应对劳动力短缺，这些措施有助于缓解对未来绩效的负面影响。该度量指标具有广泛适用性，为不完全竞争劳动力市场中的劳动-资本替代提供了新的见解。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从文本数据中构建劳动力短缺度量，并揭示了公司层面的经济后果与应对策略，对劳动经济学与公司金融交叉领域有重要贡献。

title: Optimal retirement saving and dissaving
abstract: Applying a rich model of individuals' life-cycle utility maximization, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of retirement saving plans for workers determining their contributions to the plan, emulating retirement saving with 401(k)s in the U.S. Across a range of individual characteristics, the access to basic plans with constant expected payouts and either no or full annuitization leads to individual welfare gains of up to 5.06% of initial wealth and lifetime income (around $43,700 in present value terms), and almost all the individuals prefer full annuitization and a target-date fund investment strategy. With flexible plans allowing for partial annuitization, non-constant expected payouts, and unscheduled withdrawals from the pension account, the welfare gains go up to 6.20%, and most individuals prefer a high degree of annuitization and expected payouts being increasing through retirement.
summary: 该论文构建了一个丰富的个人生命周期效用最大化模型，全面评估了工人的退休储蓄计划，工人可以自行决定对计划的缴款，模拟美国401(k)计划的运作。研究考虑了一系列个人特征，比较了两种计划：基础计划（恒定预期支付，且要么无年金化、要么完全年金化）和灵活计划（允许部分年金化、非恒定预期支付以及从养老金账户中进行非计划提取）。结果发现，基础计划可带来高达初始财富和终生收入5.06%的福利收益（现值约43,700美元），几乎所有个体都偏好完全年金化和目标日期基金投资策略。而灵活计划能带来高达6.20%的福利收益，且大多数个体偏好较高的年金化程度以及在退休期间预期支付递增的模式。
ai_comment: 模型设计细致，同时考虑了基础与灵活计划，揭示了年金化和目标日期基金策略对福利提升的重要性，为养老金产品设计提供了量化依据。

title: Invisible Primes: Fintech Lending with Alternative Data
abstract: We study the impact of alternative data on credit access and borrower outcomes using anonymized data from a major U.S. financial technology (fintech) platform that incorporates education, employment, and other nontraditional variables into its underwriting algorithm. The platform approves 15%–30% of low-credit-score applicants rejected by traditional models and offers them lower rates. It particularly benefits “invisible primes”—borrowers with thin credit files and low credit scores but low default risk. We show that gains for invisible primes are primarily driven by alternative data, while model sophistication yields additional improvements in segments where traditional credit report information is more extensive. Using exogenous variation, we find that expanded credit access improves borrowers’ subsequent financial outcomes. This paper has been accepted by Kay Giesecke for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07854 .
summary: 本研究利用美国一家大型金融科技平台的匿名数据，探讨替代数据（包括教育、就业及其他非传统变量）对信贷可及性和借款人结果的影响。该平台采用替代数据驱动的承保算法，批准了15%-30%被传统模型拒绝的低信用评分申请人，并为他们提供更低利率。研究发现，平台特别惠及“invisible primes”——即信用档案薄、信用评分低但违约风险低的借款人。收益主要来源于替代数据的使用，而模型复杂性的提升在传统信用报告信息更丰富的细分市场中带来额外改进。利用外生变异进行的分析表明，信贷扩张改善了借款人后续的财务结果。该论文被接受发表于《管理科学》数字金融虚拟特刊。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证数据量化了替代数据在提升信贷可及性中的关键作用，并提供了信贷扩张改善借款人财务结果的因果证据，对金融科技和信贷市场研究具有重要贡献。

title: Financial Inclusion via Blockchain: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
abstract: The lack of formal and verifiable credit records among borrowers is a significant barrier to financial inclusion in developing countries. In this paper, we assess the effectiveness of blockchain technology in improving credit information authenticity and enhancing financial inclusion. Using a novel data set from the online prosocial lending platform Kiva, we exploit the implementation of a blockchain-based lending protocol change in Kiva Sierra Leone as an exogenous shock to conduct difference-in-differences analyses. Our results show that borrowers attract more guarantors and larger per-guarantor contributions under the blockchain protocol, thereby increasing their likelihood of being funded on the Kiva platform. Microfinance institutions (MFIs) adopting the blockchain protocol also experience lower portfolio risks and extend larger lending volume to borrowers. In addition, the implementation of the blockchain protocol allows MFIs to achieve both growth in financial revenue and reduction in operational expenses, thus enhancing the sustainability of their lending services in developing countries. We further explore the sensitivities of blockchain effects and find that the blockchain protocol has a greater propensity to benefit borrowers from rural areas, those with weaker financial credit records, and those seeking microloans in sectors such as agriculture, textiles, and the food industry. Our findings are robust against robustness checks and alternative explanations. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance and will be included in the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: Financial support from the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Grant T35-710/20-R] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71988101] is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02303 .
summary: 本研究评估区块链技术在改善信贷信息真实性及促进金融包容性方面的有效性。利用线上公益借贷平台Kiva的数据，以Kiva在塞拉利昂实施基于区块链的借贷协议变更作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法进行分析。结果显示，在区块链协议下，借款人吸引了更多担保人及更大的每担保人贡献额，从而提高了在Kiva平台获得融资的可能性。采用区块链协议的小额信贷机构（MFIs）降低了组合风险，扩大了贷款规模。此外，区块链协议使MFIs实现了金融收入增长和运营费用降低，增强了其在发展中国家贷款服务的可持续性。进一步分析表明，区块链效应在来自农村地区、信用记录较弱以及从事农业、纺织和食品行业的小额贷款借款人中更为显著。研究结论经过稳健性检验和替代解释验证。
ai_comment: 该论文利用自然实验识别区块链对金融包容性的因果效应，数据详实，方法严谨，为区块链在普惠金融领域的应用提供了有力证据。

title: Proud to Not Own Stocks: How Identity Shapes Financial Decisions
abstract: This paper introduces a key factor influencing households’ decision to invest in the stock market: how people view stockholders. Using surveys we conducted with nearly 8,500 individuals from 11 countries, we document that a large majority hold negative views of stockholders based on identity-relevant characteristics. Linking survey and administrative data, we find that negative perceptions strongly predict households’ stock market participation. We show that negative perceptions causally influence household decision-making and provide evidence supporting identity concerns as the underlying mechanism. Our findings provide new perspectives on the malleability of financial decision-making and a novel explanation for low stock market participation. (JEL G41, G51, D14, D83)
summary: 本文研究了家庭股市参与决策的一个关键因素：人们对股东的看法。通过对来自11个国家近8500人的调查，发现大多数受访者基于身份相关特征对股东持有负面看法。结合调查和行政数据，发现这些负面看法强烈预测了家庭是否参与股市。进一步证据表明负面看法对家庭决策具有因果影响，并支持身份关切作为潜在机制。研究结果为金融决策的可塑性提供了新视角，也为低股市参与率提供了新的解释。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将身份认同纳入家庭金融决策分析，利用跨国调查和行政数据揭示了负面刻板印象对股市参与的重要影响，为解释全球普遍存在的股市有限参与现象提供了新机制。

title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions*
abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
summary: 本文分析了在政府和银行存在集体道德风险的情况下，最优的跨境风险分担与银行资本要求。跨国转移支付提供保险但会削弱财政纪律。由于宽松的财政政策会放大银行的风险转移行为，最优支持必须根据银行系统的健康状况来决定。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机且银行有偿付能力时，支持力度更大；对于财政强大的国家，在主权危机与银行危机同时发生时，支持力度更大，这要求存款保险的相互化。最优合同设定的资本要求低于无跨国转移支付时的水平，这提高了主权与银行联合危机的成本以加强财政纪律，并允许更大程度的风险分担。
ai_comment: 该论文通过模型揭示了跨国风险分担与财政纪律之间的权衡，为理解银行联盟设计提供了理论基础，尤其强调了资本要求在激励约束中的作用。

title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
summary: 本文分析了政府和银行存在集体道德风险时，跨国风险分担与银行资本要求的最优设计。转移支付能够提供保险，但会削弱财政纪律；宽松的财政政策会放大银行的风险转移行为，因此最优支持必须取决于银行体系的健康状况。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机中且银行有偿付能力时，支持力度更大；对于财政强劲的国家，在主权和银行联合危机中，支持力度更大，这需要存款保险的相互化。最优合同的特征是比没有跨国转移时更低的资本要求，通过提高联合主权银行危机的成本来强化财政纪律，从而实现更大的风险分担。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将集体道德风险纳入跨国风险分担模型，揭示了转移支付与资本要求之间的权衡，强调了财政纪律在实现有效风险分担中的关键作用，为银行业联盟设计提供了理论依据。

title: When Is the Price of Analysts’ Disagreement Risk Positive?
abstract: We provide robust evidence that the price of analysts' disagreement risk in the cross-section of stock returns changes sign over time; it's positive (negative) in periods of high (low) disagreement. We construct a general equilibrium model in which analysts have heterogeneous beliefs about aggregate earnings growth. The consumer does not trust either analyst fully and dynamically adjusts each analyst's weight, based on their performance. Each asset's risk premium depends on its exposure to (i) the market portfolio, (ii) aggregate earnings growth, and, (iii) a ``flight-to-safety'' factor. (i) decreases and (iii) increases with disagreement as investors choose lower cash flow beta assets during periods of high disagreement. We find support for such a flight-to-safetyin the data.
summary: 本文提供了稳健的证据，表明分析师分歧风险的价格在股票横截面回报中随时间改变符号：在分歧高的时期为正，在分歧低的时期为负。作者构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中分析师对总体盈利增长持有异质信念。消费者不完全信任任何一位分析师，会根据分析师的表现动态调整每个分析师的权重。每个资产的风险溢价取决于其对市场组合、总体盈利增长以及一个“安全投资转移”（flight-to-safety）因子的暴露。其中，对市场组合的暴露随分歧增加而减少，而对安全投资转移因子的暴露随分歧增加而增加，因为投资者在高分歧时期会选择现金流贝塔较低的资产。数据支持这种安全投资转移行为。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了分析师分歧风险定价的非对称性，并通过一般均衡模型引入了安全投资转移机制，为理解分歧与资产回报的关系提供了新视角。

title: Revenue Recognition Comparability and Analysts’ Disclosure Processing Costs
abstract: I examine whether the FASB's revenue recognition guidance under ASC 606 influences revenue comparability across firms and industries and whether revenue comparability reduces analysts’ disclosure processing costs. I extract firms’ revenue policy disclosures from 10‐K filings to measure their textual similarity and compare revenue policies across firms and industries. I find an increase in revenue comparability for firms in different industries with similar revenue‐generating transactions upon adoption of ASC 606. In contrast, I find a decrease in revenue comparability for firms in the same industry with similar revenue‐generating transactions. Further, though I find that analysts are more likely to forecast revenues when firms have higher revenue comparability, this benefit of revenue comparability is less pronounced under ASC 606. This finding suggests the ASC 606‐related changes to revenue comparability impose disclosure processing costs on analysts.
summary: 本文研究FASB的ASC 606收入确认准则是否影响不同公司和行业间的收入可比性，以及这种可比性是否降低分析师的信息处理成本。通过从10-K文件中提取公司的收入政策披露并测量文本相似性，发现采用ASC 606后，不同行业但收入产生交易相似的公司之间收入可比性提高，而同一行业且收入产生交易相似的公司之间可比性反而下降。此外，尽管收入可比性越高，分析师越可能对收入进行预测，但在ASC 606下，可比性带来的这种好处减弱，表明ASC 606对收入可比性的改变增加了分析师的信息处理成本。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从文本相似性角度度量收入披露可比性，揭示了ASC 606对同类及跨行业公司可比性的差异化影响，并实证了会计准则变更对分析师信息处理成本的负面作用，为准则制定者提供了重要参考。

title: Generative AI and Asset Management
abstract: Using a novel measure of investment companies’ reliance on generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), we document a sharp increase in GenAI usage by hedge funds after ChatGPT’s 2022 launch. A difference-in-differences test shows that hedge funds adopting GenAI earn 2-4% higher annualized abnormal returns than nonadopters, while non-hedge funds do not benefit. The outperformance originates from funds’ AI talent and ChatGPT’s strength in analyzing firm-specific information. We conduct a new survey of fund managers’ GenAI usage to provide direct validation of our measure and offer additional new insights on how managers adopt GenAI tools in their practice. (JEL C81, G11, G14, G23)
summary: 本文提出一种新的衡量投资公司对生成式人工智能（GenAI）依赖程度的指标，并发现ChatGPT于2022年发布后，对冲基金对GenAI的使用急剧增加。通过双重差分（DID）检验，论文发现采用GenAI的对冲基金相比未采用的基金获得了2-4%的年化异常回报率，而非对冲基金并未从中受益。这种超额收益源于基金的AI人才储备以及ChatGPT在分析公司特定信息方面的优势。此外，文章通过对基金经理进行GenAI使用调查，直接验证了该指标的准确性，并提供了基金经理在实践中采用GenAI工具的新见解。
ai_comment: 该论文通过新颖的度量方法和因果识别策略，为生成式AI在资产管理中的价值提供了有力证据，特别强调了对冲基金利用AI人才和ChatGPT分析公司信息是超额收益的关键来源。

title: The co-pricing factor zoo
abstract: We analyze 18 quadrillion models for the joint pricing of corporate bond and stock returns. Strikingly, we find that equity and nontradable factors alone suffice to explain corporate bond risk premia once their Treasury term structure risk is accounted for, rendering the extensive bond factor literature largely redundant for this purpose. While only a handful of factors, behavioral and nontradable, are likely robust sources of priced risk, the true latent stochastic discount factor is dense in the space of observable factors. Consequently, a Bayesian Model Averaging Stochastic Discount Factor explains risk premia better than all low-dimensional models, in- and out-of-sample, by optimally aggregating dozens of factors that serve as noisy proxies for common underlying risks, yielding an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.5 to 1.8. This SDF, as well as its conditional mean and volatility, are persistent, track the business cycle and times of heightened economic uncertainty, and predict future asset returns.
summary: 本文分析了18万亿个模型，研究公司债与股票收益的联合定价。核心发现是，在控制国债期限结构风险后，仅使用权益因子和不可交易因子就足以解释公司债风险溢价，使大部分债券因子文献变得冗余。虽然只有少数行为与不可交易因子是稳健的定价风险源，但真实的潜在随机贴现因子（SDF）在可观测因子空间中具有稠密性。通过贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）方法构建的SDF，能最优聚合数十个作为共同潜在风险噪声代理的因子，无论在样本内还是样本外均优于所有低维模型，样本外夏普比率达到1.5至1.8。该SDF及其条件均值和波动率具有持续性，能够追踪经济周期和高度不确定性时期，并预测未来资产收益。
ai_comment: 本文通过巨量模型空间分析，揭示了SDF在因子空间中的稠密性，并展示了BMA方法在聚合噪声代理因子方面的卓越效果，对资产定价实证研究具有重要方法论贡献。

title: Portfolio Dynamics and the Supply of Safe Securities
abstract: I study dynamic portfolio rebalancing in Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs) by developing an industry equilibrium model of nonbank lending, in which CLOs and loan funds arise endogenously in response to a premium for safe securities. When loans deteriorate after issuance, CLOs rebalance their portfolios to maintain collateral quality, which protects senior tranches at the expense of equity investors. This “self-healing” mechanism lowers CLOs’ ex ante funding costs by enabling the issuance of larger safe tranches. As more lenders operate CLOs, their portfolio rebalancing generates greater nonfundamental price pressures, incentivizing other lenders to operate loan funds. Overall, portfolio dynamics facilitate risk sharing across nonbank lenders and increase both total lending and the supply of safe securities relative to static portfolios. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07100 .
summary: 本文通过构建一个非银行贷款的行业均衡模型，研究担保贷款凭证（CLOs）中的动态投资组合再平衡。在该模型中，CLO和贷款基金内生出现，以响应安全证券的溢价。当贷款质量在发行后恶化时，CLO通过再平衡投资组合来维持抵押品质量，这种“自愈”机制以牺牲股权投资者为代价保护优先级档，从而降低CLO的事前融资成本，并允许发行更大的安全档。随着更多贷款人运营CLO，其投资组合再平衡会产生非基本面价格压力，激励其他贷款人转向运营贷款基金。总体而言，与静态投资组合相比，动态投资组合促进了非银行贷款人之间的风险分担，增加了总贷款和安全证券的供给。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将CLO的“自愈”机制纳入行业均衡分析，揭示了动态组合管理对安全证券供给和非银行放贷者结构的影响，为理解影子银行的风险分担效率提供了新视角。

title: Regurgitative Training: The Value of Real Data in Training Large Language Models
abstract: What happens if we train a new large language model (LLM) using data at least partially generated by other LLMs? The explosive success of LLMs means that content online will increasingly be generated by LLMs rather than humans, which inevitably enters the training data sets of next-generation LLMs. In this paper, we study the implications of such “regurgitative training” on LLM performance. Starting with the machine translation task (a representative language task with well-established evaluation criteria), we fine-tune LLMs with data generated either by themselves or by other LLMs, and we find strong evidence that regurgitative training handicaps the performance of fine-tuned LLMs. A comparison between LLM-generated data and real data reveals suggestive evidence that higher error rates and lower lexical diversity in LLM-generated data may be at play. Accordingly, we propose and evaluate three strategies to mitigate the performance loss by (i) prioritizing high-quality LLM-generated data, (ii) mixing data generated by multiple LLMs, and (iii) prioritizing LLM-generated data that most resemble real data. All three strategies can improve the performance of regurgitative training to some extent but cannot fully close the gap from training with real data. This highlights that real, human-generated data cannot be easily substituted by LLM-generated data in training LLMs. Additionally, we investigate regurgitative training on a creative ideation task with human judgement-based evaluations. Interestingly, we find that preference-based fine-tuning with human feedback on LLM-generated ideas can actually improve ideation performance. This showcases that human preference data when combined with LLM-generated data can bring performance gains. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72421001 and 72172070] and the Singapore Ministry of Education Academic Research Fund Tier 2 A-8003504 [Robert Brown Promising Researcher Award MOE-T2EP40]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07005 .
summary: 本文研究使用其他LLM生成的数据训练新LLM（称为“反刍训练”）对模型性能的影响。以机器翻译任务为代表，通过微调实验发现反刍训练显著损害模型性能，原因是LLM生成的数据错误率更高且词汇多样性更低。提出了三种缓解策略：优先使用高质量LLM生成数据、混合多个LLM生成的数据、优先选择最像真实数据的LLM生成数据，这些策略能部分提升性能但无法完全弥补与真实数据训练的差距，表明真实人类生成数据在训练中不可替代。进一步在创意构思任务中使用人类偏好反馈进行微调，发现可以提升性能，显示人类偏好数据与LLM生成数据结合能带来增益。
ai_comment: 论文系统揭示了LLM生成数据用于自我训练的潜在风险，并通过多任务验证了真实数据不可替代，对LLM训练数据策略具有重要指导意义。提出的缓解策略和人类反馈的积极作用为实际应用提供了可行方向。

title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies
abstract: I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
summary: 该论文构建了一个租赁市场的动态均衡模型，该模型内生地产生租金违约和驱逐现象。在模型中，驱逐保护使得驱逐违约租户变得更加困难，但房东承担的更高违约成本会推高均衡租金。作者利用关于驱逐、租金和无家可归的微观数据对模型进行了量化校准。研究发现，更强的驱逐保护措施会加剧住房不安全状况并降低社会福利。这一结果的关键实证驱动因素是租金拖欠风险的持续性。相比之下，租金援助通过降低租户事前违约的可能性，减少了住房不安全并改善了社会福利。
ai_comment: 本文通过内生违约的均衡模型揭示了驱逐保护可能产生的意外负面效应，为政策制定提供了重要理论依据。

title: Risk‐Free Rates and Convenience Yields around the World
abstract: We infer risk‐free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in 10 G11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between United States and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option‐implied rates are a similar size between the United States and each other country. A model in which convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations reflect the funding costs of international arbitrageurs financed with dollar‐denominated debt, explains these results.
summary: 该研究利用10个G11货币国家的指数期权价格推导出无风险利率，进而估计安全资产的便利收益率。研究发现，各国的便利收益率随本国利率水平上升而上升，其中美国便利收益率位居第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率普遍增长，但美国与外国便利收益率之间的差异并未显著扩大。使用期权隐含利率计算的抛补利率平价（CIP）偏差在美国与各其他国家之间大小相似。作者提出一个模型，其中便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，而CIP偏差则反映了以美元债务融资的国际套利者的融资成本，该模型能够解释上述结果。
ai_comment: 该论文通过全球多国数据系统性地度量便利收益率，并创新性地将CIP偏差与金融中介融资成本联系起来，为理解国际金融市场的风险溢价提供了新视角。

title: Incidence, Risk, and Disclosure of Corporate Litigation: Insights from Federal Court Filings
abstract: We assemble and describe a sample of 174,782 lawsuits filed against 218,437 public‐company lawsuit‐defendants in federal district court from 2006 to 2021. These lawsuits involve an array of allegations, including product liability, civil rights discrimination, contract breaches, improper compensation and labor practices, antitrust violations, corruption, securities violations, pollution, and intellectual property infringement. The sample exhibits rich variation across firms, industries, time, suit type, plaintiffs, and outcomes—reflecting not only firm activities but also social, political, and regulatory trends. Although many claims matter very little, some are important individually or in aggregate. We observe 23% of defendants experience a market value decline exceeding 10% of current assets around the lawsuit filing. Consistent with the notion that even low‐stakes claims, when numerous or persistent, can introduce frictions or reflect underlying issues, we find that aggregate legal exposure is associated with increased return volatility and decreased profitability. Subsequent tests indicate that materiality, public and private enforcement, and firms’ information environments (as well as other firm traits) are associated with managers’ decisions to disclose these claims. Collectively, our descriptive evidence establishes a foundation for further research into underexplored types of corporate litigation that represent a broad range of alleged wrongdoing and socially irresponsible behavior.
summary: 本文构建并描述了一个2006年至2021年期间美国联邦地区法院针对218,437家上市公司被告提起的174,782起诉讼样本，涵盖产品责任、民权歧视、合同违约、不当薪酬与用工、反垄断、腐败、证券违规、污染及知识产权侵权等多种指控。样本在行业、时间、诉讼类型、原告及结果上呈现丰富异质性，不仅反映企业活动，还体现社会、政治和监管趋势。尽管许多索赔影响甚微，但部分在个体或整体层面意义重大：23%的被告在诉讼提交日附近市场价值下跌超过当前资产的10%。与即使小额索赔若数量众多或持续存在可能引入摩擦或反映潜在问题的观点一致，研究发现总体法律风险与波动率上升及盈利能力下降相关。后续检验表明，重大性、公共与私人执行及企业信息环境（及其他企业特征）与管理层是否披露这些索赔的决策相关。这些描述性证据为未来研究尚未充分探索的企业诉讼类型（代表广泛的不当行为和社会不负责任行为）奠定了基础。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建大型诉讼数据集，系统描述了多种类型的企业诉讼特征及其经济后果，为理解企业法律风险与披露行为提供了重要实证基础，并开辟了新的研究方向。

title: Mutual Fund Flows and the Supply of Capital in Municipal Financing
abstract: This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
summary: 本文研究共同基金的资金供给如何影响市政债券融资。作者利用Morningstar评级规则性更新对成立5年的基金进行识别，隔离了供给端效应，发现外生基金流入增加了债券发行概率并降低了收益率。此外，当基金与发行方通过承销商建立联系时，这种影响更强，体现了关系贷款的作用。市政发行方利用有利融资条件增加收入债券发行，进而推高当地房价。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用Morningstar评级更新作为外生冲击，有效识别了基金流量对市政融资的因果效应，并揭示了承销商关系的关键作用，为理解资金供给与实体经济的联系提供了新视角。

title: Dynamic Matching with Postallocation Service and Its Application to Refugee Resettlement
abstract: Motivated by our collaboration with a major refugee resettlement agency in the United States, we study a dynamic matching problem where each new arrival (a refugee case) must be matched immediately and irrevocably to one of the static resources (a location with a fixed annual quota). In addition to consuming the static resource, each case requires postallocation service from a server, such as a translator. Given the time-consuming nature of service, a server may not be available at a given time, thus we refer to it as a dynamic resource. Upon matching, the case will wait to avail service in a first-come-first-serve manner. Bursty matching to a location may result in undesirable congestion at its corresponding server. Consequently, the central planner (the agency) faces a dynamic matching problem with an objective that combines the matching reward (captured by pair-specific employment outcomes) with the cost for congestion for dynamic resources and overallocation for the static ones. Motivated by the observed fluctuations in the composition of refugee pools across the years, we design algorithms that do not rely on distributional knowledge constructed based on past years’ data. To that end, we develop learning-based algorithms that are asymptotically optimal in certain regimes, easy to interpret, and computationally fast. Our design is based on learning the dual variables of the underlying optimization problem; however, the main challenge lies in the time-varying nature of the dual variables associated with dynamic resources. To overcome this challenge, our theoretical development brings together techniques from Lyapunov analysis, adversarial online learning, and stochastic optimization. On the application side, when tested on real data from our partner agency and incorporating practical considerations, our method outperforms existing ones, making it a viable candidate for replacing the current practice upon experimentation. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Funding: This work was supported by the Stanford Impact Lab [Stage 2 Grant], Google.org [AI for Social Good Grant TF2111-103726], the Charles Koch Foundation, and the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence [Hoffman-Yee Research Grant]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07817 .
summary: 本文基于与美国一家主要难民安置机构的合作，研究动态匹配问题：每个新到达的难民案例必须立即且不可撤回地匹配到一个静态资源（具有固定年度配额的地点），同时每个案例需要后分配服务（如翻译员），服务被视为动态资源，因为服务者可能并非随时可用。匹配后，案例按先来先服务的方式等待服务。若匹配过于集中，可能导致对应服务器拥塞。中央规划者的目标函数结合了匹配奖励（由配对特定的就业结果决定）和动态资源的拥塞成本以及静态资源的过度分配成本。针对难民构成随年份波动的观察，本文设计了不依赖历史数据分布知识的算法，提出了学习型算法，该算法在特定情境下渐近最优、易于解释且计算快速。算法基于学习底层优化问题的对偶变量，主要挑战在于动态资源对偶变量的时变性，为此综合运用了李雅普诺夫分析、对抗在线学习和随机优化技术。在合作伙伴机构的真实数据上测试，该方法优于现有方法，成为替代当前实践的可行候选方案。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将难民安置中的实际约束建模为动态匹配问题，并创新性地结合多种优化技术设计出无需历史分布知识的算法，对实践有显著指导意义。

title: Partisan Entrepreneurship
abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
summary: 本研究利用2005年至2017年间4000万有政党认同的美国人的行政数据，发现共和党人的创业率（5.5%）显著高于民主党人（3.7%），存在党派创业差距。该差距随时间变化：共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，导致13年间约17万家新公司的党派重新分配。围绕奥巴马和特朗普总统选举，党派创业出现急剧变化，这种效应在政治最活跃的群体（捐款和投票者）中最为显著。
ai_comment: 该论文利用大规模面板数据揭示了政治环境对创业决策的动态影响，为理解政治与经济互动提供了新证据。

title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
abstract: Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
summary: 通过结合随机对照试验（RCT）与行政和调查数据，本文发现信贷额度提升显著增加了总支出和收入预期。在控制个人收入预期变化后，支出对信贷额度提升的反应减弱约30%。对于财务不受限的消费者，预期变化解释了约三分之二的额度提升支出反应。这些发现与消费者从信贷供给推断未来收入的假设一致。
ai_comment: 该论文通过随机对照试验提供了信贷供给影响消费者收入预期的因果证据，并量化了预期渠道在支出反应中的重要作用，对理解消费行为和政策制定具有启示。

title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
abstract: We examine how macroeconomic expectations affect consumer decisions, using an experiment with 2,872 credit card customers at a large commercial bank. In the experiment, participants are randomized into receiving expert forecasts of inflation and the nominal exchange rate. We find that forecasts shift inflation and exchange rate expectations, but do not change spending or self-reported consumption plans as predicted by standard models of intertemporal choice. Results from a supplementary survey experiment suggest that consumers are sophisticated enough to anticipate nominal rigidities and reduce spending on durables for precautionary reasons, counteracting the effects predicted by standard models of intertemporal optimization.
summary: 本文通过在一家大型商业银行开展的信用卡客户实验，研究了宏观经济预期如何影响消费者决策。实验将2,872名参与者随机分为两组，一组接受专家对通胀和名义汇率的预测。结果发现，专家预测确实改变了消费者对通胀和汇率的预期，但并未如标准跨期选择模型所预测的那样改变他们的信用卡支出或自我报告的消费计划。进一步的补充调查实验表明，消费者足够精明，能够预见到名义刚性，并出于预防性动机减少耐用品支出，这抵消了标准跨期优化模型所预测的效果。
ai_comment: 本文通过田野实验直接检验宏观经济预期对消费行为的影响，发现传统模型预测失效，并揭示了消费者对名义刚性的前瞻性考量，为理解预期传导机制提供了新证据。

title: Private Equity Fund Debt: Agency Costs and Cash Flow Management

title: Crypto Carry
abstract: We analyze the dynamics of carry in crypto markets—the difference between futures and spot prices—and document that it can reach exceptionally high levels, sometimes exceeding 40% per annum, with significant variation over time. This phenomenon reflects a substantial and volatile inconvenience yield associated with holding spot cryptocurrencies relative to futures. We trace the large and volatile crypto carry to the interplay of two main forces: (i) demand from smaller, trend-chasing investors seeking leveraged exposure and (ii) the limited deployment of arbitrage capital because of regulatory and margin frictions. Our findings highlight how structural limits to arbitrage—especially severe in the case of crypto—can amplify price inefficiencies across financial markets, offering lessons for understanding asset pricing and market behavior more generally. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: M. Schmeling acknowledges financial support from the German Science Foundation [Grant SCHM 2623/2-1]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05069 .
summary: 本文分析了加密货币市场中carry（期货与现货价格之差）的动态，发现其可达到异常高的水平，有时年化超过40%，且随时间变化显著。这一现象反映了持有现货加密货币相对于期货的巨大且波动的“不便收益率”。研究表明，高且波动的加密carry源于两大因素的相互作用：一是较小规模、追逐趋势的投资者寻求杠杆暴露的需求，二是由于监管和保证金摩擦导致套利资本部署有限。这些发现突显了结构性套利限制（在加密货币领域尤为严重）如何放大金融市场的价格低效率，为理解资产定价和市场行为提供了更一般的启示。
ai_comment: 该论文实证揭示了加密市场carry的极端水平及其波动根源，强调了结构性套利限制的关键作用，对理解加密资产定价和市场效率有重要贡献。

title: Caution Ahead: Numerical Reasoning and Look‐Ahead Bias in AI Models
abstract: Recent work within accounting and finance has highlighted that modern AI systems exhibit superhuman performance on a variety of foundational activities within these fields. However, the literature often does not provide economic rationale for why AI models seem to outperform, largely because these models are a black box. Through a series of experiments, I set out to open the black box and provide direct evidence on how and why AI models appear to perform so well on accounting and finance‐related tasks. I show that much of the superior performance of AI models can be attributed to artifacts of the modeling itself, rather than to mechanisms grounded in economics. Focusing on two key components of AI models, which may bias inferences in papers that rely on them, I first show that Large Language Model (LLMs) exhibit extremely poor numerical reasoning and thus application in these settings should proceed with caution. Second, I highlight that commercial LLMs suffer from significant look‐ahead bias, which may explain a large portion of their predictive ability in various settings.
summary: 近期会计与金融领域的研究表明，现代AI系统在多种基础活动中表现出超越人类的能力。然而，文献通常未能提供AI模型为何表现优越的经济学解释，主要因为这些模型是黑箱。通过一系列实验，本文旨在打开黑箱，直接揭示AI模型在会计与金融相关任务中表现优异的方式和原因。研究表明，AI模型的优越性能很大程度上可归因于建模本身的伪像，而非基于经济学的机制。聚焦于AI模型的两个关键组成部分——这些部分可能使依赖它们的研究产生偏差——首先，本文展示了大语言模型（LLM）在数值推理方面表现极差，因此在这些场景中的应用应谨慎。其次，本文强调商业LLM存在显著的未来信息偏差（look-ahead bias），这可能在多种情境下解释其大部分预测能力。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的实验设计揭示了LLM在会计金融任务中看似优越性能背后的伪像，为后续研究敲响警钟，提醒学者注意数值推理缺陷和前瞻偏差问题。

title: A Dynamic Model of the Racial Wealth Gap
abstract: What explains wealth and portfolio differences between black and white Americans? We find that disparities in economic factors explain portfolios well, but only partly explain the wealth gap. In a dynamic setting, economic factors often change optimal saving rates in ways that offset their effects on income and returns. Consequently, their net wealth effect is often limited, making the wealth gap harder to explain. We estimate that differences in income levels, income risk, family structures, mortality, health expenditures, property taxes, mortgage rates, and asset returns explain half of the differential between the racial wealth gap and the racial income gap.
summary: 该论文研究美国黑人与白人之间的财富及投资组合差异。发现经济因素差异能很好地解释投资组合差异，但仅能部分解释财富差距。在动态环境下，经济因素常改变最优储蓄率，从而抵消其对收入和回报的影响，使得净财富效应有限，财富差距更难解释。估计显示，收入水平、收入风险、家庭结构、死亡率、医疗支出、财产税、抵押贷款利率和资产回报的差异，解释了种族财富差距与种族收入差距之间差额的一半。
ai_comment: 该文通过动态模型揭示了经济因素对种族财富差距的有限解释力，强调了储蓄率调整的抵消作用，为理解财富不平等提供了新视角。

title: Household Finance at the Origin: Home Ownership as a Cultural Heritage from Agriculture
abstract: I show that home ownership decisions across countries and individuals are shaped by a cultural heritage from agriculture. For centuries, dominant assets in preindustrial economies were either land or cattle. Consequently, the type of farming prevailing locally shaped preferences and beliefs about the relative value of immovable and movable assets. This cultural heritage had long-lasting consequences. Today, individuals originating from societies with a history of crop agriculture—where the dominant asset was land—are more likely to be homeowners. For identification, I rely both on home ownership decisions of second-generation immigrants in the United States and on an instrument.
summary: 本文研究农业文化遗产如何影响家庭住房所有权决策。在工业化前的经济中，主导资产因地区而异：作物农业地区以土地（不动产）为主，畜牧业地区以牲畜（动产）为主。这种差异塑造了人们对两类资产相对价值的偏好和信念，并形成文化传承，长期影响至今。利用跨国数据以及美国第二代移民的住房所有权决策（作为工具变量），作者发现来自作物农业历史背景的个体更可能拥有住房。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从文化传承角度解释住房所有权差异，利用历史农业类型作为外生变量，提供了识别因果关系的有效策略。

title: Soft Collateral, Bank Lending, and the Optimal Credit Registry
abstract: We study the design of an optimal credit registry in a general equilibrium steady-state setting where borrowers can default strategically and future access to credit markets serves as soft collateral to enforce loan repayment. We endogenize the probabilities for exclusion after default and subsequent reinstatement of clean credit records. When there are sufficient funds, optimal credit stringency is as loose as possible, subject to borrowers’ incentive constraints. When there are insufficient funds, credit stringency is driven by the need to equilibrate nonexcluded borrowers with available funds, and it increases as the imbalance grows. We examine how population growth, mortality, and persistence affect our results. Finally, we compare the simple two-tier scheme with the three-tier scheme and characterize solutions to a general N-tier registry. We show that a more graduated registry is not necessarily a better one. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.
summary: 本文在一般均衡稳态设定下研究最优信用登记机构的设计，其中借款人可能策略性违约，而未来的信贷市场准入作为软抵押来强制执行贷款偿还。模型内生化了违约后的市场排除概率以及后续信用记录恢复的概率。研究发现：当资金充足时，最优信用严苛度应尽可能宽松，只需满足借款人的激励约束；当资金不足时，信用严苛度由平衡非排除借款人与可用资金的需求驱动，并随着资金缺口扩大而增加。文章进一步分析了人口增长、死亡率和信用记录持久性对结果的影响，并比较了两层与三层信用登记方案，推广至一般N层登记机构。结论表明，更细分的信用登记机构并不必然更优。
ai_comment: 本文从一般均衡角度为信用登记机构的设计提供了理论框架，揭示了资金充裕度对最优严苛度的关键影响，并挑战了登记层级越多越好的直觉，对信用体系改革具有重要参考价值。

title: The Value of a Loss: The Impact of Restricting Tax Loss Transfers
abstract: We study the economic consequences of anti‐loss trafficking rules, which disallow the use of loss carryforwards as a tax shield after a substantial ownership change. We use staggered changes to these rules in the EU27 Member States, Norway, and the United Kingdom from 1998 to 2019 and find that limiting the transfer of tax losses is related to the number of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) declining by 18%, driven by loss‐making targets. Turning to broader industry dynamics, we find decreases in survival rates of young companies after tighter regulations. Loosening of regulation is associated with increased firm survival. Tightening (loosening) anti‐loss trafficking rules is related to decreased (increased) industry productivity, especially in R&D‐intensive industries that are more prone to loss‐making. Finally, tighter anti‐loss trafficking rules are associated with lower deal synergies and risk‐taking. All effects concentrate in strict regimes.
summary: 本文研究反亏损交易规则的经济后果，该规则禁止在所有权重大变更后使用亏损结转作为税收盾牌。利用1998年至2019年欧盟27国、挪威和英国这些规则的交错变化，发现限制亏损转移导致并购数量下降18%，主要由亏损目标驱动。更严格的规则降低了年轻公司的存活率，而放松规则则提高了存活率。收紧（放松）反亏损交易规则与行业生产率下降（上升）相关，尤其在研发密集型行业中。此外，更严格的规则与更低的交易协同和风险承担相关，所有效应集中在严格制度下。
ai_comment: 本文利用多国交错政策变化进行因果识别，提供了反亏损交易规则经济后果的全面证据，对税收政策设计有重要启示。

title: An Information-Based Theory of Auditor Switching
abstract: We model auditor switching through a tender process involving an incumbent auditor, who has private information about the client firm’s audit cost (driven by audit complexity or audit risk), and an uninformed prospective auditor. When a firm’s audit cost is high, the auditor is more susceptible to audit failure by erroneously attesting to the firm’s favorable report. We show that, in equilibrium, the client facing a high audit cost is more likely to switch to a prospective auditor because of the winner’s curse. Clients who switch auditors experience a reduction in the overall expected audit fee and are more likely to receive favorable audited reports from the new auditor than clients who do not switch. Our analytical findings collectively present a new information-based perspective on auditor switching, extending beyond the conventional “opinion shopping” explanation. We caution researchers to consider the potential influence of information asymmetry among auditors when examining auditor switching. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05977 .
summary: 该论文通过招标过程模型研究审计师更换，其中现任审计师拥有关于客户审计成本（由审计复杂性或审计风险驱动）的私人信息，而潜在的新审计师则不知情。当客户审计成本较高时，现任审计师更容易因错误证实公司的有利报告而导致审计失败。均衡结果表明，由于赢者诅咒效应，面临高审计成本的客户更可能更换审计师。与未更换审计师的客户相比，更换审计师的客户预期审计费用总体下降，且更有可能从新审计师获得有利的审计报告。这些分析结果共同提出了一个基于信息不对称的审计师更换新理论，超越了传统的“意见购买”解释。论文提醒研究者在研究审计师更换时，应考虑审计师之间信息不对称的潜在影响。
ai_comment: 该论文通过信息不对称视角为审计师更换提供了新颖的理论解释，区别于传统的意见购买假说，具有重要的理论贡献和实际启示。

title: Backfiring AI? AI Deployment in Workplace
abstract: Seeking value from artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, firms are rapidly deploying them to augment employees and improve business performance. The diffusion of AI into a firm’s business processes affords the tracking of task actions performed by high-performing employees and the codification of best practices into recommendation systems and training programs. The rising trend in AI deployment reveals managers’ expectations that AI-facilitated knowledge transfer would elevate overall firm performance. However, deploying AI in a workplace has the potential to change the competitive dynamics among employees. The AI system can learn from high-performing employees and make that knowledge available to others. In a competitive environment, this can disincentivize high-performing employees and ultimately backfire, leading to a decline in overall firm productivity. In this paper, we study this problem of employee incentive issues when deploying AI in a competitive workplace, using a game-theoretic model. Our results show that when employees compete using both tangible (“hard”) and intangible (“soft”) skills, firm policies that favor AI-facilitated knowledge transfer and task outcome-based compensation may lower firm performance. We illustrate that payoffs from AI deployments depend on workforce heterogeneity, reliance on tangible skills, the skill disparity between employees, and AI efficacy. Using our model, we develop policy recommendations for maximizing the return on organizational AI deployments. Our results suggest that some ostensibly simple solutions, like guaranteeing or increasing the wages of adversely affected employees, may not solve the problem effectively, and firms would have to judiciously choose optimal AI efficacy levels for achieving better outcomes. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03108 .
summary: 企业为获取人工智能技术价值，正迅速部署AI以增强员工绩效和业务表现。AI渗透到业务流程中，可以跟踪高绩效员工的任务行为，并将最佳实践编码为推荐系统和培训项目。然而，在工作场所部署AI可能改变员工之间的竞争动态：AI系统能从高绩效员工处学习并将知识分享给他人，在竞争环境下可能削弱高绩效员工的激励，最终反噬企业整体生产力。本文使用博弈论模型研究了竞争性工作场所中AI部署引发的员工激励问题。结果表明，当员工同时使用硬技能和软技能竞争时，偏向AI促进知识转移和基于任务结果薪酬的政策可能降低企业绩效。模型揭示了AI部署的回报取决于劳动力异质性、对硬技能的依赖、员工技能差距以及AI效能。基于模型，提出了最大化企业AI部署回报的政策建议，包括简单提高受影响员工工资并非有效解决方案，企业需审慎选择最优AI效能水平以实现更好结果。
ai_comment: 该论文通过博弈论模型揭示了AI部署可能因削弱高绩效员工激励而导致绩效下降的反直觉现象，并提供了政策建议，对实践具有重要启示。

title: The Information Content of Commodity Futures Markets
abstract: Among commodity futures sectors, only industrial metals returns predict future industrial production growth and revisions in producers’ expectations about future economic conditions across a wide range of countries. This predictive power is stronger in countries more exposed to the global economy, is driven by demand shocks, persists after controlling for trade dependence, continues to hold after the financialization of commodity markets, and is reflected in international stock returns. In contrast, energy and agriculture futures also contain relevant information but mainly for countries that depend on these commodities through trade. Our findings provide global evidence in support of the informational role of commodity markets and identify industrial metals as a reliable barometer of future global economic activity. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00899 .
summary: 本研究探讨不同商品期货部门对未来经济活动的预测能力。基于多国数据，发现仅有工业金属期货的回报能显著预测未来的工业生产增长以及生产者对经济状况预期的修正。该预测能力在更依赖全球经济的国家中更强，主要由需求冲击驱动，且不受贸易依赖程度或商品市场金融化的影响，并反映在国际股票回报中。相比之下，能源和农产品期货的预测作用仅限于通过贸易依赖这些商品的国家。研究结果为商品市场的信息角色提供了全球层面的证据，并将工业金属视为未来全球经济活动的可靠先行指标。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地区分了不同商品期货部门，揭示了工业金属作为全球经济晴雨表的独特作用，并提供了跨国证据，对理解商品市场的信息传导机制有重要贡献。

title: A Tale of Two Market Disciplines: How Does Bank Financial Misconduct Affect Peer Banks in the Local Deposit Market
abstract: This study examines the spillover effect of bank financial misconduct on the uninsured deposits of peer banks within local markets. We first validate that misconduct banks experience an increase in deposit spreads and a corresponding outflow of deposits following the misconduct. We then show local peer banks exhibit divergent deposit responses, contingent on how misconduct is perceived by information recipients in different economic contexts. During normal periods, depositors receiving a negative signal about bank misconduct reallocate their funds from misconduct banks to local peers, a local reallocation effect that decreases deposit spreads and increases deposit inflows for peer banks. Cross‐sectional analysis further reveals that this local reallocation effect is more pronounced for financially sophisticated depositors, amplified when peer banks have strong fundamentals, but attenuated when misconduct banks are financially sound. During financial crisis periods, however, bank misconduct leads to withdrawals from both misconduct banks and their peer banks, a local contagion effect whereby local peer banks face increased deposit spreads and deposit outflows following the misconduct.
summary: 本文研究银行金融不当行为对本地市场上同行银行未保险存款的溢出效应。首先验证了存在不当行为的银行在行为后存款利差上升、存款流出。进一步发现，同行银行的存款反应取决于不同经济情境下信息接收者对不当行为的解读：正常时期，存款人将资金从不法银行重新配置到本地同行，导致同行银行利差下降、存款流入增加；交叉分析表明，这一重新配置效应在财务成熟的存款人、同行银行基本面强劲时更显著，而在不法银行财务健康时减弱。金融危机时期，银行不当行为则引发本地传染效应，导致不法银行和同行银行均面临存款利差上升和存款流出。
ai_comment: 论文区分了正常时期与危机时期银行不当行为的两种溢出机制（重新配置与传染），深化了对市场纪律的理解，对监管政策具有参考价值。

title: Generative AI Use by Capital Market Information Intermediaries: Evidence from Seeking Alpha
abstract: We study the use of generative AI for firm‐specific financial analysis on the Seeking Alpha platform. After the initial launch of ChatGPT in November 2022, the share of AI‐generated articles rose sharply to 13.5% of all articles, then declined in late 2023 after Seeking Alpha equated the use of AI to plagiarism and announced a prohibition on its use. We organize our study around two questions: (1) Does AI use increase author productivity? and (2) does AI use have capital market consequences and ultimately affect the informational landscape? We find that authors who adopt AI become more productive, publishing more articles and covering more new firms than non‐adopters. Findings on AI article informativeness are more nuanced. On average, AI articles are less informative than human‐written articles, eliciting smaller trading volume and abnormal return responses. However, AI use leads to increased firm coverage and in turn to improved liquidity and faster price discovery. Our findings suggest that, while AI‐generated articles are currently perceived as less informative than human‐written articles, their comparatively low cost enables increased firm coverage and thereby improves the overall informational landscape.
summary: 本文研究生成式AI在资本市场信息中介平台Seeking Alpha上的使用情况，聚焦于企业特定财务分析。研究发现，ChatGPT于2022年11月推出后，AI生成文章占比迅速升至13.5%，但在2023年底平台将AI使用等同于抄袭并禁止后有所下降。围绕两个问题展开：AI是否提高作者生产力？AI是否影响资本市场及信息环境？结果表明，采用AI的作者生产力更高，发布更多文章并覆盖更多新公司。AI文章的信息含量平均低于人类撰写文章，引发较小的交易量和异常回报反应，但AI使用增加了公司覆盖范围，进而改善了流动性和价格发现速度。结论指出，尽管AI文章当前被视为信息含量较低，但其低成本特点促进了公司覆盖，从而改善了整体信息环境。
ai_comment: 本文利用Seeking Alpha平台的自然实验，揭示了生成式AI在金融分析中的双重效应：提高作者生产力但降低单篇文章信息含量，同时通过扩大公司覆盖改善市场整体信息环境，为监管和平台政策提供了重要实证依据。

title: Data Centers and Local Economies in the Age of AI: A Shift--Share Approach
Organization Capital, Large Startups, and the Dearth of IPOs
abstract: Many startups in the 2000s have remained private after achieving large valuations, a pattern that funding availability alone cannot explain.We propose that startups relying heavily on organization capital to achieve economies of scale and network effects through digital technologies are more likely to become large private firms than exit earlier via an IPO or acquisition.Using LinkedIn data, we construct a novel measure of organization capital intensity for startups.Exploiting a legal shock that strengthened organization capital protection, we provide causal evidence that organization-capital-intensive startups are more likely to remain private and grow large rather than exit early.
summary: 本文研究了2000年代许多估值已较高的初创公司仍选择保持私有而非尽早IPO或被收购的现象，并指出仅用融资可得性无法完全解释。作者提出，依赖组织资本通过数字技术实现规模经济和网络效应的初创公司更可能成为大型私有公司而不是早期退出。利用LinkedIn数据，作者构建了一个新的组织资本强度衡量指标。通过利用一项加强组织资本保护的法律冲击，提供了因果证据表明组织资本密集型初创公司更倾向于保持私有并发展壮大，而非早期退出。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地量化了初创公司的组织资本强度，并利用法律冲击提供了因果证据，揭示了组织资本在解释初创公司推迟上市决策中的关键作用。

title: Deep Research on a Loop: Using AI Agents to Construct Economic Datasets
abstract: Constructing datasets from primary sources is one of the costliest tasks in empirical economics.We propose Deep Research on a Loop (DRIL), a methodology that uses AI agents to assemble datasets from publicly available sources.DRIL applies a fixed research instrument across a mapped unit space (e.g., countries by years), with a two-stage architecture separating design from implementation.The instrument specifies variables and coding rules, an evidence policy governs sources and citations, and data quality mechanisms track gaps and uncertainty explicitly.We exercise DRIL on a 2025 update of the Global Tax Expenditures Database for eight Latin American and Caribbean countries.The run produces 129 sources and 136 evidence records, covering 22 qualitative fields fully and 6 quantitative estimate types with documented gaps, at the cost of a standard LLM subscription comparable to a few hours of research-assistant work.We argue that even partial automation of dataset construction can shift the production function of empirical economics.
summary: 本文提出了一种名为“深度循环研究”（DRIL）的方法，利用AI代理从公开来源自动构建经济数据集。该方法采用两阶段架构，将设计（变量和编码规则）与实施分离，并通过证据政策管理来源和引用，同时通过数据质量机制明确追踪缺失和不确定性。作者将DRIL应用于2025年全球税收支出数据库的更新，覆盖八个拉丁美洲和加勒比国家，产生了129个来源和136条证据记录，完整覆盖22个定性字段和6个定量估计类型（存在部分缺失），成本仅为标准LLM订阅费用，相当于几小时的研究助理工作。文章认为，即使部分自动化数据集构建也能改变实证经济学的生产函数。
ai_comment: 提出了一种低成本、可复用的自动化数据集构建框架，有望显著降低实证研究中数据收集的人力成本，具有较高实用价值。

title: AlphaGlass: Interpretable Characteristic-Based Portfolio Choice
Earnings Management and Price Informativeness
Owner Support for Green Shareholder Voting and Divestment
abstract: This paper examines the preferences of 10,000 capital owners worldwide, including nearly 3,000 from the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund, regarding green shareholder voting and divestment. Findings indicate substantial support (53%–72%) for shareholder engagement and green voting, which is more popular and less politically divisive than divestment. Preferences for green voting increase with the likelihood of green outcomes being implemented though 63% of the payoff is attributed to expressive benefits. These results suggest that shareholder engagement and green voting could play a central role in a broader climate strategy portfolio. This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability. Funding: This work was supported by The Norwegian Finance Market Fund (Finansmarkedsfondet). Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08186 .
summary: 本文基于对全球约1万名资本所有者（其中近3000名来自全球最大主权财富基金）的调查，研究其对绿色股东投票和撤资的偏好。结果发现，53%-72%的受访者支持股东参与和绿色投票，且绿色投票比撤资更受欢迎、政治分歧更小。绿色投票的偏好随绿色成果实施可能性的提高而增加，但高达63%的回报归因于表达性收益。这些结果表明，股东参与和绿色投票可在更广泛的气候策略组合中发挥核心作用。
ai_comment: 该研究基于大规模全球调查样本，提供了关于资本所有者对气候行动偏好的实证证据，特别是揭示了表达性收益在绿色投票驱动因素中的重要性。

title: Optimal Integration: Human, Machine, and Generative AI
abstract: I study the optimal integration of humans and technologies in multilayered decision-making processes. When each layer can correct existing errors but may also introduce new errors, who should have the final authority? I show that a decision maker’s correction capability normalized by its new errors is a one-dimensional quality metric that determines the optimal rule: deploying higher quality technologies in later stages. Intriguingly, despite its highest quality, the final layer may not generate the greatest error reduction; instead, its role hinges on minimizing new errors. Human effort varies asymmetrically across layers: early stages exert relatively lower effort and prioritize error correction, whereas later stages exert higher effort and focus on avoiding new errors. Applying the model to artificial intelligence (AI) reveals that AI’s generative capabilities make it more likely to serve as the final decision maker, reducing the need for costly human input at the risks of AI hallucination. The theoretical framework also extends to applications including repeated delegation, automation design, loan screening, tenure review, and other multilayer decision-making scenarios. This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on AI for Business and Finance Decisions.
summary: 该论文研究了多层决策过程中人类与技术的优化整合问题。每层决策者既能够纠正已有错误，也可能引入新的错误，因此需要确定谁应当拥有最终决策权。论文表明，决策者的纠正能力标准化后的新错误率是一个一维质量指标，决定了最优规则：将更高质量的技术部署在后期阶段。有趣的是，尽管最终层质量最高，但其未必能带来最大的错误减少；相反，其作用在于最小化新错误。人类努力在不同层级间不对称：早期层级付出相对较低的努力并优先纠正错误，而后期层级付出更高努力并专注于避免新错误。将模型应用于人工智能时，AI的生成能力使其更可能成为最终决策者，这减少了昂贵的人力投入，但增加了AI幻觉的风险。该理论框架还扩展到重复委托、自动化设计、贷款筛选、任期评审等多层决策场景。论文已被Will Cong接受，将发表于AI for Business and Finance Decisions虚拟特刊。
