ai_comment: 论文提出了一个新颖的框架来优化人与AI的决策层级分配，揭示了最终决策者的关键作用是减少新错误而非纠正旧错误。其对AI生成能力的分析具有重要的现实意义。

title: A Theory Model of Digital Currency with Asymmetric Privacy
abstract: This paper considers introducing asymmetric privacy in the design of central bank digital currencies (CBDC) and digital currencies more generally to preserve the privacy of money spent while keeping the benefits of digital records for money received. It is shown that this feature would help minimize real distortions between consumers, firms, and financiers while enabling tax optimization and better access to external financing. Protecting the privacy of consumers is desirable from a welfare and efficiency standpoint as long as there exist noticeable privacy concerns. Implementing asymmetric privacy is technologically feasible, using, for instance, zero-knowledge proofs or other privacy tools. This paper has been accepted by Lin William Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06830 .
summary: 该论文提出在央行数字货币（CBDC）及更广泛的数字货币设计中引入不对称隐私（asymmetric privacy）机制，即在保护支出方隐私的同时，保留收款方数字记录的优势。研究表明，这一设计有助于最小化消费者、企业和金融家之间的真实经济扭曲，同时实现税收优化并改善企业外部融资渠道。只要存在显著的隐私担忧，保护消费者隐私从福利和效率角度而言都是可取的。技术上，可以通过零知识证明（zero-knowledge proofs）等隐私工具实现不对称隐私。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将不对称隐私概念引入数字货币设计，平衡了隐私保护与监管/税务需求，为CBDC设计提供了新视角。

title: Corporate Pension Risk Transfers
abstract: Sponsors of corporate defined benefit (DB) pension plans in the United States transferred $155 billion pension obligations to insurance companies between 2012 and 2022. These pension risk transfers (PRTs) reduced the pool of corporate DB plan participants by 12% and are a huge business for the involved insurers. We assemble a new PRT database and highlight three features of PRTs: (i) the burden associated with mandatory Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) insurance premiums drives PRT activity; (ii) using an upper bound measure for the impact of PRTs, we estimate that the average sponsor reduces its pension obligations and plan participants by 22% and 27%, respectively. These large reductions are mainly because of the transfer of retired plan participants to insurance companies. (iii) Plan sponsors that conduct PRTs have less default risk and less volatile pension assets even after conducting the PRTs. Hence, PRTs increase the risk of the remaining PBGC pool. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: S. Klingler gratefully acknowledges support from the European Research Council [Grant 101040188]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05523 .
summary: 本文研究美国企业固定收益（DB）养老金计划的风险转移（PRT）现象，即计划发起人将养老金义务转移给保险公司。基于2012至2022年间转移的1550亿美元养老金债务和12%参与者减少的新数据库，作者发现三个主要特征：（i）强制性养老金福利担保公司（PBGC）保费是驱动PRT活动的主要因素；（ii）平均而言，PRT使发起人减少22%的养老金义务和27%的参与者，主要由于退休参与者的转移；（iii）进行PRT的发起人在转移后违约风险更低且养老金资产波动性更小，但增加了剩余PBGC池的风险。论文还提供了在线附录和数据文件。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建新数据库，系统揭示了养老金风险转移的驱动因素及其对发起人和PBGC的风险影响，为养老金风险管理提供了重要实证证据。

title: Do Households React to Monetary Policy?
abstract: We study how households understand and respond to monetary policy by exploiting the open auctions of early-stage crowdfunding and inferring individuals’ expectations based on their maximum requested interest rates. Using loan listings from Prosper, we find that borrowers adjust their willingness-to-pay interest rates in response to unexpected Federal funds rate changes, whereas anticipated shifts have negligible effects. These responses are more pronounced among high-income, high-credit-score borrowers; large loan applicants; and when Federal Reserve communication is transparent. The responses are highly asymmetric—Borrowers sharply lower rates during unexpected easing but resist increasing them during unexpected tightening. The results are robust to alternative specifications, including regression-discontinuity-in-time designs and alternative measures of monetary policy shock. Lenders also respond to policy shocks and counteract borrowers’ adjustments. Analysis of Robinhood data shows that retail investors mirror this behavior by reducing equity holdings after surprise rate hikes. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the general research fund from the Research Grant Council of Hong Kong [Grant 17504925], the Dean’s Research Fund of the Faculty of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, The Education University of Hong Kong [Grant FLASS/DRF 04635], the Faculty Research Grants of Macau University of Science and Technology [Grant FRG-24-019-MSB], the Seed Funding Grant of EdUHK [Grant 02C11], and the Block Grant Blueprint of EdUHK [Grant 02A23]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04649 .
summary: 该论文利用早期众筹平台的公开拍卖数据，通过借款人设定的最高利率来推断其预期，研究家庭如何理解和响应货币政策。基于 Prosper 平台的贷款列表，发现借款人会根据未预期的联邦基金利率变化调整其愿意支付的利率，而预期中的利率变化几乎没有影响。这种响应在高收入、高信用评分、大额贷款申请者以及美联储沟通透明时更为显著，且呈现出高度不对称性：在未预期的宽松政策下，借款人会大幅降低利率，但在未预期的紧缩政策下则抗拒提高利率。结果在多种稳健性检验中依然成立，包括时间断点回归设计和替代的货币政策冲击度量。出借人也对政策冲击做出反应，并抵消借款人的调整。此外，对 Robinhood 数据的分析显示，散户投资者在意外加息后会减少股票持有。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的众筹数据构建了家庭预期的代理变量，为货币政策传导机制的微观基础提供了新颖证据，尤其揭示了家庭对货币政策响应的不对称性和异质性。

title: An Economic Model of a Decentralized Exchange with Concentrated Liquidity
abstract: We develop an economic model of a decentralized exchange with concentrated liquidity (e.g., Uniswap v3 and v4), with a particular focus on the economics of liquidity provision. We demonstrate that providing liquidity for a risky/risk-free asset pool is comparable to investing in a covered call, except that the call option therein is sold at intrinsic rather than market value. Hence, when providing liquidity, liquidity providers forgo the time premium of the call option in exchange for fees, and thus equilibrium liquidity provision decreases in the time premium. Finally, we provide an expression for equilibrium liquidity provision that is useful for empirical work. This paper has been This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.
summary: 本文构建了一个具有集中流动性的去中心化交易所（如Uniswap v3和v4）的经济模型，重点关注流动性提供经济学。我们证明，为风险/无风险资产池提供流动性类似于投资于有保底看涨期权（covered call），但其中的看涨期权是以内在价值而非市场价值出售。因此，在提供流动性时，流动性提供者放弃看涨期权的时间溢价以换取费用，从而均衡流动性供给随时间溢价递减。最后，我们给出了一个适用于实证工作的均衡流动性供给表达式。
ai_comment: 通过期权定价框架深入剖析集中流动性提供机制，为实证研究提供了简洁的均衡表达式。

title: How Do Taxes Affect the Trading Behavior of Private Investors? Evidence from Individual Portfolio Data
abstract: The removal of an intertemporal tax discontinuity in Germany provides us with a natural experiment to study the causal effect of taxes on individual stock-trading behavior and the disposition effect. Using individual investor transactions data combined with nonparametric regressions and bunching methods, we find that the presence of the tax discontinuity induces investors to adjust their holding periods, which reduces their effective tax rate by 11.3%. We also find that tax effects dominate the disposition effect in the days around the discontinuity and can inhibit it (by about 20%) during the six months preceding the discontinuity. We discuss the consequences of our results for the firms whose stocks are traded and policy implications. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: F. Buhlmann gratefully acknowledges financial support by MannheimTaxation ScienceCampus. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04213 .
summary: 本研究利用德国取消跨期税收断点的自然实验，结合个人投资者交易数据、非参数回归和聚束方法，探讨税收对个人股票交易行为及处置效应的因果影响。研究发现，税收断点的存在促使投资者调整持有期，使其有效税率降低11.3%；在断点前后数天内，税收效应主导了处置效应，并在断点前六个月抑制处置效应约20%。文章还讨论了这些结果对被交易公司股票及政策制定的启示。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特自然实验和微观交易数据，清晰分离了税收与行为偏差的影响，为税收政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: The Real Impact of FinTech: Evidence from Mobile Payment Technology
abstract: We utilize the introduction of mobile payment technology by the largest bank in Singapore in 2017 to study how mobile payment technology reshapes economic activities and stimulates business creation. After the introduction, business-to-consumer industries witnessed 18.3% more business creation relative to business-to-business industries, with the effect driven by small firms and more pronounced among industries with higher cash handling costs. Underlying this pattern is consumers’ strong adoption of mobile payment and a reduction in ATM cash withdrawals during the post-shock period. The reduced transaction cost also increases consumers’ spending capacity, which justifies the business growth. Interestingly, part of the increased consumer demand is credit card spending. The pattern of changes is consistent with the bank’s adjustment to the technological change: it reduces ATMs and allows more credit card openings and higher credit limits. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: Y. Ren received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72303210], the Zhejiang Provincial Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant LQ24G010001], and the major project of the National Social Science Fund of China [Grant 24&ZD088]. S. Agarwal acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72495154]. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03947 .
summary: 本文利用新加坡最大银行在2017年引入移动支付技术的自然实验，研究移动支付如何重塑经济活动并刺激企业创建。结果显示，移动支付引入后，企业对消费者行业的初创企业数量比企业对企业行业增加了18.3%，这种效应主要由小企业驱动，并且在现金处理成本较高的行业中更为显著。消费者对移动支付的强烈接受以及ATM现金取款量的减少支撑了这一模式。交易成本的降低也提高了消费者的支出能力，部分消费通过信用卡实现，这进一步解释了企业增长。银行相应调整了策略：减少ATM数量，增加信用卡开卡和信用额度。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验识别移动支付的因果效应，揭示了其通过降低交易成本和改变消费者支付行为促进企业创建的机制，对理解金融科技对实体经济的影响具有重要贡献。

title: Unearthing Financial Statement Fraud: Insights from News Coverage Analysis
abstract: We propose a financial statement (FS) fraud detection framework, called PeerMeta, that makes improvements in all three components of the detection procedure: label measurement, feature set, and detection model. For the label measurement, prior studies mainly adopt FS fraud events that have already been disclosed and confirmed. We construct a new measure based on news coverage that can reflect unrevealed FS fraud behaviors as well. For the feature set, we innovatively add peer factors learned through the business description texts in financial reports. For the detection model, two meta-learning algorithms are applied to aggregate the 19 popular classifiers. The results indicate that the proposed method has amazingly high recall of real fraud cases announced by regulatory authorities, reaching a staggering value of 0.982. We document that all components in PeerMeta contribute to the improvements of FS fraud detection and also showcase the significant economic value of the detection framework and find that recall is more crucial for the economic value than precision. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 71991470, 7199471, 72121002, 72310107002] and the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2021YFC3340703]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03604 .
summary: 本文提出一个财务报表舞弊检测框架PeerMeta，在标签测量、特征集和检测模型三个组件上进行了改进。标签测量方面，以往研究主要采用已披露和确认的舞弊事件，而本文基于新闻覆盖度构建新指标，可以反映未揭露的舞弊行为。特征集方面，创新性地加入通过财务报告业务描述文本学习的同行因素。检测模型方面，采用两种元学习算法聚合19个流行分类器。结果表明，该方法对监管机构公布的舞弊案例召回率高达0.982。研究证实所有组件均有贡献，并展示了检测框架的显著经济价值，发现召回率比精确率对经济价值更重要。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用新闻数据弥补传统标签的滞后性，并引入同行文本特征，大幅提升舞弊检测的召回率，具有重要实践意义。

title: Forced to be Active: Evidence from a Regulation Intervention
abstract: Mutual funds known as closet indexers are marketed as active but actually operate as low-activity funds. Investors end up paying for full service but receiving only a part of it. Supervisory authorities around the world are considering ways to regulate these funds. In this context, we examine the impact of regulatory interventions by Scandinavian regulators. We compare the scrutinized Scandinavian funds with similar unaffected European funds. The findings suggest that the regulated Scandinavian funds preferred increased activity over fee reduction. Consequently, fund managers adopted more active management strategies, resulting in a significant 2% decrease in annual alpha. Therefore, the regulatory interventions resulted in unfavorable outcomes for investors. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: This research was supported by funding from the Varekrigsfond for forsikringsaktiviteter at NHH. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03124 .
summary: 本文研究监管干预对“closet indexers”（即表面声称积极管理但实际低活动度的共同基金）的影响。斯堪的纳维亚监管机构对这类基金进行了干预，迫使它们要么降低费用，要么增加投资活动。通过对比受监管的斯堪的纳维亚基金与未受影响的类似欧洲基金，研究发现受监管基金更倾向于增加活动而非降低费用。基金管理者因此采取了更积极的管理策略，但导致年化阿尔法显著下降2%，表明监管干预对投资者产生了不利后果。
ai_comment: 该论文通过自然实验提供了监管干预对closet indexers效果的经验证据，揭示了预期外的负面后果（阿尔法下降），对政策制定具有重要警示意义。

title: The Adoption of Central Bank Digital Currency
abstract: We investigate the adoption of Central Bank digital currency (CBDC) in a partial equilibrium setting, focusing on four key features: remuneration, monetary incentives, interoperability, and architecture. Agents are interested in adopting CBDC because they have a preference for digital payments, and the Central Bank may incentivize adoption through subsidies and platform development, potentially in collaboration with the private sector. Our results demonstrate that both the remuneration scheme and monetary incentives significantly influence the adoption rate and transaction volume. Calibrating the model for the digital euro case study, we show that the target of 60% of the population using CBDC can be achieved, provided that platform productivity is substantially enhanced. Although this target is feasible within a one-layer architecture, it becomes significantly more challenging in a two-layer setting. CBDC is likely to win the adoption battle against stablecoins but is likely to lose it against debit cards. This paper has been This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: This project has been partially funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU – PNRR project SERICS “Security and Rights in the CyberSpace” (PE00000014 – CUP B53C22003990006) – SPOKE 9. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01504 .
summary: 本文在部分均衡框架下研究央行数字货币（CBDC）的采用，重点考察四个关键特征：报酬机制、货币激励、互操作性和架构设计。代理人因偏好数字支付而有意采用CBDC，央行可通过补贴和平台开发（可能与私营部门合作）激励采用。结果表明，报酬方案和货币激励显著影响采用率和交易量。针对数字欧元案例的校准显示，若大幅提升平台生产力，则可实现60%人口使用CBDC的目标；该目标在一层架构下可行，但在两层架构下显著更难。CBDC在与稳定币的竞争中可能获胜，但可能输给借记卡。
ai_comment: 本文通过部分均衡模型系统分析了CBDC采用的关键驱动因素，并对数字欧元进行了现实校准，揭示了不同架构下的可行性差异，为政策制定提供了量化依据。

title: Using Social Recognition to Address the Gender Difference in Volunteering for Low-Promotability Tasks
abstract: Research shows that women volunteer significantly more for tasks that people prefer others to complete. Such tasks carry little monetary incentives because of their very nature. We use a modified version of the volunteer’s dilemma game to examine if nonmonetary interventions, particularly social recognition, can be used to reduce the gender gap associated with such tasks. We conduct a laboratory experiment with three treatments where (a) a volunteer receives positive social recognition, (b) a nonvolunteer receives negative social recognition, and (c) a volunteer receives positive social recognition but a nonvolunteer receives negative social recognition. Our results indicate that social recognition increases the overall probability that an individual volunteers. Positive social recognition reduces the gender gap observed in the baseline treatment, and so does the combination of positive and negative social recognition. These findings suggest that public recognition of volunteering for such tasks can change the default gender norms in organizations and increase efficiency simultaneously. This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This research was primarily funded by the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore [Seed Grant 7399FW]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04017 .
summary: 研究发现，女性在低晋升性任务（即人们更希望他人完成的任务）中的自愿参与率显著高于男性。这类任务因性质特殊，几乎不提供货币激励。本文通过修改版的自愿者困境博弈，考察非货币干预（特别是社会认可）能否缩小与此类任务相关的性别差距。实验设置了三种处理：志愿者获得正面社会认可、非志愿者受到负面社会认可、志愿者获正面认可以及非志愿者受负面认可。结果显示，社会认可总体上提高了个人自愿参与的概率。正面社会认可缩小了基线处理中观察到的性别差距，正面与负面社会认可的组合也产生了类似效果。这些发现表明，公开认可志愿者可以改变组织中的默认性别规范，同时提高效率。
ai_comment: 通过简单的非货币社会认可机制有效干预性别差异，具有现实应用意义；实验设计区分了正面与负面认可的效果，为组织管理提供了具体策略。

title: Natural Disasters, Financial Shocks, and Human Capital
abstract: We examine effects on productivity, employment, and debt outcomes among college students whose parents reside in areas that experience financial shocks caused by natural disasters. After shocks, treated students exhibit poorer academic performance. To boost the impaired grade point average, these students sacrifice educational content by withdrawing from more courses and enrolling in fewer STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) courses. Effects are stronger for middle class students likely relying on family income to pay for college. Students mostly mitigate financial shocks with additional part-time employment. Ultimately, disrupted students are 10% more likely to default on student loans. Overall, these results shed light on the effects of financial stress on the intensive margin of human capital formation. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02977 .
summary: 本文研究了因自然灾害导致的父母居住地区财务冲击对大学生学业、就业和债务结果的影响。受冲击后，学生在学业表现上出现下滑。为了弥补受损的绩点，这些学生通过退选更多课程和减少STEM（科学、技术、工程、数学）课程的选修来牺牲教育内容。对于可能依赖家庭收入支付大学学费的中产阶级学生而言，这种影响更为显著。学生主要通过增加兼职工作来缓解财务冲击。最终，受干扰的学生在学生贷款违约的可能性上高出10%。总体而言，这些结果揭示了财务压力对人力资本形成密集边际的影响。
ai_comment: 该论文通过独特的自然灾害外生冲击视角，揭示了家庭财务压力对学生教育决策和长期债务结果的因果影响，尤其关注了STEM课程选择这一教育内容牺牲机制。

title: Active Liquidity Management, Strategic Complementarities, and Market Price of Liquidity
abstract: This paper examines how market uncertainty impacts the liquidity premium through a demand-side channel. I find that equity mutual funds actively increase the liquidity of their portfolios in response to increased redemptions during market stress. Liquidity preservation is more intense for funds more exposed to strategic complementarities. I show that a stock’s relative illiquidity within a fund’s portfolio is a key determinant in flow-induced rebalancing decisions, whereby funds follow a liquidation “pecking order.” This “flight-to-liquidity” is associated with increases in the liquidity premium and affects individual stocks’ reversal performance: Stocks held by more fragile funds and those with higher illiquidity ranks within funds’ portfolios experience greater returns to liquidity provision during market stress. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02095 .
summary: 本文研究市场不确定性如何通过需求侧渠道影响流动性溢价。作者发现，在市场压力期间，股票型共同基金为应对赎回增加会主动提升其投资组合的流动性，且这种流动性保留行为在面临战略互补性的基金中更为显著。研究显示，股票在基金投资组合中的相对非流动性是触发赎回驱动再平衡决策的关键因素，基金遵循一种清算“啄序”。这种“流动性逃避”行为与流动性溢价上升相关联，并影响个股的反转表现：在市场压力时，由更脆弱的基金持有且在其投资组合中流动性排名更差的股票，会为流动性提供者带来更高的回报。
ai_comment: 本文从需求侧视角揭示了基金主动流动性管理对资产定价的影响，特别是通过清算“啄序”机制丰富了流动性溢价的微观基础。

title: Enterprise Risk Management and Management Earnings Forecasts
abstract: Enterprise risk management (ERM) is an institutional agenda emphasizing holistic risk oversight and strategic planning. This study examines whether and how the adoption of ERM affects management earnings forecasts. We first document that ERM adoption increases the likelihood and accuracy of management earnings forecasts. We then provide evidence that ERM adoption improves forecast quality by reducing the volatility of fundamentals and enhancing managers’ ability to assess both internal and external information. Finally, we find that the positive effect of ERM in improving forecast accuracy is more pronounced for long-horizon forecasts, consistent with ERM’s long-term strategic focus. Collectively, our results shed light on how ERM adoption improves the quality of a key voluntary disclosure—management forecasts. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: C. Li thanks the C.A. Scupin professorship at the University of Kansas, L. Sun thanks the Barney A. Coda professorship at the University of North Texas, and J. Xu gratefully acknowledges the G. Brint Ryan College of Business Summer Research Grant at the University of North Texas. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01120 .
summary: 研究考察企业风险管理（ERM）的采用是否以及如何影响管理层盈利预测。首先发现ERM采用增加了管理层盈利预测的可能性和准确性。进一步证明，ERM通过减少基础波动性并增强管理者评估内部和外部信息的能力来改善预测质量。最后，发现ERM提高预测准确性的正向效应对长期预测更为显著，这与ERM的长期战略重点一致。总体而言，结果揭示了ERM如何改善关键自愿披露——管理层预测的质量。
ai_comment: 本文从企业风险管理视角拓展了管理层预测影响因素的研究，并揭示了ERM通过降低波动性和提升信息处理能力提高预测质量的内在机制。

title: Round Number Preferences and Left-Digit Bias: Evidence from Credit Card Repayments
abstract: We examine round number preferences and left-digit bias in credit card repayments. We show half of all manual credit card payments are at a small set of round-number values, although all values between the statement minimum and balance were permissible. We use minimum payments, which place a floor on the payment value, to measure the strength of rounding behavior in a natural experiment. We find that when the minimum payment level just rules out a round number from the bottom of the range of possible repayment (e.g., a minimum payment of £50.01 just rules out a payment of £50.00), payments at the next round number jump by 15%–20% (e.g., payments at £60.00). That is, in response to a smooth increase in minimum payments, the selected payments jump up a ladder of round numbers when each lower rung is removed. We also see a classic—although nuanced—left digit bias. When the balance increases such that the left digit changes (e.g., from £1,999 to £2,000), payments in full drop by 3%–8% as if an increase in the left digit makes the balance seem much larger. But average repayments increase by 10%–15%, as smaller partial repayments are all dragged up the ladder rungs. This preference for a small set of round numbers as payment values and this effect of left digit bias on the level of repayment have policy implications. Rounding could be used by policy makers to encourage faster paydown of credit card debt, using one-click “rounds-ups,” defaults, or shrouding. These policy options could deliver interest savings of up to 40%. This paper was accepted by Yuval Rottenstreich, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by the Economic and Social Research Council [Grants ES/K002201/1, ES/N018192/1, ES/P008976/1, and ES/V004867/1] and the Leverhulme [Grant RP2012-V-022]. H. Sakaguchi acknowledges PhD studentship funding from the Economic and Social Research Council [Award 1499648]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01995 .
summary: 本文研究了信用卡手动还款中的整数偏好和左位数字偏差。尽管还款金额可以在账单最低还款额与余额之间任意选择，但一半的还款集中在少数几个整数值上。利用最低还款额作为自然实验，发现当最低还款额刚好排除某个整数（如£50.01排除£50.00）时，下一个整数还款额（如£60.00）的出现频率跳升15%-20%。同时观察到经典的左位数字偏差：当余额左位数字变化（如从£1,999到£2,000）时，全额还款比例下降3%-8%，但平均还款金额上升10%-15%，因为较小的部分还款被“拖上”了整数阶梯。这些偏好具有政策含义，政策制定者可通过一键“凑整”、默认选项或隐藏信息等方式鼓励加速还清信用卡债务，使用这些策略可节省高达40%的利息。
ai_comment: 通过巧妙利用最低还款额的断点自然实验，干净地识别了整数偏好和左位数字偏差的真实因果效应，并给出了具有可行性的政策建议，对行为金融和消费者金融领域有重要贡献。

title: Intervening against the Fed
abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness and mechanism of foreign exchange interventions (FXIs) for mitigating US monetary policy spillovers. Without interventions, contractionary US monetary policy shocks trigger foreign exchange depreciations, raise risk premiums, and induce portfolio outflows, thereby reducing foreign stock prices. The stock prices of firms with US dollar debt decline significantly more, indicating a strong role for a balance sheet channel. However, “intervening against the Fed” stabilizes exchange rate depreciations, the risk premium, and portfolio flows. FXIs also disproportionately cushion the reduction in stock prices for firms with US dollar debt, muting the balance sheet channel of exchange rates.
summary: 本文研究外汇干预（FXI）对缓解美国货币政策溢出效应的有效性和作用机制。在没有干预的情况下，美国紧缩性货币政策冲击会导致外国货币贬值、风险溢价上升以及投资组合外流，进而压低外国股票价格。其中，持有美元债务的公司的股票价格下跌更为显著，这表明汇率通过资产负债表渠道发挥了重要作用。然而，“对抗美联储”的外汇干预能够稳定汇率贬值、风险溢价和投资组合流动。此外，干预还特别缓冲了持有美元债务公司的股价下跌，从而削弱了汇率的资产负债表渠道。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证研究揭示了外汇干预在阻断美国货币政策溢出效应中的关键作用，特别是其对资产负债表渠道的缓解机制，为新兴市场政策制定提供了重要参考。

title: Innovation spillovers across U.S. tech clusters
abstract: The vast majority of U.S. inventors work for firms that also have inventors and plants in other tech clusters. Using merged USPTO–U.S. Census Bureau plant-level data, we show that larger tech clusters not only make local inventors more productive but also raise the productivity of inventors and plants in distant clusters, which are connected to the focal cluster through their parent firms’ networks of innovating plants. To rationalize these findings, we develop a tractable model of spatial innovation that features both within- and cross-cluster innovation spillovers. Within our model, we derive a sufficient statistic for the wedge between the social and private returns to innovation in a given location. Taking the model to the data, we find a 41% correlation between the location wedges and locations’ connectedness to other tech clusters.
summary: 本文利用美国专利商标局（USPTO）与美国人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）的工厂级合并数据，发现美国绝大多数发明家效力的公司往往在其他科技集群也设有发明家和工厂。研究表明，较大的科技集群不仅能够提高本地发明家的生产率，还能通过母公司创新工厂网络，提升与之相连的远距离集群中发明家和工厂的生产率。为解释这些发现，作者构建了一个包含集群内和跨集群创新溢出效应的空间创新模型，并推导出衡量特定地点创新社会回报与私人回报之间差异的充分统计量。将模型应用于数据后，发现位置楔形（location wedges）与地点对其他科技集群的连通性之间存在41%的相关性。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的企业内部网络数据揭示了跨集群创新溢出的机制，并提供了量化社会与私人回报差异的实用方法，对理解区域创新政策具有重要启示。

title: Which investors drive anomaly returns and how?
abstract: We decompose variation in anomaly returns across investor types and trading motives, linking returns to holdings within a demand system. Fundamental-based trading is the primary driver of anomalies, and both this channel and non-fundamental trading are driven disproportionately by small investors. Institution-led channels — flows and industry tilts — are secondary and concentrated in specific anomalies. These patterns favor theories with heterogeneous investors and distinct trading behaviors over pure flow- or risk-only explanations. Small investors account for a large share of the cash-flow news component of fundamentals-based trading, suggesting that biases in processing information play a role in anomaly returns.
summary: 本文通过需求系统框架，将异常收益的波动分解到不同投资者类型和交易动机，并链接到持仓数据。研究发现，基于基本面的交易是异常收益的主要驱动因素，且该渠道和非基本面交易均由小投资者不成比例地主导。机构引导的渠道——资金流和行业倾斜——是次要的，且集中在特定异常中。这些模式支持异质投资者和不同交易行为的理论，而非纯粹的资金流或风险解释。小投资者在基本面交易中的现金流新闻成分占很大比重，表明信息处理偏差在异常收益中发挥作用。
ai_comment: 该论文通过需求系统分解异常收益的驱动因素，为理解投资者异质性提供了新视角，尤其强调了小投资者在基本面交易中的重要作用。

title: Partial homeownership: A quantitative analysis
abstract: A convex combination of renting and traditional homeownership – Partial Ownership (PO) – is increasingly popular in many countries. We incorporate an existing for-profit PO contract into a life-cycle model to quantify its impact on housing investments, households’ welfare, and financial stability. We have three results: (1) PO makes more households invest in (some) housing. (2) Willingness to pay for PO increases with housing unaffordability and is highest among low-income and renting households. (3) PO increases the mean DTI in the population while compressing the right tail, and it lowers defaults under a house price collapse and a rise in aggregate unemployment.
summary: 本文研究了部分所有权（Partial Ownership, PO）——一种介于租赁和传统自有住房之间的凸组合——在多个国家日益流行的现象。通过将现有的盈利性PO合同纳入生命周期模型，量化其对住房投资、家庭福利和金融稳定的影响。主要发现包括：（1）PO使得更多家庭投资于（部分）住房；（2）对PO的支付意愿随住房不可负担性增加而上升，且在低收入和租房家庭中最高；（3）PO提高了人口中的平均债务收入比（DTI），同时压缩了其右尾分布，并且在房价崩溃和总体失业率上升的情况下降低了违约率。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细化生命周期模型，首次量化了部分所有权对家庭和宏观金融的双重影响，尤其揭示了其在缓解住房可负担性及提升金融稳定性方面的潜力，为住房政策设计提供了重要实证依据。

title: Liquidity characteristics of market anomalies and institutional trading
abstract: We find that market anomalies exhibit heterogeneous liquidity characteristics — long–short portfolios based on long-horizon (short-horizon) anomalies have liquidity-provision (liquidity-demanding) characteristics. Consistent with such liquidity characteristics, institutional investors tend to trade in the wrong (right) direction of long-horizon (short-horizon) anomalies. Further analysis shows that exogenous liquidity factors and institutional liquidity preferences have causal effects on the observed institutional trading patterns. Finally, despite the perception that liquidity improves market efficiency, we find that liquidity can exacerbate the magnitude of anomalies through its influence on institutional trading.
summary: 本文发现市场异象具有异质性的流动性特征：基于长期异象的多空组合呈现流动性供给特征，而基于短期异象的多空组合则表现为流动性需求特征。与这些流动性特征一致，机构投资者倾向于在长期异象中朝错误方向交易，在短期异象中朝正确方向交易。进一步分析表明，外生流动性因素和机构的流动性偏好对观察到的机构交易模式存在因果影响。最后，尽管流动性通常被认为能提升市场效率，但研究发现流动性会通过影响机构交易而加剧异象的幅度。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了流动性特征与异象类型之间的系统性关联，并创新性地指出流动性可能通过机构交易渠道放大市场异象，挑战了传统观念。

title: Choosing Scenarios to Estimate Resilience and Stress Test Financial Institutions
abstract: We provide a systematic, data-driven methodology for choosing test scenarios among a set of potential scenarios. The test scenarios can be used to accurately estimate measures of tail risk of financial institutions, such as conditional value at risk (CVaR), and can also simultaneously be used for stress testing, that is, to identify conditions for large losses. We validate the methodology on historical data used in stress tests by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Federal Reserve and connect it to the design of experiments methodology with a risk-based objective. The methodology does not require detailed knowledge of financial institutions’ portfolios and can aid regulators in evaluating the resilience of multiple institutions using uniform risk assessment standards. This paper was accepted by Giesecke Kay, finance. Supplemental Material: The electronic companion and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06126 .
summary: 该论文提出了一种系统的、数据驱动的方法，用于从一组潜在场景中选择测试场景。这些场景可用于准确估计金融机构的尾部风险度量（如条件风险价值CVaR），同时也可用于压力测试，以识别导致大损失的条件。作者在美国商品期货交易委员会和美联储的历史压力测试数据上验证了该方法，并将其与基于风险目标的实验设计方法联系起来。该方法无需详细了解金融机构的投资组合，能帮助监管机构使用统一的风险评估标准评估多个机构的韧性。论文发表于《Management Science》，被Giesecke Kay接受。
ai_comment: 该文提供了一个实用且系统化的场景选择框架，将压力测试与实验设计结合，有助于监管机构在不依赖内部模型的情况下进行统一评估，具有重要的政策应用价值。

title: Product Variety and Asset Pricing
abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium multi-industry model with endogenous product variety and study its implications for asset prices. We estimate the model with both the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) and the Simulated Method of Moments (SMM) and show that the equity premium and risk-free rate are consistent with empirically reasonable risk aversions and discount factors. The market risk premium increases significantly with the interindustry product complementarity. The model also generates the additional novel predictions that the market risk premium increases with the intraindustry product substitutability, and that industries with more substitutable products have higher excess returns. We show support for these implications in our empirical analysis. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05040 .
summary: 本文开发了一个具有内生产品种类的多行业一般均衡模型，并研究其对资产定价的影响。采用广义矩方法（GMM）和模拟矩方法（SMM）估计模型，结果显示股权溢价和无风险利率与经验上合理的风险厌恶和贴现因子一致。市场风险溢价随行业间产品互补性增加而显著上升。模型还产生新的预测：市场风险溢价随行业内产品替代性增加而上升，且产品替代性更高的行业具有更高的超额收益。实证分析支持这些结论。
ai_comment: 该论文将产品种类内生化纳入资产定价模型，揭示了产品互补性与替代性对风险溢价的重要影响，为理解市场风险溢价的行业差异提供了新视角。

title: Do product market threats discipline corporate misconduct?
abstract: Firms with more competitive threats from the product market are less likely to commit violations and pay lower penalties. These findings are robust to alternative measures, specifications, and subsamples, as well as different attempts that mitigate endogeneity concerns. Further analyses reveal that the disciplining effect of competition is more pronounced when managers have greater incentives to shirk and when internal governance is weaker, and that violations are associated with poor product market performance only in the presence of competitive pressure. Firms under competitive pressure are more likely to adopt ESG-related incentives in executive compensation contracts and exhibit better worker safety practices. Overall, our evidence suggests that product market threats reduce managerial slack in combating misconduct by increasing the expected damage of violations.
summary: 本文研究产品市场竞争威胁是否对企业不当行为具有约束作用。基于美国公司样本，发现面临更强产品市场竞争威胁的企业更不可能发生违规行为，且违规后支付的罚款更低。这一结论在替换变量测度、改变模型设定、不同子样本以及多种缓解内生性问题的检验中依然稳健。进一步分析表明，当管理者偷懒动机更强、内部治理更弱时，竞争的约束效应更为显著；违规行为仅在有竞争压力时才会导致较差的产品市场表现。此外，竞争压力大的公司更倾向于在高管薪酬合同中纳入ESG相关激励，并展现出更好的工人安全实践。整体证据支持产品市场威胁通过提高违规的预期损害来减少管理者松懈，从而约束企业不当行为。
ai_comment: 本文从产品市场竞争视角补充了公司治理外部机制的研究，并揭示了竞争通过增加管理者预期损害产生约束作用的传导渠道，具有较强政策含义。

title: The Cost of Regulatory Compliance in the United States*
abstract: A key question for studying business dynamism is whether the costs of regulatory compliance fall homogeneously on small and large businesses. Using comprehensive establishment-level occupational microdata and occupation task information, we quantify a firm’s compliance costs as the share of wage bill for performing regulatory compliance tasks (RegIndex). We reveal an inverted-U relationship between firms’ RegIndex and their size: On average, RegIndex for mid-sized firms with around 500 employees is about 47% greater than that of the smallest firms and 18% greater than that of the largest firms. We further develop a shift-share methodology to disentangle the influence of regulatory requirements and enforcement on driving firms’ compliance costs. (JEL G38, J01, K2, L43, L51)
summary: 本文基于美国机构层面的职业微观数据和职业任务信息，将企业监管合规成本量化为执行合规任务工资单份额（RegIndex），研究合规成本在不同规模企业间的分布。研究发现，企业RegIndex与其规模呈倒U型关系：中型企业（约500名员工）的RegIndex比最小企业平均高47%，比最大企业高18%。为进一步区分监管要求和执法对合规成本的影响，作者开发了一种转移份额方法。
ai_comment: 通过工资单份额量化合规成本提供了新视角，发现的倒U型关系对理解企业动态和监管政策设计具有重要启示。

title: The Cost of Regulatory Compliance in the United States
abstract: A key question for studying business dynamism is whether the costs of regulatory compliance fall homogeneously on small and large businesses. Using comprehensive establishment-level occupational microdata and occupation task information, we quantify a firm’s compliance costs as the share of wage bill for performing regulatory compliance tasks (RegIndex). We reveal an inverted-U relationship between firms’ RegIndex and their size: On average, RegIndex for mid-sized firms with around 500 employees is about 47% greater than that of the smallest firms and 18% greater than that of the largest firms. We further develop a shift-share methodology to disentangle the influence of regulatory requirements and enforcement on driving firms’ compliance costs.
summary: 本文研究美国监管合规成本是否均匀地落在小企业和大企业上。利用全面的企业层面职业微观数据和职业任务信息，量化企业合规成本为工资单中用于执行监管合规任务的比例（RegIndex）。研究发现，企业的RegIndex与其规模呈倒U型关系：平均而言，拥有约500名员工的中型企业的RegIndex比最小企业高约47%，比最大企业高约18%。此外，本文进一步开发了一种shift-share方法，以区分监管要求和监管执行对合规成本的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细的微观数据和创新的度量方法，揭示了监管合规成本与企业规模的非线性关系，为理解监管负担的分配效应提供了重要经验证据。

title: Betting Against the Crowd: Option Trading and Market Risk Premium
abstract: We study how equity option trading affects the market risk premium. We find that a measure of aggregate call order imbalance (ACIB), defined as the cross-sectional average of the difference between open-buy and open-sell volume, negatively forecasts future stock market returns significantly from days to months. Moreover, ACIB represents an option-based investor sentiment measure that accounts for excess option buying or selling, and is highly correlated with the stock investor sentiment. Our findings shed new insights on the distinctions for call and put option trading, index and equity option trading, and cross-sectional and time-series predictions.
summary: 本文研究股票期权交易如何影响市场风险溢价。作者提出了一个聚合看涨订单不平衡（ACIB）指标，定义为横截面平均的买入开仓与卖出开仓量之差，发现ACIB能够显著负向预测未来数天至数月的股票市场收益。进一步分析表明，ACIB是一种基于期权的投资者情绪指标，反映了过度的期权买入或卖出行为，并且与股票投资者情绪高度相关。该研究为看涨与看跌期权交易、指数与股票期权交易以及横截面与时间序列预测之间的区别提供了新的见解。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用期权交易数据构建情绪指标，揭示了期权市场对股票市场收益的预测能力，为投资者情绪理论提供了新的实证证据。

title: Evaluating Selection Bias in Early-Stage Investment Returns – CORRIGENDUM
Privacy Regulation and Fintech Lending
abstract: Consumers dislike sharing data with fintechs, but greater access to data can improve loan market outcomes through better screening. We study how the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), which grants users control over and mitigates concerns about sharing their data, affects fintech lending. After the CCPA’s introduction, fintechs’ loan rates decline relative to those of other lenders. In addition, rate dispersion across fintech loans increases, fintechs deny more applications, and they make greater use of nontraditional credit scoring models, whereas their default rates decline by more than those of other lenders. These results are consistent with an improved screening process enabled by additional data. Mortgage originations by fintechs also increase, suggesting that well-designed privacy regulation may enhance financial inclusion. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02874 .
summary: 研究利用《加州消费者隐私法案》（CCPA）作为自然实验，分析隐私监管对金融科技贷款的影响。CCPA赋予用户数据控制权并缓解数据共享担忧。结果显示，CCPA实施后，金融科技公司的贷款利率相对于其他贷款机构下降，贷款利差扩大，拒绝率上升，并更多使用非传统信用评分模型，同时违约率下降幅度大于其他贷款机构。这些结果与通过额外数据改进筛选过程一致。此外，金融科技抵押贷款发放增加，表明设计良好的隐私法规可能促进金融包容性。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验设计，实证检验了隐私法规对金融科技信贷市场的双重影响，既降低了利率和违约率，又提高了贷款可得性，为隐私与信贷市场关系提供了新证据。

title: Does AI Cheapen Talk? Theory and Evidence from Global Entrepreneurship and Hiring
abstract: Screening human capital based on signals such as job applications or entrepreneurial pitches is crucial for organizations. Signals are often informative insofar as they require differential knowledge and effort to produce. Generative AI (GAI) complicates screening by lowering the cost of producing impressive signals. We model the informational effects of GAI, showing that applicants’ access to GAI can increase—and also decrease—an evaluator’s screening mistakes. This result depends on how GAI affects experts’ signals compared with nonexperts’. Using experiments in hiring and start-up investing, we estimate that senders’ access to GAI (ChatGPT) lowers screening accuracy by 4%–9% for employers and start-up investors. Consistent with our model, senders’ access to GAI also improves screening accuracy in some settings, in our case, among senders from non–English-speaking countries. These results show that GAI can profoundly shape screening accuracy. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Funding: We are grateful for the Columbia Business School Digital Future Initiative Grant for helping fund this project. B. Cowgill thanks the Kauffman Foundation Emerging Scholars Program, the Columbia Center for Political Economy, the NET Institute, and the Stellar Development Foundation. P. Hernandez-Lagos thanks the Yeshiva University Sy Syms Dean’s Research Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07027 .
summary: 本文研究了生成式AI（GAI）如何影响组织基于信号（如工作申请或创业演讲）的人力资本筛选。作者构建了一个理论模型，表明申请人使用GAI可能增加或减少评估者的筛选错误，这取决于GAI对专家与非专家信号的影响差异。通过招聘和创业投资领域的实验，估计发送者使用ChatGPT使筛选准确性降低了4%-9%，但同时也发现在非英语国家的发送者中，GAI反而提高了筛选准确性。这些结果揭示了GAI对筛选准确性具有深远且复杂的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论与实验相结合的方法，揭示了生成式AI在人才筛选中的双刃剑效应，对理解和应对AI带来的劳动力市场信息不对称问题具有重要启示。

title: The Effect of Advisors' Incentives on Clients' Investments
abstract: We use granular data from an investment firm and a credible identification strategy to estimate the effect of financial advisors' incentives on client investments. Exploiting a natural experiment triggered by the 2018 implementation of Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II (MiFID II), we find that clients' investments respond strongly to changes in advisor incentives. Advisors react through multiple mechanisms: (i) inducing existing clients to bring in new money, (ii) channeling it to high‐incentive funds, and (iii) attracting more new clients. We also find that the MiFID II reform generated more balanced incentives, which translated into higher portfolio efficiency through lower average fees and stronger portfolio diversification.
summary: 利用一家投资公司的细粒度数据和一个可信的识别策略，该论文估计了金融顾问的激励对客户投资的影响。通过利用2018年《金融工具市场指令II》（MiFID II）实施引发的自然实验，研究发现客户的投资对顾问激励的变化反应强烈。顾问通过多种机制做出反应：（i）诱导现有客户投入新资金，（ii）将这些资金引导至高激励基金，以及（iii）吸引更多新客户。研究还发现，MiFID II改革产生了更平衡的激励，这通过降低平均费用和加强投资组合多元化转化为更高的投资组合效率。
ai_comment: 该论文利用自然实验提供了顾问激励影响客户投资决策的因果证据，并揭示了MiFID II改革对投资组合效率的积极影响，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Do Investors Value Auditor Involvement in Non‐GAAP Reporting?
abstract: This paper examines investors’ perceptions of auditor involvement in non‐GAAP reporting as captured by non‐GAAP disclosures in 10‐K filings. We find that firm‐years with auditor involvement in non‐GAAP reporting have higher CARs, lower bid–ask spreads, lower stock volatility, and lower abnormal trading volume on 10‐K filing dates. To sharpen identification of auditor involvement, we hand‐collect non‐GAAP measures and reconciliations for S&P 500 firms and identify which exclusions reconcile directly to the audited financial statements. As the percentage of exclusions that reconcile directly to the audited financial statements increases, bid–ask spreads and stock volatility on 10‐K filing dates decrease. We find that the results are not driven by strategic reporting or managers’ responses to perceived litigation risk. This study provides new insights into non‐GAAP disclosures outside of earnings announcements, which have been largely ignored in prior literature. Collectively, our results suggest investors value auditor involvement in non‐GAAP reporting and inform policymakers and standard setters considering the usefulness of assurance over non‐GAAP measures.
summary: 本文研究了投资者对非GAAP报告中审计师参与的感知，通过10-K文件中的非GAAP披露来捕捉。研究发现，审计师参与的企业年份在10-K提交日具有更高的累计异常回报率、更低的买卖价差、更低的股票波动率和更低的异常交易量。为了更清晰地识别审计师参与，作者手动收集了标准普尔500公司的非GAAP指标和调节表，并识别哪些排除项目直接与已审计财务报表调节一致。随着直接调节到已审计财务报表的排除比例增加，买卖价差和股票波动率在10-K提交日降低。研究结果并非由战略报告或管理者对感知诉讼风险的回应所驱动。该研究提供了对薪酬公告之外的非GAAP披露的新见解，表明投资者重视非GAAP报告中的审计师参与，并为考虑非GAAP指标鉴证有用性的政策制定者和准则制定者提供信息。
ai_comment: 本文通过手工收集数据巧妙识别审计师参与，揭示了非GAAP披露中审计师角色的价值，填补了文献中除薪酬公告外非GAAP披露的空白。

title: Using Unconscious Thought to Improve Evaluations of Complex Accounting Estimates
abstract: Complex accounting estimates are becoming increasingly important to financial statements. Yet, such estimates create ample opportunities for bias. Although both management and independent auditors are tasked with ensuring these estimates are free from error and bias, evaluating the appropriateness of these measures can be quite difficult. Drawing on unconscious thought theory, we predict and find across three experiments that engaging in unconscious thought can improve accounting practitioners’ evaluations of accounting estimates. In Experiment 1, we use practicing auditors as participants and find that unconscious thought improves less‐experienced auditors’ ability to recognize income‐decreasing patterns of bias. In contrast, more‐experienced auditors respond similarly to both incoming‐increasing and income‐decreasing bias, regardless of whether they use conscious or unconscious processing. In Experiments 2 and 3, we provide evidence that prompting managers to engage in unconscious thought also improves their recognition of patterns of bias within estimates. Overall, our findings demonstrate how unconscious processing can be intentionally prompted to improve accounting professionals’ ability to recognize subtle patterns of bias that they might otherwise overlook.
summary: 本文针对财务报表中日益重要的复杂会计估计所带来的偏见问题展开研究。基于无意识思维理论，通过三项实验验证了无意识思维能够改善会计从业者对会计估计的评估。实验1以执业审计师为对象，发现无意识思维能帮助经验较少的审计师更好地识别收入递减的偏见模式，而经验丰富的审计师无论采用有意识还是无意识处理，对收入递增和收入递减偏见的反应相似。实验2和3进一步表明，促使管理层进行无意识思维也能提升其识别估计中偏见模式的能力。总体而言，研究证明了有意引导无意识处理可以增强会计专业人员识别微妙偏见模式的能力，这些模式在常规有意识思考中可能被忽略。
ai_comment: 将无意识思维理论引入会计评估领域，为改进复杂估计的评估提供了新颖且实用的方法，实验设计严谨，实践启示显著。

title: Smokestacks and the Swamp
abstract: We examine whether politicians affect local firms’ industrial pollution, and whether such effects are transmitted through plant-level networks to affect pollution in other regions. We first document that close Democrat wins in U.S. congressional races are associated with lower emissions and higher abatement at the plant level, especially when politicians have strong pro-environmental preferences. We also find evidence of reallocation: firms shift emissions away from areas represented by Democrats. However, reallocation is imperfect: firm-level costs are higher and market-to-book ratios lower if firms’ representation is more Democratic. Lower pollution-related illnesses around plants in Democratic districts suggest pass-through effects on local communities.
summary: 本文研究政治家是否影响地方企业的工业污染，以及这种影响是否通过工厂层面的网络传递到其他地区。基于美国国会选举数据，发现民主党候选人以微弱优势获胜的选区，工厂的排放量更低、污染治理投入更高，尤其是当政治家具有强烈的环保偏好时。同时，企业会将排放从民主党代表的区域转移到其他地区，但这种再分配并不完美：企业所在选区中民主党议员占比越高，其成本越高、市账率越低。此外，民主党选区工厂周边因污染导致的疾病减少，表明污染减少的正面效应传递到了当地社区。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细的选举数据与工厂污染数据匹配，揭示了政治因素如何通过空间再分配影响环境结果，并量化了再分配的成本，为理解政治与环境经济学的交叉提供了新证据。

title: Intra-Household Risk Sharing in Collective Portfolio Choice Models
abstract: Using a calibrated, collective life-cycle portfolio choice model for a dual-income couple, we show that an increase in the ability to share risk within the household due to a mean-preserving spread in the partners’ coefficients of relative risk aversion leads to a substantial increase in financial risk-taking. Importantly, we show that risk sharing has a larger economic impact on portfolio choice than risk diversification. While unitary models usually do not fully replicate the optimal portfolio choice of collective models, we propose approximations that work reasonably well for moderate background risk. We provide strong empirical support for our key findings.
summary: 本文通过校准的双收入夫妻集体生命周期投资组合选择模型，展示配偶间相对风险厌恶系数的均值保持扩展增强了家庭内部风险分担能力，导致金融风险承担显著增加。重要的是，风险分担对投资组合选择的经济影响大于风险分散化。虽然单一模型通常无法完全复制集体模型的最优投资组合选择，但本文提出的近似方法在适度背景风险下表现合理。实证结果有力支持了核心发现。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地量化了家庭内部风险分担对投资组合的独立影响，并证明其效应超过传统风险分散，为家庭金融中的风险共担机制提供了新视角。

title: Politically Polarized Depositors
abstract: Do political values shape depositor behavior? Exploiting a shock drawing public attention to banks’ financial relationships with the gun industry, I find that banks that lend to the gun industry experience significant decreases in deposit growth. The effect is stronger in counties with more Democrats or higher support for gun control. Anti-gun depositor movements increase funding costs for gun-lending banks and thus reduce their lending business, which coincides with slower growth in gun establishments. Moreover, I find evidence that banks with public anti-gun policies also experience reduced deposit growth, specifically in counties with more Republicans or higher support for gun rights. The findings suggest that political values shape depositor behavior and pose financial risks to bank operations.
summary: 本文研究政治价值观是否影响储户行为。利用一个将公众注意力引向银行与枪支行业金融关系的冲击，发现向枪支行业放贷的银行存款增长显著下降。该效应在民主党人或支持枪支管制程度更高的县更为明显。反枪支储户运动增加了向枪支行业放贷银行的融资成本，进而减少其贷款业务，这与枪支相关企业增长放缓相一致。此外，持有公开反枪支政策的银行也经历了存款增长放缓，特别是在共和党人或支持枪支权利程度更高的县。这些发现表明政治价值观塑造储户行为，并对银行运营构成金融风险。
ai_comment: 利用枪支行业贷款冲击巧妙识别政治价值观对储户行为的因果效应，拓展了行为金融与政治经济学的交叉研究；同时揭示了政治极化对银行金融风险的真实影响。

title: Financial literacy and financial crime: A regression discontinuity approach
abstract: This study investigates how financial literacy shapes the propensity of individuals to commit financial crime. Using state-level administrative data on criminal charges linked to comprehensive public records , we exploit a policy-based discontinuity in grade level assignment based on individual birth dates that exogenously requires certain high school cohorts to attend a financial literacy course. Our estimates suggest that exposure to the course reduces the propensity to commit financial crime by 37%. The reduction is driven by declines in embezzlement and is stronger for low-income individuals. Additional evidence suggests that the reductions are primarily explained by improvements in household balance sheets.
summary: 本研究利用基于出生日期的政策断点，外生要求某些高中年级必须参加金融素养课程，通过匹配犯罪指控与公共记录数据的州级行政数据，采用断点回归方法估计金融素养对个人实施金融犯罪倾向的影响。估计结果显示，课程接触使金融犯罪倾向降低37%，这一减少主要由贪污下降驱动，且对低收入群体效果更强。进一步证据表明，减少主要源于家庭资产负债表的改善。
ai_comment: 本文通过政策断点设计识别了金融素养对金融犯罪的因果效应，为金融教育干预的有效性提供了坚实证据。

title: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
abstract: Machine learning methods in asset pricing are often criticized for their black box nature. We study this issue by predicting corporate bond returns using interpretable machine learning on a high-dimensional bond characteristics data set. We achieve state-of-the-art performance while maintaining an interpretable model structure, overcoming the accuracy–interpretability trade-off. The estimation uncovers nonlinear relationships and economically meaningful interactions in bond pricing, notably related to term structure and macroeconomic uncertainty. Subsample analysis reveals stronger sensitivities to these effects for small firms and long-maturity bonds. Finally, we demonstrate how interpretable models enhance transparency in portfolio construction by providing ex ante insights into portfolio composition.
summary: 本文针对机器学习在资产定价中因黑箱特性而受到批评的问题，使用可解释的机器学习方法在高维债券特征数据集上预测公司债券收益。通过保持可解释的模型结构，该方法达到了最先进的预测性能，从而克服了准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。估计结果揭示了债券定价中的非线性关系以及具有经济意义的交互作用，尤其与期限结构和宏观经济不确定性相关。子样本分析表明，小型公司和长期债券对这些效应的敏感性更强。最后，本文展示了可解释模型如何通过提供投资组合组成的先验见解来增强投资组合构建的透明度。
ai_comment: 本文提出的“玻璃箱”机器学习方法成功平衡了预测准确性与模型可解释性，并发现了期限结构和宏观经济不确定性在债券定价中的重要非线性交互作用，为资产定价研究提供了新的视角。

title: Forecasting and Managing Correlation Risks
abstract: We propose a novel and easy-to-implement framework for forecasting time-varying correlations based on a large set of salient realized correlation features and the sparsity-encouraging Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator technique. Considering the universe of S&P 500 stocks, we find that the new approach manifests in statistically superior out-of-sample forecasts compared with commonly used procedures. We further demonstrate how the forecasts translate into significant economic gains in the form of higher pairs trading profits, better equity premium predictions, more accurate portfolio risk targeting, and superior overall risk control and minimization. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: S. Z. Li received financial support from the Rutgers Business School Dean’s Research Seed Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08294 .
summary: 本文提出了一种新颖且易于实施的框架，用于预测时变相关性。该框架基于大量显著的已实现相关性特征（realized correlation features）和稀疏性鼓励的最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）技术。以标普500指数成分股为研究对象，发现新方法在样本外预测中相比常用程序具有统计上更优的表现。进一步证明，这些预测能够转化为显著的经济收益，包括更高的配对交易利润、更好的股权溢价预测、更准确的投资组合风险目标设定以及更优的整体风险控制和最小化。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将LASSO技术应用于相关性预测，并系统验证了其在交易和风险管理中的经济价值，具有较高的实用和学术价值。

title: Broken Relationships: Derisking by Correspondent Banks and International Trade
abstract: We study how terminated correspondent banking relationships affect international trade. Drawing on firm-level export data from emerging Europe, we show that when local banks lose access to correspondent services, their corporate clients, especially small- and medium-sized enterprises, experience significant export declines. Firms only partially offset lost exports with higher domestic sales, resulting in lower total revenues and employment. Other firms cease operations entirely. These firm-level impacts aggregate to lower product-level exports from countries more exposed to correspondent bank retrenchment. (JEL F14, F15, F36, G21, G28, L14)
summary: 这篇论文研究了代理行关系终止如何影响国际贸易。利用新兴欧洲的企业层面出口数据，作者发现当本地银行失去代理行服务时，其企业客户——尤其是中小企业——会经历显著的出口下降。企业仅能通过增加国内销售部分弥补出口损失，导致总收入和就业减少，部分企业甚至完全停止运营。这些企业层面的影响汇总后，导致对代理行撤资暴露程度更高的国家产品层面出口下降。
ai_comment: 利用企业级数据揭示了代理行关系终止对出口的因果影响，强调了中小企业的脆弱性，为理解去风险化行为的实体经济后果提供了微观证据。

title: The Sensitivity of Cash Saving to the Cost of Capital
abstract: We theoretically and empirically show that in the presence of a time-varying cost of capital (COC), firms save cash from external capital issuance when the firm-specific COC is low to hedge against the risk of underinvestment from a higher COC in the future. This hedging motive drives the sensitivity of cash saving to the COC in both financially constrained and currently unconstrained firms. The sensitivity is especially pronounced among firms that have a stronger correlation between their COC and financing needs for future investments. We establish the COC's causal impact on cash saving from external capital issuance through two quasi-natural experiments, viz., a change in regulatory disclosure requirements and surprises in monetary policy.
summary: 本文理论和实证研究了在时变资本成本（COC）环境下，企业为了对冲未来COC上升导致的投资不足风险，会在当前COC较低时从外部资本发行中储蓄现金。这种对冲动机驱动了现金储蓄对COC的敏感性，且该敏感性在财务约束企业和当前未受约束企业中都存在。敏感性在COC与未来投资融资需求相关性更强的企业中尤为显著。通过两个准自然实验——监管披露要求变化和货币政策意外，建立了COC对现金储蓄的因果影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型和准自然实验，为资本成本影响现金储蓄的因果关系提供了有力证据，强调了企业对未来融资风险的预防性储蓄动机。

title: Mutual Fund Strategy: Swing for the Fences or Bat for Average
abstract: We document two distinct mutual fund strategies: “Swinging for the Fences” (SF), in which managers hold stocks with extreme style-adjusted returns on either tail of the return distribution, and “Batting for Average” (BA), in which managers seek stocks with consistently moderate performance. We provide evidence that these strategies are persistent and deliberate. Existing measures of active management and known asset-pricing factors do not explain the strategies. SF attracts more flow, particularly when funds mention specific stock holdings in shareholder reports. SF funds charge higher fees and hold riskier portfolios; yet, they fail to deliver higher risk-adjusted returns. In falsification tests, SF strategies are not present in passive funds, supporting our conclusion that SF and BA are intentional strategies.
summary: 本文记录了两种显著不同的共同基金策略：“本垒打策略”（Swinging for the Fences, SF）和“保送策略”（Batting for Average, BA）。SF策略的管理者持有风格调整后极端收益（位于收益分布两端）的股票，而BA策略的管理者则寻求持续中等表现的股票。研究表明，这两种策略具有持续性和有意性。现有的主动管理度量指标和已知资产定价因子均无法解释这些策略。SF策略吸引了更多的资金流入，尤其是在基金股东报告中提及具体持仓时。SF基金收取更高的费用并持有风险更高的投资组合，但未能提供更高的风险调整后收益。在虚假检验中，被动基金中不存在SF策略，这支持了SF和BA是有意策略的结论。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了一种看似吸引眼球但并未带来超额收益的主动管理策略，为投资者提供了重要洞察，同时也对现有基金绩效评估框架提出了挑战。

title: Revenue Management Under a Price Alert Mechanism
abstract: Many online platforms adopt a price alert mechanism to facilitate customers tracking price changes. This mechanism allows customers to register their valuation with the system if they find the price higher than their valuation. Once the price drops below the customers’ registered price, a message is sent to notify customers. This paper formulates the interaction between the seller and customers as a Markov decision process. We assume customers are patient and are willing to wait for K additional periods for the price to drop if the current price is high. We first analyze the model in which [Formula: see text] and find that the seller’s optimal policy has three properties: (i) the threshold property by which the seller uses a threshold to decide whether to accept or reject a registered price, (ii) the price-at-register property by which the seller sets the price at the customer’s registered level if the registered price exceeds the threshold, and (iii) the cyclic decreasing property by which the price trajectory under the optimal policy has a stochastic cyclic decreasing structure. Modified versions of these properties still hold for the general model in which K is large or when the waiting time is heterogeneous among customers. On the policy computation side, we propose a heuristic pricing policy based on the price-at-register property. Numerical results show that the policy achieves near-optimal performance on all cases tested. We also observe that the impact of the value of K on the optimal revenue is almost negligible in many cases, and this ensures that the policies derived under our model are robust to the misspecification of K. This policy can also be adapted to the model in which customer patience is different and achieves near-optimal performance. Lastly, we show the impact of the price alert mechanism on seller’s revenue, customer surplus, and social welfare. This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: B. Jiang’s research is partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) [Grants 72394364, 72171141, 72394363, and 72442013]. Z. Wang’s research is partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) [Grants 72394361 and 72425013], the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [2023B1212010001], and the 1+1+1 CUHK-CUHK(SZ)-GDSTC Joint Collaboration Fund [2025A0505000079]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05665 .
summary: 本文研究在线平台的价格提醒机制下的收益管理问题。在该机制中，顾客可在价格高于其估值时向系统注册估值，一旦价格降至注册价以下便收到通知。作者将卖家与顾客的互动建模为马尔可夫决策过程，假设顾客愿意在价格过高时等待最多K期。首先分析K=1的模型，发现最优策略具有三个性质：阈值属性（卖家根据阈值决定是否接受注册价格）、价格匹配属性（若注册价超过阈值则将其设为当前价格）和循环下降属性（价格轨迹呈现随机循环下降结构）。对于一般K或顾客等待时间异质的情况，这些性质仍部分成立。在策略计算方面，提出基于价格匹配属性的启发式定价策略，数值实验显示其在所有测试案例中接近最优。此外，K值对最优收入的影响几乎可忽略，确保了策略对K误设的稳健性。该策略还可适应顾客耐心异质的情况并保持近优性能。最后，分析了价格提醒机制对卖家收入、消费者剩余和社会福利的影响。
ai_comment: 该论文以严谨的数学建模揭示了价格提醒机制下最优定价的结构性特征，并提出了高效的启发式策略，对在线平台的动态定价实践具有指导意义。

title: Investing in Lending Technology: IT Spending in Banking
abstract: Banks’ lending technology hinges on their handling of soft and hard information in dealing with different types of credit demand. Through assembling a novel data set on banks’ investment in information technologies (IT), this paper provides concrete empirical evidence on how banks adapt their lending technologies. We find investment in communication IT is associated with improving banks’ ability to produce and transmit soft information, whereas investment in software IT helps enhance banks’ hard information processing capacity. We exploit policies that affect geographic regions differentially to show causally that banks respond to an increased demand for small business credit (mortgage refinance) by increasing their spending on communication (software) IT spending. We also find that the entry of fintech induces commercial banks to increase their investment in IT—more so in the software IT category. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: Z. He acknowledges financial support from the John E. Jeuck Endowment at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, as most of the work was done while he worked at the University of Chicago. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04608 .
summary: 这篇论文通过构建银行在信息技术（IT）投资方面的新数据集，实证研究银行如何通过IT投资调整其贷款技术，以处理软信息和硬信息。研究发现，通信IT投资有助于提升银行产生和传递软信息的能力，而软件IT投资则增强银行的硬信息处理能力。利用影响不同地理区域的政策变动进行因果识别，结果表明，当小企业信贷需求增加时，银行会增加通信IT支出；而当抵押贷款再融资需求增加时，银行会增加软件IT支出。此外，金融科技公司的进入促使商业银行增加IT投资，尤其是在软件IT类别上。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据集和因果识别策略，揭示了银行IT投资对贷款技术的差异化影响，并提供了金融科技冲击下银行应对策略的实证证据。

title: AI Democratization and Trading Inequality
abstract: We are among the first to investigate how Generative AI (GenAI) shapes investors' trading activities. Using an AI‐sentiment measure extracted from earnings‐call transcripts to proxy for textual signals, we find notable shifts in trading behaviors around earnings calls. Before the wide deployment of ChatGPT, short selling was aligned with AI‐sentiment, whereas retail trading was not. However, following ChatGPT's deployment, the alignment of retail traders with AI‐sentiment significantly increases, while the alignment of short sellers weakens, albeit insignificantly. Stocks with higher information processing costs exhibit a more pronounced increase in retail trading alignment, scenarios where retail investors are likely to benefit more from AI. Using retail‐AI alignment as a proxy for the extent to which retail investors trade based on AI signals, we show that information asymmetry declines and retail investors' trading profitability improves, whereas short sale profitability declines in high retail‐AI alignment stocks. Exogenous outages reduce the alignment between retail trading and AI‐sentiment, allowing us to draw causal inferences. Collectively, this study suggests that AI is a promising technology for narrowing the information gap in the trading of complex textual financial disclosures between investor classes with clear disparities in the ability to process public disclosures.
summary: 本文率先研究生成式AI（GenAI）如何影响投资者的交易活动。通过从财报电话会议记录中提取AI情绪度量作为文本信号，发现在财报电话会议前后交易行为发生显著变化。在ChatGPT广泛部署之前，卖空行为与AI情绪一致，而散户交易则不然；然而，ChatGPT部署后，散户交易与AI情绪的一致性显著增强，而卖空者的一致性则减弱（虽不显著）。信息处理成本较高的股票中，散户交易一致性的增长更为明显，这表明在这些情境下散户投资者可能从AI中获益更多。利用散户-AI一致性作为散户基于AI信号交易程度的代理，发现散户-AI一致性高的股票中信息不对称下降、散户交易盈利能力提升，而卖空盈利能力下降。外生性的ChatGPT中断事件降低了散户交易与AI情绪之间的一致性，这支持了因果推断。总体而言，研究表明AI是一种有望缩小不同投资者阶层在解读复杂文本财务披露方面信息差距的技术。
ai_comment: 利用ChatGPT的推出作为自然实验，首次提供了GenAI对交易行为因果效应的证据，并揭示了AI在缩小信息差距中的潜力。

title: Generative AI in Capital Markets: Information Production, Dissemination, and Processing
abstract: We synthesize evidence from six papers presented at the 2025 Journal of Accounting Research Conference on how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping capital‐market information flows. Our discussion is organized around an economic framework with three layers: information production by firms and accounting professionals, information dissemination through intermediaries, and information processing by investors. Across these layers, the conference papers show that GenAI can lower preparation costs, improve intermediary productivity, and reduce investors’ processing costs. At the same time, they point to a common constraint: whether GenAI improves the information environment depends critically on information verification costs. We also highlight gaps in current evidence and outline future research opportunities within and across the three layers.
summary: 本论文综合了2025年《Journal of Accounting Research》会议中六篇论文的证据，探讨生成式人工智能（GenAI）如何重塑资本市场信息流。作者围绕一个三层经济框架展开组织：企业及会计专业人员的信息生产、通过中介的信息传播、以及投资者的信息处理。研究发现，GenAI能够降低信息准备成本、提高中介生产效率、并减少投资者的处理成本。同时，论文强调了一个关键约束：GenAI能否改善信息环境取决于信息验证成本。此外，论文指出了当前证据中的空白，并概述了三个层面内部及跨层面的未来研究机会。
ai_comment: 本文通过整合多篇实证证据并构建统一框架，系统揭示了GenAI在资本市场信息流动中的潜力与约束，尤其强调了验证成本的核心作用，为后续研究提供了清晰的路线图。

title: The Effect of Primary Dealer Constraints on Intermediation in the Treasury Market
abstract: Using confidential microdata, we show that shocks to primary dealers’ constraints have significant effects on the U.S. Treasury securities market. We consider two types of constraints: the supplementary leverage ratio and trading desk value-at-risk constraints. In response to tighter constraints, dealers reduce their Treasury positions, triggering a reduction in aggregate turnover and an increase in dealer intermediation margin. Impaired intermediation also amplifies the yield response to net demand shifts and weakens Treasury auction outcomes. Our estimates suggest that the (shadow) cost of dealer constraints is as high as 9% of dealers’ profit margins. (JEL G10, G12, G18, G21)
summary: 利用机密微观数据，本文研究了初级交易商约束对美国国债市场的中介功能的影响。考虑两种约束：补充杠杆率（SLR）和交易台风险价值（VaR）约束。当交易商面临更严格的约束时，他们会减少国债持仓，导致总成交量下降和中介利差扩大。受损的中介功能还会放大收益率对净需求冲击的响应，并削弱国债拍卖结果。估计显示，交易商约束的（影子）成本高达其利润率的9%。
ai_comment: 本文利用罕见的高频微观数据，直接量化了交易商约束对市场流动性和价格的影响，揭示了监管政策的实际效应，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Unlocking Local Market Information Through Franchising
abstract: This paper examines the role of franchising in enabling firms to access valuable local market information. Using comprehensive data on U.S. franchised establishments, we show that franchisee-owned establishment openings robustly predict future local economic growth reflected by house price appreciation, whereas franchisor-owned outlets lack such predictive power. Franchisee investments are especially informative in markets with greater uncertainty and complexity and when facing higher investment hurdles. Franchisors appear sensitive to information frictions, avoiding direct investment in new markets that are geographically distant and lack direct flight connectivity. Our findings support the long-standing but untested assumption that franchisees possess superior private information. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05903 .
summary: 本文考察了特许经营在帮助企业获取有价值的地方市场信息中的作用。利用美国特许经营机构的全面数据，研究发现加盟商拥有的门店开业能够稳健地预测未来当地经济增长（表现为房价升值），而特许人直接拥有的门店则不具备这种预测能力。加盟商投资在面临更高不确定性和复杂性的市场以及投资门槛较高的情境下尤其具有信息含量。特许人对信息摩擦表现出敏感性，避免对地理距离远且缺乏直飞航线连接的新市场进行直接投资。这些发现支持了长期以来未经检验的假设，即加盟商拥有优越的私有信息。
ai_comment: 本文利用大样本实证验证了加盟商相对于特许人的信息优势，为特许经营领域的经典假说提供了因果证据，并揭示了信息摩擦对企业投资决策的重要影响。

title: Government Debt Maturity and Term Structure of Credit Spreads
abstract: We investigate how government borrowing behaviors influence private sectors by exploring the relationship between government debt maturity and credit term structures. Using individual corporate bonds data between 1987 and 2015, we find that a longer government debt maturity is associated with a steeper credit term structure in both the primary and secondary corporate bond markets. An instrumental variable approach and an exogenous event study help us establish a causality. Our findings are more pronounced among riskier corporate bonds, and the influences of Treasury bond supply on credit term spreads are more pronounced near the maturity where this supply shock originates, suggesting that the credit risk and the maturity clientele channels together drive our findings. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01979 .
summary: 本文研究政府债务期限如何影响私营部门，通过探讨政府债务期限与信用期限结构的关系。使用1987年至2015年的公司债券数据，发现政府债务期限越长，公司债券在一级和二级市场上的信用期限结构越陡峭。通过工具变量法和外生事件研究建立因果关系。这种效应在风险较高的公司债券中更为显著，且国债供给对信用期限利差的影响在供给冲击发生期限附近更明显，表明信用风险和期限客户渠道共同驱动了这一结果。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的因果识别方法揭示了政府债务期限对私人部门信用市场的传导机制，并区分了信用风险和期限客户两个渠道，具有重要的政策与学术价值。

title: What Drives Variation in Investor Portfolios? Estimating the Roles of Beliefs and Risk Preferences†
abstract: We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance. (JEL G11, G12, G40, G51, J32)
summary: 本文提出了一个投资组合选择需求模型，允许对投资者的主观预期和风险偏好进行非参数估计。利用2009年至2019年全面的401(k)计划层面数据，通过实证框架探索资产配置的异质性。研究恢复了投资者对每种资产的信念，并考察了这些信念的含义和潜在来源。主要发现是，投资者之间预期的异质性对投资组合持有变异的解释程度是风险厌恶异质性的两倍。信念异质性部分由投资者特征和经验驱动，反映了当地信息源，如县级GDP和雇主过去业绩。
ai_comment: 该论文通过非参数方法分离了信念和风险偏好的作用，揭示了信念异质性在解释投资组合差异中的主导地位，为理解投资者行为提供了新视角。

abstract: We present a portfolio choice demand model that allows for the nonparametric estimation of investors’ (subjective) expectations and risk preferences. Using comprehensive 401(k)-plan-level data from 2009 through 2019, we explore heterogeneity in asset allocations using our empirical framework. We recover investors’ beliefs about each asset and examine the implications and potential sources of those beliefs. Heterogeneity in expectations across investors accounts for twice as much variation in portfolio holdings as heterogeneity in risk aversion. Belief heterogeneity is partly driven by investors’ characteristics and experiences, reflecting local sources of information such as county-level GDP and employers’ past performance.
summary: 本文提出了一个投资组合选择需求模型，允许对投资者的主观预期和风险偏好进行非参数估计。利用2009年至2019年间全面的401(k)计划层面数据，作者运用该实证框架探索资产配置的异质性。他们恢复了投资者对每种资产的信念，并考察了这些信念的含义和潜在来源。研究发现，投资者之间的预期异质性对投资组合持有变异的解释程度是风险厌恶异质性的两倍。信念异质性部分由投资者的特征和经验驱动，反映了当地信息源，如县级GDP和雇主的过往表现。
ai_comment: 该论文通过非参数方法有效分离了信念和偏好在投资组合决策中的作用，并利用大规模行政数据揭示了期望异质性的主导地位，为理解投资者行为提供了新视角。

title: Machine Forecast Disagreement
abstract: We propose a statistical model of heterogeneous beliefs wherein investors are represented as different machine learning model specifications. Investors form return forecasts from their individual models using common data inputs. We measure disagreement as forecast dispersion across investor-models (MFD). Our measure aligns with analyst forecast disagreement but more powerfully predicts returns. We document a large and robust association between belief disagreement and future returns. A decile spread portfolio that sells stocks with high disagreement and buys stocks with low disagreement earns a value-weighted return of 13% per year. Further analyses suggest MFD-alpha is mispricing induced by short-sale costs and limits-to-arbitrage.
summary: 本文提出一个异质信念统计模型，将投资者表示为不同的机器学习模型规格（如不同算法或超参数设置）。投资者使用共同的数据输入（如历史价格、财务指标）从各自模型中形成对未来收益的预测。作者将信念分歧（disagreement）衡量为不同投资者模型之间预测的分散度（Machine Forecast Disagreement, MFD）。研究发现，MFD与分析者预测分歧（analyst forecast disagreement）在横截面上高度一致，但MFD能更显著地预测未来股票收益。具体而言，一个基于MFD排序的十分位组合，卖出高分歧股票、买入低分歧股票，可获得年化13%的价值加权超额收益。进一步分析表明，该超额收益（MFD-alpha）无法被常见风险因子解释，而是源于卖空成本和套利限制导致的错误定价（mispricing）。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用机器学习模型异质性来度量投资者信念分歧，并与传统分析师分歧对比，揭示了更强预测能力的经济机制——套利限制导致的错误定价，为行为金融提供了新视角。

title: Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity†
abstract: To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.
summary: 本文构建了一个由单一潜在变量——投资者对平均禀赋增长的信心异质性驱动的一般均衡模型，以理解投资者资产需求的动态。模型预测资产需求具有持续的异质性和集中化的投资组合。与数据一致，有限的信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动，这种波动由潜在需求驱动而非可观测特征。经济机制主要源于投资者对冲未来信念变化的动机，而非当前的分歧。此外，与调查数据一致，投资者的预期与过去收益正相关，与未来收益负相关。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入一个简洁的潜在变量——信心异质性，成功解释了资产需求持续性、股价过度波动以及预期收益模式等多个市场异象，其机制聚焦于投资者对冲未来信念变化而非当前分歧，具有理论创新性和实证一致性。

title: Dynamics of Asset Demands with Confidence Heterogeneity
abstract: To understand the dynamics of investors’ asset demands, we develop a general-equilibrium model driven by a single latent variable: heterogeneity in investors’ confidence about mean endowment growth. The model predicts persistent heterogeneity in asset demands and concentrated portfolios. Consistent with the data, limited confidence reduces investors’ demand elasticities and makes stock prices excessively volatile—driven by latent demand rather than observable characteristics. The underlying economic mechanisms are driven primarily by investors’ desire to hedge changes in future beliefs instead of current disagreement. Finally, consistent with survey data, investors’ expectations correlate positively with past returns and negatively with future returns.
summary: 本文构建一个由单一潜在变量驱动的均衡模型，该变量为投资者对均值增长信心的异质性，旨在理解投资者资产需求的动态变化。模型预测资产需求的持续异质性和集中化投资组合。与实证数据一致，有限信心降低了投资者的需求弹性，并使股票价格过度波动——这种波动由潜在需求驱动，而非可观测特征。背后的经济机制主要源于投资者对冲未来信念变化的愿望，而非当前分歧。此外，模型预测与调查数据相符：投资者的预期与过去回报正相关，与未来回报负相关。
ai_comment: 该模型以单一潜在变量解释了资产需求持续性、组合集中化、低需求弹性和过度波动等多个金融异象，机制简洁而深刻。

title: The True Colors of Money: Racial Representation and Asset Management
abstract: We examine the role of race and ethnicity in the mutual fund context at two distinct levels. At the fund manager level, we document a co-racial tilt—funds managed by minority-dominant (White-dominant) teams allocate larger portfolio weights to minority-led (White-led) firms. This tilt is not associated with superior performance. It diminishes as fund managers gain experience, suggesting the presence of inaccurate statistical discrimination. At the investor level, we find that minority-led funds are penalized similarly to White-dominant funds for poor performance but are not rewarded as much for superior performance. Overall, our results uncover race-related investment choices at both levels.
summary: 本文研究了种族和民族在共同基金环境中的两个不同层面的作用。在基金经理层面，我们发现了同种族倾斜：由少数族裔主导（白人主导）的团队将其投资组合权重更多地分配给少数族裔领导（白人领导）的公司。这种倾斜与优越的业绩无关，并随着基金经理经验的积累而减弱，表明存在不准确的统计歧视。在投资者层面，我们发现少数族裔领导的基金在业绩不佳时受到的惩罚与白人主导基金相似，但在业绩优异时却没有得到同等的奖励。总体而言，我们的结果揭示了在两个层面上与种族相关的投资选择。
ai_comment: 该研究从基金经理和投资者两个层面系统揭示了种族因素在资产管理中的非对称影响，为理解金融市场中的歧视行为提供了新视角。

title: Investing in Growth Stocks: Bimodal Payoff Distribution and Expected Returns
abstract: This paper documents that the payoffs from investing in growth stocks, as measured by the decile-rank distributions (DRD) of future revenues, earnings, investment, and stock returns, follow a bimodal U-shaped pattern. In contrast, the DRD of value stocks follows a traditional bell-shaped distribution. This divergence in payoff structures suggests growth stocks are more prone to structural shocks, such as disruptive technologies. Consequently, their pricing is heavily influenced by investors’ attitude toward exceptional outcomes, resulting in lower expected stock returns in equilibrium. We find that stocks with more pronounced bimodal payoffs are associated with significantly lower subsequent stock returns. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00980 .
summary: 本文发现，以未来收入、收益、投资和股票回报的十分位数排名分布（DRD）衡量，成长股投资的回报呈现双峰U型分布，而价值股的回报则呈现传统的钟形分布。这种回报结构的差异表明成长股更容易受到结构性冲击（如颠覆性技术）的影响，因此其定价显著受到投资者对极端结果态度的影响，导致均衡状态下预期股票回报率较低。研究进一步发现，双峰回报特征越明显的股票，其后续回报显著更低。本文由Eric So（会计领域）接受，补充数据文件可在线获取。
ai_comment: 创新性地揭示了成长股回报的双峰分布特征及其定价含义，为理解成长股低回报提供了新视角。

title: The Market Cost of Business Cycle Fluctuations
abstract: We propose a novel approach to measure the cost of aggregate economic fluctuations that does not require complete specification of investors’ risk preferences or their beliefs. With data on consumption and asset prices, an information-theoretic method is used to recover an information kernel (I-SDF). The I-SDF prices asset returns much better than tightly parametrized structural models, thereby offering a reliable candidate for the measurement of the welfare cost of business cycles. Our method enables the estimation of both the unconditional (or, average) cost of fluctuations, as well as the cost conditional on the state of the economy. We find that the cost of fluctuations is strongly time varying and countercyclical and that the cost of business cycle fluctuations is substantial, accounting for a quarter to a third of the cost of all consumption uncertainty. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00484 .
summary: 本文提出了一种衡量总体经济波动成本的新方法，无需完全指定投资者的风险偏好或信念。利用消费和资产价格数据，通过信息论方法恢复信息核（I-SDF）。该I-SDF在定价资产回报方面优于高度参数化的结构模型，从而为衡量商业周期福利成本提供了可靠候选。该方法可以估计波动的无条件（平均）成本以及基于经济状态的条件成本。研究发现，波动成本具有强烈的时变性和逆周期性，且商业周期波动成本相当可观，占所有消费不确定性的四分之一到三分之一。
ai_comment: 该文巧妙利用信息理论方法，无需完整指定偏好即可度量经济波动成本，并发现其显著且逆周期，对宏观金融理论有重要贡献。

title: The Impact of Financial Reporting Mandates on Labor Unions
abstract: Labor unions in the United States are subject to financial reporting mandates. This study examines how these mandates affect unions and their members. Using several regulation‐based empirical designs, we document that more granular reporting requirements adversely affect unions' election outcomes. Supplemental analyses suggest that these findings are consistent with the strategic use of unions' disclosed information by parties such as employers and their consultants. We find mixed evidence on whether the mandates materially improve oversight of unions. Lastly, we find that the mandate reduces employees' average pay without clear benefits for employers, aside from reallocating investment from labor to capital. Collectively, our results suggest that more fine‐grained financial reporting requirements impose costs on unions and weaken their ability to represent employees, resulting in worse employment outcomes.
summary: 本研究探讨了美国劳动工会的财务报告强制要求对其自身及会员的影响。利用多个基于监管的实证设计，发现更细粒度的报告要求对工会的选举结果产生不利影响。补充分析表明，雇主及其顾问等方策略性地利用了工会披露的信息，这可能是导致上述结果的原因。关于强制要求是否显著改善对工会的监管，证据不一。此外，强制要求降低了员工的平均工资，但并未给雇主带来明显好处，除了将投资从劳动力重新分配至资本。总体而言，更详细的财务报告要求增加了工会的成本，削弱了其代表员工的能力，导致更差的就业结果。
ai_comment: 该论文通过严谨的实证设计揭示了财务报告透明度对工会的意外负面效应，挑战了信息披露有利于员工利益的传统观点。

title: Remeasuring Scale in Active Management
abstract: We show that scale in active equity portfolios is understated by at least 65% because the majority of mutual funds have “twin” institutional vehicles (IVs) managed under the same strategies. Omitting these IVs can severely skew crucial estimates in asset management research: by including IV assets, diminishing returns to scale of active investments is significantly reduced, and dollar value added of active strategies is more substantial and persistent than previously suggested. We further show that IV assets meaningfully influence managers’ portfolio decisions. In addition, these measurement issues apply to common flow measures and extend to passive funds and bond funds. (JEL G20, G23)
summary: 研究表明，主动型股票投资组合的规模被低估至少65%，因为大多数共同基金拥有按相同策略管理的“孪生”机构投资工具（IVs）。忽略这些IVs会严重扭曲资产管理研究中的关键估计：纳入IV资产后，主动投资的规模回报递减显著减弱，且主动策略的美元增加值比之前认为的更显著且更持久。此外，IV资产对基金经理的投资决策有重要影响。这些测量问题同样适用于常见的资金流量衡量指标，并延伸至被动型基金和债券基金。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了传统主动管理规模测量中的重大偏误，通过纳入机构投资工具（IVs）修正了关于规模回报递减和基金经理增值能力的结论，对资产管理和基金业绩评估具有重要修正意义。

title: Star Firms, Information Spillovers, and Predictable Industry-Level Outcomes
abstract: An abstract is not available for this content so a preview has been provided. Please use the Get access link above for information on how to access this content.
summary: 由于摘要不可用，无法获取论文的具体内容。仅从标题推测，该论文可能研究明星企业（Star Firms）的信息溢出效应如何导致行业层面的可预测结果。
ai_comment: 摘要缺失，无法评估论文的具体贡献，但标题暗示了信息溢出在行业预测中的重要性。

title: Risk-averse dealers in a risk-free market—The role of trading desk risk limits
abstract: We show that self-imposed risk limits significantly constrain dealers’ risk-taking and Treasury market intermediation, especially during market stress. Dealers near value-at-risk (VaR) limits reduce positions and demand higher compensation for risk. During March 2020, constrained dealers sold more Treasuries to the Fed at lower prices and provided less liquidity to clients. An aggregate measure of dealer VaR constraints closely tracks Treasury market illiquidity. Our findings offer a micro-foundation for the volatility–liquidity link and show that, in crises, policy actions that remove risk from intermediary balance sheets may be more effective at supporting Treasury market functioning than regulatory relief.
summary: 本文研究自设风险限制对交易商在国债市场中风险承担和中介行为的影响，特别是在市场压力时期。采用价值-at-风险（VaR）限制作为风险约束的衡量标准，发现接近VaR限制的交易商会减少头寸并要求更高的风险补偿。在2020年3月市场压力期间，受约束的交易商以更低价格向美联储出售更多国债，并为客户提供更少流动性。通过构建交易商VaR约束的总体指标，发现该指标与国债市场非流动性紧密相关。研究结果为波动性与流动性之间的联系提供了微观基础，并表明在危机期间，从中介资产负债表移除风险的政策行动（如资产购买）可能比放松监管更有效地支持国债市场功能。
ai_comment: 该论文通过微观数据揭示了风险限额在危机中加剧市场非流动性的机制，为政策设计提供了重要启示，即直接缓解中介风险承担压力比放松监管更有效。
