ai_comment: 该研究通过随机实验提供了因果证据，挑战了标准预期形成模型，并提出了主观心理模型的解释，具有重要的理论和实证贡献。

title: The Response of Mortgage Supply to Expected Flood Insurance Lapses
abstract: Flooding is among the costliest natural disasters in many countries. To protect collateral, many mortgage borrowers in the United States are legally required to maintain flood insurance. However, lax enforcement leads to frequent policy lapses. This paper shows that lenders provide credit contingent on borrowers’ insurance incentives. Exploiting exogenous premium rises ($266 annually) that disincentivize insurance take-up, I find mortgage denial rates dramatically increase by 0.49–0.81 pp. By comparison, lowering income by $266 has an effect of only 0.01 pp. Mortgage applicants’ composition remains unchanged, refuting demand-side explanations. Evidence suggests lenders internalize ex-post monitoring costs into ex-ante credit restrictions.
summary: 本文研究洪水保险保费上涨对抵押贷款供给的影响。在美国，许多抵押贷款借款人被法律要求购买洪水保险，但执行不严导致保单时常失效。利用外生的保费每年上涨266美元，降低借款人购买保险的激励，本文发现抵押贷款拒绝率显著上升0.49至0.81个百分点。相比之下，借款人收入降低266美元仅使拒绝率上升0.01个百分点。借款人的构成未发生变化，排除了需求侧的解释。证据表明，贷款人将事后监测成本内部化，从而在事前收紧信贷条件。
ai_comment: 本文通过外生保费冲击巧妙识别了贷款供给对借款人保险激励的因果效应，并揭示了贷款人内部化监测成本的行为机制，为理解保险与信贷市场的互动提供了新证据。

title: Who Bears Flood Risk? Evidence from Mortgage Markets in Florida
abstract: Government-provided flood insurance contracts have strict coverage limits, leaving some households underinsured against flood risk. This paper exploits these strict coverage limits as well as staggered flood map updates to show that mortgage lenders screen for uninsurable flood risk by requiring lower loan-to-value ratios at origination. This credit rationing leads delinquency rates to equalize inside and outside of flood zones, and shifts the composition of mortgage borrowers in flood zones toward richer and higher credit quality individuals. I conclude that lenders reduce credit supply when they retain residual uninsured exposures to flood risk, which has distributional consequences for flood zones.
summary: 本文研究政府提供的洪水保险存在严格覆盖限制，导致部分家庭未充分保险。利用保险覆盖的严格限制以及交错更新的洪水地图，作者发现抵押贷款机构通过要求更低的贷款价值比（loan-to-value ratio）来筛选不可保的洪水风险。这种信贷配给使得洪水区内外借款人的违约率趋于均衡，并将洪水区借款人的构成转向更富有、信用质量更高的个体。结论是，当贷款机构保留未保险的洪水风险敞口时，会减少信贷供给，从而对洪水区产生分配性影响。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙利用保险覆盖限制和洪水地图更新作为识别策略，揭示了气候风险通过信贷渠道的分配效应，对理解气候变化与金融市场互动具有重要贡献。

title: Incentivizing Effort and Informing Investment: The Dual Role of Stock Prices
abstract: Stock prices aggregate investor information about investment opportunities and reflect managerial performance. These dual roles may be in tension: when prices are more informative about investment opportunities, they may be less effective at incentivizing managerial effort. This tradeoff has novel consequences. Lower information costs can lead to both more efficient investment but lower firm value. The principal may strictly prefer to delegate investment to a manager who has no informational advantage and makes ex-post inefficient choices. Investment in diversifying and (ex-ante) negative NPV projects mitigate agency problems. Finally, standard measures of price efficiency provide an incomplete picture of firm value.
summary: 本文研究股票价格在汇聚投资者关于投资机会的信息与反映管理层绩效这双重角色之间的潜在冲突。当价格更有效地传递投资信息时，可能削弱其作为激励管理层努力工具的作用。这种权衡导致一系列新颖结论：降低信息成本虽能提高投资效率，却可能降低企业价值；委托人可能更愿意将投资决策权授予没有信息优势且事后会做出低效选择的经理；投资于多元化或事前净现值为负的项目反而有助于缓解代理问题；此外，传统的价格效率指标无法完整刻画企业价值。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了股票价格信息效率与激励功能之间的内在权衡，挑战了信息成本越低越好的传统观点，并指出标准价格效率指标的局限性，为代理理论和公司金融提供了新视角。

title: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
abstract: When a technology becomes the new standard, the firms that are leaders in producing this technology gain a competitive advantage. Matching the semantic content of patents to standard documents, we show that firms closer to the new technology standard increase their market share and sales. In addition, if they operate in a competitive market, these firms also increase their R&D expenditure. Yet, these effects are temporary since standardization creates a common technological basis for everyone, which allows followers to catch up and the economy to grow.
summary: 本文研究技术标准化对企业竞争、创新和经济增长的影响。通过将专利的语义内容与标准文档进行匹配，使用企业层面数据，发现更接近新技术标准的企业会提高市场份额和销售额。在竞争性市场中，这些企业还会增加研发支出。然而，这些效应是暂时的，因为标准化为所有企业创造了共同的技术基础，使得后来者能够追赶，从而推动整体经济增长。
ai_comment: 本文通过语义匹配方法将专利与标准文档联系起来，为标准化对企业行为和经济增长的微观机制提供了新的实证证据，并揭示了标准化效应的暂时性这一重要发现。

title: The Demand for Government Debt
abstract: We document that the sectoral composition and marginal buyers of government debt differ notably across jurisdictions and over time. We use instrumental variables derived from monetary policy surprises to estimate the demand elasticities of various sectors. In the United States, commercial banks and mutual funds exhibit the most price-elastic demand, whereas the foreign official sector has a price-inelastic demand. Based on these estimates and under certain assumptions, we find that a 1% increase in the Central Bank holdings of U.S. Treasuries results in an around 8- to 13-basis-point drop in long-term yields depending on the market composition. Elasticities of individual sectors do not differ in a statistically significant manner when the Central Bank share in the Treasury market increases or decreases. However, different market compositions during various quantitative easing (QE) and quantitative tightening (QT) programs have led to an asymmetric effect with the impact of QE on yields being greater than that of QT. Our results suggest that, overall, the demand for U.S. Treasuries is considerably more elastic than for equities, corporate bonds, and emerging market sovereign bonds found in the literature. We also repeat the analysis for other jurisdictions and compare estimates for different sectors. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00332 .
summary: 本文研究了政府债务需求的部门构成和边际买家在不同司法管辖区和时间上的差异。利用货币政策冲击推导的工具变量，估计了不同部门的需求弹性。在美国，商业银行和共同基金的需求价格弹性最高，而外国官方部门的需求价格弹性较低。基于这些估计并在某些假设下，发现央行持有美国国债每增加1%，长期收益率下降约8至13个基点，具体取决于市场构成。当央行在国债市场的份额增加或减少时，各部门的弹性在统计上没有显著差异。然而，在不同量化宽松和量化紧缩计划期间，市场构成的不同导致非对称效应，量化宽松对收益率的影响大于量化紧缩。总体而言，美国国债的需求比文献中股票、公司债券和新兴市场主权债券的需求更具弹性。本文还重复了对其他司法管辖区的分析，并比较了不同部门的估计。
ai_comment: 本文通过创新性地使用货币政策冲击作为工具变量，揭示了不同部门对政府债务需求的弹性差异，并发现了量化宽松与量化紧缩的非对称效应，为理解货币政策传导机制提供了新视角。

title: The Covenant-Defeasance Option in Corporate Bonds
abstract: Corporate bonds include restrictive covenants that may prevent firms from pursuing valuable growth opportunities ex post and are virtually impossible to renegotiate. We study a common but little-known contractual provision—the defeasance option—which allows issuers to immediately remove all covenants without retiring the bond. Our theoretical model predicts, and our empirical analysis confirms, that defeasance inclusion is more likely when covenants are numerous and issuers face financial constraints, uncertainty, and growth opportunities. We also show that investors require lower yields when defeasance is included in noncallable bonds, and higher yields in fixed-price callable bonds, where it raises call risk.
summary: 本文研究公司债券中的可解除选择权（defeasance option），这是一种常见但鲜为人知的合同条款，允许债券发行人在不赎回债券的情况下立即移除所有限制性契约。由于限制性契约可能阻碍公司事后追求有价值的增长机会，且几乎无法重新谈判，该选择权提供了灵活性。作者构建了理论模型，预测当契约数量较多、发行人面临财务约束、不确定性和增长机会时，可解除选择权更可能被包含在债券合约中。实证分析支持了这些预测。此外，研究发现投资者对包含可解除选择权的不可赎回债券要求较低的收益率，但对固定价格可赎回债券要求较高的收益率，因为该选择权增加了赎回风险。
ai_comment: 本文聚焦于一个被忽视的债券条款，揭示了其经济动机和对债券定价的双向影响，对理解债券契约设计和投资者定价有重要意义。

title: How Financial Markets Create Superstars
abstract: By aggregating information into stock prices, financial markets help guide the allocation of resources. We show that speculators without information about firms’ fundamentals can exploit this role of prices and profit from inflating firm valuations. Uninformed speculation is profitable because high valuations attract employees, business partners, and investors, creating value at targeted firms at the cost of diverting resources from better firms. Both large and small speculators, without pre-existing stock positions, can profit from uninformed speculation, particularly when targeting firms with moderate Q, operating in “normal” (neither hot nor cold) markets, and using performance pay or equity to attract stakeholders.
summary: 本文研究金融市场如何通过价格机制创造“超级明星”企业。作者指出，金融市场通过将信息聚合到股价中，引导资源配置。然而，缺乏基本面信息的投机者可以利用价格这一功能，通过抬高目标公司的估值来获利。这种无信息投机之所以盈利，是因为高估值能够吸引员工、商业伙伴和投资者，从而在目标公司创造价值，但代价是资源从更优企业转移。研究发现，无论大、小投机者，即使没有预先持有股票，都可以从无信息投机中获利，特别是在目标公司具有中等Q值、处于“正常”市场（既不热也不冷）且使用绩效薪酬或股权吸引利益相关者的情况下。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了金融市场中投机行为如何通过资源转移创造“超级明星”企业，为理解价格的信息功能与非基本面投机提供了新视角，对监管和市场设计具有启示意义。

title: The Broader Role of Venture Capital Due Diligence
abstract: Analyzing approximately 2,000 applicants to a U.K. seed fund, this study examines how venture capital (VC) due diligence affects startup outcomes independent of funding decisions. Leveraging random reviewer assignment, we find that due diligence increases 2-year growth but lowers continuation rates among nonfunded applicants, reflecting a dynamic of accelerated scaling or exit. Evidence points to a learning mechanism: due diligence exposes founders to advanced website technologies, prompting capability building in digital skills. Firms selected for due diligence adopt these technologies, even before raising external capital. The findings highlight VC due diligence as a formative process influencing startups beyond the funded few.
summary: 本研究基于英国一家种子基金的约2,000份申请数据，利用随机审阅者分配机制，考察了风险投资（VC）尽职调查对初创企业结果的独立于融资决策的影响。研究发现，尽职调查使未获得资助的申请者两年内增长率提高，但持续率降低，反映了加速扩张或退出的动态。证据指向一种学习机制：尽职调查让创始人接触先进的网站技术，从而促进数字技能的能力建设。被选入尽职调查的公司在筹集外部资本之前就已采用这些技术。研究结论强调了VC尽职调查作为一种形成性过程，其影响超越了少数获得资助的初创企业。
ai_comment: 通过随机审阅者分配识别因果效应，揭示了尽职调查的“学习机制”，扩展了对VC作用的理解，具有重要的理论和实践贡献。

title: Profit Persistence in the U.S. Audit Market
abstract: This study investigates the relation between audit competition, audit quality, and auditor labor hours. Using proprietary data on auditor realization rates, we construct new measures of competition based on theory predicting that abnormal profits will quickly disappear when competition is high but persist over multiple periods when competition is low. We find consistent evidence of persistent abnormal profits among U.S. Big 4 engagements and that individual offices earn persistent abnormal returns, suggesting that the market is not perfectly competitive. Examining the consequences of lower competition, we find that profit persistence is negatively related to audit hours and positively related to audit quality. Although we are cautious about inferring causality, our findings suggest that lower competition is associated with more efficient and effective audits.
summary: 本研究利用审计师实现率的专有数据，基于理论预测（高竞争时异常利润快速消失，低竞争时多期持续）构建了新的审计市场竞争度量指标。研究发现，美国四大会计师事务所的审计业务中存在持续异常利润，且单个办公室也获得持续异常回报，表明市场并非完全竞争。进一步分析显示，利润持久性与审计工时负相关，与审计质量正相关，尽管对因果关系的推断持谨慎态度，但结果暗示较低的市场竞争可能与更高效、更有效的审计相关联。
ai_comment: 利用专有数据构建新竞争指标，为审计市场非完全竞争提供了有力证据，并揭示了竞争对审计效率与质量的潜在影响，具有重要政策含义。

title: Family Matters: Exploring the Link Between Parental and Executive Financial Misconduct
abstract: Using a novel data set of misconduct records for Finnish CEOs and directors and their parents, we explore whether corporate executives’ financial misconduct is associated with similar behavior by their parents. Controlling for various other factors of executive financial misconduct, we find that executives are significantly more likely to engage in financial misconduct, including accounting, tax, and other financial offenses, if their parents have a history of financial misconduct. This intergenerational association is stronger when the parental misconduct is more severe. Additional findings reveal that growing up in high‐misconduct municipalities and cohabiting with spouses who engage in financial misconduct are also associated with a higher likelihood of executive misconduct, indicating that such behaviors may be shaped by broader socialization processes that extend beyond the immediate family. Although our analyses do not establish causal relationships, the collective evidence presented in this study offers insights into why some corporate executives engage in misconduct while others do not.
summary: 本研究利用芬兰CEO及董事及其父母的金融不当行为记录数据，探究企业高管金融不当行为是否与父母的类似行为相关联。在控制多种其他因素后，研究发现若父母有金融不当行为史，高管从事金融不当行为（包括会计、税务及其他金融犯罪）的可能性显著增加。这种代际关联在父母不当行为更为严重时更强。此外，在高不当行为率的城市成长以及与有金融不当行为的配偶同居也与高管不当行为可能性增加相关，表明此类行为可能受到超越直系亲属的更广泛社会化过程的影响。尽管分析未建立因果关系，但汇集证据为为何一些企业高管从事不当行为而另一些则不提供了见解。
ai_comment: 论文利用独特的芬兰高管-父母匹配数据，揭示了金融不当行为的代际传递效应，并探讨了社区和配偶等更广泛的社会化因素，丰富了公司治理和犯罪学文献。

title: Do Earnings Announcements Affect Employee Spending? Evidence from Transaction Data*
abstract: Leveraging micro‐level data on individual employees’ bank and credit card transactions, we examine the impact of earnings announcement (EA) news on employee spending. Utilizing an event study methodology, we find strong evidence that EA news elicits significant reactions in employee spending. These reactions are stronger for employees located in the firm's headquarters state, with longer tenure, possessing investment experience, or earning higher wages, consistent with these employees being more likely to attend to their firm's EAs. The reactions are also stronger for the fourth fiscal quarter than interim quarters, suggesting that year‐end results garner greater employee attention. Furthermore, consistent with media facilitating employee processing of EA news, the reactions are stronger for EAs covered by a larger number of news articles. Finally, in line with the notion that EAs contain information about employees’ future cash flows, we find that EA news predicts changes in employee wages and that employees with higher past wage‐to‐EA news sensitivity exhibit stronger spending reactions. Overall, our findings provide evidence of the role of financial reporting in employees’ spending decisions.
summary: 本研究利用微观层面的个人银行和信用卡交易数据，采用事件研究方法，考察了财报公告（EA）新闻对员工消费的影响。结果发现，EA新闻显著引起了员工消费的反应，且这些反应在总部所在州的员工、任期较长、有投资经验或收入更高的员工中更为强烈，这符合这些员工更可能关注公司EA的预期。此外，第四财季的反应强于中期财季，表明年终结果引起员工更多关注；EA新闻覆盖的文章数量越多，反应也越强，这与媒体促进员工处理EA新闻的假设一致。最后，EA新闻能预测员工工资变化，且过去工资对EA新闻敏感度更高的员工表现出更强的消费反应。总体而言，本文提供了财务报告影响员工消费决策的证据。
ai_comment: 利用独特微观交易数据，首次实证揭示财报公告对员工消费的非传统经济后果，为财务报告的信息传递效应提供了新视角。

title: Aggregated Compensation Peer Group Disclosure and Managerial Labor Market Competition: A Network Analysis
abstract: In this paper, we develop novel measures of managerial labor market classification and competition by constructing networks of compensation benchmarking peers disclosed in proxy statements. These networks represent firms’ relative positions within the managerial labor market. Our classifications strongly predict executive moves across firms, outperforming a comprehensive set of predictors in the literature. Subsequent tests further demonstrate the strength of our methodology in capturing the multidimensional and dynamic features of the managerial labor market. We also validate our competition measures by showing that they are associated with retention tools, such as higher equity pay and longer pay duration. Finally, we apply our measures to test two theoretical predictions. First, we find that labor market competition could explain controversial pay practices. Second, we demonstrate that the labor market provides managers with tournament incentives to deliver superior future performance.
summary: 本文通过构建代理声明中披露的薪酬比较同行网络，开发了新的经理人劳动力市场分类和竞争度量指标。这些网络反映了公司在经理人劳动力市场中的相对位置。研究发现，该分类能强有力地预测高管跨公司流动，优于文献中的综合预测因子。后续测试进一步证明了该方法在捕捉经理人劳动力市场多维动态特征方面的有效性。竞争度量与保留工具（如更高股权薪酬和更长薪酬期限）相关。最后，应用该度量检验了两个理论预测：劳动力市场竞争可以解释有争议的薪酬实践；劳动力市场为经理人提供了锦标赛激励，以推动其实现未来卓越绩效。
keywords: 经理人劳动力市场竞争
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用薪酬比较同行网络度量经理人劳动力市场竞争，预测力强且捕捉了多维动态特征，为理解高管薪酬与激励提供了新视角。

title: Reporting Regulation and Private Firms' Bank Credit
abstract: This paper studies the effect of reporting regulation on private firms' bank credit and its economic consequences. I exploit the Spanish institutional setting, which provides a unique combination of confidential loan data and regulatory features that generate quasi‐exogenous variation in reporting regulation. Using a regression discontinuity design, I find that firms subject to incremental reporting regulation obtain more bank credit primarily through cash flow–based lending, term loans, and long‐term debt, without higher interest rates. These findings are explained by stronger banking competition and greater reliance on financial statement data. However, firms do not expand their net financial position, as bank credit substitutes for other liabilities, and exhibit weaker performance consistent with the costs of reporting regulation. This evidence from a different setting offers new insights into how reporting regulation influences credit contracting for private firms and strengthens the empirical basis for policy‐making.
summary: 本研究探讨了报告监管对私人企业银行信贷的影响及其经济后果。利用西班牙的制度环境，该环境结合了保密的贷款数据和监管特征，产生了报告监管的准外生变化。通过回归断点设计，研究发现，受到增量报告监管的企业获得了更多的银行信贷，主要通过现金流贷款、定期贷款和长期债务，且利率并未提高。这些结果可以用更强的银行竞争和更高的财务报表数据依赖来解释。然而，企业的净财务状况并未扩张，因为银行信贷替代了其他负债，并且企业表现出较弱的业绩，这与报告监管的成本一致。来自不同环境的证据为报告监管如何影响私人企业的信贷合同提供了新见解，并加强了政策制定的实证基础。
ai_comment: 该论文利用西班牙独特的制度设计和准实验方法，揭示了报告监管对私人企业信贷的双重影响，既有促进信贷可得性的正面作用，也伴随着业绩成本，为监管政策制定提供了重要实证依据。

title: Corporate Litigation, Governance, and the Role of Law Firms
abstract: We study plaintiff law firms in corporate litigation, focusing on “star” firms that dominate settlement outcomes. Stars are associated with larger settlements; however, much of this effect is predicted by the defendant's litigation insurance coverage, suggesting assortative matching of stars with lawsuits that have ex ante larger expected payoffs. Moreover, stars charge higher fees for a given settlement size. Additional tests suggest that visibility and information asymmetry vis‐à‐vis less sophisticated plaintiffs help sustain the stars’ market share. These findings advance our understanding of corporate litigation and the agency relationship between plaintiff law firms and their clients.
summary: 本文研究公司诉讼中的原告律师事务所，重点关注主导和解结果的“明星”律所。研究发现，明星律所与更大的和解金额相关，但这一效应很大程度上由被告的诉讼保险覆盖预测，表明明星律所与事前预期收益更大的案件存在匹配。此外，对于给定的和解金额，明星律所收取更高费用。进一步测试表明，知名度和相对于不成熟原告的信息不对称有助于维持明星律所的市场份额。这些发现推进了我们对公司诉讼以及原告律所与其客户之间代理关系的理解。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了明星律师事务所在公司诉讼中的匹配效应，挑战了明星效应直接带来更好结果的假设，并强调了保险覆盖和信息不对称的关键作用。

title: Macroeconomic Information Acquisition Around Earnings Clusters
abstract: Research shows that investors acquire and process less firm‐specific information on days when many firms announce earnings (hereafter earnings clusters). We show that investors gather more macroeconomic information during earnings clusters, that this behavior is amplified during negative economic shocks and concurrent macroeconomic announcements, and that these information acquisition patterns have implications for equity valuations. Our findings are consistent with the benefit of extracting macroeconomic information from earnings announcements increasing during earnings clusters, which we confirm empirically. Thus, our results help explain why investors focus less on individual firm news during earnings clusters: They rationally redirect their attention to the most beneficial information.
summary: 该论文研究投资者在大量公司同时发布盈余公告（即盈余集群）期间的信息获取行为。已有研究表明，投资者在盈余集群日获取和处理的公司特定信息较少，而本文发现投资者在这些日子里会获取更多宏观经济信息，这种行为在负面经济冲击和宏观经济公告发布期间更为显著，并且这些信息获取模式对股票估值有影响。作者从理论上提出，盈余集群期间从盈余公告中提取宏观经济信息的收益增加，并通过实证验证了这一假设。因此，研究结果有助于解释投资者为何在盈余集群日减少对单个公司新闻的关注：他们理性地将注意力重新转向最有益的信息（即宏观经济信息）。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了盈余集群期间投资者信息获取的宏观转向，为注意力分配理论提供了新的实证证据，并强调了宏观经济信息在股票估值中的重要性。

title: Interactivity and Illusions of Ability: How Using Generative AI Affects Investor Judgments
abstract: I use the setting of generative AI (GenAI) to examine how processing tool interactivity affects investors’ self‐assessments of ability and willingness to invest. Although GenAI can help investors process financial information, I theorize that the interactive nature of GenAI blurs the boundaries between investors’ own abilities and those of GenAI, prompting investors to discount their reliance on GenAI and misattribute its abilities to themselves. I rely on the advantages of a laboratory setting to disentangle the interactive element of GenAI from the mere presence of GenAI assistance. Across three experiments, I find that the interactivity underpinning GenAI heightens investors’ self‐assessments of their own abilities and increases their willingness to invest, despite this interactivity not improving, and in fact hindering, their actual processing of information provided by GenAI. My study thus highlights one potential cost of using GenAI and other highly interactive processing tools.
summary: 该论文探讨生成式AI（GenAI）的交互性如何影响投资者的自我能力评估和投资意愿。通过实验室实验，将GenAI的交互性与单纯的AI帮助区分开来，发现交互性会模糊投资者自身能力与GenAI能力的界限，使投资者低估对GenAI的依赖而高估自身能力。三项实验均显示，交互性增强了投资者的自我能力评估和投资意愿，但并未改善实际信息处理能力，反而有阻碍作用。研究揭示了使用GenAI等高度交互工具的一个潜在成本。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实验设计巧妙分离了交互性与AI辅助的作用，揭示了交互性导致的能力错觉这一行为偏差，对理解AI工具在金融决策中的负面影响具有重要警示意义。

title: The Determinants of ESG Ratings: Rater Ownership Matters
abstract: We examine whether and how common ownership affects Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings—an important research question given the increasing use of these ratings in investment decisions and corporate evaluations. We find that companies with major shareholders in common with the rating agency (“sister firms”) tend to receive higher ESG ratings. When a company becomes a sister firm through a change in the rating agency's ownership structure, its rating from that agency is subsequently upgraded, whereas its ESG ratings from other agencies remain unchanged. Sister firms exhibit greater rating disagreements across agencies than other firms. The higher ESG ratings for sister firms are partly attributable to the transfer of immaterial positive ESG information through common owners. The common ownership effect is more pronounced when the owner can exert a greater influence on the rating agency. Moreover, sister firms with initially elevated ratings demonstrate poorer future ESG performance. Overall, our findings suggest that owners can affect ESG ratings of their portfolio companies in a way consistent with their influence and interest.
summary: 本文研究共同所有权如何影响ESG评级。研究发现，与评级机构拥有共同大股东的公司（“姐妹公司”）通常会获得更高的ESG评级。当一家公司因评级机构所有权结构变化而成为姐妹公司时，其来自该机构的评级会随后上调，而来自其他机构的ESG评级保持不变。姐妹公司之间的评级分歧大于其他公司。姐妹公司较高的ESG评级部分归因于通过共同所有者传递的非实质性正面ESG信息。当所有者对评级机构影响力更大时，共同所有权效应更显著。此外，初始评级较高的姐妹公司未来ESG表现较差。总体而言，研究结果表明所有者可以以其影响力和利益一致的方式影响其投资组合公司的ESG评级。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了所有权结构对ESG评级的潜在影响，为评级机构的独立性和利益冲突提供了新证据，对投资者和监管层具有重要参考价值。

title: Inheriting Versus Developing Data Analytic Tests and Auditors’ Professional Skepticism
abstract: As the use of audit data analytic tests (ADA) becomes increasingly established in practice, auditors will often confront situations in which they inherit ADA developed by others, as opposed to developing the ADA themselves. Despite the potential benefits of ADA, inheriting ADA could decrease auditors’ skeptical actions by diminishing their psychological ownership of the ADA. In an experiment where an ADA identifies a fraud red flag, we find that auditors who inherited the ADA are less likely to exercise skeptical actions than those who were personally involved in its development. We then provide evidence that informing auditors who inherit an ADA about the test development activities (e.g., a brief memorandum documenting the ADA's development) mitigates the negative effect of inheriting the ADA. Evidence from mediation analyses suggests that these effects are driven by decreased psychological ownership when auditors inherit the ADA.
summary: 本文研究审计数据分析测试（ADA）在实务中日益普及后，审计员经常面临继承他人开发的ADA而非亲自开发的情况。通过设计一个ADA识别出欺诈红旗的实验，发现继承ADA的审计员比亲自参与开发的审计员更少采取怀疑行动。进一步证据表明，向继承ADA的审计员提供测试开发活动的信息（例如简要备忘录记录ADA的开发过程）可以缓解继承ADA的负面效应。中介分析表明，这些效应是由继承ADA时心理所有权下降所驱动的。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙地将心理学中的心理所有权概念引入审计数据分析领域，为理解技术继承如何影响审计师怀疑行为提供了新视角，并提出简单实用的缓解措施。

title: Strategic (Inconsistent) Disclosures and Sophisticated Investors: Evidence from Hedge Funds
abstract: Recent SEC regulations require that qualified hedge fund advisers provide their investors with narrative disclosures of their business and operations. We find that 40% of these disclosures omit or de‐emphasize information regarding advisers' operational and investment risks when compared to other sources of public information. Funds with such “inconsistencies” are associated with predictably lower fund performance but do not differ in their fund flows, flow‐performance relation, ownership structure, or management fees. These results are consistent with investors being subject to limited strategic thinking, which prevents them from fully unraveling the implications of strategic omissions. This, in turn, contributes to advisers' successful use of discretion to de‐emphasize information with adverse performance implications. Our findings suggest that information processing frictions can facilitate nondisclosure, even in markets with sophisticated investors.
summary: 该论文研究对冲基金顾问在SEC要求的叙述性披露中战略性遗漏风险信息的行为。通过比较披露内容与其他公开信息，发现40%的披露存在不一致，即淡化或省略了操作和投资风险。这些不一致的基金可预测地表现更差，但基金流量、流量-业绩关系、所有权结构和管理费并无差异。结果表明，投资者受限于有限战略思维，未能完全识别战略省略的含义，从而使得顾问能成功利用自由裁量权淡化不利信息。该发现说明，即使在成熟投资者市场中，信息处理摩擦也会促进不披露。
ai_comment: 本文结合SEC监管背景与行为金融学视角，揭示了成熟投资者仍可能受制于有限战略思维，为披露策略的实证研究提供了新证据。

title: Excess Commitment in R&D
abstract: We document that firms exhibit “excess” commitment to R&D projects and examine its consequences for innovation outcomes. Using detailed data on pharmaceutical firms’ clinical trial projects, we find that trial delays, empirically uncorrelated with multiple project-quality measures, substantially reduce firms’ subsequent project-termination propensity. This result remains robust when we use variation in clinical trial site congestion to instrument for unexpected delays. Excess commitment intensifies when CEO compensation has greater stock-price sensitivity and the CEO is responsible for the project’s initiation. Our findings have broader implications: delay-driven commitment reduces new drug project initiations, with further evidence suggesting efficiency losses for firms.
summary: 该论文研究了企业在研发项目中的过度承诺现象及其对创新结果的影响。利用制药公司临床试验项目的详细数据，发现试验延迟（与多个项目质量指标经验上不相关）显著降低了企业随后终止项目的概率。通过使用临床试验现场拥挤程度作为工具变量处理内生性，该结果依然稳健。过度承诺在CEO薪酬对股票价格敏感性更高以及CEO负责项目启动时更为严重。进一步分析表明，延迟驱动的承诺减少了新药项目的启动，并带来了效率损失。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的临床试验数据揭示了研发项目中延迟如何导致非理性持续投入，并通过工具变量识别因果关系，为理解企业创新决策偏差提供了新视角。

title: M&As Efficiency Gains: Evidence from Branch-Level Data
abstract: We examine how banks reallocate employees following mergers and acquisitions (M&As) and the resulting effects on productivity. Using matched employee–branch data combined with branch-level financial information, we show that M&As expand internal labor markets and trigger substantial worker redeployment. Newly consolidated banks reassign high-ability loan officers to acquirer branches, increasing productivity. Target branches also experience productivity improvements, primarily driven by restructuring and cost reductions. These effects are strongest in municipalities where the combined pre-merger internal labor markets of the target and acquirer were larger, highlighting the central role of internal labor markets in generating efficiency gains from consolidation.
summary: 本文利用匹配的员工-分支机构数据与分支机构层面的财务信息，研究银行合并与收购（M&A）后如何重新分配员工及其对生产率的影响。研究发现，并购扩大了内部劳动力市场，并引发大规模的员工再部署。新合并的银行将高能力的信贷员重新分配到收购方分支机构，从而提高了生产率。目标分支机构也经历了生产率提升，这主要源于重组和成本削减。这些效应在目标方与收购方合并前内部劳动力市场更大的城市中最为显著，突出了内部劳动力市场在通过整合实现效率提升中的核心作用。
ai_comment: 本文通过分支机构层面的微观数据揭示了内部劳动力市场在银行并购效率中的关键作用，为理解并购后资源再配置提供了新视角。

title: Dealer Funding and Market Liquidity
abstract: We analyze a model where dealers provide market liquidity by intermediating trades between clients. They exert unobservable search effort to improve intermediation profit. This moral-hazard friction limits their ability to raise external finance and compete with each other, constraining market liquidity even for safe assets and more so for those with higher search costs. Dealers mitigate this friction by using debt financing and intermediating across multiple markets, making leverage endogenous and linked to liquidity variations in otherwise unrelated markets. Capping leverage reduces dealer external financing and has mixed effects on welfare. It worsens liquidity but encourages effort. Our findings illuminate how postcrisis regulations impact bond market liquidity. This paper was accepted by William Cong, finance. Funding: J. C.-F. Kuong gratefully acknowledges the financial support from INSEAD and HKIMR. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02278 .
summary: 本文构建了一个做市商通过中介客户交易提供市场流动性的模型。做市商付出不可观测的搜索努力以改善中介利润，这一道德风险摩擦限制了其外部融资能力和相互竞争，从而约束了市场流动性，即使对安全资产也是如此，且对搜索成本更高的资产影响更大。做市商通过债务融资和跨多个市场的中介来缓解这一摩擦，导致杠杆内生且与原本不相关的市场流动性变化相关联。限制杠杆会减少做市商的外部融资，并对福利产生混合影响：恶化流动性但鼓励努力。研究结果揭示了危机后监管如何影响债券市场流动性。
ai_comment: 该模型将道德风险与市场流动性联系起来，揭示了杠杆的内生性及其跨市场溢出效应，对理解危机后监管的流动性影响具有重要启示。

title: Risk Managers in Banks
abstract: Some bank regulators require that performance bonuses for risk managers (RMs) and for employees in front offices (FOs) be linked to distinct performance metrics, as correlated pay incentives could lead RMs to rubber-stamp risky investments. We theoretically show that a positive correlation between FOs and RMs is optimal for banks, but can be socially excessive in leveraged institutions. Using data from German bank employees, we show empirically that incentive pay is indeed positively correlated between RMs and FOs. Consistent with our predictions, bonus correlations are higher in banks with higher leverage and weaker performance during the Great Financial Crisis.
summary: 本文研究银行中风险经理（RMs）与前台（FOs）之间的绩效奖金相关性。理论分析表明，尽管监管要求两者奖金基于不同指标以避免盖章行为，但银行内部实现正相关的奖金结构是最优的，然而在杠杆率高的机构中这种正相关性可能存在社会过度。利用德国银行员工数据，实证发现RMs与FOs的激励性薪酬确实呈正相关。进一步，奖金相关性在杠杆率更高、金融危机期间表现更差的银行中更强，与理论预测一致。
ai_comment: 本文为银行内部激励设计提供了新的理论视角与实证证据，揭示了监管要求与银行最优激励之间的张力，并指出杠杆放大可能导致的社会成本。

title: Debt Maturity Management
abstract: This paper studies how a borrower issues long- and short-term debt in response to shocks to the fundamental value. Short-term debt protects creditors from future dilution and incentivizes the borrower to reduce leverage after small negative shocks. Long-term debt postpones default and allows the borrower time to recover after large negative shocks. When borrowers are in distress, they rely on short-term debt; however, they issue both types of debt during more normal periods. Our model generates novel implications for the dynamic adjustment of debt maturities.
summary: 本文研究借款人如何通过发行长期和短期债务来应对基本面价值的冲击。短期债务能够保护债权人免受未来的稀释效应，并激励借款人在经历小幅负面冲击后降低杠杆率。长期债务则推迟违约，为借款人在遭遇大幅负面冲击后提供恢复时间。当借款人处于困境时，他们倾向于依赖短期债务；而在较正常的时期，他们同时发行两种债务。该模型为债务期限的动态调整提供了新的理论启示。
ai_comment: 本文从动态权衡视角解释了债务期限选择，揭示了困境与正常时期的不同发行策略，对资本结构理论有重要补充。

title: Rewriting CRSP’s History: Impact of Altered Monthly Returns on Asset Pricing
abstract: In January 2025, CRSP discontinued the existing stock tape used in many published papers. This transition rewrites 9.62% of monthly returns by more than 1 basis point (bp), primarily due to a change in the dividend reinvestment assumption. Analyzing the impact for a comprehensive set of premia in several thousand sorting specifications reveals that, on average, 11.43% of all monthly long-short returns differ by more than 10 bp—especially in early periods, NBER recessions, and return-based sorts. Reassuringly, average premia and their significance remain largely unaffected, suggesting CRSP changes mainly introduce unsystematic variation without altering key asset pricing conclusions.
summary: 这篇论文研究了CRSP数据库在2025年1月发生的重大更新，即停用旧股票数据库并采用新数据库，由于股息再投资假设的变化，导致9.62%的月度收益率变化超过1个基点。通过在数千种排序规范中检查多种因子溢价，发现平均有11.43%的月度多空组合收益率差异超过10个基点，这种影响在早期时期、NBER衰退期和基于收益率的排序中尤为显著。然而，平均溢价及其统计显著性基本未受影响，表明CRSP的变化主要引入了非系统性波动，并未改变关键的资产定价结论。
ai_comment: 本文提供了一个关于数据更新如何影响实证资产定价研究的重要警示，表明虽然个别观测值发生显著变化，但总体结论稳健，强调了数据来源变更对复制研究和稳健性检验的重要性。

title: Personal Financial Information Presentation and Consumer Spending
abstract: We study whether information design influences consumer behavior in a randomized field experiment with users of an online account aggregation app. Participants received a personalized index representing their net worth as a lifetime monthly cash flow. The presentation of this index varied across treatments in its framing and the salience of its display. Consumers exposed to a consumption-oriented frame and a salient comparison of the index with their past spending reduced discretionary spending. These findings show that minor variations in information presentation can significantly affect financial behavior, highlighting the power of design in promoting saving and informing policy and regulation.
summary: 本文通过一个在线账户聚合应用的随机实地实验，研究了个人财务信息呈现方式如何影响消费者支出行为。参与者收到一个代表其净资产的终身月度现金流个性化指数，该指数在框架（如消费导向或储蓄导向）和显著性（如是否与过去支出进行突出比较）上存在差异。实验发现，当消费者暴露于消费导向框架以及指数与过去支出的显著比较时，会减少可自由支配的支出。这些结果表明，信息呈现的微小变化能显著影响金融行为，凸显了设计在促进储蓄方面的力量，并为政策和监管提供了启示。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实地实验设计，为信息呈现的微小变化如何影响实际消费行为提供了因果证据，对金融产品设计和监管政策具有直接启示。

title: Credibility of Mandatory Disclosure by Credit Rating Agencies and Market Feedback
abstract: Using the Credit Rating Agency Reform Act of 2006, we examine the effect of the credibility of mandatory disclosure by credit rating agencies (CRAs) on market feedback. We find an increase in investment-price sensitivity for firms affected by the act, and the increase is enhanced when managers have greater incentives to glean information from prices—when firms are exposed to multiple dimensions of uncertainty, have higher growth options, face more competition, have less informed managers, or have higher accounting fraud risk. Our findings suggest that the greater credibility of CRA mandatory disclosure improves managerial learning from stock prices.
summary: 利用2006年信用评级机构改革法案，研究信用评级机构（CRAs）强制性披露的可信度对市场反馈的影响。发现受影响公司的投资-价格敏感性增加，且当管理者面临多种不确定性、拥有高增长期权、竞争更激烈、信息较少或会计欺诈风险较高时，这种增加更为显著。结果表明，CRA强制性披露可信度的提高改善了管理者从股价中学习的能力。
ai_comment: 利用法案外生冲击识别强制性披露可信度的影响，为信息披露与公司投资决策的互动提供新证据。

title: Cashless payment and financial inclusion
abstract: This paper investigates how cashless payment affects credit access for underserved populations using data from Alipay, a leading Chinese BigTech platform with over 1 billion users that offers a wide range of financial services. By exploiting the staggered rollout of Alipay-bundled shared bikes across cities as a natural experiment and analyzing a representative Alipay user sample, I find that cashless payment adoption increases credit access by 56.3% and that a 1% rise in payment flow increases credit lines by 0.41%. These effects are stronger for less educated and older individuals, who have traditionally faced greater barriers to accessing financial services.
summary: 本文利用中国领先的BigTech平台——支付宝（Alipay）超过10亿用户的数据，研究无现金支付如何影响未被充分服务人群的信用获取。通过将支付宝绑定的共享单车在城市间分阶段推出作为自然实验，并分析代表性的支付宝用户样本，本文发现采用无现金支付使信用获取增加56.3%，且支付流每增加1%，信用额度增加0.41%。这些效应在受教育程度较低和年龄较大的群体中更为显著，这些群体传统上面临更大的金融服务障碍。
ai_comment: 本文利用中国支付宝的独特数据与共享单车推广的自然实验，为无现金支付促进金融包容性提供了因果证据，尤其关注传统上被排斥的弱势群体，具有重要的政策启示。

title: On the Quality of Cryptocurrency Markets: Centralized vs. Decentralized Exchanges
abstract: We analyze the market quality of centralized crypto exchanges and decentralized blockchain-based venues (DEXs) using a unique and comprehensive data set. Focusing on two fundamental aspects, transaction costs and deviations from the no-arbitrage condition, we estimate the causal effect of gas fees on DEX market quality. We show that these fixed costs impose a significant burden on relatively small trades and cause persistent arbitrage deviations. Conversely, DEXs offer more competitive transaction costs for larger trades, offering a more favorable environment for institutional investors. Furthermore, we provide causal evidence that innovations aimed at enhancing the flexibility of liquidity provision in DEX markets lead to sizeable improvements in market quality. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation nccr–on the move [Grant 204721]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07703 .
summary: 本文利用独特且全面的数据集，分析中心化加密货币交易所与去中心化区块链交易所（DEX）的市场质量，重点关注交易成本和无套利条件偏差两个核心方面。通过估计gas费用对DEX市场质量的因果效应，发现固定成本对相对较小的交易造成显著负担，并导致持续套利偏差。相比之下，DEX为较大交易提供更具竞争力的交易成本，为机构投资者创造了更有利的环境。此外，本文提供了因果证据，表明旨在增强DEX市场流动性提供灵活性的创新显著改善了市场质量。
ai_comment: 本文通过因果识别方法揭示了gas费用对DEX市场质量的影响，并突显了DEX在大型交易中的优势，为理解加密货币市场结构提供了新视角。

title: Consumer Choice and Corporate Bankruptcy
abstract: We estimate the indirect costs of corporate bankruptcy associated with lost customers. In incentivized experiments, randomly informing consumers about a firm's Chapter 11 reorganization lowers their willingness to pay for the firm's products by 17% to 28%. Consumers worry that bankruptcy could reduce product quality or prevent future interactions with the bankrupt firm. On average, 38% of consumers are aware of major bankruptcies. Using our experiments to estimate a structural model, we show that these indirect costs of bankruptcy amount to 12% to 15% of a firm's value. We show that these costs are unlikely to arise before bankruptcy.
summary: 该论文通过激励实验估计了公司破产的间接成本，特别是与消费者流失相关的部分。实验随机告知消费者公司正在经历第11章破产重组，结果发现消费者的支付意愿降低了17%到28%。消费者主要担心破产会导致产品质量下降或无法与破产公司进行未来交易。平均而言，38%的消费者知晓重大破产事件。利用实验数据估计结构模型发现，这些间接成本占公司价值的12%到15%，并且这些成本不太可能在破产前显现。
ai_comment: 该论文通过巧妙的实验设计量化了破产对消费者的影响，为理解破产的隐性成本提供了新视角，方法严谨且结论具有实践意义。

title: Foundational processes and growth
abstract: This paper studies the interaction between process and product innovations and their distinct role in firm growth dynamics. We differentiate empirically and theoretically two types of process innovations: foundational processes that advance production technology and cost-reducing processes that enhance existing production efficiency. We develop an innovation model of product varieties with quality heterogeneity to illustrate how these innovations impact firm growth differently and highlight how process innovation induces product innovation. By analyzing millions of patent texts from 1900 to 2020, we classify innovations into product, cost-reducing process, and foundational process innovations. We find that foundational processes lead to sustained firm growth, especially through their effect on subsequent product creation. R&D-intensive firms focused on “deep-tech” innovations have an advantage in creating foundational processes, resulting in superior product quality. Using patents linked to FDA-approved drugs, we show that firms with a comparative advantage in creating foundational processes, due to greater knowledge and technological stock, tend to produce higher-value products.
summary: 本文研究了过程创新与产品创新之间的相互作用及其在企业增长动态中的不同角色。作者从理论和实证上区分了两种过程创新：基础过程创新（推进生产技术）和成本降低过程创新（提升现有生产效率）。他们构建了一个具有质量异质性的产品种类创新模型，以说明这些创新如何以不同方式影响企业增长，并强调过程创新如何诱导产品创新。通过分析1900年至2020年间数百万份专利文本，将创新分类为产品创新、成本降低过程创新和基础过程创新。研究发现，基础过程创新能够带来持续的企业增长，尤其是通过其对后续产品创造的影响。专注于“深科技”创新的研发密集型企业，在创造基础过程创新方面具有优势，从而产生卓越的产品质量。利用与FDA批准药物相关的专利，作者表明，由于拥有更丰富的知识和技术存量而在创造基础过程创新方面具有比较优势的企业，往往能生产出价值更高的产品。
ai_comment: 该论文通过区分基础过程创新与成本降低过程创新，揭示了过程创新对产品创新和持续增长的关键作用，为理解创新驱动增长提供了新视角。

title: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
abstract: Pandemic fraud is geographically concentrated and stimulated local purchases, with effects on prices. Recipients of fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) funds significantly increased their home purchasing rate compared to recipients of non-fraudulent PPP funds, and house prices in high-fraud ZIP codes increased 5.8 percentage points more than in low-fraud ZIP codes within the same county. In a horse race, pandemic fraud is one of the largest and most robust factors explaining house price appreciation during COVID. ZIP codes with fraud also experienced heightened vehicle purchases and other consumer spending in 2020-21, with a return to normal in 2022.
summary: 该论文研究疫情救济欺诈（Pandemic relief fraud）对房价的影响。作者发现，欺诈行为在地理上集中，并刺激了当地的购房活动，进而推高了房价。具体而言，与接受非欺诈性PPP（Paycheck Protection Program）资金的群体相比，接受欺诈性PPP资金的个人购房率显著提高。在同一县内，高欺诈邮政编码区的房价比低欺诈邮政编码区多上涨5.8个百分点。在多种因素比较中，疫情欺诈是解释COVID-19期间房价上涨的最大且最稳健的因素之一。此外，欺诈邮政编码区在2020-21年期间还经历了车辆购买和其他消费支出的增加，而到2022年这些指标恢复正常。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的欺诈识别数据，揭示了疫情刺激政策的意外副作用，为理解疫情期间房价异常上涨提供了强有力的实证证据。

title: Asset Pricing in a World of Imperfect Foresight
abstract: A key assumption of dynamic asset pricing theory is that agents have perfect foresight: for all future contingencies, they correctly foresee the corresponding equilibrium prices. Is it possible for prices to still reflect perfect foresight even if agents have imperfect foresight? We answer affirmatively, provided agents exhibit a mild form of narrow framing, which we refer to as dynamic narrow framing: while accounting for future endowments, agents ignore retrading opportunities. This behavior vastly simplifies computation of optimal choices because it obviates the need to form beliefs about future prices. Obviously, choices will generally be different, and hence, suboptimal, compared with those that obtain if agents were to optimize dynamically using perfect foresight about future prices. With a controlled experiment, we verify that our behavioral assumption explains both prices and choices. Our findings allow us to reinterpret the successes (when evaluating prices only) and failures (when evaluating prices against choices) of traditional tests of asset pricing theory on historical data from the field. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: P. Bossaerts acknowledges funding from the Australian Research Council [Grant DP180102284], from a R@MAP Chair at the University of Melbourne, and from The Leverhulme Trust. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03690 .
summary: 本文挑战了动态资产定价理论中关于代理人具有完美预见的关键假设，即代理人能正确预见所有未来状态下的均衡价格。研究探讨了即使代理人没有完美预见，价格是否仍能反映完美预见。作者给出了肯定答案，前提是代理人表现出一种温和的窄框定形式，称为动态窄框定：在考虑未来禀赋时，代理人忽略重新交易的机会。这种行为极大地简化了最优选择的计算，因为无需形成对未来价格的信念。然而，与动态优化且完美预见未来价格的情况相比，选择通常不同且次优。通过控制实验，作者验证了该行为假设能够同时解释价格和选择。研究结果重新解释了传统资产定价理论在历史数据上的成功（仅评估价格时）和失败（评估价格与选择对比时）。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入动态窄框定放松完美预见假设，为解释资产定价理论与实际选择的差异提供了新视角。实验设计增强了结论的可靠性。

title: Operational shorting and ETF liquidity provision
abstract: ETF market makers can satisfy excess demand in secondary markets by selling shares that are not yet created. While this ability to “operationally short” is not unique to ETFs, it plays a central role in ETF liquidity provision. We propose and validate a novel “operational shorting” measure. In addition to constituting a majority of ETF short interest, it is associated with higher retail trading activity and short-term return reversals, consistent with liquidity-supplying motives. Accounting for operational shorting is important in examining ETF returns, mispricing, and the asset-pricing implications of ETF trading on underlying securities.
summary: 市场做市商可以通过卖出尚未创建的ETF份额来满足二级市场的过度需求，这种“操作卖空”能力虽非ETF独有，但在ETF流动性提供中扮演核心角色。本文提出并验证了一种新颖的“操作卖空”度量指标。该度量不仅构成ETF空头头寸的大部分，还与更高的散户交易活动和短期回报反转相关，符合流动性提供动机。在考察ETF回报、错误定价以及ETF交易对基础证券的资产定价影响时，考虑操作卖空至关重要。
ai_comment: 论文提出了操作卖空的新度量，揭示了ETF流动性提供机制的关键组成部分，对理解ETF定价和基础证券影响具有重要意义。

title: Frozen-State Value Iteration: Faster Reinforcement Learning by Freezing Slow States
abstract: We study infinite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with fast–slow structure, in which some state variables evolve rapidly (fast states), whereas others change more gradually (slow states). This structure commonly arises in practice when decisions must be made at high frequencies over long horizons and when slowly changing information still plays a critical role in determining optimal actions. Examples include inventory control under slowly changing demand indicators or dynamic pricing with gradually shifting consumer behavior. Modeling the problem at the natural decision frequency leads to MDPs with discount factors close to one, making them computationally challenging. We propose a novel approximation strategy that freezes slow states during phases of lower level planning and subsequently applies value iteration to an auxiliary upper level MDP that evolves on a slower timescale. Freezing states for short periods of time leads to easier to solve lower level problems, whereas a slower upper level timescale allows for a more favorable discount factor. On the theoretical side, we analyze the regret incurred by our frozen-state approach, and this leads to simple insights on how to trade off regret versus computational cost. Empirically, we benchmark our new frozen-state methods on three domains: (i) inventory control with fixed order costs, (ii) a grid world problem with spatial tasks, and (iii) dynamic pricing with reference price effects. We demonstrate that the new methods produce high-quality policies with significantly less computation, and we show that simply omitting slow states is often a poor heuristic. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: This research is based upon work supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation [Grant 1807536]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00012 .
summary: 本文研究具有快慢结构的无限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs），其中某些状态变量快速演化（快状态），而其他状态变化较慢（慢状态）。这种结构常见于需要在高频率下做出长期决策且缓慢变化的信息仍然关键的情境，例如基于缓慢变化的需求指标的库存控制或消费者行为逐渐变化下的动态定价。以自然决策频率建模会导致折扣因子接近1的MDPs，计算上具有挑战性。作者提出一种新颖的近似策略：在较低层级规划阶段冻结慢状态，随后对演化在较慢时间尺度上的辅助高层MDP应用值迭代。短时间冻结状态简化了低层问题，而较慢的高层时间尺度提供了更有利的折扣因子。理论上，分析了冻结状态方法产生的后悔，并给出了如何权衡后悔与计算成本的简单洞见。实证上，在三个领域（具有固定订购成本的库存控制、具有空间任务的网格世界问题、具有参考价格效应的动态定价）测试了新方法，表明新方法能以显著更少的计算量生成高质量策略，并且简单地忽略慢状态往往是一个糟糕的启发式方法。
ai_comment: 本文通过冻结慢状态巧妙地将复杂MDP分解为更易求解的子问题，并提供了理论后悔界，在多个实际领域验证了计算效率与策略质量的优势。

title: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
abstract: Confounding events can cause false positives when testing the relationship between short-term returns around a quasi-experimental event and firm characteristics. We show that this risk is severe in practice — return-characteristic relationships are often statistically significant at the 1% level on over 30% of all trading days. Benchmarking a relationship against the distribution of the same relationship on pre-event days is effective at addressing the problem. We introduce a novel GLS variation of this approach that achieves large gains in statistical power relative to OLS and provide Stata and Python modules that implement both procedures.
summary: 本文研究在准实验事件周围短期收益与公司特征之间关系的检验中，混淆事件可能导致假阳性问题。实证发现，该风险在实践中非常严重——在超过30%的交易日内，收益-特征关系在1%水平上统计显著。为解决此问题，将目标关系与事件前相同关系的分布进行基准测试是有效的方法。作者还提出了一种新的广义最小二乘法（GLS）变体，相比普通最小二乘法（OLS）显著提高了统计功效，并提供了实现这两种方法的Stata和Python模块。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了事件研究中一个被忽视的严重假阳性问题，并提供了实用的解决方案（基于历史分布的基准测试）和高效的改进方法（GLS变体），同时附带了现成的软件模块，对实证金融研究具有重要参考价值。

title: Pricing of Climate Risk Insurance: Regulation and Cross‐Subsidies
abstract: Homeowners insurance is central to managing the rising losses from climate‐related disasters. We show that insurance premiums are subject to starkly different regulations across states, creating persistent cross‐subsidies and price distortions. We employ states' regulatory rules in an instrumental variable estimation and a border discontinuity design to show insurers do not adjust rates in highly regulated states and compensate by raising rates in less regulated states. Rates and risks diverge in the long run, distorting cross‐state risk‐sharing and increasing insurer exits from highly regulated states. We argue these patterns stem from the interactions between rate regulation and insurers' financing constraints.
summary: 本文研究 homeowners insurance 在应对气候相关灾害损失中的定价问题，发现不同州的保险监管规则存在显著差异，导致持续的 cross‐subsidies 和价格扭曲。作者利用各州监管规则作为工具变量，并采用 border discontinuity design，证明保险公司在高度监管的州不会调整费率，而是通过在监管较少的州提高费率来补偿。这种机制使得费率与风险在长期内偏离，扭曲了跨州的风险分担，并增加了保险公司从高度监管州退出的可能性。作者认为这些模式源于费率监管与保险公司融资约束之间的相互作用。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证方法揭示了气候保险定价中监管的意外后果，为理解保险市场效率与稳定性提供了新视角，尤其是将融资约束纳入分析框架。

title: Face-to-face social interactions and local informational advantage
abstract: This paper examines the causal role of face-to-face (F2F) interactions in generating local informational advantages for mutual fund managers. Using COVID-19 lockdowns as an exogenous shock, I show that fund managers’ performance on local stocks declined relative to distant stocks when in-person meetings were curtailed, driven by impaired investment timing rather than changes in firm fundamentals. I investigate two distinct benefits of F2F interactions arising from interpersonal cues: trust-building, which enhances the transmission of soft information, and impression management, which facilitates the transmission of favorable information. The results cannot be fully explained by changes in internal information flows or the use of public information, and are more pronounced for stocks in less transparent information environments and in regions with stronger social traits.
summary: 本文利用COVID-19封锁作为外生冲击，实证检验了面对面(F2F)社交互动在共同基金经理本地信息优势中的因果作用。研究发现，当面对面会议受限时，基金经理在本地股票上的表现相对于远距离股票显著下降，这一下降主要源于投资时机的恶化，而非公司基本面的变化。进一步分析揭示了F2F互动通过两种人际线索产生的益处：信任建立增强了软信息的传递，而印象管理促进了有利信息的传递。这些结果不能完全由内部信息流或公共信息使用的变化所解释，并且在信息透明度较低的环境以及社会特质更强的地区更为显著。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用COVID-19封锁作为准自然实验，为面对面互动产生本地信息优势提供了因果证据，并进一步区分了信任建立与印象管理两种软信息传递机制，是对金融中介信息优势文献的重要贡献。

title: Machine Learning and the Implementable Efficient Frontier
abstract: We propose that investment strategies should be evaluated based on their net-of-trading-cost return for each level of risk, which we term the “implementable efficient frontier.” While numerous studies use machine learning return forecasts to generate portfolios, their agnosticism toward trading costs leads to excessive reliance on fleeting small-scale characteristics, resulting in poor net returns. We develop a framework that produces a superior frontier by integrating trading-cost-aware portfolio optimization with machine learning. The superior net-of-cost performance is achieved by learning directly about portfolio weights using an economic objective. Further, our model gives rise to a new measure of “economic feature importance.”
summary: 本文提出，投资策略应根据每单位风险水平下的净交易成本回报（即“可执行有效前沿”）来评估。当前许多研究利用机器学习收益预测构建投资组合，但由于忽视交易成本，导致过度依赖短暂的小规模特征，净收益不佳。为此，作者开发了一个将交易成本感知的组合优化与机器学习相结合的框架，通过直接使用经济目标学习投资组合权重，从而产生更优的有效前沿。该模型还提出了一种新的“经济特征重要性”度量。
ai_comment: 该论文将交易成本纳入机器学习驱动的投资组合优化，提出了更贴近实际的评估标准，并为特征重要性提供了经济上的解释，具有理论和实践双重贡献。

title: The Need for Absorptive Capacity Alleviates the Free-Rider Problem in Knowledge Production
abstract: Knowledge sharing is central to strategy and organizational learning, yet its effect on knowledge production remains underexplored. When knowledge diffuses too easily, individuals may free ride on others’ costly knowledge production, creating a suboptimal equilibrium in which knowledge sharing persists but the average payoff is no greater than if everyone produced knowledge independently—the so-called Rogers’ paradox. We develop a game-theoretic model to re-examine this puzzle. In our baseline model, we reproduce Rogers’ paradox; frictionless sharing does not increase performance beyond individual knowledge production alone. We then extend the model to incorporate absorptive capacity—the need for prior investment in one’s own knowledge before learning from others. Absorptive capacity discourages pure free riding. Counterintuitively, although it introduces frictions in knowledge sharing, absorptive capacity increases collective knowledge production beyond the level attainable through individual knowledge production alone. This explains why extensive knowledge sharing in domains such as academia does not erode incentives for knowledge production. It also contributes to knowledge-based theories of the firm by showing that although hierarchical control may be crucial in contexts where knowledge is simple and codifiable, it may not be necessary where knowledge is complex and tacit. More broadly, our analysis illustrates how formal modeling can uncover overlooked mechanisms and integrate insights across cultural evolution, organizational learning, and strategy. This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06471 .
summary: 本文通过博弈论模型重新审视知识共享中的免费搭车问题（Rogers悖论）。基线模型复制了Rogers悖论：无摩擦的知识共享并未使平均收益超过独立生产。扩展模型引入吸收能力（即学习他人知识前需先投资自身知识），发现吸收能力抑制了纯粹的免费搭车行为，虽然增加了知识共享的摩擦，却意外地提高了集体知识生产水平，使其超越独立生产。这解释了为何学术界等领域的广泛知识共享不会削弱知识生产激励，并贡献于知识基础企业理论：在知识复杂且隐性时，层级控制可能不是必要的。分析展示了形式化模型如何揭示被忽视的机制，并整合文化演化、组织学习和战略的见解。
ai_comment: 本文用严谨的博弈模型揭示了一个反直觉机制：增加知识共享的摩擦反而能提升集体知识产出，对理解学术共享和知识管理有重要启发。

title: Asset Overhang and Technological Change
abstract: Investors face reduced incentives to finance technological change that devalues their legacy investments. We formalize this “asset overhang” and apply our framework to the climate-banking nexus. Leveraging (1) firm-level data on green innovation and diffusion and (2) the sets of product and technology market peers, we implement a shift-share design that identifies banks’ credit facilities impacted by green firm activities. We find that green firms imposing an asset overhang across all lenders are 3 to 7 percentage points more likely to report tight credit supply conditions. The presence of legacy-free investors mitigates the asset overhang problem, thereby facilitating technological change.
summary: 本文研究了投资者对会贬低其传统投资价值的技术变革融资激励降低的现象，将其形式化为“资产过剩”（asset overhang），并将其应用于气候与银行关系。通过利用企业层面的绿色创新与扩散数据，以及产品和科技市场同行集，作者采用shift-share设计识别受绿色企业活动影响的银行信贷设施。研究发现，对所有贷款人造成资产过剩的绿色企业报告信贷供应紧张的可能性比未造成该效应的企业高出3到7个百分点。此外，无传统投资者（legacy-free investors）的存在缓解了资产过剩问题，从而促进了技术变革。
ai_comment: 本文首次将资产过剩概念系统化并应用于气候金融领域，揭示了银行对绿色创新信贷约束的机制，为理解技术变革中的融资困境提供了新视角。

title: The Hidden Costs of Fairness in Platform Markets: The Dynamics of Lowering Developer Royalty Rates
abstract: Multisided platforms crucially rely on indirect network effects. When trying to strengthen these effects, platform owners face a fundamental challenge, namely, designing incentives to enhance developer effort and simultaneously ensuring the release of high-quality products on the platform. This paper highlights the costs associated with lowering royalty rates to boost developer effort, as such reductions increase the relative supply of lower-quality offerings, worsening information congestion problems and amplifying the importance of visibility-enhancing investments. We leverage the quasi random announcements made by Apple and Google, declaring their intention to reduce the royalty rate applied to small app developers from 30% to 15%. We analyze the implications of these reforms using a difference-in-differences approach, finding a substantial increase in small developers’ likelihood of releasing lower-quality and less original apps on iOS and Android after the announcements. These effects are neither paralleled by a comparable increase in high-quality app releases nor by an increase in small developers’ likelihood of launching venture-backed apps. Consistent with worsening information congestion problems because of an influx of low-quality apps, our findings show an increase in the marginal value of experienced user certifications and developers’ app store optimization efforts post announcement. Additionally, we observe that venture capitalists are increasingly concentrating their investments in ventures with higher (observable) quality. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Education [Project PID2022-138710NB-I00 funded by MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER, UE]. A. Conti acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [Grant 100013_197807]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.0586 .
summary: 本文研究了平台降低开发者版税率（如苹果和谷歌将小型开发者版税率从30%降至15%）的隐藏成本。利用准随机公告，采用双重差分法分析iOS和Android平台上的小型开发者行为，发现降低版税率显著增加了低质量和非原创应用的发布，而高质量应用和风险投资支持的应用并未相应增加。低质量应用涌入加剧了信息拥堵问题，导致经验用户认证和开发者应用商店优化努力的边际价值上升，同时风险投资者更倾向于投资高可观察质量的项目。
ai_comment: 本文通过自然实验揭示了平台激励设计中的非预期后果，强调了降低版税率可能损害平台质量生态，对平台治理具有重要实践启示。

title: Dual peer effects and cross-stock predictability
abstract: This paper introduces a Peer Index (PI) constructed from economically motivated peer networks that summarizes (i) the strength of a firm’s peers and (ii) the firm’s position within its peer group. PI predicts stock returns and earnings surprises over short and long horizons. Machine-learning models based solely on firm-level characteristics do not subsume PI’s predictive power, supporting the interpretation that it captures genuine cross-stock information. Lag-augmented local projections show that positive PI innovations are followed by higher next-month returns that gradually decay without reversal, consistent with slow diffusion of peer information into prices.
summary: 本文构建了一个基于经济动机的同行网络（peer networks）的同行指数（Peer Index, PI），该指数综合衡量了企业同行的强度以及企业在同行群体中的位置。研究发现，PI能够显著预测股票回报和盈利意外，预测期涵盖短期和长期。基于企业层面特征的机器学习模型无法替代PI的预测能力，这支持了PI捕捉了真实的跨股票信息（cross-stock information）的解释。通过滞后增强局部投影（lag-augmented local projections）分析，正向的PI冲击会导致下月回报上升，随后逐渐衰减且不会逆转，这与同行信息缓慢扩散至价格的理论一致。
ai_comment: 该论文构建了一个简洁而有力的同行指数，不仅验证了其预测能力，还通过机器学习对比和动态分析揭示了信息扩散机制，为跨股票预测研究提供了新的视角。

title: Swimming Against the Current: Contrarian Retail Trading
abstract: Retail investor contrarian selling depends on whether a position is at a gain or a loss. Selling propensity increases in daily returns for positions with unrealized gains (contrarian selling) and decreases in returns for loss positions (trend-following selling). This pattern is consistent with behavioral arguments that investors update their beliefs when stock prices move away from their purchase prices. In line with increased liquidity from contrarian selling, illiquid stocks exhibit weaker short-term reversals when investors have higher unrealized capital gains. Our findings diminish following stock splits, suggesting that unrealized capital gains are central to contrarian behavior, particularly when investors perceive them clearly.
summary: 本文研究散户投资者的逆向卖出行为，发现该行为取决于持仓的盈亏状态：当股票处于未实现盈利时，卖出倾向随日收益率上升而增加（逆向卖出）；当处于亏损状态时，卖出倾向随收益率上升而下降（趋势跟随卖出）。这一模式符合行为金融学观点，即投资者在股价偏离买入价时会更新信念。此外，逆向卖出增加了市场流动性，使得在投资者未实现资本利得较高时，流动性较差的股票的短期反转效应减弱。股票拆分后这一效应减弱，表明未实现资本利得是逆向行为的核心因素，尤其是当投资者能清晰感知时。
ai_comment: 该研究细致区分了盈利与亏损状态下的不对称交易行为，为行为金融学中的处置效应提供了新的解释视角，并揭示了其对市场流动性和价格效率的实证影响。

title: Price Impact in Closing Auctions, Opening Auctions, and Continuous Markets: A Benchmark for Cost of Trading on Anomalies
abstract: Closing auctions account for about 10% of daily trading volume and offer a potentially attractive alternative to trading in the continuous market. We find that the price impact is lower in closing auctions than in the continuous market for all stocks except Nasdaq microcaps. Opening auctions are illiquid. We compute trading costs for anomalies based strategies by strategically placing orders in the lower cost mechanism. The annualized trading costs for long/short portfolios based on financial ratios such as profitability and investment range from 17 to 41 basis points (bps). Excluding microcaps, these costs fall to 9–21 bps in closing auctions.
summary: 本文对比了收盘拍卖、开盘拍卖和连续市场的价格冲击，发现收盘拍卖的价格冲击低于连续市场（除纳斯达克微型股），而开盘拍卖流动性较差。基于此，研究通过策略性地在低成本机制中下单，计算了基于盈利和投资等财务比率的异常交易策略的交易成本。结果显示，这些策略的年度化交易成本在17至41个基点之间，若排除微型股，则在收盘拍卖中降至9至21个基点。
ai_comment: 该研究为异常交易策略提供了实际交易成本基准，揭示了收盘拍卖在降低交易成本方面的优势，对量化交易实践有重要参考价值。

title: Beyond Old Boys' Clubs: Financial Analysts' Utilization of Professional Connections
abstract: Women often lack the opportunity to join exclusive social clubs, limiting the benefits they derive from their social networks. We investigate whether, when given the opportunity to interact with the right people in a professional setting, women gain greater advantages from these connections for career performance and advancement compared to men. Using a unique data set that documents when, where, and with whom financial analysts interact at investor conferences, we find that female analysts show greater improvement in earnings forecast accuracy than their male counterparts after interacting with a firm's executives. Further evidence suggests that female analysts overcome homophily in conference interactions with executives and that they sustain their gains, enhancing forecast accuracy for up to three years. In addition, both the capital and labor markets recognize women's superior gains from conference connections. Our findings suggest that women capitalize on professional connections, highlighting the importance of promoting structured networking opportunities for women in professional environments.
summary: 本研究探讨女性在专业社交中是否比男性更能从中获益，以弥补其在排他性社交俱乐部中的劣势。利用独特数据集，记录金融分析师在投资者会议上与公司高管互动的时间、地点和对象，发现女性分析师在与高管互动后，其盈利预测准确性的提升幅度显著大于男性同行。进一步证据表明，女性分析师克服了会议互动中的同质性偏见，并且这种收益具有持续性，预测准确性提升可持续长达三年。此外，资本市场和劳动力市场都认可女性从会议联系中获得的更大收益。研究结果强调，女性善于利用专业社交网络，突显了在职业环境中为女性提供结构化社交机会的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特会议互动数据，揭示了女性在专业社交中比男性获益更多的现象，为理解性别差异在职业网络中的作用提供了新视角，并强调了结构化社交机会的价值。

title: Too Many Managers: The Strategic Use of Titles to Avoid Overtime Payments
abstract: We find widespread evidence that firms avoid overtime payments by strategically assigning “managerial” titles. Exploiting the exemption threshold under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), we find managerial titles increase almost fivefold just above the overtime pay cutoff, including suspect listings, such as “Director of First Impressions” for a role equivalent to “Front-Desk Clerk.” Avoidance is higher when firms have more bargaining power and are financially constrained. It is also more common in occupations with volatile demand and unpredictable worker scheduling. Patterns align with litigation and Department of Labor enforcement. Firms avoid roughly 13.5% in compensation costs, hiring strategic “managers.” (JEL M51, M54, G30, G38)
summary: 本文发现企业通过战略性地赋予员工“管理”头衔来避免支付加班费的普遍证据。利用《公平劳动标准法》（FLSA）规定的加班豁免门槛，研究发现管理头衔的数量在加班费截止点上方几乎增加了五倍，其中包括一些可疑的头衔，例如将等同于“前台文员”的职位称为“第一印象总监”。当企业拥有更大的议价能力或面临财务约束时，这种规避行为更为严重。此外，在需求波动大和工人排班不可预测的职业中更为常见。这些模式与相关诉讼和劳工部的执法行动一致。据估计，企业通过雇佣这些战略性的“经理”来规避约13.5%的薪酬成本。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的识別策略和丰富的数据，揭示了企业利用头衔规避劳动法规的普遍性，对劳动经济学和公司治理领域具有重要贡献。

title: Real Effects of Subjectivity in Measuring Fair Values
abstract: This study examines how the subjectivity in measuring fair values of assets without readily observable market prices affects investment efficiency and shareholder value. When fair values are objective measures of asset value, they facilitate efficient investment decisions that align with shareholder interests. In contrast, firms' reliance on subjective valuation inputs causes underinvestment in long‐term projects. If fair values are highly subjective, they may lead firms to favor less profitable short‐term projects with objectively measurable fair values. When project returns are positively correlated, subjectivity in valuing long‐term projects induces overinvestment in short‐term projects with objective fair values. Regardless of these distortions, fair value measurement can add shareholder value. Not measuring fair values altogether leads to underinvestment, which moderately subjective fair values can alleviate.
summary: 本研究考察了资产公允价值计量中主观性（当资产缺乏可观察市场价格的公允值）如何影响投资效率和股东价值。当公允价值是资产价值的客观计量时，它们促进与股东利益一致的高效投资决策。相反，企业依赖主观估值输入会导致对长期项目投资不足。如果公允价值高度主观，可能使企业偏向于选择公允价值可客观计量的、利润较低的短期项目。当项目回报正相关时，对长期项目估值的主观性会引发对具有客观公允价值的短期项目过度投资。尽管存在这些扭曲，公允价值计量仍能增加股东价值。完全不计量公允价值会导致投资不足，而适度主观的公允价值可以缓解这一问题。
ai_comment: 本文深入分析了公允价值主观性导致的企业投资扭曲，并指出适度主观性可能具有积极效果，为会计准则制定提供了有价值的理论依据。

title: Planning under Diagnostic Uncertainty: Question-Driven Learning in the Age of AI
abstract: Many important economic decisions depend not only on acquiring information, but on determining which questions are worth asking before committing to an action.Individuals and organizations must organize inquiry: they select questions, interpret answers, and update beliefs in ways that determine whether decisive distinctions are identified or missed.Despite its importance, the organization of inquiry is largely absent from formal economic analysis.This paper studies decision-making under \emph{diagnostic uncertainty}, in which agents must learn not only about payoff-relevant states, but about which questions are informative.We develop a model in which agents choose questions sequentially prior to commitment, while facing uncertainty over a latent diagnostic structure that governs how questions generate answers.Before each inquiry step, agents may incur cognitive cost to refine beliefs about this diagnostic structure.The resulting problem is a finite-horizon dynamic program over inquiry, in which costly attention is allocated to belief transformations over diagnostic structure rather than directly to payoff-relevant states.Two canonical diagnostic geometries isolate distinct planning margins.In one, value depends on locating a decisive question; in the other, on maintaining a correct sequence of questions.Both environments admit closed-form solutions and yield a common representation in which optimal inquiry increases the probability of success relative to uninformed search.The framework identifies a distinct margin of economic behavior-planning under diagnostic uncertainty-that becomes increasingly important in environments where answers are abundant but the organization of inquiry remains scarce.
summary: 本文研究诊断不确定性下的决策问题，其中决策者不仅需要获取支付相关信息，还需确定哪些问题值得询问。构建了一个模型，代理在承诺行动前顺序选择问题，同时面临关于潜在诊断结构（决定问题如何产生答案）的不确定性。每次查询前，代理可付出认知成本来优化对诊断结构的信念。问题被形式化为有限视野的动态规划，其中注意力分配于诊断结构的信念转换而非直接支付相关状态。两种典型诊断几何识别出不同的规划边际：一种价值在于定位关键问题，另一种在于维持正确的问题序列。两种环境均得到封闭解，并揭示一个共同特征：最优查询相对于无信息搜索提高了成功概率。该框架识别了一种经济行为的独特边际——诊断不确定性下的规划，这在答案丰富但查询组织稀缺的环境中日益重要。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地将'组织查询'引入经济分析，通过诊断不确定性框架揭示了决策者在信息丰富但结构未知环境中的规划行为，填补了传统信息获取理论的空白。

title: Adaptive Enforcement with AI-Augmented Monitoring
abstract: We study a novel dynamic inspection game in which a regulator commits to a detection technology, and a regulated firm chooses whether to engage in harmful conduct and, if detected and sanctioned, whether to incur a redesign cost that generates a modified violation requiring renewed detection.In this adaptive environment, bounded sanctions give rise to three Markov perfect equilibria: full compliance, harm until recognition, and persistent redesign.We show that AI-augmented monitoring can shift the equilibrium from persistent redesign to harm until recognition, but only when regulatory investment crosses a regime-shifting threshold.Below this threshold, greater monitoring intensity may increase enforcement workload without reducing aggregate harm, as the regulator repeatedly detects adaptive violations while the firm continues to redesign.Thus, partial investments in AI monitoring can generate congestion rather than deterrence.When the firm can also adopt AI to reduce its redesign cost, the regulator's deterrence threshold rises, reinforcing the strategic interaction between enforcement and evasion technologies.Moreover, congestion becomes particularly salient when AI-flagged violations require human review and regulatory review capacity is binding.In this case, the precision of AI triage-especially its false positive rate -matters as much as detection intensity.Enforcement effectiveness therefore depends not only on expanding detection, but also on allocating scarce human review resources efficiently.
summary: 本文研究一个新颖的动态检查博弈，其中监管者承诺采用一种检测技术，受监管企业则选择是否从事有害行为，如果被发现并受到制裁，是否承担重新设计的成本以产生需要再次检测的修改后违规行为。在这种适应性环境中，有限制裁导致三个马尔可夫完美均衡：完全合规、伤害持续到被识别、持续重新设计。研究表明，AI增强监控可以将均衡从持续重新设计转变为伤害持续到被识别，但只有当监管投资跨越一个体制转变阈值时才成立。低于该阈值时，更强的监控强度可能增加执法工作量而不减少总伤害，因为监管者反复检测适应性违规而企业持续重新设计。因此，对AI监控的部分投资可能产生拥堵而非威慑。当企业也能采用AI来降低重新设计成本时，监管者的威慑阈值上升，强化了执法与逃避技术之间的战略互动。此外，当AI标记的违规行为需要人工审查且监管审查能力有限时，拥堵变得尤为突出。在这种情况下，AI分诊的精度——特别是其误报率——与检测强度同等重要。因此，执法有效性不仅依赖于扩大检测，还依赖于有效分配稀缺的人工审查资源。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了AI监控可能产生拥堵而非威慑这一反直觉结果，并强调了在人力审查资源有限时，AI分诊精度（尤其是误报率）对执法有效性的关键作用，对政策制定具有重要启示。

title: The Hidden Cost of Stock Market Concentration: When Funds Hit Regulatory Limits
abstract: As stock market concentration has risen, regulatory limits on fund portfolio concentration have become increasingly binding, especially for large-cap growth funds. When funds approach these limits, they trim their largest holdings and reduce equity exposure. Funds perform worse when constrained. A constraint-based ownership measure predicts stock returns, particularly among the largest firms. These findings suggest that high market concentration can distort stock prices by limiting the ability of optimistic investors to scale their positions. Just like short-sale constraints can produce overpricing by limiting pessimistic investors' views, constraints on long positions can generate underpricing by suppressing optimists' views.Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
summary: 随着股市集中度的上升，基金投资组合集中度的监管限制变得越来越具有约束性，尤其是对于大市值成长型基金。当基金接近这些限制时，它们会减持其最大持仓并降低股票敞口。受约束的基金表现更差。一种基于约束的所有权衡量指标可以预测股票回报，尤其是在最大的公司中。这些发现表明，高市场集中度可以通过限制乐观投资者扩大头寸的能力来扭曲股票价格，类似于卖空限制通过限制悲观投资者的观点产生高估，多头头寸限制通过抑制乐观投资者的观点产生低估。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了监管限制在股市集中度上升时对基金行为和股票定价的影响，类似于卖空限制的对称作用，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Using Global Shocks to Understand the Level and Structure of Executive Compensation
abstract: We build a model of CEO compensation that unites principal-agent and assignment models in the face of trade shocks that interact with CEO effort.The model predicts that trade shocks change CEO compensation through scale, volatility, and ability-magnification channels.Using Danish matched worker-firm data, we find empirical support for these channels: (1) Exogenous shocks to trade increase the size and value of the firm and CEO compensation; (2) the share of firm value paid to the CEO is increasing in the size and value of the firm and increasing in the volatility induced by global shocks;(3) Higher-ability CEOs generate increases in firm value that are more than 100 times greater than their compensation, through a combination of mitigating losses and maximizing the return to positive shocks.
summary: 本文构建了一个CEO薪酬模型，该模型统一了委托代理模型和分配模型，并考虑了贸易冲击与CEO努力的相互作用。模型预测贸易冲击通过规模、波动性和能力放大三个渠道改变CEO薪酬。利用丹麦匹配的雇主-员工数据，实证支持了这些渠道：（1）外生贸易冲击增加了公司规模和价值以及CEO薪酬；（2）支付给CEO的公司价值份额随公司规模和价值以及全球冲击引起的波动性增加而增加；（3）高能力CEO通过减轻损失和最大化正向冲击回报的组合，使公司价值增长超过其薪酬的100倍。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将贸易冲击引入CEO薪酬决定模型，揭示了全球因素对高管薪酬的影响机制，并通过微观数据提供了有力的实证证据。

title: Mind the Gap: AI Adoption in Europe and the U.S.
Private Credit, Balance Sheets and Financial Stability
abstract: We document new evidence on the capitalization, funding structure, and performance of private credit funds using comprehensive fund-and asset-level data covering most of the industry.Private credit funds are highly capitalized, with equity typically accounting for 65-80% of total assetsmore than six times the capitalization of U.S. banks, where equity represents about 10%.Debt usage is moderate and largely reflects bank credit lines used for liquidity management.Fund lives average 10-12 years, while underlying loan maturities are generally shorter, implying little or no maturity mismatch-unlike banks, which fund long-term assets with short-term callable deposits.Private credit portfolios are diversified across industries, geographies, and credit strategies, reducing exposure to correlated shocks.Performance data show positive average net annualized returns with limited downside risk to creditors, as losses are largely borne by equity investors.Overall, private credit funds appear conservatively structured and unlikely to pose systemic risks comparable to traditional banks under their current balance-sheet configurations.We conclude by discussing potential vulnerabilities that could emerge as the sector grows, including governance and disclosure frictions, stress-period dynamics, bank-nonbank linkages, and the transmission of losses through limited partner balance sheets and retail investment vehicles.
summary: 本文利用覆盖行业大部分的全面基金和资产层面数据，提供了关于私人信贷基金资本化、融资结构和绩效的新证据。研究发现，私人信贷基金资本化程度高，股权通常占总资产的65-80%，是美国银行资本化率的六倍以上（银行股权约占10%）。债务使用适度，主要体现为用于流动性管理的银行信贷额度。基金平均期限为10-12年，而贷款期限通常较短，意味着几乎没有期限错配——这与依靠短期可赎回存款为长期资产融资的银行不同。私人信贷组合在行业、地域和信贷策略上多元化，降低了相关冲击的风险。绩效数据显示平均净年化回报为正，且对债权人而言下行风险有限，因为损失主要由股权投资者承担。总体而言，私人信贷基金在现有资产负债表结构下显得保守，不太可能对传统银行构成系统性风险。最后，本文讨论了随着该行业增长可能出现的潜在脆弱性，包括治理和披露摩擦、压力时期动态、银行与非银行联系，以及通过有限合伙人资产负债表和零售投资工具传导损失的风险。
ai_comment: 本文提供了对私人信贷基金稳健财务结构的系统性证据，对评估非银行中介的系统性风险具有重要政策含义。

title: Contract Enforcement and Young Firm Capital Structure: A Global Perspective
abstract: We develop a framework to measure the severity of financial constraints for young firms across countries.Using ORBIS balance-sheet data for 23 economies, we show that short-term leverage rises while long-term leverage falls early in firms' life cycles, with this pattern persisting longer where contract enforcement is weaker.We build a model of optimal financing under limited enforcement with endogenous debt maturity and blueprint capacity that matches these patterns and enables structural measurement of financial constraints.The framework decomposes the funding gap into within-firm borrowing constraints that ease with repayment history and a scale distortion identifiable through cross-country comparisons.
summary: 本文构建了一个框架来测量不同国家年轻公司面临的金融约束严重程度。利用23个经济体的ORBIS资产负债表数据，研究发现公司生命周期早期短期杠杆上升而长期杠杆下降，且这种模式在合约执行较弱的经济体中持续更久。作者建立了一个在有限执行约束下具有内生债务期限和蓝图能力的最优融资模型，该模型能够匹配这些模式，并实现金融约束的结构性测量。该框架将资金缺口分解为随还款历史缓解的企业内借贷约束，以及可通过跨国比较识别的规模扭曲。
ai_comment: 利用跨国数据与结构模型，揭示了合约执行环境对年轻公司资本结构动态的深远影响，为测量金融约束提供了新方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and the Workforce: Evidence from Corporate Executives
abstract: We use novel data from a survey of nearly 750 corporate executives to study the effects of artificial intelligence (AI) on productivity and the workforce.We document substantial heterogeneity in AI adoption across firms, with more than half having already invested, though many smaller firms are only beginning to do so.Labor productivity gains are positive, vary across sectors, and are expected to strengthen in 2026, with the largest effects concentrated in high-skill services and finance.These gains are not primarily driven by firms' capital deepening but instead reflect increases in revenuebased total factor productivity, closely associated with innovation-and demand-oriented channels.We document a productivity paradox, in which perceived productivity gains are larger than measured productivity gains, likely reflecting a delay in revenue realizations.In labor markets, we find little evidence of near-term aggregate employment declines due to AI, though larger companies anticipate AI-driven workforce reductions, while smaller firms expect modest gains.We also find evidence of compositional reallocation of labor both within and across firms, with routine clerical roles declining and a relative demand for skilled technical roles increasing.We develop an index that ranks job functions most negatively affected by AI.
summary: 本文利用一项针对近750名企业高管的调查数据，研究人工智能（AI）对生产率和劳动力的影响。研究发现，不同企业在AI采用上存在显著异质性，超过一半的企业已进行投资，但许多小企业才刚刚开始。劳动生产率提升为正，但各行业差异明显，预计2026年将进一步增强，其中高技能服务业和金融业的效果最大。生产率提升并非主要由企业资本深化驱动，而是反映了基于收入的全要素生产率增长，与创新和需求导向渠道密切相关。研究还发现了一种生产率悖论：感知的生产率提升大于实际测量的提升，这很可能反映了收入实现的延迟。在劳动力市场方面，短期内几乎没有证据表明AI会导致总体就业下降，但大公司预期会因AI而裁员，而小公司则预期适度增长。此外，存在劳动力在企业和内部的重新分配，常规文职岗位减少，而技术技能岗位的需求相对增加。研究开发了一个指数，用以评估受AI负面影响最大的职位功能。
ai_comment: 本文通过高管调查数据揭示了AI影响中的生产率悖论和劳动力重新分配特征，为理解AI的经济效应提供了微观层面的新颖证据。

title: Financial Conditions Targeting in a Multi-Asset Open Economy
abstract: We analyze monetary policy responses to noisy financial conditions in an open economy where exchange rates and domestic asset prices affect aggregate demand.Noise traders operate in both markets, and specialized arbitrageurs have limited risk-bearing capacity.Monetary policy creates cross-market spillovers: by adjusting the interest rate to stabilize one market, the central bank influences volatility in the other.We show that targeting a financial conditions index (FCI)-a weighted average of exchange rates and domestic asset prices-delivers substantial macroeconomic benefits.FCI targeting commits the central bank to respond to unexpected movements in financial conditions beyond what discretionary monetary policy implies.These stronger responses improve diversification across markets: each market becomes more exposed to external shocks but less exposed to its own.This reduces volatility in both markets and activates the recruitment effect from Caballero et al. ( 2025b) in each market-lower variance induces arbitrageurs to trade against noise, further dampening volatility.Foreign exchange (FX) targeting can also be effective when the exchange rate is the primary source of noise, with benefits that increase as the economy becomes more open.In this case, FX targeting recruits arbitrageurs to stabilize the FX market, reducing volatility and dampening the macroeconomic impact of noise.However, FX targeting also raises volatility in non-targeted markets through anti-recruitment effects, limiting its effectiveness relative to FCI targeting, especially when domestic asset markets also matter for financial conditions and are comparably noisy.
summary: 本文分析了开放经济中货币政策如何应对包含噪声的金融状况，其中汇率和国内资产价格共同影响总需求。模型假设噪声交易者存在于汇率和资产市场，而专业套利者风险承受能力有限，且货币政策通过调整利率产生跨市场溢出效应。研究发现，盯住金融状况指数（FCI）——即汇率和国内资产价格的加权平均——能带来显著的宏观经济收益。FCI盯住使央行承诺对金融状况的意外变动采取比自由裁量货币政策更强的反应，从而改善跨市场多样化：每个市场对外部冲击更敏感，但对自身冲击更不敏感，进而降低两个市场的波动性，并激活每个市场中的招募效应（来自Caballero et al. 2025b）——更低的方差促使套利者反向交易以抑制噪声，进一步降低波动。当汇率是噪声主要来源时，盯住外汇（FX）也有效，且收益随经济开放度增加而增大，此时FX盯住通过招募套利者稳定外汇市场，减少波动并削弱噪声的宏观经济影响。然而，FX盯住会通过反招募效应提高非盯住市场的波动性，当国内资产市场同样影响金融状况且噪声水平相当时，其效果弱于FCI盯住。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入跨市场溢出和招募效应，系统比较了FCI盯住与汇率盯住的优劣，为央行在多重资产噪声下的最优政策规则提供了理论依据。

title: The max EPS Paradigm for Corporate Finance
abstract: There are three classic problems in corporate finance: capital structure, real investment, and payout policy. In three companion papers, we characterize the max EPS solution to each one. The max EPS approach delivers an optimal leverage ratio even in the absence of frictions, an investment rule based on comparing yields rather than using a risk-adjusted discount rate, and a payout policy where accretive buybacks are preferred to neutral dividends. Our max EPS model draws a bright line between growth and value. Growth stocks have earnings yields below the riskfree rate; value stocks have earnings yields above it. This single comparison leads the two kinds of firms to pursue different constellations of EPS-maximizing policies. The model also produces easy-to-follow calculations that closely mirror what practitioners actually do. This review article ties together these results to form a new max EPS paradigm for corporate-finance research.Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
summary: 这篇论文提出了一个用于公司金融研究的max EPS（最大化每股收益）新范式，以解决资本结构、实际投资和派息政策这三个经典问题。在无摩擦条件下，max EPS方法给出了最优杠杆率，其投资规则基于比较收益率而非使用风险调整贴现率，派息政策中增值性回购优于中性股息。该模型明确了增长型与价值型股票的区别：增长型股票的收益率低于无风险利率，而价值型股票的收益率高于无风险利率，这一简单比较引导两类公司采取不同的最大化每股收益策略组合。模型还提供了易于操作的计算方法，与从业者实践高度吻合。这篇综述文章将这些结果整合，形成了公司金融研究的新范式。
ai_comment: 该论文提出的max EPS范式简洁且贴近实践，为理解公司金融经典问题提供了新视角，尤其强调了增长与价值股的策略差异。

title: Life Cycle Portfolio Choice with Human Capital and Social Security
abstract: Target date funds -which initially invest a large share of retirement savings in stocks and shift gradually towards bonds over the life cycle -are designed to provide a "one stop shop" for retirement investing.The rationale for this pattern is that human capital, which is highest at the start of a worker's career, is "bond-like."Thus, utility is maximized when financial wealth is initially invested primarily in stocks, with the investment mix shifting towards bonds as the present value of future labor income declines.We revisit this logic in a dynamic model in which shocks to labor income are correlated with the stock market, and in which Social Security replaces a higher share of income for lower-income individuals.In line with empirical evidence, lower-income individuals in the model experience a higher degree of correlation between labor earnings growth and stock returns.We find that utility-maximizing retirement portfolios can vary greatly across individuals, deviating substantially from the pattern of a target date fund for lower-income individuals.
