title: Investment Functions with q in the Presence of Unobserved Persistent Shocks
abstract: We study the classical relationship between a firm’s investment and q , for which an unobserved persistent shock is an important factor in the investment decision. In our setting, besides the potential measurement problem of q , controlling for the unobserved shock becomes a new challenge. We develop an estimation method that addresses both econometric issues given timing and information set assumptions. Using 16,256 unique public firms in the United States from 1975 to 2021, we find that q remains a significant factor of investment even after controlling for the unobserved shock and measurement error.
summary: 该论文研究了企业投资与托宾q之间的经典关系，其中未观测到的持久冲击是投资决策的重要因素。除了q的潜在测量误差问题外，控制未观测冲击也成为新的挑战。基于时间点和信息集假设，作者开发了一种能够同时处理这两个计量问题的估计方法。利用1975年至2021年间16256家美国上市公司数据，发现即使在控制未观测持久冲击和测量误差后，q仍然是投资的显著解释变量。
ai_comment: 本文提出了一种处理未观测持久冲击和测量误差的联合估计方法，为投资-q关系研究提供了更稳健的实证证据。

title: Expectations Matter: When (Not) to Use Machine Learning Earnings Forecasts
abstract: We comprehensively examine the usefulness of machine learning technology to predict a firm’s earnings and offer three main findings. First, although prior literature suggests machine learning can offer better earnings forecasts than analysts, we show that this result is highly sensitive to machine learning model specification choices (i.e., 80% of evaluated machine forecasts fail to beat analysts). Second, we examine why the most accurate machine learning forecast consistently beats analysts, finding that they correct for predictable analyst biases that are both linear and nonlinear and largely relate to analysts’ prior forecast errors, forecasted earnings levels, and the firm’s stock price. Finally, we find that investors’ earnings expectations, as revealed through stock prices, largely—but do not fully—correct for these predictable analyst biases, with delayed price realization up to nine months. In additional analysis, we find that optimal machine learning specification choices remain stable over time and that, although the machine’s outperformance narrows in recent periods, it remains substantial among small-cap stocks. Overall, our study moves beyond the question of whether machine forecasts are superior to human forecasts and instead focuses on which machine forecast specifications matter, as well as when and why machine forecasts are most superior. In so doing, we provide code and estimates for the most accurate machine forecast specification and demonstrate that investors’ expectations appear to largely (but not fully) align with them. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05808 .
summary: 本文全面考察了机器学习技术预测企业盈余的实用性，并提供了三个主要发现。首先，尽管先前文献表明机器学习能提供优于分析师的盈余预测，但本研究显示这一结果对机器学习模型的规范选择高度敏感，即80%的评估机器学习预测未能超越分析师。其次，研究分析了最准确的机器学习预测为何始终优于分析师，发现它们纠正了可预测的分析师偏差，这些偏差既有线性也有非线性，且主要与分析师的先前预测误差、预测盈余水平以及公司股价相关。最后，研究发现投资者通过股价反映的盈余预期在很大程度上（但非完全）纠正了这些可预测的分析师偏差，价格实现延迟长达九个月。进一步分析表明，最优的机器学习规范选择随时间保持稳定，尽管机器在近期的表现优势有所缩小，但在小盘股中仍保持显著。总体而言，本研究超越了机器预测是否优于人类预测的问题，而是聚焦于哪些机器预测规范重要，以及机器预测在何时、为何最具有优势。为此，本文提供了最准确机器学习预测规范的代码和估计，并证明投资者的预期似乎在很大程度上（但非完全）与之趋同。
ai_comment: 本文严谨地揭示了机器学习在盈余预测中的适用条件，强调了模型规范的关键作用，为实际应用提供了具体指南。

title: Tail-Driven Nonparametric Estimation for State Price Densities
abstract: This paper proposes and implements a novel nonparametric method for estimating the state price density (SPD) over the entire state space, including the tails. This SPD estimator achieves shape consistency properties in theory, particularly at the tails. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of our method. In particular, our estimator accurately captures the risk-neutral tail distribution, which is often underestimated by existing alternative methods. In an empirical analysis based on Standard and Poor’s 500 options data, we evaluate the out-of-sample performance of our SPD estimation method and demonstrate that the estimates can serve as effective indicators for market conditions and exhibit predictive power for asset returns. Combining these perspectives, we suggest that our SPD estimator renders a valuable tool for risk management and asset pricing. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: The research of C. The research of X. The research of Y. Wan was supported by the School of Management Science and Engineering and the Coordinated Innovation Center for Computable Modeling in Management Science at Tianjin University of Finance and Economics as well as the Tianjin Municipal Education Commission [Grant 2022SK188]. summary: 本文提出并实现了一种新的非参数方法来估计整个状态空间（包括尾部）的状态价格密度（SPD）。该SPD估计量在理论上具有形状一致性，特别是在尾部。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了该方法的准确性和稳健性，尤其能够准确捕捉风险中性尾部分布，而现有替代方法往往低估这一点。基于标普500期权数据的实证分析评估了该SPD估计方法的样本外表现，并表明估计值可作为市场状况的有效指标，同时对资产收益具有预测能力。综合来看，该SPD估计量为风险管理和资产定价提供了有价值的工具。
ai_comment: 该方法在尾部估计上优于传统方法，理论一致性与实证预测能力相结合，为风险管理和资产定价提供了新工具。

title: Financial Climate‐Risk Measurement, Impact Funds, and Green Transitions
abstract: Regulators are contemplating or mandating precise measurement of financial climate‐risk exposure to promote sustainable investments. We show that such mandates can be counterproductive in the presence of social funds that catalyze change by subsidizing the adoption of cleaner production technologies. Firms can exploit a social fund's impact motive by measuring their climate‐risk exposure imprecisely. This strategic imprecision prevents the fund from distinguishing between firms that require subsidies and those that would switch to clean technologies for financial reasons alone, thereby increasing the ex ante subsidies firms can extract. A by‐product of this rent‐seeking behavior is that firms adopt clean technologies more frequently than would be jointly efficient under precise measurement. Our analysis suggests that the regulatory push for precise climate‐risk measurement can reduce social funds' impact and the frequency of green transitions.
summary: 本研究探讨了监管机构强制要求精确测量金融气候风险暴露对可持续投资的影响。研究发现，在存在通过补贴清洁生产技术来催化变革的社会基金（impact funds）的情况下，这种精确测量可能适得其反。企业可以通过策略性地不精确测量自身的气候风险暴露，利用社会基金的影响动机，从而提取更高的预期补贴。这种行为导致企业采用清洁技术的频率高于在精确测量下的联合效率水平。分析表明，监管推动的精确气候风险测量可能降低社会基金的影响力，并减少绿色转型的发生频率。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了精确测量可能扭曲激励的机制，挑战了传统监管直觉，对可持续金融政策设计具有重要警示意义。

title: Does General Solicitation Improve Access to Equity Capital for Small Businesses? Evidence from the JOBS Act
abstract: Under Title II of the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act, firms can sell private placement securities to the public via general solicitation (GS) or privately (non-GS). We find that equity offerings under GS tend to be riskier than under non-GS. After accounting for selection, GS issuers are less likely to succeed in i) raising capital, ii) getting venture capital (VC) funding, and iii) exiting via IPO or mergers and acquisitions, and incur substantial brokerage costs for advertising and verifying investor accreditation. However, GS appears to help new entrants and offerings that use registered brokers. The success of Form D financing improves future VC financing and exit outcomes.
summary: 本文研究美国《创业企业融资法案》(JOBS Act)第二章下，企业通过普通招股（GS）或私下（non-GS）销售私募证券的影响。基于Form D数据，发现GS发行的股权往往比非GS发行风险更高。在选择校正后，GS发行人在成功筹集资本、获得风险投资（VC）以及通过IPO或并购退出的可能性上均低于非GS发行人，同时需承担大量广告和验证投资者资质的经纪成本。然而，GS似乎有助于新进入者和使用注册经纪人的发行。此外，Form D融资的成功能改善未来的VC融资和退出结果。
ai_comment: 论文利用准自然实验揭示了普通招股对小型企业融资的双刃剑效应，为监管政策提供了实证依据，尤其关注了其对新进入者和经纪中介的积极作用。

title: Forecasting Earnings from Home
abstract: We examine the impact of working from home (WFH) practices on the financial services industry, focusing on sell-side equity analysts. We find that analysts who previously benefited from access to in-person interactions with other informed parties experience a greater decline in earnings forecast accuracy following the COVID lockdown and the shift to WFH. Notably, the informational advantage associated with the in-person access disappears during the lockdown and returns once restrictions are lifted. Our results are stronger for all-star analysts and analysts with shorter coverage periods, suggesting that all-star analysts rely relatively more on access to in-person interactions prelockdown and that accumulated firm-specific knowledge mitigates the loss of in-person interactions. Our results remain robust across alternative analyst performance measures. We conclude that, despite recent advances in communications technology, AI, and machine learning, in-person interactions remain a unique and difficult to substitute information channel for sell-side research providers and that WFH impedes information flows between market participants in capital markets. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04637 .
summary: 研究发现，居家办公（WFH）对金融服务业中的卖方股票分析师产生影响。在新冠疫情封锁和转向居家办公后，之前受益于与其他知情方面对面交流的分析师的盈利预测准确性下降更多。面对面交流带来的信息优势在封锁期间消失，限制解除后恢复。对于明星分析师和覆盖时间较短的分析师，这种效应更强，说明明星分析师在封锁前更依赖面对面交流，而积累的公司特定知识可以减轻面对面交流的损失。结果对于其他分析师绩效指标稳健。结论是，尽管通信技术、AI和机器学习取得进展，面对面交流仍然是卖方研究提供者独特且难以替代的信息渠道，居家办公阻碍了资本市场参与者之间的信息流。
ai_comment: 本文利用新冠疫情自然实验，实证检验了面对面交流在高技能金融工作中的不可替代性，对远程办公政策与信息效率有重要启示。

title: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde: Feedback and Welfare When Hedgers Can Acquire Information
abstract: I ask whether hedgers who speculate should be regulated differently from other speculators in a model where information acquisition is endogenous, and information has real effects. Hedging benefits and feedback effects generate strategic complementarities between market-maker, firm manager, and trader, which causes multiple equilibria. Gains from trade are lower when hedgers acquire information, while speculators may produce less information than socially desirable. A “Volcker rule” separating hedging and speculative activities may help select the higher welfare equilibrium. When too little information is produced, contracts whereby a firm subsidizes losses of designated market-makers (DMM) to make prices more informative increase welfare.
summary: 本文在一个信息获取内生化且信息具有真实效应的模型中，研究了对冲者投机是否应受到与其他投机者不同的监管。对冲收益和反馈效应在市场做市商、公司经理和交易者之间产生战略互补性，导致多重均衡。当对冲者获取信息时，交易收益降低，而投机者可能产生低于社会最优的信息量。实施分离对冲与投机活动的“沃尔克规则”可能有助于选择福利更高的均衡。当信息生产不足时，公司补贴指定做市商（DMM）损失的合同可以提高价格信息含量并增加福利。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将对冲者的信息获取行为与金融市场福利联系起来，为“沃尔克规则”提供了新的理论支持，并提出了公司补贴做市商这一创新机制来改善市场信息效率。

title: A Shared Interest: Do Bonds Strengthen Equity Monitoring?
abstract: Institutional investors conduct more governance research and are less likely to follow proxy advisor vote recommendations when a company’s bonds comprise a larger share of their assets. These findings are driven by bond holdings, shareholder proposals, and companies where fixed-income managers are more likely to be attentive and share an interest with equity investors in improving governance. The findings do not concentrate on companies or shareholder proposals where creditor–shareholder conflicts are likely. Overall, the findings suggest that corporate bond holdings influence how actively institutions monitor their equity positions and contribute to institutions’ overall incentive to be engaged stewards.
summary: 本文研究了机构投资者持有公司债券对其股权监控行为的影响。当机构投资者资产中公司债券占比更大时，他们会进行更多的治理研究，且更少遵循代理顾问的投票建议。这一现象主要由债券持有、股东提案以及在那些固定收益经理更可能关注并与股权投资者在改善治理方面有共同利益的公司中驱动。结果并不集中在可能存在债权人-股东冲突的公司或股东提案上。总体而言，公司债券持有影响了机构投资者监控其股权头寸的积极性，并增强了机构成为积极参与管理者的整体激励。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将债券持有与股权监控联系起来，揭示了机构投资者在不同资产类别间的协同治理行为，丰富了公司治理与投资者行为的研究视角。

title: Matchmaking Strategies for Maximizing Player Engagement in Video Games
abstract: Managing player engagement is vital to the online gaming industry, given that many games generate revenue through subscription models and microtransactions. We scrutinize engagement management in the prevalent category of competitive video games, where players are frequently matched against one another, and matchmaking systems substantially impact engagement. We propose a dynamic model to analyze player dynamics and optimize matchmaking policies for maximum engagement. Our model takes into account two essential factors in competitive games: heterogeneous skill levels and players’ aversion to losing. Additionally, the model enables us to consider pay-to-win strategies and AI-powered bots, which are contentious methods of influencing player engagement and endogenously affect the optimal matchmaking policy. To provide sharp insights, we analyze a specific case where there are two skill levels, and players churn only after experiencing a losing streak. The optimal matchmaking policy considers both short-term rewards by matching players myopically and long-term rewards by adjusting skill distribution. The pay-to-win system can positively impact player engagement when the majority of players are low-skilled, because adopting pay-to-win also affects skill distribution. This result challenges the conventional wisdom that typically regards pay-to-win as trading player experience for revenue. When incorporating AI-powered bots, we demonstrate that optimizing the matchmaking policy can significantly reduce the number of required bots. We then extend our model and conduct a case study with real data from an online chess platform. The optimal policy can improve engagement by 4%–6% or reduce the percentage of bots by 3% in comparison with skill-based matchmaking. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Funding: A. N. Elmachtoub is partially supported by NSF [Grant CMMI-1944428]. X. Lei is partially supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Early Career Scheme 27503123]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02957 .
summary: 该论文研究在线竞技游戏中最大化玩家参与度的匹配策略。作者构建了一个动态模型，考虑了玩家异质性技能水平和失败厌恶两个关键因素，并纳入付费获胜（pay-to-win）策略和AI机器人等有争议手段。在简化模型（两技能等级、连败后流失）中，最优匹配策略需平衡短期匹配收益与长期技能分布调整。研究发现，当低技能玩家占多数时，付费获胜能通过改变技能分布正面影响参与度，挑战了其仅牺牲玩家体验换收入的传统观点。引入AI机器人时，优化匹配策略可大幅减少所需机器人数量。基于在线国际象棋平台真实数据的案例研究表明，与技能匹配相比，最优策略可将参与度提升4%-6%，或将机器人比例降低3%。
ai_comment: 论文通过动态模型重新审视了付费获胜和AI机器人对玩家参与度的影响，为游戏运营提供了反直觉的洞见，且基于真实数据验证了有效性。

title: Competition Enforcement and Accounting for Intangible Capital
abstract: Antitrust laws mandate review of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) that exceed an asset size threshold based on accounting standards that exclude most intangible capital. We show that this exclusion leads to thousands of intangible‐intensive M&As being nonreportable. Acquirers in nonreportable deals achieve higher equity values and price markups, especially when consolidating product markets. Furthermore, nonreportable pharmaceutical deals are three times more likely to involve overlapping drug projects, which are subsequently 40% more likely to be terminated. Our results suggest that the growth of intangible assets may exacerbate market power through nonreportable consolidation of the sectors most concerning for consumers.
summary: 本文研究了反垄断执法中基于会计准则的资产规模门槛对并购审查的影响。由于会计准则排除了大部分无形资本，导致数千起无形密集型并购交易无需报告。研究发现，这些不可报告的并购交易中，收购方实现了更高的股权价值和价格加成，尤其是在产品市场整合的情况下。在制药行业，不可报告的交易涉及重叠药物项目的可能性是其他交易的三倍，而这些项目后续被终止的可能性高出40%。结果表明，无形资产的增长可能通过不可报告的合并加剧了市场势力，对消费者最为关注的行业产生不利影响。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了一个重要的制度漏洞：会计准则对无形资产的排除导致大量并购逃脱反垄断审查，从而可能引发市场集中和价格上升，对竞争政策具有重要启示。

title: Partisan Cities: How State‐Local Political Alignment Shapes Credit Risk and Information Processing in the Municipal Bond Market
abstract: This paper studies how partisan alignment between city leaders and state governors shapes information processing and bond pricing in the municipal bond market. Using a novel data set on 1,045 U.S. cities from 2005 to 2019, we show that cities with the same political affiliation as the state governor face 9 basis points lower borrowing costs than misaligned cities. The effect is stronger for riskier bonds, in states where governors hold greater authority, and for fiscally dependent cities. Aligned cities also receive more aid during fiscal distress. Partisan alignment shapes how investors interpret and respond to financial information: Nondisclosure and adverse audit findings raise borrowing costs primarily for misaligned cities, while penalties for aligned cities are markedly smaller.
summary: 本文研究城市领导人与州长之间的党派一致性如何影响市政债券市场的信息处理和债券定价。基于2005年至2019年间1,045个美国城市的新数据集，研究发现，与州长政治派别相同的城市相比，不一致城市的借款成本高出9个基点。这种效应在风险较高的债券、州长权力较大的州以及财政依赖型城市中更为显著。一致的城市在财政困境时还会获得更多援助。党派一致性影响投资者对财务信息的解读：不披露信息和不利审计结果主要提高不一致城市的借款成本，而对一致城市的惩罚则明显较小。
ai_comment: 该论文通过大样本实证揭示了政治一致性对市政债券定价的显著影响，并深入探讨了信息处理机制，为理解政治因素在金融市场中的作用提供了新证据。

title: Is the Value Premium Dead? Forecasting Value–Growth Cycles with the Implied Value Premium
abstract: We introduce the implied value premium ( IVP ), the difference between the implied costs of capital of value and growth stocks, to predict time variation in the ex post value premium. During 1977–2023, IVP is the strongest predictor of the ex post value premium. It also predicts the investment premium, consistent with the Investment CAPM. However, IVP ’s ability to predict the difference in cumulative abnormal returns around quarterly earnings announcements of value and growth stocks suggests that mispricing may also play a role. Overall, our results suggest that recent value underperformance reflects cyclical variation rather than a permanent shift.
summary: 本文提出隐含价值溢价（IVP），即价值股与成长股隐含资本成本之差，用于预测事后价值溢价的时间变化。基于1977年至2023年的数据，IVP是事后价值溢价的最强预测指标，同时也能预测投资溢价，与投资CAPM一致。然而，IVP在预测价值股与成长股季度盈利公告前后累计异常收益差异方面的能力表明，错误定价也可能发挥作用。总体而言，近期价值股表现不佳反映的是周期性波动，而非永久性变化。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地提出IVP指标，有效预测价值溢价周期，为解释近期价值股表现不佳提供了新视角，同时结合投资CAPM和错误定价理论。

title: Female Equity Analysts and Corporate Environmental and Social Performance
abstract: This paper examines the impact of female analyst coverage on firms’ environmental and social (E&S) performance. Exploiting broker closures as a quasi-exogenous shock to analyst coverage, we find that firms experiencing an exogenous decline in female analyst coverage subsequently show a significantly larger drop in E&S scores than those experiencing an equivalent decline in male analyst coverage. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we develop novel machine-learning models to analyze more than 2.4 million analyst reports and 120,000 earnings call transcripts. Our analysis shows that, compared with their male counterparts, female analysts are more likely to address E&S issues, particularly those involving regulatory compliance, stakeholders, and the environment, in both research reports and earnings conference calls. They also display distinct cognitive and linguistic patterns when discussing E&S issues. Furthermore, female analysts are more likely to issue lower stock recommendations and target prices (lower stock recommendations) following negative E&S discussions in their reports (E&S incidents) than male analysts. Finally, investors respond more strongly to female analysts’ negative tones when discussing E&S issues. Overall, our findings suggest that gender diversity among analysts plays a significant role in shaping corporate E&S practices and provide new insights into the origins of gender differences in skills within the equity analyst profession. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: We acknowledge financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2022-0285] and the Sauder Exploratory Research Grants Program. K. Li acknowledges financial support from the Canada Research Chair in Corporate Governance. T. Zhang acknowledges data support from the Whitcomb Center for Research in Financial Services at Rutgers University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06429 .
summary: 本文研究了女性分析师覆盖对企业环境与社会（E&S）绩效的影响。利用券商倒闭作为准外生冲击，发现经历女性分析师覆盖外生下降的企业，其E&S评分下降幅度显著大于经历同等男性分析师覆盖下降的企业。为了探究潜在机制，作者开发了新型机器学习模型，分析了超过240万份分析师报告和12万份盈利电话会议记录。分析显示，与男性分析师相比，女性分析师更可能在研究报告和盈利电话会议中提及E&S问题，特别是涉及监管合规、利益相关者和环境的问题，并且在讨论E&S问题时展现出独特的认知和语言模式。此外，在报告中对E&S问题持负面态度或E&S事件发生后，女性分析师更可能发布较低的股票推荐和目标价（或更低的股票推荐）。最后，投资者对女性分析师讨论E&S问题时的负面语气反应更强。总体而言，研究结果表明分析师的性别多样性在塑造企业E&S实践中发挥重要作用，并为股票分析师职业中性别技能差异的来源提供了新见解。
ai_comment: 利用外生冲击和机器学习文本分析，因果识别稳健，机制探索深入，为分析师多样性影响企业ESG行为提供了有力证据。

title: Depositing Corporate Payout
abstract: This article studies the flow of payout funds in the financial system. Using various data sources and empirical strategies, it provides evidence that a significant portion of payouts enters the banking sector as deposits, which are then intermediated to bank borrowers. The findings highlight an important channel through which corporate payout policies shape capital allocation in the economy and suggest that policies aimed at restricting payouts may distort this process by limiting the flow of funds from large and profitable corporations to small, bank-dependent firms and households.
summary: 本文研究公司分红资金在金融系统中的流动。利用多种数据源和实证策略，提供了显著证据表明，很大一部分分红资金以存款形式进入银行部门，随后被银行中介给借款人。这些发现突显了公司分红政策影响经济中资本配置的一个重要渠道，并表明旨在限制分红的政策可能会通过限制资金从大型盈利公司流向小型银行依赖型企业和家庭而扭曲这一过程。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了公司分红政策通过银行存款渠道影响资本配置的重要机制，为理解分红的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: How Do Interest Rates Affect Consumption? Household Debt and the Role of Asset Prices
abstract: This paper estimates how rate cuts increase consumption, via debt and asset prices.Using administrative UK data on mortgages and consumption, we exploit the expiry of fixed-rate mortgages to construct six million household-level natural experiments.A 1pp reduction in mortgage rates raises consumption by 3% in the following 6 months.Using plausibly exogenous variation in how house prices respond to rate cuts, we show that consumption increases mostly because households borrow against higher house prices; lower debt service after rate cuts matters less.These results suggest that in large part, monetary policy affects consumption through asset prices and borrowing
summary: 本文利用英国行政数据中的抵押贷款和消费信息，通过固定利率抵押贷款到期构造了600万个家庭层面的自然实验，估计了利率下调如何通过债务和资产价格影响消费。研究发现，抵押贷款利率每下降1个百分点，随后6个月的消费增加3%。利用房价对利率下调反应的外生变化，发现消费增长主要是由于家庭以更高的房价为抵押进行借贷，而利率下调后较低的偿债服务影响较小。这表明货币政策主要通过资产价格和借贷渠道影响消费。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的数据和自然实验设计，清晰区分了利率影响消费的两个渠道，强调了资产价格和借贷渠道的主导作用，对理解货币政策传导机制有重要贡献。

title: AI, Human Cognition and Knowledge Collapse
abstract: We study how generative AI, and in particular agentic AI, shapes human learning incentives and the long-run evolution of society's information ecosystem.We build a dynamic model of learning and decision-making in which successful decisions require combining shared, community-level general knowledge with individual-level, context-specific knowledge; these two inputs are complements.Learning exhibits economies of scope: costly human effort jointly produces a private signal about their own context and a "thin" public signal that accumulates into the community's stock of general knowledge, generating a learning externality.Agentic AI delivers context-specific recommendations that substitute for human effort.By contrast, a richer stock of general knowledge complements human effort by raising its marginal return.The model highlights a sharp dynamic tension: while agentic AI can improve contemporaneous decision quality, it can also erode learning incentives that sustain long-run collective knowledge.When human effort is sufficiently elastic and agentic recommendations exceed an accuracy threshold, the economy can tip into a knowledgecollapse steady state in which general knowledge vanishes ultimately, despite high-quality personalized advice.Welfare is generally non-monotone in agentic accuracy, implying an interior, welfare-maximizing level of agentic precision and motivating information-design regulations.In contrast, greater aggregation capacity for general knowledge-meaning more effective sharing and pooling of human-generated general knowledge-unambiguously raises welfare and increases resilience to knowledge collapse.
summary: 本文研究生成式AI（尤其是代理型AI）如何影响人类学习激励以及信息生态系统的长期演化。作者构建了一个学习与决策的动态模型，其中成功决策需要结合社区层面的通用知识与个体层面的情境特定知识，两者互补。学习存在范围经济：人类努力成本同时产生关于自身情境的私有信号和积累为社区通用知识存量的“薄”公共信号，从而产生学习外部性。代理型AI提供情境特定建议，替代人类努力；而更丰富的通用知识存量通过提高边际回报来补充人类努力。模型揭示了尖锐的动态张力：代理型AI能改善当期决策质量，但也可能侵蚀维持长期集体知识的学习激励。当人类努力弹性足够大且代理型建议超过某个准确度阈值时，经济会陷入“知识崩溃”稳态，即尽管个性化建议质量高，通用知识最终消失。福利关于代理型准确度通常是非单调的，存在内部福利最大化的代理精度水平，从而激励信息设计规制。相反，通用知识聚合能力（即更有效地共享和汇集人类生成的通用知识）明确提高福利并增强对知识崩溃的韧性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地建模了AI对集体知识积累的动态影响，揭示了代理型AI在提升即时决策效率与长期知识储备之间的根本性权衡，并指出福利非单调性，为AI监管提供了理论依据。

title: Equity Financing and Exports: Evidence from IPO Approvals in China
abstract: While finance theory distinguishes the roles of equity and debt in supporting firm growth, their differential impacts on international trade remain underexplored.This study provides the first empirical analysis of how access to equity financing affects firm exports.We leverage the unique institutional setting in China, where initial public offerings (IPOs) require stringent regulatory approval, ensuring that only qualified firms advance to the final review stage.Our empirical strategy compares the export performance of successful IPO applicants with that of "near misses"-applicants rejected at the final review meetings.To sharpen identification, we utilize meeting records to exclude rejections citing concerns about future revenue growth or profitability risks, as these may entail unobserved shocks to export performance.Our cohort based differencein-differences analysis reveals that IPO approval leads to a significant annualized increase of more than 6% in firm exports over the subsequent six years.Distinct from previous findings on debt financing, IPO approval primarily affects the extensive margin, enabling firms to expand into more destination-product markets.Mechanism tests suggest that IPOs enhance exports by financing intangible investments and fostering risk-taking activities.
summary: 本研究首次实证分析了股权融资对企业出口的影响。利用中国IPO需经严格监管审批的制度环境，比较成功通过IPO审批的企业与在最终评审阶段被否决的“接近失败”企业（排除因未来收入增长或盈利风险而被否决的案例），通过队列双重差分法发现，IPO审批使企业出口在随后六年中年均增长超过6%。与债务融资的已知效应不同，IPO审批主要影响出口的扩展边际，即企业进入更多目的地-产品市场。机制检验表明，IPO通过为无形资产投资融资和促进风险承担来增强出口。
ai_comment: 利用中国IPO审批制度中的准自然实验进行因果识别，是首次区分股权与债务融资对出口影响的异质性，提供了融资结构影响国际贸易的新证据。

title: Bubbles, Booms and Crashes in the US Stock Market 1792-2024
abstract: We examine the historical frequency of stock market booms, crashes, and bubbles in the United States from 1792 to 2024 using aggregate market data and industry-level portfolios.We define a bubble as a large boom followed by a crash that reverses the market's prior gains.Bubbles are extremely rare.We extend the industry-level analysis of Greenwood, Shleifer, and You (2019) through 2024 and replicate their findings out of sample using Cowles Commission industry data from 1871 to 1938.Booms do not reliably predict crashes, but they do predict higher subsequent volatility, increasing the likelihood of both large gains and large losses.
summary: 本文利用总体市场数据和行业层面投资组合，研究了1792年至2024年美国股市繁荣、崩盘和泡沫的历史频率。将泡沫定义为大规模繁荣之后出现崩盘、逆转前期涨幅的事件，发现泡沫极为罕见。作者将Greenwood, Shleifer和You (2019)的行业层面分析扩展至2024年，并使用1871年至1938年的Cowles Commission行业数据在样本外复制了其发现。结果表明，繁荣并不能可靠地预测崩盘，但能预测后续波动性上升，从而增加大幅上涨和大幅下跌的可能性。
ai_comment: 该研究利用长达两个多世纪的历史数据验证了泡沫的稀少性，并指出繁荣主要预测波动而非崩盘，对资产定价和风险管理有重要启示。

title: Capital Structure, Seniority, and Risk Premia: Evidence from the London Stock Exchange, 1870–1929
abstract: We use security-level data from the Investors Monthly Manual (IMM) to construct capitalweighted return indexes for the London Stock Exchange over the period 1870-1929.We find a significant and persistent equity risk premium of 3.7% over commercial paper and 4.5% over longterm government bonds, with significant co-movement with GDP growth.Returns decline monotonically with claim seniority: common stocks earn more than preferred shares, which earn more than corporate bonds.Both equity risk premia are highly significant, and the rolling 10-year return spread for stocks minus bonds is positive for every interval in the 60-year sample period.
summary: 本研究利用《投资者月刊手册》（IMM）的证券级数据，为1870-1929年期间的伦敦证券交易所构建了资本加权收益指数。研究发现，相对于商业票据，股权风险溢价显著且持续为3.7%；相对于长期政府债券，溢价为4.5%，且与GDP增长显著共动。收益随索取权优先级单调递减：普通股收益高于优先股，优先股收益高于公司债券。两种股权风险溢价均高度显著，且在60年样本期内，股票与债券的滚动10年收益差在每个区间均为正值。
ai_comment: 该论文利用19世纪末至20世纪初的独特历史数据，为资本结构、索取权等级与风险溢价之间的关系提供了实证支持，丰富了资产定价理论的历史证据。

title: What Threshold Should be Applied to Tests of Factor Models?
abstract: Researchers generally acknowledge that statistical tests must be adjusted when hundreds of factors and trading strategies have been examined.But how should these adjustments be made?Existing methods are often misunderstood or misapplied.We show that proper inference requires accounting for dependence across tests, correctly specifying the null distribution, and mitigating sampleselection bias.We develop a simple framework that avoids assumptions about the total number of tests run and yields a lower bound on valid significance thresholds -implying that researchers should employ a t-statistic cutoff of at least 3.0.In addition, we advocate using the local False Discovery Rate, which provides the probability that the null hypothesis is true for a given teststatistic realization -information that a conventional p-value cannot supply.
summary: 该论文研究因子模型统计检验中应该采用的阈值调整问题。研究者普遍承认，在检验数百个因子和交易策略时，必须调整统计检验。但如何进行调整？现有方法常被误解或误用。作者表明，正确的推断需要考虑检验之间的依赖性、正确设定零假设分布以及减轻样本选择偏差。他们开发了一个简单框架，避免了对运行的总检验次数的假设，并给出了有效显著性阈值的下界——意味着研究者应使用至少3.0的t统计量临界值。此外，他们提倡使用局部错误发现率，该指标能提供给定检验统计量实现值下零假设为真的概率，这是传统p值无法提供的信息。
ai_comment: 论文提供了一个简洁且实用的因子检验阈值建议，并强调了局部错误发现率相比p值的优势，对实证资产定价研究有重要指导意义。

title: Interest Rate Risk and Cross-Sectional Effects of Micro-Prudential Regulation
abstract: This paper investigates financial stability risks arising from banks' interest rate exposure and uninsured deposit funding.We develop a model of heterogeneous banks featuring endogenous run risk to jointly analyze portfolio and funding choices.The model replicates key empirical patterns, including the concentration of uninsured deposits in larger banks.We analyze the impact of monetary policy rate hikes and evaluate the capacity of microprudential tools to mitigate bank fragility.Results demonstrate that tightening capital requirements significantly lowers run risk.Higher liquidity requirements targeting uninsured deposits efficiently reduce run risk, provided they are met exclusively with reserves.
summary: 本文旨在研究银行利率风险和未保险存款融资所引发的金融稳定风险。作者构建了一个异质性银行模型，该模型包含内生的挤兑风险，用于联合分析银行的资产组合选择与融资决策。该模型成功复制了关键实证特征，例如未保险存款集中在大银行。基于该模型，论文分析了货币政策利率上调的影响，并评估了微观审慎监管工具缓解银行脆弱性的能力。研究结果表明，收紧资本要求能够显著降低挤兑风险；而针对未保险存款设定更高的流动性要求，仅在完全以准备金形式满足时才能有效降低挤兑风险。
ai_comment: 该文通过异质性银行模型将利率风险与未保险存款的挤兑风险内生化，为理解微观审慎工具的有效性提供了新视角，尤其揭示了流动性要求的具体执行条件。

title: Drivers of Dollar Share in Foreign Exchange Reserves
abstract: The share of US dollar assets in the official foreign exchange reserve portfolios of central banks, at times, is taken as an indicator of the dollar's global status.We provide a decomposition that shows two distinct channels contributing to the changes in the dollar share of reserves aggregated across countries: shifts in preferences for dollar assets, and changes in reserve balances driven by countries whose portfolio allocations differ from the aggregate.We document how the concentrated nature of foreign exchange reserve holdings allows countries that contribute a large share of aggregated reserves to exert substantial influence on aggregate dollar shares over time, potentially dominating the narrative.In recent periods, the key contributors to changes in aggregate preference shifts for dollar assets are changes in bilateral country trade with the United States and dollar debt share, with geopolitics additionally working through the investment tranches of central bank portfolios.Diversification away from dollar assets is more prevalent conditional on official reserves of countries being large enough to satisfy country liquidity needs.
summary: 本文研究美元在全球中央银行官方外汇储备中份额变动的驱动因素。作者提供了一个分解框架，将各国加总的美元份额变化拆分为两个不同渠道：一是对美元资产偏好的转变，二是由投资组合配置与加总水平不同的国家所持有的储备余额变动。论文指出，外汇储备持有的集中性特征使得那些贡献了大部分加总储备的国家能够随时间推移对加总美元份额产生显著影响，甚至可能主导整体叙事。在最近时期，加总层面美元资产偏好的主要驱动因素包括双边国家与美国贸易的变化以及美元债务份额，而地缘政治因素则通过中央银行组合的投资部分发挥作用。此外，当一国官方储备规模足以满足其流动性需求时，从美元资产分散化投资的现象更为普遍。
ai_comment: 该论文通过分解美元份额变化为两个渠道，揭示了外汇储备集中性对全球美元地位的影响，并实证了贸易、债务和地缘政治的作用。

title: Bank Runs and Interest Rates: A Revolving Lines Perspective
abstract: Revolving credit is at the core of the banking business.Corporate revolving lines are demandable claims; thus, similar to a traditional run on deposits, sudden and widespread drawdowns can destabilize banks.However, unlike deposits, credit line utilization exhibits substantial interest rate sensitivity.As a result, a run on revolving credit lines is less likely in a high-interest-rate environment but can introduce vulnerabilities when policy rates are lowered.Using an interest rate discontinuity commonly embedded in commercial credit contracts, we propose a methodology to estimate the elasticity of credit demand and apply it to measure the sensitivity of precautionary drawdowns.
summary: 本文研究银行挤兑与利率之间的关系，从循环信贷额度的视角出发。循环信贷是银行业务的核心，企业循环额度具有即期债权属性，因此类似于传统的存款挤兑，突然且广泛的提取可能破坏银行稳定。然而，与存款不同，信贷额度的使用对利率具有较高的敏感性，这使得在高利率环境下循环信贷挤兑的可能性较低，但政策利率降低时可能引入脆弱性。利用商业信贷合同中常见的利率不连续性，作者提出了一种估计信贷需求弹性的方法，并将其应用于测量预防性提取的敏感性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将循环信贷额度的挤兑风险与利率环境联系起来，并利用合同中的利率不连续性提供了实证估计方法，为理解银行脆弱性提供了新视角。

title: Public Finance in the Age of AI: A Primer
abstract: Transformative artificial intelligence (TAI) -machines capable of performing virtually all economically valuable work -may gradually erode the two main tax bases that underpin modern tax systems: labor income and human consumption.We examine optimal taxation across two stages of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven transformation.First, if AI displaces human labor, we find that consumption taxation may serve as a primary revenue instrument, with differential commodity taxation gaining renewed relevance as labor distortions lose their constraining role.In the second stage, as autonomous artificial general intelligence (AGI) systems both produce most economic value and absorb a growing share of resources, taxing human consumption may become an inadequate means of raising revenue.We show that the taxation of autonomous AGI systems can be framed as an optimal harvesting problem and find that the resulting tax rate on AGI depends on the rate at which humans discount the future.Our analysis provides a theoretically grounded approach to balancing efficiency and equity in the Age of AI.We also apply our insights to evaluate specific proposals such as taxes on robots, compute, and tokens, as well as sovereign wealth funds and windfall clauses.
summary: 本文探讨了变革性人工智能（TAI）逐步侵蚀现代税制两大税基（劳动收入与人类消费）时公共财政的最优设计。研究分为两个阶段：首先，若AI替代人类劳动，消费税可作为主要收入工具，差别商品税因劳动扭曲约束消失而重获相关性；其次，当自主通用人工智能（AGI）系统生产大部分经济价值并吸收更多资源时，对人类消费征税可能不足，此时需对AGI系统征税，可将其建模为最优收割问题，税率取决于人类贴现率。分析为AI时代平衡效率与公平提供了理论框架，并评估了机器人税、计算税、代币税、主权财富基金与暴利条款等具体方案。
ai_comment: 本文前瞻性地构建了AI时代公共财政的理论框架，为应对技术变革对税基的冲击提供了系统性分析，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Why Do Firms Pay Different Interest Rates on Their Bank Loans?
abstract: We document significant variation in interest rates among similar commercial and industrial loans using confidential supervisory data on the largest US banks.This dispersion does not appear to be due to risk.We rationalize the data using a search cost model and find that search costs are highest for smaller and riskier borrowers and lower for public firms, consistent with predictable differences in the costs of screening and monitoring.We find that search costs are substantial.Over a third of firms behave as if they do not comparison shop; half of all firms appear to only obtain two quotes before picking a lender, while the remaining firms behave as if they search widely.
summary: 本文利用美国最大银行的机密监管数据，记录了类似商业和工业贷款利率存在显著差异，且这种差异并非由风险驱动。作者通过搜索成本模型解释数据，发现搜索成本对小型和风险较高的借款人最高，对上市公司较低，这与筛选和监控成本的可预测差异一致。研究显示搜索成本相当可观：超过三分之一的公司似乎不进行比价；一半的公司仅获取两个报价；其余公司则广泛搜索。这表明搜索摩擦是导致贷款利率异质性的重要原因。
ai_comment: 该文利用独特监管数据，从搜索成本角度解释了贷款利率的异质性，为理解银行定价行为提供了新视角。

title: Machine Learning Meets Markowitz
abstract: The standard approach to portfolio selection involves two stages: forecast the asset returns and then plug them into an optimizer.We argue that this separation is deeply problematic.The first stage treats cross-sectional prediction errors as equally important across all securities.However, given that final portfolios might differ given distinct risk preferences and investment restrictions, the standard approach fails to recognize that the investor is not just concerned with the average forecast error -but the precision of the forecasts for the specific assets that are most important for their portfolio.Hence, it is crucial to integrate the two stages.We propose a novel implementation utilizing machine learning tools that unifies the expected return generation process and the final optimized portfolio.Our empirical example provides convincing evidence that our end-to-end method outperforms the traditional two-stage approach.In our framework, each investor has their own, endogenously determined, efficient frontier that depends on risk preferences, investorspecific constraints, as well as exposure to market frictions.
summary: 本文批判了传统投资组合选择的两阶段方法（先预测资产收益，再输入优化器），指出该分离式方法忽略了不同资产预测误差对最终组合的非对称影响，因为投资者的风险偏好和约束使得某些资产的预测精确性更为关键。作者提出一种利用机器学习工具实现端到端统一的新框架，将预期收益生成与组合优化过程融合。实证结果表明，该端到端方法显著优于传统两阶段方法，且每个投资者都能根据自身风险偏好、特有约束及市场摩擦暴露度，获得内生的有效前沿。
keywords: 马科维茨投资组合理论
ai_comment: 本文通过机器学习弥合了预测与优化之间的鸿沟，强调个性化投资决策，是对传统均值-方差框架的重要改进。

title: Chaining Tasks, Redefining Work: A Theory of AI Automation
abstract: Production is a sequence of steps that can be executed (1) manually, (2) augmented with AI, or (3) fully automated within contiguous AI-executed steps called “chains.” Firms optimally bundle steps into tasks and then jobs, trading off specialization gains against coordination costs. We characterize the optimal assignment of humans and AI to steps and the firm’s resulting job structure, showing that comparative advantage logic can fail with AI chaining. The model implies non-linear productivity gains from AI quality improvements and admits a CES representation at the macro level. Empirical evidence supports the model’s key predictions that (1) AI-executed steps co-occur in chains, (2) dispersion of AI-exposed steps lowers AI execution at the job level, and (3) adjacency to AI-executed steps increases the likelihood that a step is AI-executed.Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
summary: 论文将生产视为一系列步骤，这些步骤可以手动执行、AI增强或完全自动化（连续AI步骤称为“链”）。企业最优地将步骤捆绑成任务再组合成工作，在专业化收益与协调成本之间权衡。模型刻画了人类与AI在步骤上的最优分配以及由此产生的工作结构，表明比较优势逻辑在AI链式自动化下可能失效。该模型预示AI质量改进会带来非线性的生产率提升，并在宏观层面可表示为CES形式。实证证据支持三个关键预测：(1) AI执行的步骤倾向于连续出现形成链，(2) AI暴露步骤的分散程度会降低该工作级别的AI执行率，(3) 与AI执行步骤相邻的步骤更可能被AI执行。
ai_comment: 本文通过“链式任务”框架重新定义了AI对工作结构的影响，并揭示了比较优势在AI自动化中的失效机制，为理解AI带来的非线性生产率变化提供了新视角。

title: Building Pro-Worker Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This paper defines pro-worker technologies, including Artificial Intelligence, as technologies that make human skills and expertise more valuable by expanding worker capabilities.Our conceptual framework distinguishes among five categories of technological change: laboraugmenting, capital-augmenting, automating, expertise-leveling, and new task-creating.Only the last category is unambiguously pro-worker, generating demand for novel human expertise rather than commodifying it.We illustrate these distinctions through hypothetical and real-world examples spanning aviation maintenance, electrical services, custodial work, education, patent examination, and gig delivery.While AI's capacity to automate work is substantial, we argue that its potential to serve as a collaborator, by extending human judgment, enabling new tasks, and accelerating skill acquisition, is equally transformative and currently underexploited.We identify market failures, including misaligned firm and developer incentives, path dependence, and a pervasive pro-automation ideology, that may lead to underinvestment in pro-worker AI.We consider nine policy directions that would change incentives, including targeted investments in health care and education, tax code reform, antitrust enforcement, and intellectual property protections for worker expertise.
summary: 本文定义了“亲工人”技术（包括人工智能）为通过扩展工人能力来增强人类技能和专业知识的价值。提出了一个概念框架，区分了五种技术变革类别：劳动增强型、资本增强型、自动化型、专业水平化型和新任务创造型。只有最后一类明确是亲工人的，它创造了对新型人类专业知识的需求，而非将其商品化。通过航空维修、电气服务、清洁工作、教育、专利审查和外卖配送等假设和现实世界的例子说明了这些区别。虽然AI的自动化能力很强，但本文认为，它作为协作工具（通过扩展人类判断、创造新任务和加速技能获取）的潜力同样具有变革性，且目前未被充分利用。指出了可能导致对亲工人AI投资不足的市场失灵，包括企业和开发者激励不匹配、路径依赖以及普遍的亲自动化意识形态。考虑了九项政策方向以改变激励措施，包括对医疗保健和教育的定向投资、税法改革、反垄断执法以及对工人专业知识的知识产权保护。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地提出了“亲工人AI”概念，并系统区分了技术变革的多种类型，强调了AI作为协作工具的潜力被忽视，为AI政策制定提供了新视角。

title: Does Generative AI Narrow Education-Based Productivity Gaps? Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
abstract: Does generative artificial intelligence (AI) reinforce or reduce productivity differences across workers?Existing evidence largely studies AI within firms and occupations, where organizational selection compresses educational heterogeneity, leaving unclear whether AI narrows productivity gaps across individuals with substantially different levels of formal education.We address this question using a randomized online experiment conducted outside firms, in which 1,174 adults ages 25-45 with heterogeneous educational backgrounds complete an incentivized, workplacestyle business problem-solving task.The task is a general (not domain specific) exercise, and participants perform it either with or without access to a generative-AI assistant.Unlike prior work that studies heterogeneity within relatively homogeneous worker samples, our design targets the between-education-group productivity gap as the primary estimand.We find that AI increases productivity for all participants, with substantially larger gains for lower-education individuals.In the absence of AI access, higher-education participants outperform lower-education participants by 0.548 standard deviations; with AI access, this gap falls to 0.139 standard deviations, implying that generative AI closes about three quarters of the initial productivity gap.We interpret this pattern as evidence that generative AI narrows effective productivity differences in task execution by relaxing cognitive constraints that are more binding for lower-education individuals, even though underlying skill differences remain, as reflected in persistent education gaps in task performance and in a follow-up exercise without AI assistance.
summary: 本研究通过一项随机在线实验，探究生成式人工智能（AI）是否会缩小基于教育背景的生产力差距。实验招募了1174名年龄在25-45岁、教育背景异质性较大的成年人，完成一项激励性的职场式商业问题解决任务，部分参与者可使用生成式AI助手。结果显示，AI提升了所有参与者的生产力，且对低教育程度者的提升更大。无AI时，高教育程度者比低教育程度者表现高出0.548个标准差；使用AI后，差距缩小至0.139个标准差，即生成式AI填补了约四分之三的初始生产力差距。这表明，AI通过缓解低教育程度者更受约束的认知限制，缩小了任务执行中的有效生产力差异，但基础技能差距仍存在。
ai_comment: 实验设计巧妙，通过外生实验避免了组织选择偏差，为AI对劳动力市场不平等的影响提供了因果证据。

title: Mimicking Finance
abstract: We use frontier advancements in Artificial Intelligence and machine learning to extract and classify the part of key economic agents' behaviors that are predictable from past behaviors.Even the agents themselves might view these as novel (innovative) decisions; however, we show in strong contrast that a large percentage of these actions and behaviors can be predicted-and thus mimicked-in the absence of these individuals.In particular, we show that 71% of mutual fund managers' trade directions can be predicted in the absence of the agent making a single trade.For some managers, this increases to nearly all of their trades in a given quarter.Further, we find that manager behavior is more predictable and replicable for managers who have a longer history of trading and are in less competitive categories.The larger the ownership stake of the manager in the fund, the less predictable their behavior.Lastly, we show strong performance implications: less predictable managers strongly outperform their peers, while the most predictable managers significantly underperform.Even within each manager's portfolio, those stock positions that are more difficult to predict strongly outperform those that are easier to predict.Aggregating across the universe of fund managers each quarter, stocks whose position changes are least predictable additionally significantly outperform stocks whose position changes are most predictable across the universe.Our framework allows researchers to delineate and classify the portion of financial agents' action sets which are predictable from those which are novel responses to stimuli --open to being evaluated for value creation or destruction.
summary: 本文利用人工智能和机器学习的前沿技术，从关键经济主体的过往行为中提取并分类那些可预测的部分。研究表明，即使这些主体本身可能将这些视为新颖（创新）决策，但仍有很大比例的行为在缺乏这些个体的情况下可以被预测和模仿。具体而言，共同基金经理71%的交易方向可以在没有该经理进行任何交易的情况下被预测；对于某些经理，这一比例在给定季度内接近全部。此外，经理行为对于有更长交易历史且处于竞争较少类别的经理更可预测和可复制；经理在基金中的持股比例越大，其行为越不可预测。最后，研究显示出强烈的业绩含义：不可预测性高的经理显著优于同行，而可预测性高的经理显著落后。即使在每位经理的投资组合内，更难预测的股票头寸显著优于更易预测的头寸。每季度汇总所有基金经理，全市场中头寸变化最不可预测的股票显著优于最可预测的股票。该框架允许研究人员区分和分类金融主体行为集合中可预测的部分与对刺激的新颖反应，从而评估其价值创造或破坏。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地利用AI预测基金经理行为，并发现行为可预测性与业绩负相关，挑战了传统上认为可预测性代表能力或信息优势的观点，为研究金融市场中的信息挖掘和异象提供了新视角。

title: Bidder Pools in Mergers and Acquisitions
abstract: Allocation mechanisms in M&A deals are complex, but a main feature is that a target board controls who to invite to the sale.In a theoretical model, we show that it is optimal for the target to invite fewer potential acquirers when they are more homogeneous (i.e., when their values for the target are more correlated).Furthermore, greater correlation (and hence a smaller optimal bidder pool) yields the target a higher surplus from the sale (i.e., higher premium).We test the model empirically and show that M&A deals with smaller bidder pools are associated with higher target returns.This is not a result of synergies in the deals: the target's share of the surplus is simply higher in deals with smaller bidder pools.Finally, we show that cash deals are associated with larger, whereas stock deals have smaller, pools of bidders.
summary: 本文研究并购交易中的投标者池分配机制。理论模型表明，当潜在竞标者同质化程度更高（即他们对目标公司的估值相关性更强）时，目标公司最优策略是邀请更少的竞标者参与拍卖。进一步地，更大的估值相关性会导致更小的最优投标者池，并使得目标公司从交易中获得更高溢价。实证检验证实，并购交易中较小的投标者池与目标公司更高的公告期回报显著正相关，且这一效应并非源于交易协同效应，而是因为目标公司在较小投标者池中获得了更高的剩余份额。此外，现金支付交易与更大的投标者池相关，而股票支付交易则对应更小的投标者池。
ai_comment: 该文将拍卖理论系统引入并购机制研究，从理论和实证两个层面厘清了投标者池规模对目标公司收益的影响机制，并区分了协同效应与分配效应，对理解并购谈判过程有重要贡献。

title: Firm Data on AI
abstract: We present the first representative international data on firm-level AI use.We survey almost 6000 CFOs, CEOs and executives from stratified firm samples across the US, UK, Germany and Australia.We find four key facts.First, around 70% of firms actively use AI, particularly younger, more productive firms.Second, while over two thirds of top executives regularly use AI, their average use is only 1.5 hours a week, with one quarter reporting no AI use.Third, firms report little impact of AI over the last 3 years, with over 80% of firms reporting no impact on either employment or productivity.Fourth, firms predict sizable impacts over the next 3 years, forecasting AI will boost productivity by 1.4%, increase output by 0.8% and cut employment by 0.7%.We also survey individual employees who predict a 0.5% increase in employment in the next 3 years as a result of AI.This contrast implies a sizable gap in expectations, with senior executives predicting reductions in employment from AI and employees predicting net job creation.
summary: 本文通过一项覆盖美国、英国、德国和澳大利亚近6000名CFO、CEO及高管的代表性企业调查，首次提供了关于企业层面人工智能（AI）使用的国际比较数据。调查揭示了四个关键事实：第一，约70%的企业积极使用AI，尤其是年轻和生产率更高的企业；第二，虽然超过三分之二的高管定期使用AI，但平均每周仅使用1.5小时，且四分之一的高管未使用；第三，过去三年中AI的影响甚微，超过80%的企业报告AI对就业或生产率无影响；第四，企业预测未来三年AI将带来显著影响，预计生产率提升1.4%，产出增加0.8%，而就业减少0.7%。与此同时，员工调查预测AI将使未来三年就业增加0.5%。这种对比表明，高管与员工在AI对就业影响预期上存在巨大差距。
ai_comment: 该研究基于大规模、跨国企业高管调查，提供了关于AI采用率、使用强度及预期影响的首批系统性证据，并揭示了高管与员工在就业效应上的预期分歧，具有重要政策与实践启示。

title: GPT as a Measurement Tool
abstract: We present the GABRIEL software package, which uses GPT to quantify attributes in qualitative data (e.g. how “pro innovation” a speech is). GPT is evaluated on classification and attribute rating performance against 1000+ human annotated tasks across a range of topics and data. We find that GPT as a measurement tool is accurate across domains and generally indistinguishable from human evaluators. Our evidence indicates that labeling results do not depend on the exact prompting strategy used, and that GPT is not relying on training data contamination or inferring attributes from other attributes. We showcase the possibilities of GABRIEL by quantifying novel and granular trends in Congressional remarks, social media toxicity, and county-level school curricula. We then apply GABRIEL to study the history of tech adoption, using it to assemble a novel dataset of 37,000 technologies. Our analysis documents a tenfold decline of time lags from invention to adoption over the industrial age, from ~50 years to ~5 years today. We quantify the increasing dominance of companies and the U.S. in innovation, alongside characteristics that explain whether a technology will be adopted slowly or speedily.Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
summary: 本文介绍了GABRIEL软件包，该软件利用GPT对定性数据中的属性进行量化（例如，演讲的“支持创新”程度）。通过在超过1000个人工标注任务上评估分类和属性评分性能，发现GPT作为测量工具在多个领域均表现出准确性，通常与人类评估者无法区分。证据表明，标签结果不依赖于具体的提示策略，且GPT不依赖训练数据污染或从其他属性推断属性。作者通过量化国会言论、社交媒体毒性和县级学校课程中的新颖趋势展示了GABRIEL的潜力，并将其应用于研究技术采用的历史，构建了一个包含37,000种技术的新数据集。分析发现，工业时代从发明到采用的时间滞后从约50年下降至今天的约5年，下降了十倍；同时量化了公司和美国在创新中日益增长的主导地位，以及解释技术采用速度的特征。
ai_comment: 该研究展示了GPT作为可靠测量工具的潜力，尤其在大规模历史数据分析和跨领域一致性方面具有显著贡献。

title: Seeing Green: The Effects of Financial Exposures on Support for Climate Action
abstract: Despite the large common net benefits of climate mitigation, broad-based political consensus for large-scale policy action remains elusive.We hypothesize that financial exposure to energy stocks central to the green transition can induce learning and greater support for climate mitigation policies.We conduct a RCT which randomizes both the presence of financial market exposure to the energy sector, as well as which type of portfolio-fossil-fuel (brown) or renewable energy (green)-is given to an individual.Treatment increases support for mitigation action and intent to undertake adaptation, with positive support caused by ownership of both green and brown assets.The effects are particularly pronounced among individuals who are initially more climate-skeptic, and persist eight months after treatment.We present evidence consistent with learning as the primary mechanism: treated respondents are more likely to consume financial news and become more financially knowledgeable, less likely to obtain news from polarized sources, and better able to accurately predict the environmental impacts of green and brown firms.
summary: 本文通过随机对照实验（RCT）检验金融暴露于能源股（绿色和棕色资产）对个人支持气候行动的影响。实验随机分配参与者持有化石燃料（棕色）或可再生能源（绿色）投资组合，发现处理组对气候减缓政策和支持适应意图显著增加，且绿色和棕色资产均产生正向影响。效果在初始气候怀疑者中尤为显著，并持续八个月后仍存在。机制分析表明，处理组更频繁消费金融新闻、提升金融知识、减少从极化渠道获取信息，并能更准确预测绿色与棕色企业的环境影响，支持学习作为主要机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过精巧的随机实验设计，严谨识别了金融暴露对气候态度的因果效应，并揭示了学习机制，为理解金融教育与气候行动支持之间的联系提供了新证据。

title: Interest Rate Pass-Through With Adjustable Rate Mortgages
abstract: Adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs) transmit monetary policy less directly than often assumed.We exploit quasi-experimental variation in ARM rate reset timing in Portugal-where over 92% of mortgages are indexed to Euribor-around the ECB's 2022-2023 tightening cycle to estimate responses to mortgage payment shocks.After reset dates, mortgage renegotiations increase by 10 percentage points, lender switching by 4, partial prepayments by 5, and full prepayments by 3, offsetting about 17% of the payment increase implied by policy rates.Responses occur only immediately after resets, consistent with selective inattention, and are largest among younger, more educated, and higher-balance borrowers.Supply-side factors amplify these effects: as rates rise and bank competition intensifies, households at more flexible banks renegotiate, switch lenders, and prepay more, while greater broker presence further increases lender switching.Our findings suggest that monetary policy pass-through in ARM-dominated markets depends on borrower behavior, market frictions, and sticky deposit rates.
summary: 这篇论文研究了可调利率抵押贷款（ARMs）对货币政策的传导机制，发现其传导效果不如通常假设的直接。作者利用葡萄牙超过92%抵押贷款与Euribor挂钩的准实验变异，围绕欧洲央行2022-2023年紧缩周期，估计了抵押贷款支付冲击的反应。结果显示，在利率重置后，重新谈判增加10个百分点，更换贷款机构增加4个百分点，部分提前还款增加5个百分点，全部提前还款增加3个百分点，总计抵消了约17%的政策利率上升导致的支付增加。这些反应仅在重置后立即发生，表明借款人具有选择性关注特征；反应在更年轻、受教育程度更高、贷款余额更高的借款人中最为显著。供给方因素放大了这些效应：随着利率上升和银行竞争加剧，流动性更强的银行客户更倾向于重新谈判、更换贷款机构和提前还款；而经纪商的存在进一步增加了更换贷款机构的行为。研究发现，在ARM占主导的市场中，货币政策的传导取决于借款人行为、市场摩擦和粘性存款利率。
ai_comment: 该文利用准自然实验识别了ARM市场中货币政策传导的微观机制，揭示了借款人行为和市场摩擦的重要作用，对理解非常规货币政策传导具有贡献。

title: Are Government Bonds Safe in Times of War and Pandemic?
abstract: We analyze real returns on U.S. and U.K. government debt during major wars and the COVID-19 pandemic over the past three centuries.Wars are associated with sharply negative real returns on outstanding government debt, with returns falling far below economic growth, in contrast to peacetime periods when returns exceed growth.Elevated surprise inflation and financial repression account for a cumulative 31% wedge between returns and growth over four years of war, implying that bondholders bear a substantial share of wartime fiscal costs.During wartime, government bonds also systematically underperform risky assets.
summary: 该论文分析了过去三个世纪美国与英国在重大战争和新冠疫情（COVID-19）期间政府债务的实际回报。研究发现，战争期间政府债务的实际回报急剧为负，远低于经济增长率，而和平时期回报则超过增长。意外的通胀和金融压制在四年战争期间造成了回报与增长之间累计31%的差距，意味着债券持有人承担了战时财政成本的很大一部分。战争期间，政府债券的表现也系统地低于风险资产。
ai_comment: 这篇论文利用长达三个世纪的历史数据，揭示了战争期间政府债券实际回报的显著下降，并量化了通胀和金融压制的作用，为理解债券持有人的财政负担提供了新视角。

title: Screen More, Sell Later: Screening and Dynamic Signaling in the Mortgage Market
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of asset origination with unobservable screening effort and signaling of loan quality through delayed sale by extending Vanasco (2017). The theory predicts a positive relationship between screening effort and the strength of the signal. We test this central prediction using U.S. mortgage data, measuring screening effort by mortgage processing time. Consistent with the theory, loans that take longer to process are sold with longer delay and are less likely to default, even though observably riskier loans are processed more slowly. Our calibration reveals that the subprime mortgage market operated in a parameter range with endogenous fragility.Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
summary: 该论文通过扩展Vanasco（2017）的模型，构建了一个资产发起的动态模型，其中包含不可观察的筛选努力以及通过延迟出售传递贷款质量的信号。理论预测筛选努力与信号强度之间存在正相关关系。作者利用美国抵押贷款数据检验这一核心预测，以贷款处理时间作为筛选努力的衡量指标。实证结果与理论一致：处理时间更长的贷款出售延迟更长，且违约可能性更低，尽管从可观测特征来看风险较高的贷款处理速度更慢。校准分析表明，次贷市场在一定参数范围内运行，存在内生脆弱性。
ai_comment: 该文将筛选与信号传递动态结合，为次贷危机提供了新的内生脆弱性解释，实证与理论高度一致。

title: The Politics of AI
abstract: Using new data from the Gallup Workforce Panel, we document a persistent partisan gap in selfreported AI use at work: Democrats are consistently more likely than Republicans to report frequent use.In 2025:Q4, for example, 27.8% of Democrats report using AI weekly or daily, compared with 22.5% of Republicans.Democrats also report deeper task-level integration, using AI in 16% more work activities than Republicans.Consistent with this, Democrats are employed in occupations with higher predicted AI exposure based on task-content measures and report larger perceived differences in AI-related job displacement risk.However, in regression models the partisan gap in AI use disappears once we control for education, industry, and occupation, indicating that observed differences primarily reflect compositional variation rather than political affiliation per se.
summary: 基于盖洛普劳动力小组的新数据，本文记录了工作场所中自我报告的AI使用存在持续的党派差距：民主党人比共和党人更频繁地报告使用AI。例如，2025年第四季度，27.8%的民主党人报告每周或每天使用AI，而共和党人为22.5%。民主党人还在任务层面有更深入的整合，其使用AI的工作活动比共和党人多16%。此外，民主党人从事的职业基于任务内容衡量具有更高的预测AI暴露度，并且感知到的AI相关失业风险差异更大。然而，在回归模型中，一旦控制了教育、行业和职业，党派差距消失，表明观察到的差异主要反映构成变异而非政治归属本身。
ai_comment: 本文通过控制职业构成因素，揭示了党派AI使用差异的根源，为理解技术采用的社会经济因素提供了新视角。

title: AI Personality Extraction from Faces: Labor Market Implications
abstract: Human capital-encompassing cognitive skills and personality traits-is central for labor-market success, yet personality remains difficult to measure at scale.Leveraging advances in AI and comprehensive LinkedIn microdata, we extract the Big 5 personality traits from facial images of 96,000 MBA graduates, and demonstrate that this novel "Photo Big 5" predicts school rank, job matching, compensation, job transitions, and career advancement.The Photo Big 5 provides predictive power comparable to race, attractiveness, and educational background, and is only weakly correlated with cognitive measures such as test scores.We show that individuals systematically sort into occupations where their personality traits are valued and earn higher wages when traits align with occupational demands.While the scalability of the Photo Big 5 enables new academic insights into the role of personality in labor markets, its growing use in industry screening raises important ethical concerns regarding statistical discrimination and individual autonomy.
summary: 本文利用人工智能技术，从96,000名MBA毕业生的LinkedIn面部图像中提取大五人格特征（Photo Big 5），并验证其预测能力。研究发现，Photo Big 5能够显著预测学校排名、工作匹配度、薪酬水平、工作转换频率和职业晋升，其预测能力与种族、吸引力和教育背景相当，但与认知测试分数等认知指标仅弱相关。此外，个体倾向于选择与其性格特质匹配的职位，并在性格与职业需求一致时获得更高薪酬。尽管该方法为劳动力市场中人格的作用提供了规模化测量的新手段，但其在行业筛选中的广泛应用也引发了关于统计歧视和个人自主性的伦理关切。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地结合AI与微观数据实现大规模人格测量，验证了面部特征在预测劳动市场结果中的有效性，同时揭示了其潜在的伦理风险，对AI应用的社会影响具有警示意义。

title: AI, Opinion Ecosystems, and Finance
abstract: Generative AI use for content generation is associated with divergent outcomes on different financial social media platforms: indications of reasoning enhancement on Seeking Alpha, and of belief distortions on WallStreetBets.On Seeking Alpha, adoption is associated with information frictions.AI-assisted postings tilt toward analysis/credibility, and their sentiment positively predicts future returns.Use of AI is associated with more informative retail order flow and lower bid-ask spreads.In contrast, AI adoption on WallStreetBets follows surges in retail buying, and AIassisted content is associated with emotionality and sentiment contagion.Such content precedes higher trading volume, greater volatility, and more lottery-like return distributions.
summary: 该研究探讨生成式AI在金融社交媒体平台上的使用效果差异。在Seeking Alpha上，AI辅助的内容倾向于增强分析与可信度，其情绪能正向预测未来收益，且与更知情的零售订单流和更低的买卖价差相关，表明AI有助于缓解信息摩擦。而在WallStreetBets上，AI的使用跟随零售买入激增，生成的内容带有情绪化和情绪传染特征，并导致更高的交易量、波动性和彩票式收益分布。研究揭示了AI在不同意见生态系统中产生分化结果：一是提升信息效率，二是扭曲信念。
ai_comment: 该论文通过对比两个平台，清晰展示了AI在金融信息生态中的双刃剑效应，对理解AI对市场质量的影响具有重要启示。

title: Heaven or Earth? The Evolving Role of Global Shocks for Domestic Monetary Policy
abstract: Business cycles are increasingly driven by global shocks, rather than the domestic demand shocks prominent in earlier decades, posing challenges for central banks seeking to meet domestic mandates and communicate their policy decisions.This paper analyzes the evolving influence and characteristics of global and domestic shocks in advanced economies from 1970-2024 using a new FAVAR model that decomposes movements in interest rates, inflation, and output growth into four global shocks (demand, supply, oil, and monetary policy) and three domestic shocks (demand, supply, and monetary policy).We find that the role of global shocks has increased sharply over time and that their characteristics differ from those of domestic shocks across multiple dimensions.Compared to domestic shocks, global shocks have a larger supply component, higher variance, more persistent effects on inflation, and are more asymmetric (contributing more to tightening than to easing phases of monetary policy).As global supply shocks have become more prominent, central banks have also been less willing to "look through" their effects on inflation than for comparable domestic shocks.The distinct characteristics and rising influence of global shocksparticularly global supply shocks-have significant implications for modeling monetary policy and designing central bank frameworks.
summary: 本文研究全球冲击对发达经济体国内货币政策日益增强的影响。使用新FAVAR模型，将1970-2024年间利率、通胀和产出增长变动分解为四种全球冲击（需求、供给、石油、货币政策）和三种国内冲击（需求、供给、货币政策）。发现全球冲击的作用随时间急剧增加，且与国内冲击相比，具有更大的供给成分、更高的方差、对通胀更持久的影响以及更不对称性（更多导致货币政策收紧而非宽松）。央行对全球供给冲击的通胀效应更不愿意“忽略”。这些发现对货币政策建模和央行框架设计有重要启示。
ai_comment: 本文通过新颖的FAVAR分解方法，系统揭示了全球供给冲击在发达经济体货币政策中的独特角色，为理解央行应对全球通胀压力提供了实证基础。

title: Indebted Supply and Monetary Policy: A Theory of Financial Dominance
abstract: We develop a New Keynesian model with financial frictions to study how corporate capital structure shapes static and dynamic monetary policy tradeoffs through the supply side.Ex post, when corporate leverage is high, monetary tightening contracts both demand and supply.As a result, the Phillips curve is highly non-linear and state-dependent, and the "natural rate" R ensuring price stability increases with corporate leverage.Yet the tradeoff between inflation targeting and tightening supply constraints implies that the optimal ex-post policy is to set a rate R < R that can decrease with leverage.Ex ante, firms' market-timing incentives lead them to increase leverage when rates are low, which creates an intertemporal tradeoff: monetary easing supports current demand but hurts future supply, which makes easing partially self-defeating.The optimal ex-ante monetary policy features a prudential motive for leaning against leverage even when the divine coincidence holds in the current period.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的新凯恩斯模型，研究企业资本结构如何通过供给端影响货币政策的静态和动态权衡。事后（ex post），当企业杠杆较高时，货币紧缩会同时收缩需求和供给，导致菲利普斯曲线高度非线性和状态依赖，且确保价格稳定的自然利率R*随杠杆增加而上升。但通胀目标与供给约束之间的权衡意味着最优事后政策是设定一个低于R*且可随杠杆下降的利率R。事前（ex ante），企业的市场时机激励使其在低利率时增加杠杆，这创造了跨期权衡：货币宽松支持当前需求但损害未来供给，使宽松部分自我挫败。最优事前货币政策具有审慎动机，即使当前时期存在神圣巧合（divine coincidence），也应当逆风干预杠杆。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将企业杠杆引入货币政策传导的供给侧，揭示了金融主导下最优政策的审慎动机，丰富了宏观金融交叉研究的理论框架。

title: Clustered Network Connectedness: A New Measurement Framework, with Application to Global Equity Markets
abstract: Network connections, both across and within markets, are central in countless economic contexts.In recent decades, a large literature has developed and applied flexible methods for measuring network connectedness and its evolution, based on variance decompositions from vector autoregressions (VARs), as in Diebold and Yilmaz (2014).Those VARs are, however, typically identified using full orthogonalization (Sims, 1980), or no orthogonalization (Koop, Pesaran, and Potter, 1996;Pesaran and Shin, 1998), which, although useful, are special and extreme cases of a more general framework that we develop in this paper.In particular, we allow network nodes to be connected in "clusters", such as asset classes, industries, regions, etc., where shocks are orthogonal across clusters (Sims style orthogonalized identification) but correlated within clusters (Koop-Pesaran-Potter-Shin style generalized identification), so that the ordering of network nodes is relevant across clusters but irrelevant within clusters.After developing the clustered connectedness framework, we apply it in a detailed empirical exploration of sixteen country equity markets spanning three global regions.
summary: 本文提出一个新的网络连接度测量框架——聚类网络连接度（Clustered Network Connectedness），基于向量自回归（VAR）的方差分解。传统方法使用完全正交化（Sims, 1980）或非正交化（Koop, Pesaran, and Potter, 1996; Pesaran and Shin, 1998），但它们是更一般框架的特例。新框架允许网络节点按“簇”分组（如资产类别、行业、区域等），其中跨簇的冲击是正交的（Sims风格），而簇内冲击是相关的（K-P-P-S风格），使得节点排序跨簇相关但簇内无关。作者将该框架应用于16个国家股票市场（分属三个全球区域）进行实证分析。
ai_comment: 该文提出了一个更一般的网络连接度测量框架，解决了传统VAR识别中极端假设的局限性，具有理论和实证价值。

title: Behind the Curtain of Workforce Diversity: Evidence from EEO-1 Reports
abstract: We leverage the 2023 court-ordered Freedom of Information Act release of standardized Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO-1) reports to examine the workforce diversity of federal contractors. Using the released data for a sample of more than 19,000 publicly traded and private firms, we provide descriptive evidence on the variation in gender and racial diversity of these companies’ workforce. We also document the existence of a racial gap between managers and lower-level employees. A substantial portion of that gap cannot be explained by industry or geographic factors, reflecting the influence of firm-level characteristics. Then, focusing on a sample of more than 800 publicly traded federal contractors, we find robust evidence that the racial managerial gap is associated with firms’ decision to withhold the voluntary disclosure of their EEO-1 forms. Although our findings are subject to several caveats, we provide important evidence on workforce diversity and highlight the importance of using granular, firm-level data to study diversity topics. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07432 .
summary: 本研究利用2023年法院命令的信息自由法案（FOIA）发布的标准化平等就业机会（EEO-1）报告，考察联邦承包商的劳动力多样性。基于超过19,000家上市公司和私营企业的数据，提供了这些公司劳动力性别和种族多样性的描述性证据，并记录了管理者和低层员工之间的种族差距。该差距中相当大的一部分无法由行业或地理因素解释，反映了企业层面特征的影响。进一步聚焦800多家上市联邦承包商，发现种族管理差距与公司自愿披露EEO-1表格的决定存在稳健关联。尽管发现存在若干局限，但本研究提供了关于劳动力多样性的重要证据，并强调了使用细粒度企业层面数据研究多样性主题的重要性。该论文被Accounting部门Eric So接受，补充数据文件可获取。
ai_comment: 利用法院强制披露的独特数据集，揭示了企业内部劳动力多样性的真实状况及其与披露决策的关系，为多样性研究提供了难得的微观证据。

title: Voter-Induced Municipal Credit Risk
abstract: Policy shocks that increase the costs of public goods should simultaneously reduce voter support for them. We study the extent to which this creates a corresponding voter-induced municipal credit risk. We exploit changes to state and local tax (SALT) deductions from the Tax Cut and Jobs Act as a policy shock to the costs of local public goods. In a difference-in-differences framework with repeated bond trades, we find that jurisdictions with a higher share of residents who ceased deducting SALT (and therefore, face a higher marginal cost of local public goods) experienced a significant increase in municipal bond yields, with an average treatment effect of 8.3 basis points or 3.0% of the unconditional average yield spread. This effect is concentrated in areas where residents have a direct impact on municipal financing decisions via ballot initiatives. This study thus demonstrates the importance of voters in the pricing of public debt and extends the discussion of political and policy uncertainty and therefore, coordination and agency problems to the municipal context. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06072 .
summary: 本研究探讨选民导致的市政信用风险。利用《减税与就业法案》对州和地方税收扣除（SALT）的修改作为政策冲击，增加地方公共物品成本，同时降低选民支持。采用双重差分法分析重复债券交易数据，发现：在居民不再享受SALT扣除比例较高的辖区，市政债券收益率显著上升，平均处理效应为8.3个基点（相当于无条件平均收益率差的3.0%）。该效应集中在居民可通过投票直接影响市政融资决策的地区。研究强调了选民在公共债务定价中的作用，并将政治和政策不确定性以及协调与代理问题的讨论延伸至市政领域。
ai_comment: 巧妙利用税改政策冲击识别选民对市政融资成本的影响，为政治风险定价提供了新视角。

title: Price Informativeness and Corporate Investment: A Model of Costly Manipulation and Share Repurchases
abstract: We characterize how managers can curb manipulation by signaling information via stock repurchases in an environment with costly short selling and feedback effects from trading to firms’ access to capital. Without repurchases, manipulation coexists with informed trading at low shorting costs, reducing price informativeness and firm investment. Manipulation becomes less profitable as shorting costs increase, making prices more informative and boosting investment if speculators are less informed. Incentives to manipulate cease to exist at moderate short selling costs, but making shorting more costly reduces price informativeness and firm investment. Our model shows how contracts that precommit funding and condition future investment on stock prices can induce managers to eliminate manipulation through stock repurchases, facilitating optimal investment policies. An important policy implication is that when stock repurchases are allowed and shorting costs are low, short selling bans will typically reduce investment efficiency. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，研究在卖空成本较高且交易与公司融资之间存在反馈效应的环境下，管理者如何通过股票回购传递信息以遏制市场操纵。模型表明，在没有回购的情况下，当卖空成本较低时，操纵与知情交易并存，降低了价格信息含量和企业投资水平。随着卖空成本上升，操纵的盈利性下降，若投机者信息优势较弱，则价格信息含量提高，企业投资增加。当卖空成本达到中等水平时，操纵动机消失，但进一步增加卖空成本反而会降低价格信息含量和企业投资。研究显示，预先承诺资金并根据股价决定未来投资的合约可以促使管理者通过股票回购消除操纵，从而实现最优投资政策。重要的政策启示是，当允许股票回购且卖空成本较低时，禁止卖空通常会降低投资效率。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了卖空成本与股票回购对市场操纵及投资效率的非线性影响，为监管政策提供了新视角。

title: Pricing Experimental Design: Causal Effect, Expected Revenue and Tail Risk
abstract: When launching a new product, historical sales data are often not available, leaving price as a crucial experimental instrument for sellers to gauge market response. When designing pricing experiments, there are three fundamental objectives: estimating the causal effect of price (i.e., price elasticity), maximizing the expected revenue through the experiment, and controlling the tail risk that, if not controlled, may lead to significant financial losses. In this paper, we reveal the relationship among such three objectives. Under a linear structural model, we investigate the trade-offs between causal effect estimation and expected revenue maximization, as well as between expected revenue maximization and tail risk control. Furthermore, we propose an optimal pricing experimental design, which can flexibly adapt to different desired levels of trade-offs. Through the optimal design, we also explore the relationship between causal effect estimation and tail risk control. Moreover, we establish an always-valid confidence sequence and a central limit theorem for the inference of the causal effect. Finally, we extend our results and the design to a misspecified setting, where the structural model is not necessarily linear but the seller still runs our design for linear structural models. The results demonstrate the robustness of our design and the wide existence of the relationships among the three objectives. This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: The authors thank the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)-IBM partnership in Artificial Intelligence and the MIT Data Science Laboratory for support. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03209 .
summary: 当新产品推出时，历史销售数据通常不可用，价格成为卖家衡量市场反应的关键实验工具。设计定价实验有三个基本目标：估计价格的因果效应（即价格弹性）、通过实验最大化预期收入、以及控制尾部风险（若不控制可能导致重大财务损失）。本文在线性结构模型下，揭示了这三个目标之间的关系，研究了因果效应估计与预期收入最大化之间、以及预期收入最大化与尾部风险控制之间的权衡。提出了一个最优定价实验设计，能够灵活适应不同的权衡水平，并通过该设计探讨了因果效应估计与尾部风险控制的关系。此外，建立了因果效应推断的始终有效置信序列和中心极限定理。最后，将结果和设计扩展到错误指定设置（结构模型不必为线性），证明了设计的稳健性以及三个目标之间关系的广泛存在。
ai_comment: 本文系统揭示了定价实验中三个关键目标之间的内在权衡，并提出了灵活的最优设计，其稳健性扩展和统计推断方法具有重要实践价值。

title: Reimbursement Policy and Drug Shortages
abstract: Generic drug shortages have posed significant challenges to the U.S. pharmaceutical industry and the government for two decades, causing severe consequences and drawing widespread attention. Substantial efforts have been devoted to identifying the causes, with some linking shortages to Medicare’s adoption of the average sales price (ASP) policy for hospital drug reimbursement. However, little research has captured the connections among reimbursement policies, shortages, and the influence of group purchasing organizations (GPOs), which play a key role in representing hospitals to set prices with manufacturers. Recognizing that the reimbursement policy influences shortages through affecting supply chain parties’ decisions, we analyze a drug supply model that captures the essential elements and tradeoffs in drug wholesale price decisions. We find that under the ASP policy, the interplay of two opposing effects, the free-ride effect and the aligning effect, guides wholesale pricing decisions and affects shortage outcomes. We capture key factors influencing these effects and show that the ASP policy actually possesses resistance to shortages of drugs that have experienced shortages. Overcoming the challenges of limited data transparency, especially on GPOs, we further conduct numerical analysis incorporating various data sources (with the aid of machine learning) to gain additional insights. In addition to confirming ASP’s resistance to shortages, the numerical analysis quantitatively investigates the impact of policy and GPO-related parameters. We provide a thorough discussion of policy implications based on our theoretical and numerical findings. Notably, compared with the previously adopted fixed-price reimbursement policy, which we model as a benchmark in our analysis, ASP represents a market-data-driven policy. This distinction underscores the importance of a deep understanding of such policies for future policy evaluation and shortage mitigation. This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02223 .
summary: 该论文研究美国仿制药短缺问题，重点关注Medicare采用的平均销售价格（ASP）报销政策对短缺的影响。通过构建包含制药商、集团采购组织（GPO）和医院在内的药品供应模型，分析ASP政策下批发定价决策中的两种相反效应——搭便车效应和一致效应。理论分析表明，ASP政策实际上对曾经历短缺的药品具有抗短缺性。在数据有限的情况下，结合多种数据源和机器学习方法进行数值分析，量化了政策和GPO相关参数的影响。与固定价格报销政策相比，ASP是一种市场数据驱动政策，对政策评估和缓解短缺具有重要意义。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将ASP政策、GPO和药品短缺纳入统一模型，揭示了搭便车和一致两种效应的权衡，为理解市场数据驱动的报销政策提供了新视角。

title: Frequent Reporting and Short-Termism: An Experimental Investigation
abstract: Financial market regulators have long debated the appropriate frequency of mandatory corporate financial disclosures. Whereas frequent disclosures may help deter overinvestment, they may also encourage short-termism. This paper reports an experiment that examines the effects of varying reporting frequencies on managerial investment decisions. Experimental results indicate that frequent reporting modestly induces short-termism, but it fails to reduce the overinvestment observed in the infrequent reporting regime. Nonbinding communication of intended investment plans does reduce overinvestment, but only in the infrequent reporting regime. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant SES 1949112]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01955 .
summary: 金融市场监管者长期争论强制财务信息披露的合适频率。频繁披露可能有助于阻止过度投资，但也可能助长短视行为。本文通过实验研究不同报告频率对管理者投资决策的影响。实验结果表明，频繁报告适度诱发了短期主义，但未能减少在低频报告制度下观察到的过度投资。非约束性的投资计划沟通能减少过度投资，但仅在低频报告制度下有效。
ai_comment: 通过实验方法实证了报告频率对投资决策的影响，揭示了频繁报告对短期主义的诱发与对过度投资的抑制不足，为监管政策提供了有价值的证据。

title: AI, Skill, and Productivity: The Case of Taxi Drivers
abstract: We examine the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on productivity in the context of taxi drivers. The AI we study assists drivers with finding customers by suggesting routes along which the demand is predicted to be high. We find that AI improves drivers’ productivity by shortening the cruising time, and this gain is accrued only to low-skilled drivers, narrowing the productivity gap between high- and low-skilled drivers by 13.4%. This case study provides evidence that AI and skill are indeed substitutes, offering direct support for the underlying assumption of recent projection exercises regarding job displacement by AI. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by the JSPS KAKENHI [Grants 23K25495, 23H00828, 22H00847, 22H05009, and 22H00057], JST RISTEX [Grant JPMJRX18H3], and JST ERATO [Grant JPMJER2301]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01631 .
summary: 该论文研究人工智能（AI）对出租车司机生产力的影响。AI通过预测高需求区域并建议行驶路线来帮助司机寻找顾客。研究发现，AI通过缩短巡航时间提高了司机的生产率，且这一收益仅体现在低技能司机身上，从而使高低技能司机之间的生产率差距缩小了13.4%。这一案例表明AI与技能确实存在替代关系，为近期关于AI导致岗位替代的预测提供了直接支持。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实地数据为AI与技能替代假说提供了因果证据，且揭示了AI在缩小技能差距方面的潜在作用，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Phantom of the Opera: ETF Shorting and Shareholder Voting
abstract: The short-selling of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) creates “phantom” ETF shares, trading at market prices, with cash flow rights but no associated voting rights. Unlike regular ETF shares backed by underlying securities, which are voted as directed by the ETF sponsor, phantom ETF shares are typically hedged by the underlying basket as part of market-making activities and result in a significant number of sidelined votes of underlying securities. We find that increases in phantom shares for the corresponding underlying securities are associated with decreases in the number of proxy votes cast and increases in broker nonvotes. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01567 .
summary: 本文研究ETF卖空如何创造“phantom”ETF份额，这些份额以市场价格交易，拥有现金流权但无投票权。与由基础证券支持、由ETF赞助商投票的普通ETF份额不同，phantom份额通常通过做市活动由基础证券篮子对冲，导致大量基础证券的投票权被搁置。研究发现，基础证券对应的phantom份额增加与代理投票数量减少和经纪人非投票增加相关。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了ETF卖空对股东投票权的隐性影响，为市场微观结构与公司治理交叉领域提供了新视角。

title: The Effect of Uncertainty About Future Accounting Standards on Financial Reporting Quality
abstract: Financial statement preparers frequently trade off the benefit of reporting biased estimates with potential penalties for misreporting. In making this trade-off, preparers often face uncertainty about potential changes to accounting standards (“standard-setting uncertainty”) that could affect the future benefits of biased reporting. Our experiment documents two novel behavioral effects of standard-setting uncertainty on preparers’ estimates. First, standard-setting uncertainty causes preparers to make less biased estimates, even though reduced bias conflicts with their financial incentives in our setting. Second, standard-setting uncertainty increases preparers’ sensitivity to measurement imprecision, which is important for high-quality financial reporting. Although standard-setting uncertainty is often criticized, our theory and results suggest that increased financial reporting quality can be an unanticipated benefit of the uncertainty that naturally arises from a measured and deliberative standard-setting process. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: Research funding was provided by The University of Arizona, The University of Texas at Austin, and Cornell University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01469 .
summary: 本文通过实验研究标准制定不确定性对财务报告编制者估计行为的影响。编制者在报告有偏估计的利益与误报处罚之间权衡，但面临未来会计准则可能变化的不确定性。实验发现两个新颖的行为效应：第一，标准制定不确定性促使编制者做出更少偏见的估计，即使这与他们的财务激励相冲突；第二，这种不确定性提高了编制者对测量不精确性的敏感度，这对高质量财务报告至关重要。尽管标准制定不确定性常受批评，但结果表明它可能是审慎、深思熟虑的标准制定过程带来的意外收益，有助于提升财务报告质量。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了标准制定不确定性对财务报告质量的正面影响，挑战了传统负面观点，为会计准则制定提供了新视角。

title: Fundamental Anomalies
abstract: This paper proposes a portfolio-independent method to estimate q-theory models, in which parameters are obtained using Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) to match firm-level stock returns. Our methodology addresses a previous critique on prior studies that model parameters are chosen to fit a specific set of anomalies and different values are needed to fit each anomaly. By targeting the entire sample of firm-level returns and allowing industry and time variations in parameter values, our estimations yield higher correlations between realized and fundamental portfolio returns compared with prior literature. Additionally, the estimated two-capital model generates large and significant size, momentum, profitability, investment, and intangibles premiums, but falls short in explaining the value and accruals anomalies. This limitation underscores the importance of portfolio-independent parameter estimation in evaluating a model’s capability to generate return anomalies. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: S. Wang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72373110 and 71902140] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities in China. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01313 .
