summary: 本文提出了一种与投资组合无关的方法来估计q理论模型，使用贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法匹配公司级股票回报。该方法回应了先前研究中对模型参数选择针对特定异常且不同异常需要不同参数值的批评。通过针对全部公司级回报样本并允许参数值随行业和时间变化，本文的估计结果产生了比先前文献更高的实现基本组合回报与理论基本组合回报之间的相关性。此外，估计的两资本模型生成了大规模且显著的规模、动量、盈利、投资和无形资产溢价，但无法解释价值和应计异常。这一局限性突显了投资组合无关的参数估计在评估模型产生回报异常能力中的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文通过提出投资组合无关的参数估计方法，有效解决了现有文献中模型参数选择偏差问题，为资产定价模型评估提供了新视角；尽管未能解释所有异常，但强调了方法在模型验证中的关键作用。

title: A Primal-Dual Approach to Constrained Markov Decision Processes with Applications to Queue Scheduling and Inventory Management
abstract: In many operations management problems, we need to make decisions sequentially to minimize the cost, satisfying certain constraints. One modeling approach to such problems is the constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). In this work, we develop a data-driven primal-dual algorithm to solve CMDPs. Our approach alternatively applies regularized policy iteration to improve the policy and subgradient ascent to maintain the constraints. Under mild regularity conditions, we show that the algorithm converges at rate [Formula: see text], where T is the number of iterations, for both the discounted and long-run average cost formulations. Our algorithm can be easily combined with advanced deep learning techniques to deal with complex large-scale problems with the additional benefit of straightforward convergence analysis. When the CMDP has a weakly coupled structure, our approach can further reduce the computational complexity through an embedded decomposition. We apply the algorithm to two operations management problems: multiclass queue scheduling and multiproduct inventory management. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm, when combined with appropriate value function approximations, generates policies that achieve superior performance compared with state-of-the-art heuristics. This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation. Funding: Y. Chen was supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council, Early Career Scheme Fund [Grant 26508924], and partially supported by a grant from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72495125]. J. Dong was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant 1944209]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03736 .
summary: 本文针对带约束的马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）提出一种数据驱动的原始-对偶算法，通过交替应用正则化策略迭代以改进策略和次梯度上升以维持约束。在温和正则条件下，证明了该算法在折扣和长期平均成本两种设定下以速率O(1/√T)收敛，其中T为迭代次数。该算法易于结合先进深度学习技术处理复杂大规模问题，且收敛分析直接。当CMDP具有弱耦合结构时，通过嵌入式分解可进一步降低计算复杂度。将算法应用于多类队列调度和多产品库存管理两个运营管理问题，数值实验表明结合适当值函数近似后，生成的策略优于现有启发式方法。
keywords: 约束马尔可夫决策过程
ai_comment: 论文提供了带约束MDP问题的理论收敛保证，并展示了与深度学习结合的实用性和优越性能，对运营管理领域具有重要贡献。

title: Climate Change and Mutual Fund Voting on Climate Proposals
abstract: This paper explores whether investors’ personal experience with climate change affects their voting behavior on climate change–related proposals. We find that fund managers exposed to abnormally hot temperatures are significantly more likely to support climate proposals. We further show that the effect is persistent. We observe significant heterogeneity in the effect of hot temperatures, depending on firm-level climate risk, the quality of the proposals, fund investment strategy, and prior awareness of climate change. Fund managers’ personal experience with climate change matters for the outcome of climate proposals as it affects the aggregate support they receive. Fund managers exposed to abnormally hot temperatures are also more likely to divest from stocks with greater exposure to climate change. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: R. Michaely acknowledges financial support from the National Nature Science Foundation of China [Project 72332002]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03733 .
summary: 本文研究投资者的气候变化个人经历是否影响其对气候相关提案的投票行为。通过分析共同基金经理在面临异常高温天气后的投票记录，发现暴露于异常高温的基金经理更有可能支持气候提案，且该效应具有持久性。进一步研究表明，该效应因企业层面的气候风险、提案质量、基金投资策略以及基金经理对气候变化的先前认知而呈现显著异质性。此外，暴露于异常高温的基金经理也更倾向于减持高气候风险敞口的股票。研究结论表明，基金经理的个人气候变化经历通过影响总体支持率进而决定气候提案的成败。
ai_comment: 本文从行为金融角度揭示了个人经历（如异常高温）对机构投资者决策的显著影响，丰富了气候金融领域关于投资者非理性因素的实证证据。

title: Integrated Fleet and Demand Control for On-Demand Meal Delivery Platforms
abstract: We show how integrated fleet and demand control can be effectively used to benefit all stakeholders in on-demand restaurant meal delivery. Fleet control—that is, the assignment of orders to couriers—is the main control mechanism to steer delivery operations. Another, mostly overlooked, control mechanism is demand control via display optimization—that is, the ordering of restaurants’ display positions on the meal delivery platform. Based on historical customer interactions with a meal delivery platform, we reveal that display positions have a major effect on customers’ restaurant choices. We then leverage this effect by proposing an integrated, scalable reinforcement learning approach that simultaneously optimizes fleet and demand control. We employ our solution method on simulations of large-scale on-demand meal delivery operations with endogenous customer behavior to derive managerial insights on the value of integrated fleet and demand control. Our results demonstrate that integrated fleet and demand control reduces delays experienced by customers, allows for more services per driver, decreases total travel time per driver, guarantees fresher meals, and provides equal opportunities for all participating restaurants. Our results further highlight that selling display positions may cause operational inflexibility and, therefore, may cause significant delays in the fulfillment process. Finally, we show that careful display optimization not only improves service quality, but also platform revenue. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Funding: Financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG; German Research Foundation) [Project 510629371] is gratefully acknowledged. F. D. Hildebrandt received financial support from the DFG [Project 413322447]. M. W. Ulmer received financial support from the DFG Emmy Noether Programme [Project 444657906]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02039 .
summary: 该论文研究了按需餐饮配送平台中集成车队与需求控制的价值。车队控制（订单分配给配送员）是主要操作机制，而需求控制（通过调整餐厅在平台上的显示位置）常常被忽视。基于历史数据，显示位置对顾客的餐厅选择有显著影响。作者提出了一种可扩展的集成强化学习方法，同时优化车队与需求控制。在模拟大规模按需配送运营中，该方法减少了顾客等待时间、增加了每位司机的服务次数、降低了总行驶时间、保证了餐食新鲜度，并为所有参与餐厅提供了平等机会。研究还表明，出售显示位置可能导致运营僵化并造成配送延迟，而谨慎的显示优化不仅能提升服务质量，还能提高平台收入。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将显示位置优化作为需求控制手段，并与车队控制集成，通过强化学习实现双向优化，为平台运营提供了新视角。

title: The Distribution of Investor Beliefs, Stock Ownership, and Stock Returns
abstract: We study the relationship between the distribution of investor beliefs, the breadth of ownership, and expected returns in a model where stocks differ in the intensity of disagreement and in the extent to which beliefs are polarized, as measured by the number of optimists and pessimists relative to moderates. Polarization explains the size-dependent relationship between breadth and expected returns that we find empirically: positive for large stocks and negative for small stocks. We also find empirical support for the underlying mechanism: polarized stocks earn lower expected returns and are held more broadly if small and less broadly if large. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Comunidad de Madrid [Programa Excelencia para el Profesorado Universitario, Convenio con Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, V Plan Regional de Investigacion Cientifica e Innovacion Tecnologica], the LSE Paul Woolley Centre, and the Spanish National Research Council [Grant PID2019-111358GB-I00]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02027 .
summary: 本文研究投资者信念分布、股票持有广度与预期收益之间的关系。通过构建一个模型，其中股票在分歧强度和信念极化程度（以乐观者和悲观者相对于温和者的数量衡量）上存在差异，发现极化解释了广度与预期收益之间的规模依赖关系：对于大股票，广度与预期收益正相关；对于小股票，则负相关。实证结果支持该机制：极化程度高的股票预期收益更低，且如果是小股票则持有更广泛，如果是大股票则持有更少。
ai_comment: 论文通过引入极化程度这一新维度，成功解释了广度-收益关系的规模依赖性，为行为金融中投资者异质性对资产定价的影响提供了新视角。

title: Inflation, Money Demand, and Portfolio Choice
abstract: We estimate a structural, nominal, life-cycle portfolio choice model with exogenous housing tenure and use shopping costs to generate money demand. Homeowners (renters) with negative (positive) net bond positions react differently to changing inflation risks. The correlation between real bond and real stock returns emerges as the strongest inflation risk quantitatively and generates large increases in stock market demand for homeowners in a 1970s counterfactual. Higher expected inflation encourages stock market participation but affects negatively poorer households without access to that adjustment. A more negative inflation-bond return correlation pushes homeowners more into the stock market, whereas poorer renters move into money. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02007 .
summary: 本文估计了一个结构性的名义生命周期投资组合选择模型，其中包含外生住房产权，并通过购物成本生成货币需求。研究发现，具有不同净债券头寸的房主（负头寸）和租房者（正头寸）对通胀风险变化的反应不同。真实债券与股票收益之间的相关性在数量上是最强的通胀风险来源，在1970年代的反事实情景下，这种相关性导致房主的股票市场需求大幅增加。较高的预期通胀鼓励股票市场参与，但对无法通过调整资产组合来应对通胀的较贫困家庭产生负面影响。更负的通胀-债券收益相关性推动房主更多地进入股票市场，而较贫困的租房者则转向持有货币。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将货币需求机制纳入生命周期投资组合选择模型，揭示了通胀风险对不同家庭资产配置的异质性影响，尤其关注了贫困家庭的调整限制，具有重要的政策启示。

title: The Impact of Bank Financing on Borrowers’ Voluntary Disclosures and Real Investments
abstract: This paper examines how an increase in bank lending affects firms’ investment disclosures and policies. Exploiting the unconventional liquidity injections by the European Central Bank in 2011–2012, we find that U.S. borrowers of European Union (EU) banks receive greater bank financing and issue more management capital expenditure (capex) forecasts following the liquidity injections. In contrast, we find no evidence of changes in bond financing or issuance of management earnings forecasts. We also find that EU banks’ U.S. borrowers on average receive negative market reactions to their capex forecasts and make no change in investment following the liquidity injection. Further, relative to firms with positive feedback, firms with negative feedback have a lower increase in investment but a higher increase in financial assets. Additionally, we find that the effect of increased bank lending on management capex forecasts is more pronounced among banks with weaker financial conditions and among borrowers with greater financial constraints, higher growth volatility, and more informed trading. These findings highlight the important role of capex forecasts in seeking market feedback following increased bank lending and suggest that market feedback helps explain why the transmission of bank credit to corporate investment did not occur following the liquidity injections. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00528 .
summary: 本文研究银行融资增加对企业投资信息披露和投资政策的影响。利用2011-2012年欧洲央行非常规流动性注入作为外生冲击，发现欧盟银行在美国的借款者获得了更多银行融资，并发布了更多的管理层资本支出预测，但未发现债券融资或盈利预测的变化。市场对这些资本支出预测的平均反应为负，且企业投资未增加。进一步分析显示，相对于获得正面市场反馈的企业，获得负面反馈的企业投资增加更少，但金融资产增加更多。此外，银行融资增加对管理层资本支出预测的影响在财务状况较弱的银行、财务约束较大、增长波动性较高以及知情交易较多的借款者中更为显著。这些发现强调了资本支出预测在寻求市场反馈中的重要作用，并表明市场反馈有助于解释为何银行信贷在流动性注入后未传导至企业投资。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用欧洲央行流动性注入作为自然实验，揭示了银行信贷影响企业披露行为的机制，尤其是资本支出预测作为市场反馈渠道的作用，为理解信贷传导微观基础提供了新视角。

title: Regional Banks, Aggregate Effects
abstract: I develop and estimate a quantitative spatial model featuring banks’ spatial lending networks to study the real effects of bank funding shocks. I apply the model to the 2023 regional bank panic. I show that, during the panic, deposits were reallocated towards regional banks with better marginal lending opportunities, which offered higher deposit rates. This reallocation substantially mitigated the otherwise negative aggregate output effects of the remaining, panic-related deposit flows. This positive reallocation effect is primarily driven by inflows into banks with good lending opportunities, suggesting that fundamental forces, rather than panic-driven idiosyncratic runs, are behind the positive reallocation effect.
summary: 本文构建并估计了一个包含银行空间贷款网络的定量空间模型，以研究银行资金冲击的真实经济效应。该模型被应用于2023年区域银行恐慌事件。研究发现，在恐慌期间，存款被重新分配到那些拥有更好边际贷款机会并提供更高存款利率的区域银行。这种重新分配显著缓解了恐慌相关的存款流动本可能产生的负面总体产出影响。进一步分析表明，正向的重新分配效应主要由流入贷款机会良好的银行的资金驱动，这意味着基本面因素（而非恐慌驱动的特质性银行挤兑）是这一正向效应的主要原因。
ai_comment: 该研究通过空间模型揭示了恐慌中存款再分配对宏观经济的正面作用，为理解银行挤兑的真实效应提供了新视角。

title: Government bond risk and return in the US and China
abstract: We propose a new approach to modeling bond risk and risk premia, inspired by the equity risk-return literature, which does not impose the tight restrictions found in models that generate closed-form bond prices. We estimate the joint dynamics of the volatility and Sharpe ratio of principal-component bond-factor portfolios for the US and China. Predictors include yield curve variables and, for the US, VIX. We document complex time-varying relations between the price and quantity of interest rate risk inconsistent with the frameworks in existing studies. Interesting differences between the US and China further highlight the need for our more flexible approach.
summary: 受股票风险-收益文献启发，本文提出了一种新的债券风险与风险溢价建模方法，避免了现有产生封闭式债券价格的模型中的严格限制。作者估计了美国和中国的主成分债券因子组合的波动率和夏普比率的联合动态，预测变量包括收益率曲线变量（美国还加入了VIX）。研究发现，利率风险的价格与数量之间存在复杂的时变关系，这与现有研究框架不一致。中美之间的有趣差异进一步凸显了采用更灵活方法的必要性。
ai_comment: 该文提供了一个更灵活的建模框架，避免了传统模型的限制，并揭示了中美债券市场风险-收益关系的显著差异，具有重要的比较金融学意义。

title: Intermediation frictions in equity markets
abstract: Stocks with similar characteristics but different levels of ownership by financial institutions have returns and risk premia that comove very differently with shocks to the risk-bearing capacity of dealer banks. After observable stock characteristics are accounted for, excess returns on more intermediated stocks have higher betas on contemporaneous shocks to intermediary willingness to take risk and are more predictable by state variables that proxy for intermediary health. Intermediary risk-bearing capacity also explains a substantial and increasing fraction of the variation in conditional risk premia for portfolios sorted on intermediation. These effects are concentrated in stocks held by hedge funds or mutual fund investors who are more likely to be exposed to dealer banks. The empirical evidence supports the predictions of asset pricing models in which financial intermediaries are marginal investors but face frictions that induce changes in their risk-bearing capacity.
summary: 本文研究股票中介化程度（即机构持股水平）如何影响股票收益与交易商银行风险承担能力冲击的共动性。发现具有相似特征但机构持股不同的股票，其收益和风险溢价与交易商银行风险承担能力的共动性存在显著差异。控制股票特征后，中介化程度较高的股票（更依赖金融中介）的超额收益对交易商银行风险承担意愿的即时冲击具有更高的beta，并且更易被代表中介健康状况的状态变量预测。中介风险承担能力还能解释按中介化程度排序的投资组合条件风险溢价变动的显著且递增部分。这些效应集中在对冲基金或共同基金投资者持有的股票中，因其更可能暴露于交易商银行风险。实证结果支持金融中介作为边际投资者但面临摩擦导致风险承担能力变化的资产定价模型。
ai_comment: 本文从交易商银行风险承担能力角度切入，为金融摩擦影响资产定价提供了新证据，揭示了机构持股与股票收益共动性的内在机制。

title: Prospect theory in the field: Revealed preferences from mutual fund flows
abstract: Using mutual fund flows, we evaluate prospect theory with choice outcomes in the market. We provide strong support for prospect theory: under a standard set of parameters, funds whose past returns generate higher prospect theory value attract significantly larger future flows; we also find corroborative evidence using account-level data. Taking a revealed preference approach, we estimate the prospect theory parameters through a discrete choice model and find that our field-based estimates align well with previous experiment-based estimates. Moreover, we show that prospect theory offers a new framework for understanding flows, as it has explanatory power beyond existing drivers.
summary: 该论文利用共同基金流量数据，在市场环境中评估前景理论。研究发现，在标准参数设定下，过去回报产生更高前景理论值的基金吸引显著更大的未来资金流入；账户级数据也提供了佐证。通过显示偏好方法，使用离散选择模型估计前景理论参数，发现估计结果与以往基于实验的估计一致。此外，论文表明前景理论为理解基金流量提供了新框架，其解释力超越了现有驱动因素。
ai_comment: 利用真实市场数据验证前景理论，并通过显示偏好方法估计参数，与实验估计一致，增强了外部有效性。

title: Do teams alleviate or exacerbate overreaction in beliefs?
abstract: We investigate whether teams exhibit increased or reduced overreaction in expectation formation relative to individuals. Using preregistered randomized experiments that directly elicit expectations about future returns, we find that teams display lower belief overreaction to recent investment performance. A quantitative decomposition shows that this team effect stems primarily from a “self-selection” mechanism, whereby the most biased team member chooses to influence the team decision less. An LLM-based analysis of team interactions reinforces this result. A complementary analysis of US equity mutual fund managers operating both individually and as part of a team yields consistent evidence of lower overreaction in teams.
summary: 本文通过预注册随机实验直接 eliciting 未来回报预期，研究团队相对于个体在预期形成中是否表现出更多或更少的过度反应。实验发现，团队对近期投资表现显示出更低的信念过度反应。量化分解表明，这一团队效应主要源于“自我选择”机制，即最具偏见的团队成员主动减少对团队决策的影响。基于LLM的团队互动分析进一步支持了这一结果。对美国股票共同基金经理的补充分析（涵盖单独和团队运作两种情形）也提供了团队中过度反应较低的一致证据。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严谨的实验设计和分解方法，揭示了团队降低过度反应的自我选择机制，为理解团队决策优势提供了新视角。

title: Social media as a bank run catalyst
abstract: After the run on Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) in March 2023, U.S. regional banks entered a period of significant distress. We quantify social media’s role in this distress using comprehensive Twitter data. During the SVB run period, banks with high pre-existing exposure to Twitter lost 4.3 percentage points more stock market value. Moreover, Twitter pre-exposure interacts significantly with classical run risks to predict greater run severity and greater deposit outflows during Q1-2023, effects unexplained by other banking or market characteristics. At the hourly frequency during the run, high Twitter attention over the past four hours predicts stock market losses, especially for banks with high run risks. By contrast, we find that negative Twitter sentiment does not amplify bank run risks. Rather, our evidence points to a distinctive role of Twitter attention, particularly when tweets are retweeted broadly.
summary: 本文研究了社交媒体（Twitter）在2023年3月硅谷银行（SVB）挤兑后美国区域性银行危机中的作用。利用全面的Twitter数据，发现银行在SVB挤兑期间之前Twitter暴露度高的银行市值损失多出4.3个百分点。此外，Twitter暴露度与经典挤兑风险显著交互，预测了2023年第一季度更严重的挤兑程度和更大的存款外流，且这一影响无法由其他银行或市场特征解释。在挤兑期间的小时频率数据中，过去四小时的高Twitter关注度预测了股票市场损失，尤其对高挤兑风险的银行。相反，负面Twitter情绪并未放大银行挤兑风险，证据指向Twitter关注度的独特作用，尤其是当推文被广泛转发时。
ai_comment: 本文通过高频数据量化了社交媒体关注度而非情绪对银行挤兑的催化作用，为现代银行危机传播机制提供了新见解。

title: The benchmark greenium
abstract: Exploiting the “twin” structure of German government green and conventional securities, we use a dynamic term structure model to estimate a time-varying greenium stemming solely from investors’ green values and not their cash flow expectations. This greenium is distinct from the yield spread between the twin securities (the green spread), as the model purifies it from pecuniary and non-pecuniary factors unrelated to environmental concerns. While the green spread correlates with stock market prices, the conventional convenience yield, and temporary demand-supply imbalances, our greenium correlates only with proxies of environmental concerns. We also estimate expected green returns, which incorporate greenium risk.
summary: 本文利用德国政府绿色债券和传统债券的“孪生”结构，采用动态期限结构模型估计随时间变化的绿色溢价（greenium），该溢价仅源于投资者的绿色价值观，而非现金流预期。模型将绿色溢价与孪生债券之间的收益率利差（绿色利差）区分开，剔除了与环境关注无关的货币性和非货币性因素。研究发现，绿色利差与股票市场价格、传统便利收益以及暂时供需失衡相关，而绿色溢价仅与环境关注度的代理变量相关。此外，本文还估计了包含绿色溢价风险的预期绿色回报。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用德国政府债券的孪生结构分离出纯粹的绿色价值观溢价，为绿色金融定价提供了新视角，方法严谨且结论具有政策启示意义。

title: Sequential credit markets
abstract: Entrepreneurs typically seek financing in decentralized markets, where they approach investors sequentially. We develop a model of sequential capital markets with privately informed investors. The sequential market creates a dynamic adverse selection externality that leads to overinvestment and excessive rents to intermediaries, even as the number of competing investors becomes arbitrary large. The resulting rents lead to excessive entry of investors and insufficient entry of entrepreneurs. Moving to a centralized market structure or reducing transparency restores competitiveness but may harm efficiency. The model also explains how even a small skill advantage for an investor can lead to preferential deal flow and outsized returns.
summary: 这篇论文建立了一个序贯资本市场的理论模型，其中企业家在分散市场中依次接触具有私人信息的投资者。模型揭示了一种动态逆向选择外部性，导致即使投资者数量变得任意大，也会出现过度投资和中介机构获得过高租金的现象。这些租金进一步引起投资者过度进入和企业家进入不足。论文还发现，转向集中市场结构或降低透明度可以恢复竞争性，但可能损害效率。此外，模型解释了为何投资者即使只有微小的技能优势也能获得优先交易流和超额回报。
ai_comment: 该模型巧妙地将序贯博弈与逆向选择结合，揭示了市场分散化导致的非效率，并解释了投资者微弱优势如何放大为巨大回报，对金融中介和市场结构设计具有重要启示。

title: Investing in misallocation
abstract: We document that 20% of Compustat firms exhibit above-median investment rates despite having below-median marginal product of capital (MPK), seemingly “misallocating” resources. These firms are typically younger and more likely to experience substantial upwards jumps in sales and MPK in subsequent years. They contribute significantly to innovation, and their investments predict future aggregate productivity, creating value beyond their current MPK. We propose and estimate a simple endogenous firm growth model that captures key cross-sectional features and enables counterfactual analysis. Ignoring the potential for future jumps in hypothetical investment policies reduces MPK and investment dispersion but also lowers aggregate productivity.
summary: 该论文发现约20%的Compustat公司投资率高于中位数但资本边际产品（MPK）低于中位数，看似存在资源错配。然而，这些公司通常更年轻，随后几年更可能经历销售和MPK的大幅跃升，并且对创新有显著贡献，其投资能预测未来的总生产率，创造超出当前MPK的价值。作者提出了一个简单的内生企业增长模型，能够捕捉关键的截面特征，并进行反事实分析。结果表明，若忽略未来跳跃的可能性，在假设的投资政策下会降低MPK和投资分散度，但也会降低总生产率。
ai_comment: 论文挑战了传统基于当前MPK衡量资源错配的合理性，强调未来增长潜力的重要性，为理解企业投资效率提供了新视角。

title: Appropriated growth
abstract: We assess how labor mobility affects intangible investment in a dynamic agency model featuring both knowledge appropriation and moral hazard. We argue that restricting worker mobility, while reducing employees’ appropriation of firm intangible capital, can hurt their incentives to exert effort. Our calibration to U.S. data targets responses of employee turnover and firms’ intangible investment to variations in workers’ outside option values, identified through exogenous shocks to non-compete enforcement. The model simulation shows that knowledge spillovers mitigate the costs of incentive provision when agency frictions are severe, and the optimal labor mobility regulation should balance this benefit against turnover risk. Finally, we highlight the use of deferred compensation bonuses in the optimal contract as a retention mechanism, even among under-performing firms.
summary: 本文通过构建一个同时包含知识侵占和道德风险的动态代理模型，评估劳动力流动性如何影响企业的无形投资。研究发现，限制工人流动性虽然能减少员工对企业无形资本的侵占，但会损害员工付出努力的激励。基于美国数据对模型进行校准，利用非竞争协议执行的外生冲击识别员工外部选择价值变化对员工离职率和企业无形投资的影响。模型模拟表明，当代理摩擦严重时，知识溢出能够减轻激励提供成本，最优的劳动力流动性监管应平衡这一收益与离职风险。最后，文章指出最优合同中采用递延补偿奖金作为保留机制，即使在表现不佳的企业中也是如此。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将劳动经济学中的劳动力流动性问题与公司金融中的无形投资和代理问题相结合，为理解非竞争协议的经济后果提供了新的理论视角。

title: Richer earnings dynamics, consumption and portfolio choice over the life cycle
abstract: Households face earnings risk which is non-normal and varies by age and over the income distribution. We show that allowing for rich features of earnings dynamics, in the context of a structurally estimated life-cycle portfolio choice model, helps to rationalize the limited stock market participation and the low risky asset holdings of households. Because people are subject to more background risk than previously considered, the estimated model implies a substantially lower coefficient of risk aversion and lower stock market participation costs. Older workers and higher earners are exposed to negatively skewed risk and choose lower stock exposures.
summary: 本文研究收入动态的丰富特征（非正态分布、随年龄和收入分布变化）如何影响家庭的生命周期投资组合选择。通过结构估计的生命周期投资组合模型，作者发现允许收入动态的这些复杂特征有助于解释家庭有限的股市参与和低风险资产持有。该模型估计出的风险厌恶系数和股市参与成本均显著低于以往研究，因为家庭面临比先前假设更多的背景风险。此外，老年工人和高收入者面临负偏态的收入风险，因此会选择更低的股票配置。
ai_comment: 本文通过纳入收入动态的非正态性和异质性，更合理地解释了现实中家庭投资行为的保守性，并降低了结构性参数估计值，对生命周期投资模型有重要改进。

title: Public goods under financial distress
abstract: I examine the effects of public debt on municipal services and real outcomes during financial crises using a unique archival dataset of U.S. cities from 1924 to 1943. Unlike today’s countercyclical fiscal policies, the Great Depression provides a rare setting to observe fiscal shocks without substantial intergovernmental or Federal Reserve support. My findings show that financial market frictions – especially the need to refinance debt – led cities to sharply cut expenditures, particularly on capital projects and police services. As urban development halted during the Depression, cities with high pre-crisis debt levels faced significant austerity pressures, a decline in population growth, a rise in crime, and a departure of skilled public servants from municipal governments.
summary: 本文利用1924至1943年间美国城市的独特档案数据，考察了金融困境中公共债务对市政服务和实际结果的影响。与当今逆周期财政政策不同，大萧条提供了一个罕见的环境，可以观察在没有大量政府间或美联储支持下的财政冲击。研究发现，金融市场摩擦——尤其是债务再融资需求——导致城市大幅削减支出，特别是资本项目和警察服务。随着大萧条期间城市发展停滞，危机前债务水平高的城市面临显著的紧缩压力，表现为人口增长下降、犯罪率上升以及熟练公务员从市政府离职。
ai_comment: 利用历史档案数据填补了金融危机中地方政府财政反应的研究空白，揭示了债务摩擦对公共服务的长期影响。

title: Bank consolidation and uniform pricing
abstract: We evaluate how bank mergers affect consumer welfare when banks set deposit rates with a high degree of uniformity across their branch networks. First, we document that merger-induced changes to local market concentration are only weakly correlated with pricing decisions. Second, we develop a structural model of the banking sector to simulate equilibrium post-merger deposit rates with and without uniform pricing. The simulated deposit rates from the model with uniform pricing best match the observed changes in deposit rates following bank mergers. We use the model to evaluate antitrust decisions that force acquirers to divest branches in order to contain local market concentration levels. Our counterfactual exercises suggest that forced divestitures sometimes improve consumer welfare but can also impose consumer welfare losses when antitrust regulators do not consider that uniform pricing practices might lead to better deposit rates at acquired branches after a merger.
summary: 本文研究银行并购对消费者福利的影响，特别关注银行在其分支网络中高度统一设定存款利率的做法。首先，实证发现并购引起的当地市场集中度变化与存款利率定价决策弱相关。其次，构建银行部门的结构模型，模拟并购后在有和没有统一定价情况下的均衡存款利率，发现统一定价模型下的模拟利率最符合实际观察到的变化。接着，利用该模型评估反垄断决策中要求收购方剥离分支以控制当地市场集中度的效果。反事实分析表明，强制剥离有时能改善消费者福利，但当反垄断监管者未考虑统一定价实践可能导致并购后收购分支获得更优存款利率时，强制剥离也可能导致消费者福利损失。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型揭示了银行统一定价行为对并购后消费者福利的关键影响，为反垄断监管提供了新视角，即需考虑定价策略对福利的潜在正面效应。

title: Manufacturing risk-free government debt
abstract: In the presence of aggregate risk, governments face a trade-off between insuring taxpayers or bondholders. The literature assumes that the government can finance deficits at the risk-free rate, protecting bondholders at the expense of taxpayers. We characterize the implications of this assumption on the surplus process. Under reasonable debt dynamics, counter-cyclical debt issuance that protects taxpayers against adverse macro-economic shocks is limited in time and scope, and comes at the expense of higher long-run risk. We find that the restrictions imposed by risk-free debt are rejected in U.S. surplus data, especially after the GFC. Taxpayers have been protected at the expense of bondholders.
summary: 这篇论文研究政府在存在总体风险时发行无风险债务的权衡。文献通常假设政府可以以无风险利率融资，保护债券持有人而牺牲纳税人。本文刻画了这一假设对盈余过程的影响。在合理的债务动态下，保护纳税人免受不利宏观经济冲击的反周期债务发行在时间和范围上有限，并以更高的长期风险为代价。作者发现，无风险债务所施加的限制在美国盈余数据中被拒绝，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。纳税人得到了保护，但代价是债券持有人。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了政府可以无风险融资的传统假设，通过实证数据揭示了美国财政政策的实际风险分担模式，为理解政府债务动态提供了新视角。

title: Windfall income shocks with finite planning horizons
abstract: I study how the cognitive demands of financial planning shape household decisionmaking with respect to consumption out of windfall income shocks. I build a quantitative model of bounded rationality in which reoptimization is costly. Households respond to windfall income shocks by choosing a finite planning horizon over which to reoptimize, and the optimal planning horizon is increasing in wealth and the magnitude of the income shock. Calibrated to U.S. data, the model’s distribution of consumption responses is consistent with three key facts: even highly liquid households have large consumption responses out of income shocks, the fraction of households with positive consumption responses increases with shock size, and conditional on responding, larger shocks generate smaller consumption responses.
summary: 这篇论文研究了金融规划的认知需求如何影响家庭对意外收入冲击的消费决策。作者构建了一个有限理性量化模型，其中再优化需要成本。家庭通过选择有限规划期来应对意外收入冲击，最优规划期随财富和冲击规模增加。模型校准至美国数据后，消费反应的分布符合三个关键事实：即使高流动性家庭对收入冲击也有较大消费反应；有正向消费反应的家庭比例随冲击规模增加；在反应的家庭中，较大冲击产生较小的消费反应。
ai_comment: 该模型巧妙地将认知成本与家庭消费行为结合，解释了为何高流动性家庭也会对收入冲击大幅调整消费，对理解消费平滑和财政政策传导机制有重要贡献。

title: Earnings Conference Calls and the SEC Comment Letter Process
abstract: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reviews firms’ financial reports and issues comment letters to ensure compliance with applicable disclosure and accounting requirements. We explore the nature, determinants, and consequences of SEC comment letters that refer to information disclosed in voluntary earnings conference calls. Using hand-collected data, we document that the SEC primarily references these voluntary disclosures to illustrate insufficiencies and, less commonly, inconsistencies in mandatory filings across a wide range of topics. These letters are more likely to be issued when filing reviews are more complex, SEC staff are less resource constrained, and for firms with more institutional investors and analysts. Conference call–related comments tend to occur during higher-quality review processes and require greater remediation costs than other comments. The SEC’s use of call disclosures also leads to more pronounced changes in firms’ subsequent mandatory filings, particularly when the firm indicates agreement with SEC comments. However, we observe a mixed effect on the overall information environment, consistent with possible unintended consequences for the quality of firms’ voluntary disclosures. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02065 .
summary: 本文研究美国证券交易委员会（SEC）在评阅公司财务报告后发出的评阅信函中，引用自愿性财报电话会议信息披露的现象。通过手工收集数据，作者发现SEC主要引用这些自愿披露来指出强制性披露中的不足，较少情况下指出不一致之处，涉及广泛主题。此类信函更可能出现在评阅较复杂、SEC工作人员资源约束较小、以及机构投资者和分析师较多的公司中。与电话会议相关的评阅意见往往出现在更高质量的评阅过程中，且比其他意见需要更高的补救成本。SEC引用电话会议披露还会导致公司后续强制性披露发生更显著的变化，尤其是在公司同意SEC意见时。然而，对整体信息环境的效应是混合的，可能与自愿披露质量产生非预期后果。该文被Suraj Srinivasan（会计领域）接受。
ai_comment: 该论文通过手工收集数据，首次系统研究了SEC评阅信函如何利用自愿性电话会议披露，揭示了监管实践中的新维度，并指出了潜在的意外后果。

title: Judge Ideology and Corporate Tax Planning
abstract: We investigate whether judges’ political ideology affects corporate tax behaviors. We find that firms engaging in less aggressive tax planning when Circuit Court judges are more liberal. Cross-sectionally, the deterrent effect of liberal judge ideology is more pronounced for firms that engage in judiciary-sensitive tax strategies, face higher enforcement risk from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), or have larger reputational costs from tax disputes. Our findings further suggest that liberal judge ideology reduces firms’ R&D investments and market value by constraining tax planning. Overall, our evidence highlights the importance of judge ideology for firm behavior in the context of corporate tax planning.
summary: 本文研究法官政治意识形态如何影响公司税收筹划行为。利用美国巡回法院法官的党派背景衡量意识形态，发现当法官更偏向自由派时，其所在辖区公司从事激进税收筹划的倾向显著降低。横截面分析表明，这种威慑效应对采用司法敏感税收策略、面临更高美国国税局（IRS）执法风险或税收争议声誉成本较大的公司更为突出。进一步地，自由派法官意识形态通过约束税收筹划，减少了公司的研发投资并降低了市场价值。整体上，论文揭示了司法意识形态在企业税收决策中的重要作用。
ai_comment: 该研究创新地将法官个人特征与公司财务行为关联，为法律环境对企业决策的影响提供了微观证据；其利用巡回法院法官意识形态的外生性变动识别因果效应，增强了结论的可信度。

title: Is Fraud Contagious? Social Connections and the Looting of COVID Relief Programs
abstract: Fraud indicators within the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), a major COVID relief program, are highly geographically concentrated. ZIP codes and counties with high rates of suspicious PPP loans are strongly socially connected, with evidence that fraud spreads spatially over time through social networks. Individuals in suspicious social media groups have higher rates of PPP fraud, and socially connected ZIP codes frequently use the same specific FinTech lenders, consistent with social networks influencing detailed loan decisions. Our findings suggest that more proactive data analysis is needed for fraud prevention, detection, and prosecution to prevent the social spread of fraudulent schemes.
summary: 该论文研究新冠救助计划——薪资保护计划（PPP）中的欺诈是否具有传染性。研究发现，PPP中可疑贷款在地理上高度集中，且高可疑贷款率的邮政编码和县之间具有强烈的社交关联，证据表明欺诈通过社交网络在空间上随时间传播。加入可疑社交媒体群体的个体有更高的PPP欺诈率，社交关联的邮政编码经常使用相同的特定金融科技贷款机构，这与社交网络影响具体贷款决策的结论一致。结果表明，需要更主动的数据分析来预防、检测和起诉欺诈，以防止欺诈性计划的社会传播。
ai_comment: 该研究利用大规模行政数据和社会网络分析，证实了欺诈行为通过社交网络传播的机制，对监管机构加强预警和干预具有重要启示。

title: Identifying Demand Curves in Index Option Markets
abstract: We identify latent demands in index option markets using a sign-restricted vector autoregression (VAR) and highlight the bias from treating (equilibrium) net demand as exogenous. Market-maker and end-user demand curves are far from infinitely elastic as assumed by some models, but elasticities exceed existing estimates for equities. Characterizing demand curves provides insights into the structure of index option markets. Deteriorating market conditions are associated with right shifts of the latent demand curves. The at-the-money (ATM) (out-of-the-money (OTM)) markets for calls and puts are mainly driven by end-user (market-maker) demand, and end-user (market-maker) ATM (OTM) call option demand predicts S&P500 returns. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04263 .
summary: 本文通过符号约束向量自回归（VAR）模型识别指数期权市场的潜在需求，并揭示了将均衡净需求视为外生变量所带来的偏差。研究发现，做市商和终端用户的需求曲线远非某些模型假设的完全弹性，但其弹性系数仍高于现有对股票市场的估计。对需求曲线的刻画有助于理解指数期权市场的结构。市场状况恶化时，潜在需求曲线右移。在平价（ATM）和虚值（OTM）期权市场中，分别由终端用户和做市商的需求主导；其中，终端用户的ATM看涨期权需求和做市商的OTM看涨期权需求能够预测标普500指数收益率。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用符号约束VAR识别潜在需求，修正了传统外生性假设的偏差，并揭示了不同类型的期权市场参与者的需求特征和预测能力。

title: The Impact of Carcinogenic Risk Exposure on Housing Values: Estimates from Chemical Reclassifications
abstract: We quantify the impact of perceived cancer risk on housing values using widely advertised national reclassifications of chemical carcinogenicity in the United States. Combining these information events with an empirical design that compares changes in house values closer to affected toxic plants against those farther away isolates the effect of cancer risk news from other local factors. Focusing on plants previously emitting reclassified carcinogenic chemicals, we estimate a 1–2% decline in housing values within a 3-mile radius compared to those located farther away. The effects are stronger in areas with higher media presence underscoring the role of salience as a mechanism.
summary: 本文利用美国全国范围内化学致癌物重分类的广泛宣传事件，量化了感知癌症风险对住房价值的影响。通过将这些信息事件与比较靠近受影响有毒工厂与较远地区房价变化的实证设计相结合，将癌症风险新闻的影响与其他地方因素隔离。聚焦于之前排放被重新分类的致癌化学品的工厂，估计在3英里半径内的房价比更远地区下降1-2%。在媒体关注度更高的地区，影响更强，凸显了显著性作为机制的作用。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用外生政策事件（致癌物重分类）识别风险感知对房价的因果效应，并验证了媒体曝光作为传导机制，为环境风险定价提供了可靠证据。

title: Corporate Tax System Complexity and Investment Sensitivity to Tax Policy Changes
abstract: Effective policymakers must balance the demands of formulating a corporate tax system that raises revenue and spurs economic activity (e.g., investment) while promoting a “level playing field” across firms. Balancing these tradeoffs has likely caused tax systems to become more complex over time, increasing firms’ difficulty in understanding and complying with tax regulations. We investigate the impact of tax system complexity on the responsiveness of firm‐level investment to tax policy changes. Exploiting staggered tax rate changes and variation in tax system complexity across countries, we document two key findings. First, firm‐level investment is less sensitive to changes in the corporate tax rate when tax system complexity is higher, suggesting that such complexity can undermine the ability of tax policy to affect economic growth. Second, the impact of tax complexity on the sensitivity of investment to tax rate changes varies significantly across firms, with domestic‐owned, smaller, and private firms being more affected. These cross‐sectional disparities are consistent with tax system complexity potentially reducing tax system parity. Collectively, our findings suggest that corporate tax system complexity can negatively impact the ability of fiscal policy to affect investment and lead to heterogeneous tax policy responses across firms.
summary: 这篇论文研究了企业税制复杂性如何影响企业投资对税收政策变化的响应。利用各国交错的公司税率变化以及税制复杂性的跨国差异，作者发现两个主要结果：第一，当税制复杂性越高时，企业投资对公司税率变化的敏感性越低，这表明税制复杂性可能削弱税收政策影响经济增长的能力；第二，税制复杂性对投资-税率敏感性的影响在不同企业间存在显著差异，国内企业、小企业和私营企业受冲击更大。这些横截面差异与税制复杂性可能降低税收体系公平性的观点一致。总体而言，研究认为企业税制复杂性会负面地影响财政政策对投资的作用，并导致企业对税收政策的异质性反应。
ai_comment: 该论文利用跨国数据实证了税制复杂性对投资-税收敏感性的负面影响，并揭示了企业异质性，对政策制定者有重要启示，强调了简化税制的重要性。

title: A Catering Theory of Earnings Guidance: Empirical Evidence and Stock Market Implications
abstract: We propose and test a catering theory of earnings guidance. As predicted by our model, managers cater to reference point-dependent investor preferences by issuing excessively optimistic earnings forecasts if their investors have experienced poor stock returns. Moreover, earnings guidance is most biased when managers strongly discount future outcomes, when the stock’s payoff uncertainty is high, and when managers face low costs for issuing inaccurate forecasts. Catering via earnings guidance succeeds in moving stock market prices and induces mispricing which is partially corrected around the corresponding final earnings announcement.
summary: 本文提出并检验了盈利指引的迎合理论。模型预测，管理者会迎合依赖参考点的投资者偏好：当投资者经历了较差的股票回报时，管理者会发布过度乐观的盈利预测。此外，当管理者强烈折现未来结果、股票收益不确定性较高或发布不准确预测的成本较低时，盈利指引的偏差最大。通过盈利指引的迎合行为成功影响了股票市场价格，并导致了错误定价，该错误定价在相应的最终盈利公告发布时得到部分纠正。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从迎合投资者偏好的角度解释盈利指引的偏差行为，并揭示了其导致市场错误定价的机制，对理解管理者自愿披露动机和资本市场信息效率有重要贡献。

title: Remotely Productive: The Efficacy of Remote Work for Executives
abstract: We study the efficacy of remote arrangements between CEOs and firms. Such arrangements attract executive talent and overcome labor market segmentation but introduce frictions. Remote arrangements are associated with lower operating performance, firm valuation, and insider reviews. Using the private costs from uprooting the CEO’s spouse as an instrument for the CEO’s decision to seek remote work, we find similar negative effects. The performance decline increases for CEOs who live further away and who cross multiple time zones. The mechanisms include the CEO’s loss of information, short-termism, and consumption of leisure, such as recreational boats and beach homes.
summary: 本文研究CEO与公司之间的远程工作安排的有效性。远程安排能够吸引高管人才并克服劳动力市场分割，但引入了摩擦。研究发现，远程工作与较低的运营绩效、公司估值以及内部评价相关。利用CEO配偶搬迁的私人成本作为CEO寻求远程工作决策的工具变量，同样发现负面效应。CEO居住地越远、跨越多个时区时，绩效下降更加明显。机制包括CEO的信息损失、短期主义以及休闲消费（如游艇和海滨别墅）的增加。
ai_comment: 该文通过因果识别方法揭示了CEO远程办公的负面影响，并探索了具体机制，为理解高管工作模式提供了重要实证证据。

title: Do Financial Advisors Charge Sustainable Investors a Premium?
abstract: Despite growing regulatory concerns about potential overcharging of sustainable investors, empirical evidence is lacking. In two controlled laboratory-in-the-field experiments with 415 professional financial advisors from Europe and the United States and an incentivized survey, we identify two distinct but interacting effects. First, advisors charge sustainable investors a premium. This premium persists even when accounting for differences in skill, effort, and costs. Second, advisors impose higher fees on clients with low financial literacy. These factors interact. Sustainable investors with low financial literacy are charged the highest fee, whereas those with high financial literacy do not pay a sustainability premium. Our findings suggest that advisors extract additional fees for sustainable investment mandates but avoid overcharging sustainable investors with high financial literacy. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: P. Smeets was supported by the Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Grant VI.Vidi.221E.011]. The experiments were financially supported by the Graduate School of Business and Economics at Maastricht University, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, and Radboud University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00232 .
summary: 在监管层日益担忧可持续投资者可能被过度收费的背景下，本研究通过两项受控实验室实地实验（涉及欧美415名专业金融顾问）以及一项激励调查，识别出两种独立但相互影响的作用。首先，顾问对可持续投资者收取溢价，且该溢价在考虑技能、努力和成本差异后依然存在。其次，顾问对金融素养较低的客户收取更高费用。两者交互作用：低金融素养的可持续投资者被收取最高费用，而高金融素养的可持续投资者则不支付可持续溢价。研究结果表明，顾问从可持续投资委托中提取额外费用，但避免对高金融素养的可持续投资者过度收费。
ai_comment: 论文通过严谨的实验设计揭示了可持续投资中顾问收费的复杂性，并指出金融素养作为缓解过度收费的关键因素，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Model Ambiguity versus Model Misspecification in Dynamic Portfolio Choice
abstract: We study aversion to model ambiguity and misspecification in dynamic portfolio choice. Risk‐averse investors (relative risk aversion γ>1$\gamma > 1$) fear return persistence, while risk‐tolerant investors (0<γ<1$0<\gamma <1$) fear mean reversion, when confronting model misspecification concerns of identically and independently distributed (IID) returns. The intuition is that risk‐averse investors, who want to hedge intertemporally, endogenously fear return persistence, which precludes hedging. A log investor is myopic and unaffected by model misspecification, therefore only worrying about model ambiguity. Our model can generate belief scarring, nonparticipation in equity markets, and extrapolative return expectations. Extending beyond IID returns, we study model misspecification for a mean‐reverting Sharpe ratio.
summary: 本文研究动态投资组合选择中的模型模糊性和模型错误设定。对于独立同分布（IID）收益，风险厌恶投资者（相对风险厌恶系数γ>1）在面对模型错误设定时担心收益持续性，而风险容忍投资者（0<γ<1）则担心均值回归，原因是风险厌恶投资者希望进行跨期对冲，因而内生地担忧收益持续性会阻碍对冲；对数投资者（γ=1）是近视的，不受模型错误设定影响，仅关注模型模糊性。该模型能够产生信念疤痕、不参与股票市场以及外推性收益预期。此外，研究还将模型错误设定扩展到均值回复的夏普比率情形。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分投资者对模型错误设定的不同反应，揭示了风险态度与收益持续性担忧之间的内生关系，并成功解释了信念疤痕和市场非参与等现实现象，扩展至均值回复夏普比率增强了模型的适用性。

title: The Impact of Bank Consolidation on Credit Supply and Performance
abstract: Between 2009 and 2011, the Spanish banking system underwent a restructuring process based on savings banks’ consolidation. The program’s design allows us to study how banks’ consolidation affects credit supply and performance. We propose a quasi-experimental analysis showing that bank mergers restrict credit supply and set higher interest rates but also reject fewer applicants and report fewer nonperforming loans. We then estimate a structural model of credit in which banks set interest rates and lending standards. We find that, despite the relaxation in their lending standards, merged banks’ credit performance improved thanks to a significant drop in their screening costs.
summary: 本文研究2009-2011年间西班牙储蓄银行整合对信贷供给和绩效的影响。利用准实验分析发现，银行合并导致信贷供给收缩、利率上升，但拒绝申请的比例降低且不良贷款减少。进一步估计信贷的结构模型，其中银行设定利率和贷款标准，结果发现：尽管合并后银行的贷款标准有所放松，但由于筛选成本显著下降，其信贷绩效反而改善。
ai_comment: 利用准实验设计和结构模型，清晰识别银行整合的因果效应及其微观机制，对理解银行并购的经济后果有重要贡献。

title: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (genAI) is a potentially important new technology, but its impact on the economy depends on the speed and intensity of adoption. This paper reports results from a series of nationally representative U.S. surveys of genAI use at work and at home. As of late 2024, 45% of the U.S. population age 18–64 uses genAI. Among employed respondents, 27% used genAI for work at least once in the previous week: 10% used it every workday and 17% on some but not all workdays. Relative to each technology’s first mass-market product launch, work adoption of genAI has been faster than the personal computer (PC), and overall adoption has outpaced both PCs and the internet by an even wider margin. Between 1% and 7% of all work hours are currently assisted by genAI, and respondents report time savings equivalent to 1.4% of total work hours. Potential productivity gains vary widely by industry, and firm climate and policies play an important role in adoption patterns. This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardello, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by the Walmart Foundation [Grant 252882]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02523 .
summary: 本文基于美国全国代表性调查，研究了生成式人工智能（genAI）在工作与家庭中的采用速度和强度。截至2024年底，45%的18-64岁美国人口使用genAI；其中27%的就业者在过去一周内至少使用过一次genAI（10%每天使用，17%部分工作日使用）。与个人电脑（PC）和互联网相比，genAI在工作场景的采用速度更快，整体采用速度更是大幅领先。当前约1%-7%的工作小时由genAI辅助，受访者报告的时间节省相当于总工作小时的1.4%。生产率提升潜力因行业而异，且企业气候和政策对采用模式有重要影响。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模调查提供了genAI采用率的最新定量证据，并首次系统比较了其与PC和互联网的扩散速度，对理解新技术对经济的潜在影响具有重要参考价值。

title: Do Consumers Vote with Their Feet in Response to Negative ESG News? Evidence from Foot Traffic to Retail Locations
abstract: We examine whether and, if so, how retail consumers change their shopping in response to firm‐specific negative environmental, social, and governance (ESG) news. Using an event study methodology, we do not find significant changes in consumer foot traffic in response to negative ESG news, on average. However, the average consumer reacts negatively when such news is covered by national or global media outlets, which elevates consumer awareness. In addition, we provide evidence of the heterogeneity in responses to negative ESG news across consumer groups. Consumers in more ESG‐conscious counties, as measured by county ESG preferences, income, education, and political ideology, reduce store visits in response to negative ESG news. In contrast, consumers in the least ESG‐conscious counties increase their visits in response to negative ESG news. These opposing reactions explain the insignificant average consumer response to negative ESG news. Furthermore, the ESG‐conscious consumers' negative reaction is, at most, modest, dissipating within six weeks. Overall, our findings suggest that firms face divergent responses to ESG activities from different consumer groups, underscoring the divisive nature of ESG issues.
summary: 本文研究零售消费者是否以及如何因公司特定的负面环境、社会和治理（ESG）新闻而改变购物行为。采用事件研究方法，发现平均而言，消费者客流量对负面ESG新闻没有显著变化。然而，当此类新闻被全国性或全球性媒体报道从而提升消费者意识时，消费者平均会做出负面反应。此外，消费者群体对负面ESG新闻的反应存在异质性：在ESG意识较强的县（以县ESG偏好、收入、教育水平和政治意识形态衡量），消费者会减少门店访问；而在ESG意识最弱的县，消费者反而增加访问。这两种相反的反应解释了平均效应的不显著性。ESG意识较强消费者的负面反应程度温和，且在六周内消散。总体而言，研究结果表明不同类型消费者群体对ESG活动的反应存在分歧，凸显了ESG问题的分裂性质。
ai_comment: 该论文通过揭示消费者反应的异质性，解释了平均效应不显著的原因，并发现负面反应的持续时间短暂，为ESG对企业实际影响提供了细致入微的实证证据。

title: ESG Shocks in Global Supply Chains
abstract: We show that U.S. firms cut imports by 31.8% when their international suppliers experience environmental and social (E&S) incidents. These trade cuts are larger for publicly listed U.S. importers facing high E&S investor pressure and lead to cross-country supplier reallocation, suggesting that E&S preferences in capital markets can be privately costly but have real effects for foreign suppliers. Larger trade cuts around the incident result in better supplier E&S performance in subsequent years and in the eventual resumption of trade. Our results highlight the role of investors in ensuring suppliers’ E&S compliance along global supply chains.
summary: 本文研究美国公司在国际供应商发生环境和社会（E&S）事件后的进口行为变化。利用微观贸易数据，发现当供应商遭遇E&S事件时，美国进口商平均削减进口31.8%。这一削减在面临较高E&S投资者压力的上市公司中更为显著，并导致进口商在不同国家的供应商之间重新分配订单，表明资本市场中的E&S偏好虽给企业带来私人成本，却对国外供应商产生实际影响。事件后更大的进口削减与供应商后续更优的E&S表现以及贸易关系的最终恢复相关。结果凸显了投资者在保障全球供应链中供应商E&S合规方面的作用。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证揭示ESG事件在供应链中的真实经济影响，并强调投资者压力作为传导机制的关键作用，为ESG的跨市场溢出效应提供了新颖证据。

title: Investor-Driven Corporate Finance: Evidence from Insurance Markets
abstract: I study the effect of bond investor demand on the financing and investment decisions of nonfinancial firms using granular data on the bond transactions of insurance companies. Liquidity inflows from insurance premiums combined with insurers’ persistent investment preferences identify bond demand shifts in the secondary market. These raise bond prices and reduce firms’ financing costs. In response, firms issue more bonds, especially when they have well-connected bond underwriters. The proceeds are used for investment activities, particularly by financially constrained firms. My findings emphasize that bond investors significantly affect corporate decisions through their price impact.
summary: 本文利用保险公司债券交易的微观数据，研究债券投资者需求对非金融企业融资和投资决策的影响。通过保险保费收入带来的流动性流入与保险公司持续的投资偏好，识别出二级市场债券需求的变化，这些需求变化推高债券价格，降低企业的融资成本。企业因此增加债券发行，尤其在拥有良好关系的债券承销商时更为显著。发行所得资金主要用于投资活动，特别是财务受限的企业。研究强调债券投资者通过价格影响对企业决策产生重要影响。
ai_comment: 该文利用独特的保险交易数据识别投资者需求冲击，将资产定价与公司金融有机结合，揭示了债券市场投资者对企业实际决策的传导机制。

title: Price Discovery on Decentralized Exchanges
abstract: Decentralized exchanges (DEXs) allow traders to express their willingness to pay for quick execution through a public priority fee bidding mechanism. We provide evidence that high-fee DEX trades are more informative and contribute more to price discovery. Using address-level blockchain transaction data, we show that informed traders persistently bid higher fees to secure early execution, revealing a strong willingness to pay for execution priority. Further, analysis of Ethereum mempool data demonstrates that informed traders employ a “jump bidding” strategy, placing high initial bids to deter potential competitors.
summary: 该论文研究去中心化交易所（DEX）中的价格发现机制，重点关注公开优先费用竞拍机制如何影响交易信息含量。通过分析地址级区块链交易数据，作者发现高费用DEX交易更具信息含量，对价格发现贡献更大。知情交易者会持续出价更高的费用以确保早期执行，显示出强烈的执行优先级支付意愿。此外，对以太坊mempool数据的分析表明，知情交易者采用“jump bidding”策略，即通过初始高额出价来威慑潜在竞争者。
ai_comment: 该研究利用链上数据精细刻画了DEX中知情交易者的行为模式，为理解去中心化市场的微观结构提供了新的实证证据。

title: Dividend Momentum and Stock Return Predictability: A Bayesian Approach
abstract: A long tradition in macro-finance studies the dynamics of aggregate stock returns and dividends using vector autoregressions, imposing the restrictions implied by the Campbell-Shiller (CS) identity to sharpen inference. We develop Bayesian methods that encode a priori skepticism about return predictability while imposing the restrictions. We highlight that persistence in dividend growth induces “dividend momentum,” a previously overlooked channel for return predictability. By combining Bayesian shrinkage and the CS restrictions, we obtain more plausible degrees of return predictability, superior out-of-sample forecasts, and Sharpe ratios, which cannot be obtained by using either shrinkage or the CS restrictions on their own.
summary: 这篇论文研究股利动量与股票回报可预测性，采用贝叶斯方法。作者在向量自回归中施加Campbell-Shiller (CS)恒等式限制，并引入贝叶斯收缩来表达对回报可预测性的先验怀疑。他们发现股利增长的持续性会产生“股利动量”，这是一个此前被忽略的回报可预测渠道。通过结合贝叶斯收缩和CS限制，模型获得了更合理的回报可预测性程度、更优的样本外预测和夏普比率，而单独使用收缩或CS限制均无法实现这些效果。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将贝叶斯方法与CS恒等式结合，揭示了股利动量作为回报可预测的新渠道，并在样本外预测和夏普比率上取得显著改进。

title: Who Prices Credit Rating Inflation?
abstract: Credit rating agencies (CRAs) are less likely and slower to downgrade firms with performance-sensitive debt (PSD) if these downgrades increase borrowing costs. This effect is stronger when CRAs rate their most profitable clients and is not driven by selection into PSD contracts, by borrowers adjusting their leverage, or by borrowers hiding information. Originating banks price the CRAs’ conflicts of interest and sell loans with more embedded conflicts more frequently. In contrast, secondary market participants do not price conflicts of interest to the same extent. The recent settlements between the major CRAs and the U.S. government do not prevent rating inflation.
summary: 本文研究信用评级机构（CRAs）在评级具有业绩敏感债务（PSD）的公司时，因降级会提高借款成本而更不愿或更慢降级，尤其对最盈利客户更明显。该效应并非由PSD合同选择、借款人杠杆调整或信息隐瞒驱动。发起银行能识别并定价CRAs的利益冲突，更频繁地出售嵌入更多冲突的贷款，而二级市场参与者对此定价不足。近期美国主要CRAs与政府的和解未能有效防止评级通胀。
ai_comment: 本文从银行与二级市场参与者视角揭示了评级通胀的定价差异，并指出监管和解的局限性，对理解评级机构行为及市场约束有重要贡献。

title: Does Agglomeration Enhance Property Value?
abstract: Does agglomeration within a building and/or neighborhood enhance or weaken property value? The valuation impact is unclear ex ante, given that agglomeration tradesoff enhanced productivity at the expense of a more concentrated tenant base. We find that a value premium exists only when agglomeration at both the building and neighborhood levels consists of firms in the same industry. This premium represents capitalized knowledge spillover externalities. Additionally, we show the stock market rewards real estate investment trusts that transact specialized buildings. The valuation consequences arising from agglomeration in the underlying real estate market are thus consistent with the public real estate market. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Real Estate Research Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02773 .
summary: 该论文研究建筑和社区层面的集聚（同行业公司聚集）对财产价值的影响。由于集聚在提高生产率的同时也导致租户基础集中，其估值影响在事前并不明确。研究发现，只有当建筑和社区层面的集聚由同行业公司组成时，才存在价值溢价，这代表了资本化的知识溢出外部性。此外，股票市场对交易专门化建筑的房地产投资信托（REITs）给予奖励，表明房地产市场的集聚估值后果与公共房地产市场一致。
ai_comment: 将地理集聚的经济学原理与房地产估值相结合，并验证了公共市场与私人市场的一致性，为资产定价研究提供了新颖的微观视角。

title: Do Mutual Funds Respond to Mechanical Changes in ESG Ratings?
abstract: Using a quasi-experimental setting, we study whether mutual fund investors respond to a purely mechanical change in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings—that is, a change independent of concurrent changes in firms’ actual ESG activities. We find that when a firm experiences a mechanical increase in ESG ratings, the probability of being selected by an ESG fund increases (extensive margin). In contrast, if the firm is already in the fund’s portfolio, its holdings do not change (intensive margin), consistent with portfolio weighting being based on market capitalization. The selection effect is observable not only among funds that follow an ESG index but also among active ESG funds, which presumably should have the resources and ability to identify and filter out the mechanical increase in ESG ratings. Among active ESG funds, the selection effect is stronger for funds with less assets under management, larger portfolios of firms, and lower expense ratios, consistent with the notion that resource constraints may impede a fund’s screening ability. Our findings imply that passive investing based on commercial ESG ratings—whether due to resource constraints or portfolio indexing—might result in portfolio allocations that do not reflect the actual ESG activities of firms. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06184 .
summary: 本文利用准实验设定，研究共同基金投资者是否对ESG评级的纯机械变化（即与公司实际ESG活动变化无关的评级变动）做出反应。研究发现，当公司经历机械性ESG评级上升时，被ESG基金选中的概率增加（广泛边际）；但如果该公司已在基金组合中，持仓比例不会改变（集约边际），这与按市值加权的一致。这种选择效应不仅存在于追踪ESG指数的基金中，也存在于主动型ESG基金中——而主动型基金理论上应有资源识别并过滤这种机械变化。在主动型基金中，选择效应在管理资产较少、公司组合较大、费用率较低的基金中更强，表明资源约束可能阻碍基金的筛选能力。研究结论表明，基于商业ESG评级的被动投资（无论出于资源约束还是指数化）可能导致投资组合分配不能反映公司的实际ESG活动。
ai_comment: 利用准实验方法识别ESG评级机械变化的因果效应，揭示了资源约束在基金筛选中的关键作用，对ESG投资实践具有重要启示。

title: Human Capital Disclosure and Labor Market Outcomes: Evidence from Regulation S‐K
abstract: We examine the labor market consequences of the 2020 Regulation S‐K requiring human capital disclosure in 10K filings. Using large‐sample job‐level data and a Generative Large Language Model (GLLM), we observe that public firms subject to the regulation increase their disclosure of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) information in job postings relative to a matched sample of large private firms. The increase in job‐posting disclosure is more pronounced among firms facing greater external pressure to increase their workforce diversity. These findings suggest a shift in demand for diverse candidates by public firms following the regulation. Yet, consistent with short‐term inelastic labor supply, this demand shift lengthens the recruitment period, with noticeable increases in workplace gender diversity emerging one year after the regulation, particularly among firms that demonstrate a credible commitment to DEI. Our study documents how securities regulations can impact labor market practices and underscores the challenges involved in shaping workforce diversity.
summary: 本文利用大规模职位层面数据和生成式大语言模型（GLLM），研究了2020年Regulation S‐K要求上市公司在10K文件中披露人力资本信息对劳动力市场的影响。研究发现，相对于匹配的大型私营企业，受监管的上市公司在职位发布中增加了多样性、公平和包容性（DEI）信息的披露，且这种增加在面临更大外部压力的公司中更为显著。这表明法规推动了上市公司对多样化候选人的需求转变。然而，由于短期劳动力供给缺乏弹性，招聘周期延长，职场性别多样性在法规实施一年后才出现明显提升，尤其是在那些对DEI做出可信承诺的公司中。该研究揭示了证券法规如何影响劳动力市场实践，并强调了塑造劳动力多样性的挑战。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用GLLM分析职位发布文本，为人力资本披露的经济后果提供了微观证据，并揭示了多样性改进的时间滞后性。

title: Match to Grow
abstract: This study proposes a specific channel through which labor markets facilitate firm growth: the occupational alignment between an establishment’s workforce and local skills. Using occupational employment statistics, we construct an index that compares each establishment’s occupational mix to that of its local market. Establishments with higher alignment grow faster in sales and employment. This growth comes primarily through lower adjustment costs and higher capital investment. We also show that the effects are most pronounced in establishments with a higher share of skilled workers and industries with higher idiosyncratic cash flow risk. This employee–firm matching channel helps explain how local labor markets translate into competitive advantage.
summary: 本研究提出劳动力市场促进企业增长的具体渠道：机构 workforce 与当地技能的职业匹配。利用职业就业统计数据构建指数，比较每个机构的职业组合与其当地市场的职业组合。职业匹配度更高的机构在销售和就业方面增长更快，这一增长主要通过较低的调整成本和更高的资本投资实现。此外，这种效应在熟练工人比例较高的机构以及具有较高特有现金流风险的行业中最为显著。这种员工-企业匹配渠道有助于解释当地劳动力市场如何转化为竞争优势。
ai_comment: 通过构建职业匹配指数，实证了劳动力市场匹配对企业增长的重要性，提供了新视角。

title: Debt and Taxes: The Role of Tax Avoidance
abstract: Empirically, the effect of corporate tax rates on leverage has been smaller than expected based on trade-off theory. In this article, I show that tax avoidance functions as a non-debt tax shield, reducing the benefits of the debt tax shield. I find that higher tax rates cause higher non-debt tax avoidance, which crowds out the debt tax shield. Moreover, I show that the strength of the relationship between debt and tax rates depends on the level of tax avoidance. A 1-standard-deviation higher tax rate implies 2.8% higher leverage for low tax avoidance firms, but has a negative effect for high tax avoidance firms.
summary: 实证发现，公司税率对杠杆率的影响比基于权衡理论的预期要小。本文研究表明，避税作为一种非债务税盾，降低了债务税盾的收益。更高的税率会导致更高的非债务避税，从而挤出了债务税盾。此外，债务与税率之间的关系强度取决于避税水平。对于低避税公司，税率每增加一个标准差，杠杆率提升2.8%；而对于高避税公司，税率增加反而有负效应。
ai_comment: 论文通过将避税作为非债务税盾，巧妙解释了传统权衡理论预测与实证结果的偏差，为资本结构决策提供了新的视角。

title: The Crash Risk in Individual Stocks Embedded in Skewness Swap Returns
abstract: This article investigates crash risk premiums in individual stocks using skewness swaps. These swaps involve buying a stock’s risk-neutral skewness and receiving the realized skewness as a payoff. The strategy’s returns, which measure the skewness risk premium, are found to be consistently large and positive. This suggests investors are concerned about potential crashes in individual stocks and require substantial compensation for bearing this risk. Notably, significant results are mainly observed after the 2007/2009 financial crisis, indicating changes in post-crisis option market dynamics. Cross-sectional determinants of skewness swap returns include measures of systematic crash risk and stock overvaluation.
summary: 本文利用偏度互换（skewness swaps）研究个股中的崩盘风险溢价。偏度互换是一种衍生品合约，投资者买入标的股票的风险中性偏度，并接受已实现偏度作为回报。该策略的回报衡量了偏度风险溢价，研究发现该回报持续大且为正，表明投资者担忧个股可能发生崩盘并要求显著补偿。值得注意的是，显著的结果主要出现在2007/2009年金融危机之后，反映出危机后期权市场动态的变化。此外，偏度互换回报的横截面决定因素包括系统性崩盘风险和股票高估程度。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用偏度互换直接度量个股崩盘风险溢价，揭示了后金融危机时期市场对崩盘风险的定价变化，为理解个股尾部风险提供了新视角。

title: A Tale of Two Banks: When Credit Loss Models Meet Economic Crises
abstract: Policy makers and researchers are concerned that the expected credit loss (ECL) approach may exacerbate procyclicality. Using administrative loan‐level and firm‐level data in China, we find that banks adopting the ECL model reduced their credit supply and became more prudent in lending decisions after the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic, compared to banks using the incurred credit loss (ICL) approach. Our findings are more pronounced for banks that experienced greater loan loss provisions induced by ECL and for firms with higher credit risk. The credit contraction persisted throughout our sample period. We further document that firms more exposed to ECL banks experienced larger reductions in loans, assets, liabilities, and revenue after the pandemic began than those more exposed to ICL banks. These findings support the conjecture that the ECL approach may exacerbate procyclicality.
summary: 本研究关注预期信用损失（ECL）模型可能加剧顺周期性的担忧。利用中国行政级别的贷款和企业数据，论文发现，与采用已发生信用损失（ICL）模型的银行相比，采用ECL模型的银行在COVID-19大流行爆发后减少了信贷供给，并在贷款决策中变得更加谨慎。这一发现在ECL导致贷款损失拨备更大的银行以及信用风险更高的企业中更为显著。信贷收缩在整个样本期间持续存在。此外，与更依赖ICL银行的企业相比，那些更依赖ECL银行的企业在大流行后经历了贷款、资产、负债和收入的更大减少。这些发现支持了ECL方法可能加剧顺周期性的猜想。
ai_comment: 本文利用中国独特的微观数据，为ECL模型在危机中的顺周期效应提供了直接证据，对政策制定和会计准则评估具有重要价值。

title: The Assignment of Intellectual Property Rights and Innovation
abstract: We study how the assignment of intellectual property rights between inventors and their employers affects innovation. Incomplete contracting theories predict that stronger employer property rights reduce the threat that employee inventors hold up their employers, thereby affecting inventor and invention outcomes. We test these predictions using a U.S. appellate court ruling that shifted the assignment of property rights from inventors to their employers. Within‐employer‐year analyses demonstrate that affected inventors are less likely to retain patent rights, assign patents to new employers, or leave their current employer, all consistent with reduced inventor ability to hold up their employers. Due to the reduced possibility of hold‐up, affected inventors’ innovations are revealed more promptly when disclosed, draw from a broader set of prior patents, and spread more to subsequent patents. If affected inventors do leave their employer, they are more likely to relocate to unaffected states. Furthermore, employers affected by the ruling are more likely to locate their inventors in agglomeration economies and alter their innovation strategy by reallocating activity across states and expanding their innovation portfolios. Our collective evidence suggests that shifting intellectual property rights to employers affects inventor and invention outcomes by reducing the threat of employee hold‐up from the employer's perspective.
summary: 本文研究知识产权（IP）在发明人与雇主之间的归属如何影响创新。不完全契约理论预测，更强的雇主产权会减少雇员发明人敲雇主竹杠的威胁，从而影响发明人和发明成果。作者利用美国一项上诉法院裁决（该裁决将产权归属从发明人转向雇主）进行检验。基于雇主-年份层面的分析表明，受影响的发明人保留专利权的可能性降低、将专利转让给新雇主或离职的概率下降，所有这些均与发明人敲雇主竹杠的能力减弱一致。由于敲竹杠的可能性降低，受影响的发明人的创新在披露时更及时，引用更广泛的先前专利，并且更多地被后续专利引用。如果受影响的发明人确实离职，他们更可能迁移到未受裁决影响的州。此外，受裁决影响的雇主更倾向于将发明人布局在集聚经济区，并通过跨州重新配置活动和扩大创新组合来调整创新战略。总体证据表明，将知识产权归属转向雇主会通过减少雇主视角下的雇员敲竹杠威胁来影响发明人和发明成果。
ai_comment: 本文利用一个准自然实验（上诉法院裁决）为知识产权归属对创新的因果效应提供了清晰证据，并揭示了敲竹杠威胁作为传导机制的重要性。

title: CEO Compensation Changes Following Acquisitions
abstract: We find that CEO compensation increases following acquisitions only in those deals in which acquirer stock is used as the method of payment. These compensation increases are driven by increases in equity-based compensation and are concentrated in riskier acquirers, in riskier acquisitions, and in acquirers whose CEOs have low exposure to the stock price. We find little support for traditional agency cost explanations of changes in CEO pay following acquisitions. However, our findings are broadly consistent with compensation changes representing a contracting solution to a two-sided adverse selection problem that is present only in stock acquisitions.
summary: 该论文研究发现，CEO的薪酬在收购后仅在收购方使用股票作为支付方式时才会增加。这种薪酬增加主要由股权薪酬驱动，并且集中在风险更高的收购方、风险更高的收购交易以及CEO对股价风险暴露较低的收购方中。研究结果不支持传统代理成本对收购后CEO薪酬变化的解释，而是支持薪酬变化作为解决仅在股票收购中存在的双向逆向选择问题的合约解决方案。
ai_comment: 本文从逆向选择角度解释收购后CEO薪酬变化，挑战传统代理成本观点，为薪酬合约设计提供了新视角。

title: Can Lending Hierarchies Balance Bias? The Role of Personal Environmental Values in Credit to Green Firms
abstract: How do bankers treat green firms? Using unique loan application and banker preference data from a mid-sized bank, we find that customer managers, serving as front-line bankers, give more favorable recommendations to green firms, especially when they hold green values themselves. However, a minority of environmentally skeptical loan officers, aware through internal training that customer managers generally have greener preferences, counter this by downgrading positive evaluations of green firms. Despite not knowing the customer manager’s identity, these officers use their discretion to mitigate what they perceive as green biases, demonstrating the significant moderating role of superiors within the bank’s hierarchy.
summary: 本研究利用某中型银行的独特贷款申请数据以及银行家的个人偏好数据，探讨银行家如何处理绿色企业。研究发现，作为一线银行家的客户经理更倾向于向绿色企业提供更有利的推荐，尤其是当这些经理自身持有绿色价值观时。然而，少部分对绿色持怀疑态度的贷款官员通过内部培训了解到客户经理普遍倾向于绿色偏好，因此会有意降低对绿色企业的正面评价，试图抵消他们认为的绿色偏见，尽管他们并不知道客户经理的具体身份。这一过程揭示了银行层级中上级官员的显著调节作用。
ai_comment: 该研究基于独特的数据集揭示了银行内部层级如何通过上下级互动来平衡个人偏见，机制设计巧妙，为理解金融机构中的绿色信贷行为提供了新视角。

title: Enhancing Worker Productivity Without Automating Tasks: A Different Approach to AI and the Task-Based Model
abstract: The task-based approach has become the dominant framework for studying the labor-market effects of artificial intelligence (AI), typically emphasizing the replacement of human workers by machines.Motivated by growing empirical evidence that contemporary AI is more often used as a tool that augments workers, this paper develops two related task-based models in which AI enhances worker productivity without automating tasks.Abstracting from capital, we develop a pair of related task-based models that examine how technological progress in AI that provides new tools to augment workers affects aggregate productivity and wage inequality.Both models emphasize the role of human capital in intermediating the effects of AI-related technological shocks.In the first model, AI use requires specialized expertise, and technological progress expands the set of tasks for which such expertise is effective.We show that a larger supply of AI expertise amplifies the productivity gains from improvements in AI technology while attenuating its adverse effects on wage inequality.The second model focuses on non-AI skills, allowing AI tools to alter the set of tasks that workers can perform given their skills.In equilibrium, workers allocate across tasks in response to wages, generating an endogenous distribution of skills across the task space.A central result is that aggregate productivity and wage inequality depend on different global properties of this equilibrium distribution: productivity is particularly sensitive to thinly staffed tasks that create bottlenecks, while wage inequality is driven by the concentration of workers in a narrow set of tasks.As a result, improvements in AI tools can induce non-monotonic co-movement between productivity and inequality.By linking these mechanisms to multidimensional human capital---including AI expertise and higher-order non-AI skills---the paper highlights the role of education and training policies in shaping the economic consequences of AI-driven technological change.
summary: 该论文基于任务基础模型，探讨人工智能（AI）如何在不自动化任务的前提下提升工人生产力。现有研究多强调AI替代劳动力，而本文受实证启发，发展了两个相关模型，聚焦AI作为增强工具的作用。第一个模型假设AI使用需要专业技能，技术进步扩展了这些技能有效的任务范围，研究发现AI专业技能供给的增加会放大生产力提升效应，同时缓解工资不平等。第二个模型关注非AI技能，允许AI工具改变工人根据其技能可执行的任务集。在均衡中，工人根据工资分配任务，形成技能的内生分布。核心结论是：总生产力和工资不平等取决于该分布的不同全局属性——生产力对导致瓶颈的人力不足任务尤为敏感，而工资不平等则由工人集中在少数任务驱动。因此，AI工具的改进可能引发生产力与不平等之间的非单调联动。通过连接多维度人力资本（包括AI专业知识和高阶非AI技能），论文强调了教育和培训政策在塑造AI技术变革经济后果中的作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将AI建模为增强工具而非替代品，精准切入当代AI应用的实际特征；通过区分两类人力资本，揭示了生产力与不平等之间非单调关系的微观机制，为政策制定提供了理论依据。

title: Optimal Use of Preferences in Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
abstract: Machine learning systems embed preferences either in training losses or through post-processing of calibrated predictions.Applying information design methods from Strack and Yang (2024), this paper provides decision-problem-agnostic conditions under which separation-training preference-free and applying preferences ex post is optimal.Unlike prior work that requires specifying downstream objectives, the welfare results here apply uniformly across decision problems.The key primitive is a diminishing-value-of-information condition: relative to a fixed (normalised) preference-free loss, preference embedding makes informativeness less valuable at the margin, inducing a mean-preserving contraction of learned posteriors.Because the value of information is convex in beliefs, preference-free training weakly dominates for any expected-utility decision problem.This provides theoretical foundations for modular AI pipelines that learn calibrated probabilities and implement asymmetric costs through downstream decision rules.However, separation requires users to implement optimal decision rules.When cognitive constraints bind-as documented in human-AI decision-making-preference embedding can dominate by automating threshold computation.These results provide design guidance: preserve optionality through postprocessing when objectives may shift; embed preferences when decisionstage frictions dominate.
summary: 论文研究机器学习算法中偏好的最优使用方式。系统可以通过在训练损失中嵌入偏好或对校准预测进行后处理来纳入偏好。本文应用Strack和Yang（2024）的信息设计方法，给出了在决策问题无关条件下，分离（即偏好无训练与事后应用偏好）是最优的条件。不同于先前需要指定下游目标的工作，这里的福利结果统一适用于所有决策问题。关键基础是信息价值递减条件：相对于固定的（标准化）偏好无损失，偏好嵌入使得信息在边际上价值降低，从而导致学习后验的均值保持收缩。由于信息价值在信念上是凸的，偏好无训练在任何期望效用决策问题中弱占优。这为模块化AI流程提供了理论基础，该流程学习校准概率并通过下游决策规则实现非对称成本。然而，分离需要用户实施最优决策规则。当认知约束（如在人-AI决策中记录的那样）起作用时，偏好嵌入可以通过自动计算阈值来占优。这些结果为设计提供了指导：当目标可能变化时，通过后处理保留可选性；当决策阶段摩擦占主导时，嵌入偏好。
ai_comment: 本文为AI系统中偏好使用的模块化设计提供了严谨的理论基础，尤其强调了决策环境不确定性下的策略选择。

title: AI and the Quantity and Quality of Creative Products: Have LLMs Boosted Creation of Valuable Books?
abstract: With the diffusion of LLMs between 2022 and 2025, new book releases have tripled, raising a question of AI's impact on book quality.We develop a ratings-based usage measure that is comparable across book release vintages, and we find that the vintages from the AI influx period have lower average quality.Yet, the top 1,000 monthly releases per category -albeit not the top 100 -have higher quality than before; and the effect is larger in categories with faster growth in new titles.Authors entering since the LLM influx produce predominantly low-quality work; and the higher-quality output of pre-LLM authors entrants has risen.A nested logit calibration shows that LLM-enhanced book production could, in steady state, raise the surplus that consumers derive from book markets by a quarter to a half.
summary: 该论文研究了2022年至2025年间大型语言模型（LLM）的扩散对图书创作数量和质量的影响。数据显示新书发布数量增长了三倍，但平均质量有所下降。然而，每个类别月度前1000本（而非前100本）新书的质量相比以前有所提升，且这种提升在新书增长较快的类别中更为显著。进一步分析发现，LLM扩散后新进入的作者主要创作低质量作品，而原有作者的高质量产出有所增加。通过嵌套logit模型校准，论文估计在稳态下，LLM增强的图书生产可使消费者从图书市场获得的剩余提高四分之一到一半。
ai_comment: 该研究利用实际数据量化了LLM对创意产业的影响，揭示了数量激增下质量分化的现象，并为AI的经济效应提供了新证据。

title: Audit Centralization and Audit Quality: Evidence from Chinese Cities
abstract: Audit design invokes a tradeoff between a monitor's local knowledge and their independence from influence.We study this tradeoff in the context of a pilot program in six Chinese provinces in 2016, in which provincial governments were given control over budgeting and personnel decisions for city audits.Using a difference-in-differences framework we show that, compared to non-pilot provinces, centralization increases detection of suspicious expenditures by over 50%.These improvements occur also in cities with auditors appointed pre-2016, suggesting that stronger incentives and greater resources rather than auditor selection explain the improvements.Consistent with this interpretation, we find that financial (but not human) resources devoted to city audits increase with centralization.Further results show that centralization's benefits are strongest in provinces that centralized audit office financing as part of the reform -particularly in poorer citiessuggesting a role for resources in improved performance.
summary: 该论文研究审计集中化对审计质量的影响，以中国六个省份2016年实施的试点项目为背景，在该试点中省级政府获得对城市审计预算和人事的控制权。通过双重差分法，作者发现与试点省份相比，集中化使可疑支出的检测率提高了超过50%。这种改善也出现在2016年之前任命的审计师所在城市，表明改善源于更强的激励和更多的资源，而非审计师选择。进一步发现，集中化增加了城市审计的财务资源（但非人力资源），而集中化的收益在作为改革一部分而集中了审计办公室融资的省份中最强，尤其是在较穷的城市，这突出了资源在提升绩效中的作用。
ai_comment: 论文利用中国自然实验，清晰识别了审计集中化对质量的影响，并区分了激励与资源渠道，对公共财政和审计治理有重要意义。

title: A Macroeconomic Perspective on Stock Market Valuation Ratios
abstract: Traditional valuation metrics for the U.S. stock market based on a comparison of the aggregate market value of U.S. corporations to measures of dividends, earnings, output, and the replacement cost of measured capital have been above historical norms for the past 25-30 years.Will they return to their historical means?We use macroeconomic data to argue that the observed decline in labor's share of corporate output in conjunction with relatively weak corporate investment mechanically generates a persistent rise in the ratio of corporate valuation relative to corporate earnings, even absent any changes in expected returns or growth rates.
summary: 本文研究美国股票市场估值比率（如市值与股息、盈利、产出及重置成本之比）在过去25-30年持续高于历史均值的问题。作者使用宏观经济数据论证，观察到劳动收入占企业产出份额下降以及企业投资相对疲弱，这两种现象机械地导致企业估值相对于盈利的比率持久上升，即使预期回报率或增长率没有发生变化。该结论表明估值比率可能不会回归历史均值。
ai_comment: 本文从宏观经济结构变化角度解释估值比率持续偏高，挑战了传统均值回归观点，为理解长期市场估值提供了新视角。

title: Behavioral Economics of AI: LLM Biases and Corrections
abstract: Do generative AI models, particularly large language models (LLMs), exhibit systematic behavioral biases in economic and financial decisions?If so, how can these biases be mitigated?Drawing on the cognitive psychology and experimental economics literatures, we conduct the most comprehensive set of experiments to date-originally designed to document human biases-on prominent LLM families across model versions and scales.We document systematic patterns in LLM behavior.In preference-based tasks, responses become more human-like as models become more advanced or larger, while in belief-based tasks, advanced large-scale models frequently generate rational responses.Prompting LLMs to make rational decisions reduces biases.
summary: 本研究探讨生成式AI模型（尤其是大型语言模型LLMs）在经济和金融决策中是否表现出系统性行为偏差，以及如何缓解这些偏差。基于认知心理学和实验经济学文献，研究对多个主流LLM系列（涵盖不同版本和规模）进行了迄今为止最全面的实验，这些实验最初是为记录人类偏差而设计的。结果发现LLM行为存在系统性模式：在基于偏好的任务中，模型越先进/规模越大，其反应越接近人类；而在基于信念的任务中，先进的大规模模型经常产生理性反应。提示LLM做出理性决策可以减少偏差。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模实验系统揭示了LLM在决策中的行为模式，并提出了简单的提示策略来纠正偏差，为AI在金融等领域的应用提供了重要参考。

title: Does Generative AI Crowd Out Human Creators? Evidence from Pixiv
abstract: Using a comprehensive dataset of posts from a major platform for anime-and manga-style artwork, we study the impact of the launch of a prominent text-to-image generative AI.Focusing on the majority of incumbent creators who do not adopt AI as a primary tool, we show that the AI launch led to a significant decline in post uploads by illustrators, whereas comic artists were less affected, reflecting the need for tight stylistic alignment across sequential images in comics.We present empirical evidence for two underlying mechanisms.First, illustration posts experience a loss of viewer attention, measured by bookmarks, following the AI launch, which can significantly harm creators' business models.Second, direct competition from AI-generated content plays an important role: illustrators working on intellectual properties (IPs, such as Pokmon) that are more heavily invaded by AI reduce their uploads disproportionately more.We further examine creators' responses and show that illustrators with greater exposure to AI avoid using tags favored by AIgenerated content after the AI launch and broaden the range of IPs they work on, consistent with a risk-hedging response to AI invasion.
summary: 使用来自主要动漫风格艺术作品平台Pixiv的全面数据集，研究文本到图像生成式AI的推出对非采用AI的人类创作者的影响。结果显示，AI推出导致插画家上传量显著下降，而漫画家受影响较小，因为漫画需要连续图像间的风格一致性。实证表明两种机制：观众注意力（书签）减少损害创作者商业模式，以及直接竞争（如Pokémon等IP被AI入侵严重的插画家上传减少更多）。创作者反应包括避免使用AI生成内容偏好的标签，并扩大他们工作的IP范围，以对冲AI入侵风险。
ai_comment: 该研究利用自然实验揭示了生成式AI对创意平台创作者福利的负面影响，并识别出注意力流失和直接竞争两种机制，以及创作者的策略性规避行为，为AI监管和平台设计提供了重要证据。

title: Speculative Growth and the AI "Bubble"
abstract: AI technology can generate speculative-growth equilibria.These are rational but fragile: elevated valuations support rapid capital accumulation, yet persist only as long as beliefs remain coordinated.Because AI capital is labor-like, it expands effective labor and dampens the normal decline in the marginal product of capital as the capital stock grows.The gains from this expansion accrue disproportionately to capitalists, whose saving rate rises with wealth, raising aggregate saving.Building on Caballero et al ( 2006), I show that these features generate a funding feedback -rising capitalist wealth lowers the required return-that can produce multiple equilibria.With intermediate adjustment costs, elevated valuations are the mechanism that sustains a transition toward a high-capital equilibrium; a loss of confidence can precipitate a self-fulfilling crash and reversal.
summary: 本文研究AI技术如何引发投机性增长均衡。这种均衡是理性的但脆弱：高估值支持快速资本积累，但仅当市场信念保持一致时才能持续。由于AI资本具有类似劳动力的特性，它能扩大有效劳动供给，减缓资本存量增长时资本边际产品的正常下降。资本扩张带来的收益不成比例地流向资本家，其储蓄率随财富增加而上升，从而提高总储蓄。基于Caballero等人（2006）的框架，本文证明这些特征会形成资金反馈机制——资本家财富上升降低所需回报率——进而导致多重均衡。在中等调整成本下，高估值成为维持向高资本均衡转型的机制；而信心丧失可能引发自我实现的崩溃和逆转。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将AI资本的类劳动力特性与投机性增长结合，揭示了估值与资本积累之间的资金反馈机制，为理解AI泡沫的理性基础和脆弱性提供了新视角。

title: Financial Crises: History, Theory and New Insights
abstract: This review essay discusses the history, causes and consequences of financial crises.In recent years scholars have assembled new sources of data and utilized new empirical designs to analyze crises, shedding light on old questions and producing new insights.This essay highlights those new insights, and uses the historical record of crises in the United States to put those insights into perspective.I begin with a discussion of the defining characteristics of financial crises and their evolution, both in the U.S. and in the rest of the world.I then revisit the chronology of crises in the U.S. since 1870.Data on bank failure rates and large-bank equity losses suggest that some panics were not full-blown financial crises, and also identify episodes when no panic occurred that could potentially be considered crises.I then turn to two categories of theoretical models developed to analyze the mechanisms responsible for crises.The first focuses on asset price bubbles, which have been associated with many crises.The second is focused on the dynamics of bank runs and panics, which have been especially common in the United States.Finally, I present an overview of the effects of crises and the mechanisms transmitting financial distress in the banking system into the rest of the economy.
summary: 这篇综述文章讨论了金融危机的历史、成因和后果。近年来，学者们整理了新的数据来源并利用新的实证设计来分析危机，阐明了旧问题并产生了新见解。文章重点突出这些新见解，并利用美国历史上的危机记录将这些见解置于背景中。首先讨论金融危机在美国及世界其他地区的定义特征和演变。然后回顾美国自1870年以来的危机年表，使用银行倒闭率和大型银行股权损失的数据表明，一些恐慌并非完全的金融危机，同时也识别出没有发生恐慌但可能被认为是危机的时期。接着转向两类用于分析危机机制的理论模型：第一类关注与许多危机相关的资产价格泡沫；第二类聚焦于在美国尤其常见的银行挤兑和恐慌的动态。最后，概述危机的影响以及银行体系中的金融困境传导至经济其他部门的机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过整合历史数据与理论模型，为理解金融危机的本质和演化提供了新视角，尤其是对美国危机的细致分类具有参考价值。

title: Measuring Efficiency and Equity Framing in Economics Research: LLM-Based Evidence from 1950 to 2021
FinTech and Customer Capital
abstract: Financial Technology ("FinTech") firms invest significantly more in customer capital relative to traditional financial firms, and such investment builds valuable customer capital.Higher investment by FinTech firms is not accounted for by sectoral focus or differences in firm age.Reasons for higher customer capital investment are explored, including the need to build trust with customers, the focus on downstream segments of the financial marketplace, the operation of platform-based business models, and a heavier reliance on valuable customer data.
summary: 本文研究金融科技（FinTech）公司相对于传统金融公司在客户资本上的投资差异。实证发现FinTech公司在客户资本上的投资显著更高，且这种投资构建了有价值的客户资本。更高的投资不能用行业聚焦或公司年龄差异来解释。文章进一步探讨了驱动更高客户资本投资的原因，包括建立客户信任、专注于金融市场的下游环节、基于平台的商业模式运营，以及对有价值客户数据的更大依赖。
ai_comment: 论文系统性地揭示了FinTech公司在客户资本上的独特投资模式及其背后的商业逻辑，为理解金融科技公司的竞争优势提供了新视角。

title: AI in Charge: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence on Electric Vehicle Charging Demand
