This puzzle arises because standard equilibrium models with belief differences predict a strong link between asset return disagreement and fundamental disagreement, a link not supported by the data. We address this puzzle by introducing a model where disagreement about future demand for savings—driven by disagreement over the prevalence of patient versus impatient investors in the economy—generates asset return disagreement. Our mechanism produces stochastic yield volatility, time-varying bond risk premia, and an upward-sloping yield curve. Empirically, we construct a proxy for demand disagreement by isolating the component of yield disagreement unrelated to disagreement about macro-fundamentals. This proxy is positively related to yields and their volatilities, and predicts future bond risk premia, consistent with the predictions of our demand disagreement model.
summary: 现有研究表明，关于宏观经济基本面的分歧只能部分解释对未来利率的分歧，形成一个“分歧相关性”谜题。这是因为标准均衡模型假设信念差异会导致资产回报分歧与基本面分歧之间的强相关性，但数据并不支持这一关系。为解决该谜题，本文构建了一个模型，其中关于未来储蓄需求的分歧——源于经济中耐心投资者与不耐心投资者比例的分歧——驱动资产回报分歧。该机制能够产生随机的收益率波动、时变的债券风险溢价以及向上倾斜的收益率曲线。在实证方面，本文通过分离出与宏观基本面分歧无关的收益率分歧成分，构建了需求分歧的代理变量。该代理变量与收益率及其波动性正相关，并能预测未来的债券风险溢价，与需求分歧模型的预测一致。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地提出“需求分歧”概念，从投资者异质性角度破解了利率分歧的谜题，理论模型与实证检验相互印证，为债券市场定价机制提供了新视角。

title: Discount factors and monetary policy: Evidence from dual-listed stocks
abstract: This paper studies the transmission of monetary policy to the stock market through investors’ discount factors. To isolate this channel, we investigate the effect of US monetary policy surprises on the ratio of prices of the same stock listed simultaneously in Hong Kong and Mainland China. We identify a strong discount rate channel driven exclusively by cycle-amplifying surprises, defined as rate cuts during easing cycles and surprise hikes during tightening cycles. A 100 basis point of such cycle-amplifying surprise induces a 30 basis point change in the price ratio within five days.
summary: 本文研究货币政策如何通过投资者的折现因子传导至股票市场。为隔离这一渠道，作者考察了美国货币政策冲击对同时在香港和内地上市的同只股票价格比率的影响。研究发现存在一个强劲的折现率渠道，且该渠道完全由周期放大冲击驱动——即在宽松周期中的降息和紧缩周期中的意外加息。一个100基点的周期放大冲击会在5天内导致价格比率变化30个基点。
ai_comment: 利用双重上市股票巧妙分离折现因子渠道，实证识别了货币政策对股市的非对称影响机制。

title: Policy uncertainty reduces green innovation
abstract: Policy uncertainty can undermine the power of government subsidies to stimulate environmentally friendly research and development. We show that Chinese firms’ green R&D falls as the uncertainty of environmental subsidies rises: Exogenous, weather-driven air pollution variability induces subsidies to fluctuate, and firms in areas with high weather-driven subsidy variability undertake less green R&D and hire fewer technical employees, controlling for the average level of subsidies. Heavy emitters and environmental technology firms are more affected. The results also illustrate how policy uncertainty can arise when policymakers are influenced by conditions that are salient but with causes that are difficult to disentangle.
summary: 该论文研究政策不确定性如何削弱政府补贴对绿色创新的激励作用。利用中国数据，作者发现环境补贴的不确定性（由外生的天气驱动的空气污染波动导致）会显著降低企业的绿色研发投入和技术人员雇佣，即使控制平均补贴水平后结果依然成立。重排放企业和环保技术企业受影响更大。研究还揭示了政策制定者受显著但原因难以区分的条件影响时，政策不确定性如何产生。
ai_comment: 利用外生天气波动识别补贴不确定性的因果效应，为政策不确定性对绿色创新的影响提供了新颖且稳健的证据。

title: Institutions’ return expectations across assets and time
abstract: We study the equity, cash, and corporate bond risk premium expectations of asset managers, investment consultants, wealth advisors, public pension funds, and professional forecasters. Subjective risk premia vary one-to-one with objective risk premia that are available in real time and countercyclical. Despite their significant time-series variation, several subjective equity premia vary more in the cross-section of institutions than in the time series. This heterogeneity persists both over time and across asset classes. We tie the heterogeneity in subjective equity return expectations to heterogeneous expectations about long-term equity valuations: some institutions believe that the price–earnings ratio behaves like a random walk, whereas others believe in varying degrees of mean reversion.
summary: 该论文研究了资产管理公司、投资顾问、财富顾问、公共养老金和专业预测者对股票、现金和公司债券的风险溢价预期。研究发现，主观风险溢价与实时可得的客观风险溢价呈一一对应关系且具有逆周期性。尽管主观股票溢价在时间序列上有显著变化，但不同机构之间的横截面差异更大，且这种异质性在时间跨度和资产类别中持续存在。作者进一步将主观股票收益预期的异质性归因于对长期股票估值的不同信念：一些机构认为市盈率服从随机游走，而另一些则相信不同程度的均值回归。
ai_comment: 论文通过揭示机构投资者预期的巨大异质性及其与估值信念的关联，为理解资产定价中的主观预期提供了新视角，并强调了横截面差异比时间序列变化更为显著。

title: Policy news and stock market volatility
abstract: We use newspapers to create Equity Market Volatility (EMV) trackers at daily and monthly frequencies. Our headline EMV tracker moves closely with the VIX and the S&P500 returns volatility in and out of sample. We exploit the volume of newspaper text to construct forty category-specific EMV trackers. News about commodity markets, interest rates, real estate markets, aggregate activity, and inflation figure prominently in EMV articles. Policy news is another major source of market volatility: 30 % of EMV articles discuss tax policy, 30 % discuss monetary policy, and 25 % refer to some form of regulation. Combining our newspaper-based trackers with textual analysis of 10-K filings, we obtain monthly firm-level risk exposure measures. These measures help explain the cross-sectional structure of realized volatilities and its evolution over time, even after conditioning on firm and time fixed effects.
summary: 本文利用报纸文本构建了日度和月度频率的股票市场波动率（EMV）跟踪器。主EMV跟踪器在样本内外均与VIX和S&P500收益率波动紧密相关。通过分析报纸文本量，文章构建了40个类别特定的EMV跟踪器，发现商品市场、利率、房地产市场、总体活动和通货膨胀相关的新闻在EMV文章中占显著地位。政策新闻是市场波动的另一个主要来源：30%的EMV文章讨论税收政策，30%讨论货币政策，25%涉及某种形式的监管。将基于报纸的跟踪器与10-K文件的文本分析相结合，文章获得了月度公司层面的风险暴露度量。这些度量有助于解释实现波动率的横截面结构及其随时间演变，即使在控制了公司和时间固定效应后仍然有效。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用报纸文本构建高频波动率跟踪器，并揭示了政策新闻的重要作用，结合公司文本分析为解释波动率横截面提供了新工具。

title: Implicit extrapolation and the beliefs channel of investment demand
abstract: We document implicit extrapolation in investment decision-making that exceeds the extrapolation inferable from stated expectations. Locally experienced returns predict individual real-estate investment decisions even conditional on an investor’s forecasted home-price growth and risk aversion. Moreover, estimates of this experience effect on investment are larger than implied by the combined effect of past returns on stated expectations and stated expectations on investment. We demonstrate that heterogeneous forecast confidence helps explain why many investors rely on past returns over their survey-elicited forecasts. As their rationale, such survey respondents frequently cite intentional extrapolation or a lack of confidence in other belief factors.
summary: 本文记录了投资决策中存在的隐式外推现象，其程度超过了从投资者陈述的预期中可推断的外推。具体而言，个人投资者基于本地经验回报做出的房地产投资决策，即使在控制了其对房价增长和风险厌恶的预测后，仍受过去回报的显著影响。进一步地，过去回报对投资决策的经验效应，大于过去回报对陈述预期的影响与陈述预期对投资决策影响的联合效应。研究表明，异质的预测信心有助于解释为何许多投资者依赖过去回报而非调查引出的预测；受访者常将其归因于有意外推或对其他信念因素缺乏信心。
ai_comment: 该论文通过揭示投资者实际行为与陈述预期之间的系统性偏差，并引入异质信心作为解释机制，深化了对投资决策中信念渠道的理解，具有重要的理论和现实意义。

title: The canary in the coal decline: Appalachian household finance and the transition from fossil fuels
abstract: We use individual-level credit data to study how recent declines in Appalachian coal mining affected household finances between 2011 and 2018. Using exogenous variation in electricity sector demand for coal, we find declines in coal demand decreased credit scores and increased financial distress within two years of coal shocks. These effects cannot be explained solely by job losses in coal mine worker households. Credit score declines and financial distress were largest among older individuals and people with lower-middle credit scores. Our results suggest the transition away from fossil fuels may impose meaningful costs on other fossil fuel extraction communities.
summary: 本文利用个人层面的信用数据，研究2011年至2018年间阿巴拉契亚地区煤炭开采业下滑对家庭财务的影响。通过利用电力部门对煤炭需求的外生变化，我们发现煤炭需求下降在煤炭冲击后的两年内降低了信用评分并增加了财务困境。这些影响不能仅用煤矿工人家庭的失业来解释。信用评分下降和财务困境在老年人和中低收入信用评分人群中最为显著。我们的结果表明，从化石燃料转型可能对其他化石燃料开采社区造成显著成本。
ai_comment: 论文利用微观信用数据揭示了能源转型对家庭财务的潜在成本，并区分了就业损失之外的更广泛影响，对政策制定有重要启示。

title: When Two Become One: Foreign Capital and Household Credit Expansion
abstract: Rapid credit expansions predict lower output growth and banking crises, but does it matter who finances them? We identify the ultimate counterparties financing credit expansions in a panel of 33 advanced economies and find that foreign-financed household credit expansions predict lower GDP growth and higher crisis risk, but domestically financed credit expansions do not. Studying the mechanisms, we find that foreign-financed household credit expansions are accompanied by higher supply of foreign capital (reflected in low credit spreads), are followed by elevated credit cycle reversal risk, and lead to higher debt service payments to foreigners which depress aggregate demand.
summary: 这篇论文利用33个发达经济体的面板数据，识别了信贷扩张的最终对手方，并研究了外国资本与国内资本在家庭信贷扩张中的不同影响。结果发现，由外国资本融资的家庭信贷扩张会预测更低的GDP增长和更高的银行危机风险，而国内融资的信贷扩张则没有这种效应。机制分析表明，外国融资的家庭信贷扩张伴随着更高的外国资本供给（反映在低信用利差上），随后信贷周期逆转风险上升，并且导致对外债务支付增加，从而抑制总需求。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分国内外融资来源，揭示了外国资本在家庭信贷扩张中的关键负面作用，为理解金融危机预警指标提供了新视角。

title: The Intangibles Song in Takeover Announcements: Good Tempo, Hollow Tune
abstract: Mergers and acquisitions are often motivated by an intention to create value from intangible assets. We develop a word list of intangibles and apply it to takeover announcements. One standard deviation more in intangible-related language (“intangibles talk”) lowers announcement returns for the acquirer by 0.53 percentage points and predicts worse operating performance. Bidder managers appear to believe in the deals nonetheless, as evidenced by insider trades, payment choices, and completion probabilities and speed. Overall, takeover announcement texts reveal important information about hard-to-measure aspects of deal quality.
summary: 这篇论文研究了并购公告中关于无形资产的语言（“intangibles talk”）对收购方股东回报和后续运营绩效的影响。作者首先构建了一份无形资产相关词汇列表，然后将其应用于并购公告文本分析。研究发现，无形资产相关语言每增加一个标准差，收购方在公告日的累计异常回报（CAR）将降低0.53个百分点，并且这些交易在后续期间表现出更差的运营业绩。尽管市场反应负面，但收购方管理层似乎仍对交易抱有信念，这体现在内部人交易行为、支付方式选择以及交易完成概率和速度上。总体而言，并购公告的文本内容揭示了关于交易质量的难以直接衡量的重要信息。
ai_comment: 该论文通过文本分析量化了并购公告中无形资产相关表述的经济后果，揭示了管理层乐观与市场悲观之间的有趣分歧，为理解并购价值创造提供了新视角。

title: Agglomeration Effects in Initial Public Offerings
abstract: We show that the decision to go public is influenced by spatial variation in the supply of equity financing. We measure the amount of capital of equity investors in each U.S. region and document that the incidence of initial public offerings (IPOs) by intangible-intensive resident firms increases significantly when regional equity capital is abundant. Using a novel empirical strategy and hand-collected data on out-of-state pension flows, we confirm that our findings are not due to underlying regional factors.
summary: 本文研究了IPO决策如何受股权融资空间供给的影响。通过衡量美国各地区的股权投资者资本量，发现当区域股权资本充裕时，当地无形资产密集型企业的IPO显著增加。采用基于外州养老金流的手工收集数据的新颖实证策略，验证了这一结果并非由潜在的区域因素驱动。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将空间集聚效应引入IPO决策分析，为区域金融供给对企业融资行为的影响提供了新证据。

title: Price Rigidities and Credit Risk
abstract: We develop a capital structure model in which firms differ in their ability to adjust output prices. Firms with inflexible prices are more exposed to nominal and real shocks, leading to lower leverage, shorter debt maturity, higher cost of debt, tighter covenants, and greater precautionary cash holdings. Shocks to cash flow volatility raise the cost of debt more for firms with less pricing flexibility. We empirically confirm these predictions: Firms with inflexible prices experience significantly larger increases in credit spreads following monetary policy shocks and the 2008 Lehman Brothers bankruptcy, especially when they face high preshock rollover risk.
summary: 论文构建了一个资本结构模型，假设企业在调整产出价格的能力（价格刚性）上存在差异。模型显示，价格不灵活的企业更容易受到名义冲击和实际冲击的影响，从而导致它们选择更低的杠杆率、更短的债务期限、更高的债务成本、更严格的债务契约以及持有更多的预防性现金。同时，现金流波动性的增加会更大程度地提高定价灵活性较低企业的债务成本。实证分析支持了这些理论预测：在货币政策冲击和2008年雷曼兄弟破产事件后，价格不灵活企业的信用利差显著上升，尤其是当它们面临较高的事前展期风险时。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将产品市场价格刚性与企业资本结构决策联系起来，并通过理论和实证双重证据表明价格刚性在风险传导中的放大作用，为理解企业融资决策提供了新视角。

title: Mortgage Design, Repayment Schedules, and Household Borrowing
abstract: How does the design of debt repayment schedules affect household borrowing? To answer this question, we exploit a Swedish policy reform that eliminated interest-only mortgages for loan-to-value ratios above 50%. We document substantial bunching at the threshold, leading to 5% lower borrowing. Wealthy borrowers drive the results, challenging credit constraints as the primary explanation. We develop a model to evaluate the mechanisms driving household behavior and find that much of the effect comes from households experiencing ongoing flow disutility to amortization payments. Our results indicate that mortgage contracts with low initial payments substantially increase household borrowing and lifetime interest costs.
summary: 本文利用瑞典的一项政策改革（取消了贷款价值比超过50%的只付利息抵押贷款）来研究债务偿还计划的设计如何影响家庭借款。研究发现，在政策阈值处出现了显著的信贷聚集现象，导致借款减少5%，且这一结果主要由富裕借款人驱动，挑战了信贷约束作为主要解释的观点。通过构建模型评估机制，发现大部分效应源于家庭对摊销支付的持续流动负效用。结论表明，低初始支付的抵押贷款合同会显著增加家庭借款和终身利息成本。
ai_comment: 本文利用自然实验识别了抵押贷款偿还计划对家庭借款的因果效应，并通过模型揭示了流动负效用的关键作用，为政策制定提供了重要参考。

title: Financial Restructuring and Resolution of Banks
abstract: How do resolution frameworks affect the private restructuring of distressed banks? We model a bank’s shareholders and creditors negotiating a restructuring, under two frictions: asymmetric information about asset quality and externalities on the government. High-quality banks signal themselves by delaying the negotiation, which is socially inefficient. Public policies can improve welfare if they reduce the signaling motive or increase the negotiation surplus. Stricter bail-in rules make debt more information sensitive and increase delays. The bank chooses a capital structure with too little renegotiable debt, giving a new rationale, for example, for Total Loss Absorbing Capacity requirements.
summary: 这篇论文构建了一个理论模型，研究银行处置框架如何影响困境银行的私人重组过程。模型中，银行股东和债权人就重组进行谈判，面临两个主要摩擦：关于资产质量的信息不对称和对政府的外部性。高质量银行通过延迟谈判来发出信号，但这会导致社会效率损失。公共政策可以通过降低信号动机或增加谈判盈余来提升社会福利。更严格的保释金规则使债务更具信息敏感性，从而加剧延迟。银行选择的资本结构中可重组债务过少，这为总损失吸收能力要求提供了新的理论依据。
ai_comment: 论文将信息不对称和外部性纳入银行重组谈判模型，为理解处置框架对效率的影响提供了新视角，并对监管政策（如保释金和TLAC）给出了理论解释。

title: Bank Lending and Market-Based Finance for Corporations: The Effects of Minibond Issuances for Unlisted Firms
abstract: What are the benefits of access to the bond market for unlisted firms, and how does it affect their bank lending conditions? Using a regulatory reform that allowed unlisted firms to issue minibonds, we address these questions comparing new bank loans to issuers with concurrent loans to matched non-issuers. After the first minibond issuance, issuers obtain lower interest rates on bank loans of similar maturity, largely reflecting a shift in the seniority structure of corporate debt, and reduce the use of bank loans while increasing their total financial debt. They also increase turnover, total and fixed assets, particularly intangible assets.
summary: 该论文研究了非上市企业进入债券市场（通过发行迷你债券）的好处及其对银行贷款条件的影响。利用一项允许非上市企业发行迷你债券的监管改革，作者比较了发行企业与匹配的非发行企业在首次发行后的新银行贷款。结果发现，发行企业获得了利率更低的银行贷款（期限相似），这主要反映了公司债务优先结构的变化；同时，它们减少了银行贷款的使用，增加了总金融债务。此外，发行企业的营业额、总资产和固定资产（尤其是无形资产）也有所增长。
ai_comment: 该研究利用准自然实验有效识别了债券市场准入对非上市企业融资结构及实际活动的影响，揭示了债务优先顺序变化在降低银行贷款成本中的关键作用。

title: The Zombie Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
abstract: We identify a new channel in the monetary policy transmission to nonfinancial corporates—the zombie lending channel. Our findings show that unviable and unproductive zombie firms are less affected by contractionary monetary policy relative to other firms because of a more muted tightening in credit conditions. We rationalize this result with a strengthening in evergreening motives when interest rates rise: lenders face incentives to extend loans to zombies to prevent them from defaulting. Strengthening banks’ balance sheets and curbing risky lending behavior could help mitigate zombie lending practices when financial conditions tighten. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07315 .
summary: 本文识别了货币政策向非金融企业传导的一个新渠道——僵尸借贷渠道。研究发现，相对于其他企业，无法生存且低效率的僵尸企业在紧缩性货币政策下受到的影响更小，这是因为其信贷条件收紧的幅度更为温和。作者将此结果归因于利率上升时银行展期动机的增强：银行有动机向僵尸企业发放贷款以防止其违约。加强银行的资产负债表并抑制风险借贷行为有助于在金融条件收紧时缓解僵尸借贷行为。
ai_comment: 该论文提出了货币政策传导中的一个新机制，即僵尸借贷渠道，并揭示了利率上升时银行行为的独特性，对理解货币政策的非对称效应和金融稳定有重要启示。

title: Platform Expansion Through Asset Provision: Ownership, Commitment, and Flexibility
abstract: Service platforms connect consumers to independent providers, who typically deliver the service using their own assets (e.g., ride-hailing with suitable vehicles). To expand their services, platforms have introduced programs aimed at attracting prospective providers who lack the requisite assets. These programs diverge in terms of asset ownership and contract structures. In platform financing, the platform offers to finance providers’ asset investments, serving as an alternative to bank loans. Under employment and rental schemes, by contrast, the platform itself invests in assets and offers them to providers through long-term employment-like contracts or short-term rentals. We develop a game-theoretical model to study the viability and relative performance of these mechanisms. With bank financing as benchmark, we find that although each mechanism can be profitable, they also face distinct challenges. For example, platform financing often fails to benefit the platform in its simple interest-only form and instead requires payments tied to providers’ on-platform performance. Comparing these mechanisms highlights a tradeoff between the platform committing to a mutually beneficial contract with the providers and leveraging their flexibility as independent service providers. Consequently, the platform prefers the strongest commitment option—employment—when demand is high and investment cost is low and turns to the flexible financing or rental options as demand weakens or investment cost increases. Additionally, we find that minimum-wage regulation could benefit not only service providers but also the platform, particularly under financing or rental. Finally, when the providers’ outside options rely less on access to assets, employment gains ground as the preferred expansion strategy. This paper was accepted by Victor Martinez de Albeniz, operations management. Funding: S. A. Yang is funded by the Research and Material Development Fund at London Business School. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00170 .
summary: 本文研究服务平台如何通过资产提供机制吸引缺乏必要资产的潜在服务提供者，以扩张业务。作者开发了一个博弈论模型，以银行融资为基准，比较了平台融资（平台为提供者投资资产）、雇佣（平台长期雇佣提供者）和租赁（平台短期出租资产）三种机制的可行性和相对绩效。研究发现：每种机制均可盈利，但面临不同挑战。例如，简单的平台融资（仅利息）通常对平台无益，需要与提供者的平台内绩效挂钩。各机制之间存在承诺与灵活性的权衡：当需求高且投资成本低时，平台偏好承诺最强的雇佣；当需求减弱或投资成本上升时，转向灵活的平台融资或租赁。此外，最低工资监管可能使提供者和平台都受益，尤其在平台融资或租赁下。当提供者的外部选择较少依赖资产时，雇佣成为更优的扩张策略。
ai_comment: 该文通过精妙的模型揭示了平台扩张中承诺与灵活性的核心权衡，并提供了具有操作性的策略指导，尤其对最低工资监管的非预期影响给出了新颖解读。

title: Investment under Upstream and Downstream Uncertainty
abstract: The impact of uncertainty shocks on firm‐level economic activity depends on their origin in supply chains. Upstream (downstream) uncertainty from suppliers (customers) is associated with variability over future input (output) prices. Consequently, a real‐option production model with time‐to‐build suggests that only upstream uncertainty suppresses investment, since upstream (downstream) uncertainty affects the shorter (longer) run. Production network data show that upstream uncertainty negatively affects firm‐level outcomes. Conversely, downstream uncertainty affects firm‐level outcomes more weakly but positively. At the macro level, these two uncertainties oppositely predict aggregate growth and asset prices. Overall, downstream uncertainty has an expansionary effect, in contrast to other facets of uncertainty.
summary: 本文研究供应链中上游和下游不确定性冲击对企业投资的影响。作者构建了一个考虑建设时间的实物期权生产模型，理论表明：上游不确定性（来自供应商）抑制投资，因为它影响短期投入价格；下游不确定性（来自客户）则产生较弱的正向影响，因为它影响长期产出价格。利用生产网络数据，实证发现上游不确定性显著降低企业层面的产出，而下游不确定性具有正向但较弱的作用。在宏观层面，这两种不确定性对经济增长和资产价格有相反的预测能力，其中下游不确定性具有扩张效应，与传统的不确定性负面效应形成对比。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地从供应链纵向维度区分不确定性来源，揭示上游与下游不确定性截然不同的经济效应，丰富了不确定性对实体经济影响的微观机制理解。

title: The Structure of Leveraged Buyouts and the Free-Rider Problem
abstract: We study the structure of public firm buyouts in a model that features the Berle-Means problem (lack of incentives) and the Grossman-Hart problem (holdout). We find that bootstrapping, debt in excess of funding needs, and upfront fees to bidders are socially optimal and increase buyout premiums. These elements make LBO financing tantamount to a “management contract” arranged by an outside manager to receive cash and incentives to manage a firm—except the cash is funded by excess debt imposed on the firm. Our model also rationalizes why PE firms collect fees from their equity partnerships and directly from target firms.
summary: 本文通过构建一个同时包含Berle-Means问题（管理层缺乏激励）和Grossman-Hart问题（股东抵制收购）的模型，研究了上市公司杠杆收购（LBO）的结构。研究发现，bootstrapping（自举融资）、超出资金需求的债务以及向竞标者收取的前期费用是社会最优的，并且能够提高收购溢价。这些要素使得LBO融资实质上相当于一种由外部经理安排的“管理合同”——外部经理获得现金和激励来管理公司，只不过现金来源于强加给公司的超额债务。模型还解释了为何私募股权（PE）公司既向其股权合伙人收费，也直接向目标公司收费。
ai_comment: 该论文巧妙地将公司治理中的两个经典问题结合起来，为LBO的常见特征（如高杠杆、前期费用）提供了统一的理论解释，具有重要的理论和实践贡献。

title: Gender-Inclusive Language and Economic Decision-Making
abstract: Providing inclusive environments has become a primary tenet of modern societies and organizations. The use of gender-inclusive language (GIL) is often considered an instrument that can promote inclusion, yet little is known about its effects on relevant economic behaviors and on gender gaps in the labor market. GIL avoids the masculine “default” (common to many languages) by either explicitly mentioning both masculine and feminine (pro)nouns, or replacing them with nongendered (pro)nouns. Here we study the causal short-run impact of GIL on competitiveness and leadership in the laboratory, with two different language samples—English and German—which differ, among other things, in the extent to which gender is embedded linguistically. We vary GIL in experimental instructions across three treatments ([Formula: see text]): a masculine baseline condition, a condition with feminine and masculine (pro)nouns, and a condition with nongendered (pro)nouns. We find that participants who identify as female and participants who identify as male compete, stand for leadership, and vote on leader candidates similarly across all treatments, in either language. Furthermore, we find no treatment differences in participants’ feelings of inclusion and perceived entitlement. In sum, there is a lack of support for GIL having short-term causal effects on competitive and leadership behavior and inclusion perceptions. This paper was accepted by Marie-Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by the Austrian Science Fund [Grant SFB F63], UK Research and Innovation [Grant MR/T020253/1], the University of Exeter, and Regensburger Universitätsstiftung Lucia and Dr. Otfried Eberz. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04342 .
summary: 这项研究通过实验室实验，探究了性别包容性语言（GIL）对竞争行为和领导力的短期因果影响，使用了英语和德语两种语言样本（这两种语言在性别嵌入程度上不同）。实验设置了三种处理条件：男性基线、同时使用男性和女性（代）名词、使用无性别（代）名词。结果表明，无论语言如何，自我认同为女性和男性的参与者在竞争、领导力竞选以及领导候选人投票方面均无显著差异。此外，也未发现不同处理对参与者的包容感和应得权利感知有影响。总体而言，没有证据支持GIL对竞争、领导行为和包容感知具有短期因果效应。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严谨的实验设计检验了性别包容性语言的短期经济影响，其零结果对于政策和组织实践中语言干预的有效性提出了重要质疑。

title: The Changing Nature of Firm Innovation: Short-Termism and Influential Innovation in U.S. Public Firms
abstract: We examine the link between short-term pressures and technologically significant innovation in U.S. public firms in 1997–2015. Using a market-based measure of short-term pressure, we estimate its relationship with influential and novel patents. We find that firms facing more intense short-term pressures are less likely to patent highly influential or novel innovations. To evaluate whether this relationship is causal, we use changes in ownership styles following financial institution mergers as instruments. Our analysis suggests that changing short-term pressures from investors had a causal impact on firm innovative outcomes; this finding is robust to a wide variety of empirical specifications. While public firms as a whole retained a constant share of highly influential patents, this activity has become more concentrated in fewer firms. This shift does not appear to be fully compensated by an increase in technologically significant patents by nonpublic firms such as venture-capital (VC)-backed start-ups. These findings raise questions about capital markets’ impact on firm R&D strategy and the nature of innovative activities in public firms. This paper was accepted by Ashish Arora, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the inaugural Panmure House Prize for Long-term Thinking and Radical Innovation for this research, as well as Matt Marx for facilitating institutional support at Cornell for this research. B. Goldfarb and R. Corredoira received partial financial support from the National Science Foundation [Grant 1565553]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00857 .
summary: 本文研究了1997-2015年间美国上市公司短期压力与技术重大创新之间的关系。使用基于市场的短期压力衡量指标，估计其与有影响力和新颖专利的关联。发现面临更强短期压力的公司申请高影响力或新颖专利的可能性更低。为评估因果关系，利用金融机构合并后所有权风格的变化作为工具变量。分析表明投资者短期压力的变化对公司的创新产出有因果影响，该结果在多种实证设定下稳健。尽管上市公司整体保持了高影响力专利的恒定份额，但这种活动变得更加集中于少数公司。非上市公司（如风险投资支持的初创企业）并未完全弥补这一变化。这些发现引发了对资本市场影响企业研发策略及上市公司创新活动性质的疑问。
ai_comment: 利用工具变量法揭示了短期压力对创新影响的因果证据，并揭示了创新活动在上市公司中的集中趋势，对理解资本市场与创新的关系有重要贡献。

title: What Drives Investors' Portfolio Choices? Separating Risk Preferences from Frictions
abstract: We study the role of risk preferences and frictions in portfolio choice using variation in 401(k) default options. Patterns of active choice in response to different default funds imply that, absent participation frictions, 94% of investors prefer holding stocks, with an equity share of retirement wealth declining with age—patterns markedly different from observed allocations. We use this quasi‐experiment to estimate a life‐cycle model and find a relative risk aversion of 2.5, elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) of 0.25, and $160 portfolio adjustment cost. The results suggest that low levels of stock market participation in retirement accounts are due to participation frictions rather than nonstandard preferences such as loss aversion.
summary: 本文利用401(k)计划中默认选项的变化，研究风险偏好和摩擦对投资者投资组合选择的作用。通过观察投资者对不同默认基金的反应模式，发现如果没有参与摩擦，94%的投资者偏好持有股票，且退休财富中股票的份额随年龄下降，这与实际观测到的资产配置显著不同。基于这一准实验，作者估计了一个生命周期模型，得到相对风险厌恶系数为2.5，跨期替代弹性（EIS）为0.25，以及160美元的投资组合调整成本。结果表明，退休账户中股票市场参与率低主要是由于参与摩擦，而非损失厌恶等非标准偏好。
ai_comment: 利用准实验设计有效分离了风险偏好与摩擦的影响，为理解投资者实际投资行为提供了新颖视角。

title: Squeezing Shorts Through Social Media Platforms
abstract: In January 2021, a group of stocks listed on U.S. stock exchanges experienced sudden price increases, which, coupled with high short interest, led to short squeezes. We find that discussions on social media fueled the association between retail trading and subsequent stock returns. Options market activity and securities lending constraints also played a central role. Using unique data from social media platforms, we provide a comprehensive account of these short squeezes. We find that they significantly impeded market quality for the stocks at issue and their competitors. Thus, the interplay between social media and retail traders may have adverse consequences for market quality and efficiency. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02887 .
summary: 论文研究2021年1月美国股市中一群高做空兴趣股票突然涨价导致的轧空现象。基于社交媒体平台的独特数据，发现社交媒体讨论显著强化了零售交易与后续股票回报之间的关联。期权市场活动和证券借贷约束在此过程中也扮演了核心角色。研究提供了这些轧空事件的全面描述，并发现它们严重损害了相关股票及其竞争对手的市场质量。因此，社交媒体与零售交易者的互动可能对市场质量和效率产生不利后果。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特社交媒体数据揭示了社交媒体讨论在轧空事件中的关键作用，并首次系统评估了其对市场质量的负面影响，为监管社交媒体与零售交易互动提供了重要证据。

title: An Economic View of Corporate Social Impact
abstract: Growing discussions of impact investing and stakeholder capitalism have increased interest in measuring companies' social impact. We conceptualize corporate social impact as the welfare loss that would be caused by a firm's exit. To illustrate, we quantify the social impacts of 74 firms in 12 industries using a new survey measuring consumer and worker substitution patterns combined with models of product and labor markets. We find that consumer surplus is the primary component of social impact, suggesting that consumer impacts deserve more attention from impact investors. Existing environmental, social, and governance (ESG) and social impact ratings are essentially unrelated to our economically grounded measures.
summary: 这篇论文从经济学视角定义企业社会影响为企业退出造成的福利损失，并通过新的消费者和工人替代模式调查，结合产品与劳动力市场模型，量化了12个行业74家公司的社会影响。研究发现消费者剩余是社会影响的主要组成部分，表明影响投资者应更多关注消费者影响。同时，现有的环境、社会和治理（ESG）及社会影响评级与这些经济测量基本不相关。
ai_comment: 该研究为衡量企业社会影响提供了严谨的经济学框架，挑战了现有ESG评级体系的有效性，对影响投资实践具有重要指导意义。

title: Cross-Border M&A Flows, Economic Growth, and Foreign Exchange Rates
abstract: We extract information about future economic conditions from firms’ cross-border merger and acquisition announcements, and show it predicts changes in relative economic growth rates and foreign exchange rate returns. We find the predictability is driven by the acquisition decisions of domestic firms, which signal turning points in local economic growth. The findings are motivated by a simple model of exchange rate determination with heterogeneous expectations and support the theorized relationship between foreign exchange rates and macroeconomic fundamentals. The results provide new tools for policy makers seeking to predict economic activity and offer global investors a novel source of portfolio diversification.
summary: 该研究从企业跨境并购公告中提取关于未来经济状况的信息，发现这些信息能够预测相对经济增长率和外汇汇率收益。预测能力主要由国内企业的收购决策驱动，这些决策信号了当地经济增长的转折点。研究基于一个具有异质性预期的简单汇率决定模型，实证结果支持了汇率与宏观经济基本面之间的理论关系。结论为政策制定者提供了预测经济活动的工具，并为全球投资者提供了新的投资组合多样化来源。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用微观企业的并购活动预测宏观经济和汇率走势，揭示了从企业行为到宏观变量的传导机制，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: Losing Control? The Two‐Decade Decline in Loan Covenant Violations
abstract: The annual proportion of U.S. public firms that reported a financial covenant violation fell roughly 70% between 1997 and 2019. To understand this trend, we develop an estimable model of covenant design that depends on the ability to differentiate between distressed and nondistressed borrowers and the relative costs associated with screening incorrectly. We find that the drop in violations is best explained by an increased willingness to forgo early detection of distressed borrowers in exchange for fewer inconsequential violations, which we attribute largely to a shift in the composition of public borrowers and partly to heightened investor sentiment during the 2010s.
summary: 本文研究了1997年至2019年间美国上市公司财务契约违规比例的显著下降（约70%）。为了理解这一趋势，作者构建了一个可估计的契约设计模型，该模型依赖于区分困境与非困境借款人的能力以及筛选错误的相关成本。研究发现，违规下降的最佳解释是，贷款方更愿意放弃对困境借款人的早期检测，以换取更少的无意义违规。这一现象主要归因于公开借款人构成的变化，部分归因于2010年代投资者情绪的高涨。
ai_comment: 该论文通过模型估计揭示了贷款契约设计在效率与成本之间的权衡，并强调了借款人结构变化对金融契约执行的重要影响。

title: Second Chance: Life with Less Student Debt
abstract: We exploit an episode of plausibly random debt discharge due to the loss of paperwork for thousands of defaulted borrowers to examine the effects of private student debt relief on borrower outcomes. We find that borrowers who receive debt relief (treated) experience declines in debt balances and delinquency rates on other accounts, and increases in mobility and income relative to those who bear the costs of default like wage garnishment and collections (control). Borrowers in both groups contribute to our findings through different mechanisms. While our estimates may not directly apply to blanket student loan forgiveness, they speak to the benefits of forgiveness in reducing the consequences of debt burden for distressed borrowers.
summary: 本研究利用一起因文件丢失导致数千名违约借款人私人学生债务被意外免除的事件，考察了私人学生债务减免对借款人结果的影响。研究发现，与承担工资扣押和催收等违约成本的对照组相比，获得债务减免的处理组借款人在其他账户上的债务余额和违约率下降，流动性和收入增加。两组借款人通过不同机制对结果产生影响。尽管估计结果可能不直接适用于全面的学生贷款豁免，但揭示了债务减免对缓解困境借款人债务负担后果的益处。
ai_comment: 利用罕见的自然实验识别债务减免的因果效应，为政策制定提供了关于债务纾困实际效果的实证依据。

title: Do Nature‐Loving CEOs Make the World Greener?
abstract: This study examines the relation between CEOs’ preferences for environmental protection (“nature‐loving preferences”) and corporate environmental actions. Drawing on social ecology research, I develop a proxy for CEOs’ nature‐loving preferences based on their childhood exposure to greenspace and validate it using their positive discussions of nature during earnings conference calls. Findings show a significant positive association between CEOs’ nature‐loving preferences and their firms’ participation in Clean Development Mechanism projects. This effect remains robust after addressing firm–CEO matching and omitted variable concerns. Cross‐sectional tests reveal stronger effects when local environmental demands are high and when CEOs have greater decision‐making power. Further analyses suggest that these CEOs are associated with greater corporate carbon reduction, while market reactions to their appointments remain neutral. The study highlights the link between CEOs’ personal environmental preferences and firms’ environmental actions, offering new insights into individual‐level factors behind corporate social responsibility.
summary: 本研究探讨了CEO对环境保护的偏好（即“热爱自然的偏好”）与企业环保行动之间的关系。基于社会生态学研究，我以CEO童年时期接触绿色空间的程度作为其热爱自然偏好的代理变量，并通过他们在财报电话会议中对自然的积极讨论进行验证。研究发现，CEO的热爱自然偏好与其所在企业参与清洁发展机制（CDM）项目之间存在显著正相关关系，且在控制企业-CEO匹配和遗漏变量问题后结果依然稳健。横截面检验表明，当地方环境需求较高以及CEO拥有更大决策权时，这种正向效应更强。进一步分析显示，这类CEO与更大的企业碳减排相关，而市场对其任命事件的反应保持中性。本研究强调了CEO个人环保偏好与企业环保行动之间的关联，为企业社会责任背后的个体层面因素提供了新见解。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地以CEO童年绿色空间暴露作为个人环保偏好的代理变量，并通过实证揭示了CEO个人特征对企业环保行为的驱动作用，为理解企业社会责任中高层管理者的个体差异提供了新视角。

title: Informed Trade of Earnings Announcements
abstract: This paper examines how market participants trade on private information about firm fundamentals using the largest known case of informed trade of earnings announcements. From 2011 to 2015, a cartel of sophisticated traders illegally obtained early access to and traded on over 1,000 firm earnings announcements. Using this setting, I identify the information in earnings announcements that these market participants found most price relevant. The informed traders preferred announcements with larger earnings and sales surprises relative to forecasts, quantitative managerial guidance, and more extreme news sentiment. Despite their perfect foresight, the traders performed, perhaps surprisingly, poorly relative to hypothetical trading strategies based on comparable foresight. Frictions that limited their performance include price impact, risk aversion, and information processing costs. The trading performance of these informed traders implies that information about firm fundamentals explains little of the cross‐sectional variation in earnings announcement returns, even for sophisticated market participants.
summary: 本文利用2011年至2015年间一个由专业交易者组成的卡特尔非法获取并交易超过1000份企业盈利公告的最大已知内幕交易案例，研究市场参与者如何利用关于公司基本面的私有信息进行交易。通过这一独特场景，作者识别出盈利公告中最具价格相关性的信息，发现内幕交易者偏好盈利和销售超预期幅度大、包含定量管理层指引以及新闻情绪更极端的公告。尽管内幕交易者拥有完美预见，但其交易表现却令人惊讶地劣于基于相同预见性的假设性交易策略，主要受价格冲击、风险厌恶和信息处理成本等摩擦因素制约。这些内幕交易者的表现表明，即使对于专业市场参与者，关于公司基本面的信息也只能解释盈利公告回报横截面变异的很小一部分。
ai_comment: 本文利用罕见的内幕交易数据直接检验私有信息价值，发现即使完美预见也因摩擦而表现不佳，且基本面信息对回报解释力有限，挑战了传统市场有效性观点。

title: Hedging Permanent Income Shocks
abstract: This paper robustly connects observed portfolio choices to correlations of individual income shocks with an aggregate shock (or, equivalently, with stock market returns). The share of nonparticipating individuals displaying a positive correlation, and therefore a negative hedging demand for stocks, is above 79% in both our samples. Furthermore, correlations predict nonparticipation to the equity market, also out-of-sample and for the same individual over time. These results support the traditional hedging motive explanation for nonparticipation. Such new insight owes to the income shocks comovements across individuals, which we model and exploit to identify correlations. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Inquire Europe, Observatoire de l’Epargne Européenne (OEE), and The Italian Ministry of Education, University and Research (MIUR) Department of Excellence Award for years 2018–2022 and 2023–2027. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06893 .
summary: 本文通过模型和实证方法，将个人投资组合选择与个体收入冲击和总体冲击（或股市收益）的相关性联系起来。研究发现，在样本中超过79%的非参与股票市场的个体表现出正相关，即对股票有负的对冲需求。这种相关性还能预测股票市场非参与行为，包括样本外和同一人随时间的变化。这些结果支持了传统对冲动机对非参与的解释。这一新洞察得益于对收入冲击跨个体共同运动的建模和识别。
ai_comment: 本文通过创新性地利用收入冲击的跨个体共同运动来识别相关性，为股票市场非参与的传统对冲动机提供了有力的实证支持。

title: Data-Pooling Reinforcement Learning for Preventative Healthcare Intervention
abstract: Motivated by the emerging needs of tailored intervention for heterogeneous populations in preventative healthcare applications, we consider a multistage, dynamic decision-making problem in the online setting with unknown model parameters. To deal with the pervasive issue of small sample size in parameter estimation, we develop a novel data-pooling reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that adaptively pools historical data, with three main innovations: (i) the weight of pooling is directly tied to the performance of the decision (measured by regret) as opposed to estimation accuracy in conventional methods; (ii) no parametric assumptions are needed between historical and current data; and (iii) requiring data-sharing only via aggregate statistics, as opposed to patient-level data. Our data-pooling algorithm framework unifies a variety of RL algorithms, and we establish a theoretical performance guarantee that quantifies the regret bound reduction from our adaptive pooling design compared with benchmarks. We substantiate the theoretical development with extensive empirical experiments via a case study in the context of postdischarge intervention to prevent unplanned readmissions, generating practical insights into healthcare management. Our algorithm enables organizations to leverage public data or published studies for patient management and supports policymakers in promoting aggregate data sharing to enhance population health outcomes. This paper was accepted by Carri Chan, healthcare management. Funding: X. Chen was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants NSFC-72171205 and NSFC-72394361] and Shenzhen Science and Technology Innovations Committee [Grant RCXY 20210609103124047]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03880 .
summary: 本文针对预防性医疗中异质性人群的个性化干预需求，考虑在线环境下多阶段动态决策问题，模型参数未知。为解决小样本参数估计问题，提出一种新颖的数据池化强化学习算法，该算法自适应池化历史数据，具有三个主要创新：(i)池化权重直接与决策性能（由遗憾度量）而非传统方法的估计精度相关；(ii)无需在历史数据和当前数据之间进行参数假设；(iii)仅需通过汇总统计量而非患者级数据共享数据。该数据池化算法框架统一了多种RL算法，并建立了理论性能保证，量化了自适应池化设计相比基准的遗憾界减少。通过出院后干预以防止非计划再入院案例研究中的大量实证实验，验证了理论发展，并产生了医疗管理的实践见解。该算法使组织能够利用公共数据或已发表研究进行患者管理，并支持政策制定者促进汇总数据共享以改善人群健康结果。
ai_comment: 本文通过自适应池化历史数据设计强化学习算法，无需参数假设且仅需汇总统计量，显著降低遗憾界，为医疗干预提供实用见解。

title: Financing Innovation Under Ambiguity
abstract: We develop a real options model in which an entrepreneur facing ambiguity makes optimal investment and financing decisions for an innovation project. We introduce jumps in innovation returns and model investors’ aversion to ambiguity in both diffusion and jump risks. Debt accelerates investment by lowering the threshold and shortening expected waiting time, thereby increasing project value. This effect strengthens under greater ambiguity, offering a novel rationale for why debt—not equity—fosters innovation. Our results provide a coherent explanation for recent empirical findings on debt’s role in innovation and contribute to the broader literature on investment under uncertainty.
summary: 本文构建了一个实物期权模型，研究面临模糊性的企业家如何对创新项目做出最优投资与融资决策。模型引入了创新收益的跳跃，并刻画了投资者对扩散风险和跳跃风险的模糊性厌恶。结果表明，债务通过降低投资触发阈值和缩短预期等待时间加速投资，从而提升项目价值；且这一效应在模糊性更高时更为显著，为债务而非股权促进创新提供了新的理论解释。该结果系统阐释了近期关于债务在创新中作用的实证发现，并对不确定性下投资领域的文献作出了贡献。
ai_comment: 该文从模糊性厌恶视角揭示了债务促进创新的独特机制，为实证矛盾提供了简洁而有力的理论解释，是对传统融资理论的重要补充。

title: Does Litigation Risk Deter Insider Trading? Evidence from Universal Demand Laws
abstract: We exploit U.S. states’ staggered adoption of Universal Demand (UD) laws to study how the risk of shareholder lawsuits affects insider trading. UD laws, which make it harder for shareholders to bring derivative lawsuits against directors and officers, lead to more profitable insider trades, especially sales. This effect is stronger among smaller firms and firms with lower institutional monitoring. After UD laws, the timing of insiders’ trades also appears more opportunistic and riskier, for example, sales increase before negative earnings surprises. Overall, our study offers clean evidence that the threat of shareholder litigation deters opportunistic insider trading.
summary: 本文利用美国各州交错通过的Universal Demand（UD）法律，研究股东诉讼风险如何影响内幕交易。UD法律提高了股东对董事和高管提起衍生诉讼的难度，导致内幕交易（尤其是卖出）获利更多。这一效应在规模较小的公司和机构监督较弱的公司中更为显著。UD法律通过后，内幕交易时机更具机会主义和风险性，例如在负面盈利意外之前卖出增加。整体而言，研究提供了股东诉讼威胁能够阻止机会主义内幕交易的干净证据。
ai_comment: 巧妙利用UD法律的外生变化识别因果关系，为诉讼风险对内幕交易的威慑作用提供了可靠证据。

title: How and When Are High-Frequency Stock Returns Predictable?
abstract: This paper studies the predictability of ultrahigh-frequency stock returns and durations to relevant price, volume, and transaction events using machine learning methods. We find that contrary to low-frequency and long-horizon returns, where predictability is rare and inconsistent, predictability in high-frequency returns and durations is large, systematic, and pervasive over short horizons. We identify the relevant predictors constructed from trades and quotes data, and we examine what determines the variation in predictability across the stock’s own characteristics and market environments. Next, we compute how the predictability improves with the timeliness of the data on a scale of milliseconds and conversely degrades with delays, providing a valuation of each millisecond gained. Finally, we simulate the impact of getting an (imperfect) peek at the incoming order flow, a look-ahead ability that is often attributed to the fastest high-frequency traders, in terms of improving the predictability of the returns and durations. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02435 .
summary: 本文利用机器学习方法研究超高频率股票收益和持续时间的可预测性，这些收益率和持续时间与相关的价格、交易量和交易事件有关。研究发现，与低频长期收益中罕见且不一致的可预测性相反，高频收益和持续时间的可预测性在短时间范围内是大量、系统且普遍的。作者从交易和报价数据中识别出相关的预测因子，并考察了股票自身特征和市场环境如何影响预测性的变化。接着，计算了数据在毫秒级别上的及时性如何改善预测性，以及延迟如何降低预测性，从而对每一毫秒的增益进行估值。最后，模拟了获得（不完美的）未来订单流窥视能力（通常归因于最快的高频交易者）对收益和持续时间预测性的改善影响。
ai_comment: 该论文系统性地证明了高频收益的可预测性远高于低频，并量化了毫秒级数据延迟的价值，为高频交易策略和微观结构研究提供了新见解。

title: Public Signals, Default Risk, and Voluntary Disclosure
abstract: We examine how the information in public signals (e.g., earnings, analysts’ forecasts) affects firms’ voluntary disclosures. We consider levered firms and information structures such that investors update their beliefs about both the mean and variance of the firm’s cash flows. We predict that firms that, conditional on the public signal, have a higher default risk are less likely to disclose. For firms with low ex ante default risk, larger positive surprises following the public signal initially increase the disclosure likelihood because they indicate a higher mean of cash flows. However, too large positive surprises may reduce the disclosure likelihood of these firms, because the larger surprise is also indicative of higher variance and, thus, higher probability of default. Symmetrically, larger negative surprises may increase disclosure for firms with high ex ante default risk, despite the more pessimistic inference about the mean, because the higher variance makes it more likely that these firms avoid default. Extending our analysis to multiple analysts’ forecasts, we predict that not only consensus, but also dispersion affect firms’ disclosure likelihood. Consensus conveys information about the mean and variance of cash flows, whereas dispersion is informative about the precision of analysts’ signals, which in turn affects the information content of forecasts. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: D. Lee-Lo gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Accounting Research Center at Kellogg.
summary: 本文研究了公共信号（如盈利报告、分析师预测）如何影响企业的自愿披露决策。在模型中，企业被假定为杠杆企业，而投资者会根据公共信号更新对企业现金流均值和方差的信念。研究发现，在接收到公共信号后，违约风险较高的企业更不愿意进行自愿披露。对于事前违约风险较低的企业，较大的正向意外（即高于预期的信号）起初会提高披露的可能性，因为这表明现金流均值更高；然而，过大的正向意外反而可能降低披露意愿，因为这种意外同时也预示着更高的方差和违约概率。对称地，对于事前违约风险较高的企业，较大的负向意外（即低于预期的信号）尽管意味着对均值的悲观推断，但由于高方差增加了这些企业避免违约的可能性，反而可能促使它们增加披露。当扩展到多个分析师预测的情境时，文章预测不仅分析师的共识（consensus）会影响披露概率（共识传递关于现金流均值和方差的信息），分析师预测的分歧（dispersion）也会产生影响，因为分歧反映了分析师信号的精度，进而影响预测的信息含量。
ai_comment: 本文通过同时考虑公共信号对现金流均值和方差的双重影响，为自愿披露的时机选择提供了新的理论视角，尤其是揭示了违约风险与披露概率之间的非线性关系。

title: Dynamic Portfolio Choice with Intertemporal Hedging and Transaction Costs
abstract: When returns are partially predictable and trading is costly, utility-maximizing investors track a target portfolio at a constant trading speed. The target portfolio is optimal for a frictionless market, where asset returns are scaled back to account for trading costs and volatilities are adjusted to proxy the “execution risk” of holding assets that are costly to trade and exposed to volatile states. The trading speed solves an optimal execution problem, which describes how the legacy portfolio inherited from the past is traded toward the target portfolio in an optimal manner. Unlike for period-by-period mean-variance preferences, the target portfolio hedges changes in investment opportunities, and both it and the trading speed are linked and depend on execution risk. We set the problem out first in an “absolute” framework—price shocks independent of the price level, and investors have CARA preferences—and then in a “relative” framework, with price shocks scaled by price levels and CRRA preferences. We illustrate the practical implications of these results in a model where market return predictions are based on a short-term momentum and a long-term value signal. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: X. Shi acknowledges support from the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC) through Discovery [Grant RGPIN-2024-04569] and Discovery Launch Supplement [DGECR-2024-00444]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05913 .
summary: 本文研究在回报部分可预测且交易成本存在时，效用最大化投资者的动态投资组合选择问题。投资者以恒定交易速度跟踪一个目标投资组合，该目标组合是对无摩擦市场最优组合的调整，其中资产回报经过交易成本缩放，波动率经过调整以反映持有难以交易且暴露于波动状态资产的“执行风险”。交易速度由最优执行问题求解，决定了如何将历史遗留组合最优地转向目标组合。与逐期均值-方差偏好不同，目标组合对冲投资机会的变化，且目标组合与交易速度相互关联并依赖于执行风险。论文首先在“绝对”框架（价格冲击独立于价格水平，投资者具有CARA偏好）中建模，然后在“相对”框架（价格冲击按价格水平缩放，具有CRRA偏好）中建模。最后通过一个基于短期动量和长期价值信号预测市场回报的模型展示了实际意义。
ai_comment: 本文将交易成本与跨期对冲统一在一个动态框架下，推导出常数交易速度的解析解，并通过绝对与相对两种偏好设定验证稳健性，具有理论和实践价值。

title: Long-Term Pay for Performance: Cumulative Evidence over CEO Tenure
abstract: This study revisits the CEO pay-for-performance relation using two methodological innovations designed to address well-known measurement challenges. First, we aggregate pay and performance over the CEO’s entire tenure, allowing us to account for ex post settling up in pay. Second, we use realized compensation rather than ex ante estimates to better capture the actual economic rewards that CEOs receive. We find strong evidence of pay for performance in the full sample with a magnitude 2–10 times greater than that reported in previous studies. However, the pay-for-performance relation is asymmetric. CEOs who outperform their peer firms exhibit strong pay-for-performance sensitivity; those who underperform do not. This asymmetry arises because boards offset weak performance with incremental equity grants, undoing the mechanical correlation that results from declining stock prices. Finally, we show that underperforming CEOs are significantly more likely to be dismissed, suggesting that turnover, rather than lower pay, could be a disciplinary mechanism used by boards. Collectively, our findings demonstrate that tenure-aggregated realized pay better reveals how boards structure incentives and accountability over the full horizon of a CEO’s leadership. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: We gratefully acknowledge financial support from Columbia Business School, Columbia University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04322 .
summary: 本研究采用两种方法创新重新审视CEO薪酬-业绩关系：一是将薪酬和业绩在整个CEO任期内汇总，以考虑事后结算；二是使用实际报酬而非事前估计，以更好地捕捉CEO实际获得的经济回报。研究发现在全样本中薪酬-业绩关系显著，强度是之前研究的2-10倍。但该关系不对称：表现优于同行的CEO具有强薪酬-业绩敏感性，而表现不佳的CEO则没有，因为董事会通过额外股权授予抵消了股价下跌导致的机械相关性。此外，表现不佳的CEO更可能被解雇，表明解雇而非低薪可能是董事会的纪律机制。总体而言，任期汇总的实际报酬更能揭示董事会在CEO整个领导期间如何构建激励和问责机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入任期汇总和实际报酬指标，解决了以往研究中的度量问题，并揭示了薪酬-业绩关系的不对称性以及解雇作为替代纪律机制的重要发现，深化了对CEO激励的理解。

title: Private Equity Buyouts and Employee Health
abstract: We examine the role of employee health for the restructuring of the labor force during private equity buyouts using employee-level data of 56,000 Dutch buyout employees. We find no evidence that buyouts have a negative impact on the health of buyout employees. Employees lose income and employment after buyouts, and these losses are far larger for employees in poorer health. The negative effect of buyouts on employees’ incomes is buffered by social transfers, and this buffer is larger for employees in poorer health, who exit the labor market at a much higher rate. Health characteristics associated with lower wages in the general population are strongly predictive of job loss after buyouts. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) [Projects MA 3317/3-1 and MA 3317/3-2]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01874 .
summary: 本文利用荷兰56000名私募股权收购员工的个体层面数据，考察员工健康在收购后劳动力重组中的作用。研究发现，收购对员工健康没有负面影响，但员工在收购后收入和工作机会减少，且这些损失对健康较差的员工更为显著。社会转移支付缓冲了收购对员工收入的负面冲击，且对健康较差的员工缓冲作用更大，这部分员工退出劳动力市场的比率更高。此外，在普通人群中与较低工资相关的健康特征强烈预测了收购后的失业风险。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的大型员工数据集，揭示了健康因素在私募股权收购后劳动力重组中的关键作用，并强调了社会保障的缓冲效应，为理解收购的社会成本提供了新视角。

title: Going Public and the Internal Organization of the Firm
abstract: This paper examines how initial public offerings (IPOs) affect firms' internal organization. We find that IPO firms become more hierarchical and standardized organizations, characterized by additional layers, more managers, smaller control spans, and larger administrative functions. These changes occur mostly in preparation for the IPO and can be only partially explained by growth. IPO firms with greater human capital risk experience larger hierarchical changes. Hierarchical changes help firms standardize employee roles and formalize internal processes. Our results suggest that firms reorganize to reduce their dependence on key individuals' human capital when transitioning to public markets.
summary: 本文研究首次公开募股（IPOs）如何影响公司的内部组织。研究发现，IPO公司会变得更具层级化和标准化，具体表现为增加管理层级、雇佣更多管理者、缩小管理控制跨度以及扩大行政职能。这些变化主要发生在IPO准备阶段，并且只能部分由公司增长来解释。人力资本风险较高的IPO公司经历了更大的层级变化。层级变化有助于公司标准化员工角色并正式化内部流程。结果表明，公司在转向公开市场时会进行重组，以减少对关键个人人力资本的依赖。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了IPO对组织结构的重要影响，强调了人力资本风险作为组织变革的关键驱动因素，为理解公司上市后的治理变化提供了新视角。

title: Adverse Selection in Corporate Loan Markets
abstract: Theories of competition typically predict a positive relationship between market concentration and prices. However, in loan markets, adverse selection can reverse this relationship as riskier borrowers become more likely to receive funding. Using supervisory data, we show that interest rates, borrower risk, and lending volume are higher in markets with more banks. We also create a novel measure of markup that is orthogonal to borrower risk, and find that, consistent with adverse selection, markups are higher after repeated borrowing relationships. Finally, we use a shock to large banks' lending costs to provide further support for the adverse selection channel.
summary: 本文研究企业贷款市场中的逆向选择问题。传统竞争理论预测市场集中度与价格正相关，但在贷款市场中，逆向选择可能逆转这一关系，导致风险更高的借款人更有可能获得融资。利用监管数据，我们发现银行数量较多的市场中，利率、借款人风险和贷款规模均更高。我们创建了一个与借款人风险正交的 markup 新度量，发现与逆向选择一致，重复借贷关系后 markup 更高。最后，我们利用大型银行贷款成本的冲击，为逆向选择渠道提供了进一步支持。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证方法挑战了传统竞争理论，揭示了逆向选择在贷款市场中的关键作用，对理解银行竞争和信贷市场效率有重要意义。

title: Paying Too Much? Borrower Sophistication and Overpayment in the U.S. Mortgage Market
abstract: Comparing mortgage rates that borrowers obtain to rates that lenders could offer for the same loan, we find that many homeowners significantly overpay for their mortgage, with overpayment varying across borrower types and with market interest rates. Survey data reveal that borrowers' mortgage knowledge and shopping behavior strongly correlate with the rates they secure. We also document substantial variation in how expensive and profitable lenders are, without any evidence that expensive loans are associated with a better borrower experience. Despite many lenders operating in the U.S. mortgage market, limited borrower sophistication may provide lenders with market power.
summary: 通过将借款人实际获得的抵押贷款利率与贷款人本可提供的利率进行比较，研究发现许多美国房主显著多付了抵押贷款，且多付程度因借款人类型和市场利率水平而异。调查数据表明，借款人的抵押贷款知识与购物行为与其最终获得的利率高度相关。同时，不同贷款人在成本和盈利方面存在巨大差异，但没有证据显示高价贷款伴随更好的借款人体验。尽管美国抵押贷款市场参与者众多，但借款人有限的专业知识可能赋予贷款人市场力量。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据对比方法，实证揭示了借款人金融素养不足导致的市场失灵，对消费者保护政策和市场竞争评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Public Information, Relative Overconfidence, and Capital Flows
abstract: Capital flows increase in response to new public information. Conventional explanations typically conclude that this reflects a rational response to reduced risk. However, investors may also be overconfident in their ability to benefit from new information, even when it is publicly available and does not provide a relative advantage. We exploit two complementary settings to examine how this “better‐than‐average” mechanism affects capital flows. Archival evidence from horse race betting markets shows capital flows increase following the public provision of a summary measure of horse performance, even though more total parimutuel wagering necessarily implies a greater wealth transfer from bettors to tracks. A controlled lab experiment provides direct causal evidence of our proposed mechanism. Combined, our results suggest that new public information can increase capital flows due to investors’ overconfidence in their ability to benefit from information relative to others. Our findings inform regulators seeking to understand the consequences of expanding the public information available to individual investors.
summary: 本文研究公开信息如何影响资本流动，尤其是投资者相对过度自信的作用。传统解释认为公开信息通过降低风险理性地增加资本流动，但本文提出投资者即使面对公开信息（未提供相对优势）也可能高估自己从中获益的能力。研究采用两个互补设置：首先，赛马博彩市场的档案证据显示，公开提供马匹表现总结指标后，资本流动（总赌注）增加，尽管更多投注意味着赌徒向赛马场转移更多财富；其次，受控实验室实验提供了所提机制的因果证据。结合结果，作者认为新公开信息可能因投资者相对于他人的过度自信而增加资本流动。研究发现对监管机构理解扩大个人投资者公开信息的影响具有启示。
ai_comment: 本文通过实地与实验证据创新性地揭示了公开信息激发资本流动的过度自信渠道，挑战了传统理性解释，对信息透明政策有重要警示。

title: Women in Politics: The Effect on Board Diversity
abstract: We use a sharp regression discontinuity design (RDD) to show that victories by women candidates in close House, Senate, and gubernatorial elections lead to an increase in female directors in firms located in the candidates’ districts. The causal effect is higher when the media coverage of the woman candidate is higher, when voter turnout is high, and when firms have more local directors and local institutional investors. The heterogeneous regression discontinuity (RD) effects suggest that electoral wins may influence local gender norms and firms’ board diversity through multiple channels, including conveying majority views on gender-related social norms, increasing exposure to exemplar women, and facilitating learning about women’s different but effective leadership styles. The evidence suggests a potential spillover effect from women’s political leadership to the corporate world.
summary: 该论文利用尖锐回归不连续设计（RDD），以美国众议院、参议院和州长选举中激烈竞争的女性候选人险胜为自然实验，发现其当选显著提升了所在选区企业的董事会女性比例。当女性候选人获得更多媒体关注、选区投票率较高、企业拥有更多本地董事和本地机构投资者时，这一因果效应更为显著。异质性分析表明，女性政治胜利可能通过传达性别平等社会规范、增加榜样女性曝光、以及促进对女性有效领导风格的学习等多重渠道影响当地性别观念与企业董事会多元化。研究揭示了女性政治领导力向企业界溢出的潜在效应。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用政治选举的准自然实验，为政治领导力影响企业治理提供了有力的因果证据，并揭示了社会规范传播的微观机制。

title: Economic Uncertainty and the Beta Anomaly
abstract: Using various measures of economic uncertainty, we find that the beta-alpha anomaly exists only during periods of low economic uncertainty. We argue that diminished risk appetite during high economic uncertainty eases leverage constraints of typical long-only investors, making overvaluation of high-beta stocks and undervaluation of low-beta stocks less likely. Differences in uncertainty-related beta trading activities between mutual fund investors/managers and hedge funds support this explanation. Variation of the beta anomaly within the low-uncertainty state further corroborates it: the anomaly is significant (insignificant) in stocks heavily held by actively managed mutual funds (hedge funds), and it is concentrated in the subperiods in which leverage constraints for long-only investors are likely to be more severe. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. Funding: Z. Cao and W. Wu acknowledge financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72495153 and 72310107002]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04372 .
summary: 该论文研究了经济不确定性如何影响贝塔异常（beta-alpha anomaly），即高贝塔股票被高估、低贝塔股票被低估的现象。通过使用多种经济不确定性度量指标，发现贝塔异常仅存在于低经济不确定性时期。作者认为，高经济不确定性时期风险偏好下降，缓解了典型多头投资者的杠杆约束，从而降低了高贝塔股票被高估和低贝塔股票被低估的可能性。来自共同基金（mutual funds）和对冲基金（hedge funds）的不确定性相关贝塔交易行为差异支持了这一解释。进一步地，在低不确定性状态下贝塔异常的变化也提供了佐证：贝塔异常在主动管理型共同基金重仓持有的股票中显著，而在对冲基金重仓持有的股票中不显著，并且集中在多头投资者杠杆约束可能更严重的子时期。
ai_comment: 这篇论文揭示了贝塔异常的时变特征，并提出了基于投资者风险偏好和杠杆约束的新机制，对理解市场异象的驱动因素有重要贡献。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Equilibrium Computation in Multistage Auctions and Contests
abstract: We compute equilibrium strategies in multistage games with continuous signal and action spaces as they are widely used in the management sciences and economics. Examples include sequential sales via auctions, multistage elimination contests, and Stackelberg competitions. In sequential auctions, analysts performing equilibrium analysis are required to derive not just single bids but bid functions for all possible signals or values that a bidder might have in multiple stages. Because of the continuity of the signal and action spaces, these bid functions come from an infinite dimensional space. Although such models are fundamental to game theory and its applications, equilibrium strategies are rarely known. The resulting system of nonlinear differential equations is considered intractable for all but elementary models. This has been limiting progress in game theory and is a barrier to its adoption in the field. We show that deep reinforcement learning and self-play can learn equilibrium bidding strategies for various multistage games. Verifying an equilibrium in such games is challenging because of the continuous signal and action spaces. We introduce a verification algorithm and prove that the error of this verifier decreases when considering Lipschitz continuous strategies with increasing levels of discretization and sample sizes. Leveraging the novel verification algorithm, we find equilibrium in models that have not yet been explored analytically and new asymmetric equilibrium bid functions for established models of sequential auctions. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: This work was supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft [Grant BI 1057/9]. Additionally, this project has received funding from the European Research Council under the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme [Grant Agreement 101198689]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06771 .
summary: 本文研究了具有连续信号和动作空间的多阶段博弈（如顺序拍卖、多阶段淘汰赛和Stackelberg竞争）中的均衡策略计算问题。由于信号和动作空间是连续的，投标函数来自无限维空间，求解非线性微分方程组在一般情况下是棘手的。作者证明，深度强化学习（deep reinforcement learning）与自我对弈（self-play）可以学习多阶段博弈的均衡投标策略。为验证均衡，提出了一种验证算法，并证明对于Lipschitz连续策略，随着离散化水平和样本量的增加，验证误差会降低。利用该验证算法，作者在尚未被解析探索的模型中找到了均衡，并为已知的顺序拍卖模型发现了新的非对称均衡投标函数。
ai_comment: 将深度强化学习应用于多阶段博弈均衡计算，并提出了可验证误差的算法，为复杂博弈的均衡求解提供了新方法。

title: Deep Learning Statistical Arbitrage
abstract: Statistical arbitrage exploits temporal price differences between similar assets. We develop a comprehensive conceptual framework for statistical arbitrage and a novel data-driven solution. First, we construct arbitrage portfolios of similar assets as residual portfolios from conditional latent asset pricing factors. Second, we extract their time-series signals with a powerful machine learning time-series solution, a convolutional transformer. Lastly, we use these signals to form an optimal trading policy, which maximizes risk-adjusted returns under constraints. Our comprehensive empirical study on daily U.S. equities shows a high compensation for arbitrageurs to enforce the law of one price. Our arbitrage strategies obtain considerable out-of-sample mean returns and Sharpe ratios, and outperform all benchmark approaches. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: The authors thank MSCI for generous research support.
summary: 本文构建了统计套利的综合概念框架与数据驱动解决方案。首先，通过条件潜在资产定价因子构造相似资产间的套利组合作为残差组合；其次，采用卷积Transformer这一强大时间序列机器学习方法提取时间序列信号；最后，利用这些信号在约束条件下最大化风险调整后收益，形成最优交易策略。基于美国股票日度数据的全面实证研究表明，套利者执行一价定律可获得高额补偿，所提策略在样本外获得可观平均收益和夏普比率，并显著优于所有基准方法。
ai_comment: 创新性地将卷积Transformer应用于套利信号提取，并形成完整的数据驱动框架，实证表现突出。

title: When Discounted Rates End: The Costs of Taking Action in the Mortgage Market
abstract: We combine administrative data with a life cycle structural model that exploits the unique features of the U.K. mortgage market to analyze the sources of inaction and to estimate borrowers’ nonpecuniary remortgaging costs. The utility costs needed to generate a given level of inaction depend on monetary gains from remortgaging and on the importance of those monetary gains for agents, which in turn depend on the (endogenously determined) marginal utility of consumption. The model results reveal significant nonpecuniary costs of action that, when measured as a proportion of borrower income, are larger for the young and for lower-income households.
summary: 本文结合英国抵押贷款市场的行政数据与生命周期结构模型，利用该市场的独特特征分析借款人不进行再抵押（remortgaging）的根源，并估算了其非金钱成本（nonpecuniary costs）。模型显示，产生特定程度不行动所需的效用成本取决于再抵押的货币收益以及这些收益对借款人的重要性，而后者又依赖于内生的消费边际效用。结果表明，非金钱行动成本显著存在，且按借款人收入比例衡量时，对年轻人和低收入家庭更高。
ai_comment: 该文通过结构模型量化了家庭金融决策中的非金钱成本，并揭示了其在不同人群中的异质性，为理解抵押市场惰性提供了新视角。

title: Optimal Portfolio Size Under Parameter Uncertainty
abstract: We introduce a method to determine the investor’s optimal portfolio size that maximizes the expected out-of-sample utility under parameter uncertainty. This portfolio size trades off between accessing investment opportunities and limiting the number of estimated parameters. Unlike sparse methods such as lasso, which exclude assets during the optimization step, our approach fixes the optimal number of assets before optimizing the portfolio weights, which improves robustness and provides greater flexibility in practical implementations. Empirically, our size-optimized portfolios outperform their counterparts applied to all available assets. Our methodology renders portfolio theory valuable even when the data-set dimension and sample size are comparable.
summary: 本文提出了一种在参数不确定性下确定投资者最优投资组合规模的方法，该规模能够最大化期望的样本外效用。最优规模在获取投资机会与限制估计参数数量之间进行权衡。与lasso等稀疏方法不同，后者在优化步骤中剔除资产，而本方法在优化投资组合权重之前先确定最优资产数量，从而提高了鲁棒性并在实际应用中提供了更大的灵活性。实证结果表明，规模优化的投资组合优于使用所有可用资产的投资组合。该方法使得投资组合理论在数据集维度和样本量相当时仍然具有价值。
ai_comment: 本文通过先确定资产数量再优化权重的方式，解决了传统稀疏方法在参数不确定性下的不足，具有较高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Political Consumerism and the Emergence of Rare Information on User-Generated Content Platforms
abstract: Consumers are increasingly supporting businesses and brands that align closely with their values, engaging in acts of political consumerism. Despite the growing demand to support minority-owned businesses, discovering these establishments through traditional channels remains challenging. In this study, we examine whether and how online reviews facilitate the discovery of Black-owned businesses. We leverage GPS-enabled foot traffic data, hand-collected data from a directory of Black-owned restaurants, online reviews from Yelp.com, and zip code-level demographic data to understand the potential mechanisms driving this behavior. Our results suggest that Black-owned restaurants receiving reviews mentioning Black ownership as a product attribute experience about a 10% increase in foot traffic compared with those that do not receive such reviews. Furthermore, we find that reviews mentioning Black ownership primarily benefit Black-owned restaurants located in cities with lower segregation and racial isolation and those where minority ownership is not easily inferable from the kind of cuisine served. Our findings also indicate that online reviews mentioning Black ownership increase foot traffic to Black-owned restaurants by enhancing interracial exposure. Non-White consumers who patronize these restaurants experience an increased likelihood of encountering White consumers after the restaurants receive a review mentioning Black ownership. Collectively, our results demonstrate the value of user-generated content in enabling political consumerism, even without targeted interventions from digital platforms or voluntary disclosure of race by business owners. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02789 .
summary: 本研究探讨在线评论如何促进消费者发现并支持黑人拥有的企业，即政治消费主义行为。利用GPS足迹数据、黑人餐馆目录、Yelp评论以及邮编级别人口统计数据，发现收到提及黑人所有权作为产品属性的评论的黑人餐馆，其客流量比未收到此类评论的餐馆增加约10%。这种效应在城市隔离程度较低、种族隔离较少且无法从菜系推断少数族裔所有权的情况下更为显著。此外，这些评论通过增强跨种族接触来提升客流量：非白人顾客在餐馆收到此类评论后，遇到白人顾客的可能性增加。研究结果表明，用户生成内容无需平台干预或企业主自愿披露种族信息，即可促进政治消费主义。
ai_comment: 该研究利用实地追踪数据揭示了线上评价对线下行为的因果影响，为政治消费主义提供了新颖的实证证据，并阐明了跨种族接触的机制。

title: Monetary Policy through Production Networks: Evidence from the Stock Market
abstract: We study the importance of production networks for the transmission of monetary policy using the stock market reaction as laboratory. We attribute 55% to 85% of the overall response to network effects. Large network effects are a robust feature of the data; we document similar patterns in realized fundamentals. Matching sparsity and the first two outdegrees industry-by-industry can explain large network effects. A simple model with intermediate inputs predicts the reaction of stock returns follows a spatial autoregression, which we exploit for our empirical strategy. Our results suggest production networks are an important mechanism for transmitting monetary policy shocks.
summary: 本文利用股票市场反应作为实验室，研究生产网络在货币政策传导中的重要性。通过空间自回归模型，作者发现网络效应解释了货币政策冲击后股票市场整体反应的55%至85%。这一结论在实现的基本面数据中也得到验证。研究进一步表明，仅匹配行业间稀疏性和前两个出度特征即可解释大部分网络效应。一个包含中间投入的简单模型预测股票收益的反应服从空间自回归，作者据此设计实证策略。结果强调生产网络是货币政策冲击传导的重要机制。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将股票市场微观数据与生产网络宏观结构结合，为货币政策传导渠道提供了新颖的实证证据，方法论上空间自回归模型的应用值得借鉴。

title: Volatile Rates, Fragile Growth: Global Financial Risk and Productivity Dynamics
abstract: We document that rising volatility in U.S. interest rates, a key dimension of global financial risk, notably depresses the trend of economic activity in emerging market economies (EMEs) but not in advanced economies (AEs).Using a panel state-space model, we show that a one standarddeviation shock to U.S. monetary policy uncertainty permanently lowers the level of GDP in EMEs by about 25 basis points after three years, with negligible effects in AEs.We rationalize this fact in a small open economy model where firms borrow against future profits to finance innovation.Higher volatility compresses firm values, tightens collateral constraints, and endogenously slows productivity growth, especially when financial frictions are severe.
summary: 本文研究了美国利率波动（作为全球金融风险的关键维度）对新兴市场经济体（EMEs）和发达经济体（AEs）经济活动趋势的影响。使用面板状态空间模型发现，美国货币政策不确定性一个标准差冲击会使EMEs的GDP水平在三年后永久下降约25个基点，而对AEs影响微乎其微。为解释这一现象，构建了一个小型开放经济模型，其中企业以未来利润为抵押进行创新融资。较高的波动性压缩了企业价值，收紧抵押约束，并内生地减缓了生产率增长，尤其是在金融摩擦严重时。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证和理论模型相结合，揭示了美国利率波动对新兴经济体生产率的长期负面影响机制，为理解全球金融风险传导提供了新视角。

title: Financializing the Professions: The Rise of Private Equity in Accounting
abstract: Private equity (PE) has moved rapidly into professional services, yet its impact on accounting, where licensing regimes, reputational capital, and partnership governance traditionally limit external ownership, remains poorly understood.We examine how PE ownership alters the organization and market structure of accounting firms using data from 1999-2024 that link more than 3,600 PE transactions to detailed information on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), labor markets, and audit pricing.PE investment increases sharply after 2020 and extends to both CPAlicensed audit firms and non-CPA advisory practices, with most activity in large mid-tier PCAOBregistered firms.After PE entry, firms grow faster: non-audit revenues rise, employment expands, and cross-state M&A accelerates, consistent with platform-building and consolidation.These adjustments have market-level implications.PE investment raises labor-market concentration in key accounting occupations and drives up ERISA audit fees in a standardized setting, as confirmed by a synthetic difference-in-differences design.Our results reveal a key tension at the core of professions: preserving independence and competition in a market increasingly driven by financial capital.
summary: 本文利用1999-2024年涵盖3600多笔私募股权（PE）交易、并购（M&A）、劳动力市场和审计定价的详细数据，研究PE所有权如何改变会计师事务所的组织和市场结构。PE投资在2020年后显著增加，并扩展到持有CPA执照的审计事务所和非CPA咨询业务，主要集中在大型中端PCAOB注册事务所。PE进入后，事务所增长加快：非审计收入上升、就业扩张、跨州M&A加速，符合平台建设和整合趋势。这些调整具有市场层面的影响：PE投资提高了关键会计职业的劳动力市场集中度，并在标准化环境中推高了ERISA审计费用，这一点通过合成双重差分法得到确认。结果揭示了职业核心的紧张关系：在金融资本日益驱动的市场中保持独立性和竞争。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统量化了PE对会计职业的影响，揭示了金融资本进入专业服务领域带来的结构变化和市场集中度上升，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Financial Returns to Equity Investments in Infrastructure in Emerging-Market and Developing Economies
abstract: Despite the scarcity of infrastructure in emerging-market and developing economies (EMDEs), in the absence of readily accessible data on the historical performance of EMDE infrastructure as an asset class, private investors are reluctant to finance infrastructure projects in these countries.We begin to fill this information gap by computing the financial returns from equity investments in primarily unlisted firms in EMDEs made by the International Finance Corporation, the privatesector arm of the World Bank Group.The public market equivalent of 266 equity investments in core infrastructure by the IFC, with starting dates from 1961 to March 2020, was 1.17 using the S&P 500 as a benchmark, and 1.26 using the MSCI Emerging Markets Index.On average, over the past six decades, equity stakes in emerging-market infrastructure backed by the IFC thus delivered higher returns than investments in portfolios of publicly listed equities.Data from the full sample of IFC equity investments reveal that, on average, a diversified portfolio of investments in infrastructure-related sectors, and indeed, in all sectors more generally, generated significant positive financial returns, albeit with variation across decades.
summary: 针对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDE）基础设施作为资产类别缺乏历史表现数据、导致私人投资者融资意愿低的问题，本文利用世界银行集团旗下国际金融公司（IFC）在EMDE以未上市企业为主的基础设施股权投资数据，计算财务回报。采用公开市场等价（PME）方法，以标普500指数和MSCI新兴市场指数为基准，分析了1961年至2020年3月期间IFC的266项核心基础设施股权投资的回报。结果显示，以标普500为基准的PME为1.17，以MSCI新兴市场指数为基准的PME为1.26，平均而言，IFC支持的EMDE基础设施股权投资在过去六十年中回报高于公开上市股票组合。全样本分析表明，基础设施相关行业及更广泛行业的分散化投资组合平均产生显著正财务回报，但回报率存在年代间差异。
ai_comment: 该论文利用IFC独特的长期投资数据，填补了EMDE基础设施股权回报的证据空白，为私人投资者提供重要参考。其方法严谨，结论具有政策启示。

title: The Economics of Advice: Evidence from Start-up Mentoring
abstract: This paper examines the role of advice in early firm development and growth, drawing on detailed data from a global program where angel investors and venture capitalists (VCs) mentored founders over several months. Leveraging variation in mentors’ availability to support start-ups because of personal scheduling conflicts, I find that advice significantly improves start-ups’ future market performance. To explore how advice shapes early firm development, I develop a novel typology of start-up activities, finding that a defining element of mentors’ advice is to do less and learn more. Although angels and VCs are consistent in this message, they differ significantly in when they choose to advise start-ups in achieving their business objectives. Angels are more likely than VCs to help founders design and execute product market experiments, whereas VCs provide more mentoring support on business analysis and planning tasks. I find evidence consistent with the hypothesis that experimentation is a skill developed via learning-by-doing, and angels have a skill advantage in that domain because of having more operational experience. This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy. Funding: The author acknowledges support from the Government of Canada’s Strategic Innovation Fund [Grant 811949] and RBC Borealis Graduate Fellowship [Grant 2018-0439]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05115 .
summary: 本文利用全球天使投资者和风险投资家（VC）在数月内指导创始人的详细数据，研究建议对初创企业早期发展和增长的作用。通过利用导师因个人日程冲突而导致的可用性变化作为外生变异，发现建议显著改善了初创企业未来的市场表现。为探索建议如何塑造早期企业发展，作者开发了一种新的初创企业活动分类法，发现导师建议的一个核心要素是“做得更少，学得更多”。尽管天使和VC在这一信息上一致，他们在何时选择建议初创企业实现业务目标上存在显著差异：天使更倾向于帮助创始人设计和执行产品市场实验，而VC则在商业分析与规划任务上提供更多指导。证据支持实验技能是通过“做中学”培养的假设，且天使因拥有更多运营经验而在该领域具有技能优势。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生变异识别因果效应，并细化了不同投资者建议的异质性，为创业辅导实践提供了新见解。

title: Intraday Liquidity and Money Market Dislocations
abstract: This paper proposes a new model of monetary policy implementation to account for two key developments: (i) the introduction of intraday liquidity requirements and (ii) the decreasing relevance of the federal funds market in favor of repurchase agreement (repo) markets with nonbank participants. Our paper studies how liquidity requirements prevent banks from arbitraging between the fed funds and repo markets and generate large repo spikes. We propose a simple measure of excess intraday reserves. Consistent with our theory, this metric is close to zero in 2019Q2, when U.S. repo markets experienced a spike of 400 basis points. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Fama-Miller Center for Research in Finance, Booth School of Business, University of Chicago. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04037 .
summary: 本文提出一个新的货币政策实施模型，以解释两个关键发展：(i) 日内流动性要求的引入，(ii) 联邦基金市场重要性下降，而回购市场（与非银行参与者）日益重要。研究流动性要求如何阻止银行在联邦基金和回购市场之间进行套利，并导致回购利率大幅飙升。论文提出一个简单的超额日内储备度量指标。与理论一致，该指标在2019年第二季度接近于零，当时美国回购市场经历了400个基点的飙升。本文得到了芝加哥大学布斯商学院Fama-Miller金融研究中心的资助。
ai_comment: 该模型巧妙地解释了回购利率飙升的成因，为理解流动性监管对货币市场的影响提供了新视角。

title: Financial Reporting Regulation in the Laboratory: A Case on Earnings Management
abstract: Using a controlled laboratory experiment, we examine how financial reporting regulations—limits on earnings management and auditing—affect disclosure quality and market efficiency. Our findings indicate that a tight limit and the possibility of an audit enhance the informativeness of earnings disclosures, leading to improved pricing efficiency while a weak limit deteriorates disclosure quality and pricing efficiency. Financial reporting regulations enhance disclosure quality via both constraining earnings management practices and inducing signaling behavior. Auditing more effectively boosts social welfare by suppressing manipulation, whereas limits trigger overinvestment in costly signal. Our results also shed light on previously contradictory empirical findings regarding financial reporting regulations. This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Y. Dai acknowledges support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72372163, 72132010, and 72273156] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [23wkqb10]. T. Bao acknowledges the financial support from the Ministry of Education (MOE) of Singapore Academic Research Fund Tier 1 Grant [RG121/23], NTU Centre for Computational Technologies in Finance (CCTF) and Alibaba-NTU Global e-Sustainability CorpLab (ANGEL). J. Zhu acknowledges the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72303170, 72141304, and 72201190], and the National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2022YFC3303304]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03361 .
summary: 该论文通过控制实验室实验，考察财务报告监管（包括盈余管理限制和审计）如何影响披露质量和市场效率。研究发现，严格的盈余管理限制和审计的可能性能够提高盈余披露的信息含量，从而改善定价效率；而薄弱的限制则会降低披露质量和定价效率。财务报告监管通过约束盈余管理行为和诱导信号行为来提升披露质量。与限制相比，审计能更有效地通过抑制操纵来提高社会福利，而限制则可能导致对昂贵信号的过度投资。研究结果还揭示了此前关于财务报告监管的实证研究中存在的矛盾之处。
ai_comment: 该文利用实验室实验方法，为财务报告监管的效果提供了因果证据，并揭示了不同监管强度下的异质性影响，有助于调和以往实证研究中的矛盾结论。

title: In-Group Bias in Financial Markets
abstract: Using gender to identify analyst groups, we examine whether in-group bias affects the behavior of sell-side equity analysts and the information dissemination process. We find that analysts hold more optimistic and less accurate earnings expectations for firms with same-gender CEOs, where in-group bias is stronger among men. Greater exposure to out-of-group individuals weakens in-group bias, and the bias is also weaker among analysts located in U.S. states with greater gender equality. Group definitions based on race/ethnicity and name similarity yield similar results. These findings are robust and unlikely to reflect selective information access or various selection effects. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01467 .
summary: 本文利用性别来识别分析师群体，研究内群体偏见是否影响卖方股票分析师的行为及信息传播过程。研究发现，分析师对公司CEO与自己性别相同时，其盈利预期更乐观但准确性更低，且男性分析师的内群体偏见更强。增加与外群体成员的接触会削弱这种偏见，而在性别平等程度较高的美国州，分析师的偏见也较弱。基于种族/民族和名字相似性的群体定义也得到了类似结果。这些发现具有稳健性，不太可能反映选择性信息获取或各种选择效应。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地以性别划分群体，揭示了内群体偏见在金融分析师预测中的显著影响，并探讨了环境因素（如性别平等）的调节作用，为行为金融学提供了新证据。

title: Market Returns and a Tale of Two Types of Attention
abstract: We provide novel evidence that aggregate investor attention to stocks predicts marketwide returns, but with a striking difference across investor clienteles. Daily aggregate retail attention (ARA) negatively predicts one-week-ahead market returns, is associated with aggregate retail order imbalance and flows to equity mutual funds, and exhibits a stronger predictability during periods of high marketwide uncertainty, poor liquidity, or more costly short selling. In contrast, aggregate institutional attention (AIA), when observed before major news announcements, positively predict future marketwide returns. In cross-sectional analysis, we show that the predictability is stronger for ARA among illiquid stocks and for AIA among high-beta stocks. The predictability results are robust out-of-sample and correspond to meaningful expected utility gains even for diversified investors. The findings are consistent with the idea that attention-driven retail buying can generate an aggregate price pressure on the stock market, whereas institutional attention precedes the resolution of marketwide uncertainty and the accrual of risk premiums. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: J. Hua acknowledges the Professional Staff Congress-City University of New York Research Foundation for financial support. L. Peng acknowledges the Wasserman Summer Research Grant and the Krell Research Fund for financial support. T.C.-C.
