Hung acknowledges research support from the Ministry of Science and Technology, Taiwan [Grants 110-2410-H-002-245 and 111-2410-H-002-197], and the E. Sun Academic Award. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01294 .
summary: 本文提供了新的证据，表明投资者对股票的总体注意力可以预测市场整体回报，但不同投资者群体之间存在显著差异。每日总体零售注意力（ARA）负向预测一周后的市场回报，并与零售订单失衡和股票共同基金的资金流入相关；在市场不确定性高、流动性差或卖空成本高的时期，其预测能力更强。相比之下，总体机构注意力（AIA）在重大新闻公告前观察时，正向预测未来市场回报。横截面分析显示，ARA对流动性差的股票的预测能力更强，而AIA对高贝塔股票的预测能力更强。预测结果在样本外稳健，且能为多元化投资者带来有意义期望效用收益。这些发现与零售注意力驱动买入产生市场整体价格压力、而机构注意力先于市场不确定性解决和风险溢价累积的观点一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分零售和机构两种注意力的不同预测效应，揭示了注意力驱动市场回报的异质性机制，为行为金融和资产定价文献提供了新视角。

title: Automated Enforcement and Traffic Safety
abstract: Traffic safety poses a persistent challenge for society and public policy. Conventional law enforcement by human police is often cost-ineffective because of information asymmetry and negative externalities of unsafe driving behaviors. Automated enforcement, in the form of traffic cameras on the road, has gained prominence in recent decades, yet its effectiveness and underlying mechanisms remain debated. This study examines the impact of traffic cameras on road safety using longitudinal data from a metropolitan city in China. We distinguish between advanced cameras, which use machine learning to detect various traffic violations and constantly record video, and conventional cameras, which rely on triggered image capture for a limited number of violations. Using an event study design with staggered camera installations at road intersections, we observe a significant and sustained reduction in accidents near advanced cameras, compared with locations with no cameras or only conventional cameras. Further analysis identifies three key mechanisms driving the effects of advanced cameras: (i) automated detection effect—superior technical capabilities to automate violation detection; (ii) real-time recording effect—continuous monitoring and recording capability to augment accident cause identification; and (iii) driver learning effect—technology-enabled deterrence that increases driver awareness of these cameras and encourages behavioral adjustments to mitigate accident risks. This study contributes to information systems, transportation economics, and criminology, offering policy insights into the effective design and deployment of automated enforcement to improve traffic safety. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: Z. Cheng acknowledges the support of the Staff Research Fund at the London School of Economics and Political Science. Z. Dong acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) Young Scientists Fund [Grant 72202247] and the Guangdong Basic and Applied Basic Research Foundation [Grant 2024A1515012806]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00575 .
summary: 交通安全是社会和公共政策面临的持续挑战。传统的人工执法由于信息不对称和不安全驾驶行为的负外部性而往往成本效益低下。自动执法以道路上的交通摄像头形式在近几十年受到重视，但其有效性和内在机制仍存在争议。本研究利用中国某大城市的纵向数据，考察交通摄像头对道路安全的影响。我们区分了先进摄像头和传统摄像头：先进摄像头使用机器学习检测多种交通违规并持续录制视频，而传统摄像头依赖触发式图像捕获检测有限的违规行为。使用交错安装摄像头的路口事件研究设计，我们观察到与没有摄像头或仅有传统摄像头的位置相比，先进摄像头附近的事故显著且持续减少。进一步分析确定了先进摄像头效应的三个关键机制：（i）自动检测效应——自动检测违规的优越技术能力；（ii）实时记录效应——持续监控和记录能力以增强事故原因识别；（iii）驾驶员学习效应——技术驱动的威慑增加了驾驶员对这些摄像头的意识，鼓励行为调整以减轻事故风险。本研究为信息系统、运输经济学和犯罪学做出贡献，为有效设计和部署自动执法以改善交通安全提供政策见解。
ai_comment: 该研究通过区分先进与传统摄像头，揭示了自动执法的三种机制，为政策制定提供了细致的实证依据。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: The Role of Corporate Board of Directors in Public Charity Lobbying
abstract: We show that public charities with corporate directors on their boards are more likely to lobby on behalf of connected corporate interests. We document this result using granular fixed effects and alternative measures, excluding donor firms, focusing on specific legislation bills, and shocks to board connections. The effects of connections are stronger when firms face more competition, have better corporate governance, and are more exposed to political risks. Through connected charity lobbying, firms enjoy political benefits in the form of governmental procurement contracts. Policies aimed at improving the transparency of nonprofits help discipline charities who would otherwise seek funding benefits through procorporate lobbying activities. Our results highlight directors’ charitable engagement as a complementary avenue for corporate political activities. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00165 .
summary: 本文研究公共慈善机构中企业董事的存在如何影响慈善游说活动。利用粒度固定效应、替代测量、排除捐赠企业、聚焦特定立法草案以及董事会连接冲击等方法，发现拥有企业董事的公共慈善机构更可能为关联企业利益进行游说。这种效应在企业面临更强竞争、公司治理更好、政治风险暴露更高时更为显著。通过关联慈善游说，企业获得政府采购合同等政治利益。旨在提高非营利组织透明度的政策有助于约束那些通过亲企业游说活动获取资金利益的慈善机构。研究结果突出了董事的慈善参与作为企业政治活动的补充途径。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了企业董事会成员通过慈善机构进行政治游说的隐蔽渠道，丰富了企业政治活动与非营利组织治理的交叉研究，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Bank Compensation for the Penalty-Free Loan Prepayment Option: Theory and Evidence
abstract: While it is standard for corporate bonds to include a loan cancellation fee, a surprising 90% of tranche A commercial and industrial term loans allow borrowers to prepay the loan without penalty. We use a simple framework with dynamic learning to derive testable implications for the required bank compensation when including a penalty-free prepayment option. In this framework, after loan origination, borrowers receive noncontractible public information about the value of the project funded by the bank loan. This information causes some ex post high-value borrowers to prepay or renegotiate the loan to obtain a lower rate, deteriorating the credit quality of the bank’s remaining borrower pool. To avoid credit rationing of borrowers with a high prepayment risk, we show that the bank’s compensation must be in the form of an upfront fee rather than a higher initial loan rate, as the latter only exacerbates the adverse prepayment incentive. The model also accounts for the possibility that in relationship lending, an upfront fee may dominate a loan cancellation fee when the latter triggers costly ex post bargaining with high-value clients. To test model predictions, we construct a prepayment risk index, which contains proxies for borrower upside potential and loan renegotiation costs, and we use aggregate industry-level merger and acquisition (M&A) activity as an instrument for exogenous variation in loan prepayment risk. The tests support that upfront fees increase with borrower prepayment risk. In addition, upfront fees are lower for credit lines and loans with performance-sensitive pricing, as predicted. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: Partial financial support from Tuck’s Lindenauer Forum for Corporate Governance (Eckbo) and from the Norwegian Research Council [Grant 273678] (Thorburn and Su) is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00159 .
summary: 本文研究银行对无罚金提前还款选择权的补偿机制。虽然公司债券通常包含贷款取消费，但约90%的A档商业工业定期贷款允许借款人在无罚金的情况下提前还款。作者构建了一个包含动态学习的简单框架，推导出银行要求补偿的可检验含义。在该框架中，贷款发放后，借款人收到关于银行所资助项目价值的非合约公共信息，这些信息导致部分事后高价值借款人提前还款或重新谈判以获得更低利率，从而恶化银行剩余借款人池的信用质量。为避免对高提前还款风险的借款人进行信贷配给，银行的补偿必须采取预付费形式而非更高的初始贷款利率，因为后者会加剧提前还款的不良激励。模型还指出，在关系贷款中，预付费可能优于贷款取消费，因为后者会触发与高价值客户的事后昂贵谈判。为检验模型预测，作者构建了包含借款人上行潜力和贷款重新谈判成本代理变量的提前还款风险指数，并使用行业层面的并购活动作为提前还款风险的外生工具变量。实证检验支持预付费随借款人提前还款风险增加而增加，且对于信贷额度和具有业绩敏感定价的贷款，预付费较低，与模型预测一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过动态学习框架创新性地解释了银行对无罚金提前还款选择权的补偿机制，并利用并购活动作为外生工具变量提供了有力的实证证据，对银行贷款定价实务具有重要启示。

title: Assuring the Crowd: The Role of Assurance in Securities Crowdfunding Success
abstract: This paper examines the role of CPA financial statement assurance in securities crowdfunding. Under SEC Regulation Crowdfunding, effective May 2016, early-stage private companies are permitted to conduct securities crowdfunding offerings—low-dollar securities offerings on Internet platforms—to a large number of investors. Using SEC filings and hand-collected data on the universe of offerings from 2016 to 2019, we examine the relation between CPA assurance and capital raised in the securities crowdfunding market. We fail to find evidence that issuers voluntarily seek higher levels of assurance, and we document high rates of noncompliance with the CPA assurance requirements. Our results suggest the on average positive association between CPA assurance and crowdfunding outcomes shown in prior research is explained by noncompliance with the Reg CF assurance requirements and is not driven by additional assurance. Overall, this study provides new insights of interest to crowdfunding issuers, investors, and regulators on the role of assurance in this nascent market of capital formation for startups. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03178 .
summary: 本文研究注册会计师财务报告保证在证券众筹中的作用。根据美国证券交易委员会2016年5月生效的Regulation Crowdfunding，早期私营公司可通过互联网平台向大量投资者进行低金额证券众筹。作者使用SEC备案文件和手工收集的2016至2019年间所有众筹发行数据，检验CPA保证与筹资金额之间的关系。研究发现，发行人并未自愿寻求更高水平的保证，且存在高比例的不符合CPA保证要求的情况。结果表明，先前研究显示的CPA保证与众筹结果之间的正相关关系实际上是由对Reg CF保证要求的不合规所解释，而非额外保证本身驱动。该研究为众筹发行人、投资者和监管机构提供了关于保证在初创企业资本形成新兴市场中作用的新见解。
ai_comment: 该文通过手工收集的大量数据揭示了CPA保证在众筹中的实际合规问题，挑战了以往研究中简单正相关的结论，对监管政策有一定启示。

title: Relaxed Indexability and Index Policy for Partially Observable Restless Bandits
abstract: This paper addresses an important class of restless multiarmed bandit (RMAB) problems that finds broad application in operations research, stochastic optimization, and reinforcement learning. There are N independent Markov processes that may be operated, observed and offer rewards. Due to the resource constraint, we can only choose a subset of [Formula: see text] processes to operate and accrue reward determined by the states of selected processes. We formulate the problem as a partially observable RMAB with an infinite state space and design an algorithm that achieves a near-optimal performance with low complexity. Our algorithm is based on a generalization of Whittle’s original idea of indexability. Referred to as the relaxed indexability, the extended definition leads to the efficient online verifications and computations of the approximate Whittle index under the proposed algorithmic framework. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02831 .
summary: 本文研究了一类重要的休止多臂老虎机（RMAB）问题，该问题在运筹学、随机优化和强化学习中有广泛应用。问题涉及N个独立的马尔可夫过程，每个过程可以被操作、观察并提供奖励。由于资源约束，只能选择[公式]个过程进行操作并获取奖励。作者将问题建模为具有无限状态空间的部分可观察RMAB，并设计了一种低复杂度的近最优算法。该算法基于Whittle原始可索引性概念的推广，称为松弛可索引性，该扩展定义使得在所提出的算法框架下能够高效地在线验证和计算近似Whittle索引。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入松弛可索引性，将Whittle索引方法推广到部分可观察场景，并提供了在线验证和计算框架，具有重要的理论创新和实际应用价值。

title: Finding Your Calling: Matching Skills with Jobs in the Mutual Fund Industry
abstract: To best utilize labor, companies need to match employees’ skills with jobs that best fit those skills. Exploiting unique features of the mutual fund industry, we identify instances when this matching happens for fund managers and study its consequences. When fund managers are matched, they deliver a significantly higher risk-adjusted performance. Fund companies use this information to maximize company value by increasing assets under the management of these managers (i.e., assigning them to more and larger funds) and by collecting higher fees from these managers’ funds. In addition, they make the expertise of these managers available to other managers of the fund company. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02805 .
summary: 本文利用共同基金行业的独特特征，识别基金经理技能与岗位匹配的情形，并研究其影响。研究发现，当基金经理与岗位匹配时，他们能实现显著更高的风险调整后收益（risk-adjusted performance）。基金公司利用这一信息来最大化公司价值：通过增加这些经理管理的资产规模（分配更多和更大的基金）以及对其管理的基金收取更高费用。此外，公司还将这些经理的专业知识分享给其他经理。该文被Lukas Schmid接受，附录和数据集可在指定链接获取。
ai_comment: 本文利用行业独特数据实证了岗位匹配对个人绩效和公司价值的双重影响，为人力资源管理在金融领域的应用提供了新视角。

title: Is Relevancy Everything? A Deep-Learning Approach to Understand the Effect of Image-Text Congruence
abstract: Firms increasingly use a combination of image and text description when displaying products and engaging consumers. Existing research has examined consumers’ response to text and image stimuli separately but has yet to systematically consider how the semantic relationship between image and text impacts consumer choice. In this research, we conduct a series of multimethod empirical studies to examine the congruence between image- and text-based product representation. First, we propose a deep-learning approach to measure image-text congruence by building a state-of-the-art two-branch neural network model based on wide residual networks and bidirectional encoder representations from transformers. Next, we apply our method to data from an online reading platform and discover a U-shaped effect of image-text congruence: Consumers’ preference toward a product is higher when the congruence between the image and text representation is either high or low than when the congruence is at the medium level. We then conduct experiments to establish the causal effect of this finding and explore the underlying mechanisms. We further explore the generalizability of the proposed deep-learning model and our substantive finding in two additional settings. Our research contributes to the literature on consumer information processing and generates managerial implications for practitioners on how to strategically pair images and text on digital platforms. This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing. Funding: J. Cao acknowledges financial support from Young Scientists Fund of National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72402192], the General Research Fund [Grant 17501423] and Early Career Scheme [Grant 27502521] of the Research Grants Council of Hong Kong, and the Institute of Behavioural and Decision Science, the University of Hong Kong (HKU). Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01896 .
summary: 本文研究企业同时使用图像和文字描述产品时，图像与文字之间的语义一致性如何影响消费者选择。作者提出了一种基于深度学习的度量方法，使用宽残差网络（Wide ResNet）和双向编码器表示（BERT）构建两分支神经网络模型来测量图像-文本一致性。基于在线阅读平台数据，发现图像-文本一致性对消费者偏好呈U型效应：当一致性很高或很低时，消费者偏好较高；而一致性中等时偏好较低。通过实验验证了因果关系并探讨了内在机制，并在另外两个环境中检验了模型和发现的泛化性。研究为消费者信息处理文献做出贡献，并为数字平台上图像与文本的战略配对提供了管理启示。
ai_comment: 利用深度学习客观量化图像与文本的语义一致性，并揭示U型关系，为数字营销中的内容组合策略提供了新颖的实证证据和理论解释。

title: Leveraging Expert Consistency to Improve Algorithmic Decision Support
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly being used to support high-stakes decisions. However, there is frequently a construct gap: a gap between the construct of interest to the decision-making task and what is captured in proxies used as labels to train ML models. As a result, ML models may fail to capture important dimensions of decision criteria, hampering their utility for decision support. Thus, an essential step in the design of ML systems for decision support is selecting a target label among available proxies. In this work, we explore the use of historical expert decisions as a rich—yet also imperfect—source of information that can be combined with observed outcomes to narrow the construct gap. We argue that managers and system designers may be interested in learning from experts in instances where they exhibit consistency with each other while learning from observed outcomes otherwise. We develop a methodology to enable this goal using information that is commonly available in organizational information systems. This involves two core steps. First, we propose an influence function-based methodology to estimate expert consistency indirectly when each case in the data are assessed by a single expert. Second, we introduce a label amalgamation approach that allows ML models to simultaneously learn from expert decisions and observed outcomes. Our empirical evaluation, using simulations in a clinical setting and real-world data from the child welfare domain, indicates that the proposed approach successfully narrows the construct gap, yielding better predictive performance than learning from either observed outcomes or expert decisions alone. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Funding: This work was supported by the National Institutes of Health [Grant R01NS124642], Good Systems, University of Texas at Austin, the Metro 21 Institute, the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency [Grant FA8750-17-2-0130], the National Science Foundation [Grant 1939606], Google [Award for Inclusion Research], and the UK Medical Research Council [Grants MC UU 00002/2, MC UU 00002/5, and MC UU 00040/02–Precision Medicine]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01576 .
summary: 机器学习（ML）越来越多地被用于支持高风险决策，但常常存在构造差距（construct gap），即决策任务关心的构造与用于训练ML模型的代理标签之间的差距，导致ML模型可能无法捕捉决策标准的重要维度。本文提出利用历史专家决策作为丰富但也不完美的信息源，结合观察到的结果来缩小构造差距。方法包括两步：首先，提出一种基于影响函数（influence function）的方法，在数据中每个案例仅由单个专家评估时间接估计专家一致性；其次，引入一种标签融合（label amalgamation）方法，使ML模型能够同时从专家决策和观察结果中学习。在临床模拟和儿童福利真实数据上的实证评估表明，该方法成功缩小了构造差距，预测性能优于仅从观察结果或仅从专家决策中学习。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用专家一致性作为桥梁，结合观察结果来改进标签质量，方法实用且具有现实意义，尤其适用于标签不完美的决策场景。

title: Internal Capital Allocation, Voluntary Disclosure, and Investment Efficiency
abstract: I develop an analytical model to examine the effect of disclosure on organizational structure. In this model, an owner with two investment projects decides whether to organize them as a single multidivisional firm or two stand-alone firms whose manager(s) may issue a truthful but costly disclosure of each project’s profitability to raise capital. In a multidivisional firm, capital is initially provided by investors and subsequently allocated across the two projects by the manager. The analysis shows that a multidivisional structure allows for efficient internal capital allocation while avoiding disclosure costs, whereas a stand-alone structure prevents inefficient cross-subsidization. Specifically, a multidivisional structure is optimal when disclosure costs are high relative to project payoffs. These results help explain empirical evidence that multidivisional firms tend to trade at a discount. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Ananthakrishnan, accounting.
summary: 本文构建了一个分析模型，研究自愿披露对组织结构（多部门公司vs独立公司）的影响。模型假设一位所有者拥有两个投资项目，可选择将其组建为一个多部门公司（由经理统一配置资本）或两个独立公司（经理可进行真实但有成本的自愿披露以融资）。研究发现，多部门结构能实现高效的内部资本配置并避免披露成本，但可能产生低效的交叉补贴；而独立结构可防止交叉补贴但需承担披露成本。当披露成本相对项目收益较高时，多部门结构最优。这一结果有助于解释实证中多部门公司普遍存在的折价交易现象。
ai_comment: 模型巧妙地将披露成本与组织结构选择相结合，为多部门公司折价效应提供了新的理论解释。

title: Textual Factors: A Scalable, Interpretable, and Data-Driven Approach to Analyzing Unstructured Information
abstract: We introduce a general approach for analyzing large-scale text-based data, combining the strengths of neural network language processing and generative statistical modeling to create a factor structure of unstructured data for downstream regressions typically used in social sciences. We generate textual factors by (i) representing texts using vector word embedding, (ii) clustering the vectors using locality-sensitive hashing to generate supports of topics, and (iii) identifying relatively interpretable spanning clusters (i.e., textual factors) through topic modeling. Our data-driven approach captures complex linguistic structures while ensuring computational scalability and economic interpretability, plausibly attaining certain advantages over and complementing other unstructured data analytics used by researchers, including emergent large language models. We conduct initial validation tests of the framework and discuss three types of its applications: (i) enhancing prediction and inference with texts, (ii) interpreting (non–text-based) models, and (iii) constructing new text-based metrics and explanatory variables. We illustrate each of these applications using examples in finance and economics such as macroeconomic forecasting from news articles, interpreting multifactor asset pricing models from corporate filings, and measuring theme-based technology breakthroughs from patents. Finally, we provide a flexible statistical package of textual factors for online distribution to facilitate future research and applications. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the financial support from the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation, the Becker Friedman Institute of Economics, the Fama-Miller Center for Research in Finance, INQUIRE Europe, the Kenan Institute of Private Enterprise, and the Risk Institute at OSU Fisher College of Business (while L. W. Cong was a fellow at the institute). W. Zhu acknowledges financial support from the Tsinghua University Initiative Scientific Research Program [Grant 2022Z04W02016], the Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management [Research Grant 2022051002], and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72442014]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01180 .
summary: 本文提出了一种可扩展、可解释且数据驱动的文本因子方法，用于分析大规模非结构化文本数据。该方法结合神经网络语言处理和生成统计模型，通过三个阶段构建文本因子：首先使用词向量嵌入表示文本，然后利用局部敏感哈希对向量进行聚类以生成主题支持，最后通过主题建模识别可解释的跨领域聚类（即文本因子）。该方法捕获复杂语言结构的同时保证计算可扩展性和经济可解释性，可能优于并补充其他非结构化数据分析方法（包括大型语言模型）。作者进行了初步验证测试，并讨论了三种应用类型：利用文本增强预测与推断、解释非文本模型、构建基于文本的度量与解释变量。通过金融与经济实例（如基于新闻文章的宏观经济预测、从企业文件中解释多因子资产定价模型、从专利中衡量主题技术突破）加以说明。最后，提供了一个灵活的文本因子统计软件包以便未来研究与应用。
ai_comment: 该方法在可扩展性与可解释性之间取得了良好平衡，为社会科学中大规模文本分析提供了通用框架。其在金融经济学中的实证应用展示了实际价值。

title: Measuring regulatory complexity
abstract: We propose a framework to study regulatory complexity, based on concepts from computer science. We distinguish different dimensions of complexity, classify existing measures, develop new ones, compute them on three examples — Basel I, the Dodd–Frank Act, and the European Banking Authority’s reporting rules — and test them using experiments and a survey on compliance costs. We highlight two measures that capture complexity beyond the length of a regulation. We propose a quantitative approach to the policy trade-off between regulatory complexity and precision.
summary: 本文基于计算机科学概念提出一个研究监管复杂性的框架。作者区分了复杂性的不同维度，对现有度量进行了分类，并开发了新的度量方法。他们将这些度量应用于三个案例——Basel I、Dodd-Frank Act和European Banking Authority's reporting rules——并通过实验和合规成本调查进行了测试。研究强调两个度量指标能够捕捉到超出监管文本长度之外的复杂性。最后，文章提出了一个定量方法，用于权衡监管复杂性与精确性之间的政策取舍。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将计算机科学概念引入金融监管复杂性度量，并提出了超越篇幅的复杂性的定量方法，对监管政策设计有重要意义。

title: Heterogeneous clienteles and dealer networks
abstract: This paper studies a search-based model of OTC markets in which clients with heterogeneous trading needs direct their trades to one of ex-ante identical dealers. The main insight of the paper is that the way clients sort across dealers shapes dealer-to-dealer trading patterns and, in turn, generates a core–periphery interdealer network structure. Dealers in the model become heterogeneous because they attract different clients in equilibrium. Some dealers attract clients who trade frequently (e.g., index funds); others attract clients with infrequent trading needs (e.g., pension funds). Dealers attracting clients with frequent trading needs receive a larger volume of client orders, trade more with other dealers, and, as a result, form the core of the interdealer network. Conversely, dealers specializing in clients with infrequent trading needs form the periphery. I also show that accounting for client heterogeneity across dealers (a) challenges standard measurements and interpretations of bid–ask spreads and (b) generates predictions on bid–ask spreads and dealer centrality consistent with the empirical literature.
summary: 该论文构建了一个基于搜索的场外交易（OTC）市场模型，其中具有异质性交易需求的客户将其交易导向事前同质的交易商。核心洞察在于，客户在交易商之间的分类方式塑造了交易商之间的交易模式，进而形成了核心-外围的交易商间网络结构。均衡中，交易商因吸引不同客户而产生异质性：吸引频繁交易客户（如指数基金）的交易商获得更大规模的客户订单，与其他交易商交易更多，从而构成网络核心；而吸引低频交易客户（如养老基金）的交易商则形成外围。此外，论文表明，考虑交易商间的客户异质性会挑战买卖价差的标准度量与解释，并产生与实证文献一致的关于买卖价差和交易商中心性的预测。
ai_comment: 该模型为OTC市场中核心-外围网络结构的形成提供了内生解释，并揭示了客户异质性对价差度量与交易商中心性的重要影响。

title: Global sales, international currencies, and the currency denomination of debt
abstract: We document that the currency denomination of the debt of large firms in developed countries is strongly associated with the geographical distribution of their sales. Furthermore, those firms exhibit significant home currency bias and international currency bias in borrowing: controlling for the geography of sales, they borrow more in their home currency and the two most traded currencies, the US dollar and the euro. We also show that the firms’ debt currency denomination choices are associated with export invoicing currency patterns in a way consistent with a currency hedging mechanism. In particular, firms domiciled in countries that invoice a larger share of their exports in either their home currency or in a vehicle currency exhibit a weaker connection between the currency denomination of their debt and the geography of their sales. Moreover, firms in countries that invoice more of their exports in an international currency are characterized by stronger international currency bias in debt issuance.
summary: 本文研究了发达国家大型企业债务的货币构成与其销售地域分布之间的关系。研究发现，债务货币与销售地域分布显著相关，并且企业表现出显著的本币偏好和国际货币偏好（即美元和欧元）。在控制销售地域分布后，企业倾向于以本币及美元、欧元这两种交易最活跃的货币借款。此外，债务货币选择与出口发票货币模式一致，支持货币对冲机制：当企业所在国出口中以本币或媒介货币（如美元、欧元）开票的比例较高时，债务货币与销售地域分布之间的联系较弱；而当出口中使用国际货币的比例较高时，企业债务发行中的国际货币偏好更强。
ai_comment: 本文通过大样本实证揭示了销售地域分布对企业债务货币选择的关键作用，并识别出本币与国际货币的双重偏好，为理解跨国公司融资决策提供了新视角，同时也为货币国际化研究提供了微观证据。

title: Robots and firm investment
abstract: Using cross-country and German administrative data on robotization, we show that the impact of robots on firms and labor markets is limited. First, investment in robots is small and highly concentrated in a few industries, representing less than 0.3% of aggregate expenditures on equipment. Second, robotization does not grow as rapidly as Information Technology did in the past, and current growth is driven by gains in developing countries. Third, firms invest in robots when they face difficulties in finding workers and subsequently increase employment after the investment. The total employment effect in exposed industries and regions is negative but modest in magnitude. We discuss why the effects of robots are limited and demonstrate that other digital technologies have more potential for large economic impact.
summary: 本文使用跨国数据和德国行政管理数据研究机器人化对企业和劳动力市场的影响。研究发现：首先，机器人投资规模小且高度集中于少数行业，仅占设备总支出的不到0.3%；其次，机器人化的增长速度远不及过去的信息技术（IT），当前的增长主要由发展中国家驱动；第三，企业在招工困难时投资机器人，投资后就业反而增加。在受影响的行业和地区，总体就业效应为负，但幅度较小。文章讨论了机器人影响有限的原因，并指出其他数字技术具有更大的经济影响潜力。
ai_comment: 本文利用详细的微观数据，从投资规模、增长速度和就业效应等多个维度全面论证了机器人对经济的影响有限，为理解技术变革的实际经济后果提供了重要实证。

title: Dealer balance sheets and bidding behavior in the Bank of England’s QE reverse auctions
abstract: We study dealers’ bidding behavior in the Bank of England’s quantitative easing (QE) reverse auctions. Using a granular dataset on both accepted and rejected offers together with an equilibrium model of bidding behavior, we estimate dealers’ valuations of securities offered to the Bank of England. We also recover the rents accruing to dealers from participating in the auctions as opposed to liquidating gilts in the secondary market, thereby possibly causing prices to change. These rents or so-called ”liquidity benefits” are largest in the early phases of QE implemented during the Global Financial Crisis, suggesting that QE may be particularly effective in restoring smooth market functioning when market participants are facing large liquidity shocks. Finally, we document that dealers’ valuations vary significantly with the amount of interest rate risk acquired in the secondary gilt market before the auction and with dealers’ regulatory capital.
summary: 本文研究英国央行量化宽松（QE）反向拍卖中交易商的投标行为。利用包含已接受和已拒绝报价的细粒度数据集，结合投标行为的均衡模型，估计交易商对提供给英国央行的证券的估值，并计算交易商参与拍卖相对于在二级市场清算金边债券所获得的租金（即“流动性收益”）。研究发现，这些租金在全球金融危机期间实施的QE早期阶段最大，表明当市场参与者面临大规模流动性冲击时，QE在恢复市场平稳运行方面特别有效。此外，交易商的估值与拍卖前在二级金边市场获得的利率风险量以及交易商的监管资本显著相关。
ai_comment: 利用独特的微观数据（包含未中标报价）和结构模型，首次量化了QE反向拍卖中交易商的租金，并揭示了流动性收益在危机早期阶段的突出作用，为理解QE传导机制提供了新证据。

title: Green tilts
abstract: We estimate financial institutions’ portfolio tilts related to U.S. stocks’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) characteristics. From 2012 to 2023, ESG-related tilts consistently total about 6% of the investment industry’s assets and rise from 17% to 27% of institutions’ total portfolio tilts. Significant ESG tilts arise from the choice of stocks held and, especially, the weights on stocks held. The largest institutions tilt increasingly toward green stocks, while other institutions and households tilt increasingly brown. Divestment from brown stocks is typically partial rather than full, even for individual mutual funds. UNPRI signatories and European institutions tilt greener; banks tilt browner.
summary: 研究估计了2012年至2023年间金融机构在美国股票环境、社会和治理（ESG）特征上的投资组合倾向。ESG相关倾向平均占投资行业总资产的约6%，并在机构总组合倾向中的占比从17%上升至27%。显著的ESG倾向源于所持股票的选择，尤其是持仓权重。最大型机构日益转向绿色股票，而其他机构和家庭则日益转向棕色股票。剥离棕色股票通常是部分而非完全剥离，即使在单个共同基金层面也是如此。联合国负责任投资原则（UNPRI）签署方和欧洲机构更倾向于绿色，而银行更倾向于棕色。
ai_comment: 论文通过大样本数据量化了ESG投资倾向的动态变化，并揭示了不同机构类型间的显著分化，为理解ESG投资行为的异质性提供了实证依据。

title: Data and welfare in credit markets
abstract: We show how to measure the welfare effects arising from increased data availability. When lenders have more data on prospective borrower costs, they can charge prices that are more aligned with these costs. This increases total social welfare and transfers surplus across borrower types. We show that under certain assumptions the magnitudes of these welfare changes can be estimated using only quantity and price data. Applying our methodology to bankruptcy flag removal, we find that in a counterfactual world where bankruptcy flags are never removed from credit reports, previously-bankrupt borrowers’ surplus decreases substantially, whereas efficiency increases only modestly.
summary: 该论文研究数据可用性增加对信用市场福利效应的影响。当贷款人获得更多关于借款人成本的信息时，能够制定更匹配成本的定价，从而提高总社会福利并转移借款人类型之间的剩余。作者证明，在特定假设下，这些福利变化的大小可仅通过数量和价格数据估算。将该方法应用于破产标志移除（即信用报告中破产记录不再删除）的反事实分析，发现未移除破产标志会导致已破产借款人的剩余大幅下降，而效率仅小幅提升。
ai_comment: 本文仅利用价格和数量数据即可估计数据可得性变化带来的福利影响，方法简洁且实用；对破产标志移除政策的分析揭示了效率与公平之间的权衡。

title: Regulatory leakage among financial advisors: Evidence from FINRA regulation of “bad” brokers
abstract: The regulatory framework for financial advisors is fragmented, with multiple state and federal regulators. Prior empirical literature on financial advisors has largely focused on a single subset of financial advisors, but we create a database containing brokers regulated primarily by FINRA, investment advisers regulated by the SEC or state securities regulators, and insurance producers regulated by state insurance regulators. There is significant overlap across the regimes; more than 40% of the advisors in our data are registered with more than one regulator. This overlap has implications for labor allocation and market discipline. For example, of the individuals who exit FINRA’s broker regime, 79% were jointly registered in insurance upon exiting FINRA’s regime. This could be efficient if it reflects bad actors who transition to lower risk work, but our evidence shows that these advisors continue to engage in financial planning after they move to the insurance side, as over 90% maintain licenses to sell annuities. Moreover, those who committed misconduct when regulated by FINRA continue to have heightened levels of misconduct in insurance. Our findings have additional implications for regulatory discipline. In 2018 and 2019, FINRA proposed rules designed to nudge “bad” brokers out of the industry. We show that these proposals caused thousands of high-risk brokers to exit the FINRA broker regime, but that the majority of these individuals did not leave financial services—98% are currently registered with state regulators as insurance producers.
summary: 本文研究金融顾问监管框架碎片化导致的监管漏洞。作者构建了一个包含由FINRA监管的经纪人、SEC或州监管的投资顾问以及州保险监管的保险生产商的综合数据库，发现超过40%的顾问跨多个监管机构注册。例如，退出FINRA经纪系统的个人中，79%同时拥有保险注册，且其中超过90%继续持证销售年金；此外，这些人在FINRA监管期间有不当行为的，转入保险后仍维持较高的不当行为水平。FINRA在2018-2019年提出驱逐问题经纪人的规则，导致数千高风险经纪人退出，但98%的人以保险生产商身份在州监管机构注册，继续从事金融服务。这表明监管重叠导致不良行为者向监管较弱的领域转移，削弱了市场纪律。
ai_comment: 该研究通过构建跨监管数据库，揭示了监管重叠和碎片化导致的监管逃脱现象，对完善金融顾问监管政策具有重要启示。

title: How valuable is corporate adaptation to crisis? Estimates from Covid-19 work-from-home announcements
abstract: This article investigates predictors and benefits of corporate adaptation to crisis, adding a new dimension to studies of flexibility and resilience based on ex ante characteristics. We produce a unique sample of work-from-home announcements scraped from company websites during Covid-19. The announcers’ valuations increased by 3%–5% and risk declined versus matches, consistent with real-options theory under asymmetric information. We estimate characteristics, including subtle textual topics from 10-Ks, that predicted adaptation, show faster price response following Bloomberg coverage, and real advantages in subsequent operating performance. Corporate adaptation to crisis adds value and reduces risk, beyond information in firm characteristics.
summary: 本文研究了企业危机适应性的预测因素和收益，为基于事前特征的灵活性和韧性研究增添了新维度。作者通过爬取COVID-19期间公司网站上的在家办公公告，构建了一个独特的样本。研究发现，与匹配公司相比，公告公司的估值增加了3%-5%，风险下降，这与信息不对称下的实物期权理论一致。文章估计了预测适应性的特征，包括从10-K中提取的细微文本主题，并展示了Bloomberg报道后更快价格反应以及后续运营绩效的实际优势。企业危机适应性增加了价值并降低了风险，其信息超出了公司特征所能提供的范围。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据集和实证方法，揭示了危机中企业适应性的价值，为韧性研究提供了新视角。

title: Bank Debt, Mutual Fund Equity, and Swing Pricing in Liquidity Provision
abstract: Liquidity provision is often attributed to debt-issuing intermediaries like banks. We develop a unified theoretical framework and empirically show that mutual funds issuing demandable equity also provide an economically significant amount of liquidity by insuring against idiosyncratic liq uidity shocks. Quantitatively, bond funds provide 12.5% of the liquidity that banks provide per dollar. Our model further shows that when equity values incorporate the liquidation cost from re demptions, as in swing pricing, liquidity provision is not necessarily reduced. This is because swing pricing may increase funds’ capacity for holding illiquid assets without inducing panic runs. (JEL G01, G21, G23, G28)
summary: 论文提出一个统一的理论框架，实证表明发行活期权益的共同基金（如债券基金）通过抵御特质流动性冲击，提供了经济上显著的流动性。定量上，债券基金每美元提供的流动性相当于银行的12.5%。模型进一步显示，当权益价值包含赎回清算成本（即摆动定价）时，流动性提供不一定减少，因为摆动定价可能增强基金持有非流动性资产的能力，同时避免恐慌性赎回。研究挑战了传统观点，即只有银行等债务发行中介才能提供流动性，并揭示了摆动定价在流动性提供中的积极作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将银行和共同基金纳入统一框架分析流动性提供，并实证了共同基金的重要作用，同时发现摆动定价可能增强而非抑制流动性提供，对金融监管具有启示意义。

title: The Effect of Principal Reduction on Household Distress: Evidence from Mortgage Cramdown
abstract: Mortgage cramdown enabled bankruptcy judges to discharge the underwater portion of a mortgage in a chapter 13 bankruptcy until the Supreme Court disallowed this practice in 1993. We investigate the impact of mortgage cramdown on household distress exploiting the random assignment of cases to judges. The impact of bankruptcy protection on foreclosures is reduced by more than half after the Supreme Court disallowed cramdown. Our results suggest that large principal reductions considerably decrease homeowners’ distress by reducing debt overhang.
summary: 本文利用法官随机分配的自然实验，研究抵押贷款强制减记（mortgage cramdown）对家庭困境的影响。强制减记允许破产法官在第十三章破产中免除抵押贷款的负净值部分，直到1993年最高法院禁止该做法。研究发现，在最高法院禁止强制减记后，破产保护对止赎（foreclosure）的影响减少了超过一半。结果表明，大幅本金减免通过减少债务积压（debt overhang）显著降低了房主困境。
ai_comment: 本文利用法官随机分配的自然实验，识别了抵押贷款本金减免对家庭困境的因果效应，为债务积压理论提供了强有力的实证证据。

title: Costly Rewards Sustain Cooperation with Imperfect Monitoring
abstract: This research examines the role of reward systems in enhancing cooperation, particularly when individual contributions are not fully transparent. We investigate the impact of reward mechanisms on cooperative behavior using an experimental setup known as the Voluntary Contribution Mechanism with Rewards. Our experimental design compares centralized reward (CR) systems, where an authority distributes rewards, with decentralized reward (DR) systems, where peers allocate rewards, against a no-reward baseline. The results reveal that CR generally promotes the highest level of cooperation, whereas DR achieves the greatest economic efficiency across all test environments. Participants also exhibited a strong preference for CR. These findings contribute to the existing literature by highlighting the effectiveness of reward systems in mitigating social dilemmas under conditions of imperfect information. The study offers vital insights for policymakers and organizational members in selecting incentive mechanisms that foster sustained collective action, even when individual efforts are not directly observable. This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kubler, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72503075 and 72203132]; the National Social Science Foundation of China [Grants 20AZD044, 22&ZD150, and 24&ZD084]; the Natural Science Foundation of Shandong Province [Grants ZR2023QG096, ZR2023QG071, ZR2022MG068, and ZR2022QG048]; the Taishan Scholar Program of Shandong Province [Grant tsqn201909013 and tsqn202408212]; and the Project of Humanities and Social Sciences of Shandong University [Grant 21RWZD15] is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06479 .
summary: 本研究探讨奖励系统如何在不完全监督（即个人贡献不完全透明）的情况下促进合作。通过自愿贡献机制与奖励的实验设计，比较了集中奖励（CR，由权威机构分配奖励）、分散奖励（DR，由同伴分配奖励）和无奖励基线三种情境。结果表明，CR在促进合作方面最为有效，而DR在所有测试环境中实现了最高的经济效率。参与者普遍偏好CR。研究为不完全信息条件下缓解社会困境的机制设计提供了证据，对政策制定者和组织成员选择激励措施以维持集体行动具有重要启示。
ai_comment: 该研究通过比较集中与分散奖励机制在不完全监督下的效果，为组织激励设计提供了实证依据，尤其突出了经济效率与合作水平的权衡。

title: Can Social Media Inform Corporate Decisions? Evidence from Merger Withdrawals
abstract: This paper studies whether social media sentiment predicts merger withdrawals. We find that a one‐standard‐deviation increase in social media sentiment after a merger announcement is associated with a 0.64 percentage point lower probability of withdrawal (16.6% of the average). This effect is unexplained by abnormal price reactions, traditional news, and analyst recommendations. Consistent with manager learning, the informativeness of social media strengthens after firms start corporate Twitter accounts. The informativeness is driven by longer acquisition‐related tweets by fundamental investors, rather than memes and price trend tweets. These findings suggest that social media signals can be important for corporate decisions.
summary: 本文研究社交媒体情绪是否能预测并购撤回。研究发现，并购宣布后社交媒体情绪每增加一个标准差，并购撤回的概率降低0.64个百分点（占平均撤回概率的16.6%）。该效应无法由异常股价反应、传统新闻或分析师推荐解释。进一步分析表明，在公司开设企业Twitter账户后，社交媒体情绪的信息含量增强；且这种信息性主要源于基本面投资者发布的、与收购相关的较长推文，而非表情包或价格趋势推文。结论表明社交媒体信号对企业决策具有重要参考价值。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用社交媒体情绪预测并购结果，并通过企业Twitter账户开通等外生变化识别因果机制，为社交媒体影响公司决策提供了有力证据。

title: Collateral Damage: Low-Income Borrowers Depend on Income-Based Lending
abstract: We use negative durability shocks from vehicle discontinuations to study asset-backed lending and income-based lending (IBL) in auto finance. Discontinuations lead to increased down payments, higher loan-to-value ratios, and larger post-default personal recoveries. These results all indicate that economically disadvantaged consumers are relatively more reliant on unsecured IBL, in stark contrast to corporate financing patterns. Vehicle recoveries on discontinued cars are lower for borrowers who purchase after discontinuations, implying that depreciation is partially borrower-dependent. Our findings suggest that lower-income borrowers, in particular, benefit from technologies that facilitate IBL, such as income monitoring.
summary: 该论文利用车辆停产带来的负面耐久性冲击，研究资产抵押贷款与基于收入的贷款在汽车金融中的作用。停产导致首付增加、贷款价值比上升以及违约后个人追偿金额变大，表明经济弱势消费者更依赖无担保的基于收入的贷款，这与公司融资模式形成鲜明对比。停产车辆的回收率对停产后的购买者更低，意味着折旧部分依赖于借款人。结论认为，低收入借款人尤其受益于促进基于收入贷款的技术，如收入监控。
ai_comment: 利用车辆停产的自然实验，揭示了低收入借款人对收入型贷款的独特依赖，为金融包容性政策提供了实证依据。

title: Real(istic) Time-Varying Probability of Consumption Disasters
abstract: We model the time-varying probability of consumption disasters with international risk interactions and estimate the model using national accounts data of 42 countries back to 1833. The estimated world and country-specific disaster probabilities accord well with historical macroeconomic disasters. A match of the equity premium requires a relative risk aversion coefficient of approximately 5, which is significantly lower than previous estimates. Furthermore, the model provides notably better fits for equity volatility compared with alternative rare-disaster models. Finally, the disaster probability index estimated from the model demonstrates significant out-of-sample predictive power over long horizons, performing well not only over time but also across countries.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含国际风险相互作用的消费灾难时变概率模型，并使用42个国家自1833年以来的国民账户数据对模型进行估计。估计出的全球和国家层面的灾难概率与历史上的宏观经济灾难高度吻合。在匹配股权溢价时，所需的相对风险厌恶系数大约为5，显著低于以往研究的估计值。此外，与替代的罕见灾难模型相比，该模型对股权波动的拟合效果明显更优。最后，从模型中估计出的灾难概率指数在长期内展现出显著的样本外预测能力，不仅在时间跨度上表现良好，而且在跨国预测中也同样有效。
ai_comment: 该研究通过跨国长历史数据显著降低了股权溢价之谜所需的风险厌恶系数，且灾难概率指数的跨国预测能力为宏观金融提供了新工具。

title: Are Subjective Expectations Formed as in Rational Expectations Models of Active Management?
abstract: We recover forward-looking expected net-of-fee abnormal returns (alphas) for active equity mutual funds from analyst ratings. In contrast to the typical equilibrium implication of zero alphas, analyst alphas are negative for most funds, but positive for the largest funds. We compare analysts’ subjective expectations with expectations from a rational expectations learning model. The model’s rational learner believes that an increase in fund size leads to a decrease in returns, but we find no evidence that analysts believe so. Consistently, counterfactual ratings based on the rational model tend to outperform analysts’ ratings out of sample. Investor fund flows respond significantly to analyst ratings. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: Support from the Center for Big Data in Finance [Grant DNRF167], the Danish Finance Institute, and the Swedish House of Finance is gratefully acknowledged. This work was funded by Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (UIDB/00124/2025, UID/PRR/124/2025, Nova School of Business and Economics) and LISBOA2030 (DataLab2030 - LISBOA2030-FEDER-01314200). Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04419 .
summary: 该文通过分析师评级恢复主动管理型股票基金的预期净费用异常收益（alpha），发现大多数基金的分析师alpha为负，但最大型基金的alpha为正。论文将分析师的主观预期与理性预期学习模型的预期进行比较：理性学习者认为基金规模增长会导致收益下降，但分析师并未表现出这一信念。样本外检验显示，基于理性模型的反事实评级往往优于分析师的评级。此外，投资者资金流对分析师评级有显著反应。
ai_comment: 本文通过对比分析师主观预期与理性模型预期，揭示了分析师在规模收益关系上的系统性偏差，为理解主动管理基金定价和投资者行为提供了新视角。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Privacy Regulation on E-Commerce Firms: Evidence from Apple’s App Tracking Transparency
abstract: Assembling novel data sets on online advertiser spending, performance, and revenue, we quantify the economic effects of Apple’s App Tracking Transparency (ATT) privacy policy on e-commerce firms. We find that conversion-optimized Meta advertisements, affected most by ATT, saw a 37% reduction in click-through rates after ATT. Although firms responded by shifting ad spending from Meta to the Google ecosystem, firms with higher baseline Meta dependence nevertheless experienced a substantial decline in firm-wide revenue relative to firms with lower baseline Meta dependence. We quantify these effects using a variety of methods, finding revenue decreases in the range between 8% and 40% relative to less exposed firms. These declines were primarily borne by smaller e-commerce firms, raising questions about the tradeoffs between consumer privacy and the ability of smaller e-commerce and direct-to-consumer firms to succeed in the product market. This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the LEC Program on Economics & Privacy, MSI Research Grant [4001820]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06600 .
summary: 通过整合在线广告支出、表现和收入的新数据集，本文量化了苹果应用追踪透明度（ATT）隐私政策对电商企业的经济影响。研究发现，受ATT影响最大的转化优化型Meta广告，其点击率在ATT后下降了37%。尽管企业通过将广告支出从Meta转向Google生态系统来应对，但原本更依赖Meta的企业相对于依赖较低的企业，整体收入仍大幅下降。采用多种方法量化后，受冲击较大的企业收入下降幅度在8%至40%之间。这些损失主要由小型电商企业承担，引发了关于消费者隐私与小型电商及直接面向消费者企业在市场中成功能力之间权衡的讨论。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的数据集和准自然实验方法，首次量化了苹果ATT政策对电商企业收入的显著负面效应，尤其揭示了小型企业受到的冲击更大，为隐私政策的经济后果提供了重要实证证据。

title: A Flash in the Pan(Demic)? Migration Risks and Municipal Bonds
abstract: We show that migration induced by the COVID-19 pandemic significantly predicts changes in municipal bond yields. Negative migration shocks have made debt more expensive, especially in the areas and bonds most exposed to the work-from-home (WFH) transition. Over the full sample, a one-standard-deviation increase in COVID period out-migration predicts an approximate 4.5-basis-point rise in municipal bond yields, after controlling for a range of local economic factors including state- or core-based statistical area (CBSA)-year fixed effects. This effect is 40% larger for areas in the top decile of WFH exposure and approximately twice as large for transportation-backed bonds. Moreover, areas containing the most exposed bonds (i.e., those with out-migration and high WFH exposure) also experience relatively large post-COVID declines in municipal revenue. Overall, our results suggest that investors have changed their estimates of the level or uncertainty of municipalities’ future cash flows, especially for areas and bonds most exposed to the transition toward remote work. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02674 .
summary: 本文研究COVID-19疫情导致的迁移对市政债券收益率的影响。发现负向迁移冲击使债务更昂贵，特别是在工作从家（WFH）转型中暴露度高的地区和债券。全样本中，COVID期间迁出一标准差增加预测市政债券收益率上升约4.5个基点，控制地方经济因素和固定效应后结果依然显著。对于WFH暴露度前十分位的地区，效果增大40%；对于交通支持债券，效果增大两倍。此外，迁出和WFH暴露度双高的地区在疫情后市政收入下降较大。结果表明投资者改变了市政未来现金流水平或不确定性的估计，尤其是对远程工作转型暴露度高的地区和债券。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将疫情导致的迁移与远程工作暴露度结合，揭示了投资者对市政债券定价的新预期，对理解疫情后财政稳健性有重要启示。

title: Firms’ Stock Prices, Stock Returns, and Remaining Lifetime Earnings
abstract: We document the disconnect between earnings expectations as captured in stock prices and the ultimate realization of earnings over long periods. To do so, we compare firms’ stock prices on the first trading day and the beginning of each year to the realized earnings over their remaining lifetime (RLTEP ratio). We document that the RLTEP ratio, averaged over long periods and over 15,000 U.S. domestic public firms, approximates one, suggesting that expectations match actuals in the aggregate. However, most firms fail to deliver an RLTEP ratio greater than one. Acquisition prices are the largest contributors to the RLTEP ratio, with many surviving firms failing to generate enough earnings even after operating for between 15 and 45 years. The RLTEP ratio for survivors is positively associated with the future RLTEP ratio, future lifetime wealth creation, and future lifetime stock returns. Significant returns-based wealth creation by firms in the short term does not persist in the long term unless it is supported by fundamental wealth creation (high past RLTEP ratio). This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: Financial support from SC Johnson Graduate School of Management, Cornell University, Columbia Business School, Columbia University, Binghamton University School of Management, and Haskayne School of Business, University of Calgary is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03251 .
summary: 本文研究了股票价格中隐含的盈利预期与公司剩余生命周期实际盈利之间的脱节现象。通过比较公司首个交易日及每年年初的股价与剩余生命周期实际盈利（RLTEP比率），发现长期平均RLTEP比率约等于1，表明总体预期与实际相符。但大多数公司的RLTEP比率低于1，收购价格是RLTEP比率的最大贡献者，许多幸存公司在运营15至45年后仍未能产生足够盈利。幸存公司的RLTEP比率与未来RLTEP比率、未来生命周期财富创造及未来生命周期股票回报正相关。公司短期基于回报的财富创造若缺乏基本面支撑（高历史RLTEP比率），则难以持续。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建RLTEP比率，直观揭示了股价与长期基本面之间的复杂关系，实证表明收购价格在盈利实现中的关键作用，对理解市场效率与长期投资价值有重要贡献。

title: Do Municipal Bond Investors Pay a Convenience Premium to Avoid Taxes?
abstract: We study the valuation of state-issued tax-exempt municipal bonds and find that there are significant convenience premia in their prices. These premia parallel those identified in Treasury markets. We find evidence that these premia are tax related. Specifically, the premia are related to measures of tax and fiscal uncertainty, forecast flows into state municipal bond funds, and are directly linked to outmigration from high-tax to low-tax states and to other measures of tax aversion such as IRA and retirement plan contributions. These results suggest that investors are willing to pay a substantial premium to avoid taxes.
summary: 本文研究州政府发行的免税市政债券的估值，发现其价格中存在显著的便利溢价，类似于美国国债市场中的便利溢价。证据表明这些溢价与税收相关，具体来说，它们与税收和财政不确定性指标、流入州市政债券基金的预测流量、从高税州向低税州的迁移以及其他避税行为（如个人退休账户和退休计划缴款）直接相关。结果表明，投资者愿意支付大量溢价以规避税收。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了税收因素在市政债券定价中的关键作用，将避税行为与金融资产溢价直接联系起来，为理解税收驱动的市场异象提供了新视角。

title: Optimal Ownership and Capital Structure with Agency Conflicts
abstract: We develop a continuous-time model examining agency conflicts among controlling shareholders (managers), minority shareholders, and creditors in corporate investment decisions. The manager’s private benefits encourage overinvestment, while their equity stake and debt overhang lead to underinvestment. We show these offsetting incentive effects can achieve optimal investment timing under certain conditions. Agency costs exhibit U-shaped relationships with private benefits, tax rates, volatility, managerial ownership, and leverage. The model reveals how the interplay among agency conflicts, tax benefits, and bankruptcy costs shapes optimal ownership and capital structure, explaining several documented empirical patterns in corporate finance.
summary: 本文构建了一个连续时间模型，研究控股股东（兼任经理人）、小股东和债权人之间代理冲突对企业投资决策的影响。经理人的私人利益会激励过度投资，而他们的持股比例和债务积压则导致投资不足。研究发现，这些方向相反的激励效应在特定条件下可以实现最优投资时机。代理成本与私人利益、税率、波动性、管理层持股比例及杠杆率呈U形关系。模型揭示了代理冲突、税收优惠与破产成本之间的相互作用如何塑造最优所有权结构和资本结构，并解释了公司金融领域中多个已记录的实证现象。
ai_comment: 该模型通过U形关系揭示了代理成本的非线性特征，并整合了税收与破产成本，为理解最优资本结构提供了新视角。

title: Tweeting for Money: Social Media and Mutual Fund Flows
abstract: We unveil asset managers’ social media communications as a distinct new channel for attracting flows of money to mutual funds. Combining a database of more than 1.6 million posts on X/Twitter by U.S. mutual fund families with textual analysis, we find that flows of money to mutual funds respond positively to both the number and tone of the posts. Whereas the link between social media communications and flows of money is not explained by conventional marketing efforts, our findings suggest that the social media channel is not independent from asset management companies’ broader marketing strategies. A high-frequency analysis that exploits intraday ETF trade data allows us to isolate the effect of tweets on investor decisions from potential confounders. We then consider and test four different economic mechanisms. The results of these tests do not support the hypothesis that asset managers’ social media communications reduce search costs for potential investors. The results do not support, either, that asset management companies’ Twitter activity increases investor attention or alleviates information asymmetries by communicating performance-relevant information to investors. In contrast, our evidence suggests that asset managers use social media as an effective persuasion tool. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: Both authors acknowledge financial support from the FinTech & Digital Finance Chair at Paris Dauphine - PSL. J. Gil-Bazo acknowledges financial support from the Severo Ochoa Programme for Centres of Excellence in R&D (Barcelona School of Economics) [Grant CEX2024-001476-S], funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033, as well as from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [Grant PID2023-153288NB-I00]. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07584 .
summary: 本文研究美国共同基金家族在社交媒体（X/Twitter）上的沟通如何影响基金的资金流动。利用超过160万条推文的数据集和文本分析，发现推文的数量和语气与资金流入正相关。通过高频分析利用日内ETF交易数据，隔离了推文对投资者决策的因果效应。检验四种经济机制后，结果不支持社交媒件沟通降低投资者搜索成本、增加投资者关注或缓解信息不对称的假设，而是支持资产管理公司将社交媒体作为有效的说服工具。虽然社交媒件沟通与资金流动的关系不能由传统营销努力解释，但该渠道并非独立于整体营销策略。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将社交媒体沟通作为资金流动的新渠道，并通过严谨的实证设计隔离因果效应，为资产管理公司的营销行为提供了新的视角。

title: Financial Inclusion via FinTech: From Digital Payments to Platform Investments
abstract: We study household finance in the age of FinTech, where digital payments are integrated with various financial services through all-in-one super apps. We hypothesize that increased FinTech adoption via digital payments can lower the nonmonetary costs (e.g., psychological barriers) associated with financial market participation. We find that higher FinTech adoption leads to greater participation and increased risk taking in mutual fund investments. Using distance from Ant as an instrument for FinTech penetration, as well as the exogenous penetration of QRPay in Shenzhen, we further provide causal evidence from digital payment to risky fund investment. Moreover, the effect of FinTech is stronger among individuals who are otherwise more constrained, those with higher risk tolerance, or those living in under-banked counties. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: C. Y. Hong acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72003125]. X. Lu acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72473028]. J. Pan acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant W2431051]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04423 .
summary: 本文研究金融科技时代下，数字支付与多种金融服务整合的超级应用如何影响家庭金融。假设通过数字支付提升金融科技采纳可以降低参与金融市场的非货币成本（如心理障碍）。发现更高的金融科技采纳导致共同基金投资的参与度和风险承担增加。使用与蚂蚁的距离作为金融科技渗透的工具变量，以及深圳二维码支付的外生渗透，提供了从数字支付到风险基金投资的因果证据。此外，金融科技的影响在原本更受约束的个体、风险容忍度更高或生活在银行服务不足地区的个体中更强。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验和工具变量方法，为金融科技促进家庭金融参与提供了可靠因果证据，并揭示了异质性影响，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Factor Models of Asset Returns and Bear Market Risk
abstract: We propose a conditional model of asset returns that allows for good and bad states of the world, depending on bear market risk. Specifically, we generalize existing latent factor models in three ways: we show how to estimate the threshold that identifies the “disappointment” event triggering the bad state of the world, we permit different factor structures for asset returns in good and bad states, and we show how to estimate consistently the conditional risk premia of observable factors from the estimated latent factors. The usefulness of the conditional model is illustrated with an empirical application to a broad cross-section of stock portfolio excess returns. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04276 .
summary: 本文提出了一个条件资产回报模型，根据熊市风险区分市场的好状态和坏状态。该模型在三个方向上扩展了现有潜在因子模型：首先，展示了如何估计识别触发坏状态的“失望”事件的阈值；其次，允许资产回报在好状态和坏状态下有不同的因子结构；最后，展示了如何从估计的潜在因子中一致地估计可观测因子的条件风险溢价。通过对广泛横截面的股票组合超额收益进行实证应用，展示了该条件模型的有效性。论文已被Management Science接受。
ai_comment: 该模型通过引入市场状态变化，创新性地改进了传统因子模型，对理解和预测资产收益在极端市场条件下的表现具有重要贡献。

title: Nonadditivity of Subjective Expectations over Different Time Intervals
abstract: We examine the additivity of expectations over different time intervals. For example, when asked about 10-year stock price growth, survey respondents report an expected change that is not equal to, but closer to zero than, the sum of their expectations over two shorter time intervals that cover the same 10 years. Such subadditivity, which we also find in expectations for other economic variables, is irrational, as it cannot stem from aggregating short-term expectations. Model estimates show that the pattern is consistent with a time perception where shorter time intervals have a proportionally larger weight. We also find that the respondents’ degree of additivity is correlated with making larger financial investments. This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (the German Science Foundation) via CRC TRR 190 [Grant 280092119]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01558 .
summary: 这篇论文研究了主观期望在不同时间间隔上的可加性问题。通过调查受访者对股票价格长期（如10年）增长的预期，发现其报告的变化并不等于两个较短时间间隔（覆盖相同总时长）的预期之和，而是更接近零，表现出次可加性。这种非理性模式也出现在其他经济变量的期望中，无法通过短期预期的简单加总来解释。模型估计表明，该模式与时间感知偏差一致，即较短时间间隔被赋予比例更大的权重。此外，受访者的可加性程度与更大的金融投资相关，暗示时间感知偏差影响实际决策。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证和模型揭示了时间感知的次可加性偏差，并链接到实际金融投资行为，为行为金融提供了新的视角。

title: Profit Persistence in the U.S. Audit Market
abstract: This study investigates the relation between audit competition, audit quality, and auditor labor hours. Using proprietary data on auditor realization rates, we construct new measures of competition based on theory predicting that abnormal profits will quickly disappear when competition is high but persist over multiple periods when competition is low. We find consistent evidence of persistent abnormal profits among U.S. Big 4 engagements and that individual offices earn persistent abnormal returns, suggesting that the market is not perfectly competitive. Examining the consequences of lower competition, we find that profit persistence is negatively related to audit hours and positively related to audit quality. Although we are cautious about inferring causality, our findings suggest that lower competition is associated with more efficient and effective audits.
summary: 本研究利用美国审计市场专有数据，基于异常利润快速消失（高竞争）或持续存在（低竞争）的理论，构建新的竞争衡量指标。研究发现，美国四大会计师事务所的审计业务中存在持续的异常利润，且单个办公室也获得持久异常回报，表明市场并非完全竞争。进一步分析显示，利润持久性与审计工时负相关，与审计质量正相关，提示较低竞争可能关联更高效和有效的审计。尽管对因果推断持谨慎态度，但结果支持竞争程度影响审计行为。
ai_comment: 创新点在于利用专有实现率数据构建竞争指标，揭示了审计市场利润持久性现象及其与审计效率和质量的复杂关系。

title: Whence LASSO? A Rational Interpretation
abstract: This paper develops an economic setting to rationalize the use of the “least absolute shrinkage and selection operator” (LASSO) in estimating asset returns. In this setting, multiple traders engage in trading based on information extracted from historical asset prices. Facing model uncertainty in forecasting asset returns, these traders adopt robust-trading strategies. Within this context, the use of LASSO for estimating asset returns emerges endogenously as an equilibrium outcome. We further extend our analysis to rationalize the application of elastic-net estimation. Although LASSO-type strategies enhance traders’ profits by mitigating competition among them, they also introduce biases in trading decisions, which can adversely affect profitability. This dual effect highlights the nuanced tradeoffs associated with employing such estimation techniques in financial markets. This paper has been This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Special Issue on AI for Finance and Business Decisions. Funding: This work was supported by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2021-0040] and the Bank of Canada [Fellowship]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06127 .
summary: 本文构建了一个经济模型来解释LASSO（最小绝对收缩与选择算子）在估计资产收益中的应用。在该模型中，多个交易者基于历史资产价格提取信息进行交易，面临预测资产收益时的模型不确定性，并采用稳健交易策略。在此框架下，LASSO作为均衡结果内生出现，用于估计资产收益。研究进一步将分析扩展到弹性网估计。尽管LASSO类策略通过减少交易者之间的竞争提高了利润，但它们也在交易决策中引入了偏差，可能对盈利能力产生不利影响。这一双重效应突显了在金融市场中使用此类估计技术时的微妙权衡。
ai_comment: 该论文从信息经济学和理性均衡的视角为LASSO在资产定价中的使用提供了理论基础，揭示了竞争缓解与偏差引入之间的权衡，具有重要的理论贡献。

title: Behavioral Simulation of Blockchain-Enabled Market for Supplier Capacity Trading Among Retailers
abstract: We study a supply chain distribution system and investigate experimentally operations of markets where retailers can trade digital claims (tokens) on the supplier’s capacity. Subjects play the role of retailers, have heterogeneous valuations of goods, face random demands, and buy tokens on the supplier’s capacity. Following demand realization, retailers trade tokens with each other in markets implemented as double-sided, single-price, blind, batch auctions. We compare six behavioral treatments, featuring two wholesale prices and three market sizes. As expected, markets reduce leftovers and shortages. Interestingly, market-clearing prices are anchored to wholesale prices and do not signal the value of goods in large markets. Players deploy novel ordering and trading strategies that differ from the transshipment literature. We identify strategies by applying unsupervised machine learning algorithms. In one strategy, players buy a few claims and, after demand realization, use the market to satisfy it. Other players buy more claims than the maximum demand and, once demand is known, sell their excess on the market. Both strategies reduce costs from demand uncertainty but expose players to liquidity and mistakes risks. A third strategy, in which players order from the supplier initially as if expecting the market to be cleared cooperatively, is more profitable. This strategy diversifies demand and market risks. The introduction of markets causes the “pull-to-the-mean” effect and increases order variability. Thus, markets can cause the Bullwhip Effect. Retailers’ and the supply chain’s average profits are higher with markets, but suppliers with low wholesale prices suffer from lower revenues because of the pull-to-the-mean effect. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03771 .
summary: 该论文研究了一个区块链支持的零售商之间供应商产能交易的市场实验。受试者扮演零售商，具有异质性商品估值，面临随机需求，并购买供应商产能的数字代币（tokens）。在需求实现后，零售商在双边、单一价格、匿名、批量拍卖市场中相互交易代币。实验比较了六种行为测试，包括两种批发价格和三种市场规模。结果显示，市场减少了剩余和短缺，但市场出清价格锚定于批发价格，在大型市场中并不反映商品价值。玩家采用了三种主要策略：一是购买少量代币，需求实现后通过市场满足；二是购买超过最大需求的代币，然后卖出多余部分；三是预期市场会被合作出清而初始订购较多，该策略更有利可图，能分散需求和市场风险。市场引入导致'拉向均值'（pull-to-the-mean）效应并增加订单波动性，可能引发牛鞭效应（Bullwhip Effect）。零售商和供应链的平均利润在有市场时更高，但低批发价格的供应商因拉向均值效应收益降低。
ai_comment: 通过实验室实验揭示了区块链代币交易平台对供应链的影响，识别了三种交易策略，并发现了拉向均值效应和牛鞭效应等有趣现象，对实际供应链管理有启示。

title: Representing Random Utility Choice Models with Neural Networks
abstract: Motivated by the successes of deep learning, we propose a class of neural network–based discrete choice models, called RUMnets, inspired by the random utility maximization (RUM) framework. This model formulates the agents’ random utility function using a sample average approximation. We show that RUMnets sharply approximate the class of RUM discrete choice models: Any model derived from random utility maximization has choice probabilities that can be approximated arbitrarily closely by a RUMnet. Reciprocally, any RUMnet is consistent with the RUM principle. Our approach is closely related to ranking-based models and mixtures of multinomial logits proposed in previous literature in a more general contextual setting. We derive an upper bound on the generalization error of RUMnets fitted on choice data and provide theoretical insights on their ability to predict choices on new unseen data depending on critical parameters of the data set and architecture. The models are estimated by leveraging open-source libraries for training neural networks. We find that RUMnets are competitive against several choice modeling and machine learning methods in terms of predictive accuracy on two real-world data sets. We also conduct synthetic experiments that isolate the effects of each architecture component. This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: A. Désir is supported by the Desmarais Fund for Research in AI from INSEAD. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02189 .
summary: 受深度学习成功启发，本文提出一类基于神经网络的离散选择模型RUMnets，其灵感来源于随机效用最大化（RUM）框架。该模型使用样本平均近似来定义代理的随机效用函数。理论证明表明，RUMnets可以任意逼近任何由随机效用最大化导出的离散选择模型的选择概率，且任何RUMnet都符合RUM原则。该方法与先前文献中的排序模型和混合多项logit模型密切相关，并具有更一般的上下文设置。本文推导了RUMnets在拟合选择数据上的泛化误差上界，并提供了关于其在新数据上预测能力的理论见解，这些见解依赖于数据集和架构的关键参数。模型通过利用开源库训练神经网络进行估计。在两个真实数据集上，RUMnets在预测准确性上与多种选择建模和机器学习方法相比具有竞争力。此外，还进行了合成实验以隔离各架构组件的影响。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将神经网络与随机效用最大化理论结合，不仅提供了理论上的可逼近性证明和泛化误差分析，还在实证中展示了竞争性的预测表现，为离散选择建模提供了新工具。

title: Spectral Volume Models: Universal High-Frequency Periodicities in Intraday Trading Activities
abstract: We develop spectral volume models to systematically estimate, explain, and exploit the high-frequency periodicity in intraday trading activities using Fourier analysis. The framework consistently recovers periodicities at specific frequencies in three steps, despite their low signal-to-noise ratios. This reveals persistent and universal high-frequency periodicities in the United States and Chinese stock markets in recent years, and the dominant frequencies explain a significant fraction of the total variance of intraday volumes. We provide evidence that this phenomenon likely reflects the behaviors of trading algorithms with repeated and regular trading instructions. Finally, we demonstrate that uncovering such high-frequency periodicities improves intraday volume predictions and volume weighted average price execution qualities, yields insights for price informativeness of algorithmic trading, and generates excess returns. This paper was accepted by William Lin Cong, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2022YFA1007900], the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 12271013 and 72342004], and the Peking University’s Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06215 .
summary: 本文开发了频谱成交量模型（spectral volume models），利用傅里叶分析（Fourier analysis）系统性地估计、解释和利用日内交易活动中的高频周期性。该框架通过三步一致地恢复特定频率的周期性，尽管信噪比低，仍能揭示美国和中国股票市场近年来存在持久且普遍的高频周期性，且主导频率解释了日内成交量总方差的很大一部分。证据表明，这一现象可能反映了具有重复和定期交易指令的交易算法（trading algorithms）的行为。最后，揭示这种高频周期性能够改进日内成交量预测和成交量加权平均价格（volume weighted average price, VWAP）执行质量，为算法交易的价格信息含量提供见解，并产生超额收益。
ai_comment: 该论文通过频谱分析发现了日内交易中普遍存在的高频周期性，并揭示了其与算法交易行为的关系，对市场微观结构和交易策略有重要启示。

title: Who Falls Prey to the Wolf of Wall Street? Investor Participation in Market Manipulation
abstract: Price distortions created by so-called “pump-and-dump” schemes are well documented, but relatively little is known about the investors in these schemes. By examining 470 pump-and-dump schemes and a large data set of trading records for over 110,000 individual investors from a major German bank, we provide comprehensive evidence on the participation rate, the magnitude of the investments, the losses, and the characteristics of the individuals who invest in such schemes. Participation is quite common, with nearly 8% of active retail investors participating in at least one pump-and-dump losing on average nearly 30%. We identify several distinct types of participating investors, some of which (e.g., speculating day trader) should not be viewed as falling prey to the schemes. We also show that portfolio composition and past trading behavior better explain scheme participation than demographics. Last, we document longer-lasting effects on participating investors beyond their immediate financial losses. Our analysis highlights that an effective regulatory response to pump-and-dump schemes requires understanding who invests in such schemes and why, as, for instance, not all investors are likely to be dissuaded from investing by traditional regulatory disclosures. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Clark Center for Global Markets at the University of Chicago and the Danish Finance Institute. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03181 .
summary: 本文研究了散户投资者参与“拉高出货”（pump-and-dump）市场操纵计划的情况。通过分析470个此类计划以及来自德国一家大型银行的超过11万个个人投资者的交易记录，提供了关于参与率、投资规模、损失和投资者特征的全方位证据。研究发现，近8%的活跃散户投资者参与了至少一次拉高出货，平均损失接近30%。研究识别出几种不同类型的参与投资者，其中一些（如投机性日内交易者）不应被视为该计划的受害者。此外，投资组合构成和过往交易行为比人口统计学特征更能解释参与行为。最后，本文还记录了参与投资者在直接财务损失之外的长期影响。分析强调，有效的监管应对需要理解谁参与了这些计划以及为何参与，例如，并非所有投资者都会因传统的监管披露而放弃投资。
ai_comment: 本文系统性地揭示了散户投资者参与拉高出货操纵的行为特征和异质性，并创新性地指出了非财务的长期影响，为监管政策提供了基于实证的深刻见解。

title: Taxes and Executive Pay: Evidence from Nonqualified Deferred Compensation
abstract: I study the influence of tax deductibility on decisions to defer executive compensation by exploiting a plausibly exogenous tax change that increases the deductibility of the chief financial officer’s (CFO’s) nonperformance-based compensation, with no impact on the nontax determinants of deferrals. Using a difference-in-differences research design, I find that CFO deferred compensation significantly decreases after the tax change, relative to the deferrals of the chief executive officer (CEO) and the highest paid non-CEO and non-CFO executive in the same firm. This finding is more pronounced for firms with higher marginal tax rates and thus greater tax benefits of deferrals. Additional tests show that tax deductibility also influences firms’ decisions on nonperformance-based compensation and that CFO total pay appears to decline in response to decreased deferrals. This paper was accepted by Shivaram Rajgopal, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01483 .
summary: 本文利用一项外生的税收变化（增加首席财务官非绩效薪酬的税收可扣除性，且不影响递延的非税收决定因素）来研究税收扣除对高管薪酬递延决策的影响。采用双重差分研究设计，发现税收变化后，CFO的递延薪酬显著减少，相对于同一公司内CEO和最高薪非CEO/非CFO高管的递延薪酬。这一发现在边际税率较高（因此递延的税收收益更大）的公司中更为明显。额外检验表明，税收可扣除性也影响公司对非绩效薪酬的决策，并且CFO的总薪酬似乎因递延减少而下降。
ai_comment: 利用外生税收变化识别因果关系，揭示了税收政策对高管薪酬结构的影响。

title: Smart Stochastic Discount Factors
abstract: We provide a no-arbitrage framework for stochastic discount factors (SDFs) that satisfy convex pricing constraints in markets characterized by a wide range of trading frictions. We demonstrate a duality relationship connecting minimum dispersion SDFs to portfolio optimization problems with penalty functions directly capturing the underlying frictions. Empirically, we examine how mispricing impacts the SDF’s effectiveness in explaining both cross-sectional and time series variation in asset returns. We find that a minimum-variance SDF, constructed by combining the capital asset pricing model SDF with a portfolio that constrains the mispricing of nonmarket risks, achieves a favorable tradeoff between time series and cross-sectional fit. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05750 .
summary: 本文提出了一个无套利框架，用于构建满足凸定价约束的随机贴现因子（SDF），该框架适用于具有广泛交易摩擦的市场。通过展示最小分散SDF与带有惩罚函数的投资组合优化问题之间的对偶关系，这些惩罚函数直接捕捉底层摩擦，该框架统一了SDF估计与交易成本。实证分析考察了错误定价如何影响SDF在解释资产收益的横截面和时间序列变化中的有效性。研究发现，通过将资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的SDF与一个约束非市场风险错误定价的组合相结合构建的最小方差SDF，在时间序列和横截面拟合之间实现了有利的权衡。该论文被《Management Science》接受。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入交易摩擦和凸定价约束，拓展了传统SDF框架，为解释资产收益的横截面和时间序列特征提供了新视角。实证结果凸显了最小方差SDF在平衡不同维度拟合方面的优势。

title: The Entrepreneurial Finance of Fintech Firms and the Effect of Investments in Fintech Startups on the Performance of Corporate Investors
abstract: We analyze how corporate direct investments in fintech startups affect startup performance and that of investing firms. Corporate investment in fintech startups is associated with a greater likelihood of successful exit, more and higher-quality innovation, and a greater inflow of high-quality inventors. A stacked difference-in-differences analysis shows that direct investments enhance the operating performance and equity-market valuation of corporate investors in the financial services sector, but not those in the nonfinancial sector. We establish two channels that drive fintech startups’ performance improvements: strategic alliance formation between investors and startups, and enhanced startup monitoring by corporate investors.
summary: 本文研究公司对金融科技初创企业的直接投资如何影响初创企业的表现以及投资公司的绩效。研究发现，公司直接投资与金融科技初创企业更高的成功退出可能性、更多且更高质量的创新成果以及高质量发明人的流入增加相关。通过堆叠双重差分分析，文章进一步发现，这类直接投资显著提升了金融服务业公司投资者的运营绩效和股权市场估值，但对非金融行业的公司投资者没有类似影响。文章确定了两个驱动金融科技初创企业绩效改善的渠道：投资者与初创企业之间形成战略联盟，以及公司投资者对初创企业加强监督。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了公司直接投资金融科技初创企业的价值创造机制，尤其是通过战略联盟和加强监督两个渠道，并发现了显著的行业异质性，为理解企业风险投资和金融科技创业融资提供了新视角。

title: Does Personality Similarity Influence the Formation of Auditor-in-Charge–Client Relationships and Audit Quality? Evidence from Swedish Military Conscription Data
abstract: This study investigates the role of personality similarity in the formation of auditor-in-charge (AIC)–client management dyads and the development of a collaborative relationship in auditing engagements. We apply the principle of homophily from sociology, that is, the attraction of individuals with similar traits to one another, to the formation of supplier–customer dyads in auditing engagements. Our analyses suggest that AIC–management personality similarity increases the likelihood of dyad formation and facilitates client retention. Using an instrumental variable approach, we further find evidence that AIC–chief executive officer (CEO) personality similarity enhances audit quality, and that this effect is stronger for clients with higher misreporting risk and at the beginning of the AIC–client tenure relationship. Among publicly listed clients, where chief financial officer (CFO) data are available, we find that AIC–CFO personality similarity plays a more important role in AIC–client matching and audit outcomes than AIC–CEO personality similarity. Collectively, our results suggest that a personality homophily-based relationship facilitates collaboration in auditing engagements, ultimately enhancing audit quality. Overall, our evidence highlights the benefit of interpersonal relationships in the production of audit services. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Penn State Smeal College of Business, the Handelsbanken Jan Wallanders and Tom Hedelius Foundation [Grants P25-0334 and W21-0009], the Torsten Söderbergs Foundation [Grant ET4/17], and the Mistra Center for Sustainable Markets at the Stockholm School of Economics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04195 .
summary: 本研究从社会学同质性原则出发，利用瑞典军方征兵数据中的人格测量，探究审计主管与客户管理层之间的人格相似性如何影响审计业务中双方关系的形成及审计质量。研究发现，审计主管-管理层人格相似性会增加双方配对形成的可能性并促进客户留存。通过工具变量法，进一步发现审计主管-首席执行官人格相似性会提升审计质量，且这一效应对错报风险较高的客户以及审计主管与客户合作初期更为显著。在可获得首席财务官数据的上市公司中，审计主管-首席财务官的人格相似性在匹配与审计结果中的作用比审计主管-首席执行官更为重要。综合结果表明，基于人格同质性的关系有助于审计业务中的协作，最终提高审计质量，凸显了人际关系在审计服务生产中的益处。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用瑞典征兵数据中的人格测量，为审计关系中非理性因素的作用提供了独特证据，拓展了审计质量影响因素的研究视角。

title: Consistent Backtesting Systemic Risk Measures
abstract: This article offers two novel backtests to evaluate the adequacy of well-known systemic risk measures such as CoVaR, MES, SES, and SRISK. Both the new backtests are robust to estimation risk (i.e., their null distributions remain invariant in the presence of estimation risk). While existing backtest is consistent against divergence from the null hypothesis up to a finite order, the article shows that the new backtests are fully consistent. The real-world implications brought by the new backtests are economically significant as they reveal significantly more cases of inadequate systemic risk modeling among the major financial institutions.
summary: 本文针对CoVaR、MES、SES和SRISK等主流系统性风险度量指标，提出了两种新的回测方法来评估其充分性。这两种新回测方法对估计风险具有稳健性（即零分布在存在估计风险时保持不变），并且是完全一致的，而现有回测方法仅能在一阶有限范围内对原假设偏离保持一致。实际应用表明，新回测方法能揭示更多主要金融机构中系统性风险建模不充分的案例，具有显著的经济意义。
ai_comment: 该文解决了系统性风险度量回测中估计风险影响和一致性不足的问题，提出的完全一致且对估计风险稳健的回测方法具有重要的理论贡献和实践价值。

title: Capital Allocation and the Market for Mutual Funds: Inspecting the Mechanism
abstract: We exploit heterogeneity in decreasing returns to scale (DRS) parameters across mutual funds to analyze the importance of scalability for investors’ capital allocation decisions. We find strong evidence that steeper DRS attenuate flow sensitivity to performance. We calibrate a rational model of active fund management and show that a large fraction of cross-sectional variation in assets-under-management is due to investors anticipating the effects of scale on return performance. We conclude that DRS play a key role in achieving equilibrium in the intermediated investment management market.
summary: 本文利用不同共同基金之间规模报酬递减（DRS）参数的异质性，分析可扩展性对投资者资本配置决策的重要性。研究发现，更陡峭的DRS会减弱资金流量对业绩的敏感度。通过校准一个主动型基金管理理性模型，表明投资者对规模影响回报的预期可以解释大部分资产管理规模的横截面差异。结论认为，DRS在实现中介投资管理市场的均衡中起关键作用。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证和理论模型揭示了规模不经济在共同基金市场均衡中的关键作用，为理解投资者决策提供了新视角。

title: Misreporting of Mandatory ESG Disclosures: Evidence from Gender Pay Gap Information
abstract: We examine environmental, social, and governance (ESG) misreporting in the context of the UK government requirement to report gender employment ratios and pay gaps. Highlighting misreporting, many employers report a set of disclosures that are together mathematically impossible. Further, a disproportionate number of employers report perfectly balanced gender statistics, consistent with misreporting as a form of ESG-washing. Suggesting that a lack of ethical considerations encourages misreporting, employers involved in ESG controversies and who commit labor violations are more likely to misreport. Suggesting that capital market and media scrutiny discourage misreporting, employers that are the subject of an article about their gender pay gap reports and employers that receive an ESG audit or financial audit from a Big 4 auditor are less likely to misreport. Overall, our results suggest that 12%–15% of employers misreport in 2017 and 8%–11% misreport in subsequent years. Our findings highlight the importance of meaningful oversight within the context of ESG reporting. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05125 .
summary: 本文研究了英国政府要求报告性别就业比例和薪酬差距的背景下，强制性ESG披露中的错误报告问题。研究发现，许多雇主报告了一组在数学上不可能成立的披露数据，并且有不成比例的雇主报告了完美平衡的性别统计，这与作为ESG洗白形式的错误报告一致。缺乏道德考量（如涉及ESG争议和劳动违规）的雇主更有可能错误报告，而资本市场和媒体监督（如关于性别薪酬差距的报道、接受四大审计师的ESG或财务审计）则降低了错误报告的可能性。总体而言，2017年有12%-15%的雇主错误报告，随后几年降至8%-11%。结果强调了在ESG报告中有效监督的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据集揭示了强制性ESG披露中的虚假陈述现象，并量化了其程度，为监管和审计在ESG报告中的作用提供了实证证据。

title: Heterogeneous Oil Supply Elasticities: Indebtedness and Production Responses to the COVID-19 Shock
abstract: Debt matters for oil supply elasticities. We document the resiliency of oil production to the COVID-19-related collapse in demand due to indebtedness. We use exogenous variation in the timing of debt-related payments to identify financially constrained operators. We show that more financially constrained firms cut production by less than less-constrained firms and were less likely to complete new wells. To explore the mechanisms, we use borrowing-limit cuts and credit-line drawdowns to measure access to credit, and we exploit failed hedging practices. The propagation of oil demand shocks crucially depends on the indebtedness of the oil sector.
summary: 本文研究债务对石油供给弹性的影响。利用COVID-19导致的需求崩溃这一外生冲击，以及债务偿还时机的外生差异来识别财务约束运营商。发现财务约束更强的公司减产幅度小于约束较弱的公司，且更不倾向于完成新井。通过借贷限额削减和信贷额度支取衡量信贷获取能力，并利用失败的套期保值实践探讨机制。结论表明石油需求冲击的传导关键取决于石油部门的负债水平。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用COVID-19冲击和债务偿还时机识别因果效应，揭示了财务约束对石油供给行为的重要影响，为理解大宗商品市场波动提供了新视角。

title: Decoding Momentum Spillover Effects
abstract: This article studies the making of return predictability among economically linked firms. I characterize an asymmetric cross-firm tug-of-war: i) High peer overnight returns are followed by elevated overnight returns for focal stocks, which fully reverse during intraday, and ii) high peer intraday returns are followed by high intraday returns but minor overnight price reactions. This pattern aligns with the story that individuals’ persistent trading on salient information distorts opening prices, while slow-moving arbitrage by professional investors gradually corrects mispricing.
