Mutual fund and hedge fund flows exhibit distinct associations with the tug-of-war, supporting the hypothesis that heterogeneous demand drives the return predictability.
summary: 本文研究经济关联企业之间收益溢出的形成机制。作者发现一种非对称的交叉拉锯模式：当同行业股票隔夜收益高时，焦点股票随后隔夜收益也会升高，但该效应在日内完全反转；而当同行业股票日内收益高时，焦点股票日内收益升高，但隔夜价格反应微弱。这一现象与个人投资者对显著信息的持续交易扭曲开盘价、而专业投资者的慢速套利逐渐修正错误定价的解释一致。共同基金和对冲基金的流量与这种拉锯战呈现不同关联，支持了异质需求驱动收益可预测性的假说。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分隔夜和日内收益，精细刻画了动量溢出中的个体与专业投资者行为差异，为理解投资者异质性提供了新颖的经验证据。

title: The Treasury Collateral Spread and Levered Safe-Asset Production
abstract: Banks are vital suppliers of money-like safe assets, which they produce by issuing short-term liabilities and pledging collateral. But their ability to create safe assets varies over time as leverage constraints fluctuate. I write a simple model to describe private safe-asset production when intermediaries face leverage constraints. I directly measure leverage constraints using confidential supervisory data on high-frequency changes in the largest banks’ repurchase agreements (repos). The collateral spread—the maturity-matched yield spread between Treasuries used as repo collateral more often and Treasuries used less often—compensates for bank leverage risk and averages about 0.5 basis points, a sizable magnitude roughly equal to 60% of the five-year Treasury cheapest-to-deliver basis. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06104 .
summary: 研究银行作为安全资产（现金类）的关键供给者，通过发行短期负债和抵押品来生产安全资产，但受杠杆约束波动的影响。作者构建了一个简单模型，描述中介面临杠杆约束时的私人安全资产生产。利用美国最大银行回购协议的高频变化机密监管数据，直接测量杠杆约束。提出抵押品利差——即作为回购抵押品使用频率较高的国债与频率较低的国债之间的期限匹配收益率差——作为补偿银行杠杆风险的指标，该利差平均约0.5个基点，其规模相当于五年期国债最便宜交割基差的60%。论文被Bo Becker接受，在线附录和数据文件可获取。
ai_comment: 利用高频监管数据直接测量杠杆约束，方法创新；发现抵押品利差具有显著的经济意义，为理解银行安全资产生产提供了新视角。

title: Incentivizing Resource Pooling
abstract: Resource pooling improves system efficiency drastically in large stochastic systems, but its effective implementation in decentralized systems remains relatively underexplored. This paper studies how to incentivize resource pooling when agents are self-interested, and their states are private information. Our primary motivation is applications in the design of decentralized computing markets, among others. We study a standard multiserver queueing model in which each server is associated with an [Formula: see text] queue and aims to minimize its time-average job holding and processing costs. We design a simple token-based mechanism where servers can earn tokens by offering help and spend tokens to request help from other servers, all in their self-interest. The mechanism induces a complex game among servers. We employ the fluid mean-field equilibrium (FMFE) concept to analyze the system, combining mean-field approximation with fluid relaxation. This framework enables us to derive a closed-form characterization of servers’ FMFE strategies. We show that these FMFE strategies approximate well the servers’ rational behavior. We leverage this framework to optimize the design of the mechanism and present our main results: As the number of servers increases, the proposed mechanism incentivizes complete resource pooling—that is, the system dynamics and performance under our mechanism match those under centralized control. Finally, we show that our mechanism achieves the first-best performance even when helping others incurs higher job processing costs and remains nearly optimal in settings with heterogeneous servers. This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: Y. Chen acknowledges the support by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) [Grants NSFC-72501250 and NSFC-72394361] and by the Guangdong Key Lab of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03550 .
summary: 这篇论文研究如何在代理自利且状态为私有信息的去中心化系统中激励资源池化（resource pooling），主要动机来自去中心化计算市场等应用。作者采用标准的多服务器排队模型，每个服务器关联一个队列，目标是最小化其时间平均作业持有和处理成本。他们设计了一个基于代币的简单机制，服务器可以通过帮助他人赚取代币，并使用代币请求帮助，所有行为均出于自利。该机制引出一个复杂博弈。作者采用流体平均场均衡（FMFE）概念进行分析，结合平均场近似与流体松弛，推导出服务器FMFE策略的闭式解，并证明这些策略很好地近似了理性行为。利用该框架优化机制设计，主要结果是：随着服务器数量增加，该机制激励完全的资源池化，即系统动态和性能与集中控制下匹配。此外，即使帮助他人产生更高的作业处理成本，该机制也能实现第一最佳（first-best）性能，并且在异构服务器设置中仍接近最优。
ai_comment: 本文通过设计简洁的代币机制，结合平均场均衡分析，理论上证明了在大型去中心化系统中可实现与集中控制等同的效率，并对异质性和额外成本具有鲁棒性，为资源池化激励机制提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Bond Market Resiliency: The Role of Insurers
abstract: We examine the role of insurance companies in supporting resiliency in the corporate bond market. We show that during the COVID-19 liquidity crisis, insurers increased their corporate bond positions, particularly in bonds facing fire sales by mutual funds. Insurers with more stable funding were more likely to buy, and they bought more from dealers with whom they had prior trading relationships. Dealers improved their bond liquidity provision when they had trading relationships with insurers with more stable funding. Our work demonstrates that insurers can play an important role in supporting bond market resiliency during times of stress.
summary: 本文研究了保险公司在公司债券市场韧性中的作用。通过分析COVID-19流动性危机期间的数据，发现保险公司增加了公司债券持仓，特别是针对那些面临共同基金抛售的债券。具有更稳定资金来源的保险公司更倾向于购买，并且它们更多地从此前有过交易关系的交易商那里买入。当交易商与资金更稳定的保险公司存在交易关系时，其债券流动性提供能力得到改善。结果表明，保险公司在压力时期能够有效支持债券市场的韧性。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了保险公司在市场压力下的稳定化作用，强调了稳定资金来源和既有交易关系对市场流动性的重要性，为理解债券市场韧性提供了新视角。

title: Nonbank Lending and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
abstract: We analyze the role of nonbank lenders in the transmission of monetary policy using data on the universe of unsecured credit to firms and households in Denmark. Nonbanks increase their credit supply after a monetary contraction, both relative to banks and in absolute terms. The increase in nonbank lending is financed through increased long-term debt. A model with segmented debt markets featuring differential investor rate sensitivities rationalizes these findings. Nonbank credit insulates corporate investment and household consumption from monetary contractions, with positive spillovers extending beyond nonbank clients through industry and geographic channels.
summary: 本文利用丹麦企业和家庭无担保信贷的全样本数据，分析了非银行贷款机构在货币政策传导中的作用。研究发现，货币政策紧缩后，非银行机构相对于银行以及绝对量上都增加了信贷供给，并通过增加长期债务来融资。通过引入一个债务市场分割模型（其中不同投资者利率敏感性存在差异），这些发现得到了合理化解释。非银行信贷能够隔离企业投资和家庭消费免受货币紧缩的负面影响，并通过行业和地理渠道产生正向溢出效应。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的高质量微观数据，系统揭示了非银行在货币紧缩期的逆周期信贷行为，并阐明了其对实体经济的缓冲作用及溢出机制，为理解现代金融体系中的货币政策传导提供了新视角。

title: Portfolio Regulation of Financial Institutions with Market Power
abstract: We examine how portfolio regulations affect risk sharing between financial institutions with market power. Unconstrained access to complete markets permits flexible exploitation of market power and induces inefficient risk sharing. Appropriate portfolio restrictions counteract this, improving liquidity and risk sharing by bundling securities with offsetting strategic incentives. However, excessive regulation can be counterproductive, destroying gains from trade. An application of our theory shows that cross-asset spillovers are critical for policy evaluation: in general equilibrium, risk sharing can improve even if certain asset-specific liquidity measures deteriorate. We also discuss the effects of asymmetric regulation for different institutions.
summary: 本文研究组合监管如何影响具有市场势力的金融机构之间的风险分担。在无约束地进入完全市场的情况下，机构可以灵活利用市场势力，导致低效的风险分担。适当的组合限制可以通过捆绑具有对冲战略激励的证券来改善流动性和风险分担，从而抵消这种低效。然而，过度监管可能适得其反，破坏交易收益。应用该理论表明，交叉资产溢出效应对政策评估至关重要：在一般均衡中，即使某些特定资产的流动性指标恶化，风险分担仍可能改善。本文还讨论了不对称监管对不同机构的影响。
ai_comment: 该论文从一般均衡视角揭示了组合监管与市场势力之间的权衡，强调交叉资产溢出效应对于政策评估的关键作用，为监管设计提供了新见解。

title: Treasury Reuse and the Demand for Safe Assets
abstract: We theoretically and empirically show how the reuse of Treasury securities as collateral alleviates safe asset scarcity. Our model characterizes how reuse allows intermediaries to efficiently reallocate the safety benefits of long-term Treasury securities to a broader investor base. By reusing Treasury securities, intermediaries can access more collateral to create safe assets without interest rate risk. When the demand for safe assets is high, intermediaries increase reuse, distributing safe asset benefits to investors that value safety the most. Using supervisory data to calculate a dealer-level measure of reuse called the “collateral multiplier,” we empirically confirm the model’s main predictions.
summary: 本文通过理论与实证研究，揭示了国债作为抵押品的再使用（reuse）如何缓解安全资产稀缺。模型刻画了中介机构（intermediaries）通过再使用长期国债（long-term Treasury securities）的安全收益（safety benefits），将其更高效地重新分配给广泛的投资者基础，从而在不承担利率风险的情况下获取更多抵押品来创造安全资产。当安全资产需求高涨时，中介会增加再使用，将安全资产收益分配给最看重安全性的投资者。利用监管数据计算交易商层面的再使用指标——“抵押乘数”（collateral multiplier），实证结果支持了模型的主要预测。
ai_comment: 该文首次从理论和实证角度系统研究国债再使用对安全资产供给的影响，并引入‘抵押乘数’这一新颖度量指标，为理解金融中介在安全资产创造中的关键作用提供了有力证据。

title: Information, Asset Price Volatility, and Liquidity
abstract: How are asset price volatility and liquidity impacted by public perception of the economic state and by market competitivity? We wish to understand the direct impacts as well as indirect impacts via information acquisition and aggregation. To investigate, we design a laboratory experiment with human subjects as bond investors and exogenously vary the bond default rate, the private information cost schedule, and the market format. To discipline the experiment parameters and to obtain hypotheses for empirical testing, we construct a theoretical model that closely parallels the experiment. We find that the laboratory data support most theoretical predictions, for example, liquidity increases when traders purchase more precise private information, when public information indicates a less ominous state, and when the market is less competitive. Overall price volatility also increases with more precise private information and less competitivity, but it decreases with less ominous public information. Decomposing volatility into “efficient” and “inefficient” components may offer insight for policy analysis. This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by University of California Santa Cruz. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04911 .
summary: 本文通过实验室实验和理论模型研究资产价格波动性和流动性如何受公众对经济状态的看法以及市场竞争力的影响。实验以人类被试作为债券投资者，外生改变债券违约率、私有信息成本结构和市场形式。理论模型与实验紧密对应，用于校准参数和提出实证假设。实验数据支持大多数理论预测：当交易者购买更精确的私有信息、公共信息显示较不严峻的经济状态、以及市场竞争性较低时，流动性增加。整体价格波动性也随更精确的私有信息和较低竞争性而增加，但随较不严峻的公共信息而降低。将波动性分解为“有效”和“无效”成分可能为政策分析提供见解。
ai_comment: 通过可控实验与理论模型紧密结合，揭示了信息获取和市场结构对资产价格波动和流动性的因果影响，为理解市场微观结构提供了新的视角。

title: Antitrust Platform Regulation and Entrepreneurship: Evidence from China
abstract: Many jurisdictions have launched antitrust enforcement and brought in regulation of large tech platforms. The swift and strict implementation of China’s Anti-Monopoly Guidelines for the Platform Economy (Platform Guidelines) provides a quasi-natural experiment to evaluate the impact of antitrust regulation on platform competition. We adopt a difference-in-differences approach to empirically explore the impact of China’s Platform Guidelines on the number of investments and the entry of startups in platform markets. The results show that the Platform Guidelines did not increase entrepreneurship in these affected markets. Rather, entrepreneurship weakened in these markets, with less venture capital investment flowing into them and fewer startups entering these markets. Our study suggests that governments should consider more carefully the potential unintended consequences of antitrust platform regulation. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04397 .
summary: 本文利用中国《平台经济反垄断指南》作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法，实证评估反垄断监管对平台市场竞争和创业活动的影响。研究发现，该指南并未促进受影响平台市场的创业，反而导致风险资本投资减少和初创企业进入下降，表明反垄断监管可能产生意想不到的负面后果。研究建议政府在实施反垄断监管时应更谨慎地考虑其潜在的不利影响。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了反垄断监管可能抑制而非促进创业的意外后果，对全球平台监管政策具有重要警示意义。

title: Dynamic Scheduling of a Multiclass Queue in the Halfin–Whitt Regime: A Computational Approach for High-Dimensional Problems
abstract: We consider a multiclass queueing model of a telephone call center in which a system manager dynamically allocates available servers to customer calls. Calls can terminate through either service completion or customer abandonment, and the manager strives to minimize the expected total of holding costs plus abandonment costs over a finite horizon. Focusing on the Halfin–Whitt heavy traffic regime, we derive an approximating diffusion control problem and, building on earlier work by Beck et al. [Beck C, Becker S, Cheridito P, Jentzen A, Neufeld A (2021) Deep splitting method for parabolic PDEs. SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 43(5):A3135–A3154], develop a simulation-based computational method for solution of such problems, one that relies heavily on deep neural network technology. Using this computational method, we propose a policy for the original (prelimit) call center scheduling problem. Finally, the performance of this policy is assessed using test problems based on publicly available call center data. For the test problems considered so far, our policy does as well as or better than the best benchmark we could find. Moreover, our method is computationally feasible at least up to dimension 500, that is, for call centers with 500 or more distinct customer classes. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, stochastic models and simulation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03921 .
summary: 本文研究电话呼叫中心的多类别队列动态调度问题。在Halfin-Whitt重流量机制下，系统管理员动态分配服务器处理客户呼叫，呼叫可通过服务完成或客户放弃终止，管理者旨在最小化有限时间内的期望持有成本加放弃成本。作者推导了近似扩散控制问题，并基于Beck等人的工作，开发了一种依赖深度神经网络技术的仿真计算方法，用于求解此类高维问题。利用该方法，为原始呼叫中心调度问题提出了一种策略，并通过公开呼叫中心数据测试性能。结果表明，该策略在测试问题上优于或至少不劣于最佳基准方法，且计算上可处理高达500个客户类别的维度。
ai_comment: 本文将深度神经网络应用于高维呼叫中心调度问题，在理论上提供了扩散控制近似，并通过实际数据验证了有效性，展示了机器学习在运筹优化中的潜力。

title: Deciphering the PCAOB Inspection Process: Evidence and Predictive Insights from Public Data
abstract: Little is known about how the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) selects audits for inspections. We exploit public data that track PCAOB searches of issuer Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings and the trial transcripts of United States of America v. David Middendorf to provide the first large-sample evidence on confidential PCAOB monitoring activities. We initially validate that PCAOB searches spike during actual inspections of triennially inspected auditors and for a list of KPMG audits inspected in 2016. Importantly, we find that PCAOB searches vary predictably with ongoing audit-flagged events, client corporate events, and client characteristics, and these screening and inspection activities extend beyond enforcement actions. Using KPMG data, we introduce a PCAOB inspection prediction model for Big 4 clients based solely on public data, with predicted incidence closely aligning with actual inspections. One implication of our study is that, perhaps to mitigate political costs, the PCAOB relies overly on conspicuous trigger events that already signal low audit quality (i.e., restatements, auditor changes, chief financial officer turnovers, bankruptcies, and SEC comment letters), raising the question of how its risk-based inspection program is designed to improve overall audit quality or minimize large audit failures. In addition, although model-inferred PCAOB inspections are not associated with future restatements, broader PCAOB monitoring activities, as proxied by search intensity, exhibit modest predictive power. Overall, our study provides a more nuanced understanding of the PCAOB inspection program and the factors driving its revealed preferences. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Jones Graduate School of Business at Rice University, Baruch College, and the Penn State Smeal College of Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08084 .
summary: 本文利用公开数据（美国证券交易委员会（SEC）对PCAOB搜索的记录以及United States v. David Middendorf案的审判笔录）首次对大样本下的PCAOB保密监控活动进行证据研究。研究发现，PCAOB的搜索活动在实际检查期间（特别是对三年期检查的审计师和2016年KPMG审计清单）会激增。这些搜索活动与审计中标记的事件、客户公司事件和客户特征具有可预测的关系，且不局限于执法行动。基于KPMG数据，作者构建了一个仅使用公开数据的PCAOB检查预测模型，预测结果与实际检查高度吻合。研究指出，PCAOB可能过度依赖已经暗示审计质量低下的显性触发事件（如重述、审计师变更、CFO离职、破产和SEC意见函），这引发了对风险导向检查计划能否有效提高整体审计质量或减少重大审计失败的疑问。尽管模型预测的检查与未来重述不相关，但以搜索强度为代表的总监控活动具有一定的预测能力。整体上，本文提供了对PCAOB检查程序及其偏好驱动因素的更细致理解。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用公开数据揭示PCAOB检查过程，并构建预测模型，对理解监管行为及审计质量有重要启示。

title: Earnings Call Slide Deck
abstract: In recent years, earnings call slide decks (hereafter, earnings decks) have become increasingly common in the earnings announcements of public firms. In this paper, I examine the characteristics of earnings decks and the determinants of firms’ use of them. More importantly, I study their capital market roles. While I fail to find evidence that earnings decks on average offer information incremental to traditional disclosures, such as press releases and conference calls, they significantly reduce users’ information processing time. My analyses reveal three mechanisms that contribute to this acceleration: inclusion of visuals (e.g., charts and tables), summarization of key information, and release prior to earnings calls. Overall, this study documents a novel aspect of earnings announcements and highlights the role of multimedia elements in reducing information processing costs of corporate disclosures. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72402110, 72442014]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04956 .
summary: 本文研究上市公司在盈利公告中日益普遍使用的盈利电话幻灯片（earnings decks）。分析了其特点和使用决定因素，并重点考察其在资本市场中的作用。虽然未发现平均而言盈利电话幻灯片比传统披露（如新闻稿和电话会议）提供增量信息，但它们显著减少了用户的信息处理时间。加速机制包括：包含视觉元素（如图表和表格）、关键信息总结以及在盈利电话会议前发布。总之，该研究记录了盈利公告的一个新特征，并强调了多媒体元素在降低公司披露信息处理成本中的作用。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统性地分析了盈利电话幻灯片这一新型披露形式，并揭示了其通过视觉化、总结和提前发布等方式降低信息处理成本的具体机制，为理解多媒体在资本市场信息披露中的作用提供了新视角。

title: ETF Sampling and Index Arbitrage
abstract: This article shows that exchange-traded funds (ETFs) “sample” their indexes, systematically underweighting or omitting illiquid index stocks. As a result, arbitrage activity between the ETF and its index has heterogeneous effects on underlying asset markets. Using an instrumental variables approach, we find that the trading activity of ETFs reduces liquidity and price efficiency and increases volatility and co-movement for liquid stocks but has no effect on illiquid stocks. Our results demonstrate that the effects of passive investing on asset markets depend on how passive funds replicate their target index.
summary: 本文发现交易所交易基金（ETF）在复制其目标指数时会进行“抽样”，即系统性地低配或完全忽略流动性较差的指数成分股。这种抽样行为导致ETF与指数之间的套利活动对基础资产市场产生异质性影响。通过工具变量法，研究表明ETF的交易活动降低了流动性好的股票的流动性和价格效率，增加了其波动性和与市场的联动性，但对流动性差的股票没有显著影响。这些结果说明，被动投资对资产市场的影响取决于被动基金复制目标指数的具体方式。
ai_comment: 本文从ETF抽样指数这一独特视角切入，揭示了被动投资机制细节对市场微观结构的异质性影响，为理解ETF套利活动的实际后果提供了新的证据。

title: Competition and Debt Conservatism
abstract: Exploiting changes in countries’ competition laws, we find that competition increases firms’ propensity to use zero leverage (ZL). We test the financial-flexibility, financial-constraint, and quiet-life explanations for this result, concluding that desire for flexibility is the one most likely. The relation between competition and ZL strengthens with cash-flow volatility, which supports the flexibility motive. Adoption of ZL by firms is accompanied by increases in payouts, so it is unlikely that ZL adopters are constrained. Proxies for governance have no effect on the relation between competition and ZL, suggesting that desire for a quiet life is not the explanation either.
summary: 利用各国竞争法变化这一外生冲击，研究竞争对企业零杠杆（ZL）决策的影响。发现竞争显著增加了企业采用零杠杆的倾向。通过检验财务灵活性、财务约束和安逸生活三种潜在机制，结论支持财务灵活性动机：竞争与零杠杆的正向关系在现金流波动性更高的企业中更强；企业采用零杠杆时伴随着支付增加，表明并非受财务约束；治理变量对二者关系无影响，排除了安逸生活假说。
ai_comment: 利用跨国竞争法变动的准自然实验，有效识别因果效应，并通过多重机制检验增强了结论的可靠性，对理解产品市场竞争与企业财务政策的关系有重要贡献。

title: On Generalization and Regularization via Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization
abstract: Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization (DRO) has gained prominence in operations research and machine learning as a powerful method for achieving solutions with favorable out-of-sample performance. Two compelling explanations for its success are the generalization bounds derived from Wasserstein DRO and its equivalence to regularization schemes commonly used in machine learning. However, existing results on generalization bounds and regularization equivalence are largely limited to settings where the Wasserstein ball is of a specific type, and the decision criterion takes certain forms of expected functions. In this paper, we show that generalization bounds and regularization equivalence can be obtained in a significantly broader setting, where the Wasserstein ball is of a general type and the decision criterion accommodates any form, including general risk measures. This not only addresses important machine learning and operations management applications but also expands to general decision-theoretical frameworks previously unaddressed by Wasserstein DRO. Our results are strong in that the generalization bounds do not suffer from the curse of dimensionality and the equivalency to regularization is exact. As a by-product, we show that Wasserstein DRO coincides with the recent max-sliced Wasserstein DRO for any decision criterion under affine decision rules, resulting in both being efficiently solvable as convex programs via our general regularization results. These general assurances provide a strong foundation for expanding the application of Wasserstein DRO across diverse domains of data-driven decision problems. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 12371476 and 71921001] and the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grant RGPIN-2023-05829]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03895 .
summary: 本文研究了Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化（DRO）的泛化边界和正则化等价性，并将其推广到更广泛的设定中。以往的结果局限于特定类型的Wasserstein球和期望函数形式的决策准则，而本文证明了在一般类型的Wasserstein球和任意形式（包括一般风险度量）的决策准则下，泛化边界和正则化等价性仍然成立。这些结果不遭受维度灾难的影响，并且与正则化的等价性是精确的。此外，本文还证明了在仿射决策规则下，Wasserstein DRO与最近提出的最大切片Wasserstein DRO对于任何决策准则都一致，从而两者都可以通过一般的正则化结果有效地作为凸规划求解。这些保证为Wasserstein DRO在数据驱动决策问题中的广泛应用提供了坚实基础。
ai_comment: 本文显著扩展了Wasserstein DRO的理论基础，解决了泛化边界和正则化等价的普适性问题，特别是在一般风险度量下的应用，为数据驱动优化提供了重要的理论支撑。

title: Systematic Mispricing of Speculative Stocks and the Cross-Sectional Risk-Return Trade-off
abstract: We examine the cross-section of returns from the perspective of a benchmark model that only includes systematic mispricing factors. In contrast to conclusions from standard benchmark models, we recover robust positive risk-return relations for many cross-sectional risk, distress, and friction proxies. Our findings are consistent with systematic mispricing that primarily affects speculative stocks and predominantly results in overpricing, predicting lower returns. Hence, failing to control for exposure to systematic mispricing can bias tests of risk-return trade-offs for anomalies with one speculative leg (e.g., risky, distressed, or high-friction stocks) and one nonspeculative leg. Overall, our study offers novel economic insight for this subset of anomalies, indicating that a positive risk-return trade-off can be resurrected after purging out the systematic mispricing component. The evidence suggests that a small shift in perspective generates a substantially different interpretation of the same data. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08815 .
summary: 本文从包含系统性错误定价因子的基准模型视角，研究股票横截面收益。与标准基准模型结论不同，在控制系统性错误定价后，许多横截面风险、困境和摩擦代理变量恢复了显著的正向风险-收益关系。这些发现与系统性错误定价主要影响投机性股票、且主要导致高估从而预测较低收益的结论一致。因此，未能控制系统性错误定价暴露会使得对具有投机性一端（如风险高、困境或高摩擦股票）和非投机性一端的异常现象的风险-收益权衡检验产生偏差。总体而言，该研究为这类异常子集提供了新的经济学解释，表明在剔除系统性错误定价成分后，正向风险-收益权衡得以恢复。证据表明，视角的微小转变会导致对同一数据的截然不同的解读。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入系统性错误定价因子，重新检验了横截面的风险-收益关系，为解释众多异常现象提供了新视角，对资产定价实证研究有重要启示。

title: Deep Neural Newsvendor
abstract: We consider a data-driven newsvendor problem, where one has access to past demand data and the associated feature information. We solve the problem by estimating the target conditional quantile function using a deep neural network (DNN). The remarkable representational power of DNNs allows our framework to incorporate or approximate various extant data-driven models. We provide theoretical guarantees in terms of excess risk bounds for the DNN solution characterized by the network structure and sample size in a nonasymptotic manner, which justify the applicability of DNNs in relevant contexts. Specifically, the convergence rate of the excess risk bound with respect to the sample size increases in the smoothness of the target quantile function but decreases in the dimension of feature variables. This rate can be further accelerated when the target function possesses a composite structure. In particular, our theoretical framework can be extended to accommodate data-dependent scenarios, where the data-generating process could be time-dependent but not necessarily identical over time. Building on our theoretical results, we provide further managerial insights and practical guidance through simulation studies. Finally, we apply the DNN method to a real-world data set obtained from a food supermarket. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that (1) the DNN method consistently outperforms alternatives across a wide range of cost parameters, and (2) it exhibits good performance when the sample size is either very large or relatively limited. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grant RGPIN-2021-04295]; the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Project: Data-Driven Operations Analytics Methods]; the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities, Peking University; the General Research Fund of the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant 15305523]; and the Research Fund of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University [Grant P0048718]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03157 .
summary: 本文研究数据驱动的报童问题，即利用历史需求数据和相关特征信息来优化订货决策。作者使用深度神经网络（DNN）估计条件分位数函数，利用DNN强大的表示能力来整合或近似多种现有数据驱动模型。理论上，提供了非渐近意义下的超额风险界，该界受网络结构和样本量影响，收敛速度随目标分位数函数平滑性增加而加快，随特征维度增加而减慢，且当目标函数具有复合结构时速度可进一步提升。理论框架可扩展至数据生成过程随时间依赖但非同分布的情形。通过模拟研究提供管理见解和实践指导，并在食品超市的真实数据集上验证了方法有效性。实验表明，DNN方法在广泛成本参数下持续优于其他方法，且在样本量很大或相对有限时均表现良好。
ai_comment: 将深度学习理论（DNN表示能力与泛化界）系统引入传统报童问题，在提供严格理论保证的同时展示了卓越的实证性能，为运营管理中的数据驱动决策开辟了新路径。

title: Raising Bond Capital in Segmented Markets
abstract: The difference between corporate bond yields at issuance and in secondary markets, the “issuance premium,” spikes in bad times, raising firms’ capital costs. Using new bond-level data and high-frequency variation in bond supply and demand, I estimate a model of primary markets with imperfectly elastic investors, endogenous bond supply, and underwriter frictions that quantifies drivers of issuance premiums. I find underwriters’ favoritism toward investors increases issuance premiums’ levels and cyclical variation. On the other hand, relatively elastic investors allow primary markets to absorb large bond issuances. My findings inform policies targeted at bond issuance markets.
summary: 本文研究公司债券发行收益率与二级市场收益率之间的差异（即“发行溢价”），发现该溢价在经济下行时期飙升，增加了企业的融资成本。作者利用新的债券层面数据以及债券供需的高频变化，构建了一个包含不完全弹性投资者、内生债券供给和承销商摩擦的一级市场模型，用以量化发行溢价的驱动因素。研究发现，承销商对投资者的偏袒（favoritism）会提高发行溢价的水平并加剧其周期性波动；而相对富有弹性的投资者则有助于一级市场吸收大规模债券发行。这些发现为针对债券发行市场的政策制定提供了依据。
ai_comment: 本文通过高频数据和结构模型首次量化了发行溢价中承销商偏袒的作用，为理解债券融资成本周期波动提供了新机制。

title: Transmission of Information from Private to Public Markets
abstract: We report evidence consistent with institutional investors using industry-level information that they obtain from their investments in venture capital (VC) funds to earn excess returns in publicly traded stocks. We use court rulings regarding the Freedom of Information Act as an exogenous shock affecting the information flow between VC funds and institutional investors to show that the excess returns are explained by information received via this channel. Thus, institutional investors serve as conduits of information from private to public markets. In the process, institutional investors earn higher returns from their VC investments than implied by the cash flows received therefrom.
summary: 本文研究机构投资者如何利用从风险投资（VC）基金投资中获得的行业层面信息，在公开股票市场上获取超额收益。通过利用信息自由法案（Freedom of Information Act）的法院裁决作为外生冲击，影响VC基金与机构投资者之间的信息流动，作者证明了超额收益源于这一信息渠道。结论表明，机构投资者充当了信息从私人市场传递到公共市场的传导者，并且他们从VC投资中获得的回报高于其现金流所隐含的收益。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生冲击识别私人市场信息向公共市场传导的因果效应，为信息传递机制提供了有力证据，对理解机构投资者的角色具有重要贡献。

title: Climate-Triggered Institutional Price Pressure: Does It Affect Firms’ Cost of Equity?
abstract: We document that climate-triggered institutional portfolio rebalancing affects S&P 500 firms’ cost of equity through climate change price pressure (CCPP). Using a demand-based asset pricing framework, we estimate firm-level CCPP from physical and transition exposures over 2005–2021. A one-standard-deviation intensification of CCPP raises the cost of equity by up to 6% of its average, with banks and insurers as the main drivers. Yet firms do not subsequently improve environmental performance, indicating that the statistically significant effect of CCPP on cost of equity is ineffective to alter corporate behavior. Our CCPP metrics can help policymakers and investors design targeted environmental strategies.
summary: 本文研究气候变化引发的机构投资组合再平衡如何通过气候变化价格压力（CCPP）影响标普500企业的权益成本。基于需求驱动的资产定价框架，作者从物理风险和转型风险两个维度估计了2005-2021年间企业层面的CCPP。研究发现，CCPP每增加一个标准差，权益成本平均上升6%，银行和保险公司是主要驱动因素。然而，受冲击的企业并未随后改善环境绩效，表明CCPP对权益成本的影响虽然统计显著，但不足以改变企业行为。本文提供的CCPP指标有助于政策制定者和投资者设计更有针对性的环境战略。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将气候风险通过机构投资者行为传导至企业融资成本，并发现市场压力未能有效促进企业环保改善，为气候政策有效性提供了重要实证警示。

title: Market Feedback Effect on CEO Pay: Evidence from Peers’ Say-on-Pay Voting Failures
abstract: This article shows that when a compensation peer firm experiences a significant failure in its say-on-pay (SOP) voting, the focal firm’s stock price is adversely affected, resulting in reduced CEO pay in the subsequent period. This pay-reduction effect is amplified when the board is more powerful, when proxy advisors express concerns about CEO pay, and when the compensation consultant lacks quality. Directors who react to the price drop and cut the CEO’s pay receive higher votes in future director elections, implying a market feedback effect for directors of the focal firm triggered by their peers’ SOP voting failure.
summary: 本文研究薪酬同行公司“say-on-pay”（SOP）投票失败如何通过市场反馈效应影响焦点公司的CEO薪酬。研究发现，当同行公司在SOP投票中遭遇显著失败时，焦点公司的股价会受到负面影响，进而导致其CEO薪酬在随后期间降低。这一薪酬削减效应在董事会权力更大、代理顾问对CEO薪酬表达担忧以及薪酬顾问质量较低时会进一步放大。此外，对股价下跌做出反应并削减CEO薪酬的董事在未来的董事选举中获得更高支持投票，表明同行SOP投票失败通过市场反馈机制影响焦点公司董事的行为和激励。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用同行SOP投票失败作为外生冲击，揭示了市场反馈在薪酬治理中的作用，并提供了董事个人利益（选举支持）与薪酬决策之间关联的证据，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Information Acquisition By Mutual Fund Investors: Evidence from Stock Trading Suspensions
Misaligned by Design: Incentive Failures in Machine Learning
abstract: The cost of error in many high-stakes settings is asymmetric: misdiagnosing pneumonia when absent is an inconvenience, but failing to detect it when present can be life-threatening.Accordingly, artificial intelligence (AI) models used to assist such decisions are frequently trained with asymmetric loss functions that incorporate human decision-makers' trade-offs between false positives and false negatives.In two focal applications, we show that this standard alignment practice can backfire.In both cases, it would be better to train the machine learning model with a loss function that ignores the human's objective and then adjust predictions ex post according to that objective.We rationalize this result using an economic model of incentive design with endogenous information acquisition.The key insight from our theoretical framework is that machine classifiers perform not one but two incentivized tasks: choosing how to classify and learning how to classify.We show that while the adjustments engineers use correctly incentivize choosing, they can simultaneously reduce the incentives to learn.Our formal treatment of the problem reveals that methods embraced for their intuitive appeal can in fact misalign human and machine objectives in predictable ways.
summary: 论文指出在许多高风险场景中，错误成本是不对称的（例如，漏诊肺炎可能致命，而误诊则相对轻微）。因此，用于辅助决策的AI模型通常使用不对称损失函数进行训练，以纳入人类决策者对假阳性和假阴性的权衡。然而，在两个重点应用中，作者发现这种标准的对齐实践可能适得其反。在这两种情况下，更好的做法是使用忽略人类目标的损失函数来训练机器学习模型，然后根据该目标对预测进行事后调整。作者通过一个包含内生信息获取的激励设计经济模型来解释这一结果。理论框架的关键见解是，机器分类器执行两项激励任务：选择如何分类和学习如何分类。虽然工程师使用的调整正确地激励了选择，但它们同时可能减少学习的激励。对问题的正式处理表明，那些因其直观吸引力而被采用的方法实际上可能以可预测的方式使人类和机器目标错位。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了标准对齐实践可能导致的激励错位问题，为高风险管理中AI与人类目标的协调提供了新的理论视角。

title: Social Dynamics of AI Adoption
abstract: Anxiety about falling behind can drive people to embrace emerging technologies with uncertain consequences.We study how social forces shape demand for AI-based learning tools early in the education pipeline.In incentivized experiments with parents-key gatekeepers for children's AI adoption-we elicit their demand for unrestricted AI tools for teenagers' education.Parental demand rises with the share of other teenagers using the technology, with social forces increasing willingness to pay for AI by more than 60%.Providing information about potentially adverse effects of unstructured AI use negatively shifts beliefs about the merits of AI, but does not change individual demand.Instead, this information increases parents' preference for banning AI in schools.Follow-up experiments show that social information has little effect on beliefs about AI quality, perceived skill priorities, or support for bans, suggesting that effects operate through social pressure rather than social learning.Our evidence highlights social pressure driving individual technology adoption despite widespread support for restricting its use.
summary: 本研究通过激励实验探究社会因素如何影响父母对AI教育工具的采纳需求。研究发现，父母对AI工具的支付意愿随其他青少年使用比例的上升而显著增加，社会因素使其支付意愿提高超过60%。提供AI潜在负面信息会降低对AI益处的信念，但并未改变个体需求，反而增加了父母对学校禁止AI的支持。后续实验表明，社会信息对AI质量信念、技能优先级认知或禁令支持影响甚微，提示效应主要通过社会压力而非社会学习发挥作用。研究强调了社会压力在技术采纳中的驱动作用，尽管多数人支持限制AI使用。
ai_comment: 通过精巧的激励实验揭示了社会压力在技术采纳中的强大驱动作用，即使信息负面也无法改变个人需求，反而强化了对他人的限制意愿，为理解技术扩散中的社会互动提供了新视角。

title: Stablecoins: A Revolutionary Payment Technology with Financial Risks
abstract: The GENIUS Act, recently signed into law, establishes a dual federal and state regulatory framework for stablecoins, effectively segmenting the USD stablecoin market into GENIUScompliant stablecoins and those that are not.This paper discusses the use cases and potential benefits of stablecoins in terms of payment system efficiency and costs, as well as their substitutability with money market mutual funds and bank deposits.It then analyzes the financial stability risks associated with both GENIUS-compliant and unregulated stablecoins using empirical analysis and historical case studies.It concludes by discussing the economic implications of the emergence of a large dollar stablecoin ecosystem.The discussion is supported by a new survey of expert opinions canvassed through Large Language Model (LLM) analysis of all U.S.
summary: 本文讨论稳定币作为支付技术的应用场景与潜在益处，包括提高支付系统效率和降低成本，以及它们与货币市场共同基金和银行存款之间的可替代性。通过实证分析和历史案例研究，本文分析了符合GENIUS法案监管框架的稳定币以及未受监管的稳定币所带来的金融稳定风险。最后，本文探讨了大规模美元稳定币生态系统出现的经济影响，并基于对美国专家意见的大语言模型分析提供了一项新的调查支持。
ai_comment: 本文结合新立法与实证分析，系统评估了稳定币的双刃剑效应，为理解数字资产监管与金融稳定提供了重要视角。

title: Portfolio Choice and Settlement Frictions: A Theory of Endogenous Convenience Yields
Selling to Yourself: Continuation Funds in Private Equity
abstract: Continuation funds (CFs) are private equity structures in which a manager raises a new fund to purchase assets from their existing fund.This structure has surged in popularity, from five funds in 2018 to 130 in 2024.We use a hand-collected sample of 472 CFs to test a model in which heterogeneous preferences drive CFs.Consistent with the model's predictions, CFs emerge when LPs are more heterogeneous and managers have earned carried interest that they can roll.LPs typically choose to exit rather than invest, with this decision driven by both LP-level frictions and time varying LP liquidity demands.
summary: Continuation funds (CFs) 是一种私募股权结构，基金管理人通过设立新基金收购其现有基金所持有的资产。此类基金近年来急剧增加，从2018年的5只增长至2024年的130只。本文利用手工收集的472个CFs样本，检验了一个基于异质性偏好的模型。模型预测及实证结果均表明：当有限合伙人（LPs）的偏好异质性更强、且管理人已获得可结转的carried interest时，CFs更有可能出现。LPs通常倾向于退出而非继续投资，这一决策既受LP层面摩擦的影响，也随其流动性需求随时间变化而调整。
ai_comment: 本文通过手工采集大样本数据，为CFs的兴起提供了首个系统性实证证据，并揭示了LP退出决策的微观驱动因素，对理解私募二级市场交易具有重要贡献。

title: The Coasean Singularity? Demand, Supply, and Market Design with AI Agents
The Mortgage Debt Channel of Monetary Policy when Mortgages are Liquid
Optimizing Retirement Financial Strategies: Integrating Annuities, Defined Contribution Plans, and Long-Term Care Costs
abstract: Nursing home costs in the United States now exceed $100,000 per year, and government assistance programs such as Medicaid help out only when retirees are largely destitute.Moreover, health shocks driving the need for such care can arise suddenly in old age, are frequently permanent in nature, and can be associated with declining mental and physical abilities.These facts raise the important question of how households can best prepare to finance this final phase of life.Building on past research, we determine how retirees should manage payouts from defined contribution plans to balance trade-offs between consumption and health care cost shocks, using both retirement plan assets and annuitization.Our analysis explicitly integrates the role of taxes, required minimum distributions, bequest motives, and the possibility of retiree insolvency.We conclude that payout annuities, especially deferred and variable annuities, can be quite valuable for retirees, even when they face health shocks in later life.
summary: 美国养老院成本现已超过每年10万美元，而政府援助项目如Medicaid仅在退休人员几乎贫困时才提供帮助。此外，导致此类护理需求的健康冲击可能在老年期突然出现，通常具有永久性，并可能与智力和身体能力下降相关。这些事实提出了一个重要问题：家庭如何最好地为这一生命最后阶段提供资金支持？基于以往研究，我们确定了退休人员应如何管理确定缴费计划的支出，以平衡消费和医疗费用冲击之间的权衡，同时利用退休计划资产和年金化。我们的分析明确整合了税收、最低分配要求、遗赠动机以及退休人员无力偿债的可能性。我们得出结论：支付年金，尤其是递延年金和可变年金，对退休人员可能非常有价值，即使他们在晚年面临健康冲击。
ai_comment: 该论文在退休金融领域做出了重要贡献，明确整合了税收、遗赠动机和破产风险等因素，强调了递延年金和可变年金在应对晚年健康冲击中的价值，为退休规划提供了实用指导。

title: Demand Elasticity in Dynamic Asset Pricing
abstract: Standard demand elasticity estimation treats investors' demand slopes as stable objects that can be traced out by exogenous residual supply shifts.We show this identification strategy fails in dynamic settings: supply shocks cause demand curves to tilt and shift through general equilibrium effects.The mechanism is intuitive-investors' demand depends on the entire distribution of current and future returns, including volatility, covariances, and correlations with investment opportunities.Supply shocks that change today's prices inevitably reshape future return distributions, moving the demand curve itself.We develop and calibrate a dynamic model to quantify this mismeasurement.The measured slope is approximately 40% of its conceptual counterpart, implying that demand curves are substantially steeper than estimated.This distortion operates through two channels: endogenous risk (altered volatility and covariances) and amplified intertemporal hedging (changed correlation with investment opportunities).The distortion remains sizable even for infinitesimal or purely transitory shocks.
summary: 标准需求弹性估计假定投资者需求斜率是稳定的，可由外生剩余供给冲击追踪。本文指出，这一识别策略在动态环境中失效：供给冲击通过一般均衡效应导致需求曲线倾斜和移动。其机制在于，投资者需求取决于当前和未来收益的整个分布，包括波动率、协方差以及与投资机会的相关性。改变当前价格的供给冲击会重塑未来收益分布，从而移动需求曲线。作者构建并校准了一个动态模型来量化这种测量误差，发现测量得到的斜率仅约为概念上的40%，意味着需求曲线远比估计的更陡。该扭曲通过两个渠道实现：内生风险（改变波动率和协方差）和放大跨期对冲（改变与投资机会的相关性）。即使对于无穷小或纯暂时性冲击，该扭曲仍然显著。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了标准需求弹性估计在动态资产定价中的系统性偏差，并通过结构模型量化了偏差的大小及传导渠道，对实证资产定价方法提出了重要修正。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Competition, and Welfare
abstract: We study how market power in artificial intelligence (AI) shapes wages and welfare in openeconomy general equilibrium by treating AI as a priced, imported factor.Across three models, we separate technical efficiency from the impact of upstream price setting.In a two-traded-goods benchmark, the incidence of AI price changes depends on how sectoral skill intensity changes with AI prices; non-monotone intensity can generate "double harm" for unskilled workers (lower real wage after a large decrease in the price of AI, and real wage decreases further when the AI price rises as a result of market power).With one non-traded sector, we observe that the classic "Dutch disease" effect here would arise when one sector gets more productive and draws labor away from other sectors, creating scarcity and raising prices; but this is not what we expect from the introduction of labor-substituting AI.In contrast, our last model considers two non-traded sectors and CES/free entry, and the opportunity for discrete adoption of technology that replaces unskilled labor from the AI-using sector.When AI reduces unit costs and increases variety, it will not pull U from non-tradables, instead it will displace workers from the AI-using sector and lower wage due to diminishing returns in alternative sectors.Strategic upstream pricing of AI then harms welfare through unit-cost (usage fees) and variety (access fees) channels, with income leakage abroad.We derive an adoption frontier tying feasible usage prices to displaced workers' outside options and show a monopolist typically prices on this boundary; capping one instrument shifts rents to the other.Broad gains for the adopting country relies on pressure (or regulation) on both usage and access fees and as well as policy that supports productive absorption of displaced labor.The framework clarifies when AI can lower real wages and aggregate welfare despite efficiency gains.
summary: 研究将人工智能（AI）视为一种有价的进口要素，在开放经济一般均衡框架下分析AI市场势力如何影响工资和社会福利。通过三种模型分离技术效率与上游定价的影响：在两种贸易品基准模型中，AI价格变化的影响取决于部门技能强度随AI价格的非单调变化，这可能导致低技能工人遭受“双重伤害”（AI价格大幅下降后实际工资下降，且因市场势力导致AI价格上涨时实际工资进一步下降）；在包含非贸易部门的模型中，经典“荷兰病”效应在AI引入时并不适用；在两种非贸易部门且采用CES/自由进入的模型中，AI替代低技能劳动力的技术采纳机会使得AI降低单位成本并增加品种，但会从使用AI的部门挤出工人，因替代部门收益递减而降低工资。上游AI的战略性定价通过单位成本（使用费）和品种（访问费）渠道损害福利，并导致收入外流。研究推导出采用边界，将可行使用价格与被替代工人的外部选择联系起来，发现垄断者通常在该边界上定价；限制一种工具会将租金转移到另一种工具。采用国必须对使用费和访问费施加压力或监管，并制定支持生产性吸收被替代劳动力的政策，才能获得广泛收益。该框架阐明了即使存在效率提升，AI也可能降低实际工资和总福利的条件。
ai_comment: 本文通过多种一般均衡模型系统分析了AI市场势力对工资和福利的负面影响机制，揭示了AI可能降低实际工资和总福利的悖论，对政策制定有重要启示。

title: Breaking Parity: Equilibrium Exchange Rates and Currency Premia
abstract: We offer a unifying empirical model of covered and uncovered currency premia, interest rates and spot and forward exchange rates, both in the cross section and time series of currencies.We find that the rich empirical patterns are in line with a partial equilibrium model of the currency market, where hedged and unhedged currency is supplied by intermediary banks subject to value-at-risk balancesheet constraints, emphasizing the frictional nature of equilibrium currency premia and exchange rate dynamics.In the cross section, the excess supply of local-currency savings is the key determinant of low relative interest rates, negative covered and uncovered currency premia, cheap forward dollars; and vice versa.In the time series, covered currency premia change infrequently and in concert across currencies, driven by aggregate financial market conditions.In contrast, uncovered currency premia move frequently in response to currency-specific demand shocks, which we capture with the dynamics of net currency futures positions of dealer banks.Exchange rate depreciations in response to negative shifts in currency demand are followed by small persistent appreciations that generate predictable expected returns necessary to ensure intermediation of currency demand shocks, irrespective of their financial or macroeconomic origin.Changes in net futures positions of dealer banks account for most of the variation in the spot exchange rate for every currency.
summary: 本文提出了一个统一的外汇市场实证模型，涵盖有抛补和无抛补货币溢价、利率、即期和远期汇率的横截面和时间序列特征。研究发现，丰富的实证模式符合一个局部均衡模型：外汇市场中，货币由面临在险价值（VaR）资产负债表约束的中介银行供给，强调货币溢价和汇率动态的摩擦性本质。在横截面上，本地货币储蓄的过剩供给是低相对利率、负的有抛补和无抛补货币溢价、远期美元便宜的关键决定因素；反之亦然。在时间序列上，有抛补货币溢价变化不频繁且跨货币协同变化，由整体金融市场条件驱动；而无抛补货币溢价则频繁响应货币特定的需求冲击，这种冲击以交易商银行净货币期货头寸的动态来刻画。因负向货币需求冲击导致的汇率贬值之后会出现小幅持续的升值，从而产生可预测的预期回报，无论冲击源自金融还是宏观经济，该回报对于确保货币需求冲击的中介是必要的。交易商银行净期货头寸的变化解释了每种货币即期汇率的大部分变动。
ai_comment: 本文通过将银行中介的VaR约束引入外汇市场，统一解释了有抛补和无抛补货币溢价及汇率动态，为理解货币市场摩擦提供了新视角。

title: Central Bank Liquidity Backstops, Bank Regulation, and Risk-Taking by Asset Managers
abstract: Central bank liquidity backstops and bank leverage regulation interact across financial intermediaries and states of the world. A backstop is implemented only in some states to grease the wheels of bank dealers that absorb fire sales. It also incentivizes asset managers to take on excessive redemption risk. Regulation binds in other states, in which it hamstrings market making. Because this outcome increases asset managers’ fire sale costs, it reins in their risk-taking. Empirically, we confirm such a disciplining effect of regulation on U.S. money market funds. Theoretically, we derive that the two policy measures complement each other in raising social welfare because they address different sources of redemption-driven losses—fire sale costs for given risk-taking and excessive risk-taking, respectively. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06997 .
summary: 本文研究了央行流动性支持与银行杠杆监管在不同金融中介和市场状态下的相互作用。央行流动性支持仅在部分状态下实施，以帮助银行交易商吸收抛售压力，但同时也激励资产管理人过度承担赎回风险。银行杠杆监管在其他状态下约束了做市行为，增加了资产管理人的抛售成本，从而抑制了其风险承担。实证部分利用美国货币市场基金数据证实了监管的这种约束效应。理论上，两种政策工具通过分别降低给定风险承担下的抛售成本和过度风险承担，在提高社会福利方面相互补充。
ai_comment: 该论文理论模型与实证分析相结合，揭示了宏观审慎政策的互补性，为理解流动性支持和资本监管的协同效应提供了新视角。

title: Concentration in Mortgage Markets: Government Sponsored Enterprise Exposure and Risk-Taking in Uncertain Times
abstract: When home prices threaten to decline, large mortgage investors can benefit from fostering new lending that boosts demand. We ask whether this benefit contributed to the growth in acquisitions of risky mortgages by the Government Sponsored Enterprises (GSEs) in the first half of 2007. We find that it helps explain the variation of this growth across regions, as well as regional house price and credit changes. The growth predicted by this benefit is on top of the acquisition growth caused by the exit of private-label securitizers. We conclude that the GSEs actively targeted their acquisitions to counter home-price declines. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05912 .
summary: 本文研究当房价面临下跌威胁时，大型抵押贷款投资者（包括政府支持企业，GSEs）是否通过促进新贷款来提振需求，从而增加了对风险抵押贷款的收购。利用2007年上半年的区域数据，作者发现GSEs收购风险抵押贷款的增长与这一动机显著相关，且该增长叠加了私人标签证券化机构退出导致的收购增长。区域房价和信贷变化也支持这一解释。结论表明，GSEs主动针对性地收购风险抵押贷款以对抗房价下跌。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了GSEs在次贷危机前夕主动增加风险敞口以稳定房价的行为，为理解危机前金融机构的动机提供了新视角。

title: The News in Earnings Announcement Disclosures: Capturing Word Context Using LLM Methods
abstract: This study examines the information content of textual disclosures in firms’ earnings announcements. Using a large language model (LLM) to capture information in both words and word context, I show that the news in earnings press releases (i) explains three times more variation in short-window stock returns than a host of textual measures based on dictionary and non-LLM machine learning methods; (ii) doubles the R 2 of an array of financial statement surprises, modeled with conventional regression or machine learning approaches; and (iii) accounts for a large fraction of immediate price revisions within just five minutes of release. LLM-modeled conference calls further enhance R 2 by one fourth compared with press releases and financial surprises. Textual disclosures are more informative when earnings are less persistent and during periods of aggregate uncertainty. Most news arises from text describing numbers, at the beginning of the disclosure, and including novel contents. These findings highlight the role of firms’ textual disclosures in moving stock prices and advance our understanding of how investors utilize corporate disclosures. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: The author gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Naveen Jindal School of Management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05417 .
summary: 本研究利用大语言模型（LLM）捕捉公司盈利公告中文本披露的词汇和上下文信息，发现盈利新闻稿中的文本信息（i）比基于词典和非LLM机器学习方法的多种文本指标更能解释短期窗口股票回报的变异，解释力高出三倍；（ii）将一系列财务报表惊喜（通过常规回归或机器学习方法建模）的R方提高了一倍；（iii）在发布后短短五分钟内解释了大部分即时价格修正。相较于新闻稿和财务惊喜，LLM建模的电话会议进一步将R方提高了四分之一。当盈利持续性较低和宏观经济不确定性较高时，文本披露的信息含量更高。大部分信息来自描述数字的文本、披露开头部分以及包含新内容的部分。这些发现凸显了公司文本披露在推动股价变动中的作用，并加深了我们对投资者如何利用公司披露的理解。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地利用LLM捕捉上下文信息，显著提升了文本信息对股票回报的解释力，为会计与金融领域的文本分析提供了新范式。

title: Do Managers Successfully Shop for Auditors Who Allow Them to Opportunistically Report Positive News? Evidence from Accounting Estimates
abstract: Prior auditor shopping literature examines managers’ attempts to opportunistically underreport negative news by finding auditors who will allow them to avoid negative audit opinions or underreport goodwill impairments or financial misstatements. We advance this literature by examining management attempts to opportunistically report positive news, as captured by income-increasing changes in accounting estimates. Adapting a previous framework, we find that, ex ante, managers are more (less) likely to dismiss their auditor if it increases (decreases) the expected likelihood of reporting income-increasing changes in accounting estimates (POSCHGs). We also find that, ex post, following auditor dismissals, the frequency and magnitude of POSCHGs increase, and companies reporting POSCHGs are more likely to restate earnings, receive Securities and Exchange Commission comment letters related to estimates, meet or beat earnings targets, and less likely to receive going concern opinions or violate debt covenants. Placebo tests show that none of the above results hold for income-decreasing changes in estimates. Finally, we identify several institutional factors that constrain managers’ ability to shop for lenient auditors, including the quality of the successor auditor and strong corporate governance. Collectively, our findings are consistent with managers successfully shopping for auditors who allow them to opportunistically report positive news following auditor dismissals. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05299 .
summary: 这篇论文研究经理人是否通过更换审计师来机会主义地报告正面新闻，具体表现为报告收益增加的会计估计变更（POSCHGs）。作者改编了前人框架，发现事前，如果审计师增加（减少）POSCHGs的报告可能性，经理人更可能（更不可能）解雇该审计师；事后，审计师解雇后POSCHGs的频率和幅度均增加，且报告POSCHGs的公司更可能重述收益、收到SEC关于估计的评论信、达成或超过盈利目标，而更不可能收到持续经营意见或违反债务契约。安慰剂测试显示，这些结果对收益减少的会计估计变更不成立。此外，研究识别了若干限制经理人寻租能力的制度因素，包括继任审计师质量和强有力的公司治理。综上，证据表明经理人能够成功寻找到允许他们机会主义地报告正面新闻的审计师。
ai_comment: 本文首次聚焦于经理人通过审计师选择来机会主义地报告正面新闻，而非传统的负面新闻隐藏，拓展了审计师寻租文献。其实证设计严谨，包括事前事后分析和安慰剂测试。

title: Blocking Block Formation: Evidence from Private Loan Contracts
abstract: Does the structure of the borrower’s equity ownership matter in debt contracting? This paper addresses this question by examining change in control clauses. These clauses are pervasive in loan contracts, yet their terms are not boilerplate. Examining 14,940 contracts, we document significant heterogeneity in the use and size of ownership caps, which limit large equity block formation. Overall, our evidence indicates that the way equity capital is distributed matters to lenders. Lenders set lower caps to mitigate risks arising from power contests among shareholders, formation of a new (coordinating) block, potentially resulting in activism, and hostile takeover threats via toehold strategies. We confirm some of these effects using two quasi-natural experiments. Caps below 50% are associated with a drop in firm value but not in the cost of debt, consistent with exacerbated firm-manager agency costs. Finally, two findings shed light on ways creditors may influence corporate governance: the largest block size increases when these minority block restrictions expire, and the likelihood of withdrawing an announced buyback increases during the life of these loans. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04224 .
summary: 本文研究借款人股权结构是否影响债务契约，具体通过分析贷款合同中的控制权变更条款（特别是所有权上限）来探讨。通过对14940份合同的分析，发现所有权上限在合同中的使用和规模存在显著异质性，这些上限限制了大型股权块的形成。证据表明，股权分布方式对贷款人很重要：贷款人设置较低的上限以缓解股东间权力争夺、新（协调性）股权块形成（可能导致激进主义）以及通过脚趾策略进行的敌意收购威胁带来的风险。利用两个准自然实验验证了部分效应。低于50%的所有权上限与企业价值下降相关，但不影响债务成本，这与加剧的企业-经理代理成本一致。此外，当这些少数股权限制到期时，最大股东规模增加；在贷款存续期间，宣布回购撤回的可能性增加。这些发现揭示了债权人可能影响公司治理的途径。
ai_comment: 本文通过大量合同数据揭示了贷款合同中所有权上限的异质性及其经济后果，为理解债权人如何通过契约条款影响公司治理提供了新证据。

title: The Labor Market Consequences of Student Loan Forbearance
abstract: We examine the effects of student loan forbearance on job search outcomes. Our experimental setting is the 2020 federal student loan moratorium that provided some borrowers with forbearance by pausing the payments on their student loans. We use data on unemployment insurance claims, payroll records, and credit histories to compare unemployed borrowers who received forbearance to unemployed borrowers who had to continue making payments. We find that the payment pause did not have any economically or statistically significant effects on job search durations or subsequent incomes. Further, we find no heterogeneity in these effects across borrowers’ financial, demographic, or labor market characteristics. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04047 .
summary: 本文利用2020年联邦学生贷款暂停作为自然实验，通过比较获得宽限的失业借款人与仍需还款的失业借款人的求职结果，来研究学生贷款宽限对求职的影响。使用失业保险索赔、工资记录和信用历史数据，发现贷款支付暂停对求职时长和后续收入没有经济上或统计上显著的影响，且在不同借款人财务、人口统计或劳动力市场特征上均无显著异质性。
ai_comment: 利用大规模自然实验提供了关于宽限政策效果的因果证据，结论对政策制定有参考价值。

title: Skilled Labor Uncertainty and Corporate Investment: Evidence from H-1B Visa Lottery Cycles
abstract: We study how periodic uncertainty about skilled labor supply affects corporate investment using the H-1B visa program for skilled workers as an empirical setting. Exploiting cross-regional variation in H-1B labor flows based on historical immigrant enclaves, we find that firms in regions that attract more H-1B workers concentrate their investments in the quarter after uncertainty about visa access is resolved by the H-1B lottery. Consistent with a skilled labor uncertainty channel, we find that the investment spikes are confined to industries where invested capital cannot be easily redeployed, to firms that cannot easily find domestic substitutes for lost H-1B workers, and to firms that cannot easily arrange alternative employment visas for their foreign employees. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: S.-J. Xu gratefully acknowledges research support from the University of Alberta. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03486 .
summary: 本文利用H-1B签证项目作为研究背景，探讨技能劳动力供应的周期性不确定性如何影响企业投资。通过基于历史移民飞地构建的跨区域H-1B劳动力流动差异，研究发现，在吸引更多H-1B工人的地区，企业在H-1B抽签解决签证不确定性后的季度内集中增加投资。进一步分析表明，这种投资激增仅出现在资本难以重新配置的行业、难以找到国内替代H-1B员工的企业以及难以为其外籍员工安排其他就业签证的企业中，这与技能劳动力不确定性渠道的预期一致。
ai_comment: 该研究利用H-1B签证抽签的自然实验，巧妙识别了劳动力不确定性对企业投资的因果效应，并揭示了异质性机制，为理解政策不确定性下的企业行为提供了新证据。

title: Statistical Tests for Replacing Human Decision Makers with Algorithms
abstract: This paper proposes a statistical framework of using artificial intelligence to improve human decision making. The performance of each human decision maker is benchmarked against that of machine predictions. We replace the diagnoses made by a subset of the decision makers with the recommendation from the machine learning algorithm. We apply both a heuristic frequentist approach and a Bayesian posterior loss function approach to abnormal birth detection using a nationwide data set of doctor diagnoses from prepregnancy checkups of reproductive-age couples and pregnancy outcomes. We find that our algorithm on a test data set results in a higher overall true positive rate and a lower false positive rate than the diagnoses made by doctors only. This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: H. Hong’s work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant SES 1658950]. K. Tang’s work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72192802, 72342008]. J. Wang’s work was partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72222022, 72171013, 72242101]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01845 .
summary: 本文提出了一个统计框架，利用人工智能改善人类决策。该框架将每位人类决策者的表现与机器预测进行基准比较，并用机器学习算法的推荐替换部分决策者的诊断。研究采用启发式频率学派方法和贝叶斯后验损失函数方法，使用全国范围内育龄夫妇孕前检查的医生诊断数据及妊娠结局数据集，对异常出生检测进行实证分析。结果表明，在测试集上，该算法相比仅由医生做出的诊断，实现了更高的总真阳性率和更低的假阳性率。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将频率学派和贝叶斯方法结合，为AI辅助医疗决策提供了严谨的统计验证，具有较强的实际应用价值。

title: The Informativeness of Balance Sheet Disaggregations: Evidence from Forecasting Operating Assets
abstract: We investigate the usefulness of balance sheet disaggregations in the context of forecasting operating asset growth and its implications for revenue growth. We show that models using disaggregated balance sheet information have greater accuracy than models that use only aggregate information, with the most accurate disaggregation scheme separately considering property, plant, and equipment, intangible assets, other noncurrent operating assets, and current operating assets. When investigating market participants’ use of disaggregated balance sheet information, we find that differences in growth predictions from a disaggregated model and an aggregate model are associated with year-ahead abnormal returns, suggesting that investors do not fully utilize disaggregated balance sheet information. We corroborate this result by showing that returns are concentrated around the earnings announcement, are more pronounced for stocks with low transient institutional ownership, and are consistent with subsequent improvements in actual financial performance. Finally, we find that these returns are driven by both the asset growth predictions of a disaggregated model and the ability of such a model to incorporate the unique revenue-generating ability of individual asset components. Importantly, we find that our results are incremental to the information embedded in income statement disaggregations, even when forecasting income statement items such as profitability. Overall, our study provides evidence on the informativeness of balance sheet disaggregations and proposes the use of disaggregated models when forecasting growth in operating assets and its implications for future revenues. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org10.1287/mnsc.2023.01413 .
summary: 本文研究资产负债表分解在预测经营性资产增长及其对收入增长影响中的信息含量。通过对比使用分解信息与汇总信息的模型，发现分解模型（特别是将资产分为财产、厂房和设备、无形资产、其他非流动经营性资产和流动经营性资产）具有更高的预测准确性。进一步分析市场参与者对分解信息的利用情况，发现分解模型与汇总模型预测的差异与未来一年的异常回报相关，表明投资者并未充分利用分解信息。这种回报集中在盈余公告期间，且在低机构持股的股票中更为显著，并与后续实际财务表现的改善一致。最后，这些回报不仅源于分解模型对资产增长的预测能力，还源于其捕捉各资产组件独特收入创造能力的能力，且结果独立于利润表分解的信息。研究证实了资产负债表分解的信息增量，并建议在预测经营性资产增长及未来收入时采用分解模型。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证揭示了资产负债表明细数据在预测中的增量价值，并指出市场投资者的有限关注，对会计信息有用性研究具有重要贡献。

title: Network-Motivated Forbearance Lending
abstract: This paper develops a theoretical framework for network-motivated forbearance lending, or forbearance lending to influential buyers and sellers in a supply network. Because dominant banks in a financial market internalize the negative externality of an influential firm’s exit, they may continue to refinance a loss-making influential firm at an interest rate lower than the prime rate. This type of forbearance lending is distinct from other strategies such as evergreening or gambling for resurrection, and we show that network-motivated forbearance lending is independent of the financial soundness of the bank and can be welfare improving. To evaluate the extent of the externality of an influential seller or buyer, we propose two measures: the price influence coefficient and the demand influence coefficient, respectively. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Seimeikai Foundation; the Seoul National University Institute of Economic Research, Housing and Commercial Bank Economic Research Fund; the Nomura Foundation; and the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science [Grants 15K01217, 16K13367, 17K03818, 20K20511, 23243050, 26245037, 26590051]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00459 .
summary: 本文构建了一个理论框架，研究网络动机的宽限贷款，即银行向供应链中有影响力的买方或卖方提供的宽限贷款。由于金融市场的主导银行会内部化有影响力企业退出带来的负外部性，因此它们可能继续以低于优惠利率的利率为亏损但有影响力的企业再融资。这种宽限贷款不同于常青贷款或赌复活等其他策略，并且独立于银行的财务健全性，能够改善社会福利。为了评估有影响力卖方或买方的外部性程度，本文分别提出了价格影响力系数和需求影响力系数两个度量指标。
ai_comment: 该论文创造性地将供应链网络视角引入银行宽限贷款研究，提出了network-motivated forbearance lending的新概念，并设计了度量外部性的具体指标，为理解银行对系统重要性企业的特殊信贷行为提供了理论基础。

title: Evidence on Expectations of Household Finances
abstract: We use panel data on expected and realized changes in household finances to study the process of expectation formation. Households extrapolate from improvements in financial situation, but deteriorations are associated with an increased dispersion of forecasts, and higher probabilities of both negative and positive forecast errors. Individuals who expect earnings declines to revert too quickly save less and are more likely to be financially worse off again in the future. Learning from past errors reduces the likelihood that individuals are optimistic following a deterioration in their finances. The evidence shows how experiences, learning, and life events matter for expectation formation. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03257 .
summary: 本文利用家庭财务预期与实现变化的面板数据，研究预期形成的过程。研究发现，家庭会从财务状况改善中外推，但财务状况恶化与预期离散度增加相关，且负面和正面预测错误的概率均升高。预期收入下降会过快恢复的个人储蓄较少，未来更可能再次陷入财务困境。从过去错误中学习会降低个人在财务状况恶化后保持乐观的可能性。证据表明经历、学习和生活事件对预期形成至关重要。该论文被Camelia Kuhnen（金融方向）接受。在线附录和数据文件可获取。
ai_comment: 利用丰富面板数据深入揭示家庭财务预期形成的微观机制，特别是外推偏差与学习效应，对消费者金融和预期经济学有重要贡献。

title: A Sample Size Calculation for Training and Certifying Targeting Policies
abstract: We propose an approach for determining the sample size required when using an experiment to train and certify a targeting policy. Calculating the rate at which the performance of a targeting model improves with additional training data is a complex problem. We address this challenge by assuming that customers are grouped into segments that capture relevant information about their responsiveness to the firm’s marketing actions. We consider two problem formulations. The first formulation identifies the sample size required to train a targeting policy and certify that its expected performance exceeds a predefined threshold. The second formulation identifies the sample size required to train a targeting policy and certify that it outperforms a baseline in an out-of-sample statistical test. We establish theoretical properties of these problems, based on which we propose computationally efficient algorithms for optimal sample size calculations. We illustrate our algorithms and analysis using data from a luxury fashion retailer. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02947 .
summary: 本文提出了一种基于实验来训练和认证目标策略（targeting policy）时所需样本量的确定方法。作者假设客户被划分为若干细分市场（segments），这些市场捕捉了客户对企业营销行为响应性的相关信息。研究考虑了两个问题设定：第一个是确定训练目标策略并认证其预期绩效超过预设阈值所需的样本量；第二个是确定训练目标策略并认证其在样本外统计测试中优于基线策略所需的样本量。文章建立了这些问题的理论性质，并基于此提出了计算最优样本量的高效算法。最后，作者利用一家奢侈时装零售商的数据对其算法和分析进行了说明。本文已被《管理科学》（Management Science）接受，由David Simchi-Levi编辑，行业为市场营销。
ai_comment: 本文为营销策略的样本量计算提供了严谨的统计框架和实用算法，兼具理论深度与实际应用价值。

title: Designing AI-Based Work Processes: How the Timing of AI Advice Affects Diagnostic Decision Making
abstract: Although clinical artificial intelligence (AI) systems can augment medical diagnosis decisions by providing competent second opinions, how to effectively integrate AI into routine diagnostic processes, such as when to present AI advice to human physicians, remains largely unexplored. Therefore, our research experimentally examines how the timing of AI advice affects diagnostic decision making using a think-aloud approach. Physicians perform medical diagnoses under three conditions: ex post advice (AI advice given after an initial diagnosis), ex ante advice (AI advice given concurrently with clinical information), and a control condition (no AI advice). Our results indicate that the timing of AI advice significantly affects diagnostic accuracy and calibration, with the ex post advice condition yielding the best performance and the control condition the worst. We then conduct several analyses to disentangle the underlying mechanism. We reveal that the superior diagnostic quality in the ex post advice condition can be attributed to more thorough clinical information processing and more active cognitive engagement with AI’s reasoning rationale. As a result, participants in the ex post advice condition are more capable of differentiating correct from incorrect AI advice than those in the ex ante advice condition. Additionally, they benefit more from high-quality AI advice that contradicts their initial diagnoses. To gain additional insights, we estimate the heterogeneous treatment effects based on physician and clinical case characteristics. Our findings underscore the importance of presenting AI advice at appropriate times during routine diagnostic processes to achieve successful decision augmentation with AI advice. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Funding: This work was supported by the National University of Singapore [Grants Dean Strategic Fund - Health Informatics (HIIOT)/E and NSCP/ N-171-000-499-001] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72301279]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01454 .
summary: 该研究通过出声思考法实验，探讨了临床AI建议的时机（事后建议、事前建议、无建议）对医生诊断决策的影响。结果显示，事后建议（初始诊断后提供AI建议）显著提升了诊断准确性和校准能力，优于事前建议（与临床信息同时提供）和控制组。机制分析表明，事后建议促使医生更彻底地处理临床信息、更积极地认知参与AI的推理逻辑，从而能更好地区分正确与错误的AI建议，并更多地利用与初始诊断矛盾的高质量AI建议。此外，研究还估计了基于医生和病例特征的异质性处理效应。结论强调了在常规诊断流程中适时呈现AI建议对于实现有效决策增强的重要性。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实验设计揭示了AI建议时机对诊断决策的关键影响，为AI辅助医疗决策的流程优化提供了实证依据。

title: The Joint Determination of Haircuts and Interest Rates for Collateralized Loans in Shadow Banking
abstract: This paper examines the joint determination of haircuts and interest rates for collateralized loans in shadow banking within a general equilibrium model. Three results emerge. First, higher downside quality (the distribution of future collateral payoffs below the debt face value) reduces haircuts only under certain conditions, whereas higher upside quality (the distribution of future collateral payoffs above the debt face value) always increases them. Second, the relative insensitivity of interest rates to shocks, compared with haircuts, occurs when shocks affect only the upside collateral quality and can also arise endogenously, with changes in haircuts amplified and changes in interest rates dampened. Third, when depositors’ saving needs increase, interest rates unexpectedly rise while haircut requirements are relaxed. The same effects occur when banks’ collateral supply shrinks. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00541 .
summary: 本文在一个一般均衡模型中研究了影子银行中抵押贷款的保证金和利率的联合决定。三个主要发现：第一，更高的下行质量（未来抵押品收益低于债务面值的分布）仅在特定条件下降低保证金，而更高的上行质量（未来抵押品收益高于债务面值的分布）则总是提高保证金。第二，与保证金相比，利率对冲击的相对不敏感性出现在冲击仅影响上行抵押品质量时，并且可能内生地产生，保证金变化被放大而利率变化被抑制。第三，当存款人储蓄需求增加时，利率意外上升而保证金要求放松；当银行抵押品供给减少时，也会出现相同的效应。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了抵押品质量不同维度对保证金和利率的非对称影响，为理解影子银行信贷市场的动态提供了新视角。

title: The (Heterogeneous) Economic Effects of Private Equity Buyouts
abstract: The effects of private equity buyouts on employment, productivity, and job reallocation vary tremendously with macroeconomic and credit conditions, across private equity groups, and by type of buyout. We reach this conclusion by examining the most extensive database of U.S. buyouts ever compiled, encompassing thousands of buyout targets from 1980 to 2013 and millions of control firms. Employment shrinks 12% over two years after buyouts of publicly listed firms—on average, and relative to control firms—but expands 15% after buyouts of privately held firms. Postbuyout productivity gains at target firms are large on average and much larger yet for deals executed amid tight credit conditions. A postbuyout tightening of credit conditions or slowing of gross domestic product growth curtails employment growth and intrafirm job reallocation at target firms. We also show that buyout effects differ across the private equity groups that sponsor buyouts, and these differences persist over time at the group level. Rapid upscaling in deal flow at the group level brings lower employment growth at target firms. We relate these findings to theories of private equity that highlight agency problems at portfolio firms and within the private equity industry itself. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Harvard Business School’s Division of Research, the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation, the Smith Richardson Foundation [Grant no. 2014-0136], and the Private Capital Research Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.03890 .
summary: 本文利用从1980年至2013年美国数千个收购目标和数百万家对照公司组成的大型数据库，研究私募股权收购对就业、生产率和岗位重新分配的影响。发现这些影响因宏观经济和信贷条件、私募股权集团以及收购类型而异。具体而言，收购上市公司后两年内就业平均减少12%，而收购私营公司后就业平均增长15%；收购后目标公司的生产率平均大幅提升，且在信贷紧缩时提升更大；收购后信贷条件收紧或GDP增长放缓会抑制目标公司的就业增长和内部岗位重新分配。此外，不同私募股权集团的收购效应存在差异，且这些差异在集团层面随时间持续；集团层面交易流的快速扩张会导致目标公司就业增长降低。这些发现与强调投资组合公司及私募股权行业内代理问题的理论相符。
ai_comment: 该论文利用迄今最全面的美国收购数据，系统揭示了私募股权收购效应的异质性，为理解其经济影响提供了重要实证证据。

title: Position Auctions with Endogenous Product Information: Why Live-Streaming Advertising Is Thriving
abstract: Live-streaming advertising in e-commerce is soaring. Both Amazon and Alibaba have employed this novel marketing model to engage consumers by sequentially exhibiting different products through live-streaming videos. In this paper, we adopt a mechanism design framework to model live-streaming e-commerce as a position auction with endogenous provision of product information. We prove that finding the mechanism that simultaneously optimizes position allocation and information provision is NP-hard. Thus, we develop several approximation algorithms. Building on the connection to the order selection problem, our analysis establishes that heuristics relying solely on product information provision can achieve up to 66.9% of the optimal revenue in the worst case. In contrast, heuristics exploiting position allocation alone may result in arbitrarily large revenue losses. We attribute the efficacy of product information provision to its enhancement of the value of ad spots in position auctions. Our findings suggest that advertising that focuses on differentiating product information—as in live-streaming e-commerce—is more lucrative than conventional position-based sponsored search. This managerial insight remains valid when accommodating multiproduct purchases with dependency or accounting for random consumer attention spans. This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72201234, 72192805], the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grants 16211619, 16502219, 16212821, 16501722, C6032-21G], and the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [Grant 2023B1212010001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01299 .
summary: 本文采用机制设计框架，将直播电商建模为内生提供产品信息的位臵拍卖。研究发现，同时优化位臵分配和信息提供是NP难的，因此开发了若干近似算法。分析表明，仅靠产品信息提供的启发式方法在最坏情况下可达到最优收入的66.9%，而仅靠位臵分配的启发式方法可能导致任意大的收入损失。信息提供的有效性在于提升了广告位在拍卖中的价值。结论是，专注于产品信息差异化的广告（如直播电商）比传统基于位臵的搜索广告更有利可图，该管理洞见在多产品购买或随机消费者注意力情况下仍然成立。
ai_comment: 本文从理论层面揭示了信息提供在直播电商广告中的关键作用，通过近似算法证明了其相对于位臵分配的优势，为平台广告设计提供了新视角。

title: Startup Accelerators, Information Asymmetry, and Corporate Venture Capital Investments
abstract: Beyond financial incentives, investments by Corporate Venture Capitalists (CVCs) are often motivated by strategic objectives, such as gaining early exposure to emerging technologies. However, in the presence of information asymmetry, CVCs tend to invest in startups with a high degree of business relatedness—startups that are less risky but lacking in knowledge novelty—which are not ideal for achieving their strategic objectives. With startup accelerators showing promise in mitigating the information asymmetry problem, we examine how a CVC’s investment pattern in a region shifts following a startup accelerator’s entry, with a particular interest in the degree of business relatedness between the CVC’s parent corporation and its portfolio companies. Analyses reveal that CVCs increase investments in startups that are dissimilar to their parent’s business following the entry of startup accelerators. We show that the two pathways through which accelerators reduce information asymmetry—quality signals, and mentorship and training—likely contribute to this change. In addition, the change is most pronounced for CVCs whose parent firm operates in an IT-using—rather than an IT-producing—industry, suggesting that accelerators help IT-using firms gain a foothold in the technology space through CVC investments. These findings deepen the understanding of the role that startup accelerators play in the entrepreneurial ecosystem against the backdrop of digital transformation occurring in nearly every industry. This paper was accepted by Kartik Hosanagar, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.03494 .
summary: 这项研究探讨了创业加速器如何缓解企业风险投资（CVC）中的信息不对称问题，从而改变其投资模式。CVC除了财务动机外，还有获取新兴技术等战略目标，但由于信息不对称，他们倾向于投资与母公司业务关联度高的初创企业，这类企业风险较低但缺乏知识新颖性，不利于实现战略目标。研究发现，当创业加速器进入某一地区后，CVC会增加对与母公司业务不相似的初创企业的投资。这种变化主要通过加速器提供的质量信号以及指导和培训两条途径实现。此外，这一效应在母公司属于IT使用行业（而非IT生产行业）时更为显著，表明加速器帮助IT使用型企业通过CVC投资在技术领域站稳脚跟。这些发现深化了对创业加速器在数字化转型背景下创业生态系统中作用的理解。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实证揭示了创业加速器作为信息中介机制如何改变CVC的投资策略，特别是对IT使用型企业的战略价值，为理解加速器在生态系统中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Have CEOs changed?
abstract: Using more than 4900 personality assessments, we study changes in the characteristics of CEOs and top executives since 2001. The same four factors explain roughly half of the variation in executive characteristics in this larger sample of assessments as in Kaplan and Sorensen (2021). In later years, CEO candidates have shown declining general ability, are increasingly execution-oriented, less interpersonal, less charismatic, and less creative-strategic, and many of these differences persist for hired CEOs. We find no evidence of increasing prevalence or importance of interpersonal and softer skills. Executives assessed for the same company have positively correlated abilities, suggesting that high-ability executives complement each other. Finally, we consider corporate objectives and CEO characteristics.
summary: 利用超过4900份个性评估数据，研究自2001年以来CEO及高管特征的变化。发现与Kaplan和Sorensen (2021)相同的四个因子解释了约一半的高管特征变异。后期CEO候选人的一般能力下降，更注重执行导向，人际交往能力、魅力和创造性战略能力减弱，且这些差异在已聘用的CEO中持续存在。没有证据表明人际和软技能的重要性增加。同一公司的高管能力正相关，表明高能力高管相互补充。最后，考虑了公司目标与CEO特征的关系。
ai_comment: 基于大规模个性评估数据，提供了CEO特征随时间变化的纵向证据，挑战了软技能重要性上升的普遍观点。

title: Inflation and Trading
abstract: We study how investors respond to inflation combining a customized survey experiment with trading data at a time of historically high inflation. Investors’ beliefs about the stock return–inflation relation are very heterogeneous in the cross section and on average too optimistic. Moreover, many investors appear unaware of inflation-hedging strategies despite being otherwise well-informed about prevailing inflation rates and asset returns. Consequently, whereas exogenous shifts in inflation expectations do not impact return expectations, information on past returns during periods of high inflation leads to negative updating about the perceived stock-return impact of inflation, which feeds into return expectations and subsequent actual trading behavior.
summary: 本研究结合定制调查实验与交易数据，在高通胀历史时期探讨投资者如何应对通胀。结果发现，投资者关于股票回报与通胀关系的信念在横截面上高度异质，且平均而言过于乐观。此外，许多投资者尽管对当前通胀率和资产回报有充分了解，却似乎对通胀对冲策略缺乏认识。因此，虽然通胀预期的外生变化不影响回报预期，但提供高通胀时期历史回报的信息会导致投资者对通胀感知的股票回报影响进行负面更新，进而传导至回报预期及随后的实际交易行为。
ai_comment: 本文通过结合实验和实际交易数据，揭示了投资者通胀信念的异质性与行为偏差，对理解高通胀环境下的资产定价具有重要启示。

title: Taking sides on return predictability
abstract: We assess how nine different categories of market participants trade relative to a comprehensive forecasted-return variable based on 193 predictors. Firms and short sellers tend to be the smart money—both sell stocks with low-forecasted returns, and their trades predict returns in the intended direction. Retail investors trade against forecasted returns. Retail investors’ and institutions’ trades predict returns opposite to the intended direction. This poor trading performance is driven by trades in stocks with either high- or low-forecasted returns. The forecasted-return variable predicts returns more strongly in stocks with more intense retail trading, consistent with retail investors exacerbating mispricing.
summary: 本文评估了九类市场参与者如何根据一个由193个预测因子构成的综合预测回报变量进行交易。研究发现，公司和卖空者倾向于成为“聪明钱”——他们卖出预测回报较低的股票，且其交易方向与预测回报一致，能够正确预测未来回报。相反，散户投资者逆预测回报方向交易，而散户和机构投资者的交易行为预测的回报方向与预期相反。这种糟糕的交易表现主要由那些预测回报极高或极低的股票交易驱动。此外，预测回报变量在散户交易更活跃的股票中预测能力更强，这与散户投资者加剧错误定价的观点一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模预测因子整合和参与者分类，系统性地揭示了不同市场参与者的交易智慧差异，为错误定价的行为金融解释提供了新的证据。

title: Resilience in collective bargaining
abstract: A central finding of the theoretical literature on bargaining is that parties’ attitudes towards delay influence bargaining outcomes. However, the ability to endure delays, resilience, is often private information and hard to measure in most real-world contexts. In the context of collective bargaining, we show firms actively attempt to become financially resilient in anticipation of labor negotiations. Firms adjust their financial resilience to respond to the passage of right-to-work laws (RWLs). Unions’ financial structure also responds to RWLs. Our findings suggest resilience is key to understanding the process through which collective bargaining determines wages.
summary: 论文研究集体谈判中各方承受延迟的能力（韧性）对谈判结果的影响。由于韧性通常是私人信息且难以直接观测，作者利用美国各州工作权法（RWLs）的通过作为外生冲击，分析企业和工会财务结构的调整。发现企业在预期劳动谈判时会主动增强财务韧性（如增加现金持有或降低杠杆），并对RWLs的通过做出显著调整；工会的财务结构同样对RWLs产生响应。结果表明韧性是理解集体谈判如何决定工资的关键机制。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验为谈判中的韧性提供实证证据，揭示企业和工会双向策略调整，丰富了集体谈判与公司金融的交叉研究。

title: Entrepreneurship and the gig economy: Evidence from U.S. tax returns
abstract: Platform intermediation of goods and services has considerably transformed the U.S. economy. We use administrative data on U.S. tax returns to study the role of the gig economy on entrepreneurship. We find that gig workers are more likely to become entrepreneurs, particularly those who are lower income, younger, and benefit from flexibility.
