summary: 这篇论文探讨了有社会使命的AI公司应如何定价和部署AI。作者推导了不同于利润最大化的定价公式，该公式融入了改善社会福利和减少劳动市场冲击的激励。利用美国数据，论文评估了几种情境：福利主义公司（同时重视利润和社会福利）应定价接近边际成本，因为效率提升超过了分配顾虑；而专注于劳动市场稳定的保守型公司短期内应定价高于利润最大化水平，特别是当其AI可能替代低收入工人时。总体而言，具有社会意识的公司在扩大AI可及性与由此导致的利润损失和劳动市场风险之间面临权衡。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将社会福利目标融入AI定价模型，为有社会使命的科技公司提供了非传统的定价策略参考，并基于美国数据提供了具体情境分析。

title: The Prestakes of Stock Market Investing
abstract: How rational is the stock market and how efficiently does it process information?We use machine learning to establish a practical measure of rational and efficient expectation formation while identifying distortions and inefficiencies in the subjective beliefs of market participants.The algorithm independently learns, stays attentive to fundamentals, credit risk, and sentiment, and makes abrupt course-corrections at critical junctures.By contrast, the subjective beliefs of investors, professionals, and equity analysts do little of this and instead contain predictable mistakes-prestakes-that are especially prevalent in times of market turbulence.Trading schemes that bet against prestakes deliver defensive strategies with large CAPM and Fama-French 5-factor alphas.
summary: 本文利用机器学习建立了一个实用指标来衡量股票市场的理性预期和效率，同时识别市场参与者主观信念中的扭曲与低效。该算法能够自主学习，持续关注基本面、信用风险和情绪，并在关键时刻进行突然的方向修正。相比之下，投资者、专业人士和股票分析师的主观信念很少表现出这种特性，而是包含可预测的错误（prestakes），这些错误在市场动荡时期尤为普遍。做空这些prestakes的交易策略能够产生防御性的投资组合，并带来显著的CAPM和Fama-French五因子alpha。
ai_comment: 本文通过机器学习方法揭示了市场参与者系统性预测错误的存在，并展示了利用这些错误构建盈利策略的可能性，为行为金融和资产定价提供了新的实证视角。

title: Managing Financial Crises
abstract: In this paper, we revisit the question of how to manage financial crises using the framework proposed by Bianchi and Mendoza (2018).We show that this model economy exhibits a multiplicity of constrained-efficient equilibria, which arises because the private shadow value of collateral influences the forward-looking asset price.Among these equilibria, the specific one studied in Bianchi and Mendoza (2018) can be implemented using a tax/subsidy on debt alone.In that case, both the ex ante tax and ex post subsidy are quantitatively important for welfare under the optimal time-consistent policy.Limiting either component can lead to a welfare loss relative to the unregulated competitive equilibrium, highlighting the complementarity between crisis prevention and crisis resolution tools.We also show that, under certain conditions, all Pareto-dominant constrained-efficient equilibria entail the unconstrained allocation chosen by a social planner subject to the country budget constraint, and this allocation can be implemented with purely ex post policies.
summary: 本文利用Bianchi and Mendoza (2018)的框架重新探讨金融危机管理问题。研究发现，该模型经济中存在多种约束有效均衡，这是由于抵押品的私人影子价值影响前瞻性资产价格所致。在这些均衡中，Bianchi and Mendoza (2018)所研究的具体均衡可以通过单一债务税收/补贴来实现。在最优时间一致性政策下，事前税收和事后补贴对福利均具有重要影响。限制其中任何一个部分都可能导致相对于无管制竞争性均衡的福利损失，从而凸显了危机预防与危机解决工具的互补性。此外，文章还表明，在特定条件下，所有帕累托占优的约束有效均衡都对应于由面临国家预算约束的社会规划者选择的无约束配置，并且这一配置可以通过纯粹的事后政策实现。
ai_comment: 该论文从均衡多重性的角度重新审视金融危机管理，强调了事前与事后政策的互补性，为危机干预提供了新的理论视角。

title: Interpreting Turbulent Episodes in International Finance
abstract: We study the anatomy of the international portfolio finance network.As global financial linkages have become denser over time, cross-border portfolio equity positions have grown in importance relative to debt for Emerging markets and Advanced economies.Using the framework developed by Stavrakeva and Rey (2024), we construct a novel proxy of daily foreign investor holdings in both equity and long-term sovereign debt markets across 32 currency areas.Leveraging an instrumental variable strategy, we identify an effect of foreign equity ETF inflows on exchange rates and local stock market prices.Our high-frequency proxy enables us to interpret episodes of turbulence in international finance.It should prove useful to assess how persistent the current shocks to the international financial system are likely to be.
summary: 本文研究国际组合金融网络的结构。随着全球金融联系日益紧密，跨境股权投资在新兴市场和发达经济体中的重要性相对于债务有所上升。基于Stavrakeva和Rey（2024）的框架，作者构建了一个新颖的日度外国投资者在32个货币地区的股票和长期主权债券市场持仓代理变量。通过工具变量策略，识别出外国股权ETF流入对汇率和本地股票市场价格的影响。该高频代理变量有助于解读国际金融动荡时期，并可用于评估当前国际金融体系冲击的持续性。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建新颖的高频代理变量，揭示了外国股权ETF流入对汇率和股价的因果效应，为理解国际金融动荡提供了有力工具。

title: Monetary Policy and Housing Overvaluation
GDP Growth Expectations and Cash-flow Risk Premium
abstract: We show that procyclical stocks-those whose cash flows rise with expected economic growth-earn higher average returns than countercyclical stocks.Leveraging nearly 75 years of economist survey data on real GDP growth expectations, we identify economic states while sidestepping modeldriven forecast error.GDP forecasts comove with consumption and predict the market return, real GDP growth, and consumption growth.This approach builds on the literatures on both the Intertemporal and Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Models.We document a statistically significant, economically meaningful procyclicality premium that remains robust to standard factor controls.
summary: 本文利用近75年经济学家对实际GDP增长预期的调查数据，识别经济状态，避免模型驱动的预测误差。研究发现，顺周期股票（其现金流随预期经济增长上升）的平均回报高于逆周期股票。GDP预测与消费共同变动，并能预测市场回报、实际GDP增长和消费增长。基于跨期资本资产定价模型（ICAPM）和消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）的文献，本文记录了统计显著且经济意义显著的顺周期溢价，该溢价在控制标准因子后依然稳健。
ai_comment: 本文利用长期调查数据而非模型预测来识别经济状态，为顺周期溢价提供了稳健证据，是对资产定价文献的重要补充。

title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
abstract: From 1900 to 1940, ordinary working-and middle-class families saved for retirement and contingencies via ordinary life insurance policies.These policies combined insurance and savings in a single financial instrument that paid its face value to insured individuals who survived until maturity and to beneficiaries if the insured died before the maturity date.The popularity of these policies peaked before WWII when a substantial share of all households and most of the middle class invested in them.This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day.Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment.They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks.The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation.Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.
summary: 该论文研究了1900年至1940年间普通工薪和中产家庭通过ordinary life insurance（普通寿险）进行退休和应急储蓄的现象。这类保单将保险与储蓄结合，在投保人存活至到期时支付面值，若提前身故则支付给受益人，在二战前非常流行，大部分家庭尤其是中产阶级都投资于此。论文解释了其流行原因：ordinary life policies适应了20世纪初的经济环境，具有良好回报、低风险、税收优惠，且与银行存款、建筑贷款股份、邮政储蓄存款、房地产或股票等竞争性投资回报的相关性低。这些保单保护家庭免受老年贫困、主要收入者过早死亡、残疾及通缩等风险。理解历史上的家庭储蓄方式对社会科学的多类文献具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 本文通过历史实证揭示了普通寿险在20世纪初的独特优势，对理解家庭金融行为演变及现代社会保障制度设计具有参考价值。

title: On the Optimality of Deferred Public Annuities
abstract: What is the optimal path of Social Security benefits for an individual who has retired with a stock of wealth, faces stochastic mortality, and has no access to annuities and no preferences for bequests?It is a deferred annuity in which the government annuity pays out zero for some periods and a constant amount after that.The optimal length of the deferral period is increasing in the retiree's initial wealth and in their survival probability.
summary: 本文研究一个退休且拥有财富积累的个人，在面临随机死亡率、无法购买年金且无遗产偏好的情况下，其社会保障福利的最优路径。结果表明最优方案是一种延期年金，即政府年金在最初若干期内支付为零，随后支付固定金额。延期期限的长度随退休者的初始财富和生存概率的增加而增加。
ai_comment: 本文从理论角度推导了无年金市场时退休个体的最优社会保障福利路径，揭示了延迟支付在提高保险效率中的作用，对公共年金设计有重要参考价值。

title: Disentangling Age, Time, and Cohort Effects in Income Inequality: A Proxy Machine Learning Approach
Tolls on Entrepreneurs from Capital Market Distortions: Evidence from IPO Locational Choices
Making AI Count: The Next Measurement Frontier
abstract: Generative AI is transforming production, consumption, and work, yet current statistical frameworks would likely struggle to capture its economic full economic impact.While the 2025 System of National Accounts introduces AI as a distinct asset, challenges remain in valuing AIrelated investments, inputs, and outputs.Moreover, as a general-purpose technology, AI alters business processes, service quality, and labor organization in ways poorly reflected in official data.This paper outlines key measurement gaps from transformative AI, including the tracking crossborder inputs, quality change, and process changes.We argue that economic statistics should adopt more granular, task-based, and outcome-focused approaches to ensure relevance in an increasingly AI-driven economy.
summary: 本文指出，生成式AI正在改变生产、消费和工作方式，但当前的统计框架难以完全捕捉其经济影响。尽管2025年国民账户体系将AI视为独立资产，但在估值AI相关投资、投入和产出方面仍存在挑战。作为一种通用技术，AI改变了业务流程、服务质量和劳动组织，但这些变化在官方数据中反映不足。本文概述了变革性AI带来的关键测量缺口，包括追踪跨境投入、质量变化和过程变化，并主张经济统计应采用更细致、任务导向和结果导向的方法，以确保在日益由AI驱动的经济中的相关性。
ai_comment: 本文前瞻性地指出了统计体系在AI时代面临的系统性挑战，并提出了任务导向和结果导向的改进方向，对政策制定和数据基础设施建设有重要启示。

title: Financial Value of Nature: Coastal Housing Markets, Mangroves, and Climate Resilience
abstract: Measuring the financial value of nature is difficult, often resulting in insufficient funding directed to nature conservation and restoration.As coastal risks increase from development and climate change, a tangible benefit of nature is the protection it offers against storm damages.Many studies from the risk industry and others assess the direct effects of wetlands for reducing damage during storms.However, the value of wetlands for coastal protection could extend to many other benefits, including home prices in areas where storms are common.We use property-level housing transaction data from Zillow and show that proximity to mangroves in Florida moderates home price decline and dispersion following major hurricanes.The effects are substantial in magnitude, reducing the probability of losing a quarter or more of housing value by 2-7 percentage points, which corresponds to 20-40-thousand-dollar value for a million-dollar property, conditional on a hurricane.
summary: 该研究利用 Zillow 的房产交易数据，考察了佛罗里达州红树林对沿海住房市场在飓风后的影响。研究发现，靠近红树林的房产在经历重大飓风后，房价下跌幅度和房价波动性显著降低，具体表现为房价损失超过四分之一的可能性降低2-7个百分点，对应百万美元房产价值减少2-4万美元。这表明红树林作为自然资本，在气候韧性中具有显著的金融价值。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实证数据量化了自然资本对房地产市场的保护价值，为将生态系统服务纳入金融决策提供了有力证据。

title: FCI-plot: Central Bank Communication Through Financial Conditions
abstract: We develop a model of central bank communication where market participants' uncertainty about desired financial conditions creates misunderstandings ("tantrums") and amplifies the impact of financial noise on asset prices and economic activity.We show that directly communicating the expected financial conditions path (FCI-plot) eliminates tantrums and recruits arbitrageurs to insulate conditions from noise, while communicating expected interest rates alone fails to achieve these benefits.We demonstrate that scenario-based FCI-plot communication enhances recruitment when participants disagree with the central bank regarding scenario probabilities.This enables an "agree-to-disagree" equilibrium where markets help implement central bank objectives despite differing views.
summary: 本文构建了一个中央银行沟通模型，其中市场参与者对未来金融状况的不确定性会导致误解（'tantrums'）并放大金融噪声对资产价格和经济活动的影响。研究表明，直接沟通预期的金融状况路径（FCI-plot）可以消除误解，并吸引套利者将金融状况与噪声隔离，而仅沟通预期利率则无法实现这些好处。进一步证明，当市场参与者与中央银行对情景概率存在分歧时，基于情景的FCI-plot沟通能增强对套利者的吸引，从而实现一种'同意分歧'均衡，在这种均衡下，尽管观点不同，市场仍能帮助实施中央银行的货币政策目标。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地提出FCI-plot沟通方式，有效解决了因不确定性导致的误解问题，并展示了在意见分歧下如何利用市场力量实现政策目标，对央行沟通策略具有重要启示。

title: The Impact of AI and Digital Platforms on the Information Ecosystem
abstract: We develop a tractable model to study how AI and digital platforms impact the information ecosystem.News producers -who create truthful or untruthful content that becomes a public good or bad -earn revenue from consumer visits.Consumers search for information and differ in their ability to distinguish truthful from untruthful information.AI and digital platforms influence the ecosystem by: improving the efficiency of processing and transmission of information, endangering the producer business model, changing the relative cost of producing misinformation and altering the ability of consumers to screen quality.We find that in the absence of adequate regulation (accountability, content moderation, and intellectual property protection) the quality of the information ecosystem may decline, both because the equilibrium quantity of truthful information declines and the share of misinformation increases; and polarization may intensify.While some of these problems are already evident with digital platforms, AI may have different, and overall more adverse, impacts.
summary: 本文构建了一个可处理模型，研究AI和数字平台如何影响信息生态系统。新闻生产者创造真实或虚假内容（成为公共品或公共坏品），并通过消费者访问获得收入。消费者搜索信息，且在辨别真实与虚假信息的能力上存在差异。AI和数字平台通过以下方式影响生态系统：提高信息处理和传输效率、危及生产者商业模式、改变制造虚假信息的相对成本、以及改变消费者筛选质量的能力。研究发现，在缺乏适当监管（问责制、内容审核和知识产权保护）的情况下，信息生态系统质量可能下降，表现为均衡状态下真实信息数量减少、虚假信息份额增加，同时极化可能加剧。尽管部分问题已在数字平台上显现，但AI可能产生不同且整体更不利的影响。
ai_comment: 该研究从理论模型出发，系统分析了AI和数字平台对信息生态的潜在负面影响，强调了监管的重要性，为理解AI时代的信息质量下降和极化问题提供了新视角。

title: Genius on Demand: The Value of Transformative Artificial Intelligence
What Can Satellite Imagery and Machine Learning Measure?
Artificial Intelligence in Research and Development
abstract: How much can AI accelerate progress in different research fields?This paper shows that three features-the share of research tasks AI performs, the productivity of AI at those tasks, and the strength of bottlenecks-are key determinants of AI's implications in any area, from cancer therapeutics to software design.The model maps changes in AI capabilities to research outcomes, quantifies the "marginal returns to intelligence," and shows how AI can shift returns to R&D investment.Concepts like superintelligence, Powerful AI, and Transformative AI are further engaged and disciplined.Finally, the framework sets a measurement agenda linking AI benchmarks to field-specific opportunities for accelerating progress.
summary: 这篇论文探讨了人工智能（AI）如何加速不同研究领域的进步。作者指出，三个关键特征——AI在研究任务中的执行份额、AI在这些任务上的生产率以及瓶颈的强度——决定了AI在从癌症治疗到软件设计等任何领域的影响。模型将AI能力的变化映射到研究成果，量化了“智能的边际回报”，并展示了AI如何改变研发（R&D）投资的回报。论文还进一步探讨和约束了超级智能、强大AI和变革性AI等概念。最后，框架设定了一个测量议程，将AI基准与特定领域加速进步的机会联系起来。
ai_comment: 该文提出了一个统一框架来量化AI对研发的影响，强调了任务份额、生产率和瓶颈三个关键因素，为未来测量AI的进步提供了方向。

title: LLM Survey Framework: Coverage, Reasoning, Dynamics, Identification
abstract: We propose a new LLM-based survey framework that enables retrospective coverage, economic reasoning, dynamic effects, and clean identification.We recover human-comparable treatment effects in a multi-wave randomized controlled trial of inflation expectations surveys, at 1/1000 the cost.To demonstrate the framework's full potential, we extend the benchmark human survey (10 waves, 2018-2023) to over 50 waves dating back to 1990.We further examine the economic mechanisms underlying agents' expectation formation, identifying the mean-reversion and individual-attention channels.Finally, we trace dynamic treatment effects and demonstrate clean identification.Together, these innovations demonstrate that LLM surveys enable research designs unattainable with human surveys.
summary: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的调查框架，能够实现回顾性覆盖、经济推理、动态效应和干净识别。通过多轮随机对照试验（RCT）对通胀预期进行调查研究，以仅千分之一的成本获得了与人类调查可比的处理效应。为了展示该框架的潜力，论文将原始基准人类调查（2018-2023年共10轮）扩展至1990年以来的50多轮。进一步，论文探究了预期形成的经济机制，识别出均值回归渠道和个人注意渠道。最后，论文追踪了动态处理效应并展示了干净识别。这些创新表明，LLM调查能够实现人类调查无法达到的研究设计。
ai_comment: 该论文的创新在于利用LLM大幅降低调查成本并扩展时间跨度，同时保持因果识别的可信度，为宏观金融中的预期研究提供了新工具。

title: Private Equity, Consumers, and Competition: Evidence from the Nursing Home Industry
Takeover Threats and Mandatory Disclosure Avoidance: Evidence from Contract Redactions
abstract: Mandatory disclosure is a primary source of public information available to acquirers, yet little is known about how potential target managers respond to takeover threats by avoiding mandatory disclosure. This study focuses on redactions in material contracts as a setting of mandatory disclosure avoidance. We find that managers facing takeover threats are more likely to redact material contracts than other managers. To better differentiate the motives for redactions, we classify redacted contracts into nine different categories and examine managers’ redaction decisions on the three most prominently redacted types. We find managers facing takeover threats redact research and development contracts more heavily when firms possess trade secrecy, as a strategy to thwart technological acquisitions aiming at innovation combinations. By contrast, managers redact purchase and sales contracts and license and royalty contracts more heavily when they have greater private control benefits. Overall, our results highlight new tactics that managers use when they face takeover threats, especially under threats of technological acquisitions. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: L. (N.) Su acknowledges the financial support from the Faculty of Business, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05948 .
summary: 本研究探讨了目标公司经理如何通过避免强制披露来应对收购威胁，聚焦于材料合同中的删减行为。基于合同删减数据，研究发现面临收购威胁的经理更可能删减材料合同。为区分删减动机，将删减合同分为九类，重点分析三种主要类型：研发合同、采购销售合同和许可版税合同。结果显示，当公司拥有商业秘密时，经理更倾向于删减研发合同，以阻挠旨在创新组合的技术收购；而当经理拥有更多私人控制收益时，他们更倾向于删减采购销售合同和许可版税合同。研究揭示了经理面临收购威胁时的新策略，尤其是在技术收购威胁下。
ai_comment: 本文通过合同删减这一独特视角揭示了经理应对收购威胁的策略，并区分了技术收购与非技术收购的不同动机，对强制披露文献有重要贡献。

title: Who Is AI Replacing? The Impact of Generative AI on Online Freelancing Platforms
abstract: This paper studies the impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) technologies on the demand for online freelancers using a large data set from a leading global freelancing platform. We identify the types of jobs that are more affected by generative AI and quantify the magnitude of the heterogeneous impact. Our findings indicate a 21% decrease in the number of job posts for automation-prone jobs related to writing and coding compared with jobs requiring manual-intensive skills within eight months after the introduction of ChatGPT. We show that the reduction in the number of job posts increases competition among freelancers, whereas the remaining automation-prone jobs are of greater complexity and offer higher pay. We also find that the introduction of image-generating AI technologies led to a 17% decrease in the number of job posts related to image creation. We use Google Trends to show that the more pronounced decline in the demand for freelancers within automation-prone jobs correlates with their higher public awareness of ChatGPT’s substitutability. This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05420 .
summary: 本文利用来自领先全球自由职业平台的大型数据集，研究了生成式人工智能（AI）技术对在线自由职业者需求的影响。研究识别了更容易受生成式AI影响的职位类型，并量化了异质性影响的程度。结果发现，在ChatGPT推出后的八个月内，与写作和编码相关的自动化倾向性职位的招聘帖子数量减少了21%，而需要手工技能的职位则受影响较小。招聘帖子数量的减少加剧了自由职业者之间的竞争，但剩余的自动化倾向性职位复杂度更高、薪酬也更高。研究还发现，图像生成AI技术的引入导致图像创作相关职位的招聘帖子数量减少了17%。通过Google Trends数据，研究表明自动化倾向性职位需求下降幅度更大的原因在于公众对ChatGPT可替代性的认知程度更高。
ai_comment: 该论文利用平台宏观数据实证量化了生成AI对就业市场的即时冲击，揭示了替代效应与任务复杂度的权衡，为理解AI对劳动力市场的影响提供了宝贵证据。

title: Auditing with a Chance of Whistleblowing
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of promoting whistleblowing on audit quality and the efficiency of detecting misstatements. On the one hand, whistleblowing alerts the enforcer to the possibility of a misstatement and intensifies the regulatory effort, thereby incentivizing the auditor to improve audit quality. On the other hand, promoting whistleblowing reduces the enforcer’s investigative effort when there is no whistleblowing allegation, which in turn dampens the auditor’s incentive to enhance audit quality. We demonstrate that, under certain conditions, encouraging more whistleblowing can impair audit quality and reduce detection efficiency. We also examine the socially optimal whistleblowing program, and our analysis implies that the optimal whistleblowing intensity is increasing in investment cost and the quality of the whistleblower’s information. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: C. Tang acknowledges financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grant Council [Project 16503921]. M. Ye thanks the Canadian Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council for funding support [Grant 435-2022-0093]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04808 .
summary: 本文研究了促进举报对审计质量和错报检测效率的影响。一方面，举报会提醒监管者注意潜在的错报并加强监管力度，从而激励审计师提高审计质量；另一方面，在没有举报指控时，促进举报会减少监管者的调查努力，进而削弱审计师改善审计质量的动机。论文证明，在特定条件下，鼓励更多举报反而可能损害审计质量并降低检测效率。此外，本文还考察了社会最优的举报计划，分析表明最优举报强度随着投资成本和举报人信息质量的提高而增加。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了举报机制可能带来负面效应的权衡，对监管设计具有重要启示。

title: Market Ambiguity Attitude Restores the Risk-Return Trade-Off
abstract: A positive relation between the conditional mean and conditional volatility of aggregate stock returns, although viewed as a fundamental law of finance, has been challenging to find empirically. We consider a representative agent asset pricing model with Knightian uncertainty and demonstrate that this risk-return trade-off depends on the agent’s ambiguity attitude (reflecting the agent’s degree of optimism or pessimism). The model predicts that the conditional equity premium is increasing in market volatility, but its slope flattens as market optimism rises. We develop a methodology to extract the representative agent’s ambiguity attitude from our asset pricing model. Results validate our model predictions. We document the significant in-sample and out-of-sample explanatory power of ambiguity attitude in explaining the risk-return trade-off. In our sample, market volatility is not significant in forecasting returns. However, including the market ambiguity attitude leads to a significant positive relationship between volatility and future returns. Hence, our model and results identify market ambiguity attitude as a missing state variable that can explain why the literature has found it difficult to empirically validate the risk-return trade-off. This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03595 .
summary: 本文研究市场模糊态度如何恢复股票收益的条件均值与条件波动率之间的正相关关系（即风险-收益权衡）。作者构建了一个包含奈特不确定性的代表性主体资产定价模型，证明这种权衡取决于主体的模糊态度（反映其乐观或悲观程度）。模型预测条件股权溢价随市场波动率增加而上升，但斜率随市场乐观情绪上升而变平。本文开发了一种方法从资产定价模型中提取代表性主体的模糊态度，结果验证了模型预测。研究发现，模糊态度在解释风险-收益权衡方面具有显著的样本内和样本外解释能力。在样本中，市场波动率本身对预测收益不显著，但加入市场模糊态度后，波动率与未来收益之间呈现显著的正相关关系。因此，模型和结果将市场模糊态度识别为一个缺失的状态变量，可以解释为什么文献难以经验验证风险-收益权衡。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入模糊态度这一状态变量，成功解决了风险-收益权衡实证难题，为行为金融与资产定价交叉领域提供了新视角。

title: Exchanges for Government Bonds? Evidence During COVID-19
abstract: We leverage the unique institutional feature that the Israeli government bond market operates on an exchange rather than over-the-counter to analyze whether and why having an exchange affects market liquidity during a crisis. We document how the liquidity crisis in March 2020 affected the Israeli government bond market and conduct difference-in-differences analyses, comparing bid-ask spreads in exchange markets, such as the Israeli government bond market, with markets lacking an exchange. Our findings support the idea that having an exchange enhances market liquidity. A counterfactual analysis using trade data from the Israeli exchange suggests that this is due to the ability of investors to readily provide liquidity to one another and the efficient netting of trade flows on an exchange. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02344 .
summary: 本文利用以色列政府债券市场在交易所交易而非场外交易的独特制度特征，分析危机期间交易所是否以及为何影响市场流动性。通过记录2020年3月流动性危机对以色列政府债券市场的影响，并采用双重差分法比较以色列政府债券市场（交易所市场）与其他非交易所市场的买卖价差，发现交易所的存在增强了市场流动性。基于以色列交易所交易数据的反事实分析表明，这一增强效应源于投资者能够方便地相互提供流动性以及交易所对交易流的有效净额结算。
ai_comment: 利用独特的制度设计和反事实分析，为交易所提升危机期间流动性的机制提供了有力证据，对市场微观结构研究具有重要贡献。

title: Short of Capital: Stock Market Implications of Short Sellers’ Losses
abstract: We provide evidence that losses constrain short sellers but not the transmission of information to prices. Using unique data on U.S. equity lending, we document a negative impact of the mark-to-market losses of a stock’s short sellers, but no impact of their gains, on the future shorting of the stock. Consistent with funding and institutional constraints limiting short selling, we further show that the effect is highly asymmetric across different loss levels and stronger among stocks facing higher margin requirements. However, loss-making short selling has no impact on price efficiency or predictive power for returns, suggesting that these constraints affect mostly uninformed shorting activity. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the University of Melbourne [Faculty Research Grant]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01356 .
summary: 本文利用美国股票借贷的独特数据，研究卖空者损失对卖空活动及价格信息传递的影响。发现股票卖空者的按市值计价损失会减少未来的卖空，而收益则无此效应，且该效应在不同损失水平上高度不对称，在面临更高保证金要求的股票中更强，表明资金和制度约束限制了卖空。然而，亏损的卖空对价格效率或回报预测能力无影响，说明这些约束主要影响非知情卖空活动。
ai_comment: 利用独特借贷数据揭示了卖空者损失对卖空行为的非对称约束，但发现损失的卖空不影响价格效率，为卖空约束的知情性提供了新证据。

title: Machine Data: Market and Analytics
abstract: Machine data (MD), that is, data generated by machines, are increasingly gaining importance, potentially surpassing the value of the extensively discussed personal data. We present a theoretical analysis of the MD market, addressing challenges such as data fragmentation, ambiguous property rights, and the public-good nature of MD. We consider machine users producing data and data aggregators providing MD analytics services (e.g., with digital twins for real-time simulation and optimization). By analyzing machine learning algorithms, we identify critical properties for the value of MD analytics, Scale, Scope, and Synergy. We leverage these properties to explore market scenarios, including anonymous and secret contracting, competition among MD producers, and multiple competing aggregators. We identify significant inefficiencies and market failures, highlighting the need for nuanced policy interventions. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00674 .
summary: 本文对机器数据市场进行了理论分析，探讨了数据碎片化、产权模糊以及机器数据的公共品属性等挑战。研究考虑机器用户（数据生产者）和数据聚合商（提供数据分析服务，如利用数字孪生进行实时仿真和优化）两类主体。通过分析机器学习算法，本文识别出机器数据分析价值的关键性质：规模性、范围性和协同性。基于这些性质，本文研究了匿名与秘密合同、机器生产者之间的竞争、多个竞争性聚合商等市场情景，发现了显著的低效率和市场失灵，强调了需要精细化的政策干预。
ai_comment: 本文从理论层面系统剖析了机器数据市场的独特性，提出了Scale、Scope、Synergy三个核心性质，并揭示了市场失灵机制，为数据经济政策提供了重要启示。

title: Speed Matters: Limited Attention and Supply Chain Information Diffusion
abstract: We develop a measure of the speed of firm-level information diffusion, study how it is affected by limited attention, and examine its effect on real corporate decisions. Using local flu epidemics as exogenous attention shocks, we show that inattention from dual-covering analysts and cross-holding institutions reduces the speed of information diffusion from customer to supplier stock prices. We find that the speed of information diffusion along the supply chain affects the price feedback effect for corporate investment decisions and facilitates coordination between customers and suppliers. Our findings demonstrate that coattention from key market participants affects information efficiency and generates real economic outcomes. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: L. Cen acknowledges financial support from the Chinese University of Hong Kong and General Research Fund [Grant 14504920] from the Hong Kong Research Grants Council. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00291 .
summary: 本文开发了一个公司层面信息扩散速度的度量指标，研究有限注意力如何影响该速度及其对企业实际决策的影响。利用当地流感疫情作为外生注意力冲击，发现双重覆盖分析师和交叉持股机构的注意力不足会降低信息从客户股票价格向供应商股票价格扩散的速度。此外，供应链上的信息扩散速度通过价格反馈效应影响公司投资决策，并促进客户与供应商之间的协调。研究结果表明，关键市场参与者的共同注意力影响信息效率并产生实际经济后果。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用流感疫情作为外生注意力冲击，揭示了有限注意力对供应链信息传导的阻碍作用及其对真实投资决策的影响。

title: The Effects of MiFID II on Voluntary Disclosure
abstract: We examine the effect of the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID) II’s controversial unbundling provision on corporate voluntary disclosure. Although prior research has largely focused on changes in sell-side research post-MiFID II, changes in voluntary disclosure and their effects on the information environment are less known. We find that European Union (EU) firms significantly increased the propensity and frequency of management earnings guidance issuance after MiFID II enactment. This effect is more pronounced among firms experiencing a decline in the quantity of sell-side research or a reduction in the consumption and dissemination of analyst reports and is more muted among firms witnessing improvements in research quality. Furthermore, we find that post-MiFID earnings guidance by EU firms becomes more thorough and elicits stronger market reactions. Moreover, we demonstrate that the increased guidance effectively alleviates the negative liquidity effects of MiFID II. Collectively, we contribute to the ongoing debate on the efficacy of MiFID II’s unbundling provision by providing evidence that voluntary disclosure plays a key role in mitigating the unintended net negative consequences on the information environment following the regulation. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: Financial support from the New York University Stern School of Business, Seoul National University, the Baruch College Zicklin School of Business, and George Washington University is gratefully acknowledged. C. Kim also received financial support from the Institute of Management Research of Seoul National University. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00286 .
summary: 本文研究了《金融工具市场指令》（MiFID II）中具有争议的“解绑”（unbundling）条款对企业自愿披露的影响。尽管以往研究主要关注MiFID II后卖方研究的变化，但自愿披露的变化及其对信息环境的影响尚不明确。研究发现，MiFID II实施后，欧盟（EU）公司显著增加了管理层盈利预测（management earnings guidance）的发布倾向和频率。这一效应在卖方研究数量下降或分析师报告消费与传播减少的公司中更为显著，而在研究质量改善的公司中则相对较弱。此外，MiFID II后的盈利预测变得更加详尽，并引发了更强的市场反应。进一步分析表明，增加的预测有效缓解了MiFID II对流动性的负面冲击。综上所述，本文通过证明自愿披露在缓解监管对信息环境造成的意外净负面影响中发挥关键作用，为MiFID II解绑条款有效性的持续争论提供了证据。
ai_comment: 本文从自愿披露角度切入，揭示了监管冲击下企业行为调整的补偿机制，为理解MiFID II的意外后果提供了新视角。

title: Do Institutional Investors Stabilize Equity Markets in Crisis Periods? Evidence from COVID-19
abstract: During the COVID-19 stock market crash, U.S. stocks with higher institutional ownership (IO) performed worse than those with lower IO. By studying firm-level changes, we identify two mechanisms behind this effect: a sudden downscaling of institutional capital in the equity market and a collective attempt by institutions to reposition their equity portfolios toward more COVID-resilient stocks. The stock price effects of their “portfolio downscaling” trades quickly reversed in the market’s recovery phase, whereas those of their “portfolio repositioning” trades lingered. The institutional rush for firm resilience also caused price pressures, with retail investors providing liquidity to stocks sold by institutional investors, both during the crisis and afterward. Overall, our results indicate that when a tail risk is realized, institutional investors amplify price crashes. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: S. Glossner and P. Matos acknowledge financial support from the Richard A. Mayo Center for Asset Management at the Darden School of Business. S. Ramelli and A. F. Wagner acknowledge financial support from the University of Zurich Research Priority Program “Financial Market Regulation.” Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03411 .
summary: 本研究针对COVID-19股市崩盘期间，考察机构投资者是否稳定市场。发现美国股市中机构持股比例高的股票表现更差。通过公司层面变化分析，识别出两个机制：一是机构资本在股票市场的突然降规模，二是机构集体尝试将其股票投资组合重新调整为更具COVID-19抗性的股票。机构'投资组合降规模'交易的价格效应在市场复苏阶段迅速反转，而'投资组合重新定位'交易的影响则持续存在。机构对抗性股票的追逐也造成了价格压力，零售投资者在危机期间及之后为机构投资者出售的股票提供流动性。总体结果表明，当尾部风险实现时，机构投资者会加剧价格崩溃。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分两种不同的交易机制，深入揭示了机构投资者在极端事件中放大市场波动的行为，对理解危机中的市场微观结构具有重要贡献。

title: Evaluating Mortgage Renegotiation Strategies: A Data-Driven Framework for Investors
abstract: This paper offers a novel framework to quantify the expected gains from renegotiating delinquent loans. The framework accounts for important trade-offs between concessions to borrowers, postdelinquency loan performance, and expected collateral values. The framework’s parameters are calibrated using data on renegotiated 30-year residential fixed-rate mortgages that went delinquent during the Great Recession. Our model-implied expected gains increase during the 2007–2009 period coinciding with an increase in the rate of loan renegotiation. Counterfactual analyses show that larger expected gains can be generated from employing principal forbearance and extensions of the term to maturity compared with principal write-downs and interest-rate reductions. On the other hand, principal write-downs can be a powerful tool when borrowers are deeply underwater. Our analyses illustrate how lenders or policymakers might deploy this framework when faced with another delinquency crisis. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: The author thanks the Fisher Center for Real Estate and Urban Economics at the University of California, Berkeley and the Center for Investors and Financial Markets at the University of Virginia for funding for this paper. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02672 .
summary: 本文提出一个新颖的框架，用于量化逾期贷款再谈判的预期收益。该框架考虑了向借款人让步、逾期后贷款表现和预期抵押品价值之间的重要权衡，并使用大衰退期间逾期再谈判的30年期固定利率抵押贷款数据校准参数。模型得出的预期收益在2007-2009年期间增加，这与贷款再谈判率上升一致。反事实分析表明，与本金减记和利率降低相比，本金宽限和期限延长可以产生更大的预期收益；然而，当借款人深度负资产时，本金减记是有效的工具。该分析说明了贷款机构或政策制定者在面临另一场逾期危机时如何运用这一框架。
ai_comment: 提出了一个实用的量化框架，为贷款机构和政策制定者提供了应对逾期贷款危机的决策工具，并通过反事实分析揭示了不同再谈判策略的优劣。

title: Revealed Wisdom of the Crowd: Bids Predict Loan Quality
abstract: Despite the popularity of the phrase “wisdom of the crowd,” not all crowds are wise because not everyone in them acts in an informed, rational manner. Identifying informative actions, therefore, can help to isolate the truly wise part of a crowd. Motivated by this idea, we evaluate the informational value of investors’ bids using data from online, debt-based crowdfunding, in which we were able to track both investment decisions and ultimate repayment statuses for individual loans. We propose several easily scalable variables derived from the heterogeneity of investors’ bids in terms of size and timing. We first show that loans funded with larger bids relative to the typical bid amount in the market or to the bidder’s historical baseline, particularly early in the bidding period, are less likely to default. More importantly, we perform theory-driven feature engineering and find that these variables improve the predictive performance of state-of-the-art models that have been proposed in this context. Even during the fundraising process, these variables improve predictions of both funding likelihood and loan quality. We discuss the implications of these variables, including loan pricing in secondary markets, crowd wisdom in different market mechanisms, and financial inclusion. Crowdfunding platforms can easily implement these variables to improve market efficiency without compromising investor privacy. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, information systems. Funding: We gratefully acknowledge the financial support of the Business Analytics Center in the Scheller College of Business and the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02575 .
summary: 该论文研究了在线债务型众筹市场中投资者投标的 informational value，旨在从“群体智慧”中识别出真正信息丰富的部分。作者利用平台数据，跟踪每笔贷款的投资决策和最终还款状态，基于投标大小和时间的异质性构建了多个易扩展的变量。研究发现，相对于市场典型投标金额或投标人历史基线，更大规模的投标（尤其是早期投标）所资助的贷款违约率更低。更重要的是，通过理论驱动的特征工程，这些变量提升了现有最优预测模型对贷款违约的预测性能，且在筹款过程中就能改善对融资成功率和贷款质量的预测。论文讨论了这些变量在二级市场贷款定价、不同市场机制下的群体智慧以及金融包容性方面的启示，并指出众筹平台可以轻松实施这些变量以提高市场效率，同时不损害投资者隐私。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从投资者投标行为的异质性中提取了简单易用的预测变量，显著提升了贷款违约预测的准确性，且方法具备实际可操作性，对众筹平台和投资者均有重要价值。

title: Consumption Commitments and Housing Dynamics
abstract: Using a measure of local long-run growth prospects, I uncover a novel link between economic fundamentals and house prices. Whereas excess housing returns are positively associated with economic growth prospects, housing valuations are negatively associated with shocks to growth prospects. I document an explanation in metro-area consumption: housing consumption is asymmetrically exposed to economic prospects in that it expands more quickly when prospects are strong than it contracts when prospects are poor. I explain these findings through the lens of an asset pricing model that focuses on a trade-off between nonseparable committed housing and nonhousing consumption. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: Data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01996 .
summary: 本文利用本地长期增长前景的度量，揭示了经济基本面与房价之间的新联系。研究发现，超额住房回报与经济增长前景正相关，而住房估值与增长前景的冲击负相关。基于都市区消费数据的分析表明，住房消费对经济前景的暴露是不对称的：当经济前景强劲时，住房消费扩张速度快于前景疲软时的收缩速度。作者通过一个资产定价模型解释这些发现，该模型聚焦于不可分割的承诺性住房消费与非住房消费之间的权衡。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将消费承诺概念引入住房市场，为房价与经济基本面的关系提供了新的微观机制，模型简洁而富有洞察力。

title: Trading Volume Manipulation and Competition Among Centralized Crypto Exchanges
abstract: How competition affects manipulation by firms of information about important attributes of their products and how such information manipulation impacts firms’ short-term and long-term performance are open empirical questions. We use a setting that is especially suitable for answering these questions—centralized crypto exchanges, on which information manipulation takes the form of inflated trading volume. We find that static and dynamic competition measures are positively associated with volume inflation, indicating that competition may lead to increased information manipulation. Exchanges that manipulate volume obtain short-run benefits but are punished in the long run, consistent with the trade-off between short-lived increases in rents and future losses because of damaged reputation. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: The authors thank the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 2225/21], the Coller School of Management Blockchain Research Institute, the Henry Crown Institute for Business Research in Israel, and the Cornell Fintech Initiative for financial support. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02903 .
summary: 本文研究竞争如何影响中心化加密货币交易所对交易量信息的操纵（即虚增交易量），以及这种信息操纵对交易所短期和长期绩效的影响。利用静态和动态竞争指标，发现竞争与交易量膨胀呈正相关，表明竞争可能导致信息操纵加剧。操纵交易量的交易所短期内获得收益，但长期因声誉受损而受到惩罚，体现了短期租金增加与未来损失之间的权衡。
keywords: 中心化加密货币交易所
ai_comment: 利用加密货币交易所这一独特场景，首次实证检验了竞争对信息操纵的影响以及操纵的短期收益与长期代价，为理解市场微观结构中的信息失真提供了新证据。

title: Managing Channel Profits with Positive Demand Externalities
abstract: Demand externalities arise when past sales stimulate future demand. They pervade many consumer markets. To penetrate such markets, how should manufacturers contract with retailers? We formulate the problem as a dynamic game, wherein the retailer can privately observe and control evolving market conditions, and consumers can act either myopically or strategically. Our contribution is threefold. (i) We characterize the optimal contract: It resolves a dynamic tradeoff between exploiting demand externalities, screening new information, and optimizing channel efficiency; moreover, it has a simple implementation of quantity discount. (ii) We characterize the dual role of demand externalities. Although demand externalities can improve channel surplus by expanding market size, they can also exacerbate information friction by enhancing the retailer’s ability to manipulate the market. Ignoring the dark side of the agency cost, previous studies may have overestimated the benefit of demand externalities. (iii) We provide new practical guidance. We show private information per se need not hurt channel efficiency: The manufacturer can use recursive advance selling to extract new information for free. Our results also shed light on when and why manufacturers should moderate demand externalities and prefer long-term contracts. By highlighting the dual role of demand externalities in long-run channel performance, this study sharpens our understanding of channel theory and practice. This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing. Funding: L. Gao was partly supported by Academic Senate COR Grants of UCR. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00008 .
summary: 该论文研究当存在正需求外部性（即过去销售刺激未来需求）时，制造商应如何与零售商签订合同以管理渠道利润。作者将问题建模为动态博弈，其中零售商可以私下观察并控制不断变化的市场条件，消费者可能表现为短视或策略性。主要贡献有三：（1）刻画了最优合同，该合同解决了利用需求外部性、筛选新信息和优化渠道效率之间的动态权衡，并具有简单的数量折扣实现形式；（2）揭示了需求外部性的双重作用：一方面通过扩大市场规模提高渠道剩余，另一方面通过增强零售商操纵市场的能力加剧信息摩擦，以往研究忽略了代理成本的阴暗面，可能高估了需求外部性的收益；（3）提供了新的实践指导，表明私人信息本身不一定损害渠道效率——制造商可以利用递归提前销售免费提取新信息，并说明了制造商何时以及为何应调节需求外部性并偏好长期合同。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地揭示了需求外部性的双重作用，尤其强调了其加剧信息摩擦的阴暗面，为渠道合同设计提供了新视角。递归提前销售的机制设计为实践提供了简洁有效的解决方案。

title: Stressed Banks? Evidence from the Largest-Ever Supervisory Review
abstract: We study short-term and medium-term changes in bank risk-taking as a result of supervision and the associated real effects. For identification, we exploit the European Central Bank’s asset-quality-review (AQR) in conjunction with security and credit registers. After the AQR announcement, reviewed banks reduce riskier securities and credit supply, with the greatest effect on riskiest securities. We find negative spillovers on asset prices and firm-level credit availability. Moreover, nonbanks with higher exposure to reviewed banks acquire the shed risk. After the AQR compliance, reviewed banks reload riskier securities but not riskier credit, resulting in negative medium-term firm-level real effects. These effects are especially strong for firms with high ex ante credit risk. Among these nonsafe firms, even those with high ex ante productivity, experience negative real effects. Our findings suggest that banks’ liquid assets help them to mask risk from supervisors and risk adjustments banks make in response to supervision have persistent corporate real effects. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: J.-L. Peydró acknowledges financial support from the BBVA Foundation [2018 Leonardo Grant for Researchers and Cultural Creators], the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme [Grant Agreement 648398], the MCIU/AEI/FEDER, UE [Grant PGC2018-102133-B-I00], and the Spanish Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness, through the Severo Ochoa Programme for Centres of Excellence in R&D [Grant SEV-2015-0563]. The analysis, conclusions, and opinions set forth in the paper are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily represent the views of the Bundesbank, Eurosystem, Federal Reserve Board, or the United States. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01714 .
summary: 本文利用欧洲央行资产质量审查（AQR）作为外生冲击，结合证券和信贷登记数据，研究监管对银行风险承担行为的短期和中期变化及其实际经济影响。结果显示，AQR公告后，受审查银行减少风险较高的证券持有和信贷供给，对最风险证券影响最大；同时产生负向溢出效应，导致资产价格下跌和非受审查企业信贷可得性下降，非银行机构接手了被剥离的风险。在AQR合规后，银行重新增持风险证券但未增加风险信贷，造成中期企业层面的负实际效应，尤其对事前信用风险高的企业，即使这些企业事前生产率高，也遭受负面影响。结论表明，银行的流动资产帮助其向监管者隐藏风险，且监管引发的风险调整具有持续的企业实际影响。
ai_comment: 本文利用大型监管审查的准自然实验，揭示了银行风险调整的短期和中期动态，并通过信贷和资产价格渠道向实体经济的传导，为监管有效性提供了重要见解。

title: Diversity Tokenism
abstract: Using data from over 4,000 Black Lives Matter (BLM) protests across 600 U.S. counties from 2014 to 2021, we examine how BLM activism shapes corporate diversity at different organizational levels. We develop an approach integrating OpenAI's GPT‐4 with Chain‐of‐Thought prompting to classify race and ethnicity. In our validation tests, this method achieves higher accuracy than several tested open‐source algorithms. Our main findings are as follows. First, although firms headquartered in protest‐affected counties add more Black directors, particularly in larger protests, this gain appears to largely offset the representation of other non‐Black minority directors. Second, these board‐level shifts do not consistently extend to executives or the general workforce. In contrast, a gap may emerge between a firm's workforce composition and local labor‐market demographics, particularly in the representation of Black employees. This pattern is consistent with diversity tokenism, which suggests firms may prioritize high‐visibility board appointments and potentially downplay broader, transformative change. Our findings indicate that although board‐level diversity gains are highly visible and attract notable public attention, they may not be accompanied by an organization's transformative commitment to company‐wide diversity.
summary: 基于2014年至2021年美国600个县的4000多场Black Lives Matter抗议活动数据，研究BLM行动如何影响企业不同组织层面的多样性。开发了一种整合OpenAI的GPT-4与Chain-of-Thought提示的方法对种族进行分类，验证测试表明该方法比多个开源算法更准确。主要发现：总部位于抗议影响县的公司在董事会中增加了黑人董事，尤其在抗议规模较大时，但这一增长似乎很大程度上取代了其他非黑人的少数族裔董事；董事会层面的变化并未一致延伸至高管层或普通员工；相反，企业劳动力构成与当地劳动力市场人口结构之间可能出现差距，尤其体现在黑人员工的代表性上。这种模式符合多样性象征主义，即企业可能优先考虑高可见度的董事会任命，而淡化更广泛、变革性的承诺。结果表明，董事会层面的多样性虽引人注目，但未必伴随组织范围对多样性的真正变革性承诺。
ai_comment: 利用LLM进行种族分类的方法创新性强，揭示了企业多样性表面化现象，对理解社会运动与企业行为的关系有重要贡献。

title: Dissecting Corporate Culture Using Generative AI
abstract: We conduct the first large-scale study of how different stakeholder groups assess corporate culture and quantify the economic implications of those differences. We employ generative AI to analyze analyst reports, call transcripts, and employee reviews, and organize the extracted information into a knowledge graph that links a culture type to its perceived causes and effects. We demonstrate that the divergence in different stakeholder groups' assessment of culture aligns with their distinct roles and economic incentives. Moreover, we show that analysts' culture analyses are incorporated into stock recommendations and target prices, and investors react to divergence in stakeholders' assessment of culture.
summary: 本研究首次大规模探讨不同利益相关者群体如何评估企业文化，并量化这些评估差异的经济影响。作者使用生成式AI分析分析师报告、电话会议记录和员工评论，将提取的信息组织成知识图谱，将文化类型与其感知的原因和结果联系起来。结果表明，不同利益相关者对企业文化评估的分歧与其各自的角色和经济激励相一致。此外，分析师的文化分析被纳入股票推荐和目标价格中，投资者对利益相关者文化评估的分歧做出反应。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用生成式AI构建知识图谱，系统揭示了不同利益相关者对企业文化评估的分歧及其市场反应，为理解公司文化的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Stealthy shorts: Informed liquidity supply
abstract: Short sellers are widely known to be informed, which would typically suggest that they demand liquidity. We obtain comprehensive transaction-level data to decompose daily short volume into liquidity-demanding and liquidity-supplying components. Contrary to conventional wisdom, we show that the most informed short sellers are actually liquidity suppliers, not liquidity demanders. They are particularly informative about future returns on news days and trade on prominent cross-sectional return anomalies. Our analysis suggests that market making and opportunistic risk-bearing are unlikely to explain these findings. Instead, our results align with recent market microstructure theory, pointing to strategic liquidity provision by informed traders.
summary: 本文利用全面的交易级别数据，将每日卖空交易量分解为流动性需求型和流动性供给型两个部分。与普遍认知相反，研究发现最知情的卖空者实际上是流动性提供者，而非流动性需求者。他们在新闻日对未来收益具有特别强的预测能力，并交易于显著的横截面回报异常。分析表明，做市商行为和机会主义风险承担不太可能解释这些结果，而是与近年来的市场微观结构理论一致，即知情交易者会策略性地提供流动性。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据分解挑战了传统直觉，揭示了知情卖空者的流动性提供角色，为市场微观结构理论提供了重要实证支持。

title: Why does options market information predict stock returns?
abstract: Several influential studies show that transformations of implied volatilities calculated from options prices predict stock returns. This predictability is puzzling because market participants readily observe options prices. We find that this predictability is consistent with implied volatilities reflecting stock borrow fees that are known to predict stock returns. We derive a formula relating the option-implied volatility spread to the borrow fee. Motivated by this relation, we show that the return predictability from implied volatility spread and skew decreases by at least two-thirds if high-fee stocks are excluded. The patterns for other predictors computed from option implied volatilities are similar.
summary: 基于几项有影响力的研究显示，从期权价格计算的隐含波动率的转换可以预测股票收益，但这种可预测性令人困惑，因为市场参与者可以轻易观察到期权价格。本文发现，这种可预测性与已知能预测股票收益的股票借券费用一致。我们推导出一个公式，将期权隐含波动率价差与借券费用联系起来。基于此关系，我们表明如果排除高借券费用的股票，隐含波动率价差和偏斜的收益预测性至少降低三分之二。其他从期权隐含波动率计算的预测指标也呈现类似模式。
ai_comment: 本文通过借券费用这一新机制解释了期权市场信息预测股票收益的现象，为理解市场微观结构提供了新的视角。

title: Responsible investing: Costs and benefits for university endowment funds
abstract: We examine the adoption rates of responsible investment (RI) policies among university endowments. Adoption rates are higher among universities that face stakeholder pressure and are donation-dependent. Policy adoption predicts greater abnormal donations totaling 12 % of endowment assets, especially from “socially conscious” donors and during periods of higher media attention to climate change. Universities also experience greater student applications following adoptions. RI endowments have greater management costs, greater return volatility, and similar overall asset growth (donations plus net-of-cost investment income) compared to non-RI endowments. We conclude that RI policies are an important part of the optimal contract between universities and their stakeholders.
summary: 本文研究了大学捐赠基金采纳负责任投资（RI）政策的动因与后果。基于美国大学捐赠基金数据，发现面临更大利益相关者压力（如校友捐赠依赖、学生关注）的大学更可能采纳RI政策。政策采纳后，这些大学获得了显著的额外捐赠收入（平均占捐赠资产的12%），尤其来自“有社会意识”的捐赠者，并且在媒体关注气候变化的时期更为突出。此外，采纳RI政策的大学还吸引了更多学生申请。然而，RI捐赠基金的管理成本更高，回报波动更大，但其总资产增长（捐赠收入加净投资收入）与非RI捐赠基金无显著差异。结论认为，RI政策是大学与利益相关者之间最优契约的重要组成部分，在平衡成本与收益中发挥作用。
ai_comment: 本文为机构投资者的社会责任投资行为提供了独特见解，巧妙利用大学捐赠基金场景分离了财务与非财务动机，并量化了利益相关者压力的经济后果。

title: The financial consequences of undiagnosed memory disorders
abstract: We examine the effect of undiagnosed memory disorders on credit outcomes using individually-matched nationally representative credit reporting and Medicare data. We find effects of early stage disease, years before diagnosis, on a wide range of financial outcomes, including credit card account payment delinquency and amount of delinquent balance, credit utilization among credit card account holders, mortgage delinquency and delinquent balance amount, and credit scores. Effects are pervasive, affecting seniors in single and coupled households, racial/ethnic minorities and non-minorities, and older adults living in areas with higher and lower education levels. Early stage effects are greater among singles and Black individuals.
summary: 利用个体匹配的全国代表性信贷报告和Medicare数据，研究未诊断的记忆障碍对信贷结果的影响。发现在记忆障碍诊断前的早期阶段，已对信用卡还款违约、违约余额、信用卡使用率、抵押贷款违约、违约余额和信用评分等广泛金融结果产生显著影响。这些影响普遍存在于单身和夫妻家庭、少数族裔与非少数族裔、不同教育水平地区的老年人中，且早期影响在单身和黑人群体中更为显著。
ai_comment: 利用独特的数据集揭示早期未诊断疾病对金融健康的显著影响，为金融与健康交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: When do short sellers trade? Evidence from intraday data and implications for informed trading models
abstract: Using 2015–2019 intraday short sale data from CBOE, we show that shorting flows near the open, middle, and close all negatively predict future returns, but the shorting flows near the open and middle have stronger predictive power than shorting flows near the close. We relate our findings to three informed trading models with different predictions on the timing of the trades. The long term predictive power of shorting flows near the open and midday is consistent with Kyle’s (1985) model of steady trading; the intraday variation in shorting flows’ predictive power is more consistent with Holden and Subrahmanyam’s (1992) aggressive trading model, in the sense that predictive power of shorting flows is stronger when there is greater urgency to trade at open and when the securities lending market is more competitive; and the liquidity timing hypothesis from Collin-Dufresne and Fos (2016) is also supported by the finding that opening shorting flows increase for firms with better liquidity conditions.
summary: 基于2015-2019年CBOE的日内卖空数据，研究发现开盘、盘中及收盘附近的卖空流量均能负向预测未来收益，但开盘和盘中的预测能力显著强于收盘。该结果与三种知情交易模型进行对比：开盘和午间卖空流量的长期预测能力支持Kyle（1985）的稳定交易模型；卖空流量预测能力的日内变化更符合Holden和Subrahmanyam（1992）的激进交易模型，表现为开盘时交易紧迫性更高且证券借贷市场竞争更激烈时预测能力更强；而Collin-Dufresne和Fos（2016）的流动性时机假说也得到了支持，因为开盘卖空流量在流动性条件更好的公司中增加。
ai_comment: 利用高频日内数据检验经典理论，提供了卖空者交易时机的精细实证证据，并综合对比了多个模型。

title: Polarization, purpose and profit
abstract: We present a model in which firms compete for workers who value nonpecuniary job attributes, such as purpose, sustainability, political stances, or working conditions. Firms adopt production technologies that enable them to offer jobs with varying levels of these desirable attributes. Firms’ profits are higher when they cater to workers with extreme preferences. In a competitive assignment equilibrium, firms become polarized and not only reflect but also amplify the polarized preferences of the general population. More polarized sectors exhibit higher profits, lower average wages, and a reduced labor share of value added. Sustainable investing amplifies firm polarization.
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，其中企业为员工而竞争，员工重视非金钱工作属性（如目标感、可持续性、政治立场或工作条件）。企业采用生产技术，提供不同水平的这些理想属性。当企业迎合具有极端偏好的员工时，利润更高。在竞争性分配均衡中，企业变得极化，不仅反映而且放大总体人口的极化偏好。更极化的行业呈现更高的利润、更低的平均工资和更低的劳动收入份额。可持续投资加剧了企业的极化。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了企业极化的内生机制，并指出可持续投资会进一步放大这一现象，对理解劳动市场与企业战略交互具有重要启示。

title: Stakes and investor behaviors
abstract: We examine how stakes affect investor behaviors. In our unique setting, investors trade stocks in real accounts using their own money and simultaneously in a simulated setting. Our real-world within-investor estimation shows that investors exhibit stronger biases and perform worse in higher-stakes real accounts than in lower-stakes simulated accounts. Investors exhibit strong biases in both types of accounts, and the biases in both are strongly positively correlated. Such behavioral consistency suggests that low-stakes experiments are informative about real-world behaviors. Using additional account-level datasets, we demonstrate external validity by documenting a stronger (reverse) disposition effect on stocks (funds) with greater portfolio weights.
summary: 本文研究赌注（stakes）如何影响投资者行为。在一个独特的数据环境中，投资者同时在真实账户（使用自有资金）和模拟账户中进行股票交易。基于真实世界投资者内估计（within-investor estimation），我们发现投资者在高赌注的真实账户中表现出更强的行为偏差，并且业绩更差，而在低赌注的模拟账户中偏差较弱。然而，两类账户中的偏差呈强正相关，表明低赌注实验中的行为对真实世界行为具有参考价值。通过额外的账户级数据集，我们验证了外部有效性：对于投资组合权重更大的股票（基金），投资者表现出更强的（反向）处置效应。
ai_comment: 利用罕见的真实与模拟交易配对数据，直接比较同一投资者的行为差异，为行为金融学中赌注效应的研究提供了强有力的证据，并验证了实验结果的可靠性。

title: The retail habitat
abstract: Retail investors trade hard-to-value stocks. We document a large and persistent spread in the stock-level intensity of retail trading, even allowing for known biases in the attribution of retail trades. Stocks with a high share of retail-initiated trades exhibit higher shares of intangible capital, longer duration cash flows, and a higher likelihood of being mispriced. Consistent with retail-favored stocks being harder to value, we document that these stocks are less sensitive to earnings news and more sensitive to retail order imbalances. Such segmentation of trading intensity arises in a model where informed investors face a trade-off between the benefits of hiding their trades within noisy retail investor order flow and the costs of producing information about the fundamentals of hard-to-value stocks.
summary: 这篇论文研究散户投资者交易行为与股票特征之间的关系。作者发现，无论是否考虑散户交易归因中的已知偏差，散户交易强度在股票层面存在显著且持续的差异。具体而言，散户交易比例高的股票具有更高的无形资本占比、更长的现金流持续期以及更高的被错误定价可能性。进一步分析显示，这些散户偏好的股票对盈利新闻的敏感度较低，而对散户订单失衡的敏感度较高，印证了它们更难估值的特性。最后，论文构建了一个理论模型，其中知情投资者面临在利用散户订单流隐藏交易与为难以估值的股票生产信息成本之间的权衡，从而解释了这种交易强度的分化现象。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证和理论模型揭示了散户交易对难估值股票的系统性偏好，为理解知情交易者策略与市场微观结构提供了新视角。

title: Firm uncertainty and households: Spending, savings, and risks
abstract: Using daily banking and credit card data for thousands of households linked to U.S. publicly listed employers, we find novel evidence that firm-specific uncertainty persistently reduces future spending and spurs precautionary savings. A one-standard-deviation rise in option-implied firm volatility—akin to the S&P 500 VIX—predicts a $106 monthly spending drop (8 hours of wages) and a $193 increase in bank balances, reflecting notable cutbacks in typical non-durable goods and services. The mechanism operates through heightened household risks: firm uncertainty expands both income and consumption risk over the next year, with the largest effects among lower and top earners (notably the top 1%). Employers only partly shield earnings, while households only partly self-insulate consumption risk via smoothing channels. Detrimental uncertainty effects on households are stronger than firm stock price declines.
summary: 本文利用连接至美国上市公司雇主的数千个家庭的每日银行和信用卡数据，首次发现公司特定不确定性会持续减少家庭未来支出并促使预防性储蓄增加。一个标准差的公司期权隐含波动率上升（类似于标普500 VIX指数）预测家庭每月支出减少106美元（相当于8小时工资），银行存款增加193美元，主要体现在非耐用品和服务的显著削减。其作用机制通过增加家庭风险实现：公司不确定性在未来一年内同时扩大了家庭收入和消费风险，且对低收入和高收入者（尤其是前1%）的影响最大。雇主仅能部分缓冲收入冲击，而家庭仅能通过平滑消费渠道部分自我隔离消费风险。公司不确定性对家庭的不利影响强于公司股价下跌的影响。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的高频微观数据，揭示了企业层面不确定性向家庭传导的具体机制，并对比了不同收入群体的异质性效应，为理解不确定性冲击的家庭经济后果提供了新证据。

title: Household debt overhang and human capital investment
abstract: Unlike labor income, human capital is inseparable from individuals and does not completely accrue to creditors. Therefore, human capital investment is more resilient to “debt overhang” than labor supply. We develop a dynamic model displaying this difference. We find that while both labor supply and human capital investment are hump-shaped in household indebtedness, human capital investment declines less aggressively as indebtedness builds up. Importantly, because human capital is only valuable when households expect to supply labor, the greater reduction in labor supply due to debt overhang back-propagates into ex-ante human capital investment. We provide empirical support for the model.
summary: 不同于劳动收入，人力资本与个人不可分离且不完全归属于债权人，因此人力资本投资比劳动供给对'债务积压'更具韧性。本文构建了一个动态模型来展示这一差异。研究发现，劳动供给和人力资本投资都随家庭债务呈驼峰形，但随着债务积累，人力资本投资下降的幅度较小。重要的是，由于人力资本只有在家庭预期提供劳动力时才有价值，债务积压导致的劳动供给减少会反向传导至事前的人力资本投资。最后，提供了实证支持。
ai_comment: 本文从理论模型和实证两个角度揭示了债务积压对人力资本投资的非同质化影响，强调了人力资本投资与劳动供给之间的内在反馈机制，为理解家庭债务的长期经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Overvaluing simple bets: Evidence from the options market
abstract: We document a new anomaly that we prove standard preference models are unable to capture, regardless of functional form or parametric specification used. Analyzing trading behavior in the binary option market for retail investors, we find that market participants purchase binary options although strictly dominant bull spreads are available at lower prices: 15% of S&P index, 19% of gold, and 25% of silver trades violate no-dominance conditions consistently across three different asset classes. Buyers of dominated binaries lose on average 34% of the contract price by forgoing the dominating product. We prove that neither prospect theory nor ambiguity aversion nor other popular theoretical justifications for retail anomalies such as rational inattention and salience, can capture these results. We also test for, and reject, standard financial explanations including trading costs, liquidity, exchange fixed effects, and noise trading. We show that our results are consistent with retail investors valuing simple, easy-to-understand binary bets. Our work provides a theoretically-grounded empirical impetus for research in behavioral finance which goes beyond historically pervasive utility frameworks.
summary: 本文记录了期权市场中的一种新异常：零售投资者在二元期权市场中，尽管存在更便宜的严格占优的牛市价差，却仍然购买二元期权。通过分析标普500指数、黄金和白银的二元期权交易数据，发现15%的标普指数、19%的黄金和25%的白银交易违反了非占优条件。购买这些被占优二元期权的投资者平均损失合约价格的34%。作者证明，标准偏好模型（无论函数形式或参数设定如何）以及前景理论、模糊厌恶、理性注意和显著性等零售异常的理论解释均无法捕捉这一结果。同时，交易成本、流动性、交易所固定效应和噪音交易等标准金融解释也被排除。研究结果表明，零售投资者偏好简单、易于理解的二元赌注。本文为行为金融学超越传统效用框架提供了理论驱动的实证动力。
ai_comment: 本文通过二元期权市场的独特证据，揭示了现有理论无法解释的异常，为行为金融学提供了新的实证基础和理论挑战。

title: Social preferences and corporate investment
abstract: This paper presents a framework to study how investors’ social concerns affect technology choices. Consequentialist preferences (disutility from aggregate harm) influence outcomes only if investors coordinate, unless internalized harm is independent of an investor’s mass. Non-consequentialist preferences (disutility from stockholdings) affect outcomes regardless of coordination. Both preferences have stronger impact when risk-sharing consequences of technology supply are small (e.g., highly correlated returns), and their effects cannot be inferred from cost-of-capital differences. When harm is stochastic, polluting firms may appear less risky to social investors. Depending on type and strength of social preferences, this can support or hinder the green transition.
summary: 本文提出了一个分析框架，研究投资者的社会关切如何影响企业的技术选择。框架区分了两种社会偏好：结果主义偏好（投资者从总危害中获得负效用）和非结果主义偏好（投资者从持股中获得负效用）。研究发现，结果主义偏好只有在投资者协调行动时才影响结果，除非内部化的危害与投资者规模无关；而非结果主义偏好无论协调与否都会影响结果。两种偏好的影响在技术供应的风险分担后果较小（如高度相关的回报）时更强，且其影响不能从资本成本差异中推断。当危害具有随机性时，污染企业对社会投资者可能显得风险较低，这取决于社会偏好的类型和强度，可能支持或阻碍绿色转型。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地将社会偏好分为结果主义和非结果主义两种类型，并揭示了它们影响企业技术选择的不同机制，为理解绿色转型中投资者的作用提供了新视角。

title: Machine learning from a “Universe” of signals: The role of feature engineering
abstract: We construct real-time machine learning strategies based on a “universe” of fundamental signals. The out-of-sample performance of these strategies is economically meaningful and statistically significant, but considerably weaker than those documented by prior studies that use curated sets of signals as predictors. Strategies based on a simple recursive ranking of each signal’s past performance also yield substantially better out-of-sample performance. We find qualitatively similar results when examining past-return-based signals. Our results underscore the key role of feature engineering and, more broadly, inductive biases in enhancing the economic benefits of machine learning investment strategies.
summary: 本文构建了基于大量基本信号的实时机器学习策略。这些策略的样本外表现具有经济意义和统计显著性，但显著弱于先前使用精选信号集作为预测因子的研究。使用简单递归排名每个信号过去表现的策略也能产生明显更好的样本外表现。在考察基于过去收益的信号时也发现了定性类似的结果。研究结果强调了特征工程以及更广泛的归纳偏见在增强机器学习投资策略经济收益中的关键作用。
ai_comment: 本文指出，基于大量原始信号而非精选信号的机器学习策略表现较差，强调了特征工程在实践中的重要性，对量化投资研究具有启示意义。

title: Loan guarantees, bank lending and credit risk reallocation
abstract: Do banks extending government-guaranteed loans simultaneously reduce their risk exposure to firms? Using unique euro-area credit register data and the COVID-19 guarantee programs as a laboratory, we find that 1 euro of guaranteed lending was associated with a reduction of 28 cents in non-guaranteed credit, relative to other banks lending to the same firm. Substitution was highest for riskier and smaller firms in more affected sectors and for stronger banks. Nevertheless, banks offered cheaper credit and longer maturities to guaranteed loan recipients, especially more fragile ones. This improvement in lending terms is the flipside of credit substitution.
summary: 利用欧元区独特的信用登记数据，以COVID-19担保项目为实验室，研究银行在发放政府担保贷款时是否同时减少对企业的风险敞口。研究发现，相对于向同一企业放贷的其他银行，1欧元担保贷款与非担保信贷减少28分相关联。替代效应在风险较高、规模较小的企业以及受疫情影响较大的行业和实力较强的银行中最为显著。此外，银行向担保贷款接受者提供更便宜的信贷和更长的期限，尤其是对更脆弱的借款人，这种贷款条件的改善是信贷替代的另一面。
ai_comment: 本文利用高精度数据揭示政府担保贷款的双重效应：信贷替代与贷款条件改善，为理解危机期间政策干预的微观机制提供了重要证据。

title: Mergers and acquisitions, technological change, and inequality
abstract: Mergers and acquisitions (M&As) are an important mechanism through which technology is adopted by firms. Firms with greater technological skill acquire less tech-savvy firms and, subsequently, increase technology investment at the target. This has important implications for labor reallocation following M&As. We show that target establishments become less routine intensive post-M&A, especially when a target had greater routine occupational employment, compared to its acquirer, ex-ante. We also provide evidence consistent with targets investing in information technology which tends to displace more office routine occupations. Such labor reallocation impacts wages, resulting in higher pay inequality within target establishments.
summary: 该论文研究并购（M&As）作为企业采用技术的重要机制。技术能力更强的公司收购技术较弱的公司，并在收购后增加对目标公司的技术投资。这导致并购后的劳动力重新分配：目标公司的设施在并购后减少了常规性职业的密集度，尤其是当目标公司事前相对于收购方有更多常规性职业就业时。证据表明目标公司投资于信息技术，这往往会取代办公室常规性职业。这种劳动力重新分配影响工资，导致目标公司内部工资不平等加剧。
ai_comment: 本文从并购视角切入技术变革对劳动力市场的影响，实证揭示技术扩散如何通过并购引发职业结构变化和工资不平等，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Information-based pricing in specialized lending
abstract: We study how competition between asymmetrically informed banks, one specialized and one nonspecialized, affects loan prices. Both banks possess “general” signals regarding the borrower’s quality, which they use to screen loans. The specialized bank also has access to a “specialized” signal on which it bases its loan pricing. This private information-based pricing makes the specialized bank bid more aggressively, mitigating the informational rent effect that gives it monopolistic power. Our findings explain why loans from specialized lenders feature lower interest rates and better ex post performance. Supporting empirical evidence emphasizes the role of specialized information in shaping credit market outcomes.
summary: 论文研究不对称信息银行之间的竞争如何影响贷款价格，其中一家银行为专业化银行，另一家为非专业化银行。两家银行都拥有关于借款人质量的“通用”信号，用于筛选贷款。专业化银行还可以获取“专业化”信号，并以此为基础进行贷款定价。这种基于私有信息的定价使专业化银行出价更具侵略性，从而减轻了赋予其垄断权力的信息租金效应。研究结果解释了为什么来自专业贷款机构的贷款利率更低、事后表现更好。支持性实证证据强调了专业化信息在塑造信贷市场结果中的作用。
ai_comment: 本文理论贡献在于揭示了专业化银行基于私有信息的定价如何通过缓解信息租金效应降低贷款利率，并提供了实证支持。对于理解银行专业化与信贷市场效率的关系有重要启示。

title: The marginal value of public pension wealth: Evidence from border house prices
abstract: We study how state pension windfalls affect property prices near state borders, where theory suggests real estate reflects the value of additional public resources. Windfalls, representing a source of state revenue about half the size of total taxes, provide economically significant and plausibly exogenous variation in fiscal conditions. We find that each dollar of pension asset returns increases border house prices by approximately two dollars, suggesting that governments allocate additional funds towards high-value projects or tax abatement rather than wasting incremental resources. Evidence of larger effects in financially constrained municipalities highlights how fiscal resources amplify welfare effects of economic shocks.
summary: 本文利用美国州界附近的房价数据，研究州级养老金意外收益（pension windfalls）对房地产价值的影响。理论认为，边界地区的房价会资本化当地公共资源的边际价值。养老金意外收益作为州财政收入的重要来源（约占税收总额的一半），为财政状况提供了外生且显著的变动。研究发现，每1美元养老金资产回报使边界房价上升约2美元，表明政府将额外资金用于高价值公共项目或减税，而非浪费。此外，财政受限的市政当局中该效应更为显著，凸显了财政资源如何放大经济冲击的福利效应。
ai_comment: 利用行政边界识别财政外生冲击，为公共养老金的经济价值提供了新颖的因果证据，并揭示了财政约束对福利效应的放大作用。

title: Defunding controversial industries: Can targeted credit rationing choke firms?
abstract: This paper examines the effects of targeted credit rationing by banks on firms likely to generate negative externalities. We exploit an initiative of the U.S. Department of Justice, labeled Operation Choke Point, which compelled banks to limit relationships with firms in controversial industries. Using supervisory loan-level data, we show that, as intended, targeted banks reduced lending and terminated relationships with affected firms. However, most of these firms fully substituted credit through nontargeted banks under similar terms. Overall, we find no significant shifts in the performance and investment of affected firms, suggesting that targeted credit rationing is widely ineffective in promoting change.
summary: 本文研究银行针对可能产生负外部性的企业的定向信贷配给的效果。利用美国司法部发起的“Operation Choke Point”计划作为自然实验，该计划迫使银行限制与争议行业企业的关系。基于监管层面的贷款数据，研究发现，目标银行确实减少了向受影响企业的贷款并终止了关系，但大多数企业从非目标银行获得了完全替代的信贷，且贷款条件相似。总体来看，受影响企业的业绩和投资没有显著变化，表明定向信贷配给在推动变革方面基本无效。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的外生政策冲击，揭示了定向信贷政策可能因企业的信贷替代而失效，对监管有效性提出了重要警示。

title: Maximal extractable value and allocative inefficiencies in public blockchains
abstract: The blockchain settlement layer facilitates systematic frontrunning, resulting in inefficient block-space allocation. Private transaction pools can reduce these inefficiencies and enhance welfare. However, full adoption is limited by misaligned incentives between users and validators. Validators are reluctant to forgo rents they earn from frontrunning – referred to as maximal extractable value – leading to a partial adoption equilibrium in which frontrunning persists. Our empirical analysis of Ethereum’s Flashbots private pool supports these findings: validators earn higher revenues, users facing greater frontrunning risk are more likely to use the private pool, and attackers’ cost-to-revenue ratios in private pools converge to one.
summary: 该论文研究公共区块链中最大可提取价值（MEV）导致的区块空间分配低效问题。区块链结算层存在系统性前端交易（frontrunning），造成资源浪费。私人交易池可以减轻这些低效并提高福利，但全面采用受限于用户与验证者之间的激励错位：验证者不愿放弃从前端交易中获取的租金（即MEV），导致部分采用均衡，前端交易持续存在。对以太坊Flashbots私人池的实证分析支持这些发现：验证者通过私人池获得更高收入，面临较大前端交易风险的用户更可能使用私人池，且私人池中攻击者的成本-收益比率趋近于1。
ai_comment: 论文通过理论与实证结合，揭示了区块链套利中激励冲突对市场效率的影响，为理解MEV和私人交易池的作用提供了重要视角。

title: Climbing and falling off the ladder: Asset pricing implications of labor market event risk
abstract: Administrative earnings data reveal that households are exposed to large, countercyclical idiosyncratic tail risks in labor earnings. I illustrate how these risks affect asset prices within an asset pricing framework with recursive preferences, heterogeneous agents and incomplete markets. Quantitatively, a model in which agents face a time-varying probability of experiencing a rare, idiosyncratic disaster, with parameters disciplined by data, matches the level and dynamics of the equity premium. Stock returns are highly informative about labor market event risk, and, consistent with model predictions, initial claims for unemployment, a proxy for labor market uncertainty, is a highly robust predictor of returns.
summary: 本文利用行政收入数据发现家庭面临巨大的、逆周期的异质性劳动力收入尾部风险。作者在一个具有递归偏好、异质性代理人和不完全市场的资产定价框架中，展示了这些风险如何影响资产价格。定量上，一个模型让代理人面临随时间变化的罕见异质性灾难概率（参数由数据约束），能够匹配股权溢价的水平与动态。股票收益对劳动力市场事件风险具有高度信息含量，且与模型预测一致，作为劳动力市场不确定性代理的失业初请人数是收益的高度稳健预测因子。
ai_comment: 本文将劳动力市场事件风险与资产定价有机结合，通过罕见灾难模型成功解释了股权溢价之谜，并揭示了失业初请数据作为股票收益预测因子的稳健性，具有重要的理论与实证贡献。

title: Macroeconomic drivers and the pricing of uncertainty, inflation, and bonds
abstract: The correlation between uncertainty shocks, as measured by changes in the VIX, and changes in break-even inflation rates declined and turned negative after the Great Recession. This estimated time-varying correlation is shown to be consistent with the predictions of a standard New Keynesian model with a lower bound on interest rates and a trend decline in the natural rate of interest. In one equilibrium of the model, higher uncertainty raises the probability of large shocks that leave the central bank constrained by the lower bound and unable to offset negative shocks. Resulting inflation shortfalls lower average inflation rates.
summary: 本文研究不确定性冲击（以VIX变化衡量）与盈亏平衡通胀率变化之间的相关性，发现该相关性在大衰退后下降并转为负值。通过一个包含利率下限和自然利率趋势下降的标准新凯恩斯模型，本文证明了这种时变相关性与模型预测一致。在模型的一个均衡中，更高的不确定性增加了冲击导致央行受限于零利率下限而无法抵消负面冲击的概率，由此产生的通胀不足降低了平均通胀率。
ai_comment: 本文成功地将时变相关性与结构性模型联系起来，揭示了零利率下限在不确定性传导中的关键作用。

title: Measurement and effects of bank exit policies
abstract: We study whether exit policies by financial institutions have financial and real consequences on the firms they target, using bank coal exit policies as a laboratory. In contrast to theories assuming high capital substitutability, we find large effects of these policies. Bank exit policies negatively affect both the financing and operation of coal assets. Substitution to other sources and providers of capital appears to be limited. Coal power plants owned by firms exposed to exit policies are more likely to retire, translating into lower CO2 emissions. Exit policies have reduced CO2e emissions from energy production by an estimated 0.62 gigaton.
summary: 本文以银行煤炭退出政策作为研究场景，考察金融机构的退出政策是否对其目标企业产生金融和实际经济后果。与高资本替代性理论预期相反，研究发现银行退出政策对煤炭资产的融资和运营产生显著的负面冲击，且资本向其他来源和提供者的替代十分有限。受政策影响的企业拥有的燃煤电厂更有可能退役，从而降低二氧化碳排放量。据估计，这些退出政策已使能源生产中的二氧化碳当量排放减少约0.62吉吨。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证证据挑战了高资本替代性的理论假设，揭示了银行退出政策在影响企业融资和实际产出方面的有效性，并量化了其环境效益，对绿色金融政策评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Michael C. Jensen’s empirical work
abstract: Much of Mike Jensen's research is foundational, including his early publications, which focus on empirical asset pricing. For example, Jensen's alpha, which he developss in Jensen (1968 and 1969) to evaluate mutual fund managers, is the foundation for most measures of investment performance. Similarly, in Fama et al (1969), Jensen and coauthors present the first event study, Thereafter, event studies play a major role in finance, accounting, and legal research. Finally, Black, Jensen, and Scholes (1972) develop a key insight about the importance of interdependence of sampling errors in the precision of asset pricing tests.
summary: 本文回顾了Michael C. Jensen的实证研究贡献，包括他早期在实证资产定价方面的工作。Jensen（1968, 1969）提出的Jensen's alpha成为评估共同基金经理表现的基础，也是大多数投资业绩衡量指标的基石。在Fama et al.（1969）中，Jensen与合作者首次提出了事件研究法，该方法随后在金融、会计和法律研究中扮演了重要角色。此外，Black, Jensen和Scholes（1972）揭示了资产定价检验精度中抽样误差相互依赖的关键见解。
ai_comment: 本文系统梳理了Jensen对金融实证方法的奠基性贡献，特别是Jensen's alpha和事件研究法，这些工具至今仍是核心分析手段。

title: The lessons of Michael C. Jensen
abstract: This paper assesses the contributions of Michael C. Jensen to financial economics and to American business. His work on agency theory is the cornerstone of modern corporate finance. He influenced how American business operates by helping make the internal and external governance of firms more efficient. He changed how knowledge in financial economics is diffused both through the founding of the Journal of Financial Economics and of the Social Science Research Network. I question the claim made by some that he recanted his ideas in the 2000s.
summary: 本文评估了Michael C. Jensen对金融经济学和美国商业的贡献。他的代理理论研究是现代公司金融的基石，通过提高公司的内部和外部治理效率，影响了美国企业的运营方式。他通过创办《Journal of Financial Economics》和社会科学研究网络（SSRN）改变了金融经济学知识的传播方式。本文还质疑了关于他在2000年代放弃自己观点的说法。
ai_comment: 本文系统总结了Jensen的学术贡献，并对关于他晚年思想的争议给出了客观评价，对于理解现代公司金融的发展具有重要参考价值。

title: Agency cost of free cash flow, capital allocation, and payouts
abstract: Jensen’s (1986) analysis of the agency costs of free cash flow radically transformed our understanding of corporate payout policy. This paper details the main pre-Jensen advances in the payout literature, explains how his analysis profoundly altered the way financial economists view payout policy, and discusses prominent regularities that provide real-world texture for understanding the importance of his insights about payout policy. These regularities include: (i) the dominance (measured as a percent of value or earnings) of the public equity markets by firms in the distribution phase of the corporate lifecycle; (ii) changes since the 1980s in aggregate cash payouts, the profitability of payers, payout rates, and the set of firms that dominate the payout supply; and (iii) the recent politicization of share repurchases.
summary: 本文回顾了Jensen（1986）关于自由现金流代理成本的分析如何彻底改变了我们对公司派息政策的理解。文章详细阐述了Jensen之前派息文献的主要进展，解释了他的分析如何深刻改变了金融经济学家看待派息政策的方式，并讨论了几个重要的现实规律：一是公司生命周期中处于分配阶段的公司在公开股票市场中占据主导地位（以价值或盈利的百分比衡量）；二是自1980年代以来，总体现金派息、派息公司的盈利能力、派息率以及主导派息供应的公司群体发生了变化；三是近年来股票回购的政治化。
ai_comment: 本文系统梳理了Jensen自由现金流代理成本理论对派息政策研究的深远影响，并结合现实规律提供了实证背景，具有重要的文献综述价值。

title: Jensen and Meckling at 50
abstract: This article does three things: (1) it offers a slightly modernized treatment of the two well-known agency costs of external financing of Jensen and Meckling; (2) it provides a deeper exploration than they offer of the limited liability corporation, and of optimal control allocations when financial contracts are incomplete; and, (3) it assesses the lasting influence or their ideas, their multiple interpretations, as well as misinterpretations.
summary: 本文做了三件事：首先，对Jensen和Meckling提出的两种外部融资代理成本进行了稍微现代化的处理；其次，比他们更深入地探讨了有限责任公司的性质，以及在不完全金融合同下的最优控制权分配；第三，评估了他们思想的持久影响、多种解释以及误读。
ai_comment: 本文在经典理论基础上进行了扩展和反思，特别强调了不完全合同的作用，为理解公司金融中的代理问题提供了更深层的视角。

title: The invention of corporate governance
abstract: The analysis of corporate governance begins with a central feature of modern capitalism – the separation of ownership and control in large corporations – first empirically documented by Berle and Means (1932). Such separation entails several agency problems reflecting conflicts between managers and shareholders, such as self-dealing by managers, low effort, consumption of perquisites, and excessive growth and diversification. Berle and Means saw self-dealing as the central agency problem and stressed the law as the fundamental mechanism of addressing it. Jensen and Meckling (1976) considered the consumption of perquisites and emphasized private mechanisms, such as financial incentives for managers, to counter wasteful perks. Jensen (1986) instead focused on excessive growth and diversification, which led him to count on leverage and takeovers. The combination of public corporate governance mechanisms, mostly the law, and market governance shaped both theory and practice.
summary: 本文追溯了公司治理理论的起源与发展，首先基于Berle and Means (1932)对现代资本主义核心特征——大型公司中所有权与控制权分离的实证发现，指出这种分离导致了经理人与股东之间的多重代理问题，包括自我交易、低努力、特权消费以及过度增长与多元化。Berle and Means视自我交易为核心代理问题，并强调法律是解决该问题的基础机制。Jensen and Meckling (1976)则关注特权消费，强调私人机制如经理人财务激励的作用。Jensen (1986)聚焦过度增长与多元化，主张依靠杠杆和接管来控制。文章认为，公共公司治理机制（主要是法律）与市场治理的结合，共同塑造了公司治理的理论与实践。
ai_comment: 本文通过梳理公司治理理论的经典文献，清晰展现了不同学派对代理问题的侧重及对应治理机制，为理解公司治理的演进提供了重要框架。

title: Equity duration and predictability
abstract: After 1945, expected returns have started to dominate the variation in equity price movements, leaving little room for expected dividend growth. An increase in equity duration can help explain this change. Expected returns vary more for payouts further into the future. Furthermore, because expected returns are more persistent than growth rates, they are more important for longer-duration assets. We provide empirical support for this explanation across three datasets: dividend strips, the long time series for the aggregate market, and the cross-section of stocks. A simple present value model with time-varying duration can largely explain the post-1945 dominance of expected returns.
summary: 论文研究1945年后预期收益在股价波动中占主导地位，而预期股息增长的作用减弱的现象。作者提出权益久期增加可以解释这一变化：对于更远期的收益，预期收益的变动更大，且因其比增长率更持久，对长久期资产更重要。通过股息剥离数据、总市场长期时间序列和股票横截面三个数据集提供实证支持，一个带有时变久期的简单现值模型基本能解释1945年后预期收益主导股价变动的现象。
ai_comment: 论文切入点新颖，从权益久期角度解释了预期收益主导地位的变化，理论简洁且实证扎实。

title: The value of financial intermediation: Evidence from online debt crowdfunding
abstract: Most online marketplaces are peer-to-peer. Credit ones, however, are not and they have resurrected many features of traditional financial intermediaries. To understand why, we use online credit as a laboratory to investigate the value of financial intermediation. We develop a structural model of online debt crowdfunding and estimate it on a novel database. We find that abandoning the peer-to-peer paradigm raises lender surplus, platform profits, and credit provision, but exposes investors to liquidity risk. A counterfactual where the platform resembles a bank by bearing liquidity risk can generate larger lender surplus and credit provision when liquidity is low and lenders are risk averse.
summary: 本研究利用在线债务众筹作为实验室，探究金融中介的价值。作者构建了一个在线债务众筹的结构模型，并基于新颖的数据集进行估计。研究发现，放弃P2P（peer-to-peer）范式能够提高贷方剩余、平台利润和信贷供给，但同时也使投资者面临流动性风险。反事实分析表明，如果平台像银行一样承担流动性风险，在流动性较低且贷方风险厌恶的情况下，可以产生更大的贷方剩余和信贷供给。论文的核心贡献在于通过结构模型量化了金融中介在在线信贷市场中的作用，并揭示了流动性风险与中介收益之间的权衡。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型实证检验了在线众筹中金融中介的价值，揭示了P2P模式与平台中介模式在效率和风险上的权衡，为理解数字金融中的中介角色提供了新视角。

title: The trade imbalance network and currency returns
abstract: We introduce in the theory of Gabaix and Maggiori (2015) a network structure to capture the complexity of the balance sheets of financial intermediaries, using the Leontief inverse-based centrality. We use this framework in a multi-country world with imperfect financial markets to study how currency risk premia are connected to financiers’ risk bearing capacity. Guided by the theory, we construct a Centrality Based Characteristic (CBC), based on the centrality of the trade imbalance network and variance–covariance matrix of currency returns.
