summary: 这篇论文指出，经济学和金融学中关于银行监管以增强金融稳定的大量文献，忽略了会计准则赋予银行的会计自由裁量权，导致理论模型假设的信息与监管者实际可获得的信息之间存在差距。文章整合了经济学、金融学和会计学的见解，提出了一个简单框架来组织相关想法，包括银行监管动机的外部性、允许会计自由裁量权的理由，以及利用自由裁量权规避监管的行为。通过回顾这些领域的研究，作者得出结论：学术研究需要采用更统一的方法来设计适用于现实世界的最优政策。
ai_comment: 该文跨越经济学、金融学和会计学，弥合了理论模型与现实监管之间的信息差距，为设计更切合实际的银行监管政策提供了统一视角。

title: AI Agents for Economic Research
abstract: The objective of this paper is to demystify AI agents -autonomous LLM-based systems that plan, use tools, and execute multi-step research tasks -and to provide hands-on instructions for economists to build their own, even if they do not have programming expertise.As AI has evolved from simple chatbots to reasoning models and now to autonomous agents, the main focus of this paper is to make these powerful tools accessible to all researchers.Through working examples and step-by-step code, it shows how economists can create agents that autonomously conduct literature reviews across myriads of sources, write and debug econometric code, fetch and analyze economic data, and coordinate complex research workflows.The paper demonstrates that by "vibe coding" (programming through natural language) and building on modern agentic frameworks like LangGraph, any economist can build sophisticated research assistants and other autonomous tools in minutes.By providing complete, working implementations alongside conceptual frameworks, this guide demonstrates how to employ AI agents in every stage of the research process, from initial investigation to final analysis.
summary: 本文旨在揭示AI代理——基于LLM的自主系统，能够规划、使用工具并执行多步研究任务——并为经济学家提供构建自己的AI代理的实践指南，即使他们没有编程专业知识。随着AI从简单聊天机器人发展到推理模型再到自主代理，本文的主要目标是使这些强大工具对所有研究人员可及。通过工作示例和逐步代码，展示了经济学家如何创建能自主跨来源进行文献综述、编写和调试计量经济学代码、获取和分析经济数据以及协调复杂研究工作流的代理。论文表明，通过“vibe coding”（自然语言编程）并基于现代代理框架（如LangGraph），任何经济学家都能在几分钟内构建复杂的研究助手和其他自主工具。通过提供完整的工作实现和概念框架，本指南展示了如何在研究过程的每个阶段（从初步调查到最终分析）使用AI代理。
ai_comment: 本文通过自然语言编程和现代框架大幅降低了AI代理的使用门槛，使经济学家无需编程背景即可快速构建研究辅助工具，有望革新经济研究的工作流程。

title: Understanding Patenting Disparities via Causal Human+Machine Learning
abstract: We develop an empirical approach for analyzing multi-dimensional discrimination using multimodal data, combining human perception measures with language-embedding-based, nonlinear controls for latent quality to relax restrictive assumptions in causal machine learning.Applying it to the U.S. patent examination process, we find that, ceteris paribus, applications from female inventors are 1.8 percentage points less likely to be approved, and those from Black inventors are 3 percentage points less likely-inconsistent with legally prescribed criteria.Jointly studying multiple bias dimensions and their intersections for the first time, we uncover new biases, including an affiliation bias-individual inventors are disadvantaged by 6.6 percentage points relative to employees of large, public firms, a disparity larger than any demographic gap.Moreover, innovation quality, location, and other factors can mitigate or compound discrimination, and the disparities interact: for example, racial gaps vanish among public-firm employees, masking more severe discrimination against individuals.Existing theories such as homophily cannot fully explain the results, but a simple model of correlation neglect does.
summary: 本文开发了一种结合人类感知与基于词嵌入的非线性控制的多模态数据实证方法，用于分析多维歧视，并在因果机器学习中放松了严格假设。应用于美国专利审查过程，发现在其他条件相同的情况下，女性发明人的专利申请批准概率低1.8个百分点，黑人发明人低3个百分点，这与法定标准不符。首次联合研究多个偏见维度及其交叉，发现了新的附属偏见：个体发明人相比大型上市公司雇员，批准概率低6.6个百分点，这一差距超过任何人口统计特征上的差异。此外，创新质量、地理位置等因素可缓解或加剧歧视，且各维度歧视存在交互作用：例如，种族差异在上市公司雇员中消失，掩盖了对个体的更严重歧视。现有理论如同质性无法完全解释结果，但一个简单的相关性忽视模型可以。
ai_comment: 该方法创新性地融合人类判断与机器学习，揭示了多重偏见及其交互，为政策设计提供新视角。

title: Performance Attribution for Portfolio Constraints
abstract: We propose a new performance attribution framework that decomposes a constrained portfolio’s holdings, expected returns, variance, expected utility, and realized returns into components attributable to (1) the unconstrained mean-variance optimal portfolio; (2) individual static constraints; and (3) information, if any, arising from those constraints. A key contribution of our framework is the recognition that constraints may contain information that is correlated with returns, in which case imposing such constraints can affect performance. We extend our framework to accommodate estimation risk in portfolio construction using Bayesian portfolio analysis, which allows one to select constraints that improve—or are least detrimental to—future performance. We provide simulations and empirical examples involving constraints on environmental, social, and governance portfolios. Under certain scenarios, constraints may improve portfolio performance relative to a passive benchmark that does not account for the information contained in these constraints. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: Research funding from the National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2022YFA1007900], the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 12271013, 72342004], Peking University’s Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities, and the MIT Laboratory for Financial Engineering is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05365 .
summary: 本文提出了一种新的投资组合绩效归因框架，将受约束投资组合的持仓、预期收益、方差、预期效用和实现收益分解为三个组成部分：无约束均值方差最优组合、单个静态约束的影响，以及这些约束可能带来的信息。关键贡献在于认识到约束本身可能包含与收益率相关的信息，此时施加约束会影响绩效。该框架通过贝叶斯投资组合分析扩展到处理估计风险，允许投资者选择能够改善或最小化对未来绩效损害的约束。通过模拟和实证例子（涉及环境、社会和治理（ESG）约束）展示，在某些情景下，约束相对于不考虑约束信息的被动基准可以提升组合绩效。
ai_comment: 亮点在于将约束视为潜在的信息来源，并通过贝叶斯方法处理估计风险，为ESG等约束型投资提供了理论支撑。

title: Investor Perceptions of the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax
abstract: The Inflation Reduction Act establishes a new 15% corporate minimum tax on the adjusted financial accounting income for large U.S. corporations. Although the minimum tax is estimated to raise $222 billion over 10 years, some fear firms will manipulate their accounting earnings to reduce their tax liabilities, resulting in less revenue raised. Using an event study, we examine the extent to which investors believe this tax will reduce firm value. We examine stock market reactions around key legislative developments leading to the enactment of the book minimum tax. Our findings show targeted firms experience significantly lower stock returns than nontargeted firms during the enactment process (about 1.4%–1.8% of firm value). In aggregate, our findings are consistent with the Joint Committee on Taxation’s revenue estimates. In cross-sectional tests, we fail to find evidence that firms most likely to avoid the tax via earnings management experience more positive returns. We also fail to find less negative returns for firms most likely to pass on the tax to consumers. Overall, our results suggest investors do not expect firms to avoid this tax. Instead, they appear to expect a significant portion of the corporate minimum tax to be remitted by firms and borne by shareholders. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: F. B. Gaertner acknowledges support from the Cynthia and Jay Ihlenfeld Professorship, M. Pflitsch acknowledges support of a postdoc fellowship of the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), S. O. Kelley gratefully acknowledges support from the James L. Henderson Chair, and J. L. Hoopes gratefully acknowledges support from the Harold Q. Langenderfer fellowship. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04750 .
summary: 本文研究投资者对《通胀削减法案》新设的15%企业替代性最低税（corporate minimum tax）的看法。该税针对美国大型企业的调整后财务会计收入，预计十年内增收2220亿美元，但有人担心企业会操纵会计收益以减少税负。通过事件研究法，考察关键立法进展期间的股票市场反应，发现目标公司在立法过程中股票回报显著低于非目标公司约1.4%–1.8%，与联合税收委员会的税收估计一致。横截面检验未发现最可能通过盈余管理避税或转嫁税负给消费者的企业有更积极的回报。总体表明投资者预期企业无法有效避税，大部分最低税将由企业缴纳并由股东承担。
ai_comment: 该研究利用事件研究法提供了投资者对新型企业最低税预期的直接证据，并排除了避税和转嫁假说，具有重要的政策启示。

title: ChatGPT for Textual Analysis? How to Use Generative LLMs in Accounting Research
abstract: Generative large language models (GLLMs), such as ChatGPT and GPT-4 by OpenAI, are emerging as powerful tools for textual analysis tasks in accounting research. GLLMs can solve any textual analysis task solvable using nongenerative methods as well as tasks previously only solvable using human coding. Whereas GLLMs are new and powerful, they also come with limitations and present new challenges that require care and due diligence. This paper highlights the applications of GLLMs for accounting research and compares them with existing methods. It also provides a framework on how to effectively use GLLMs by addressing key considerations, such as model selection, prompt engineering, and ensuring construct validity. In a case study, I demonstrate the capabilities of GLLMs by detecting nonanswers in earnings conference calls, a traditionally challenging task to automate. The new GPT method achieves an accuracy of 96% and reduces the nonanswer error rate by 70% relative to the existing Gow et al. (2021) method. Finally, I discuss the importance of addressing bias, replicability, and data sharing concerns when using GLLMs. Taken together, this paper provides researchers, reviewers, and editors with the knowledge and tools to effectively use and evaluate GLLMs for academic research. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: Supported by the Foster School of Business – University of Washington. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03253 .
summary: 本文探讨了生成式大语言模型（如ChatGPT和GPT-4）在会计研究文本分析中的应用。GLLMs能够解决传统非生成方法可解决的任务，以及以往仅能通过人工编码完成的任务。论文比较了GLLMs与现有方法的优劣，并提出了一个有效使用GLLMs的框架，涵盖了模型选择、提示工程和确保构念效度等关键考虑因素。通过一个案例研究——检测财报电话会议中的非回答（即不直接回应问题的内容），作者展示了GLLMs的能力：GPT方法达到了96%的准确率，相比Gow等人（2021）的方法，非回答错误率降低了70%。此外，文章还讨论了使用GLLMs时需要注意的偏见、可复制性和数据共享问题。本文旨在为研究人员、审稿人和编辑提供有效使用和评估GLLMs进行学术研究的知识与工具。
ai_comment: 本文为会计研究方法论提供了重要贡献，不仅展示了GLLMs在文本分析中的强大性能，还提出了系统的使用框架和注意事项，对推动该领域实证研究的严谨性具有指导意义。

title: Tracking Truth with Liquid Democracy
abstract: The dynamics of random transitive delegations on a graph are of particular interest when viewed through the lens of an emerging voting paradigm: liquid democracy. This paradigm allows voters to choose between directly voting and transitively delegating their votes to other voters so that those selected cast a vote weighted by the number of delegations that they received. In the epistemic setting, where voters decide on a binary issue for which there is a ground truth, previous work showed that a few voters may amass such a large amount of influence that liquid democracy is less likely to identify the ground truth than direct voting. We quantify the amount of permissible concentration of power and examine more realistic delegation models, showing that they behave well by ensuring that (with high probability) there is a permissible limit on the maximum number of delegations received. Our theoretical results demonstrate that the delegation process is similar to well-known processes on random graphs that are sufficiently bounded for our purposes. Along the way, we prove new bounds on the size of the largest component in an infinite Pólya urn process, which may be of independent interest. In addition, we empirically validate the theoretical results, running six experiments (for a total of N = 168 participants, 62 delegation graphs, and over 11,000 votes collected). We find that empirical delegation behaviors meet the conditions for our positive theoretical guarantees. Overall, our work alleviates concerns raised about liquid democracy and bolsters the case for the applicability of this emerging paradigm. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Funding: This work was supported by the Michael Hammer Fellowship, the Office of Naval Research [2016 Vannevar Bush Faculty Fellowship, 2020 ONR Vannevar Bush Faculty Fellowship, and Grant N00014-20-1-2488], the Office of Secretary of Defense [Grants ARO MURI W911NF-19-0217 and ARO W911NF-17-1-0592], Simons [Investigator Award 622132], the Open Philanthropy Foundation, and the National Science Foundation [Grants IIS-178108, CCF-1733556, CCF-1918421, CCF-2007080, IIS-1703846, and IIS-2024287]. J. Y. Halpern was supported by a grant from the Cooperative AI Foundation [ARO Grant W911NF-22-1-0061]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02470 .
summary: 本文研究液态民主中随机传递委托的动态，尤其是在选民对存在客观真相的二元问题进行决策的认知环境中。之前研究表明，少数选民可能积累大量影响力，使液态民主不如直接投票。本文量化了允许的权力集中度，并考察了更现实的委托模型，证明它们能够确保（以高概率）最大委托数在允许范围内。理论结果将委托过程与随机图上的已知过程联系起来，同时证明了无限波利亚瓮过程中最大分量大小的新边界。通过六项实验（共168名参与者、62个委托图、超过11000张选票）验证了理论结果，发现实际委托行为满足理论保证条件。总体而言，本文缓解了对液态民主的担忧，支持了这一新兴范式的适用性。
ai_comment: 通过理论建模与实验验证相结合，本文为液态民主在更现实场景下的可行性提供了有力证据，并推导了随机图过程中的新边界，具有独立学术价值。

title: Impact of OM Content in Earnings Calls on a Firm’s Stock Performance
abstract: We investigate whether and to what extent financial markets value and respond to operations management (OM)-related information in quarterly earnings calls directed toward financial market participants. We develop and use a novel construct called “stated OM focus” (SOMF) to mine the incidence of and emphasis on OM information in the quarterly earnings conference calls for a large cross-section of firms (S&P 1500) over a time frame of 15 years. We empirically establish the value-relevance of OM information as well as summarize and capture both explanatory and predictive aspects of the OM function’s contribution to firm value. We show that OM-related information disclosed by firms systematically, significantly, positively, and persistently affects abnormal stock returns after controlling for known covariates and controls (financial metrics, standard OM metrics, firm and time effects, and lexical-structure related) and after accounting for earnings surprise. Furthermore, we find evidence that firms’ stated OM focus bears significant predictive power in the short term. Long-short portfolios, created using a sorting signal derived solely from stated OM-focus information, predict future abnormal returns consistently over one, two and three months forward from the earnings call event. We show that the OM information metric is reliable and bears internal, external, and predictive validity. These findings offer useful implications for firms, financial market participants, and OM function stakeholders. This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02221 .
summary: 本文研究金融市场是否以及如何对财报电话会议中的运营管理（OM）相关信息做出反应。作者构建了一个名为“陈述性OM焦点”（SOMF）的新指标，用于挖掘S&P 1500公司15年间季度财报电话会议中OM信息的出现频率和强调程度。实证结果表明，在控制已知协变量（包括财务指标、标准OM指标、公司及时间效应、词汇结构相关因素）以及考虑盈利意外后，公司披露的OM相关信息系统性、显著且持续地正向影响异常股票收益。此外，SOMF在短期具有显著预测能力；基于SOMF构建的多空组合在未来1、2、3个月均能持续预测异常收益。研究还验证了该OM信息指标的内部效度、外部效度和预测效度。该论文发表于《管理科学》杂志，由Jayashankar Swaminathan担任运营管理领域的编辑。
ai_comment: 该研究通过文本分析创新性地量化了运营管理信息披露，并证实其对资本市场的价值相关性，为运营管理与金融交叉领域提供了新的实证证据。

title: Intraday Market Return Predictability Culled from the Factor Zoo
abstract: We provide strong empirical evidence for time-series predictability of the intraday return on the aggregate market portfolio by exploiting lagged high-frequency cross-sectional returns on the factor zoo. Our results rely on the use of modern machine-learning techniques to regularize the predictive regressions and help tame the signals stemming from the zoo together with techniques from financial econometrics to differentiate between continuous and theoretically nonpredictable discontinuous high-frequency price increments. Using the predictions from the model estimated for the aggregate market portfolio in the formulation of simple intraday trading strategies for a set of highly liquid ETFs results in sizeable out-of-sample Sharpe ratios and alphas after accounting for transaction costs. Further dissecting the abnormal intraday returns, we find that most of the superior performance may be traced to periods of high economic uncertainty and a few key factors related to tail risk and liquidity, pointing to slow-moving capital and the gradual incorporation of new information as the underlying mechanisms at work. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01657 .
summary: 本文利用因子动物园中滞后高频横截面收益，为市场组合的日内收益率提供了强烈的时间序列可预测性证据。研究采用现代机器学习技术对预测回归进行正则化，以驯服因子动物园中的信号，并结合金融计量经济学方法区分连续与理论上不可预测的不连续高频价格增量。基于市场组合预测构建的简单日内交易策略，在考虑交易成本后，对一组高流动性ETF产生了显著样本外夏普比率和alpha。进一步分解异常日内收益发现，表现优异主要源于高经济不确定性时期及与尾部风险和流动性相关的几个关键因子，指出慢动资本和新信息逐步纳入是潜在机制。
ai_comment: 将因子动物园与机器学习结合用于日内预测，展示了高经济不确定性时期尾部风险与流动性的关键作用，方法新颖且实证稳健。

title: Segment Profit/Loss and the Limitations of a “Management Approach”
abstract: GAAP’s “Management Approach” to segment reporting (ASC 280) requires firms to report segment profit/loss as the measure managers use when allocating resources internally across segments under the assumption that investors benefit from viewing segment performance through the eyes of management. We examine how segment performance measurement aligns with the way that investors use segment profit/loss measures externally. We first survey professional investors and find that they primarily use segment profit/loss to assess firm value and therefore desire measures focused on persistent income items that help predict future performance. Next, for a sample of public multi-segment firms from 2003 to 2018, we hand-collect details on the construction of firms’ segment profit/loss measures and compare them to the same firms’ valuation-focused measures (i.e., non-GAAP earnings and non-GAAP segment profit/loss). Relative to non-GAAP measures, ASC 280 segment profit/loss is significantly more likely to include less persistent items (e.g., restructuring charges) and exclude more persistent items (e.g., interest expense). ASC 280 segment profit/loss is also less predictive of future performance and less value relevant than non-GAAP measures. These differences are attributable to ASC 280 yielding segment profit/loss measures that focus on the controllability of items by segment managers instead of items’ persistence. Overall, ASC 280’s segment profit/loss exhibits misalignment between its internal use by managers (i.e., internal resource allocation) and its primary external use by investors (i.e., valuation), which limits its usefulness for investors. Our study informs market participants and standard setters considering the usefulness of segment disclosures. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01224 .
summary: 该论文研究了GAAP下分部报告（ASC 280）的“管理方法”要求，即企业必须报告分部利润/损失，其度量方式应与经理内部资源配置时使用的指标一致，假设投资者能通过管理视角受益。作者首先调查专业投资者，发现他们主要用分部利润/损失进行估值，因此希望关注持续性收入项目以预测未来业绩。接着，手工收集2003-2018年多分部上市公司的数据，比较其ASC 280分部利润/损失与非GAAP盈利及分部利润/损失。结果显示，相比非GAAP指标，ASC 280分部利润/损失更可能包含非持续性项目（如重组费用）并排除持续性项目（如利息费用），且对未来业绩的预测能力和价值相关性均更低。这些差异源于ASC 280侧重分部经理对项目的可控性而非持续性。总体而言，ASC 280分部利润/损失在经理内部使用（资源配置）与投资者外部使用（估值）之间存在错位，限制了其对投资者的有用性。研究为市场参与者和准则制定者提供了参考。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证揭示了管理方法下分部报告与投资者估值需求的错位，为准则制定者改进分部披露提供了重要依据。

title: The Role of Lockups in Stock Mergers
abstract: We document the frequent use of stock lockup agreements in mergers and acquisitions (M&As) paid in stock and examine the corporate determinants and consequences of the use and duration of lockups. Lockup agreements prohibit target shareholders from selling shares issued by the acquirer as a means of payment for a prespecified period. We find support for the hypothesis that target shareholders agree to lockups to precommit to hold on to the acquirer’s stock if they believe the merger’s long-term fundamentals are strong. Consistent with our hypothesis, lockups come with larger acquirer announcement returns, particularly when acquirer valuations are high; ex ante, lockup adoption likelihood increases with acquirers’ valuation. Lockups also come with higher deal completion likelihood, shorter merger negotiations, and higher long-term operating performance. We conclude the market interprets lockups as a signal of strong fundamentals, particularly when acquirers’ valuations are high. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00993 .
summary: 本文研究了股票合并中锁定协议（lockup agreements）的普遍使用，这些协议禁止目标股东在预设期间内出售收购方作为支付手段发行的股票。我们检验了锁定协议使用和持续时间的公司决定因素及其后果。研究发现支持假设：如果目标股东相信合并的长期基本面强劲，他们会同意锁定以预先承诺持有收购方股票。与假设一致，锁定协议与更大的收购方公告回报相关，尤其是当收购方估值较高时；事前，锁定采用的可能性随收购方估值增加而增加。锁定还与更高的交易完成可能性、更短的合并谈判以及更高的长期运营绩效相关。结论认为市场将锁定解读为强劲基本面的信号，尤其在收购方估值较高时。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证分析揭示了锁定协议在并购中的信号作用，特别是在高估值情境下，为理解并购支付方式的经济意义提供了新视角。

title: Is Information Risk Priced? New Evidence from Outer Space
abstract: Satellite images of the parking lots of U.S. retail firms provide information about the firms’ future earnings, and the limited access to these images produces information asymmetry between sophisticated and unsophisticated investors. We construct a cloud-based information risk (CIR) measure to capture this satellite information risk and investigate its asset pricing performance. We find that CIR positively predicts future stock returns of retail firms in the cross-section and that the predictability cannot be explained by weather reasons. We provide evidence that CIR indeed captures the information asymmetry among investors. The profitability of short selling is more pronounced on clear days. The return predictability of CIR is more pronounced in preannouncement periods. During cloudy days, parking lot traffic data from satellite images are harder to obtain, and the retail store sales estimated using parking lot data are noisier. We further show that high CIR is associated with low liquidity and that the decrease in liquidity purchases is greater than the decrease in liquidity sales. Our empirical analyses suggest that information asymmetry is priced and that CIR affects equity premiums through the liquidity channel, which are consistent with the theoretical predictions from a noisy rational expectations equilibrium model under imperfect competition. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: S. Wang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72373110 and 71902140] and Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities in China. Y. Wang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72342003 and 72071114]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00713 .
summary: 该论文利用美国零售企业的卫星图像（停车场）获取公司未来收益信息，由于只有部分投资者能获取这些图像而产生信息不对称。作者构建了基于云的信息风险（CIR）度量，考察其资产定价表现。研究发现CIR在横截面上正向预测零售企业未来股票回报，且该预测性不能被天气原因解释。证据表明CIR确实捕捉了投资者之间的信息不对称：卖空盈利在晴天更显著，回报预测性在预告期更明显；阴天时停车场数据更难获取，基于停车场数据估计的零售店销售更嘈杂。进一步，高CIR与低流动性相关，且流动性的购买下降大于销售下降。实证分析表明信息不对称被定价，CIR通过流动性渠道影响权益溢价，这与不完全竞争下带噪音的理性预期均衡模型的理论预测一致。
ai_comment: 创新性地使用卫星图像这一外生数据来源，为信息不对称的定价提供了新颖证据，并揭示了通过流动性渠道的影响机制。

title: Diversification Quotients: Quantifying Diversification via Risk Measures
abstract: We establish the first axiomatic theory for diversification indices using six intuitive axioms: nonnegativity, location invariance, scale invariance, rationality, normalization, and continuity. The unique class of indices satisfying these axioms, called the diversification quotients (DQs), are defined based on a parametric family of risk measures. A further axiom of portfolio convexity pins down DQs based on coherent risk measures. The DQ has many attractive properties, and it can address several theoretical and practical limitations of existing indices. In particular, for the popular risk measures value at risk and expected shortfall, the corresponding DQ admits simple formulas, and it is efficient to optimize in portfolio selection. Moreover, it can properly capture tail heaviness and common shocks, which are neglected by traditional diversification indices. When illustrated with financial data, the DQ is intuitive to interpret, and its performance is competitive against other diversification indices. This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: X. Han is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 12301604, 12371471, and 12471449). L. Lin is supported by the Hickman Scholarship from the Society of Actuaries. R. Wang is supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grants CRC-2022-00141 and RGPIN-2024-03728] and the Sun Life Research Fellowship. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00513 .
summary: 该论文首次建立了分散化指数的公理化理论，提出六条直观公理：非负性、位置不变性、尺度不变性、理性、归一化和连续性。满足这些公理的唯一指数类被称为分散化商（Diversification Quotients, DQs），其定义基于一个参数化风险测度族。进一步引入投资组合凸性公理则确定了基于一致性风险测度的DQs。DQs具有许多优良性质，并能解决现有分散化指数在理论和实践上的若干局限性。特别是对于流行的风险测度VaR和Expected Shortfall，相应的DQ具有简洁公式，且在投资组合选择中优化高效。此外，DQ能够正确捕捉尾部重性和共同冲击，而这些被传统分散化指数所忽略。使用金融数据进行的实例表明，DQ直观易解释，且其表现与其他分散化指数相比具有竞争力。
ai_comment: 该文通过公理化方法为分散化测度提供了坚实的理论基础，并给出了易于计算和优化的具体形式，尤其是在VaR和ES下的简洁表达式，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: Fearless Woman: Financial Literacy, Confidence, and Stock Market Participation
abstract: Women are less financially literate than men, and it has been difficult to determine whether this gap reflects a lack of knowledge or, rather, a lack of confidence. To address this important research question, we designed two survey modules that enable us to calculate the extent to which confidence matters for both financial literacy and behavior. We developed and estimated a model that provides a new measure of financial literacy and disentangles confidence from knowledge. We find that confidence accounts for about 30% of the gender difference in financial literacy. Moreover, both financial knowledge and confidence are linked to stock market participation. We also provide researchers with a method to account for confidence in regressions. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the European Investment Bank Institute (n/a), which is gratefully acknowledged. The findings and views presented in this article are entirely those of the authors and should not be attributed in any manner to the European Investment Bank or its Institute or to the European Central Bank, the Eurosystem, or De Nederlandsche Bank. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00425 .
summary: 本研究设计两个调查模块，开发并估计了一个模型，用于区分金融素养中的知识与自信，从而量化自信在女性金融素养低于男性这一性别差异中的作用。研究发现，自信解释了约30%的性别差异，且金融知识和自信均与股市参与相关。此外，本文为研究者提供了在回归分析中考虑自信的方法。
ai_comment: 通过精巧的模型设计分离知识与自信，为理解金融素养性别差异提供了新视角，并提供了实用的计量方法。

title: Intertemporal Pricing with Resellers: An Empirical Study of Product Drops
abstract: Product drops occur when a retailer releases a limited-edition product line on a specific date for a short period of time. Due to limited inventory of the product and the short sales horizon, a resale market emerges where products may resell at higher prices once the firm stocks out. The firm faces a central tradeoff: pricing too high may lead to a longer stockout time and future markdowns; pricing too low may lead to transfer of profits to resellers. Any firm in this position may ask, “How do resellers impact my profit?” To answer this question, we build a dynamic structural model that captures customer decisions to consume or strategically resell, as well as the firm’s intertemporal pricing decision in the presence of resellers. We estimate our model using a unique data set from a retailer of baby clothing with weekly product drops, where customers engage in a resale marketplace through Facebook groups. We find resale data collection and analysis is valuable to incorporate into pricing as firm profit increases by 8.8%, and reseller presence reduces firm profit by 5.8% even if resale data are used in pricing. These impacts are magnified by resale market growth, demonstrating that managers need to take action as resale markets gain wider adoption. This paper was accepted by Victor Martínez-de-Albéniz, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04152 .
summary: 本文研究零售商在限量产品发布（product drops）情境下面临的跨期定价问题。由于库存有限且销售期短，企业售罄后会形成转售市场，产品以更高价格转卖。企业核心权衡在于：定价过高导致库存时间长和未来降价；定价过低则利润流向转售者。为回答“转售者如何影响利润”，作者构建了一个动态结构模型，捕捉消费者选择消费或策略性转售的行为，以及企业在有转售者时的跨期定价决策。利用一家婴儿服装零售商的周度产品发布数据（消费者通过Facebook群组进行转售）估计模型。研究发现：将转售数据纳入定价可使企业利润提升8.8%，但即使使用转售数据，转售者的存在仍使利润降低5.8%。这些影响随转售市场规模扩大而加剧，表明管理者需在转售市场日益普及的背景下采取行动。
ai_comment: 该研究通过动态结构模型整合消费者策略性行为和转售数据，为限量发售企业的定价决策提供了量化指导，并揭示了转售市场的双重影响。

title: Monetary Easing, Leveraged Payouts, and Lack of Investment
abstract: We study a model in which a low monetary policy rate lowers the cost of corporate debt, potentially spurring productive investment; low interest rates, however, also induce firms to lever up so as to increase payouts to equity. Whereas such leveraged payouts privately benefit shareholders, leverage comes at the social cost of distorting their incentives, thereby lowering productivity and discouraging investment. If leverage is unregulated (for example, because of the presence of a shadow banking system), then the optimal monetary policy seeks to contain such socially costly leveraged payouts by stimulating investment in response to adverse shocks only up to a level below the first best. The optimal monetary policy may even consist of leaning against the wind, that is, not stimulating the economy at all, in order to fully contain leveraged payouts and maintain productive efficiency. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01440 .
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，分析低货币政策利率如何降低企业债务成本，可能促进生产性投资。然而，低利率也会诱使企业增加杠杆以扩大股权支付（即杠杆支付）。这种杠杆支付虽然对股东有利，但会扭曲激励、降低生产率并抑制投资，从而产生社会成本。当杠杆未受监管（例如存在影子银行体系）时，最优货币政策旨在通过仅将投资刺激到低于第一最优的水平来遏制这类高社会成本的杠杆支付，以应对不利冲击。在最极端情况下，最优货币政策甚至可能逆风而行，即完全不刺激经济，以完全遏制杠杆支付并维持生产效率。
ai_comment: 该论文从社会成本角度揭示了低利率环境下杠杆支付与投资之间的权衡，为央行在影子银行存在时的政策设计提供了新视角。

title: The Crowdfunding Effects on Venture Capital Investment
abstract: We examine the impact of crowdfunding on venture capital (VC) investments in the presence of competition among VC firms. Our economic model comprises a startup, a crowdfunding platform, and two VC firms, each with its own perception of the startup’s potential. The startup seeks equity funding from the VC firms and decides on the size of its equity offer. If the VC firms decline to invest, the startup pivots to crowdfunding. Following the crowdfunding campaign, all firms update their beliefs about the startup’s likelihood of success based on the crowdfunding outcome, prompting the VC firms to revisit their investment decisions, now with a reduced equity offer if the crowdfunding outcome was positive. This study provides theoretical underpinnings at the firm level for the observed aggregate-level empirical relationships, both positive and negative, between crowdfunding and VC investments. Specifically, based on our model, the positive relationship, where increased crowdfunding activity leads to a rise in subsequent VC investments, is attributed to startups that fail to secure VC funding in the absence of a crowdfunding platform but succeed in attracting VC attention after a successful crowdfunding campaign. In contrast, the negative relationship is attributed to highly valued startups that could have secured VC funding without crowdfunding, but with crowdfunding, VC firms choose to defer their investment decision until after the crowdfunding campaign’s result is known; on the one hand, a successful crowdfunding outcome lowers their post-crowdfunding VC investment demand, and on the other hand, an unsuccessful outcome deters potential VC investors. Besides these relationships, we also identify another dynamic, where the option of accessing crowdfunding raises VC investment, even if the startup does not actually launch a crowdfunding campaign. This paper was accepted by Sridhar Tayur, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grants RGPIN-2015-06757 and RGPIN-2021-04295] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71901135]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00994 .
summary: 本文构建了一个包含初创公司、一个众筹平台和两家风险投资（VC）公司的经济模型，研究在VC竞争环境下众筹对VC投资的影响。初创公司首先向两家VC寻求股权融资并决定股权发行规模；如果VC拒绝投资，初创公司则转向众筹。众筹活动结束后，所有公司根据众筹结果更新对初创公司成功概率的信念，促使VC重新考虑投资决策，且在众筹结果积极时降低股权要求。该模型为观测到的众筹与VC投资之间正负两种总体经验关系提供了企业层面的理论解释：正相关源于那些原本无法获得VC融资的初创公司在成功众筹后吸引了VC关注；负相关则源于高估值初创公司原本无需众筹即可获得VC融资，但众筹使得VC选择延迟投资——若众筹成功则降低后续VC需求，若失败则阻止潜在VC投资。此外，模型还识别出另一种动态：即使初创公司实际未发起众筹，众筹选项的存在也能提升VC投资。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的理论模型清晰区分了众筹对VC投资的正负影响机制，为实证研究中看似矛盾的关系提供了统一的微观基础，并揭示了众筹选项的“隐含价值”。

title: War Discourse and the Cross Section of Expected Stock Returns
abstract: A war‐related factor model derived from textual analysis of media news reports explains the cross section of expected stock returns. Using a semisupervised topic model to extract discourse topics from 7,000,000 New York Times stories spanning 160 years, the war factor predicts the cross section of returns across test assets derived from both traditional and machine learning construction techniques, and spanning 138 anomalies. Our findings are consistent with assets that are good hedges for war risk receiving lower risk premia, or with assets that are more positively sensitive to war prospects being more overvalued. The return premium on the war factor is incremental to standard effects.
summary: 本研究通过文本分析媒体新闻报道构建了一个战争相关的因子模型，用于解释预期股票收益的横截面。研究者使用半监督主题模型从160年间700万篇纽约时报报道中提取战争话语主题，该战争因子能够预测传统和机器学习技术构建的测试资产（涵盖138个异常）的横截面收益。结果表明，对战争风险具有良好对冲作用的资产获得较低的风险溢价，而对战争前景更敏感的资产则可能被高估。战争因子的回报溢价独立于标准效应。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用长达160年的新闻文本数据构建战争因子，将历史叙事与资产定价结合，揭示了战争风险在股票回报中的定价作用，方法新颖且实证扎实。

title: Relative Performance Evaluation and Strategic Competition
abstract: We examine how relative performance evaluation (RPE) affects industry competition—a question relevant for corporate boards interested in incentivizing executives. Using U.S. airline data, we estimate a dynamic game of competition between heterogeneous firms in an oligopolistic market, with managers incentivized by RPE contracts. While RPE can induce a firm to compete more intensely by smoothing compensation, it also amplifies a firm’s cost efficiency relative to its peers and can weaken competition from inefficient firms. The first effect dominates in small markets and the second in median-sized markets. RPE has little effect in large, highly profitable markets.
summary: 本文研究相对绩效评估（RPE）如何影响行业竞争，这是一个关乎公司董事会激励高管的相关问题。利用美国航空业数据，本文估计了一个寡头市场中异质企业之间的动态竞争博弈，其中管理者受到RPE合同的激励。研究发现，RPE可以通过平滑薪酬促使企业更激烈地竞争，但同时也会放大企业相对于同行的成本效率，并可能削弱低效企业的竞争。第一个效应在小市场中占主导，第二个效应在中位数规模市场中占主导，而在大型高利润市场中RPE影响甚微。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构估计方法揭示了RPE对市场竞争的复杂非线性效应，并强调了市场规模的重要调节作用，为高管薪酬设计提供了新的理论视角。

title: Economic links from bonds and cross-stock return predictability
abstract: Identifying firms’ bond-market-specific economic links through credit-rating comovement of their corporate bonds, a long-short strategy for stocks based on these links generates a risk-adjusted alpha of 0.45% per month, which cannot be explained by existing economic links in the literature. Market segmentation between the equity and bond markets appears to be the underlying mechanism: ( i ) The cross-return predictability is muted in the bond market; ( i i ) The cross-return predictability is mitigated in the presence of cross-holding investors; ( i i i ) Equity analysts slowly incorporate information from rating-comovement links to their forecasts.
summary: 通过公司债券信用评级共同变动来识别债券市场特定的经济联系，基于这些联系构建的股票多空策略每月产生0.45%的风险调整后alpha，该回报无法被文献中已有的经济联系所解释。市场分割（股票与债券市场之间的分割）是潜在机制：债券市场上不存在这种跨股票回报可预测性；交叉持有投资者的存在会削弱该预测性；股票分析师在预测中缓慢纳入来自评级共同变动联系的信息。
ai_comment: 该论文通过债券信用评级共同变动这一新颖视角识别经济联系，并揭示了市场分割作为跨市场预测性的关键机制，为理解股票与债券市场信息传导提供了新证据。

title: Private equity in the hospital industry
abstract: We examine the survival prospects, employment profiles, and patient outcomes at private equity (PE)-acquired hospitals. Target hospitals maintain their survival rates while significantly reducing employment and wage expenditures. The number of core medical workers drops temporarily, but returns to its pre-acquisition level in the long run. However, administrative job and wage cuts persist over the long term, particularly at previously nonprofit hospitals. Using proprietary insurance claims data, we find no significant changes in patient demographics or inpatient prices at PE-acquired hospitals. While patient satisfaction declines, there is no evidence of increased patient mortality or readmission rates at PE-acquired hospitals.
summary: 本文研究了私募股权（PE）收购对医院生存前景、就业情况和患者结果的影响。被收购医院的生存率保持不变，但显著减少了就业和工资支出。核心医疗人员数量暂时下降，但长期恢复至收购前水平；然而，行政岗位和工资的削减长期持续，尤其是在之前非盈利的医院中。利用专有的保险理赔数据，研究发现PE收购医院的病人人口统计特征和住院价格没有显著变化。尽管患者满意度下降，但没有证据表明PE收购医院的死亡率或再入院率上升。
ai_comment: 该论文利用详尽的就业和保险理赔数据，揭示了PE收购在削减成本的同时并未显著恶化患者核心健康指标，但牺牲了员工福利和患者体验，为PE在医疗领域的影响提供了重要实证。

title: Conditional risk and the pricing kernel
abstract: We propose a statistical methodology for jointly estimating the pricing kernel and conditional physical return densities from option prices. Pricing kernel estimates show that negative stock market returns are significantly more painful to investors in low-volatility periods. Density estimates reflect a significantly positive risk–return trade-off, suggest that Martin’s (2017) lower bound on the equity premium is violated in high-volatility periods, and provide new evidence on the variance premium’s predictive power for excess returns as well as the co-movement between higher return moments. Lastly, we show that leading macrofinance models are at odds with basic features of conditional stock market risks and risk pricing.
summary: 该论文提出了一种统计方法，利用期权价格联合估计定价核和条件物理收益密度。估计结果显示，低波动时期负的股票市场回报对投资者显著更痛苦；密度估计反映了显著的正风险-收益权衡，并表明Martin（2017）的股权溢价下界在高波动时期被违反；此外，提供了方差溢价对超额收益预测能力以及高阶收益矩共同运动的新证据。最后，该研究指出主要宏观金融模型与条件股票市场风险和风险定价的基本特征不一致。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地联合估计定价核与条件密度，实证结果挑战了经典下界和宏观金融模型，深化了对市场风险动态的理解。

title: Bank stress testing, human capital investment and risk management
abstract: This paper studies banks’ investment in risk management human capital following the Global Financial Crisis and the advent of stress testing. Our results suggest that ‘Too Big to Fail’ distortions may have weakened large banks’ incentive to invest in risk management talent. Stress testing, which focuses on the largest banks, spurred demand for skilled quantitative risk managers, but only narrowly in anticipation of a test and following poor performance on a test. Stress testing does not affect demand for the over 90 % of risk management jobs not linked to passing tests, limiting its effectiveness in improving risk management practices.
summary: 本文研究全球金融危机和压力测试出现后银行对风险管理人力资本的投资。结果表明，“大而不倒”扭曲可能削弱了大银行投资风险管理人才的激励。压力测试主要针对大型银行，刺激了对熟练量化风险管理者的需求，但仅限于预期到测试或测试表现不佳之后。压力测试并不影响超过90%的与通过测试无关的风险管理工作，从而限制了其在改善风险管理实践方面的有效性。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了压力测试在提升银行整体风险管理水平方面的局限性，强调了需要更广泛的激励措施来促进风险管理人力资本投资。

title: The impact of prices on analyst cash flow expectations: Reconciling subjective beliefs data with rational discount rate variation
abstract: I show that prices impact analyst cash flow expectations and argue this impact can partially reconcile subjective beliefs data with asset pricing models in which investors have rational expectations and discount rate variation drives prices. Previous work argues that correlations of biased analyst cash flow expectations with prices and future returns contradict rational models and imply biased investor expectations distort prices. However, using two instrumental variables for price, I find increases in price unrelated to cash flow news raise analyst cash flow expectations. Based on this empirical finding, I propose a model with rational investors that matches key moments in beliefs data: analysts form biased cash flow expectations by learning from prices that contain discount rate variation. Thus, while stylized facts in beliefs data can be consistent with investors having biased expectations that distort prices, these facts can also be consistent with investors having rational expectations and analysts learning from prices.
summary: 本文研究价格如何影响分析师现金流预期, 并论证这种影响可以部分调和主观信念数据与资产定价模型（其中投资者具有理性预期且贴现率变动驱动价格）。先前研究认为分析师有偏的现金流预期与价格和未来收益的相关性与理性模型相矛盾，暗示投资者有偏预期扭曲价格。然而，本文使用两个价格工具变量，发现与现金流新闻无关的价格上涨会提高分析师的现金流预期。基于这一实证发现，作者提出一个包含理性投资者的模型，该模型匹配了信念数据的关键特征：分析师通过从包含贴现率变动的价格中学习，形成有偏的现金流预期。因此，尽管信念数据中的典型事实可能与投资者有偏预期扭曲价格一致，但这些事实也与投资者具有理性预期且分析师从价格中学习相一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过工具变量识别了价格对分析师预期的因果效应，并提出一个理论模型调和主观信念数据与理性预期资产定价模型，为理解分析师偏差提供了新视角。

title: The economics of “Buy Now, Pay Later”: A merchant’s perspective
abstract: “Buy Now, Pay Later” (BNPL) is a key innovation in consumer payments. It bundles the sale of a product with a subsidized loan, effectively offering lower prices to low-creditworthiness customers. BNPL thereby allows merchants to price-discriminate among customers with different willingness-to-pay. Consistent with a price-discrimination mechanism, we show that BNPL increases sales by 20%, driven by low-creditworthiness customers and products where market power is larger. We find that the benefits of offering BNPL significantly outweigh the costs for the merchant. Our findings help to explain the surge in popularity of BNPL in e-commerce around the world.
summary: 本文从商家视角研究“先买后付”（BNPL）的经济学机制。BNPL将产品销售与补贴贷款捆绑，实质上为低信用客户提供更低价格，从而使商家能够根据客户不同的支付意愿进行价格歧视。与价格歧视机制一致，研究表明BNPL使销售额增加20%，这一增长主要由低信用客户和商家市场势力更大的产品驱动。此外，商家提供BNPL的收益显著超过成本。这些发现有助于解释BNPL在全球电子商务中迅速流行的原因。
ai_comment: 本文从商家定价策略角度揭示了BNPL流行的经济学逻辑，为理解新型支付工具的兴起提供了新见解。

title: Differential access to dark markets and execution outcomes
abstract: Dark pools can restrict access for specific trader types. We compare execution outcomes between dark pools that restrict high frequency trader access and those that do not. We find that trades executed in dark pools with more access restrictions have less order flow information leakage, adverse selection risk and post-trade order imbalances than trades in less restricted pools. Evidence from exogenous dark pool closures demonstrates that these differences are causal. The ability to segment order flow can benefit investors because it allows them to make trade-offs between execution risk and information leakage across different dark venues.
summary: 本文研究暗池中不同类型交易者（特别是高频交易者）的准入限制对执行结果的影响。通过比较那些限制高频交易者进入的暗池与不限制的暗池，发现限制更多的暗池中交易具有更少的订单流信息泄露、逆向选择风险和交易后订单不平衡。外生暗池关闭事件提供的证据表明这些差异具有因果性。研究结论指出，订单流分割能力使投资者能够在不同暗池之间权衡执行风险和信息泄露，从而获益。
ai_comment: 该研究通过对比不同限制程度的暗池，揭示了订单流分割对投资者执行结果的影响，提供了暗池中信息不对称的新证据。

title: CRISK: Measuring the climate risk exposure of the financial system
abstract: We develop a market-based methodology to assess banks’ resilience to climate-related risks and study the climate-related risk exposure of large global banks. We introduce a new measure, CRISK, which is the expected capital shortfall of a bank in a climate stress scenario. To estimate CRISK, we construct climate risk factors and dynamically measure banks’ stock return sensitivity (that is, climate beta) to the climate risk factor. We validate the climate risk factor empirically and the climate beta estimates by using granular data on large US banks’ loan portfolios. The measure is useful in quantifying banks’ climate-related risk exposure through the market risk and the credit risk channels.
summary: 本文开发了一种基于市场的方法来评估银行对气候相关风险的韧性，并研究了大型全球银行的气候相关风险敞口。作者引入了一个新指标CRISK，即银行在气候压力情景下的预期资本短缺。为了估计CRISK，他们构建了气候风险因子，并动态测量银行股票收益对该因子的敏感性（气候贝塔）。通过使用美国大型银行贷款组合的细粒度数据，实证验证了气候风险因子和气候贝塔估计的有效性。该指标有助于通过市场风险和信用风险渠道量化银行的气候相关风险敞口。
ai_comment: 创新性地提出CRISK指标，为系统性气候风险度量提供了新工具，并结合市场数据和贷款组合数据验证了其有效性，具有重要的政策与监管意义。

title: Printing away the mortgages: Fiscal inflation and the post-covid boom
abstract: We analyze interactions between fiscal and monetary stimulus in a new Keynesian model with nominal mortgage debt that can be inflated away. Redistributive transfers are most impactful when followed by a temporary deviation from inflation-targeting monetary policy. Unlike other fiscal policies, redistribution causes inflation even in the absence of long-run debt sustainability problems, and inflating away mortgages results in additional redistribution. In a quantitative model with mortgage refinancing frictions, transfer payments provide much more stimulus than the redistributive effects of inflation. Borrowers gradually refinance after their mortgages are inflated away, dampening their immediate consumption response and reducing their long-run labor supply.
summary: 本文在新凯恩斯模型中引入名义抵押债务，研究财政刺激与货币刺激的相互作用，其中抵押债务可通过通胀消除。研究发现，再分配转移支付在货币政策暂时偏离通胀目标时最为有效。与其他财政政策不同，再分配即使在不存在长期债务可持续性问题时也会引发通胀，且通过通胀消除抵押债务会进一步产生再分配效应。在包含抵押再融资摩擦的量化模型中，转移支付的刺激效果远超通胀的再分配效应。借款人会在抵押债务被通胀消除后逐步进行再融资，这抑制了其即期消费反应并减少了长期劳动供给。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将名义抵押债务与通胀消除机制纳入新凯恩斯框架，揭示了财政货币政策交互中再分配效应的传导渠道，并量化了再融资摩擦对消费和劳动供给的动态影响。

title: Surviving the fintech disruption
abstract: We examine the impact of fintech on firm labor demand, job turnover, and firm performance. Occupations with higher exposure to fintech experience a net decline in job postings and employment, though both complementary and substitutive effects emerge across different sectors. Fintech blurs traditional industry boundaries, creating demand for workers with a combination of finance and technology skills. In response, firms upskill through hiring, reallocate talent internally, and pivot innovation to new areas. As a result, firms are better equipped to absorb the shock than individual workers, with innovative firms even experiencing growth in employment, sales, and productivity upon fintech disruption.
summary: 该论文研究了金融科技（fintech）对企业劳动力需求、工作更替和企业绩效的影响。研究发现，fintech暴露程度较高的职业出现职位发布和就业净减少，但不同行业同时存在互补和替代效应。Fintech模糊了传统行业边界，创造了对兼具金融和技术技能工人的需求。作为回应，企业通过招聘提升技能、内部重新分配人才，并将创新转向新领域。结果，企业比个体工人更能吸收冲击，创新型企业甚至在fintech冲击下经历了就业、销售和生产率增长。
ai_comment: 论文聚焦fintech对劳动力市场的颠覆效应，并揭示了企业层面的适应机制，尤其是创新企业的韧性，为理解技术冲击下的动态调整提供了新视角。

title: The Aftermath of Credit Booms: Evidence from Credit Ceiling Removals
abstract: We study removals of “credit ceilings,” quantitative limits on bank credit supply imposed by many countries until the 1980s. Exploiting differences in loan types affected, we find that these removals predict increases in bank credit, residential investment, house prices, and bank stock prices, followed by reversals, recessions, and banking crises. These effects are separate from those of other financial deregulations. Overall, our results suggest that credit supply shocks do not simply amplify existing fragilities but can initiate economic boom-and-bust cycles on their own.
summary: 本文研究了许多国家在1980年代之前实施的“信用上限”（credit ceilings）取消后的经济后果。通过利用不同贷款类型受影响程度的差异，我们发现信用上限的取消导致银行信贷、住宅投资、房价和银行股价的上升，随后出现逆转、经济衰退和银行危机。这些影响与其他金融放松管制措施的效果是独立的。总体而言，研究结果表明信贷供应冲击不仅会放大已有的脆弱性，而且能够自行引发经济繁荣-萧条周期。
ai_comment: 本文利用历史制度变革识别了信贷供应冲击的因果效应，表明其可以独立引发经济周期，为理解信贷繁荣的后果提供了新视角。

title: The Credit Line Channel
abstract: Aggregate U.S. bank lending to firms expanded following the outbreak of COVID‐19. Using loan‐level supervisory data, we show that this expansion was driven by draws on credit lines by large firms. Banks that experienced larger credit line drawdowns restricted term lending more, crowding out credit to smaller firms, which reacted by reducing investment. A structural model calibrated to match our empirical results shows that while credit lines increase total bank credit in bad times, they redistribute credit from firms with high propensities to invest to firms with low propensities to invest, exacerbating the decrease in aggregate investment.
summary: 本文利用美国贷款级监管数据，研究新冠疫情后银行对企业贷款扩张的现象。结果表明，贷款扩张主要由大型企业提取信贷额度驱动。银行在经历大规模信贷额度提取后，会减少定期贷款，从而挤出对中小企业的信贷，导致中小企业削减投资。通过校准结构模型，本文发现信贷额度虽能在经济低迷时期增加银行总信贷，但会将信贷从高投资倾向企业重新分配给低投资倾向企业，从而加剧总体投资的下滑。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的贷款级数据揭示了信贷额度渠道的负面分配效应，并量化了对总投资的影响，对理解银行信贷在危机中的作用具有重要启示。

title: The Propagation of Cyberattacks through the Financial System: Evidence from an Actual Event
abstract: This article quantifies the effects of a multiday cyberattack that forced offline a technology service provider (TSP) to the banking sector. The attack impaired customers’ ability to send payments through the TSP, but the business continuity plans of banks and the TSP reduced the effect by more than half. Large banks performed better. Through contagion, banks not directly exposed to the attack experienced a liquidity shortfall, causing them to borrow funds or tap reserves. The ability to send payments after hours helped avoid further contagion. These results highlight the importance of preparedness by the private and official sector for cyberattacks.
summary: 本文量化了一场多日网络攻击的影响，该攻击迫使银行业的一家技术服务提供商（TSP）离线。攻击损害了客户通过该TSP发送支付的能力，但银行和TSP的业务连续性计划将影响减少了超过一半。大型银行表现更好。通过传染效应，未直接暴露于攻击的银行也出现了流动性短缺，导致它们借入资金或动用准备金。下班后发送支付的能力有助于避免进一步的传染。这些结果突显了私营和官方部门为网络攻击做好准备的重要性。
ai_comment: 利用实际事件数据量化网络攻击的传染效应，强调了业务连续性计划在缓解冲击中的关键作用，为金融系统网络安全风险提供了实证依据。

title: Marijuana Legalization and Firms’ Cost of Equity
abstract: After medical marijuana legalization (MML) by U.S. states, firms’ cost of equity (COE) decreases, especially for those with more growth opportunities, higher productivity, or a more skilled workforce. This policy change also reduces firm risk and leads to an increase in labor supply through increased labor force participation, employment, hours worked, and net migration. Further, home prices rise after MML, reflecting increased local housing demand due to a growing supply of workers. These findings align with theoretical models that link asset prices to labor markets and suggest that MML can lower firms’ COE by mitigating labor search frictions.
summary: 该研究利用美国各州通过医用大麻合法化（MML）政策的自然实验，发现MML显著降低了企业的权益资本成本（COE），尤其是对于具有更多增长机会、更高生产率或更熟练劳动力的企业。政策还降低了企业风险，并通过增加劳动力参与率、就业、工时和净迁移提高了劳动力供给，进而导致房价上涨，反映了因劳动力供应增加而提升的当地住房需求。这些结果支持资产价格与劳动力市场相关联的理论模型，表明MML通过缓解劳动力搜索摩擦降低了企业的COE。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将大麻合法化的经济影响拓展至企业融资领域，揭示了劳动力市场摩擦缓解作为降低权益资本成本的新渠道，为政策评估和资产定价提供了实证依据。

title: Over‐the‐Counter Markets for Nonstandardized Assets
abstract: We study a search and bargaining model of over‐the‐counter markets for nonstandardized assets of heterogeneous quality. Once matched, investors privately learn their values positively correlated with asset quality. Bargaining results in delay that is hump‐shaped in quality and U‐shaped in asset turnover. We document these patterns in commercial real estate and corporate bonds markets. Extreme qualities are little affected by changes in asset standardization, while intermediate qualities are more susceptible. For nonstandardized assets, opacity ensures active trading of all assets, which explains why their trading is decentralized and suggests that trade centralization should come with greater standardization.
summary: 本文构建了一个搜索与议价模型，研究异质性质量非标准化资产的场外市场。在匹配后，投资者私下获知与资产质量正相关的价值。议价导致延迟，该延迟在质量上呈驼峰形，在资产周转率上呈U形。作者在商业房地产和公司债券市场中实证验证了这些模式。研究发现，极端质量受资产标准化变化的影响较小，而中间质量更易受影响。对于非标准化资产，不透明性确保了所有资产的活跃交易，这解释了为何其交易分散化，并表明交易中心化应伴随更大的标准化。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型与实证证据揭示了非标准化资产市场交易延迟的非线性模式，并强调了不透明性在维持市场活跃度中的关键作用，为理解场外市场结构提供了新颖视角。

title: Pockets of Predictability: A Replication
abstract: Farmer, Schmidt, and Timmermann (FST) document time‐variation in market return predictability, identifying “pockets” of significant predictability through kernel regressions. However, our analysis reveals a critical discrepancy between the method outlined by FST and the code actually implemented. Instead of using a one‐sided kernel, which guarantees out‐of‐sample forecasts, they perform in‐sample estimation with a two‐sided kernel. As a result, future information leaks into the forecasting model, undermining its reliability. Rectifying this error qualitatively alters the findings, invalidating most conclusions of the FST study. Thus, attempts to exploit such “pockets”—should they exist—offer little help in forecasting market returns.
summary: 本文复制了Farmer, Schmidt, and Timmermann (FST)关于市场回报可预测性时间变化的研究，发现FST声称通过核回归识别出的“可预测性口袋”存在方法错误。作者指出，FST在描述中声称使用单侧核保证样本外预测，但实际代码采用了两侧核进行样本内估计，导致未来信息泄漏。纠正这一错误后，FST的主要结论被推翻，表明即使存在这种可预测性口袋，也无法有效用于预测市场回报。
ai_comment: 本文通过仔细检查代码揭示了经典研究中的方法错误，强调了复制研究中代码审计的重要性。

title: Short-Term Reversals and Longer-Term Momentum around the World: Theory and Evidence
abstract: Stock returns exhibit reversals at short horizons but slowly transition to momentum over longer horizons. To help understand this pattern, we develop a multiperiod model with short- and long-horizon noise traders, and active investors who underreact to information they do not themselves produce. The model accords with the transition from reversals to momentum and yields the following novel predictions: (a) attenuated reversals after earnings announcements, (b) a negative relation between monthly reversal and longer-term momentum profits across economies and time, and (c) larger reversals when there is more noise trading. Empirical analysis using U.S. and international data supports these predictions.
summary: 本文研究股票收益在短期呈现反转、长期逐渐转为动量的模式。作者构建了一个多期模型，包含短期和长期噪声交易者，以及主动投资者对非自产信息反应不足。该模型成功解释了从反转到动量的过渡，并提出了三个新颖预测：(a) 盈利公告后反转减弱；(b) 月度反转与长期动量利润在经济体和时间序列上呈负相关；(c) 噪声交易越多，反转越大。使用美国和国际数据的实证分析支持了这些预测。
ai_comment: 该论文通过理论模型与跨国实证检验，系统揭示了短期反转与长期动量之间的动态关联，为理解市场异象提供了统一的行为解释。

title: Thirty Years of Change: The Evolution of Classified Boards
abstract: Based on a comprehensive data set of classified (staggered) boards covering nearly all U.S. public firms from 1991 to 2020, we show that contrary to conventional wisdom, the use of classified boards remains widespread. Moreover, classified board usage over a firm's life cycle depends significantly on the decade the firm matured or year it went public. While classified boards were rarely removed in the 1990s, firms became more likely to declassify as they matured during the following decades. Decreased collective action costs and increased innovation‐related investments, institutional ownership, and scrutiny of governance contributed to this more dynamic adjustment.
summary: 基于1991年至2020年涵盖几乎所有美国上市公司的全面数据集，本研究显示，与传统观点相反，分类（分期）董事会的使用仍然广泛。此外，分类董事会在公司生命周期中的使用在很大程度上取决于公司成熟的十年或上市年份。虽然分类董事会在1990年代很少被取消，但随着公司在随后几十年成熟，它们更有可能去分类。集体行动成本的降低、创新相关投资的增加、机构所有权以及治理审查的加强促成了这种更动态的调整。
ai_comment: 该论文通过长期大样本数据揭示了分类董事会使用的动态变化，挑战了其正在减少的普遍认知，并强调了时代和生命周期的影响，对公司治理研究具有重要贡献。

title: Company Websites: A New Measure of Disclosure
abstract: We propose a new measure of firms' disclosure based on company websites, which are widely available and contain a wealth of information. For a sample of U.S. public firms, we construct our disclosure measure using historical website data, validate it by correlating it with extant measures of disclosure and information asymmetry, and explore its determinants. We then apply our measure to the study of U.S. private firms' disclosure and French firms' compliance with a nonfinancial disclosure mandate. Our applications illustrate that our website‐based measure provides a useful complement to extant measures of disclosure, which are more narrowly focused on investors in public capital markets.
summary: 本文提出了一种基于公司网站的新披露度量方法。利用美国上市公司的历史网站数据构建该度量，通过将其与现有的披露度量和信息不对称度量进行相关性验证，并探讨其决定因素。随后，将该度量应用于研究美国私营公司的披露情况以及法国公司对非金融披露规定的遵守情况。应用表明，基于网站的披露度量能够有效补充现有主要关注公开资本市场投资者需求的披露度量。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用公司网站数据构建披露度量，补充了传统度量方法的不足，并验证了其在不同情境下的有效性。

title: Option Pricing with Time-Varying Volatility Risk Aversion
abstract: We introduce a pricing kernel with time-varying volatility risk aversion to explain the observed time variations in the shape of the pricing kernel. When combined with the Heston-Nandi GARCH model, this framework yields a tractable option pricing model in which the variance risk ratio (VRR) emerges as a key variable. We show that the VRR is closely linked to economic fundamentals, as well as sentiment and uncertainty measures. A novel approximation method provides analytical option pricing formulas, and we demonstrate substantial reductions in pricing errors through an empirical application to the S&P 500 index, the CBOE VIX, and option prices.
summary: 本文引入一个具有时变波动率风险厌恶的定价核，以解释观测到的定价核形状的时变特征。当与Heston-Nandi GARCH模型结合时，该框架产生一个易处理的期权定价模型，其中方差风险比率（VRR）成为关键变量。研究表明，VRR与经济基本面以及情绪和不确定性指标紧密相关。通过一种新颖的近似方法，推导出解析的期权定价公式，并通过S&P 500指数、CBOE VIX和期权价格的实证应用，展示了定价误差的大幅降低。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入时变波动率风险厌恶的定价核，创新性地将VRR作为关键变量，实现了对定价核形状时变性的解释，并通过解析公式和实证显著降低了定价误差。

title: Adverse Selection in Mortgage Markets: Evidence from Ginnie Mae Early Buyouts
abstract: This article documents adverse selection in Ginnie Mae issuers’ early buyout decisions. Conditional on default, we find a 1 percentage point increase in interest rate spread increases the probability of an early buyout by 7–9 percentage points. Issuers buy out higher interest rate spread loans because they generate greater economic gains when they reperform. We illustrate how issuers acquire private soft information that provides direct insight into the likelihood of reperformance. Although the soft information is ostensibly collected on behalf of investors during the delinquent loan servicing process, issuers can exploit the information in their early buyout decisions.
summary: 本文利用Ginnie Mae发行人的早期买断决策数据，实证研究了抵押贷款市场中的逆向选择问题。研究发现，在贷款违约的情况下，利率差每增加1个百分点，发行人进行早期买断的概率会增加7-9个百分点。发行人更倾向于买断利率差较高的贷款，因为这些贷款在重新履约时能产生更大的经济收益。研究进一步揭示了发行人如何通过获取私人软信息（在违约贷款服务过程中收集，表面上是为投资者服务）来直接了解贷款重新履约的可能性，并利用这些软信息优化其早期买断决策，从而加剧逆向选择。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的Ginnie Mae早期买断场景，实证揭示了发行人利用服务过程中获取的软信息进行逆向选择的机制，为抵押贷款市场的信息不对称问题提供了新的微观证据。

title: Impediments to the Schumpeterian Process in the Replacement of Large Firms
abstract: We use newly assembled data overall encompassing up to 75 countries and starting circa 1910, to study impediments to the Schumpeterian process of creative destruction as it “proceeds by competitively destroying old businesses.” Political connections appear to represent an obstacle to the destructive part of the Schumpeterian process in the replacement of large firms. When accompanied by regulations that restrict entry, political connections can play a role in allowing large firms to remain large. When connected to Fogel, Morck, and Yeung (2008, Journal of Financial Economics 89, 83–108), the results imply that political connections, combined with barriers to entry, can retard economic development.
summary: 本文利用新收集的数据（涵盖多达75个国家，起始于约1910年）研究阻碍熊彼特创造性破坏过程（即通过竞争性摧毁旧企业来发展）的因素。研究发现，政治关联是阻碍大公司替代过程中创造性破坏破坏部分的一个障碍。当政治关联与限制进入的法规相结合时，会使得大公司得以长期保持其规模。结合Fogel, Morck和Yeung (2008)的研究，结果表明政治关联与进入壁垒共同作用会阻碍经济发展。
ai_comment: 该研究利用跨越一个世纪、多国数据，揭示了政治关联与政策环境交互作用对经济发展的长期影响，为理解制度性障碍提供了宝贵证据。

title: Superstar Returns? Spatial Heterogeneity in Returns to Housing
abstract: This paper makes the first comprehensive attempt to study within‐country heterogeneity of housing returns. We introduce a new city‐level data set covering 15 OECD countries over 150 years and show that national housing markets are characterized by systematic spatial variation in housing returns. Total returns in large agglomerations are close to 100 basis points lower per year than in other parts of the same country. Excess returns outside the large cities can be rationalized as compensation for higher risk, especially higher covariance with income growth and lower liquidity. Real estate in diversified large agglomerations is comparatively safe.
summary: 本文首次系统性地研究住房回报的国内异质性。作者引入了一个涵盖15个OECD国家、150年城市层面数据的新数据集，发现国家住房市场存在系统性的空间变异：大城市的总回报每年比同一国家其他地区低约100个基点。大城市以外地区的超额回报可被解释为对更高风险的补偿，特别是对收入增长更高协方差和更低流动性的补偿。多元化大城市的房地产相对安全。
ai_comment: 该研究利用长期跨国数据揭示了住房回报的空间模式及其风险解释，为理解房地产市场异质性提供了新视角。

title: Arbitrage Capital of Global Banks
abstract: We study the impact of the U.S. money market fund reform implemented in October 2016 on global banks' funding supply and business activities. We show that the reform induced a large negative wholesale funding shock for global banks. In contrast to the conventional bank lending channel, the primary response of global banks to the reform was a cutback in arbitrage positions that relied on unsecured funding, rather than a reduction in loan provision. We discuss the role of postcrisis liquidity regulations and unconventional monetary policy in explaining our findings, and implications for banks' business models and deposit competition.
summary: 本文研究了2016年10月美国货币市场基金改革对全球银行融资供给和业务活动的影响。改革对全球银行造成了巨大的批发融资负面冲击。与传统银行信贷渠道相反，全球银行对改革的主要反应是削减依赖无担保融资的套利头寸，而不是减少贷款发放。文章讨论了后危机流动性监管和非常规货币政策在解释这些发现中的作用，以及对银行业务模式和存款竞争的影响。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了监管改革通过套利活动而非传统信贷渠道对银行行为产生影响，挑战了传统银行信贷渠道的认知。

title: The Impact of the Financial Education of Executives on the Financial Practices of Medium and Large Enterprises
abstract: We study the impact of an MBA‐style executive education course in finance on corporate policies and firm performance targeting top managers of medium and large Mozambican enterprises. Using a randomized controlled trial, we find that the educational treatment induces changes in financial policies that improve firm performance. Specifically, a reduction in working capital (0.4 to 0.5 standard deviations) increases cash flow, and in turn long‐term investments. This effect operates primarily through a reduction in accounts receivable (0.4 to 1 standard deviations). Our findings show that targeted educational interventions can build managerial capital and enhance corporate performance by improving financial decision making among executives.
summary: 本文通过随机对照试验，研究针对莫桑比克大中型企业高管的MBA式金融教育课程对公司财务政策和业绩的影响。结果表明，该教育干预促使高管改变财务政策，改善了企业业绩：具体而言，营运资本减少0.4至0.5个标准差，从而增加了现金流，进而促进了长期投资。这一效果主要通过减少应收账款（0.4至1个标准差）实现。研究发现，针对性的教育干预能够通过改善高管的财务决策来建立管理资本并提升企业绩效。
ai_comment: 该研究采用随机对照试验方法，为高管金融教育的因果效应提供了严谨证据，尤其在新兴市场背景下具有重要实践意义。

title: Learning About Directors
abstract: This article studies the importance of corporate boards through a learning model in which capital markets learn about incoming directors’ quality. The model’s predictions are tested across a large sample of director appointments. Estimates show that governance-related uncertainty accounts for about 10% of stock return volatility when a new director joins. The learning framework provides a theoretically grounded approach to identify when directors matter more to investors. The analysis shows that director importance varies with board composition and firm attributes: Investors perceive directors as more important on boards with greater generational diversity, in smaller firms, and firms with higher knowledge capital.
summary: 本文通过一个学习模型研究公司董事会的重要性，其中资本市场会学习新任董事的质量。基于大量董事任命样本检验模型预测，估计显示与治理相关的不确定性约占新董事加入时股票回报波动的10%。该学习框架提供了一种理论依据来识别董事何时对投资者更为重要。分析表明，董事的重要性随董事会构成和公司属性而变化：投资者认为董事在代际多样性更大的董事会、规模较小的公司以及知识资本较高的公司中更为重要。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将学习模型应用于董事会研究，量化了治理不确定性对股价波动的贡献，并揭示了董事重要性的情境依赖特征，为理解公司治理的市场影响提供了新视角。

title: Labor Market Power and Financial Leverage: Evidence from Online Job Postings
abstract: Using the near universe of online job postings from 2007 to 2021, we construct a firm-level metric of labor market power. We find that firms with higher labor market power tend to have higher financial leverage. Our findings are not driven by product market competition or correlated labor market characteristics. The evidence is less pronounced among firms hiring in occupations with high labor mobility and skill transferability. To establish causality, we exploit the establishment of Amazon HQ2 in Crystal City as a shock to the labor market power of local firms and show consistent findings with our baseline results.
summary: 本文利用2007至2021年几乎全部在线招聘数据，构建了企业层面的劳动力市场势力指标。研究发现，劳动力市场势力越强的企业，其财务杠杆水平越高。该结论不受产品市场竞争或劳动力市场相关特征的影响。在雇佣高劳动力流动性和技能可转移性职业的企业中，这一效应较弱。为建立因果关系，本文利用亚马逊第二总部（Amazon HQ2）选址于水晶城（Crystal City）作为对当地企业劳动力市场势力的冲击，得到了与基准结果一致的证据。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用在线招聘大数据构建劳动力市场势力指标，并揭示了其与财务杠杆的正向关系，为劳动经济学与公司金融交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: Baby Booms and Asset Booms: Demographic Change and the Housing Market
abstract: Based on centuries of data, we demonstrate that demographics have been a major, predictable driver of house prices. High birth rates 25 to 29 (60 to 64) years ago predict declining (rising) rent‐price ratios today. This pattern arises from age‐concentrated entry into and exit from homeownership affecting house prices, rather than changes in housing consumption that could also impact rents. We provide evidence for possible mechanisms: slow responses of other market participants to shifts in homeownership demand, and geographic segmentation between rental and owner‐occupied markets. Evidence for age‐dependent demand effects on yields of bonds and stocks is significantly weaker.
summary: 本研究利用数百年的数据，论证了人口结构是房价的主要且可预测的驱动因素。具体而言，25至29年前的高出生率预示着当前租金-价格比的下降，而60至64年前的高出生率则预示着其上升。这一模式源于年龄集中进入和退出住房所有权对房价的影响，而非同时可能影响租金的住房消费变化。本文还提供了可能的机制证据：其他市场参与者对住房所有权需求变化的缓慢反应，以及租赁市场和自有住房市场之间的地理分割。相比之下，年龄依赖需求对债券和股票收益的影响明显较弱。
ai_comment: 该论文运用长达数百年的数据，创新性地揭示了出生率对房价的长期预测能力，并区分了住房所有权需求与消费变化的影响，为人口经济学与资产定价领域提供了重要实证证据。

title: Persuading Investors: A Video‐Based Study
abstract: Persuasive communication functions through not only content but also delivery—facial expression, tone of voice, and diction. This paper examines the persuasiveness of delivery in startup pitches. Using machine learning algorithms to process full pitch videos, we quantify persuasion in visual, vocal, and verbal dimensions. We find that positive (i.e., passionate, warm) pitches increase funding probability. However, conditional on funding, startups with higher levels of pitch positivity underperform. Women are more heavily judged on delivery when evaluated in single‐gender teams, but they are neglected when copitching in mixed‐gender teams. Using an experiment, we show that persuasion delivery works mainly through leading investors to form inaccurate beliefs.
summary: 本文研究初创企业路演中说服性沟通的传达方式（面部表情、语调、措辞）对融资的影响。通过机器学习算法处理完整路演视频，量化视觉、声音和语言维度的说服力。主要发现：积极（热情、温暖）的路演能增加融资概率，但获得融资后，路演积极性更高的初创企业表现不佳。女性在单一性别团队中更易因传达方式受到评判，但在混合性别团队中共同路演时则被忽视。实验表明，说服传达主要通过引导投资者形成不准确的信念来起作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用机器学习量化投资者说服的多个维度，并揭示了传达方式与融资后表现的负相关，对性别偏见在融资中的调节作用提供了新证据。

title: Freedom of Expression Protection and Corporate Concealment of Bad News: Evidence from State Anti‐SLAPP Laws
abstract: The protection of free speech enhances the ability of various public stakeholders to disseminate privately observed adverse information about public firms, making it difficult for corporate managers to conceal negative information about their companies. Using the staggered enactment of anti‐strategic lawsuit against public participation (anti‐SLAPP) laws across U.S. states as a shock that strengthens free speech protection, we show that stronger protection is associated with less concealment of bad news. This is evidenced by a lower likelihood of stock price crashes, a decreased probability of accounting fraud, and an increased frequency of firm‐initiated negative press releases. These results are more pronounced for states with stronger anti‐SLAPP laws and where such laws are likely to be more influential. Moreover, the impact of free speech protection on bad news concealment is more significant for firms with greater ex ante incentives to conceal negative information. Further analyses suggest that free speech protection likely enhances the ability of short sellers, employees, and the media, among others, to reveal bad news about public firms. Finally, we find evidence that strengthened free speech protection also improves financial reporting quality. Our study highlights the importance of free speech protection in enhancing corporate transparency.
summary: 本文利用美国各州交错实施反战略诉讼参与（anti-SLAPP）法案作为增强言论自由保护的外生冲击，检验言论自由保护对公司隐藏坏消息行为的影响。研究发现，更强的言论自由保护显著降低了公司隐藏坏消息的程度，表现为更低的股价崩盘风险、更低的会计欺诈概率以及更频繁的公司主动发布负面新闻。这种影响在anti-SLAPP法律更强、法律潜在影响力更大的州更为显著；对于事前有更强隐藏负面信息动机的公司，效果也更为明显。机制分析表明，言论自由保护增强了做空者、员工和媒体等外部利益相关者向公众揭示上市公司负面信息的能力。此外，更强的言论自由保护还提升了财务报告质量。研究强调了言论自由保护在促进公司透明度方面的重要作用。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生政策冲击识别因果关系，为言论自由保护与公司透明度之间的正向关联提供了可靠证据，拓展了法与金融领域的研究。

title: Amendment Thresholds and Voting Rules in Debt Contracts
abstract: Most loan contracts in the United States contain a provision for lender voting rules. We study the optimal voting rule that allows lenders to waive a covenant violation. When lenders have heterogeneous preferences, lenient voting rules increase the probability of waivers that allow inefficient investments. Stringent voting rules tend to allocate the marginal vote to lenders who deny waivers after false alarms so that they can renegotiate the loan to extract value from the firm, which incurs deadweight costs. In equilibrium, the optimal voting rule balances these two forces to improve contracting efficiency. We derive and empirically test comparative statics on how the optimal voting rule varies with lenders’ preferences and the borrower's accounting properties. Our model offers a rationale for the prevalent use of voting rule clauses in syndicated loan contracts.
summary: 本文研究美国贷款合同中普遍存在的贷款人投票规则条款，旨在探讨允许贷款人豁免契约违反的最优投票规则。当贷款人偏好异质时，宽松的投票规则会增加豁免概率，从而允许低效投资；而严格的投票规则则倾向于将边际投票分配给那些在错误警报后拒绝豁免的贷款人，以便他们通过重新谈判从公司提取价值，但会产生无谓成本。均衡状态下，最优投票规则平衡这两种力量以提高合同效率。作者推导并实证检验了最优投票规则如何随贷款人偏好和借款人会计属性变化的比较静态结果。该模型为辛迪加贷款合同中广泛使用投票规则条款提供了理论依据。
ai_comment: 该论文为辛迪加贷款中投票规则条款的普遍存在提供了严密的理论解释，并通过比较静态分析揭示了其与贷款人偏好及借款人特征的关系，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Does Foreign Investors’ Information Access Vary with Geopolitical Tensions? Evidence from Corporate Conference Calls
abstract: We study how foreign investors’ access to corporate information varies with pairwise geopolitical tensions between the investor's and investee's countries. Using a sample of 1,760 country‐pairs, we find that geopolitical tensions between a conference call host firm's country and a foreign country relate negatively with investor participation from that foreign country as well as the quality and tone of management responses in the call, suggesting reduced foreign investor information access with rising tensions. A single‐country analysis of Chinese AB‐share firms produces similar inferences. With higher China–foreign tensions, foreign attendance at private meetings with management declines, and English translations of local language disclosures become less frequent and shorter in length. Curtailment in English translations is more pronounced when local language disclosures contain politically sensitive words, suggesting lower information supply by firm choice. Reduced disclosures from geopolitical tensions are impounded in foreign investors’ asset pricing decisions, resulting in steeper foreign‐share price discounts.
summary: 本文研究国家间地缘政治紧张如何影响外国投资者获取公司信息。基于1760个国家对样本，发现电话会议主办国与外国之间的地缘政治紧张与外国投资者参会率、管理层回答质量和语气呈负相关，表明紧张加剧降低了外国投资者信息获取。对中国AB股公司的单国分析得出一致结论：中外关系紧张时，外国投资者参加私人会议减少，本地语言披露的英文翻译频率降低且篇幅缩短，尤其在本地语言含政治敏感词时更显著。公司因紧张减少的信息披露反映在外资资产定价决策中，导致外资股价折扣加大。
ai_comment: 创新性地将地缘政治因素纳入公司信息获取微观分析，利用电话会议和翻译数据提供了跨国层面与公司层面证据，对理解国际投资信息摩擦有重要意义。

title: When Financial Advice Leads to Positive Performance: Evidence from Repeated Client–Advisor Interactions
abstract: Does the performance of advisors’ recommendations influence investors’ propensity to seek advice again? I investigate a sample of calls between 10,063 German brokerage clients and financial advisors from 2005–2015. If advisors’ recommendations in the initial meeting led to positive (vs. negative) performance, investors are 2.1 times more likely to arrange a second meeting. This effect is driven by the performance of the recommendations the investor decided to follow. Investors with positive performance follow recommendations to a greater degree. The findings show that experiences matter in the advisory context and shape the demand for advice.
summary: 这篇论文研究了金融顾问的建议表现如何影响投资者再次寻求建议的倾向。基于2005年至2015年间德国10,063名经纪客户与金融顾问的通话样本，发现如果初次会面中顾问的建议带来正收益（相对于负收益），投资者安排第二次会面的可能性是2.1倍。这一效应主要由投资者实际遵循的建议表现所驱动，且正收益的投资者会更多地遵循建议。结果表明，经验在顾问关系中至关重要，并塑造了投资者对建议的需求。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的通话数据，揭示了投资者基于顾问建议的实际表现动态调整后续咨询需求，为理解金融顾问市场的反馈机制提供了重要证据。

title: Household Portfolios and Retirement Saving over the Life Cycle
abstract: Using account‐level data on millions of U.S. middle‐class investors over 2006 to 2018, we characterize the share of investable wealth that they hold in the stock market over their working lives. Relative to the 1990s, this share has both risen by 10% and become age‐dependent. The Pension Protection Act (PPA)—which allowed target date funds (TDFs) to be default options in retirement plans—played an important role: younger (older) workers starting at a firm after TDFs became the default option post‐PPA invested more (less) in stocks, in line with the TDF glidepath. In contrast, contribution rates changed little following the PPA.
summary: 本文利用2006年至2018年间数百万美国中产阶级投资者的账户级数据，刻画了其工作生涯中持有股票的可投资财富份额。与1990年代相比，这一份额上升了10%，且呈现年龄依赖性。《养老金保护法案》（PPA）——该法案允许目标日期基金（TDFs）作为退休计划的默认选项——发挥了重要作用：在PPA之后，当TDFs成为默认选项后，年轻（年长）员工在新入职公司时，股票投资比例增加（减少），与TDF的滑行路径一致。相比之下，PPA后缴费率变化不大。
ai_comment: 本文利用大样本账户级数据，揭示了政策变化（PPA）如何通过默认选项机制影响家庭资产配置的生命周期模式，对理解退休储蓄行为有重要贡献。

title: Do Shared Auditors Facilitate Follow‐on Innovation?
abstract: We investigate whether shared auditors promote the dissemination of innovative knowledge among their clients, thereby fostering follow‐on innovation. We find that a company cites more patents from another company when they are audited by the same audit office. To address concerns about potential confounding factors stemming from commonalities in the fundamentals of the two companies, we leverage a quasi‐exogenous shock to auditor sharing: the demise of Arthur Andersen and the subsequent increase in auditor switching in 2002. Further analysis reveals that the effect of a shared auditor on cross‐client patent citations is stronger when both clients engage in intensive innovation activities. Additional evidence suggests that shared auditors exert more influence on the citations of recent patents and patents that are easier for outsiders to utilize. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors affect corporate innovation by facilitating the transfer of innovative knowledge among their clients.
summary: 本文研究共享审计师是否促进客户企业间的创新知识传播，从而推动后续创新。通过分析专利引用数据，发现当两家公司由同一审计办公室审计时，前一家公司的专利被后一家公司引用的次数更多。为排除公司基本面相似性等混淆因素，利用安达信倒闭及其引发的2002年审计师变更潮作为准外生冲击。进一步分析表明，当两家客户都进行密集创新活动时，共享审计师对跨客户专利引用的促进作用更强；此外，共享审计师对近期专利和易于被外部利用的专利引用影响更大。总体结论是，审计师通过促进客户间创新知识转移，影响了企业创新。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验识别了审计师在创新知识扩散中的因果作用，为审计师的经济后果提供了新证据，并揭示了知识溢出的微观机制。

title: Institutional Cross-Ownership of Peer Firms and Revelatory Price Efficiency
abstract: We argue that cross-ownership increases the amount of private information in stock prices, enhancing the ability of stock prices to provide feedback to managers. Consistent with this argument, we find greater cross-ownership heightens a firm’s investment- q sensitivity. This effect is stronger for firms with a lower propensity for voluntary disclosure and for firms whose managers hold less private information. Furthermore, we find that cross-ownership is negatively associated with the sensitivity of a firm’s investment to its peers’ stock prices. Additionally, cross-ownership has a stronger impact on the investment- q sensitivity when measured among investors who trade more actively in the firm’s shares. By using financial institution mergers as an identification strategy, we strengthen the causal inference. Overall, our results suggest that cross-ownership helps increase revelatory price efficiency (RPE), potentially leading to more efficient corporate decisions.
summary: 本文研究机构交叉持股对股票价格中私有信息量及反馈效应的影响。作者认为交叉持股增加了股票价格中的私有信息量，从而增强股票价格对管理者决策的反馈作用。实证发现：交叉持股提高了公司投资对托宾q的敏感性（投资-q敏感性），且该效应在自愿披露倾向较低或经理人持有私有信息较少的公司中更为显著；此外，交叉持股降低了公司投资对其同行股票价格的敏感性。当以更积极交易公司股票的投资者衡量时，交叉持股对投资-q敏感性的正向影响更强。通过利用金融机构合并作为外生冲击进行因果识别，进一步支持了因果推断。总体结果表明，交叉持股有助于提高揭示性价格效率，可能促使公司决策更加有效。
ai_comment: 本文通过精巧的因果识别策略，揭示了交叉持股通过提升价格信息含量改善公司投资效率的机制，丰富了市场微观结构与公司金融交叉领域的研究。

title: Gender Pay Gap and Cultural Values
abstract: Employing a cross-country sample, we examine how a population’s underlying cultural values help explain gender compensation variation across corporate executives. The results show that the cultural differences, embedded in societies long before the board’s compensation decisions, have significant explanatory power for the observed gender gap in executive compensation. Using an Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition combined with variables previously shown to be fundamental determinants of executive compensation, we find that adding cultural measures increases the model’s explanatory power of the gender compensation gap from 44% to 95%. We use further identification strategies to support causal inference.
summary: 该论文利用跨国样本，研究社会文化价值观如何解释企业高管中的性别薪酬差异。研究发现，早在董事会做出薪酬决策之前就已根植于社会中的文化差异，对高管薪酬性别差距具有显著的解释力。通过Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法，结合先前被证明是高管薪酬基本决定因素的变量，加入文化指标后，模型对性别薪酬差距的解释力从44%提升至95%。研究还采用进一步识别策略支持因果推断。
ai_comment: 该研究通过引入文化价值观变量，显著提升了对高管性别薪酬差异的解释力，强调了文化因素在薪酬不平等中的重要作用。

title: Banking on Competition: The Spillover Effects of Bank Entry into Microfinance
abstract: This article examines how the entry of commercial lenders (CLs) transforms microfinance markets, focusing on borrower outcomes and market-wide spillovers. Using detailed credit registry data, we show that increased competition improves loan terms for both graduating and staying borrowers, generating sustained benefits. Our setting also allows us to document what happens when entry fails and entrants retreat following a crisis. Despite increasing defaults, borrowers who graduate to banks experience long-term gains, particularly through lower borrowing costs. Our findings highlight the broader benefits and risks of fostering competition in microfinance, providing valuable insights for policymakers and financial inclusion initiatives.
summary: 本文研究商业贷款机构进入小额信贷市场如何改变市场格局，重点关注借款人结果和市场范围的溢出效应。利用详细的信用登记数据，研究发现竞争加剧改善了贷款条件，对毕业借款人（转向银行）和留守借款人均产生持续收益。同时，该研究还记录了进入失败的情况，即进入者在危机后退出市场。尽管违约率上升，但毕业至银行的借款人获得了长期收益，尤其体现在更低的借贷成本上。这些发现揭示了在小额信贷领域促进竞争的更广泛收益和风险，为政策制定者和金融包容性倡议提供了有价值的见解。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的信用登记数据，同时考察了商业贷款机构进入成功与失败的情境，为理解小额信贷市场竞争的双刃剑效应提供了全面视角。

title: Mutual Fund Trading, Fund Flows, and ESG Portfolios
abstract: This article studies how ESG and conventional mutual funds trade stocks during the COVID-19 crash. Both fund types trade individual stocks similarly: Net purchases of ESG stocks are less sensitive than other stocks to fund flows pre-crash, but sensitivities increase for all stocks during the crash. In contrast, ESG funds’ aggregate net purchases are less sensitive than those of conventional funds during the crash. This difference is due to ESG funds’ portfolio tilt toward the less flow-sensitive ESG stocks. There is no evidence of an ESG clientele effect in trading decisions, as both fund types trade individual stocks similarly.
summary: 本文研究ESG和传统共同基金在COVID-19危机期间如何交易股票。两种基金类型对个股的交易行为相似：危机前，ESG股票的净买入对资金流的敏感度低于其他股票，但在危机期间所有股票的敏感度均上升。然而，ESG基金的总净买入在危机期间对资金流的敏感度低于传统基金，这种差异源于ESG基金的组合倾向于持有对资金流敏感度较低的ESG股票。没有证据表明交易决策中存在ESG客户效应，因为两种基金对个股的交易方式相似。
ai_comment: 本文利用COVID-19危机作为外生冲击，巧妙区分了客户效应与组合构成对基金交易行为的影响，为理解ESG基金的资金流敏感度提供了新证据。

title: Tail Risk Around FOMC Announcements
abstract: Predictive regressions of market returns on option-implied moments measured before pre-scheduled FOMC meetings show that tail risks play an important role in understanding the market risk premium around FOMC announcement days. Skewness and kurtosis, which capture investors’ expectations of the tails of the return distribution, robustly predict post-FOMC returns both in-sample and out-of-sample. The predictability lasts up to 1 week and is stronger for expansionary monetary policy shocks. The signs of the corresponding risk premiums are consistent with economic intuition, illustrating the role of periods with high risk premiums to confirm theoretical predictions.
summary: 论文研究在预先安排的FOMC会议前，基于期权隐含矩度量的尾部风险对市场回报的预测能力。通过预测回归发现，偏度和峰度（捕捉投资者对收益分布尾部预期）能够稳健预测FOMC公告后的市场回报，无论是样本内还是样本外。这种预测性持续长达一周，并且在扩张性货币政策冲击下更为显著。风险溢价的符号与经济学直觉一致，表明高风险溢价时期在验证理论预测中的重要性。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙结合期权隐含矩与货币政策事件，为尾部风险定价提供了新证据，并揭示了预测能力的非对称性（扩张性冲击更强），对理解宏观政策与市场风险关系有重要贡献。

title: Optimal Portfolio Choice with Fat Tails and Parameter Uncertainty
abstract: Existing portfolio combination rules that optimize the out-of-sample performance under parameter uncertainty assume multivariate normally distributed returns.
