However, we show that this assumption is not innocuous because fat tails in returns lead to poorer out-of-sample performance of the sample mean–variance and sample global minimum-variance (GMV) portfolios relative to normality. Consequently, when returns are fat-tailed, portfolio combination rules should allocate less to the sample mean–variance and sample GMV portfolios, and more to the risk-free asset, than the normality assumption prescribes. Empirical evidence shows that accounting for fat tails in the construction of optimal portfolio combination rules significantly improves their out-of-sample performance.
summary: 现有投资组合组合规则在参数不确定性下优化样本外表现时，通常假设多元正态分布。本文证明这一假设并非无害，因为肥尾分布会导致样本均值-方差组合和样本全局最小方差组合的样本外表现较差。因此，当收益具有肥尾特征时，组合规则应分配更少权重给样本均值-方差和GMV组合，更多权重给无风险资产。实证证据表明，在构建最优组合规则时考虑肥尾能显著提升样本外表现。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了正态分布假设在肥尾情况下的误导性，并提供了改进投资组合规则的实用建议，对金融实践具有重要指导意义。

title: Sentiment, Productivity, and Economic Growth
abstract: Earlier research finds correlation between sentiment and future economic growth, but disagrees on the channel that explains this result. We shed new light on this issue by exploiting cross-sectional variation in country size and market efficiency. We find that sentiment shocks in the largest advanced economies increase economic activity, but only temporarily and without affecting productivity. Conversely, sentiment shocks in smaller or less advanced economies predict prolonged economic growth and a corresponding increase in productivity. The results support the view that sentiment can create economic booms, although only in economies where sentiment and fundamentals are harder to disentangle.
summary: 早期的研究发现情绪与未来经济增长之间存在相关性，但对于解释这一结果的渠道存在分歧。本文通过利用国家规模和市场效率的横截面差异来揭示新见解。研究发现，在最大的发达经济体中，情绪冲击会暂时增加经济活动，但不影响生产率。相反，在较小或欠发达经济体中，情绪冲击则预示着长期的经济增长以及相应的生产率提高。这些结果支持了情绪可以创造经济繁荣的观点，但仅限于那些情绪与基本面难以区分的经济体。
ai_comment: 本文通过横截面差异揭示了情绪影响经济增长的不同渠道，为理解情绪在经济中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Index Investing and Asset Pricing Under Information Asymmetry and Ambiguity Aversion
abstract: In a setting with a tradable value-weighted market index, ambiguity-averse investors do not trade, and the index is not mean–variance efficient. But when a passive fund offers the risk-adjusted market portfolio ( RAMP ), whose weights depend on information precision as well as market values, investors share risk via index investing and effectively hold the same portfolios as in the economy without model uncertainty. This follows from a new Information Separation Theorem : equilibrium portfolios are the sum of RAMP , which is the optimal portfolio conditional on public information, and their optimal private-information-based portfolios. RAMP is in equilibrium mean–variance efficient.
summary: 这篇论文研究了在存在可交易价值加权市场指数、信息不对称和模糊厌恶的环境下，指数投资与资产定价的关系。当投资者为模糊厌恶时，他们不交易，且传统价值加权指数并非均值方差有效。然而，当引入一种被动基金，提供基于信息精度和市场价值的风险调整市场组合（RAMP）时，投资者能够通过指数投资分担风险，实际上持有与没有模型不确定性经济中相同的投资组合。这一结论源于新提出的信息分离定理：均衡投资组合是RAMP（基于公共信息的最优组合）与基于私有信息的最优组合之和。RAMP在均衡中是均值方差有效的。
ai_comment: 该论文通过提出RAMP和信息分离定理，为模糊厌恶下的指数投资效率提供了新的理论解释，具有重要的理论贡献。

title: Options on Interbank Rates and Implied Disaster Risk
abstract: The identification of disaster risk has remained a significant challenge due to the rarity of macroeconomic disasters. We show that the interbank market can help characterize the time variation in disaster risk. We propose a risk-based model in which macroeconomic disasters are likely to coincide with interbank market failure. Using interbank rates and their options, we estimate our model via maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) and filter the short-run and long-run components of disaster risk. Our estimation results are independent of the stock market and serve as an external validity test of rare disaster models, which are typically calibrated to match stock moments.
summary: 该论文旨在解决宏观经济灾难风险识别困难的问题，提出银行间市场能够帮助刻画灾难风险的时变特征。作者构建了一个基于风险的模型，假设宏观经济灾难与银行间市场失灵同时发生。利用银行间利率及其期权数据，通过最大似然估计（MLE）估计模型，并过滤出灾难风险的短期和长期成分。估计结果独立于股票市场，从而为通常校准以匹配股票矩的罕见灾难模型提供了外部有效性检验。
ai_comment: 本文的创新之处在于利用银行间市场数据对罕见灾难风险进行分离和外部验证，独立于股票市场提供了新视角，增强了罕见灾难模型的稳健性。

title: Investor Factors
abstract: This paper develops an empirical methodology for extracting pricing factors from investor portfolio data. We apply this approach to the stockholdings of Norwegian individual investors from 1997 to 2017. A two‐factor model, featuring the market portfolio and a long‐short portfolio constructed from the holdings of investors sorted by age or wealth, explains both the common variation in portfolio holdings and the cross section of stock returns. Portfolio tilts toward the long‐short investor factor correlate with indebtedness, macroeconomic exposure, gender, and investment experience. Our paper illustrates the benefits of using holdings data for explaining the risk premia of financial assets.
summary: 本文提出了一种从投资者组合数据中提取定价因子的实证方法，并将其应用于1997-2017年间挪威个人投资者的股票持有数据。研究发现，一个包含市场组合和按年龄或财富排序投资者构建的多空组合的两因子模型，能够同时解释组合持有中的共同变动和股票收益的横截面差异。此外，投资者组合向多空投资者因子的倾斜与负债、宏观经济暴露、性别和投资经验相关。论文展示了使用持股数据解释金融资产风险溢价的好处。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地从投资者实际持股数据中提取定价因子，揭示了投资者人口统计特征与资产定价的关系，为因子研究提供了新视角。

title: Failure to Share Natural Disaster Risk
abstract: I test whether asset prices reflect risk exposures of financial intermediaries in a setting well-suited to tackling concerns about omitted risk factors. I analyze catastrophe bonds whose cash flows are linked to natural disasters and find that 71% of the security-level variation in expected returns can be explained by a theoretically motivated measure of intermediaries’ marginal utility. Assuming natural disasters are independent of aggregate wealth, this result is inconsistent with any alternative explanation based on unobserved macroeconomic risks. In addition, the aggregate premium decreases and becomes less sensitive to the occurrence of disasters when intermediaries’ access to outside capital improves.
summary: 本文利用巨灾债券（其现金流与自然灾害挂钩）来检验资产价格是否反映金融中介的风险敞口，这一设置有助于排除遗漏风险因子的担忧。研究发现，71%的证券层面预期收益变化可以由一个理论驱动的中介边际效用指标解释。假设自然灾害与总财富独立，这一结果与任何基于未观测宏观经济风险的替代解释不一致。此外，当中介获得外部资本的渠道改善时，总溢价下降且对灾害发生敏感度降低。
ai_comment: 该论文利用巨灾债券这一独特数据，有效排除了遗漏风险因子的干扰，为中介资产定价理论提供了有力证据。

title: Segmented Arbitrage
abstract: We use arbitrage activity in equity, fixed income, and foreign exchange markets to characterize the frictions and constraints facing intermediaries. The average pairwise correlation between the 32 arbitrage spreads that we study is 22%. These low correlations are inconsistent with canonical intermediary asset pricing models. We show that at least two types of segmentation drive arbitrage dynamics. First, funding is segmented—certain trades rely on specific funding sources, making their arbitrage spreads sensitive to localized funding shocks. Second, balance sheets are segmented—intermediaries specialize in certain trades, so arbitrage spreads are sensitive to idiosyncratic balance‐sheet shocks.
summary: 本文利用股票、固定收益和外汇市场中的套利活动来刻画金融中介面临的摩擦与约束。作者研究了32个套利价差，发现其平均成对相关性仅为22%，远低于经典中介资产定价模型的预测。进一步分析表明，套利动态至少受两种类型的分割驱动：一是资金分割，即某些交易依赖特定资金来源，导致套利价差对局部资金冲击敏感；二是资产负债表分割，即中介机构专注于特定交易，使得套利价差对特异的资产负债表冲击敏感。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证揭示套利活动中的分割现象，挑战了经典中介定价模型，为理解金融市场摩擦提供了新视角。

title: Paving the Road to the Buy‐Side
abstract: Sell‐side analysts commonly transition to buy‐side money managers. I examine whether and how these career transitions shape sell‐side analysts' behavior, relying on the granular career information of 6,310 analysts in the United States. I identify analysts who transition from the sell‐side to the buy‐side and find that these analysts issue inflated recommendations on stocks of interest to their future buy‐side employers. This favoritism is (1) present only during the year preceding their transition, (2) more pronounced among stocks where a single analyst is more influential in moving the stock price; and (3) present only among transitions likely to be strategically planned. Importantly, stocks receiving inflated recommendations experience a significant price decline following the departure of transitioning analysts from the sell‐side. Overall, these findings suggest that analyst career transitions are an important source of conflicts of interest.
summary: 基于美国6,310名分析师的详细职业信息，研究卖方分析师向买方转型如何影响其行为。识别出从卖方到买方的分析师后，发现他们会为未来雇主感兴趣的股票发布夸大的推荐。这种偏向仅出现在转型前一年，在单个分析师对股价影响更大的股票中更显著，并且仅存在于可能战略性计划的转型中。这些股票在转型分析师离开卖方后价格显著下跌。结论表明，分析师职业转型是利益冲突的重要来源。
ai_comment: 利用详尽的职业数据揭示了分析师转型过程中的利益冲突，为理解分析师行为偏差提供了新证据，具有较强的实证贡献。

title: Establishment of National Public Audit Oversight Boards: Descriptive Evidence and Implications for Audit Quality
abstract: We investigate the establishment of public audit oversight bodies (POBs) worldwide. We present descriptive evidence on POBs’ characteristics and factors influencing the timing of their establishment, finding that countries with stronger institutions, civil law traditions, and higher media attention to audit quality adopt POBs faster. While countries may choose similar POB design features, these choices do not align with the factors driving adoption speed. We also explore whether the finding of a positive impact on audit quality of the U.S. PCAOB generalizes to other countries. A difference‐in‐differences analysis over 20 years provides some evidence that POB establishment and their characteristics improve audit quality. However, the results appear sensitive to audit quality measures and research design. Our study offers the first broad‐based investigation of POB adoption and provides important nuance on the relation between POBs and audit quality.
summary: 本文调查了全球公共审计监督机构（POBs）的建立。我们提供了关于POBs特征和影响其建立时机的因素的描述性证据，发现制度更完善、采用大陆法系传统以及媒体对审计质量关注度更高的国家更快地采纳了POBs。尽管国家可能选择相似的POB设计特征，但这些选择与推动采用速度的因素并不一致。我们还探讨了美国PCAOB对审计质量的积极影响是否适用于其他国家。一项跨越20年的双重差分分析提供了一些证据表明POBs的建立及其特征改善了审计质量，但结果对审计质量衡量指标和研究设计较为敏感。本研究首次对POBs的采用进行了广泛调查，并提供了关于POBs与审计质量关系的重要细微差别。
ai_comment: 首次全球范围研究审计监督机构建立的驱动因素及其对审计质量的影响，提供了跨国比较的细致视角，但需注意结果对衡量指标敏感。

title: Productivity and Wedges: Economic Convergence and the Real Exchange Rate
abstract: This paper explores the relationship between economic growth and the real exchange rate, specifically focusing on the convergence in price levels in Eastern European countries.While these countries have had significant convergence in GDP per capita (relative to the EU average) since the 1990s, convergence in real exchange rates for these countries stalled after the EU crisis.Using a standard theoretical framework, we estimate the main drivers of real exchange rates and show that a combination of productivity growth (Balassa-Samuelson effects) and labor market distortions help explain real exchange rate trends.We develop a structural two-country model that provides a rich decomposition of the long run determinants of the real exchange rate.Simulations based on observed sectoral productivities and labor market wedges show that the model can accurately account for the historical path of Eastern European real exchange rates, both before and after the EU crisis.
summary: 本文研究了经济增长与实际汇率的关系，重点关注东欧国家的价格水平收敛。尽管这些国家自1990年代以来人均GDP相对于欧盟平均水平显著收敛，但实际汇率收敛在欧盟危机后停滞。利用标准理论框架，估计了实际汇率的主要驱动因素，表明生产率增长（巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应）和劳动力市场扭曲的组合有助于解释实际汇率趋势。作者开发了一个结构性两国模型，提供了实际汇率长期决定因素的丰富分解。基于观察到的部门生产率和劳动力市场楔子的模拟显示，该模型能够准确解释东欧实际汇率在欧盟危机前后的历史路径。
ai_comment: 该文通过结构性模型分解实际汇率的长期决定因素，并成功模拟东欧国家的历史路径，为理解欧盟危机后实际汇率停滞提供了新视角。

title: How Retrainable are AI-Exposed Workers?
abstract: We document the extent to which workers in AI-exposed occupations can successfully retrain for AI-intensive work.We assemble a new workforce development dataset spanning over 1.6 million job training participation spells from all US Workforce Investment and Opportunity Act programs from 2012-2023 linked with occupational measures of AI exposure.Using earnings records observed before and after training, we compare high AI exposure trainees to a matched sample of similar workers who only received job search assistance.We find that the average earnings return to training among AI-exposed workers is high, around $1,470 per quarter.Low-exposure trainees capture higher returns, and trainees who target AI-intensive work face a 29% earnings return penalty relative to their high exposure peers who pursue more general training.We estimate that between 25% to 40% of occupations are "AI retrainable" as measured by its workers receiving higher pay for moving to more AI-intensive occupations-a large magnitude given the relatively low-income sample of displaced workers.Positive earnings returns in all groups are driven by the most recent years when labor markets were tightest, suggesting training programs may have stronger signal value when firms reach deeper into the skill market.
summary: 本文利用2012-2023年美国劳动力投资法案下超过160万次职业培训参与记录，结合职业AI暴露度量，比较了高AI暴露培训者与仅接受求职帮助的匹配样本的收益。研究发现，AI暴露工人培训的平均季度收益回报约为1470美元，但低暴露培训者的收益更高，而目标AI密集型工作的培训者相比追求一般培训的高暴露同行面临29%的收益惩罚。估计25%至40%的职业是“AI可再培训”的，即工人转向更AI密集型职业获得更高薪酬。所有组的正收益主要由近年劳动力市场紧张时期驱动，表明培训项目在劳动力需求强时信号价值更强。
ai_comment: 本文首次大规模量化AI暴露工人再培训的经济收益，并揭示目标AI密集型工作的收益惩罚，挑战了“培训转向AI领域”的直觉，对政策制定和职业培训设计有重要启示。

title: Practical Finance: An Approximate Solution to Lifecycle Portfolio Choice
abstract: Research on normative household financial choices almost always gives quantitative guidance in one of two forms: a simple formula for an unrealistic setting, or numerical solutions for only a few parameter sets in a realistic setting.We propose a middle-ground approach we call practical finance: analytic approximations to optimal solutions as a function of relevant parameters in realistic settings that are easily computed in a spreadsheet.We provide such an approximation for lifecycle portfolio choice with labor income.Across 5,103 parameter sets, our approximation results in welfare that is on average only 0.06% lower than that of the optimal solution.
summary: 关于规范性家庭金融选择的研究通常给出两种形式的量化指导：不切实际环境下的简单公式，或切合实际环境下的仅有少数参数集的数值解。本文提出一种折中方法，称为“实用金融”：在切合实际环境中，作为相关参数的函数，给出最优解的解析近似，且易于在电子表格中计算。作者为带有劳动收入的终身投资组合选择提供了这种近似。在5103个参数集上，该近似解的福利损失平均仅为最优解的0.06%。
keywords: 生命周期投资组合选择
ai_comment: 该方法在计算简便性和精确度之间取得了良好平衡，具有实际应用价值。

title: Intermediaries and Asset Prices
abstract: Intermediary asset pricing posits that financial institutions are important players in financial markets, and that their decisions shape asset prices beyond simply reflecting the preferences of the average household in the economy.We explain how the intermediary-asset pricing approach helps make sense of empirical patterns in the data: the excess volatility of asset prices, differences in price movements across asset classes, the cross section of expected returns within asset classes, and specific arbitrages and price dislocations.We also review how this view of price fluctuations has important implications for macroeconomic dynamics, international economics, and policy.In particular, the role of financial regulation and monetary policy in alleviating constraints or removing risk from intermediary balance sheets during periods of stress is central in this approach.We highlight both existing progress and gaps for future research.
summary: 这篇论文系统阐述了中介资产定价理论，该理论认为金融机构是金融市场的重要参与者，其决策不仅反映平均家庭偏好，还会塑造资产价格。作者解释了该理论如何帮助理解数据中的实证模式：资产价格的过度波动、不同资产类别价格变动的差异、资产类别内部预期收益的横截面差异，以及特定的套利和价格错位。论文还回顾了价格波动的这一观点对宏观经济动态、国际经济学和政策的重要影响，特别是金融监管和货币政策在压力时期缓解约束或从中介资产负债表中移除风险的核心作用。最后，指出了现有进展和未来研究的空白。
ai_comment: 该论文系统整合了中介资产定价理论的实证证据和政策含义，为理解金融市场波动和跨资产定价差异提供了统一框架，对学术研究和政策制定均有重要参考价值。

title: Financial Advisors and Investors' Bias
abstract: We study an intervention by a brokerage firm providing advisory services to high-net-worth investors.In 2018, the firm changed the information displayed on its internal platform, so that financial advisors could no longer observe which clients' holdings were in paper gain or loss.Using data on portfolio stock transactions between 2016 and 2021, we show that, while all investors exhibit a significant disposition effect before 2018, i.e., a greater propensity to realize gains than losses, highly-advised investors see their bias significantly reduced afterward.Our paper shows that by appropriately manipulating advisors' information, financial firms can successfully reduce their clients' biases.
summary: 本文研究了一家经纪公司对其高净值投资者提供咨询服务的干预措施。2018年，该公司更改了内部平台显示信息，使财务顾问无法看到客户持仓处于盈利还是亏损状态。利用2016年至2021年的投资组合股票交易数据，作者发现所有投资者在2018年前都表现出显著的处置效应，即更倾向于实现盈利而非亏损；然而，在干预后，高咨询强度的投资者的这一偏差显著减少。研究表明，通过适当操纵顾问的信息环境，金融公司可以有效降低客户的行为偏差。
ai_comment: 本文利用公司内部平台变动的自然实验，为信息环境对顾问行为和投资者偏差的影响提供了因果证据，具有重要的实践意义。

title: The Dynamics of Deposit Flightiness and its Impact on Financial Stability
The Legacy of High Inflation on Monetary Policy Rules
When is Less More? Bank Arrangements for Liquidity vs Central Bank Support
abstract: Theory suggests that in the face of fire-sale externalities, banks have incentives to overinvest in order to issue cheap money-like deposit liabilities.The existence of a private market for insurance such as contingent capital can eliminate the overinvestment incentives, leading to efficient outcomes.However, it does not eliminate fire sales.A central bank that can infuse liquidity cheaply may be motivated to intervene in the face of fire sales.If so, it can crowd out the private market and, if liquidity intervention is not priced at higher-than-breakeven rates, induce overinvestment once again.We examine various forms of public intervention to identify the least distortionary ones.Our analysis suggests why private contingent capital dominated in the era preceding central banks and deposit insurance, why it waned subsequently, as well as why banking crises and speculative excesses continue to recur periodically.
summary: 文章探讨银行在甩卖外部性下的过度投资问题。理论表明，面对甩卖外部性，银行有动机过度投资以发行廉价货币类存款负债。私人保险市场如或有资本可以消除过度投资激励，实现有效结果，但无法消除甩卖。能够廉价注入流动性的中央银行可能在甩卖时干预，这有可能挤出私人市场，并且如果流动性干预的定价不高于盈亏平衡利率，则重新引发过度投资。作者分析了各种公共干预形式，以识别扭曲最小的方式。分析解释了为何私人或有资本在中央银行和存款保险出现之前占据主导，后来为何衰退，以及为何银行危机和投机过度周期性复发。
ai_comment: 本文通过比较私人市场与中央银行干预机制，揭示了公共干预的潜在扭曲，对理解银行危机周期性有重要启发。

title: Retail Investors’ Contrarian Behavior Around News, Attention, and the Momentum Effect
Entrepreneurial Experimentation Design for Venture Finance
abstract: This paper examines how entrepreneurs strategically design experiments to convince venture capitalists (VCs) to fund their projects when investors interpret data through heterogeneous statistical frameworks.Drawing on Liang (2021)'s model of games with incomplete information played by statistical learners, we translate her abstract theoretical framework into a practical venture capital setting.We characterise how entrepreneurs balance funding plausibility against equity dilution by strategically choosing experiments along two critical dimensions: sample size (precision) and dimensionality (breadth of metrics).Our analysis reveals that for genuinely highquality projects, increased precision helps by forcing VC beliefs to converge toward true quality.For low-quality projects, funding depends on preserving disagreement through sparse, highdimensional experiments.The entrepreneur's optimal design depends critically on their prior beliefs: confident entrepreneurs choose high-precision, low-dimensional experiments that minimise equity dilution, while uncertain entrepreneurs opt for sparse, high-dimensional experiments that maximise the probability some VC will hold sufficiently optimistic beliefs.The framework provides a rigorous foundation for understanding how entrepreneurs and investors can rationally disagree when observing identical evidence, with significant implications for strategic information design in entrepreneurial settings.
summary: 本文研究企业家如何通过战略性地设计实验来说服风险投资家（VC）为其项目融资，其中投资者采用异质的统计框架来解释数据。基于Liang（2021）关于统计学习者参与的不完全信息博弈模型，作者将该抽象理论框架转化为实际的风险投资情境。研究刻画了企业家如何通过选择实验的两个关键维度——样本量（精度）和维度（指标广度）——来平衡融资可能性与股权稀释。分析表明，对于真正高质量的项目，提高精度有助于促使VC信念收敛于真实质量；而对于低质量项目，融资依赖于通过稀疏的高维实验保留投资者之间的分歧。企业家的最优设计取决于其先验信念：自信的企业家会选择高精度、低维度的实验以最小化股权稀释，而不确定的企业家则倾向于稀疏、高维度的实验，以最大化至少有一个VC持有足够乐观信念的概率。该框架为理解企业家和投资者在观察相同证据时如何理性地产生分歧提供了严格的基础，对创业环境中的战略信息设计具有重要启示。
ai_comment: 本文将抽象的不完全信息博弈理论巧妙地应用于风险融资场景，揭示了企业家如何通过实验设计影响投资者信念，为创业金融中的信息策略提供了严谨的理论框架。

title: Employee Board Representation and Capital Investment
abstract: We examine how parity employee representation (PER) on corporate boards affects firms’ capital investments. In Germany, PER is legally mandated for firms with more than 2,000 domestic employees, but not for those below this threshold. Exploiting this discontinuity, we show that PER has heterogeneous effects on firms operating in diverse environments. For firms experiencing positive growth, PER increases their responsiveness to investment opportunities, suggesting that employee participation increases firms’ ability to exploit growth options. The effect through growth options is particularly salient in situations in which growth options are highly valuable. In contrast, for firms experiencing negative growth, PER reduces investment responsiveness, suggesting that employees resist the exercise of abandonment options. This effect is more pronounced in firms with high labor intensity, in which employees are likely to have a strong voice. Furthermore, operational risk moderates the effects of employee representation––the positive effect through growth options is attenuated in high-risk firms and the negative effect through abandonment options is exacerbated, thereby suggesting that employee board representatives are less interested in pursuing growth where businesses are relatively risky, and they protect their constituents more forcefully in high-risk environments. Moreover, the positive effect of PER on exploiting growth options is attenuated by collective bargaining agreements, while its effect through abandonment options is little affected. Evidence from stock price behavior further supports the viewpoint that employee representation affects capital investment. Our findings are relevant to policymakers as well as to firms’ various stakeholders. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by China’s National Science Foundation [Grants 72032003, 72102166]; China’s Ministry of Education [111 Project (B18033)]; and China’s Ministry of Education (Project of Key Research Institutes of Humanities and Social Science in Universities [22JJD790094]). Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03495 .
summary: 本文研究了德国公司董事会中员工代表权（parity employee representation, PER）对企业资本投资的影响。利用德国法律规定员工超过2000人的企业必须实行PER，而低于该阈值则无此要求的断点，采用断点回归方法识别因果效应。研究发现PER对企业投资的影响具有异质性：对于处于正增长的企业，PER增强了其对投资机会的响应能力，表明员工参与有助于企业利用增长期权，这种效应在增长期权价值较高时更为显著；而对于负增长的企业，PER降低了投资响应能力，表明员工抵制放弃期权的执行，这种效应在劳动密集型企业中更为明显。此外，经营风险调节了这些效应——在高风险企业中，PER通过增长期权的正向效应减弱，而通过放弃期权的负向效应增强，说明员工董事更不愿意在风险较高的环境中追求增长，并在高风险环境下更坚决地保护员工利益。集体谈判协议削弱了PER对增长期权的正向影响，但对放弃期权的影响不大。股票价格行为进一步支持了员工代表权影响资本投资的结论。研究结果对政策制定者和企业利益相关者具有参考意义。
ai_comment: 本文利用德国独特的制度断点，为员工代表权对企业投资决策的因果效应提供了可信证据，并揭示了其在不同企业情境下的异质性，拓展了公司治理与资本投资关系的理解。

title: Media Conglomeration, Local News, and Capital Market Consequences
abstract: We examine the effect of news media consolidation on local business coverage and its consequences for firms, investors, and capital markets. Using television transcripts, we find a substantial drop in coverage of local firms following the consolidation of local television stations associated with Sinclair acquisitions. Local information search, institutional portfolio local bias, and overall retail trading decrease for firms in treated geographic areas. Results are most pronounced for small firms, for stations with higher ex ante viewership, and for stations with greater reductions in local coverage. Our results provide insight into the consequences of media consolidation for local business coverage, firms, investors, and capital markets. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: Financial support from the Brigham Young University Marriott School of Business, Purdue University Mitch Daniels School of Business, and Kenan-Flagler Business School is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02247 .
summary: 本文研究新闻媒体整合对当地商业报道及其对企业、投资者和资本市场的影响。通过使用电视转录数据，发现Sinclair收购导致的地方电视台整合后，当地企业的报道大幅下降。受影响的地区中，当地信息搜索、机构投资组合的本地偏好以及整体散户交易均减少。这些影响在小企业、事前收视率较高的电视台以及当地报道减少更多的电视台中最为显著。研究结果揭示了媒体整合对当地商业报道、企业、投资者和资本市场的后果。
ai_comment: 利用独特的数据集和准自然实验设计，实证了媒体所有权集中对当地信息环境和资本市场的负面影响，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Financial Statement Audits and Data Breaches
abstract: Financial statement audits for public companies require auditors to test the internal controls over the client’s information systems that are material to the financial reporting process. Given the increasingly integrated nature of corporate data and control systems, a standard audit may have a positive effect on client firms’ other information systems, such as those that help prevent data breaches. In this paper, I provide evidence on whether and how auditors help prevent data breaches. Using plausibly exogenous improvements in auditing due to regulatory inspections and auditors’ cross-client learning, I find a decreased likelihood of data breaches among these auditors’ clients. Institutional insights gathered from interviews with accounting firm partners and industry professionals suggest two mechanisms for the role of auditors in preventing data breaches: the provision of relevant information and incentives for internal controls. Collectively, the findings provide evidence that improving accounting information systems can have a positive impact on nonaccounting systems. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: I gratefully acknowledge financial support from Columbia Business School, the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, the Deloitte Foundation, and the Bradley Fellowship awarded by the Stigler Center for the Study of the Economy and the State. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01357 .
summary: 本研究探讨财务报表审计是否以及如何帮助预防数据泄露。上市公司审计要求审计师测试与财务报告过程相关的客户信息系统的内部控制。鉴于企业数据和控制系统日益集成，标准审计可能对客户的其他信息系统（如防止数据泄露的系统）产生积极影响。利用监管检查和审计师跨客户学习带来的外生审计改进，研究发现审计师的客户发生数据泄露的可能性降低。通过对会计事务所合伙人和行业专业人士的访谈，揭示了两种机制：审计师提供相关信息以及激励内部控制的改善。总体而言，研究结果表明改善会计信息系统可以对非会计系统产生积极影响。
ai_comment: 本文利用审计的外生变化识别了审计对数据泄露的因果效应，并揭示了审计对非会计系统的正面溢出效应，具有重要的实践和政策意义。

title: The Importance of Unemployment Risk for Individual Savings
abstract: In this paper, we use a novel natural experiment and Norwegian tax data to quantify the causal impact of unemployment risk on individual savings. By comparing individuals who live in the same area but face different increases in risk, we show that a one-percentage-point increase in unemployment rates increases safe assets by 1.3%. Reassuringly, this effect is driven by low-tenured workers, who face the highest increase in risk. Savings in risky financial assets remain unaffected, implying a decrease in the overall risky share of individual portfolios. We use two independent approaches, relying either on cross-sectional variation or time series variation, to quantify the importance of job loss risk in accounting for higher savings during recessions. Our results suggest that unemployment risk can explain 60%–80% of the recession-induced increase in safe assets. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00987 .
summary: 本文利用挪威税务数据和一项新颖的自然实验，量化失业风险对个人储蓄的因果影响。通过比较同一地区但面临不同风险增加的个体，发现失业率每上升一个百分点，安全资产增加1.3%，该效应主要由低任期工人驱动。 risky金融资产储蓄不受影响，导致个人投资组合中风险资产占比下降。采用基于横截面和时间序列两种独立方法，量化失业风险对衰退期间储蓄增加的贡献，结果显示失业风险可解释60%–80%的衰退导致的安全资产增加。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特自然实验和高频行政数据，为失业风险影响储蓄提供了因果证据，并量化了其在衰退解释中的重要性。

title: An Intertemporal Risk Factor Model
abstract: Prominent factor models are based on tradable factors that do not represent theoretically relevant risks. To address this issue, we develop a factor model that captures the risks to long-term investors present in the intertemporal capital asset pricing model (ICAPM). Empirically, we construct intertemporal risk factors as long-short portfolios based on stock exposures to dividend yield and realized variance. These tradable factors mimic news to long-term expected returns and volatility, and they offset part of the marginal utility increase in recessions induced by wealth declines. Our intertemporal factor model estimation implies significant risk prices that are consistent with the ICAPM restrictions under moderate risk aversion. Moreover, our model performs well relative to previous factor models in terms of its tangency Sharpe ratio and its pricing of key test assets, including single stocks, industry portfolios, and portfolios sorted on risk exposures and lagged anomalies. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00261 .
summary: 针对传统因子模型基于可交易因子但未能代表理论相关风险的问题，本文基于跨期资本资产定价模型（ICAPM）开发了一个捕捉长期投资者风险的因子模型。实证中，通过构建基于股票对股息收益率和已实现方差的暴露的多空组合作为跨期风险因子，这些可交易因子模仿了长期预期收益率和波动率的新闻，并部分抵消了衰退期财富下降导致的边际效用增加。模型估计显示风险价格显著，且在适度风险厌恶下与ICAPM约束一致。此外，该模型在切线夏普比率以及对关键测试资产（包括单只股票、行业组合以及按风险暴露和滞后异象排序的组合）的定价方面均优于以往因子模型。
ai_comment: 本文通过将ICAPM理论转化为可交易因子，弥补了传统因子模型缺乏理论基础的不足，实证表现优异，是对资产定价领域的重要贡献。

title: Bank Competition and Risk-Taking Under Market Integration
abstract: Linkages between bank competition and risk-taking are analyzed in a model where market integration is the principal driver of increased competition. Risk implications of across-market competition under banking market integration are significantly different from that of within-market competition. Although both modes of competition increase the number of competitor banks, across-market competition yields a bank-customer effect that can potentially reverse any relation that prevails between within-market competition and risk-taking. This result suggests that the lack of consensus in the bank competition-financial stability literature is not an anomaly but an inherent feature of the analysis. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03495 .
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，其中市场整合是加剧银行竞争的主要驱动因素，并分析了银行竞争与风险承担之间的关系。研究区分了银行业市场整合下的跨市场竞争与内部市场竞争，发现两者对风险的影响存在显著差异。尽管两种竞争模式都增加了竞争对手银行的数量，但跨市场竞争产生的“银行-客户效应”可能反转内部市场竞争与风险承担之间的任何关系。这一结果表明，银行竞争与金融稳定性文献中缺乏共识并非异常，而是分析的固有特征。
ai_comment: 该论文通过区分跨市场与内部市场竞争，为银行竞争与风险承担关系中长期存在的争议提供了理论解释，揭示了市场整合情境下竞争效应的复杂性。

title: Noise Trading and Asset Pricing Factors
abstract: We demonstrate that a broad set of asset pricing factors/anomalies are significantly exposed to “noise trader risk,” and the noise trader risk is priced in factor premia. We first confirm that mutual funds’ flow-induced trading of factors are uninformed, as they generate a large price impact on factor returns, followed by a complete reversal. We then show that asset pricing factors are subject to flow-driven noise trader risk in that expected variation (covariation) of flow-induced noise trading strongly forecasts variance (covariance) of factor returns. Importantly, factor premia are higher when flow-driven noise trader risk is expected to be more salient. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01827 .
summary: 本文发现广泛的资产定价因子/异象显著暴露于“噪声交易者风险”，且该风险在因子溢价中被定价。首先，验证了共同基金因资金流驱动的因子交易是非信息性的，因为这些交易对因子收益产生巨大的价格冲击，随后完全反转。然后，表明资产定价因子受到资金流驱动的噪声交易者风险的影响，即预期资金流驱动噪声交易的变异（协变异）强烈预测因子收益的方差（协方差）。重要的是，当预期噪声交易者风险更加显著时，因子溢价更高。文章被《管理科学》接受，在线附录和数据文件可获取。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将噪声交易者风险引入因子定价模型，揭示了资金流驱动的非信息交易对因子收益和溢价的重要影响，为理解因子异常提供了新视角。

title: Portfolio Optimization Based on Almost Second-Degree Stochastic Dominance
abstract: In portfolio optimization, the computational complexity of implementing almost stochastic dominance has limited its practical applications. In this study, we introduce an optimization framework aimed at identifying the optimal portfolio that outperforms a specified benchmark under almost second-degree stochastic dominance (ASSD). Our approach involves discretizing the return range and establishing both sufficient and necessary conditions for ASSD. We then propose a three-step iterative procedure: first, identifying a candidate portfolio; second, assessing its optimality; and third, refining the discretization scheme. Theoretical analysis guarantees that the portfolio identified through this iterative process improves with each iteration, ultimately converging to the optimal solution. Our empirical study, utilizing industry portfolios, demonstrates the efficacy of our approach by consistently identifying an optimal portfolio within a few iterations. Furthermore, comparative analysis against other decision criteria, such as mean-variance, second-degree stochastic dominance, and third-degree stochastic dominance, reveals that ASSD generally leads to portfolios with higher out-of-sample average excess returns but also entails increased variations and risks. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: C. Luo acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72101070] and the Zhejiang Provincial Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant LY23G010001]. P. Chen acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401253]. P. Jaillet acknowledges financial support from the Office of Naval Research [Grant N00014-18-1-2122 and N00014-24-1-2470] and the Air Force Office of Scientific Research [Grant FA9550-23-1-0182 and Grant FA9550-23-1-0190]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01092 .
summary: 本文针对几乎二阶随机占优（ASSD）在投资组合优化中计算复杂、实际应用受限的问题，提出了一种优化框架，旨在识别出优于给定基准的最优投资组合。该框架通过离散化收益率区间，建立ASSD的充分必要条件，并设计了一个三步迭代过程：首先识别候选组合，其次评估其最优性，最后改进离散化方案。理论分析保证迭代过程中组合逐步优化并最终收敛到最优解。基于行业投资组合的实证研究表明，该方法能在少量迭代内一致地识别出最优组合。与其他决策准则（如均值-方差、二阶随机占优、三阶随机占优）的比较发现，ASSD通常能带来更高的样本外平均超额收益，但同时也伴随着更大的波动和风险。
ai_comment: 本文为几乎随机占优在投资组合优化中的实际应用提供了可行的计算方法，并通过实证展示了其相对于传统准则的优劣，兼具理论贡献与实践价值。

title: The Click-Based MNL Model: A Framework for Modeling Click Data in Assortment Optimization
abstract: We introduce the click-based MNL choice model, a framework for capturing customer purchasing decisions in e-commerce settings. Specifically, we augment the classical Multinomial Logit choice model by assuming that customers only consider the items they have clicked on before they proceed to compare their random utilities. In this context, we study the resulting assortment optimization problem, where the objective is to select a subset of products, made available for purchase, to maximize the expected revenue. Our main algorithmic contribution comes in the form of a polynomial-time approximation scheme (PTAS) for this problem, showing that the optimal expected revenue can be efficiently approached within any degree of accuracy. To establish this result, we develop several technical ideas, including enumeration schemes and stochastic inequalities, which may be of broader interest. Using data from Alibaba’s online marketplace, we fit click-based MNL and latent class MNL models to historical sales and click data in a setting where the online platform recommends a personalized six-product display to each user. We propose an estimation methodology for the click-based MNL model that leverages clickstream data and machine learning classification algorithms. Our numerical results suggest that clickstream data are valuable for predicting choices and that the click-based MNL model can outperform standard logit-based models in certain settings. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: D. Segev was supported by the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 1407/20]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00281 .
summary: 本文提出了点击基础MNL选择模型（click-based MNL choice model），用于捕捉电子商务环境中的客户购买决策。该模型通过假设客户只考虑其点击过的商品来增强经典的多项式Logit模型。在此基础上，研究了品类优化问题，目标是在可选商品中选取子集以最大化期望收入。主要算法贡献是一个多项式时间近似方案(PTAS)，可以在任意精度内逼近最优期望收入。利用阿里巴巴在线市场的数据，将点击基础MNL和潜在类MNL模型拟合到历史销售和点击数据上，其中在线平台为每位用户推荐个性化的六件商品展示。提出了一种利用点击流数据和机器学习分类算法的估计方法。数值结果表明，点击流数据对预测选择具有价值，并且点击基础MNL模型在某些设置下优于标准Logit模型。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙地将点击行为纳入MNL框架，并提供了理论上的近似算法，同时通过实际数据验证了模型的有效性，为电商平台优化推荐提供了新思路。

title: Liquidity picking and fund performance
abstract: Using global mutual fund and American Depositary Receipt (ADR) data, we test if funds strategically trade cross-listed firms’ equity shares in the most liquid trading location. We find that especially funds that score high on traditional skill measures exhibit a liquidity-based trading venue preference. We identify an informed trading motive as the most likely driver for such behaviour rather than preference based on geographic, economic, cultural, or governance motives. Thus, liquidity picking is associated with fund outperformance and stock selection ability that is not limited to only cross-listed firms. Our tests directly support theories of informed trading in a multi-market setting.
summary: 该论文利用全球共同基金和美国存托凭证（ADR）数据，检验基金是否策略性地在流动性最强的交易地点交易跨境上市公司的股票。研究发现，尤其是传统技能衡量指标得分高的基金表现出基于流动性的交易场所偏好。信息交易动机被确定为这种行为最可能的驱动因素，而非地理、经济、文化或治理等偏好。因此，流动性选择与基金的超额表现和选股能力相关，且这种能力不仅限于跨境上市公司。研究结果直接支持了多市场环境下知情交易的理论。
ai_comment: 论文通过全球数据揭示了流动性选择作为基金表现的新指标，并为多市场知情交易理论提供了实证支持。

title: Exorbitant privilege? Quantitative easing and the bond market subsidy of prospective fallen angels
abstract: We document capital misallocation in the U.S. investment-grade (IG) corporate bond market, driven by quantitative easing (QE). Prospective fallen angels — risky firms just above the IG cutoff — enjoyed subsidized bond financing in 2009–19. This effect is driven by Fed purchases of securities inducing long-duration IG-focused investors to rebalance their portfolios towards higher-yielding IG bonds. The benefiting firms (i) exploited the sluggish downward adjustment of credit ratings after M&A to finance risky acquisitions with bond issuances, and (ii) increased market share affecting competitors’ employment and investment, but (iii) suffered severe downgrades at the onset of the pandemic.
summary: 该论文记录了量化宽松（QE）导致美国投资级（IG）公司债市场中的资本错配。在2009-2019年期间，潜在的堕落天使——即略高于IG评级门槛的风险公司——享受了补贴性的债券融资。这种效应源于美联储购买证券，促使长期IG投资者重新平衡其投资组合，转向高收益IG债券。受益公司利用并购后信用评级调整缓慢的时机，通过发行债券为风险收购融资，并增加市场份额，影响了竞争对手的就业和投资。然而，这些公司在新冠疫情爆发时遭受了严重的信用评级下调。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了量化宽松政策在债券市场中的意外副作用，即对高风险公司的隐性补贴，并强调了信用评级调整滞后在资本错配中的关键作用，具有重要的政策启示。

title: A quantitative analysis of bank lending relationships
abstract: We study the aggregate consequences of dynamic lending relationships in a model of heterogeneous banks facing financial frictions. We estimate the model’s loan demand system on administrative loan-level data: the market power implied by the estimated strength and persistence of relationships yields a long run reduction in credit of 5.9%. Relationships amplify the negative real effects of credit supply shocks, but mute those of negative credit demand shocks. In a financial crisis which destroys 25% of bank net worth, for example, loan volume drops more than twice as much in our baseline model than in a competitive analog with no relationships, but banks recapitalize faster.
summary: 本文构建了一个异质性银行面临金融摩擦的动态借贷关系模型，利用行政级别的贷款数据估计贷款需求系统，量化分析借贷关系的宏观影响。研究发现，由关系强度和持续性所隐含的市场势力导致长期信贷减少5.9%。借贷关系放大了信贷供给冲击的负面实际效应，但减弱了信贷需求冲击的负面效应。例如，在银行净值损失25%的金融危机中，基准模型的贷款量下降幅度是无关系竞争模型的2倍以上，但银行资本重组速度更快。
ai_comment: 该文通过结构估计首次定量评估了借贷关系在宏观层面的成本与冲击传导的非对称性，为理解银行-企业关系的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Do intermediaries improve GSE lending? Evidence from proprietary GSE data
abstract: We analyze the trade-offs of having intermediaries originate government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) mortgages using proprietary GSE data. We first find evidence of lenders pricing for observable and unobservable default risk independently of the GSEs. We then develop and estimate a model of competitive lending in which lenders have skin-in-the-game and conduct additional screening beyond the GSEs’ criteria. Lenders reduce costs via screening but also charge markups. On net, interest rates are higher compared to a counterfactual effectively without intermediaries. In an extension, the observed differences between banks and nonbanks are more consistent with differences in their skin-in-the-game rather than screening quality.
summary: 本文利用专有的政府赞助企业（GSE）数据，分析了中介机构参与GSE抵押贷款发放的利弊。首先发现贷款人独立于GSE对可观察和不可观察的违约风险进行定价。接着构建并估计了一个竞争性贷款模型，其中贷款人具有风险自担（skin-in-the-game）并进行超出GSE标准的额外筛选。贷款人通过筛选降低成本，但同时收取加价。总体而言，与一个没有中介的反事实情形相比，利率更高。进一步分析表明，银行与非银行之间的差异更符合风险自担的差异，而非筛选质量的差异。
ai_comment: 本文通过专有数据揭示了中介在GSE抵押贷款中的双重作用（筛选节省成本与加价），并区分了银行与非银行差异的来源，对理解房贷中介的经济意义有重要贡献。

title: Robust difference-in-differences analysis when there is a term structure
abstract: For variables with a term structure, the standard difference-in-differences (DiD) model is predisposed toward misspecification, even under random assignment, because of heterogeneity over the maturity spectrum and imperfect matching between treated and control units. Estimated treatment effects that are false, biased, or hard to interpret become a concern. Neither unit fixed effects nor standard term-structure controls resolve the problem. Solutions that overcome imperfect matching involve estimating the term structure of hypothesized treatment, which is also what is economically interesting (regardless of matching efficiency). These issues are not unique to DiD analysis, but are generic to group-assignment settings.
summary: 本文研究具有期限结构的变量在双重差分（DiD）分析中的设定偏误问题。即使处理组和控制组是随机分配的，由于期限结构异质性和两组之间不完美匹配，标准DiD模型容易产生错误、有偏或难以解释的处理效应。研究发现，单元固定效应或标准期限结构控制无法解决该问题。有效的解决方案是估计假设处理的期限结构，这本身也具有经济意义。这些问题不仅限于DiD分析，而是普遍存在于组分配设置中。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了期限结构变量在DiD分析中容易被忽视的设定偏误，并提出了更具经济意义的解决方案，对实证金融研究具有重要指导意义。

title: Banks as regulated traders
abstract: Banks use trading as a vehicle to take risk. Using high-frequency regulatory data, we estimate the sensitivity of weekly bank trading profits to aggregate equity, fixed-income, credit, currency, and commodity risk factors. Our estimates imply that U.S. banks had large trading exposures to equity market risk before the Volcker Rule, which they curtailed afterwards. Credit and currency risk exposures were smaller. The results hold up in a quasi-natural experiment that exploits the phased-in introduction of reporting requirements for identification. Total trading-book risk was also curtailed afterwards with material financial stability implications and no evidence of migration to other bank activities.
summary: 本文利用高频监管数据，估计美国银行每周交易利润对股票、固定收益、信用、货币和商品等五大类系统性风险因子的敏感性。研究发现，在沃尔克规则实施之前，银行对股票市场风险有较大的交易敞口，而规则实施后显著降低了该敞口；信用和货币风险敞口相对较小。通过利用分阶段引入的报告要求作为准自然实验，结果依然稳健。此外，沃尔克规则实施后，银行交易账簿的总风险也降低了，这对金融稳定产生了实质性影响，且没有证据表明风险转移到了其他银行业务中。
ai_comment: 本文利用高频监管数据揭示了沃尔克规则对银行交易风险暴露的实际影响，并提供了准自然实验的因果证据，对监管政策评估有重要参考价值。

title: Revenue collapses and the consumption of small business owners in the COVID-19 pandemic
abstract: Using financial account data linking small businesses to their owner households, we examine how business owners’ consumption responded to changes in business revenues during the COVID-19 crisis. In the first two months following the National Emergency, business revenues declined by 40 percent, largely driven by national factors rather than local infection rates or policies. However, the pass-through of revenue losses to owner consumption was limited: each dollar of revenue loss resulted in only a 1.6-cent decline in consumption. This muted pass-through persisted through 2021, even after the introduction of COVID-19 vaccines. Our findings suggest that federal subsidies and pandemic-induced reductions in spending opportunities explain the limited impact.
summary: 本文利用连接小企业与其所有者家庭的金融账户数据，研究了COVID-19危机期间企业主消费如何响应业务收入变化。在国家紧急状态后的头两个月，业务收入下降40%，这主要由全国性因素驱动，而非当地感染率或政策。然而，收入损失向所有者消费的传导有限：每1美元收入损失仅导致1.6美分的消费减少。这种弱传导持续到2021年，甚至在COVID-19疫苗引入后仍如此。研究结果表明，联邦补贴和疫情导致的支出机会减少解释了这种有限影响。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的高频金融账户数据，揭示了收入崩溃对消费的有限传导，强调了政策补贴和支出限制的关键作用，为理解疫情经济影响提供了微观证据。

title: Entrepreneurial spillovers across coworkers
abstract: How do workplace social connections shape everyday entrepreneurship? Using comprehensive data on millions of American workers across the economy, I find three key patterns. First, entrepreneurial coworkers inspire and teach entrepreneurship: individuals are more likely to become entrepreneurs after working with coworkers who previously led young businesses. Second, these effects predominantly occur within demographic groups, perpetuating lower entrepreneurship rates for women and Black Americans. Third, these workplace spillovers can increase productivity: individuals exposed to relatively successful coworkers subsequently run successful companies too.
summary: 这篇论文利用覆盖美国经济中数百万工人的全面数据，研究了工作场所社会联系如何影响日常创业行为。研究发现三个关键模式：第一，与曾经营年轻企业的同事共事后，个人更有可能成为创业者，表明创业同事能起到激励和教导作用；第二，这种效应主要发生在人口统计群体内部（如同种族或同性别群体），导致女性和美国黑人的创业率持续偏低；第三，工作场所的创业溢出还能提高生产率，接触过相对成功创业同事的个人后来也能成功运营公司。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了工作场所中创业行为的同伴效应及其加剧群体间创业不平等的机制，对理解社会网络与创业决策的关系有重要贡献。

title: Pension fund flows, exchange rates, and covered interest rate parity
abstract: Frequent, yet uninformed, market timing recommendations by a financial advisory firm generate significant flows for Chilean pension funds. These flows induce substantial changes in the Chilean foreign exchange rate due to the funds’ high allocation to international securities. Local banks provide liquidity to pension funds in the spot market and their hedging transactions propagate the demand fluctuations from the spot to the forward market, resulting in deviations from covered interest rate parity. Using bank balance sheet data, we confirm that banks’ risk bearing constraints create limits to arbitrage.
summary: 本文研究智利养老基金因财务顾问公司频繁且非信息驱动的市场时机建议而产生的大量资金流动。这些流动由于养老基金高度配置于国际证券，导致智利外汇汇率显著变动。当地银行在即期市场为养老基金提供流动性，其对冲交易将需求波动从即期市场传导至远期市场，从而造成对抵补利率平价（covered interest rate parity）的偏离。利用银行资产负债表数据，本文证实银行的风险承担约束（risk bearing constraints）构成了套利限制（limits to arbitrage）。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的智利养老金基金数据，揭示了非基本面因素通过银行中介对汇率和利率平价产生实际影响，为理解金融摩擦下的国际金融传导提供了新证据。

title: Redeploying dirty assets: The impact of environmental
abstract: This paper investigates how firms’ pollution incentives are influenced by their ability to divest polluted assets. My empirical setting is a major reform that exempts purchasers from liability for past contamination. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that the reform reduces toxic emissions, lowers bankruptcy risk, and increases firm value. Cross-sectional tests show that the decline in emissions is driven by firms with weaker financial health and fewer assets. These findings highlight a novel net worth channel: by limiting ex-post liability, the reform enhances landowners’ net worth ex-ante, reducing their incentives to engage in risky behavior, such as excessive emissions.
summary: 本研究探讨企业剥离污染资产的能力如何影响其污染激励。实证背景是一项重大改革，该改革免除购买方对过去污染的责任。通过双重差分法，研究发现该改革减少了有毒排放、降低了破产风险并提升了企业价值。横截面检验表明，排放减少主要由财务健康状况较弱、资产较少的公司驱动。这些发现揭示了一个新颖的净值渠道：通过限制事后责任，改革增加了土地所有者的事前净值，从而降低了他们从事过度排放等风险行为的动机。
ai_comment: 该研究通过净值渠道揭示了环保政策经济效应的新机制，对理解企业环境行为具有重要贡献。

title: Receiving investors in the block market for corporate bonds
abstract: We study block trades in the corporate bond market, where dealers buy or sell blocks from initiating customers and offset their positions with receiving investors. Our findings indicate that while receivers benefit from trading cost savings, they primarily bear adverse selection costs and experience worse outcomes when informed trading is prevalent. Mandatory trade reporting improves receiver outcomes by revealing dealers’ private information, but the benefits are reduced when reporting is delayed. Our results emphasize the importance of transparency regime design and suggest potential market fragility: if information asymmetry becomes severe, receivers may withdraw from the block market.
summary: 本文研究公司债券市场中的大宗交易，交易商从发起客户处买卖大宗债券，并与接收投资者对冲头寸。研究发现，尽管接收投资者能从交易成本节省中获益，但他们主要承担逆向选择成本，且在知情交易盛行时结果更差。强制交易报告通过披露交易商的私人信息改善了接收投资者的结果，但报告延迟会削弱这一好处。结果强调了透明度制度设计的重要性，并暗示市场潜在脆弱性：若信息不对称加剧，接收投资者可能退出大宗市场。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了公司债券大宗市场中接收投资者的逆向选择风险，并强调透明度设计的关键作用，对市场监管有重要启示。

title: Too Much, Too Soon, for Too Long: The Dynamics of Competitive Executive Compensation
abstract: We examine executive compensation in a general equilibrium model with dynamic moral hazard, where executives' outside options are endogenously determined by equilibrium market compensation. Firms provide incentives through compensation packages featuring deferred payments as “carrots” and termination as “sticks.” Crucially, the effectiveness of termination as an incentive device is undermined by the outside options available to executives. As individual firms fail to internalize the effect of their compensation design on these endogenous outside options, the equilibrium is generally inefficient. Compared to shareholder‐value‐maximizing compensation packages, executives are paid too much, too soon, and keep their jobs for too long.
summary: 本文构建了一个具有动态道德风险的一般均衡模型，研究竞争环境下高管薪酬的决定机制。模型中，高管的外部选择由市场均衡薪酬内生决定，企业通过“胡萝卜”（递延薪酬）和“大棒”（解雇）提供激励。关键发现是，解雇作为激励手段的有效性因高管可获得的外部选择而削弱。由于单个企业在设计薪酬时未考虑其对整体外部选择的影响，均衡结果通常是低效的：与股东价值最大化相比，高管薪酬过高、支付过早、且任期过长。
ai_comment: 本文通过一般均衡框架揭示了竞争性高管薪酬的市场失灵机制，为薪酬管制提供了理论依据。

title: Dynamic Coordination and Bankruptcy Regulations
abstract: Many regulations aim to promote coordination among creditors in bankruptcy by ex post restricting their ability to exit distressed firms. However, such restrictions may harm creditors’ ex ante incentives to stay invested, thereby worsening coordination outcomes. We build a dynamic coordination model to show how this force shapes creditor runs, bankruptcy filings, and regulation designs. Intriguingly, filing for bankruptcy early, thereby preserving more assets for latecomers, can prolong firm life. Furthermore, regulators’ clawbacks on prebankruptcy repayments can be superior to firms’ commitment to early bankruptcy filing. Our analysis generates implications for automatic stay, avoidable preference, bank failures, and seniority structure.
summary: 本文构建了一个动态协调模型，研究破产法规如何通过事后限制债权人退出困境企业的能力来促进协调，同时这种限制可能损害债权人事前继续投资的激励，从而恶化协调结果。模型揭示了这一力量如何塑造债权人挤兑、破产申请和法规设计。有趣的是，早期申请破产（从而为后来者保留更多资产）可以延长企业寿命。此外，监管者对破产前还款的追回（clawbacks）优于企业承诺早期破产申请。分析对自动中止（automatic stay）、可撤销优先权（avoidable preference）、银行失败和优先层级结构（seniority structure）具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 论文通过动态协调模型揭示了破产法规中事前与事后激励的权衡，为理解破产申请时机和监管设计提供了新颖视角。

title: The “Actual Retail Price” of Equity Trades
abstract: We compare execution quality of six brokerage accounts across five brokers by generating a sample of 85,000 simultaneous market orders. Commission levels and payment for order flow (PFOF) differ across our accounts. We find that execution prices vary significantly across brokers: the mean account‐level round‐trip cost ranges from 0.07% to 0.46%, excluding any commissions. The dispersion is due to off‐exchange wholesalers systematically giving different execution prices for the same trades to different brokers. Across brokers, variation in PFOF does not explain the large variation in price execution. We provide several suggestions for more informative disclosures on execution quality.
summary: 本文通过生成85,000个同步市价订单样本，比较了五家券商的六个经纪账户的执行质量。不同账户的佣金水平和订单流付费（PFOF）存在差异。研究发现，不同券商之间的执行价格差异显著：平均账户级别的往返交易成本从0.07%到0.46%不等（不含佣金）。这种差异主要源于场外批发商对不同券商系统性提供不同的执行价格。此外，PFOF的差异并不能解释执行价格的大幅变动。最后，本文提出了改进执行质量信息披露的建议。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模实证揭示了零售交易执行成本的巨大差异，并指出订单流付费并非主要决定因素，对监管和投资者具有重要启示。

title: Internal Forecasts in Multi‐Location Firms
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of internal forecasting in multi‐location firms and the relations between forecast characteristics and investment. Using U.S. Census microdata on plant‐level growth expectations, we find that plants within multi‐location firms make forecasts that are both more certain and less accurate than those of standalone plants. We provide evidence suggesting that headquarters infers uncertainty from inter‐plant forecast disagreement, and that headquarters is able to facilitate the use of relevant information held by one plant but applicable to another. Differences between peer and focal plants' forecasts predict forecast errors and relate to investment decisions at the focal plant, suggesting that information from multiple sources is integrated into capital allocation decisions. Headquarters' heavier use of peer plant forecast information when focal plants are more uncertain likely weakens focal plant managers' incentives to consider extreme scenarios when forecasting.
summary: 本文研究多地点公司内部预测的动态特征及其与投资决策的关系。利用美国人口普查微观数据中的工厂级增长预期，发现多地点公司内工厂的预测比独立工厂更确定但准确性更低。证据表明，总部从工厂间预测分歧中推断不确定性，并能够促进一个工厂拥有的相关信息被另一个工厂使用。同行与焦点工厂预测之间的差异能够预测预测误差，并与焦点工厂的投资决策相关，表明多个来源的信息被整合到资本配置决策中。当焦点工厂更不确定时，总部更多使用同行工厂的预测信息，这可能削弱焦点工厂经理在预测时考虑极端场景的激励。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的人口普查微观数据揭示了多地点公司内部预测的独特特征和总部信息整合机制，对理解企业内部资本配置有重要贡献。

title: Agency MBS as Safe Assets
abstract: Measured as yield spreads against Treasury securities and AAA corporate bonds, the convenience premium of newly issued agency MBS averages more than half of the long-term Treasury convenience premium. The agency MBS convenience premium and issuance amount vary negatively with mortgage rate, consistent with a prepayment-driven channel. Placing agencies into conservatorship in 2008 and introducing liquidity regulations in 2013 significantly affected MBS convenience premium, consistent with government guarantee and regulatory treatment channels. Analyses of dispersion of dealers’ prepayment forecasts, seasoned MBS, and investors’ MBS holdings deliver further economic implications for agency MBS as safe assets.
summary: 本文以新发行的机构MBS相对于国债和AAA级公司债的收益率利差度量其便利溢价，发现该溢价平均超过长期国债便利溢价的一半。机构MBS的便利溢价和发行量与抵押贷款利率负相关，支持提前还款驱动的渠道。2008年将机构纳入政府托管以及2013年引入流动性监管显著影响了MBS的便利溢价，与政府担保和监管处理渠道一致。对交易商提前还款预测的分散度、老券MBS和投资者持有MBS的分析进一步揭示了机构MBS作为安全资产的经济含义。
ai_comment: 本文系统度量了机构MBS的便利溢价，并揭示了其受提前还款、政府担保和监管的多重影响，为理解安全资产供给提供了新视角。

title: The Elasticity of Quantitative Investment
abstract: What is the demand elasticity of statistical arbitrageurs that invest according to the advice of modern cross-sectional asset pricing models? Thirteen models from the literature exhibit strikingly inelastic demand, in contrast to classical models that rely on statistical arbitrageurs to create elastic market demand for assets. This inelasticity arises from the difficulty of trading against price changes. A quantitative equilibrium model shows that aggregate demand remains inelastic even with these statistical arbitrageurs in the market.
summary: 这篇论文研究了根据现代横截面资产定价模型建议进行投资的统计套利者的需求弹性。通过分析文献中的13个模型，发现这些模型表现出显著的无弹性需求，这与经典模型中依靠统计套利者创造弹性市场需求的假设形成对比。这种无弹性源于统计套利者在价格变化时难以进行交易。进一步，一个量化均衡模型表明，即使市场中存在这些统计套利者，总需求仍然保持无弹性。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了经典金融学中套利者需求弹性的假设，通过实证和理论模型揭示了量化投资需求的无弹性特征，对市场效率和价格形成机制有重要启示。

title: Measuring the Economic Value of an Innovation When Some Investors Are Inattentive
abstract: We analyze the effects of limited investor attention on the stock market reaction to innovation announcements and develop a new measure of patents’ economic value. We hypothesize that, when some investors pay delayed attention to innovation announcements, there will be a post-announcement drift in addition to the announcement effect, with the former decreasing and the latter increasing in investor attention. Using media coverage and abnormal Google search volume as investor attention proxies, we find consistent evidence. Our new attention-weighted measure of patents’ economic value has greater predictive power for future firm performance than measures based on the announcement effect alone.
summary: 论文分析了有限投资者注意力对创新公告后股票市场反应的影响，并提出一种新的专利经济价值度量方法。作者假设，当部分投资者延迟关注创新公告时，除了公告效应外，还会出现公告后漂移，且公告后漂移随投资者注意力增加而减小，公告效应则随注意力增加而增大。使用媒体覆盖和异常谷歌搜索量作为投资者注意力的代理变量，实证结果支持该假设。新提出的注意力加权专利价值度量方法，相比仅基于公告效应的度量，对未来公司绩效具有更强的预测能力。
ai_comment: 引入投资者注意力机制来改进专利价值度量，视角新颖且实证证据充分，为创新经济价值评估提供了更准确的工具。

title: Identifying Price Informativeness
abstract: We identify and estimate price informativeness, a necessary step in testing theories of information aggregation. Starting from a pricing equation and a stochastic process for payoffs, we show how to recover relative price informativeness from regressions of asset price changes on changes in payoffs. Applying our identification results, we estimate a panel of stock-specific measures of informativeness for U.S. stocks. In the cross-section, large stocks with high turnover, idiosyncratic volatility, institutional ownership, and analyst coverage have higher informativeness. In the time series, the median, mean, and standard deviation of the distribution of informativeness have steadily increased since the mid-1980s.
summary: 本文提出了一种识别和估计价格信息含量的方法，这是检验信息聚合理论的前提。作者从定价方程和收益的随机过程出发，展示了如何通过回归资产价格变化对收益变化来恢复相对价格信息含量。利用该识别方法，他们估计了美国股票的面板数据，得到个股层面的信息含量度量。在截面分析中，大市值、高换手率、高特质波动、高机构持股和高分析师覆盖的股票具有更高的信息含量。在时间序列上，自1980年代中期以来，信息含量的中位数、均值和标准差均稳步上升。
ai_comment: 本文为衡量价格信息含量提供了清晰的识别框架，并给出了丰富的实证结果，对理解市场效率和信息聚合具有重要价值。

title: Syndicated Lending Relationships, Information Asymmetry, and Market Making in the Secondary Loan Market
abstract: This paper investigates why commercial lenders make markets for the loans that they sell on the secondary market. Using loan‐level data, I find that origination lenders with extensive borrower relationships and more reputational capital at stake are more likely to serve as market makers. Greater participation of origination lenders as market makers is associated with lower trading costs for their borrowers' loans. This association remains even in conditions where origination lenders could exploit their information advantage for market making profits. Lenders benefit from being market makers by maintaining strong subsequent lending relationships with their borrowers. Collectively, this evidence is consistent with origination lenders' participation in the secondary market being motivated by reducing trading frictions rather than market making profits.
summary: 本文利用贷款级数据，研究商业贷款人为何在二级市场为其出售的贷款做市。发现与借款人关系广泛、声誉资本多的贷款人更可能成为做市商；他们的做市参与降低了借款人的交易成本，即使在可能利用信息优势的情况下依然如此。贷款人通过维持后续贷款关系获益，表明其做市动机是减少交易摩擦而非获利。
ai_comment: 利用实证数据揭示了贷款人做市的动机是降低交易摩擦而非信息套利，为二级贷款市场流动性提供新见解。

title: Getting to the Core: Inflation Risks Within and Across Asset Classes
abstract: Do real assets protect against inflation? Stocks’ core inflation betas are negative, while their energy betas are positive. Currencies, commodities, and real estate mostly hedge against energy inflation, but not core inflation. These hedging properties are reflected in the prices of inflation risks: only core inflation carries a negative risk premium, and its magnitude is consistent within and across asset classes, uniquely among macroeconomic risk factors. Energy inflation has become more procyclical and volatile since the 1990s, which helps explain the time-varying correlation between stock and bond returns. A two-sector New Keynesian asset pricing model accounts for these facts quantitatively.
summary: 本文研究实物资产是否对冲通货膨胀。发现股票的核心通胀贝塔为负，而能源通胀贝塔为正；货币、大宗商品和房地产主要对冲能源通胀，而非核心通胀。这些对冲特性反映在通胀风险价格中：只有核心通胀携带负风险溢价，且其大小在资产类别内和跨资产类别一致，这在宏观经济风险因子中独一无二。能源通胀自1990年代以来变得更具顺周期性和波动性，有助于解释股票与债券收益的时变相关性。一个两部门新凯恩斯资产定价模型定量解释了这些事实。
keywords: 新凯恩斯资产定价模型
ai_comment: 该文系统揭示了核心通胀与能源通胀在资产定价中的非对称角色，并通过模型统一解释了跨资产类别的风险溢价一致性及股债相关性变化。

title: Gender Stereotypes and Entrepreneur Financing
abstract: I document a significant gender gap in entrepreneurs’ access to early-stage equity financing. Using unique administrative data on French startups, I show that this gap is particularly pronounced in male-dominated sectors. Controlling for a comprehensive set of entrepreneur and startup characteristics—including demographics, backgrounds, and motivations—accounts for 42% of the average gender gap. However, in male-dominated sectors, 80% of the gap remains unexplained. Growth-oriented female entrepreneurs rely more heavily on bank loans, substituting equity with debt. Finally, VC-backed female-founded startups outperform their male counterparts in male-dominated sectors. These findings suggest that context-dependent stereotypes influence equity financing decisions.
summary: 该论文利用法国初创企业的独特管理数据，记录了企业家在早期股权融资中显著的性别差异，尤其是在男性主导行业中更为突出。在控制了企业家和初创企业的大量特征（包括人口统计、背景和动机）后，平均性别差异的42%得以解释，但在男性主导行业中，80%的差异仍无法解释。成长导向的女性企业家更依赖银行贷款，以债务替代股权。此外，在男性主导行业中，获得风投支持的女性创办的初创企业表现优于男性同行。这些发现表明，情境依赖的刻板印象会影响股权融资决策。
ai_comment: 利用独特的管理数据和丰富的控制变量，深入揭示了性别刻板印象在融资中的作用，特别是其在男性主导行业的显著影响和女性企业家的替代融资策略。

title: The Role of Observed Punishment in Deterring the Spillover Effects of Corporate Misconduct Among Non‐Peers
abstract: This study investigates (1) whether misreporting by corporate executives impacts unethical decision‐making by non‐peers in unrelated reporting tasks, and (2) whether observing various forms of punishment for corporate misreporting deters this spillover effect. Specifically, we examine the deterrent effects of two common forms of punishment (fines or imprisonment) and a novel form of punishment (public shaming). Across two experiments, we find that participants are more likely to misreport performance when exposed to media reports about executives engaging in financial misreporting. This evidence is consistent with executive misreporting leading to unethical decision‐making among non‐peer observers. We also find that participant misreporting is reduced when the media reports the punishments levied against those executives. In further mediation tests, our findings suggest observed punishments for corporate misconduct can influence perceptions of injunctive norms and potentially mitigate spillover in unethical behavior.
summary: 本研究通过两项实验考察了企业高管财务虚假报告对非同行在无关报告任务中的不道德决策的溢出效应，以及观察惩罚形式对此溢出效应的威慑作用。具体检验了两种常见惩罚（罚款或监禁）和一种新颖惩罚（公开羞辱）。实验发现，当参与者接触高管财务虚假报告的媒体报道时，更可能虚报业绩；而当媒体报道高管所受惩罚时，参与者虚报行为减少。进一步的中介检验表明，观察到对企业不当行为的惩罚能够影响对禁令性规范的感知，并可能缓解不道德行为的溢出。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实验设计揭示了高管不当行为对非同行不道德决策的溢出效应，并创新性地检验了公开羞辱的威慑作用，为理解惩罚的规范影响提供了新视角。

title: Leaky Director Networks and Innovation Herding
abstract: We first document that, despite potential legal issues, overlapping directors are surprisingly prevalent among direct competitors. Using panel data regressions and plausibly exogenous shocks, we find that competing firms in markets with dense overlapping-director networks experience innovation herding, lose product differentiation, and, ultimately, perform poorly. Novel text-based network propagation tests of technologies show that intellectual property leakage plays a role as firms with dense overlapping director networks experience faster propagation of technologies to competitors. Our findings suggest a coordination problem where industry participants cannot stop rivals from earning small gains from leakage despite much larger industry-wide negative externalities.
summary: 本文首先发现，尽管存在潜在法律问题，重叠董事在直接竞争对手中出人意料地普遍。通过面板数据回归和看似外生的冲击，作者发现，在重叠董事网络密集的市场中，竞争公司会出现创新趋同，失去产品差异化，并最终表现不佳。基于文本的网络传播测试显示，知识产权泄漏在其中起了作用，因为拥有密集重叠董事网络的公司，其技术向竞争对手的传播更快。研究结果表明存在一个协调问题：行业参与者无法阻止竞争对手从泄漏中获得微小收益，尽管行业整体的负外部性要大得多。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了董事网络在竞争对手间的普遍性及其导致创新趋同的负面后果，强调了知识产权泄漏的协调困境，对董事网络研究具有重要贡献。

title: A Trend Factor for the Cross Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
abstract: We propose CTREND, a new trend factor for cryptocurrency returns, which aggregates price and volume information across different time horizons. Using data on more than 3,000 coins, we employ machine learning methods to exploit information from various technical indicators. The resulting signal reliably predicts cryptocurrency returns. The effect cannot be subsumed by known factors and remains robust across different subperiods, market states, and alternative research designs. Moreover, it survives the impact of transaction costs and persists in big and liquid coins. Finally, an asset pricing model that incorporates CTREND outperforms competing factor models, providing a superior explanation of cryptocurrency returns.
summary: 本文提出了一种针对加密货币收益的新趋势因子CTREND，该因子聚合了不同时间跨度的价格和成交量信息。基于超过3000种加密货币的数据，我们使用机器学习方法挖掘各种技术指标的信息。得到的信号能够可靠地预测加密货币收益。该效应无法被已知因子所解释，并且在不同的子时期、市场状态以及替代研究设计下保持稳健。此外，它在考虑交易成本后仍然有效，并且在大型和流动性强的加密货币中持续存在。最后，包含CTREND的资产定价模型优于其他竞争因子模型，为加密货币收益提供了更优的解释。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地构建了一个基于价格和成交量的趋势因子CTREND，并通过机器学习方法提升了预测能力，在加密货币领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: Liquidity Provision on Blockchain-Based Decentralized Exchanges
abstract: We show that the infrastructure of decentralized exchanges subjects liquidity providers (LPs) to a “tragedy of the commons.” Liquidity providers lack incentives to exit liquidity pools to prevent arbitrage losses, as these are collectively shared, while withdrawal costs are borne individually. Arbitrage rents primarily flow to validators as infrastructure fees, with the median arbitrageur transferring 96% of profits. Proposed solutions—speed technology, alternative sequencing rules, and flexible pricing curves—fail to reduce these rents. Leveraging the Silicon Valley Bank crisis as a natural experiment, we show that LPs defensively adopt more convex pricing curves to mitigate adverse selection risks.
summary: 本文揭示了基于区块链的去中心化交易所（DEX）的基础设施使流动性提供者（LPs）面临“公地悲剧”：流动性提供者缺乏退出流动性池的激励以防止套利损失，因为这些损失是集体承担的，而退出成本由个人承担。套利租金主要流向验证者作为基础设施费用，中位套利者将96%的利润转移。提出的解决方案——速度技术、替代排序规则和灵活定价曲线——未能减少这些租金。利用硅谷银行危机作为自然实验，本文展示流动性提供者防御性地采用更凸的定价曲线以减轻逆向选择风险。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将公地悲剧概念引入DEX流动性提供问题，并用自然实验验证了LP的防御性行为，对理解DEX市场微观结构有重要贡献。

title: Π-CAPM: The Classical CAPM with Probability Weighting and Skewed Assets
abstract: We propose a new asset pricing model that generalizes the mean-variance framework by including probability weighting, specifically the overweighting of rare, high-impact events. Our model—the $ \Pi $-CAPM—generates several new predictions: (i) skewness has a positive price effect, amplified by volatility; (ii) the price effect of volatility is negative for left-skewed assets but positive for right-skewed assets; and (iii) option-implied variance premiums for stocks have a U-shaped relation to skewness, amplified by volatility. We find strong empirical support for these predictions. Finally, we show that the $ \Pi $-CAPM predicts an exaggerated co-movement of assets and can explain the correlation premium.
summary: 本文提出了一个新颖的资产定价模型Π-CAPM，它通过纳入概率加权（特别是对罕见高影响事件的过度加权）来推广均值-方差框架。该模型产生了若干新预测：偏度具有正向的价格效应，且该效应会随着波动率的增加而放大；波动率的价格效应对于左偏资产为负，而对于右偏资产为正；股票的期权隐含方差溢价与偏度呈U型关系，且这种关系会随波动率增加而放大。作者发现了对这些预测的强实证支持。最后，Π-CAPM还预测了资产的过度联动，并能解释相关性溢价。
ai_comment: 该模型通过引入概率加权扩展了经典CAPM，为偏度和波动率的定价效应提供了统一解释，实证结果增强了其可信度。

title: Default Costs and Repayment of Underwater Mortgages
abstract: We explore an overlooked phenomenon in mortgage markets: repayment of underwater mortgages. Using a sample of mortgages terminated between 2007 and 2016, we show that such repayment indeed occurs, and that it is affected by the same factors commonly used in studies of default: the magnitude of home equity and the borrower’s credit score, which captures default cost as well as liquidity. A novel insight is that underwater repayers, unlike most defaulters, are not liquidity constrained, providing a much cleaner environment to study default costs. We estimate lower bounds on these costs. Our results indicate that default costs are substantial.
summary: 本文研究了抵押贷款市场中一个被忽视的现象——水下抵押贷款的偿还。通过使用2007年至2016年间终止的抵押贷款样本，研究表明这种偿还确实存在，并且受通常用于违约研究的相同因素影响：房屋净值的大小和借款人的信用评分，后者捕捉了违约成本和流动性。一个新颖的见解是，水下偿还者与大多数违约者不同，不受流动性约束，这为研究违约成本提供了一个更干净的环境。本文估计了这些成本的下限，结果表明违约成本是巨大的。
ai_comment: 本文指出了水下抵押贷款偿还这一被忽视的现象，并利用其无流动性约束的特点更干净地估计违约成本，为理解抵押贷款违约决策提供了新视角。

title: Real Effects of Non‐Streamlined Sales Tax Administration: Evidence from the Florida Hotel Industry
abstract: We examine whether the local administration of sales taxes (as opposed to a more streamlined state administration) affects the real economy for businesses complying with the tax. We study this question in the Florida hotel industry, as counties in Florida can choose to locally administer the county‐level tourist tax or have the state administer the county‐level tax along with the state‐level tourist tax. Local administration is popular because it supports local employment (of tax administrators) and provides more stringent enforcement on non‐commercial operators (e.g., private rentals). State administration, however, has fewer compliance costs for hotels (e.g., reduced filings and fewer audits). Commentary from the profession suggests the incremental compliance costs of local administration can be considerable. We find that counties switching from state to local administration of tourist taxes is associated with slower growth in aggregate hotel payroll and employment, consistent with local tax administration increasing compliance costs to the point that affected businesses cut other services.
summary: 本文研究非精简销售税管理（地方管理相对于更集中的州管理）对合规企业实体经济的影响。以佛罗里达州酒店业为研究对象，因为该州各县可选择自行管理县级旅游税，或由州政府连同州级旅游税一并管理。地方管理因支持本地就业（税收管理员）并能对非商业经营者（如私人租赁）实施更严格执法而受欢迎，但州管理对酒店而言合规成本较低（如减少申报和审计）。行业评论指出地方管理的增量合规成本可能相当大。研究发现，从州管理转向地方管理旅游税的县，其酒店业总工资和就业增长较慢，这与地方税收管理增加合规成本、导致受影响企业削减其他服务的结论一致。
ai_comment: 该文利用佛罗里达州独特的制度差异，实证揭示了地方税收管理对酒店业实际雇佣和工资的负面影响，为税收合规成本的实体经济后果提供了新证据。

title: Shared Destinies? Small Banks and Small Businesses
abstract: We identify a new source for the declining role of small banks in the banking industry: Long-term changes in the banking sector are partially a consequence of changes in the industrial sector. Small banks are relatively more exposed to small business shocks, because small businesses compose a larger share of their customers. Lower real-side demand for small business financial services is responsible for part of the relative decline in small banks’ deposits. Rough calculations suggest that deposits at small banks would have been $280 billion higher from 2002 to 2017 if small firms had grown at the rate of larger firms.
summary: 这篇论文识别出小银行在银行业中角色下降的一个新来源：银行部门的长期变化部分源于工业部门的变化。小银行相对更多地暴露于小企业冲击，因为小企业在其客户中占更大比例。小企业金融服务实际需求的下降部分解释了小银行存款的相对减少。粗略计算表明，如果小企业以与大企业相同的速度增长，2002年至2017年间小银行的存款将增加2800亿美元。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了银行部门与实体经济部门之间的因果关系，强调了小企业需求变化对银行结构的显著影响，为理解金融中介演变提供了新视角。

title: How Does Removing the Tax Benefits of Debt Affect Firms? Evidence from the 2017 U.S. Tax Reform
abstract: The impact of tax benefits of debt on firms remains an open question. The 2017 U.S. tax reform limited the tax advantage of debt for all firms except for small businesses with average sales below $25 million. A regression discontinuity design based on the exception threshold shows that, as tax benefits of debt shrink, corporate debt declines significantly, while equity does not increase sufficiently to offset the reduction. Treated firms also decrease their investments due to the higher cost of capital. Overall, we document a first-order role for tax incentives that affect the cost of capital in shaping corporate policies. (JEL G31, G32, G38, H25, K34)
summary: 2017年美国税改缩减了所有企业的债务税收优势，但平均销售额低于2500万美元的小型企业除外。基于该豁免阈值，采用断点回归设计发现，随着债务税收利益减少，公司债务显著下降，而股权融资的增加不足以抵消债务的减少；受处理企业还因资本成本上升而减少投资。这表明税收激励通过影响资本成本在企业政策制定中发挥首要作用。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验提供了税收激励影响公司财务决策的因果证据，断点回归设计有效控制了内生性。

title: Option Auctions
abstract: Wholesale market makers pay for retail options orders that must be executed on exchanges. Payment for order flow (PFOF) wholesalers compete via price improvement in exchange auctions. To attract retail orders, wholesalers run more auctions when their recent price improvement has been lower. However, auction price improvement lowers market maker revenues. Wholesalers earn revenues to pay PFOF in nonauction trades where their designated market maker status increases their execution priority. While some auctions produce substantial price improvement, most do not have multiple bidders offering meaningful price improvement. Overall, options market structure better promotes competition in auctions than in nonauctions.
summary: 本文研究期权市场中的订单流付款（PFOF）与拍卖机制。批发市场做市商为零售订单支付订单流付款，这些订单必须通过交易所拍卖执行。PFOF批发商通过提供价格改善参与拍卖竞争，且近期价格改善水平较低时会增加拍卖频率以吸引零售订单。然而，拍卖中的价格改善降低了做市商收入，批发商主要通过非拍卖交易（利用指定做市商身份获得执行优先权）赚取收入以支付PFOF。尽管部分拍卖产生显著价格改善，但大多数拍卖缺乏多个竞标者提供有意义的价格改善。总体而言，期权市场结构在拍卖中比非拍卖中更能促进竞争。
ai_comment: 本文实证揭示了期权拍卖与订单流付款之间的动态关系，指出拍卖机制虽促进竞争，但多数拍卖存在竞标不足问题，实际价格改善有限。

title: Foreign Exchange Order Flow as a Risk Factor
abstract: We propose a novel pricing factor for currency returns motivated by the market microstructure literature. Our factor aggregates order flow data to provide a measure of buying and selling pressure related to conventional currency trading strategies. It successfully prices the cross-section of currency returns sorted on the basis of forward discount and momentum. The association between our factor and currency returns differs according to the customer segment of the foreign exchange market. In particular, it appears that financial customers are risk-takers in the market, while nonfinancial customers serve as liquidity providers.
summary: 本文提出了一个受市场微观结构文献启发的新型货币回报定价因子。该因子通过聚合订单流数据，构建了与常规货币交易策略相关的买卖压力度量，并成功解释了基于远期贴水和动量的货币回报截面差异。研究发现，该因子与货币回报的关系因外汇市场客户类型而异，具体而言，金融客户表现出风险承担者角色，而非金融客户则充当流动性提供者。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙地将市场微观结构中的订单流信息引入资产定价领域，为理解货币回报的截面差异提供了新视角，并揭示了不同客户群体的角色差异。

title: Debt Maturity and Investor Heterogeneity
abstract: This paper studies how investor heterogeneity impacts equilibrium debt maturity. The optimal issuance strategy combines long- and short-term debts. A long-term debt contains default risk but hedges against intermediate downturns. A short-term debt provides repayment commitment but requires being rolled over and becomes risky during downturns. Issuing multiple debt maturities spreads the cost of these risky claims to investors most willing to hold risk at different points in time. The model predicts that debt maturity is more dispersed with lower financing costs and more investment opportunities when debt ownership is spread among many different types of investors.
summary: 本文研究投资者异质性如何影响均衡债务期限结构。最优发行策略是同时发行长期和短期债务：长期债务虽包含违约风险，但能够对冲经济中期下行；短期债务虽提供偿还承诺的约束，但需要展期且在经济低迷时变得有风险。通过发行多种期限的债务，可以将风险成本分散给不同时间点最愿意承担风险的投资者。模型预测，当债务所有权分散在多种不同类型的投资者中时，债务期限更为分散，融资成本更低，且投资机会更多。
ai_comment: 本文将投资者异质性纳入债务期限结构分析，为多期限债务共存提供了新的理论解释，具有较强的现实意义。

title: The Role of Taxes in the Rise of ETFs
abstract: This paper argues that a lesser known yet economically significant tax-deferral feature of ETFs’ security design is crucial to their success. By relying on the in-kind redemption exemption, authorized participants help ETFs avoid distributing capital gains and reduce their tax overhang, partly by deploying heartbeat trades. We estimate that the ETF tax efficiency has increased long-term investors’ after-tax returns by 1.05% per year relative to mutual funds in recent years. Exploiting cross-sectional and time-series variations in investors’ tax burden, we show that tax efficiency is a significant driver of capital migration by high-net-worth investors from mutual funds into ETFs.
summary: 本文探讨税收在交易所交易基金（ETF）兴起中的关键作用，指出ETF设计中一个被忽视但经济上显著的税收递延特征是其成功的重要因素。通过依赖实物赎回豁免，授权参与者帮助ETF避免分配资本利得并减少税收积压，部分通过执行心跳交易实现。我们估计，近年来ETF的税收效率使长期投资者的税后回报相对于共同基金每年提高1.05%。利用投资者税收负担的横截面和时间序列变化，我们表明税收效率是高净值投资者资金从共同基金转向ETF的重要驱动因素。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统量化了税收效率对ETF成功的影响，揭示了实物赎回豁免和心跳交易机制在提升税后回报中的关键作用，为理解ETF的快速增长提供了新视角。

title: Does Disagreement Facilitate Informed Trading?
abstract: Using high-frequency disagreement data from the investor social network StockTwits, we find that greater unsophisticated disagreement facilitates informed buying and selling. During periods of overvaluation, the facilitating effect of disagreement on trading is dampened for informed buyers but is amplified for informed sellers. These findings are unexplained by sentiment, news, and retail order flow, and they remain when we measure disagreement overnight and disagreement of technical investors, which alleviates the concern that disagreement and informed trading respond to a common shock. These findings suggest that informed traders respond meaningfully but differently to valuation changes induced by unsophisticated disagreement.
summary: 本文利用来自投资者社交网络StockTwits的高频分歧数据，研究了非专业投资者之间的分歧如何影响知情交易。研究发现，更大的非专业分歧促进了知情买入和卖出。在估值过高时期，分歧对交易的促进效应对知情买方减弱，但对知情卖方增强。这些发现不能被情绪、新闻和零售订单流所解释，并且在隔夜分歧和技术投资者分歧的测量中依然稳健，从而缓解了分歧与知情交易对共同冲击反应的担忧。结果表明，知情交易者对非专业分歧引起的估值变化做出了有意义但不同的反应。
ai_comment: 该研究利用社交媒体高频数据为分歧与知情交易的关系提供了新颖证据，并揭示了不同市场状态下买卖双方的异质性反应，对理解信息交易行为具有重要价值。

title: Local Labor Markets and Corporate Innovation
abstract: We construct a measure ( fLMA ) of the extent to which neighboring firms hire similar types of workers, based on the similarity between the labor profile of a firm and that of its locality. We show that a firm’s innovation is positively related to fLMA. The enhanced labor mobility induced by higher fLMA is an important channel for this positive relation. This relation is stronger when firms have increased outside job opportunities for employees, increased knowledge spillovers via coworkership, and more employee stock options. Innovation is higher when intellectual property ownership is with employers, not employees. This effect increases in fLMA.
summary: 本文构建了一个衡量公司与其所在地劳动力画像相似度的指标fLMA，并发现公司创新与fLMA正相关。增强的劳动力流动性是这一正向关系的重要渠道。当员工拥有更多外部工作机会、通过同事关系实现的知识溢出更多、以及员工股票期权更多时，该关系更强。此外，当知识产权归属于雇主而非员工时，创新水平更高，且该效应随fLMA增大而增强。
ai_comment: 本文将劳动力市场结构与公司创新联系起来，提出了新颖的fLMA指标，并揭示了劳动力流动性作为关键传导机制，对创新经济学有重要贡献。

title: Does Saving Cause Borrowing? Implications for the Coholding Puzzle
abstract: Using an experiment in which 3.1 million bank customers were encouraged to save, we explore the mechanisms behind coholding liquid savings and credit card debt. Theoretically, we show that the joint responses of spending, saving, and borrowing to the nudge differ across economic models of coholding. Using machine learning techniques, we find that the most responsive individuals reduce spending and increase savings by 4.9% (206 USD PPP per month) while their credit card debt remains unchanged. These individuals' marginal responses to the nudge are consistent with our model of coholding for the purpose of self‐ or partner‐control.
summary: 该论文通过一项涉及310万银行客户的实验，探究了同时持有流动性储蓄和信用卡债务（共持有谜题）的机制。理论上，作者展示了不同经济模型对储蓄推动的反应差异；实证中，利用机器学习技术发现，最敏感的个体在受到推动后减少了支出并将储蓄增加了4.9%（相当于每月206美元购买力平价），而信用卡债务保持不变。这些边际反应与自我或伴侣控制的共持有模型一致。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模随机实验和机器学习方法，为共持有谜题提供了机制证据，支持了自我控制动机的解释，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Can Author Manipulation of AI Referees be Welfare Improving?
abstract: This paper examines a new moral hazard in delegated decision-making: authors can embed hidden instructions-known as prompt injections-to bias AI referees in academic peer review.If AI reviews are inexpensive, referees may delegate fully.If AI quality is low, this leads to market collapse.The paper shows that the possibility of manipulation, combined with moderate detection, can paradoxically improve welfare in this low-quality regime.With intermediate detection probabilities, only low-quality authors undertake manipulation, and detection becomes informative about quality, inducing referees to mix between manual and AI reviews.This mixed-strategy equilibrium disciplines referees and generates information, potentially sustaining the market when AI quality is low.However, this benefit vanishes when AI quality is intermediate or high; in these cases, strong detection is optimal as it enables an efficient pure AI market.Thus, prompt injection can play a welfare-enhancing role, but only when AI reviews are easily produced but insufficiently accurate.The results highlight a non-monotonic relationship between enforcement and welfare in the presence of weak AI technologies.
summary: 本文研究委托决策中的新型道德风险：作者可以通过嵌入隐藏指令（称为提示注入）来操纵AI审稿人，从而在学术同行评议中产生偏见。如果AI评审成本低廉，审稿人可能会完全委托给AI。当AI质量较低时，这会导致市场崩溃。论文表明，结合适度的检测，操纵的可能性可以反常地改善低质量AI下的福利。在中等检测概率下，只有低质量作者会进行操纵，检测变得具有信息性，促使审稿人在手动评审和AI评审之间混合使用。这种混合策略均衡约束了审稿人并产生信息，可能在AI质量较低时维持市场。然而，当AI质量中等或较高时，这种好处消失；在这些情况下，强检测是最优的，因为它能够实现高效的纯AI市场。因此，提示注入可以发挥提升福利的作用，但仅在AI评审易于产生但不够准确的情况下。结果凸显了在AI技术薄弱时，执法与福利之间存在非单调关系。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了在AI质量低下时，作者操纵行为可能意外提升福利的非单调效应，为AI辅助决策中的道德风险提供了新颖视角。

title: The Risk, Reward, and Asset Allocation of Nonprofit Endowment Funds
abstract: Using tax filings from 374,351 U.S. nonprofit organizations from 2008 to 2020, we provide the first large-scale analysis of endowment prevalence, function, asset allocation, and returns.Endowment use varies systematically across sectors and revenue models.Organizations with endowments scale mission-related spending more effectively and hedge revenue risk through asset allocation.Yet most endowments underperform passive benchmarks, with the weakest performance concentrated among smaller, self-managed funds.Advisory fees are positively correlated with gross returns but negatively with net returns, suggesting overpayment for investment services.Stronger governance, lower discretionary spending, and the use of outsourced CIOs are associated with better performance.
