We interpret this finding as evidence that firms increase tournament incentives to keep executives incentivized after the loss of valuable outside employment options. Consistent with this argument, we observe more significant increases in pay gaps for executives with greater ex ante mobility options. However, shocks reducing enforceability have a weaker, less robust impact on pay gaps, contributing to asymmetric effects. Following restrictions to mobility, equity portfolios that long (short) firms that boost (do not boost) executive pay gaps generate positive alphas.
summary: 本文研究外部就业机会对高管锦标赛激励的影响。通过分析竞业禁止协议的可执行性，发现当高管流动性受到更可执行的竞业禁止协议限制时，公司会扩大高管薪酬差距。这一结果被解释为公司旨在通过增强锦标赛激励，使高管在失去有价值的外部就业选项后仍保持动力。进一步支持该论点的证据表明，对于事前流动性更高的高管，薪酬差距的增加更为显著。然而，降低可执行性的冲击对薪酬差距的影响较弱且不够稳健，导致不对称效应。在流动性受限后，买入扩大高管薪酬差距的公司股票、卖出未扩大差距的公司股票的投资组合产生了正alpha。
ai_comment: 利用竞业禁止协议的自然实验，揭示了薪酬差距作为替代激励机制的动态调整，并发现了不对称效应的存在，对锦标赛激励理论有重要补充。

title: Does Private Equity Ownership Make Firms Cleaner? The Role of Environmental Liability Risks
abstract: This paper shows that private equity (PE) ownership, in private-to-private buyouts, leads to a reduction in pollution when the target company faces high potential liabilities for polluting. Conversely, PE-backed firms increase pollution when environmental liability risks are low, as shown by a novel natural experiment that reduced these risks for projects located on federal land. Exploiting specific PE deals within the energy industry, I find that PE governance is the main driver of the results. The results suggest that increasing litigation and regulation-related risks can mitigate the potentially detrimental effects of PE ownership on stakeholders.
summary: 这篇论文研究了私募股权（PE）所有权对企业污染排放的影响。通过分析私人对私人收购交易，发现当目标公司面临较高的潜在污染责任风险时，PE所有权会导致污染减少；反之，当环境责任风险较低时，PE支持的企业会增加污染。研究利用了一个新颖的自然实验——该实验降低了位于联邦土地上的项目的环境责任风险——验证了上述结论。进一步聚焦能源行业的特定PE交易，发现PE治理是影响结果的主要驱动因素。结果表明，增加诉讼和监管相关风险可以缓解PE所有权对利益相关者可能产生的不利影响。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用自然实验识别了PE所有权对环境影响的因果效应，揭示了PE治理的关键作用，为监管政策提供了实证依据。

title: A Macroeconomic Model of Central Bank Digital Currency
abstract: We develop a quantitative New Keynesian DSGE model with monopolistic banks to study the macroeconomic effects of introducing a central bank digital currency (CBDC).Households benefit from an expansion of liquidity services and higher deposit rates as bank deposit market power is curtailed, while bank profitability and lending decline.We assess this trade-off for a wide range of economies that differ in their level of interest rates.We find substantial welfare gains from introducing a CBDC with an optimal rate that can be approximated by a simple rule of thumb: the maximum between 0% and the policy rate minus 1%.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含垄断银行的新凯恩斯DSGE定量模型，研究引入央行数字货币（CBDC）的宏观经济效应。家庭受益于流动性服务的扩展以及银行存贷款市场势力被削弱后存款利率的上升，但银行盈利能力和贷款规模下降。作者评估了不同利率水平的经济体中的这一权衡，发现引入CBDC能带来显著的福利收益，其最优利率可以近似为一个简单的经验法则：取0%与政策利率减1%之间的最大值。
ai_comment: 该论文通过定量模型评估了CBDC的宏观经济影响，提出了一个简单实用的最优利率规则，对央行政策设计有重要参考价值。

title: Building Costs and House Prices
abstract: We take a long, broad, and theoretically agnostic view toward the connection between building costs and house prices in the US housing market.We find that building costs have never had all that much explanatory power over US housing prices, but even the imperfect correlations of the past have weakened further in recent decades along multiple dimensions.
summary: 本文对美国住房市场中建筑成本与房价之间的关系进行了长期、广泛且理论中立的考察。研究发现，建筑成本对房价的解释力历来不强，而近几十年来，这种原本不完美的相关性在多个维度上进一步减弱。
ai_comment: 本文通过长期数据挑战了建筑成本决定房价的传统观点，揭示了二者关系的弱化趋势，为理解房价波动提供了新视角。

title: Maturity Risks and Bank Runs
abstract: Inspired by the Silicon Valley Bank run and building on Diamond-Dybvig (1993), we develop a model in which asset price fluctuations can trigger bank runs.Liquidation amounts to selling assets at their market price.Depositors can buy and hold the assets after paying an idiosyncratic cost.We characterize the equilibria.We introduce a withdrawal pressure function to distinguish between fundamental runs, driven by market price declines, and self-enforcing runs triggered by depositor panic.Deposit insurance can prevent self-enforcing runs but incurs losses during fundamental runs.Regulatory measures ensuring price resilience reduce run risks, but at the expense of depositor welfare.
summary: 受硅谷银行挤兑启发，并在Diamond-Dybvig (1993)基础上，本文构建了一个资产价格波动可触发银行挤兑的模型。清算即按市场价格出售资产，存款人支付异质性成本后可购买并持有资产。通过刻画均衡，引入提款压力函数区分由市场价格下跌驱动的基本面挤兑和由存款人恐慌触发的自执行挤兑。研究发现，存款保险可防止自执行挤兑，但在基本面挤兑中会产生损失；确保价格弹性的监管措施能降低挤兑风险，但会损害存款人福利。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分基本面和恐慌性挤兑机制，为理解硅谷银行事件提供了理论框架，并揭示了存款保险与价格稳定监管措施之间的福利权衡。

title: Designing Human-AI Collaboration: A Sufficient-Statistic Approach
abstract: We propose a sufficient statistic for designing AI information-disclosure and selective automation policies.The approach allows for endogenous and biased beliefs, and effort crowd-out, without using a structural model of human decision-making.We deploy and validate our approach in a factchecking experiment.Humans under-respond to AI predictions and reduce effort when presented with confident AI predictions.Overconfidence in own-signal rather than under-confidence in AI drives AI under-response.The optimal policy automates decisions where the AI is confident and delegates the other decisions while fully disclosing the AI prediction.Although automation is valuable, the benefit of assisting humans with AI is negligible.
summary: 本文提出了一种用于设计AI信息揭示和选择性自动化策略的充分统计量方法。该方法允许内生和有偏信念以及努力挤出，无需使用人类决策的结构模型。作者在事实核查实验中部署并验证了该方法。实验发现，人类对AI预测反应不足，并且在面对自信的AI预测时会减少自身努力。这种对AI预测的反应不足是由对自己信号的过度自信驱动，而非对AI的不自信。最优策略是自动化AI有信心的决策，并委托其他决策同时完全揭示AI预测。尽管自动化具有价值，但用AI辅助人类带来的收益微乎其微。
ai_comment: 提出了一种无需结构模型的充分统计量方法设计人机协作策略，并通过实验揭示了人类对AI预测反应不足的深层原因——过度自信而非对AI不自信，为AI系统设计提供了新视角。

title: Financing the Next VC-Backed Startup: The Role of Gender
abstract: What is the role of gender in the serial founding of VC-backed startups?Despite robust evidence linking serial entrepreneurship to startup success, women comprise 13.3% of VC-backed founders but only 4% of those founding three or more startups.Using a novel design comparing men and women cofounders of the same startup, we estimate substantial gender gaps in subsequent funding outcomes on average and following failure or success of the current startup.We find these at both the extensive and intensive margins.For example, following failure, women are 22.5% less likely to found another VC-backed startup compared to their cofounders who are men.Among those who do found another VC-backed firm, women raise 53.3% less capital following failure of the current venture and 24.6% less capital following success.These gaps contribute to the well-documented gender gap in VC funding.Lower interest of women in founding new firms can only partially explain our findings.We find no evidence of gender differences in founder quality or of statistical updating by investors.Instead, consistent with unequal treatment of women, we find that women serial founders are penalized with smaller VC deals following failures of their prior startups but they are not rewarded with larger deal sizes following past successes.By contrast, men are rewarded for their prior experiences as founders, regardless of whether their startups were failures or successes.In line with theories of stereotyping and confirmation bias, we also find striking negative spillovers from unrelated women-founded failures within investors' portfolios (and no positive spillovers from their successes).
summary: 本文研究性别在连续创立风投（VC）支持创业公司中的作用。女性占VC支持创始人的13.3%，但仅占创立三家及以上创业公司的4%。通过比较同一创业公司中男女联合创始人的后续融资结果，发现平均而言以及当前创业成功或失败后，存在显著的性别差距：失败后，女性再创立VC支持公司的可能性比男性联合创始人低22.5%；在成功后再创立时，女性融资额低24.6%；失败后则低53.3%。这些差距部分可由女性创业兴趣较低解释，但无法由创始人质量差异或投资者统计更新解释。相反，与不平等待遇一致，女性连续创始人因先前失败在VC交易中受到惩罚（规模更小），而不因成功获得奖励；男性则无论先前成败，均因经验获得奖励。此外，还发现投资者投资组合中其他无关女性创立的失败带来显著的负面溢出效应（成功无正面溢出），符合刻板印象和确认偏误理论。
ai_comment: 该文通过巧妙的联合创始人比较设计，揭示了性别在VC连续创业中的不对称奖惩机制，并识别出投资者层面的负面溢出效应，为理解性别差距提供了新视角。

title: Private Equity and Workers: Modeling and Measuring Monopsony, Implicit Contracts, and Efficient Reallocation
abstract: We measure the real effects of private equity buyouts on worker outcomes by building a new database that links transactions to matched employer-employee data in the United States.To guide our empirical analysis, we derive testable implications from three theories in which private equity managers alter worker outcomes: (1) exertion of monopsony power in concentrated markets, (2) breach of implicit contracts with targeted groups of workers, including managers and top earners, and (3) efficient reallocation of workers across plants.We do not find any evidence that private equity-backed firms vary wages and employment based on local labor market power proxies.Wage losses are also very similar for managers and top earners.Instead, we find strong evidence that private equity managers downsize less productive plants relative to productive plants while simultaneously reallocating high-wage workers to more productive plants.We conclude that postbuyout employment and wage dynamics are consistent with professional investors providing incentives to increase productivity and monitor the companies in which they invest.
summary: 本文通过构建一个将美国私人股权交易与匹配的雇主-雇员数据联系起来的新数据库，衡量私人股权收购对工人结果的真实影响。为引导实证分析，作者从三种理论中推导出可检验的推论：一是私人股权经理在集中市场中行使垄断权力；二是违反与目标工人群体（包括经理和高收入者）的隐性合同；三是跨工厂的高效劳动力重新配置。研究发现，没有证据表明私人股权支持的企业会根据当地劳动力市场权力代理指标调整工资和就业；经理和高收入者的工资损失也非常相似。相反，有强有力的证据表明，私人股权经理相对于高生产率工厂会缩减低生产率工厂的规模，同时将高工资工人重新分配到高生产率工厂。结论认为，收购后的就业和工资动态与专业投资者提供激励以提高生产率并监控所投资公司的行为一致。
ai_comment: 该研究利用详尽的雇主-雇员匹配数据，系统检验了私人股权收购影响工人的三种竞争性理论，为理解PE对劳动力市场的影响提供了严谨的实证证据。

title: Does Matching Contribution Incentivize Informal Workers to Participate in Retirement Saving Plans? A Randomized Evaluation Interacted with a Natural Experiment
abstract: We conducted a large field experiment in Peru on informal workers and studied whether offering them a matching contribution raise participation and contributions in their Individual Retirement Accounts.We had three groups: a control group receiving no match, and two treatments groups receiving 50 and 100 percent match, respectively.Additionally, due to the time span, we can also analyze the difference responses between pre and during Covid-19.The results were as follows.First, the match incentive increases participation.Workers in the 50 and 100 percent match groups show participation rates of 5.2 and 6.5 p.p. higher than workers in the control group, respectively.The participation effect is also present pre Covid-19 and disappears during it.Second, the 100 percent match incentive was the only effective in increasing savings among all individuals (1.4 p.p.), pre (2.3 p.p.) and during Covid-19 (0.97 p.p.).This effect still presents in LATE specification with higher p.p. Third, 100% match was again the only effective to make contribute more than once, in the full sample (1.2 p.p.), and pre Covid-19 (2.7 p.p.), including LATE specification (full sample -5.6 p.p.; pre .Fourth the 50 percent match is not effective in raising contribution in any specification.
summary: 本文通过在秘鲁对非正式工人进行的大规模实地实验，研究匹配缴款能否提高其个人退休账户的参与率和缴款额。实验设置三个组：对照组（无匹配）、50%匹配组和100%匹配组，并利用时间跨度分析新冠疫情前后的不同反应。结果发现：匹配激励提高了参与率，50%和100%匹配组的参与率分别比对照组高5.2和6.5个百分点，该效应在疫情前存在但疫情期间消失；仅100%匹配激励有效增加了全体样本的储蓄（1.4个百分点）、疫情前（2.3个百分点）和疫情期间（0.97个百分点），在LATE估计中效应更大；仅100%匹配激励使工人多次缴款（全体样本1.2个百分点，疫情前2.7个百分点），LATE估计中全体样本为5.6个百分点；50%匹配在任何设定下均未有效提高缴款。
ai_comment: 该研究通过田野实验结合自然实验，为匹配激励对非正式工人退休储蓄行为的影响提供了因果证据，并揭示了疫情冲击下激励效果的异质性，对设计针对非正规部门的社会保障政策具有重要参考价值。

title: Using AI to Generate Option C Scaling Ideas: A Case Study in Early Education
abstract: In recent years, field experiments have reshaped policy worldwide, but scaling ideas remains a thorny challenge.Perhaps the most important issue facing policymakers today is deciding which ideas to scale.One approach to attenuate this information problem is to augment traditional A/B experimental designs to address questions of scalability from the beginning.List 2024 denotes this approach as "Option C" thinking.Using early education as a case study, we show how AI can overcome a critical barrier in Option C thinking -generating viable options for scaling experimentation.By integrating AI-driven insights, this approach strengthens the link between controlled trials and large-scale implementation, ensuring the production of policy-based evidence for effective decision-making.
summary: 本文探讨如何利用人工智能（AI）生成Option C扩展思路，以解决政策实验中决定哪些想法可以规模化的挑战。Option C思维（List 2024）是一种通过改进传统A/B实验设计来预先评估可扩展性的方法。以早期教育为例，研究展示AI如何克服Option C思维中的关键障碍——生成可行的扩展实验选项。通过整合AI驱动的洞察，该方法增强了受控试验与大规模实施之间的联系，从而为有效决策提供基于政策的证据。
ai_comment: 创新性地将AI与Option C思维结合，为政策实验的可扩展性评估提供了新路径；以早期教育为案例，展示了AI在生成实验选项中的实际应用价值。

title: Defaulting 401(k) Assets into Payout Annuities for “Pretty Good” Lifetime Incomes
abstract: Some US defined contribution plans offer retirees access to an annuity or lifetime income stream as payout options from their 401(k) accounts.Nevertheless, for behavioral reasons, some retirees may hesitate to elect lifetime income streams as a drawdown vehicle.To counter this, plan sponsors could automatically allocate a portion of retirees' 401(k) assets to annuities, now that regulatory barriers to doing so have eased.Using a lifecycle economic model, we evaluate the pros and cons of defaulting retirees' 401(k) assets into payout annuities.We show that defaulting 20% of a retiree's assets over a threshold into an immediate annuity enhances retirement security for most plan participants.An annuity deferred to the age of 80 is particularly beneficial to college graduates, in terms of enhancing their welfare
summary: 本文研究美国固定缴款计划（如401(k)）中，将退休资产默认配置为支付年金（payout annuity）以提供终身收入的利弊。由于行为因素，部分退休者可能不愿主动选择年金，而计划发起人可自动将一定比例的资产投入年金。作者使用生命周期经济模型，评估默认将超过阈值的20%资产投入即时年金的效果，发现此举能提升大多数参与者的退休安全性。此外，将年金延迟到80岁领取对大学毕业生尤其有益，能显著提高其福利。
ai_comment: 该研究利用生命周期模型量化评估默认年金策略的福利效应，为政策制定提供了重要参考，尤其关注了不同教育水平群体的异质性影响。

title: Firm Investment and the User Cost of Capital: New U.S. Corporate Tax Reform Evidence
abstract: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA) marked the first time in three decades that material changes were made to the corporate tax code of the United States.We use TCJA as a quasi natural experiment to estimate the impact of changes in user cost of capital on investment.Following the method of Auerbach and Hassett (1991), using cross-sectional data we find that the user cost is associated with higher rates of investment consistent with previous studies.BEA asset types with greater reductions in user cost of capital and marginal effective tax rate (METR) after the 2017 TCJA had greater statistically significant increases in their investment rates several years after the tax reform.Specifically, we find the magnitude of a 1 percentage point decrease in user cost is associated with a 1.68 to 3.05 percentage point increase in the rate of investment, larger than prior estimates of the responsiveness of investment with respect to user cost of capital.
summary: 本文利用2017年美国《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）作为准自然实验，估计用户资本成本变化对企业投资的影响。遵循Auerbach and Hassett (1991)的方法，使用横截面数据发现，用户成本与投资率正相关，与先前研究一致。具体而言，TCJA后用户成本和边际有效税率（METR）降幅更大的BEA资产类型，其投资率在税改后几年有更显著的统计性增长。结果表明，用户成本每降低1个百分点，投资率增加1.68至3.05个百分点，该弹性大于先前估计。
ai_comment: 本文利用TCJA这一重大税改事件，提供了用户成本与投资弹性更大的新证据，对企业税收政策评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Growth in AI Knowledge
abstract: Building on recent advances in the literature on knowledge creation and innovation (notably Carnehl and Schneider (2025), we propose a novel general equilibrium model that explicitly incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) as a decision-enhancing technology capable of interpolating between known points of knowledge.Our framework formalises the trade-off between AI's coverage-its ability to span wider knowledge gaps-and its accuracy, and reveals the surprising result that, beyond producing immediate productivity gains, AI fundamentally alters the novelty of research.Specifically, when AI systems offer sufficiently broad coverage, they incentivise exploratory research that taps into novel, distant areas of knowledge and accelerates long-run growth; conversely, limited coverage promotes incremental research that may boost short-term efficiency while dampening the overall advancement of new ideas.Moreover, our analysis uncovers that the type of knowledge-whether novel or dense-plays a critical role in determining both the growth and welfare implications of AI, charting a new path for understanding how knowledge influences research strategies.By also examining the roles of market structure, licensing arrangements, and regulatory frameworks, our work contributes new, policy-relevant insights that reconcile the immediate benefits of AI adoption with the demands of sustainable long-term economic expansion.
summary: 本文基于Carnehl和Schneider（2025）的知识创造与创新文献，提出一个包含人工智能（AI）作为决策增强技术的新型一般均衡模型。AI能够内插已知知识点，模型形式化了AI的覆盖度（跨越更广知识差距的能力）与准确性之间的权衡。研究发现，除了直接的生产力提升，AI会根本性地改变研究的新颖性：当AI覆盖范围足够广时，会激励探索性研究，进入新颖、遥远的知识领域，加速长期增长；反之，有限的覆盖会促进渐进式研究，可能提升短期效率但抑制新思想的整体进步。此外，知识类型（新颖或密集）对AI的增长和福利影响起关键作用，为理解知识如何影响研究策略开辟了新路径。通过分析市场结构、许可安排和监管框架，本文提供了政策相关见解，协调了AI采用的即时收益与可持续长期经济增长的需求。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了AI覆盖度与长期增长之间的非平凡关系，为理解AI对知识生产的影响提供了新视角。

title: AI and Social Media: A Political Economy Perspective
abstract: We consider the political consequences of the use of artificial intelligence (AI) by online platforms engaged in social media content dissemination, entertainment, or electronic commerce.We identify two distinct but complementary mechanisms, the social media channel and the digital ads channel, which together and separately contribute to the polarization of voters and consequently the polarization of parties.First, AI-driven recommendations aimed at maximizing user engagement on platforms create echo chambers (or "filter bubbles") that increase the likelihood that individuals are not confronted with counter-attitudinal content.Consequently, social media engagement makes voters more polarized, and then parties respond by becoming more polarized themselves.Second, we show that party competition can encourage platforms to rely more on targeted digital ads for monetization (as opposed to a subscription-based business model), and such ads in turn make the electorate more polarized, further contributing to the polarization of parties.These effects do not arise when one party is dominant, in which case the profit-maximizing business model of the platform is subscription-based.We discuss the impact regulations can have on the polarizing effects of AI-powered online platforms.
summary: 这篇论文从政治经济学视角分析人工智能（AI）在社交媒体平台上的应用所产生的政治后果。研究识别出两个互补的机制：社交媒体渠道和数字广告渠道，它们共同或单独导致选民极化，进而促使政党极化。首先，AI驱动的推荐算法为最大化用户参与度而创建了“回音室”或“过滤气泡”，减少了用户接触对立观点的可能性，导致选民极化，政党随后响应而变得更加极化。其次，政党竞争可能促使平台更依赖定向数字广告（而非订阅制商业模式）来盈利，而这种广告进一步加剧了选民的极化，从而加深政党的极化。当某一政党占据主导地位时，这些效应不会出现，因为此时平台的利润最大化商业模式是订阅制。论文还讨论了监管措施如何影响AI驱动的在线平台的极化效应。
ai_comment: 该文从政治经济学角度系统剖析了AI驱动平台导致极化的双重渠道（社交与广告），并指出主导政党时的商业模式差异，为监管提供了理论依据。

title: Post-Pandemic Global Inflation, Disinflation, and Central Bank Policy Responses: A Review of the Facts, Empirical Findings, and their Implications for Monetary Policy Framework Assessments
abstract: This paper examines the 2021-2022 global inflation surge and the belated but aggressive monetary policy response to it by advanced economy central banks.Drawing on body of recent empirical research, it identifies three primary drivers of the global inflation surge: supply shocks from pandemic disruptions and Russia's invasion of Ukraine, accommodative fiscal and monetary policies that responded to the economic dislocation caused by pandemic, and a demand shift toward goods relative to services, that exacerbated supply chain pressures.Advanced economy central banks were initially slow to react but ultimately raised rates aggressively and succeeded, with help from a reversal of the initial supply shocks which contributed to the initial inflation surge, in returning inflation to "2 point something" were confident enough in the prospects for further disinflation to began cutting interest rates by the summer of 2024.The paper explores benefits and costs of proposals to make forward guidance on the policy rate and the balance sheet more robust and considers the benefits and costs of incorporating scenario analysis into the communication toolkit.
summary: 本文回顾了2021-2022年全球通胀飙升以及发达经济体央行对此迟缓但激进的货币政策反应。基于近期实证研究，本文识别出全球通胀飙升的三个主要驱动因素：疫情干扰和俄罗斯入侵乌克兰导致的供给冲击、应对疫情经济混乱的宽松财政和货币政策、以及需求从服务转向商品从而加剧供应链压力。发达经济体央行最初反应缓慢，但最终激进加息，并在初始供给冲击逆转的帮助下（这些冲击最初导致通胀飙升），成功将通胀降至“2点几”的水平，并且到2024年夏季对进一步去通胀的前景足够有信心，开始降息。本文探讨了使政策利率和资产负债表的前瞻指引更加稳健的提议的收益与成本，并考虑了将情景分析纳入沟通工具包的收益与成本。
ai_comment: 本文系统梳理了后疫情时代全球通胀的成因与央行应对，特别强调供给冲击反转在去通胀中的作用，对货币政策框架评估具有参考价值。

title: Gender, Race, and Entrepreneurship: A Randomized Field Experiment on Venture Capitalists and Angels
abstract: We study gender and race in high-impact entrepreneurship using a tightly controlled randomized field experiment. We sent out 80,000 pitch emails introducing promising but fictitious start-ups to 28,000 venture capitalists and angels. Each email was sent by a fictitious entrepreneur with randomly assigned gender and race. Female entrepreneurs received 9% more interested replies than males pitching identical projects and Asians received 6% more than Whites. Our results suggest that investors do not discriminate against female or Asian entrepreneurs when evaluating unsolicited pitch emails and that future research on investor biases should focus on networks and in-person interactions. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: The grant is Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada Insight Development [Grant 430-2019-00306] “Gender and racial discrimination in venture capital” through the University of British Columbia. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.4990 .
summary: 本文通过一个严格控制的随机田野实验，研究了性别和种族在高影响力创业中的作用。实验向28,000名风险投资人和天使投资人发送了80,000封介绍虚构初创企业的推销邮件，每封邮件由性别和种族随机分配的虚构创业者发送。结果显示，女性创业者比男性获得多9%的感兴趣回复，亚洲创业者比白人获得多6%的回复。这表明投资者在评估主动推销邮件时并未歧视女性或亚洲创业者，未来研究应关注网络和面对面互动中的偏见。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模随机实验提供了关于创业者性别和种族偏见的因果证据，挑战了普遍存在的歧视假设，并指出偏见可能出现在后续互动而非初始接触阶段。

title: Revisiting the CEO Effect Through a Machine Learning Lens
abstract: An important debated topic in strategic management concerns the so-called “chief executive officer (CEO) effect,” which quantifies the impact that CEOs have on the performance of the firms that they lead. Prior literature has empirically investigated the CEO effect and found support for both theses: a significant effect and no effect at all. We note, however, that virtually all prior studies have relied on an empirical specification that leverages in-sample data, which could be unreliable in certain circumstances. In this paper, we utilize machine learning models and predictive analytics based on out-of-sample data to revisit the CEO effect. In particular, we operationalize the CEO effect as the gain in the out-of-sample predictive accuracy by adding the CEO information to the model input in addition to the firm information. By analyzing 1,245 firms and 1,779 CEOs over 20 years, we demonstrate that the results of the approach from the literature have limited external validity. More specifically, we convey that the analyses are purely based on in-sample data and that the predictive effects of CEOs are not substantive when out-of-sample test data sets are used. Although our main analysis relies on optimized distributed gradient boosting, we also conduct extensive robustness tests spanning close to 100 models with alternative algorithms and specifications, all of which yield consistent results. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03625 .
summary: 本研究重新审视了战略管理中关于CEO效应（CEO对企业绩效的影响）的争议。传统文献使用样本内数据实证分析，得到了支持或否定CEO效应的不同结论。本文采用机器学习模型和基于样本外数据的预测分析，将CEO效应操作化为在模型输入中添加CEO信息后样本外预测准确性的提升。通过分析1,245家公司和1,779位CEO在20年间的数据，发现传统文献方法的结果外部有效性有限：CEO的预测效应在样本外测试中并不显著。主要分析基于优化分布式梯度提升（optimized distributed gradient boosting），并通过近100种不同算法和设定的稳健性检验得到一致结果。
ai_comment: 该研究通过引入样本外预测框架，为长期争论的CEO效应提供了有力证据，挑战了传统基于样本内分析的结论。其广泛的稳健性检验增强了结论的可信度。

title: Stock Return Autocorrelations and Expected Option Returns
abstract: We show that the return autocorrelation of underlying stock is an important determinant of expected equity option returns. Using an extended Black-Scholes model incorporating the presence of stock return autocorrelation, we demonstrate that expected returns of both call and put options are increasing in the return autocorrelation coefficient of the underlying stock. Consistent with this insight, we find strong empirical support in the cross-section of average returns of equity options. Our paper highlights the necessity to control for stock return autocorrelation when studying option return predictability. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03071 .
summary: 本文研究了标的股票收益的自相关对预期期权收益的影响。通过扩展Black-Scholes模型纳入股票收益自相关，理论上证明了看涨和看跌期权的预期收益均随标的股票收益自相关系数的增加而增加。实证分析基于期权横截面数据，提供了强有力的支持证据。论文强调，在研究期权收益可预测性时必须控制股票收益自相关因素。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地将股票收益自相关引入期权定价框架，揭示了其对期权收益的重要解释作用，为期权市场实证研究提供了新的控制变量。

title: Narratives and Valuations
abstract: Although the significance of narrative thinking has been increasingly recognized by social scientists, very little empirical research has documented its consequences for economically significant outcomes. The current paper addresses this gap in one important domain: valuations. In three experiments, participants were given the opportunity to sell an item they owned (mug in Study 1, hat in Studies 2 and 3) using an incentive-compatible procedure (multiple price list). Prior to making selling decisions, participants were randomly assigned to either a narrative treatment, in which they were asked to tell the story of their item, or a list treatment, in which they were asked to list the characteristics of their item. The narrative treatment led to significantly higher selling prices and increased rates of participants refusing all offered prices. We further explore potential mechanisms, and the impact of different types of narratives, by analyzing self-reported classifications of, and employing natural language processing techniques on, participants’ narratives. This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: Funding for the studies came from Loewenstein’s personal research fund provided by Carnegie Mellon University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01076 .
summary: 本文通过三个实验（杯子、帽子）研究叙事对物品估值的影响。参与者采用激励相容的多价列表达出售自持物品，随机分配到叙事处理（讲述物品故事）或列表处理（列出物品特征）。叙事处理导致显著更高的卖出价格，且更多参与者拒绝所有出价。进一步通过自我报告分类和自然语言处理分析参与者叙事，探索潜在机制及不同叙事类型的影响。该文被行为经济学与决策分析领域接受，由卡内基梅隆大学赞助。
ai_comment: 该文通过严谨实验设计，首次因果性地证实叙事对个人估值有显著影响，并利用NLP深入机制分析，为行为经济学贡献了新视角。

title: Managerial Overextrapolation: Who and When
abstract: Corporate managers overextrapolate past earnings in their earnings guidance, and this behavior is robust after including extensive controls, such as expectation management, earnings management, and overconfidence. The degree of overextrapolation is driven by the persistence of the underlying earnings process and other factors that affect representativeness heuristics, including trend, salience, and volatility. Experience and value diversity among corporate managers help mitigate this bias, whereas demographic diversity does not. Using the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, we provide causal evidence that managers overextrapolate past earnings. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00901 .
summary: 这篇论文研究企业管理者在发布盈利指引时过度外推过去盈利的行为。即使控制了预期管理、盈余管理和过度自信等因素，该行为依然稳健。过度外推的程度受基础盈利过程的持续性以及其他影响代表性启发式的因素（如趋势、显著性和波动性）驱动。管理者的经验和价值多样性有助于缓解这种偏差，但人口多样性则没有效果。利用2017年减税与就业法案（TCJA）作为外生冲击，论文提供了管理者过度外推过去盈利的因果证据。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证和因果识别方法，深入分析了管理者过度外推的驱动因素和缓解机制，特别是区分了不同类型多样性的影响，为行为金融学提供了新证据。

title: Passive Ownership and Price Informativeness
abstract: I show that passive ownership negatively affects the degree to which stock prices anticipate earnings announcements. Estimates across several research designs imply that the rise in passive ownership over the last 30 years has caused the amount of information incorporated into prices ahead of earnings announcements to decline by approximately one-fourth of its whole-sample mean and one-sixth of its whole-sample standard deviation. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00836 .
summary: 本文研究被动所有权（passive ownership）如何影响股价对盈余公告的预测能力（price informativeness）。通过多种研究设计估计，发现被动所有权显著降低了股价在盈余公告前提前反映信息（anticipate earnings announcements）的程度。具体而言，过去30年被动所有权的上升导致盈余公告前价格中融入的信息量下降了约整个样本均值的四分之一和整个样本标准差的三分之一。这表明被动投资的增加削弱了市场的价格发现功能。
ai_comment: 本文提供了被动投资对市场信息效率负面影响的直接证据，并且量化了其经济显著性，对理解被动投资崛起的影响具有重要贡献。

title: Multi-armed Bandit Experimental Design: Online Decision-Making and Adaptive Inference
abstract: Multi-armed bandit has been well known for its efficiency in online decision-making in terms of minimizing the loss of the participants’ welfare during experiments (i.e., the regret). In clinical trials and many other scenarios, the statistical power of inferring the treatment effects (i.e., the gaps between the mean outcomes of different arms) is also crucial. Nevertheless, minimizing the regret entails harming the statistical power of estimating the treatment effect because the observations from some arms can be limited. In this paper, we investigate the trade-off between efficiency and statistical power by casting the multi-armed bandit experimental design into a minimax multi-objective optimization problem. We introduce the concept of Pareto optimality to mathematically characterize the situation in which neither the statistical power nor the efficiency can be improved without degrading the other. We derive a useful sufficient and necessary condition for the Pareto optimal solutions to the minimax multi-objective optimization problem. Additionally, we design an effective Pareto optimal multi-armed bandit experiment that can be tailored to different levels of the trade-off between the two objectives. Moreover, we extend the design and analysis to the setting where the outcome of each arm consists of an adversarial baseline reward and a stochastic treatment effect, demonstrating the robustness of our design. Finally, motivated by clinical trials, we examine the setting where the employed experiment must split the experimental units into a small number of batches, and we propose a flexible Pareto optimal design. This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: The authors thank the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)-IBM partnership in Artificial Intelligence and the MIT Data Science Laboratory for support. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00492 .
summary: 本文研究多臂赌博机实验设计中在线决策效率（即后悔最小化）与统计功效（推断处理效应）之间的固有权衡，通过将问题建模为极小极大多目标优化问题。引入帕累托最优性来刻画两个目标无法同时改进的状态，推导出帕累托最优解的充要条件，并设计出一种可调节两者权衡的帕累托最优多臂赌博机实验。进一步，将设计扩展到每个臂的结果由对抗性基线奖励和随机处理效应组成的情境，验证了鲁棒性。最后，受临床试验启发，探讨实验单元需分成少量批次的场景，提出灵活的分批帕累托最优设计。
ai_comment: 本文从多目标优化角度系统分析了多臂赌博机实验中的效率-功效权衡，提供了帕累托最优的理论框架与实用设计，对临床试验等领域的自适应实验有重要指导意义。

title: Stock Market Ownership Transitions
abstract: A significant portion of U.S. households enters and exits investment accounts. Empirically, income and wealth changes are related to these transitions, with income changes not affecting the retired. A life cycle model with participation costs cannot match the observed ownership dynamics, but an extension with stock market crash better fits the average participation rate and ownership transitions of the middle-aged and retired. This extended model does not match the ownership dynamics of the young, which are better captured by a model with elevated income risk. Overall, these findings indicate that ownership transitions respond to wealth shocks across the life cycle, both in our model and the data. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00290 .
summary: 大量美国家庭会进入和退出投资账户。研究发现，收入和财富变化与这些所有权转变相关，但收入变化对退休人员没有影响。传统的带有参与成本的生命周期模型无法匹配观察到的所有权动态，而引入股市崩盘的扩展模型能更好地拟合中年和退休人员的平均参与率及所有权转变模式。然而，该扩展模型无法解释年轻人的所有权动态，年轻人的行为更适合用高收入风险模型来刻画。总体而言，这些发现表明，无论是在模型还是数据中，所有权转变在生命周期中均受到财富冲击的影响。
ai_comment: 该文通过区分不同年龄段的驱动因素，揭示了标准生命周期模型的局限，并提出了有针对性的扩展，对理解家庭金融参与行为具有重要价值。

title: Local Agglomeration and Household Mortgage Debt
abstract: Using detailed household data, we find that households working in locally agglomerated economies have high mortgage loans and are more likely to have mortgage loans. Channel testing shows that local agglomeration increases housing and mortgage demand as well as mortgage supply. The increase in mortgage loans is driven by purchases of larger houses and smaller down payments. Mechanism analyses document that local agglomeration affects mortgage loans by increasing career upward potential and providing downside protection. Specifically, we find that the impact of local agglomeration is stronger for skilled employees with enhanced prospects. In addition, local agglomeration weakens the negative relation between unemployment and mortgage loans, which supports the downside-protection role of local agglomeration. These results hold under instrumental variables analysis, difference-in-difference analysis, and a set of robustness checks. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of local labor market composition in household mortgage debt. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: F. F. Chen acknowledges the financial support provided by the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities; the MOE Project of Key Research Institute of Humanities and Social Science in University [Grant 22JJD790094]; and the 111 Project [Grant B18033]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03486 .
summary: 基于详细家庭数据，研究发现本地集聚经济中工作的家庭持有更高抵押贷款额且更可能拥有抵押贷款。渠道检验表明，本地集聚同时提升了住房与抵押贷款需求以及抵押供给。抵押贷款增加主要由购买更大房屋和更低首付驱动。机制分析揭示，本地集聚通过提升职业向上潜力和提供下行保护影响抵押贷款：对于技能型员工，因前景改善影响更强；同时，本地集聚削弱了失业与抵押贷款之间的负相关关系，支持了其下行保护作用。在工具变量、双重差分及一系列稳健性检验中结果依然成立。总体而言，研究强调了本地劳动力市场构成在家庭抵押债务中的重要性。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地将劳动力市场集聚与家庭抵押贷款决策联系起来，揭示了职业前景和下行保护机制，为理解区域经济特征如何影响家庭金融行为提供了新视角。

title: The Color of Hedge Fund Activism
abstract: The racial disparity in mortgage approval rates decreases by four percentage points as a result of hedge fund activism targeting banks. Target banks experience a higher turnover of mortgage officers and open new bank branches in areas with greater racial disparities in mortgage approval rates. We show that the results are driven by hedge fund activists’ efforts to increase profitability and comply with the community reinvestment act. Our results suggest that hedge funds’ incentives to maximize shareholder value do not necessarily lead to a negative impact on other stakeholders. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: This work is financially supported by the Key Program of National Natural Science Foundation of China [NSFC Grant Number 72233003] and the General Program of National Natural Science Foundation of China [NSFC Grant Number 72372517]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03452 .
summary: 对冲基金激进主义（hedge fund activism）针对目标银行后，这些银行的抵押贷款批准率（mortgage approval rates）的种族差异（racial disparity）下降了4个百分点。目标银行出现了更高的抵押贷款官员（mortgage officers）流动率，并在种族差异更大的地区开设新的银行分行。研究表明，这些结果源于对冲基金激进主义者（hedge fund activists）为提高盈利能力和遵守《社区再投资法案》（Community Reinvestment Act）所做的努力。该发现表明，对冲基金最大化股东价值的动机并不必然对其他利益相关者产生负面影响。
ai_comment: 本文提供了一个新颖的视角，说明对冲基金激进主义可能减少而非加剧社会不平等，挑战了关于股东价值最大化与社会责任是零和博弈的传统观点。

title: Volatility Ambiguity, Portfolio Decisions, and Equilibrium Asset Pricing
abstract: This paper develops a new approach to volatility ambiguity and studies its implications for equilibrium consumption, portfolio choice, and asset prices. Our approach does not require equivalence between priors. The measure of ambiguity is based on the statistical confidence in the reference model that can be assessed with sample statistics. The approach is analytically tractable and amenable to empirical/calibration analysis. A stochastic discount pricing formula is given. At sensible levels of volatility ambiguity, the empirical regularity of equity premium and consumption growth in U.S. data can be the equilibrium outcome of our model featuring a relative risk aversion (RRA) coefficient within a reasonable range. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: H. Wang received financial support from the Tsinghua University Initiative Scientific Research Program [2023THZWJC20]. L. Zhang received financial support from the Tsinghua University Initiative Scientific Research Program [2021THZWJC28] and The National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72473079]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02902 .
summary: 本文提出了一种新的波动率模糊性处理方法，并研究了其对均衡消费、投资组合选择和资产定价的影响。该方法不要求先验等价，而是基于参考模型的统计置信度来度量模糊性，且具有解析可处理性，适用于实证和校准分析。文章给出了随机折现（SDF）定价公式，并发现：在合理的波动率模糊性水平下，美国数据中的股权溢价和消费增长的经验规律可以成为模型的均衡结果，且此时相对风险厌恶（RRA）系数处于合理范围内。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将波动率模糊性建模为统计置信度，既保持了解析可处理性，又能在合理风险厌恶水平下匹配股权溢价等经验事实，为资产定价提供了新的均衡框架。

title: The Use and Usefulness of Big Data in Finance: Evidence from Financial Analysts
abstract: Alternative data have become a new source of information for investors. This paper examines how this development is reshaping the role of sell-side analysts. Employing textual analysis of analysts’ written reports, we show that analysts themselves have begun to adopt alternative data in their analyses. Furthermore, we find that when analysts report drawing from alternative data they generate more accurate earnings forecasts, and their brokerages subsequently receive higher amounts in trading commissions from investors, suggesting that investors value the adoption of alternative data by analysts. This paper was accepted by Kay Gieseke, finance. Funding: This research is supported by NTU-Singapore under its startup grant program. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02659 .
summary: 本文研究替代数据如何重塑卖方分析师的角色。通过对分析师书面报告的文本分析，发现分析师开始在其分析中采用替代数据。当分析师报告使用替代数据时，他们能生成更准确的盈利预测，并且其券商随后从投资者处获得更高的交易佣金，这表明投资者重视分析师对替代数据的采用。
ai_comment: 利用文本分析直接捕捉分析师对替代数据的实际使用，提供了替代数据价值的有力证据，方法创新且结论具有实践意义。

title: Learning the Minimal Representation of a Continuous State-Space Markov Decision Process from Transition Data
abstract: This paper proposes a framework for learning the most concise Markov decision process (MDP) model of a continuous state-space dynamic system from observed transition data. This setting is encountered in numerous important applications, such as patient treatment, online advertising, recommender systems, and estimation of treatment effects in econometrics. Most existing methods in offline reinforcement learning construct functional approximations of the value or the transition and reward functions, requiring complex and often not interpretable function approximators. Our approach instead relies on partitioning the system’s observation space into regions constituting states of a finite MDP representing the system. We discuss the theoretically minimal MDP representation that preserves the values and, therefore, the optimal policy of the dynamic system—in a sense, the optimal discretization. We formally define the problem of learning such a concise representation from transition data without exploration. Learning such a representation allows for enhanced tractability and, importantly, provides interpretability. To solve this problem, we introduce an in-sample property on partitions of the observation space we name coherence, and we show that if the class of possible partitions is of finite Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension, any coherent partition with the transition data converges to the minimal representation of the system with provable finite-sample probably approximately correct convergence guarantees. This insight motivates our minimal representation learning algorithm that constructs from transition data an MDP representation that approximates the minimal representation of the system. We illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework through numerical experiments in both deterministic and stochastic environments as well as with real data. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors are very grateful to the Health Systems Initiative at MIT Sloan for financial support for this project. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01652 .
summary: 本文提出一个框架，从连续状态空间动态系统的转移数据中学习最简洁的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）模型。通过将观测空间划分为有限MDP的状态区域，该方法旨在找到理论上保持值函数和最优策略的最小MDP表示（即最优离散化）。文章定义了分区上的“coherence”内在性质，并证明在有限Vapnik-Chervonenkis维数下，任何一致分区与转移数据能以有限样本概率近似正确（PAC）收敛到系统的极小表示。基于此，提出最小表示学习算法，利用转移数据构造近似极小MDP表示。数值实验在确定性和随机环境以及真实数据上验证了框架的有效性。该文发表于Management Science，为优化方向。
ai_comment: 论文提供了一种兼具理论收敛保证和实际可解释性的状态离散化方法，为离线强化学习中的模型简约性提供了新视角。

title: What Are the Firm Value Implications of SEC-Challenged Shareholder Proposals?
abstract: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) permits managers to request the exclusion of shareholder-initiated proposals. I construct a novel data set of excluded and withdrawn proposals from the SEC’s responses to managers’ requests. An examination of announcement returns to withdrawal and exclusion decisions demonstrates that SEC-challenged proposals are value destroying. I find that special interest investors pursuing self-serving agendas and retail investors advocating for one-size-fits-all reforms explain the value-destroying nature of SEC-challenged proposals. On average, the SEC challenge benefits firm value by filtering out these harmful proposals. However, a regression discontinuity design reveals that proposals the SEC refuses to exclude may receive majority shareholder support and destroy firm value. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: I thank the Swiss Finance Institute for its generous financial support. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01344 .
summary: 本研究探讨了美国证券交易委员会(SEC)允许管理层排除股东提案的规则对公司价值的影响。作者构建了一个从SEC对管理层排除请求的回复中提取的包括被排除和撤回提案的新数据集。通过分析提案被撤回或排除的公告回报，发现被SEC挑战的提案会破坏公司价值。研究识别出两类价值破坏性提案：追求自私议程的特殊利益投资者和倡导一刀切改革的散户投资者提出的提案。平均而言，SEC的挑战通过过滤这些有害提案有利于公司价值。然而，利用断点回归设计发现，SEC拒绝排除的提案可能获得多数股东支持并继续破坏公司价值。
ai_comment: 该研究利用新颖的数据集和断点回归方法，为SEC在股东提案监管中的角色提供了因果证据，揭示了监管过滤的价值效应及其边界条件。

title: Nonsubstitutable Consumption Growth Risk
abstract: Standard applications of the consumption-based asset pricing model assume that goods and services within the nondurable consumption bundle are substitutes. We estimate substitution elasticities between different consumption bundles and show that households cannot substitute energy consumption by consumption of other nondurables. As a consequence, energy consumption affects the pricing function as a separate factor. Variation in energy consumption betas explains a large part of the premia related to value, investment, and operating profitability. For example, value stocks are typically more energy intensive than growth stocks and thus riskier, because they suffer more from the oil supply shocks that also affect households. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: C. Schlag gratefully acknowledges research and financial support from the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01269 .
summary: 本文挑战了标准消费资产定价模型中非耐用品消费内的商品和服务可相互替代的假设。通过估计不同消费束之间的替代弹性，发现家庭无法用其他非耐用品消费替代能源消费，因此能源消费作为一个独立因子影响资产定价。能源消费贝塔的变动解释了价值、投资和盈利溢价中的很大一部分。例如，价值股通常比成长股更能源密集，因此更具风险，因为它们更易受到同时影响家庭的石油供应冲击的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入不可替代的能源消费因子，为解释价值溢价等长期存在的资产定价异象提供了新视角，具有重要的理论和实证贡献。

title: Central bank liquidity reallocation and bank lending: Evidence from the tiering system
abstract: We document that the reallocation of central bank reserves towards banks with higher liquidity needs fosters credit supply. Exploiting the ECB's tiered reserve remuneration system for identification, we show that this system encouraged banks with low reserve holdings to obtain more reserves through the money market. Concomitantly, these banks reduced their securities holdings and extended more credit. We estimate that the reallocation of one euro of reserves towards banks with ex ante low reserve holdings resulted in an increase in credit supply of about 15 cents.
summary: 本文研究了央行准备金重新分配对银行信贷供给的影响。利用欧洲央行（ECB）分级准备金报酬系统（tiered reserve remuneration system）作为识别机制，发现该系统鼓励了原本持有较少准备金的银行通过货币市场获取更多准备金。这些银行随后减少了证券持有量，并扩大了信贷投放。定量估计表明，每向事先持有较低准备金的银行重新分配1欧元准备金，会导致信贷供给增加约15欧分。
ai_comment: 该研究利用央行政策变化（分级准备金报酬系统）作为自然实验，有效识别了准备金再分配对信贷供给的因果效应，并提供了具体的量化估计，对理解央行流动性管理工具在银行体系中的传导机制具有重要价值。

title: Reaching for yield: Evidence from households
abstract: The literature has documented “reaching for yield”—the phenomenon of investing more in risky assets when interest rates drop—among institutional investors. We analyze detailed transaction data from a large brokerage firm to provide direct field evidence that individual investors also exhibit this behavior. Consistent with models of portfolio choice with labor income, reaching for yield is more pronounced among younger and less-wealthy individuals. Consistent with prospect theory, reaching for yield is more pronounced when investors are trading at a loss. Finally, we observe and discuss the phenomenon of “reverse reaching for yield.”
summary: 本文利用一家大型经纪公司的详细交易数据，提供直接现场证据表明个人投资者也存在“追求收益”现象（即利率下降时增加风险资产投资）。与带有劳动收入的组合选择模型一致，追求收益在年轻和不太富裕的个体中更明显；与前景理论一致，当投资者处于亏损交易时更倾向于追求收益。此外，还观察并讨论了“反向追求收益”现象。
ai_comment: 本文利用微观交易数据验证了个人投资者也存在追求收益行为，并发现其与年龄、财富状况及交易盈亏相关，拓展了行为金融学在家庭投资决策中的应用。

title: Strategic digitization in currency and payment competition
abstract: We model the competition between digital forms of fiat money and private digital money. Countries digitize their currencies–by upgrading existing or launching new payment systems (including CBDCs)–to compete with foreign fiat currencies and private digital money. A pecking order emerges: less dominant currencies digitize earlier, reflecting a first-mover advantage; dominant currencies delay digitization until they face competition; the weakest currencies forgo digitization. However, delayed digitization allows private digital money to gain widespread adoption, eventually weakening fiat money’s role. We highlight how geopolitical considerations, stablecoins, and interoperability between fiat and private digital money shape the dynamics of currency competition.
summary: 本文构建了一个法定数字货币与私人数字货币之间的竞争模型。研究指出，各国通过升级现有支付系统或推出新的支付系统（包括央行数字货币）来实现货币数字化，以与外国法定货币和私人数字货币竞争。模型揭示了一种层级顺序：不太占主导地位的货币会更早进行数字化，以利用先发优势；主导货币则推迟数字化，直到面临竞争压力；最弱势的货币则放弃数字化。然而，推迟数字化会使私人数字货币获得广泛采用，最终削弱法定货币的作用。本文还强调了地缘政治因素、稳定币以及法定与私人数字货币之间的互通性如何影响货币竞争动态。
ai_comment: 本文通过博弈模型揭示了货币数字化时机选择与主导地位之间的关键关系，为理解全球货币体系演变提供了新视角。

title: Understanding the strength of the dollar
abstract: We attribute variation in the strength of the U.S. dollar and its covariance with other currencies to economic primitives using a global asset demand system. We take global investor savings, asset supply, and monetary policy as exogenous primitives, and show how these variables explain dollar exchange rate behavior. Prior to the global financial crisis, global savings and demand shifts explain dollar depreciation, whereas post-crisis they explain dollar appreciation. Interest rates and cross-border bank loans explain short-term fluctuations in the dollar, but decline in significance over longer horizons. When explaining the dollar factor structure, we find that global savings explain common variations across dollar exchange rates, whereas investor demand shifts account for cross-sectional heterogeneity in dollar betas.
summary: 本文利用全球资产需求系统，将美元汇率强弱及其与其他货币的协方差归因于经济基本面。以全球投资者储蓄、资产供给和货币政策作为外生原始变量，分析这些变量如何解释美元汇率行为。研究发现，全球金融危机前，全球储蓄和需求变化解释了美元贬值，而危机后则解释了美元升值。利率和跨境银行贷款解释了美元汇率的短期波动，但在长期显著性下降。在解释美元因子结构时，全球储蓄解释了美元汇率的共同变动，而投资者需求变化则解释了美元贝塔的横截面异质性。
ai_comment: 本文通过系统性地将美元强弱联系到全球储蓄、资产供给和货币政策等经济基本面，区分了短期与长期驱动因素，并同时解释了汇率共同因子和异质性，视角独特且具有实证深度。

title: The retail execution quality landscape
abstract: We demonstrate that off-exchange (wholesaler) executions provide significant cost savings to retail investors. Wholesaler concentration has raised regulatory concerns; however, we show that the largest wholesalers offer the lowest costs due to economies of scale. The entry of a new large wholesaler reduces incumbent scale economies, resulting in higher execution costs. Most retail brokers route to multiple wholesalers and actively monitor their performance, rewarding those offering lower execution costs with more volume. While retail investors benefit from the current landscape across all stocks, those trading small stocks benefit the most.
summary: 本文研究零售投资者的订单执行质量，发现场外批发商执行能为零售投资者显著节省交易成本。尽管批发商集中度引发监管担忧，但最大批发商因规模经济而提供最低执行成本。新大型批发商进入会削弱现有批发商的规模经济，导致执行成本上升。多数零售经纪商将订单路由至多个批发商并积极监控其表现，对提供较低执行成本的批发商分配更多交易量。零售投资者在所有股票中均受益，其中交易小股票的投资者获益最大。
ai_comment: 研究揭示了批发商市场集中度与规模经济之间的复杂关系，并指出新进入者可能带来的反直觉成本上升，对监管政策有启示意义。

title: Fintech entry, lending market competition, and welfare
abstract: We provide a spatial framework to study competition between banks and fintechs in the lending market and examine the impact on investment and welfare. Based on the key differences between banks and fintechs, we derive results consistent with the empirical evidence available. We find that fintechs with inferior monitoring efficiency can successfully enter because of their superior flexibility in pricing and that higher bank concentration leads to higher fintech loan volume. If fintechs and banks have similar funding costs, fintech borrowers pay lower loan rates and have higher default rates than bank borrowers with similar characteristics; however, the result will flip if fintechs have much higher funding costs than banks. The advantage of fintechs in offering convenience can also induce them to charge higher loan rates than banks. Fintech entry will improve welfare if fintechs have high monitoring efficiency and inter-fintech competition intensity is intermediate. Fintech entry may induce banks’ exit and reduce investment; however, it will increase investment if inter-fintech competition is intense enough.
summary: 本文构建了一个空间框架来研究银行与金融科技在贷款市场中的竞争，并分析其对投资和福利的影响。基于银行与金融科技的关键差异（如监控效率、定价灵活性、便利性），推导出与现有实证证据一致的结果。研究发现：监控效率较低但定价灵活的金融科技能够成功进入市场；银行集中度越高，金融科技贷款量越大。当金融科技与银行融资成本相近时，金融科技借款人的贷款利率更低但违约率更高；若金融科技融资成本远高于银行，则结果反转。金融科技提供的便利性优势也可能使其收取比银行更高的贷款利率。金融科技进入会改善福利的条件是：金融科技具有高监控效率且金融科技间竞争强度适中。金融科技进入可能导致银行退出并减少投资，但如果金融科技间竞争足够激烈，则会增加投资。
ai_comment: 本文通过空间竞争模型系统揭示了金融科技与银行差异化竞争的关键机制，特别是定价灵活性、监控效率和融资成本的作用，为理解金融科技对信贷市场的影响提供了重要理论框架。

title: Investor demand, firm investment, and capital misallocation
abstract: Fluctuations in investor demand significantly affect firms’ valuation and access to capital. To quantify their real effects, we develop a dynamic investment model, incorporating both the demand and supply sides of capital. Strong investor demand relaxes financial constraints and facilitates equity issuance and investment, while weak demand encourages opportunistic share repurchases, crowding out investment. We estimate the model using indirect inference, matching the endogenous relationship between investor demand and firm policies. Our estimation reveals that demand fluctuations are important drivers of firm-level investment and economy-wide capital misallocation, accounting for 26.9% of dispersion in MPK and 23.4% of productivity losses.
summary: 本文研究投资者需求波动如何通过资本供需两侧影响企业实际投资和资本错配。作者构建了一个动态投资模型，同时纳入资本的需求方（投资者）和供给方（企业），分析发现：强投资者需求通过放松融资约束促进企业股权发行和投资，而弱需求则激励企业进行机会主义股票回购，从而挤出投资。采用间接推断方法，基于投资者需求与企业政策之间的内生关系对模型进行估计。结果表明，投资者需求波动是企业层面投资和整个经济层面资本错配的重要驱动因素，分别解释了资本边际产出（MPK）离散度的26.9%和生产率损失的23.4%。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将投资者需求波动纳入动态投资模型，并量化其对资本错配的贡献，为理解金融市场摩擦对实体经济的传导机制提供了新视角。

title: Can everyone tap into the housing piggy bank? Racial disparities in access to home equity
abstract: We document large racial disparities in the ability of homeowners to access their accumulated housing wealth. Minority homeowners are significantly more likely to have their mortgage equity withdrawal (MEW) product applications rejected than White homeowners, and the unconditional disparities are significantly larger than those found in prior studies that focused on purchase and rate/term refinance loans. Had Black homeowners faced the same MEW denial rate as White homeowners in our sample period we show they would have extracted an additional $11.2 billion in housing equity, or almost 25% of the total amount of actual equity extracted. Controlling for key underwriting variables significantly narrows the racial disparities, with the Black–White gap falling by nearly 85%, and the Hispanic-White gap falling by more than 75%. Credit scores and debt-to-income ratios are the most important factors explaining the gaps, while differences in loan-to-value ratios contribute only modestly. “Residual” disparities after conditioning on observable underwriting factors are large and vary significantly across lenders. A battery of tests suggests that differences in unobserved underwriting factors are unlikely to fully explain the residual disparities, which tend to be larger in geographic areas characterized by more racial animus.
summary: 本文记录了房主利用其积累的住房净值能力方面的巨大种族差异。少数族裔房主的抵押贷款净值提取（MEW）产品申请被拒绝的可能性显著高于白人房主，且无条件差异远大于以往关注购房和利率/期限再贷款的研究。研究发现，如果黑人房主在样本期内面临与白人房主相同的MEW拒绝率，他们将额外提取112亿美元住房净值，约占实际提取总额的25%。控制关键承销变量后，种族差异显著缩小，黑人与白人的差距下降近85%，西班牙裔与白人的差距下降超过75%。信用评分和债务收入比是解释差距的最重要因素，而贷款价值比差异贡献有限。在可观测承销因素条件下，“剩余”差异仍然较大且在不同贷款机构间变化显著。一系列检验表明，未观测到的承销因素差异不太可能完全解释剩余差异，这些差异在种族敌意更强的地理区域往往更大。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统研究MEW产品中的种族差异，量化了巨大的经济影响，并深入分析了承销因素和区域种族敌意的解释作用，对理解住房财富不平等有重要贡献。

title: Main Street’s Pain, Wall Street’s Gain
abstract: We propose a fiscal policy expectations mechanism. When bad macro news arrives (in our study, when initial jobless claims (IJC) are higher than expected), investors may expect more generous government spending and drive up aggregate stock prices through the expected cash flow channel. Using a time-series sample from January 2013 to March 2021, we find that this phenomenon emerges when newspapers mention fiscal policy more. In the cross section, firms expected to receive more government spending – through stimulus supports during COVID-19 or procurement contracts before 2020 – exhibit higher individual stock returns when bad IJC shocks arrive.
summary: 论文提出财政政策预期机制：当坏宏观新闻（如首次申请失业救济人数高于预期）出现时，投资者可能预期政府将增加支出，从而通过预期现金流渠道推高整体股票价格。基于2013年1月至2021年3月的美国时间序列数据，研究发现当报纸更多提及财政政策时，这一现象更显著。横截面分析表明，预期获得更多政府支出的公司（如疫情期间的刺激支持或2020年之前的采购合同）在坏消息冲击时个股回报更高。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将宏观新闻与财政政策预期结合，揭示了坏消息下股市上涨的机制，并验证了总市场与横截面效应，为理解政策预期在资产定价中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Benchmarking benchmarks
abstract: Financial benchmarks such as LIBOR underpin the pricing of trillions of dollars of contracts around the world. We evaluate the quality of benchmark prices using a state-space model to separate information from noise. Applying the method to LIBOR benchmarks and their replacements, we find that alternative reference rates (ARRs) are less noisy in four of the five currencies. However, the USD ARR is considerably more noisy, resulting in billions of dollars of noise-related wealth transfers between contract counterparties. We show that benchmark reforms such as expanding the reference market and using a trimmed mean can reduce noise in ARRs.
summary: 该论文评估了金融基准（如LIBOR）的价格质量。作者使用状态空间模型将价格中的信息与噪声分离，并应用于LIBOR及其替代品。研究发现，在五种货币中，四种货币的替代参考利率（ARRs）噪声低于LIBOR，但美元ARR的噪声显著更大，导致合约对手方之间数十亿美元的噪声相关财富转移。论文进一步表明，扩大参考市场和使用修剪均值等基准改革措施可以有效降低ARRs中的噪声。
ai_comment: 本文通过量化基准利率中的噪声成分，为基准改革提供了实证依据，并发现了美元ARR的高噪声问题。

title: What Is the Cost of Privatization for Workers?
abstract: Privatization of state‐owned enterprises is on the agenda across the globe. Using Swedish data covering two decades, we show that productivity gains and headcount reductions are associated with economic costs for incumbent workers. Workers experience income losses and higher unemployment, but half of the losses are covered by the social safety net. We also find small positive effects on entrepreneurship and cash holdings but no meaningful effects on other labor market, family, health, or household finance outcomes. Productivity improves when the CEO is replaced, and the gains outweigh workers' income declines by a factor of between two and six.
summary: 本文利用瑞典两十年的数据研究国有企业私有化对工人的经济成本。研究发现，私有化带来的生产率提升和裁员导致工人收入损失和失业风险增加，但社会保障体系弥补了约一半的损失。此外，私有化对创业和现金持有有小幅正面影响，但对劳动力市场、家庭、健康或家庭财务等结果无显著影响。当CEO被更换时，生产率提升更为明显，且生产率收益是工人收入下降的2到6倍。
ai_comment: 该文利用瑞典面板数据提供了私有化对工人影响的量化证据，揭示了生产率收益与工人成本之间的权衡，并指出社会保障的重要缓冲作用。

title: Regulating Over‐the‐Counter Markets
abstract: Over‐the‐counter (OTC) trading thrives despite competition from exchanges. We let OTC dealers cream skim from exchanges in an otherwise standard Glosten and Milgrom framework. Restricting the dealer's ability to cream skim induces “cheap substitution”: some traders exit while others with larger gains from trade enter. Cheap substitution implies trading costs, trade volumes, and market shares are poor policy indicators. In a benchmark case, restricting the dealer raises welfare only if trading cost increases, volume falls, and OTC market share is high. By contrast, the restriction improves welfare when adverse selection risk is low. A simple procedure implements the optimal Pigouvian tax.
summary: 本文研究场外交易（OTC）市场在交易所竞争下仍能繁荣的现象。通过将OTC做市商在标准Glosten和Milgrom框架中允许从交易所中攫取奶油（cream skim）的行为模型化，分析限制做市商攫取能力的影响。研究发现，这种限制会导致“廉价替代”（cheap substitution）：部分交易者退出市场，而其他交易收益更大的交易者进入。廉价替代使得交易成本、交易量和市场份额成为糟糕的政策指标。在基准案例中，限制做市商仅在交易成本上升、交易量下降且OTC市场份额高时才能提高福利；相反，当逆向选择风险低时，限制会改善福利。此外，文章提出一个简单程序可实现最优的庇古税（Pigouvian tax）。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入cream skimming机制扩展了经典信息模型，并揭示了传统政策指标在OTC市场监管中的局限性，提出了基于事故事前最优的简单税收程序。

title: An Intermediation-Based Model of Exchange Rates
abstract: We develop a continuous-time general equilibrium model with intermediaries at the heart of international financial markets. Global intermediaries bargain with households and extract rents from providing access to foreign claims. By tilting state prices, intermediaries’ market power breaks monetary neutrality and makes international risk-sharing inefficient. Despite having zero net positions, markups charged by intermediaries significantly distort international asset prices, affecting exchange rate dynamics and their response to shocks. Our model can reproduce patterns consistent with several well-known exchange rate puzzles, such as deviations from uncovered and covered interest parity. All equilibrium quantities are derived in closed form, allowing us to pin down the underlying economic mechanisms explicitly.
summary: 本文构建了一个连续时间一般均衡模型，将金融中介置于国际金融市场的核心。全球中介与家庭进行议价，并从提供外国资产准入中抽取租金。通过倾斜状态价格，中介的市场势力打破了货币中性，并使国际风险分担变得低效。尽管中介的净头寸为零，其收取的加成显著扭曲了国际资产价格，影响汇率动态及其对冲击的反应。该模型能够再现与多个著名汇率谜题一致的模式，如无抛补和抛补利率平价的偏离。所有均衡量都以闭合形式推导，从而可以明确地确定潜在的经济机制。
ai_comment: 该模型以闭合形式推导均衡，从金融中介的市场势力角度解释了多个汇率谜题，为国际金融中介研究提供了清晰的理论基础。

title: Labor Links, Comovement, and Predictable Returns
abstract: Using firms’ online job postings, we identify economically related peer firms in the labor market. Firms’ labor peers are vastly different from their industry peers, where the overlap is about 20%. Returns of labor-linked firms strongly comove, suggesting common responses to labor market shocks on average. However, industry shocks can affect firms outside the industry through the labor network, leading to substitution effects between labor peers. Last, we show that investors do not promptly incorporate news about labor-linked firms, leading to predictable subsequent returns. A long-short strategy exploiting this delay generates an average annualized excess return of 9%.
summary: 本文利用企业在线招聘信息，识别出劳动力市场中具有经济关联的同行企业。研究发现，劳动同行与行业同行的重叠率仅约20%，两者差异显著。劳动关联企业的收益率表现出强烈的共同变动，表明它们平均对劳动力市场冲击有共同反应。然而，行业冲击可通过劳动力网络影响行业外企业，导致劳动同行之间出现替代效应。最后，投资者未能及时将劳动关联企业的信息纳入股价，导致后续收益可预测。基于这种延迟构建的多空策略年均超额收益达9%。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用在线招聘数据构建劳动力关联网络，揭示了与行业关联不同的收益共同变动模式，并发现投资者反应不足导致的收益可预测性，对理解跨企业信息传递和市场效率有重要贡献。

title: The Value of Bank Lending
abstract: Using a novel data set of realized syndicated loan cash flows and a risk‐adjustment methodology adapted from the private equity literature, I provide a measure of risk‐adjusted returns for bank loan cash flows. Banks, on average, generate 180 basis points in gross risk‐adjusted returns and add $75 million of value annually to their loan portfolios. Banks earn higher returns when they lend to financially constrained borrowers, and the risk‐adjusted performance of bank loan portfolios exhibits persistence. However, banks require higher risk‐adjusted returns when facing their own financing frictions, and shareholders earn nearly zero net risk‐adjusted returns once bank staff are compensated for their lending effort. Overall, these findings suggest that banks provide valuable services to mitigate borrowers' financing frictions, and the present value of loan cash flows pays for the costs of providing these services.
summary: 本文利用一套新颖的银团贷款实际现金流数据集，并采用从私募股权文献中改编的风险调整方法，来衡量银行贷款现金流的风险调整后回报。研究发现，银行平均产生180个基点的总风险调整后回报，每年为其贷款组合增加7500万美元的价值。银行在向财务受限的借款人放贷时获得更高的回报，且贷款组合的风险调整后表现具有持续性。然而，当银行面临自身融资摩擦时，会要求更高的风险调整后回报，而股东在补偿员工贷款努力后几乎获得零净风险调整后回报。总体而言，这些发现表明银行提供了有价值的服务以缓解借款人的融资摩擦，且贷款现金流的现值恰好支付了提供这些服务的成本。
ai_comment: 本文创新地使用实际现金流数据和私募股权风险调整方法，量化了银行放贷的价值创造，并揭示了银行融资摩擦与回报之间的关系。

title: The Term Structure of Interest Rates in a Heterogeneous Monetary Union
abstract: We build an arbitrage‐based model of the yield curves in a heterogeneous monetary union with sovereign default risk, which accounts for the asymmetric shifts in euro‐area yields during the Covid‐19 pandemic. We derive an affine term structure solution, and decompose yields into expectations, term premium, expected default loss, and credit risk premium components. In an extension, we endogenize the peripheral default probability, showing that it decreases with central bank bond holdings. Calibrating the model to Germany and Italy, we show that both the level and the shifts in the sovereign spread are mainly attributable to the credit risk premium.
summary: 该论文构建了一个基于套利的异质性货币联盟收益率曲线模型，考虑了主权违约风险，并解释了新冠疫情期间欧元区收益率的非对称变化。模型推导出了仿射期限结构解，将收益率分解为预期、期限溢价、预期违约损失和信用风险溢价四个组成部分。在扩展部分，模型将外围国家的违约概率内生化，发现其随央行债券持有量增加而降低。通过对德国和意大利的数据进行校准，研究表明主权利差的水平和变动主要归因于信用风险溢价。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将主权违约风险引入货币联盟的利率期限结构模型，并成功解释了欧元区利差在危机期间的异质性变化，为理解央行政策对主权风险的影响提供了新视角。

title: Interlocking Directorates and Competition in Banking
abstract: We study the effects on corporate loan rates of an unexpected change in the Italian legislation that forbade interlocking directorates between banks. Exploiting multiple firm‐bank relationships to fully account for all unobserved heterogeneity, we find that prohibiting interlocks decreased the interest rates of previously interlocked banks by 14 basis points relative to other banks. The effect is stronger for high‐quality firms and for loans extended by interlocked banks with a large joint market share. Interest rates on loans from previously interlocked banks become more dispersed. Finally, firms borrowing more from previously interlocked banks expand investment, employment, and sales.
summary: 本文利用意大利立法的意外变化——禁止银行间连锁董事——来研究其对贷款利率的影响。通过利用多个企业-银行关系以完全控制未观测异质性，发现禁止连锁董事使之前存在连锁关系的银行的贷款利率相对于其他银行下降了14个基点。这一效应在高质量企业和市场份额较大的连锁银行中更为显著。此外，来自之前连锁银行的贷款利率变得更加分散，而更多从这些银行借款的企业扩大了投资、就业和销售额。
ai_comment: 该研究利用准自然实验和丰富的微观数据，为连锁董事对银行竞争和信贷市场的因果效应提供了有力证据。

title: The Signaling Value of Internal Employee Coordination
abstract: We examine the effect of internal employee coordination on customer trust, focusing specifically on employees’ responsiveness to each other as an important, quantifiable, and objective aspect of internal coordination. Using proprietary data from a company with exogenous assignment of employees to teams that serve individual customers, we study how inter‐employee responsiveness influences customer trust. Each customer is served via an app‐based group chat by a randomly assigned team of employees. Our data include more than 2 million group chat messages with over 16 thousand customers. We find that inter‐employee responsiveness serves as a credible signal that helps build customer trust, as evidenced by their subsequent contracting choices. The effect is more pronounced when the signal is (1) more frequent and (2) more intense. Our findings highlight the novel value of internal employee responsiveness as a credible signal that helps build trust with external stakeholders.
summary: 本文研究内部员工协调对客户信任的影响，聚焦于员工之间的响应性作为内部协调的重要、可量化且客观的方面。利用一家公司专有的数据，该公司将员工随机分配到服务个人客户的团队中，通过基于应用程序的群聊进行沟通，数据包括超过200万条群聊消息和1.6万多名客户。研究发现，员工间响应性作为一种可信信号，有助于建立客户信任，具体体现在客户后续的合同选择上。当信号更频繁、更强烈时，该效应更为显著。研究结果突显了内部员工响应性作为可信信号的新价值，有助于与外部利益相关者建立信任。
ai_comment: 本文利用随机分配和客观消息数据，为内部协调的信号价值提供了因果证据，创新性地将员工间响应性与外部信任联系起来。

title: Fast and Slow Arbitrage: The Predictive Power of (Persistent) Capital Flows for Factor Returns
abstract: We document that persistent aggregate capital flows to hedge and mutual funds predict monthly factor returns with an out-of-sample R2 reaching 6.6%. Transient flows display no such power despite being more predictable. We show—both empirically and theoretically—that persistent flows’ predictive power stems from active fund managers’ capital constraints. As a result, managers invest persistent, but not transient, capital flows into factor trading strategies, leading to factor-return predictability and factor momentum, yet greater price efficiency. Our key insight is that capital-constrained managers account for both current and anticipated future flows in the arbitrage sector, thereby incorporating the dynamics of capital into their strategies.
summary: 本文发现，对冲基金和共同基金的持续性总资本流量（persistent aggregate capital flows）能够预测月度因子收益，样本外R²达到6.6%，而短暂流量（transient flows）虽更具可预测性却无此预测能力。通过理论和实证分析，作者表明持续性流量的预测能力源自主动型基金经理面临的资本约束（capital constraints）：经理们只会将持续性（而非短暂性）资本流量用于因子交易策略，从而产生因子收益的可预测性和因子动量（factor momentum），但同时提升了价格效率。核心洞察在于，受资本约束的经理在套利部门会同时考虑当前和预期的未来流量，从而将资本动态纳入其策略。
ai_comment: 该论文区分了持久性和短暂性资本流动对因子收益的不同预测能力，并揭示了资本约束在其中的核心作用，为因子动量提供了新的解释。

title: Learning to Disclose: Disclosure Dynamics in the 1890s Streetcar Industry
abstract: We study the influence of bounded rationality on companies’ disclosure to investors in new industries. Using a historical example of a new industry, we document that several companies initially withheld their earnings, despite external capital needs and investor information demands. However, almost all these companies started disclosing shortly thereafter. Interpreted through the lens of a disclosure model featuring level-$ k $ thinking, these patterns suggest that limited strategic thinking of some companies contributed to the initial failure to disclose, while feedback and learning over time contributed to the quick convergence to an equilibrium of (almost) full disclosure in the new industry.
summary: 本文研究有限理性如何影响新行业中公司对投资者的信息披露行为。以19世纪90年代的美国街车工业为例，发现多家公司在面临外部资本需求和投资者信息需求的情况下，最初选择隐瞒盈利信息。然而，几乎所有公司在此后不久便开始披露。通过引入包含k级思维（level-k thinking）的披露模型进行解释，这些模式表明：一些公司因有限的战略思维而未能初始披露，但随时间推移，反馈与学习机制促使行业快速收敛到（几乎）完全披露的均衡状态。
ai_comment: 该论文利用罕见的历史文本数据和行为经济学模型（k级思维），生动揭示了企业披露决策从初期失败到快速趋同的演化机制，为理解信息披露动态提供了新颖视角。

title: Steering a Ship in Illiquid Waters: Active Management of Passive Funds
abstract: Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) are typically viewed as passive index trackers. In contrast, we show that corporate bond ETFs actively manage their portfolios, trading off index tracking against liquidity transformation. In our model, ETFs optimally choose creation and redemption baskets that include cash and only a subset of index assets, especially if those assets are illiquid. Our evidence supports the model. We find that ETFs dynamically adjust their baskets to correct portfolio imbalances while facilitating ETF arbitrage. Basket inclusion improves bond liquidity in general, but worsens it in periods of large imbalance between creations and redemptions, such as the COVID-19 crisis.
summary: 本文挑战了ETF作为被动指数追踪者的传统观点，通过理论与实证分析，表明公司债券ETF实际上主动管理其投资组合，在指数跟踪与流动性转换之间进行权衡。模型表明，ETF最优地选择包含现金和仅一部分指数资产的创建和赎回篮子，尤其是当这些资产流动性较差时。实证证据支持模型预测：ETF动态调整其篮子以纠正投资组合失衡，同时促进套利。篮子包含总体上改善了债券流动性，但在创建与赎回严重失衡期间（如COVID-19危机）则恶化了流动性。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了被动管理基金中的主动决策行为，为理解ETF在流动性市场中扮演的角色提供了新视角，尤其对疫情期间流动性危机的分析具有现实意义。

title: Would Order‐By‐Order Auctions Be Competitive?
abstract: We model two methods of executing segregated retail orders: brokers' routing, whereby brokers allocate orders using the market maker's overall performance, and order‐by‐order auctions, where market makers bid on individual orders, a recent U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission proposal. Order‐by‐order auctions improve allocative efficiency, but face a winner's curse reducing retail investor welfare, particularly when liquidity is limited. Additional market participants competing for retail orders fail to improve total efficiency and investor welfare when entrants possess information superior to incumbent wholesalers. Our results hold when new entrants are less informed or the information structure differs. We also examine the cross‐subsidization of brokers' routing.
summary: 本文建模了两种执行隔离零售订单的方法：券商路由（brokers' routing），即券商根据做市商的整体表现分配订单；以及逐单拍卖（order-by-order auctions），即做市商对单个订单竞标，这是美国证券交易委员会最近的提案。研究发现，逐单拍卖提高了分配效率，但面临“赢者诅咒”（winner's curse）问题，这会降低散户投资者福利，尤其是在流动性有限的情况下。当新进入者拥有优于现有批发商的信息时，额外市场参与者竞争零售订单无法提高整体效率和投资者福利。这些结果在新进入者信息较少或信息结构不同时仍然成立。论文还考察了券商路由的交叉补贴（cross-subsidization）效应。
ai_comment: 该论文对SEC提案的逐单拍卖机制进行了严谨的理论分析，揭示了其效率与福利权衡，并验证了信息优势对竞争效果的关键影响，为监管设计提供了重要参考。

title: How Are Firms Sold? The Role of Common Ownership
abstract: We find that common ownership among acquirers enhances rather than hinders competition in the firm sale process. One common owner raises the likelihood that target firms are sold through auction (vs. negotiation with one buyer) by 21.5%. The effect is causal according to identifications based on mergers between financial institutions. Exploring economic channels, we observe selling firms respond to common ownership among acquirers by avoiding cross-owned acquirers, bargaining hard, and inviting more buyers when cross-owned acquirers initiate the deal but not by terminating the deal. Consistent with enhanced competition, common ownership among acquirers is positively associated with deal quality.
summary: 本文研究收购方之间的共同所有权如何影响目标公司的出售过程。基于金融机构合并的因果识别发现，共同所有权使目标公司通过拍卖（而非与单一买家谈判）出售的可能性提高21.5%。探索经济渠道时发现，出售公司会通过避免交叉所有收购方、强硬谈判以及在交叉所有收购方发起交易时邀请更多买家来应对，但不会终止交易。共同所有权与交易质量正相关，表明其增强了竞争。
ai_comment: 通过外生冲击识别共同所有权的因果效应，挑战了传统认为共同所有权会削弱竞争的观点，对反垄断监管具有重要启示。

title: Does Speculative News Hurt Productivity? Evidence from Takeover Rumors
abstract: We show that productivity at both the firm and employee (i.e., analyst and inventor) level temporarily declines upon announcements of takeover rumors that do not materialize. Such speculative news may hurt productivity because uncertainty and the threat of job loss cause anxiety, distraction, and reduced commitment among employees and managers. Consistently, we observe a more pronounced productivity dip for rumored targets and when the likelihood of job loss is higher. Firm performance mirrors these results. We find no indication of reverse causality. The evidence fosters our understanding of potential real effects of speculative financial news and the costs of takeover threats.
summary: 本文研究了未实现的收购谣言对生产率的影响。通过分析公司和员工（包括分析师和发明家）层面的数据，发现当收购谣言公布但最终未实现时，生产率会暂时下降。这种下降归因于不确定性和失业威胁引发的焦虑、分心和员工及管理层承诺的降低。进一步研究表明，当目标公司更可能成为收购对象或失业风险更高时，生产率下降更为显著。公司绩效也呈现类似趋势。研究排除了反向因果的可能性。该证据有助于理解投机性金融新闻的潜在实际影响以及收购威胁带来的成本。
ai_comment: 本文从微观层面揭示了投机性新闻对实体经济的负面影响，并创新性地从员工和经理人心理机制切入，丰富了收购威胁成本的理论研究。

title: Who Holds Sovereign Debt and Why It Matters
abstract: This paper studies whether investor composition affects the sovereign debt market. We construct a data set of sovereign debt holdings by foreign and domestic bank, nonbank private and official investors for 101 countries across three decades. Compared with other investors, private nonbank investors absorb a disproportionate share of the debt supply, and their demand for emerging market debt is most price responsive. A counterfactual analysis of emerging market sovereigns shows a 10% increase in debt leads to a 5.8% yield increase but an outsized 8.4% increase without nonbank investors. We conclude that sovereigns are vulnerable to the loss of nonbanks.
summary: 本文研究投资者构成是否影响主权债务市场。作者构建了一个涵盖101个国家、跨越三十年（1984-2014年）的主权债务持有数据集，按投资者类型分为外国银行、国内银行、非银行私人投资者和官方投资者。研究发现，与其他投资者相比，非银行私人投资者吸收了不成比例的债务供应，且其需求对新兴市场债务的价格最为敏感（即需求弹性最高）。反事实分析表明，对于新兴市场主权国家，债务增加10%会导致收益率上升5.8%，但若没有非银行投资者，收益率将上升8.4%。结论是，主权债务市场易受非银行投资者流失的影响，即非银行投资者的存在有助于稳定市场。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的大规模跨国面板数据，首次系统识别了非银行投资者在主权债务市场中的关键作用，为理解主权债务脆弱性提供了新的视角。

title: Near-Rational Equilibria in Heterogeneous-Agent Models: A Verification Method
abstract: We propose a general simulation-based procedure for estimating the quality of approximate policies in heterogeneous-agent equilibrium models, which allows us to verify that such approximate solutions describe a near-rational equilibrium. Our procedure endows agents with superior knowledge of the future path of the economy, while imposing a suitable penalty for such foresight. The relaxed problem is more tractable than the original, and results in an upper bound on agents’ welfare. Our method applies to various solution algorithms. We illustrate our approach in two applications: the incomplete-markets model of Krusell and Smith (1998) and the heterogeneous firm model of Khan and Thomas (2008).
summary: 本文提出一种通用的基于模拟的流程，用于估计异质性代理人均衡模型中近似策略的质量，从而验证这些近似解是否构成一个近理性均衡。该流程赋予代理人关于经济未来路径的优越知识，同时对这种预见施加适当的惩罚。放松后的优化问题比原始问题更易于处理，并给出代理人福利的上界。该方法适用于多种求解算法，并通过两个经典模型——Krusell and Smith (1998)的不完全市场模型和Khan and Thomas (2008)的异质性企业模型——进行应用说明。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了一种通用且易于实施的验证方法，能够系统性地评估异质性代理人模型中近似解的合理性，对宏观金融和计算经济学领域具有重要价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Technological Unemployment
abstract: How large is the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on labor productivity and unemployment?This paper introduces a labor-search model of technological unemployment, conceptualizing the generative aspect of AI as a learning-by-using technology.AI capability improves through machine learning from workers and in turn enhances their labor productivity, but eventually displaces workers if wage renegotiation fails.Three distinct equilibria emerge: no AI, some AI with higher unemployment, or unbounded AI with sustained endogenous growth and little impact on employment.By calibrating to the U.S. data, our model predicts more than threefold improvements in productivity in some-AI steady state, alongside a long-run employment loss of 23%, with half this loss occurring over the initial five-year transition.Plausible change in parameter values could lead to global and local indeterminacy.The mechanism highlights the considerable uncertainty of AI's impacts in the presence of labor-market frictions.In the unbounded-AI equilibrium, technological unemployment would not occur.We further show that equilibria are inefficient despite adherence to the Hosios condition.By improving job-finding rate and labor productivity, the optimal subsidy to jobs facing the replacement risk of AI can generate a welfare gain from 26.6% in the short run to over 50% in the long run.
summary: 本文构建了一个技术性失业的劳动搜索模型，将人工智能（AI）的生成特性概念化为一种边用边学的技术。AI能力通过从工人那里机器学习而提升，进而提高劳动生产率，但如果工资重新谈判失败，最终会取代工人。模型揭示了三种不同的均衡：无AI、存在AI但失业率更高、无限AI且持续内生增长对就业影响很小。通过校准美国数据，模型预测在存在AI的稳态下，生产率提高三倍以上，同时长期就业损失23%，其中一半发生在最初的五年过渡期。参数值的合理变化可能导致全局和局部不确定性。该机制突显了在劳动力市场摩擦存在的情况下，AI影响的巨大不确定性。在无限AI均衡中，技术性失业不会发生。进一步研究表明，即使满足Hosios条件，均衡也是无效率的。通过提高工作发现率和劳动生产率，对面临AI替代风险的岗位进行最优补贴，可以在短期内产生26.6%的福利收益，长期超过50%。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入边用边学的AI机制，为理解AI对就业和生产率的影响提供了全新的理论框架，并量化了短期与长期的福利效应，政策含义明确。

title: Inflation, Expectations and Monetary Policy: What Have We Learned and to What End?
abstract: We review recent research and experiences linking inflation and expectations, emphasizing what has been learned since 2020.One clear lesson is that the inflation expectations of most economic agents have been and remain unanchored.The unanchored nature of inflation expectations, in combination with supply shocks, can explain much of the inflation surge and subsequent disinflation when viewed through the lens of an expectations-augmented Phillips curve, both in the U.S. and abroad.New policy frameworks are unlikely to address this feature of expectations.Only a communication strategy that breaks what we refer to as the "cycle of selective inattention" is likely to be successful, but it is probably already too late to stop the next inflation surge.
summary: 本文回顾了2020年以来通胀与预期关系的研究和经验，指出大多数经济主体的通胀预期已经且仍然脱锚（unanchored），这种脱锚状态结合供给冲击，通过预期增强的菲利普斯曲线（expectations-augmented Phillips curve）解释了美国和国外的通胀飙升及随后的反通胀。新的政策框架不太可能解决预期脱锚问题，只有打破所谓的“选择性忽视循环”（cycle of selective inattention）的沟通策略才可能成功，但阻止下一次通胀飙升可能已为时过晚。
ai_comment: 本文强调通胀预期脱锚的核心作用，挑战了传统政策框架的有效性，并提出“选择性忽视循环”这一新的沟通困境概念，对央行政策制定具有重要启示。

title: Local Monetary Policy
abstract: When Federal Reserve districts experience high inflation or low unemployment but lack voting rights to influence FOMC decisions, credit extended to commercial banks through the Discount Window (DW) declines.Our identification strategy is based on the exogenous rotation of voting rights among Reserve Banks and on within borrower-time and district-time variation in DW loans and Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) loans, implying that factors related to changes in macroeconomic conditions, local credit demand, or borrower characteristics do not drive the results.The effect on bank funding sources translates into changes in the composition of loans extended by commercial banks.
summary: 论文研究地方货币政策，发现当美联储地区经历高通胀或低失业但缺乏影响FOMC决策的投票权时，通过贴现窗口向商业银行提供的信贷减少。识别策略利用储备银行投票权的外生轮换，以及借款银行时间和地区时间内贴现窗口贷款和联邦住房贷款银行贷款的变化，排除了宏观经济条件、地方信贷需求或借款人特征变化的影响。该效应进一步导致商业银行贷款构成的改变。
ai_comment: 利用投票权外生轮换进行识别，为货币政策传导的银行渠道提供了新的证据。

title: Exchange Rates and Monetary Stabilization of Tariff Shocks
abstract: Central banks around the world have grappled with the question of how to respond to the mix of inflationary and output implications of a trade war.Recent tariff changes have impacted a wider cross-section of goods than was true in the previous tariff round, targeting final consumption goods in addition to materials such as aluminum and steel.This paper studies the optimal monetary stabilization of tariffs using a New Keynesian model enriched with comparative advantage between multiple traded sectors that differ in terms of tariff exposure as well as market structure and price rigidity.We find that, in the aggregate, the optimal monetary response is expansionary, supporting activity and producer prices at the cost of tolerating short-run headline inflation -both in response to tariffs aimed at differentiated consumption goods and to tariffs on non-differentiated goods.The output and export dynamics arising from tariffs on each sector differ sharply, as do the motivations for an expansionary monetary response.Sectoral reallocation is an order of magnitude larger than predicted by standard macro models featuring one tradable and one nontradable sector.
summary: 本文研究央行如何最优地通过货币政策稳定关税冲击带来的通胀和产出波动。基于一个嵌入多贸易部门（具有比较优势、不同的关税暴露、市场结构和价格刚性）的新凯恩斯模型，分析发现：总体而言，最优货币反应是扩张性的——通过容忍短期 headline 通胀来支持经济活动与生产者价格，这一结论对针对差异化消费品和非差异化商品的关税均成立。不同部门的关税冲击导致迥异的产出与出口动态，也催生了不同的扩张性货币政策动机。此外，部门间资源再配置的规模比标准的一部门可贸易品加一部门非贸易品模型的预测大一个数量级。
ai_comment: 本文将比较优势与关税异质性引入新凯恩斯框架，揭示了部门层面关税效应的显著差异，并得出了系统性扩张性最优政策处方，为理解贸易战下的货币政策提供了新视角。

title: Equilibrium Price Responses to Targeted Student Financial Aid
