summary: 本文研究短期债务对公司治理的双重影响。现有理论认为短期债权人通过快速响应信息促进治理，但作者指出这一特征也可能破坏治理。适度的短期债务能提高大股东退出机制的有效性并增强其参与动力，然而高水平的短期债务会使退出威胁不可信、公开参与风险过高，并削弱大股东幕后参与的激励。论文聚焦于依赖短期融资的企业（如银行）所面临的治理挑战。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了短期债务在治理中的双刃剑效应，对理解金融机构等依赖短期融资企业的治理困境具有重要启示。

title: Limits to Political Capture: Evidence from Patent Grants, Disclosures, and Litigation
abstract: Substantial evidence suggests that regulatory agencies in the United States can be captured by the politicians who oversee them. We provide novel evidence of a federal agency in which capture is limited: the United States Patent and Trademark Office. Although patent applications from politically connected applicants are slightly more likely to be approved despite being of lower ex post quality, additional analyses suggest these outcomes are not indicative of capture. In particular, the disclosure quality of connected patents' legal claims increases more than unconnected patents during the review process, narrowing the scope of the patents and constraining the intellectual property rights. Furthermore, connected patents are no more likely than others to be litigated ex post, suggesting these patent grants are not spurious. Our findings provide insights into how the design of a regulator can limit the benefits that accrue to politically connected firms.
summary: 这篇论文研究美国联邦机构中政治俘获的局限性，以美国专利商标局（USPTO）为对象。尽管政治关联申请人的专利略更容易被批准且事后质量较低，但进一步分析表明这并非俘获的证据：在审查过程中，关联专利的法律权利要求披露质量提升幅度大于非关联专利，从而缩小了专利范围并限制了知识产权权利；此外，关联专利事后被诉讼的概率并不更高，说明这些专利并非虚假授权。研究发现揭示了监管机构的设计如何限制政治关联企业所获得的利益。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了政治俘获有限性的新颖证据，并揭示了通过提升披露质量和降低诉讼风险来约束政治关联的机制，对监管设计和公司政治行为研究有重要启示。

title: Investor Corporate Visits and Predictable Returns
abstract: Using a unique data set of firms listed on China’s Shenzhen Stock Exchange, we show that investors’ corporate site visits convey information about future stock returns. Firms with abnormally frequent investor visits predictably outperform firms with abnormally infrequent investor visits by approximately 70-to-100 basis points per month. This return predictability concentrates on neglected firms with low trading volumes and when investors incur higher travel costs. Abnormally frequent investor visits accompany increased holdings among visiting institutions and predict improvements in firms’ fundamental performance, consistent with institutions using visits to gain an information advantage regarding underpriced firms. The significance of conducting site visits and in-depth research by fund companies is to consistently deliver stable and substantial returns to clients through professional expertise. (Lei Jing, CEO of Harvest Fund Management Co., Ltd., China)
summary: 基于中国深圳证券交易所上市公司的独特数据集，研究发现投资者企业实地考察传递了关于未来股票收益的信息。异常频繁的投资者访问公司每月比异常稀疏的访问公司表现出约70至100个基点的超额收益。这种收益可预测性主要集中于低交易量的被忽视公司以及投资者旅行成本较高的情况。异常频繁的访问伴随着访问机构持股的增加，并预测了公司基本面表现的改善，这与机构利用访问获取关于被低估公司的信息优势是一致的。
ai_comment: 利用独特数据验证了实地调研的信息价值，发现了显著的收益可预测性，丰富了市场微观结构和信息获取文献。

title: Collusion in Brokered Markets
abstract: High commissions in the U.S. residential real estate agency market pose a puzzle for economic theory because brokerage is not a concentrated industry. We model brokered markets as a game in which agents post prices for customers and then choose which other agents to work with. We show that there exists an equilibrium in which each agent conditions working with other agents on those agents' posted prices. Prices can therefore be meaningfully higher than the competitive level (for a fixed discount factor), regardless of the number of agents. Thus, brokered markets can remain uncompetitive even with low concentration and easy entry.
summary: 本文针对美国住宅房地产经纪市场的高佣金现象，提出一个理论模型进行解释。模型将经纪市场建模为一个博弈过程：代理商首先向客户报出价格，然后选择与其他哪些代理商合作。研究发现，存在一个均衡状态，其中每个代理商根据其他代理商报出的价格来决定是否与其合作。因此，无论代理商数量多少，价格都能显著高于竞争水平（给定折现因子）。这表明，即使市场集中度低且进入门槛低，经纪市场仍可能保持非竞争状态。
ai_comment: 本文通过博弈论模型揭示了低集中度市场也能维持高佣金的理论机制，对理解现实中的市场失灵有重要启示。

title: Bail-Ins, Optimal Regulation, and Crisis Resolution
abstract: We develop a tractable dynamic contracting framework to study bank bail-in regimes. In the presence of a repeated monitoring problem, the optimal bank capital structure combines standard debt, which induces liquidation and provides strong incentives, and bail-in debt, which restores solvency but provides weaker incentives. Given fire sales, an optimal policy response entails joint regulation: a bail-in regime reduces standard debt while leverage regulation reduces total debt. Bail-ins replace bailouts as a recapitalization tool.
summary: 本文构建了一个易于处理的动态契约框架来研究银行内部纾困（bail-in）机制。在存在重复监督问题的情况下，最优银行资本结构结合了标准债务（引发清算并提供强激励）和内部纾困债务（恢复偿付能力但提供较弱激励）。鉴于折价销售（fire sales），最优政策反应需要联合监管：内部纾困机制减少标准债务，而杠杆率监管减少总债务。内部纾困取代了外部纾困（bailouts）作为资本重组工具。
ai_comment: 本文通过动态契约框架为银行内部纾困机制提供了理论分析，强调了联合监管的重要性，并区分了内部纾困与外部纾困的激励效果。

title: Managerial Response to Shareholder Empowerment: Evidence from Majority-Voting Legislation Changes
abstract: We study how managers react to shareholder empowerment that makes votes on shareholder proposals binding. We empirically exploit staggered legislative changes that introduce such empowerment for proposals regarding majority voting in director elections. We find that managers become more responsive to shareholder requirements by initiating majority voting through either management proposals or governance guidelines. This early action crowds out shareholder proposals. Further results suggest compromised implementation: Managers adopt provisions that give them greater control over the channel of implementation and allow them to retain directors who fail in elections. Our results suggest that managers retain substantial discretion to modulate shareholder requirements. This article was partially completed when Wu was at Fudan University. Any errors are attributable solely to the authors.
summary: 本文研究管理者如何应对股东赋权，具体关注使股东提案具有约束力的立法变化。通过利用关于董事选举多数投票提案的交错立法变化进行实证分析，发现管理者通过管理层提案或治理指南主动发起多数投票，从而更响应股东要求，但这种抢先行动挤出了股东提案。进一步结果表明，管理者会采取妥协的实施方式，采用赋予他们更大控制权并允许留任选举失败董事的条款。研究结论表明，管理者保留相当大的自由裁量权来调节股东要求。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了管理者在面对股东赋权时可能采取策略性应对措施，如抢先行动和保留控制权，为理解公司治理中的权力动态提供了新视角。

title: Racial Disparities in Financial Complaints and the Role of Corporate Social Attitudes
abstract: Using consumer complaints filed with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau as a measure for the quality of financial products and services, we present evidence of racial disparities in the service quality received by consumers. Consumers in high‐minority communities file more complaints than those in low‐minority communities, and the racial gap in financial complaints increased by more than 60% during the COVID‐19 pandemic. Using a triple‐difference approach, we establish the role of corporate social attitudes, reflected in, for example, inclusive promotion practices and diversity in leadership, in mitigating the complaint racial gap and its pandemic‐period increase. Our results shed light on how inclusive corporate culture filters through an organization to benefit minority communities and underscore the effect of corporate social attitudes on important stakeholder outcomes.
summary: 本文利用消费者金融保护局（CFPB）的投诉数据衡量金融产品和服务质量，发现少数族群社区（high-minority communities）的消费者提交的投诉比低少数族群社区更多，且COVID-19疫情期间投诉的种族差距扩大了60%以上。通过三重差分方法，研究证实企业社会态度（如包容性晋升实践和领导层多样性）能够缓解投诉的种族差距及其在疫情期间的扩大。结果表明，包容性企业文化通过组织渗透并惠及少数族群社区，凸显了企业社会态度对重要利益相关者结果的影响。
ai_comment: 论文利用CFPB投诉数据为金融服务中的种族不平等提供了新颖证据，并从企业社会态度视角揭示了缓解机制，对包容性企业文化的利益相关者影响具有政策启示。

title: Dynamic Information Acquisition, Investment, and Disclosure
abstract: We present a dynamic model of information acquisition and disclosure. The manager seeks to maximize future stock prices and collects information privately about the firm's fundamentals. Information acquisition increases the arrival rate of private information. The manager can choose to disclose his private information or withhold it in perpetuity. We study the impact of information acquisition on the accumulation of private information, disclosure, and the firm's initial investment.
summary: 本文构建了一个关于信息获取和披露的动态模型。经理以最大化未来股价为目标，私下收集与公司基本面相关的信息。信息获取会提高私人信息的到达率，而经理可以选择披露私人信息或永久隐瞒。模型研究了信息获取如何影响私人信息的积累、披露决策以及公司初始投资。
ai_comment: 该论文将信息获取与披露纳入动态框架，为理解经理人的信息策略及其对公司决策的影响提供了新的理论视角。

title: Accounting Information Usage and Trading by Retail Investors: Evidence from Integrated Trading Platform
abstract: This registered report investigates self‐directed retail investors' information choices and trading decisions on an integrated trading platform that provides timely and convenient access to accounting information. The analyses reveal that these investors access a mosaic of information, with a high proportion not firm‐specific. In accessing accounting disclosures, retail investors are more interested in media articles providing summaries or expert analyses than original filings. Retail trades on this integrated trading platform are more informed than another retail trading platform providing little information services while exhibiting no significant differences in informativeness compared with institutional trades using Bulge Bracket platforms. In particular, trade informativeness is more pronounced when there are accounting disclosures. The evidence suggests that self‐directed retail investors can benefit from a trading environment that provides rich and convenient access to a mosaic of information, particularly timely accounting disclosures.
summary: 这项注册报告研究了自主零售投资者在集成交易平台上的信息选择与交易决策。平台提供及时便捷的会计信息获取。分析发现，零售投资者获取多样化的信息，其中很大一部分并非公司特定。在获取会计披露时，他们更倾向于阅读媒体摘要或专家分析文章，而非原始监管文件。在该集成交易平台上的零售交易比另一个提供较少信息服务的零售平台更知情，但与使用机构级平台的机构交易相比，信息含量无显著差异。特别是，当有会计披露时，交易信息含量更加显著。证据表明，自主零售投资者能从提供丰富且便捷信息获取（尤其是及时会计披露）的交易环境中受益。
ai_comment: 该研究通过注册报告设计，为零售投资者在集成平台上的信息使用与交易知情性提供了因果证据，表明改善信息获取环境有助于缩小散户与机构间的信息差距。

title: Creating Controversy in Proxy Voting Advice
abstract: We analyze how a profit‐maximizing proxy advisor designs vote recommendations and research reports. The advisor benefits from producing informative, unbiased reports, but only partially informative recommendations, biased against the a priori likely alternative. Such recommendations induce close votes, increasing controversy and thereby the relevance and value of proxy advice. Our results suggest shifting from an exclusive emphasis on recommendations, highlighting the importance of both reports and recommendations in proxy advisors' information provision. They rationalize the one‐size‐fits‐all approach and help reinterpret empirical patterns of voting behavior, suggesting that proxy advisors' recommendations may not be a suitable benchmark for evaluating shareholders' votes.
summary: 本文研究利润最大化的代理投票顾问如何设计投票建议和研究报告。顾问通过提供信息丰富且无偏见的报告获益，但仅提供部分信息的建议，且偏向于先验可能的替代方案。这种设计导致投票结果接近，增加争议，从而提升代理建议的相关性和价值。研究结果建议从仅关注建议转向同时重视报告和建议在信息提供中的作用，合理化了“一刀切”的方法，并帮助重新解释投票行为的经验模式，表明代理顾问的建议可能不适合作为评估股东投票的基准。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了代理投票顾问通过制造争议来提升自身价值的策略，并区分了报告与建议的不同角色，为公司治理中的信息中介研究提供了新视角。

title: Uncertainty, Contracting, and Beliefs in Organizations
abstract: We study the impact of uncertainty on optimal contracting in a multidivisional firm. Headquarters contract with division managers to induce effort. Uncertainty creates endogenous disagreement, thereby aggravating moral hazard. By hedging uncertainty, headquarters design incentive contracts that reduce disagreement and lower incentive provision costs, thereby promoting effort. Because hedging uncertainty can conflict with hedging risk, optimal contracts differ from those in standard principal-agent models. Our model helps explain the prevalence of equity-based incentive contracts and the rarity of relative-performance contracts, especially in firms facing greater uncertainty.
summary: 本文研究不确定性对多部门公司中最优合同设计的影响。总部通过合同激励部门经理付出努力，但不确定性导致经理与总部之间产生内生分歧，从而加剧道德风险。通过对冲不确定性，总部可以设计激励合同来减少分歧并降低激励成本，进而促进努力。然而，对冲不确定性与对冲风险可能存在冲突，因此最优合同不同于标准委托人-代理人模型中的结果。该模型有助于解释为什么股权激励合同普遍存在而相对绩效合同较为罕见，尤其是在面临较大不确定性的公司中。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入内生分歧，为不确定性与激励合同设计之间的关系提供了新视角，并解释了股权激励的普遍性。

title: Leverage and Stablecoin Pegs
abstract: Stablecoins are a new form of private money. They are fragile but largely trade at par. How? We present a model and empirical work to examine a novel source of demand for stablecoins. Stablecoin owners are indirectly compensated for run risk by lending their coins to crypto speculators. The stablecoin can then support its $1 peg, but this arrangement links crypto speculation to traditional financial markets where stablecoins invest their reserves.
summary: 本文研究稳定币（一种新型私人货币）如何维持与美元的锚定。作者构建了一个模型并基于实证分析，考察了稳定币需求的新来源：稳定币持有者通过向加密投机者出借代币间接获得补偿，从而激励其持有稳定币并维持1美元锚定。然而，这种机制将加密市场的投机风险与传统金融市场（稳定币储备投资于传统资产）联系起来。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统揭示了稳定币维持盯住的内在激励机制及其与传统金融市场的风险关联，对理解加密金融系统的稳定性具有重要贡献。

title: Horizon Effects in the Pricing Kernel: How Investors Price Short-Term Versus Long-Term Risks
abstract: We show that investors price short-term stock market outcomes very different from outcomes that occur further into the future. To this end, we introduce the expected forward pricing kernel and decompose long-term pricing kernels into short-term and expected forward pricing kernels. Using index options, we find that kernels with maturities of up to 12 months are U-shaped and show that this results from the shape of the 1-month pricing kernel. Once we remove the impact of the 1-month kernel, the expected forward kernels are in line with standard long-run risk models in terms of their shape, level, and time-series variation.
summary: 本文研究投资者如何对不同时间跨度的股票市场风险进行定价。作者引入预期远期定价核的概念，将长期定价核分解为短期定价核和预期远期定价核两部分。通过分析指数期权数据，发现期限在12个月以内的定价核呈现U形，且该形状主要由1个月期限的定价核驱动。剔除1个月核的影响后，预期远期定价核在形状、水平及时间序列变化上与标准长期风险模型一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过分解定价核，创新性地揭示了投资者对短期与长期风险定价的显著差异，为理解期限结构提供了新视角。

title: Filing Agents and Information Leakage
abstract: Filing agents—intermediaries used by 80% of U.S. firms—are associated with leakage of information that affects stock prices. Prior to the public release of a securities filing, most firms outsource the final processing and submission of the filing to a third-party filing agent. We find leakage is higher when firms use filing agents than when firms self-file, particularly pre-2018. Leakage is greater when the private information is more valuable and decreases when firms switch to self-filing. Our research suggests filing agents, and a firm’s choice to use them, are an important, understudied channel for the leakage of private information.
summary: 本文研究申报代理人（filings agents）作为信息泄露渠道的影响。申报代理人被80%的美国公司用于证券申报的最终处理和提交。研究发现，使用申报代理人的公司相比自行申报的公司，在公开申报前存在更显著的信息泄露，尤其在2018年之前。当私人信息价值更高时，泄露程度更大，而公司转向自行申报后泄露减少。结论表明，申报代理人及其使用选择是未被充分研究的私人信息泄露渠道。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统性地揭示申报代理人在信息泄露中的作用，并提供了公司选择对这一渠道影响的经验证据，对信息披露监管具有重要启示。

title: Compensation Consultants: Whom Do They Serve? Evidence from Consultant Changes
abstract: We investigate whether compensation consultants recommend excessive pay to earn repeat business by studying consultant changes. Our results show consultants’ interests are aligned with shareholders’ to appropriately pay the CEO. Boards dismiss consultants making large pay recommendation errors, particularly positive ones. However, powerful or poorly monitored CEOs interfere with such disciplinary turnover, weakening the relation. Peer groups are more likely to change with new consultant appointments. New consultants are less likely to include highly paid executives in the compensation peer group and CEO pay falls following the change. Directors earn higher votes in annual elections when they replace compensation advisors.
summary: 通过研究薪酬咨询师变更，本文探讨了咨询师是否为了获取重复业务而推荐过高薪酬。结果表明，咨询师利益与股东一致，倾向于合理支付CEO。董事会会解雇存在重大薪酬推荐错误（尤其是正向错误）的咨询师，但权力过大或监督不足的CEO会干扰这种纪律性更换。随着新咨询师上任，同行群组更可能发生变化，新咨询师不太可能将高薪高管纳入薪酬同行群组，且CEO薪酬在变更后下降。此外，更换薪酬顾问的董事在年度选举中获得了更高的投票支持。
ai_comment: 本文利用咨询师变更的自然实验，提供了薪酬咨询师与股东利益一致性的证据，并揭示了公司治理在约束过度薪酬中的作用。

title: The New Keynesian Model and Bond Yields
abstract: This article presents a New Keynesian model to capture the linkages between macro fundamentals and the nominal yield curve. The model explains bond yields with a low level of news in expected inflation and plausible term premia. This implies that the slope of the yield curve predicts future bond yields and that risk-adjusted historical bond yields satisfy the expectations hypothesis. The model also explains the spanning puzzle, matches key moments for real bond yields, captures the evolution of the price-dividend ratio, and implies that the slope of the yield curve and the price-dividend ratio forecast excess equity returns.
summary: 本文提出了一个新凯恩斯模型，用于捕捉宏观基本面和名义收益率曲线之间的联系。该模型通过低水平的预期通胀新闻和合理的期限溢价来解释债券收益率，意味着收益率曲线斜率可预测未来债券收益率，且风险调整后的历史债券收益率满足预期假设。模型进一步解释了跨期定价谜题，匹配了实际债券收益率的关键矩，并捕捉了价格股息比的演变，同时暗示收益率曲线斜率和价格股息比能够预测超额股票收益。
ai_comment: 该论文通过一个统一的新凯恩斯框架同时解释了债券和股票市场的多个谜题，展现了模型在宏观金融中的强大解释力。

title: Nexus Effect: Unraveling the Impact of Political Patronage Connections on Corporate Investment
abstract: This study investigates how political patronage influences local firms’ investment decisions in China, focusing on changes in patronage ties resulting from provincial leadership turnover. By examining prefectural officials with connections to their provincial superiors, we find that firms in these regions experience increased investment expenditures, albeit with reduced efficiency. This effect is primarily driven by stronger promotion incentives for local officials, bolstered by favoritism from provincial patrons. While political patronage helps address agency problems within political hierarchies, our findings highlight its adverse economic impact due to misaligned interests between politicians and the public.
summary: 本研究探讨中国政治庇护关系如何影响地方企业投资决策，重点关注省级领导更替导致的庇护关系变化。通过考察与省级上级有联系的地级市官员，发现这些地区的企业投资支出增加但效率下降。该效应主要由地方官员更强的晋升激励驱动，并受到省级庇护者偏袒的强化。虽然政治庇护有助于解决政治层级中的代理问题，但研究结果强调，由于政客与公众利益错位，其产生了负面经济影响。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用省级领导更替识别政治庇护关系的变化，揭示了政治激励对企业投资行为的双重影响，为理解新兴市场政企关系提供了新视角。

title: Country Rotation and International Mutual Fund Performance
abstract: International equity funds attain superior subsequent performance by actively changing their country asset allocations, which we capture through a new measure of active country rotation intensity. Across funds, those that rotate country allocations with the greatest intensity on average have the highest value added. We offer evidence that a fund’s change of holdings in a country is associated with future outperformance in those specific holdings. Outperformance is concentrated on the downside when funds sell down country holdings before subsequent poor country market returns. Overall, our findings affirm that active international mutual funds have country market timing abilities.
summary: 该研究通过构建新的主动国家轮换强度指标，发现国际股票基金通过主动调整国家资产配置能够获得持续的超额收益。轮换强度越高的基金，其平均附加值越高；基金在某国家的持仓变动与该国未来持仓的超额表现相关，且超额收益主要集中在基金提前减持后该国市场表现不佳的下跌区间。结论表明主动型国际共同基金具备国家市场择时能力。
ai_comment: 提出了量化国家轮换强度的新指标，并提供了基金具有国家市场择时能力的直接证据，对主动管理有效性研究有重要贡献。

title: Competition and the Reputational Costs of Litigation
abstract: We study the role of competition in customers’ reactions to litigation against firms, using anonymized mobile phone location data. A class action lawsuit filing is followed by a 4% average reduction in customer visits to target firms’ outlets in the following months. The effect strongly depends on competition. Outlets facing more competition experience significantly larger negative effects. Closer competition matters more, both in terms of geographic and industry proximity. Announcement returns and quarterly accounting revenues around lawsuit filings also strongly depend on competition. Our results suggest that competition is an important component in customers’ ability to discipline firms for misbehavior.
summary: 本文利用匿名手机位置数据研究竞争在企业面临诉讼时客户反应中的作用。集体诉讼提起后的几个月内，目标企业门店的客户访问量平均减少4%。该效应强烈依赖于竞争程度：面临更激烈竞争的门店遭受显著的更大负面影响。地理和行业层面更接近的竞争更为重要。诉讼提起前后的公告收益和季度会计收入也强烈依赖于竞争。结果表明，竞争是客户约束企业不当行为的重要组成部分。
ai_comment: 利用手机位置数据直接度量客户行为，为诉讼的信誉成本提供了新颖微观证据，并凸显了竞争的关键调节作用。

title: Political Activism and Market Power
abstract: We document an increase in market power for politically active firms during times of heightened policy uncertainty, when their information and influence advantage is greater. The effect is long-lasting and stronger for large politically active firms. We show that relatively large investments during high uncertainty periods serve as a potential mechanism for gains in market power. Industries populated with politically active firms experience lower business dynamism and import penetration, consistent with active firms leveraging investment timing to restrict competition. Results suggest that political activism is a likely contributing factor to the dominance of large firms over the last two decades.
summary: 本文实证研究了政治活跃企业在政策不确定性加剧时期市场力量的变化。研究发现，这些企业凭借信息和影响力优势，市场力量显著提升，且该效应具有持久性，对大型企业更为显著。高不确定性时期相对较大的投资是市场力量提升的潜在机制。政治活跃企业密集的行业表现出更低的商业活力和进口渗透，表明这类企业通过投资时机策略限制竞争。结论认为，政治活动是过去二十年大企业主导地位持续增强的一个潜在驱动因素。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将政治活动与企业市场力量联系起来，并揭示了投资时机作为核心机制，为理解大企业主导地位上升提供了新视角。

title: In Safe Hands: The Financial and Real Impact of Investor Composition over the Credit Cycle
abstract: I show that investor composition affects bond price dynamics and capital allocation during crises. Using large-scale holdings data and within-firm ownership variation across near-identical bonds, I causally identify bond returns’ investor composition elasticities. Corporate bonds held predominantly by insurers rather than mutual funds suffer milder losses in downturns: increasing insurer holdings by half a bond’s size causes 20% shallower drawdowns. A shift-share instrument isolates variation from large insurers’ idiosyncratic primary-market allocations. Differences in intermediaries’ liability structures drive these results, which hold across countries. During crises, firms with more stable bondholders maintain higher borrowing at lower cost and invest more.
summary: 本文利用大规模持仓数据和同一公司内近乎相同的债券的所有权差异，因果识别债券收益的投资者构成弹性。研究发现，由保险公司而非共同基金持有的公司债券在衰退中损失更小：保险公司持有量增加债券规模的半数会导致回撤减少20%。通过shift-share工具变量隔离大型保险公司特殊的初级市场配置变异，证实中介机构负债结构的差异驱动这些结果，且在跨国样本中成立。危机期间，债券持有者更稳定的公司能以更低成本维持更高借款并进行更多投资。
ai_comment: 该文利用同一公司内不同债券的所有权差异进行因果识别，方法巧妙；揭示了投资者构成对危机时期企业融资和投资的重要影响。

title: Common Pricing of Decentralized Risk: A Linear Option Pricing Model
abstract: This paper proposes a top-down linear option pricing model that unifies the pricing of different option contracts not by assuming common dynamics but by imposing common pricing on each risk source in proportion to decentralized risk estimates. The model generates significantly better pricing performance than existing bottom-up models. Its high-dimensional risk structure effectively explains the options return variation, allowing for the seamless integration of option pricing with risk management. The market price of risk estimate from the model strongly predicts the future excess return of the corresponding risk-targeting option portfolio, an important dimension of attribute completely absent from prior literature.
summary: 本文提出了一种自上而下的线性期权定价模型，通过将每个风险来源按分散风险估计的比例施加共同定价，而非假设共同动态，从而统一了不同期权合约的定价。该模型比现有自下而上的模型表现出显著更好的定价性能。其高维风险结构有效解释了期权收益的变化，实现了期权定价与风险管理的无缝整合。模型估计的风险市场价格对相应风险目标期权组合的未来超额收益具有强预测能力，这是前人文献完全缺失的重要维度。
ai_comment: 该模型从风险定价的统一性入手，创新性地将高维风险结构与期权定价结合，并验证了风险价格对未来收益的预测能力，为期权定价与风险管理提供了新视角。

title: Strategic Scientific Disclosure: Evidence from the Leahy–Smith America Invents Act
abstract: We examine the impact of technological competition on voluntary innovation disclosure around the enactment of the Leahy–Smith America Invents Act of 2011 (“AIA”). The AIA moves the US patent system from the first‐to‐invent to first‐inventor‐to‐file system and induces a patent race that increases technological competition. Firms that are slow to file a patent are disadvantaged in this race. We find that focal firms with lagging patent classes strategically increase scientific publications in their lagging technology areas in an attempt to block competitors from obtaining a patent. This effect is more pronounced in technology areas where the firm has better information about their relative competitive position (proxied by greater inventor mobility), in technology classes with constraints on increasing patent filing timeliness (proxied by fewer experienced attorneys), and areas characterized by more intense competition. We find that the peers of firms with lagging classes experience greater patent filing rejections for lack of novelty and obviousness reasons after the AIA, suggesting that strategic scientific disclosure is effective.
summary: 本文考察了技术竞争对自愿性创新信息披露的影响，利用2011年《Leahy-Smith美国发明法案》（AIA）作为外生冲击。该法案将美国专利制度从“先发明”改为“第一发明人提交”，从而诱发了专利竞赛并加剧了技术竞争。研究发现，在技术领域落后的公司会策略性地增加科学出版物，试图阻碍竞争对手获得专利。这种效应在以下情况下更为显著：公司对其相对竞争地位拥有更好信息的领域（以发明人流动性衡量）、专利提交时间受限的技术类别（以经验丰富的律师较少衡量）以及竞争更激烈的领域。此外，落后公司的同行在AIA后因缺乏新颖性和显而易见性而面临更多的专利驳回，表明这种战略性科学披露是有效的。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验识别了技术竞争对企业创新披露策略的因果效应，揭示了企业通过公开科学出版物进行战略性阻碍的新机制，为创新和公司金融文献提供了重要贡献。

title: Excess Capacity, Marginal q, and Corporate Investment
abstract: Theory posits that when managers anticipate excess capacity, average q becomes a biased estimator of marginal q as the potential for underutilizing new capital reduces the marginal benefit of investing. After correcting for this source of measurement error, the explanatory power of Tobin's q substantially improves in time‐series and cross‐sectional regressions as well as in out‐of‐sample tests. These findings, together with a secular erosion in capacity utilization, help explain why corporate investment rates have been declining for decades despite average q increasing significantly. Our analysis indicates that economic rigidities have contributed to the persistent erosion in capacity utilization.
summary: 论文提出当管理者预期存在产能过剩时，平均Tobin's q会高估边际q，因为新资本可能被闲置，从而降低投资的边际收益。通过纠正这一测量误差，Tobin's q在时间序列、横截面回归以及样本外测试中的解释力显著提高。结合产能利用率的长期侵蚀，这有助于解释为何尽管平均q大幅上升，企业投资率却持续下降数十年。分析表明，经济刚性是导致产能利用率持续下降的原因之一。
ai_comment: 该论文通过纠正平均q对边际q的测量偏差，显著提升了Tobin's q对投资的解释力，并揭示了产能利用率长期下降与投资不足之间的关联，为理解投资低迷提供了新视角。

title: Intrahousehold Disagreement about Macroeconomic Expectations
abstract: This paper highlights the simple fact that households typically consist of multiple members who may hold divergent views, a fact that existing approaches to measuring and modeling household macroeconomic expectations largely abstract from. Using unique data on the macroeconomic expectations of both spouses, I document substantial intrahousehold disagreement about inflation, economic recessions, and stock market returns. I further show that household asset allocation decisions are shaped by disagreement between spouses about future stock returns, and a preregistered randomized survey experiment confirms the causal impact of such disagreement on portfolio choice.
summary: 本文揭示了一个简单但重要的事实：家庭通常由多个成员组成，他们可能持有不同的观点，而现有衡量和建模家庭宏观经济预期的方法在很大程度上忽略了这一点。利用配偶双方宏观经济预期的独特数据，本文记录了夫妻在通胀、经济衰退和股市回报预期上的显著分歧。进一步研究表明，家庭资产配置决策受配偶之间对未来股市回报分歧的影响，一项预注册的随机调查实验确认了这种分歧对投资组合选择的因果影响。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统性地记录了家庭内部宏观经济预期的分歧，并通过实验证据确立了这种分歧对资产配置的因果影响，为理解家庭金融决策提供了新的微观基础。

title: Banks, Low Interest Rates, and Monetary Policy Transmission
abstract: I study how the secular decline in interest rates affects banks' intermediation spreads and credit supply. Following a permanent decrease in rates, bank lending may rise initially but contracts in the long run. As lower rates compress deposit spreads even well above the zero lower bound, banks' retained earnings, equity, and lending fall until loan spreads have risen enough to offset the reduction in deposit spreads. A higher inflation target can support bank lending at the cost of higher liquidity premia. I find support for the model's predictions in U.S. aggregate and bank‐level data.
summary: 本文研究利率长期下降如何影响银行的中介利差和信贷供给。在利率永久性下降后，银行贷款起初可能上升但长期会收缩。其机制在于，即使利率远高于零下限，较低利率也会压缩存款利差，导致银行留存收益、股权和贷款下降，直到贷款利差上升至足以抵消存款利差的减少。提高通胀目标可以在增加流动性溢价为代价的前提下支持银行贷款。美国总体和银行层面数据为模型的预测提供了支持。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了利率长期下降对银行贷款的动态非单调影响，并强调了存款利差压缩作为关键传导渠道，为理解低利率环境下的货币传导提供了新视角。

title: Digital Tokens and Platform Building
abstract: We present a model rationalizing the economic value of digital tokens for launching peer-to-peer platforms. By using the blockchain to transparently distribute tokens before the platform launches, a token sale overcomes later coordination failures between the platform’s users. This result follows from forward induction reasoning, under which the costly and observable action of token acquisition credibly communicates the intent to participate on the platform. Our framework demonstrates the applications of digital tokens to entrepreneurship, and offers guidance for both practitioners and regulators.
summary: 本文提出了一个模型，解释了数字代币在启动对等平台中的经济价值。通过利用区块链在平台启动前透明地分发代币，代币销售能够克服平台用户之间后来的协调失败。这一结果源于前向归纳推理，其中代币收购的昂贵且可观察的行为可信地传达了参与平台的意图。该框架展示了数字代币在创业中的应用，并为从业者和监管者提供了指导。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从协调失败角度解释了代币的经济价值，并将前向归纳推理应用于代币销售场景，为加密货币和平台经济学提供了新视角。

title: Social Connectedness in Bank Lending
abstract: We present evidence that loan allocations and loan terms are closely linked to the strength of social connections between bank and borrower regions. Lending increases with social connectedness, particularly in the presence of strong screening incentives. If connectedness is high, banks discriminate between borrowers more, the terms of originated loans are more borrower friendly, and loan performance is better. Furthermore, social connectedness is associated with higher bank profitability and with lending-related increases in borrower-region GDP growth and employment. Our results suggest that lending barriers decrease with social connectedness, which helps our understanding of geographic lending patterns and regional economic disparities.
summary: 本文研究银行与借款人所在地之间的社会连通性（Social Connectedness）对贷款分配和贷款条款的影响。利用地区间社会连接数据，发现社会连通性越强，贷款金额越大，尤其是在银行具有强烈筛选激励时。高社会连通性下，银行对借款人实行更强的区分，贷款条款更有利于借款人，且贷款表现更好。此外，社会连通性与银行盈利能力提升、借款人所在地区GDP增长和就业增加相关联。结果表明，社会连通性降低了借贷壁垒，有助于解释地理贷款模式和区域经济差异。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将社会网络分析引入银行借贷研究，实证揭示了社会资本如何影响信贷配置与经济地理，为理解金融中介的非正式渠道提供了新视角。

title: How Credit Cycles across a Financial Crisis
abstract: We analyze the behavior of credit and output in financial crises using data on credit spreads and credit growth. Crises are marked by a sharp rise in credit spreads, signaling sudden shifts in expectations. The severity of a crisis can be predicted by the extent of credit losses (spread increases) and financial sector fragility (precrisis credit growth). This interaction is a key feature of crises. Postcrisis recessions are typically severe and prolonged. Notably, precrisis spreads tend to drop to low levels while credit growth accelerates, indicating that credit supply expansions often precede crises. The 2008 crisis aligns with these patterns.
summary: 本文利用信贷利差和信贷增长的数据，分析了金融危机中信贷和产出的行为。研究发现，危机期间信贷利差急剧上升，反映出预期的突然转变。危机的严重程度可以通过信贷损失（利差增加）和金融部门脆弱性（危机前信贷增长）来预测，这种相互作用是危机的关键特征。危机后的衰退通常严重且持久。值得注意的是，危机前利差趋于下降，而信贷增长加速，表明信贷供应扩张往往先于危机发生。2008年的金融危机与这些模式一致。
ai_comment: 该研究通过信贷利差和信贷增长数据揭示了金融危机前后信贷周期的规律性，为预测危机严重程度提供了有效指标，兼具理论与实践价值。

title: In Too Deep: The Effect of Sunk Costs on Corporate Investment
abstract: Sunk costs are unrecoverable costs that should not affect decision making. I provide evidence that firms systematically fail to ignore sunk costs and that this leads to significant investment distortions. In fixed‐exchange‐ratio stock mergers, aggregate market fluctuations after parties enter into a binding merger agreement induce plausibly exogenous variation in the final acquisition cost. These quasi‐random cost shocks strongly predict firms' commitment to an acquired business following deal completion, with an interquartile cost increase reducing subsequent divestiture rates by 8% to 9%. Consistent with an intrapersonal sunk cost channel, distortions are concentrated in firm‐years in which the acquiring CEO is still in office.
summary: 沉没成本是不可回收的成本，理论上不应影响决策。本文提供证据表明，企业系统性地未能忽略沉没成本，并因此导致显著的投资扭曲。在固定汇率股票合并中，双方达成具有约束力的合并协议后，市场总体波动会引发最终收购成本的准外生变化。这些准随机成本冲击显著预测了企业在交易完成后对收购业务的投入程度，四分位距的成本增加使后续剥离率降低8%至9%。与个体内部沉没成本渠道一致，扭曲集中在收购CEO仍在任的企业年份。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验巧妙地识别了沉没成本对真实投资决策的因果影响，揭示了管理者的非理性行为，为企业金融中的行为偏差提供了新证据。

title: The Effect of Intangible Asset Classification on Professional Financial Statement Users’ Assessments
abstract: Classification of financial statement elements into categories is an inherent, integral part of the financial reporting system. Although prior research documents that categories influence users’ perceptions of included items, we explore the reverse effect—how classifying items in a category can impact perceptions of the category itself and its other members. Using categorization theory from psychology and accounting literature and exploiting the classification challenges inherent to the crypto asset setting, we predict and find that classifying individual items into a category can impact equity analysts’ perceptions of the category itself and perceptions of the category's other members. We also explore the boundaries of this effect and find that categories like intangibles, with fewer common prototypical features, are more susceptible to these classification effects. Our results show several ways in which balance sheet classification could lead to unintended consequences for users.
summary: 本研究基于心理学和会计学中的分类理论，利用加密资产分类困难的特性，探究财务报表项目分类对用户感知的反向影响——即分类如何影响用户对类别本身及其成员（加密资产）的感知。通过实验发现，将个别项目（如加密资产）分类到无形资产类别中，会显著影响股权分析师对该类别及其其他成员的感知。研究进一步揭示这种效应的边界：具有较少共同原型特征的无形资产更易受到分类效应影响。结果表明，资产负债表分类可能对用户产生非预期的后果。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地反转了传统研究视角，从类别感知的角度揭示财务报表分类的潜在影响，对会计准则制定具有重要警示意义。

title: Public Disclosure of Private Meetings: Does Observing Peers’ Information Acquisition Affect Analysts’ Attention Allocation?
abstract: We investigate the impact of observing peers’ information acquisition on financial analysts’ allocation of attention. Using the timely disclosure mandate by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange as a setting, we find that, shortly after analysts observe that a firm has been visited by peer analysts, they reduce short‐term attention to that firm, as indicated by a reduced tendency to conduct follow‐up visits. Nonvisiting analysts who do not conduct follow‐up visits are more likely to discontinue coverage of the visited firm. These findings are consistent with the conjecture that the timely disclosure reveals the first‐mover advantage of visiting analysts, leading nonvisiting ones to reallocate their limited attention. We also find that, compared with the pre‐mandate period, the information environments of visited firms deteriorate immediately after an analyst's visit but not over the longer term. Further evidence suggests that the timely disclosure mandate has positive externalities in the form of increased immediate attention to and improved short‐term information environments of unvisited peer firms.
summary: 研究利用深交所要求分析师及时披露访问信息的制度，探究观察同行信息获取对分析师注意力分配的影响。发现当分析师观察到同行已访问某公司后，他们会减少对该公司的短期关注，表现为减少后续访问；未访问的分析师更可能停止覆盖该公司。这些发现支持及时披露揭示了访问分析师的先发优势，导致非访问分析师重新分配有限注意力。此外，访问后公司的信息环境在短期内恶化，但长期无显著影响。及时披露对未访问的同行公司产生正外部性，表现为立即关注增加和短期信息环境改善。
ai_comment: 利用深交所独特制度提供分析师注意力受同行影响的因果证据，并发现正外部性，对信息市场设计具有启示意义。

title: Investor Memory
abstract: We provide experimental evidence of a positive memory bias that affects individuals’ beliefs, decisions to reinvest, and overconfidence in the stock market. Individuals overremember positive investment outcomes of chosen assets and underremember negative ones. Based on their memories, subjects form overly optimistic beliefs about their investment, reinvest too much, and become overconfident about their investment ability relative to others. We further provide evidence on motivation driving the memory bias. This positive memory bias offers a cognitive microfoundation for why gains weight more than losses when people learn from experiences. This helps reconcile various stylized facts in investor beliefs and behavior.
summary: 通过实验证据，本文发现投资者存在正向记忆偏差，即倾向于过度记忆所选资产的正面投资结果，而忽略负面结果。这种记忆偏差导致个体形成过度乐观的信念、过度再投资，并相对于他人变得过度自信。进一步，本文提供了驱动这种记忆偏差的动机证据。正向记忆偏差为人们从经验中学习时收益比损失权重更大的现象提供了认知微观基础，有助于解释投资者信念和行为中的各种典型事实。
ai_comment: 本文通过精巧的实验设计揭示了记忆偏差对投资者决策的深远影响，为行为金融学提供了新的心理机制解释。

title: Choosing Wisely: Evaluating Latent Factor Models in the Presence of a Contaminated Instrumental Variable with Varying Strength
abstract: Causal inference methods are widely used in empirical research; however, there is a paucity of evidence on the properties of shared latent factor estimators in the presence of contaminated instrumental variable (IV) when a strong IV may not be available.We present a theoretical formulation to depict how the strength and degree of contamination of the IV simultaneously determine the optimal choice of estimator.We perform Monte Carlo simulations with four outcome variables and an endogenous treatment variable, with sample sizes of 1000 and 2000, and for 1000 iterations, to compare the finite sample properties of the OLS, 2SLS, Shared Latent Factor without IV (SLF), and Shared Latent Factor with IV (SLF+IV) estimators.Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the proposed estimators to study the causal impact of maternal parity on various maternal and child health indicators: child's height-for-age percentile, child's weight-for-age percentile, child's haemoglobin count, and mother's haemoglobin count, using data from the 2019-21 Round 5 of the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) from India.Our simulation results indicate that for a given degree of contamination of the IV, there exists a threshold strength of the IV, such that the SLF+IV estimator has a lower (greater) bias than the SLF estimator when the strength of the IV lies above (below) that threshold.The empirical results suggest that a lower parity is associated with higher height-for-age and weight-for-age percentile and haemoglobin count in children and a higher haemoglobin count in mothers.
summary: 本文旨在解决因果推断中当工具变量（IV）受到污染且强度可能较弱时，如何选择最优的共享潜在因子估计量的问题。首先，通过理论推导刻画了IV的强度与污染程度如何共同决定最优估计量的选择。然后，通过Monte Carlo模拟（样本量1000和2000，1000次迭代，四个结果变量和一个内生处理变量）比较了OLS、2SLS、无IV的共享潜在因子（SLF）以及有IV的共享潜在因子（SLF+IV）这四种估计量的有限样本性质。最后，利用印度2019-21年第五轮全国家庭健康调查（NFHS-5）数据，实证分析了母亲胎次对儿童身高/年龄百分位数、体重/年龄百分位数、儿童血红蛋白计数以及母亲血红蛋白计数等健康指标的因果影响。模拟结果显示，对于给定的IV污染程度，存在一个IV强度的阈值：当IV强度高于该阈值时，SLF+IV估计量的偏误小于SLF；反之则更大。实证结果表明，较低的胎次与儿童更高的身高/年龄百分位、体重/年龄百分位和血红蛋白计数以及母亲更高的血红蛋白计数相关。
ai_comment: 该论文系统性地考虑了工具变量污染和强度对估计量选择的联合影响，并通过理论、模拟和实证相结合的方式给出了指导性结论，具有较强的方法论创新和实际应用价值。

title: Cloze Encounters: The Impact of Pirated Data Access on LLM Performance
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in text generation, but their performance may be influenced by the datasets on which they are trained, including potentially unauthorized or pirated content. We investigate the extent to which data access through pirated books influences LLM responses. We test the performance of leading foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, and Gemini) on a set of books that were and were not included in the Books3 dataset, which contains full-text pirated books and could be used for LLM training. We assess book-level performance using the “name cloze” word-prediction task. To examine the causal effect of Books3 inclusion we employ an instrumental variables strategy that exploits the pattern of book publication years in the Books3 dataset. In our sample of 12, 916 books, we find significant improvements in LLM name cloze accuracy on books available within the Books3 dataset compared to those not present in these data. These effects are more pronounced for less popular books as compared to more popular books and vary across leading models. These findings have crucial implications for the economics of digitization, copyright policy, and the design and training of AI systems.
summary: 本研究探讨了盗版数据访问对大型语言模型（LLM）性能的影响。通过比较包含在盗版书籍数据集Books3中的书籍与未包含的书籍，使用GPT、Claude、Llama和Gemini等基础模型进行“名称完形填空”任务测试。利用工具变量法处理因果识别，基于书籍出版年份的模式，发现Books3中的书籍显著提升了LLM的预测准确性，且对不太流行的书籍效果更为明显，不同模型间存在差异。研究结果对数字化经济、版权政策以及AI系统设计与训练具有重要启示。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的因果推断方法揭示了盗版数据对LLM性能的显著提升作用，为理解AI训练数据的合规性与经济影响提供了重要实证证据。

title: Does Fund Size Affect Private Equity Performance? Evidence from Donation Inflows to Private Universities
abstract: Do returns in private equity (PE) rise or fall with fund scale?This question is increasingly urgent amid larger funds and new focus on the retail market.Since better managers can raise larger funds, the causal effect is difficult to identify.We develop an instrument based on gifts to universities, which lead to more capital for managers with preexisting relationships.We show decreasing returns; for example, a 1% size increase reduces net IRR by 0.1 percentage points.Larger funds do larger deals, which perform worse.We find no change in risk, in part because additional deals are more levered.
summary: 本文研究私募股权（PE）基金规模对业绩的因果效应。由于优秀经理人能募集更大基金，导致识别内生性困难。作者利用美国私立大学捐赠流入作为工具变量：捐赠增加使与大学有既有关系的经理人获得更多资本，从而外生地影响基金规模。研究发现规模报酬递减：基金规模每增加1%，净内部收益率（net IRR）下降0.1个百分点。机制上，更大规模基金倾向于做更大交易，而这些交易表现更差；同时风险水平不变，因为额外交易使用了更高杠杆。
ai_comment: 利用大学捐赠作为工具变量巧妙解决了基金规模的内生性问题，为私募股权规模报酬递减提供了因果证据。

title: Shadow Always Touches the Feet: Implications of Bank Credit Lines to Non-Bank Financial Intermediaries
abstract: We study the implications of banks extending credit lines to non-bank financial intermediaries (NBFIs), using real estate investment trusts (REITs) as an economically important example.While smaller banks hold significant direct exposures in CRE loans, the CRE exposure of large banks is also indirect via credit-line provision to REITs.REITs' credit-line utilization is substantially more sensitive to market stress than for other publicly-traded NBFIs and corporates.In turn, large banks suffer drawdowns on credit lines to REITs and attendant equity corrections in stress times.Ignoring this NBFI credit-line channel understates the exposure of large banks to aggregate stress.
summary: 本文研究了银行向非银行金融中介（NBFI）提供信贷额度的潜在影响，以房地产投资信托基金（REITs）作为重要实例。研究发现，尽管小型银行直接持有大量商业房地产（CRE）贷款，但大型银行通过向REITs提供信贷额度间接承担CRE风险。在市场压力时期，REITs对信贷额度的使用比其它公开交易的NBFI和企业更为敏感，导致大型银行面临信贷额度提取和随之而来的股权调整。忽略这一NBFI信贷额度渠道将低估大型银行在整体压力下的风险敞口。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了大型银行通过信贷额度间接暴露于CRE风险的渠道，补充了传统直接贷款风险的研究，对系统性风险监管有重要启示。

title: Supply Constraints do not Explain House Price and Quantity Growth Across U.S. Cities
abstract: The standard view of housing markets holds that differences in the flexibility of local housing supply-shaped by factors like geography and regulation-explain differences in how house price and quantity growth respond to rising demand across U.S. cities.However, from 2000 to 2020, we find that higher income growth predicts the same growth in house prices, housing quantity, and population regardless of a city's estimated housing supply elasticity.We find the same results when we examine rents, expand the sample to 1980 to 2020, use different elasticity measures, use per capita income or population growth instead of total income growth, and when exploiting a variety of plausibly exogenous variation in local housing demand.Using a general demand-andsupply framework, we show that these results imply that estimated housing supply constraints are unimportant in explaining differences in rising house prices among U.S. cities.Our conclusions challenge the prevailing view of local housing and labor markets and suggest that relaxing regulatory housing supply constraints may not materially affect housing affordability.
summary: 本文挑战了住房供给约束决定美国城市房价和数量增长差异的标准观点。作者使用2000-2020年数据，发现无论城市估计的housing supply elasticity如何，更高的收入增长对房价、住房数量及人口增长的预测作用相同。通过稳健性检验（包括租金、扩展样本至1980-2020年、不同弹性度量、使用人均收入或人口增长替代总收入增长，以及利用多种外生需求冲击）均得到一致结果。基于一般供需框架的分析表明，估计的住房供给约束在解释美国城市房价上涨差异中不重要，暗示放松管制可能不会实质性改善住房可负担性。
ai_comment: 该论文通过大量稳健性检验挑战了主流观点，为住房市场研究提供了新视角，具有重要的政策启示。

title: A Quest for AI Knowledge
abstract: This paper examines how AI tools that excel at interpolating existing knowledge affect scientific research directions.Using a model where AI assists both scientists (S-AI) and decision-makers (DM-AI), it is shown that AI's impact on research novelty is non-monotonic and depends critically on capability thresholds.While S-AI predictably encourages knowledge consolidation by reducing costs within established domains-potentially creating distinct pockets of deepening-DM-AI generates surprising effects.With limited capabilities, scientists ignore DM-AI.In a moderate regime, scientists "work to the AI," constraining novelty to match AI's operational range.Only with sufficiently advanced DM-AI do scientists unambiguously pursue more novel research.The strong complementarity between AI capabilities and knowledge gaps means that moderate AI may reduce research ambition.These findings challenge the conventional wisdom that interpolative AI uniformly pushes science toward consolidation, revealing a nuanced relationship between AI capabilities and scientific progress instead.
summary: 本文研究擅长内插已有知识的AI工具如何影响科学研究方向。通过构建一个AI同时辅助科学家（S-AI）和决策者（DM-AI）的模型，发现AI对研究新颖性的影响是非单调的，取决于关键的能力阈值。S-AI通过降低已有领域的成本可预测地促进知识整合，可能形成深度化的知识孤岛；而DM-AI则产生意外效果。当DM-AI能力有限时，科学家忽视它；在中等能力区间，科学家“为AI而工作”，限制新颖性以匹配AI的运作范围；只有当DM-AI足够先进时，科学家才会明确追求更具新颖性的研究。AI能力与知识差距之间的强互补性意味着中等能力的AI可能降低研究雄心。这些发现挑战了“内插型AI统一推动科学走向整合”的传统观点，揭示了AI能力与科学进步之间的微妙关系。
ai_comment: 该研究通过理论建模揭示了AI能力与科研创新之间的非线性关系，挑战了AI必然导致知识整合的固有认知，为理解AI对科学方向的影响提供了新视角。

title: The Optimal Monetary Policy Response to Tariffs
abstract: What is the optimal monetary policy response to tariffs?This paper explores this question within an open-economy New Keynesian model, characterizes the macroeconomic effects of tariffs, and shows that the optimal monetary policy response is expansionary, with inflation rising above and beyond the direct effects of tariffs.This result holds regardless of whether tariffs apply to consumption goods or intermediate inputs, whether the shock is temporary or permanent, and whether terms of trade are exogenous or endogenous.When tariffs address other distortions, monetary policy remains expansionary, but the inflationary effects are mitigated.
summary: 本文在开放经济新凯恩斯模型中研究关税的最优货币政策反应，刻画关税的宏观经济效应，并表明最优货币政策反应是扩张性的，导致通胀上升超过关税的直接影响。这一结论在关税适用于消费品或中间投入品、冲击是暂时性或永久性、贸易条件是外生或内生的情况下均成立。当关税用于解决其他扭曲时，货币政策仍保持扩张性，但通胀效应有所减弱。
ai_comment: 该文系统性地论证了关税冲击下扩张性货币政策的必要性，并检验了多种情景的稳健性，为理解货币与贸易政策的协调提供了理论支撑。

title: Labor, Loans and Leisure: The Impact of the Student Loan Payment Pause
abstract: Beginning in March 2020 and ultimately continuing to September 2023, most student loan borrowers had their required payments on federal student loans paused. For student loan borrowers with limited access to credit, the payment pause provided additional cash-on-hand that may have allowed them to reduce their work hours. Using survey data capturing individual finances, monthly work characteristics and educational attainment, we find that suspended student debt payments reduced average weekly hours worked by 1.34 (-4%) over a 10-month period with declines concentrated among workers who had not completed a college degree. For borrowers who had completed a college degree or graduate degree, there is no evidence that the payment pause changed employment or hours worked. These findings are consistent with consumer finance data showing that borrower households without a college degree are approximately twice as likely to report liquidity constraints relative to more educated households with federal student debt.
summary: 本文研究了2020年3月至2023年9月期间美国联邦学生贷款还款暂停对借款人劳动供给的影响。利用包含个人财务、月度工作特征和教育程度的调查数据，发现还款暂停使得借款人平均每周工作时间减少1.34小时（约4%），且这一下降主要集中在未完成大学学位的借款人中。对于已完成大学或研究生学位的借款人，还款暂停并未显著改变其就业或工作时间。这些结果与消费金融数据一致，显示无大学学位的借款人家庭面临流动性约束的概率约为有学位的家庭的兩倍。
ai_comment: 该研究利用自然实验揭示了流动性约束在劳动供给决策中的重要作用，并突出了教育程度的异质性效应，为理解财政刺激政策的劳动力市场影响提供了新证据。

title: Number Processing Constraints and Earnings News
abstract: Neuroscience shows that human brains are neurologically constrained to process small numbers linearly and large numbers logarithmically, leading to underreactions to larger numbers as their perceived difference becomes smaller. We test this hypothesis in the context of earnings announcements and find that investors respond less in the short term to earnings news for stocks with high earnings per share magnitudes, exacerbating postearnings announcement drift for these stocks. These findings are distinct from and incremental to several risk-based and behavioral explanations, attenuated by robot presence and present in a quasi-experimental design using stock splits. Our evidence suggests that number processing constraints have implications for stock price efficiency. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01722 .
summary: 神经科学研究表明，人脑在处理数字时存在约束：对小数字线性处理，对大数字对数处理，导致对大数字的感知差异变小，从而反应不足。本文在盈余公告情境中检验这一假设，发现对于每股收益（EPS）数值较高的股票，投资者在短期对盈余新闻的反应更弱，这加剧了这些股票的盈余公告后漂移（PEAD）。该效应独立于且优于多种基于风险和行为解释，且当机器人交易者存在时会减弱。通过股票分割的准实验设计进一步支持了因果解释。证据表明，数字处理约束对股价效率有重要影响。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将神经科学中的数字处理约束引入金融实证，为盈余公告后漂移提供了新颖的行为解释，并通过准实验设计增强了因果推断的可靠性。

title: Vaccine Progress, Stock Prices, and the Value of Ending the Pandemic
abstract: One measure of the ex ante cost of disasters is the welfare gain from shortening their expected duration. We introduce a stochastic clock into a standard disaster model that summarizes information about progress (positive or negative) toward disaster resolution. We show that the stock market response to duration news is essentially a sufficient statistic to identify the welfare gain to interventions that alter the state. Using information on clinical trial progress during 2020, we build contemporaneous forecasts of the time to vaccine deployment, which provide a measure of the anticipated length of the COVID-19 pandemic. The model can thus be calibrated from market reactions to vaccine news, which we estimate. The estimates imply that ending the pandemic would have been worth from 5% to 15% of total wealth as the expected duration varied in this period. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00863 .
summary: 本文通过引入一个随机时钟到标准灾难模型中，该时钟总结了关于灾难解决进展（正面或负面）的信息，证明了股票市场对持续时间新闻的反应本质上是一个充分统计量，可用于识别改变状态的干预措施的福利收益。利用2020年临床试验进展信息，构建了疫苗部署时间的同期预测，从而衡量COVID-19疫情的预期长度。通过估计市场对疫苗新闻的反应来校准模型，发现结束疫情的价值相当于总财富的5%到15%，具体取决于预期持续时间的变化。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用股市对疫苗进展新闻的反应来量化缩短灾难持续时间的经济价值，为评估公共卫生干预措施提供了新视角。

title: Credit Market Conditions and Mental Health
abstract: Research offers conflicting predictions about the impact of credit conditions on mental health. We first assess how bank regulatory reforms that improved credit conditions, for example, by enhancing the efficiency of credit allocation and lowering lending rates, impacted mental health. We discover that among low-income individuals, these regulatory reforms reduced mental depression, boosted labor market outcomes, eased access to mortgage debt, and reduced the ranks of the “unbanked.” We also find that mergers of large regional banks that led to branch closures and tighter credit constraints in affected counties harmed the mental health of lower-income individuals in treated counties. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: C. Lin and M. Tai acknowledge financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72192841] and the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administration Region, China [Project T35/710/20R]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00194 .
summary: 该论文研究了信贷条件对心理健康的影响，针对现有文献中的矛盾预测，利用银行监管改革（提升信贷分配效率、降低贷款利率）和大型区域银行合并（导致分行关闭、信贷收紧）作为外生冲击，分析其对低收入人群心理健康的影响。研究发现，改善信贷条件的监管改革显著降低了低收入个体的抑郁水平，改善了其劳动市场表现、增加了抵押贷款可及性、减少了无银行账户人数；而银行合并导致的信贷紧缩则损害了低收入人群的心理健康。
ai_comment: 该文利用自然实验提供了信贷条件影响心理健康的因果证据，尤其关注低收入群体，具有重要政策含义；同时揭示了银行监管与合并的不同效应，丰富了金融与健康交叉领域的研究。

title: Risks to Human Capital
abstract: We build a model with inalienable human capital, in which investors finance individuals who can potentially become skilled. Although investment in skill is always optimal, it does not take place in some states of the world, due to moral hazard. In intermediate states of the world, individuals acquire skill; however outside investors and individuals inefficiently share risk. We show that this simple moral hazard problem, combined with risk aversion of individuals and outside investors, amplifies the equity premium, lowers the risk-free rate, and leads to disaster states that fall especially heavily on some agents but not on others. We show that the possibility of disaster states distorts risk prices and affects wealth inequality, even under calibrations in which they never occur in equilibrium. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: M. Ebrahimian acknowledges funding from the Swedish House of Finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03068 .
summary: 本文构建了一个包含不可分割人力资本的模型，其中投资者资助可能成为技能人才的个体。尽管技能投资总是最优的，但由于道德风险，在某些状态下不会发生投资。在中间状态下，个体获得技能，但外部投资者和个体之间的风险分担效率低下。该模型表明，简单的道德风险问题加上个体和外部投资者的风险厌恶，放大了股权溢价，降低了无风险利率，并导致灾害状态对某些代理人影响特别严重而对其他人则不然。此外，即使灾害状态在均衡中从未发生，其存在的可能性也会扭曲风险价格并影响财富不平等。
ai_comment: 该文从人力资本不可分割性和道德风险角度揭示了资产定价核心谜团的新机制，尤其强调了从未实现的灾害状态对风险价格的潜在扭曲，具有理论深度。

title: Insider Trading Restrictions and Informed Trading in Peer Stocks
abstract: Using a uniquely constructed data set of trades by corporate insiders in all stocks, we find that, after insider trading regulations become stricter, insiders are 20% more likely to trade in peer stocks and that such trades become more profitable. The increase in both the probability and profitability of peer-stock trades is driven by the insider’s information that is fungible to industry peers. Stricter insider trading laws are designed to improve liquidity and price informativeness in capital markets. We show that peer trading dampens these intended benefits of the insider trading regulation. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by NSE-NYU Stern Initiative on the Study of Indian Financial Markets. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02907 .
summary: 利用独特构建的企业内幕人士在所有股票中的交易数据集，研究发现内幕交易法规变得更加严格后，内幕人士交易同行股票的概率增加了20%，且此类交易变得更加盈利。这种概率和盈利性的增加是由内幕人士掌握的可转移给行业同行的信息驱动的。严格的内幕交易法规旨在提高资本市场的流动性和价格信息性，但同行交易削弱了这些预期收益。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了内幕交易限制的意外后果，即内幕人士转向同行股票交易，削弱了监管的预期效果，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Human in the Loop Automation: Ride-Hailing with Remote (Tele-)Drivers
abstract: Tele-driving refers to a novel concept by which drivers can remotely operate vehicles (without being physically in the vehicle). By putting the human back in the loop, tele-driving has emerged recently as a more viable alternative to fully automated vehicles with ride-hailing (and other on-demand transportation-enabled services) being an important application. Because remote drivers can be operated as a shared resource (any driver can be assigned to any customer regardless of trip origin or destination), it may be possible for such services to deploy fewer drivers than vehicles without significantly reducing service quality. In this paper, we examine the extent to which this is possible. Using a spatial queueing model that captures the dynamics of both pickup and trip times, we show that the impact of reducing the number of drivers depends crucially on system workload relative to the number of vehicles. In particular, when workload is sufficiently high relative to the number of vehicles, we show that, perhaps surprisingly, reducing the number of drivers relative to the number of vehicles can actually improve service level (e.g., as measured by the amount of demand fulfilled in the case of impatient customers). Having fewer drivers than vehicles ensures that there are always idle vehicles; the fewer the drivers, the likelier it is for there to be more idle vehicles. Consequently, the fewer the drivers, the likelier it is for the pickup times to be shorter (making overall shorter service times likelier). The impact of shorter service time is particularly significant when the workload is high, and in this case, it is enough to overcome the loss in driver capacity. When workload is sufficiently low relative to the number of vehicles, we show that it is possible to significantly reduce the number of drivers without significantly reducing service level. In systems in which customers are patient and willing to queue up for the service, we show that reducing the number of drivers can also reduce delay, including stabilizing a system that may otherwise be unstable. In general, relative to a system in which the number of vehicles equals the number of drivers (as in a system with in-vehicle drivers), a system with remote drivers can result in savings in the number of drivers either without significantly degrading performance or actually improving performance. We discuss how these results can, in part, be explained by the interplay of two counteracting forces: (1) having fewer drivers increasing service rate and (2) having fewer drivers reducing the number of servers with the relative strength of these forces depending on system workload. This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation. Funding: This work was supported by the US National Science Foundation [Grant SCC-1831140], and the Guangdong (China) Provincial Key Laboratory of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [2023B1212010001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01687 .
summary: 本文研究远程驾驶（tele-driving）在叫车服务中的应用，即驾驶员远程操作车辆而非亲自驾驶。通过空间排队模型，分析了在叫车服务中减少驾驶员数量（相对于车辆数）对服务水平的影响。模型考虑了接客时间和行程时间动态，发现影响取决于系统工作负载与车辆数的相对水平。当工作负载相对于车辆数足够高时，减少驾驶员数量反而可能提高服务水平（如满足不耐烦顾客的需求量），因为空闲车辆增多缩短了接客时间，从而降低总服务时间，克服了驾驶员容量损失。当工作负载较低时，可大幅减少驾驶员而不显著降低服务水平。对于耐心且愿意排队等候的顾客，减少驾驶员还能减少延迟，甚至稳定原本不稳定的系统。总体上，相对于驾驶员与车辆一一对应的系统（如传统车内驾驶），远程驾驶系统可在不显著降低性能甚至提高性能的情况下节省驾驶员数量。这些结果可通过两种相反力量的相互作用部分解释：减少驾驶员增加服务率与减少驾驶员降低服务器数量，其相对强度取决于工作负载。
ai_comment: 本文提出了一种新颖的远程驾驶叫车服务模型，揭示了减少驾驶员数量在某些条件下反而能提升服务水平的反直觉现象，对自动驾驶和共享出行领域具有重要启示。

title: Innovation Strategy After IPO: How AI Analytics Spurs Innovation After IPO
abstract: We examine the role of AI analytics in facilitating innovation in firms that have gone through IPO. Using patent data on over 1,000 publicly traded firms, we find that firms acquiring AI analytics capability post-IPO experience less of a decline in innovation quality compared with similar firms that have not acquired that capability. This effect is greater when only machine learning capabilities are considered. Moreover, we find this sustained rate of innovation is driven principally by the continued development of innovations that combine existing technologies into new ones—a form of innovation that is especially well supported by analytics. By examining three main mechanisms that hampered post-IPO innovation, we find that AI analytics can ameliorate the pressure to meet short-term financial goals and disclosure requirements. However, it has limited effect in addressing managerial incentives. For firms with long product cycles, the disclosure effect is reduced to a greater extent than it is for those with short cycles. Overall, our results show the importance of examining technology as a critical input factor in innovation. We show that the increased deployment of AI analytics may reduce some of the innovative penalties suffered by IPOs and that investors and managers can potentially mitigate post-IPO reductions in innovative output by directing capital acquired in the IPO process to the acquisition of AI analytics capabilities. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: The authors appreciate the generous financial support from Wharton Dean’s Research Fund and Mack Institute for Innovation Management. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01559 .
summary: 本文研究了IPO后企业如何利用AI分析促进创新。基于超过1000家上市公司的专利数据，发现IPO后获得AI分析能力的企业，其创新质量下降幅度小于未获得该能力的同类企业，且当仅考虑机器学习能力时效果更显著。这种持续的创新率主要源于对现有技术进行组合创新的持续发展——AI分析特别支持此类创新。通过检验阻碍IPO后创新的三种主要机制，发现AI分析可以缓解短期财务目标压力和披露要求，但对管理激励的影响有限。对于产品周期长的企业，披露效应的缓解程度大于产品周期短的企业。结果表明，技术作为创新的关键投入因素的重要性，增加AI分析部署可能减少IPO后的创新损失，投资者和管理者可通过将IPO资本用于获取AI分析能力来缓解IPO后创新产出下降。
ai_comment: 本文首次实证了AI分析能力对IPO后企业创新质量的保护作用，并揭示了其缓解短期压力而非管理激励的机制，为技术投资与创新管理提供了新视角。

title: Like Stars: How Firms Learn at Scientific Conferences
abstract: Scientific conferences are an underexplored channel by which firms can learn from science. We provide empirical evidence that firms learn from scientific conferences in which they participate but also that this is conditional on intense participation. Using data from conference papers in computer science since the 1990s, we show that corporate investments in participation are both frequent and highly skewed, with some firms contributing to a given conference scientifically, some as sponsors, and some doing both. We use direct flights as an instrumental variable for the probability that other scientists participate in the same conference as a firm, altering the knowledge set to which the firm is exposed. We find that a firm’s use of scientists’ knowledge increases when they participate in the same conferences. Greater participation efforts, where the firm seeks the spotlight by both sponsoring the conference and contributing to its scientific discourse, foretell research collaborations and a stronger learning effect. Such learning is disproportionately concentrated among the most prominent firms and scientists rather than benefitting those without alternative interaction channels. Therefore, on average, firms learn from scientists that they encounter at conferences, but the substantial heterogeneity of the effect reflects the influence of reputation mechanisms in social interactions. This paper was accepted by Ashish Arora, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: S. Baruffaldi acknowledges financial support from the Swiss Science National Foundation (Reference No.: P2ELP1-161847). Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01373 .
summary: 本文研究企业如何通过科学会议从科学家那里学习。基于20世纪90年代以来计算机科学会议论文的数据，发现企业参会是频繁且高度偏斜的：一些企业贡献科学论文，一些作为赞助商，还有一些两者兼有。利用直飞航班作为工具变量，估计其他科学家参与同一会议的概率，从而改变企业接触的知识集。结果发现，当企业与科学家参加同一会议时，企业对科学家知识的利用增加。企业通过赞助和科学贡献双重方式寻求“聚光灯”时，预示着研究合作和更强的学习效应。然而，这种学习不成比例地集中在最著名的企业和科学家身上，而非缺乏其他互动渠道的群体。因此，平均而言，企业从会议中遇到的科学家那里学习，但效应的显著异质性反映了社会互动中声誉机制的影响。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将科学会议作为企业学习渠道，并使用直飞航班作为工具变量识别因果效应，为知识溢出研究提供了新视角。

title: Accessing the Untapped Brand Leverage Potential: A Strategic Framework from a Capital Market View
abstract: Do firms fully capitalize on the financial strength of their customer-based brand equity (CBBE)? If not, how large is the gap to a benchmark condition where CBBE is financially fully leveraged? Which market strategies, if any, should the firm emphasize to close the gap? This research addresses these questions. The authors introduce a framework and methodology that enables firms to identify and measure their “brand capabilities gap,” which captures the firm’s potential for leveraging CBBE into firm value when the most effective and efficient brand leverage strategy is in place, and, if necessary, take corrective action to realize their brand leverage potential. The authors further examine three market strategy moderators that firms can steer via their marketing programs and tactics to close the brand capabilities gap. The application of the framework and methodology to a wide-ranging sample of firms from 2005 to 2013 reveals that, on average, firms only realize 35% of their financial brand leverage potential. This translates into an average brand capabilities gap worth $2.1 bn per brand, which represents 4.3% of firm value. These findings have important implications for strategic brand analysis and planning and can help firms design a more effective financial brand leverage strategy. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00670 .
summary: 本文研究企业是否充分利用了基于客户的品牌资产（CBBE）的财务潜力，以及如何衡量和缩小与最优杠杆状态之间的差距。作者提出了一个框架和方法，使企业能够识别并测量其“品牌能力差距”，即在最有效和高效的品牌杠杆策略下，企业将CBBE转化为公司价值的潜在空间，并据此采取纠正措施。进一步地，文章考察了三种可通过营销计划和策略调整的市场策略调节因素，以缩小这一差距。通过对2005年至2013年广泛的样本企业进行应用分析，发现平均而言，企业仅实现了其财务品牌杠杆潜力的35%，这意味着每个品牌的平均品牌能力差距价值21亿美元，占企业价值的4.3%。这些发现对战略品牌分析和规划具有重要意义，有助于企业设计更有效的财务品牌杠杆策略。
ai_comment: 该研究提出了一个量化品牌杠杆潜力的框架，并揭示了企业普遍存在巨大的品牌能力差距，为品牌战略的财务优化提供了新视角。

title: Digital vs. Traditional Advertising and the Recognition of Brand Intangible Assets
abstract: This paper examines how different advertising categories are associated with attributes of brand asset recognition arising in the context of acquisitions. Prior research documents that aggregate advertising is positively associated with firm sales and brand values, but it fails to consider major recent shifts in advertising from traditional channels (such as TV) to digital advertising (such as paid search and online display). Using proprietary data, I decompose advertising expenditures into the categories of traditional, online display, and paid search. Consistent with expectations, results confirm that target firms’ traditional and online display advertising exhibit a higher likelihood of brand asset recognition and higher recognized brand values as compared with paid search advertising. Confirming the economic substance of the recognized brands, additional results reveal positive investor equity market reactions to brand value, which are driven by firms investing more in traditional and online display advertising. Overall, these results confirm that certain advertising channels exhibit stronger associations with the recognition and characteristics of the underlying brand asset, consistent with their heterogeneous properties. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: I acknowledge the financial support from my advisor, Eddie Riedl, as well as from the UNH Paul College of Business and Economics Summer Research Support Award. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00387 .
summary: 本文研究不同广告类别（传统广告、在线展示广告和付费搜索广告）如何与收购中品牌资产确认的属性相关联。现有文献发现总体广告支出与公司销售额和品牌价值正相关，但未考虑从传统渠道向数字广告的近期重大转变。作者利用专有数据将广告支出分解为传统、在线展示和付费搜索三类。结果一致显示，与传统广告和在线展示广告相比，目标公司进行传统广告和在线展示广告时，品牌资产确认的可能性更高，确认的品牌价值也更高。进一步发现，投资者对品牌价值的正向股权市场反应主要由投资于传统广告和在线展示广告的公司驱动。总体而言，这些结果表明某些广告渠道与品牌资产的确认和特征有更强的关联，符合它们的异质性特征。
ai_comment: 本文通过细分广告类型深化了对品牌资产确认的理解，揭示了不同广告渠道在并购中的差异化作用。

title: A Benchmark for Collateralized Loan Obligations
abstract: We build a benchmark for AAA-rated tranches of collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) using business development companies (BDCs), which hold a diversified portfolio of loans as CLOs do. BDCs are publicly listed, and their share price, equity volatility, and borrowing cost can be easily obtained. Applying a structural model to BDCs, we extract market-implied correlation in their loan portfolio, compare spreads on CLO tranches and BDC-implied benchmark, and find that observed large credit spreads on CLO senior tranches after the financial crisis are a fair reflection of the systematic risk of correlated loan defaults. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00097 .
summary: 本文利用商业发展公司（BDC）构建了抵押贷款债务（CLO）的AAA级分层基准。BDC与CLO类似，持有分散化的贷款组合，且公开上市，其股价、权益波动率和融资成本易于获取。通过对BDC应用结构模型，提取其贷款组合的市场隐含相关性，并比较CLO分层利差与BDC隐含基准，发现金融危机后CLO高级分层的高信用利差是对关联贷款违约系统风险的合理反映。
ai_comment: 利用BDC作为CLO的潜在基准，提供了一种新颖的定价视角，并实证解释了金融危机后CLO高级分层利差的合理性。

title: Investor-Paid Credit Ratings and Managerial Information Disclosure
abstract: Unlike issuer-paid credit rating agencies (CRAs), investor-paid CRAs are compensated by investors for providing rating services. Exploiting the staggered timing of rating initiation by an investor-paid rating agency (the Egan Jones Ratings (EJR)), I document that the coverage by EJR increases rated firm managers’ voluntary disclosure of negative news. Consistent with EJR’s rating coverage deterring managerial bad news hoarding by informing investors of downside risks, I find that the effect of EJR coverage is more pronounced when issuer-paid CRAs tend to assign inflated ratings and when rated firms’ managers have a stronger incentive to conceal bad news. I also document that firms unwind upward earnings management after being covered by EJR. In contrast, coverage by an issuer-paid CRA (Standard & Poor’s) is not associated with changes in managerial information disclosure. I conclude that investor-paid CRAs function as a type of effective information intermediary to discipline firm managers and improve corporate transparency. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: The author acknowledge financial support from the MOE Project of the Key Research Institute of Humanities and Social Science in University [Grants 22JJD790093 and 22JJD790094], the Program for Innovative Research Team of Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, and the 111 Project [Grant B18033]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01914 .
summary: 本文利用投资者付费信用评级机构Egan-Jones Ratings (EJR) 启动评级的交错时间作为准自然实验，研究投资者付费信用评级对上市公司管理层信息披露行为的影响。研究发现，EJR 的评级覆盖显著增加了公司自愿披露负面新闻的频率，其作用机制在于EJR 通过向投资者传递下行风险信息，有效抑制了管理层的坏消息隐藏行为。这一效应在发行人付费评级机构（如标普）倾向于给出虚高评级、以及管理层有更强动机隐瞒坏消息的公司中更为显著。此外，EJR 覆盖后，公司会减少向上的盈余管理。相比之下，发行人付费评级机构（标普）的覆盖对管理层信息披露无显著影响。结论表明，投资者付费信用评级机构作为一种有效的信息中介，能够约束管理层行为并提升公司透明度。
ai_comment: 该文利用交错引入的外生冲击识别因果效应，深入探究了不同付费模式下信用评级机构的信息中介作用，对理解评级机构商业模式的经济后果具有重要贡献。

title: Proof-of-Work versus Proof-of-Stake: A Comparative Economic Analysis
abstract: We develop an economic model to compare equilibrium security of Proof-of-Work (PoW) versus Proof-of-Stake (PoS) blockchains. We derive general conditions to determine when PoW blockchains are more secure than otherwise equivalent PoS blockchains and vice versa. Applying real-world parameter values to these conditions, we demonstrate that PoS blockchains are more secure than otherwise equivalent PoW blockchains. Furthermore, we demonstrate that PoS’s security advantage over PoW is particularly salient for high-scale blockchains.
summary: 本文构建了一个经济模型来比较工作量证明（PoW）与权益证明（PoS）区块链的均衡安全性。推导出一般性条件以确定何时PoW区块链比等效的PoS区块链更安全，反之亦然。将实际世界参数值应用于这些条件后，表明PoS区块链比等效的PoW区块链更安全。此外，PoS相对于PoW的安全优势在高规模区块链中尤为突出。
ai_comment: 本文通过经济模型为PoW与PoS的安全性比较提供了严谨的理论基础，并利用实际参数验证了PoS在高规模场景下的优越性，对区块链设计具有重要指导意义。

title: Optimal illiquidity
abstract: We study the socially optimal level of illiquidity in an economy populated by households with taste shocks and present bias with naive beliefs. The government chooses mandatory contributions to accounts, each with a different pre-retirement withdrawal penalty. Collected penalties are rebated lump sum. When households have homogeneous present bias, β , the social optimum is well approximated by a single account with an early-withdrawal penalty of 1 − β . When households have heterogeneous present bias, the social optimum is well approximated by a two-account system: (i) an account that is completely liquid and (ii) an account that is completely illiquid until retirement.
summary: 本文研究了在一个由具有品味冲击和天真信念的现时偏误家庭组成的经济中，社会最优的非流动性水平。政府选择向不同账户的强制缴款，每个账户设有不同的退休前取款罚金，所收取的罚金以一次性总付方式返还。当家庭具有同质的现时偏误β时，社会最优可以通过一个提前取款罚金为1-β的单一账户较好地近似。当家庭具有异质的现时偏误时，社会最优可以通过一个两账户系统较好地近似：（i）一个完全流动的账户和（ii）一个在退休前完全非流动的账户。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将行为经济学的现时偏误引入最优非流动性设计，提出了简单而实用的两账户方案，为退休储蓄政策提供了新视角。

title: Asymmetric information, disagreement, and the valuation of debt and equity
abstract: We study debt and equity valuation when investors have private information and may exhibit differences of opinion. Our model generates several predictions that are consistent with empirical evidence but difficult to reconcile with traditional models. Belief dispersion relates to expected equity and debt returns in opposite directions. Similarly, expected debt (equity) returns typically increase (decrease) with default risk, though these relationships reverse for firms close to bankruptcy. Firms’ capital structures affect their valuations even without classical capital structure frictions (e.g., tax shields, distress costs) – when liquidity is higher in the equity than in the debt market, leverage can raise firm value.
summary: 本文研究了当投资者拥有私人信息且可能持不同意见时，债务和股权的估值问题。模型产生了一系列与实证证据一致但传统模型难以解释的预测：信念分散度与预期股权收益和预期债务收益呈相反方向的关系；预期债务（股权）收益通常随违约风险增加而增加（减少），但对于接近破产的企业，这种关系会发生反转；即使没有传统的资本结构摩擦（如税收盾牌、财务困境成本），企业的资本结构也会影响其估值——当股权市场的流动性高于债务市场时，杠杆可以提高企业价值。
ai_comment: 该模型统一解释了多个传统模型难以同时解释的实证现象，并揭示了资本结构影响估值的新渠道——市场流动性差异。

title: The volatility puzzle of the beta anomaly
abstract: This paper shows that leading theories of the beta anomaly fail to explain the anomaly’s conditional performance. Abnormal returns and Sharpe ratios of betting-against-beta (BAB) factors rise following months with below-median realized volatility, even controlling for mispricing, limits to arbitrage, lottery preferences, analyst disagreement, and sentiment. Moreover, the leverage constraints theory counterfactually predicts that market and BAB Sharpe ratios increase with volatility. We further show that institutional investors shift their demand from high- to low-beta stocks as volatility increases, and the resulting price impact is sufficient to explain the difference in abnormal BAB returns between high- and low-volatility states.
summary: 本文研究了beta异常的条件性表现，发现领先的beta异常理论无法解释该异常在不同市场状态下的表现。具体而言，在月度已实现波动率低于中位数的月份中，做空高beta、做多低beta（BAB）因子的异常收益和夏普比率更高，且这一结果在控制错误定价、套利限制、彩票偏好、分析师分歧和情绪等变量后依然稳健。相反，杠杆约束理论错误地预测市场与BAB夏普比率会随波动率增加而上升。进一步研究表明，随着波动率上升，机构投资者将需求从高beta股票转向低beta股票，由此产生的价格冲击足以解释高波动与低波动状态下BAB异常收益的差异。
ai_comment: 该论文通过揭示beta异常的条件性表现，挑战了主流理论，并提供了机构投资者行为驱动的解释，对资产定价文献具有重要贡献。

title: Yield drifts when issuance comes before macro news
abstract: UK government bond yields tend to drift upwards before scheduled news such as monetary policy announcements and labour market data releases. This effect is particularly pronounced during periods of UK bond issuance and is linked to higher term premia. Financial intermediary constraints play a role as dealers avoid accumulating inventory in pre-news windows following issuance. The composition of liquidity providers also shifts: hedge funds buy a large share of the bond issuance outside pre-news windows, but more passive investors – such as foreign central banks and pension funds – provide liquidity in pre-news windows. We outline a simple model to rationalize these findings.
summary: 论文发现英国国债收益率在货币政策公告和劳动力市场数据发布等预定新闻之前会出现向上漂移，这一现象在英国债券发行期间尤为显著，并与更高的期限溢价相关。金融中介约束发挥了作用，交易商为避免在发行后的预新闻窗口积累库存而减少参与。流动性提供者的构成也发生变化：对冲基金在非预新闻窗口购买大部分发行债券，而外国央行和养老基金等更被动的投资者则在预新闻窗口提供流动性。作者提出了一个简单模型来合理化这些发现。
ai_comment: 该研究从金融中介约束和流动性提供者结构变化的角度揭示了债券发行与宏观经济新闻发布之间的交互效应，为理解收益率动态提供了新视角。

title: ESG: A panacea for market power?
abstract: We study the equilibrium effects of the “S” dimension of ESG under imperfect competition. ESG policies are pledges made by firms that constrain managers to treat their stakeholders better than market conditions alone dictate. Moderate policies limit market power and prompt managers to be more competitive; aggressive polices backfire, both for adopting firms and intended beneficiaries. In contrast to the “shareholder primacy” paradigm, competition in ESG policies under the “stakeholder capitalism” paradigm is a panacea for market power, delivering the first-best outcome in equilibrium. We discuss drivers behind the recent rise in ESG, ESG-linked compensation, and disclosure practices.
summary: 这篇论文研究在不完全竞争市场条件下，ESG中“S”维度（社会维度）的均衡效应。ESG政策是企业承诺约束管理者以比市场条件更优的方式对待利益相关者。研究发现，适度的ESG政策能够限制市场权力并促使管理者更具竞争性，但激进的ESG政策会适得其反，伤害采用企业和预期受益者。与“股东至上”范式不同，在“利益相关者资本主义”范式下，企业间在ESG政策上的竞争可以成为解决市场权力的万能药，实现均衡中的最优结果。论文还讨论了近年来ESG兴起、ESG关联薪酬和信息披露实践背后的驱动因素。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型揭示了ESG政策在不完全竞争市场中的双重效应，并提出了在利益相关者资本主义下ESG竞争能够实现帕累托最优的新视角，对理解ESG的经济影响具有重要贡献。

title: Q: Risk, rents, or growth?
abstract: We document that the increasing polarization in Tobin’s Q within industries is closely connected to the growing divergence in rents and the emergence of superstar firms over the past four decades, while discount rates and growth rates did not exhibit the same increasing dispersion. We explain these industry polarization trends in an estimated general equilibrium model where each industry consists of large superstar oligopolists and small monopolistically competitive firms with endogenous transitions between them. Small firms make investments in speculative innovation to increase their probability of becoming superstars. Our model estimation finds that rising entry barriers in both small and superstar firms contribute to rising polarization in markups, but the rising barriers to creating small firms and increasing tastes for goods produced by superstars account for most of the divergence in Q . Stunting the creation of small firms generates greater incentives for speculative innovation, magnifying the impact of market power dispersion on industry polarization in Q .
summary: 该论文研究了过去四十年间行业内托宾Q的日益极化现象，发现其与租金的日益分化以及超级明星公司的出现紧密相关，而折现率和增长率并未表现出相同的分散趋势。作者在一个估计的一般均衡模型中解释了这些行业极化趋势，模型假设每个行业由大型超级明星寡头和小型垄断竞争企业组成，且两者之间存在内生转换。小企业通过投资于投机性创新来增加成为超级明星的概率。模型估计表明，小企业和超级明星公司进入壁垒的上升共同导致了加成率的极化，但小企业创建壁垒的上升以及消费者对超级明星产品偏好的增强是解释Q分化的主要因素。抑制小企业的创建会引发更强的投机性创新激励，从而放大了市场势力分散对行业Q极化的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建包含内生企业转型的一般均衡模型，创新性地揭示了小企业创建壁垒和消费者偏好变化在托宾Q极化中的关键作用，为理解超级明星企业现象提供了新的理论视角。

title: Fed information effects: Evidence from the equity term structure
abstract: Do investors interpret central bank target rate decisions as signals about the current state of the economy? We study this question using a short-term equity asset that entitles the owner to the near-term dividends of the aggregate stock market. We develop a stylized model of monetary policy and the equity term structure and derive tests of Fed information effects using the short-term asset announcement return. Consistent with the existence of information effects, we find that the short-term asset return in a 30-minute window around FOMC announcements loads positively on monetary policy surprises. Furthermore, the announcement return predicts near-term macroeconomic growth.
summary: 本文研究投资者是否将央行利率决策解读为当前经济状况的信号。作者利用一种短期股票资产（赋予持有者获得近期股票市场股息的权利），构建了货币政策与权益期限结构的简约模型，并通过该短期资产在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后30分钟窗口内的回报来检验美联储信息效应。结果发现，短期资产回报与货币政策意外（monetary policy surprises）呈正相关，支持信息效应的存在。此外，公告窗口回报还能预测近期宏观经济增长。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的短期股权资产回报数据，巧妙地将信息效应与资产定价联系起来，为理解货币政策传导机制提供了新视角。

title: Self-Declared benchmarks and fund manager intent: “Cheating” or competing?
abstract: Using a panel of self-declared benchmarks, we examine funds’ use of mismatched benchmarks over time. Mismatching is high at the beginning of our sample (45 % of TNA in 2008), consistent with prior studies, but declines significantly over time (27 % in 2020), driven by existing specialized funds changing benchmarks to match their style. Market forces including investor learning, institutional governance, market competition, and product positioning all play a role in benchmark correction decisions. For funds with difficult to categorize investment strategies, mismatched benchmarks are less associated with performance bias. Our study highlights the value of market solutions in aligning manager-investor interests.
summary: 使用一组自我声明的基准面板数据，本文研究了基金随时间使用不匹配基准的情况。样本初期（2008年）不匹配率高达45%的TNA，与先前研究一致，但随时间显著下降至2020年的27%，这一下降主要由现有专业化基金改变基准以匹配其风格驱动。市场力量包括投资者学习、机构治理、市场竞争和产品定位，在基准修正决策中发挥作用。对于投资策略难以分类的基金，不匹配基准与绩效偏差的关联较弱。研究强调了市场解决方案在协调经理与投资者利益方面的价值。
ai_comment: 本文利用长面板数据揭示了基金基准不匹配现象的动态变化，并系统分析了市场力量在纠正基准错配中的作用，为理解基金治理提供了新视角。

title: The Spillover Effect of Liquidity Transparency on Liquidity Holdings
abstract: I study how the disclosure of the liquidity coverage ratio mandated for a group of systemically important U.S. banks affects peer banks' liquidity holdings. I predict that the disclosure mitigates uncertainty about aggregate liquidity risk by providing insight into the likelihood of market‐wide liquidity shocks and specific sources of liquidity stress. This uncertainty resolution, in turn, reduces nondisclosing banks' precautionary demand for liquidity. Using bank business interactions to measure the treatment intensity of the disclosure, I find that more treated nondisclosing banks cut their liquidity significantly more in response to the disclosure. In addition, the disclosure rule was followed by lower overall liquidity and a build‐up of systemic risk, indicating an economically considerable disclosure spillover effect in the aggregate.
