abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence on how media-driven narratives influence cross-border institutional investment flows.Applying natural language processing techniques to one-and-a-half million newspaper articles, we document substantial cross-country variation in sentiment and risk indices constructed from domestic media narratives about China in 15 countries.These narratives significantly affect portfolio flows, even after controlling for macroeconomic and financial fundamentals.This impact is smaller for investors with greater familiarity or private information about China and larger during periods of heightened uncertainty.Political and environmental narratives are as influential as economic narratives.Investors react more sharply to negative narratives than positive ones.
summary: 本文首次提供了媒体驱动叙事影响跨境机构投资流量的实证证据。通过对15个国家关于中国的150万篇报纸文章应用自然语言处理技术，构建了国内媒体叙事中的情绪和风险指数，发现这些指数在国家间存在显著差异。在控制宏观经济和金融基本面后，这些叙事显著影响组合投资流量。对于更熟悉中国或拥有私人信息的投资者，这种影响较小；在不确定性高企时期，影响更大。政治和环境叙事与经济叙事具有同等影响力，且投资者对负面叙事的反应强于正面叙事。
ai_comment: 本文的贡献在于首次将媒体叙事与跨境资本流动联系起来，利用大样本数据和NLP方法揭示了非基本面因素的重要作用，拓展了国际资本流动的研究视角。

title: Nonpayment and Eviction in the Rental Housing Market
abstract: Recent research has documented the prevalence and consequences of evictions, but our understanding of underlying drivers of the eviction rate and the scope for policy to affect it remains limited. In this paper, we study landlords' decisions to evict tenants and how these decisions may be influenced by policy. We combine novel lease-level ledger data from low-income rental markets with a model of the landlord's eviction decision to characterize the persistence of shocks to tenant default risk, landlords' information about these shocks, and landlords' cost of eviction. Our data show that nonpayment is common, is frequently tolerated by landlords, and is often followed by recovery, suggesting that landlords face a trade-off between initiating a costly eviction or waiting to learn whether a tenant can continue paying. Our dynamic discrete choice model of the eviction decision captures this tradeoff. Estimates indicate that filing an eviction costs landlords the equivalent of 2-3 months of rent, and that the majority of evictions involve tenants who are unlikely to pay going forward. This implies that uniformly applied policies can generate additional forbearance for tenants, but they do not prevent most evictions. We find that 15% of those evicted would have resumed paying rent, suggesting a role for more targeted interventions. Among the policy instruments we consider, direct financial incentives for landlords—such as taxes and subsidies—are more likely to durably prevent evictions than procedural delays.
summary: 该研究结合低收入租赁市场的新型租户级账本数据和驱逐决策模型，分析房东驱逐租户的决策及政策影响。数据显示不支付租金普遍存在，但房东经常容忍，且许多租户后续恢复支付，表明房东面临发起高成本驱逐或等待租户能否继续支付之间的权衡。动态离散选择模型捕捉了这一权衡，估计驱逐申请成本相当于2-3个月租金，且多数驱逐涉及未来不太可能支付的租户。这意味着统一应用的政策能增加对租户的宽容，但无法阻止大多数驱逐。约15%被驱逐者本会恢复支付，表明有针对性的干预有作用。在考虑的政策工具中，对房东的直接财政激励（如税收和补贴）比程序性延迟更能持久地防止驱逐。
ai_comment: 该论文通过独特的数据和结构模型，量化了驱逐成本及政策干预的效果，为设计更有效的住房政策提供了实证依据。

title: Capital Flow Stability and Policy Challenges in Southeast Asia: Historical Perspectives from the 19th to the 21st Century
abstract: Over the last 200 years, economies have accumulated significant experience in managing capital flows in the face of globalization.This study examines management of capital flows since the 1800s with an eye towards providing historical lessons for Southeast Asia today.We start with the global sterling/gold standard regime of the late 19th century globalization and then discuss the tumultuous inter-war period.We then examine policies in Southeast Asian countries since the 1950s.In the 1980s and 1990s, many economies faced increasing financial instability related to the resumption of global capital flows, most noticeably in Southeast Asia during the Asian Financial Crisis.The paper examines the historical importance of exchange rate policies for capital flow stability.Capital flow management in the 21st century faces various challenges such as enhanced state-intervention and digital currencies.
summary: 该论文回顾了过去200年全球资本流动管理的历史经验，重点关注东南亚地区。研究从19世纪末的全球英镑/金本位制度开始，探讨两次世界大战期间的动荡时期，然后分析1950年代以来东南亚国家的政策。在1980年代和1990年代，许多经济体因全球资本流动恢复而面临金融不稳定，尤其是亚洲金融危机期间的东南亚国家。论文强调了汇率政策对资本流动稳定的历史重要性，并指出21世纪资本流动管理面临国家干预增强和数字货币等新挑战。
ai_comment: 本文通过长期历史视角为东南亚资本流动管理提供宝贵教训，对理解当前政策挑战具有重要参考价值。

title: Concentrating Intelligence: Scaling and Market Structure in Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This paper examines the evolving structure and competition dynamics of the rapidly growing market for foundation models, with a focus on large language models (LLMs).We describe the technological characteristics that shape the AI industry and have given rise to fierce competition among the leading players.The paper analyzes the cost structure of foundation models, emphasizing the importance of key inputs such as computational resources, data, and talent, and identifies significant economies of scale and scope that may create a tendency towards greater market concentration in the future.We explore two concerns for competition, the risk of market tipping and the implications of vertical integration, and we evaluate policy remedies that aim to maintain a competitive landscape.Looking ahead to increasingly transformative AI systems, we discuss how market concentration could translate into unprecedented accumulation of power, highlighting the broader societal stakes of competition policy.
summary: 本文考察了基础模型（尤其是大型语言模型）快速增长的市场的结构和竞争动态。描述了塑造AI行业的技术特征以及导致领先企业激烈竞争的因素。分析了基础模型的成本结构，强调计算资源、数据和人才等关键投入的重要性，并识别出显著的规模经济和范围经济，可能在未来导致市场集中度上升。探讨了市场倾斜风险和垂直整合的影响，评估了旨在维持竞争格局的政策措施。展望未来变革性的AI系统，讨论了市场集中如何转化为前所未有的权力积累，突出了竞争政策更广泛的社会意义。
ai_comment: 该论文系统性地分析了AI行业竞争动态与市场结构趋势，强调了规模经济和垂直整合带来的集中风险，为政策制定提供了有价值的视角。

title: Central Bank Information or Neo-Fisher Effect?
abstract: The central bank information (CBI) effect and the neo-Fisher effect produce similar outcomes: under both, a monetary tightening fails to reduce inflation and output.Separate estimates of these effects run the risk of confounding one with the other.To disentangle these two channels, we introduce into a new-Keynesian model, among other sources of fluctuations, a permanent monetary shock that generates neo-Fisher effects and a preference shock to which the central bank responds that creates CBI effects.We estimate the model on postwar quarterly U.S. data.We find that both effects are important: The neo-Fisher effect explains about one third of changes in inflation.And shutting down the Fed's direct response to the preference shock causes a doubling of the variance of inflation and a twenty percent increase in the variance of output.The results are robust to assuming that private agents have imperfect information, suggesting the presence of a central bank information channel, but the absence of a central bank information advantage, at least at quarterly frequency.
summary: 本文旨在区分中央银行信息效应（CBI）和新费雪效应（Neo-Fisher effect），因为两者都导致货币紧缩无法降低通胀和产出，混淆估计可能相互干扰。作者在新凯恩斯模型中引入永久性货币冲击（产生新费雪效应）和中央银行响应的偏好冲击（产生CBI效应），使用美国战后季度数据估计模型。研究发现两种效应都很重要：新费雪效应解释了约三分之一的通胀变化；关闭美联储对偏好冲击的直接反应会导致通胀方差翻倍、产出方差增加20%。在假设私人主体信息不完全时结果依然稳健，表明存在中央银行信息渠道，但至少季度频率上不存在中央银行信息优势。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型创新性地分离了两种效应，实证表明两者对宏观经济均有显著影响，且信息渠道存在但无优势，为货币政策传导机制研究提供了新视角。

title: Randomized Entry: The Equilibrium Effects of Entry in Digital Financial Markets
abstract: We created randomized variation across and within markets to estimate the equilibrium effects of small microenterprises' entry into a new market: the market for mobile money services.Entry has a negative net effect on firm misconduct in mobile money.There is a positive direct effect but a similar-sized negative indirect effect on prices for non-financial goods/services.Market-level price-cost markups decreased, indicating net gains in consumer surplus.We nd evidence of withinmarket revenue reallocation for mobile money, and a large services multiplier: revenues for nonfinancial goods/services increased by 20%.We show the improvements come from adoption externalities and decreased transaction costs.
summary: 本文通过跨市场和市场内的随机化实验，估计了小微型企业进入移动货币服务市场的均衡效应。研究发现：进入对移动货币中的企业不当行为有负向净效应；对非金融商品/服务的价格存在大小相当的正向直接效应和负向间接效应；市场层面的价格-成本加成下降，表明消费者剩余净增加；移动货币收入在市场中发生再分配，同时非金融商品/服务的收入因服务乘数效应增加了20%。这些改善源于采用外部性和交易成本降低。
ai_comment: 论文通过随机化实验识别了市场进入的复杂均衡效应，特别是揭示了直接与间接效应的抵消以及服务乘数的重要性，为理解数字金融市场竞争提供了新颖视角。

title: Resolving Puzzles of Monetary Policy Transmission in Emerging Markets
abstract: Conventional empirical models of monetary policy transmission in emerging market economies produce puzzling results: monetary tightening often leads to an increase in prices (the price puzzle) and depreciation of the currency (the FX puzzle).We show that incorporating forward-looking expectations into standard open economy structural VAR models resolves these puzzles.Specifically, we augment the models with novel survey-based measures of expectations based on consumer, business, and professional forecasts.We find that the rise in prices following monetary tightening is related to currency depreciation, so eliminating the FX puzzle helps solve the price puzzle.
summary: 本文研究了新兴市场经济体货币政策传导中的两个经验谜题：价格谜题（货币紧缩导致价格上涨）和汇率谜题（货币紧缩导致本币贬值）。作者将前瞻性预期（基于消费者、企业和专业预测者的调查指标）纳入标准开放经济结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型中，发现这些调整能够消除上述谜题。具体而言，货币紧缩后的价格上升与货币贬值密切相关，因此解决汇率谜题有助于解决价格谜题。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入基于调查的预期指标，有效解决了传统模型中的经验谜题，强调了预期在货币政策传导中的关键作用，为理解新兴市场货币政策效果提供了新视角。

title: Expecting Climate Change: A Nationwide Field Experiment in the Housing Market
abstract: Climate change presents new risks for property in the United States. Due to the high cost and sometimes unavailability of location-specific property risk data, home buyers can greatly benefit from acquiring knowledge about these risks. To explore this, a large-scale nationwide natural field experiment was conducted through Redfin to estimate the causal impact of providing home-specific flood risk information on the behavior of home buyers in terms of their search, bidding, and purchasing decisions. Redfin randomly assigned 17.5 million users to receive information detailing the flood risk associated with the properties they searched for on the platform. Our analysis reveals several key findings: (1) the flood risk information influences every stage of the house buying process, including the initial search, bidding activities, and final purchase; (2) individuals are willing to make trade-offs concerning property amenities in order to own a property with a lower flood risk; (3) the impact of the flood risk information on behavior is more pronounced for users conducting searches in high flood risk areas, but does not differ significantly between buyers in Republican and Democrat Counties; and (4) the information resulted in changes to property prices and altered the market's hedonic equilibrium, providing a new finding that climate adaptation can be forward-thinking and proactive.
summary: 论文通过Redfin平台进行大规模全国性实地自然实验，随机向1750万用户提供其搜索房产的洪水风险信息，研究该信息对购房者搜索、竞价和购买决策的因果影响。分析发现：洪水风险信息影响购房全过程的每个阶段；个人愿意在房产便利设施上做出权衡以降低洪水风险；在高洪水风险区域影响更显著，而在共和党与民主党各县之间无显著差异；信息导致房价变化并改变市场特征均衡，表明气候适应可以是前瞻性和主动性的。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模实地实验揭示了气候风险信息对房地产市场的因果影响，提供了气候适应行为的前瞻性证据。

title: Taming the Curse of Dimensionality: Quantitative Economics with Deep Learning
abstract: We argue that deep learning provides a promising approach to addressing the curse of dimensionality in quantitative economics. We begin by exploring the unique challenges involved in solving dynamic equilibrium models, particularly the feedback loop between individual agents’ decisions and the aggregate consistency conditions required to achieve equilibrium. We then introduce deep neural networks and demonstrate their application by solving the stochastic neoclassical growth model. Next, we compare deep neural networks with traditional solution methods in quantitative economics. We conclude with a review of the applications of neural networks in quantitative economics and provide arguments for cautious optimism.
summary: 本文认为深度学习为解决数量经济学中的维度诅咒提供了有前景的方法。首先探讨了解动态均衡模型面临的独特挑战，特别是个体决策与实现均衡所需的总体一致性条件之间的反馈循环。然后介绍了深度神经网络，并通过求解随机新古典增长模型展示了其应用。接着将深度神经网络与传统数量经济学求解方法进行了比较。最后回顾了神经网络在数量经济学中的应用，并给出了谨慎乐观的理由。
ai_comment: 论文系统梳理了深度学习在数量经济学中应对维度诅咒的潜力，并通过典型模型演示了其有效性，为后续研究提供了清晰的方法论指导。

title: Unbalanced Trade: Is Growing Dispersion from Financial or Trade Reforms?
abstract: We study the reasons for the large, coincident increases in unbalanced international trade and overall trade from 1970 to 2019. We show that these two salient features—a rise in net and gross international trade—are largely a consequence of a reduction in intratemporal trade barriers rather than a substantial reduction in the frictions on intertemporal trade or greater asymmetries in business cycles. Beyond explaining changes in the distribution of gross and net trade, the decline in intratemporal trade frictions is consistent with a fall in the dispersion across countries in other key macro time series, including the real exchange rate, terms of trade, export-import ratio, relative spending, and relative GDP.
summary: 该论文研究了1970年至2019年间国际贸易不平衡（净贸易）和贸易总量（总贸易）同时大幅增长的原因。通过区分期内贸易壁垒和跨期贸易摩擦（或商业周期不对称）的影响，作者发现这两个显著特征——国际贸易净额和总额的上升——主要是由期内贸易壁垒的减少所致，而非跨期贸易摩擦的显著降低或商业周期不对称的加剧。此外，期内贸易壁垒的下降还与各国其他关键宏观时间序列（如实际汇率、贸易条件、进出口比率、相对支出和相对GDP）的离散程度下降相一致。
ai_comment: 该论文通过区分期内和跨期贸易摩擦，为解释国际贸易净额和总额的同步增长提供了新的视角，并揭示了贸易自由化对宏观变量离散度的影响。

title: Revisiting Stock Market Signals as a Lens for Patent Valuation
Global Financial Cycle, Household Credit, and Macroprudential Policies
abstract: We show that macroprudential policies dampen the impact of global financial conditions on local bank credit cycles. For identification, we exploit variation in the U.S. volatility index (VIX) and household and business credit registers in an emerging market economy in which banks depend on foreign funding and macroprudential measures vary over the full cycle. Our results suggest that when the VIX is low, tighter macroprudential policies reduce household lending, notably for riskier (foreign currency (FX) and high debt-service-to-income) loans and by banks dependent on foreign funding. Moreover, they increase (less regulated) local currency lending to real estate firms. Such periods are associated with less subsequent total lending to households and firms and with a lower share of FX loans at the local level. Consistently, when the VIX is low, tighter macroprudential policies dampen house prices and economic activity. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: M. Epure acknowledges support from the Serra Húnter program. This project received funding from the European Research Council under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program [Grant 648398], from the Agencia Estatal de Investigacion [Grants PID2020-115660GB-I00 and PGC2018-102133-B-I00], and the Severo Ochoa Program for Centers of Excellence in Research and Development [Grant CEX2019-000915-S]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.4981 .
summary: 本文研究了宏观审慎政策如何抑制全球金融状况对本地银行信贷周期的影响。通过利用美国波动率指数（VIX）的变化以及一个新兴市场经济体（银行依赖外国融资且宏观审慎措施随周期变化）的家庭和企业信贷登记数据，作者发现当VIX较低时，收紧宏观审慎政策会减少家庭贷款，尤其是风险较高的外币贷款和高债务收入比贷款，并减少依赖外国融资的银行发放的贷款。同时，这些政策增加了对房地产企业的（监管较少的）本币贷款。随后，家庭和企业的总贷款减少，本地外汇贷款占比下降。相应地，当VIX较低时，收紧宏观审慎政策会抑制房价和经济活动。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的微观数据和识别策略，揭示了宏观审慎政策在全球金融周期传导中的关键作用，为新兴市场政策制定提供了重要实证依据。

title: Do Credit Rating Agencies Learn from the Options Market?
abstract: Do credit rating agencies (CRAs) learn from the options market? We examine this question by exploring the relation between options trading activity and credit rating accuracy. We find that as options trading volume increases, credit ratings become more responsive to expected credit risk and exhibit greater ability to predict future defaults. We also find that CRAs rely more on the options market as a source of ratings-related information when firm default risk is higher, options trading is more informative, manager-provided information is of lower quality, and firm uncertainty is higher. Our results are robust to a number of sensitivity tests, including alternative measures of options trading and credit rating accuracy. We reach similar inferences using various approaches to address endogeneity issues, including difference-in-difference analyses and an instrumental variables approach. Overall, our findings are consistent with the view that CRAs incorporate unique information from the options market into their rating decisions which, in turn, improves credit rating accuracy. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4980 .
summary: 本研究探讨信用评级机构（CRAs）是否会从期权市场中学习。通过分析期权交易活动与信用评级准确性之间的关系，发现随着期权交易量的增加，信用评级对预期信用风险的响应更加灵敏，并且预测未来违约的能力更强。进一步研究发现，当企业违约风险较高、期权交易信息更丰富、管理层提供的信息质量较低以及企业不确定性较高时，CRAs更倾向于依赖期权市场作为评级相关信息来源。结果在多种稳健性检验（包括替代度量指标）下依然成立，并且通过双重差分和工具变量等方法处理内生性问题后得到一致结论。总体而言，研究结果支持CRAs将期权市场的独特信息纳入评级决策，从而提高了信用评级的准确性。
ai_comment: 该论文从期权交易活动的信息含量角度切入，为信用评级准确性的影响因素提供了新的解释，方法严谨且内生性处理充分，具有较高的学术贡献。

title: How Large are Predefault Costs of Financial Distress? Estimates from a Dynamic Model
abstract: We estimate the costs of financial distress prior to default (predefault costs) separately from the loss incurred at default (the loss given default) using a dynamic tradeoff model of capital structure. We show that predefault costs account for a large fraction of total distress costs, approximately 64.1%. At the same time, they vary across industries ranging from 32.1% to 75%. We demonstrate that the expected predefault costs of financial distress vary significantly across industries with a range between 3.2% and 8.3% and are higher for small firms relative to larger ones. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4974 .
summary: 本文通过一个动态资本结构权衡模型，将违约前的财务困境成本（predefault costs）与违约时的损失（loss given default）分开估计。研究发现，违约前成本占总困境成本的很大比例，约为64.1%，且在不同行业间差异显著，范围从32.1%到75%。预期违约前成本在行业间也差异显著，介于3.2%到8.3%之间，并且小公司比大公司更高。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将违约前与违约时成本分离，揭示了违约前成本的主导地位，为资本结构理论提供了重要定量证据。

title: Optimal Cross-Sectional Regression
abstract: Errors-in-variables (EIV) biases plague asset pricing tests. We offer a new perspective on addressing the EIV issue: instead of viewing EIV biases as estimation errors that potentially contaminate next stage risk premium estimates, we consider them to be return innovations that follow a particular correlation structure. We factor this structure into our test design, yielding a new regression model that generates the most accurate risk premium estimates. We demonstrate the theoretical appeal as well as the empirical relevance of our new estimator. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The supplemental appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4966 .
summary: 本文针对资产定价测试中的变量误差（EIV）偏差问题，提出了一种新的视角。与传统观点将EIV偏差视为可能污染下一阶段风险溢价估计的估计误差不同，本文将EIV偏差视为遵循特定相关结构的回报创新。通过将此结构纳入测试设计，作者构建了一个新的回归模型，能够生成最准确的风险溢价估计。论文展示了新估计量的理论吸引力和实证相关性，并已发表在《管理科学》上。
ai_comment: 创新性地将EIV偏差重新解释为回报创新，从而设计出最优的回归模型，为资产定价测试提供了新的有效方法。

title: The Risk of Expected Utility Under Parameter Uncertainty
abstract: We derive analytical expressions for the risk of an investor’s expected utility under parameter uncertainty. In particular, our analysis focuses on characterizing the out-of-sample utility variance of three portfolios: the classic mean-variance portfolio, the minimum-variance portfolio, and a shrinkage portfolio that combines both. We then use our analytical expressions to study a robustness measure that balances out-of-sample utility mean and volatility. We show that neither the sample mean-variance portfolio nor the sample minimum-variance portfolio exhibits maximal robustness individually, and one needs to combine both to optimize portfolio robustness. Accordingly, we introduce a robust shrinkage portfolio that delivers an optimal tradeoff between out-of-sample utility mean and volatility and is more resilient to estimation errors. Our results highlight the importance of considering out-of-sample performance risk in designing and evaluating investment strategies and stochastic discount factor models. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: N. Lassance gratefully acknowledges financial support by the Fonds de la Recherche Scientifique [Grant J.0115.22]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00178 .
summary: 本文推导了参数不确定性下投资者期望效用风险的解析表达式，重点关注三种投资组合的样本外效用方差：经典均值-方差组合、最小方差组合以及结合两者的收缩组合。通过解析表达式研究平衡样本外效用均值与波动的稳健性度量，发现样本均值-方差组合和样本最小方差组合单独都不具有最大稳健性，需要结合两者才能优化组合的稳健性。为此，作者引入一种稳健收缩组合，在样本外效用均值和波动之间实现最优权衡，并对估计误差更具弹性。研究结果强调了在设计评估投资策略和随机贴现因子模型时考虑样本外表现风险的重要性。
ai_comment: 理论贡献突出，解析推导了参数不确定性下组合的样本外风险，并引入稳健性度量，为投资组合优化提供了新视角。

title: Political Influence, Bank Capital, and Credit Allocation
abstract: Political influence on bank credit allocation is often viewed as being necessary to address social problems like income inequality. We hypothesize that such influence elicits bank capital responses. Our hypothesis yields three testable predictions for which we find supporting evidence. First, when banks observe election outcomes that suggest greater impending political credit-allocation influence, they reduce capital to increase fragility and deter political influence. Second, banks subject to greater political influence nonetheless increase lending that politicians favor, and household consumption consequently increases. Third, these banks exhibit poorer post-lending performance. Our study has implications for the interaction between politics, household consumption, and bank risk through a specific channel—the interplay between credit-allocation regulation and bank capital structure. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04056 .
summary: 本文研究政治影响对银行信贷分配的作用，并提出一个假设：政治影响会引发银行资本结构的反应。基于该假设，作者推导出三个可检验的预测并找到支持证据。首先，当银行观察到选举结果预示着未来政治信贷分配影响增强时，它们会减少资本以增加脆弱性，从而阻止政治干预。其次，受到更大政治影响的银行会增加政治家偏好的贷款，进而导致家庭消费上升。最后，这些银行在贷款后的表现较差。研究通过信贷分配监管与银行资本结构之间的互动渠道，揭示了政治、家庭消费与银行风险之间的相互作用。
ai_comment: 论文从银行资本结构视角切入政治对信贷分配的影响，揭示了银行在政治压力下通过调整资本结构来应对的机制，实证证据丰富，对理解政治与金融系统的互动有重要贡献。

title: Investor Regret and Stock Returns
abstract: We introduce a measure of regret for stock market investors and investigate its cross-sectional asset pricing implications. According to our regret-based framework, investors experience regret due to not achieving the highest possible return from a similar set of stock investments, and equity portfolios with high regret generate 6.84% more annualized alpha than portfolios with low regret. Using investor-trading activity of 78,000 households at a large U.S.-based brokerage firm, we develop an investor-based regret index and show that this household-level regret measure predicts stock returns in a similar way to our proposed regret measure. We also show that regret is not spanned by established risk or behavioral factors that have been documented to be robust predictors of equity returns. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03389 .
summary: 本文提出一种度量股票市场投资者后悔程度的方法，并研究其在横截面资产定价中的含义。基于后悔框架，投资者因未能从一组类似股票投资中获得最高可能回报而感到后悔。研究发现，高后悔股票组合比低后悔组合每年多产生6.84%的alpha。通过分析一家美国大型经纪公司78,000户家庭的交易活动，作者构建了基于投资者的后悔指数，并证明该家庭层面的后悔度量与所提出的后悔度量对股票回报的预测方式相似。此外，后悔效应不能被已有的风险因子或行为因子（已被证明是股票回报的稳健预测因子）所解释。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地构建了投资者后悔的度量指标，并提供了强有力的实证证据，支持后悔情绪在资产定价中的重要作用，丰富了行为金融学的文献。

title: Takeover Protections and Asset Prices
abstract: We study the effects of takeover feasibility on asset prices and returns in a unified framework. We show theoretically that takeover protections increase equity risk, stock returns, and bond yields by removing a valuable put option to sell the firm, notably for firms approaching distress. We investigate these claims empirically and find that distressed firms experience a significant decrease in value and increase in returns and market betas after the passage of antitakeover laws, in line with our predictions. At issue bond yields are also higher when an antitakeover law is in effect. Consistent with the model, the effects of antitakeover laws on stock returns, respectively, bond yields, are greater when shareholders, respectively, bondholders, have greater bargaining power. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: E. Morellec acknowledges financial support from the Swiss Finance Institute. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03111 .
summary: 本文在一个统一框架下研究了反收购可行性对资产价格和回报的影响。理论表明，反收购保护通过移除出售公司的看跌期权（特别是在公司接近困境时），增加了股权风险、股票回报和债券收益率。实证检验发现，在反收购法通过后，陷入困境的公司价值显著下降，股票回报和市场贝塔增加，且发行时的债券收益率也更高。模型预测，当股东或债券持有人拥有更大议价权时，反收购法对股票回报和债券收益率的影响更大。
ai_comment: 本文从理论和实证两方面系统分析了反收购法对资产定价的影响，揭示了其通过移除看跌期权效应影响风险溢价的机制，对理解公司控制权市场与资产价格关系有重要贡献。

title: A Continuous Time Framework for Sequential Goal-Based Wealth Management
abstract: We develop a continuous time framework for sequential goals-based wealth management. A stochastic factor process drives asset price dynamics and the client’s goal amount and income. We prove the weak dynamic programming principle for the value function of our control problem, which we show to be the unique viscosity solution of the corresponding Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. We develop an equivalent and computationally efficient representation of the Hamiltonian, which yields the optimal portfolio within a factor-dependent opportunity set defined by the maximum and minimum variance hypersurfaces. Our analysis shows that it is optimal to fund an expiring goal up to the level where the marginal benefit of additional fundedness is exceeded by the opportunity cost of diverting wealth from future goals. An all-or-nothing investor is more risk averse toward an approaching goal deadline if well funded, but more risk seeking if not on track with upcoming goals, compared with an investor with flexible goals. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Discovery Grant RGPIN-2020-06290] and Fi-Tek.
summary: 本文提出了一个连续时间框架，用于序列目标的财富管理。驱动资产价格动态、客户目标金额和收入的随机因子过程被引入。作者证明了控制问题值函数的弱动态规划原理，并表明该值函数是相应Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的唯一粘性解。他们开发了一种等价且计算高效的哈密顿量表示，该表示在由最大和最小方差超曲面定义的因子依赖机会集中产生最优投资组合。分析表明，最优策略是为即将到期的目标提供资金，直到额外资金化的边际收益被从未来目标转移财富的机会成本所超过。与具有灵活目标的投资者相比，如果资金充足，全有或全无的投资者对临近的目标截止日期更加风险厌恶，但如果未按计划实现即将到来的目标，则更加风险寻求。
ai_comment: 本文通过连续时间框架和粘性解方法，为序列目标财富管理提供了严格的理论基础，并揭示了目标截止日期对投资者风险偏好的非线性影响。

title: Incentive Auction Design Alternatives: A Simulation Study
abstract: This paper revisits the descending clock “reverse” auction design used in the U.S. Federal Communications Commission’s 2016–2017 “incentive auction.” We use extensive computational simulations to investigate the quantitative significance of various aspects of the design, leveraging a reverse auction simulator and realistic models of bidder values. This paper was accepted by Gabriel Weintraub, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: This work was supported by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency [Grant FA8750-19-2-0222 CFDA\# 12.910], the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research [Canada AI Research Chair at the Alberta Machine In], the National Science Foundation [Grant 1525730], and the Canadian Network for Research and Innovation in Machining Technology, Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Discovery Grant, Discovery Grant Supplement]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.02489 .
summary: 本文重新审视了美国联邦通信委员会2016-2017年激励拍卖中使用的降钟“反向”拍卖设计，通过大量计算模拟，利用反向拍卖模拟器和投标人价值的真实模型，量化了设计各个方面的数量显著性。论文被《管理科学》收益管理与市场分析领域接受，受到多个基金资助。
ai_comment: 通过模拟实验量化了激励拍卖设计各要素的影响，为政策制定和拍卖理论提供了实证依据。

title: The risk and return of equity and credit index options
abstract: We develop a structural credit risk model, which allows us to price equity/credit indices and their options through the asset dynamics of index constituents. We estimate the model via MLE and find that equity and credit index option prices are well explained out-of-sample. Contrary to recent empirical findings, the two option markets are not inconsistently priced through the lens of our model. Returns on both options, while extreme, do not indicate any evidence of mispricing. Our analysis suggests that jointly addressing the pricing of various instruments requires properly attributing three different sources of systematic risk: asset, variance, and jump risks.
summary: 本文开发了一个结构信用风险模型，通过指数成分股的资产动态来对股票/信用指数及其期权进行定价。利用最大似然估计（MLE）估计模型，发现该模型能够很好地解释样本外的股权和信用指数期权价格。与近期的实证发现相反，从模型角度看，这两个期权市场并不存在不一致的定价。尽管两种期权的收益极端，但没有证据表明存在错误定价。分析表明，联合定价多种工具需要正确归因三种不同的系统性风险来源：资产风险、方差风险和跳跃风险。
ai_comment: 该文通过统一的结构模型解释了股权与信用期权市场的一致性，强调了多维度系统性风险的重要性。

title: Monetary policy and fragility in corporate bond mutual funds
abstract: We document aggregate outflows from corporate bond mutual funds days before and after the announcement of increases in the Federal Funds Target rate (FFTar). To rationalize this phenomenon, we build a model in which funds’ net-asset-values (NAVs) are stale and investors strategically redeem to profit from the mispricing when they learn about the increases of FFTar. Consistent with the model’s predictions, we find that stale NAVs and loose monetary policy environments weaken (strengthen) outflows sensitivity to increases in FFTar during illiquid (liquid) market conditions. Our results highlight when and how monetary policy could systematically exacerbate the fragility of corporate bond funds.
summary: 本文发现，在联邦基金目标利率（FFTar）上调公告前后，公司债券共同基金出现大规模资金流出。为了解释这一现象，作者构建了一个模型，其中基金的资产净值（NAV）存在滞后性，当投资者得知FFTar上调时，他们会利用定价错误进行战略性赎回。模型预测，在流动性较差的市场条件下，滞后的NAV和宽松的货币政策环境会削弱（增强）资金流出对FFTar上调的敏感性；而在流动性较好的市场条件下则相反。研究结果揭示了货币政策何时以及如何可能系统性地加剧公司债券基金的脆弱性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将货币政策冲击与基金流动性错配结合起来，揭示了滞后NAV在传导中的关键作用，为理解货币政策的金融稳定效应提供了新视角。

title: Systemic bank runs without aggregate risk: How a misallocation of liquidity may trigger a solvency crisis
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of self-fulfilling bank runs. The key novelty is the way in which the banking system’s assets and liabilities are connected. Banks issue loans to entrepreneurs who sell goods to households, which in turn pay for the goods by redeeming bank deposits. The return on bank assets is thus contingent on households being able to withdraw their deposits. In a run, not all households that wish to consume manage to withdraw, since part of banks’ cash reserves end up in the hands of households without consumption needs. This misallocation of liquidity lowers revenues of entrepreneurs and bank asset returns, thereby rationalising the run. Interventions that restrict redemptions in a run can be self-defeating due to their negative effect on demand in goods markets. We show how runs can sometimes be prevented with combinations of deposit freezes and redemption penalties as well as with the provision of emergency liquidity.
summary: 本文构建了一个自我实现的银行挤兑一般均衡模型，其核心创新在于银行系统资产与负债的关联方式：银行向企业家发放贷款，企业家向家庭出售商品，家庭通过赎回银行存款来支付商品。因此，银行资产的回报取决于家庭能否提取存款。在挤兑中，并非所有希望消费的家庭都能成功提款，因为部分银行现金储备最终落入没有消费需求的家庭手中。这种流动性错配降低了企业家的收入和银行资产回报，从而合理化挤兑。限制挤兑中赎回的干预措施可能因对商品市场需求的负面影响而适得其反。研究表明，结合存款冻结、赎回惩罚以及提供紧急流动性有时可以防止挤兑。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了无总风险时银行挤兑的微观机制，强调信贷与消费市场的内生关联，对监管干预的潜在负效应提出了警示。

title: The risk and return of impact investing funds
abstract: We provide the first analysis of the risk exposure and risk-adjusted performance of impact investing funds, private market funds with dual financial and social goals. We introduce a dataset of impact fund cash flows and exploit distortions in VC performance measures to characterize risk profiles. Impact funds have a lower market β than comparable private market strategies. Accounting for β , impact funds underperform the public market, though not necessarily more so than comparable strategies. We consider alternative pricing models, accounting for sustainability and emerging markets risk. We show investors’ wealth portfolios and taste change the perceived financial merit of impact investing.
summary: 该论文首次分析了影响力投资基金（具有财务和社会双重目标的私募市场基金）的风险暴露和风险调整绩效。通过引入影响力基金的现金流数据集，并利用风险投资绩效衡量中的扭曲来刻画风险特征，研究发现影响力基金的市场β低于可比私募市场策略。在考虑β后，影响力基金的表现逊于公开市场，但与其他可比策略相比未必更差。论文还考虑了可持续性和新兴市场风险的替代定价模型，并表明投资者的财富组合和品味会改变对影响力投资财务价值的认知。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统性地分析了影响力投资基金的风险与收益特征，填补了该领域的实证空白，并揭示了投资者偏好对绩效评估的影响。

title: Modeling volatility in dynamic term structure models
abstract: We propose no-arbitrage term structure models with volatility factors that follow GARCH processes. The models’ tractability is similar to canonical affine term structure models, but they fit yield volatility much better, especially for long-maturity yields. This improvement does not come at the expense of a deterioration in yield fit. Because of the improved volatility fit, the model performs substantially better in pricing Treasury futures options. We conclude that the specification of the volatility factors is critical. Modeling volatility as a function of (lagged) squared innovations to factors improves on models where volatility is a linear function of the factors.
summary: 本文提出了无套利期限结构模型，其中包含遵循GARCH过程的波动率因子。该模型的易处理性与经典仿射期限结构模型相似，但在拟合收益率波动方面表现更好，尤其是对长期到期收益率。这种改进并未以牺牲收益率拟合度为代价。由于波动率拟合的改进，该模型在定价国债期货期权时表现显著更优。作者得出结论，波动率因子的设定至关重要，将波动率建模为（滞后的）因子平方新息的函数优于波动率为因子线性函数的模型。
ai_comment: 该论文通过将GARCH过程引入传统仿射期限结构模型，显著提升了波动率拟合和期权定价表现，方法简洁且有效。

title: Efficient estimation of bid–ask spreads from open, high, low, and close prices
abstract: Popular bid–ask spread estimators are downward biased when trading is infrequent. Moreover, they consider only a subset of open, high, low, and close prices and neglect potentially useful information to improve the spread estimate. By accounting for discretely observed prices, this paper derives asymptotically unbiased estimators of the effective bid–ask spread. Moreover, we combine them optimally to minimize the estimation variance and obtain an efficient estimator. Through theoretical analyses, numerical simulations, and empirical evaluations, we show that our efficient estimator dominates other estimators from transaction prices, yields novel insights for measuring bid–ask spreads, and has broad applicability in empirical finance.
summary: 流行的买卖价差估计量在交易不频繁时存在向下偏差，并且仅考虑了开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价中的子集，忽略了可能提高估计精度的有用信息。本文通过考虑离散观测价格，推导了有效买卖价差的渐近无偏估计量，并进一步通过最优组合以最小化估计方差，得到了一个有效估计量。通过理论分析、数值模拟和实证评估，研究表明该有效估计量优于其他基于交易价格的估计量，为衡量买卖价差提供了新见解，并在实证金融中具有广泛适用性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用了所有OHLC价格信息，提出了一种渐近无偏且方差最小化的有效买卖价差估计量，弥补了传统估计量在低频交易下的缺陷，具有重要的理论贡献和实用价值。

title: Uncertainty about what is in the price
abstract: A critical question facing speculators contemplating to trade on private information is whether their signal has already been priced in by the market. In our model, speculators assess the novelty of their information based on recent price movements, and market makers are aware that speculators might be trading on stale news. An asymmetric response to past price movements ensues: after price increases, buy volume – because it may result from stale news trading – has a lower price impact than sell volume (and vice versa after price decreases). Consequently, return skewness is negatively related to lagged returns. We find strong support for these and other predictions using a comprehensive sample of US stocks.
summary: 本文研究投机者在交易私有信息时面临的关键问题：他们的信号是否已经被市场定价。作者构建了一个模型，其中投机者根据近期价格变动评估其信息的“新颖性”，而做市商则意识到投机者可能是在交易“旧消息”。模型推导出对过去价格变动的非对称反应：价格上涨后，买入量（可能源于旧消息交易）的价格影响低于卖出量（价格下跌后则相反）。因此，收益偏度（return skewness）与滞后收益负相关。作者利用美国股票的综合样本，为上述及其他预测找到了强有力的实证支持。
ai_comment: 该模型巧妙地将市场微观结构中的信息不对称与价格动态联系起来，揭示了由于‘旧消息’担忧导致的非对称价格影响，为理解收益偏度的行为提供了新视角。

title: The Shadow Cost of Collateral
abstract: We quantify the cost of pledging collateral for small businesses by exploiting a regulatory quirk of the SBA disaster lending program in which firms are exempt from posting collateral if their loan size is below a threshold. Firms bunch their loans below the threshold, and the resultant distortion in the loan size distribution reveals the magnitude of the collateral cost. The collateral cost is substantial and varies across collateral types, business sectors, and collateral laws in ways consistent with flexibility-based theories. Our findings have implications for firms’ borrowing constraints and disaster lending program designs.
summary: 本文利用美国小企业管理局（SBA）灾难贷款计划中的一个监管特殊性——贷款金额低于某一门槛的企业无需提供抵押品——来量化小企业抵押担保的成本。企业会将贷款金额集聚在门槛以下，由此造成的贷款规模分布扭曲揭示了抵押成本的大小。研究发现，抵押成本相当可观，并且其随抵押品类型、行业部门以及抵押法律的不同而变化，这与基于灵活性的理论解释一致。研究结论对企业借款约束和灾难贷款计划设计具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 该研究利用准自然实验巧妙识别了抵押担保的隐性成本，结果对理解小企业融资约束及政策设计有重要价值。

title: House Prices and Rents
abstract: Variation in monthly metro area house prices unrelated to expected rents clouds the information about future rents in price-rent ratios and lagged changes in house prices. The variation in house prices unrelated to expected rents is, however, correlated across areas, and the problem is mitigated by measuring rent growth regression variables net of their monthly cross-section (across-area) means. This control for price variation unrelated to expected rents substantially enhances the information about future rents that we extract from price-rent ratios and lagged changes in house prices.
summary: 本文研究美国大都市区月度房价与租金的关系。发现房价变动中存在与预期租金无关的部分，这干扰了从租金价格比以及房价滞后变化中提取的未来租金信息。然而，这些与预期租金无关的房价变动在区域间存在相关性，通过将租金增长回归变量减去其月度横截面（跨区域）均值可以有效缓解该问题。这种控制显著增强了从租金价格比和滞后房价变化中提取的未来租金信息。
ai_comment: 通过横截面均值控制区域间共同波动，巧妙提取了房价中与租金无关的成分，提升了租金预测的准确性。

title: Does Floor Trading Matter?
abstract: Although algorithmic trading now dominates financial markets, some exchanges continue to use human floor traders. On March 23, 2020 the NYSE suspended floor trading because of COVID‐19. Using a difference‐in‐differences analysis around the closure of the floor, we find that floor traders are important contributors to market quality. The suspension of floor trading leads to higher spreads and larger pricing errors for treated stocks relative to control stocks. To explore the mechanism, we exploit two partial floor reopenings that have different characteristics. Our finding suggests that in‐person human interaction facilitates the transfer of valuable information that algorithms lack.
summary: 本文利用2020年3月23日纽约证券交易所因新冠疫情暂停场内交易这一外生事件，采用双重差分方法检验人工场内交易员对市场质量的影响。研究发现，与对照组相比，暂停场内交易导致处理组股票的买卖价差扩大、定价误差增加。为了探究作用机制，文章进一步利用两次具有不同特征的局部重开交易大厅，结果表明，面对面的人际互动能够传递算法交易缺乏的有价值信息，从而证实场内交易员对市场质量的重要贡献。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验巧妙识别因果效应，揭示了在算法交易主导时代人工交易员的不可替代价值。

title: Equilibrium Data Mining and Data Abundance
abstract: We study theoretically how the proliferation of new data (“data abundance”) affects the allocation of capital between quantitative and nonquantitative asset managers (“data miners” and “experts”), their performance, and price informativeness. Data miners search for predictors of asset payoffs and select those with a sufficiently high precision. Data abundance raises the precision of the best predictors, but it can induce data miners to search less intensively for high‐precision signals. In this case, their performance becomes more dispersed and they receive less capital. Nevertheless, data abundance always raises price informativeness and can therefore reduce asset managers' average performance.
summary: 本文通过理论建模研究数据丰富如何影响量化与非量化资产管理者（分别称为“数据挖掘者”和“专家”）之间的资本配置、业绩表现以及价格信息效率。数据挖掘者搜寻资产收益的预测因子，并选择那些精度足够高的因子。数据丰富虽然提高了最佳预测因子的精度，但也可能诱使数据挖掘者降低对高精度信号的搜寻强度。在这种情况下，数据挖掘者的业绩变得更加分散，所获得的资本也减少。尽管如此，数据丰富总是能提升价格信息效率，并因此可能降低资产管理者的平均业绩。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了数据丰富对资产管理行业可能产生的非直觉影响：数据丰富虽提升了最佳预测因子质量，但可能削弱数据挖掘者的搜寻动机，从而影响其资本流入，但最终仍能提升市场效率。

title: A Multifactor Perspective on Volatility‐Managed Portfolios
abstract: Moreira and Muir question the existence of a strong risk‐return trade‐off by showing that investors can improve performance by reducing exposure to risk factors when their volatility is high. However, Cederburg et al. show that these strategies fail out‐of‐sample, and Barroso and Detzel show they do not survive transaction costs. We propose a conditional multifactor portfolio that outperforms its unconditional counterpart even out‐of‐sample and net of costs. Moreover, we show that factor risk prices generally decrease with market volatility. Our results demonstrate that the breakdown of the risk‐return trade‐off is more puzzling than previously thought.
summary: Moreira and Muir 质疑风险-收益权衡的存在，发现投资者在高波动时期减少风险敞口能提高表现。但 Cederburg 等指出这些策略在样本外失败，Barroso 和 Detzel 表明它们无法覆盖交易成本。本文提出一个条件多因子组合（conditional multifactor portfolio），即使在样本外和扣除交易成本后，其表现仍优于无条件组合。此外，因子风险价格通常随市场波动而下降。结果表明，风险-收益权衡的失效比之前认为的更加令人困惑。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建条件多因子组合，在更严格的样本外和考虑成本条件下验证了波动率管理策略的有效性，并发现因子风险价格的反周期性，进一步揭示了风险-收益权衡的悖论。

title: Designing Pension Plans According to Consumption-Savings Theory
abstract: We derive optimal characteristics of contribution rates into defined contribution pension plans based on consumption-savings theory. Contribution rates should increase with age and decrease with the balance-to-income ratio. Using Swedish registry data, we show that on average, individuals save according to those principles. However, almost half of the population behaves hand-to-mouth and does not undo the mandated constant contribution rates. In a quantitative model, designing contribution rates to follow the principles implies a 1.8% welfare gain and less dispersed replacement rates, while maintaining the same average replacement rate. Results are robust to various sources of model misspecification, including temptation preferences.
summary: 本文基于消费储蓄理论，推导确定缴费型养老金计划中贡献率的最优特征。研究表明，贡献率应随年龄增长而增加，随余额与收入比率的上升而下降。利用瑞典注册数据，作者发现平均而言，个体的储蓄行为符合这些原则。然而，近一半的人口表现为手到口（hand-to-mouth）行为，不会调整强制性的恒定贡献率。在一个定量模型中，按照这些原则设计贡献率可带来1.8%的福利增益，并在保持相同平均替代率的同时减少替代率的离散程度。结果对包括诱惑偏好（temptation preferences）在内的多种模型设定错误具有稳健性。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将消费储蓄理论应用于养老金设计，并利用瑞典微观数据验证了优化规则的有效性，尤其关注了异质性人口的行为偏差。

title: Equity Term Structures without Dividend Strips Data
abstract: We use a large cross section of equity returns to estimate a rich affine model of equity prices, dividends, returns, and their dynamics. Our model prices dividend strips of the market and equity portfolios without using strips data in the estimation. Yet model‐implied equity yields closely match yields on traded strips. Our model extends equity term‐structure data over time (to the 1970s) and across maturities, and generates term structures for various equity portfolios. The novel cross section of term structures from our model covers 45 years and includes several recessions, providing a novel set of empirical moments to discipline asset pricing models.
summary: 本文利用大量横截面股票收益数据，估计了一个包含股票价格、股息、回报及其动态的丰富仿射模型。该模型在估计过程中未使用股息拆分成份数据，但模型隐含的股票收益率与交易型拆分成份的收益率高度匹配。模型将股票期限结构数据扩展到1970年代及更远期限，并生成了多种股票投资组合的期限结构。这一新的期限结构横截面数据集覆盖45年，包含多次经济衰退，为资产定价模型提供了新的经验矩。
ai_comment: 本文的亮点在于无需依赖股息拆分成份数据即可有效估计股票期限结构，并大幅扩展了数据的时间跨度和资产覆盖范围，为资产定价研究提供了新的经验约束。

title: The Hedging Channel of Exchange Rate Determination
abstract: We propose the currency hedging channel that connects countries’ external imbalances to their exchange rate behavior. We present a model in which investors increase their currency hedging during periods of financial distress in proportion to their net foreign asset exposure. This behavior coupled with constrained financial intermediation explains observed relationships between gradually adjusting external imbalances and volatile spot and forward exchange rates. We find empirical support for the hedging channel in both the conditional and unconditional moments of exchange rates, option prices, and countries’ uses of Federal Reserve swap lines.
summary: 本文提出货币对冲渠道（currency hedging channel），连接国家外部失衡与汇率行为。模型显示，投资者在金融困境期间按净外国资产暴露（net foreign asset exposure）比例增加对冲操作；这种对冲行为与受约束的金融中介共同解释了渐进调整的外部失衡与波动剧烈的即期、远期汇率之间的观察关系。实证支持该渠道在汇率条件矩与非条件矩、期权价格以及各国对美联储互换额度（Federal Reserve swap lines）使用中的表现。
ai_comment: 从汇率决定的未充分研究渠道切入，结合模型与多维度实证（包括期权和央行互换数据）提供有力的经验证据。

title: How Does Judges’ Personal Exposure to Financial Fraud Affect White‐Collar Sentencing?
abstract: We study whether federal judges’ personal exposure to financial fraud affects their professional behavior, in the form of sentencing outcomes in white‐collar cases. Following the methodology outlined in our registered report, we construct a novel measure of financial fraud exposure based on judges’ direct shareholdings in firms that commit financial fraud. Using this measure, we exploit the random assignment of cases to judges to examine whether judges exposed to fraud in one firm are (1) less likely to rule in favor of defendants in white‐collar cases involving other firms and (2) less likely to grant favorable pretrial motions to defendants. We find minimal evidence in support of either (1) or (2), concluding that for all but the most serious frauds, judges are unlikely to let their personal victimhood experience affect their professional sentencing behavior with respect to related cases. Our study broadens our understanding of the spillover effects of financial fraud enforcement and contributes to the literature on how judges’ personal experiences can shape judicial decision‐making.
summary: 本文研究联邦法官个人经历财务欺诈是否会影响其职业行为，具体表现为对白领案件的量刑结果。作者采用预注册报告中的方法，构建了一个新颖的衡量指标——基于法官直接持有实施财务欺诈公司的股票，来度量其个人暴露于财务欺诈的程度。通过利用案件随机分配给法官的机制，检验了暴露于某公司欺诈的法官是否更不倾向于在涉及其他公司的白领案件中做出有利于被告的裁决，以及是否更不倾向于批准有利于被告的审前动议。研究发现，对于这两种假设的支持证据微乎其微，得出结论认为，除最严重的欺诈外，法官不太可能让其个人受害经历影响其对相关案件的专业量刑行为。该研究拓宽了对财务欺诈执法溢出效应的理解，并为关于法官个人经历如何塑造司法决策的文献做出了贡献。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建法官持股的独特数据，并结合随机分配案件的方法，严谨地检验了个人经历对司法决策的影响，其零结果对于理解司法客观性具有重要启示。

title: Disclosure, Patenting, and Trade Secrecy
abstract: Patent applications often reveal proprietary information to competitors, but does such disclosure harm firms or also benefit them? We develop and empirically support a theory showing that when firms patent enhancements to incumbent, nondisruptive technologies, they can cooperate more easily on these technologies, increasing their profitability. The downside of cooperating on nondisruptive technologies is that the investment in and commitment to disruptive technologies decline. To improve their commitment to disruptive technologies, some firms rely more on trade secrecy. We provide empirical support for these predictions. We document that after a patent reform that made information about patent applications widely accessible, firms cooperate more and charge higher markups. Furthermore, the nature of patented innovation has changed, with the proportion of nondisruptive patents increasing substantially. Finally, while some firms start patenting more, others patent less and rely more on trade secrecy, with the response depending on the attractiveness of firms' innovation prospects.
summary: 论文构建并实证检验了一个理论：当企业对现有非颠覆性技术进行专利保护时，能够促进企业间的合作，从而提高盈利能力。然而，这种合作的代价是减少对颠覆性技术的投资和承诺。为增强对颠覆性技术的承诺，一些企业更依赖于商业机密。实证研究发现，在一项使专利申请信息广泛可获取的专利改革后，企业合作增多并收取更高的加价；非颠覆性专利的比例大幅上升；同时，部分企业增加专利申请，而另一些则减少专利并更依赖商业机密，其反应取决于企业自身创新前景的吸引力。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了专利制度的两面性，通过区分非颠覆性与颠覆性技术，为理解企业专利策略和商业秘密选择提供了新视角。

title: Should the Government Be Paying Investment Fees on $3 Trillion of Tax-Deferred Retirement Assets?
abstract: Under standard assumptions, individuals and the government are indifferent between traditional tax-deferred retirement accounts and “front-loaded” (Roth) accounts. Adding investment fees to this benchmark, individuals are still indifferent, but the government is not. We show that under weak conditions firms charge equal percent fees under both systems, yielding higher dollar fees under Traditional. We estimate that tax deferral increases demand for asset management services by $3.8 trillion, costing the government $23.4 billion in annual fees. In a general equilibrium differentiated-product model, tax deferral produces a larger asset management industry, higher taxes, and lower social welfare.
summary: 该论文重新审视了传统税收递延退休账户（Traditional）与税前缴款（Roth）账户的标准无差异结论。在引入投资费用后，个人仍无差异，但政府面临不同成本。研究发现，在弱条件下，公司对两种账户收取相同百分比费用，导致传统账户产生更高美元费用。估计税收递延使资产管理服务需求增加3.8万亿美元，每年给政府带来234亿美元的费用成本。通过一般均衡差异化产品模型，论文表明税收递延导致资产管理行业规模扩大、税收增加和社会福利下降。
ai_comment: 该论文从投资费用视角揭示了税收递延政策被忽视的财政成本，对退休账户税收优惠政策的效率评估有重要启示。

title: Real Consequences of Shocks to Intermediaries Supplying Corporate Hedging Instruments
abstract: I show that shocks to financial intermediaries supplying hedging instruments to corporations have real effects. I exploit a quasi-natural experiment in South Korea in 2010, where regulations required banks to hold enough capital for taking foreign exchange derivatives (FXD) positions. Using variation in exposure to this regulation across banks, I find that the regulation caused a reduction in FXD supply, leading to a significant decline in exports for firms contracting derivatives with more exposed banks. Results indicate the crucial role of intermediaries in allocating risks through derivatives provision and establish a causal relationship between financial hedging and real economic outcomes.
summary: 本文研究了金融中介在向企业提供对冲工具时受到的冲击如何产生实际经济效应。作者利用韩国2010年的一项准自然实验，即监管要求银行持有足够资本以持有外汇衍生品头寸，通过考察不同银行受该监管影响的差异，发现监管导致外汇衍生品供给减少，进而使得与受监管影响较大的银行签订衍生品合约的企业出口显著下降。研究结果强调了金融中介通过衍生品供给在风险配置中的关键作用，并建立了金融对冲与实际经济结果之间的因果关系。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验方法，巧妙识别了金融中介供给冲击通过衍生品渠道影响实体经济的因果链条，为理解金融中介在风险管理中的核心作用提供了有力证据。

title: The Effects of Macroeconomic Shocks: Household Financial Distress Matters
abstract: When a macroeconomic shock arrives, variation in household balance sheet health (captured by the presence of financial distress, or “FD”) leads to differential access to credit and hence a distribution in consumption responses. As we document, though, over the past two recessions, households in prior FD also experienced macroeconomic shocks more intensely than others, leading to a distribution of shock severity. Quantifying the importance of each dimension of heterogeneity (FD or shock severity) for consumption requires a structural model. We find that heterogeneity in FD matters more for shaping the responses of individual and aggregate consumption to shocks.
summary: 研究宏观冲击如何通过家庭资产负债表健康状况的异质性（以财务困境FD表示）影响消费。实证发现，过去两次衰退中，先前处于FD的家庭不仅面临信贷获取差异，还更强烈地遭受宏观冲击，导致冲击严重性分布不均。通过构建结构模型，量化FD异质性与冲击严重性异质性对消费的影响，发现FD异质性对个体和总消费冲击的响应起主导作用。
ai_comment: 该论文通过结构模型清晰区分了两种异质性的贡献，强调了家庭财务困境在传导宏观冲击中的关键作用，为理解消费行为提供了新视角。

title: Carbon Returns across the Globe
abstract: The pricing of carbon transition risk is central to the debate on climate‐aware investments. Emissions are tightly linked to sales and are available to investors only with significant lags. The positive carbon return, or brown‐minus‐green return differential, documented in previous studies arises from forward‐looking firm performance information contained in emissions rather than a risk premium in ex ante expected returns. After accounting for the data release lag, carbon returns turn negative in the United States and insignificant globally. Developed markets experience lower carbon returns due to intense climate concern shocks, while countries with stringent climate policies exhibit higher carbon returns.
summary: 本文研究全球范围内碳过渡风险的定价问题，即所谓的“棕色-绿色”回报差异。研究发现，碳排放与销售额紧密相关，但投资者获取排放数据存在显著滞后。以往文献中观察到的正碳回报（棕色优于绿色）实际上来源于排放数据中包含的前瞻性企业绩效信息，而非事前预期回报中的风险溢价。在考虑数据发布滞后后，美国市场的碳回报转为负值，全球范围内不显著。发达国家因受到更强烈的气候担忧冲击而呈现较低的碳回报，而气候政策严格的国家则表现出较高的碳回报。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分信息效应与风险溢价，并引入数据发布滞后这一关键变量，对碳回报现象给出了新解释，为气候因子定价研究提供了重要视角。

title: Mortgage Lock‐In, Mobility, and Labor Reallocation
abstract: We study the impact of rising mortgage rates on mobility and labor reallocation. Using individual‐level credit record data and variation in the timing of mortgage origination, we show that a 1 percentage point decline in the difference between mortgage rates locked in at origination and current rates reduces moving by 9% overall and 16% between 2022 and 2024, and this relationship is asymmetric. Mortgage lock‐in also dampens flows in and out of self‐employment and the responsiveness to shocks to nearby employment opportunities that require moving, measured as wage growth within a 50‐ to 150‐mile ring and instrumented with a shift‐share instrument.
summary: 本研究利用个人信用记录数据，基于抵押贷款发放时间的差异，考察了抵押贷款利率上升对居民流动性和劳动力再配置的影响。研究发现，锁定在贷款发放时的利率与当前利率之差每下降1个百分点，整体搬家率将减少9%，其中2022年至2024年间减少16%，且该效应存在不对称性。此外，抵押贷款锁定还抑制了自我雇佣的进入与退出流动，并削弱了居民对附近（50至150英里范围内）就业机会冲击的反应，该反应通过工资增长和shift-share工具变量进行衡量。
ai_comment: 该研究利用大样本微观数据精准量化了抵押贷款利率锁定对劳动力流动的抑制效应，揭示了利率政策对劳动力市场调整的重要微观机制。

title: Bonds versus Equities: Information for Investment
abstract: We provide a simple model of investment by a firm funded with debt and equity and empirical evidence to demonstrate that, once we control for the debt overhang problem with credit spreads, asset volatility is an unambiguously positive signal for investment, while equity volatility sends a mixed signal: Elevated volatility raises the option value of equity and increases investment for financially sound firms, but exacerbates debt overhang and decreases investment for firms close to default. Our study provides a simple unified understanding of the structural and empirical relationships between investment, credit spreads, equity versus asset volatility, leverage, and Tobin's .
summary: 本文提出了一个简单的公司投资模型，该模型由债务和股权共同融资，并提供了实证证据。研究表明，在通过信用利差控制了债务积压问题后，资产波动率是投资的明确正向信号，而股权波动率则发出混合信号：对于财务健康的企业，高波动率增加了股权的期权价值从而促进投资；但对于接近违约的企业，高波动率加剧了债务积压问题从而抑制投资。本文统一解释了投资、信用利差、股权与资产波动率、杠杆率以及托宾Q之间的结构和实证关系。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地区分了资产波动率与股权波动率对投资的异质性影响，为理解资本结构与企业投资行为提供了统一的理论框架。

title: The Role of Information in Building a More Sustainable Economy: A Supply and Demand Perspective
abstract: Interest in sustainability information, from investors, managers, researchers, and others, has been expanding rapidly. We discuss recent advances and open questions related to sustainability reporting and disclosure through the lens of a supply and demand framework. Our discussion builds on prior research on financial reporting and highlights unique aspects of the provision of sustainability information.
summary: 本文通过供给和需求框架探讨可持续信息在构建更可持续经济中的作用，讨论可持续报告与披露的最新进展和开放问题。研究建立在财务报告已有研究基础上，并强调可持续信息提供的独特方面。
ai_comment: 采用供给与需求视角分析可持续信息，为理解其独特性提供了新颖的框架，并紧密联系财务报告文献。

title: Financial Sophistication and Consumer Spending
abstract: Using detailed account‐level data, this paper explores how financial sophistication affects consumers' spending responses to changes in income. I document that, controlling for liquidity, financially unsophisticated consumers display significant spending responses to predictable decreases in their disposable income. Furthermore, they have lower savings rates, fewer liquid savings, and higher debt‐to‐income ratios, leaving them more exposed to income shocks. Robustness tests, supported by anecdotal survey evidence, indicate that these results are driven by some consumers' lack of financial sophistication and their consequent failure to understand their financial contracts, rather than by random idiosyncratic shocks, rational liquidity management, or optimal inattention.
summary: 基于详细的账户级数据，本文研究了金融素养如何影响消费者对收入变化的支出反应。在控制流动性的情况下，金融素养较低的消费者对可预测的税后收入下降表现出显著的支出反应。此外，这些消费者储蓄率较低、流动性储蓄较少、债务收入比更高，使他们更容易受到收入冲击的影响。通过稳健性检验和调查证据支持，表明这些结果是由部分消费者缺乏金融素养、未能理解其金融合同所致，而非随机个体冲击、理性流动性管理或最优忽视。
ai_comment: 本研究利用高质量账户数据，识别了金融素养对消费行为的因果影响，而非仅仅相关性，为家庭金融领域提供了重要实证证据。

title: Time‐Consistent Individuals, Time‐Inconsistent Households
abstract: I present a model of consumption and savings for a multiperson household in which members are imperfectly altruistic, derive utility from both private and shared public goods, and share wealth. I show that, despite having standard exponential time preferences, the household is time‐inconsistent: Members save too little and overspend on private consumption goods. The household remains time‐inconsistent even when members save separately, because the possibility of voluntary transfers or joint contribution to the public good preserves the dynamic commons problem. The household will choose to share wealth when the risk‐sharing benefits outweigh the utility cost of overconsumption.
summary: 本文构建了一个多成员家庭的消费与储蓄模型，模型中家庭成员非完全利他，从私人消费品和共享公共品中获得效用，并共同分享财富。尽管每个成员具有标准的指数时间偏好（即时间一致性），但整体家庭却表现出时间不一致性：成员储蓄过少，且过度消费私人商品。即使成员分别储蓄，由于存在自愿转移或共同贡献公共品的可能性，动态公共品问题仍然存在，导致家庭依然时间不一致。当风险分担的收益超过过度消费的效用成本时，家庭会选择共享财富。
ai_comment: 该模型首次将家庭的时间不一致性归因于成员间的动态公共品问题，而非个人偏好，为理解家庭储蓄行为提供了新视角。

title: Comply or Explain: Do Firms Opportunistically Claim Trade Secrets in Mandatory Environmental Disclosure Programs?
abstract: This paper studies whether firms opportunistically make proprietary claims in mandatory environmental disclosure programs with trade secret exemption rules. Examining the mandatory chemical disclosure program in the fracking industry, I find evidence of opportunistic withholding of information among operators that are less likely to have trade secrets. Specifically, I find that these operators claim fewer chemicals as trade secrets when the operating site is in close proximity to water quality monitors. This is only observed among publicly traded operators that face a higher cost of societal backlash when disclosing pollutant information. Further analyses suggest that these operators are concerned about external environmental monitoring, which deters them from opportunistic information withholding. Regarding public and private operators that are more likely to have trade secrets, I do not find strong evidence that their information withholding varies with the monitoring conditions.
summary: 本文研究企业是否在强制性环境披露项目中机会主义地利用商业秘密豁免规则。以压裂行业的强制性化学品披露项目为例，发现那些不太可能拥有商业秘密的运营商存在机会主义隐瞒信息的行为。具体而言，当作业地点靠近水质监测站时，这些运营商声称的化学品商业秘密数量更少。这一现象仅出现在上市公司中，因为它们面临更高的社会反弹成本。进一步分析表明，这些运营商担心外部环境监测，从而抑制了机会主义隐瞒。对于更可能拥有商业秘密的公共和私营运营商，未发现其信息隐瞒行为随监测条件变化的强有力证据。
ai_comment: 论文利用水质监测站的准自然实验，巧妙识别了企业环境披露中机会主义行为的动机差异，对信息披露监管政策具有重要启示。

title: The Gender Investment Gap over the Life Cycle
abstract: Single women invest less in risky assets than do single men. This paper analyzes the determinants of the “gender investment gap” based on a structural life-cycle framework. The model can rationalize the gender investment gap without gender heterogeneity in preferences. Rather, lower deterministic income and larger household sizes shift the composition of single women toward poorer households that invest less risky (composition effect). Additionally, future outcomes of both variables (which cannot easily be controlled for in regressions) make single women more vulnerable to financial shocks and decrease their optimal equity share even conditional on state variables (policy effect).
summary: 本文基于结构性生命周期框架，分析单身女性与单身男性在风险资产投资上的“性别投资差距”的决定因素。模型表明，无需引入偏好异质性即可解释该差距：较低确定性收入和较大家庭规模使单身女性更可能处于低收入家庭，从而减少风险投资（组成效应）；此外，未来收入与家庭规模的不确定性（难以在回归中控制）使单身女性更易受金融冲击，即使在控制状态变量后也会降低其最优股权份额（政策效应）。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构性模型排除偏好差异，揭示了收入与家庭规模的不确定性在性别投资差距中的关键作用，为政策干预提供了新视角。

title: Is Capital Structure Irrelevant with ESG Investors?
abstract: This paper examines whether capital structure is irrelevant for enterprise value and investment when investors care about environmental, social, and governance issues, which we refer to as “ESG-Modigliani-Miller” (ESG-MM). Theoretically, we show that ESG-MM holds with linear pricing and additive ESG. ESG-MM means that issuing low-yielding green bonds does not lower the overall cost of capital because it makes the issuer’s other securities browner. Hence, a firm’s incentive to make a green investment does not depend on its financing choice. We provide suggestive evidence of failure of ESG-MM, implying that firms and governments can exploit inconsistent ESG attribution or segmented markets.
summary: 本文研究当投资者关注环境、社会和治理（ESG）问题时，资本结构是否仍与企业价值和投资无关，即检验“ESG-莫迪利亚尼-米勒”（ESG-MM）命题。理论上，在线性定价和可加性ESG假设下，ESG-MM成立：发行低收益绿色债券不会降低整体资本成本，因为该发行会使公司的其他证券变得更“棕色”，从而绿色投资的激励不依赖于融资方式。然而，本文提供了ESG-MM失效的暗示性证据，表明企业和政府可以利用不一致的ESG归因或分割的市场来获取利益。
ai_comment: 本文拓展了经典的MM理论至ESG情境，揭示了绿色金融市场的潜在无效率，对绿色债券发行和ESG投资实践具有重要启示。

title: Liquidity Transformation and Fragility in the U.S. Banking Sector
abstract: Liquidity transformation, a key role of banks, is thought to increase fragility, as uninsured depositors face an incentive to withdraw money before others (a so‐called panic run). Despite much theoretical work, however, there is little empirical evidence establishing this mechanism. In this paper, we provide the first large‐scale evidence of this mechanism. Banks that engage in more liquidity transformation exhibit higher fragility, as captured by stronger sensitivities of uninsured deposit flows to bank performance and greater levels of uninsured deposit outflows when performance is poor. We also explore the effects of deposit insurance and systemic risk.
summary: 这篇论文研究了美国银行业流动性转换与脆弱性之间的关系。流动性转换是银行的关键职能，但被认为会增加脆弱性，因为未保险存款人面临抢先取款的激励（即恐慌性挤兑）。尽管有大量理论研究，但缺乏实证证据。本文提供了首个大规模实证证据，表明流动性转换越多的银行，其脆弱性越高，这体现在未保险存款流量对银行绩效的敏感性更强，以及绩效较差时未保险存款流出更多。论文还探讨了存款保险和系统性风险的影响。
ai_comment: 提供首个大规模实证证据，填补了流动性转换与脆弱性关系实证研究的空白，对理解银行风险和监管有重要意义。

title: Moving the Goalposts? Mutual Fund Benchmark Changes and Relative Performance Manipulation
abstract: We analyze changes to mutual funds’ self-declared benchmarks using hand-collected data from funds’ prospectuses. Under existing rules, funds can freely change their benchmark indexes and, implicitly, the historical returns to which they compare their past performance. Funds exploit this loophole by adding (dropping) indexes with lower (higher) past returns, thereby materially improving the appearance of their benchmark-adjusted returns. High-fee funds, broker-sold funds, and funds experiencing poor performance and outflows are more likely to engage in this behavior. These funds subsequently attract additional flows despite continuing to underperform their peers.
summary: 本文利用手工收集的基金招募说明书数据，分析了共同基金变更其自行声明的基准指数的行为。在现有规则下，基金可以自由更改基准指数，从而隐式地调整用于比较历史业绩的基准回报。基金利用这一漏洞，通过添加过去回报较低的指数、剔除过去回报较高的指数，显著改善其基准调整后回报的表现。高费用基金、经纪销售基金以及业绩差且出现资金流出的基金更可能参与这种行为。这些基金尽管持续跑输同行，但随后仍能吸引额外资金流入。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了共同基金利用基准选择漏洞进行业绩操纵的现象，对投资者保护和监管政策具有重要启示。

title: Risk-Adjusted Returns of Private Equity Funds: A New Approach
abstract: This paper introduces a new metric, α, to benchmark the performance of individual private equity funds. Our metric is substantially less sensitive to noise in fund cash flows compared to the popular public market equivalent (PME) and its generalization (GPME), while having the same aggregate pricing implications as GPME. For a large data set of fund cash flows, α estimates have much lower standard deviation across funds than does (G)PME. For buyout funds, PME and α are close, but deviate in certain subsamples. Using α increases power in regressions involving fund performance and improves performance predictability of future funds.
summary: 本文引入了一个新指标 α，用于衡量单个私募股权基金的风险调整后收益。与流行的公开市场等价物（PME）及其推广形式（GPME）相比，该指标对基金现金流中的噪声的敏感度大大降低，同时具有与 GPME 相同的总体定价含义。基于大量基金现金流数据集，α 估计值在基金间的标准差远低于 (G)PME。对于收购基金，PME 和 α 相近，但在某些子样本中存在偏离。使用 α 可以提高涉及基金业绩的回归功效，并改善对未来基金业绩的可预测性。
ai_comment: 提出了对私募股权基金业绩评估更稳健的α指标，显著降低噪声影响，提升统计检验力和预测能力。

title: Utility Tokens as a Commitment to Competition
abstract: We show that utility tokens can limit the rent‐seeking activities of two‐sided platforms with market power while preserving efficiency gains due to network effects. We model platforms where buyers and sellers can meet to exchange services. Tokens serve as the sole medium of exchange on a platform and can be traded in a secondary market. Tokenizing a platform commits a firm to give up monopolistic rents associated with the control of the platform, leading to long‐run competitive prices. We show how the threat of entrants can incentivize developers to tokenize and discuss cases where regulation is needed to enforce tokenization.
summary: 本文研究utility tokens（实用代币）如何限制具有市场力量的双边平台的寻租行为，同时保留网络效应带来的效率提升。作者构建了一个买卖双方在平台上交换服务的模型，其中代币作为平台上的唯一交换媒介，并可在二级市场交易。代币化平台使企业承诺放弃与平台控制相关的垄断租金，从而在长期实现竞争性价格。文章还展示了进入威胁如何激励开发者进行代币化，并讨论了需要监管强制代币化的情形。
ai_comment: 该论文为代币经济学提供了理论基础，揭示了代币作为承诺竞争工具的作用，并区分了自愿与强制代币化的条件，对平台监管具有启示意义。

title: Putting the Price in Asset Pricing
abstract: We propose a novel way to estimate a portfolio's abnormal price , the percentage gap between price and the present value of dividends computed with a chosen asset pricing model. Our method, based on a novel identity, resembles the time‐series estimator of abnormal returns, avoids the issues in alternative approaches, and clarifies the role of risk and mispricing in long‐horizon returns. We apply our techniques to study the cross‐section of price levels relative to the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) and find that a single characteristic, adjusted value , provides a parsimonious model of CAPM‐implied abnormal price.
summary: 本文提出了一种估计投资组合异常价格的新方法，即价格与根据所选资产定价模型计算的股息现值之间的百分比差距。该方法基于一个新的恒等式，类似于异常收益的时间序列估计量，避免了其他方法的缺陷，并阐明了风险与错误定价在长期收益中的作用。作者将该技术应用于研究相对于资本资产定价模型（CAPM）的价格水平截面，发现单一特征——调整后的价值——为CAPM隐含的异常价格提供了一个简约模型。
ai_comment: 提出了一种新的异常价格估计方法，通过恒等式简化了计算，并成功识别出调整后的价值作为CAPM异常价格的简约解释因子。

title: Beliefs about the Stock Market and Investment Choices: Evidence from a Survey and a Field Experiment
abstract: We survey retail investors at an online bank to study how beliefs about the autocorrelation of aggregate stock returns shape investment decisions measured in administrative account data. Individuals’ beliefs exhibit substantial heterogeneity and predict trading responses to market movements. We inform half of our respondents that, historically, the autocorrelation was close to zero, which causes them to update their perceived current autocorrelation and return expectations. The treatment shifts respondents’ equity purchases during the COVID-19 crash months later in the direction implied by the intervention. Our results provide causal evidence about the drivers of disagreement and trade in asset markets.
summary: 该论文通过在线银行对零售投资者进行问卷调查和实地实验，研究投资者对股票收益自相关性的信念如何影响其投资决策，并使用行政账户数据测量实际交易行为。研究发现个体信念存在显著异质性，且能够预测投资者对市场波动的交易反应。实验中，一半受访者被告知历史自相关性接近零，这导致他们更新当前感知的自相关性和收益预期，并在数月后的COVID-19市场崩盘期间，其股票购买行为朝干预所暗示的方向发生转变。研究提供了关于资产市场中分歧和交易驱动因素的因果证据。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实地实验提供了信念影响投资决策的因果证据，揭示了市场参与者异质性信念的关键作用，对理解市场波动与交易行为有重要贡献。

title: Measuring the Prevalence of Earnings Manipulations: A Novel Approach
abstract: We provide prevalence estimates for five forms of earnings manipulation based on executives’ reports about their firms’ actual reporting practices. After preregistering our methods and analyses via the Journal of Accounting Research ’s registration‐based editorial process, we recruit nearly a thousand executives from firms listed in the Russell 3000 Index to participate in either a survey or a list experiment; the hallmark of the latter being additional privacy protections designed to promote honest disclosure about self‐incriminating information. In our survey, 26.8% of executives disclose at least one form of earnings manipulation at their firm in the 2018–2023 period: 18.0% report changing an operational activity to meet a near‐term earnings target at the expense of long‐term value (i.e., real earnings management), 8.8% report intentionally obfuscating unfavorable information, 6.6% report manipulating accruals, 3.9% report withholding material information, and 0.0% report accounting fraud. Our list experiment produces an economically higher result in two cases, estimating that 29.9% of firms engaged in real earnings management and 12.4% committed accounting fraud over the same time period. We conclude that while a traditional survey can provide credible lower‐bound estimates for the prevalence of many forms of earnings manipulation, list experiments encourage more honest disclosure in some cases.
summary: 本研究基于对Russell 3000指数公司近千名高管的调查和列表实验，估计了五种盈余操纵形式的普遍程度。在调查中，26.8%的高管披露其公司在2018-2023年间至少实施了一种盈余操纵，包括18.0%的真实盈余管理、8.8%故意隐瞒不利信息、6.6%操纵应计项目、3.9%隐瞒重要信息，以及0.0%的会计欺诈。列表实验（提供额外隐私保护）在两个方面产生了更高的估计：29.9%的公司进行了真实盈余管理，12.4%的公司实施了会计欺诈。结论认为，传统调查可以为多种盈余操纵的普遍性提供可信的下限估计，而列表实验在某些情况下能鼓励更诚实的披露。
ai_comment: 该研究通过注册报告流程和列表实验方法，提高了对盈余操纵普遍性估计的可信度，尤其揭示了会计欺诈可能被传统调查低估。

title: How Do Short-Term Incentives Affect Long-Term Productivity?
abstract: Previous research shows that incentives to meet short-term earnings targets can cause firms to increase share buybacks, leading to cuts in investments and employment. Using plant-level census data, we find that incentives to engage in earnings-per-share-motivated buybacks result in lower productivity at both the plant and firm level. We attribute this productivity drop to two mechanisms: reduced investment in productivity-augmenting technology, and inefficient allocation of resources across a firm’s plants. We identify multiple frictions—including labor unions, financial constraints, agency problems, and adjustment costs—that can constrain efficient reallocations across plants and thus exacerbate the consequences of firms’ short-term incentives.
summary: 这篇论文研究短期激励（如为达到短期盈利目标而进行的股票回购）如何影响企业的长期生产率。利用工厂层面的普查数据，作者发现，基于每股收益动机的回购会导致工厂和企业层面的生产率下降。这种下降归因于两个机制：对提升生产率的技术投资减少，以及企业内工厂间资源的低效配置。此外，论文识别了多种摩擦因素——包括工会、财务约束、代理问题和调整成本——这些因素限制了工厂间的有效资源再分配，从而加剧了短期激励带来的负面后果。
ai_comment: 本文利用详尽的工厂级数据，揭示了短期激励通过投资减少和资源错配两条渠道损害长期生产率，并识别了多种放大效应的摩擦因素，对理解短期主义经济后果有重要贡献。

title: Tyranny of the Personal Network: The Limits of Arm’s Length Fundraising in Venture Capital
abstract: U.S. securities regulators have sought to protect investors in private markets by forcing issuers to fundraise via personal networks.Focusing on VC fund managers, we study a 2013 policy permitting public advertising in private markets ("506(c)").Less well-networked and underrepresented managers disproportionately use 506(c).Yet its take-up is limited because arm's length fundraising depends on hard information, especially a track record, and few managers establish a track record without developing a network.Arm's length fundraising also imposes costs -to access the "crowd" and verify investors-leading it to send a negative signal.
summary: 研究聚焦美国证券监管机构通过强制发行人利用个人网络募资以保护私人市场投资者的政策。以风险投资（VC）基金管理人为对象，分析了2013年允许私人市场公开广告的政策（506(c)）。发现网络较弱和代表性不足的管理人更倾向于使用506(c)，但该政策采用率有限，因为无关联募资（arm's length fundraising）依赖于硬信息，尤其是业绩记录，而很少有管理人能在未建立网络的情况下建立业绩记录。此外，无关联募资还带来接触“大众”和核实投资者的成本，从而发出负面信号。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了监管意图与市场现实之间的重要张力，强调个人网络在风险投资募资中的核心作用，为理解私募市场信息不对称提供了新视角。

title: AI and Finance
Optimal Dynamic Asset Allocation with Transaction Costs: The Role of Hedging Demands
abstract: A number of papers have solved for the optimal dynamic portfolio strategy when expected returns are time-varying and trading is costly, but only for agents with myopic utility.Non-myopic agents benefit from hedging against future shocks to the investment opportunity set even when transaction costs are zero (Merton, 1969(Merton, , 1971)).In this paper, we propose a solution to the dynamic portfolio allocation problem for non-myopic agents faced with a stochastic investment opportunity set when trading is costly.We show that the agent's optimal policy is to trade toward an "aim" portfolio, the makeup of which depends both on transaction costs and on each asset's correlation with changes in the investment opportunity set.The speed at which the agent should trade towards the aim portfolio depends both on the shock's persistence and on the extent to which the shock can be effectively hedged.We illustrate the differences in portfolio makeup that result from considering hedging demands of a long-horizon investor using a set of simplified examples, and using a daily trading strategy based on the estimated relation between retail order imbalance and future returns.
summary: 本文研究了存在交易成本时，非短视投资者在随机投资机会集下的动态资产配置问题。与已有文献仅考虑短视投资者不同，本文允许投资者具有对冲未来投资机会集冲击的需求。作者提出了一种求解方法，指出最优策略是向一个“目标”组合交易，该组合的构成取决于交易成本以及各资产与投资机会集变化的相关系数。交易速度取决于冲击的持久性和可对冲程度。通过简化例子和基于零售订单不平衡与未来收益估计关系的日交易策略，本文展示了考虑长期投资者对冲需求导致的组合差异。
ai_comment: 本文拓展了经典Merton模型至交易成本情境，揭示了非短视投资者的对冲需求如何影响最优交易策略，具有较强的理论创新和实践指导意义。

title: Trading Volume Alpha
Theorizing with Large Language Models
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are proving to be a powerful toolkit for management and organizational research. While early work has largely focused on the value of these tools for data processing and replicating survey-based research, the potential of LLMs for theory building is yet to be recognized. We argue that LLMs can accelerate the pace at which researchers can develop, validate, and extend strategic management theory. We propose a novel framework called Generative AI-Based Experimentation (GABE) that enables researchers to conduct exploratory in silico experiments that can mirror the complexities of real-world organizational settings, featuring multiple agents and strategic interdependencies. This approach is unique because it allows researchers to unpack the mechanisms behind results by directly modifying agents’ roles, preferences, and capabilities, and asking them to reveal the explanations behind decisions. We apply this framework to a novel theory studying strategic exploration under uncertainty. We show how our framework can not only replicate the results from experiments with human subjects at a much lower cost, but can also be used to extend theory by clarifying boundary conditions and uncovering mechanisms. We conclude that LLMs possess tremendous potential to complement existing methods for theorizing in strategy and, more broadly, the social sciences.
summary: 本文探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）在管理研究中的理论构建潜力，提出名为生成式AI实验（GABE）的框架。该框架允许研究人员进行探索性计算机模拟实验，模拟多主体和战略相互依赖的复杂组织环境，通过直接修改代理的角色、偏好和能力来揭示决策背后的机制。作者将GABE应用于不确定性下的战略探索理论，证明其不仅能以更低成本复制人类实验的结果，还能通过澄清边界条件和揭示机制来扩展理论。研究认为，LLMs在补充现有战略及社会科学理论构建方法方面具有巨大潜力。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将LLMs用于理论构建而非仅是数据处理，提出的GABE框架为管理研究提供了低成本、可解释的模拟实验新范式。

title: 12 Best Practices for Leveraging Generative AI in Experimental Research
abstract: We provide twelve best practices and discuss how each practice can help researchers accurately, credibly
summary: 该论文提出了12项最佳实践，并讨论了每项实践如何帮助研究人员准确、可信地进行实验研究。这些实践旨在指导有效利用生成式人工智能（Generative AI）提升研究质量。
ai_comment: 尽管摘要简短，但论文聚焦于实用的方法论指导，对实证研究者具有直接参考价值。

title: Is Distance from Innovation a Barrier to the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence?
The ABC’s of Who Benefits from Working with AI: Ability, Beliefs, and Calibration
abstract: We use a controlled experiment to show that ability and belief calibration jointly determine the benefits of working with Artificial Intelligence (AI). AI improves performance more for people with low baseline ability. However, holding ability constant, AI assistance is more valuable for people who are calibrated, meaning they have accurate beliefs about their own ability. People who know they have low ability gain the most from working with AI. In a counterfactual analysis, we show that eliminating miscalibration would cause AI to reduce performance inequality nearly twice as much as it already does.
summary: 这项实验研究了能力水平和信念校准如何共同影响从人工智能合作中获得的收益。结果显示，AI 对低能力者的绩效提升更大；但在能力相同时，校准者（即对自己能力有准确信念的人）从 AI 中获益更多。知道自己能力低的人与 AI 合作获益最大。反事实分析表明，消除错误校准会使 AI 降低绩效不平等的效果接近翻倍。
ai_comment: 通过精巧的实验设计揭示了能力与信念校准在 AI 合作中的交互作用，为理解 AI 如何影响绩效不平等提供了新机制。

title: CEO Activism and Firm Value
abstract: We investigate the increasingly common practice of chief executive officers (CEOs) taking public stances on social and political issues (CEO activism). We find that CEO activism stems from a CEO’s personal ideology and its alignment with investor, employee, and customer ideologies. We show that CEO activism results in positive market reactions. Furthermore, firms with CEO activism realize increased shareholdings from investors with a greater liberal leaning, who rebalance their portfolios toward these firms. Our results suggest that investors’ socio-political preferences are an important channel through which CEO activism affects equity demand and stock prices. Notably, CEOs are less likely to be fired when their activist stances generate positive market responses. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4971 .
summary: 该论文研究CEO在公共场合对社会和政治议题表态（CEO activism）这一日益普遍的现象及其对公司价值的影响。研究发现，CEO activism源于CEO的个人意识形态，并与投资者、员工和客户的意识形态相契合。CEO activism引发正向市场反应，并促使具有更强自由主义倾向的投资者增持这些公司的股份，即投资者重新平衡其投资组合。结果表明，投资者的社会政治偏好是CEO activism影响股权需求和股价的重要渠道。此外，当CEO的激进表态产生积极市场反应时，他们被解雇的可能性更低。
ai_comment: 该论文将CEO个人政治立场与公司财务结果联系起来，揭示了投资者偏好作为传导机制的重要性，拓展了ESG和公司治理研究。

title: The Dynamic Informativeness of Scheduled News
abstract: We propose a method to identify the informativeness of a future scheduled announcement at the daily level, exploiting the discontinuity it creates in the term structure of option volatility. We implement the strategy in a panel data model to estimate the relation between prior signals and the future announcement. This method allows us to separate substitutes from complements, it can isolate multiple signals within the same quarter, and it can condition on the timing and signal characteristics. We find that analyst forecasts substitute earnings announcement information and that recommendations do not provide extra information on top of forecasts. Moreover, our evidence suggests that insiders sell to avoid uncertainty when the announcement is far away but pull forward earnings information when they trade one month before. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: This publication is part of the project “Eliciting the properties of private signals” (with project number VI.Veni.201E.029 of the research program VENI SGW, which is (partly) financed by the Dutch Research Council (NWO). Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4970 .
summary: 本文提出了一种利用期权波动率期限结构中由未来预定公告带来的不连续性，来识别该公告在日度层面信息含量的方法。该方法在面板数据模型中实施，用以估计先前信号与未来公告之间的关联，能够区分替代品与互补品，隔离同一季度内的多个信号，并依据时机和信号特征进行条件分析。研究发现，分析师预测会替代盈利公告的信息，而推荐并未在预测之外提供额外信息。此外，证据表明内部人在公告距离较远时会卖出以规避不确定性，但在交易发生前一个月会提前利用盈利信息。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用期权波动率期限结构的不连续性来度量公告的信息含量，为研究预定事件的信息环境提供了新工具。

title: Calibrating Sales Forecasts in a Pandemic Using Competitive Online Nonparametric Regression
abstract: Motivated by our collaboration with Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), a consumer packaged goods (CPG) company, we consider the problem of forecasting sales under the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic. Our approach combines nonparametric regression, game theory, and pandemic modeling to develop a data-driven competitive online nonparametric regression method. Specifically, the method takes the future COVID-19 case estimates, which can be simulated via the susceptible-infectious-removed (SIR) epidemic model as an input, and outputs the level of calibration for the baseline sales forecast generated by AB InBev. In generating the calibration level, we focus on an online learning setting where our algorithm sequentially predicts the label (i.e., the level of calibration) of a random covariate (i.e., the current number of active cases) given past observations and the generative process (i.e., the SIR epidemic model) of future covariates. To provide robust performance guarantee, we derive our algorithm by minimizing regret, which is the difference between the squared [Formula: see text]-norm associated with labels generated by the algorithm and labels generated by an adversary and the squared [Formula: see text]-norm associated with labels generated by the best isotonic (nondecreasing) function in hindsight and the adversarial labels. We develop a computationally efficient algorithm that attains the minimax-optimal regret over all possible choices of the labels (possibly non-i.i.d. and even adversarial). We demonstrate the performances of our algorithm on both synthetic and AB InBev’s data sets of three different markets (each corresponds to a country) from March 2020 to March 2021. The AB InBev’s numerical experiments show that our method is capable of reducing the forecast error in terms of weighted mean absolute percentage error (WMAPE) and mean squared error (MSE) by more than 37% for the company. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: This work was partially supported by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology Data Science Lab and AB-InBev Corporation. Supplemental Material: The e-companion and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4969 .
