summary: 本文与消费品公司百威英博合作，研究在新冠疫情背景下如何校准销售预测。采用结合非参数回归、博弈论和疫情建模的竞争性在线非参数回归方法。该方法以通过易感-感染-恢复（SIR）流行病模型模拟的未来病例估计为输入，输出对百威英博基线销售预测的校准水平。算法在在线学习环境中顺序预测随机协变量（当前活跃病例数）的标签（校准水平），利用过去观测和未来协变量的生成过程（SIR模型）。通过最小化遗憾（算法标签与对抗标签的平方L2范数之差与事后最优等渗函数的平方L2范数之差）推导算法，并开发出计算高效且达到极小极大最优遗憾的算法。在合成数据集和百威英博2020年3月至2021年3月间三个不同市场（各对应一个国家）的数据上验证性能。数值实验表明，该方法能帮助公司将加权绝对百分比误差（WMAPE）和均方误差（MSE）降低37%以上。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将博弈论与非参数回归结合，在疫情背景下提供了一种具有理论保证的在线学习校准方法，并在实际业务中取得显著效果。

title: How APIs Create Growth by Inverting the Firm
abstract: Traditional asset management strategy has emphasized building barriers to entry or closely guarding unique assets to maintain a firm’s comparative advantage. A new “inverted firm” paradigm, however, has emerged. Under this strategy, firms share data seeking to become platforms by opening digital services to third parties and capturing part of their external surplus. This contrasts with a “pipeline” strategy where the firm itself creates value. This paper quantitatively estimates the effect of adopting an inverted firm strategy through the lens of application programming interfaces (APIs), a key enabling technology. Using both public data and those of a private API development firm, we document rapid growth of the API network and connecting apps since 2005. We then perform difference-in-difference and synthetic control analyses and find that public firms adopting public APIs grew an additional 38.7% over 16 years relative to similar nonadopters. We find no significant effect from the use of APIs purely for internal productivity: the pipeline strategy. Within the subset of firms that adopt public APIs, those that attract more third-party complementors and those that become more central to the network see faster growth. Using variation in network centrality caused by API degradation, an instrumental variables analysis confirms a causal role for APIs in firm market value. Finally, we document an important downside of public APIs: increased risk of data breach. Overall, these facts lead us to conclude that APIs have a large and positive impact on economic growth and do so primarily by enabling an inverted firm strategy. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: This work was partially supported by Mulesoft and Apigee Corporation. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4968 .
summary: 本文研究应用程序编程接口（API）如何通过“倒置企业”战略促进企业增长。传统资产管理强调建立壁垒或保护独特资产，而“倒置企业”通过共享数据、开放数字服务吸引第三方，捕获外部剩余，与内部创造价值的“管道”战略形成对比。利用公共数据和私有API开发公司数据，本文发现自2005年以来API网络和应用快速增长。通过双重差分和合成控制分析，采用公共API的上市公司在16年内比未采用的类似公司增长额外38.7%，而仅用于内部效率的API无显著效果。在采用公共API的公司中，吸引更多第三方补充者或成为网络中心性更高的公司增长更快。利用API退化导致的网络中心性变化进行工具变量分析，确认API对市场价值的因果作用。最后，公共API增加了数据泄露风险。结论：API主要通过实现倒置企业战略对经济增长产生积极影响。
ai_comment: 本文首次大规模实证估计API开放对企业增长的因果效应，区分公共与内部API的不同作用，并揭示网络中心性和第三方补充的关键机制，同时关注数据泄露风险这一重要成本。

title: Let’s Chat… When Communication Promotes Efficiency in Experimental Asset Markets
abstract: The growing prevalence of stock market chat rooms and social media suggests that communication between traders may affect market outcomes. Using data from a series of laboratory experiments, we study the causal effect of trader communication on market efficiency. We show that communication allows markets to convey private information more effectively. This effect is robust to a wide range of information settings. The presence of insiders limits the impact, whereas posted reputation scores in the communication platform magnify it. These findings illustrate the need to consider social interactions when designing market institutions to leverage the social motives that foster information aggregation. This paper was accepted by Axel Ockenfels, behavioral economics & decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The e-companion and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4967 .
summary: 研究通过实验室实验考察交易者之间的沟通对市场效率的因果影响。发现沟通能够使市场更有效地传递私有信息，这一效果在多种信息设置下保持稳健。存在内幕交易者会削弱沟通的积极作用，而沟通平台上的声誉评分则会增强其效果。研究结果强调了在设计市场机制时需考虑社会互动，以利用促进信息聚合的社会动机。
ai_comment: 通过实验方法清晰识别沟通对市场效率的因果关系，并发现声誉机制可作为调节因素，为市场设计提供了新视角。

title: The Impact of Family-Based Human Capital on Corporate Innovation: Evidence from Sibling-Chairpersons in China
abstract: We examine the impact of family-based human capital stemming from a chairperson’s having siblings vis-à-vis not having siblings on corporate innovation in Chinese family firms. Using hand-collected data, we document that when a firm has a sibling-chairperson, it holds more patents, receives more total citations to its patents, and has greater innovation efficiency and innovation quality than an otherwise equivalent firm with a chairperson having no siblings. The results are economically significant and robust to a battery of robustness checks. Specifically, the findings remain intact after using China’s one-child policy as an exogenous shock to apply a regression discontinuity research design to mitigate endogeneity. Additional analyses suggest that the mechanisms behind the impact of siblings on innovation are consistent with family-based human capital embedded in the sibling relationships such as competition, knowledge spillover, and family firm succession effect among siblings. Furthermore, we show that sibling comanagement and sibling gender diversity matter in corporate innovation. In addition, sibling effect enhances corporate investment efficiency, stock returns, and merger and acquisition performance. Overall, family-based human capital from siblings positively contributes to corporate innovation. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72225005 and 72202249] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [Grant 2022M713658]. Supplemental Material: Data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4965 .
summary: 本文研究家族企业董事长是否有兄弟姐妹（sibling-chairperson）对家族企业创新的影响。利用手工收集的中国家族企业数据，发现当董事长有兄弟姐妹时，企业拥有更多专利、专利总被引次数更高、创新效率和创新质量更好，且结果在经济上显著，经过一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。采用中国独生子女政策作为外生冲击的断点回归设计缓解内生性问题后，结论依然稳健。机制分析表明，兄弟姐妹关系嵌入的家族人力资本（如竞争、知识溢出和家族企业继承效应）是主要渠道。此外，兄弟姐妹共同管理和性别多样性也对创新有影响；兄弟姐妹效应还能提升企业投资效率、股票回报和并购绩效。总体而言，来自兄弟姐妹的家族人力资本对企业创新有正向贡献。
ai_comment: 本文利用中国独生子女政策作为外生冲击，为家族企业中兄弟姐妹关系对创新的因果影响提供了可靠证据，丰富了家族人力资本与公司创新的文献。

title: Not All Shocks Are Created Equal: Assessing Heterogeneity in the Bank Lending Channel
abstract: We provide evidence that the yield impact of unconventional monetary policy is not a sufficient statistic to measure the strength of the bank lending channel of unconventional monetary policy. As a laboratory, we study three major positive events in the European sovereign debt crisis—the Greek debt restructuring (private sector involvement (PSI)), outright monetary transactions (OMT), and quantitative easing (QE)—using credit registry and security-level bank balance sheet data from Portugal, a country that was directly exposed to all three events. Even though the price of sovereign debt increased by substantially more after the PSI and OMT announcements, only QE led banks to reduce their net sovereign debt holdings and had statistically and economically significant effects on lending to firms and households. The differential effect on banks’ behavior reflects two forces. First, lower bank capitalization levels during the PSI and OMT episodes as well as disincentives to sell sovereign bonds because of their collateral value in the European Central Bank’s long-term refinancing operation facilities reduce the effectiveness of the recapitalization channel. Second, only QE involved direct asset purchases by the central bank and thereby induced a portfolio rebalancing channel from sovereign debt to loans. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: The contribution by G. Nogueira to this paper has been prepared under the Lamfalussy Fellowship Program sponsored by the European Central Bank. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00104 .
summary: 本文研究了非常规货币政策的银行借贷渠道的异质性，指出收益率影响不足以衡量其强度。以欧洲主权债务危机中的三个重大事件——希腊债务重组（PSI）、直接货币交易（OMT）和量化宽松（QE）——为实验室，使用葡萄牙的信贷登记和证券级银行资产负债表数据。尽管PSI和OMT公告后主权债务价格涨幅更大，但只有QE导致银行减少净主权债务持有，并对企业和家庭贷款产生统计和经济上显著的影响。银行行为的差异源于两个因素：第一，PSI和OMT期间银行资本化水平较低，以及因主权债券在欧洲央行长期再融资操作设施中的抵押价值而缺乏出售激励，削弱了资本重组渠道的效果；第二，只有QE涉及央行直接资产购买，从而引发了从主权债务到贷款的投资组合再平衡渠道。
ai_comment: 本文通过精心设计的事件对比，揭示了非常规货币政策传导机制中的关键异质性，对理解量化宽松的实际效果具有重要贡献。

title: A Regularized High-Dimensional Positive Definite Covariance Estimator with High-Frequency Data
abstract: This paper proposes a novel large-dimensional positive definite covariance estimator for high-frequency data under a general factor model framework. We demonstrate an appealing connection between the proposed estimator and a weighted group least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) penalized least-squares estimator. The proposed estimator improves on traditional principal component analysis by allowing for weak factors, whose signal strengths are weak relative to idiosyncratic components. Despite the presence of microstructure noises and asynchronous trading, the proposed estimator achieves guarded positive definiteness without sacrificing the convergence rate. To make our method fully operational, we provide an extended simultaneous alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm to solve the resultant constrained convex minimization problem efficiently. Empirically, we study the monthly high-frequency covariance structure of the stock constituents of the S&P 500 index from 2008 to 2016, using all traded stocks from the NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ stock markets to construct the high-frequency Fama-French four and extended eleven economic factors. We further examine the out-of-sample performance of the proposed method through vast portfolio allocations, which deliver significantly reduced out-of-sample portfolio risk and enhanced Sharpe ratios. The success of our method supports the usefulness of machine learning techniques in finance. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Research Grants Council, University Grants Committee [Grants 11500119, 11505522, 11505721, and 21504818] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) Basic Scientific Center Project [Grant 71988101], entitled as “Econometric Modelling and Economic Policy Studies”, as well as NSFC [Grants 71803166 and 72173104]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04138 .
summary: 本文提出一种适用于高频数据的大维正定协方差估计器，基于一般因子模型框架。作者展示了该估计器与加权group LASSO惩罚最小二乘估计之间的有趣联系。该估计器相比传统主成分分析改进了对弱因子的处理能力（弱因子信号强度弱于特质成分）。在存在微观结构噪声和非同步交易的情况下，该估计器能在不牺牲收敛速度的前提下保证正定性。为求解带约束的凸最小化问题，提供了扩展的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）算法。实证部分使用2008-2016年S&P 500成分股的月度高频协方差结构，利用NYSE、AMEX和NASDAQ所有交易股票构建高频Fama-French四因子和扩展的十一因子。通过大量投资组合分配检验样本外性能，结果显示显著降低的样本外组合风险和提高的夏普比率。该方法的成功支持了机器学习技术在金融中的实用性。
ai_comment: 本文将正则化高维协方差估计与加权group LASSO建立联系，并引入弱因子处理，理论扎实；实证效果显著，体现了机器学习在金融中的价值。

title: Informal Cross-Border Trade in Africa: Operations, Policy, and Opportunities
abstract: Informal cross-border trade (ICBT) refers to the illegal activities of cross-border commerce conducted by unregistered small-scale traders. We seek to develop insights to understand the ICBT value chain and offer policy recommendations to successfully integrate it into the formal economy. Using a game-theoretic model, we analyze the operations and key market dynamics of ICBT. We analyze the policy implications of three representative UN directives: enhancing marginalized traders’ access to formal channels, reducing export tax rates for formal traders, and introducing an alternative simplified trade regime (STR) for informal traders. All three policies result in an increase in government proceeds when the inherent profitability of the formal or STR channels is sufficiently high. Furthermore, social welfare increases when the policies effectively balance wholesale price competition within the formal and informal channels. We apply our model to a case study based on Uganda’s agricultural exports over an 11-year horizon. The access enhancement policy is most effective in increasing government proceeds but least effective in improving the welfare of other participants. The tax reduction policy enhances traders’ profitability but sacrifices the welfare of farmers and government proceeds substantially. Finally, the STR acknowledgement policy results in the largest increase in profitability of marginalized traders and farmers but comes at the cost of government proceeds. This paper was accepted by Jay Swaminathan, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Institute of Management Research, College of Business Administration, Seoul National University. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02479 .
summary: 本文研究非洲非正规跨境贸易（ICBT）的运作、政策与机遇。通过博弈论模型分析ICBT价值链和市场动态，评估三种联合国政策指令的效果：增强边缘化贸易商进入正规渠道、降低正式贸易商的出口税率、为非正规贸易商引入替代的简化贸易制度（STR）。研究发现，当正规或STR渠道的内在盈利能力足够高时，所有三种政策都能增加政府收入；当政策有效平衡正规与非正规渠道的批发价格竞争时，社会福利增加。基于乌干达农业出口11年数据的案例研究表明：增强进入政策最能增加政府收入，但对其他参与者的福利改善最小；降税政策提高贸易商盈利能力但牺牲农民福利和政府收入；STR认可政策最大程度提高边缘化贸易商和农民的福利，但以政府收入为代价。
ai_comment: 本文结合博弈论建模与乌干达案例，系统比较了三种非正规贸易正规化政策的权衡，为政策制定提供了理论依据。

title: A Decomposition of Conditional Risk Premia and Implications for Representative Agent Models
abstract: We develop a methodology to decompose the conditional market risk premium and risk premia on higher-order moments of excess market returns into risk premia related to contingent claims on down, up, and moderate market returns. The decomposition exploits information about the risk-neutral market return distribution embedded in option prices, but does not depend on assumptions about the functional form of investor preferences or about the market return distribution. The total market risk premium is highly time-varying, as are the contributions from downside, upside, and central risk. Time-series variation in risk premia associated with each region is primarily driven by variation in risk prices associated with the probability of entering each region at short horizons, but it is primarily driven by variation in risk quantities at longer horizons. Analogous decompositions implied by prominent representative agent models generally fail to match the dynamic risk premium behavior implied by the data. Our results provide a set of new empirical facts regarding the drivers of conditional risk premia and identify new challenges for representative agent models. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01663 .
summary: 本文提出一种方法，将条件市场风险溢价和超额市场收益的高阶矩风险溢价分解为与下行、上行和温和市场回报相关的或有索赔风险溢价。该方法利用期权价格中隐含的风险中性市场回报分布信息，但不依赖于投资者偏好函数形式或市场回报分布的假设。研究发现，总市场风险溢价高度时变，下行、上行和中心风险的贡献也随时间变化。各区域风险溢价的时间序列变化在短期主要由进入该区域的概率（风险价格）驱动，但在长期主要由风险数量驱动。典型的代表性代理模型（如消费资本资产定价模型）的类似分解通常无法匹配数据中观察到的动态风险溢价行为。这些结果为条件风险溢价的驱动因素提供了一组新的实证事实，并揭示了代表性代理模型面临的新挑战。
ai_comment: 该文提出了一种创新的不依赖偏好假设的分解方法，利用期权价格信息分离不同市场状态的风险溢价，揭示了风险价格与风险数量的时变作用，为评估和挑战代表性资产定价模型提供了重要基准。

title: Quantifying the Impact of Impact Investing
abstract: We propose a quantitative framework for assessing the financial impact of any form of impact investing, including socially responsible investing; environmental, social, and governance (ESG) objectives; and other nonfinancial investment criteria. We derive conditions under which impact investing detracts from, improves on, or is neutral to the performance of traditional mean-variance optimal portfolios, which depends on whether the correlations between the impact factor and unobserved excess returns are negative, positive, or zero, respectively. Using Treynor–Black portfolios to maximize the risk-adjusted returns of impact portfolios, we derive an explicit and easily computable measure of the financial reward or cost of impact investing as compared with passive index benchmarks. We illustrate our approach with applications to biotech venture philanthropy, a semiconductor research and development consortium, divesting from “sin” stocks, ESG investments, and “meme” stock rallies such as GameStop in 2021. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: Research funding from the National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2022YFA1007900], the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 12271013], Peking University’s Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities, and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology Laboratory for Financial Engineering is acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01168 .
summary: 本文提出了一个量化框架，用于评估任何形式的影响力投资（包括社会责任投资、环境、社会和治理（ESG）目标以及其他非财务投资标准）的财务影响。该框架推导了影响力投资对传统均值方差最优投资组合表现是减损、改善还是中性的条件，这些条件取决于影响力因子与未观测超额收益之间的相关性为负、正或零。通过使用Treynor-Black组合来最大化影响力投资组合的风险调整收益，该研究给出了一个显式且易于计算的财务回报或成本度量，可与被动指数基准进行比较。作者通过生物技术风险慈善、半导体研发联盟、撤资“罪恶”股票、ESG投资以及2021年GameStop等“meme”股票上涨的应用案例说明了该方法。
ai_comment: 该研究为影响力投资的财务效应提供了严谨的量化框架，特别是推导了影响方向与相关性的清晰关系，并通过多种实际案例展示了其适用性，具有较强的理论价值和实践指导意义。

title: Financing Innovative Activity and the Endogeneity of Patenting
abstract: It is common for lenders to require innovative firms to report all innovations and take actions, such as patenting, to protect their value. However, many future innovations are difficult to verify, making enforcement of such requirements difficult. This creates a tension for firms between protecting their innovations through patenting and creating assets that can be liquidated by a lender when not fully repaid. We show that the endogeneity of the patenting decision introduces an upper bound on the long-term payments that can be credibly promised to a lender, affecting the feasibility of obtaining financing and the terms of financial contracts. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance.
summary: 本文研究创新活动融资中专利决策的内生性问题。贷款人通常要求创新企业报告所有创新并通过专利等方式保护其价值，但未来创新难以验证，使得这类要求难以执行。企业需要在通过专利保护创新与创建可供贷款人清算的资产之间进行权衡。研究表明，专利决策的内生性引入了可向贷款人可信承诺的长期支付上限，从而影响融资的可行性及金融合同的条款。本文被《金融学》期刊接受。
ai_comment: 本文首次将专利决策的内生性纳入企业融资分析框架，揭示了创新企业融资困难的新根源，对理解知识产权保护与融资契约设计具有重要启示。

title: Attention and Biases: Evidence from Tax-Inattentive Investors
abstract: We first provide evidence of investor inattention to a very simple and well-known capital gains tax exemption in the Brazilian stock market. We then show that inattentive investors exhibit worse trading performance and stronger trading biases even after controlling for several investor-level variables, such as past trading experience. The evidence is consistent with inattention being one of the explanations for the prevalence of behavioral biases. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: F. Chague and B. Giovannetti gratefully acknowledge financial support from Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02516 .
summary: 本文首先提供了巴西股票市场中投资者对一项简单且广为人知的资本利得税豁免的忽视证据。然后表明，即使控制了过去的交易经验等多个投资者层面变量，忽视的投资者表现出更差的交易表现和更强的交易偏差。这一证据支持忽视是行为偏差普遍存在的一个解释。
ai_comment: 从税收忽视这一独特视角验证了注意力缺乏与行为偏差之间的因果关系，为行为金融学提供了新的实证证据。

title: Smartphone Trading Technology, Investor Behavior, and Mutual Fund Performance
abstract: Using proprietary individual-level trading data around a natural experiment—the release of a smartphone trading app by a large investment advisor—this study investigates how smartphone trading technology affects retail investor behavior and mutual fund performance. App adoption by retail investors leads to an increase in investor attention and trading volume. App adopters’ flows become more sensitive to short-term fund returns and market sentiment, resulting in higher aggregate flow volume among adopters. The funds more exposed to the shock experience a greater decline in abnormal returns, likely attributable to higher fund flow volume and liquidity costs. As a result, both adopters and nonadopters experience a decline in their mutual fund investment returns. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. Funding: The W. Edwards Deming Center and the Eugene Lang Entrepreneurship Center at Columbia University provided funding to support this research. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02099 .
summary: 本研究利用一家大型投资顾问公司推出智能手机交易APP这一自然实验的专有个人级交易数据，考察智能手机交易技术如何影响零售投资者行为及共同基金业绩。研究发现，APP的采用导致投资者注意力和交易量增加，采用者的资金流动对短期基金回报和市场情绪更加敏感，从而在采用者中形成更高的总资金流动量。受冲击较大的基金异常回报下降幅度更大，这很可能归因于更高的资金流动量和流动性成本。结果，采用者和非采用者的共同基金投资回报均出现下降。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验的严谨因果识别方法，揭示了金融科技对投资者行为及基金市场的实际影响，对理解技术驱动的交易行为及其市场后果具有重要价值。

title: Inferring Intermediary Risk Exposure from Trade
abstract: We propose a novel measure of intermediary risk exposure based on the fraction of all trade that is conducted between dealers, called the interdealer trade (IDT) measure. Intuitively, when dealers’ aggregate risk exposure rises, they trade more with each other to redistribute inventory shocks. Consistent with risk exposures relating to expected returns, market-specific IDT measures add incremental return predictability across five different markets. For example, one-standard-deviation increases in the Treasury and foreign exchange (FX) IDT measures, respectively, forecast a 1.8% higher annual excess return on a five-year bond and a 3.7% higher annual excess return on currency-specific FX trades. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01831 .
summary: 本文提出了一种基于交易商之间交易比例的中介风险暴露度量指标，称为交易商间交易（IDT）度量。其直觉是，当交易商的总体风险暴露上升时，他们会更频繁地相互交易以重新分配库存冲击。与风险暴露与预期收益率相关的理论一致，不同市场的特定IDT度量在五个不同的市场中均具有增量收益预测能力。例如，国债和外汇IDT度量一个标准差的变化分别预测五年期债券年超额收益率上升1.8%和特定货币外汇交易年超额收益率上升3.7%。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地利用交易商间交易比例作为风险暴露的代理变量，并在多个市场中验证了其预测能力，为理解中介在资产定价中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Dynamic Market Making with Asymmetric Information and Market Power
abstract: We study the dynamics of trading volume and bid-ask spread using a multiperiod trading model with oligopolistic market makers. Traders smooth out their trading even though they are not strategic, and thus trading persists after the arrival of information or liquidity shocks. Traders act quickly on their private information while postponing hedging trades until later periods. The market power of market makers enables them to widen bid-ask spreads when trading incentives are heightened. Consequently, both trading volume and bid-ask spread may exhibit U-shaped patterns. Our model calibration aligns with the empirical intraday patterns observed in bid-ask spreads and trading volumes. (JEL D53, D61, D82, G12, G14, G18)
summary: 本文构建了一个包含寡头做市商的多期交易模型，研究交易量和买卖价差的动态变化。模型显示，非策略性交易者会平滑其交易行为，导致信息或流动性冲击后交易持续存在。交易者会迅速利用私有信息进行交易，而将对冲交易推迟到后续时期。做市商的市场力量使其能够在交易动机增强时扩大买卖价差。因此，交易量和买卖价差可能呈现出U型模式。模型校准结果与实证中观察到的买卖价差和交易量的日内模式一致。
ai_comment: 该论文通过考虑做市商的市场力量，同时解释了交易量和买卖价差的U型日内模式，为市场微观结构理论提供了新的视角。

title: The credit supply channel of monetary policy tightening and its distributional impacts
abstract: This paper studies how tightening monetary policy transmits to the economy through the mortgage market and sheds new light on the distributional consequences at both individual and regional levels. We specifically examine the sharp increase in mortgage interest rates during 2022 and 2023. We find that almost all of the decline in mortgages compared to prior years was concentrated in loans that would have had a debt-to-income (DTI) ratio above underwriting thresholds. These effects are even more pronounced for minority and middle-income borrowers. Additionally, regions more affected by the thresholds exhibited greater reductions in mortgage originations, house prices, and consumption.
summary: 本文研究紧缩性货币政策如何通过抵押贷款市场传导至实体经济，并揭示其个体与区域层面的分配效应。具体以2022-2023年抵押贷款利率急剧上升为背景，发现相较于往年，抵押贷款总量下降几乎全部集中于那些债务收入比（DTI）超出承销门槛的贷款。这种效应在少数族裔和中等收入借款人中尤为显著。此外，受门槛影响更大的地区在抵押贷款发放量、房价和消费方面出现更大幅度的下降。
ai_comment: 利用2022-2023年利率急升这一准自然实验，清晰识别了信贷供给渠道的分配效应，对理解货币政策异质性影响有重要贡献。

title: Disclosing and cooling-off: An analysis of insider trading rules
abstract: We analyze two insider-trading regulations recently introduced by the Securities and Exchange Commission: mandatory disclosure and “cooling-off period”. The former requires insiders disclose trading plans at adoption, while the latter mandates a delay period before trading. These policies affect investors’ trading profits, risk sharing, and hence their welfare. If the insider has sufficiently large hedging needs, in contrast to the conventional wisdom from “sunshine trading”, disclosure reduces the welfare of all investors. In our calibration, a longer cooling-off period benefits speculators, and its implications for the insider and hedgers depend on whether the disclosure policy is already in place.
summary: 本文分析了美国证券交易委员会最近引入的两项内幕交易规则：强制披露和冷静期。强制披露要求内部人在采用交易计划时进行披露，而冷静期则强制规定交易前的延迟期。这些政策影响投资者的交易利润、风险分担，进而影响其福利。研究发现，如果内部人具有足够大的对冲需求，与传统的“阳光交易”观点相反，披露会降低所有投资者的福利。在论文的校准中，更长的冷静期有利于投机者，而其对内部人和套期保值者的影响取决于披露政策是否已经实施。
ai_comment: 该论文通过理论建模和校准，挑战了传统“阳光交易”观点，揭示了披露政策在特定条件下的负面福利效应。

title: The cross-border effects of bank capital regulation
abstract: We study the international coordination of bank capital requirements under a host-country rule: the requirement depends on where the borrower, not the bank, is located. In such a regime, countries compete for scarce bank equity capital. Raising a country’s requirement may generate bank capital outflows as well as inflows. We pin down the condition for the sign of the capital flow and the associated externality, and highlight the policy implications. Absent collaboration, overshooting is likely: individual countries have an incentive to increase Basel III’s Counter-Cyclical Capital Buffer too much in good times and cut it too much in bad times.
summary: 本文研究银行资本监管的国际协调问题，具体是在东道国规则下（即资本要求取决于借款人所在地而非银行所在地），各国如何竞争稀缺的银行股本资本。通过理论模型，文章确定了提高一国资本要求导致银行资本流入还是流出的条件，并分析了由此产生的跨境溢出效应。研究指出，在缺乏国际合作的情况下，各国倾向于过度调整：经济繁荣时过度提高巴塞尔III的逆周期资本缓冲，经济衰退时过度削减，从而导致政策过度反应。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了东道国规则下银行资本监管的国际竞争机制，为理解逆周期资本缓冲的跨境溢出和过度反应提供了理论依据，对全球金融监管协调具有重要启示。

title: Racial disparities in the Paycheck Protection Program
abstract: Consistent with contemporaneous research, we document that minority-owned firms were more likely than observationally similar white-owned firms to receive PPP loans from nonbank lenders than from banks. However, we show that this substitution to nonbanks was only partial, resulting in significantly lower PPP take-up by minority-owned firms, particularly Black-owned ones. Location and firm characteristics explain about two-thirds of the 25 percentage point disparity in PPP take-up by Black-owned firms. While there was greater substitution to nonbanks in more racially biased locations, overall take-up was still lower in those locations. Access to professional help with applications facilitated use of nonbanks and mitigated disparities.
summary: 本文研究了薪资保护计划（PPP）中的种族差异。与同期研究一致，发现少数族裔企业比观察上相似的白人企业更可能从非银行贷款机构而非银行获得PPP贷款。然而，这种向非银行的替代只是部分的，导致少数族裔企业（尤其是黑人企业）的PPP参与率显著较低。地理位置和公司特征解释了黑人企业参与率25个百分点差距中的约三分之二。在种族偏见更严重的地区，向非银行的替代更多，但总体参与率仍较低。获得专业申请帮助促进了非银行的使用，并减轻了差距。
ai_comment: 利用贷款数据深入揭示了PPP实施中的种族不平等，并量化了替代效应和地域因素的影响，为政策评估提供了重要实证证据。

title: From Man vs. Machine to Man + Machine: The art and AI of stock analyses
abstract: An AI analyst trained to digest corporate disclosures, industry trends, and macroeconomic indicators surpasses most analysts in stock return predictions. Nevertheless, humans win “Man vs. Machine” when institutional knowledge is crucial, e.g., involving intangible assets and financial distress. AI wins when information is transparent but voluminous. Humans provide significant incremental value in “Man + Machine”, which also substantially reduces extreme errors. Analysts catch up with machines after “alternative data” become available if their employers build AI capabilities. Documented synergies between humans and machines inform how humans can leverage their advantage for better adaptation to the growing AI prowess.
summary: 本文训练了一个AI分析师，它能够消化公司披露、行业趋势和宏观经济指标，在股票回报预测方面超越了大多数人类分析师。然而，在需要机构知识的领域（如涉及无形资产和财务困境时），人类在“人机对抗”中获胜；当信息透明但量庞大时，AI占优。在人机协作模式下，人类提供了显著的增量价值，同时大幅减少了极端错误。如果分析师的雇主构建了AI能力，他们可以在“替代数据”可用后追赶机器。本文记录了人与机器之间的协同效应，为人类如何利用自身优势更好地适应日益强大的AI提供了启示。
ai_comment: 本文实证展示了人机协作的互补优势，而非简单替代，为金融领域AI应用提供了重要实践指导。

title: Inflation and Disintermediation
abstract: We test a bank credit channel through which unexpected increases in inflation lead to short-run macroeconomic fluctuations. For identification, we study an unexpected U.S. inflation increase in early 1977 and exploit differences in state-level reserve requirements for Federal Reserve nonmember banks, which create differences in banks’ inflation exposures. More exposed banks reduce lending, lowering local house prices and construction employment. We provide evidence for potential mechanisms, including a bank net wealth and a loan misallocation channel. Our results suggest that an important consequence of inflation is its impairment of the banking sector.
summary: 该论文研究了银行信贷渠道，即非预期的通胀上升如何导致短期宏观经济波动。通过研究1977年初美国一次非预期的通胀上升，利用不同州对联邦储备非成员银行准备金要求的差异，这些差异导致银行对通胀的暴露程度不同。结果发现，通胀暴露更高的银行减少了贷款，进而降低了当地房价和建筑就业。论文还提供了潜在机制的证据，包括银行净财富渠道和贷款错配渠道。结果表明，通胀的一个重要后果是对银行部门的损害。
ai_comment: 利用州级准备金要求差异作为外生冲击，提供了通胀影响实体经济的微观证据，机制分析清晰。

title: Block trade contracting
abstract: We study the optimal execution problem in a principal–agent setting. A client contracts to purchase from a dealer. The dealer hedges, buying from the market, creating temporary and permanent price impact. The client chooses a contract, which specifies payment as a function of market prices; hidden action precludes conditioning on the dealer’s hedging trades. We show the first-best benchmark is theoretically achievable with an unrestricted contract set. We then consider weighted-average-price contracts, which are commonly used. In the continuous-time limit, the optimal weighting entails a constant density at interior times and discrete masses at the extremes.
summary: 本文研究委托-代理框架下的最优执行问题。客户与经销商签订合约，经销商通过从市场买入进行对冲，这会产生暂时性和永久性的价格影响。客户选择合约，合约支付取决于市场价格，但由于隐藏行动，无法根据经销商的对冲交易进行调整。作者证明，在不受限制的合约集中，理论上可以实现第一最佳基准。随后，他们考虑了实践中常用的加权平均价格合约。在连续时间极限下，最优加权方案涉及内部时间的常数密度和两端的离散质量。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将大宗交易最优执行问题置于委托-代理框架中，理论证明了第一最佳基准的可实现性，并对常见加权平均价格合约的最优权重结构给出了连续时间极限下的解析刻画。

title: Discontinuous Distribution of Test Statistics Around Significance Thresholds in Empirical Accounting Studies
abstract: Examining test statistics from articles in six leading accounting journals, we detect discontinuities in their distributions around conventional significance thresholds ( p‐ values of 0.05 and 0.01) and find an unusual abundance of test statistics that are just significant. Further analysis reveals that these discontinuities are more prominent in studies with smaller samples and are more salient in experimental than in archival studies. The discontinuity discrepancy between experimental and archival studies relates to several proxies for researcher degrees of freedom. Nevertheless, this evidence does not imply that experimental research is more prone to questionable research practices than archival studies. Overall, our findings speak to the concern of whether accounting researchers could exercise undisclosed discretion to obtain and report statistically significant results. Based on our results, a healthy skepticism of some just‐significant test statistics is warranted.
summary: 通过分析六本顶级会计学期刊文章的检验统计量分布，该研究检测到在传统显著性阈值（p值0.05和0.01）附近存在不连续性，且恰好显著的检验统计量异常丰富。进一步分析表明，这种不连续性在小样本研究中更为突出，在实验研究中比在档案研究中更显著。实验与档案研究之间的差异与研究者自由度的若干代理变量相关，但该证据并不暗示实验研究比档案研究更易受可疑研究实践影响。总体而言，研究结果引发了对会计研究者是否可能通过未披露的自由裁量权来获得并报告显著结果的担忧，并主张对某些恰好显著的检验统计量保持健康怀疑。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模数据检测揭示了会计领域可能存在的p值操纵迹象，尤其是实验研究中的不连续性更为显著，但作者谨慎地避免将差异归因于有意的不良行为，为学术诚信讨论提供了统计证据。

title: The Impact of Crisis-Period Interest Rate Declines on Distressed Borrowers
abstract: We measure the causal impact of reductions in benchmark interest rates on the renegotiation and performance of distressed loans, using 2000s subprime mortgages as a laboratory. Subprime borrowers treated with larger benchmark rate reductions benefited from increased debt-renegotiation probabilities and lower debt-service payments. Modification rates were similar among current and delinquent borrowers but higher for real estate investors, highlighting the role of financial acumen in renegotiation. Renegotiations also reduced longer-run foreclosures, but treated borrowers who lingered in delinquency offset these benefits. Findings suggest monetary easing can spur debt renegotiation but alone may not lead to longer-run curative outcomes.
summary: 本文利用2000年代次级抵押贷款数据，实证研究危机时期基准利率下降对困境借款人债务重新谈判和贷款表现的影响。研究发现，基准利率下降幅度较大的借款人获得债务重新谈判的概率更高，且债务服务支付更低。重新谈判率在当前和拖欠借款人之间相似，但房地产投资者更高，凸显了金融知识在重新谈判中的作用。重新谈判减少了长期止赎，但部分借款人长期拖欠抵消了这些益处。结论表明，货币宽松可以促进债务重新谈判，但单独可能无法产生长期治愈效果。
ai_comment: 本文利用自然实验识别了利率下降对债务重新谈判的因果效应，并揭示了其局限性和异质性，对理解货币政策在危机中的传导机制有重要贡献。

title: Tax Policy Expectations and Investment
abstract: This paper examines how firms’ tax policy expectations (TPE) evolve around and relate to their investment responses to changes in tax policy. Using a text‐based approach to measuring TPE, we find that two recent tax policy–changing events—namely, the 2016 U.S. presidential election and the enactment of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA)—spawned considerable between‐ and within‐firm variation in TPE, with aggregate time‐series patterns in TPE occasionally challenging prevailing assumptions in previous research. Further, we observe that event‐induced TPE relate to investment both before and in response to the TCJA's passage in 2017, with offsetting associations between its first and second moments, and that these TPE moderate the TCJA's intended investment‐stimulating effect. Furthermore, we document a difference between domestic and multinational firms in their TPE‐investment response, with the former (latter) more likely to adjust the level (shift the country location) of their investment. Overall, our findings support the idea that TPE can impact investment behavior in the face of a tax policy change and suggest that our methodology can be used by future research to incorporate TPE into analyses of tax policy effects.
summary: 本文研究企业税收政策预期（TPE）如何演变，及其与企业投资对税收政策变化反应的关系。通过基于文本的方法衡量TPE，发现2016年美国总统大选和《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）的颁布这两个最近的税收政策变化事件，在企业间和企业内部引发了显著的TPE差异，且TPE的总体时间序列模式有时挑战了先前研究的普遍假设。进一步观察到，事件引发的TPE与TCJA通过前后的投资相关，其第一矩和第二矩之间存在相互抵消的关联，并且这些TPE减弱了TCJA预期的投资刺激效应。此外，国内企业与跨国企业在TPE与投资反应上存在差异：前者更倾向于调整投资水平，后者更倾向于转移投资的国家地点。总体而言，研究支持TPE在税收政策变化时影响投资行为的观点，并表明该方法可用于未来研究将TPE纳入税收政策效应的分析中。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用文本分析方法度量企业税收政策预期，揭示了预期在税收政策传导中的关键作用，尤其区分了国内与跨国企业的不同反应，为理解税收政策效果的微观机制提供了新视角。

title: Court Disclosures of Firms in Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
abstract: Stakeholders in the Chapter 11 reorganization process face significant information uncertainty about the post‐emergence prospects of the firm. The U.S. Bankruptcy Code requires a debtor to provide a disclosure statement containing “adequate information” about its financial status and a proposed reorganization plan but stops short of rigidly defining the adequacy standard. We document the heterogeneity in disclosure statement information across 16 distinct attributes and examine the variation in disclosures along several dimensions that reflect agency costs and coordination problems. We observe that Chapter 11 disclosure correlates more with claimant‐ and case‐specific characteristics than pre‐bankruptcy debtor characteristics. Our results illustrate the importance of institutional features in specific disclosure settings such as bankruptcy court filings. The research questions and methods of this study were registered via the Journal of Accounting Research ’s registration‐based editorial process.
summary: 本文研究美国破产法第11章重组过程中，利益相关者面临公司重组后前景的重大信息不确定性。法律要求债务人提供包含“充足信息”的披露声明，但未严格定义“充足”标准。作者记录了16个不同属性下披露声明的信息异质性，并考察了反映代理成本和协调问题的多个维度上的披露变化。发现Chapter 11披露更多地与索赔人和案件特定特征相关，而非破产前债务人特征。结果强调了破产法院备案等特定披露环境中制度特征的重要性。该研究的问题和方法通过Journal of Accounting Research的注册编辑流程进行注册。
ai_comment: 本文通过注册研究方式提高了透明度，系统性地刻画了破产披露的异质性及其制度影响因素，对理解特定披露环境下的信息提供有重要贡献。

title: The Imitation Game: The Imitation Game: How Encouraging Renegotiation Makes Good Borrowers Bad
abstract: We show that commercial mortgage borrowers behave opportunistically to attempt to obtain principal reductions. We develop a model in which lenders cannot perfectly observe borrowers’ use values and renegotiation is costly. We then exploit a tax rule change that reduced the cost of renegotiation. Consistent with the model predictions, borrowers with high private use values of the property are more likely to transfer into special servicing when lenders have a higher capacity to negotiate principal reductions after the rule change. Our results suggest adverse consequences of principal forgiveness for lenders.
summary: 本文研究商业抵押贷款借款人如何通过机会主义行为试图获得本金减免。作者构建了一个模型，其中贷款人无法完美观察借款人的使用价值，且重新谈判成本高昂。利用一项税收规则变化（降低了重新谈判成本）作为准自然实验，实证发现：在规则变化后，当贷款人更有能力协商本金减免时，具有高私人使用价值的借款人更可能将贷款转入特殊服务。这一结果表明，本金减免对贷款人可能产生不利后果，即鼓励了借款人的投机行为。
ai_comment: 巧妙利用税收规则变化识别因果关系，揭示了贷款减免中的逆向选择风险，对债务契约设计有重要启示。

title: Capital Investment, Equity Returns, and Aggregate Dynamics in Oligopolistic Production Economies
abstract: We analyze effects of tacit collusion in a dynamic general equilibrium model of oligopolistic sectors with capital investment and real frictions. Through their effects on equilibrium- and off-equilibrium stock prices, fundamental shocks affect incentives for defection from tacit collusion, amplifying the interaction between the real economy and financial markets as well as firms’ risk exposure. The model implies ambiguous relationship between industry concentration and equity returns depending on operating leverage, which helps reconcile conflicting evidence in the literature. We find quantitative and empirical support for novel theoretical predictions regarding the effects of concentration on returns and investment.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含资本投资和实际摩擦的寡头垄断生产经济体的动态一般均衡模型，分析默契合谋（tacit collusion）的影响。基本冲击通过影响均衡和非均衡股票价格，改变企业背离合谋的激励，从而放大实体经济与金融市场的相互作用以及企业的风险暴露。模型表明行业集中度与股票回报之间的关系不确定，取决于经营杠杆（operating leverage），这有助于解释文献中的矛盾证据。文章为集中度对回报和投资影响的新理论预测提供了定量和实证支持。
ai_comment: 本文将产业组织理论中的合谋行为引入资产定价，为行业集中度与股票回报的关系提供了新的解释，并调和了现有文献中的矛盾。模型框架丰富且具有实证支撑。

title: Duration-Based Valuation of Corporate Bonds
abstract: We decompose corporate bond and equity index returns into duration-matched government bond returns and the excess returns over this duration-matched counterfactual, which we term duration-adjusted returns. Compared with previously used excess return definitions (ie, returns in excess of Treasury bills), our decomposition leads to markedly different return patterns and asset pricing implications. In particular, we find that investment-grade bonds earn a small credit risk premium, comparable in magnitude to the convenience yield, and that duration adjustment resolves the CAPM’s failure to price corporate bonds. These findings highlight the importance of adjusting for nonstationary interest rate environments in asset pricing tests.
summary: 本文将公司债券和股票指数收益分解为久期匹配的国债收益和相对于该久期匹配反事实的超额收益，称之为久期调整收益。与以往使用的超额收益定义（即超过国库券的收益）相比，这种分解导致了显著不同的收益模式和资产定价含义。具体而言，我们发现投资级债券获得较小的信用风险溢价，其规模与便利收益相当，并且久期调整解决了CAPM无法对公司债券进行定价的问题。这些发现强调了在资产定价测试中调整非平稳利率环境的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文通过久期调整方法，揭示了传统CAPM在公司债券定价上的失效原因，并指出利率环境非平稳性的关键影响，为资产定价提供了新的视角。

title: Socially Responsible Finance: How to Optimize Impact
abstract: Can a socially responsible fund (SRF) improve social welfare while maximizing assets under management? We consider a two-sector model integrating financial intermediation, emissions’ negative externalities, and investors’ social preferences with regard to value alignment and impact. In scenarios with a high proportion of value-aligned investors, the SRF invests in clean sectors and compels recipients companies to use low-emission suppliers from the polluting sector, which appeals to both investor types. Alternatively, the SRF adopts a dual-fund approach, with one fund targeting clean sectors for value-aligned investors and another focusing on reducing direct emissions in polluting sectors to attract impact investors.
summary: 该论文研究社会责任基金（SRF）如何在最大化管理资产的同时改善社会福利。作者构建了一个两部门模型，整合了金融中介、排放的负外部性以及投资者在价值一致性和影响力方面的社会偏好。模型显示，当价值一致型投资者比例较高时，SRF投资于清洁部门，并迫使被投资公司使用来自污染部门的低碳供应商，从而同时吸引两种类型的投资者。另一种策略是采用双基金方法：一只基金针对清洁部门以吸引价值一致型投资者，另一只基金专注于减少污染部门的直接排放以吸引影响力投资者。
ai_comment: 论文创新地提出了双基金策略，为解决社会责任投资中价值一致与影响力目标之间的权衡提供了理论框架。模型简洁但富有洞察力，对理解ESG投资实践有指导意义。

title: Internalizing Peer Firm Product Market Concerns: Supply Chain Relations and M&A Activity
abstract: We explore whether firms internalize the product market concerns of their economically linked peers by examining merger and acquisition decisions in the context of customer–supplier relations. Given the extensive transfer of capital, knowledge, and information between merging parties, we hypothesize that customers’ competition concerns discourage their suppliers from engaging in vertically conflicted transactions (i.e., acquisitions of their customers’ rivals or suppliers to those rivals). Consistent with our hypothesis, we find that suppliers are less likely to engage in such transactions when their customers are subject to higher product market competition. Moreover, the effect is more pronounced when suppliers and customers have greater relationship‐specific investments and when customers face heightened proprietary information concerns. Using plausibly exogenous variation in common ownership between customers and their rivals as a shock to customers’ competition concerns, we conclude that the link between customers’ competition concerns and supplier acquisitions is likely causal. Our findings suggest that firms alter their investment and strategic decisions in response to the product market competition concerns of their economically related peers.
summary: 本文研究企业是否在并购决策中内化其经济关联同行的产品市场竞争担忧，聚焦于客户-供应商关系。假设客户的竞争担忧会抑制供应商进行垂直冲突的交易（即收购客户的竞争对手或这些竞争对手的供应商）。通过分析并购数据，发现当客户面临更高的产品市场竞争时，供应商更少从事此类交易；该效应在关系特定投资较大或客户专有信息担忧较强时更显著。利用客户与竞争对手之间的共同所有权变化作为客户竞争担忧的外生冲击，表明客户竞争担忧与供应商并购之间的因果关系。结论显示企业会根据经济关联同行的产品市场竞争担忧调整投资与战略决策。
ai_comment: 本文通过客户-供应商关系视角揭示了企业内化经济关联同伴竞争担忧的机制，并利用外生冲击建立因果识别，为并购决策与供应链互动文献提供了新证据。

title: Are Bankruptcy Professional Fees Excessively High?
abstract: Chapter 7 is the most popular bankruptcy system for U.S. firms and individuals. Chapter 7 professional fees are substantial. Theoretically, high fees might be an unavoidable cost of incentivizing professionals. I test this empirically. I study trustees, the most important professionals in chapter 7, who liquidate assets in exchange for legally mandated commissions. Exploiting kinks in the commission function, I estimate a structural model of moral hazard by trustees. I show that a policy change lowering trustee fees would harm trustee incentives, reducing liquidation values. Nonetheless, such a policy would dramatically improve creditor recovery, increasing small-business-lender recovery by 15.7%.
summary: 本文研究美国破产法第7章中专业费用是否过高。第7章是美国企业和个人最常用的破产系统，专业费用高昂。理论上，高费用可能是激励专业人士的不可避免成本。作者通过实证检验这一观点，聚焦于第7章中最重要的专业人士——受托人，他们以法定佣金为交换清算资产。利用佣金函数中的拐点，估计受托人道德风险的结构模型。结果表明，降低受托人费用的政策变化会损害受托人激励，从而降低清算价值，但会显著提高债权人回收率，使小企业贷款人的回收率增加15.7%。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型揭示了受托人费用与债权人回收之间的权衡，为破产费用监管提供了重要的实证依据。

title: The Brand Premium
abstract: We highlight the limitations of using cumulative advertising expenses as an input measure of brand value. Using two output measures—Interbrand’s data and a novel text-based measure—we find that an equal-weighted portfolio of top brands yields an annual abnormal return of 3%. The excess returns are driven by companies that develop their brands internally. Intangible factors proposed in the literature have no explanatory power for the premium. Analysts underestimate the future earnings of top brands, leading to significant excess returns following earnings announcements. We find no abnormal returns associated with the input measure of brand value. (JEL G4, G12, G14, M41)
summary: 本文指出现有文献用累计广告支出来度量品牌价值（输入法）存在局限，转而采用两种输出度量——Interbrand的品牌价值数据和基于文本分析的新指标。研究发现，等权重持有顶级品牌的股票年化异常收益达3%，这种超额收益主要由内部开发品牌的公司贡献，而文献中常见的无形资产定价因子无法解释该溢价。进一步分析显示，分析师对顶级品牌公司未来盈利的预测系统性偏低，导致财报公告后出现显著的超额收益；相比之下，基于广告支出的输入度量与未来收益无关。
ai_comment: 本文通过输出度量重新审视品牌价值在资产定价中的作用，并揭示了分析师预测偏差是品牌溢价的关键驱动机制，为理解无形资产价值提供了新的实证证据。

title: Global Evolution of Environmental and Social Disclosure in Annual Reports
abstract: We study environmental and social (E&S) disclosures in annual reports. Using the word embedding model to examine over 210,000 annual reports from 24,271 public firms in 30 international countries/regions between 2001 and 2020, we create an E&S dictionary that allows us to document trends in annual report E&S disclosure. Specifically, we find: (1) increases in length and boilerplate language and (2) decreases in specificity. Our results also suggest that E&S disclosure quality improves after the adoption of voluntary ESG reporting frameworks but deteriorates after disclosure mandates. Our findings provide systematic evidence on the evolution of E&S disclosure in annual reports over the past two decades and shed light on how voluntary and mandatory standards have shaped global E&S reporting practices.
summary: 本文利用词嵌入模型，研究了2001年至2020年间来自30个国际国家/地区的24,271家上市公司的超过21万份年度报告中的环境和社会（E&S）披露。通过构建E&S词典，作者记录了年度报告中E&S披露的趋势。主要发现包括：(1) 披露长度增加，模板化语言增多；(2) 具体性下降。此外，研究结果表明，在自愿采用ESG报告框架后，E&S披露质量提高，但在强制披露要求实施后质量下降。这些发现提供了过去二十年E&S披露演变的系统性证据，并揭示了自愿和强制标准如何塑造全球E&S报告实践。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模跨国数据揭示了E&S披露在自愿与强制框架下的相反效应，为政策制定提供了重要实证依据。

title: Syndicated Lending, Competition, and Relative Performance Evaluation
abstract: Relative performance evaluation (RPE) intensifies competitive pressure by tying executive compensation to the profits of rivals. We show that these contracts make loan syndication harder by reducing banks’ willingness to participate in loans underwritten by banks named in their RPE contracts. Lead arranger banks, which are more frequently named in RPE, hold larger shares of the loans they syndicate, and their borrowers receive smaller and fewer loans and face higher spreads. Our results highlight the tension between the normal benefits of competition versus the need for cooperation in loan syndication.
summary: 相对业绩评价（RPE）通过将高管薪酬与竞争对手的利润挂钩，加剧了银行间的竞争压力。本文发现，这种激励合同使得银团贷款更加困难，因为银行不愿参与由RPE合同中指定的银行（通常是主承销行）承销的贷款。主承销行更频繁地被列入RPE合同，因此它们在银团贷款中持有更大份额，并且其借款人获得的贷款规模更小、数量更少，同时面临更高的利差。研究结果揭示了竞争的正常收益与银团贷款所需合作之间的紧张关系。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将高管薪酬激励与银团贷款市场联系起来，揭示了竞争与合作之间的微观冲突，对理解银行间合作机制和信贷市场结构具有重要启示。

title: Student Loans, Access to Credit, and Consumer Credit Demand
abstract: This paper provides novel evidence that increased student loan debts, caused by rising tuitions, increase borrowers’ demand for additional consumer debt, while simultaneously restricting their ability to access it. The net effect of student loan debt on consumer borrowing varies by market, depending on whether the supply or demand channel dominates. In loosely underwritten credit markets, increased student loan debt causes borrowing to increase, while in tightly underwritten markets, increased student loan debt reduces credit use. These findings match predictions of a standard life cycle model of household consumption and borrowing, augmented by a realistic student loan repayment contract. (JEL G51, D15, I22, D14)
summary: 本文研究了学费上涨导致的学生贷款债务增加如何影响借款人对额外消费信贷的需求和获取能力。结果表明，学生贷款债务增加会同时提高消费信贷需求（需求渠道）并限制信贷可得性（供给渠道）。在信贷审核宽松的市场中，学生贷款债务增加导致消费借贷上升；而在审核严格的市场中，学生贷款债务增加则减少了信贷使用。这些发现与包含现实学生贷款还款合同的家庭消费与借贷标准生命周期模型的预测一致。
ai_comment: 本文的贡献在于区分了学生贷款对消费信贷的需求和供给效应，并利用生命周期模型提供了理论解释，对理解学生贷款的经济影响具有重要政策含义。

title: The Technical Default Spread
abstract: We study the quantitative impact of lender control rights on corporate investment, asset prices, and the aggregate economy. We build a general equilibrium model in which the breaching of a loan covenant (technical default) entails a switch in investment control rights from borrowers to lenders. Lenders optimally choose low-risk projects, thus mitigating borrowers’ risk-taking incentives and lowering the cost of equity. This mechanism generates strong macroeconomic effects and mitigates the financial accelerator. Consistent with our model, proximity to technical default in the data is associated with 4.12% lower returns and lower exposure to systematic risk.
summary: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，研究贷款契约中技术违约对控制权转移的影响。当借款人违反贷款契约（技术违约）时，投资控制权从借款人转移到贷款人，贷款人倾向于选择低风险项目，从而抑制借款人的风险承担动机并降低股权成本。该机制产生显著的宏观经济效应，并缓解金融加速器的作用。实证分析表明，接近技术违约的公司在数据中呈现出4.12%的更低收益率和更低的系统性风险暴露，与模型预测一致。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将贷款契约的技术违约与控制权转移纳入一般均衡框架，揭示了其对企业投资、资产价格及宏观经济的系统性影响，为理解金融摩擦提供了新视角。

title: Horizon-Dependent Risk Aversion and the Timing and Pricing of Uncertainty
abstract: Inspired by experimental evidence, we amend the recursive utility model to let risk aversion decrease with the temporal horizon. Our pseudo-recursive preferences remain tractable and retain appealing features of the long-run risk framework, notably its success at explaining asset pricing moments. In addition, our model addresses two challenges to the standard model. Calibrating the agents’ preferences to explain the equity premium no longer implies an extreme preference for early resolutions of uncertainty. Horizon-dependent risk aversion helps resolve key puzzles in finance on the valuation of assets across maturities and captures the term structure of equity risk premiums and its dynamics.
summary: 基于实验证据，本文修正了递归效用模型，使风险厌恶随期限缩短而降低。所提出的伪递归偏好保持了可处理性，并保留了长期风险框架的成功特征，特别是解释资产定价矩的能力。此外，该模型解决了标准模型面临的两个挑战：校准代理人偏好以解释股权溢价不再需要极端的早期不确定性解决偏好；期限依赖的风险厌恶有助于解决金融中关于资产跨期限估值的核心谜题，并捕捉股权风险溢价的期限结构及其动态。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将实验证据中的期限依赖风险厌恶引入资产定价模型，在不牺牲可解性的前提下，较好地解释了股权溢价和期限结构等难题，是对长期风险框架的重要补充。

title: Credit Cycles, Expectations, and Corporate Investment
abstract: We provide a systematic empirical assessment of the Minsky hypothesis that business fluctuations stem from irrational swings in expectations. Using predictable firm-level forecast errors, we build an aggregate index of irrational expectations and use it to provide three sets of results. First, we show that our index predicts aggregate credit cycles. Next, we show that these predictable credit cycles drive cycles in firm-level debt issuance and investment and similar cycles between financially constrained and unconstrained firms, as Minsky predicts. Finally, we show more pronounced cycles in firm-level financing and investment for firms with ex ante more optimistic expectations. (JEL G31, G32, G40, E32, E44)
summary: 本文系统性地实证评估了明斯基假说，即经济波动源于预期的非理性波动。利用可预测的企业层面预测误差，构建了一个非理性预期综合指数，并据此提供三组结果：第一，该指数能够预测总体信贷周期；第二，这些可预测的信贷周期驱动企业层面的债务发行和投资周期，且财务受限与非受限企业表现出类似周期，符合明斯基预测；第三，对于事前更乐观预期的企业，其融资和投资的周期波动更为显著。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建非理性预期指数，为明斯基的金融不稳定假说提供了有力的企业层面证据，并揭示了预期、信贷与投资之间的动态传导机制。

title: Sexism, Culture, and Firm Value: Evidence from the Harvey Weinstein Scandal and the #MeToo Movement
abstract: During the revelation of the Harvey Weinstein scandal and the reemergence of the #MeToo movement, firms with a nonsexist corporate culture, proxied by having women among the five highest‐paid executives, earn excess returns of 1.3% relative to firms without female top executives. These returns are driven by changes in investor preferences toward firms with a nonsexist culture. Institutional ownership increases in firms with a nonsexist culture after the Weinstein/#MeToo events, particularly for investors with larger holdings and investors with a lower ESG focus ex ante. Firms without female top executives improve gender diversity after these events, particularly in more sexist states and in industries with few women executives. Our evidence attests to the value of having a nonsexist corporate culture and indicates that changes in societal norms toward women are permeating into capital markets and corporations.
summary: 本研究利用哈维·韦恩斯坦丑闻和#MeToo运动的曝光作为外生冲击，考察性别歧视文化对公司价值的影响。以最高薪酬高管中是否有女性作为非性别歧视文化的代理变量，发现事件期间，拥有女性高管的公司相比没有女性高管的公司获得1.3%的超额收益，且该收益主要由投资者偏好变化驱动。机构投资者在事件后增持非性别歧视文化的公司，尤其是大额持股者和此前ESG关注度较低的投资者。此外，没有女性高管的公司在事件后提高了性别多样性，特别是在性别歧视更严重的州和女性高管较少的行业。研究证明非性别歧视文化具有价值，并表明社会规范变化正在渗透到资本市场和公司决策中。
ai_comment: 巧妙地利用外生事件识别公司文化价值的因果效应，为社会运动影响资本市场提供了有力证据。

title: Proxy Advisory Firms and Corporate Shareholder Engagement
abstract: We study how Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) affect firms’ engagement with shareholders. Our analyses exploit a quasi-natural experiment using say-on-pay voting outcomes near a threshold that triggers ISS to review engagement activities. Firms receiving ISS treatment exhibit swift and substantive increases in extensive and intensive margins of engagement, especially when their boards have higher agency conflicts and directors are more likely to lose voting support from ISS. Increases in engagement persist over time, and shareholders appear to value the increased engagement. Collectively, we shed light on an unexplored channel through which ISS positively influences firms’ governance and information environments.
summary: 本文研究机构股东服务公司（ISS）如何影响公司与股东之间的互动。利用薪酬话语权投票结果接近一个阈值（触发ISS审查公司互动活动）的准自然实验，发现受到ISS处理的公司在互动广度和深度上迅速且显著增加，尤其是在董事会代理冲突较高以及董事更可能失去ISS投票支持的情况下。这种互动增加具有持续性，且股东似乎重视这种增加。总体而言，本文揭示了ISS通过一个未被探索的渠道正面影响公司治理和信息环境。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验识别因果关系，揭示了代理咨询公司通过审查机制促进公司-股东互动的渠道，对理解外部治理机制有重要贡献。

title: A Comprehensive 2022 Look at the Empirical Performance of Equity Premium Prediction
abstract: Our paper reexamines whether 29 variables from 26 papers published after Goyal and Welch 2008, as well as the original 17 variables, were useful in predicting the equity premium in-sample and out-of-sample as of the end of 2021. Our samples include the original periods in which these variables were identified, but end later. More than one-third of these new variables no longer have empirical significance even in-sample. Of those that do, half have poor out-of-sample performance. A small number of variables still perform reasonably well both in-sample and out-of-sample.
summary: 本文重新检验了Goyal和Welch（2008）之后发表的26篇论文中的29个变量以及原始17个变量在预测权益溢价方面的实证表现，样本覆盖原始时期但截至2021年底。研究发现，超过三分之一的新变量在样本内已不再具有统计显著性；在仍显著的变量中，有一半样本外表现不佳。仅有少数变量在样本内和样本外均表现合理。
ai_comment: 系统性地更新了权益溢价预测变量的实证表现，揭示了众多新变量预测能力下降的现状。

title: Machine Learning for Continuous-Time Finance
abstract: We develop an algorithm for solving a large class of nonlinear high-dimensional continuous-time models in finance. We approximate value and policy functions using deep learning and show that a combination of automatic differentiation and Ito’s lemma allows for the computation of exact expectations, resulting in a negligible computational cost that is independent of the number of state variables. We illustrate the applicability of our method to problems in asset pricing, corporate finance, and portfolio choice and show that the ability to solve high-dimensional problems allows us to derive new economic insights.
summary: 本文提出了一种用于求解金融中广泛非线性高维连续时间模型的算法。该方法利用深度学习近似值函数和策略函数，并结合自动微分与伊藤引理实现精确期望的计算，其计算成本与状态变量数量无关。作者将该方法应用于资产定价、公司金融和投资组合选择等问题，并展示了解决高维问题所带来的新经济洞察。
ai_comment: 该研究通过深度学习与伊藤引理的巧妙结合，突破了传统连续时间模型中高维度求解的计算瓶颈，为金融计量领域提供了强有力的新工具。

title: On the EPA's Radar: The Role of Financial Reports in Environmental Regulatory Oversight
abstract: This paper investigates the role of corporate financial reports in the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) regulatory activities. By tracking the EPA's direct retrieval of SEC filings, we identify three key findings. First, the EPA retrieves a large volume of financial reports, especially from firms in high‐pollution industries. Second, the EPA is more likely to access financial reports during enforcement investigations and significant rule proposals, but less so during compliance monitoring, with patterns varying predictably across firms. Third, the EPA's reliance on financial reports is potentially driven by its demand for information on firm liquidity, solvency, and profitability. Overall, our study highlights the usefulness of financial reports for the EPA as an environmental regulator.
summary: 本文研究美国环保署（EPA）如何利用企业财务报告进行监管。通过追踪EPA直接检索SEC文件的行为，发现三个关键结果：首先，EPA检索大量财务报告，尤其是高污染行业的企业；其次，EPA在执法调查和重要规则提案期间更可能访问财务报告，但合规监测期间较少，且模式在不同企业间有可预测的差异；第三，EPA对财务报告的依赖可能源于其对流动性、偿付能力和盈利能力信息的需求。总体而言，研究突出了财务报告对作为环境监管者的EPA的实用价值。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将会计信息与环保监管联系起来，揭示了财务报告在非传统用户（如环境监管机构）中的实际用途，拓展了会计信息有用性的研究边界。

title: Financial Transparency of Private Firms: Evidence from a Randomized Field Experiment
abstract: This paper examines why private firms choose to be financially transparent or opaque by conducting a field experiment with more than 25,000 firms in Germany. We inform a randomly chosen set of firms about a disclosure option that allows eligible firms to restrict access to their otherwise publicly available financial statements. We also vary the messaging in subtle ways to induce experimental variation in the probability that firms take transacting (capital providers or customers and suppliers) versus non‐transacting stakeholders (competitors or general interest parties) into consideration when making their filing decision. Based on each firm's actual filing decision, we find that treated firms are 15% more likely to restrict access to their financial statements. This intention‐to‐treat effect is persistent and concentrated among firms that should derive lower net benefits from disclosure (smaller, more mature firms in less capital‐intensive industries). These findings indicate that informational constraints affect firms’ disclosure practice. Additionally, we show that the treatment effect is almost 40% larger for firms that have a higher, exogenously induced, probability of considering non‐transacting stakeholders when making their disclosure decision. By analyzing subsequent firm activity and complementary survey evidence, we also provide suggestive evidence that disclosure requirements put an undue burden on very small private firms.
summary: 本文通过一项在德国超过25,000家企业中进行的实地实验，探讨了私营企业为何选择财务透明或不透明。实验随机告知一组企业关于一项披露选项，该选项允许合格企业限制对其原本公开的财务报表的访问。同时，通过微妙的信息变化，实验诱导企业在做出申报决策时考虑交易方（资本提供者或客户和供应商）与非交易方（竞争对手或一般利益相关者）的概率。基于每家企业的实际申报决策，发现处理组企业限制访问的可能性高出15%。这一意向处理效应是持久的，并集中在那些从披露中获得的净收益较低的企业（规模较小、更成熟、资本密集度较低的行业）。这些结果表明信息约束影响企业的披露实践。此外，处理效应对于外生诱导的考虑非交易方利益相关者概率更高的企业几乎大40%。通过分析后续企业活动和补充调查证据，本文还提供了暗示性证据，表明披露要求对非常小的私营企业造成了过度负担。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模实地实验提供了私营企业财务透明度的因果证据，揭示了信息约束和利益相关者考虑在披露决策中的重要作用，对理解小企业的披露负担有政策启示。

title: APT or “AIPT”? The Surprising Dominance of Large Factor Models
abstract: We introduce artificial intelligence pricing theory (AIPT).In contrast with the APT's foundational assumption of a low dimensional factor structure in returns, the AIPT conjectures that returns are driven by a large number of factors.We first verify this conjecture empirically and show that complex nonlinear models with an exorbitant number of factors (many more than the number of training observations or base assets) are far more successful in describing the out-of-sample behavior of asset returns than simpler benchmark models.Economically, we show that complex models are more than twice as sensitive to long-run macroeconomic activity than simpler benchmarks.Finally, we theoretically characterize the behavior of large factor pricing models, from which we show that the AIPT's "many factors" conjecture faithfully explains our empirical findings, while the APT's "few factors" conjecture is contradicted by the data.
summary: 本文提出人工智能定价理论（AIPT），与经典套利定价理论（APT）假设的低维因子结构相反，AIPT认为资产收益由大量因子驱动。实证上，使用因子数量远超训练样本或基础资产的复杂非线性模型，在描述资产收益的样本外行为方面显著优于简单基准模型。经济意义上，复杂模型对长期宏观经济活动的敏感度是简单基准模型的两倍以上。理论上，论文刻画了大因子定价模型的行为特征，表明AIPT的“多因子”假设能够合理解释实证发现，而APT的“少因子”假设与数据相悖。
ai_comment: 该论文挑战了经典的APT低维因子假设，提出并验证了“多因子”定价理论，为资产定价研究开辟了新方向。其结合大模型与宏观经济敏感性的分析具有重要启示。

title: Cross-Border Shopping: Evidence and Welfare Implications for Switzerland
abstract: Consumers access foreign goods by purchasing them domestically or shopping abroad.We present new facts on cross-border shopping by Swiss households showing, for example, that prices of identical products are lower in neighboring countries, cross-border shopping shares fall with distance to the border, and price gaps and cross-border shopping shares rose following the 2015 Swiss Franc appreciation.We use a simple model of cross-border shopping to quantify how variation across space in cross-border shopping results in heterogeneous changes in cost-of-living in response to changes in international prices such as the 2015 Swiss Franc Appreciation and the 2020 Covid-19-related closing of the border.
summary: 本文研究了瑞士家庭的跨境购物行为，提供了新事实：相同产品在邻国价格更低；跨境购物份额随距边境距离增加而下降；2015年瑞士法郎升值后，价格差距和跨境购物份额均上升。利用一个简单的跨境购物模型，量化了跨境购物在空间上的异质性如何导致生活成本对国际价格变化（如2015年瑞士法郎升值和2020年因新冠疫情关闭边境）的异质性反应。
ai_comment: 利用家庭微观数据揭示跨境购物的空间异质性，并量化其对福利的影响，为国际贸易和汇率政策提供了新视角。

title: Currency Centrality in Equity Markets, Exchange Rates and Global Financial Cycles
abstract: The paper explores empirically the tight links between exchange rates and the global network of equity holdings.Exchange rates can be expressed in terms of "equity net currency supplies", i.e. local currency stock market capitalization minus equity holdings, denominated in investors' currencies, as well as elasticities, reflecting the "centrality" of currencies in global equity markets.The observed components of our exchange rate decomposition account for, on average, 95% of the monthly variation of 28 bilateral currency crosses vis--vis the USD and 98% vis--vis the EUR.We use the decomposition to elucidate the unique role of the USD in transmitting risk aversion and U.S. macroeconomic news throughout the global equity network.Our findings contribute towards explaining global financial cycles and "risk-on"/"risk-off" episodes.
summary: 本文实证研究了汇率与全球股票持有网络之间的紧密联系。汇率可以被分解为“股票净货币供给”（即本地股票市场市值减去以投资者货币计价的股票持有量）以及反映货币在全球股票市场中“中心性”的弹性。该分解的观测成分平均解释了28种货币对美元双边汇率月度变动的95%，对欧元为98%。利用这一分解，本文阐明了美元在通过全球股票网络传递风险厌恶和美国宏观经济新闻中的独特作用。研究结果有助于解释全球金融周期和“风险偏好/风险规避”事件。
ai_comment: 提出了一种基于股票持有网络的汇率新分解方法，直观揭示了美元在全球金融周期中的核心地位，为理解汇率联动性和风险传导提供了新视角。

title: Financial Advice and Investor Beliefs: Experimental Evidence on Active vs. Passive Strategies
abstract: Using a randomized controlled trial we test how retail investors assess and update their priors based on different types of financial advice, which either aligns with their priors or goes against it.We compare advice that emphasizes either the benefits of passive investment strategies (such as diversification and low fees) or active strategies (such as stock picking and market timing).We find that participants rate advice significantly higher when it aligns with their priors rather than contradicts them.But people update their beliefs about investment strategies in the direction of the advice they receive, independent of their priors.At the same time, there is significant heterogeneity based on the subjects' financial literacy.Financially more literate subjects positively update in response to seeing passive advice, but most do not update (and rate the advice negatively) when exposed to active advice.In contrast, financially less literate subjects are strongly influenced by both types of advice.Finally, subjects rate the advice lower if the advisor is perceived to have misaligned incentives compared to when they are more aligned.
summary: 通过随机对照实验，研究零售投资者如何评估和更新对不同类型财务建议的先验信念。实验比较了强调被动投资策略（如分散化和低费用）与主动策略（如选股和市场时机）的建议。结果发现，参与者对与先验一致的建议评分显著更高，但会根据所获建议更新对投资策略的信念，且与先验无关。同时，存在基于金融素养的显著异质性：金融素养较高的对象在收到被动建议时正向更新，但多数在接触主动建议时不更新并负面评价；金融素养较低的对象受两种建议强烈影响。此外，如果认为顾问激励不一致，参与者评分更低。
ai_comment: 实验揭示先验信念和金融素养对建议采纳的差异影响，为理财建议的针对性设计提供启示。

title: Fiscal and Monetary Policy with Heterogeneous Agents
abstract: In the past decade, a new paradigm for fiscal and monetary policy analysis has emerged, combining the canonical macro model of income and wealth inequality with the New Keynesian model.These Heterogeneous-Agent New Keynesian ("HANK") models feature new transmission channels and allow for the joint study of aggregate and distributional effects.We review key developments in this literature through the lens of a canonical HANK model.Monetary and balanced-budget fiscal policy have similar aggregate effects as in the standard new Keynesian model, while deficitfinanced fiscal policy is much more expansionary.We discuss the split between direct and indirect effects of policy, and also the implications of cyclical income risk, maturity structure, nominal assets, behavioral frictions, and many other extensions to the model.Throughout, we highlight the benefits of using sequence-space methods to solve and analyze this class of models.
summary: 该论文综述了近年来兴起的异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。该模型将收入与财富不平等的典型宏观模型与新凯恩斯模型相结合，形成了财政与货币政策分析的新范式。HANK模型具有新的传导渠道，能够同时研究总量效应和分配效应。论文通过一个典型HANK模型回顾了该文献的关键发展。结果表明，货币政策和平衡预算财政政策的总体效应与标准新凯恩斯模型相似，而赤字融资的财政政策则更具扩张性。论文还讨论了政策的直接与间接效应划分，以及周期性收入风险、期限结构、名义资产、行为摩擦等众多扩展的含义。论文强调了使用序列空间方法求解和分析这类模型的好处。
ai_comment: 该文系统梳理了HANK模型的理论框架与最新进展，对理解宏观政策与不平等之间的关系具有重要参考价值。

title: Evaluating Monetary Policy Counterfactuals: (When) Do We Need Structural Models?
abstract: To evaluate the evolution of the macro-economy under alternative assumptions on monetary policy, it suffices, under weak structural assumptions, to know the causal effects of monetary shocks on macroeconomic outcomes.The existing empirical literature estimates the effects of monetary shocks to the short end of the yield curve, thus allowing the evaluation of counterfactuals that change assumptions on near-term policy.If the contemplated policy changes are instead more persistent, then model structure becomes necessary, for one sole purpose: to extrapolate from the estimated short-end effects to those of policy shocks further out on the yield curve.Among popular models of monetary policy transmission, market incompleteness (i.e., "HANK") does not change this extrapolation much, while behavioral frictions do.
summary: 本文探讨在评估货币政策反事实时是否需要结构性模型。作者论证，在弱结构假设下，只需知道货币冲击对宏观经济结果的因果效应，即可评估短期政策变化（如调整短期利率）的反事实。然而，若政策变化更为持久（如长期利率目标），则必须借助模型结构将短期冲击效应外推至长期。通过比较主流货币政策传导模型，研究发现市场不完全性（如HANK模型）对外推结果影响不大，而行为摩擦（如有限理性）则显著改变外推结论。
ai_comment: 本文清晰界定了何时需要结构性模型，并揭示了行为摩擦在政策外推中的关键作用，对实证货币政策研究具有重要指导意义。

title: Do Investor Differences Impact Monetary Policy Spillovers to Emerging Markets?
abstract: We re-examine monetary policy spillovers to Emerging Market Economies (EME) in the form of capital flow reversals, using sectoral-level securities holdings data for Euro Area investors.In response to a surprise monetary tightening, active investors such as investment funds re-balance their portfolios away from EME, while more passive, long term investors such as insurance funds and banks exhibit no significant reaction on average.For active investors, the reallocation out of EME appears stronger under synchronized monetary tightening between the Fed and the ECB.However, these investors may even inject more capital to EME securities when the monetary tightening surprises contain positive news about the Euro Area economy.Issuers' monetary-fiscal stability may explain the heterogeneous impact of these spillovers.
summary: 该论文重新审视了货币政策溢出效应对新兴市场经济体（EME）资本流动逆转的影响，利用欧元区投资者的部门级证券持有数据。研究发现，面对意外货币政策紧缩，活跃投资者（如投资基金）会重新平衡投资组合，减少对EME的配置；而更为被动的长期投资者（如保险基金和银行）平均而言没有显著反应。对于活跃投资者，当美联储与欧洲央行同步实施货币政策紧缩时，资金从EME重新配置的效应更强。然而，若紧缩冲击包含欧元区经济的正面信息，这些投资者甚至可能增加对EME证券的资本注入。此外，发行者的货币财政稳定性可以解释这些溢出效应的异质性。
ai_comment: 利用部门级数据精细刻画投资者异质性，揭示了溢出效应的条件性，对理解货币政策传导和资本流动管理有重要政策启示。

title: Mining Chinese Historical Sources At Scale: A Machine Learning-Approach to Qing State Capacity
abstract: Primary historical sources are often by-passed for secondary sources due to high human costs of accessing and extracting primary information-especially in lower-resource settings.We propose a supervised machine-learning approach to the natural language processing of Chinese historical data.An application to identifying different forms of social unrest in the Veritable Records of the Qing Dynasty shows that approach cuts dramatically down the cost of using primary source data at the same time when it is free from human bias, reproducible, and flexible enough to address particular questions.External evidence on triggers of unrest also suggests that the computer-based approach is no less successful in identifying social unrest than human researchers are.
summary: 论文提出一种监督机器学习方法用于中文历史文献的自然语言处理，以解决传统上因人力成本高而回避使用原始史料的问题。应用在清朝《实录》中识别不同形式的社会动荡，结果显示该方法大幅降低使用原始史料成本，同时避免人为偏见、可重复、灵活且能针对特定问题。外部证据也表明计算机方法与人类研究者识别社会动荡的效果不相上下。
ai_comment: 本文展示了机器学习在历史研究中的价值，为大规模分析原始史料提供了高效、可靠的路径。

title: Economic Policy Challenges for the Age of AI
abstract: This paper examines the profound challenges that transformative advances in AI towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) will pose for economists and economic policymakers.I examine how the Age of AI will revolutionize the basic structure of our economies by diminishing the role of labor, leading to unprecedented productivity gains but raising concerns about job disruption, income distribution, and the value of education and human capital.I explore what roles may remain for labor post-AGI, and which production factors will grow in importance.The paper then identifies eight key challenges for economic policy in the Age of AI: (1) inequality and income distribution, (2) education and skill development, (3) social and political stability, (4) macroeconomic policy, (5) antitrust and market regulation, (6) intellectual property, (7) environmental implications, and (8) global AI governance.It concludes by emphasizing how economists can contribute to a better understanding of these challenges.
summary: 本文探讨了人工智能（特别是向通用人工智能AGI的变革性进展）对经济学家和经济政策制定者带来的深刻挑战。研究指出，AGI时代将通过削弱劳动的作用彻底改变经济基本结构，带来前所未有的生产率提升，但同时也引发对就业冲击、收入分配以及教育和人力资本价值的担忧。文章分析了AGI后劳动可能扮演的角色以及哪些生产要素的重要性将增加。随后，论文识别了AI时代经济政策的八个关键挑战：不平等与收入分配、教育与技能发展、社会与政治稳定、宏观经济政策、反垄断与市场监管、知识产权、环境影响以及全球AI治理。最后强调经济学家如何能够促进对这些挑战的更好理解。
ai_comment: 本文系统性地梳理了AI对经济政策的多维度挑战，为后续实证研究和政策设计提供了重要框架。

title: Exchange Rates, Natural Rates, and the Price of Risk
abstract: We study the source of exchange rate fluctuations using a general equilibrium model accommodating shocks in goods and financial markets. These shocks differ in their induced comovements between exchange rates, interest rates, and quantities. A calibration matching data from the U.S. and G10 currency countries implies that persistent shocks to relative demand, reflected in persistent interest rate differentials, account for 75% of the variance in the dollar/G10 exchange rate. Shocks to currency intermediation are important, however, in generating deviations from uncovered interest parity at high frequencies and explaining the dollar appreciation in crises.
summary: 该论文通过一个包含商品和金融市场冲击的一般均衡模型研究汇率波动的来源。这些冲击在汇率、利率和数量的联合波动上表现不同。通过对美国与G10国家数据的校准，发现相对需求的持续性冲击（反映在持续的利率差异）解释了美元兑G10汇率75%的方差。同时，货币中介冲击在高频产生非抛补利率平价偏离以及危机时期美元升值中扮演重要角色。
ai_comment: 该模型将商品和金融市场冲击统一纳入一般均衡框架，量化了不同驱动因素对汇率波动的相对重要性，尤其强调了货币中介冲击在短期和危机中的关键作用。

title: Optimal Financing of Government Purchases
abstract: We characterize a planner's optimal allocation of consumption and capital in an overlapping generations model with exogenous government purchases, privately-observed idiosyncratic shocks to the depreciation rate of capital, and a proportional cost of reversing investment to transform used capital to consumption.We show how a package of various taxes and government bonds can finance government purchases and support the same balanced growth path as in the planner's optimum.The optimal tax rate on capital income implements the planner's optimal (but incomplete) sharing of idiosyncratic depreciation risks, while respecting the private nature of these risks.
summary: 论文在一个具有外生政府购买、资本折旧率受到私人观测的异质性冲击、以及投资逆转存在比例成本（即将已使用资本转化为消费）的交叠世代模型中，刻画了规划者对消费和资本的最优配置。作者展示了如何通过一揽子不同税收和政府债券来为政府购买融资，并支持与规划者最优相同的平衡增长路径。最优资本所得税率实现了对异质性折旧风险的最优（但不完全）分担，同时尊重这些风险的私人性质。
ai_comment: 本文从理论层面系统分析了政府购买的最优融资方案，将税收、债券与私人信息下的风险分担相结合，为财政政策设计提供了深刻见解。

title: Putting the "Finance" into "Public Finance": A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors (“discount rates”). We show that a combination of realization-based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset-price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so-called lock-in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig-Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual-based capital gains taxes. We
summary: 该论文挑战了标准最优资本税收理论中忽视资产价格建模的做法，通过引入现代金融观点，将资产价格波动归因于现金流变化和贴现率变化，研究存在资产价格波动环境下的最优再分配税收。论文证明，无论资产价格波动来源如何，基于实现的资本利得税与现金流税的组合能够实现最优配置，且这种资本利得税通过针对总净交易而非单资产出售收益，避免了锁定效应等投资组合扭曲。该结论与Haig-Simons综合所得税及财富税、应计制资本利得税等现行提案形成鲜明对比。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将资产定价理论融入公共财政分析，为资本利得税设计提供了新的理论视角，特别是其对锁定效应的规避机制具有重要政策启示。

title: Optimal Monetary Policy with Redistribution
abstract: We study optimal monetary policy in a general equilibrium economy with heterogeneous agents and nominal rigidities.Households differ in type-specific, state-contingent labor productivity and initial firm ownership, yet markets are complete.The fiscal authority has access to a linear tax schedule with non-state-contingent tax rates and uniform, lump-sum taxes (or transfers).We derive sufficient conditions under which implementing flexible-price allocations is optimal.We then show that when there are fluctuations in relative labor productivity across households, it is optimal for monetary policy to abandon the flexible-price benchmark and target a state-contingent markup.The optimal markup covaries positively with a sufficient statistic for labor income inequality.In a calibrated version of the model, countercyclical earnings inequality implies countercyclical optimal markups.
summary: 本文在异质性代理人、名义刚性的一般均衡经济中研究最优货币政策。家庭在类型特定的状态依存劳动生产率和初始企业所有权上存在差异，但市场是完备的。财政当局采用线性税收安排，包括非状态依存的税率和统一的总额税（或转移支付）。推导出实现弹性价格配置最优的充分条件，并表明当存在相对劳动生产率波动时，货币政策应放弃弹性价格基准，转而针对状态依存加成定价。最优加成与劳动收入不平等的一个充分统计量正相关。在标定模型中，反周期的收入不平等意味着反周期的最优加成。
ai_comment: 该文将收入不平等与货币政策中的最优加成联系，为理解货币政策的分配效应提供了新视角。

title: Invoicing Currency and Exchange Rate Pass-Through in Japanese Imports: A Panel VAR Analysis
abstract: This study utilizes the granular Japanese customs data from 2014 to 2020 to examine the exchange rate pass-through (ERPT) to Japanese import prices.It mainly focuses on the impact of the invoicing currency choice on ERPT.The ERPT elasticity in products invoiced in the exporter's currency is greater than those invoiced in yen.In the full sample analysis, the ERPT elasticity was 0.75 for products invoiced in the exporter's currency, compared to about 0.19 for yen-invoiced products.We find the same tendency for imports from two Asian powerhouses: China and Thailand.There is no significant difference in the ERPT elasticity between products invoiced in the exporter's currency and those invoiced in a third currency (i.e., a currency other than yen or the exporter's currency).In addition, an asymmetric pass-through is found, namely the ERPT during the appreciation phase of the yen is higher than during the depreciation phase.This finding is interpreted that foreign exporters strengthen their pricing-to-market behavior during the yen depreciation phase to maintain their market share.
summary: 本研究利用2014-2020年日本微观海关数据，考察汇率传递（ERPT）对日本进口价格的影响，重点关注发票货币选择的作用。分析发现，以出口商货币计价的产品的ERPT弹性（0.75）显著高于以日元计价的产品（约0.19）；从中国和泰国进口的产品也呈现相同趋势。以出口商货币和以第三货币（既非日元也非出口商货币）计价的产品的ERPT弹性无显著差异。此外，存在不对称传递：日元升值阶段的ERPT高于贬值阶段，表明外国出口商在日元贬值时期加强“盯市”定价行为以维持市场份额。
ai_comment: 利用高度细化的海关数据，为发票货币选择对汇率传递的影响提供了新证据，并揭示了不对称传递现象，对理解全球贸易定价行为有重要参考价值。

title: Trade, Innovation and Firm Financing
abstract: While the trade literature has tended to view export activity and innovation as complementary activities, we present evidence that financial constraints are a reason the two activities can act as substitutes for small exporters.In particular, we find that small exporters have lower expenditure on R&D than comparable non-exporters, and we find a corresponding pattern in the leverage ratio of the capital structure of small firms.A model that combines firm decisions regarding the amount of innovation, exporting, and endogenous financial capital structure is able to account for these empirical findings.The model implies that small firms are unable to fully reap the gains from exporting due to financial constraints, as they reduce R&D to finance the costs of export participation.
summary: 本文挑战了贸易文献中出口与创新互补的传统观点，发现对于小型出口企业，财务约束导致二者呈现替代关系。实证表明，小型出口商的研发支出低于可比非出口商，且其资本结构的杠杆率也呈现相应模式。作者构建了一个同时包含企业创新、出口决策和内源性财务资本结构的模型，成功解释了这些实证结果。模型隐含的结论是：由于财务约束，小型企业不得不削减研发以筹措出口参与的成本，从而无法充分获取出口带来的收益。
ai_comment: 本文创新地指出财务约束使出口与创新从互补变为替代，并通过内生资本结构模型提供了统一的解释框架。

title: What’s Across the Border? Re-Evaluating the Cross-Border Evidence on Minimum Wage Effects
abstract: Dube, Lester, and Reich (2010) argue that state-level minimum wage variation correlated with economic shocks generates spurious evidence that higher minimum wages reduce employment.Using minimum wage variation within contiguous county pairs sharing a state border, they find no relationship between minimum wages and employment in the U.S. restaurant industry.Using the same research design, we show that this result is overturned if we use instead multi-state commuting zones, which provide superior definitions of local economic areas.These contrasting results are explained by a positive bias in the county-pair specification when using pairs formed by counties from different commuting zones.
summary: 该论文重新评估了跨州边界的最低工资效应证据。原有研究（Dube, Lester, and Reich 2010）使用相邻县对设计发现美国餐饮业最低工资与就业无显著关系，但作者认为该结果可能受经济冲击的虚假相关影响。本文采用相同的研究设计，但改用多州通勤区作为经济区域定义，结果发现最低工资对就业存在显著负面效应。对比分析表明，原研究使用的相邻县对规范存在正向偏差，因为许多县对来自不同通勤区，从而掩盖了真实效应。
ai_comment: 通过改进经济区域定义，揭示原经典研究的设计缺陷，对最低工资实证研究的方法论有重要贡献。

title: Reassessing Sources of Risk Premiums in Currency Markets
abstract: We show that a small set of emerging markets with floating exchange rates expand the investment frontier substantially relative to G10 currencies.The frontier is characterized by an out-of-sample mean-variance efficient portfolio that prices G10-and emerging markets-based trading strategies unconditionally as well as conditionally.Our approach reveals that returns to prominent trading strategies are largely driven by factors that do not command a risk premium.After real-time hedging of such unpriced risks, the Sharpe ratios of these strategies increase substantially, providing new benchmarks for currency pricing models.For instance, the Sharpe ratio of the carry strategy increases from 0.71 to 1.29.The unpriced risks are related to geographically-based currency factors, while the priced risk that drives currency risk premiums is related to aggregate consumption exposure.
summary: 本文重新评估了货币市场风险溢价的来源。研究发现，一组拥有浮动汇率的新兴市场显著扩展了相比G10货币的投资前沿。通过构建样本外均值-方差有效组合，该组合能够无条件及条件性地定价基于G10和新兴市场的交易策略。研究表明，知名交易策略的回报主要由不要求风险溢价的因子驱动，而在对这些未定价风险进行实时对冲后，策略的夏普比率大幅提升，例如利差交易策略的夏普比率从0.71升至1.29。这些未定价风险与基于地理的货币因子相关，而驱动货币风险溢价的定价风险则与总消费暴露相关。
ai_comment: 论文通过引入新兴市场货币扩展投资前沿，揭示了著名交易策略中未被定价的风险，为货币定价模型提供了新的基准。

title: High-frequency trading in the stock market and the costs of options market making
abstract: We investigate how high-frequency trading (HFT) in equity markets affects options market liquidity. We find that increased aggressive HFT activity in the stock market leads to wider bid–ask spreads in the options market through two main channels. First, options market makers’ quotes are exposed to sniping risk from HFTs exploiting put–call parity violations. Second, informed trading in the options market further amplifies the impact of HFT in equity markets on the liquidity of options by simultaneously increasing the options bid–ask spread and intensifying aggressive HFT activity in the underlying market.
summary: 本文研究股票市场高频交易（HFT）如何影响期权市场流动性。通过实证分析，发现股票市场中激进的HFT活动会导致期权市场买卖价差扩大，这一效应通过两个渠道实现：第一，期权做市商的报价面临HFT利用看跌-看涨平价（put–call parity）关系进行狙击的风险；第二，期权市场的知情交易进一步放大了股票市场HFT对期权流动性的影响，同时增加了期权买卖价差并加剧了标的市场的激进HFT活动。文章揭示了跨市场联动机制，表明股票市场HFT会通过信息传递和风险暴露增加期权做市成本。
