ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了股票市场高频交易通过跨市场渠道影响期权市场流动性的具体机制，为理解不同金融产品间的流动性联动提供了新视角。

title: Monetary tightening and U.S. bank fragility in 2023: Mark-to-market losses and uninsured depositor runs?
abstract: We develop a conceptual framework and an empirical methodology to analyze the effect of rising interest rates on the value of U.S. bank assets and bank stability. We mark-to-market the value of banks’ assets due to interest rate increases from Q1 2022 to Q1 2023, revealing an average decline of 10 %, totaling about $2 trillion in aggregate. We present a model illustrating how asset value declines due to higher rates can lead to self-fulfilling solvency runs even when banks’ assets are fully liquid. Banks with high asset losses, low capital, and, critically, high uninsured leverage are most fragile. A case study of the failed Silicon Valley Bank confirms the model insights. Our empirical measures of bank fragility suggest that, in the absence of regulatory intervention, many U.S. banks would have been at risk of self-fulfilling solvency runs.
summary: 本文建立了一个概念框架和实证方法，以分析2022年第一季度至2023年第一季度利率上升对美国银行资产价值和银行稳定性的影响。通过市值计价，发现银行资产平均下降10%，总计约2万亿美元。构建的模型表明，即使银行资产完全流动，利率上升导致的资产价值下降也可能引发自我实现的偿付能力挤兑。银行若具有高资产损失、低资本以及高无保险杠杆，则最为脆弱。对硅谷银行失败的案例研究证实了模型的结论。实证测度表明，若无监管干预，许多美国银行将面临自我实现偿付能力挤兑的风险。
ai_comment: 该论文通过量化利率上升对银行资产价值的巨大冲击，并建立理论模型揭示了未保险存款在银行挤兑中的关键作用，对理解2023年银行危机具有重要价值。

title: Borrow now, pay even later: A quantitative analysis of student debt payment plans
abstract: In the U.S., student debt is currently the second largest component of consumer debt. Households are required to repay these loans early in their lifecycle, when marginal utility is particularly high. We study alternative contracts that offer partial or full payment deferral until later in life. We calibrate an economy with the current contracts, and then solve for counterfactual equilibria. The alternative contracts yield large welfare gains, which are robust to assumptions about the behavior of the lenders and borrower preferences. The gains are similar to those that could come from the debt relief program currently being considered in the U.S., but without its adverse fiscal implications.
summary: 本文研究学生债务的还款计划替代方案。在美国，学生债务是第二大消费债务，家庭需在生命周期早期偿还贷款，而早期边际效用较高。作者研究允许部分或全部还款推迟到生命周期后期的合同。通过校准当前合同下的经济模型，求解反事实均衡。发现替代合同能带来显著的福利收益，且该收益对贷方和借款人行为的假设具有稳健性。这些收益类似于美国正在考虑的债务减免计划，但没有其不利的财政影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过量化分析方法，提出延迟还款计划可显著增进福利，且避免了债务减免的财政成本，为政策设计提供了新视角。

title: Are cryptos different? Evidence from retail trading
abstract: Trading in cryptocurrencies grew rapidly over the last decade, dominated by retail investors. Using data from eToro, we show that retail traders are contrarian in stocks and gold, yet the same traders follow a momentum-like strategy in cryptocurrencies. The differences are not explained by individual characteristics, investor composition, inattention, differences in fees, or preference for lottery-like assets. We conjecture that retail investors have a model where cryptocurrency price changes affect the likelihood of future widespread adoption, which leads them to further update their price expectations in the same direction.
summary: 利用eToro平台的数据，研究发现零售投资者在股票和黄金交易中采用反向策略，而在加密货币交易中则表现出动量策略特征。这种交易行为的差异无法由个人特征、投资者构成、注意力不足、费用差异或对彩票型资产的偏好等因素解释。研究者推测，零售投资者可能认为加密货币价格变化会影响其未来被广泛采用的可能性，从而促使他们同方向更新价格预期。
ai_comment: 该论文通过同一批投资者的跨资产交易行为对比，揭示加密货币市场的独特微观机制，为理解散户在新型资产中的非理性行为提供了新视角。

title: The effects of policy interventions to limit illegal money lending
abstract: We estimate a structural model of borrowing and lending in the illegal money lending market using a unique panel survey of 1,090 borrowers taking out 11,032 loans from loan sharks. We use the model to evaluate the effects of interventions aimed at limiting this market. We find that an enforcement crackdown that occurred during our sample period increased lenders’ unit cost of harassment and interest rates, while lowering volume of loans, lender profits and borrower welfare. Policies removing borrowers in the middle of the repayment ability distribution, reducing gambling or reducing time discounting are also effective at lowering lender profitability.
summary: 本文利用一项包含1090名借款人从高利贷者处获取的11032笔贷款的独特面板调查数据，构建了一个非法借贷市场的结构性借贷模型。通过该模型，评估了旨在限制该市场的政策干预效果。研究发现，样本期间发生的执法打击行动增加了放贷人的骚扰单位成本和利率，同时降低了贷款量、放贷人利润和借款人福利。此外，移除还款能力中等分布的借款人、减少赌博行为或降低时间贴现率的政策也能有效降低放贷人的盈利能力。
ai_comment: 利用独特微观数据构建结构性模型，为评估非法借贷市场政策效果提供了严谨分析，结论对监管实践具有直接启示。

title: The reserve supply channel of unconventional monetary policy
abstract: We find that central bank reserves injected by QE crowd out bank lending. We estimate a structural model with cross-sectional instrumental variables for deposit and loan demand. Our results are determined by the elasticity of loan demand and the impact of reserve holdings on the cost of supplying loans. The reserves injected by QE raise loan rates by 7.4 basis points, and each dollar of reserves reduces bank lending by 7.7 cents. Our results imply that a large injection of central bank reserves has the unintended consequence of crowding out bank loans because of bank balance sheet costs.
summary: 该论文研究非常规货币政策（量化宽松，QE）中，央行注入的储备如何影响银行贷款。作者采用结构模型，并利用横截面工具变量估计存款和贷款需求。研究发现，QE注入的储备导致贷款利率上升7.4个基点，且每1美元储备减少银行贷款7.7美分。结果表明，大规模注入央行储备因银行资产负债表成本而产生意外的挤出效应，抑制了银行贷款。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型量化了QE的负面溢出效应，揭示了银行资产负债表成本在货币政策传导中的重要作用，为理解非常规货币政策的风险提供了新视角。

title: Importance of transaction costs for asset allocation in foreign exchange markets
abstract: Transaction costs have a first-order effect on the performance of currency portfolios. Proportional costs based on quoted bid–ask spread are relatively small, but when a fund is large, costs due to the trading volume price impact are sizable and quickly erode returns, leaving many popular strategies unprofitable. A mean–variance-transaction-cost optimized approach (MVTC) that accounts for costs in the optimization efficiently tackles the problem with only relatively minor negative implications on before-cost profitability. MVTC is robust even when the price impact of trading is severe. Finally, we introduce an accurate extrapolation approach to expand the sample of the realized Amihud measure of Ranaldo and Santucci de Magistris (2022) from 12 to 26 currencies and from 2012 back in time to 1986.
summary: 本文研究交易成本对外汇市场资产配置的一阶效应。基于报价买卖价差的比例成本通常较小，但对于大规模基金，交易量价格冲击导致的成本巨大且快速侵蚀收益，使许多流行策略无利可图。作者提出一种考虑成本优化的均值-方差-交易成本优化方法（MVTC），在优化中直接纳入交易成本，有效解决了这一问题，且对税前盈利能力的影响相对较小。MVTC方法在交易价格冲击严重时仍保持稳健。此外，作者还引入一种准确的外推方法，将Ranaldo和Santucci de Magistris（2022）的实现的Amihud度量样本从12种货币扩展到26种货币，并将时间范围从2012年回溯到1986年。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统揭示交易成本在外汇资产配置中的一阶效应，提出的MVTC优化方法具有实践价值，且通过外推方法大幅扩展了研究数据的历史覆盖。

title: The short-termism trap: Catering to informed investors with limited horizons
abstract: Does the stock market exert short-term pressure on listed firms, do they respond, and is this response value reducing? We show that limited investor horizons indeed have those consequences, as follows. First, informative stock prices increase firm value; in our model, they reduce the agency cost of incentivizing managers. Second, short project maturity improves stock price informativeness by catering to informed investors with short horizons. Third, since informed trading capital is a scarce resource, attracting informed investors cannot increase an individual firm’s price informativeness in equilibrium: it simply destroys shareholder value. This “short-termism trap” can potentially destroy up to 100% of the benefits of stock market listing.
summary: 本文研究股票市场是否对上市公司施加短期压力、公司如何应对以及这种应对是否损害公司价值。作者构建模型证明有限投资者视野确实导致这些后果：首先，信息丰富的股票价格能提升公司价值，因为它降低了激励管理层的代理成本；其次，短期项目期限通过迎合具有短期视野的信息型投资者来提高股价信息含量；第三，由于信息交易资本是稀缺资源，在均衡中吸引信息型投资者无法提高个股的价格信息含量，反而会破坏股东价值。这种“短视陷阱”可能摧毁股票上市收益的100%。
ai_comment: 该文通过严谨的模型揭示了“短视陷阱”的存在及其对股东价值的毁灭性影响，为理解市场短期压力与公司长期价值之间的冲突提供了深刻洞见。

title: Financial market concentration and misallocation
abstract: How does financial market concentration affect capital allocation? We propose a complete-markets model in which real investment and financial price impact are jointly determined in general equilibrium. We identify a two-way feedback mechanism whereby price impact induces misallocation and misallocation raises price impact. The mechanism is stronger if productivity is low or productivity dispersion is high. Given rising dispersion, the model can rationalize trends in corporate discount rates, cash holdings, investment, asset prices, and capital reallocation over the last two decades, even when market concentration is relatively stable. Overall, our findings suggest that financial market concentration may hamper allocative efficiency.
summary: 这篇论文研究金融市场集中度如何影响资本配置效率。作者构建了一个完全市场的一般均衡模型，其中实际投资决策与金融市场的价格影响是联合决定的。模型揭示了双向反馈机制：投资者的价格影响导致资本错配，而资本错配又会反过来放大价格影响。这种机制在生产率较低或生产率离散度较高时更为显著。考虑到近二十年生产率离散度不断上升，该模型能够解释企业贴现率、现金持有、投资、资产价格和资本再分配等经济变量的趋势，即使在此期间金融市场集中度保持相对稳定。总体而言，研究结果表明金融市场集中度可能阻碍配置效率。
ai_comment: 论文通过一般均衡框架揭示了金融市场集中度与资本错配之间的双向因果机制，并成功解释了多个宏观经济变量的长期趋势，具有很强的理论创新性和实证解释力。

title: Concealed carry
abstract: The slope carry takes a long (short) position in the long-term bonds of countries with steeper (flatter) yield curves. The traditional carry takes a long (short) position in countries with high (low) short-term rates. We document that: (i) the slope carry return is slightly negative (strongly positive) in the pre (post) 2008 period, whereas it is concealed over longer samples; (ii) the traditional carry return is lower post-2008; and (iii) expected global growth and inflation declined post-2008. We connect these findings through an equilibrium model in which countries feature heterogeneous exposure to news shocks about global output and global inflation.
summary: 该论文研究了两种利差交易策略：斜率利差（做多收益率曲线更陡峭国家的长期债券，做空更平坦国家的长期债券）和传统利差（做多短期利率高国家的货币，做空短期利率低国家的货币）。研究发现：(i) 斜率利差的回报在2008年之前微弱为负，2008年之后显著为正，但在更长样本期内被掩盖；(ii) 传统利差的回报在2008年之后下降；(iii) 预期全球增长和通胀在2008年之后下降。作者通过一个均衡模型将这些发现联系起来，模型中各国对全球产出和全球通胀的新闻冲击具有异质性暴露。
ai_comment: 该论文细致区分了斜率利差与传统利差，揭示了2008年前后利差回报的显著反转，并将其与宏观预期变化通过均衡模型关联，对理解利差交易动态和宏观风险有重要贡献。

title: FinTech Credit and Entrepreneurial Growth
abstract: Based on automated credit lines to vendors trading on Alibaba's online retail platform and a discontinuity in the credit decision algorithm, we document that a vendor's access to FinTech credit boosts its sales growth, transaction growth, and the level of customer satisfaction gauged by product, service, and consignment ratings. These effects are more pronounced for vendors characterized by greater information asymmetry about their credit risk and less collateral, which reveals the information advantage of FinTech credit over traditional credit technology.
summary: 基于阿里巴巴在线零售平台向供应商提供的自动化信用额度，并利用信用决策算法中的断点回归设计，本文发现金融科技信贷可显著促进供应商的销售增长、交易增长以及客户满意度（通过产品、服务和寄售评级衡量）。这些效应在信用风险信息不对称程度更高、抵押品更少的供应商中更为显著，表明金融科技信贷相对于传统信贷技术具有信息优势。
ai_comment: 利用平台数据和断点回归设计，严谨识别了金融科技信贷对小微企业成长的因果效应，并揭示了其信息优势的关键机制。

title: Heterogeneous Real Estate Agents and the Housing Cycle
abstract: The real estate market is highly intermediated, with 90% of buyers and sellers hiring an agent. However, low barriers to entry and fixed commission rates result in large market share for inexperienced intermediaries. Using micro-level data on 8.5 million listings and a novel research design, we show that house listings by inexperienced agents have a lower probability of selling, and this effect is strongest during the housing bust. We estimate that 3.7% more listings would have been sold in a flexible commission equilibrium. Eighty percent of this improvement comes from competition and the remainder from commission variation across experience.
summary: 本文研究房地产市场中不同经验的经纪人（agents）对房屋销售的影响。利用850万条房源微观数据，发现经验不足的经纪人（inexperienced agents）挂牌的房屋售出概率更低，且这一效应在房市低迷期（housing bust）最强。通过反事实估算，在灵活佣金（flexible commission）均衡下，额外3.7%的房源能够售出；其中80%的改善来自竞争，其余来自经验差异导致的佣金变化。
ai_comment: 利用大规模微观数据识别经纪经验对销售概率的因果效应，并量化灵活佣金均衡的潜在收益，为理解房地产中介市场的低效率提供了重要证据。

title: ESG Disclosures in the Private Equity Industry
abstract: This paper offers the first systematic evidence on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosures provided by a large global sample of private equity (PE) firms. Using historical websites from 2000 to 2022, we develop and validate a novel dictionary‐based measure of voluntary PE firm ESG disclosures. Descriptive statistics reveal an increasing time trend in these disclosures, with social topics becoming as important as environmental topics recently. Multivariate analyses show that the demand for ESG information from fund investors is a significant determinant of PE firms’ ESG disclosures. Leveraging data on PE firms’ portfolio companies, we document that more PE firm ESG disclosures are associated with better ESG outcomes at the portfolio company level, suggesting that voluntary ESG disclosures align with real actions for the average PE firm.
summary: 该论文首次系统性地提供了全球大量私募股权（PE）公司环境、社会和治理（ESG）披露的证据。作者利用2000年至2022年的历史网站数据，开发并验证了一种基于词典的自愿性PE公司ESG披露衡量指标。描述性统计显示，这些披露随时间呈上升趋势，且社会话题最近变得与环境话题同等重要。多变量分析表明，基金投资者对ESG信息的需求是PE公司ESG披露的重要决定因素。通过利用PE公司投资组合公司的数据，研究发现更多的PE公司ESG披露与投资组合公司层面更好的ESG结果相关，这表明自愿性ESG披露与平均PE公司的实际行为一致。
ai_comment: 该研究的贡献在于首次为PE行业的ESG披露提供了系统性证据，并开发了新颖的衡量方法。关键发现是披露与实际ESG结果正相关，为自愿披露的有效性提供了支持。

title: The Working Capital Credit Multiplier
abstract: We provide novel evidence that funding frictions can limit firms’ short‐term investments in receivables and inventories, reducing their production capacity. We propose a credit multiplier driven by these considerations and empirically isolate its importance by comparing how a similar firm responds to shocks differently when these shocks are initiated in their most profitable quarter (“main quarter”). We implement this test using recurring and unpredictable shocks (e.g., oil shocks) and provide extensive evidence supporting our identification strategy. Our results suggest that funding constraints and credit multiplier effects are significant for smaller firms that heavily rely on financing from suppliers.
summary: 本文提供了新的证据表明融资摩擦会限制企业对应收账款和存货的短期投资，从而降低其生产能力。作者提出了一种基于这些考虑的信用乘数，并通过比较企业在最盈利季度（“main quarter”）与其他季度对类似冲击的不同反应来实证识别该乘数的重要性。该测试利用了重复且不可预测的冲击（如石油冲击），并提供了大量支持识别策略的证据。结果表明，融资约束和信用乘数效应对于严重依赖供应商融资的小型企业更为显著。
ai_comment: 本文通过巧妙的季度比较设计识别了信用乘数效应，为理解融资约束对企业短期投资和生产能力的影响提供了新视角，尤其对依赖供应商融资的小企业具有重要政策启示。

title: Capital Commitment
abstract: Twelve trillion dollars are allocated to private market funds that require outside investors to commit to transferring capital on demand. We show within a novel dynamic portfolio allocation model that ex‐ante commitment has large effects on investors' portfolios and welfare, and we quantify those effects. Investors are underallocated to private market funds and are willing to pay a larger premium to adjust the quantity committed than to eliminate other frictions, like timing uncertainty and limited tradability. Perhaps counterintuitively, commitment risk premiums increase with secondary market liquidity, and they do not disappear when investments are spread over many funds.
summary: 本文研究私募市场基金中投资者需要承诺按需转移资本这一机制对投资组合和福利的影响。通过构建一个新颖的动态投资组合分配模型，作者量化了事前承诺（capital commitment）的重大影响。研究发现，投资者对私募市场基金的配置不足，且投资者愿意支付更高的溢价来调整承诺数量，而非消除时机不确定性或有限可交易性等其他摩擦。反直觉的是，承诺风险溢价随二级市场流动性增加而上升，且分散投资于多个基金时该溢价并不会消失。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了私募市场资本承诺机制对投资者行为的深远影响，特别是其与二级市场流动性的非直觉关系，为理解资本约束下的资产配置提供了新视角。

title: Treasury Bill Shortages and the Pricing of Short‐Term Assets
abstract: We propose a model of post‐Great Financial Crisis (GFC) money markets and monetary policy implementation. In our framework, capital regulation may deter banks from intermediating liquidity derived from holding reserves to shadow banks. Consequently, money markets can be segmented, and the scarcity of Treasury bills available to shadow banks is the main driver of short‐term spreads. In this regime, open market operations have an inverse effect on net liquidity provision when swapping ample reserves for scarce T‐bills or repos. Our model quantitatively accounts for post‐2010 time series for repo rates, T‐bill yields, and the Fed's reverse repo facility usage.
summary: 本文构建了一个后金融危机时代的货币市场与货币政策实施模型。模型指出，资本监管可能阻止银行将持有储备产生的流动性传导至影子银行，从而导致市场分割。在此情形下，影子银行可获得的国库券短缺成为短期利差的主要驱动因素。在该体制下，公开市场操作在将充裕储备置换为稀缺国库券或回购协议时，会对净流动性供给产生反向效应。该模型定量解释了2010年后回购利率、国库券收益率以及美联储逆回购工具使用的时间序列数据。
ai_comment: 模型清晰地刻画了资本监管下市场分割如何导致短期资产定价偏离，并揭示了公开市场操作的反直觉效果，对理解后危机时代货币政策传导有重要贡献。

title: Currency Management by International Fixed‐Income Mutual Funds
abstract: Investments in international fixed‐income securities are exposed to significant currency risks. We collect novel data on currency derivatives used by U.S. international fixed‐income funds. We document that while 90% of funds use currency forwards, they hedge, on average, only 18% of their currency exposure. Funds' currency forward positions differ substantially based on risk management demands related to portfolio currency exposure, return‐enhancement motives such as currency momentum and carry trade, and strategic considerations related to past performance and fund clientele. Funds that hedge their currency risk exhibit lower return variability, but do not generate inferior abnormal returns.
summary: 本文研究了美国国际固定收益共同基金的货币管理实践。通过收集基金使用货币衍生品的新数据，发现90%的基金使用货币远期合约，但平均仅对冲了18%的货币风险暴露。基金的货币远期头寸差异显著，取决于与组合货币风险敞口相关的风险管理需求、基于货币动量和套利交易的回报增强动机，以及基于历史业绩和基金客户群的战略考虑。对冲货币风险的基金回报波动性较低，但并未产生更差的异常收益。
ai_comment: 该研究首次提供了美国国际固定收益基金货币衍生品使用的详细数据，发现对冲比例极低但并未损害收益，挑战了传统对冲有效性观念。

title: Bailout Stigma
abstract: We develop a model of bailout stigma in which accepting a bailout signals a firm's balance‐sheet weakness and reduces its funding prospects. To avoid stigma, high‐quality firms withdraw from subsequent financing after receiving bailouts or refuse bailouts altogether to send a favorable signal. The former leads to a short‐lived stimulation followed by a market freeze even worse than if there were no bailout. The latter revives the funding market, albeit with delay, to the level achievable without any stigma and implements a constrained optimal outcome. A menu of multiple bailout programs compounds bailout stigma and exacerbates the market freeze.
summary: 本文构建了一个关于救助污点（bailout stigma）的理论模型，分析企业接受救助如何因传递资产负债表疲软的信号而降低其后续融资前景。为避免污点，高质量企业要么在接受救助后退出后续融资，导致短期刺激后市场冻结甚至比无救助时更糟；要么完全拒绝救助以发出正面信号，从而在有延迟的情况下重振融资市场至无污点水平，并实现约束最优结果。研究还发现，提供多种救助计划会加重救助污点并加剧市场冻结。
ai_comment: 该模型深刻揭示了救助政策的负面信号效应，为设计更有效的救助机制提供了重要的理论依据。

title: Founder‐CEO Compensation and Selection into Venture Capital‐Backed Entrepreneurship
abstract: We show theoretically that a critical determinant of the attractiveness of venture capital (VC)‐backed entrepreneurship for high‐earning potential founders is the expected time to develop a startup's initial product. This is because founder‐CEOs' cash compensation increases substantially after product development, alleviating the nondiversifiable risk that founders face at startup birth. Consistent with the model's predictions of where the supply of entrepreneurial talent is likely to be most constrained, we find that technological shocks differentially altering the expected time to product across industries can explain changes in both the rate of entry and characteristics of individuals selecting into VC‐backed entrepreneurship.
summary: 本文通过理论模型发现，高收入潜力创始人是否选择风险投资支持的创业，关键取决于开发初创公司初始产品的预期时间。因为创始人CEO在完成产品开发后，现金薪酬会大幅增加，从而缓解初创期面临的风险。与模型预测一致，技术冲击通过改变各行业的产品开发预期时间，既能影响创业进入率，也能影响创业者特征的变化，解释了创业人才供给的行业差异。
ai_comment: 论文构建的理论框架将产品开发时间与创始人薪酬激励联系起来，为创业选择提供了新颖的微观机制解释，实证部分利用技术冲击验证了模型预测，具有较高的理论和现实意义。

title: The Effect of the Federal Judicial System on Public Enforcement: Evidence from SEC Enforcement Actions
abstract: This study examines whether the efficiency of federal district courts affects the likelihood of SEC enforcement. The results indicate that the SEC is less likely to initiate enforcement actions against firms in less efficient federal district courts. In addition, the study examines the implications of court efficiency for firms’ financial reporting quality (FRQ). The evidence suggests that firms residing in more efficient federal districts have higher FRQ and the effect is stronger in subsamples with weak private enforcement regimes. Additional analysis of the choice of venue suggests that the SEC's decision to file in the District Court for D.C. is not affected by local court efficiency. Collectively, this study highlights the importance of an efficient federal judicial system for public enforcement.
summary: 本研究考察联邦地区法院效率是否影响美国证券交易委员会（SEC）执法的可能性。结果表明，SEC对处于效率较低的联邦地区法院的公司发起执法行动的可能性较小。此外，研究还探讨了法院效率对公司财务报告质量（FRQ）的影响：证据显示，位于更高效联邦地区的公司具有更高的FRQ，且在私人执法机制较弱的子样本中，该效应更为显著。对立案地点的额外分析表明，SEC选择在哥伦比亚特区地区法院立案的决定不受当地法院效率的影响。综上，本研究强调了高效的联邦司法系统对公共执法的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文独特地考察了司法系统效率对证券执法和财务报告质量的交叉影响，揭示了法院效率作为一种外部治理机制的作用。

title: The Gender Gap in Household Bargaining Power: A Revealed-Preference Approach
abstract: When members of the same household have different risk preferences, whose preference matters more for investment decisions and why? We propose an intrahousehold model that aggregates individual preferences at the household level as a result of bargaining. We structurally estimate the model, analyze the determinants of bargaining power, and find a significant gender gap. Gender differences in individual characteristics, as well as gender effects, partially explain the gap. These patterns hold broadly across Australia, Germany, and the United States. We further link the distribution of bargaining power to households’ perceived gender norms in a cross-sectional analysis. (JEL G11, G41, G50)
summary: 本文通过揭示偏好方法研究家庭内部议价能力中的性别差距。作者提出一个家庭内部模型，将个人风险偏好通过议价过程聚合为家庭层面的偏好，并对模型进行结构估计。研究发现存在显著的性别差距，个体特征差异以及性别效应部分解释了这一差距，且该模式在澳大利亚、德国和美国均成立。进一步地，文章通过横截面分析将议价能力的分布与家庭感知的性别规范联系起来。
ai_comment: 本文采用结构估计方法，提供了跨国家证据，并引入感知性别规范解释性别差距，是家庭金融领域的重要贡献。

title: The Portfolio‐Driven Disposition Effect
abstract: The disposition effect for a stock significantly weakens if the portfolio is at a gain, but is large when it is at a loss. We find this portfolio‐driven disposition effect (PDDE) in four independent settings: U.S. and Chinese archival data, as well as U.S. and Chinese experiments. The PDDE is robust to a variety of controls in regression specifications and is not explained by extreme returns, portfolio rebalancing, tax considerations, or investor heterogeneity. Our evidence suggests that investors form mental frames at both the stock and the portfolio levels and that these frames combine to generate the PDDE.
summary: 该论文研究了投资组合状态对股票处置效应的影响，发现当投资组合处于盈利状态时，单个股票的处置效应显著减弱，而投资组合处于亏损状态时处置效应则较大。作者在美国和中国的档案数据以及两国进行的实验中均观察到这一投资组合驱动的处置效应（PDDE）。该效应在多种回归控制下依然稳健，且不能被极端回报、投资组合再平衡、税收考虑或投资者异质性所解释。证据表明，投资者同时在股票层面和投资组合层面形成心理框架，这些框架共同作用产生了PDDE。
ai_comment: 本文创新地提出了投资组合层面的心理框架对处置效应的影响，并通过跨国、多方法的实证提供了有力证据，深化了对投资者行为偏差的理解。

title: The Value of ETF Liquidity
abstract: We analyze how ETFs compete. Drawing on a new model and empirical analysis, we show that ETF secondary market liquidity plays a key role in determining fees. More liquid ETFs for a given index charge higher fees and attract short-horizon investors who are more sensitive to liquidity than to fees. Higher turnover from these investors sustains the ETF’s high liquidity, allowing the ETF to extract a rent through its fee, and creating a first-mover advantage. Liquidity segmentation through clientele effects generates welfare losses. Our findings resolve the apparent paradox that higher-fee ETFs not only survive but also flourish in equilibrium.
summary: 本文通过构建新模型和进行实证分析，研究ETF如何竞争。研究发现，对于同一指数，二级市场流动性更高的ETF会收取更高的费用，并吸引对流动性比对费用更敏感的短期投资者。这些投资者的高交易量维持了ETF的高流动性，使ETF能够通过费用获取租金，并形成先发优势。流动性通过客户效应产生的分割会导致福利损失。这一发现解释了高费用ETF在均衡中不仅存活而且繁荣的明显悖论。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了流动性在ETF费用定价中的核心作用，并解释了高费用ETF的市场生存机制，对理解ETF市场竞争和投资者行为有重要贡献。

title: Lying to Speak the Truth: Selective Manipulation and Improved Information Transmission
abstract: We analyze a principal‐agent model in which an effort‐averse agent can manipulate a publicly observable performance report. The principal cannot observe the agent's cost of effort, her effort choice, and whether she manipulated the report. An optimal contract links compensation to the realized output and the (possibly manipulated) report. Manipulation can be beneficial to the principal because it can make the report more informative about the agent's effort choice, thereby reducing the agent's information rent. This is achieved through a contract that incentivizes the agent to selectively engage in manipulation based on her effort choice.
summary: 本文分析了一个委托-代理模型，其中风险规避的代理人可以操纵公开可观察的业绩报告。委托人无法观察代理人的努力成本、努力选择以及是否进行了操纵。最优合同将薪酬与实际产出和（可能被操纵的）报告联系起来。研究发现，操纵可能对委托人有利，因为它可以使报告更能反映代理人的努力选择，从而减少代理人的信息租金。这是通过设计一个激励代理人根据其努力选择而选择性地进行操纵的合同来实现的。
ai_comment: 该论文挑战了传统观点，揭示了业绩报告操纵在特定合同设计下可以改善信息传递并降低代理成本，为激励机制设计提供了新的视角。

title: Where Does the Time Go? Auditors’ Commercial Effort, Professional Effort, and Audit Quality
abstract: Audit theory and regulation assumes that auditors’ commercial motivation threatens audit quality. In this registered report, we use data from two Big Four firms in the Netherlands and provide empirical evidence on the relation between auditors’ commercial motivation and (1) compensation, (2) total audit effort, and (3) audit quality. We proxy commercial motivation as the time that individual auditors report allocating to commercial activities. We hypothesize that auditors’ commercial effort is positively related to compensation and we find mixed support. Next, we hypothesize that auditors’ commercial effort is negatively related to the audit effort but we find no support. Turning to audit quality, we hypothesize a negative direct relation between auditors’ commercial effort and audit quality but we find no support. We also predict a positive indirect relation in which auditors’ commercial effort increases quality control reliance leading to higher audit quality. We find some support for this hypothesis but only when we use technical consultations to proxy for quality control. Auditors with greater commercial effort maintain quality because they rely more on technical consultations. In sum, our study challenges the assumption that auditors’ commercial effort threatens audit quality and questions the need for additional regulation to constrain commercial motivation.
summary: 该研究基于荷兰两家四大会计师事务所的数据，检验审计师的商业动机（以报告用于商业活动的时间衡量）与薪酬、总审计努力和审计质量之间的关系。研究发现，商业努力与薪酬正相关的假设仅获得混合支持；商业努力与审计努力负相关以及与审计质量直接负相关的假设均未得到支持。然而，商业努力通过增加对技术咨询等质量控制的依赖，间接提高审计质量，这一间接正相关关系在特定情境下得到部分支持。总体而言，该研究挑战了商业努力威胁审计质量的传统观点，并质疑了为此加强监管的必要性。
ai_comment: 利用实际审计师时间分配数据，提供了对审计中商业动机与质量关系的直接证据，挑战了监管假设。

title: Informed Voting
abstract: Information production by shareholders is essential for proxy voting to produce efficient outcomes. We propose a stock return-based measure to capture informed voting. Our measure, the vote alpha, quantifies the extent to which a shareholder votes in the direction that the market perceives as value increasing. Using data on mutual funds’ proxy voting records, we find that the vote alpha exhibits persistence. Our main result shows that the voting pattern of high vote alpha funds positively predicts long-run abnormal stock returns following contentious votes, suggesting that these funds possess information about the shareholder value implication of contentious governance proposals.
summary: 本文研究股东投票中的信息含量，提出一种基于股票收益的度量指标“vote alpha”，用于量化股东投票方向与市场认为价值增加方向的一致性。利用共同基金的投票记录数据，发现vote alpha具有持续性。主要结果表明，高vote alpha基金的投票模式能够正向预测有争议投票后的长期异常股票收益，说明这些基金掌握关于有争议治理提案股东价值影响的信息。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从股票收益角度度量投票的信息含量，为研究股东投票效率提供了新工具，并实证了知情投票对市场预测的价值。

title: Conflicts of Interest in Municipal Bond Advising and Underwriting
abstract: When can financial advisor conflicts of interest generate worse outcomes for clients? A regulation following from Dodd-Frank prohibits municipal advisors from simultaneously acting as bond underwriters. Using a difference-in-differences approach and 20,051 bond auctions, I test whether limited advisor privileges affect financial advice and borrower outcomes. Financing costs of bonds with potential dual advisor-underwriters fall by 11.4 basis points after the advisor is no longer allowed to underwrite. The decline follows from increases in standardization, third-party certification, and auction participation, all of which are consistent with limiting the adverse selection that arises from advisors withholding information from the market. (JEL D44, D53, G12, G14, G28, H74)
summary: 本文研究市政债券顾问与承销商之间的利益冲突对客户融资成本的影响。基于Dodd-Frank法案后禁止市政顾问同时担任承销商的监管变化，利用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）分析20051次债券拍卖数据。结果发现，当潜在的双重角色顾问不再被允许承销后，债券融资成本下降11.4个基点。这一下降源于标准化程度提高、第三方认证增加以及拍卖参与度提升，这些变化均与限制顾问向市场隐瞒信息所导致的逆向选择（adverse selection）相一致。
ai_comment: 论文利用准自然实验清晰识别了利益冲突对市场效率的负面影响，为监管有效性提供了实证支持。

title: The SOE Premium and Government Support in China's Credit Market
abstract: Studying China's credit market using a structural default model that integrates credit risk, liquidity, and bailout, we document improved price discovery and a deepening divide between state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) and non‐SOEs. Amidst liquidity deterioration, the presence of government bailout helps alleviate the heightened liquidity‐driven default, making SOE bonds more valuable and widening the SOE premium. Meanwhile, the increased importance of government support makes SOEs more sensitive to bailout, while the heightened default risk increases non‐SOEs' sensitivity to credit quality. Examining the real impact, we find severe performance deteriorations of non‐SOEs relative to SOEs, reversing the long‐standing trend of non‐SOEs outperforming SOEs.
summary: 本文采用一个整合信用风险、流动性和政府救助的结构违约模型，研究中国信贷市场。研究发现，价格发现得到改善，但国有企业和非国有企业之间的差距加深。在流动性恶化的情况下，政府救助有助于缓解流动性驱动的违约，使得国企债券更具价值，从而扩大了国企溢价。同时，政府支持重要性的增加使得国企对救助更加敏感，而违约风险的上升使得非国企对信用质量更加敏感。从实际影响来看，非国企相对国企的表现严重恶化，逆转了非国企长期优于国企的趋势。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型量化了政府救助在流动性危机中的关键作用，揭示了国企溢价扩大的机制，并发现了非国企相对表现逆转的重要趋势，具有深刻的政策含义。

title: Firm Performance Pay as Insurance against Promotion Risk
abstract: The prevalence of pay based on risky firm outcomes for nonexecutive workers presents a puzzling departure from conventional contract theory, which predicts insurance provision by the firm. When workers at the same firm compete against each other for promotions, the optimal contract features pay based on firm outcomes as insurance against promotion risk. The model's predictions are consistent with many observed phenomena, such as performance‐based vesting and overvaluation of equity pay by nonexecutive workers. It also generates novel predictions linking a firm's hierarchy to its workers' pay structure.
summary: 本文研究非执行员工基于公司风险的绩效薪酬的普遍性，这一现象与传统合同理论中公司应提供保险的预测相悖。当同一公司的员工互相竞争晋升时，最优合同包含基于公司绩效的薪酬，作为晋升风险的保险。模型预测与许多观察到的现象一致，如基于绩效的归属和非执行员工对股权支付的过高估价，并提出了关于公司层级与员工薪酬结构的新预测。
ai_comment: 从晋升竞争视角为股权薪酬的普遍性提供了新解释，挑战了传统保险理论，并产生了可检验的层级与薪酬结构关系。

title: Business News and Business Cycles
abstract: We propose an approach to measuring the state of the economy via textual analysis of business news. From the full text of 800,000 Wall Street Journal articles for 1984 to 2017, we estimate a topic model that summarizes business news into interpretable topical themes and quantifies the proportion of news attention allocated to each theme over time. News attention closely tracks a wide range of economic activities and can forecast aggregate stock market returns. A text‐augmented vector autoregression demonstrates the large incremental role of news text in forecasting macroeconomic dynamics. We retrieve the narratives that underlie these improvements in market and business cycle forecasts.
summary: 本文提出通过商业新闻的文本分析来衡量经济状态。基于1984年至2017年间80万篇《华尔街日报》文章的全文，作者估计了一个主题模型，将商业新闻总结为可解释的主题，并量化每个主题随时间变化的新闻关注度。研究发现，新闻关注度与广泛的经济活动密切相关，并能预测整体股市回报。通过文本增强的向量自回归模型，展示了新闻文本在预测宏观经济动态中的显著增量作用。此外，研究还提取了改善市场与商业周期预测背后的叙事。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用大规模新闻文本的主题模型来度量经济状态，并展示了其在预测市场回报和宏观经济动态中的增量价值，为文本分析在宏观金融领域的应用提供了有力证据。

title: Movements in Yields, not the Equity Premium: Bernanke-Kuttner Redux
Exchange Rate Determination under Limits to CIP Arbitrage
abstract: Recent theories of exchange rate determination have emphasized limited UIP arbitrage by international financial institutions.New regulations since 2008 have also lead to imperfect CIP arbitrage.We show that under limited CIP arbitrage the exchange rate and CIP deviation are jointly determined by equilibrium in the FX spot and swap markets.The model is used to investigate the impact of a wide range of financial shocks.The exchange rate is affected by a new set of financial shocks that operate through the swap market, which have no effect under perfect CIP arbitrage.More familiar financial shocks that impact the spot market have an amplified effect on the exchange rate as a result of their feedback to the swap market.Implications of the model are consistent with a broad range of evidence.
summary: 论文研究了在无抛补利率平价（CIP）套利受限条件下的汇率决定。自2008年以来，新监管导致CIP套利不完全。作者证明，在有限CIP套利下，汇率和CIP偏差由外汇即期和掉期市场的均衡共同决定。模型用于研究多种金融冲击的影响。汇率受到通过掉期市场操作的新金融冲击的影响，而在完美CIP套利下这些冲击没有影响。更熟悉的冲击即期市场的金融冲击，由于其对掉期市场的反馈，对汇率有放大效应。模型的含义与广泛的证据一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入有限CIP套利，将掉期市场纳入汇率决定框架，揭示了金融冲击通过新渠道影响汇率，对传统模型进行了重要扩展。

title: Dual Credit Markets: Income Risk, Household Debt, and Consumption
abstract: Many young employees work on a temporary basis, which entails significantly greater income risk than "permanent" work, even for jobs in the same occupation and at a similar wage.We find that this income uncertainty leads lenders to ration credit to temporary workers, precisely at the stage of life when permanent workers rely on mortgages to invest in housing and loans to smooth consumption and purchase durable goods.Labor laws that improve job security for permanent workers create a dual credit market alongside the dual labor market, making it harder for young adults to establish financial independence and new families.
summary: 许多年轻员工从事临时工作，相较于同一职业、相似工资的永久员工，面临显著更高的收入风险。这种收入不确定性导致贷款机构对临时工实行信贷配给，而永久工在同一生命阶段却依赖抵押贷款购房、平滑消费和购买耐用品。改善永久工工作保障的劳动法在双轨劳动力市场之外创造了双重信贷市场，使年轻人更难建立财务独立和组建新家庭。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地联结了劳动力市场双轨制与信贷市场分割，揭示了劳动保护政策对金融公平的意外影响，对理解年轻家庭财务脆弱性具有重要启示。

title: NAR Settlement, House Prices, and Consumer Welfare
abstract: Motivated by the recent National Association of Realtors (NAR) settlement, we examine how reduced real estate agent commissions affect home prices, housing turnover, and consumer welfare.Using a calibrated dynamic structural search model, we show that by reducing future transaction costs, lower commissions raise the value of housing as a durable asset and tend to increase house prices.While reduced fees generally improve consumer welfare, most gains accrue to current homeowners, with limited benefits for prospective buyers.Higher prices may also crowd out financially constrained households, suggesting that lower agent fees are unlikely to significantly improve housing affordability and access.Our findings underscore the importance of accounting for market dynamics, consumer heterogeneity, and general equilibrium effects.They also shed light on the redistributive implications of technological innovations-such as those leveraging AI-that reduce transaction costs.Finally, our analysis suggests that static IO-style models may be ill-suited to studying transaction costs in durable goods markets, where dynamic considerations and repeated resale are central, as this can lead to misestimated magnitudes and even incorrect signs of key effects.
summary: 这项研究以美国全国房地产经纪人协会（NAR）近期和解为背景，考察降低房地产经纪人佣金如何影响房价、住房交易量和消费者福利。通过校准的动态结构搜索模型，研究发现：降低佣金会减少未来交易成本，从而提升住房作为耐用资产的价值，倾向于推高房价。虽然降低费用总体上改善消费者福利，但大部分收益归现有房主所有，对潜在购房者的好处有限。房价上涨还可能挤出财务受限的家庭，表明降低经纪人佣金不太可能显著改善住房可负担性和可及性。研究强调了考虑市场动态、消费者异质性和一般均衡效应的重要性，并揭示了降低交易成本的技术创新（如AI）的分配效应。此外，分析表明静态产业组织模型不适用于研究耐用商品市场的交易成本，因为动态考虑和重复转售至关重要，否则可能导致关键效应的估计错误甚至符号颠倒。
ai_comment: 该研究通过动态结构模型揭示了降低佣金对房价的意外推升效应，并指出了静态模型的局限性，对政策制定和技术创新具有重要启示。

title: Who Benefits from Retirement Saving Incentives in the U.S.? Evidence on Gaps in Retirement Wealth Accumulation by Race and Parental Income
Managing Margins: PE Effects on Financial, Physical, and Human Capital
abstract: Private equity (PE) plays an increasingly important role in the modern US economy.However, its impacts on owned-firms are incompletely understood.We exploit a historically large leveraged buyout of a national hospital chain to examine how the full life cycle of PE influences hospitallevel revenues, technology sourcing, labor use, and financial performance.We find permanent improvements in hospital volumes and revenues.PE also reduces growth in full-time employees, with a suggestive partial substitution toward part-time workers.Technology adoption is restrained, but the number of vendors expands.Overall, PE has nuanced effects on hospital management, which translate to improved operating margins.
summary: 本文利用历史上一次大型杠杆收购（一家全国性医院连锁被收购）作为自然实验，全面考察私募股权（PE）在其完整生命周期内对医院层面的收入、技术采用、劳动力使用和财务绩效的影响。研究发现，PE带来了医院业务量和收入的永久性改善，同时减少了全职员工的增长，并部分替代为兼职员工。技术采用受到抑制，但供应商数量增加。总体而言，PE对医院管理产生了细微的影响，最终提升了经营利润率。
ai_comment: 本文利用大规模杠杆收购作为准自然实验，提供了PE对实体企业影响的因果证据，尤其关注人力资本和技术决策的微妙变化，丰富了PE经济后果的研究。

title: Why Do Europeans Save? Micro-Evidence from the Household Finance and Consumption Survey
abstract: We analyze the saving motives of European households using micro‐data from the Household Finance and Consumption Survey, which is conducted by the European Central Bank. We find that the rank ordering of saving motives differs greatly depending on what criterion is used to rank them. We find that the precautionary motive is the most important saving motive of European households when the proportion of households saving for each motive is used as the criterion to rank them, but that the retirement motive is the most important saving motive of European households if the quantitative importance of each motive is taken into account. Moreover, the generosity of social safety nets seems to affect the importance of individual saving motives, with saving for the retirement motive being less important in countries with generous public pension benefits and saving for the precautionary motive being less important in countries with generous public health systems.
summary: 本文利用欧洲央行进行的家庭金融与消费调查（HFCS）的微观数据，分析欧洲家庭的储蓄动机。研究发现，根据不同的排名标准，储蓄动机的排序存在显著差异：当以储蓄各动机的家庭比例作为排名标准时，预防性动机是最重要的储蓄动机；但当考虑各动机的量化重要性时，退休动机则成为最重要的储蓄动机。此外，社会安全网的慷慨程度会影响各储蓄动机的重要性，例如在公共养老金慷慨的国家，退休动机的重要性较低；而在公共医疗体系慷慨的国家，预防性动机的重要性较低。
ai_comment: 该论文通过微观数据揭示了储蓄动机排序对排名标准的敏感性，并考察了社会保障制度的影响，为理解欧洲家庭储蓄行为提供了细致见解。

title: The Impact of Cloud Computing and AI on Industry Dynamics and Concentration
abstract: We examine the rise of cloud computing and AI in China and their impacts on industry dynamics after the shock to the cost of Internet-based computing power and services. We find that cloud computing is associated with an increase in firm entry, exit and the likelihood of M&A in industries that depend more on cloud infrastructure. Conversely, AI adoption has no impact on entry but reduces the likelihood of exit and M&A. Firm size plays a crucial role in these dynamics: cloud computing increases exit rates across all firms, while larger firms benefit from AI, experiencing reduced exit rates. Cloud computing decreases industry concentration but AI increases concentration. On the financing side, firms exposed to cloud computing increase equity and venture capital financing, while only large firms increase equity financing when exposed to AI.
summary: 本文考察了中国云计算和人工智能（AI）的兴起及其对行业动态的影响，基于互联网计算能力和服务成本冲击。研究发现，云计算增加了对云基础设施依赖较高行业的企业进入、退出和并购（M&A）的可能性；而AI采用对进入无影响，但降低了退出和并购的概率。企业规模在这些动态中起关键作用：云计算提高了所有企业的退出率，而大型企业从AI中受益，退出率降低。云计算降低了行业集中度，但AI提高了集中度。在融资方面，接触云计算的企业增加了股权和风险资本融资，而只有大型企业在接触AI时增加了股权融资。
ai_comment: 该论文区分了云计算和AI对行业动态的不同影响，并揭示了企业规模的调节作用，为理解技术变革的竞争效应提供了新视角。

title: Macro-Financial Implications of the Surging Global Demand (and Supply) of International Reserves
abstract: Research has shown that the unilateral accumulation of international reserves by a country can improve its own macro-financial stability.However, we show that when many countries accumulate reserves, the induced general equilibrium effects weaken financial and macroeconomic stability, especially for countries that do not accumulate reserves.The issuance of public debt by advanced economies has the opposite effect.We derive these results from a two-region model where private defaultable debt has a productive use.Quantitative counterfactuals show that the surge in reserves (public debt) contributed to reduce (increase) world interest rates but also to increase (reduce) private leverage.This in turn increased (decreased) volatility in both emerging and advanced economies.
summary: 已有研究表明，一国单边积累国际储备可改善自身宏观金融稳定。然而，本文发现当多国同时积累储备时，引发的一般均衡效应会削弱金融和宏观经济稳定性，尤其对不积累储备的国家影响更大。发达经济体发行公共债务则产生相反效应。本文基于一个两区域模型推导出上述结果，模型中私人违约债务具有生产性用途。量化反事实分析显示，储备激增（公共债务增加）导致世界利率下降（上升），同时私人杠杆上升（下降），进而加剧了新兴和发达经济体的波动性。
ai_comment: 本文通过一般均衡框架揭示了集体储备积累的负面溢出效应，对传统单国视角的研究形成重要补充，为理解全球储备体系演变提供了新视角。

title: Neural Network Learning for Nonlinear Economies
abstract: Neural networks offer a promising tool for the analysis of nonlinear economies. In this paper, we derive conditions for the stability of nonlinear rational expectations equilibria under neural network learning. We demonstrate the applicability of the conditions in analytical and numerical examples where the nonlinearity is caused by monetary policy targeting a range, rather than a specific value, of inflation. If shock persistence is high or there is inertia in the structure of the economy, then the only rational expectations equilibria that are learnable may involve inflation spending long periods outside its target range. Neural network learning is also useful for solving and selecting between multiple equilibria and steady states in other settings, such as when there is a zero lower bound on the nominal interest rate.
summary: 本文研究了非线性经济体中基于神经网络学习的理性预期均衡的稳定性条件，推导了在神经网络学习下均衡稳定的充分条件。通过货币政策瞄准通胀区间（而非单一目标值）的数值例子，展示了该条件的适用性。研究发现，当冲击具有高持续性或经济结构存在惯性时，唯一可学习的理性预期均衡可能导致通胀长期偏离目标区间。此外，神经网络学习还可用于求解和选择多重均衡及稳态，例如名义利率零下限的情形。
ai_comment: 该论文将神经网络学习理论应用于宏观经济学非线性均衡分析，为通胀目标区间政策下的学习动态提供了理论依据，并展示了神经网络在多重均衡选择中的新用途。

title: Bank Lending and Deposit Crunches during the Great Depression
abstract: Bank distress was a defining feature of the Great Depression in the United States. Most banks, however, weathered the storm and remained in operation throughout the contraction. We show that surviving banks cut lending when depositors withdrew funds en masse during panics. This panic-induced decline in lending explains about one-third of the reduction in aggregate commercial bank lending between 1929 and 1932, more than twice as much as attributed to the failure of banks.
summary: 本文研究大萧条时期银行恐慌对幸存银行贷款行为的影响。发现恐慌期间储户大规模提取资金导致幸存银行削减贷款，这种恐慌导致的贷款减少解释了1929-1932年间商业银行总贷款减少的三分之一，是银行倒闭效应的两倍多。
ai_comment: 该研究量化了恐慌中幸存银行贷款收缩的宏观经济影响，揭示了存款挤兑对信贷供给的重要传导机制。

title: Understanding Korea’s Long-Run Real Exchange Rate Behavior
abstract: Korea's real exchange rate has displayed a mild downward trend since the 1980s, with fluctuations of ±20 percent around that trend.This pattern is surprising because the classic Harrod-Balassa-Samuelson framework suggests that countries experiencing rapid growth in the productivity of their tradable industries should experience real currency appreciation over time.We decompose the sources of change behind the Korean won's real exchange rate into internal price drivers (the relative price of nontradable goods) and external price drivers (the international relative price of tradable consumption goods, which is heavily dependent on the nominal exchange rate).We find that, on average, the variability in Korea's real exchange rate, even over long periods, is overwhelmingly due to external price factors.Given the persistent medium-term effects of nominal exchange rate changes on the real exchange rate, the Korean policy of intervening in foreign exchange markets to smooth exchange rate fluctuations appears prudent.However, we also find that over the entire period 1985-2023, internal price factors are the main explanator of the won's real depreciation.This finding poses a puzzle for standard accounts of the linkage between productivity growth and real exchange rates.
summary: 韩国自1980年代以来的实际汇率呈现温和下降趋势，并围绕该趋势有±20%的波动。这一现象令人惊讶，因为经典的Harrod-Balassa-Samuelson框架预测，贸易品部门生产率快速增长的国家应经历实际汇率长期升值。本文分解了韩元实际汇率变动的驱动因素：内部价格因素（非贸易品相对价格）和外部价格因素（贸易消费品国际相对价格，强烈依赖名义汇率）。研究发现，平均而言，韩元实际汇率的波动，即使长期来看，也主要由外部价格因素驱动。考虑到名义汇率变动对实际汇率的持续中期影响，韩国干预外汇市场以平滑汇率波动的政策显得审慎。然而，在1985-2023年整个期间，内部价格因素才是韩元实际贬值的主要解释因素。这一发现对生产率增长与实际汇率之间关系的标准解释提出了挑战。
ai_comment: 该文通过分解内部与外部价格因素，揭示了韩国实际汇率长期趋势与经典理论预测的悖论，挑战了生产率增长驱动升值的传统观点。

title: Deep Learning for Economists
abstract: Deep learning provides powerful methods to impute structured information from large-scale, unstructured text and image datasets.For example, economists might wish to detect the presence of economic activity in satellite images, or to measure the topics or entities mentioned in social media, the congressional record, or firm filings.This review introduces deep neural networks, covering methods such as classifiers, regression models, generative AI, and embedding models.Applications include classification, document digitization, record linkage, and methods for data exploration in massive scale text and image corpora.When suitable methods are used, deep learning models can be cheap to tune and can scale affordably to problems involving millions or billions of data points..The review is accompanied by a companion website, EconDL, with userfriendly demo notebooks, software resources, and a knowledge base that provides technical details and additional applications.
summary: 该综述介绍了深度学习在经济学家中的应用，重点在于从大规模非结构化文本和图像数据中推断结构化信息的方法。覆盖了深度神经网络，包括分类器、回归模型、生成式AI和嵌入模型等技术。应用场景包括检测卫星图像中的经济活动、衡量社交媒体或国会记录及公司文件中的主题或实体、分类、文档数字化、记录链接以及大规模文本和图像语料库的数据探索。当方法适当时，深度学习模型调优成本低，并能以可负担的规模处理涉及数百万或数十亿数据点的问题。该综述还配备了一个配套网站EconDL，提供用户友好的演示笔记本、软件资源以及包含技术细节和其他应用的知识库。
ai_comment: 为经济学家量身定制的深度学习综述，强调实用性和可扩展性，并附有实操资源，极具参考价值。

title: The Effect of New Information Technologies on Asset Pricing Anomalies
abstract: We test and compare the effects of introduction of two new financial information technologies, EDGAR and XBRL, on well-known asset pricing anomalies often attributed to mispricing.EDGAR facilitates easier access to public accounting information about public firms; XBRL reduces the cost of processing such information.Using stacked difference-in-differences regressions, we find that both EDGAR and XBRL reduce mispricing for accounting-based anomalies but not for non-accounting-based anomalies.The economic magnitudes of the effects on accounting-based anomalies are similar for EDGAR and XBRL.These results suggest that both easier access to and less costly processing of public information enhance market efficiency.
summary: 本文检验并比较了两种新型金融信息技术——EDGAR和XBRL——对常见资产定价异象（通常归因于错误定价）的影响。EDGAR便于获取上市公司的公开会计信息，而XBRL降低了处理此类信息的成本。通过使用堆叠双重差分回归，研究发现EDGAR和XBRL均减少了基于会计的异象（如盈利动量、应计异象等）的错误定价，但对非基于会计的异象（如动量、波动率异象等）没有显著影响。两者对基于会计的异象的经济影响幅度相似。这些结果表明，更便捷地获取和更低成本地处理公共信息能够增强市场效率。
ai_comment: 本文通过准自然实验方法，分离了信息获取成本与处理成本对市场效率的影响，为信息技术如何改善资产定价提供了因果证据。

title: Distributed Ledgers and Secure Multi-Party Computation for Financial Reporting and Auditing
abstract: To understand the disruption and implications of distributed ledger technologies for financial reporting and auditing, we analyze firm misreporting, auditor monitoring and competition, and regulatory policy in a unified model.A federated blockchain for financial reporting and auditing can improve verification efficiency not only for transactions in private databases, but also for cross-chain verifications through privacy-preserving computation protocols.Despite the potential benefit of blockchains, private incentives for firms and first-mover advantages for auditors can create inefficient under-adoption or partial adoption that favors larger auditors.Although a regulator can help coordinate the adoption of technology, endogenous choice of transaction partners by firms can still lead to adoption failure.Our model also provides an initial framework for further studies of the costs and implications of the use of distributed ledgers and secure multi-party computation in financial reporting, including the positive spillover to discretionary auditing and who should bear the cost of adoption.
summary: 这篇论文构建了一个统一模型，分析分布式账本技术（DLT）对财务报告和审计的颠覆性影响及启示。该模型研究企业误报、审计师监督与竞争以及监管政策。研究发现，一个用于财务报告和审计的联邦区块链可以通过隐私保护计算协议提高私有数据库交易以及跨链验证的效率。尽管区块链具有潜在优势，但企业的私人激励和审计师的先发优势可能导致低效的采用不足或部分采用，且偏向大型审计师。虽然监管机构可以帮助协调技术采用，但企业内生的交易伙伴选择仍可能导致采用失败。该模型为后续研究分布式账本和安全多方计算在财务报告中的成本与影响（包括对自由审计的正向溢出效应及采用成本的承担方）提供了初步框架。
ai_comment: 该论文将区块链、安全多方计算与审计监管结合，深入剖析了技术采纳中的市场失灵，为理解分布式账本在会计领域的实际应用困境提供了理论框架。

title: Auditor Tenure and Misreporting: Evidence from a Dynamic Oligopoly Game
abstract: We estimate an infinite-horizon dynamic oligopoly model of audit firm tenure and misstatements and evaluate a policy counterfactual involving mandatory audit firm rotation. Longer tenure lowers the cost of producing audits, increasing audit quality and reducing audit fees. Thus clients are less likely to misstate and more likely to keep the incumbent audit firm as tenure increases. By reducing the value of retaining audit firms, mandatory rotation leads to large increases in auditor switches, even before the term limit, implying increases in the switching costs borne by clients. Misstatement rates increase because audit firms endogenously lower audit quality and newly hired audit firms have lower quality. Overall, the model suggests caution when evaluating the costs and benefits of government oversight over the audit profession. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: The authors thank the financial support from the Olin Busiiness School and the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4944 .
summary: 该论文构建了一个无限期动态寡头垄断模型，研究审计事务所任期与财务报表错报之间的关系，并评估了强制审计事务所轮换政策的反事实效果。研究发现，更长的审计任期会降低审计生产成本，从而提高审计质量并降低审计费用，使得客户更少发生错报，也更倾向于继续聘用现任审计事务所。然而，强制轮换政策降低了保留审计事务所的价值，导致在任期限制之前就出现大量的审计事务所变更，增加了客户承担的转换成本。由于审计事务所内生地降低了审计质量，且新聘用的审计事务所质量较低，错报率反而上升。整体而言，该模型提醒在评估审计行业政府监管的成本与收益时需要谨慎。
ai_comment: 采用结构模型估计审计市场动态，反事实分析揭示了强制轮换政策的意外后果，对监管有重要启示。

title: Impact of Physician Payment Scheme on Diagnostic Effort and Testing
abstract: Diagnostic errors are common and can result in serious patient harm. Making the right diagnosis often requires significant diagnostic effort. Yet most physician payment schemes are procedure based and do not account for diagnostic effort or accuracy because of observability issues. In this paper, we develop a parsimonious model to examine the impact of a physician payment scheme on a physician’s decisions to (1) exert diagnostic effort and (2) perform a confirmatory test. High effort provides an informative (though imperfect) signal of the patient’s true state; the test is confirmatory in that it is a prerequisite for diagnosing a severe condition. Our model uses a two-step diagnostic process to capture the interaction between the physician’s diagnostic effort and testing decisions. We show that under a fee-for-service payment scheme, the physician may view the diagnostic effort and the confirmatory test as either complementary or substitutive, depending on the additional revenue from testing. We also reveal nonmonotonic properties such that a more patient-centered physician may not exert more effort or provide a more accurate diagnosis. In addition, either a flat or differentiated payment scheme may be optimal. We also show that an alternative payment scheme, under which the revenue from the confirmatory test is contingent on its result, can induce the social optimum under certain conditions. With the advent of artificial intelligence as part of the standard of care and its increasing use as confirmatory tests, our research has implications for the design of physician payment systems in light of concerns about the potential erosion of individual attention. This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management. Funding: T. Dai was supported by the Johns Hopkins Discovery Award (2022–2024) and the Hopkins Business of Health Initiative Seed Grant (2022–2023). Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4937 .
summary: 本文研究医生支付方案对医生诊断努力和确认性测试决策的影响。诊断错误常见且危害严重，正确诊断需大量努力，但多数支付方案基于过程，不考虑诊断努力或准确性。作者构建了一个简约的两步诊断过程模型，分析医生在按服务收费（fee-for-service）方案下，如何选择诊断努力（提供关于患者真实状态的有信息但非完美信号）和执行确认性测试（诊断严重状况的前提）。模型揭示：在按服务收费下，医生可能将诊断努力和确认性测试视为互补或替代，取决于测试的额外收益；同时存在非单调性，即更以患者为中心的医生不一定付出更多努力或提供更准确诊断；平坦或差异化支付方案可能最优；而一种替代支付方案（确认性测试收入取决于结果）可在特定条件下诱导社会最优。随着人工智能成为标准护理并越来越多作为确认性测试，本研究对设计医生支付体系具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 本文通过建模揭示医生支付方案的复杂影响，特别是诊断努力与测试之间的互补/替代关系，为医疗支付体系设计提供了新视角。

title: Tick Size and Earnings Guidance in Small-Cap Firms: Evidence from the SEC’s Tick Size Pilot Program
abstract: The Securities and Exchange Commission’s 2016 Tick Size Pilot Program was a natural experiment that imposed increases in tick size for randomly selected small-cap firms. Using a difference-in-differences research design, we examine the effect of this increase in tick size on earnings guidance. We find that after initiation of the program, treatment firms provide significantly less earnings guidance. We provide further evidence that this decrease is driven by increases in investors’ fundamental information acquisition and in firms’ financial reporting quality, consistent with firms reducing earnings guidance when investors are already more informed. The decrease is stronger for firms with higher proprietary costs of disclosure, consistent with firms being more likely to reduce costly disclosure when investors are more informed. In contrast, the decrease is weaker for firms with greater external financing needs, consistent with these firms continuing to seek the benefits of disclosure, even when investors are more informed. Taken together, our results suggest that an increase in tick size makes investors more informed, which, in turn, reduces the need for firms to provide earnings guidance, though the extent of the reduction depends on the costs and benefits of providing earnings guidance. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4930 .
summary: 本文利用美国证券交易委员会2016年实施的Tick Size Pilot Program作为自然实验，该实验随机增加了小型股公司的最小报价单位。采用双重差分法，研究了最小报价单位增大对盈利预测指引的影响。发现实验启动后，处理组公司显著减少了盈利预测指引。进一步证据表明，这种减少是由投资者基础信息获取增加和公司财务报告质量提升驱动的，与公司在投资者信息更充分时减少盈利预测指引的预期一致。对于披露专有成本较高的公司，减少效应更强，而对有外部融资需求的公司，减少效应较弱。整体结果表明，最小报价单位增大使投资者信息更充分，从而降低了公司提供盈利预测指引的必要性，但减少程度取决于提供指引的成本和收益。
keywords: 最小报价单位试点计划
ai_comment: 利用自然实验和双重差分方法，为最小报价单位影响公司信息披露行为提供了因果证据，并深入分析了背后的机制和异质性。

title: Policy Learning with Adaptively Collected Data
abstract: In a wide variety of applications, including healthcare, bidding in first price auctions, digital recommendations, and online education, it can be beneficial to learn a policy that assigns treatments to individuals based on their characteristics. The growing policy-learning literature focuses on settings in which policies are learned from historical data in which the treatment assignment rule is fixed throughout the data-collection period. However, adaptive data collection is becoming more common in practice from two primary sources: (1) data collected from adaptive experiments that are designed to improve inferential efficiency and (2) data collected from production systems that progressively evolve an operational policy to improve performance over time (e.g., contextual bandits). Yet adaptivity complicates the problem of learning an optimal policy ex post for two reasons: first, samples are dependent and, second, an adaptive assignment rule may not assign each treatment to each type of individual sufficiently often. In this paper, we address these challenges. We propose an algorithm based on generalized augmented inverse propensity weighted (AIPW) estimators, which nonuniformly reweight the elements of a standard AIPW estimator to control worst case estimation variance. We establish a finite-sample regret upper bound for our algorithm and complement it with a regret lower bound that quantifies the fundamental difficulty of policy learning with adaptive data. When equipped with the best weighting scheme, our algorithm achieves minimax rate-optimal regret guarantees even with diminishing exploration. Finally, we demonstrate our algorithm’s effectiveness using both synthetic data and public benchmark data sets. This paper was accepted by Hamid Nazerzadeh, data science. Funding: This work is supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant CCF-2106508]. R. Zhan was supported by Golub Capital and the Michael Yao and Sara Keying Dai AI and Digital Technology Fund. Z. Ren was supported by the Office of Naval Research [Grant N00014-20-1-2337]. S. Athey was supported by the Office of Naval Research [Grant N00014-19-1-2468]. Z. Zhou is generously supported by the New York University’s 2022–2023 Center for Global Economy and Business faculty research grant and the Digital Twin research grant from Bain & Company. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4921 .
summary: 本文研究在自适应收集数据（如自适应实验和渐进式运营策略产生的数据）中进行策略学习的问题。由于样本依赖性和某些治疗分配不足，自适应数据增加了事后学习最优策略的难度。作者提出一种基于广义增强逆概率加权（AIPW）估计器的算法，通过非均匀重加权控制最坏情况下的估计方差。该算法在有限样本下具有遗憾上界，并匹配下界以实现极小化最优，即使在探索减少时也能保证最优遗憾。通过合成数据和公开基准数据集验证了算法的有效性。
keywords: 广义增广逆概率加权估计器
ai_comment: 本文为自适应数据下的策略学习提供了理论完备的算法，并证明了其极小化最优性，对机器学习与因果推断的交叉领域有重要贡献。

title: Reaching for Yield and the Cross Section of Bond Returns
abstract: Reaching for yield, which we define as an investor preference for higher-yield bonds at a given rating or for higher-rated bonds at given yields, is associated with inflated valuation and thus negatively predicts risk-adjusted returns. Controlling for ratings, alphas are lower for higher-yield bonds, whereas, controlling for yields, alphas are lower for safer-looking, higher-rated bonds. Future bond returns are particularly low when current interest rates are low and demand from yield-reaching investors increases. These bonds experience more frequent downgrades and defaults, suggesting that they are riskier despite their high valuation. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The e-companion and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4920 .
summary: 该论文将“追逐收益”定义为投资者在给定评级下偏好高收益债券，或在给定收益下偏好高评级债券。研究发现，这种行为导致估值膨胀，从而负向预测风险调整后收益。控制评级后，高收益债券的alpha更低；控制收益后，看似安全的高评级债券的alpha也更低。当当前利率较低且追逐收益的投资者需求增加时，未来债券收益尤其低迷。这些债券经历更频繁的降级和违约，表明尽管估值较高，它们实际上风险更高。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将投资者追逐收益的行为与债券的横截面收益联系起来，揭示了其估值泡沫和真实风险，尤其强调了低利率环境下该行为的放大效应，对资产定价和风险管理有重要启示。

title: Washington Policy Analysts and the Propagation of Political Information
abstract: Washington policy research analysts (WAs) monitor political developments and produce research to interpret the impact of these events. We find institutional clients channel more commissions to brokerages providing policy research and commission-allocating institutional clients generate superior returns on their politically sensitive trades. We find that WA policy research reports are associated with significant price and volume reactions. Finally, we find sell-side analysts with access to WA issue superior stock recommendations on politically sensitive stocks. These effects are particularly acute during periods of high political uncertainty. Overall, we uncover a unique and an important conduit through which political information filters into asset prices. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4919 .
summary: 华盛顿政策研究分析师（WAs）监测政治动态并发布研究报告以解读这些事件的影响。研究发现，机构客户将更多佣金分配给提供政策研究的经纪商，而这些分配佣金的机构客户在其政治敏感交易中获得了超额回报。WA政策研究报告与显著的价格和交易量反应相关。此外，拥有WA支持的分析师对政治敏感股票发布了更优的推荐。这些效应在政治不确定性高时尤为显著。总体而言，该研究揭示了一个独特且重要的渠道，政治信息通过该渠道过滤并融入资产价格。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了政策分析师在政治信息传导至市场价格中的关键角色，填补了政治事件与金融市场互动机制的研究空白，对理解信息传播和资产定价有重要贡献。

title: The SEC’s Short-Sale Experiment: Evidence on Causal Channels and Reassessment of Indirect Effects
abstract: During 2005–2007, the Securities and Exchange Commission conducted a randomized trial in which it removed short-sale restrictions from one third of the Russell 3000 firms. Early studies found modest market microstructure effects of removing the restrictions but no effect on short interest, stock returns, volatility, or price efficiency. More recently, many studies have attributed a wide range of indirect outcomes to this experiment, mostly without assessing the causal channels for those outcomes. We examine the three most often cited causal channels for these indirect effects: short interest, returns, and managerial fear. We find no evidence to support these channels. We then reexamine the principal findings in four recent studies using a sample that closely matches the actual experiment and a common research design and find minimal support for the reported indirect effects. Our findings highlight the importance of confirming a causal channel or an economic mechanism and show that sample selection and specification choices can produce statistical significance even without an underlying economic mechanism. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4918 .
summary: 该论文重新审视了美国证券交易委员会（SEC）在2005-2007年期间进行的一项随机实验，该实验取消了Russell 3000指数中三分之一公司的卖空限制。早期研究发现，取消限制仅对市场微观结构产生轻微影响，但对卖空兴趣、股票收益、波动性或价格效率无显著影响。然而，近期许多研究将广泛的间接效应归因于这一实验，但大多未验证因果渠道。作者检验了三个最常被引用的因果渠道：卖空兴趣、股票收益和管理层恐惧，未发现支持证据。随后，作者使用与实际实验紧密匹配的样本和统一的研究设计，重新检验了四项近期研究的主要结论，发现对报告的间接效应的支持非常有限。该研究强调了确认因果渠道或经济机制的重要性，并表明样本选择和规格选择即使在没有潜在经济机制的情况下也能产生统计显著性。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的复制和因果渠道检验，对大量引用SEC卖空实验的文献提出了有力质疑，揭示了实证研究中样本选择和规格选择可能导致的虚假发现。

title: Partisan Return Gap: The Polarized Stock Market in the Time of a Pandemic
abstract: Using two proxies for investors’ political affiliation, we document sharp differences in stock returns between firms likely dominated by Democratic investors (blue stocks) and those dominated by Republican investors (red stocks) during the COVID pandemic. Red stocks have 20 basis points higher risk-adjusted returns than blue stocks on COVID news days (Partisan Return Gap). Lockdown policies, COVID cases, industry and firm fundamentals only explain at most 40% of the return gap. Polarized political beliefs about COVID, revealed through people’s social distancing behavior, contribute to about 40% of the return gap beyond the fundamental channel. Our paper provides partisanship as a novel aspect in understanding abnormal stock returns during the pandemic. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data and e-companion are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4913 .
summary: 本文利用投资者政治倾向的两个代理变量，研究了COVID-19疫情期间由民主党投资者主导的股票（蓝股）和由共和党投资者主导的股票（红股）之间的回报差异。发现红股在COVID新闻日比蓝股有20个基点的更高风险调整回报（Partisan Return Gap）。封锁政策、COVID病例、行业和公司基本面最多只能解释该回报差距的40%。通过人们社交距离行为揭示的两极分化政治信念，贡献了基本面渠道之外的约40%的回报差距。论文提出了党派性作为理解疫情期间异常股票回报的新视角。
ai_comment: 该论文巧妙地将政治党派信念与股票市场异常回报联系起来，并量化了基本面与非基本面渠道的贡献，为行为金融提供了新视角。

title: Replicating and Digesting Anomalies in the Chinese A-Share Market
abstract: We replicate 469 anomaly variables similar to those studied by Hou et al. (2020) using Chinese A-share data and a reliable testing procedure with mainboard breakpoints and value-weighted returns. We find that 83.37% of the anomaly variables do not generate significant high-minus-low quintile raw return spreads. Further adjusting risk increases the failure rate slightly to 84.22% based on CAPM alphas and 86.99% based on Fama–French three-factor alphas. We show that the conventional procedure using all A-share breakpoints with equal-weighted returns for the anomaly test is indeed problematic as it assigns too much weight to microcaps and has a very limited investment capacity. The CH3-factor, CH4-factor, and q-factor models show the best performance over the whole sample period. The q-factor model is the best performer in the post-2007 subsample period after significant improvements occurred in China’s financial market environment, such as the completion of the split-share structure reform and the implementation of new accounting standards conforming to the International Financial Reporting Standards. The non–state-owned enterprise subsample in the post-2007 period is a cleaner sample in which the CH4-factor and q-factor models are the best performers. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: Z. Li acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72103043] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities in UIBE [Grants 19QN01 and 22PY053-72103043]. L. X. Liu acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 71872006 and 72273006]. L. X. Liu and X. Liu acknowledge financial support from the Guanghua Thought Leadership Platform of Peking University. K. C. J. Wei acknowledges partial financial support from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Grant 15507320]. The authors acknowledge financial support from the Guanghua School of Management, Peking University; the School of Banking and Finance, University of International Business and Economics; and the Non-PAIR Research Centre “Research Centre for Quantitative Finance” at Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4904 .
summary: 本文复制了Hou等人(2020)研究的469个异常变量，使用中国A股数据以及可靠的测试程序（主板断点和价值加权回报）。发现83.37%的异常变量不能产生显著的高减低五分组原始收益价差。进一步调整风险后，基于CAPM alpha和Fama-French三因子alpha的失败率分别略微上升至84.22%和86.99%。研究表明，使用全A股断点和等权回报的传统异常测试程序确实存在问题，因为它对微盘股赋予过多权重且投资容量非常有限。在整个样本期内，CH3因子、CH4因子和q因子模型表现最佳。在2007年后子样本期（中国金融市场环境显著改善后，如股权分置改革完成和实施符合国际财务报告准则的新会计准则），q因子模型是表现最好的。在2007年后的非国有企业子样本中（更干净的样本），CH4因子和q因子模型是表现最好的。
ai_comment: 该文系统性地复制了大量异常变量，揭示了中国A股市场中多数异常不显著，并指出了传统测试程序的缺陷，为因子模型在中国市场的适用性提供了重要证据。

title: Machine Learning for Demand Estimation in Long Tail Markets
abstract: Random coefficient multinomial logit models are widely used to estimate customer preferences from sales data. However, these estimation models can only allow for products with positive sales; this selection leads to highly biased estimates in long tail markets, that is, markets where many products have zero or low sales. Such markets are increasingly common in areas such as online retail and other online marketplaces. In this paper, we propose a two-stage estimator that uses machine learning to correct for this bias. Our method first uses deep learning to predict the market shares of all products, where the neural network’s structure mirrors the random coefficient multinomial logit model’s data generating process. In the second stage, we use the predictions of the first stage to reweight the observed shares in a way that corrects for the induced bias and maintains the causal interpretation of the structural model. We show that the estimated parameters are consistent in the number of markets. Our method performs well on simulated and real long tail data, producing accurate estimates of customer behavior. These improved estimates can subsequently be used to provide prescriptive policy recommendations on important managerial decisions such as pricing, assortment, and so on. This paper was accepted by Gabriel Weintraub, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4893 .
summary: 随机系数多项logit模型广泛应用于从销售数据估计客户偏好，但这类模型只能处理正销售产品，在长尾市场（即许多产品零销售或低销售的市场）中会导致严重估计偏差。针对这一问题，本文提出一种两阶段估计器，利用机器学习纠正偏差。第一阶段使用深度学习预测所有产品的市场份额，其中神经网络结构模仿随机系数多项logit模型的数据生成过程；第二阶段利用第一阶段的预测值重新加权观测到的市场份额，以纠正选择偏差并保持结构模型的因果解释。理论证明估计参数在市场数量上具有一致性。在模拟数据和真实长尾数据上的实验表明，该方法能够准确估计客户行为，并能进一步用于定价、品类优化等重要管理决策的制定。该文已被Management Science接收。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将深度学习与结构模型结合，有效解决了长尾市场中的选择偏差问题，理论证明与实证表现均具说服力，对在线零售等领域的实践有重要指导价值。

title: Analyst Coverage Networks and Corporate Financial Policies
abstract: We use the setting of analyst coverage networks to shed light on the nature of peer effects in financial policies. First, we use the “friends-of-friends” approach and exploit the fact that analyst coverage networks partially overlap to identify endogenous peer effects, in which firms respond directly to the capital structure choices of their peers, separately from contextual effects, in which they respond to their peers’ characteristics. We further show evidence that analysts facilitate these peer effects through their role as informational intermediaries. Analyst network peer effects are distinct from industry peer effects and are more pronounced among peers connected by analysts that are more experienced and from more influential brokerage houses. Finally, the analyst peer effects become weaker after exogenous reductions in common coverage as a consequence of brokerage closures. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: F. Marcet acknowledges funding from ANID/CONICYT Proyecto FONDECYT Iniciacion [Grant 11221187]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4891 .
summary: 本文利用分析师覆盖网络研究企业财务政策（尤其是资本结构）中的同伴效应。采用“朋友的朋友”方法，利用分析师覆盖网络部分重叠的特性，区分内生同伴效应（企业直接响应同行的资本结构选择）与情境效应（响应同行特征）。研究发现，分析师作为信息中介促进了这些同伴效应，且分析师网络同伴效应与行业同伴效应不同，在分析师经验更丰富或来自更有影响力经纪公司的同伴中更为显著。此外，由于经纪公司关闭导致共同覆盖外生减少后，分析师同伴效应减弱。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用网络分析识别内生同伴效应，并借助外生冲击验证因果关系，为理解信息传递与公司决策互动提供了新视角。

title: When Bankers Go to Hail: Insights into Fed–Bank Interactions from Taxi Data
abstract: We introduce taxi ridership between the Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank of New York and large financial institutions headquartered in New York City as a novel proxy for Fed–bank face-to-face interactions. We document a negative relation between past Fed–bank interactions and future stock market returns, particularly on days around the Fed’s public announcements. We also find significantly elevated Fed–bank interactions immediately following the lifting of the Federal Open Market Committee blackout. Our findings suggest that the Fed increases its information gathering via face-to-face interactions when it possesses negative private information about the condition of the economy. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Muma College of Business Center for Analytics and Creativity at the University South Florida, the George Stigler Center for the Study of the Economy and the State, the Lynde and Harry Bradley Foundation, the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, the Liew Fama-Miller Fellowship, and the Fischer Black Fellowship. Supplemental Material: Data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4885 .
summary: 本文利用纽约联邦储备银行与纽约大型金融机构之间的出租车出行次数作为美联储与银行面对面互动的新代理变量。研究发现，过去的美联储-银行互动与未来股市回报呈负相关，尤其是在美联储公开声明前后。同时，在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）封锁期结束后，互动显著增加。这些发现表明，当美联储掌握关于经济状况的负面私人信息时，会通过面对面互动加强信息收集。
ai_comment: 创新性地使用出租车数据量化监管者-金融机构互动，为理解央行信息优势与市场传导机制提供了新视角。

title: Extrapolative Uncertainty and Household Economic Behavior
abstract: We examine the uncertainty in households’ expectations regarding macroeconomic outcomes, namely inflation and the rate of nationwide home price growth. We document that people extrapolate from the instability of their personal and local environment when assessing the future volatility of these macroeconomic variables. Consequently, there are within-person spillovers in subjective uncertainty regarding different economic outcomes. This extrapolative behavior is more pronounced among lower-numeracy individuals, and it persists throughout the business cycle. People with more uncertain macroeconomic expectations are more likely to engage in precautionary behaviors regarding consumption and equity market exposure and are more concerned about credit market access. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00820 .
summary: 本文研究了家庭对宏观经济结果（通货膨胀和全国房价增长率）预期的不确定性。作者发现，人们会从自身及当地环境的不稳定性中推断这些宏观经济变量的未来波动性，从而导致不同经济结果的主观不确定性存在个人内部溢出效应。这种外推行为在计算能力较低的个体中更为明显，并贯穿整个经济周期。宏观经济预期不确定性较高的家庭更倾向于采取预防性消费和股市暴露行为，并对信贷市场准入更加担忧。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地揭示了家庭主观不确定性的外推形成机制及其对消费和投资行为的显著影响，为理解预期异质性提供了新视角。

title: Understanding Partnership Formation and Repeated Contributions in Federated Learning: An Analytical Investigation
abstract: Limited access to large-scale data is a key obstacle to building machine learning (ML) applications in practice, partly due to a reluctance of information exchange among data owners out of privacy and data security concerns. To address this “information silo” problem, federated learning (FL) techniques have been proposed to enable decentralized model training via an orchestrating central server and have received increasing attention in several industries (including healthcare and finance). Despite its superior privacy protection property, adoption of FL is limited by a lack of systematic understanding of its underlying economics. In this paper, we take an analytical approach to answer two questions: (1) when do data owners prefer to form a FL partnership over building ML models by themselves and (2) how can different contractual mechanisms be used to promote repeated contributions to FL (the cooperative outcome that benefits all participants). We formulate an iterated prisoner’s dilemma (IPD) model that accounts for unique FL characteristics, including the specification of the payoff matrix and the involvement of a central server to sanction noncooperation. We find that partnership formation requires participants to be not too forward-looking in temporal preferences, which is contrary to the conventional wisdom in IPD. Furthermore, to promote repeated contributions, it is insufficient to only rely on penalties imposed by the central server or by participants for noncooperation, but a combination of both is enough. Our work advances theoretical understanding of the economics of FL and provides prescriptive insights that can inform FL participant selection and contract design. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: This work was partially supported by Cisco Research. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00611 .
summary: 本文采用分析方法研究联邦学习中的合作伙伴形成和重复贡献问题。首先，作者构建了一个迭代囚徒困境模型，该模型考虑了联邦学习的独特特性，包括支付矩阵的指定和中央服务器对不合作行为的惩罚。研究发现，合作伙伴形成要求参与者在时间偏好上不要太前瞻，这与传统迭代囚徒困境的认知相反。其次，为了促进重复贡献，仅依赖中央服务器或参与者的惩罚是不够的，需要两者结合才能实现合作。该工作推进了对联邦学习经济学的理论理解，并为参与者选择和合同设计提供了指导性见解。
ai_comment: 该研究将博弈论应用于联邦学习的经济学分析，揭示了不同于传统认知的时间偏好条件，并为机制设计提供了双惩罚机制的有效性证据。

title: Buy Now Pay (Pain?) Later
abstract: “Buy-now-pay-later” (BNPL) is a relatively unregulated FinTech innovation that provides consumers with easy access to credit for retail purchases. BNPL spending is projected to reach $1 trillion by 2025, but we know little about its effects. Using banking data for 10.6 million U.S. consumers, we investigate the effects of BNPL on leading indicators of users’ financial health. We find that new BNPL users experience rapid increases in bank overdraft charges and credit card interest and fees compared with nonusers, consistent with BNPL facilitating overborrowing. An instrumental variable exploiting consumers’ pre-BNPL shopping habits bolsters our inferences. Our results inform regulatory investigations into the effects of BNPL on users’ financial health and expand academia’s understanding of an important consumer credit innovation. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Funding: E. deHaan acknowledges financial support from Stanford University; B. Lourie and C. Zhu acknowledge financial support from University of California Irvine. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03266 .
summary: 该论文研究了“先买后付”（BNPL）这一相对缺乏监管的金融科技创新对消费者财务健康的影响。利用1060万美国消费者的银行数据，论文发现新BNPL用户相比于非用户，其银行透支费用和信用卡利息及费用迅速增加，这与BNPL助长过度借贷的假说一致。为增强因果推断，论文利用消费者使用BNPL前的购物习惯作为工具变量。研究结果为监管机构调查BNPL对用户财务健康的影响提供了信息，并扩展了学术界对重要消费者信贷创新的理解。
ai_comment: 该论文利用大规模银行数据揭示了BNPL可能加剧用户财务困境的实证证据，为监管提供了重要参考。工具变量的运用增强了因果推断的可信度。

title: Peg Abandonment and Cross-Currency Contagion
abstract: Using a novel data set comprising bid–ask quotes for foreign exchange swaps from individual dealers, we examine the consequences of the Swiss National Bank’s sudden termination of the Swiss franc/euro minimum exchange rate in 2015 on other pegged currencies. Our findings indicate a spillover effect as dealer banks began to reassess the risk associated with unexpected peg terminations, subsequently leading to wider bid–ask spreads for pegged currencies. This highlights that, even in strong economies, the credibility of a currency peg is influenced not only by the actions of the respective central bank but also by the stability of other pegged currencies. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01117 .
summary: 本文利用包含外汇掉期买卖价差的新颖数据，研究了2015年瑞士央行突然终止瑞士法郎/欧元最低汇率对其它盯住汇率货币的影响。研究发现存在溢出效应：交易商银行开始重新评估意外终止盯住汇率的风险，导致盯住汇率货币的买卖价差扩大。这表明即使在强劲经济体中，盯住汇率的可信度不仅受本国央行影响，还受其它盯住汇率货币稳定性的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的高频数据揭示了汇率制度突变对其它盯住汇率货币的传染机制，强调了市场对承诺可信度的重新评估，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Media Attention and Event-Based Grouping of Stocks: An Examination of Stocks Hyped by Media Outlets as Benefiting from the Olympics
abstract: We examine five summer Olympics and identify stocks that media outlets hype as benefiting from the Olympics (Olympic stocks). There is a seven-year period from the time that a country first learns it has won the Olympic bid to the start of the games (Olympic time period). We predict that the excitement of the Olympics along with the greater media attention impacts the valuation and risk of Olympic stocks. Consistent with this prediction, we show that Olympic stocks earn higher returns than their matched counterparts and comove more strongly with each other over the Olympic time period. Olympic stocks also exhibit increases in trading volume and stock volatility on days when media outlets have stories linking the firm to the Olympic Games. However, we find no evidence that the Olympic Games translate into stronger fundamentals for Olympic firms or stronger fundamental comovements. These findings suggest that investors are not purchasing the stocks based on an analysis of fundamentals, but are purchasing them based on their Olympic attribute. To confirm that event-based groupings occur in other settings, we show that comovement increases for stocks classified by the media as “stay-at-home” stocks at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02218 .
summary: 本研究考察了五届夏季奥运会，识别出媒体宣扬的将从奥运会中受益的股票（奥运股票）。从国家首次得知赢得奥运主办权到奥运会开幕的七年期间（奥运时段），预测奥运会的兴奋情绪和更大的媒体关注会影响奥运股票的估值和风险。结果显示，奥运股票在奥运时段内比匹配的对照股获得更高收益，且彼此之间共动性更强。在媒体发布将该公司与奥运会联系起来的报道的日子里，奥运股票的交易量和波动性也有所增加。然而，没有证据表明奥运会转化为奥运公司更强的基本面或更强的基本面共动性。这些发现表明投资者并非基于基本面分析购买这些股票，而是基于其奥运属性。为证实事件驱动分组也出现在其他情境中，研究还显示在COVID-19大流行初期，媒体归类为“宅家股”的股票共动性增加。
ai_comment: 该论文通过奥运会这一外生事件，巧妙识别了媒体关注驱动的非基本面股票分组，并提供了共动性增强的直接证据，对行为金融和资产定价研究有重要贡献。

title: How do Treasury dealers manage their positions?
abstract: Using 31 years of data (1990–2020) on U.S. Treasury dealer positions, we find that Treasury issuance is the main driver of dealers’ weekly inventory changes. Such inventory fluctuations are only partially offset in adjacent weeks and not significantly hedged with futures. Dealers are compensated for inventory risk by means of subsequent price appreciation of their holdings. Amid increased balance sheet costs attributable to post-crisis regulatory changes, dealers significantly reduce their position taking and layoff inventory faster. Moreover, the increased participation of non-dealers (investment funds) in the primary market contributes to diminishing compensation for inventory risk taken on at auctions.
summary: 利用1990年至2020年美国国债经销商持仓的31年数据，研究发现国债发行是经销商每周库存变化的主要驱动因素。这些库存波动仅在相邻周被部分抵消，且未通过期货进行显著对冲。经销商通过其持仓的后续价格升值获得对库存风险的补偿。在危机后监管变化导致资产负债表成本上升时，经销商显著减少持仓并更快地甩卖库存。此外，非经销商（投资基金）在一级市场参与的增加导致拍卖中承担的库存风险补偿减少。
ai_comment: 长期数据揭示了经销商库存管理的行为模式及其对监管变化的响应，对理解国债市场微观结构和风险补偿机制有重要贡献。
