title: Refinancing cross-subsidies in the mortgage market
abstract: In household finance markets, inactive households can implicitly cross-subsidize active households who promptly respond to financial incentives. We assess the magnitude and distribution of cross-subsidies in the mortgage market. To do so, we build a structural model of household mortgage refinancing and estimate it on rich administrative data covering the stock of outstanding mortgages in the UK. We estimate sizeable cross-subsidies that flow from relatively poorer households and those located in less-wealthy areas towards richer households and those located in wealthier areas. Our work highlights how the design of household finance markets can contribute to wealth inequality.
summary: 研究家庭金融市场中抵押贷款的交叉补贴现象。通过构建家庭抵押贷款再融资的结构模型，并利用英国未偿还抵押贷款的行政数据进行估计，发现存在显著的交叉补贴，从相对较贫穷的家庭和较不富裕地区的家庭流向较富裕的家庭和较富裕地区的家庭。研究强调了家庭金融市场设计如何加剧财富不平等。
ai_comment: 该文量化了抵押市场中隐含的再融资交叉补贴，揭示了家庭金融设计对财富不平等的贡献，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Intermediation frictions in debt relief: Evidence from CARES Act forbearance
abstract: We study how intermediaries – mortgage servicers – shaped the implementation of mortgage forbearance during the COVID-19 pandemic and use servicer-level variation to trace out the causal effects of forbearance on borrowers. Forbearance provision varied widely across servicers. Small servicers, nonbanks, and especially nonbanks with small liquidity buffers, facilitated fewer forbearances and saw a higher incidence of forbearance-related complaints. Easier access to forbearance substantially increased mortgage nonpayment but also reduced delinquencies outside of forbearance. Part of the liquidity from forbearance was used to reduce credit card debt, but most was saved or used for nondurable consumption.
summary: 本文研究抵押贷款服务商（intermediaries）如何影响CARES法案下贷款暂缓偿还（forbearance）的实施，并利用服务商层面的差异识别暂缓偿还对借款人的因果效应。研究发现，暂缓偿还的提供在不同服务商之间差异很大：小型服务商、非银行机构，尤其是流动性缓冲较小的非银行机构，提供的暂缓较少，且与暂缓相关的投诉发生率更高。更容易获得暂缓偿还显著增加了抵押贷款不支付，但同时也减少了暂缓之外的违约行为。暂缓释放的流动性部分用于减少信用卡债务，但大部分被储蓄或用于非耐用品消费。
ai_comment: 该研究通过服务商层面的变异性识别因果效应，揭示了中介摩擦在政策传导中的关键作用，为理解抵押市场干预的效果提供了微观基础。

title: Discrimination in the payments chain
abstract: We examine whether discrimination affects customers’ willingness to pay their suppliers. Using a dataset of detailed trade credit networks, we find that when facing a macroeconomic shock, customers delay payments to their suppliers with female or black trade credit officers at a 10%–20% higher rate relative to their payments to non-minorities. These results hold after controlling for a host of economic differences between minority groups and non-minority groups. In particular, we exploit the complexity of the supply chain network – wherein suppliers transact with multiple customers in each month and customers transact with multiple suppliers in each month – to estimate within-relationship changes in payment behavior during periods of financial hardship. Results indicate that the largest increases in payment delays are between customers that are classified as having racial or gender biases and suppliers that have minority lead credit officers. The results suggest that biased beliefs and preferences play a critical role in trade credit.
summary: 本文研究歧视是否影响客户支付供应商的意愿。利用详细的贸易信用网络数据，发现宏观经济冲击下，客户对拥有女性或黑人信贷员的供应商延迟付款的比例比非少数族裔信贷员高出10%-20%。通过控制少数族裔与非少数族裔之间的经济差异，并利用供应链网络的复杂性（供应商每月与多个客户交易，客户每月与多个供应商交易），估计了财务困难时期同一关系内支付行为的变化。结果显示，最大的支付延迟增加发生在被归类为具有种族或性别偏见的客户与拥有少数族裔首席信贷员的供应商之间。这表明偏见信念和偏好对贸易信用起着关键作用。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用供应链网络结构识别歧视效应，提供了歧视影响贸易信用的直接证据，对理解金融摩擦和资源配置有重要贡献。

title: The death of a regulator: Strict supervision, bank lending, and business activity
abstract: We exploit the extinction of the thrift supervisor (OTS) to analyze the effects of supervision on bank lending and bank management. We first show that the OTS replacement resulted in stricter supervision of former OTS banks. Next, we analyze the ensuing lending effects and show that former OTS banks on average increase small business lending by roughly 10 percent. This increase is concentrated in well-capitalized banks and especially in banks that changed management practices following the supervisory transition. These findings suggest that stricter supervision operates not only through the enforcement of loss recognition and capital adequacy, but can also act as a catalyst for operational changes that correct deficiencies in bank management and lending practices, which in turn increase lending.
summary: 本文利用储蓄监管机构（OTS）被撤销这一自然实验，分析监管严格性对银行贷款和银行管理的影响。研究发现，OTS被替代导致前OTS银行面临更严格的监管，这些银行的小企业贷款平均增加约10%。这一增长集中在资本充足的银行，尤其是那些在监管过渡后改变管理实践的银行。结果表明，更严格的监管不仅通过强制损失确认和资本充足率发挥作用，还能作为催化剂推动运营变化，纠正银行管理和贷款实践中的缺陷，从而促进贷款增长。
ai_comment: 利用监管机构消亡的外生冲击，识别了监管严格性对银行行为的因果效应，并揭示了监管通过推动管理变革促进贷款的新机制，实证设计巧妙。

title: The social signal
abstract: We examine social media attention and sentiment from three major platforms: Twitter, StockTwits, and Seeking Alpha. We find that, even after controlling for firm disclosures and news, attention is highly correlated across platforms, but sentiment is not: its first principal component explains little more variation than purely idiosyncratic sentiment. Using market events, we attribute differences across platforms to differences in users (e.g., professionals versus novices) and differences in platform design (e.g., character limits in posts). We also find that sentiment and attention contain different return-relevant information. Sentiment predicts positive next-day returns, but attention predicts negative next-day returns. These results highlight the importance of considering both social media sentiment and attention, and of distinguishing between different investor social media platforms.
summary: 本文研究了来自Twitter、StockTwits和Seeking Alpha三个主要平台的社交媒体关注度和情绪。研究发现，即使控制了公司披露和新闻，不同平台之间的关注度高度相关，但情绪却不相关：情绪的第一主成分解释的变异仅略多于纯粹的特质情绪。通过市场事件，将平台之间的差异归因于用户差异（如专业人士与新手）和平台设计差异（如帖子字符限制）。此外，情绪和关注度包含不同的回报相关信息：情绪预测正向的次日回报，而关注度预测负向的次日回报。这些结果强调了同时考虑社交媒体情绪和关注度的重要性，以及区分不同投资者社交媒体平台的必要性。
ai_comment: 该研究细致区分了社交媒体情绪与关注度的不同预测能力，并揭示了平台用户结构与设计差异的深层影响，对理解社交媒体在资产定价中的作用具有重要贡献。

title: Tax Policy and Abnormal Investment Behavior
abstract: This paper studies tax-minimizing investment, whereby firms tilt capital purchases toward year-end to reduce taxes. We use this pattern to characterize how taxes affect investment behavior. We exploit variation in firm tax positions from administrative data to confirm that tax minimization causes spikes. Spikes increase when firms face financial constraints or higher option values of waiting. Cumulative investment does not completely reverse after spikes. We develop an investment model with tax asymmetries to rationalize these patterns. Both depreciation motives (later investments face lower effective tax rates) and option value motives (tax asymmetry implies time-varying opportunities to minimize taxes) are necessary to fit the data. (JEL G31, G38, H25)
summary: 本文研究企业为最小化税收而进行的异常投资行为，特别是企业倾向于在年底调整资本购买以降低税负。利用行政数据中企业税务状况的变化，确认税收最小化导致投资尖峰。当企业面临财务约束或等待的期权价值较高时，投资尖峰现象更为显著。尖峰后累积投资并未完全逆转。为解释这些模式，本文构建了一个包含税收不对称性的投资模型，发现折旧动机（后期投资面临较低有效税率）和期权价值动机（税收不对称导致随时间变化的税收最小化机会）对于拟合数据均不可或缺。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用税收最小化导致的投资尖峰行为，揭示了税收政策对企业投资决策的复杂影响，模型结合了折旧与期权价值动机，理论与实证结合紧密。

title: The Mortgage‐Cash Premium Puzzle
abstract: All‐cash homebuyers account for one‐third of U.S. home purchases between 1980 and 2017. We use multiple data sets and research designs to robustly estimate that mortgaged buyers pay an 11% premium over all‐cash buyers to compensate home sellers for mortgage transaction frictions. A dynamic, representative‐seller model implies only a 3% premium, which would suggest an 8% puzzle. Accounting for heterogeneity in selling conditions explains half of this difference, but a puzzle holds in conditions with high transaction risk. An experimental survey of U.S. homeowners replicates these patterns and suggests that belief distortions can explain the puzzle in these high‐risk states.
summary: 该论文研究了1980至2017年间美国住房市场中全现金购房者占三分之一的典型事实，并利用多个数据集和研究设计稳健地估计出贷款购房者比全现金购房者平均多支付11%的溢价以补偿卖家因抵押贷款交易摩擦带来的成本。通过动态代表性卖家模型，理论预测的溢价仅为3%，由此产生了8%的“抵押贷款-现金溢价之谜”。进一步分析表明，卖房条件的异质性解释了约一半的差异，但在高交易风险条件下该谜题依然存在。一项针对美国房主的实验调查复制了这些模式，并表明信念扭曲可以解释高风险状态下的谜题。
ai_comment: 论文通过大样本数据与实验方法双重验证，揭示了一个新的市场异象，并创新性地将信念扭曲引入对高交易风险条件下溢价谜题的解释，为后续研究提供了新的理论视角。

title: Valuing Financial Data
abstract: How should an investor value financial data? The answer is complicated because it depends on the characteristics of all investors. We develop a sufficient statistics approach that uses equilibrium asset return moments to summarize all relevant information about others’ characteristics. Our approach values public or private data, data about one or many assets, and data relevant for dividends or sentiment. While different data types, of course, have different valuations, heterogeneous investors also value the same data very differently. This finding suggests a low price elasticity for data demand. Heterogeneous investors’ data valuations are also affected very differentially by market illiquidity.
summary: 论文研究投资者如何评估金融数据的价值，指出该问题因依赖于所有投资者的特征而复杂。作者开发了一个充分统计量方法，利用均衡资产收益矩来概括关于其他投资者特征的所有相关信息。该方法可用于评估公开或私有数据、关于单一或多个资产的数据、以及与股息或情绪相关的数据。研究发现，不同类型的数据自然具有不同的估值，而异质投资者对相同数据的估值也差异极大，这表明数据需求的价格弹性很低。此外，市场非流动性对异质投资者的数据估值产生非常不同的影响。
ai_comment: 本文提供了评估金融数据价值的新框架，揭示了异质性和市场非流动性对数据估值的重要影响，对数据定价和投资决策具有指导意义。

title: Technological Progress and Rent Seeking
abstract: We model firms’ allocation of resources across surplus-creating (ie, productive) and surplus-appropriating (ie, rent-seeking) activities. Our model predicts that industry-wide technological advancements, such as recent progress in data collection and processing, induce a disproportionate and socially inefficient reallocation of resources toward surplus-appropriating activities. As technology improves, firms rely more on appropriation to obtain their profits, thereby endogenously reducing the impact of technological progress on economic progress and inflating the price of the resources used for both types of activities. Our theoretical insights shed light on the rise of high-frequency trading.
summary: 本文构建了一个企业将资源分配于创造剩余（生产性）与获取剩余（寻租）活动的模型。模型预测，行业层面的技术进步（如数据收集与处理领域的最新进展）会导致资源不成比例地、社会无效地向寻租活动重新配置。随着技术改进，企业更依赖寻租来获取利润，从而内生地削弱技术进步对经济进步的促进作用，并抬高用于两类活动的资源的价格。这一理论洞见有助于解释高频交易的兴起。
ai_comment: 通过理论模型揭示技术进步可能引发寻租行为加剧，从而抑制经济效率，为理解高频交易的负面效应提供了新视角。

title: On the Magnification of Small Biases in Hiring
abstract: We analyze a setting in which a board must hire a chief executive officer (CEO) after exerting effort to learn about the quality of each candidate. Optimal effort is asymmetric, implying asymmetric likelihoods of each candidate being chosen. If the board has an infinitesimal bias in favor of one candidate, it allocates effort to maximize the likelihood of that candidate being chosen. Even when the board's prior is that its preferred candidate is inferior, she may still be chosen most often. A glass ceiling can also arise whereby the tendency to hire favored candidates increases as the importance of the position increases.
summary: 本文分析了一个董事会聘请首席执行官（CEO）的情境，其中董事会需要付出努力来了解每位候选人的质量。研究发现，最优的努力分配是不对称的，这导致每位候选人被选中的概率不对称。如果董事会对某位候选人存在微小偏向，它会将努力分配以最大化该候选人被选中的可能性。即使董事会的先验信念认为其偏好的候选人质量较差，该候选人仍可能最常被选中。此外，还可能出现“玻璃天花板”效应，即随着职位重要性的增加，董事会雇佣偏好的候选人的倾向也随之增强。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型揭示了微小偏见在CEO选拔中被放大的机制，并解释了玻璃天花板效应的一种非传统成因，对理解组织中的偏见和晋升决策具有重要启示。

title: Anomaly Time
abstract: We examine the timing of returns around the publication of anomaly trading signals. Using a database that captures when information is first publicly released, we show that anomaly returns are concentrated in the first month after information release dates, and these returns decay soon thereafter. We also show that the academic convention of forming portfolios in June underestimates predictability because it uses stale information, which makes some anomalies appear insignificant. In contrast, we show many anomalies do predict returns if portfolios are formed immediately after information releases. Finally, we develop guidance on forming portfolios without using stale information.
summary: 本文研究了异常交易信号发布后的回报时机。利用一个记录信息首次公开发布时间的数据库，作者发现异常回报集中在信息发布后的第一个月，之后迅速衰减。同时，通过对比不同投资组合形成时点，发现学术惯例中在6月形成投资组合的做法会因使用过时信息而低估预测能力，导致部分异常看似不显著；而若在信息发布后立即形成组合，许多异常确实能预测回报。最后，论文提出了避免使用过时信息的投资组合构建指南。
ai_comment: 本文通过精确追溯信息发布时间，揭示了数据时效性对异常回报测试的关键影响，对实证资产定价研究的方法论有重要贡献。

title: Very Noisy Option Prices and Inference Regarding the Volatility Risk Premium
abstract: The stylized fact that volatility is not priced in individual equity options does not withstand scrutiny. First, we show that the average return of heavily traded deep out‐of‐the‐money call options on stocks is −116 basis points per day. Second, Fama‐MacBeth estimates of the volatility risk premium in stock options are similar to those in S&P 500 Index call options. Third, the mean return of heavily traded delta‐hedged at‐the‐money calls (puts) is −23 (−30) basis points. Fourth, the variance risk premium in stock options is negative. Our analysis highlights the importance of microstructure biases and robustness in empirical work with options.
summary: 本文推翻了“波动率在个股期权中未被定价”这一常见观点。首先，作者发现大量交易的深度虚值看涨期权的平均日收益为-116个基点。其次，Fama-MacBeth回归估计的股票期权波动率风险溢价与标普500指数看涨期权相似。第三，大量交易的对冲平价看涨期权和看跌期权的平均收益分别为-23和-30个基点。第四，股票期权的方差风险溢价为负。研究强调了在期权实证分析中考虑微观结构偏差和进行稳健性检验的重要性。
ai_comment: 本文通过多个实证检验否定了前期结论，并揭示了微观结构噪音对期权定价研究的关键影响，方法严谨且具有重要启示。

title: Treasury Richness
abstract: We provide estimates of Treasury convenience premia across the entire term structure of Treasury bills, notes, and bonds over more than a quarter of a century and document a variety of key stylized facts about their time‐series and cross‐sectional patterns. These results raise concerns about the evolving nature of Treasury markets and suggest that investors may now place less weight on the traditional role of Treasury securities as liquid trading vehicles. These stylized facts provide empirical benchmarks that could help guide future theoretical and empirical work about the economics of safe assets in financial markets.
summary: 本文估计了超过25年期间美国国债（包括短期国库券、中期和长期国债）全期限结构上的便利收益率溢价，并系统记录了其时间序列和横截面模式的一系列关键风格化事实。这些结果对国债市场的演变性质提出质疑，表明投资者可能不再像传统那样重视国债作为流动性交易工具的角色。提供的风格化事实为未来关于金融市场中安全资产经济学的理论和实证研究建立了经验基准。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了国债便利溢价长期以来跨越整个期限结构的全面估计，揭示了市场特征的转变，为安全资产理论研究奠定了坚实的实证基础。

title: Human Capital Portability and Careers in Finance
abstract: How does firm-specific human capital shape careers in the finance industry? We build a dynamic model where workers accumulate portable and nonportable (firm-specific) human capital and learn about their match quality with employers. Estimating the model using granular data on M&A advisory bankers, we show that a large fraction of bankers’ human capital is nonportable, ranging from 12% to 46% across different firm types. Bankers make a dynamic trade-off between portability and returns on human capital, leading to time-varying job preferences over their life cycle. Our results have broad implications for careers in finance and the provision of financial services.
summary: 本文研究企业特定人力资本如何塑造金融行业职业生涯。构建了一个动态模型，其中工人积累可携带和不可携带（企业特定）的人力资本，并通过工作经历了解与雇主的匹配质量。利用并购咨询银行家的微观数据估计模型，发现银行家的人力资本中有很大部分是不可携带的，比例因公司类型而异，在12%到46%之间。银行家在可携带性与人力资本回报之间进行动态权衡，导致其职业偏好随生命周期变化。研究结果对金融行业职业生涯以及金融服务的提供具有广泛启示。
ai_comment: 通过微观数据量化了金融从业者人力资本的不可携带性，揭示了职业选择的动态权衡，为理解金融人才流动提供新视角。

title: Just Friends? Managers’ Connections to Judges
abstract: We study the impact of social connections between judges and executives on the outcomes of Securities Class Action Litigation (SCAL). Judges who are socially connected to a firm's executives are significantly more likely to dismiss lawsuits against the firm. There is also evidence of faster resolution and lower payout amounts in connected cases. The favorable outcomes cannot be explained by the lower severity of connected cases, or by court, judge, or firm characteristics. Our results are more pronounced when executives connected to the judge are named defendants in the lawsuits, when connected cases involve less visible lawsuits or firms, and when connections between judges and executives are likely more direct. Our evidence indicates that social connections influence judge impartiality and meaningfully alter SCAL outcomes.
summary: 本文研究法官与企业高管之间的社会联系对证券集体诉讼（SCAL）结果的影响。法官与企业高管存在社会关系时，显著更可能驳回针对该企业的诉讼，案件解决速度更快，赔付金额也更低。这些有利结果无法由案件严重程度、法院、法官或企业特征解释。当涉案高管与法官有联系时、案件或企业知名度较低时、以及法官与高管联系更直接时，这种效应更为显著。证据表明，社会联系损害了法官的公正性，并实质性改变了证券集体诉讼的结果。
ai_comment: 该研究为法律与金融交叉领域提供了直接证据，揭示了非正式社会关系如何影响司法公正及企业诉讼结果，对理解法律执行中的潜在偏误具有重要价值。

title: The Decision Relevance of Loan Fair Values for Depositors
abstract: Using a large sample of U.S. commercial banks from 1994 to 2019, we find that loan fair values are highly relevant for depositor decision making. A one‐standard‐deviation decrease in loan fair value performance is associated with more than 10% lower uninsured deposit flows than the sample average. Information in fair values about loan credit quality is quite limited and cannot account for the bulk of the relevance. Instead, consistent with models of bank fragility, the relevance seems to stem more from information on the decline in loan liquidation values, triggering panic‐based withdrawals motivated by (self‐fulfilling) expectations of withdrawals by other depositors. The findings inform the cost‐benefit tradeoff of reporting loan fair values.
summary: 基于1994年至2019年美国大型商业银行样本，研究发现贷款公允价值对存款人决策具有高度相关性。贷款公允价值绩效每下降一个标准差，无保险存款流出量比样本平均值低10%以上。公允价值中包含的贷款信用质量信息有限，无法解释大部分相关性；相反，与银行脆弱性模型一致，相关性更多源于贷款清算价值下降的信息，这触发了基于恐慌的提款，其动机是其他存款人可能提款的自我实现预期。研究结果为报告贷款公允价值的成本效益权衡提供了信息。
ai_comment: 该论文深入揭示了贷款公允价值通过清算价值信息触发银行挤兑的机制，对会计准则制定和银行监管具有重要启示。

title: Unobserved Performance of Hedge Funds
abstract: We investigate hedge fund firms’ unobserved performance (UP), measured as the risk‐adjusted return difference between a firm's reported gross return and its portfolio return inferred from its disclosed long‐equity holdings. Firms with high UP outperform those with low UP by 6.36% per annum on a risk‐adjusted basis. UP is negatively associated with a firm's trading costs and positively associated with intraquarter trading in equity positions, derivatives usage, short selling, and confidential holdings. We show that limited investor attention can delay investors’ response to UP and lead to longer lived predictability of fund firm performance.
summary: 本文研究了对冲基金公司的未观测表现（UP），将其定义为公司报告的总回报与其从披露的长期股票持仓中推断出的投资组合回报之间的风险调整收益差。研究发现，高UP的公司每年在风险调整基础上比低UP的公司表现高出6.36%。UP与公司的交易成本负相关，与季内股票交易、衍生品使用、卖空和保密持仓正相关。此外，投资者有限的关注会延迟对UP的反应，从而使得基金公司表现的预测性具有更长的持久性。
ai_comment: 本文提出了一种新颖的衡量未观测表现的方法，并揭示了与其相关的关键因素，为理解对冲基金业绩的持久性提供了新视角。

title: From Feeds to Inboxes: A Comparative Study of Polarization in Facebook and Email News Sharing
abstract: This study explores the polarization of news content shared on Facebook compared with email using data from the New York Times’ Most Emailed and Most Shared lists over 2.5 years. Employing latent Dirichlet allocation and large language models (LLMs), we find that highly polarized articles are more likely to be shared on Facebook (versus email), even after accounting for factors like topics, emotion, and article age. Additionally, distinct topic preferences emerge, with social issues dominating Facebook shares and lifestyle topics prevalent in emails. Contrary to expectations, political polarization of articles shared on Facebook did not escalate post-2020 election. We introduce a novel approach to measuring polarization of text content that leverages generative artificial intelligence models, like ChatGPT, and it is both scalable and cost effective. This research contributes to the evolving intersection of LLMs, social media, and polarization studies, shedding light on descriptive patterns of content dissemination across different digital channels. This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04134 .
summary: 本研究利用纽约时报2.5年的“最多邮件”和“最多分享”列表数据，比较了Facebook和电子邮件中新闻内容的极化程度。通过潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）和大语言模型（LLMs）分析，发现高度极化的文章更可能在Facebook上分享（相比电子邮件），即使控制了主题、情感和文章年龄等因素。此外，主题偏好存在显著差异：社会议题主导Facebook分享，而生活方式主题在电子邮件中更为普遍。出乎意料的是，Facebook上文章的政治极化在2020年大选后并未加剧。研究还引入了一种利用生成式AI模型（如ChatGPT）测量文本极化的新方法，该方法具有可扩展性和成本效益。该研究为LLMs、社交媒体与极化研究的交叉领域做出了贡献，揭示了不同数字渠道中内容传播的描述性模式。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用LLMs测量文本极化，方法可扩展且成本低，为理解数字渠道中的内容分化提供了新视角。

title: Liquidity, Liquidity Everywhere, Not a Drop to Use: Why Flooding Banks with Central Bank Reserves May Not Expand Liquidity
abstract: Central bank balance sheet expansion, through actions like quantitative easing, is run through commercial banks. While this increases liquid central bank reserves held on commercial bank balance sheets, demandable uninsured deposits issued to finance the reserves also increase. Subsequent shrinkage in the central bank balance sheet may entail shrinkage in bank‐held reserves without a commensurate reduction in deposit claims. Furthermore, during episodes of liquidity stress, when many claims on liquidity are called, surplus banks may hoard reserves. As a result, central bank balance sheet expansion may create less additional liquidity than typically thought, and indeed, may increase the probability and severity of episodes of liquidity stress.
summary: 本文探讨了央行资产负债表扩张（如量化宽松）通过商业银行传导时对流动性的影响。虽然扩张增加了商业银行持有的流动性央行准备金，但同时也增加了用于融资这些准备金的活期无保险存款。当央行资产负债表收缩时，银行持有的准备金可能减少，而存款索赔并未相应减少。此外，在流动性压力期间，盈余银行可能囤积准备金。因此，央行资产负债表扩张实际创造的额外流动性可能低于通常预期，甚至可能增加流动性压力事件发生的概率和严重性。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了传统观点，指出央行资产负债表扩张可能反而加剧流动性风险，对货币政策传导机制有重要启示。

title: Do Women Receive Worse Financial Advice?
abstract: We arranged for trained undercover men and women to pose as potential clients and visit all 65 local financial advisory firms in Hong Kong. At financial planning firms, but not at securities firms, women were more likely than men to receive advice to buy only individual or only local securities. Female clients who signaled high confidence, high risk tolerance, or a domestic outlook were especially likely to receive this suboptimal advice. Our theoretical model explains these patterns as a result of statistical discrimination interacting with advisors’ incentives. Taste‐based discrimination is unlikely to explain the results.
summary: 研究通过安排经过培训的卧底男性和女性扮演潜在客户，实地走访香港全部65家本地金融咨询公司，调查女性是否获得更差的金融建议。结果显示，在财务规划公司（而非证券公司），女性比男性更可能被建议只购买个人证券或仅投资本地证券。尤其是表现出高信心、高风险容忍度或国内投资倾向的女性客户，更易收到这种次优建议。作者构建的理论模型表明，这些模式源于统计歧视与顾问激励的相互作用，而基于偏好的歧视不太可能解释结果。
ai_comment: 本研究的创新之处在于采用实地实验方法直接观察真实咨询过程，为金融建议中的性别差异提供了因果证据，并提出了统计歧视的理论解释，区别于传统偏好歧视。

title: Why Did Bank Stocks Crash during COVID-19?
abstract: A two-sided “credit-line channel”—relating to drawdowns and repayments—explains the severe drop and partial subsequent recovery in bank stock prices during the COVID-19 pandemic. Banks with greater exposure to undrawn credit lines saw larger stock price declines but performed better outside of crises periods. Despite deposit inflows, high drawdowns led to reduced bank lending, suggestive of capital encumbrance upon drawdowns. Repayments of credit lines unencumbered capital which explains the stock price recovery starting Q2 2020. Bank provision of credit lines resembles writing put options on aggregate risk, and we propose how to incorporate this feature into bank stress tests.
summary: 该论文研究了新冠疫情初期银行股价格大幅下跌及随后部分恢复的现象，提出一个双边的“信贷额度渠道”进行解释。该渠道涉及信贷额度的提取和偿还：银行对未提取信贷额度的敞口越大，其股价在危机中下跌越严重，但在非危机时期表现更好。尽管危机期间银行获得存款流入，但高额的信贷提取导致银行资本占用，从而减少贷款发放。而随后的信贷偿还释放了资本，解释了2020年第二季度开始的股价回升。银行提供信贷额度的行为类似于卖出关于总体风险的看跌期权，作者建议将这一特征纳入银行压力测试。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地从信贷额度提取和偿还的双向角度解释银行股在疫情中的表现，并提出了将信贷额度风险纳入压力测试的实用建议。

title: Show Your Hand: The Impacts of Fair Pricing Requirements in Procurement Contracting
abstract: This paper studies how a federal procurement regulation, known as the Truth in Negotiations Act (TINA), affects the competitiveness and execution of government contracts. TINA stipulates how contracting officials (COs) can ensure reasonable prices. Following TINA, for contracts above a certain size threshold, COs can no longer rely solely on their own judgment that a price is reasonable. Instead, they must either require suppliers to provide accounting data supporting their proposed prices or expect multiple bids. Using a regression discontinuity design, I find that above‐threshold contracts experience greater competition (i.e., more bids), improved performance (i.e., less frequent renegotiations and cost overruns), and reduced use of the harder‐to‐monitor cost‐plus pricing, compared to below‐threshold contracts. These findings suggest that TINA's requirements enhance competition and oversight for above‐threshold contracts.
summary: 该论文研究了联邦采购法规《谈判真实性法案》（TINA）对政府合同竞争性和执行的影响。TINA规定了合同官员如何确保合理价格：对于超过特定规模阈值的合同，合同官员不能仅凭自身判断，必须要求供应商提供支持其报价的会计数据或期待多个投标。采用断点回归设计，研究发现，与阈值以下的合同相比，阈值以上的合同经历了更大的竞争（更多投标）、改进的绩效（更少的重新谈判和成本超支），以及更少使用难以监控的成本加成定价。这些发现表明，TINA的要求增强了阈值以上合同的竞争和监督。
ai_comment: 利用断点回归设计清晰识别了法规阈值对合同竞争和绩效的因果效应，为政府采购监管提供了实证证据。

title: Missing Financial Data
abstract: We document the widespread nature and structure of missing observations of firm fundamentals and show how to systematically handle them. Missing financial data affects more than 70% of firms that represent about half of the total market cap. Firm fundamentals have complex systematic missing patterns, invalidating traditional approaches to imputation. We propose a novel imputation method to obtain a fully observed panel of firm fundamentals that exploits both time-series and cross-sectional dependency of data to impute missing values and allows for general systematic patterns of missingness. We document important implications for risk premiums estimates, cross-sectional anomalies, and portfolio construction. (JEL C14, C38, C55, G12)
summary: 本文记录了公司基本面数据缺失的普遍性和结构，发现超过70%的样本公司（约占市场总市值的一半）存在财务数据缺失问题。公司基本面的缺失模式复杂且系统化，使得传统的插补方法失效。作者提出了一种新的插补方法，该方法利用时间序列和横截面的数据依赖性来填充缺失值，并允许一般化的系统性缺失模式。研究还展示了该方法在风险溢价估计、横截面异象和投资组合构建中的重要影响。
ai_comment: 本文系统揭示了财务数据缺失的普遍性与结构性，并提出一种兼顾时间序列与横截面依赖性的插补方法，对实证资产定价与组合管理具有重要价值。

title: Estimating Discount Functions with Consumption Choices over the Lifecycle
abstract: We estimate β-δ time preferences and relative risk aversion (RRA) using a lifecycle model including stochastic income, liquid and illiquid assets, credit cards, dependents, Social Security, mortality, and bequests. Preference parameters are identified by cross-tabulating four lifecycle age intervals and four balance sheet moments: the share of households carrying (ie, revolving) credit card debt, average carried credit card debt, average net wealth among households carrying credit card debt, and average net wealth among households not carrying credit card debt. The 16 moments are approximately matched by (MSM) parameter estimates β=0.53, δ=0.99, and RRA = 1.9.
summary: 本文使用一个包含随机收入、流动性和非流动性资产、信用卡、受抚养人、社会保障、死亡和遗赠的生命周期模型，估计了β-δ时间偏好和相对风险厌恶（RRA）参数。通过将四个生命周期年龄区间与四个资产负债表矩（持有信用卡循环债务的家庭比例、平均信用卡循环债务、持有信用卡债务家庭的平均净财富、不持有信用卡债务家庭的平均净财富）交叉列表，得到16个矩。利用模拟矩估计（MSM）近似匹配这些矩，得到参数估计值：β=0.53，δ=0.99，RRA=1.9。
ai_comment: 该研究通过资产负债表矩创新地识别了时间偏好和风险厌恶参数，为家庭金融中的消费决策提供了实证基础。

title: The Savings of Corporate Giants
abstract: We construct a novel panel data set to provide new evidence on how the largest nonfinancial firms manage their financial assets. Our granular data show that, over the past decade, bond portfolios have grown to be at least as large as cash-like instruments, driven by the meteoric rise of corporate bond holdings. To shed light on the drivers of this growth, we conduct a pair of event studies around the 2017 tax reform and the 2020 liquidity crisis. We find that large holdings of marketable securities are primarily driven by cross-border tax incentives, while cash-like instruments are driven by liquidity motives. (JEL G32, G35, G11, E440)
summary: 研究通过构建新的面板数据集，揭示了大型非金融企业如何管理其金融资产。数据显示，过去十年中，债券组合（尤其是公司债券）的规模已至少与现金类工具相当。通过围绕2017年税改和2020年流动性危机的事件研究，发现可交易证券的大量持有主要由跨境税收激励驱动，而现金类工具则主要由流动性动机驱动。
ai_comment: 利用细粒度数据和双重事件研究，有效区分了跨境税收与流动性动机对大型企业金融资产配置的影响，为理解企业储蓄行为提供了新视角。

title: Elephants in Equity Markets
abstract: We introduce a novel empirical decomposition of equity price growth rates in terms of equity holdings, based on market-clearing conditions.Although our sample holdings cover only an average of 5% of market capitalization, our reconstructed equity holdings account for, on average, 89% of the time variation in over 20,000 individual stock prices and 96% of the fluctuations in 33 aggregate stock markets.Using this decomposition, we introduce new stylized facts to inform asset pricing models.We find that changes in portfolio weights explain most of the variation of individual stock prices, while aggregate wealth effects are more important for the overall stock market fluctuations.Equity markets are global and exchange rates play a key equilibrating role.They dampen local stock market volatility for all stock markets, except those associated with the three safe-haven currencies---USD, JPY, and CHF---and currencies pegged to the USD.
summary: 本文提出了一种基于市场出清条件的股票价格增长率的新颖经验分解方法。尽管样本持仓仅覆盖平均5%的市值，但重构的股票持仓平均解释了超过2万只个股价格时间变化的89%和33个股票市场指数波动的96%。利用该分解，本文揭示了新的典型事实以指导资产定价模型：投资组合权重变化解释了个股价格的大部分变动，而总财富效应对整体股市波动更为重要。股票市场是全球性的，汇率起到关键均衡作用——除了三种避险货币（USD、JPY、CHF）及与USD挂钩的货币外，汇率抑制了当地股票市场波动。
ai_comment: 该文通过巧妙的分解方法，同时解释了微观个股和宏观市场指数的波动来源，并强调了汇率在不同货币区股市中的不对称角色，为资产定价提供了新视角。

title: Pricing the Priceless: The Financial Cost of Biodiversity Conservation
abstract: The pace of biodiversity loss requires drastic shifts in conservation efforts that carry substantial costs. We investigate how the financial market prices such conservation costs exploiting the "Green Shield Action, " a major regulatory initiative launched by the Chinese central government in 2017 to enforce biodiversity preservation rules in national nature reserves. We document that, while improving local biodiversity, the initiative led to a significant increase in bond yields for Chinese municipalities with national nature reserves. Evidence suggests that these effects are driven by expected increases in transition costs resulting from shutting down illegal economic activities within reserves and local public spending on biodiversity following the initiative. Overall, our results indicate that investors show little consideration beyond financial payoffs towards endeavors counteracting biodiversity loss.
summary: 本文研究金融市场如何为生物多样性保护的成本定价。利用中国中央政府2017年发起的“绿色盾牌行动”这一重大监管举措，该行动旨在加强国家级自然保护区的生物多样性保护。研究发现，尽管该行动改善了当地生物多样性，但显著提高了拥有国家级自然保护区的中国市政债券的收益率。证据表明，这些效应是由该行动后关闭保护区内非法经济活动以及地方公共支出增加所导致的预期转型成本驱动的。总体而言，结果表明投资者在应对生物多样性损失的努力中，除了财务回报外很少考虑其他因素。
ai_comment: 该研究首次量化了生物多样性保护政策对地方政府融资成本的影响，揭示了金融市场在环境治理中的定价机制。

title: The Shifting Finance of Electricity Generation
abstract: Private equity (PE), institutional investors, and foreign corporations own 58% of wind, 47% of solar, and 34% of natural gas electricity generation.These new entrants are twice as likely to create new power plants as incumbent domestic listed utilities, highlighting a new role for PE in large-scale asset creation.They also acquire existing plants.While fossil-fuel plant sales to foreign corporations extend operations, PE has similar decommissioning rates to incumbents.The new owners create more efficient plants and improve acquired ones.Market deregulation drives the results, highlighting the dual importance of competition and new financing for both creation and acquisitions.
summary: 本文研究私募股权（PE）、机构投资者和外国公司在发电行业中的所有权角色。数据显示，这些新进入者拥有58%的风电、47%的太阳能和34%的天然气发电装机容量。与现有国内上市公用事业公司相比，它们创建新电厂的可能性是后者的两倍，表明PE在大规模资产创造中发挥了新作用。同时，它们也收购现有电厂。对于化石燃料电厂，出售给外国公司会延长运营寿命，但PE的退役率与现有公司相似。新所有者通常创建更高效的电厂，并改进收购的电厂效率。市场放松管制是驱动这些结果的关键因素，强调了竞争和新融资对电厂创建和收购的双重重要性。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证数据揭示了私募股权在电力行业大规模资产创造中的新角色，并强调了市场放松管制和竞争的重要性，对理解能源转型中的金融结构变化具有重要价值。

title: Mispricing Narratives after Social Unrest
abstract: We study how negative sentiment around an industry impacts beliefs and behaviors, focusing on demands for racial justice after the murder of George Floyd and the salience of the "defund the police" movement.We assess stakeholder beliefs on the impact of protests on the stock prices of police-affiliated firms.In our survey experiment, laypeople and finance professionals predicted more negative stock price outcomes when they lacked details on the products supplied by such firms.Exposure to narratives about the context of the protests further reduced the prediction accuracy of these groups.In contrast, product information improved the prediction accuracy of respondents.Turning to real-life behavior, we find that mutual funds exposed to protests were 20% less likely to hold police stocks, after the protests, than funds in areas without protests.Political support for maintaining police funding, though in the majority, declined by 4.3 percentage points in protest areas.The salience of the "defund the police" narrative led to significant overreactions in both financial predictions and real-life behavior.
summary: 这篇论文研究社会动荡（特别是乔治·弗洛伊德被谋杀后“削减警察经费”运动）引发的负面情绪如何影响对警察关联企业的信念和行为。通过调查实验，作者发现缺乏产品细节的普通人和金融专业人士对公司股价的预测更悲观；接触抗议背景叙事进一步降低了预测准确性，而产品信息则改善了预测。在实际行为中，受抗议影响的共同基金持有警察股票的可能性降低20%，抗议地区对维持警察经费的政治支持下降4.3个百分点。“削减警察经费”叙事的显著性导致金融预测和实际行为中的过度反应。
ai_comment: 该研究将行为金融与社会事件结合，通过实验和实证揭示了负面叙事如何导致定价偏差，具有现实意义。

title: The Effects of Wealth on Health Care Spending: Evidence from the Housing Market
abstract: The U.S. healthcare system requires substantial out-of-pocket payments by most consumers, which can prevent some from receiving needed medical services. Recent policy proposals seek to address this problem by increasing government health care spending in order to reduce out-of-pocket costs. The social value of these policies rests in part on the extent to which consumers face credit constraints in financing medical spending. We present a novel analysis of whether elderly households face such credit constraints by estimating the effects of wealth variation from home price changes on out-of-pocket medical expenditures. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study and various measures of home price changes, we find no evidence that housing wealth impacts out-of-pocket medical spending. The estimates are universally small and precise, allowing us to rule out even modest-sized effects. Effects are zero across the expenditure distribution, for specific categories of expenditure, and for different types of consumers split by health insurance status and SES. Our results suggest that further subsidizing health care for elderly homeowners, the majority of older Americans, would increase moral hazard costs without increasing access to needed care.
summary: 本文利用美国健康与退休研究数据，通过房价变动作为财富变动的外生冲击，分析住房财富对老年人自付医疗支出的影响。研究发现，住房财富变化对自付医疗支出没有显著影响，估计结果精确且效应极小，可排除中等规模效应。这一结果在支出分布、具体支出类别以及不同医疗保险状况和社会经济地位的人群中均成立。结论表明，进一步补贴老年房主（占美国老年人多数）会增加道德风险成本，而不会提高必要医疗服务的可及性。
ai_comment: 利用外生的房价变动识别因果效应，为财富对医疗支出的影响提供了干净证据，对评估医疗保险政策具有重要参考价值。

title: Do Mergers and Acquisitions Improve Efficiency? Evidence from Power Plants
abstract: Using rich data on hourly physical productivity and thousands of ownership changes from US power plants, we study the effects of acquisitions on efficiency and underlying mechanisms.We find a 2% average increase in efficiency for acquired plants, beginning five months after acquisitions.Efficiency gains rise to 5% under direct ownership changes, with no significant change when only parent ownership changes.Investigating the mechanisms, three-quarters of the efficiency gain is attributed to increased productive efficiency, while the rest comes from dynamic efficiency through changes in production allocation.Our evidence suggests that highproductivity firms buy underperforming assets from low-productivity firms and make them as productive as their existing assets through operational improvements.Finally, acquired plants improve their performance beyond efficiency by increasing output and reducing outages.
summary: 本文利用美国发电厂每小时物理生产率和数千次所有权变更的丰富数据，研究收购对效率的影响及其潜在机制。研究发现，被收购工厂的效率平均提高2%，这一提升在收购完成后五个月开始显现；当发生直接所有权变更时，效率提升达到5%，而仅母公司所有权变更时则无显著变化。机制分析表明，四分之三的效率增益来自生产效率提高，其余来自生产分配变化带来的动态效率。证据显示，高生产率企业从低生产率企业收购表现不佳的资产，并通过运营改进使其效率达到现有资产水平。此外，被收购工厂不仅效率提升，还通过增加产出和减少停机时间改善了整体绩效。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的高频物理生产率数据，精确识别了收购对效率的因果效应及其动态，并区分了直接与间接所有权变更的不同影响，为并购效率的微观机制提供了新证据。

title: Toward a Holistic Approach to Central Bank Trust
abstract: We examine public trust in the European Central Bank (ECB) and its determinants using data from the Bundesbank Household Panel survey for Germany.Employing an interdisciplinary approach that integrates insights from political science and psychology, we offer a fresh perspective on the factors influencing central bank trust that is more holistic than the conventional one.Our primary findings can be summarized as follows.Households who state that competence, which we define as the ECB's performance in maintaining stable prices and making decisions grounded in rules, science, and data, matters for their trust in the ECB, tend to express higher trust in the ECB.Conversely, those who place greater importance on values, particularly the integrity of top central bankers, honest communication and broader concern, tend to trust the ECB less.Trust in the ECB also hinges on trust in political institutions more generally and, to a lesser extent, on generalized trust (i.e.trust in others).
summary: 本文利用德国央行家庭面板数据，采用跨学科方法（融合政治学与心理学视角），全面考察公众对欧洲央行的信任及其决定因素。主要发现：认为央行能力（即稳定物价、基于规则、科学与数据决策）重要的家庭更倾向于信任欧洲央行；而更重视价值观（如高层银行家的诚信、诚实沟通及广泛关怀）的家庭则信任度较低。此外，对欧洲央行的信任还依赖于对政治机构的普遍信任，并在较小程度上依赖于一般性信任（对他人的信任）。
ai_comment: 该论文的亮点在于引入跨学科视角，超越传统经济因素，揭示了价值观与能力对央行信任的差异化影响，为理解信任构建提供了新思路。

title: Subjective Income Expectations and Household Debt Cycles
abstract: Matched transaction-level, credit-registry, and survey-based data reveal that consumers on average form excessively high (low) income expectations relative to ex-post realizations after unexpected positive (negative) income shocks.These extrapolative income expectations lead consumers to increase current spending, accumulate more debt, and face more defaults when lower-than-expected incomes are realized.We assess the aggregate implications by estimating a consumption model with defaultable unsecured debt and diagnostic Kalman filtering whereby consumers over-extrapolate income shocks when forming expectations.Extrapolative income expectations help explain state-dependent household debt cycles qualitatively and quantitatively.
summary: 该论文利用匹配的交易级、信用登记和调查数据，发现消费者在经历意外正（负）收入冲击后，平均会形成过高（低）的收入预期，相对于事后实现。这种外推性的收入预期导致消费者增加当前支出、积累更多债务，并在收入低于预期时面临更高的违约率。为了评估总体影响，论文估计了一个包含违约无担保债务和诊断性卡尔曼滤波的消费模型，其中消费者在形成预期时会过度外推收入冲击。结果表明，外推性收入预期在定性和定量上都有助于解释状态依赖的家庭债务周期。
ai_comment: 论文通过微观数据揭示了消费者收入预期的系统性偏差及其对债务周期的驱动作用，为理解家庭财务脆弱性提供了新的视角。

title: Is Model Accuracy Enough? A Field Evaluation Of A Machine Learning Model To Catch Bogus Firms
abstract: the rest of the policy team championed the project with the state leadership at every turn.Mihir Bhaskar and Suddhasatwa Bhattacharya were exceptional and tireless in managing the multitude of stakeholder relationships and administration matters.We would like to thank the efforts of the leadership at the taxation
summary: 该论文致谢了项目管理和利益相关者关系维护团队，未在摘要中呈现具体研究内容。
ai_comment: 摘要仅为致谢，未提供研究细节，无法评估论文贡献。

title: Government as Venture Capitalists in AI
abstract: Venture capital plays an important role in funding and shaping innovation outcomes, characterized by investors' deep knowledge of the technology, industry, and institutions, as well as their long-running relationships with the entrepreneurship and innovation community.China, in its pursuit of global leadership in AI innovation and technology, has set up government venture capital funds so that both national and local governments act as venture capitalists.These government-led venture capital funds combine features of private venture capital with traditional government innovation policies.In this paper, we collect comprehensive data on China's government and private venture capital funds.We draw three important contrasts between government and private VC funds: (i) government funds are spatially more dispersed than private funds; (ii) government funds invest in firms with weaker ex-ante performance signals but these firms exhibit growth rates exceeding those of firms in which private funds invest; and (iii) private VC funds follow government VC investments, especially when hometown government funds directly invest on firms with weaker ex-ante performance signals.We interpret these patterns in light of VC funds' traditional role overcoming information frictions and China's unique institutional environment, which includes important frictions on mobility and information.
summary: 摘要指出风险投资在资助和塑造创新成果方面的重要作用，其特征是投资者对技术、行业和机构的深刻了解，以及与创业和创新社区的长期关系。中国在追求AI创新和技术全球领导地位的过程中，设立了政府风险投资基金，使国家和地方政府都扮演风险投资者的角色。这些政府主导的风险投资基金结合了私人风险投资与传统政府创新政策的特点。本文收集了中国政府和私人风险投资基金的全面数据，发现政府与私人VC基金之间存在三个重要差异：(i) 政府基金在空间上比私人基金更分散；(ii) 政府基金投资的企业前期绩效信号较弱，但这些企业的增长率超过私人基金投资的企业；(iii) 私人VC基金跟随政府VC投资，尤其是当地方政府基金直接投资于前期绩效信号较弱的企业时。作者根据VC基金传统上克服信息摩擦的作用以及中国独特的制度环境（包括重要的流动性和信息摩擦）来解释这些模式。
ai_comment: 该论文通过对比政府与私人风险投资基金的差异，揭示了政府作为风险资本家在AI创新中的独特作用，并提供了对中国制度环境的深刻洞察。

title: How will Generative AI impact Communication?
abstract: This paper examines the impact of Generative AI (GAI) on communication through the lens of salience and signalling models.It explores how GAI affects both senders' ability to create salient messages and receivers' costs of absorbing them.The analysis reveals that while GAI can increase communication by reducing costs, it may also disrupt traditional signalling mechanisms.In a salience model, GAI generally improves outcomes but can potentially reduce receiver welfare.In a pure signalling model, GAI may hinder effective communication by making it harder to distinguish high-quality messages.This suggests that GAI's introduction necessitates new instruments and mechanisms to facilitate effective communication and quality assessment in this evolving landscape.
summary: 本文通过显著性和信号模型的视角，研究了生成式AI（GAI）对沟通的影响。分析表明，GAI在影响发送者创建显著信息的能力和接收者吸收信息的成本方面具有双重作用。GAI通过降低沟通成本可能增加沟通量，但也可能破坏传统的信号机制。在显著性模型中，GAI通常改善结果，但可能降低接收者福利；而在纯信号模型中，GAI可能阻碍有效沟通，因为使其更难区分高质量信息。因此，GAI的引入需要新的工具和机制来促进有效沟通和质量评估。
ai_comment: 本文从理论模型出发，系统揭示了生成式AI对沟通的潜在负面影响，特别是对信号机制的干扰，为未来研究提供了新视角。

title: Will User-Contributed AI Training Data Eat Its Own Tail?
abstract: This paper examines and finds that the answer is likely to be no.The environment examined starts with users who contribute based on their motives to create a public good.Their own actions determine the quality of that public good but also embed a free-rider problem.When AI is trained on that data, it can generate similar contributions to the public good.It is shown that this increases the incentive of human users to provide contributions that are more costly to supply.Thus, the overall quality of contributions from both AI and humans rises compared to humanonly contributions.In situations where platform providers want to generate more contributions using explicit incentives, the rate of return on such incentives is shown to be lower in this environment.
summary: 本文探讨用户贡献的AI训练数据是否会导致自身质量下降（即“吃自己的尾巴”），发现答案很可能是否定的。研究设定用户出于创造公共物品的动机进行贡献，其自身行动决定公共物品质量，但也存在搭便车问题。当AI基于这些数据训练后，能够生成类似的公共物品贡献。结果表明，AI的参与反而激励人类用户提供成本更高的贡献，因此AI和人类的整体贡献质量相比纯人类贡献有所提升。在平台提供显性激励以鼓励更多贡献的情境下，这种环境中的激励回报率较低。
ai_comment: 本文从公共物品视角出发，为AI训练数据与人类贡献的互动提供了新见解，反驳了数据自噬的担忧，具有理论创新和现实启示。

title: Demand for Artificial Intelligence in Settlement Negotiations
abstract: When AI prediction substantially resolves trial uncertainty, a party purchasing AI prediction will disclose it if it is in their favour and not otherwise, signalling the outcome to the other party. Thus, the trial outcome becomes common knowledge. However, this implies that the parties will settle rather than purchase the AI prediction. When parties have differing prior beliefs regarding trial outcomes, these differences are only resolved if the AI prediction is purchased and utilised. In this case, AI will be purchased in equilibrium. Different trial cost allocation rules awarding all costs to the losing party (the English Rule) or having each party bear their own costs (the American Rule) can impact the demand for AI for settlement negotiations, but how this occurs interacts with the expectations regarding whether a settlement will occur or not in AI's absence.
summary: 这篇论文构建理论模型，分析在审判结果不确定性较高时，当事人对人工智能（AI）预测的需求及其对和解谈判的影响。如果一方购买AI预测，当其有利时会主动披露，不利时则隐瞒，从而向对方传递信号，使审判结果成为共同知识。这导致双方倾向于直接和解而无需购买AI。但当双方对审判结果存在不同的先验信念时，这些差异只能通过实际购买和使用AI预测来解决，此时AI会在均衡中被购买。论文进一步探讨了不同诉讼成本分配规则——英国规则（败诉方承担全部费用）和美国规则（各方自担费用）——如何影响和解谈判中对AI的需求，且这种影响与当事人在无AI情况下是否预期和解有关。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将AI预测引入经典法律经济学模型，揭示了信息不对称下AI的策略性使用，并比较了不同法律规则对技术采纳的影响，对AI在司法领域的应用具有重要启示。

title: Estimation of Nonlinear Exchange Rate Dynamics in Evolving Regimes
Stock Market Wealth and Entrepreneurship
How Does Risk Hedging Impact Operations? Insights from a Price-Setting Newsvendor Model
abstract: If a financial asset’s price movement impacts a firm’s product demand, the firm can respond to the impact by adjusting its operational decisions. For example, in the automotive industry, automakers decrease the selling prices of fuel-inefficient cars when the oil price rises. Meanwhile, the firm can implement a risk-hedging strategy using the financial asset jointly with its operational decisions. Motivated by this, we develop and solve a general risk-management model integrating risk hedging into a price-setting newsvendor. The optimal hedging strategy is calculated analytically, which leads to an explicit objective function for optimizing price and “virtual production quantity” (VPQ). (The latter determines the service level—that is, the demand-fulfillment probability.) We find that hedging generally reduces the optimal price when the firm sets the target mean return as its production-only maximum expected profit. With the same condition on the target mean return, hedging also reduces the optimal VPQ when the asset price trend positively impacts product demand; meanwhile, it may increase the VPQ by a small margin when the impact is negative. We construct the return-risk efficient frontier that characterizes the optimal return-risk trade-off. Our numerical study using data from a prominent automotive manufacturer shows that the markdowns in price and reduction in VPQ are small under our model and that the hedging strategy substantially reduces risk without materially reducing operational profit. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: Financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [General Research Fund 17200521] is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The data files and e-companion are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4942 .
summary: 本文研究风险对冲如何影响企业的运营决策，基于价格设定报童模型（price-setting newsvendor model）。当金融资产价格波动影响产品需求时，企业可以同时调整定价和库存决策，并利用该金融资产进行风险对冲。通过解析求解最优对冲策略，得到显式的目标函数以优化价格和“虚拟生产量”（VPQ，决定服务水平）。研究发现，当企业将目标平均收益设定为仅运营时的最大期望利润时，对冲通常会降低最优价格。当资产价格趋势对产品需求有正向影响时，对冲也降低最优VPQ；当影响为负向时，对冲可能小幅提高VPQ。本文构建了收益-风险有效前沿，并使用一家大型汽车制造商的数据进行数值研究，结果显示价格下调幅度和VPQ减小幅度较小，而对冲策略显著降低了风险，且未大幅降低运营利润。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将金融对冲与运营决策结合，揭示了风险管理对定价和库存的精细影响，数值实验表明对冲能有效降低风险而几乎不牺牲运营利润，具有实践价值。

title: Hospital-Wide Inpatient Flow Optimization
abstract: An ideal that supports quality and delivery of care is to have hospital operations that are coordinated and optimized across all services in real time. As a step toward this goal, we propose a multistage adaptive robust optimization approach combined with machine learning techniques. Informed by data and predictions, our framework unifies the bed assignment process across the entire hospital and accounts for present and future inpatient flows, discharges, and bed requests from the emergency department, scheduled surgeries and admissions, and outside transfers. We evaluate our approach through simulations calibrated on historical data from a large academic medical center. For the 600-bed institution, our optimization model was solved in seconds and reduced off-service placement by 24% on average and boarding delays in the emergency department and postanesthesia units by 35% and 18%, respectively. We also illustrate the benefit of using adaptive linear decision rules instead of static assignment decisions. This paper was accepted by Carri Chan, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4933 .
summary: 本文提出一种结合机器学习技术的多阶段自适应鲁棒优化方法，旨在实现医院范围内住院流程的实时协调与优化。该方法统一了整个医院的床位分配过程，考虑了当前和未来的住院流量、出院、急诊科床位请求、计划手术和入院以及外部转院，并通过基于历史数据模拟的大型学术医疗中心（600床位）进行了评估。优化模型在秒级求解，平均减少了24%的跨科室安置，并分别降低了急诊科和麻醉后护理单元35%和18%的滞留延误。此外，研究还展示了使用自适应线性决策规则相较于静态分配决策的优势。该论文被接受发表于《管理科学》医疗管理栏目。
ai_comment: 该研究将机器学习和鲁棒优化相结合，实现了医院全局实时优化，显著提升了运营效率，具有实际应用价值。

title: Text-Based Measure of Supply Chain Risk Exposure
abstract: Using textual analysis techniques, including seeded word embedding and bag-of-words-based content analysis, I develop a firm-level measure of supply chain risk exposure from a novel source of unstructured data—the discussion between managers and equity analysts on supply chain-related topics during firms’ quarterly earnings conference calls. I validate the measure by showing that (1) the measure exhibits intuitive variations over time and across firms, successfully capturing both routine and systematic supply chain risk events; and (2) the measure is about risk exposure, as it significantly correlates with realized and options-implied stock return volatility, even after controlling for well-known aggregate risk measures. I then demonstrate that the measure is specifically indicative of the supply chain component of risk exposure. (3) Consistent with theoretical predictions, firms facing higher supply chain risks have higher inventory buffers, particularly in raw materials and intermediate inputs, increased cash holdings in lieu of investments, and significantly lower trade credit received from suppliers. Moreover, (4) during unexpected risk episodes, such as the Tohoku earthquake, firms with higher ex ante risk exposure have worse operating and financial performance. These results indicate that the text-based measure provides a credible quantification of firm-level exposure to supply chain risks and can thus be reliably utilized as outcome or explanatory variables in empirical supply chain research. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4927 .
summary: 本文利用文本分析技术（包括种子词嵌入和基于词袋的内容分析），从公司季度财报电话会议中管理层与分析师关于供应链的讨论中，构建了一个企业层面的供应链风险暴露度量。通过验证，该度量在时间序列和横截面上表现出直观的变化，成功捕捉了常规和系统性供应链风险事件，并且与已实现和期权隐含的股票收益波动率显著相关，即使控制了已知的聚合风险度量后仍然成立。进一步，该度量特别反映了供应链风险成分：与理论预测一致，面临更高供应链风险的企业拥有更高的库存缓冲（尤其是原材料和中间投入）、增加现金持有并减少投资，以及从供应商获得的贸易信贷显著减少。此外，在意外风险事件（如东北大地震）中，事前风险暴露较高的企业运营和财务表现更差。结果表明，基于文本的度量提供了对企业供应链风险暴露的可信量化，可可靠地用作实证供应链研究中的结果或解释变量。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用非结构化文本数据构建供应链风险指标，并从多个角度验证其有效性，为实证供应链研究提供了有力工具。

title: Go West Young Firm: The Impact of Startup Migration on the Performance of Migrants
abstract: This paper studies how regional migration to tech clusters impacts the performance of startups within the United States. Startups that move to Silicon Valley experience a significant improvement in performance. This improvement is higher than migrations to other regions in the United States, many of which report null treatment effects. The startups that benefit the most from migration are those leaving low performing entrepreneurial ecosystems and moving to high performing ecosystems, consistent with an agglomeration mechanism. Within different measures of the ecosystem, the level of local patenting predicts startup improvements more than venture capital or the quality-adjusted number of startups, suggesting the local innovation environment is more important to migrant performance than financing or the presence of other startup peers. This paper was accepted by Toby Suart, entrepreneurship and innovation. Funding: This work was supported by Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation, the Jean Hammond (1986) and Michael Krasner (1974) Entrepreneurship Fund at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), and the Edward B. Roberts (1957) Entrepreneurship Fund at MIT. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4924 .
summary: 本文研究了美国初创公司迁移至技术集群对其业绩的影响。研究发现，迁移到硅谷的初创公司业绩显著提升，且这种提升效果强于迁移到美国其他地区（许多地区无显著效果）。受益最大的公司是从低绩效创业生态系统迁移到高绩效生态系统的公司，这符合集聚效应机制。在不同生态系统指标中，本地专利水平对初创公司业绩提升的预测能力超过风险投资或质量调整后的初创公司数量，表明本地创新环境比融资或同行初创公司对迁移业绩更重要。
ai_comment: 该文通过对比不同迁移目的地，揭示了硅谷的特殊优势，并创新性地分解了生态系统各要素的作用，为创业政策提供了新视角。

title: Market Reaction to CEOs’ Dynamic Hemifacial Asymmetry of Expressions
abstract: Neuropsychological studies propose that listeners unconsciously assess speakers’ trustworthiness via their facial expressions. Building on this theory, we investigate how investors respond to CEOs’ dynamic hemifacial asymmetry of expressions (HFAsy) shown in CNBC’s video interviews about corporate earnings. Consistent with the neuropsychological prediction that facial asymmetry induces distrust, we document that (1) the stock market reacts negatively to the CEO’s HFAsy shown in the interview video, and (2) the market reaction to favorable earnings news is negatively associated with the CEO’s HFAsy. We also find a significantly positive association between the short-window abnormal bid-ask spreads and HFAsy, suggesting a larger investor disagreement for firms with high-HFAsy CEOs. Furthermore, we show that analyst forecast revisions are negatively associated with CEOs’ HFAsy. Our results are robust to conducting a falsification test using the previous quarter as a pseudo-event, employing an alternative measure of HFAsy, and using more granular trading data at the second level. Overall, our study provides evidence that investor trust and trading behavior are affected by the dynamic hemifacial asymmetry of expressions appearing on CEOs’ faces. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: Financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 71772123, 72132006, 72172038, 72241425, 72273088, 72372103, and 72310107002], the National Social Science Foundation of China [Grant 23ZDA039], Fudan University (Sci-Tech Innovation Foundation of School of Management), and the Research Fund of Shanghai Data Exchange Corporation is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4922 .
summary: 基于神经心理学中面部不对称引发不信任的理论，本文研究投资者如何对CEO在CNBC财报视频采访中表现出的动态半面不对称（HFAsy）做出反应。研究发现：（1）股票市场对CEO的HFAsy呈现负面反应；（2）市场对利好盈利新闻的反应与CEO的HFAsy负相关；（3）短期异常买卖价差与HFAsy显著正相关，表明高HFAsy CEO所在公司投资者分歧更大；（4）分析师预测修正与CEO的HFAsy负相关。结果在使用上一季度作为伪事件、替换HFAsy度量以及使用秒级交易数据的安慰剂检验中稳健。论文提供证据表明投资者的信任和交易行为受到CEO面部动态不对称的影响。
ai_comment: 该研究创新地结合神经心理学与金融学，通过视频分析CEO面部动态特征对市场的影响，方法严谨且结论稳健，拓展了行为金融学中非语言线索的研究。

title: Who Profits from Trading Options?
abstract: We use account-level transaction data to examine trading styles and profitability in a leading derivatives market. Approximately 66% of active retail investors predominantly hold simple, one-sided positions in only one class of options, whereas institutional investors are more likely to use complex strategies. Hypothesizing that the complexity of trading styles reflects investors’ skills, we examine the effect of options trading styles on investment performance. We find that retail investors using simple strategies lose to the rest of the market. For both retail and institutional investors, selling volatility is the most successful strategy. We conclude that these style effects are persistent and cannot be fully explained by systematic risk exposure. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: J. Hu acknowledges financial support from Lee Kong Chian Fellowship. A. Kirilova acknowledges financial support from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [Grant PID2021-128994NA-I00]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4916 .
summary: 该研究利用账户级交易数据，分析了一个主要衍生品市场中投资者的交易风格与盈利能力。数据显示，约66%的活跃散户投资者主要持有简单、单边头寸，且仅交易一类期权，而机构投资者更倾向于使用复杂策略。基于交易风格复杂性反映投资者技能的假设，本文考察了期权交易风格对投资业绩的影响。结果发现，采用简单策略的散户投资者整体表现逊于市场其他参与者。对于散户和机构投资者而言，卖出波动率是最成功的策略。这些风格效应具有持续性，且无法完全由系统性风险暴露解释。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的高频账户数据，揭示了交易风格与盈利能力的直接关联，尤其强调了简单策略的劣势和卖出波动率的优势，为投资者行为提供了实证依据。

title: Disclosure Similarity and Future Stock Return Comovement
abstract: Existing research often assumes that firms’ financial reporting choices influence their return comovement with other firms. We examine the validity of that assumption. First, we provide initial evidence suggesting that similarity in two firms’ disclosures not only predicts but influences future return comovement between those two firms. Second, we show that this predictive ability aggregates to the market level; disclosure similarity can be used to estimate more accurate forward-looking market betas. Taken together, these two results suggest that firms’ reporting decisions can influence their firms’ betas even in the absence of changes to capital structure or operations. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: The authors are grateful for financial support from the Brigham Young University Marriott School of Business and the Fisher College of Business, Ohio State University. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4915 .
summary: 本文检验了公司财务报告选择是否影响其与其他公司的股票收益同步性（return comovement）。首先，提供初步证据表明两家公司披露的相似性（disclosure similarity）不仅预测而且会影响它们未来的收益同步性。其次，展示这种预测能力可以聚合到市场层面，即披露相似性可用于估计更准确的前瞻性市场贝塔（forward-looking market betas）。总体而言，结果表明即使在资本结构或运营没有变化的情况下，公司的报告决策也能影响其贝塔。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地利用披露相似性预测股票收益同步性，并拓展到市场贝塔估计，为会计信息影响资产定价提供了新证据。

title: Mutual Fund Fragility, Dealer Liquidity Provision, and the Pricing of Municipal Bonds
abstract: Against the backdrop of COVID-19, we study how the interactions of mutual funds and dealers introduce fragility to the municipal bond market and induce lasting market impacts. During the crisis, trading surges, whereas dealers’ liquidity provision plunges for mutual-fund-held bonds, leading to greater price depressions in these bonds. Importantly, the crisis reshapes the market’s perceptions of mutual fund fragility risks, with the aftermath-yield spreads widening significantly more for bonds with greater mutual fund exposures. Such postcrisis pricing effects reflect dealers’ continued reluctance to provide liquidity for mutual fund–held bonds, and they are stronger for bonds whose mutual fund holders are more susceptible to investor runs. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4912 .
summary: 以COVID-19危机为背景，研究共同基金与交易商之间的互动如何导致市政债券市场脆弱性并产生持久影响。危机期间，交易量激增，但交易商对共同基金持有的债券的流动性提供大幅下降，导致这些债券价格跌幅更大。危机重塑了市场对共同基金脆弱性风险的认知：事后（危机后）收益率利差在共同基金敞口较大的债券上显著扩大。这种事后定价效应反映了交易商持续不愿为共同基金持有的债券提供流动性，且对于其共同基金持有人更易遭受投资者挤兑的债券，该效应更强。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了危机期间共同基金与交易商互动对市场定价的持久影响，强调了事后风险重定价现象，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Networking Behind the Scenes: Institutional Cross-Industry Holdings and Corporate Loan Markets
abstract: Institutional investors increasingly hold firms in both the industrial and financial sectors. These cross-industry holdings link firms to “outside” banks that they have not borrowed from, creating a network between the two sectors. We show that such networks reduce firms’ loan spreads. This effect is more prominent when cross-holders are actively involved in borrowers’ routine operations and when they have stronger incentives to advocate for borrowers in the loan process. Furthermore, outside banks begin to lend more to firms once the two parties become linked. This network is “behind-the-scenes” because it does not arise from prior interactions between firms and banks, but is instead built through institutions’ cross-holdings. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4911 .
summary: 本文研究机构投资者跨行业持股（同时持有工业公司和金融公司股份）如何影响企业贷款市场。通过构建工业公司与“外部”银行（此前未借款银行）之间的网络，发现此类网络显著降低了企业的贷款利差。这一效应在跨行业投资者积极参与借款人日常运营、或具有更强动机为借款人争取贷款条件时更为显著。此外，一旦企业与外部银行通过该网络建立联系，外部银行会增加对该企业的贷款。这种网络属于“幕后”性质，并非源于企业与银行先前的互动，而是通过机构交叉持股形成。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示了机构投资者跨行业持股通过“幕后网络”渠道降低企业融资成本，并识别了作用机制与异质性，对理解银企关系及机构投资者的治理角色具有重要贡献。

title: Equity Market Fragmentation and Capital Investment Efficiency
abstract: This study examines how equity market fragmentation affects firms’ capital investment decisions. Recent empirical research finds that market fragmentation lowers trading costs and thus improves market quality. We examine whether this increase in market quality translates into greater revelatory price efficiency, where stock prices reveal with greater precision information to managers and/or creditors about firms’ investment opportunities. Consistent with this notion, our findings reveal that the association between capital investment and investment opportunities is increasing in market fragmentation. Additional evidence suggests that (a) market fragmentation increases revelatory price efficiency at least in part by encouraging information acquisition and informed trade by equity investors and (b) the more efficient stock prices inform both managers and creditors about firms’ investment opportunities. Inferences based on difference-in-differences and instrumental variable tests are consistent with those based on our primary findings. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: The authors are grateful to the Kenan-Flagler Business School, Cox School of Business, Smeal School of Business, and David Eccles School of Business for funding our research. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4905 .
summary: 本文研究股权市场碎片化（equity market fragmentation）如何影响企业的资本投资决策。最近的实证研究发现市场碎片化降低了交易成本，从而提高了市场质量。本文进一步探讨了这种市场质量的提升是否能转化为更高的揭示性价格效率（revelatory price efficiency），即股票价格更精确地向管理层或债权人揭示企业的投资机会信息。研究结果显示，资本投资与投资机会之间的正相关性随着市场碎片化的增加而增强。进一步证据表明：（a）市场碎片化通过鼓励股权投资者的信息获取和信息交易来部分提升揭示性价格效率；（b）更有效的股票价格同时为管理层和债权人提供企业投资机会的信息。基于双重差分法（difference-in-differences）和工具变量（instrumental variable）检验的推断与主要结论一致。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将市场微观结构（碎片化）与公司金融（投资效率）联系起来，为市场碎片化的实际经济后果提供了新证据。

title: Fragmented Securities Regulation, Information-Processing Costs, and Insider Trading
abstract: Using a unique setting where stand-alone banks submit filings to bank regulators instead of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), we examine the consequences of fragmented securities regulation for information-processing costs and opportunistic insider trading. We find the market reaction to insider-trading filings on FDICconnect is less timely than to those on SEC’s Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval (EDGAR) system, suggesting FDICconnect generates higher information-processing costs. We also find only large investors trade more on insider-trading filings on FDICconnect than on insider-trading filings on SEC EDGAR, thus extracting benefits from the delayed market reaction to insider-trading filings on FDICconnect. Finally, we find increased insider selling in stand-alone banks prior to negative earnings news, suggesting insiders’ opportunistic use of private information. These findings collectively suggest regulatory fragmentation undermines market efficiency and distorts the level playing field. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Eugene Lang Junior Faculty Fellowship. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4903 .
summary: 本文利用美国独立银行向银行监管机构（而非SEC）提交文件的独特制度，研究碎片化证券监管对信息处理成本和内幕交易的影响。发现相比SEC的EDGAR系统，市场对FDICconnect上内幕交易申报的反应更不及时，表明FDICconnect导致更高的信息处理成本。只有大型投资者能从FDICconnect的内幕交易申报中获利，利用市场反应的延迟。此外，在负面盈利消息公布前，独立银行内部人卖出行为增加，显示内幕信息的机会主义使用。综上，监管碎片化损害市场效率并扭曲公平竞争环境。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特制度环境，为监管碎片化的经济后果提供了新证据，并从信息处理成本角度解释市场异象。

title: Managing Weather Risk with a Neural Network-Based Index Insurance
abstract: Weather risk affects the economy, agricultural production in particular. Index insurance is a promising tool to hedge against weather risk, but current piecewise-linear index insurance contracts face large basis risk and low demand. We propose embedding a neural network-based optimization scheme into an expected utility maximization problem to design the index insurance contract. Neural networks capture a highly nonlinear relationship between the high-dimensional weather variables and production losses. We endogenously solve for the optimal insurance premium and demand. This approach reduces basis risk, lowers insurance premiums, and improves farmers’ utility. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Research Grants Council, University Grants Committee [Grants GRF 16502020, GRF 16504522, and T31-603/21-N], Singapore Ministry of Education Academic Research Fund Tier 1 [Grants RG143/19 and RG55/20], the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grants RGPIN-2021-04144 and DGECR-2021-00330], the Research Database Matching Fund, and the School of Business and Management, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4902 .
summary: 这篇论文研究如何利用基于神经网络的指数保险合同来管理天气风险，尤其是农业生产中的天气风险。现有分段线性指数保险合同存在较大的基差风险和低需求问题。作者提出将神经网络优化方案嵌入期望效用最大化问题中，以设计指数保险合同。神经网络能够捕捉高维天气变量与生产损失之间的高度非线性关系，并内生求解最优保险费和需求。该方法降低了基差风险，降低了保险费，并提高了农民的效用。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地应用神经网络设计保险合同，有效降低了基差风险，提升了指数保险的实用性，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Skewness Sentiment and Market Anomalies
abstract: This study demonstrates that skewness preference of investors is an important driver of various market anomalies. Using a combined measure of mispricing based on 11 prominent anomaly strategies, we show that return predictability associated with the mispricing component of market anomalies is stronger among firms with higher idiosyncratic skewness. The predictability differences are driven by the higher underperformance of high-skewness firms in short anomaly portfolios. Skewness does not affect the performance of long anomaly portfolios. Portfolio holdings data from a retail brokerage firm show that investors with stronger skewness preferences assign relatively larger weights to stocks in short anomaly portfolios. This paper was accepted by Karl Diether, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4898 .
summary: 本文研究投资者偏度偏好（skewness preference）对市场异象的驱动作用。基于11个主流异象策略构建的综合错误定价指标，发现特质偏度（idiosyncratic skewness）较高的公司中，市场异象的错误定价成分带来的收益可预测性更强。这种差异主要源于高偏度股票在空头异象组合中表现更差，而偏度不影响多头组合的表现。此外，来自零售经纪公司的投资组合持有数据显示，偏度偏好更强的投资者在空头异象组合中配置了更大的权重。
ai_comment: 该研究从投资者偏度偏好角度解释了市场异象，为行为金融学提供了新证据，尤其揭示了高偏度股票在空头端的表现差异。

title: Generalized Stochastic Arbitrage Opportunities
abstract: Concepts are introduced and applied for analyzing and selecting arbitrage portfolios in the face of uncertainty about initial positions and risk preferences. A stochastic arbitrage opportunity is defined as a zero-cost investment portfolio that enhances every feasible host portfolio for all admissible utility functions. The alternative to the existence of such investment opportunities is the existence of a solution to a dual system of asset pricing restrictions based on a class of stochastic discount factors. Feasible approaches to numerical optimization and statistical inference are discussed. Empirical results suggest that equity factor investing is appealing for all risk-averse stock investors with a wide range of initial position and sufficiently low transactions costs by mixing multiple factor portfolios with high after-cost appraisal ratios, low mutual correlation, and negative exposures to the relevant host portfolios. These findings weaken the case for risk-based explanations for the profitability of factor investing. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4892 .
summary: 本文引入并应用了广义随机套利机会的概念，用于在初始头寸和风险偏好不确定的情况下分析和选择套利组合。随机套利机会被定义为一个零成本投资组合，该组合对所有可行的效用函数均能增强每个可行的主组合。这种投资机会存在的替代条件是存在一个基于一类随机贴现因子的资产定价限制的对偶系统解。文章讨论了数值优化和统计推断的可行方法。实证结果表明，对于所有风险厌恶的股票投资者，通过混合多个具有高税后评估比率、低相互相关性以及对相关主组合负暴露的因子组合，在交易成本足够低的情况下，股权因子投资具有吸引力。这些发现削弱了基于风险解释的因子投资盈利性观点。
ai_comment: 本文为因子投资的盈利性提供了非风险偏好驱动的解释，通过引入广义随机套利框架，在理论和实证上都具有创新性，可能对资产定价和投资实践产生重要影响。

title: Employee Satisfaction, Labor Market Flexibility, and Stock Returns Around the World
abstract: Studying 30 countries, we find that the link between employee satisfaction and stock returns is significantly increasing in a country’s labor market flexibility. This result is consistent with employee satisfaction having greater recruitment, retention, and motivation benefits where firms face fewer hiring and firing constraints and employees have greater ability to respond to satisfaction. Labor market flexibility also increases the link between employee satisfaction and current valuation ratios, future profitability, and future earnings surprises, inconsistent with omitted risk factors and identifying channels through which employee satisfaction may affect stock returns. The findings have implications for the differential profitability of socially responsible investing strategies around the world—in particular, the importance of considering institutional factors when forming such strategies. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Deloitte Institute of Innovation and Entrepreneurship. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4889 .
summary: 基于对30个国家的跨国研究，本文发现员工满意度与股票回报之间的正相关关系随着国家劳动力市场灵活性的提高而显著增强。这一结果与员工满意度在招聘、保留和激励员工方面具有更大收益的假说一致，尤其是在企业面临较少雇佣和解雇限制、员工对满意度有更强反应能力的环境中。此外，劳动力市场灵活性还放大了员工满意度与当前估值比率、未来盈利能力以及未来盈利惊喜之间的关联，这排除了遗漏风险因素的解释，并揭示了员工满意度影响股票回报的潜在渠道。研究结论对全球社会责任投资策略的差异化盈利能力具有启示意义，尤其强调了在制定此类策略时考虑制度因素的重要性。
ai_comment: 该研究通过跨国视角揭示了劳动力市场灵活性作为调节员工满意度与股票回报关系的制度因素，为社会责任投资的策略制定提供了重要理论依据和实践启示。

title: Value Uncertainty
abstract: We examine how time-series volatility of book-to-market (UNC) is priced in equity returns and the relative contributions of its book volatility (variations in earnings and book value) and market volatility components (shocks in required return). UNC captures valuation risk, so stocks with high valuation risk earn higher return. An investment strategy long in high-UNC firms and short in low-UNC firms generates 8.5% annual risk-adjusted return. UNC valuation risk premium is driven by outperformance of high-UNC firms facing higher information risk and is not explained by established risk factors and firm characteristics. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from Spain’s Ministry of Education [Grant EC02011-24928], Generalitat de Catalonia [Grant 2014-SGR-1079], Banc Sabadell, the Bank of Cyprus, and the European Social Fund. M. El Hefnawy acknowledges financial support from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [Grant PID2021-128994NA-I00]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4888 .
summary: 本文研究账面市值比的时间序列波动率（UNC）在股票收益中的定价机制，并分解其两个组成部分：账面波动（源自收益和账面价值的变化）和市场波动（由必要回报率的冲击引起）。UNC被视为估值风险的度量，因此具有高UNC的股票获得更高的风险补偿。基于UNC构建的多空投资策略（做多高UNC公司、做空低UNC公司）能够产生年化8.5%的风险调整后收益。UNC的估值风险溢价主要来自面临更高信息风险的高UNC公司的优异表现，且不能被已有的风险因子和公司特征所解释。
ai_comment: 通过构造账面市值比时间序列波动率作为估值风险的代理变量，本文发现了一个新的、不能被已有因子解释的风险溢价，为资产定价文献提供了新视角。

title: Small and Medium Enterprises Amidst the Pandemic and Reopening: Digital Edge and Transformation
abstract: Using administrative universal business registration data as well as primary offline and online surveys of small businesses (including unregistered self-employments) in China, we examine (i) whether digitization helps small and medium enterprises (SMEs) better cope with the COVID-19 pandemic and (ii) whether the pandemic has spurred digital technology adoption. We document significant economic benefits of digitization in increasing SMEs’ resilience against such a large shock, as seen through mitigated demand decline, sustainable cash flow, ability to quickly reopen, and positive outlook for growth. After the January 2020 lockdown, firm entries exhibited a V-shaped pattern, with entries of e-commerce firms experiencing a less pronounced immediate drop and a quicker rebound. Moreover, the pandemic has accelerated the digital transformation of existing firms and the industry in multiple dimensions (e.g., altering operation scope to include e-commerce, allowing remote work, and adopting electronic information systems). The effect persists more than one year after reopening, and it is more pronounced for certain sectors, firms in industrial clusters, and areas with more digital inclusion but less financial efficiency, constituting initial evidence for the long-term impact of the pandemic and the supposedly transitory mitigation policies. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Funding: This research was funded in part by the China Natural Science Foundation [Grants 71874008, 71441008, 71873121, and 72192844], Peking University, the Kauffman Foundation [Junior Fellowship], and the FinTech Chair at Paris–Dauphine University–Université Paris Sciences et Lettres. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02424 .
summary: 本文利用中国的行政企业注册数据以及对小企业（包括未注册自雇者）的线下和线上调查数据，考察了两个问题：一是数字化是否帮助中小企业（SMEs）更好地应对COVID-19疫情；二是疫情是否推动了数字技术的采用。研究发现，数字化显著提高了中小企业抵御此类大冲击的经济韧性，表现为需求下降幅度较小、现金流可持续、能够快速复工以及对增长持积极预期。2020年1月封锁后，企业注册呈现V型走势，其中电商企业的注册在封锁期间下降更小、反弹更快。此外，疫情在多个维度加速了现有企业和行业的数字化转型，例如调整经营范围以纳入电商、允许远程工作以及采用电子信息系统。这一效应在复工一年多后仍然持续，并且在某些行业、产业集群以及数字包容性较高但金融效率较低的地区更为显著，这为疫情及其临时缓解政策的长期影响提供了初步证据。
ai_comment: 本文结合行政数据和调查数据的混合方法，不仅验证了数字化的短期缓冲作用，还发现了疫情对数字化转型的长期加速效应，为理解疫情的经济影响提供了新视角。

title: Government Loan Guarantees, Market Liquidity, and Lending Standards
abstract: We study third-party loan guarantees in a model in which lenders can screen and sell loans before maturity when in need of liquidity. Loan guarantees improve market liquidity, reduce lending standards, and can have a positive overall welfare effect. Guarantees improve the average quality of nonguaranteed loans traded and thus, the market liquidity of these loans because of selection. This positive pecuniary externality provides a rationale for guarantee subsidies. Our results contribute to a debate about reforming government-sponsored mortgage guarantees by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, suggesting that the excessively high subsidies to these guarantees should be reduced but not completely eliminated. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.
summary: 本文通过一个模型研究第三方贷款担保，其中贷款人在需要流动性时可以筛选和出售贷款。研究发现，贷款担保提高了市场流动性，降低了贷款标准，并可能产生正的总体福利效应。担保通过选择效应改善了非担保贷款的平均质量，从而提高了这些贷款的市场流动性。这种正的金钱外部性为补贴担保提供了理由。研究结果有助于关于改革房利美和房地美的政府赞助抵押担保的辩论，表明这些担保的过高补贴应减少但不应完全消除。
ai_comment: 本文通过模型揭示了贷款担保的正外部性，为抵押担保改革提供了政策建议，强调补贴应减少但不应完全消除，具有现实指导意义。

title: Ownership Concentration and Firm Value: New Evidence from Owner Stakes in IPOs
abstract: We study the relationship between ownership concentration and firm value using hand-collected data on the stakes of owner–managers before and after initial public offerings (IPOs). We instrument for the reduction in stake using market returns shortly before IPOs. Short-run market returns are plausible instruments because owners engage in market timing by selling more when prior returns are high, but high short-run returns are unlikely to directly affect firm value years after the IPO. As predicted by agency theory, a large reduction in ownership concentration at the IPO is negatively related to valuation. Future asset growth is low when owners have low stakes. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: B. Larrain acknowledges funding from ANID/CONICYT Proyecto FONDECYT Regular [Grant 1180593]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01039 .
summary: 本文利用手工收集的IPO前后所有者-管理者持股数据，研究所有权集中度与公司价值的关系。采用IPO前的短期市场回报作为所有者减持的工具变量，因为所有者会根据市场时机在回报高时卖出更多，但短期回报不太可能直接影响IPO后多年的公司价值。实证结果支持代理理论：IPO时所有权集中度的大幅下降与公司估值负相关，且所有者持股低时未来资产增长缓慢。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用市场回报作为工具变量，有效解决了内生性问题，为所有权结构与公司价值的关系提供了因果证据。

title: The diversification and welfare effects of robo-advising
abstract: We study the diversification and welfare effects of a large US robo-advisor on the portfolios of previously self-directed investors and document five facts. First, robo-advice reshapes portfolios by increasing indexing and reducing home bias, number of assets held, and fees. Second, these portfolio changes contribute to higher Sharpe ratios. Third, those who benefit most from robo-advice are investors who did not have high exposure to equities or indexing and had poorer diversification levels. Fourth, robo-advice decreases the time investors dedicate to managing their investments. Fifth, those investors who benefit most are more likely to join the service and not quit it.
summary: 本文研究了一家美国大型机器人投顾对先前自主投资的投资者投资组合的多元化和福利效应，并记录了五个关键事实。首先，机器人投顾通过增加指数化投资、减少本土偏好、降低持有资产数量和费用来重塑投资组合。其次，这些投资组合变化带来了更高的夏普比率。第三，从机器人投顾中获益最多的投资者是那些先前对股票或指数化投资敞口不高、多元化水平较差的群体。第四，机器人投顾减少了投资者用于管理投资的时间。第五，获益最多的投资者更倾向于加入并持续使用该服务。
ai_comment: 本文利用实际数据揭示了机器人投顾对个人投资者组合的改善效果及其受益者特征，为金融科技在家庭金融中的应用提供了重要实证证据。

title: Real effects of supplying safe private money
abstract: Privately issued money often bears default risk, which creates transaction frictions when used as a medium of exchange. The late 19th century US provides a unique context to evaluate the real effects of supplying a new type of money that is safe from default. We measure the local change in “monetary” transaction frictions with a market access approach derived from general equilibrium trade theory. Consistent with theories hypothesizing that lowering transaction frictions benefits the traded and inputs-intensive sectors, we find an increase in traded goods production, in the share of manufacturing output and employment, and in innovation.
summary: 本文利用19世纪末美国的历史背景，评估提供一种无违约风险的私人货币对经济的实际影响。作者通过一般均衡贸易理论推导的市场准入方法，衡量当地货币交易摩擦的变化。研究发现，降低交易摩擦促进了贸易品生产、制造业产出和就业份额的增加，以及创新活动的提升，验证了理论假设：降低交易摩擦有利于贸易密集型和投入密集型部门。
ai_comment: 本文利用历史自然实验和贸易理论方法，为货币安全性与实体经济之间的因果关系提供了新颖证据，具有重要的政策启示。

title: The passive ownership share is double what you think it is
abstract: Each time a stock gets added to or dropped from an index, we ask: “How much money would have to be tracking that index to explain the huge spike in rebalancing volume we observe on reconstitution day?” While index funds held 16 % of the US stock market in 2021, we put the overall passive ownership share at 33 . 5 % . Our headline number is twice as large because it reflects index funds as well as other kinds of passive investors, such as institutional investors with internally managed index portfolios and active managers who are closet indexing.
summary: 每当股票被加入或剔除指数时，通过观察重组日交易量的异常激增，反推出追踪该指数的资金规模。基于此方法，研究发现2021年指数基金仅持有美国股市的16%，但包括内部管理指数组合的机构投资者和隐性指数化的主动管理基金在内的整体被动所有权份额高达33.5%，几乎是指数基金份额的两倍。
ai_comment: 本文通过交易量异常反推被动资金规模，提供了比单纯统计指数基金更全面的被动份额估算，揭示了隐性指数化行为的普遍性。

title: When failure is an option: Fragile liquidity in over-the-counter markets
abstract: Markets can give false impressions of liquidity and stability if failed attempts to trade are ignored. For collateralized loan obligations, we quantify this bias by estimating the total cost of immediacy (TCI) which incorporates failure rates and failure costs. TCI is substantially higher than the observed cost, 0.3–3.8% versus 0.04–0.12% across credit-quality tranches because trade failures are frequent, failure costs are large, and failure costs and rates are correlated. TCI is almost double the realized gains from trade for low-rated tranches. Overall, auction-based over-the-counter markets become illiquid and fragile, especially during stressful periods for low-rated assets.
summary: 本文探讨场外市场中因忽略交易失败而产生的流动性虚假印象，以担保贷款凭证为研究对象，提出包含失败率和失败成本的即时性总成本指标，并量化其偏差。研究发现，TCI远高于观察到的成本，例如不同信用评级分层的TCI为0.3%-3.8%，而观察成本仅为0.04%-0.12%。交易失败频繁、失败成本高昂且两者相关导致偏差显著；对于低评级分层，TCI几乎达到交易实现收益的两倍。这表明拍卖式场外市场尤其在压力时期对低评级资产变得流动性不足且脆弱。
