ai_comment: 本文通过引入包含失败成本的TCI指标，揭示了场外市场流动性被高估的严重程度，对理解市场微观结构中的隐性成本具有重要贡献。

title: Crowdsourcing peer information to change spending behavior
abstract: We isolate the information channel of peer effects in consumption in a setting that excludes a role for common shocks or social pressure—a spending panel paired with crowdsourced information about anonymous “peers” elicited at different times. Consumers converge to peers’ spending, and more so when peer signals are more informative. Convergence is asymmetric: within 12 months of information provision, overspenders close 17% and underspenders 5% of their gap relative to peers. We exploit the quasi-random assignment to peer groups in an instrumental-variable strategy and implement an experiment for external validity. Our results are consistent with information-based theories of overconsumption.
summary: 本文利用消费面板数据与不同时间众包收集的匿名同伴信息，在排除共同冲击或社会压力的情境中，孤立出同伴效应在消费中的信息渠道。研究发现，消费者会向同伴的消费水平靠拢，且当同伴信号信息量更大时收敛更明显。收敛存在不对称性：在信息提供后的12个月内，过度消费者缩小了与同伴差距的17%，而消费不足者仅缩小了5%。作者利用准随机分配到同伴组的工具变量策略，并实施了外部有效性实验。结果支持基于信息的过度消费理论。
ai_comment: 该研究通过准随机分组和实验设计，有效识别了同伴效应的信息渠道，揭示了消费行为的非对称收敛特征，为理解过度消费提供了新视角。

title: Regulatory arbitrage or random errors? Implications of race prediction algorithms in fair lending analysis
abstract: When race is not directly observed, regulators and analysts commonly predict it using algorithms based on last name and address. In small business lending—where regulators assess fair lending law compliance using the Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) algorithm—we document large prediction errors among Black Americans. The errors bias measured racial disparities in loan approval rates downward by 43%, with greater bias for traditional vs. fintech lenders. Regulation using self-identified race would increase lending to Black borrowers, but also shift lending toward affluent areas because errors correlate with socioeconomics. Overall, using race proxies in policymaking and research presents challenges.
summary: 在公平借贷分析中，由于种族数据通常未能直接观测，监管者和分析师经常使用基于姓氏和地址的贝叶斯改进姓氏地理编码（BISG）算法来预测种族。本文聚焦于小企业贷款领域，发现该算法对非裔美国人存在较大的预测误差。这些误差使得贷款批准率中可观测的种族差异被低估了43%，且传统贷款机构比金融科技贷款机构产生的偏差更大。若改用自我报告的种族进行监管，虽然会增加对黑人借款人的贷款，但由于误差与社会经济因素相关，会导致贷款向富裕地区转移。总体而言，在政策制定和研究中使用种族代理变量会带来诸多挑战。
ai_comment: 该论文系统量化了BISG算法在公平借贷分析中的系统性偏差，并揭示了其与贷款机构类型的交互效应，对监管政策具有重要启示。

title: Intermediary-based equity term structure
abstract: We demonstrate that a financial intermediary-based asset pricing model offers a compelling explanation for a new set of conditional moments of equity term structure and convenience yields. The model’s key mechanism is that the time-varying tightness of intermediaries’ leverage constraints drives significant mean reversion in the price of risk. This model guides us in devising a novel empirical methodology to estimate the tightness of these constraints (i.e., the Relative Tightness Index) from cross-sectional returns of various asset classes. Our findings affirm that this measure significantly drives the dynamics of equity yield slope and convenience yields, both empirically and quantitatively.
summary: 本文展示了一个基于金融中介的资产定价模型，能够有力解释股票期限结构和便利收益的一组新的条件矩。模型的核心机制是中介杠杆约束的时变紧度导致风险价格的显著均值回归。该模型指导作者设计了一种新的实证方法，从各类资产的横截面收益中估计这些约束的紧度（即相对紧度指数）。研究结果证实，该指标在实证和定量上显著驱动股票收益率斜率和便利收益的动态。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入相对紧度指数，创新性地将金融中介的杠杆约束与资产定价的期限结构联系起来，提供了实证和理论上的有力证据。

title: Financial constraints, cash flow timing patterns, and asset prices
abstract: We show that firms collect almost 70% of their cash flows in the second half of the fiscal year, and that firms that collect more cash by year-end earn a 6.8% higher per annum risk premium and save more cash. We rationalize these facts in a quantitative investment-based asset pricing model. Immediate cash payments negatively affect profitability, but reduce equity financing costs by increasing information transparency. Financially constrained firms optimally collect more cash at year-end when firms’ performance attracts more attention and information transparency is more valuable. Such behavior further results in greater exposure to aggregate productivity and financial shocks.
summary: 本文发现企业约70%的现金流集中在财政年下半年收取，且年末现金流占比更高的企业年风险溢价高出6.8%，同时储蓄更多现金。通过一个定量投资型资产定价模型进行解释：即时现金支付虽降低盈利能力，但通过提高信息透明度降低股权融资成本。财务约束企业最优地选择在年末收取更多现金，此时企业绩效更受关注，信息透明度价值更高。这种行为导致企业对总生产率冲击和金融冲击的暴露程度更大。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将现金流时间模式与资产定价联系起来，揭示了财务约束企业通过调整现金收取时点影响风险溢价的机制，对理解企业融资决策与市场风险定价有重要意义。

title: Associative memory, beliefs and market interactions
abstract: Recent theories and narratives highlight the potential role of associative recall in driving overreaction in expectations and market behavior. Based on a simple model, we test this idea through a series of experiments in which news are communicated with memorable contexts. Because the experimental participants predominantly remember those past news that get cued by new information, their beliefs about fundamentals strongly overreact. In a betting market experiment, associative recall translates into overreaction in market prices, which makes realized prices too extreme. Our results highlight the importance of associative memory for beliefs and financial decisions.
summary: 该论文通过一系列实验检验关联记忆在驱动预期和市场行为过度反应中的作用。基于简单模型，研究者将新闻与难忘情境关联，发现实验参与者倾向于记住被新信息提示的过去新闻，导致对基本面的信念强烈过度反应。在博彩市场实验中，关联记忆转化为市场价格的过度反应，使实际价格过于极端。结果强调了关联记忆对信念和金融决策的重要性。
ai_comment: 论文通过实验设计直接验证了关联记忆对市场过度反应的影响，为行为金融理论提供了微观基础。

title: Debtor income manipulation in consumer credit contracts
abstract: We show that forcing insolvent consumer debtors to repay a larger fraction of debt causes them to strategically manipulate the data they report to creditors. Exploiting a policy change that required insolvent debtors to increase debt repayments at an arbitrary income cutoff, we document that some debtors reduce reported income to just below this cutoff to avoid the higher repayment. Those debtors who manipulate income have a lower probability of default on their repayment plans, consistent with having access to hidden income. We estimate this strategic manipulation costs creditors 12% to 36% of their total payout per filing.
summary: 本文研究证明，迫使资不抵债的消费者债务人偿还更大比例的债务会导致他们策略性地操纵向债权人报告的数据。利用一项政策变化（要求资不抵债的债务人在任意收入临界点增加债务偿还），作者发现一些债务人将报告收入降低到刚好低于该临界点以避免更高的偿还额。那些操纵收入的债务人在还款计划上违约的可能性较低，这与他们拥有隐藏收入一致。估计这种策略性操纵使债权人每份申请损失总支付的12%至36%。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用政策断点识别债务人的收入操纵行为，并量化了对债权人的成本，对消费者金融监管有重要启示。

title: When the markets get CO.V.I.D: COntagion, Viruses, and Information Diffusion
abstract: We quantify the exposure of major financial markets to news shocks about global contagion risk while accounting for local epidemic conditions. For a wide cross section of countries, we construct a novel dataset comprising (i) announcements related to COVID19 and (ii) high-frequency data on epidemic news diffused through Twitter (Hassan et al., 2019’s methodology). We provide novel empirical evidence about financial dynamics both around epidemic announcements and at daily/intra-daily frequencies. Analysis of contagion data and social media activity about COVID19 suggest that the market price of contagion risk is significant.
summary: 该论文量化了全球主要金融市场对全球传染风险新闻冲击的暴露程度，同时考虑了当地疫情状况。针对多个国家，作者构建了一个新颖的数据集，包括（i）与COVID-19相关的公告，以及（ii）通过Twitter传播的疫情新闻高频数据（采用Hassan等人2019年的方法）。论文提供了关于疫情公告前后以及日/日内频率下金融动态的新实证证据。对传染数据及关于COVID-19的社交媒体活动分析表明，传染风险的市场风险溢价显著。
ai_comment: 该论文通过融合传统公告数据与社交媒体高频数据，创新性地度量了疫情新闻传播对金融市场的影响，并为传染风险定价提供了新的实证依据。

title: Tiny trades, big questions: Fractional shares
abstract: This paper investigates fractional share trading. We develop a latency-based method for identifying a large sample of fractional share trades. We find that high-priced stocks, meme stocks, IPOs, SPACs, and popular retail stocks exhibit considerable numbers of these tiny trades. We surmise that this reflects dollar-based order entry, with many tiny trades being fractional components of larger orders. We show that our fractional trade measure is predictive of future liquidity and volatility, suggesting a new metric to capture the information in retail trades. We identify how data and reporting protocols preclude knowing the extent of fractional share trading, inflate volume data, and provide censured samples of these off-exchange trades.
summary: 本文研究零碎股交易（fractional shares）。作者开发了一种基于延迟的方法来识别大量零碎股交易样本，发现高价格股票、meme股票、IPO、SPAC和热门零售股中存在大量此类微交易。推测这反映了基于美元的订单输入，许多微交易是大订单的零碎部分。研究表明，零碎交易指标能预测未来流动性和波动性，从而提供捕捉零售交易信息的新指标。同时也指出，当前的数据与报告协议阻碍了解零碎股交易的真实程度，夸大了成交量数据，并提供了这些场外交易的审查样本。
ai_comment: 本文从数据细节出发，揭示了零碎股交易对市场指标的影响，并提出了一个新颖的零售交易信息捕捉指标。对理解市场微观结构和交易数据质量有重要贡献。

title: Firm Networks and Asset Returns
abstract: Changes in the propagation of shocks along firm networks are important to understanding aggregate and cross-sectional features of stock returns. When calibrated to match key characteristics of supplier–customer networks in the United States, a model in which firms are interlinked via enduring relationships generates long-run consumption risks, high and volatile risk premiums, and a small and stable risk-free rate. The model also matches cross-sectional patterns of portfolio returns sorted by firm centrality, a feature unaccounted for by standard asset pricing models. (JEL C67, E30, G12, L14)
summary: 本文研究企业网络中冲击传播的变化如何影响股票回报的总体和截面特征。通过校准一个模型，模拟美国供应商-客户网络的关键特征，其中企业通过持久关系相互连接，该模型能够产生长期消费风险、高且波动的风险溢价，以及小且稳定的无风险利率。此外，模型还匹配了按企业中心性排序的投资组合回报的截面模式，这是标准资产定价模型未能解释的。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建企业网络模型，成功解释了标准资产定价模型无法捕捉的截面回报模式，为理解冲击传播与资产定价的关系提供了新视角。

title: Price elasticity of demand and risk-bearing capacity in sovereign bond auctions
abstract: The paper uses bids submitted by primary dealer banks at auctions of sovereign bonds to quantify the price elasticity of demand. The price elasticity of demand correlates strongly with the volatility of returns of the same bonds traded in the secondary market but only weakly with their bid-ask spread. It predicts same-bond post-auction returns in the secondary market, even after controlling for pre-auction volatility. The evidence suggests that the price elasticity of demand is associated with the magnitude of price pressure in the secondary market around auction days and proxies for primary dealer risk-bearing capacity.
summary: 本研究利用主权债券拍卖中一级交易商银行提交的投标数据，量化了需求的价格弹性。研究发现，价格弹性与同一债券在二级市场的收益波动率强相关，但与买卖价差弱相关。该弹性能够预测同一债券在二级市场的拍卖后收益，即使在控制了拍卖前波动率后依然显著。证据表明，价格弹性与拍卖日前后二级市场的价格压力幅度相关，并可作为一级交易商风险承担能力的代理变量。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的拍卖投标数据直接估计需求价格弹性，揭示了其与二级市场波动和价格压力的紧密联系，为理解市场微观结构提供了新视角。

title: Information Spillovers at Earnings Announcements
abstract: Research documents price co‐movements, or “spillovers,” between focal firms and their peers at focal firms’ earnings announcements. We find that both signed and absolute co‐movements between focal‐ and peer‐firm returns are significantly lower at earnings‐announcement dates compared to other dates. Analytically, we demonstrate that co‐movements do not necessarily indicate common information; instead, co‐movements measure the relative proportion of focal firm‐specific information to common information in focal‐firm earnings announcements. We study three settings where information transfers might be higher: when focal firms report significant earnings surprises, are industry leaders, or share correlated earnings patterns with peer firms. We continue to find lower return correlations during focal‐firm earnings announcements. We conduct two alternative tests but fail to find evidence that common information released during focal‐firm earnings announcements is significantly greater than on other days. These results raise doubt about the extent of the information externality attributable to financial‐report releases.
summary: 本文研究焦点公司在盈利公告期间与同行业公司之间的股价联动（信息溢出）现象。实证发现，与其它日期相比，在盈利公告日，焦点公司与同行业公司之间的回报相关性和绝对相关性均显著更低。通过理论分析，本文表明股价联动并不一定反映共同信息的传递，而是衡量焦点公司特异性信息相对于共同信息的比例。即使在预期信息传递更强的三种情境下（焦点公司报告显著盈余意外、是行业领导者、与同行盈余模式相关），仍然观察到回报相关性在公告日更低。两项替代检验也未发现公告日共同信息显著多于其他日期的证据。这些结果对财务报告发布所产生信息外部性的程度提出了质疑。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严谨的实证分析和理论推导，对传统认为盈利公告会产生显著信息溢出效应的观点提出了挑战，为理解财务报告的信息外部性提供了新的视角。

title: Meeting Targets in Competitive Product Markets
abstract: We show that public banks face negative stock return jumps after missing their earnings per share (EPS) targets, and theoretically and quantitatively link these jumps to bunching behavior in the EPS surprise distribution. Bunching banks cut deposit rates to meet their targets, but do so at the expense of deposit outflows and franchise value losses. Local competitors, including private banks unexposed to capital market pressure, increase deposit rates, compensating depositors for switching. Our results provide new evidence that performance targeting incentives can affect consumer product prices, and suggest that competition may provide a check on public firms' targeting efforts.
summary: 本文研究公共银行为达到每股收益（EPS）目标而采取的行为及其市场后果。实证发现，未达标的公共银行面临显著的负向股票收益跳跃，且该跳跃与盈余惊喜分布中的聚束现象（bunching）在理论和量化上相关联。为实现EPS目标，聚束银行会下调存款利率，但这导致存款外流和特许权价值损失。相反，不受资本市场压力的当地竞争对手（如私人银行）则提高存款利率，以补偿储户的转换成本。研究结果表明，业绩目标激励能够影响消费品价格（如存款利率），并暗示市场竞争可能对上市公司的目标追求行为起到制约作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将EPS目标激励与银行存款利率定价联系起来，揭示了资本市场压力对产品市场竞争的影响，为理解上市公司非价格竞争行为提供了新视角。

title: Did Banks Pay Fair Returns to Taxpayers on TARP?
abstract: Financial institutions received investments under the Troubled Asset Relief Program in a bad state of the world but repaid them in a relatively good state. We show that the recipients paid considerably lower returns to taxpayers compared to private‐market securities with similar risk over the same investment horizon, resulting in a subsidy of over $50 billion on the preferred equity investment by the government. Ex‐post renegotiation of contract terms limited the upside gains received by taxpayers in good times and contributed to the subsidy. These findings have important implications for the design and implementation of future bailouts. Our simple methodology for calculating the subsidy can be applied to evaluate the financial costs of other bailouts.
summary: 论文研究了问题资产救助计划（TARP）中，金融机构在状况不佳时获得政府投资，但在相对较好的状态下偿还的情况。研究发现，与同一投资期限内具有类似风险的私人市场证券相比，接受救助的金融机构向纳税人支付的回报显著偏低，导致政府优先股权投资产生了超过500亿美元的隐性补贴。事后的合同条款重新谈判限制了纳税人在经济向好时可获得的上行收益，进一步加剧了补贴规模。该发现对未来救助计划的设计和实施具有重要意义，文中提出的计算补贴的简易方法也可用于评估其他救助项目的财务成本。
ai_comment: 论文通过量化隐性补贴揭示了TARP救助的真实成本，强调了合同设计的重要性，为政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: News Diffusion in Social Networks and Stock Market Reactions
abstract: We study how the social transmission of public news influences investors’ beliefs and the securities markets. Using data on social networks, we find that earnings announcements from firms in higher-centrality counties generate a stronger immediate price, volatility, and trading volume reactions. Post-announcement, such firms experience weaker price drift and faster volatility decay but higher and more persistent volume. These findings suggest greater social connectedness facilitates the timely incorporation of news into prices, as well as opinion divergence and excessive trading. We propose the social churning hypothesis, which is confirmed using granular data from StockTwits messages and household trading records.
summary: 本文研究公开新闻在社会网络中的传播对投资者信念和证券市场的影响。利用社会网络数据，发现位于社交网络中心度较高县的公司发布盈利公告时，会引发更强的即时价格、波动率和交易量反应。公告后，这些公司的价格漂移更弱，波动率衰减更快，但交易量更高且更持久。这些发现表明社会连通性既有助于新闻及时融入价格，也导致意见分歧和过度交易。作者提出并基于StockTwits消息和家庭交易记录数据验证了“社会搅动假说”。
ai_comment: 该文通过微观数据实证了社会网络在信息传播中的双重角色，提出的“社会搅动假说”为理解交易行为提供了新视角。

title: Computational Reproducibility in Finance: Evidence from 1,000 Tests
abstract: We analyze the computational reproducibility of more than 1,000 empirical answers to 6 research questions in finance provided by 168 research teams. Running the researchers’ code on the same raw data regenerates exactly the same results only 52% of the time. Reproducibility is higher for researchers with better coding skills and those exerting more effort. It is lower for more technical research questions, more complex code, and results lying in the tails of the distribution. Researchers exhibit overconfidence when assessing the reproducibility of their own research. We provide guidelines for finance researchers and discuss implementable reproducibility policies for academic journals.
summary: 本文研究了金融领域计算可重复性的实证证据。168个研究团队针对6个金融研究问题提供了超过1000个实证答案，通过运行研究者的代码，在相同原始数据上仅52%的结果能完全重现。研究发现，编程技能更高、投入更多努力的研究者其研究可重复性更高；而技术性更强的研究问题、更复杂的代码以及位于分布尾部的结果，可重复性更低。研究者对自己研究的可重复性表现出过度自信。文章最后为金融研究者提供了指南，并讨论了学术期刊可实施的可重复性政策。
ai_comment: 该研究系统性地评估了金融实证研究的可重复性，揭示了研究者过度自信的偏差，为改进研究实践和期刊政策提供了实证依据。

title: Institutional Brokerage Networks: Facilitating Liquidity Provision
abstract: We argue that institutional brokerage networks facilitate liquidity provision and mitigate the price impact of large non-information-motivated trades. Using commissions, we map trading networks of mutual funds (institutions) and their brokers. Central funds (institutions) tend to outperform their peripheral counterparts in terms of return gap (execution shortfall). This outperformance is more pronounced when funds experience large outflows and for large trades in less liquid stocks. Central brokers can deliver superior trade execution compared to peripheral brokers, but mainly for central institutions. We use the collapse of Lehman Brothers as a quasi-natural experiment to establish the likely causality of our findings.
summary: 本文研究了机构经纪网络如何促进流动性提供并缓解大宗非信息驱动交易的价格影响。通过使用佣金数据，作者构建了共同基金（机构）与其经纪商之间的交易网络。研究发现，处于网络中心的基金在回报差距（执行缺口）方面优于外围基金，这种优势在基金经历大额赎回以及交易低流动性股票的大宗交易时更为显著。中心经纪商能够提供比外围经纪商更优的交易执行，但这一优势主要针对中心机构。作者利用雷曼兄弟倒闭作为准自然实验，为研究结论的因果关系提供了证据。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用佣金数据构建机构交易网络，揭示了网络中心性对交易执行质量的影响，并通过雷曼兄弟倒闭这一外生冲击提供了因果证据。

title: Half Banked: The Economic Impact of Cash Management in the Marijuana Industry
abstract: We investigate the economic value of cash management. In the legal marijuana industry, where only half of businesses have access to cash management services from a financial institution, we examine dispensary profitability using administrative and survey data. Our results show that businesses with cash management charge higher retail prices (8.3%), pay lower wholesale prices (7.3%), and have higher sales volume (19%). Together, these advantages create a 40% increase in profitability. These results support our model in which reputational capital and administrative costs drive profitability regardless of whether national banks, credit unions, or fintech provide the cash management functions.
summary: 本文研究了现金管理的经济价值。在合法大麻行业中，仅有一半企业能获得金融机构的现金管理服务。通过行政数据和调查数据，本文考察了药房的盈利能力。结果显示，拥有现金管理的企业零售价格更高（8.3%），批发价格更低（7.3%），销量更高（19%）。这些优势共同使盈利能力提升40%。这些结果支持了一个模型，即无论是由国家银行、信用合作社还是金融科技公司提供现金管理功能，声誉资本和行政成本都是驱动盈利能力的因素。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的大麻行业数据，实证揭示了现金管理对企业盈利能力的显著影响，并构建了理论模型，为理解金融服务的实体经济效应提供了新视角。

title: Insensitive Investors
abstract: We experimentally study the transmission of subjective expectations into actions. Subjects in our experiment report valuations that are far too insensitive to their expectations, relative to the prediction from a frictionless model. We propose that the insensitivity is driven by a noisy cognitive process that prevents subjects from precisely computing asset valuations. The empirical link between subjective expectations and actions becomes stronger as subjective expectations approach rational expectations. Our results highlight the importance of incorporating weak transmission into belief‐based asset pricing models. Finally, we discuss how cognitive noise can provide a microfoundation for inelastic demand in the stock market.
summary: 本文通过实验研究主观预期如何影响实际行动。实验发现，被试报告的资产估值对其主观预期的敏感度远低于无摩擦模型的预测。作者提出，这种不敏感性源于一种噪声认知过程，阻碍了被试精确计算资产估值。主观预期与行动之间的实证联系随着主观预期趋近理性预期而增强。结果强调了将弱传导纳入基于信念的资产定价模型的重要性。最后，讨论了认知噪声如何为股票市场的无弹性需求提供微观基础。
ai_comment: 本文通过精巧的实验设计揭示了主观预期传导中的认知噪声机制，为理解资产定价中的弱传导现象提供了新视角。

title: News Bias in Financial Journalists’ Social Networks
abstract: Connected financial journalists—those with working relationships, common school ties, or social media connections to company management—introduce a marked media slant into their news coverage. Using a comprehensive set of newspaper articles covering mergers and acquisition (M&A) transactions from 1997 to 2016, I find that connected journalists use significantly fewer negative words in their coverage of connected acquirers. These journalists are also more likely to quote connected executives and include less accurate language in their reporting. Moreover, they tend to portray other firms in the same network in a less negative light. Journalists’ favoritism bias has implications for both capital market outcomes and their careers. I find that acquirers whose M&As are covered by connected journalists receive significantly higher stock returns on the news article publication date. However, these acquirers’ stock prices reverse in the long term, suggesting market overreaction to news covered by connected journalists. Around M&A transactions, connected articles are correlated with increased bid competition and deal premiums. In terms of future career development, connected journalists are more likely to leave journalism and join their associated industries in the long run. Taken together, the evidence suggests that financial journalists’ personal networks promote news bias that potentially hinders the efficient dissemination of information.
summary: 本文研究金融记者与公司管理层之间的社交网络如何导致新闻报道偏见。通过分析1997年至2016年并购交易的相关报纸文章，发现与并购方有工作关系、校友关系或社交媒体联系的记者，在其报道中使用显著更少的负面词汇，更倾向于引用有关联的高管，且语言准确性较低。这些记者对其他网络内公司的报道也呈现较少负面色彩。这种偏袒影响资本市场：有关联记者报道的并购方在新闻发布日获得更高股票收益，但长期股价反转，表明市场过度反应。此外，有关联文章与投标竞争增加和交易溢价上升相关。职业发展方面，有关联的记者长期更可能离开新闻业并加入相关行业。总体证据表明，金融记者的个人网络导致新闻偏见，可能阻碍信息有效传播。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的数据集揭示了记者个人网络对新闻报道客观性的显著影响，并提供了市场反应和职业后果的完整证据，对理解媒体偏见在资本市场中的作用具有重要意义。

title: Using and Interpreting Fixed Effects Models
abstract: Fixed effects (FE) have emerged as a ubiquitous and powerful tool for eliminating unwanted variation in observational accounting studies. Unwanted variation is plentiful in accounting research because we often use rich data to test precise hypotheses derived from abstract theories. By eliminating unwanted variation, FE reduce concerns that omitted variables bias our estimates or weaken test power. FE are not costless, though, so their use should be carefully justified by theoretical and institutional considerations. FE also transform samples and variables in ways that are not immediately apparent, and in doing so affect how we should interpret regression results. This primer explains the mechanics of FE and provides practical guidance for the informed use, transparent reporting, and careful interpretation of FE models.
summary: 本文旨在解释固定效应（FE）模型在观察性会计研究中的使用和解释。固定效应模型已成为消除不必要变异的普遍且强大的工具，在会计研究中，由于常用丰富数据检验来自抽象理论的精确假设，不必要变异尤为常见。通过消除不必要变异，FE减少了遗漏变量偏误估计或削弱检验效力的担忧。但FE并非无成本，其使用应基于理论和制度考量进行合理证明。FE还会以不直接明显的方式改变样本和变量，从而影响回归结果的解释。本文解释了FE的机制，并为FE模型的有依据使用、透明报告和谨慎解释提供实践指导。
ai_comment: 这篇论文为会计研究者提供了关于固定效应模型使用的系统实践指南，强调了理论依据和结果解释的重要性，有助于提高研究的严谨性和透明度。

title: What Drives Variation in the U.S. Debt‐to‐Output Ratio? The Dogs that Did not Bark
abstract: A higher U.S. government debt‐to‐output (D‐O) ratio does not forecast higher surpluses or lower returns on Treasurys in the future. Neither future cash flows nor discount rates account for the variation in the current D‐O ratio. The market valuation of Treasurys is surprisingly insensitive to macro fundamentals. Instead, the future D‐O ratio accounts for most of the variation because the D‐O ratio is highly persistent. Systematic surplus forecast errors may help account for these findings. Since the start of the Global Financial Crisis, surplus projections have anticipated a large fiscal correction that failed to materialize.
summary: 研究探讨美国政府债务产出比（D-O比率）变化的驱动因素。发现当前D-O比率的变化不能由未来财政盈余或国债回报率的预期变化来解释，即未来现金流和贴现率均不显著。相反，由于D-O比率的高度持续性，其变化主要由未来的D-O比率本身所解释。市场对国债的估值对宏观基本面异常不敏感。系统性盈余预测错误可能有助于解释这些结果，例如自全球金融危机以来，盈余预测一直预期大规模财政调整但未能实现。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了传统的现值关系理论，揭示了债务比率的高度持续性特征，强调了预期误差在理解财政动态中的关键作用，对财政可持续性研究具有重要启示。

title: Information Aggregation with Asymmetric Asset Payoffs
abstract: We study noisy aggregation of dispersed information in financial markets without imposing parametric restrictions on preferences, information, and return distributions. We provide a general characterization of asset returns by means of a risk‐neutral probability measure that features excess weight on tail risks. Moreover, we link excess weight on tail risks to observable moments such as forecast dispersion and accuracy, and argue that it provides a unified explanation for several prominent cross‐sectional return anomalies. Simple calibrations suggest the model can account for a significant fraction of empirical returns to skewness, returns to disagreement, and interaction effects between the two.
summary: 本文研究金融市场中分散信息的噪声聚合，不预设偏好、信息和回报分布的参数形式。通过风险中性概率测度，发现资产回报在尾部风险上存在过度权重，并将此过度权重与可观测的矩（如预测离散度和准确性）关联起来，从而为多个横截面回报异常（如偏度回报、分歧回报及其交互效应）提供了统一解释。简单校准表明模型能够解释这些异常效应的很大部分。
ai_comment: 本文在不依赖参数假设下揭示了尾部风险过度权重是多种横截面异常的统一机制，理论简洁且校准效果显著。

title: Inside and Outside Information
abstract: We study an economy with financial frictions in which a regulator designs a test that reveals outside information about a firm's quality to investors. The firm can also disclose verifiable inside information about its quality. We show that the regulator optimally aims for “public speech and private silence,” which is achieved with tests that give insiders an incentive to stay quiet. We fully characterize optimal tests by developing tools for Bayesian persuasion with incentive constraints, and use these results to derive novel guidance for the design of bank stress tests, as well as benchmarks for socially optimal corporate credit ratings.
summary: 本文研究存在金融摩擦的经济中，监管者如何设计测试以向投资者揭示关于公司质量的外部信息，同时公司可自愿披露可验证的内部信息。通过开发带激励约束的贝叶斯说服工具，作者完全刻画了最优测试，发现监管者最优目标是实现“公共言论与私人沉默”，即设计测试使内部人有动机保持沉默。这些结果为银行压力测试的设计提供了新的指导，并建立了社会最优公司信用评级的基准。
ai_comment: 本文通过贝叶斯说服框架巧妙融合内外部信息披露，为压力测试和信用评级设计提供了理论依据。

title: Financial Effects of Remote Product Delivery: Evidence from Hospitals
abstract: We study financial effects of remote product delivery in the healthcare industry. Exploiting staggered law adoption for identification, we find that telehealth provision redistributes hospital operations and access to capital away from rural communities. As urban telehealth providers acquire rural patients, rural hospitals experience decreased revenue and profit, credit rating downgrades, increased cost of capital, and ultimately risk of closure. Although telehealth reduces travel costs, some communities lose access to acute care. Overall, we conclude that remote healthcare services have financial consequences as well as real effects, and their benefits are unequally distributed.
summary: 本文研究远程产品交付（远程医疗）在医疗行业的财务影响。通过利用各州法律采纳时间差异作为识别策略，发现远程医疗的普及导致医院运营和资本获取从农村社区向城市转移。具体而言，随着城市远程医疗提供商吸引农村患者，农村医院出现收入和利润下降、信用评级下调、资本成本上升，最终面临关闭风险。尽管远程医疗减少了患者的出行成本，但部分社区失去了急症护理服务。总体而言，远程医疗服务不仅产生财务后果，还有实际影响，且其收益分配不均。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验揭示了远程医疗对农村医院财务健康的负面影响，为政策制定者评估远程医疗的社会成本提供了重要证据。

title: Money and Banking with Reserves and CBDC
abstract: We analyze the role of retail central bank digital currency (CBDC) and reserves when banks exert deposit market power and liquidity transformation entails externalities. Optimal monetary architecture minimizes the social costs of liquidity provision, and optimal monetary policy follows modified Friedman rules. Interest rates on reserves and CBDC should differ. Calibrations robustly suggest that CBDC provides liquidity more efficiently than deposits unless the central bank must refinance banks and this is very costly. Accordingly, the optimal share of CBDC in payments tends to exceed that of deposits.
summary: 本文分析了当银行具有存款市场势力且流动性转换产生外部性时，零售央行数字货币（CBDC）和准备金的作用。研究构建了最优货币架构以最小化流动性提供的社会成本，并推导出最优货币政策遵循修正的弗里德曼规则。结论表明，准备金和CBDC的利率应存在差异。校准结果强烈显示，除非央行必须为银行再融资且成本高昂，否则CBDC比存款更有效地提供流动性，因此CBDC在支付中的最优份额往往超过存款。
ai_comment: 本文在银行市场势力和流动性外部性框架下分析CBDC与准备金的最优设计，为数字货币时代的货币政策提供了新视角。

title: The Time‐Varying Price of Financial Intermediation in the Mortgage Market
abstract: We introduce a new measure of the price charged by financial intermediaries for connecting mortgage borrowers with capital market investors. Based on administrative lender pricing data, we document that the price of intermediation reacts strongly to variation in demand, reflecting capacity constraints of mortgage originators. This positive comovement of price with quantity reduced the pass‐through of quantitative easing. We also find a notable upward trend in this price between 2008 and 2014, likely due to increased legal and regulatory burden in the mortgage market. The trend led to an implicit cost to borrowers of nearly $100 billion over this period.
summary: 本文基于行政贷款定价数据，提出了一种衡量金融中介在抵押贷款市场连接借款人与资本市场投资者所收取价格的新指标。研究发现，中介价格对需求变化反应强烈，反映了抵押贷款发起人的产能约束，这种价格与数量的正相关降低了量化宽松政策的传导效果。此外，2008年至2014年间，该价格呈现显著上升趋势，主要归因于抵押贷款市场法律和监管负担的增加，这期间给借款人带来了近1000亿美元的隐含成本。
ai_comment: 该论文利用微观定价数据动态刻画了抵押贷款中介收费行为，揭示了产能约束和监管负担对量化宽松传导及借款人成本的关键影响，具有重要的政策启示。

title: How Do Cash Windfalls Affect Entrepreneurship? Evidence from the Spanish Christmas Lottery
abstract: We show cash windfalls affect the real economy by spurring entrepreneurship. We identify these effects using the Spanish Christmas Lottery, which provides a unique setting as prizes are geographically concentrated and distributed among thousands of households. We find higher start-up entry, job creation, and self-employment in winning regions. Consistent with a financial constraints channel, results are strongest in sectors relying on external finance and regions with limited credit access. Newly created firms are larger, more profitable, and survive longer. For existing firms, however, growth and profitability do not respond to lottery awards, but wages increase due to tighter labor markets.
summary: 本文研究现金意外之财如何通过促进创业活动影响实体经济。利用西班牙圣诞彩票作为准自然实验，该彩票奖金在地理上高度集中并分配给成千上万的家庭，提供了独特的研究环境。研究发现，在获奖地区，新企业进入、就业创造和自雇比例均显著增加。这一效应在依赖外部融资的行业和信贷受限的地区最为显著，支持了金融约束渠道的解释。新创立的企业规模更大、盈利能力更强且存活时间更长。然而，对于现有企业，彩票奖金并未促进其增长或盈利，但由于劳动力市场趋紧，工资水平有所上升。
ai_comment: 利用大规模彩票奖金的地理差异识别因果关系，揭示了流动性冲击对创业的异质性影响，并对新企业与现有企业的不同反应提供了微观证据。

title: Ravi Jagannathan
abstract: Ravi's research made methodological contributions to the field of asset pricing that helped in the use of asset markets data to guide the development of superior models, which has improved our understanding of how asset prices are linked to the economy, and how investors behave.His joint work with Lars Hansen (Journal of Political Economy, 1991 and The Journal of Finance, 1997) shows that the mean variance frontier of returns, familiar to finance academics as well as professionals, contains interesting information about how investors trade current payoffs for risky future payoffs even when risk is not characterized just by the variances of the payoffs.They showed that observed returns on securities provide additional information about investors' preferences when there are no arbitrage opportunities in financial markets.The market risk premium (MRP), which is the expected return on the market above the risk-free return, plays an important role in corporate finance as a component of the cost of capital.It is well-recognized that historical average MRP is a very noisy measure, and theoretical models of how investors behave are necessary to provide confidence in estimates of what the MRP will be going forward.The papers developed two measures summarizing the information in asset returns about investors' preferences, Hansen-Jagannathan Bound and Hansen-Jagannathan Distance, both of which provide guidance for developing theoretical models of MRP.
summary: 该文回顾了Ravi Jagannathan的研究贡献，特别是与Lars Hansen合作的工作（Journal of Political Economy, 1991; The Journal of Finance, 1997）。他们的研究指出，金融学术界和专业人士熟悉的收益均值方差前沿包含了关于投资者如何用当前收益交换未来风险收益的有趣信息，即使风险不仅仅由收益的方差刻画。他们表明，在金融市场无套利机会时，观察到的证券收益提供了关于投资者偏好的额外信息。市场风险溢价（MRP）作为资本成本的重要组成部分，在公司金融中扮演重要角色。历史平均MRP是一个有噪声的指标，而理论模型对于估计未来MRP至关重要。该论文开发了两种总结资产收益中关于投资者偏好信息的指标：Hansen-Jagannathan Bound和Hansen-Jagannathan Distance，两者都为发展MRP理论模型提供了指导。
ai_comment: 该文系统总结了Jagannathan的学术贡献，特别是Hansen-Jagannathan Bound和Distance的提出，为资产定价实证研究提供了重要工具，具有深远方法论意义。

title: Monetary Policy without Moving Interest Rates: The Fed Non-Yield Shock
abstract: Existing high-frequency monetary policy shocks explain surprisingly little variation in stock prices and exchange rates around FOMC announcements.Further, both of these asset classes display heightened volatility relative to non-announcement times.We use a heteroskedasticity-based procedure to estimate a "Fed non-yield shock", which is orthogonal to yield changes and is identified from excess volatility in the S&P 500 and various dollar exchange rates.The non-yield shock has large effects on global markets, with a positive non-yield shock raising U.S. and foreign stock prices, depreciating the dollar, and increasing commodity prices.At the same time, the shock leaves global yields unaffected.Further results indicate that the non-yield shock transmits mostly through risk premia.The existence of the non-yield shock generally has implications for how monetary policy shocks can be identified, raising concerns about the validity of many common approaches.
summary: 现有高频货币政策冲击对FOMC公告期间的股票价格和汇率变动解释力不足，且这两类资产在公告期间波动性显著高于非公告期。本文采用基于异方差性的方法，估计出一个与收益率变化正交的“美联储非收益率冲击”（Fed non-yield shock），该冲击从标普500指数和多种美元汇率的超额波动中识别。实证发现，正向的非收益率冲击会推高美国和外国股票价格、导致美元贬值、并提升大宗商品价格，同时全球收益率保持不变。进一步研究表明，该冲击主要通过风险溢价渠道传导。非收益率冲击的存在对货币政策冲击的标准识别方法提出质疑，并引发对许多常见识别策略有效性的担忧。
ai_comment: 创新性地从资产价格超额波动中提取与收益率无关的货币政策冲击，挑战传统高频识别方法，为理解货币政策传导机制提供新视角。

title: The Long and Variable Lags of Monetary Policy: Evidence from Disaggregated Price Indices
Firms' Perceived Cost of Capital
abstract: We study hand-collected data on firms’ perceptions of their cost of capital. Firms with higher perceived cost of capital earn higher returns on invested capital and invest less, suggesting that the perceived cost of capital shapes long-run capital allocation. The perceived cost of capital is partially related to the true cost of capital, which is determined by risk premia and interest rates, but there are also large deviations between the perceived and true cost of capital. Only 20% of the variation in the perceived cost of capital is justified by variation in the true cost of capital. The remaining 80% reflects deviations that are consistent with managers making mistakes. These deviations lead to misallocation of capital that lowers long-run aggregate productivity by 5% in a benchmark model. Forcing all firms to apply the same cost of capital would improve the allocation of capital relative to current corporate practice. The deviations in the perceived cost of capital challenge standard models, in particular the production-based asset pricing paradigm, and lead us to reject the “Investment CAPM.” We describe actionable methods that allow firms to improve their perceptions and capital allocation.
summary: 本文利用手工收集的数据研究公司对其资本成本的感知。研究发现，感知资本成本较高的公司获得更高的投资资本回报率且投资更少，表明感知资本成本影响长期资本配置。感知资本成本与实际资本成本（由风险溢价和利率决定）部分相关，但两者之间存在巨大偏差：仅20%的感知资本成本变化可由实际资本成本变化解释，剩余80%反映了管理者的错误。这些偏差导致资本错配，在基准模型中使长期全要素生产率降低5%。如果迫使所有公司采用相同的资本成本，相对于当前企业实践将改善资本配置。感知资本成本的偏差挑战了标准模型，特别是基于生产的资产定价范式，并导致拒绝“投资CAPM”。本文还描述了可操作的方法，帮助公司改善其感知和资本配置。
ai_comment: 本文通过新颖的手工数据揭示了管理者感知资本成本与实际资本成本之间的巨大偏差，并量化了其对生产率的负面影响，对资本成本和资产定价理论提出了重要挑战。

title: Exchange Rate Disconnect Revisited
abstract: We find that variation in expected U.S. productivity explains over half of G6 exchange rate fluctuations vis-a-vis the USD. Both correctly-anticipated changes in productivity and expectational “noise, ” which influences expectations of productivity but not the actual realization, have significant effects on exchange rates. Together, these two types of disturbances explain many unconditional exchange rate patterns, including predictable excess returns, low Backus-Smith correlations, and excess volatility. Our findings suggest these well-known puzzles have a common empirical origin, which is linked to (expected) productivity. We also discuss how noise in expectations has obscured the relationship between exchange rates and fundamentals in the empirical approaches undertaken in prior work.
summary: 本文重新审视了汇率脱节现象，发现预期美国生产率的变化可以解释超过一半的G6货币对美元汇率波动。研究区分了两种类型的扰动：正确预期的生产率变化和影响预期但未实际实现的“噪声”预期，两者均对汇率有显著影响。这两种扰动共同解释了多种无条件汇率模式，包括可预测的超额回报、低Backus-Smith相关性以及过度波动。结果表明，这些著名的汇率谜题具有共同的经验起源，即与（预期）生产率相关。此外，文章讨论了预期噪声如何模糊了先前实证研究中汇率与基本面之间的关系。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分预期生产率的实际变化和噪声，为多个汇率谜题提供了统一解释，揭示了预期在汇率决定中的核心作用，具有重要的理论贡献和实证启示。

title: Property Insurance and Disaster Risk: New Evidence from Mortgage Escrow Data
abstract: We develop a new dataset to study homeowners insurance using over 74 million premiums from 2014–2024 inferred from mortgage escrow payments. We document rapidly rising premiums and a doubling of the pass-through from disaster risk into premiums. Using variation in correlated wildfire and hurricane exposure, we show that the increase in the risk-to-premium gradient was accelerated by a repricing of catastrophic risk in global capital markets. Premium increases are capitalized into home values, reducing home price growth by over $40, 000 in the most exposed zipcodes. The premium and home price effects are larger in areas facing rising climate risk.
summary: 本文利用2014-2024年间超过7400万笔从抵押贷款托管支付中推断出的保费数据，构建了一个新的数据集来研究房屋保险。研究发现保费迅速上涨，且灾难风险向保费的传导率翻倍。通过关联野火和飓风风险的变化，文章表明全球资本市场对灾难风险的重新定价加速了风险-保费梯度的上升。保费的上涨被资本化到房价中，在风险最高的邮政编码地区，房价增长减少了超过4万美元。保费和房价效应在面临日益增长的气候风险的地区更为显著。
ai_comment: 利用独特的托管支付数据揭示了灾难风险与保费、房价之间的动态关系，为理解气候风险的经济影响提供了新证据。

title: Traumatic Financial Experiences and Persistent Changes in Financial Behavior: Evidence from the Freedman's Savings Bank
abstract: The failure of the Freedman's Savings Bank (FSB), one of the only Black-serving banks in the early post-bellum South, was an economic catastrophe and one of the great episodes of racial exploitation in post-Emancipation history. It was also most Black Americans' first experience of banking. Can events like these permanently alter financial preferences and behavior? To test this, we examine the impact of FSB collapse on life insurance-holding, an accessible alternative savings vehicle over the late 19th and early 20th centuries. We document a sharp and persistent increase in insurance demand in affected counties following the shock, driven disproportionately by Black customers. We also use FSB migrant flows to disentangle place-based and cohort-based effects, thus identifying psychological and cultural scarring as a distinct mechanism underlying the shift in financial behavior induced by the bank's collapse. Horizontal and intergenerational transmission of preferences help explain the shock’s persistent effects on financial behavior.
summary: 本文研究美国重建时期弗里德曼储蓄银行倒闭这一创伤性金融事件对黑人群体金融行为的长期影响。通过分析19世纪末至20世纪初的人寿保险持有数据，发现银行倒闭后受影响地区的人寿保险需求急剧且持续增长，且主要由黑人客户驱动。作者利用移民流数据区分地区效应与代际效应，识别出心理和文化创伤是导致金融行为转变的独特机制，并指出偏好水平与代际传递解释了冲击的持续性影响。
ai_comment: 利用罕见历史自然实验，为极端金融事件通过文化代际传递塑造长期金融行为提供了有力证据。

title: U.S. Liquid Government Liabilities and Emerging Market Capital Flows
abstract: Empirical work finds that flows of investments from the U.S. and other high income countries to emerging markets increase during times of quantitative easing by the U.S. Federal Reserve, and the reverse movement occurs under quantitative tightening.We offer new evidence to confirm these findings, and then propose a theory based on the liquidity of U.S. government liabilities held by the public.We hypothesize that QE, by increasing liquidity, offers greater flexibility for investors that might be concerned their funds will be tied up when shocks to income or investment opportunities arise.With the assurance that some of their portfolio can be readily sold in liquid markets, rich country investors are more willing to increase investments in illiquid loans to emerging markets.The effect of increasing the liquidity of U.S. government liabilities on investments in EMs may even be stronger during times of greater uncertainty.
summary: 实证研究发现，美国量化宽松期间，从美国等发达国家流向新兴市场的投资增加，而量化紧缩时期则出现反向流动。本文首先提供新的证据证实这一现象，然后提出一个基于美国政府债务流动性理论的解释。该理论认为，量化宽松通过增加债务工具的流动性，为担心收入或投资机会冲击时资金被冻结的投资者提供更大的灵活性。由于确信部分投资组合能够在流动性市场迅速出售，发达国家投资者更愿意增加对新兴市场非流动性贷款的投资。在高不确定性时期，增加美国政府债务流动性对新兴市场投资的影响可能更强。
ai_comment: 本文从流动性角度为量化宽松对新兴市场资本流动的影响提供了新的理论解释，并强调了不确定性环境下的强化效应，具有创新性和政策启示意义。

title: Creative Destruction, Stock Return Volatility, and the Number of Listed Firms
abstract: Average idiosyncratic volatility and firm idiosyncratic volatility increase with the number of listed firms.Average industry idiosyncratic volatility increases with the number of listed firms in the industry.We ex-plain the relation between idiosyncratic volatility and the number of listed firms through Schumpeterian creative destruction.We show that Schumpeterian creative destruction increases as the number of listed firms increases.However, there is no consistent evidence of an incremental effect of the number of non-listed firms on idiosyncratic volatility either in the aggregate or at the industry level, suggesting that listed firms play a unique role in the dynamism of the economy.
summary: 本文研究发现，平均特质波动率和企业特质波动率随上市公司数量的增加而上升，行业平均特质波动率也随行业上市公司数量的增加而上升。作者通过熊彼特创造性破坏理论解释这一关系，表明随着上市公司数量增加，创造性破坏程度增强。然而，无论在总体还是行业层面，非上市公司数量对特质波动率均无一致影响，这表明上市公司在经济活力中扮演着独特角色。
ai_comment: 本文用创造性破坏理论连接上市公司数量与特质波动率，揭示了上市公司在经济动态中的独特作用，为理解市场波动提供了新视角。

title: Stronger IPR, Better Inclusion? Impact Of WTO Accession On Female AI Inventors in China
abstract: Do stronger intellectual property rights incentivize female participation in innovation?We provide new evidence on this question using a unique database of artificial intelligence patents publicly shared by the USPTO.Our identification strategy leverages China's WTO TRIPs accession, which led to stronger intellectual property rights in 2002.We find a significant rise in the number of female inventors and an increase in the number of patents with females on inventor teams vis-a-vis a control group of countries.We also find that after stronger intellectual property rights, the quality of Chinese artificial intelligence patents with female inventors on the team improved.Results are robust controlling for unobserved heterogeneity at the country, technology class, and over time.Additional robustness tests with synthetic controls, coarsened exact matching, randomized inference and alternative control groups support our benchmark findings.Our results highlight that stronger intellectual property rights can be helpful in improving gender division of labor thereby benefiting society and innovation.
summary: 该论文利用美国专利商标局（USPTO）公开的人工智能（AI）专利数据库，研究更强的知识产权（IPR）是否激励女性参与创新。以中国2002年加入WTO《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》（TRIPs）作为识别策略，通过准自然实验方法，发现相对于对照组国家，中国在IPR强化后女性发明人数量和包含女性发明人的专利数量显著增加，同时这些专利的质量也有所提升。结果在控制国家、技术类别和时间固定效应后依然稳健，并通过合成控制法、粗化精确匹配、随机推断和替代对照组等额外检验得到支持。研究表明，更强的知识产权有助于改善性别分工，从而造福社会和创新。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验方法，为知识产权保护促进性别平等和创新质量提供了新的因果证据，具有政策启示意义。

title: Emotional Engagement and Trading Performance
abstract: Emotional involvement is known to be necessary but not sufficient for good decision making in the face of uncertainty. It has been conjectured that emotional engagement in anticipation of risky outcomes constitutes “good” emotions. We introduce a new methodology to determine whether anticipatory emotional engagement is beneficial in the context of trading in financial markets. We focus on heart rate changes because they occur at a sufficiently high frequency to discern timing relative to events in the marketplace. After conservatively adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing, we find that participants whose heart rate changes anticipate their order submissions at inflated prices earn significantly more, whereas participants whose heart rate responds to their trades earn significantly less. By investigating cointegration between skin conductance response and the dynamics of individual portfolio values, we confirm the importance of emotional involvement in determining who makes or loses money. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Australian Research Council [Grants DP180102284 and LE130100112]. The authors also thank the Monash Business School for funds associated with the Monash Business Behavioural Laboratory facility and equipment used in this study. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4883 .
summary: 该论文研究情感参与在金融市场交易中的影响，尤其是预期情感是否有助于交易表现。作者通过监测参与者的心率变化来捕捉交易前的情感预期，并分析皮肤电导反应与个人投资组合价值的协整关系。研究发现，心率变化提前于订单提交（即预期情感）的参与者盈利显著更高，而心率对交易做出反应（即反馈情感）的参与者盈利显著更低。结果表明，预期情感参与对交易表现有积极作用，而反应性情感参与则不利。
ai_comment: 利用生理指标量化情感参与，揭示了预期情感与交易表现之间的因果关系，方法创新性强。

title: On the Other Side of Hedge Fund Equity Trades
abstract: Hedge funds earn positive ex post abnormal returns and avoid negative abnormal returns on their equity portfolios when trading in the opposite direction of highly diversified low-turnover institutional investors (quasi indexers). This pattern seems to be driven by the preferences of quasi indexers for high-market-beta stocks together with the ability of hedge funds to identify subsets of especially profitable trades. It remains pronounced when accounting for other determinants of hedge fund trades, such as stock liquidity, market anomalies, and major corporate events. Trading against other institutional investors or noninstitutions does not result in abnormal performance for hedge funds. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: Data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4877 .
summary: 本文研究对冲基金在与不同类型投资者交易时的异常收益表现。研究发现，当对冲基金与高度分散且低换手率的机构投资者（称为准指数基金）进行反向交易时，能够获得正的异常收益，并避免负的异常收益。这种模式主要由两个因素驱动：准指数基金倾向于持有高市场贝塔值的股票，以及对冲基金有能力识别出特别有利可图的交易机会。即使控制了股票流动性、市场异象和重大公司事件等其他交易决定因素，这种模式依然显著。然而，与机构投资者（除准指数基金外）或非机构投资者的反向交易并未给对冲基金带来异常表现。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了对冲基金在与特定机构投资者（准指数基金）反向交易时获得显著异常收益的独特模式，为理解不同投资者类型间的交易互动提供了新视角。

title: Inventory as a Financial Instrument: Evidence from China’s Metal Industries
abstract: Classic inventory theory suggests that inventory plays a vital role in matching demand and supply. This paper provides both country- and firm-level evidence that inventory can be used as a financial instrument to take advantage of arbitrage opportunities in financial markets with limited capital mobility. Using data from China customs’ metal imports and firm-level inventory from metal processing industries, we show that firms can utilize the inventory of an imported product to carry lower cost capital into a country with strict capital controls and, thus, gain higher financial returns. Specifically, at the country level, we find that the level of imported metal commodities is positively associated with the expected returns from financial arbitrage. At the firm level, we find that a higher expected return from financial arbitrage will incentivize a firm to increase its inventory level through short-term borrowing. In addition, our evidence supports the notion that firms with higher liquidation value, larger size, and higher sales growth (i.e., firms with higher borrowing capacity) may be more active in using inventory as an instrument to seek higher financial gains. We also utilize a unique regulatory policy shock as a quasi-natural experiment to enhance the causality interpretation of our empirical findings. This paper was accepted by Vishal Gaur, operations management. Funding: This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72201230] and the Research Grants Council of Hong Kong, University Grants Committee [Grant 14504621]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4873 .
summary: 本文研究库存作为金融工具在资本流动性受限的市场中利用套利机会的作用。基于中国海关金属进口数据和金属加工企业的库存数据，发现国家层面进口金属商品水平与金融套利预期回报正相关；企业层面，更高的金融套利预期回报会激励企业通过短期借款增加库存。此外，具有更高清算价值、更大规模和更高销售增长的企业（即借款能力更强的企业）更倾向于将库存作为寻求更高金融收益的工具。研究还利用独特的监管政策冲击作为准自然实验增强因果推断。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将库存管理与金融套利结合，利用中国金属行业数据提供了实证证据，并通过政策冲击验证因果关系，对理解库存的金融属性有重要贡献。

title: Cross-Sectional Variation of Option-Implied Volatility Skew
abstract: The stock option-implied volatility skew reflects both the structural risk characteristics of the underlying company and the short-term information flow about the stock price movement. This paper builds a semistructural, cross-sectional option pricing model to separate the structural risk contributions from the information flow. The model identifies two structural risk sources that contribute to the cross-sectional variation of the skew: the company’s business cyclicality and its default risk. The model can explain as much as 44% of the cross-sectional variation in implied volatility skew and is particularly informative during and after recessions. The remaining skew variation reflects mainly short-term information flow and can be used to construct stock portfolios with much better investment performance and without hidden structural risk exposures. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: L. Wu gratefully acknowledges support by a grant from the City University of New York PSC-CUNY Research Award Program. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4872 .
summary: 该论文构建了一个半结构化的横截面期权定价模型，用于分离结构性风险和信息流对期权隐含波动率偏斜的贡献。模型识别出两个结构性风险来源：公司的商业周期性（business cyclicality）和违约风险（default risk），这些因素共同解释了横截面上隐含波动率偏斜变异的约44%，尤其在衰退期间及其后解释力更强。剩余的偏斜变异主要反映短期信息流，可用于构建股票投资组合，获得更好的投资表现且无隐藏的结构性风险暴露。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地分离了结构性风险与信息流对波动率偏斜的影响，并展示了剩余部分在投资组合构建中的实用价值，具有较强的理论与实践意义。

title: Counterparty Risk and Counterparty Choice in the Credit Default Swap Market
abstract: We investigate how market participants price and manage counterparty credit risk using confidential trade repository data on single-name credit default swap (CDS) transactions. We find that counterparty risk has a modest impact on the pricing of CDS contracts but a large impact on the choice of counterparties. For contracts ineligible for central clearing, we show that market participants are significantly less likely to trade with counterparties whose credit risk is highly correlated with the credit risk of the reference entities and with counterparties whose credit quality is low. For clearable contracts, we find that nondealers are more likely to clear during a crisis and less likely to clear when the reference entity is a large U.S. dealer or a sovereign. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4870 .
summary: 本文利用机密交易报告数据，研究单名称信用违约互换（CDS）交易中市场参与者如何定价和管理对手方信用风险。研究发现，对手方风险对CDS合约定价影响较小，但对对手方选择影响显著。对于无法中央清算的合约，市场参与者更不愿与信用风险与参考实体高度相关或信用质量较低的对手方交易。对于可清算合约，非交易商在危机期间更倾向于中央清算，而当参考实体为大型美国交易商或主权国家时，清算可能性降低。
ai_comment: 该研究利用机密交易数据揭示对手方风险对CDS定价影响有限，但对对手方选择影响显著，为中央清算机制的设计提供了实证依据。

title: Voluntary Disclosure, Moral Hazard, and Default Risk
abstract: We study a dynamic moral hazard setting where the manager has private evidence that predicts the firm’s cash flows. Bad-news disclosure is rewarded by a lower borrowing cost relative to the no-evidence case, whereas no disclosure leads to higher borrowing costs. For a given capital structure, disclosure reduces the firm’s default risk by lowering its pay-for-performance sensitivity. However, for a set of low-profitability firms, the anticipation of future disclosure of information by managers lowers both firm value and managerial rents at the financing stage because of a reduction in the firm’s initial liquidity. The model can reconcile the empirical evidence on the effects of providing earnings guidance, especially for loss firms. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Funding: S. Fu is supported by the Shanghai Pujiang Program and the Program for Professor of Special Appointment (Eastern Scholar) at Shanghai Institutions of Higher Learning [Grant 0900000182]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4860 .
summary: 本文构建了一个动态道德风险模型，其中经理拥有预测公司现金流的私人证据。模型表明，坏消息的披露通过降低借贷成本获得奖励，而不披露则导致更高的借贷成本。在给定资本结构下，披露通过降低绩效薪酬敏感性来减少公司的违约风险。然而，对于一组低盈利能力的公司，经理未来披露信息的预期会通过降低公司初始流动性而同时降低公司价值和经理租金。该模型能够协调有关提供盈利指引的实证证据，特别是对于亏损公司的影响。
ai_comment: 该论文通过动态模型揭示了自愿披露对违约风险的双重影响，尤其是对低盈利公司的不利效应，为解释盈利指引的实证矛盾提供了新视角。

title: Dynamic Market Timing in Mutual Funds
abstract: We use the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) model to estimate daily frequency mutual fund betas. Compared with traditional estimates, daily betas better capture changes in fund risk stemming from daily fund trading activity. Based on these beta estimates and a two-stage estimation procedure, we find significant evidence of market timing ability among actively managed U.S. equity funds that is not apparent via standard approaches. Unlike traditional measures, our timing estimates correlate positively with fund performance. Market timing is especially evident during down markets, with successful timers exhibiting low downside risk. Timing ability persists across time and attracts investor flows. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72173127 and 72121001] and by the Institute for Industrial Innovation and Finance at Tsinghua University. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4857 .
summary: 使用动态条件相关（DCC）模型估计每日频率的共同基金贝塔值，相比于传统估计方法，日度贝塔能更好地捕捉基金日常交易活动带来的风险变动。基于这些贝塔估计和两阶段估计程序，研究发现主动管理型美国股票基金存在显著的市场择时能力，而标准方法无法发现。与传统指标不同，该研究的择时估计与基金业绩正相关。市场择时在下跌市场中尤为明显，成功的择时者表现出较低的下行风险。择时能力在时间上具有持续性，并吸引投资者资金流入。
ai_comment: 创新性地采用DCC模型估计日频贝塔，揭示了传统方法遗漏的市场择时能力，并证实其与业绩正相关，对基金评估有重要实践价值。

title: Market Consequences of Sovereign Accounting Errors
abstract: This paper investigates the market consequences of sovereign accounting errors, opening a new area of research on sovereign accounting quality in the accounting literature. Eurostat, a division of the European Commission, provides semiannual assessments of financial reports produced by the member states of the European Union (EU) and issues reservations that detail financial reporting errors. Using a sample of Eurostat reservation issuances across 28 EU countries from 2004 to 2018, we find that sovereign bond yields abnormally increase during a reservation announcement window, especially when a reservation explicitly mentions deficit or debt, when it quantifies the extent of the errors’ financial impact, or when the errors relate to recent fiscal data. Consistent with a home bias after the release of negative news, we find that domestic holdings of sovereign debt increase after the issuance of a reservation. Overall, our evidence suggests that sovereign accounting errors have significant market consequences and raises further questions for future research in sovereign accounting quality. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00724 .
summary: 本文研究主权会计错误的市场后果，开辟了会计文献中关于主权会计质量的新研究领域。利用欧盟委员会下属的欧洲统计局（Eurostat）对28个欧盟成员国2004年至2018年期间发布的半年度财务报告评估中提出的保留意见（reservations）样本，发现主权债券收益率在保留意见公告窗口异常上升，尤其是当保留意见明确提及赤字或债务、量化了错误的财务影响、或错误与近期财政数据相关时。此外，负面消息发布后，国内持有主权债务的比例增加，表明存在国内偏好。总体而言，证据表明主权会计错误具有显著的市场后果，并提出了未来研究的问题。
ai_comment: 本文首创性地利用Eurostat保留意见数据，实证揭示了主权会计错误对债券市场和投资者行为的实质性影响，为会计信息质量在主权债务定价中的作用提供了新证据。

title: High Discounts and Low Fundamental Surplus: An Equivalence Result for Unemployment Fluctuations
abstract: We establish an observational equivalence between unemployment fluctuations of the Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides search economy augmented with time varying risk premia and an otherwise identical economy without risk premia but with a time varying value of leisure. This equivalence holds for general risk premia processes and allows us to view the effects of different models of risk premia as operating through a single channel—one that alters the value of leisure. We derive simple expressions for semielasticities of labor market tightness with respect to productivity and risk premium shocks. We show wages can be used to detect misspecification in the discount rate process used in hiring decisions. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03712 .
summary: 本文在Diamond-Mortensen-Pissarides搜索经济模型中，建立了带有时变风险溢价的失业波动与不带风险溢价但具有时变闲暇价值的等价关系。这种等价性适用于一般风险溢价过程，并将不同风险溢价模型的效果统一为通过改变闲暇价值这一渠道。作者推导了劳动力市场紧度对生产率冲击和风险溢价冲击的半弹性表达式，并指出工资可用于检测雇佣决策中使用的贴现率过程的误设定。
ai_comment: 该论文通过建立风险溢价与闲暇价值之间的等价性，为理解失业波动提供了统一的理论框架，并给出了可检验的工资含义，连接了金融与劳动经济学。

title: Lightning Network Economics: Channels
abstract: Compared with existing payment systems, Bitcoin’s throughput is low. Designed to address Bitcoin’s scalability challenge, the Lightning Network (LN) is a protocol allowing two parties to secure bitcoin payments and escrow holdings between them. In a lightning channel, each party commits collateral toward future payments to the counterparty and payments are cryptographically secured updates of collaterals. The network of channels increases transaction speed and reduces blockchain congestion. This paper (i) identifies conditions for two parties to optimally establish a channel, (ii) finds explicit formulas for channel costs, (iii) obtains the optimal collaterals and savings entailed, and (iv) derives the implied reduction in congestion of the blockchain. Unidirectional channels costs grow with the square-root of payment rates, while symmetric bidirectional channels with their cubic root. Asymmetric bidirectional channels are akin to unidirectional when payment rates are significantly different, otherwise to symmetric bidirectional. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Funding: Partially supported by SFI (16/IA/4443, 16/SPP/3347), Columbia-IBM Center for Blockchain and Data Transparency, Chaire Fintech at University Paris Dauphine—PSL, Algorand Foundation, and Simons Institute.
summary: 本文研究比特币闪电网络（LN）中的通道经济学。闪电网络旨在解决比特币可扩展性问题，允许两方在通道中抵押比特币以实现快速支付。论文识别了双方最优建立通道的条件，推导了通道成本的显式公式，获得了最优抵押和由此产生的节省，并得出了区块链拥堵减少的隐含结果。研究发现，单向通道的成本随支付率的平方根增长，而对称双向通道随立方根增长；非对称双向通道在支付率显著差异时类似于单向通道，否则类似于对称双向通道。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了闪电网络通道经济的分析框架和显式公式，为理解Layer 2扩展方案的效率提供了理论基础。

title: Operational Risk Management: Optimal Inspection Policy
abstract: Major banks around the world lost nearly $210 billion during the period of 2011–2016 due to operational risk events. To mitigate the severe consequences that can arise from such events, the Basel Regulatory Committee has mandated that financial institutions worldwide conduct inspections on operational risk. In light of the importance of operational risk and its current regulation in the industry, this paper proposes a continuous-time principal-agent model that explores the optimal inspection policy of a financial firm (principal) and the effort of its employees (agent) to reduce the occurrence of risk events. First, we characterize the optimal inspection strategy under two commonly used policies in practice, namely random and periodic policies. This characterization reveals the conditions for two different modes of inspection (effort inducement and error correction), as well as the nuanced interactions among the inspection frequency, the penalty charged for errors, and the wage paid to employees. Next, by comparing random and periodic policies, we find that the random policy outperforms the periodic policy if and only if the inspection cost is high. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid policy that strictly dominates the random policy and weakly dominates the periodic policy, suggesting that a proper reduction of the random element in the inspection policy, in the manner of our proposed hybrid policy, can always improve its performance. Finally, we examine the complete information benchmark (without moral hazard), supplemental mitigation strategies, and numerical studies to provide further insights and show the robustness of our main findings. This paper was accepted by Vishal Gaur, operations management. Supplemental Material: The e-companion is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00322 .
summary: 本文研究了银行操作风险管理中的最优检查政策。针对2011-2016年间全球银行因操作风险事件损失近2100亿美元的现实，以及巴塞尔协议要求金融机构进行操作的背景，作者构建了一个连续时间委托代理模型，探讨金融企业（委托人）的最优检查政策与员工（代理人）减少风险事件发生努力之间的互动。首先，刻画了实践中常用的随机检查和定期检查两种政策下的最优检查策略，揭示了两种检查模式（努力激励与错误纠正）的条件，以及检查频率、错误罚款和员工工资之间的微妙互动。通过比较随机与定期政策，发现仅当检查成本高时随机政策优于定期政策。进一步，提出一种混合政策，该政策严格优于随机政策且弱优于定期政策，表明适当减少检查中的随机成分总能提升绩效。最后，通过完全信息基准（无道德风险）、补充缓解策略和数值研究验证了主要发现的稳健性。
ai_comment: 本文将操作风险管理问题形式化为连续时间委托代理模型，比较了不同检查政策的优劣，并创新性地提出混合政策，为监管实践提供了理论指导。

title: Financial inclusion, economic development, and inequality: Evidence from Brazil
abstract: We study a financial inclusion policy targeting Brazilian cities with low bank branch coverage using data on the universe of employees from 2000–2014. The policy leads to bank entry and to similar increases in both deposits and lending. It also fosters entrepreneurship, employment, and wage growth, especially for cities initially in banking deserts. These gains are not shared equally and instead increase with workers’ education, implying a substantial increase in wage inequality. The changes in inequality are concentrated in cities where the initial supply of skilled workers is low, indicating that talent scarcity can drive how financial development affects inequality.
summary: 该论文利用2000-2014年巴西所有员工的面板数据，研究了一项针对低银行网点覆盖率城市的金融包容性政策。该政策促进了银行进入，并导致存款和贷款同时增加。政策的实施促进了创业、就业和工资增长，尤其是在初始处于“银行沙漠”的城市。然而，这些增长收益并不平等，而是随着工人教育水平的提高而增加，从而显著加剧了工资不平等。不平等加剧主要集中在初始技能工人供应较低的城市，这表明人才稀缺是金融发展影响不平等的一个关键驱动因素。
ai_comment: 该研究利用详尽的微观数据揭示了金融包容性政策的分配效应，强调了人力资本供给在调节金融发展对不平等影响中的重要作用，为发展金融与不平等理论提供了新的经验证据。

title: Gradual information diffusion across commonly owned firms
abstract: This paper studies how common institutional ownership (CIO) affects information diffusion in the stock market. My findings suggest that CIO can exacerbate the slow spread of information across firms. With over 50% of institutional investors holding concentrated stock portfolios, I infer a fundamental connection among firms with CIO. These firms exhibit cross-predictability in monthly stock returns, leading to a CIO-based peer momentum strategy that outperforms Ali and Hirshleifer's (2020) shared-analyst momentum strategy. This anomaly stems primarily from institutional investors with fewer stock holdings, who employ passive asset management characterized by lower portfolio turnover and more delegated investment.
summary: 本文研究共同机构所有权（CIO）如何影响股票市场中的信息扩散。研究发现，CIO会加剧信息在关联企业间的缓慢传播。由于超过50%的机构投资者持有集中化的股票投资组合，本文推断CIO企业之间存在基本面关联，这些企业的月度股票收益表现出交叉可预测性，从而产生基于CIO的同行动量策略，该策略的表现优于Ali和Hirshleifer（2020）的共享分析师动量策略。这一异象主要源于持股较少的机构投资者，他们采用被动资产管理模式，具有较低的投资组合周转率和更多的委托投资。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地从共同机构所有权角度揭示信息缓慢扩散的机制，并挖掘出新的动量策略，对理解机构投资者行为与市场效率具有重要贡献。

title: Ambiguity and private investors’ behavior after forced fund liquidations
abstract: We investigate individual investors' decisions under time-varying ambiguity (VVIX) using plausibly exogenous forced mutual fund liquidations at a German brokerage. Investors reinvest 87% of forced liquidations when the refund occurs on a day of low ambiguity and 0% when it occurs on a day of high ambiguity. Instead of reinvesting, investors become inert and keep the refund in their cash holdings. The effect reverses approximately six months after the liquidation. If investors reinvest, they decrease their risk-taking under ambiguity. Our results are not driven by risk, rebalancing decisions, experiencing losses, or attention and are robust to alternative measures of ambiguity.
summary: 本文利用德国经纪商处因外生强制基金清算导致的资金返还事件，研究个体投资者在时变模糊性（以VVIX衡量）下的决策行为。研究发现，当资金返还发生在低模糊性日时，投资者将87%的清算资金进行再投资；而若发生在高模糊性日，再投资比例降至0%，投资者倾向于保持惰性并将资金持有为现金。这种效应在清算后约六个月发生反转。在投资者选择再投资的情况下，模糊性会降低其风险承担水平。该结果并非由风险、再平衡决策、亏损经历或注意力因素驱动，且对模糊性的替代度量指标保持稳健。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生强制清算事件识别了模糊性对投资者决策的因果效应，并排除了风险等传统解释，为行为金融中的模糊性厌恶提供了有力证据。

title: Portfolio pumping in mutual fund families
abstract: This paper investigates portfolio pumping at the fund family level, where non-star fund managers strategically purchase stocks held by star funds in the family to inflate their quarter-end performance. Star funds that engage in such activities show inflated performance after 2002 when the Securities and Exchange Commission increased regulation on portfolio pumping. Stocks pumped by the strategy show strong reversals at the quarter end. Moreover, despite a minor underperformance stemming from portfolio misallocation, non-star fund managers pumping for star funds receive abnormally high subsequent flows, suggesting a pattern of family subsidization.
summary: 本文研究基金家族层面的组合操纵(portfolio pumping)现象，即非明星基金经理策略性地购买家族内明星基金已持有的股票，以在季末抬高其业绩。研究发现，虽然2002年美国证券交易委员会加强监管，但明星基金仍在季末表现出业绩膨胀。被操纵的股票在季末呈现强烈的价格反转。尽管由于投资组合错配导致非明星基金经理的业绩轻微下滑，但他们在随后获得了异常高的资金流入，这揭示了基金家族内部的补贴模式。
ai_comment: 本文从基金家族内部视角揭示操纵行为，创新性地识别了非明星基金为明星基金牺牲业绩以换取未来资金流入的补贴机制，对监管基金业绩操纵具有重要启示。

title: Measuring macroeconomic tail risk
abstract: This paper estimates consumption and GDP tail risk dynamics over the long run (1900–2020). Our predictive approach circumvents the scarcity of large macroeconomic crises by exploiting a rich information set covering 42 countries. This flexible approach does not require asset price information and can thus serve as a benchmark to evaluate the empirical validity of rare disaster models. Our estimates covary with asset prices and forecast future stock returns, in line with theory. A calibration disciplined by our estimates supports the prediction that macroeconomic tail risk drives the equity premium.
summary: 本文估计了长期（1900-2020）消费和GDP尾部风险的动态变化。所采用的预测方法通过利用涵盖42个国家的丰富信息集，避免了大型宏观经济危机数据稀缺的问题。该方法不需要资产价格信息，因此可以作为评估罕见灾难模型（rare disaster models）经验有效性的基准。估计结果与资产价格协变，并能预测未来股票回报，这与理论一致。基于估计结果的校准支持了宏观经济尾部风险驱动股权溢价（equity premium）的预测。
ai_comment: 该文通过跨国面板数据有效克服了尾部风险估计的数据稀缺问题，为罕见灾难理论提供了有力的经验证据，并连接了宏观经济风险与资产定价。

title: Shattered housing
abstract: Do negative housing shocks lead to persistent changes in household attitudes toward housing and homeownership? We use the residential destruction of Germany during World War II (WWII) as a quasi-experiment and exploit the reasonably exogenous region-by-cohort variation in destruction exposure. We find that WWII-experiencing cohorts from high destruction regions are significantly less likely to be homeowners decades later, controlling for regional differences and household characteristics. Underlying this effect are changes in household attitudes toward homeownership that also extend to preferences for housing consumption, with little or no support for risk preferences, income and wealth effects, or supply-side factors.
summary: 本文研究负向住房冲击是否会导致家庭对住房和自有住房的态度发生持久变化。利用二战期间德国住宅破坏作为准实验，通过区域-队列差异暴露的合理外生性，发现来自高破坏地区的二战经历队列在几十年后成为房主的可能性显著降低，即使在控制区域差异和家庭特征后依然如此。这一效应背后是家庭对自有住房态度的改变，也延伸至住房消费偏好，而风险偏好、收入和财富效应以及供给因素几乎没有解释力。
ai_comment: 利用二战历史事件进行因果识别，揭示了住房冲击对家庭长期态度的持久影响，为行为金融和家庭金融提供了新视角。

title: Consumption smoothing or consumption binging? The effects of government-led consumer credit expansion in Brazil
abstract: Brazil initiated a major credit expansion program through government banks in 2011. The program primarily targeted public sector workers with offers of payroll-backed loans. Using individual-level administrative data we find that the program led to a 15 percentage point rise in debt to initial income for public sector workers. We develop a new method for estimating workers' expected income growth, and show that “consumption smoothing” cannot explain the rise in consumer borrowing. Instead, the evidence supports “consumption binging”: less financially sophisticated workers borrowed more at high real interest rates, and experienced both higher consumption volatility and lower average consumption.
summary: 本文研究巴西政府银行2011年启动的信贷扩张计划，该计划主要面向公共部门员工提供工资抵押贷款。利用个体层面行政数据，发现该计划使公共部门员工的债务占初始收入比例上升了15个百分点。为分析这一现象，作者开发了一种新方法来估计工人的预期收入增长，结果发现“消费平滑”不能解释借贷增长，而“消费狂欢”假说得到支持：金融素养较低的工人以高实际利率借入更多债务，并经历了更高的消费波动和更低的平均消费水平。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特行政数据和新方法，清晰区分了消费平滑与消费狂欢两种机制，对理解信贷扩张的真实经济后果具有重要政策启示。

title: The Bright Side of Political Uncertainty: The Case of R&D
abstract: We use close gubernatorial elections as a quasi-natural experiment to document a positive effect of political uncertainty on firm-level R&D. This finding is in contrast to the existing literature documenting a negative impact of political uncertainty on capital investment. We examine potential mechanisms and find that our results are consistent with the growth option view of R&D investment. The effect is stronger for politically sensitive and high-tech industries.The results are robust to different proxies for political uncertainty shocks. As predicted by models of investment under uncertainty, the real effects of political uncertainty critically depend on the type of the investment. JEL G18, G38, O31, O32
summary: 本文利用州长竞争激烈的选举作为准自然实验，记录了政治不确定性对企业研发（R&D）的正面影响，这与现有文献中政治不确定性对资本投资产生负面影响的结论形成对比。研究检验了潜在机制，发现结果与研发投资的增长期权观点一致。这一效应在政治敏感行业和高科技行业中更为显著。结果对于政治不确定性冲击的不同代理变量具有稳健性。正如不确定性下的投资模型所预测的，政治不确定性的实际效果关键取决于投资类型。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分投资类型，揭示了政治不确定性对研发的正面作用，丰富了不确定性影响公司行为的理论。

title: The Dynamics of Loan Sales and Lender Incentives
abstract: How much of a loan should a lender retain, and how do loan sales affect loan performance? We address these questions in a model in which a lender originates loans that it can sell to investors. The lender reduces default risk through screening at origination and monitoring after origination, but is subject to moral hazard. The optimal lender-investor contract can be implemented by requiring the lender to initially retain a share of the loan that it gradually sells to investors, rationalizing loan sales after origination. The model generates novel predictions linking loan and lender characteristics to initial retention, sales dynamics, and loan performance.
summary: 本文研究贷款销售中贷款人的最优保留比例以及贷款销售对贷款表现的影响。通过构建一个模型，贷款人发放贷款并出售给投资者，通过初期的筛选和贷后监控来降低违约风险，但存在道德风险问题。最优的贷款人-投资者合同要求贷款人最初保留一部分贷款，然后逐步出售给投资者，这为贷后贷款销售提供了理论依据。模型产生了关于贷款和贷款人特征与初始保留比例、销售动态和贷款表现之间联系的新预测。
ai_comment: 通过动态模型揭示了贷款人保留与出售贷款的最优策略，为理解贷款销售中的激励设计提供了理论洞见。

title: Repurchases for Price Impact: Evidence from Fragile Stocks
abstract: We highlight an important but overlooked characteristic of financial fragility: “Fragile” stocks command higher liquidity. This reduces their sensitivity to corporate actions with price impact and affects the firms’ incentives to engage in such actions. We show that fragile firms have lower share repurchases, issue more equity, and invest more. We establish causality by relating changes in corporate actions to exogenous changes in fragility induced by mergers of asset managers. Our results suggest that financial fragility has direct but unexpected real implications for corporate actions.
summary: 本文揭示了财务脆弱性的一个重要但被忽视的特征：“脆弱”的股票具有更高的流动性。这降低了这些股票对公司行为（如价格影响）的敏感度，从而影响公司采取此类行为的动机。研究发现，财务脆弱性较高的公司股票回购更少，股权发行更多，投资也更多。通过利用资产管理公司合并导致的外生脆弱性变化，本文建立了因果关系。结果表明，财务脆弱性对公司行为具有直接但意外的实际影响。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了财务脆弱性对流动性及公司决策的独特作用，通过自然实验提供了因果证据，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Government Subsidies and Corporate Misconduct
abstract: I study whether firms that receive targeted U.S. state‐level subsidies are more likely to subsequently engage in corporate misconduct. I find that firms are more likely to engage in misconduct in subsidizing states, but not in other states that they operate in, after receiving state subsidies. Using data on both federal and state enforcement actions, and exploiting the legal principle of dual sovereignty for identification, I show that this finding reflects an increase in the underlying rate of misconduct and that this increase is attributable to lenient state‐level misconduct enforcement. Collectively, my findings present evidence of an important consequence of targeted firm‐specific subsidies: nonfinancial misconduct that potentially could impact the very stakeholders subsidies are ostensibly intended to benefit.
summary: 本研究考察了获得美国州级针对性补贴的企业是否更可能随后从事企业不当行为。结果发现，企业在获得州补贴后，在提供补贴的州更可能发生不当行为，但在其经营的其他州则没有。通过利用联邦和州执法行动数据，并借助双重主权法律原则进行识别，研究表明这一发现反映了不当行为基础率的上升，且该上升归因于州级执法对不当行为的宽容。总体而言，这些证据揭示了针对性企业补贴的一个重要后果：非金融不当行为可能潜在地影响补贴本应惠及的利益相关者。
ai_comment: 利用双重主权原则识别因果效应是方法上的亮点，揭示了补贴政策可能带来的非预期负面后果，对政策制定具有警示意义。

title: News and Asset Pricing: A High-Frequency Anatomy of the SDF
abstract: Utilizing real-time newswire data, together with a robustly estimated intraday stochastic discount factor (SDF), we identify and quantify the economic news that is priced. News related to monetary policy and finance on average accounts for most of the variation in the SDF, followed by news about international affairs and macroeconomic data. We also document nontrivial temporal variation in the relative importance of the news, along with marked differences in the estimated news risk premiums in the “factor zoo.” To further highlight the economic mechanisms at work, we associate the different news effects with interest rate, growth, and risk premium shocks.
summary: 利用实时新闻数据以及稳健估计的日内随机贴现因子（SDF），本文识别并量化了被定价的经济新闻。与货币政策及金融相关的新闻平均解释了SDF变动的大部分，其次是国际事务和宏观经济数据的新闻。研究还记录了新闻相对重要性的显著时间变化，以及在“因子动物园”中估计的新闻风险溢价的显著差异。为进一步突出经济机制，本文将不同的新闻效应与利率、增长和风险溢价冲击联系起来。
ai_comment: 本文将高频新闻数据与SDF估计相结合，为新闻风险定价提供了精细化的实证证据，并揭示了因子溢价的时间变异来源。

title: Who Can Tell Which Banks Will Fail?
abstract: We study the run on the German banking system in 1931 to understand whether depositors anticipate which banks will fail in a major financial crisis. We find that deposits decline by around 20% during the run. There is an equal outflow of retail and nonfinancial wholesale deposits from both failing and surviving banks. In contrast, we find that interbank deposits almost exclusively decline for failing banks. Our evidence suggests that banks are better informed about which fellow banks will fail. In turn, banks being informed allows the interbank market to continue providing liquidity even during times of severe financial distress.
summary: 本文研究1931年德国银行系统的挤兑事件，探讨存款人是否能预判哪些银行会倒闭。研究发现，挤兑期间存款整体下降约20%，零售和非金融批发存款在倒闭银行和幸存银行中均等流出；而银行间存款则几乎仅从倒闭银行减少。结果表明，银行对同行倒闭风险的了解更为充分，这种信息优势使得银行间市场即使在严重金融困境中仍能继续提供流动性。
ai_comment: 本文利用历史事件揭示银行间信息优势在危机中的作用，为理解银行挤兑中的信息不对称提供了独特视角。

title: Innovation Under Pressure
abstract: Firms become more efficient at innovation activities when they face pressure to meet earnings per share (EPS) targets using stock repurchases. Using a regression-discontinuity framework, we find that incentives to engage in “EPS-motivated buybacks” are followed by more citations and higher values for firms’ new patents. We trace these effects to improved allocation of R&D resources and a greater focus on novel innovation. The positive effects are concentrated among ex ante “innovation-efficient” firms that achieve better patenting outcomes after reorganizing (but not cutting) their R&D investments. Our findings illustrate that short-term earnings pressure can act through a free cash flow channel that motivates more efficient spending.
summary: 本文研究企业在面临每股收益（EPS）目标压力时，通过股票回购提升创新效率的现象。采用回归断点框架，发现“EPS驱动的回购”激励导致企业新专利的引用次数和价值显著增加。这些效应可归因于研发（R&D）资源分配的优化以及对新颖创新的更大关注。正面影响集中在事前“创新效率高”的企业，这些企业在重组（而非削减）R&D投资后实现了更好的专利成果。研究结果表明，短期盈利压力可通过自由现金流渠道发挥作用，激励更高效的支出。
ai_comment: 该文巧妙地将短期盈利压力与长期创新效率联系起来，通过断点回归方法识别因果效应，并揭示了自由现金流渠道的作用机制，对回购与创新的文献有重要贡献。

title: Teams and Bankruptcy
abstract: We study how the human capital embedded in teams is affected by, and reallocated through, corporate bankruptcies. After a bankruptcy, U.S. inventors produce fewer and less impactful patents. Moreover, teams become less stable. Consequently, compared to inventors that rely less on teamwork, the performance of team inventors deteriorates more. These findings point to the loss of team-specific human capital as a cost of resource reallocation through bankruptcy. Acquisitions by industrial firms and joint mobility of inventors with past collaborations limit these losses, suggesting that the labor market and the market for corporate control help preserve team-specific human capital in bankruptcies.
summary: 本文研究企业破产如何影响嵌入在团队中的人力资本及其再分配。利用美国发明人数据，发现破产后发明人产出更少且专利影响力下降，同时团队稳定性降低。与较少依赖团队合作的发明人相比，团队型发明人的业绩下滑更显著，表明破产通过资源再分配导致团队特定人力资本的损失。工业公司收购以及具有合作历史的发明人联合流动能缓解这些损失，说明劳动力市场和企业控制市场有助于在破产中保护团队特定人力资本。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统量化破产对团队人力资本的破坏，并揭示了劳动市场和企业控制市场的缓解作用，为破产成本来源提供了新证据。

title: The Coholding Puzzle: New Evidence from Transaction-Level Data
abstract: Why do individuals pay debt interest when they could use their savings to pay down the debt? We explore why individuals “cohold” debt and savings using detailed and highly disaggregated daily-level data on household finances. We find that coholding mostly occurs in short spells within the month and the level of coholding is typically modest. Periods of coholding are not associated with shocks at the individual level. We show that mental accounting has a role to play in explaining coholding, in particular how individuals allocate different categories of expenditure to accounts in credit and debit.
summary: 本文利用详尽的日度家庭财务交易数据，探究个体为何同时持有债务和储蓄（即“coholding”现象）。研究发现，coholding主要发生在月内的短期时间段，且持有水平通常较低；这些时期与个人层面的冲击无关。结果表明，心理账户（mental accounting）在解释coholding中发挥作用，特别是个体如何将不同类别的支出分配到信用账户和借记账户中。
ai_comment: 该文通过高频交易数据为“coholding puzzle”提供了新证据，揭示了其短期性和低水平特征，并强调了心理账户机制的重要性。

title: The Effects of Mandatory ESG Disclosure Around the World
abstract: We compile a novel data set on mandatory environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosure around the world to analyze the stock liquidity effects of such disclosure mandates. We document a positive effect of ESG disclosure mandates on firm‐level stock liquidity. The effects are strongest if the disclosure requirements are implemented by government institutions, not on a comply‐or‐explain basis, and coupled with strong enforcement by informal institutions. Firms with weaker information environments benefit more from ESG disclosure mandates. Our results support the view that ESG disclosure regulation improves the information environment and has beneficial capital market effects.
summary: 该论文编制了一个全新的全球强制性环境、社会和治理（ESG）披露数据集，旨在分析此类披露要求对股票流动性的影响。研究发现，强制ESG披露对公司层面的股票流动性具有显著的正面效应。这种效应在以下情况下最为强烈：披露要求由政府机构实施、非基于“遵守或解释”原则、且与非正式制度的强力执行相结合。此外，信息环境较弱的企业从强制ESG披露中获益更多。这些结果支持了ESG披露监管能够改善信息环境并产生有益资本市场效应的观点。
ai_comment: 该研究通过全球跨国数据集，为强制ESG披露的资本市场效应提供了实证证据，并识别了关键调节因素，具有重要的政策启示。

title: A (Sub)penny for Your Thoughts: Tracking Retail Investor Activity in TAQ
abstract: We placed 85,000 retail trades in six retail brokerage accounts from December 2021 to June 2022 to validate the Boehmer et al. algorithm, which uses subpenny trade prices to identify and sign retail trades. The algorithm identifies 35% of our trades as retail, incorrectly signs 28% of identified trades, and yields uninformative order imbalance measures for 30% of stocks. We modify the algorithm by signing trades using the quoted spread midpoints. The quote midpoint method does not affect identification rates but reduces the signing error rates to 5% and provides informative order imbalance measures for all stocks.
summary: 该论文通过从2021年12月到2022年6月期间在六个零售经纪账户中进行的85,000笔零售交易，验证了Boehmer等人的算法，该算法利用subpenny交易价格来识别和标记零售交易。结果显示，该算法识别了35%的交易为零售交易，但错误标记了28%的已识别交易，并且对30%的股票产生了无信息的订单不平衡度量。作者修改了算法，使用报价中点（quote midpoint）来标记交易方向。这种报价中点方法不影响识别率，但将错误标记率降低到5%，并为所有股票提供了有信息量的订单不平衡度量。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实际放置交易来验证现有算法，提供了可靠的实证证据，并提出了简单而有效的改进方法，显著提升了算法在零售交易识别和订单不平衡度量方面的准确性。

title: Relative Performance Evaluation and Strategic Peer‐Harming Disclosures
abstract: Many firms use relative stock performance to evaluate and incentivize their CEOs. We document that such firms routinely disclose information that harms their peers' stock prices, and sometimes explicitly mention the harmed peers, by name, in these disclosures. Consistent with deliberate sabotage, peer‐harming disclosures appear to be aimed at peers whose stock price depressions are most likely to benefit the disclosing firms' CEOs. The pricing effect of these disclosures does not reverse, suggesting that the disclosures contain legitimate information regarding peers' prospects. In sum, our results suggest that relative performance evaluation in CEO pay motivates CEOs to internalize the externalities of their disclosures, and strategically disclose information that harms peers' stock prices, in order to improve their firms' relative standing within their peer group.
summary: 本文研究相对绩效评估（RPE）如何激励CEO进行策略性损害同行的信息披露。通过实证分析发现，采用RPE的公司经常披露损害同行股价的信息，甚至点名提及被损害的同业。这些披露行为具有策略性，针对那些股价下跌最有利于披露公司CEO薪酬的同行。且披露的股价效应不会反转，表明其中包含关于同行前景的合法信息。结论表明，RPE使CEO内化其信息披露的外部性，通过策略性披露损害同行股价，以提升公司在同业中的相对排名。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统揭示RPE可能导致的负面信息披露行为，为理解CEO薪酬激励的副作用提供了新证据，对信息披露监管具有重要启示。
