title: Blood Money: Selling Plasma to Avoid High-Interest Loans
abstract: Little is known about the motivations and outcomes of sellers in remunerated markets for human materials. We exploit dramatic growth in the U.S. blood plasma industry to shed light on the sellers of plasma. Sellers tend to be young and liquidity-constrained with low incomes and limited access to traditional credit. Plasma centers absorb demand for nontraditional credit. After a plasma center opens nearby, demand for payday loans falls by over 13% among young borrowers. Meanwhile, foot traffic increases by over 4% at nearby stores, suggesting that constrained households use plasma markets to smooth consumption without appealing to high-cost debt.
summary: 本文利用美国血浆行业的快速增长，揭示了血浆卖家的动机和结果。卖家倾向于年轻、流动性受限、收入低且难以获得传统信贷。血浆中心开业后，年轻借款人的发薪日贷款需求下降超过13%，同时附近商店的客流量增加超过4%，表明受约束的家庭通过血浆市场平滑消费，避免了高成本债务。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了血浆销售作为非正式金融工具的作用，为理解家庭在应对流动性约束时的行为提供了新视角。

title: Digitalization and Retirement Contribution Behavior: Evidence from Administrative Data
abstract: Retirement savings decisions are increasingly mediated by digital technologies that promise to help individuals plan adequately for their retirement. We exploit a natural experiment to show that introducing a digital pension application increases the probability of making a voluntary retirement contribution by 1.8 percentage points, from an average pretreatment contribution rate of 2.8%. Men and higher-income earners are more likely to respond to the app introduction. We then leverage a field experiment to show that using the app affects contribution behavior mainly through reducing the “hassle” costs of making contributions, rather than by providing information on the associated tax savings.
summary: 该论文利用自然实验和实地实验，研究数字化养老金应用对自愿退休贡献行为的影响。基于行政数据，应用引入使贡献概率提高1.8个百分点（基线为2.8%），且男性和高收入者反应更显著。实地实验表明，应用主要通过降低贡献的“麻烦成本”起作用，而非提供税收节省信息。
ai_comment: 巧妙结合自然实验与实地实验，揭示数字化降低摩擦成本的机制，而非单纯信息效应，对政策设计有重要启示。

title: The Exchange Rate as an Industrial Policy
abstract: We study the role of exchange rates in industrial policy. We construct an open-economy macroeconomic framework with production externalities and show that the desirability of these policies critically depends on the dynamic patterns of externalities. When they are stronger in earlier stages of development, economies that are converging to the technological frontier can improve welfare by intervening in foreign exchange markets, keeping the exchange rate undervalued, and speeding the transition; economies that are not converging to the technological frontier are better off not using the exchange rate as an industrial policy tool. Capital-flow mobility and labor market dynamism play a central role in the effectiveness of these policies. We also discuss the role of capital controls as an industrial policy tool and use our framework to interpret historical experiences.
summary: 本文研究汇率在产业政策中的作用。作者构建了一个包含生产外部性的开放经济宏观框架，并指出这些政策的合意性关键取决于外部性的动态模式。当外部性在经济发展早期阶段更强时，向技术前沿收敛的经济体可以通过干预外汇市场、保持汇率低估来改善福利并加速转型；而不向技术前沿收敛的经济体则不宜将汇率作为产业政策工具。资本流动性和劳动力市场活力在这些政策的效果中起着核心作用。文章还讨论了资本管制作为产业政策工具的作用，并用该框架解释历史经验。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入生产外部性的动态模式，为汇率干预作为产业政策提供了新的理论依据，并强调了资本流动和劳动力市场的重要性，对理解新兴经济体的汇率政策具有启示意义。

title: The Law of Small Numbers in Financial Markets: Theory and Evidence
abstract: We build a model of the law of small numbers (LSN)—the incorrect belief that even small samples represent the properties of the underlying population—to study its implications for trading behavior and asset prices. In our model, a belief in the LSN induces investors to expect short-term price trends to revert and long-term price trends to persist. As a result, asset prices exhibit short-term momentum and long-term reversals. The model can reconcile the coexistence of the disposition effect and return extrapolation. In addition, it makes new predictions about investor behavior, including return patterns before purchases and sales, a weakened disposition effect for long-term holdings, doubling down in buying, a positive correlation between doubling down and the disposition effect, and heterogeneous selling propensities to past returns. By testing these predictions using account-level transaction data, we show that the LSN provides a parsimonious way of understanding a variety of puzzles about investor behavior.
summary: 本文构建了一个基于“小数定律”（LSN）的理论模型，即投资者错误地认为即使小样本也能代表总体特征，并研究该信念对交易行为和资产价格的影响。模型预测，由于LSN信念，投资者预期短期价格趋势会反转，而长期价格趋势会持续，从而导致资产价格呈现短期动量与长期反转。该模型能够调和处置效应与收益外推的共存现象，并做出新的预测，包括买卖前的收益模式、长期持有的弱化处置效应、买入时的加倍下注、加倍下注与处置效应的正相关，以及投资者对过去收益的异质性卖出倾向。通过账户级交易数据检验这些预测，结果表明LSN为理解投资者行为的多种谜团提供了一个简约的框架。
ai_comment: 本文通过一个简洁的信念偏差模型，统一解释了多个投资者行为异象，具有理论和实证的双重贡献。

title: Life-cycle Forces make Monetary Policy Transmission Wealth-centric
abstract: This paper adds life-cycle features to a New Keynesian model and shows how this places financial wealth at the center of consumption/saving decisions, thereby enriching the determinants of aggregate demand and affecting the transmission of monetary policy.As retirement preoccupations strengthen, the potency of conventional monetary policy declines and depends more on the response of asset prices (supporting central banks closely monitoring the impact of monetary policy on asset prices).Especially "low/high for long" policies are shown to often have only muted effects on economic activity due to offsetting income and substitution effects of interest rates, in a way that can be compounded by Quantitative Easing.We also show why the presence of life-cycle forces can favor a monetary policy strategy which stabilizes asset prices in response to financial shocks.Being explicit about the role of retirement savings in aggregate demand therefore offers new perspectives on several aspects of monetary interventions.
summary: 本文在新凯恩斯模型中引入生命周期特征，揭示金融财富如何成为消费/储蓄决策的核心，从而丰富总需求的决定因素并影响货币政策的传导机制。研究发现，随着退休顾虑增强，传统货币政策的效力下降，且其效果更多地依赖于资产价格的反应（支持央行密切监控货币政策对资产价格的影响）。特别是，“长期低/高利率”政策因利率的收入效应和替代效应相互抵消，往往对经济活动的刺激效果有限，而量化宽松可能加剧这种抵消效应。此外，研究还表明，生命周期力量的存在可能支持一种在金融冲击下稳定资产价格的货币政策策略。明确退休储蓄在总需求中的作用为理解货币干预的多个方面提供了新视角。
ai_comment: 本文通过将生命周期特征融入标准框架，系统揭示了人口老龄化背景下货币政策传导机制的新维度，为央行关注资产价格提供了理论支持。

title: Household Inflation Expectations: An Overview of Recent Insights for Monetary Policy
abstract: This paper discusses the recent wave of research that has emphasized the importance of measures of consumers’ inflation expectations. In contrast to other measures of expected inflation, such as for experts or financial market participants, consumers’ inflation expectations capture the broader distribution of societal beliefs about inflation. This research has revealed very significant deviations from traditional assumptions about rationality in consumers’ expectations formation. However, households do act on their beliefs about inflation, though in heterogeneous ways that can depart from the predictions of conventional economic models. Recent euro area experiences highlight the importance of tracking the degree of anchoring in consumers’ inflation expectations in a way that considers their inherent complexity, heterogeneity, and subjectivity. On average, consumers’ medium and longer-term expectations deviate noticeably in levels from central bank targets and, in contrast with expert expectations, often co-move more closely with shorter-term inflation news. By stepping up their engagement with the wider public, central banks may be able to influence expectations by building up greater knowledge and trust and thereby support more effective monetary transmission. Communication efforts need to be persistent because central banks must compete with many other demands on consumers’ attention.
summary: 本文综述了近期强调消费者通胀预期重要性的研究浪潮。与专家或金融市场参与者的预期通胀指标不同，消费者的通胀预期捕捉了社会对通胀信念的更广泛分布。研究揭示了消费者预期形成过程中与传统理性假设的显著偏离。然而，家庭确实根据其通胀信念采取行动，尽管方式多样且可能偏离传统经济模型的预测。最近的欧元区经验凸显了在考虑消费者通胀预期固有的复杂性、异质性和主观性的前提下，追踪其锚定程度的重要性。平均而言，消费者的中期和长期预期在水平上与央行目标明显偏离，且与专家预期相反，往往与短期通胀新闻更紧密地联动。央行通过加强与公众的互动，可能通过建立更多知识和信任来影响预期，从而支持更有效的货币政策传导。沟通努力需要持续，因为央行必须与众多其他争夺消费者注意力的需求竞争。
ai_comment: 该文系统梳理了消费者通胀预期的独特性质及其对货币政策的启示，强调了沟通和信任的重要性，为央行政策制定提供了新视角。

title: The Simple Macroeconomics of AI
abstract: This paper evaluates claims about large macroeconomic implications of new advances in AI. It starts from a task-based model of AI’s effects, working through automation and task complementarities. So long as AI’s microeconomic effects are driven by cost savings/productivity improvements at the task level, its macroeconomic consequences will be given by a version of Hulten’s theorem: GDP and aggregate productivity gains can be estimated by what fraction of tasks are impacted and average task-level cost savings. Using existing estimates on exposure to AI and productivity improvements at the task level, these macroeconomic effects appear nontrivial but modest—no more than a 0.66% increase in total factor productivity (TFP) over 10 years. The paper then argues that even these estimates could be exaggerated, because early evidence is from easy-to-learn tasks, whereas some of the future effects will come from hard-to-learn tasks, where there are many context-dependent factors affecting decision-making and no objective outcome measures from which to learn successful performance. Consequently, predicted TFP gains over the next 10 years are even more modest and are predicted to be less than 0.53%. I also explore AI’s wage and inequality effects. I show theoretically that even when AI improves the productivity of low-skill workers in certain tasks (without creating new tasks for them), this may increase rather than reduce inequality. Empirically, I find that AI advances are unlikely to increase inequality as much as previous automation technologies because their impact is more equally distributed across demographic groups, but there is also no evidence that AI will reduce labor income inequality. Instead, AI is predicted to widen the gap between capital and labor income. Finally, some of the new tasks created by AI may have negative social value (such as design of algorithms for online manipulation), and I discuss how to incorporate the macroeconomic effects of new tasks that may have negative social value.
summary: 该论文基于一个任务导向（task-based）的模型，通过自动化和任务互补性机制，评估人工智能（AI）新进展对宏观经济的潜在影响。研究指出，只要AI的微观经济效应源于任务层面的成本节约或生产率提升，其宏观经济后果可由Hulten定理的变体给出：GDP和全要素生产率（TFP）的提升可通过受影响任务的比例和平均任务层面成本节约来估算。利用现有关于AI暴露程度和任务层面生产率提升的估计，这些宏观经济效应虽非微不足道但较为温和——10年内TFP增长不超过0.66%。然而，论文认为这些估计可能被夸大，因为早期证据来自易学任务，而未来部分效应将来自难学任务（涉及众多情境依赖因素且缺乏客观结果衡量标准），因此未来10年预测的TFP增益更低，预计低于0.53%。此外，论文探讨了AI对工资和不平等的影响：理论上，即使AI提高了低技能劳动者在特定任务上的生产率（未为其创造新任务），也可能加剧而非减少不平等。实证发现，AI进步不太可能像之前的自动化技术那样大幅加剧不平等，因其影响在各人口群体间分布更均匀，但没有证据表明AI会减少劳动收入不平等；相反，AI预计会扩大资本与劳动收入之间的差距。最后，论文指出AI创造的一些新任务可能具有负社会价值（如设计用于在线操纵的算法），并讨论了如何将可能具有负社会价值的新任务的宏观经济效应纳入分析。
ai_comment: 该文通过严谨的理论模型和实证估计，对AI宏观经济影响的乐观预期提出质疑，并创新性地引入任务学习难易度和新任务社会价值等维度，为政策讨论提供了平衡视角。

title: Fiscal Consequences of Central Bank Losses
abstract: In response to the Global Financial Crisis, central banks engaged in large-scale asset purchases funded by the issuance of reserves. These “unconventional” policies continued during the pandemic, so that by 2022 central banks’ balance sheets had grown up to ten-fold. As a result of rapidly increasing interest rates, these massive portfolios began producing substantial losses. We interpret these losses as fiscal policy consequences of quantitative easing and stress that they must be balanced against the prior benefits of implementing purchase policies. Importantly, losses differ qualitatively depending on whether the central bank chooses to buy domestic or foreign assets, thus resulting in transfers either within or between countries. Effects of losses may differ due to accounting rules (when losses are realized) and when the fiscal authority compensates for losses (the structure of indemnification agreements). Data from the Federal Reserve, the Eurosystem, and the Bank of England show that maximum annual losses are between 0.3 and 1.5 percent of GDP. By contrast, the Swiss National Bank is sustaining losses up to 17 percent of GDP.
summary: 本文研究央行因大规模资产购买（量化宽松）而产生的亏损的财政后果。在应对全球金融危机和疫情期间，央行通过发行准备金购买资产，导致资产负债表扩张数倍。随着利率快速上升，这些组合产生巨额亏损。作者将这些亏损解释为量化宽松政策的财政后果，并强调必须与之前实施购买政策带来的收益相权衡。重要的是，亏损的性质因央行选择购买国内还是国外资产而不同，导致国内或跨国转移。会计规则（何时确认亏损）和财政当局补偿亏损的方式（赔偿协议结构）也会影响亏损的影响。来自美联储、欧元体系和英格兰银行的数据显示，最大年度亏损占GDP的0.3%至1.5%，而瑞士国家银行的亏损高达GDP的17%。
ai_comment: 该文量化了央行亏损的财政规模，并区分了国内外资产购买的不同影响，对理解非常规货币政策的代价有重要启示。

title: Old Moats for New Models: Openness, Control, and Competition in Generative AI
abstract: Drawing insights from the field of innovation economics, we discuss the likely competitive environment shaping generative AI advances. Central to our analysis are the concepts of appropriability—whether firms in the industry are able to control the knowledge generated by their innovations—and complementary assets—whether effective entry requires access to specialized infrastructure and capabilities to which incumbent firms can ration access. While the rapid improvements in AI foundation models promise transformative impacts across broad sectors of the economy, we argue that tight control over complementary assets will likely result in a concentrated market structure, as in past episodes of technological upheaval. We suggest the likely paths through which incumbent firms may restrict entry, confining newcomers to subordinate roles and stifling broad sectoral innovation. We conclude with speculations regarding how this oligopolistic future might be averted. Policy interventions aimed at fractionalizing or facilitating shared access to complementary assets might help preserve competition and incentives for extending the generative AI frontier. Ironically, the best hopes for a vibrant open source AI ecosystem might rest on the presence of a “rogue” technology giant, who might choose openness and engagement with smaller firms as a strategic weapon wielded against other incumbents.
summary: 本文借鉴创新经济学的见解，探讨了塑造生成式AI发展的竞争环境。分析的核心概念是专有性（即企业能否控制其创新产生的知识）和互补资产（即有效进入是否需要访问现有企业可以限制访问的专门基础设施和能力）。尽管AI基础模型的快速改进有望对广泛的经济部门产生变革性影响，但本文认为，对互补资产的严格控制可能导致市场结构集中，正如过去技术变革的案例所示。本文指出了现有企业可能限制进入、将新进入者限制在从属角色并抑制广泛部门创新的可能途径。最后，本文推测了如何避免这种寡头垄断的未来。旨在分割或促进互补资产共享访问的政策干预可能有助于保持竞争和扩展生成式AI前沿的激励。讽刺的是，维持一个充满活力的开源AI生态系统的最佳希望可能在于一个“流氓”科技巨头，它可能选择开放并与小企业合作，作为对抗其他现有企业的战略武器。
ai_comment: 本文从创新经济学视角切入，揭示了生成式AI行业可能走向寡头垄断的内在逻辑，特别是对互补资产控制的强调，为理解AI竞争格局提供了新颖的理论框架。

title: What Went Wrong with Federal Student Loans?
abstract: At a time when the returns to college and graduate school are at historic highs, why do so many students struggle with their student loans? The increase in aggregate student debt and the struggles of today’s student loan borrowers can be traced to changes in federal policies intended to broaden access to federal aid and educational opportunities, and which increased enrollment and borrowing in higher-risk circumstances. Starting in the late 1990s, policymakers weakened regulations that had constrained institutions from enrolling aid-dependent students. This led to rising enrollment of relatively disadvantaged students, but primarily at poor-performing, low-value institutions whose students systematically failed to complete a degree, struggled to repay their loans, defaulted at high rates, and foundered in the job market. As these new borrowers experienced similarly poor outcomes, their loans piled up, loan performance deteriorated, and with it the finances of the federal program. The crisis illustrates the important role that educational institutions play in access to postsecondary education and student outcomes, and difficulty of using broadly-available loans to subsidize investments in education when there is so much heterogeneity in outcomes across institutions and programs and in the ability to repay of students.
summary: 这篇论文探讨了联邦学生贷款项目为何在高等教育回报创历史新高时仍导致许多学生陷入困境。研究发现，自20世纪90年代末以来，政策制定者放宽了对录取依赖资助学生的教育机构的监管，导致更多弱势学生入学，但主要集中在表现差、价值低的院校。这些院校的学生普遍未能完成学业，贷款偿还困难，违约率高，且在就业市场上表现不佳。随着贷款累积，贷款表现恶化，联邦项目的财务状况也受到影响。该危机凸显了教育机构在高等教育入学和学生成果中的关键作用，以及当不同院校和项目的成果以及学生还款能力存在巨大异质性时，利用广泛可用的贷款补贴教育投资的困难。
ai_comment: 该文通过政策变迁视角揭示了联邦学生贷款危机的制度根源，强调了教育机构异质性的核心作用，为反思贷款项目设计提供了重要实证依据。

title: Demand-side and Supply-side Constraints in the Market for Financial Advice
abstract: In this review, we argue that access to financial advice and the quality of this advice is shaped by a broad array of demand-side and supply-side constraints. While the literature has predominantly focused on conflicts of interest between advisors and clients, we highlight that the transaction costs of providing advice, mistaken beliefs on the demand side or supply side, and other factors can have equally detrimental effects on the quality and access to advice. Moreover, these factors affect how researchers should assess the impact of financial advice across heterogeneous groups of households. While households with low levels of financial literacy are more likely to benefit from advice—potentially including conflicted advice—they are also the least likely to detect misconduct, and perhaps the least likely to understand the value of paying for advice. Regulators should consider not only how regulation changes the quality of advice, but also the fraction of households who are able to receive it and how different groups would have invested without any advice. Financial innovation has the potential to provide customized advice at low cost, but also to embed conflicts of interest in algorithms that are opaque to households and regulators.
summary: 这篇综述论文认为，金融咨询的可获得性和质量受到广泛的需求侧和供给侧约束。尽管文献主要关注顾问与客户之间的利益冲突，但本文强调，提供咨询的交易成本、需求侧或供给侧的误解以及其他因素同样会对咨询的质量和可及性产生不利影响。此外，这些因素影响研究人员如何评估金融咨询对不同家庭群体的影响。金融素养较低的家庭更可能从咨询中受益——甚至可能包括有利益冲突的咨询——但他们也最不可能发现不当行为，也可能最不理解付费咨询的价值。监管机构不仅应考虑监管如何改变咨询质量，还应考虑能够获得咨询的家庭比例以及不同群体在没有咨询的情况下如何投资。金融创新有潜力以低成本提供定制化咨询，但也可能将利益冲突嵌入到对家庭和监管机构不透明的算法中。
ai_comment: 本文系统梳理了金融咨询市场中的多重约束，拓宽了传统仅关注利益冲突的视角，并强调了监管与金融创新的复杂影响，对政策制定具有重要启示。

title: Optimal Mortgage Refinancing with Inattention
abstract: We build a model of optimal fixed-rate mortgage refinancing with fixed costs and inattention and derive a new sufficient statistic that can be used to measure inattention frictions from simple moments of the rate gap distribution.In the model, borrowers pay attention to rates sporadically so they often fail to refinance even when it is profitable.When paying attention, borrowers optimally choose to refinance earlier than under a perfect attention benchmark.Our model can rationalize almost all errors of "omission" (refinancing too slowly) and a large fraction of the errors of "commission" (refinancing too quickly) previously documented in the data.
summary: 本文构建了一个固定利率抵押贷款最优再融资模型，其中考虑了固定成本和借款人的注意力不足（inattention）。模型假设借款人只是偶尔关注利率变化，因此即使再融资有利可图，他们也经常不进行再融资。当借款人关注时，他们最优选择会比完全注意力基准下更早进行再融资。该模型能够解释数据中之前记录的大部分“遗漏”错误（再融资过慢）和很大一部分“过犯”错误（再融资过快）。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入注意力不足这一行为摩擦，为抵押贷款再融资中的常见错误提供了统一的解释框架，提出的充分统计量具有实证应用潜力。

title: What do Financial Markets say about the Exchange Rate?
abstract: We develop a general framework characterizing when exchange rates connect or disconnect from fundamentals across different financial market structures.International portfolio risk sharing governs how tightly exchange rates track households' stochastic discount factors.We introduce a tractable sufficient statistic for connect: the prevalence of globally-traded risks, the component of asset risks that households in both countries can trade through available financial instruments.When globally-traded risks dominate, exchange rate puzzles persist regardless of market structure.In turn, disconnect requires neither extreme segmentation nor thin financial markets; it emerges whenever globally-traded risks are limited.Empirically, cross-country asset return correlations are weak, implying modest amount of globally-traded risks and pervasive disconnect in intermediated market structures.When correlations increase, as observed post-2008 or during high-risk episodes, exchange rates track fundamentals more closely.
summary: 论文构建了一个一般框架，刻画在不同金融市场结构下汇率与基本面何时连接或脱钩。国际投资组合风险分担决定了汇率追踪家庭随机贴现因子的紧密程度。引入可处理的充分统计量——全球交易风险的普遍性，即两国居民通过可用金融工具可以交易的资产风险成分。当全球交易风险占主导时，无论市场结构如何，汇率谜题持续存在。脱钩不需要极端分割或薄金融市场，只要全球交易风险有限就会出现。实证上，跨国资产回报相关性较弱，意味着全球交易风险适中，中介市场结构中普遍存在脱钩。当相关性增加（如2008年后或高风险时期），汇率更紧密追踪基本面。
ai_comment: 该文通过构建统一框架解释了汇率谜题的持续性，并指出全球交易风险是关键决定因素，为理解汇率与基本面关系提供了新视角。

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Skill Premium
abstract: How will the emergence of ChatGPT and other forms of artificial intelligence (AI) affect the skill premium?To address this question, we propose a nested constant elasticity of substitution production function that distinguishes among three types of capital: traditional physical capital (machines, assembly lines), industrial robots, and AI.Following the literature, we assume that industrial robots predominantly substitute for low-skill workers, whereas AI mainly helps to perform the tasks of high-skill workers.We show that AI reduces the skill premium as long as it is more substitutable for high-skill workers than low-skill workers are for high-skill workers.
summary: 本文研究ChatGPT等人工智能（AI）对技能溢价的影响。作者提出一个嵌套的常数替代弹性（CES）生产函数，将资本区分为三类：传统实物资本、工业机器人和AI。基于文献假设，工业机器人主要替代低技能工人，而AI主要辅助高技能工人完成任务。理论分析表明，当AI与高技能工人之间的替代弹性大于低技能工人与高技能工人之间的替代弹性时，AI会降低技能溢价。
ai_comment: 通过区分不同类型的资本和劳动力，为理解AI对收入分配的影响提供了简洁而有力的理论框架，结论具有政策启示意义。

title: Identifying Monetary Policy Shocks: A Natural Language Approach
abstract: We develop a novel method for the identification of monetary policy shocks. By applying natural language processing techniques to documents that Federal Reserve staff prepare in advance of policy decisions, we capture the Fed's information set. Using machine learning techniques, we then predict changes in the target interest rate conditional on this information set and obtain a measure of monetary policy shocks as the residual. We show that the documents' text contains essential information about the economy which is not captured by numerical forecasts that the staff include in the same documents. The dynamic responses of macro variables to our monetary policy shocks are consistent with the theoretical consensus. Shocks constructed by only controlling for the staff forecasts imply responses of macro variables at odds with theory. We directly link these differences to the information that our procedure extracts from the text over and above information captured by the forecasts.
summary: 本文提出了一种识别货币政策冲击的新方法。通过应用自然语言处理技术分析美联储工作人员在政策决策前准备的文件，捕获美联储的信息集。利用机器学习技术，基于该信息集预测目标利率的变化，并将残差作为货币政策冲击的度量。研究表明，这些文件的文本包含了工作人员在同一文档中提供的数值预测所未能捕捉的重要经济信息。由此得到的货币政策冲击对宏观变量的动态响应与理论共识一致。而仅控制工作人员预测构建的冲击则导致与理论相悖的宏观变量响应。这些差异直接归因于本文方法从文本中提取的超出预测信息以外的信息。
ai_comment: 该方法的创新之处在于利用文本信息作为额外信息源，超越了传统的数值预测，为更准确地识别货币政策冲击提供了新视角。

title: Learning from Ricardo and Thompson: Machinery and Labor in the Early Industrial Revolution, and in the Age of AI
abstract: David Ricardo initially believed machinery would help workers but revised his opinion, likely based on the impact of automation in the textile industry. Despite cotton textiles becoming one of the largest sectors in the British economy, real wages for cotton weavers did not rise for decades. As E.P. Thompson emphasized, automation forced workers into unhealthy factories with close surveillance and little autonomy. Automation can increase wages, but only when accompanied by new tasks that raise the marginal productivity of labor and/or when there is sufficient additional hiring in complementary sectors. Wages are unlikely to rise when workers cannot push for their share of productivity growth. Today, artificial intelligence may boost average productivity, but it also may replace many workers while degrading job quality for those who remain employed. As in Ricardo’s time, the impact of automation on workers today is more complex than an automatic linkage from higher productivity to better wages.
summary: 本文从历史视角探讨自动化对工人的影响。大卫·李嘉图最初认为机器有助于工人，但后来因纺织业自动化的影响而改变观点。尽管棉纺织业成为英国经济最大部门之一，但棉织工的实际工资数十年未涨。E.P. Thompson强调，自动化迫使工人进入不健康的工厂，受到严密监视且缺乏自主权。自动化可以提高工资，但前提是伴随新任务提高劳动边际生产率，或互补部门有足够额外雇佣。当工人无法争取生产率增长份额时，工资难以提升。如今，人工智能可能提高平均生产率，但也可能取代许多工人，并降低留任工人的工作质量。与李嘉图时代一样，自动化对工人的影响比从更高生产率到更好工资的自动关联更为复杂。
ai_comment: 本文通过历史对照，揭示了技术进步对劳动者影响的复杂性，对当前AI时代的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。

title: Decision-Making Delegation in Banks
abstract: Using natural disasters as shocks to local economies, we document that a bank branch’s ability to set deposit rates locally has real effects. Following disasters, branches with rates set locally increase deposit rates more and experience higher deposit volumes in affected counties. Consistent with imperfect insurance from internal capital markets, banks with more branches setting rates locally relatively expand mortgage lending in affected counties. House prices recover faster in local areas where more branches’ rates are set locally. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4856 .
summary: 本文利用自然灾害作为当地经济的外生冲击，实证检验银行分行在本地设定存款利率的授权决策是否具有真实效应。研究发现，在受灾县，有权本地设定利率的分行会更大程度地提高存款利率，并吸引更多存款。同时，拥有更多此类分行的银行会在受灾县相对扩大抵押贷款发放，这与内部资本市场的不完全保险机制一致。此外，在更多分行实行本地定价的地区，房价恢复速度更快。
ai_comment: 该文利用自然灾害作为外生冲击，巧妙识别了银行分支层面定价权授权的因果效应，为理解银行内部决策权配置对实体经济的影响提供了新证据。

title: Bank Supervision and Corporate Credit Supply
abstract: We exploit the quasi-random assignment of federal bank examiners to syndicated loans to study the effect of supervision on corporate lending. Following supervisory rating downgrades, banks decrease credit commitments and downgrade internal risk assessments. Borrowers face larger commitment reductions whenever banks have low ex ante screening and monitoring incentives or whenever examiners’ assessments contain more information than banks’ assessments, suggesting that examinations complement bank monitoring. Although public firms can offset the loss of bank credit by tapping external capital markets, smaller and more opaque private firms draw on internal cash balances instead and reduce investment and sales growth. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4854 .
summary: 本文利用联邦银行检查员在银团贷款中的准随机分配，研究银行监管对企业信贷供应的影响。研究发现，当监管评级下调后，银行会减少信贷承诺并下调内部风险评估。当银行的事前筛选和监督激励较低，或检查员的评估比银行自身的评估包含更多信息时，借款人面临的信贷承诺削减幅度更大，这表明检查补充了银行的监督。虽然上市公司可以通过外部资本市场弥补银行信贷的损失，但规模较小且信息不透明的私营企业只能动用内部现金储备，并因此减少投资和销售增长。
ai_comment: 利用准随机分配识别因果效应，提供了银行监管影响实体经济信贷的微观证据，尤其揭示了不同企业类型的异质性反应。

title: Motivating Experts to Contribute to Digital Public Goods: A Personalized Field Experiment on Wikipedia
abstract: We conducted a large-scale personalized field experiment to examine how match quality, recognition, and social impact influence domain experts’ contributions to Wikipedia. Forty-five percent of the experts expressed willingness to contribute in the baseline condition, whereas 51% (a 13% increase over the baseline) expressed interest when they received a signal that an article matched their expertise. However, none of the treatments had a significant effect on actual contributions. Instead experts contributed longer and better comments when the actual match between a recommended Wikipedia article and an expert's expertise, measured by cosine similarity, was higher, when they had higher reputation, and when the original article was longer. These findings suggest that match quality between volunteers and tasks is critically important in encouraging contributions to digital public goods and likely to volunteering in general. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation through [Grant SES-1620319] awarded to Carnegie Mellon University and the University of Michigan. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4852 .
summary: 我们进行了一项大规模个性化田野实验，研究匹配质量、认可度和社会影响如何影响领域专家对维基百科的贡献。在基线条件下，45%的专家表示愿意贡献，而当他们收到文章与其专长匹配的信号时，有51%（比基线增加13%）表示兴趣。然而，没有任何处理对实际贡献产生显著影响。相反，当推荐维基百科文章与专家专长的实际匹配度（以余弦相似度衡量）较高、专家声誉较高以及原始文章较长时，专家会贡献更长且更好的评论。这些发现表明，志愿者与任务之间的匹配质量对于鼓励对数字公共品的贡献（以及一般的志愿服务）至关重要。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模田野实验揭示了匹配质量对贡献意愿的影响，但发现实际贡献更受客观匹配度、声誉等因素驱动，为数字公共品贡献机制提供了新见解。

title: The Use of Credit Ratings in the Delegated Management of Fixed Income Assets
abstract: Investment mandates of fixed income funds constrain managers’ portfolio decisions, often employing credit ratings to classify asset risk. We categorize U.S. and European fixed income funds’ mandates using textual analysis and measure the use of ratings. Over the past two decades, despite the weaknesses of ratings revealed in the global financial crisis, ratings use has increased significantly. Since 2010, the fraction of funds not using ratings in any way has fallen by almost half in both the United States and Europe. By 2020, 94% of U.S. funds and 65% of European funds used ratings. These patterns fit agency-based models of investment mandates and point to a lack of practically useful alternatives. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Nasdaq Nordic Foundation. Supplemental Material: The data files and e-companion are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4848 .
summary: 本文研究固定收益基金投资委托中对信用评级的使用情况，通过文本分析分类美国和欧洲固定收益基金的委托条款，并衡量评级的实际使用程度。结果发现，尽管全球金融危机暴露了信用评级的弱点，但在过去二十年中，评级的使用显著增加：自2010年以来，完全不使用评级的基金比例在美国和欧洲均下降了近一半；截至2020年，94%的美国基金和65%的欧洲基金使用了信用评级。这些模式符合基于代理理论的投资委托模型，并表明缺乏实际可行的替代方案。
ai_comment: 本文通过大规模文本分析提供了评级使用长期趋势的系统证据，揭示出危机后评级依赖反而加强的悖论，对评级的监管和替代方案提出了重要反思。

title: Birds of a Feather: Do Hedge Fund Managers Flock Together?
abstract: Mandatory filings for UK hedge funds suggest that managers having worked at the same prior employer invest more similarly in terms of distances of returns. If they overlapped in employment, increasing the chance of social ties, investments become even more similar. The joint effect accounts for up to two thirds of the difference in investing behavior. Results are robust to fund- and manager-level controls as well as to identification concerns. With controls, the same-employer effect is concentrated in the systematic component (beta), whereas the overlap effect is concentrated in the idiosyncratic components (alpha and residuals). Managerial ties make any two funds more similar in their stock holdings. Moreover, portfolios of connected funds outperform their peers in terms of alpha, return volatility, and Sharpe ratio. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data file is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4843 .
summary: 本文利用英国对冲基金的强制披露数据，研究基金经理的社会联系对其投资行为的影响。发现曾受雇于同一雇主的基金经理，其投资回报的相似性更高；若曾同时在同一雇主处工作（即雇佣期重叠），投资相似性进一步增加。联合效应最多可解释投资行为差异的三分之二。在控制基金和经理层面特征以及处理识别问题后，结果依然稳健。进一步分析表明，同一雇主效应主要影响系统性成分（beta），而重叠效应主要影响特质性成分（alpha和残差）。此外，社会联系使得任意两只基金的股票持仓更加相似，且关联基金的投资组合在alpha、收益波动率和夏普比率上优于非关联基金。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的英国监管数据，实证揭示了基金经理的社会网络（共同雇主和雇佣重叠）对投资决策和业绩的显著影响，为行为金融和社会资本在资产管理中的作用提供了有力证据。

title: Countercyclical Risks, Consumption, and Portfolio Choice: Theory and Evidence
abstract: Using a quantitative, calibrated life-cycle model, I show that countercyclical earnings risk affects individual consumption growth, reduces the share of wealth in stocks, and affects savings behavior. Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics survey, I construct an empirical measure of countercyclical earnings risk and find evidence consistent with the model’s predictions. Specifically, larger downside earnings risk decreases consumption growth, increases left skewness in consumption growth, and reduces the share of wealth in stocks. Furthermore, the consumption effects are substantially more significant for stockholders than for nonstockholders, which arises through heterogeneity in the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4837 .
summary: 本文通过一个量化的、校准的生命周期模型，展示了反周期收益风险如何影响个人消费增长、降低股票财富份额并影响储蓄行为。利用PSID调查数据，构建了反周期收益风险的实证指标，并找到了与模型预测一致的证据。具体而言，较大的下行收益风险会降低消费增长，增加消费增长的左偏程度，并减少股票财富份额。此外，消费效应在股东中比非股东更为显著，这源于跨期替代弹性异质性。
ai_comment: 该文首次将反周期收益风险与个体消费增长和股票持有决策联系起来，并通过实证数据验证了理论模型，贡献突出。特别地，揭示了股东与非股东在消费弹性上的异质性差异，深化了我们对风险—消费—投资组合关系的理解。

title: Offsetable Derivatives and Investor Risk Assessment
abstract: U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) allows banks to offset derivative assets against derivative liabilities with the same counterparty and report only the net amount on the balance sheet. Derivative offsetting under international financial reporting standards (IFRS) is much more restrictive, resulting in the single largest difference in balance sheet presentation between U.S. GAAP and IFRS. Two important factors dominate the standard-setting discussion on this issue: (1) whether these derivatives are informative about bank risk and (2) whether disclosing them substitutes for recognition on the balance sheet. Using a hand-collected global sample of banks, we first show that offsetable derivatives are positively associated with bank risk, based on multiple risk measures, suggesting that these derivatives are informative about bank risk. Next, exploiting the differential accounting treatment across U.S. GAAP and IFRS banks, we find that disclosure versus recognition of offsetable derivatives matters for the risk assessment of equity investors but not for that of (more sophisticated) credit default swap investors. Additional tests corroborate the inference that investor sophistication helps explain the differential investor assessment of recognized versus disclosed offsetable derivatives. Collectively, our findings suggest that offsetable derivatives convey information about bank risk and that, for less sophisticated investors, disclosing them may not substitute for recognizing them. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4831 .
summary: 基于手工收集的全球银行样本，研究美国GAAP下允许的可抵消衍生品（与同一对手方进行净额结算）对银行风险的信息含量，以及确认（资产负债表内）与披露（表外）对不同投资者风险评估的差异影响。利用GAAP与IFRS在衍生品抵消处理上的差异，发现可抵消衍生品与银行风险（基于多个风险度量）正相关，表明其对风险具有信息含量。对于股权投资者，确认与披露影响其风险评估；而对于更复杂的信用违约互换投资者，两者无显著差异。进一步分析表明，投资者成熟度解释了这种差异。结论认为，可抵消衍生品传递银行风险信息，且对不太成熟的投资者，披露不能替代确认。
ai_comment: 利用国际会计准则差异的准自然实验，揭示了确认与披露在投资者风险评估中的非对称影响，并强调投资者成熟度的关键调节作用，为会计准则制定提供了行为证据。

title: Common Institutional Ownership and Product Market Threats
abstract: The common ownership of firms can have anticompetitive effects by incentivizing collusive outcomes that maximize joint surpluses of the commonly held firms or procompetitive effects through enhanced knowledge spillovers. Using a difference-in-differences regression methodology that exploits mergers between financial institutions as exogenous shocks to common ownership, our baseline results suggest that higher common ownership leads to greater product market fluidity (a text-based metric of competition) and generally leads to more product development and higher investments. These findings suggest that, on average, common ownership spurs dynamism in product spaces rather than tacit collusion between cross-held competitors. This is especially true in economic environments in which it is easier to take advantage of knowledge spillovers. However, common ownership can also inhibit product market competition and dynamism, especially in industries more prone to quasi-monopoly outcomes in product spaces. Implementing a one-size-fits-all regulatory policy limiting common ownership may be harmful in industries with strong spillover opportunities. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4830 .
summary: 本文研究共同机构所有权对产品市场竞争的影响。利用金融机构合并作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法，发现共同所有权平均而言增加了产品市场流动性（一种衡量竞争的文本指标），并促进了产品开发和更高的投资。这表明共同所有权促进了产品空间动态而非合谋。这种效应在知识溢出更容易的环境中尤为显著。然而，共同所有权也可能抑制竞争，特别是在容易形成准垄断的行业中。因此，一刀切的限制共同所有权政策可能对溢出机会强的行业造成伤害。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地使用金融机构合并作为外生冲击，揭示了共同所有权的双重效应，为监管政策提供了重要启示。

title: In-sample and out-of-sample Sharpe ratios of multi-factor asset pricing models
abstract: Using available return data, many multi-factor asset pricing models present impressive in-sample Sharpe ratios, significantly surpassing that of the market portfolio. Such a performance, however, contradicts the conventional wisdom in finance. Investors cannot realistically attain the in-sample Sharpe ratios. They obtain the out-of-sample Sharpe ratios, which are significantly lower. Estimation risk is one reason for this performance deterioration. We theoretically study the effect of estimation risk by obtaining the exact distributions of in-sample and out-of-sample Sharpe ratios, and argue that such effect needs to be considered in model comparisons.
summary: 本文利用可得的回报数据发现，许多多因子资产定价模型在样本内（in-sample）展示了令人印象深刻的夏普比率（Sharpe ratios），显著超越市场组合。然而，这种表现与金融学的传统观念相矛盾，因为投资者实际获得的是样本外（out-of-sample）夏普比率，其数值显著更低。估计风险（estimation risk）是导致这一性能下降的原因之一。本文从理论上研究了估计风险的影响，通过推导样本内和样本外夏普比率的精确分布，论证了在模型比较中需要考虑这种效应。
ai_comment: 该论文从理论层面严谨地分析了估计风险对夏普比率的影响，为解释多因子模型样本内表现优异但样本外不佳的现象提供了重要见解，对模型比较和投资者实践具有启示意义。

title: The pricing of U.S. Treasury floating rate notes
abstract: Since January 2014, the U.S. Treasury has been issuing floating rate notes (FRNs). These notes pay quarterly interest based on an average of the constant maturity rates of newly issued three-month T-bills during the quarter. We show how to price such FRNs. We estimate that they have been paying excess interest between 3 and 42 basis points above the implied interest of other Treasury securities. We interpret this fact through the lens of a model where money-like assets differ in their degrees of moneyness. Additional empirical evidence supports this interpretation.
summary: 本文研究美国财政部自2014年发行的浮动利率票据（FRNs）的定价问题。这些票据每季度支付利息，该利息基于季度内新发行三个月期国债的恒定到期利率的平均值。作者展示了如何对这类FRNs进行定价，并估计它们支付的超额利息在3到42个基点之间，高于其他国债的隐含利息。通过一个模型，其中货币类资产的货币性程度不同，来解释这一现象，并提供了实证证据支持这一解释。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统性地定价美国财政部浮动利率票据，并利用货币性差异模型解释超额利息，为理解政府债券定价提供了新视角。

title: The timing of voluntary delisting
abstract: For many firms, voluntarily delisting from a stock exchange can be optimal. We model an entrepreneur's incentives to voluntarily delist the firm as a trade-off between consumption of private benefits when listed and expected improvements in the firm's performance after delisting. Our model allows for heterogeneity across firms and countries, and various micro and macro shocks affect the delisting decision. Such a model makes novel predictions regarding the delisting patterns around the world. We empirically confirm these predictions using manually collected delisting data from 26 countries. Increasing policy and regulatory uncertainties can partially explain the greater popularity of voluntary delistings.
summary: 该论文研究企业自愿从证券交易所退市的时机选择。作者构建了一个理论模型，将企业家的退市激励视为上市时私人利益消费与退市后预期绩效改善之间的权衡。模型允许企业和国家间的异质性，并纳入各种微观和宏观冲击对退市决策的影响。模型对全球自愿退市模式提出了新颖的预测，并利用从26个国家手工收集的退市数据进行了实证验证。研究发现，政策和监管不确定性的增加可以部分解释自愿退市现象的日益流行。
ai_comment: 该论文通过构建理论模型并结合跨国数据，为理解自愿退市时机提供了新视角，特别是强调了政策和监管不确定性的重要作用。

title: Sustainability or performance? Ratings and fund managers’ incentives
abstract: We explore how mutual fund managers and investors react when the tradeoff between a fund's sustainability and performance becomes salient. Following the introduction of Morningstar's sustainability ratings (the “globe” ratings), mutual funds increased their holdings of sustainable stocks to attract flows. Such sustainability-driven trades, however, underperformed, impairing the funds’ overall performance. Consequently, a tradeoff between sustainability and performance emerged. In the new equilibrium, the globe ratings do not affect investor flows and funds no longer trade to improve their globe ratings.
summary: 本文研究晨星引入可持续性评级（globe ratings）后，共同基金管理者与投资者如何应对可持续性与绩效之间的权衡。研究发现，评级引入后，基金为吸引资金而增持可持续股票，但这些交易表现不佳，损害了基金整体绩效，从而形成了可持续性与绩效的权衡。在新的均衡状态下，globe评级不再影响投资者资金流，基金也不再为了改善评级而进行交易。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了可持续投资与绩效之间存在的实际权衡，并展示了市场如何通过调整达到新的均衡，对理解ESG投资的实际影响具有重要启示。

title: Trade credit and the stability of supply chains
abstract: We show that trade credit flows increase when a firm in a production network becomes a less reliable supplier due to an operating shock. Affected firms extend more trade credit when their customers have lower switching costs or expect more disruption. Suppliers that are more dependent on the affected firms facilitate the trade credit extension. However, when financial constraints at the affected firms and their suppliers prevent the increase in trade credit, customers sever their relationships with the affected firms, and the sales of the affected firms and their suppliers drop, suggesting that trade credit enhances production network stability.
summary: 本文研究了贸易信用如何在生产网络中应对供应商运营冲击而维持供应链稳定性。当一家公司（受冲击方）因运营冲击成为不可靠供应商时，其贸易信用流出增加，尤其是在客户转换成本低或预期中断损失大时。同时，受影响公司的供应商（即其上游）会提供更多贸易信用以支持这种扩展。然而，如果受影响公司及其供应商面临财务约束而无法增加贸易信用，客户会切断合作关系，导致受影响公司及其供应商的销售额下降。这证明贸易信用有助于稳定生产网络。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地从供应链网络视角考察贸易信用的稳定作用，并揭示了财务约束的破坏性影响，为理解企业间融资与运营风险互动提供了新洞见。

title: Robo advisors and access to wealth management
abstract: We investigate how access to robo-advisors impacts the financial investment and welfare of less-wealthy investors. We leverage a quasi-experiment where a major U.S. robo-advisor significantly expands access by reducing its account minimum, increasing participation by middle-class investors but not the poor. A benchmark model calibrated to portfolio-level data rationalizes this increase: middle-class investors want sophisticated investing but cannot achieve it themselves. Their welfare rises moderately, driven by advanced features like multi-dimensional glide-paths and additional priced risk factors. Middle-age investors gain three times more than millennials. Our results reveal novel margins of demand for robo-advisors, helping explain their sustained growth.
summary: 本文研究机器人顾问的准入如何影响不太富裕投资者的金融投资和福利。利用一项准实验（美国一家大型机器人顾问通过降低账户最低金额大幅扩大准入），发现这一举措增加了中产阶级投资者的参与，但未影响贫困群体。基于投资组合层面数据校准的基准模型解释了这一增长：中产阶级投资者希望进行复杂投资但自身无法实现。其福利适度提升，主要驱动力为多维下滑路径（multi-dimensional glide-paths）和额外定价风险因素等高级功能。中年投资者的获益是千禧一代的三倍。结果揭示了机器人顾问需求的新边际，有助于解释其持续增长。
ai_comment: 本文利用准实验设计严谨论证了机器人顾问降低门槛对中产阶级投资者的显著影响，并量化了福利提升的异质性，为金融科技普惠性提供了新证据。

title: Aggregate lapsation risk
abstract: We study aggregate lapsation risk in the life insurance sector. We construct two lapsation risk factors that explain a large fraction of the common variation in lapse rates of the 30 largest life insurance companies. The first is a cyclical factor that is positively correlated with credit spreads and unemployment, while the second factor is a trend factor that correlates with the level of interest rates. Using a novel policy-level database from a large life insurer, we examine the heterogeneity in risk factor exposures based on policy and policyholder characteristics. Young policyholders with higher health risk in low-income areas are more likely to lapse their policies during economic downturns. We explore the implications for hedging and valuation of life insurance contracts. Ignoring aggregate lapsation risk results in mispricing of life insurance policies. The calibrated model points to overpricing on average. In the cross-section, young, low-income, and high-health risk households face higher effective mark-ups than the old, high-income, and healthy.
summary: 本文研究寿险行业的总体退保风险。我们构建了两个退保风险因子，它们解释了美国30家最大寿险公司退保率共同变动的很大一部分：第一个是周期因子，与信用利差和失业率正相关；第二个是趋势因子，与利率水平相关。利用一家大型寿险公司的保单级数据库，我们考察了基于保单和保单持有人特征的风险因子暴露异质性：低收入地区、健康风险较高的年轻投保人在经济衰退期间更可能退保。我们探讨了对冲和寿险合同估值的含义：忽略总体退保风险会导致保单错误定价，校准模型显示平均定价过高。在横截面上，年轻、低收入、高健康风险家庭面临的有效加价高于年老、高收入、健康家庭。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将退保行为建模为系统性风险因子，并利用微观数据揭示了不同人群的风险暴露差异，对保险负债定价和风险管理具有重要实践意义。

title: Price ceilings, market structure, and payout policies
abstract: To prevent issuers from inflating their share prices, SEC Rule 10b-18 sets price ceilings on share repurchases through open markets. We find that market-structure reforms in the 1990s and 2000s dramatically increased share repurchases because they relaxed constraints on issuers competing with other buyers under price ceilings. The Tick Size Pilot Program, a controlled experiment that partially reversed previous reforms, significantly reduced share repurchases. We estimate that price ceilings and reduced market-structure frictions explain 18% of the secular increase in share repurchases. Meanwhile, these two frictions still exist, which explains why share repurchases have not crowded out dividends entirely.
summary: 本文研究SEC Rule 10b-18设定的价格上限对股票回购的影响。利用1990年代和2000年代的市场结构改革以及Tick Size Pilot Program这一控制实验，发现市场结构改革通过放松价格上限下发行人与其他买家竞争的约束，大幅增加了股票回购；Tick Size Pilot Program部分逆转了之前的改革，显著减少了股票回购。估计价格上限和减少的市场结构摩擦解释了股票回购长期增长的18%。同时，这两种摩擦仍然存在，解释了为什么股票回购没有完全取代股息。
ai_comment: 本文通过自然实验和长期数据，量化了市场结构摩擦对回购决策的影响，为理解回购与股息的替代关系提供了新视角。

title: The effect of female leadership on contracting from Capitol Hill to Main Street
abstract: This paper provides novel evidence that female politicians increase the proportion of US government procurement contracts allocated to women-owned firms. For identification, we use a regression discontinuity design on a sample of mixed-gender elections in the US House of Representatives. The effect grows over a female representative's tenure and concentrates in female representatives who are on powerful congressional committees. Changes in the pool of and behavior by government contractors cannot explain the result. The more gender-balanced representation in government contracting is not associated with economic costs.
summary: 本文提供了新证据，表明女性政治家增加了美国政府采购合同中分配给女性所有企业的比例。为识别因果关系，采用美国众议院混合性别选举样本的断点回归设计。该效应随女性代表任期增长而增强，并集中于在强大国会委员会任职的女性代表。政府承包商行为变化无法解释该结果，且政府合同中的性别平衡代表性与经济成本无关。
ai_comment: 本文利用断点回归设计，为女性政治家促进女性企业获得政府合同提供了因果证据，且发现该效应无经济代价，为女性领导力的经济影响提供了新视角。

title: Political polarization in financial news
abstract: Comparing coverage of the same corporate financial news by the conservative Wall Street Journal and the liberal New York Times, we find strong evidence of political polarization in their reporting on both the intensive and extensive margins of coverage. We show that this politics-induced disagreement in corporate financial news leads to an increase in abnormal trading volume for the most politically extreme firms. Our results highlight a new source of investor disagreement, arising out of polarized reporting of corporate financial news, that generates trade among investors.
summary: 本文比较了保守派《华尔街日报》和自由派《纽约时报》对同一企业金融新闻的报道，发现在报道的广泛边际和集约边际上均存在明显的政治极化。研究表明，这种由政治因素引发的企业金融新闻分歧导致政治最极端公司的异常交易量增加。结果强调了投资者分歧的一个新来源，即企业金融新闻的极化报道，并促使投资者之间产生交易。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统实证了新闻媒体的政治立场如何影响企业金融报道，并进一步影响市场交易行为，为理解投资者分歧提供了新视角。

title: Missing values handling for machine learning portfolios
abstract: We characterize the structure and origins of missingness for 159 cross-sectional return predictors and study missing value handling for portfolios constructed using machine learning. Simply imputing with cross-sectional means performs well compared to rigorous expectation-maximization methods. This stems from three facts about predictor data: (1) missingness occurs in large blocks organized by time, (2) cross-sectional correlations are small, and (3) missingness tends to occur in blocks organized by the underlying data source. As a result, observed data provide little information about missing data. Sophisticated imputations introduce estimation noise that can lead to underperformance if machine learning is not carefully applied.
summary: 本文研究了在利用机器学习构建投资组合时，如何处理159个横截面收益率预测因子的缺失值问题。首先刻画了缺失值的结构和来源，发现缺失值以时间维度的大块形式出现、横截面相关性较小，且缺失往往由底层数据源决定。因此，观测数据对缺失数据的信息量有限。与复杂的期望最大化（EM）插补方法相比，简单地使用横截面均值进行插补表现良好。复杂的插补方法会引入估计噪声，若机器学习应用不当，可能导致绩效下降。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了预测因子缺失值的结构特点，并指出在机器学习组合中简单均值插补的稳健性，对实际应用有重要启示。

title: The governance of director compensation
abstract: The average total compensation of directors in U.S.-listed companies was $342,030 in 2020, 5.06 times the median household income. Directors set their own pay, giving rise to potential self-dealing. We argue and document that in the presence of self-dealing, external mechanisms such as legal standards act as effective means of governance. Following a landmark Delaware court ruling that subjected director pay to a more stringent legal standard, Delaware-incorporated firms reduced director compensation relative to non-Delaware firms and experienced positive and non-transient stock price reactions. Our results indicate that proper governance of director compensation enhances firm value.
summary: 本文研究董事薪酬的治理问题。2020年美国上市公司董事平均总薪酬为342,030美元，是家庭收入中位数的5.06倍。由于董事自行设定薪酬，存在潜在的自利行为。作者指出并证明，在自利行为存在的情况下，外部机制如法律标准是有效的治理手段。继特拉华州具有里程碑意义的法院裁决对董事薪酬施加更严格的法律标准后，相较于非特拉华州公司，特拉华州注册的公司降低了董事薪酬，并经历了积极且非短暂的股价反应。结果表明，对董事薪酬的适当治理能提升公司价值。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验揭示外部治理机制对董事薪酬的有效性，为监管政策提供实证支持。

title: Production complementarity and information transmission across industries
abstract: Economic theory suggests that production complementarity is an important driver of sectoral co-movements and business cycle fluctuations. We operationalize this concept using a measure of production complementarity proximity (COMPL) between any two companies. We show firms from different industries but are closely aligned in COMPL exhibit strong co-movement in their operating, investing, and financing activities, as well as quarterly earnings revisions and monthly returns. We further document a lead-lag effect in their returns, such that a long-short strategy based on recent COMPL peer returns yields a monthly 6-factor alpha of 122 basis points. This inter-industry momentum spillover effect is not explained by other network-based mechanisms, such as shared analyst coverage. We conclude information transmission takes place along complementarity networks, but stock prices do not update instantaneously.
summary: 论文基于生产互补性（production complementarity）概念，构建了公司间生产互补性邻近度（COMPL）度量。研究发现，尽管来自不同行业，但COMPL高度相关的公司在经营、投资和融资活动、季度盈利修正以及月度回报上表现出显著的协同运动。进一步，论文发现了这些公司回报的领先-滞后效应：基于近期COMPL同行回报的多空策略每月可获得122个基点的六因子alpha。这种跨行业动量溢出效应无法被其他网络机制（如共同分析师覆盖）解释。结论表明，信息沿互补性网络传播，但股票价格并非瞬时更新。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地将生产互补性引入跨行业信息溢出研究，并通过可交易策略验证了市场效率不足，为行业间定价异常提供了新的解释机制。

title: Spending Less after (Seemingly) Bad News
abstract: Using high‐frequency spending data, we show that household consumption displays excess sensitivity to salient macroeconomic news, even when the news is not real. When the announced local unemployment rate reaches a 12‐month maximum, local news coverage of unemployment increases and local consumers reduce their discretionary spending by 1.5% relative to consumers in areas with the same macroeconomic conditions. Low‐income households display greater excess sensitivity to salience. The decrease in spending is not later reversed. Households in treated areas act as if they are more financially constrained than those in untreated areas with the same fundamentals.
summary: 利用高频消费数据，本文发现家庭消费对显著的宏观经济新闻表现出过度敏感性，即使这些新闻并非真实信息。当公布的当地失业率达到12个月最高点时，当地新闻对失业的报道增加，导致消费者的可自由支配支出相对于具有相同宏观经济条件的其他地区减少1.5%。低收入家庭对显著性的过度敏感程度更强。这种支出下降在后续期间并未逆转。处理地区的家庭在行为上表现得比未处理地区具有相同基本面的家庭更加财务受限。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用非真实的新闻冲击，分离了实际经济条件与信息显著性对消费的影响，并发现了持久的行为偏差，对理解消费行为中的心理因素具有重要贡献。

title: The Capital Market Effects of Centralizing Regulated Financial Information
abstract: We study the capital market effects of information centralization by exploiting the staggered implementation of digital storage and access platforms for regulated financial information (Officially Appointed Mechanisms, or OAMs) in the European Union. We find that the implementation of OAMs results in significant improvements in capital market liquidity, consistent with the notion that OAMs lower investors' processing costs. The findings are more pronounced when processing costs are high to begin with, that is, when firms (1) are small and receive low business press coverage and (2) have high levels of retail ownership. We then identify a mechanism through which centralization facilitates capital market effects: information spillovers. First, we find that liquidity improvements are larger when OAMs have features that easily allow investors to search for peer firm information. Second, liquidity improvements are larger for firms with a high share of industry peers operating on the same OAM and for firms with a high share of small, low‐coverage peers on that OAM. Third, around the annual report release dates of peer firms, focal‐firm liquidity improves and focal‐peer stock return synchronicity increases. Overall, our evidence suggests that, even in a modern information age, information centralization improves capital market liquidity and facilitates the acquisition and use of peer firm information.
summary: 本研究利用欧盟各国逐步实施官方指定机制（OAMs）——即存储和访问受监管财务信息的数字平台——来考察信息集中化对资本市场的影响。研究发现，OAMs的实施显著改善了资本市场流动性，表明其降低了投资者的信息处理成本。这种效应在处理成本本就较高的情境下更为明显：当公司规模较小且商业媒体报道较少、以及零售投资者持股比例较高时。进一步，研究揭示了信息集中化通过信息溢出效应发挥作用的机制：首先，当OAMs具备便于投资者搜索同行公司信息的功能时，流动性改善更大；其次，对于行业中更多同行在同一OAM上运营的公司，以及那些同平台上有较多小型、低媒体报道率的同行公司，流动性改善也更显著；最后，在同行公司年度报告发布日附近，焦点公司的流动性提高，且焦点公司与同行股票收益的同步性增强。总体而言，即使在现代信息时代，信息集中化仍能改善资本市场流动性，并促进同行公司信息的获取与使用。
ai_comment: 本文利用欧盟OAMs的分步实施提供了信息集中化影响资本市场的因果证据，并创新性地揭示了同行信息溢出这一重要机制，对理解监管科技与市场效率具有重要贡献。

title: Earnings Management via Not-Wholly-Owned Subsidiaries
abstract: We investigate an unexplored mechanism of earnings management: income shifting from not-wholly-owned subsidiaries to help the parent company avoid losses at the expense of subsidiaries. Consolidated net income attributable to the parent company (i.e., net income) increases through this mechanism, as the parent company enjoys the full amount of the shifted earnings rather than sharing them with minority investors. We design an empirical model to directly estimate the amount of income shifted from subsidiaries to parent firms. Employing this measure, we find that firms opportunistically decrease earnings of their not-wholly-owned subsidiaries to manage net income upward to avoid losses. The results are stronger for firms with high noncontrolling ownership, firms with large subsidiaries, firms with strong influence over not-wholly-owned subsidiaries, and firms with a high level of related-party transactions. Our results are robust to alternative research designs, including controls for within-firm variations, alternative earnings thresholds, propensity score matching, and entropy balancing techniques. Our mechanism of earnings management is generalizable to other earnings management scenarios, such as share pledging. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: X. Zhang thanks the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72102243] for financial support. M. Luo thank the financial support from National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71840011], and the Research Center for Digital Financial Assets at School of Economics and Management of Tsinghua University. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03090 .
summary: 该论文研究了一种未被探索的盈余管理机制：母公司通过将利润从非全资子公司转移至自身，以避免亏损，从而损害子公司利益。合并净利润中归属于母公司的部分因此增加，因为母公司独享转移的全部利润而非与少数股东分享。作者设计了一个实证模型直接估计从子公司转移至母公司的利润金额。运用该度量，发现公司机会主义地降低非全资子公司的利润，以向上管理净利润避免亏损。该结果在以下公司中更为显著：拥有高非控制性所有权、拥有大型子公司、对非全资子公司有强影响力、以及关联交易水平高的公司。结果对替代研究设计（包括控制公司内部变化、替代盈余阈值、倾向得分匹配和熵平衡技术）稳健。该盈余管理机制可推广至其他盈余管理场景，如股权质押。
ai_comment: 该论文首次系统研究了通过非全资子公司进行盈余管理的机制，提供了直接估计收入转移的方法，丰富了盈余管理文献，具有重要实践意义。

title: Bridging Theory and Empirical Research in Accounting
abstract: Formal theory and empirical research are complementary in building and advancing the body of knowledge in accounting in order to understand real‐world phenomena. We offer thoughts on opportunities for empiricists and theorists to collaborate, build on each other's work, and iterate over models and data to make progress. For empiricists, we see room for more descriptive work, more experimental work on testing formal theories, and more work on quantifying theoretical parameters. For theorists, we see room for theories explicitly tied to descriptive evidence, new theories on individuals' decision making in a data‐rich world, theories focused on accounting institutions and measurement issues, and richer theories for guiding empirical work and providing practical insights. We also encourage explicitly combining formal theory and empirical models by having both in one paper and by structural estimation.
summary: 本文探讨了形式理论与实证研究在会计领域中的互补关系，认为二者共同构建和推进知识体系以理解现实世界现象。作者为实证学者和理论学者提出了合作机会，包括实证学者可开展更多描述性工作、检验形式理论的实验研究以及量化理论参数；理论学者可发展与描述性证据紧密相关的理论、研究数据丰富环境下个体决策的新理论、聚焦会计制度和计量问题的理论，以及为实证工作提供指导的丰富理论。此外，鼓励在一篇论文中同时包含形式理论和实证模型，并通过结构估计将二者明确结合。
ai_comment: 该论文为会计领域的理论与实证研究提供了清晰的合作框架，特别强调了结构估计在连接二者中的作用，具有重要的方法论指导意义。

title: The Bullwhip Effect in Servitized Manufacturers
abstract: The shift to a service-oriented economy has driven traditional product-oriented manufacturing firms to integrate various services into their businesses. This study aims to provide empirical evidence on how manufacturers’ service offerings impact demand variability and intrafirm bullwhip effects. Through “bag-of-words” text mining on 10-K filings of U.S.-listed manufacturing firms, we propose a novel measurement to identify annual services offered. We validate the measurement’s statistical and economic significance and verify its consistency with the results obtained using the large language model (i.e., GPT-4). Services are categorized as complementing product sales (e.g., maintenance and repair) or substituting product sales entirely (e.g., machine hours). Utilizing difference-in-difference techniques, we find robust evidence that manufacturers’ service offerings reduce the bullwhip effect in two steps: basic complementing services decrease demand variability, whereas advanced substituting services mitigate intrafirm bullwhip. Moreover, servitization mainly minimizes demand variability through information channels, whereas increased production efficiency decreases intrafirm bullwhip. Our findings contribute to understanding manufacturers’ business model innovations by demonstrating that servitization can smooth demand and mitigate intrafirm bullwhip. This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 71931007, 72091214] and General Research Fund by Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant 14505320]. Supplemental Material: The data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01026 .
summary: 本研究旨在提供制造企业服务化对需求波动性和企业内部牛鞭效应影响的实证证据。通过对美国上市制造企业10-K文件进行“词袋”文本挖掘，构建了识别年度服务种类的新度量方法，并通过统计与经济显著性验证，同时与大型语言模型GPT-4的结果一致性检验。服务被分类为补充产品销售的（如维护与修理）或完全替代产品销售的（如机器小时）。利用双重差分法，发现制造企业服务化分两个步骤降低牛鞭效应：基础补充型服务减少需求波动性，而高级替代型服务减轻企业内部牛鞭效应。此外，服务化主要通过信息渠道最小化需求波动性，而生产效率提升则降低企业内部牛鞭效应。研究贡献在于证明了服务化能够平抑需求并缓解企业内部牛鞭效应，加深了对制造企业商业模式创新的理解。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将文本挖掘与双重差分法结合，量化服务化对供应链牛鞭效应的影响，并区分了服务类型的不同作用路径，为运营管理与公司金融交叉领域提供了新视角。

title: Nonperforming Loan Disposals Without Resolution
abstract: Using proprietary data on nonperforming loan (NPL) transactions in China, we document that banks conceal NPLs in disposal transactions that are supposed to resolve NPLs. In these transactions, banks provide financing and retain the credit risks and debt collection obligations. Transaction prices contradict underlying credit risks: Despite being delinquent for 4.5 years, the median NPL package is sold at face value with zero haircut. The majority of NPL packages are resold at a premium to banks’ non–government-owned borrowers, further supporting the concealment view. Banks under stricter regulation conceal NPLs more and engage in more illicit concealment. NPL-concealing banks increase zombie lending, suggesting that an ineffective resolution exacerbates credit misallocation. Recognizing the hidden NPLs implies the total NPLs in China is two to three times the reported amount. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: B. Charoenwong acknowledges financial support from the Singapore Ministry of Education [AcRF Tier 1 Research Grant A-8000760-00-00]. T. Ruan acknowledges financial support from the National University of Singapore (NUS) [Start-Up Grant A-0003870-00-00]. B. Charoenwong and T. Ruan acknowledge financial support from the NUS Business School Financial Database [Grant N-311-000-251-001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02163 .
summary: 利用中国不良贷款（NPL）交易的专有数据，本文发现银行在旨在解决NPL的处置交易中实际上隐藏了NPL。在这些交易中，银行提供融资并保留信用风险和债务催收义务。尽管NPL包平均逾期4.5年，但中位交易价格仍为面值（零折价），与潜在信用风险严重背离。多数NPL包以溢价转售给银行非政府所有的借款人，进一步支持隐藏观点。受更严格监管的银行隐藏更多NPL，并更多参与非法隐藏。隐藏NPL的银行增加了僵尸贷款，表明无效处置加剧了信贷错配。识别隐藏的NPL意味着中国总NPL可能是报告金额的2到3倍。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特交易数据揭示了银行通过NPL处置交易系统性隐藏不良贷款的机制，并量化了隐藏规模，对理解中国银行体系风险和信贷扭曲有重要意义。

title: Innovation and Financial Disclosure
abstract: We examine how financial disclosure policy affects a firm manager's strategy to innovate within a two‐period bandit problem featuring two production methods: an old method with a known probability of success, and a new method with an unknown probability. Exploring the new method in the first period provides the manager with decision‐useful information for the second period, thus creating a real option that is unavailable under exploiting the old known production method. Voluntary disclosure of the firm's financial performance provides the manager with another option to potentially conceal initial failure from the market. The interaction of these two options determines the manager's incentive to explore. In equilibrium, a myopic manager who cares about the interim market price may over‐ or under‐explore compared to the optimal exploration strategy that maximizes firm value. Our analysis shows that firms operating in an environment with voluntary disclosure early in the trial stage and mandated requirement later are most motivated to explore, while firms subject to early mandated disclosure and late voluntary disclosure are least likely to do so. We also provide empirical predictions about the link between the disclosure environment and the intensity and efficiency of corporate innovation.
summary: 该论文通过一个两期bandit问题模型，研究了财务披露政策如何影响公司经理的创新策略。模型中包含两种生产方法：旧方法（成功概率已知）和新方法（成功概率未知）。经理在第一期探索新方法可以获得对第二期决策有用的信息，从而创造了一个在利用旧方法时不可得的实物期权。自愿披露公司财务业绩为经理提供了另一个期权，即可能向市场掩盖初始失败。这两个期权的互动决定了经理的探索激励。均衡分析表明，关注中期市场价格的短视经理相较于最大化公司价值的最优探索策略，可能过度或不足地探索。研究显示，在早期试验阶段允许自愿披露、后期要求强制披露的环境下，企业最有探索动机；而在早期强制披露、后期自愿披露的环境下，企业最不可能探索。论文还提供了关于披露环境与企业创新强度和效率之间关系的实证预测。
ai_comment: 通过两期bandit模型和实物期权框架，创新性地揭示了披露机制与创新探索之间的非线性关系，为实证研究提供了清晰的理论预测。

title: Diversity Washing
abstract: We provide large‐sample evidence on whether U.S. publicly traded corporations use voluntary disclosures about their commitments to employee diversity opportunistically. We document significant discrepancies between companies' external stances on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) and their hiring practices. Firms that discuss DEI excessively relative to their actual employee gender and racial diversity (“diversity washers”) obtain superior scores from environmental, social, and governance (ESG) rating organizations and attract more investment from institutional investors with an ESG focus. These outcomes occur even though diversity‐washing firms are more likely to incur discrimination violations and have negative human‐capital‐related news events. Our study provides evidence consistent with growing allegations of misleading statements from firms about their DEI initiatives and highlights the potential consequences of selective ESG disclosures.
summary: 本文基于大样本数据，研究了美国上市公司是否机会主义地利用关于员工多元化承诺的自愿性披露。通过比较公司对多元化、公平和包容（DEI）的外部立场与其实际招聘实践，发现存在显著差异。那些相对于实际员工性别和种族多样性过度讨论DEI的公司（即“diversity washers”）获得了环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级机构的更高评分，并吸引了更多注重ESG的机构投资者。然而，这些公司更有可能发生歧视违规行为，并出现负面的人力资本相关新闻事件。该研究提供了与日益增长的关于公司DEI倡议误导性陈述指控一致的证据，并强调了选择性ESG披露的潜在后果。
ai_comment: 本文通过大样本实证揭示了企业DEI披露与实际表现之间的差距，并指出ESG评级机构可能被表面披露所误导，具有重要的政策意义。

title: Predictability Puzzles
abstract: Dynamic equilibrium models based on present value computation not only imply that returns are predictable but also generate particular short-term patterns of predictability in asset returns. I take advantage of this to construct a set of tests of equilibrium generated predictability (EGP). I apply the tests to document two puzzles: First, option-implied or realized measures of volatility ought to predict returns but do not; and second, the variance risk premium (VRP) predicts returns but only at long horizons. VRP fails the tests of EGP as the term structure of predictable variation is inconsistent with an equilibrium interpretation.
summary: 本文基于现值计算的动态均衡模型，这些模型不仅暗示回报率可预测，还会产生资产回报率的特定短期可预测模式。作者利用这一点构建了一套均衡生成可预测性（EGP）检验，并应用该检验揭示了两个谜题：第一，期权隐含或已实现的波动率指标本应预测回报率，但实际上并未做到；第二，方差风险溢价（VRP）能够预测回报率，但仅限于长期。VRP未能通过EGP检验，因为其可预测变动的期限结构与均衡解释不一致。
ai_comment: 论文通过构造EGP检验，系统性地揭示了标准均衡模型无法解释的预测异象，为资产定价实证研究提供了新的诊断工具。

title: Measuring the Quality of Mergers and Acquisitions
abstract: We develop a measure of merger and acquisition (M&A) quality using accounting theory. This measure, implied return-on-equity improvement (IRI), quantifies the minimum improvement in the target’s post-acquisition return on equity (ROE) the acquirer must attain to break even on the acquisition price. Employing a large sample of M&As from 1980 to 2018, we find that a high IRI is, on average, less attainable ex post and predicts worse acquirer financial performance. The acquirer’s ROE growth over the first three years after the M&A is 11 percentage points lower for high-IRI M&As compared with low-IRI M&As. Worse high-IRI acquirer performance is observable through higher operating costs, tighter financial constraints, lower investments, and larger and more frequent goodwill impairments. We also find that IRI increases with acquiring chief executive officers’ overconfidence, incentive misalignment, and difficulty in estimating synergies; IRI decreases with acquirers’ financial discipline and due diligence effort. As such, overestimating synergies and managerial incentives that drive overpayment are potential mechanisms underlying IRI’s negative association with acquirers’ post-M&A performance. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01225 .
summary: 本文基于会计理论提出了一种衡量并购（M&A）质量的新指标——隐含净资产收益率改进（IRI），该指标量化了收购方为在收购价格上实现盈亏平衡所需达到的目标公司最低事后ROE改进。利用1980年至2018年间的大样本并购数据，研究发现高IRI平均而言事后更难以实现，且预示着收购方更差的财务表现：高IRI并购后三年内收购方的ROE增长比低IRI并购低11个百分点。高IRI收购方还表现出更高的运营成本、更紧的财务约束、更低投资以及更大且更频繁的商誉减值。IRI随CEO过度自信、激励不匹配和协同效应估计难度的增加而增加，随收购方财务纪律和尽职调查努力程度的增加而减少。因此，过度估计协同效应和导致过度支付的经理人激励是IRI与收购方并购后表现负相关的潜在机制。
keywords: 隐含净资产收益率改进
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从会计视角量化并购质量，揭示了IRI与并购后财务表现之间的稳健负相关关系，并识别出过度自信和激励错配等机制，对并购评估与公司治理有重要启示。

title: A Better Estimate of Internally Generated Intangible Capital
abstract: Internally developed intangibles are not included in reported assets under U.S. generally accepted accounting principles. The omission of this increasingly important class of assets reduces the usefulness and relevance of financial statement analysis, conducted with reported values of equity and assets. Recent studies overcome this deficiency by capitalizing research and development (R&D) expenses to estimate the value of knowledge capital and by capitalizing selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) expenses to estimate the value of organization capital. Those two estimates are then added to reported values for financial statement analysis. For convenience, many studies rely on two rules of thumb and assume them to be equally applicable in all instances: (1) 30% of SG&A and 100% of R&D expenses are investments, and (2) the useful life of SG&A and R&D investments is three and five years, respectively. We propose a more flexible approach by estimating the capitalization and amortization parameters on an industry–year–specific basis. Our modified values of total assets and equity, inclusive of the value of capitalized intangibles, exhibit greater association with future returns and investments compared with as-reported values and values estimated with uniform rules of thumb. We provide a better estimate of intangible capital for the consumers of financial statements. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: A. Srivastava and R. Zhao acknowledge financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada. A. Srivastava acknowledges financial support from the Canada Research Chairs Program of the Government of Canada. A. Iqbal acknowledges financial support from the Canadian Securities Institute Research Foundation and Chartered Professional Accountants (Alberta) Education Foundation. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01703 .
summary: 该论文针对美国通用会计准则下未计入内部开发无形资产的问题，提出一种更灵活的估算方法。传统研究通常采用固定规则（如SG&A的30%和R&D的100%视为投资，使用年限分别为3年和5年）来资本化研发费用和销售、管理费用，以估计知识资本和组织资本。作者提出按行业-年度特定参数进行资本化和摊销，从而改进对内部生成无形资本的估计。实证结果表明，与报告值及统一规则估计值相比，调整后的总资产和权益价值与未来回报和投资的关联性更强，为财务报表使用者提供了更优的无形资本估计。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入行业-年度特定参数，克服了传统固定规则的局限性，显著提升了无形资产估值在预测未来回报和投资方面的相关性，对会计和财务分析领域具有重要贡献。

title: Understanding the Impact of Reviews on Consumer Product Choices Under Negotiated Pricing
abstract: We study the impact of reviews on product choices when consumers can negotiate price. Although prior research has examined the impact of reviews in various contexts, none has considered a setting in which the purchase price is negotiated. We postulate that online reviews affect demand through consumer baseline product preference and consumer bargaining power. Leveraging a unique data set of consumer reviews of new car purchases, we developed and estimated a structural model to decompose and quantify the two mechanisms of how reviews affect demand: baseline preference mechanism versus bargaining power mechanism. Our counterfactual analysis suggests that the bargaining power mechanism is more important than the baseline preference mechanism in explaining how historical price and discount frequency information in reviews affect seller profits. Ignoring the impact of reviews on the negotiated price leads to a biased estimation of the effectiveness of reviews. We call into caution a popular selling practice of using discounts in exchange for positive reviews, as it can backfire when future consumers leverage this discount information to negotiate a lower price. This paper was accepted by Kartik Hosanagar, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.02658 .
summary: 本文研究在可议价环境下，在线评论如何影响消费者的产品选择。以往研究未考虑购买价格可协商的情境。作者提出评论通过消费者基线产品偏好和消费者议价能力两个渠道影响需求。利用新车购买的独特评论数据集，构建并估计了一个结构模型，分解并量化了评论影响需求的两个机制：基线偏好机制与议价能力机制。反事实分析表明，评论中的历史价格和折扣频率信息通过议价能力机制对卖家利润的影响比基线偏好机制更为重要。忽视评论对议价价格的影响会导致对评论有效性的有偏估计。研究还警示了以折扣换取好评的常见销售策略可能适得其反，因为未来消费者会利用折扣信息来压低价格。
ai_comment: 本文创新地探讨了议价情境下评论的作用机制，揭示了折扣换好评策略的潜在反效果，为信息系统的定价策略提供了重要见解。

title: Is Long‐Run Risk Really Priced? Revisiting Liu and Matthies (2022)
abstract: The claim by Liu and Matthies (LM) that their macro news risk factor (NI) prices 51 portfolios (associated with four different portfolio groups) is not appropriate. In fact, their single‐factor model is successful only in explaining the momentum deciles, while producing strongly negative performance for the remaining groups. The pricing performance is more doubtful in the case of the alternative news factor (HNI), as the respective risk price is not identified. LM's conclusions stem from a combination of questionable empirical choices and misinterpretation of their results. Moreover, the NI model cannot explain prominent capital asset pricing model anomalies not considered in their study.
summary: 该文对Liu and Matthies (2022)提出的宏观新闻风险因子（NI）的定价能力进行了批判性再检验。作者发现，LM声称的单一NI因子能够定价51个投资组合（涉及四组不同投资组合）的结论并不成立；实际上，该因子仅成功解释了动量十分位数组的收益率，而对其他组别则产生了强烈的负表现。对于替代性新闻因子（HNI），其风险价格无法被识别，因此定价表现更值得怀疑。作者认为LM的结论源于一系列有问题的实证选择以及对结果的误读。此外，NI模型也无法解释研究中未涵盖的显著资本资产定价模型（CAPM）异象。
keywords: 资本资产定价模型异象
ai_comment: 该文尖锐指出了Liu and Matthies (2022)研究中的关键缺陷，强调了因子检验中样本选择与结果解读的重要性，对长周期风险定价文献的稳健性提出了有价值的警示。

title: Managing Mental Accounts: Payment Cards and Consumption Expenditures
abstract: Does mental accounting matter for total consumption expenditures? We exploit a unique setting in which individuals exogenously receive a new payment card, without requesting one. Using random variation in the time of receipt, we show that individuals temporarily increase total consumption expenditure by making purchases with the new card without reducing spending on the others. We do not observe a corresponding increase in indebtedness. Total consumption expenditure rises even for the least liquidity-constrained individuals. The evidence is consistent with consumers treating methods of payment as nonfungible budget categories, as suggested by models of mental accounting and narrow bracketing.
summary: 本文研究心理账户是否影响总消费支出。利用一个独特情境，个体在没有主动请求的情况下外生地收到一张新支付卡，通过随机变化的时间，发现收到新卡后个体暂时增加了总消费支出，使用新卡购买商品而不减少其他卡的支出，且未观察到相应的债务增加。即使是流动性约束最小的个体，总消费支出也会上升。这一证据与消费者将支付方式视为不可替代的预算类别的观点一致，符合心理账户和窄框定模型的理论。
ai_comment: 利用外生冲击的自然实验，巧妙识别了心理账户对消费的因果效应，为支付方式作为心理预算类别的非替代性提供了有力证据。

title: ETFs, Creation and Redemption Processes, and Bond Liquidity
abstract: We examine a link between bond exchange-traded fund (ETF) creation and redemption processes and the underlying bond market liquidity. Using daily creation and redemption data, we find that including a bond in a creation or redemption basket has a favorable impact on the bond’s liquidity for both high-yield and investment-grade markets. The improvement in liquidity persists during times of market stress with this impact being stronger for redemptions than creations. Our results suggest that ETF mispricing arbitrage explains the improvement in bond liquidity. However, we also find evidence that transaction costs and bond inventory management limit the ETF arbitrage.
summary: 本文研究了债券交易所交易基金（ETF）的创建与赎回过程如何影响基础债券市场的流动性。通过使用每日创建和赎回数据，发现将债券纳入创建或赎回篮子在高收益和投资级市场中均对其流动性产生积极影响。这种流动性改善在市场压力时期仍然持续，且赎回的影响强于创建。结果表明，ETF错误定价套利解释了债券流动性的提升，但同时存在交易成本和债券库存管理限制套利效应。
ai_comment: 本文填补了ETF微观结构对债券流动性影响的实证空白，并揭示了套利机制的局限性，对理解市场压力下的流动性供给有重要价值。

title: Protecting Your Friends: The Role of Connections in Division Manager Careers
abstract: We find that division managers who are connected to the CEO are substantially less likely than others to depart from the firm and are more likely to be promoted. Connected managers are protected when performance is poor, and they display no special ability to improve performance given this protection. Connections matter more in weak governance/incentive environments, and the external labor market and stock market appear skeptical of connected managers’ talents. While much of the evidence suggests inefficient favoritism, connected managers are protected more in peripheral segments, suggesting a possible efficiency benefit in helping to resolve intrafirm information problems.
summary: 本文研究部门经理与CEO之间的私人关系对其职业生涯的影响。利用企业数据发现，与CEO有关系的部门经理离职概率显著更低，晋升概率更高；即使在业绩不佳时，他们也受到保护，且未表现出提升业绩的特殊能力。这种保护在治理和激励较弱的环境中更为突出。外部劳动力市场和股票市场对关系经理的能力持怀疑态度。尽管大部分证据指向低效的偏袒行为，但关系经理在非核心业务部门受到更多保护，这可能有助于缓解企业内部的信息问题，暗示存在潜在的效率收益。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将人际关系与内部劳动力市场效率结合起来，揭示了关系同时存在偏袒和潜在信息协调的双重效应，对理解公司内部治理有重要贡献。

title: Rent or Buy? Inflation Experiences and Homeownership within and across Countries
abstract: We show that past inflation experiences strongly predict homeownership within and across countries. First, we collect novel survey data, which reveal inflation protection to be a key motivation for homeownership, especially after high inflation experiences. Second, using household data from 22 European countries, we find that higher exposure to historical inflation predicts higher homeownership rates. We estimate similar associations among immigrants to the United States who experienced different past inflation in their home countries but face the same U.S. housing market. Consistent with the experience effects model, the relationship is strongest in countries with predominantly fixed‐rate mortgages.
summary: 论文研究了过去通胀经历如何强烈预测国内和跨国的房屋拥有率。首先，通过收集新颖的调查数据，发现通胀保护是房屋拥有的关键动机，尤其是在经历高通胀之后。其次，利用22个欧洲国家的家庭数据，发现对历史通胀的更高暴露预测更高的房屋拥有率。在美国移民中也观察到类似的关联，这些移民在本国经历了不同的过去通胀但面对相同的美国住房市场。与经验效应模型一致，这种关系在固定利率抵押贷款占主导的国家最为显著。
ai_comment: 论文利用跨国和移民数据，创新性地揭示了通胀经历对房屋拥有决策的因果影响，为家庭金融行为提供了新证据。

title: Site Visits and Corporate Investment Efficiency
abstract: Site visits allow visitors to physically inspect productive resources and interact with on-site employees and executives face to face. We posit that, by allowing visitors to acquire investment-related information and monitor the management team, site visits offer disciplinary benefits for corporate investments. Using mandatory disclosures of site visits in China, we find that corporate investments become more responsive to growth opportunities as the intensity of site visits increases, consistent with the notion that site visits yield disciplinary benefits. We also find that the positive association between site visits and investment efficiency is more pronounced when visitors can glean more investment-related information and when they have stronger incentives and greater power to monitor managers. This positive association is also stronger among firms with more severe agency problems and higher asset tangibility. The overall evidence supports the notion that site visits serve as a unique venue for institutional investors and financial analysts to acquire valuable information and serve a monitoring function, which generates disciplinary benefits for corporate investments. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00302 .
summary: 本研究利用中国强制披露的实地考察数据，检验了实地考察对企业投资效率的影响。研究发现，随着实地考察强度的增加，企业投资对增长机会的反应更加敏感，表明实地考察具有纪律性益处。这种正向关系在访客能获取更多投资相关信息、拥有更强监督动机和权力时更为显著；在代理问题更严重、资产有形性更高的公司中也更强。总体证据支持实地考察为机构投资者和分析师提供独特的信息获取和监督渠道，进而改善企业投资效率。
ai_comment: 利用中国独特的强制披露数据，实证揭示了实地考察的治理效应，为信息获取与监督机制研究提供了新视角。

title: Nonstandard Errors
abstract: In statistics, samples are drawn from a population in a data‐generating process (DGP). Standard errors measure the uncertainty in estimates of population parameters. In science, evidence is generated to test hypotheses in an evidence‐generating process (EGP). We claim that EGP variation across researchers adds uncertainty—nonstandard errors (NSEs). We study NSEs by letting 164 teams test the same hypotheses on the same data. NSEs turn out to be sizable, but smaller for more reproducible or higher rated research. Adding peer‐review stages reduces NSEs. We further find that this type of uncertainty is underestimated by participants.
summary: 这篇论文提出，在科学证据生成过程中（EGP），不同研究人员之间的差异会带来标准误差之外的额外不确定性，称为非标准误差（NSEs）。作者通过让164个研究团队对同一数据集的相同假设进行检验来量化NSEs，发现非标准误差相当大，但对于可复制性更高或评级更高的研究，NSEs较小；增加同行评审环节可以降低NSEs。此外，参与者普遍低估了这种不确定性。
ai_comment: 本文创造性地提出了“非标准误差”概念，并通过大规模多团队实验揭示了科学研究中隐藏的不确定性来源，对实证研究的可靠性和可复制性具有重要警示意义。

title: Broadband Internet and the Stock Market Investments of Individual Investors
abstract: We study the effects of broadband internet use on the investment decisions of individual investors. A public program in Norway provides plausibly exogenous variation in internet use. Our instrumental variables estimates show that internet use causes a substantial increase in stock market participation, driven primarily by increased fund ownership. Existing investors tilt their portfolios toward funds, thereby obtaining more diversified portfolios and higher Sharpe ratios, and do not increase their trading activity in stocks. Overall, access to high‐speed internet spurs a “democratization of finance,” with individuals making investment decisions that are more in line with the advice from portfolio theory.
summary: 该论文研究了宽带互联网使用对个人投资者股票市场投资决策的影响。利用挪威一项公共项目提供的准外生互联网使用变化，采用工具变量估计发现，互联网使用显著增加了股票市场参与，主要推动力是基金所有权的增长。现有投资者将投资组合转向基金，从而获得更分散的投资组合和更高的夏普比率，同时并未增加股票交易活动。总体而言，高速互联网的接入促进了“金融民主化”，使个人投资者的决策更符合投资组合理论的建议。
ai_comment: 该研究利用准自然实验方法，为互联网如何影响个人投资者行为提供了可靠的因果证据，揭示了金融科技在促进投资多样化和理性化方面的积极作用。

title: Informational Efficiency of Cryptocurrency Markets
abstract: This study employs variance ratios (VRs) to assess the roles of regulation and liquidity on cryptocurrency market efficiency, focusing on crypto-assets subject to varying degrees of regulation.
