This finding contributes significantly to explaining the equity premium and sheds light on empirical relationships between forecast dispersion and asset prices, the upward sloping real yield curve, and long-term yield movements.
summary: 本文提出了一个纯交换经济的解析解，其中包含连续代理人之间的分歧、时变信息质量以及参照依赖偏好。该一般均衡模型展现了平稳动态特性。通过分析模型含义，研究发现通常研究的分歧的资产定价渠道具有有限的定量显著性。相反，影响分歧水平的信息质量变化导致了显著的股票超额价格波动。这一发现为解释股权溢价、预测分散与资产价格之间的经验关系、向上倾斜的实际收益率曲线以及长期收益率变动提供了重要见解。
ai_comment: 本文创新地分离了分歧与信息质量对资产价格的不同影响，揭示了信息质量变化是价格波动的主要驱动因素，并为多个经典金融谜题提供了统一解释。

title: The Real Effects of Supply Chain Transparency Regulation: Evidence from Section 1502 of the Dodd–Frank Act
abstract: Section 1502 of the Dodd–Frank Act requires SEC‐registered issuers to conduct supply chain due diligence and submit conflict minerals disclosures (CMDs) that indicate whether their products contain tantalum, tin, tungsten, or gold (3TG) sourced from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or its neighboring countries (“covered countries”). Consistent with the reputational cost hypothesis, we find that heightened public attention to CMDs increases responsible sourcing. After Section 1502 takes effect, we find higher demand for 3TG products processed in certified smelters, decreased conflicts in covered countries’ mining regions relative to other regions, and reduced sensitivity of conflict risk to conflict minerals’ price spikes. Finally, we find that conflicts decrease in Eastern DRC territories with prevalent 3T (tantalum, tin, and tungsten) mines but increase in territories with prevalent gold mines. Overall, our findings highlight the real effects of enhanced supply chain transparency regulation.
summary: 本文研究《多德-弗兰克法案》第1502条对供应链透明度监管的实际影响。该条款要求SEC注册发行人进行供应链尽职调查，并提交冲突矿产披露（CMDs），说明产品是否含有源自刚果民主共和国（DRC）及其邻国（“覆盖国家”）的钽、锡、钨或金（3TG）。与声誉成本假说一致，研究发现公众对CMDs关注度的提升促进了负责任采购。第1502条生效后，对经认证冶炼厂加工的3TG产品的需求增加，覆盖国家采矿地区的冲突相对于其他地区减少，且冲突风险对冲突矿产价格飙升的敏感性降低。最后，研究发现刚果民主共和国东部拥有3T（钽、锡、钨）矿的地区冲突减少，而拥有金矿的地区冲突增加。总体而言，研究结果强调了加强供应链透明度监管的实际效应。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证证据揭示了供应链透明度监管对企业行为和社会冲突的实际影响，尤其是发现了金矿与其他3T矿产的异质性效果，为监管有效性提供了重要见解。

title: Judge Ideology and Opportunistic Insider Trading
abstract: Although federal judges are the ultimate arbiters of insider trading enforcement, the role of their political ideology in insider trading is unclear. Using the partisanship of judges’ nominating presidents to measure judge ideology, we first document that liberal judges are associated with heavier penalties in insider trading lawsuits than conservative judges. Next, we find that firms located in circuits with more liberal judges have fewer opportunistic insider sales. Cross-sectional analyses show that this deterrent effect is stronger when managers face a higher risk of insider trading lawsuits. Finally, we find that the Securities and Exchange Commission considers judges’ ideology when selecting litigation forums.
summary: 本文研究法官政治意识形态对内幕交易执法的影响。利用法官提名总统的党派衡量其意识形态，发现自由派法官在内幕交易诉讼中判处的惩罚比保守派法官更重。进一步，所在巡回区自由派法官比例较高的公司，其机会主义内部人卖出行为更少。横截面分析表明，当管理层面临更高的内幕交易诉讼风险时，这种威慑效应更为明显。最后，美国证券交易委员会在选择诉讼法院时也会考虑法官的意识形态。
ai_comment: 该研究将法律政治学与公司金融结合，揭示了司法意识形态对执法效果和市场行为的实际影响，为理解内幕交易监管中的非经济因素提供了新视角。

title: Which Subjective Expectations Explain Asset Prices?
abstract: We present a method for determining whether errors in expectations explain asset pricing puzzles without imposing assumptions about the error mechanism. Using accounting identities and survey forecasts, we find that errors in expected long-term inflation explain price variation, return predictability, and the rejection of the expectations hypothesis for aggregate stock and bond markets. Errors in short-term (long-term) nominal earnings growth expectations explain (do not explain) stock price variation and return predictability. The relevant errors are consistent with mistakes about the persistence of forecasted variables and the response to surprises. A simple framework based on fundamental extrapolation successfully replicates these findings. (JEL G40, G12, G14, E71)
summary: 本文提出一种方法，用于判断预期误差是否能解释资产定价谜题，而无需对误差机制施加假设。利用会计恒等式和调查预测，研究发现长期通胀预期误差解释了股票和债券市场的价格变动、收益可预测性以及预期假设的被拒绝。短期名义收益增长预期误差解释了股票价格变动和收益可预测性，但长期名义收益增长预期误差则不能。相关误差与对预测变量持续性的误判以及对意外的反应一致。一个基于基本外推的简单框架成功复制了这些发现。
ai_comment: 本文的创新在于不依赖特定误差机制假设，直接利用会计恒等式和调查数据识别关键预期误差，为资产定价谜题提供了新的实证证据。

title: Informed Trading Intensity
abstract: We train a machine learning method on a class of informed trades to develop a new measure of informed trading, informed trading intensity (ITI). ITI increases before earnings, mergers and acquisitions, and news announcements, and has implications for return reversal and asset pricing. ITI is effective because it captures nonlinearities and interactions between informed trading, volume, and volatility. This data‐driven approach can shed light on the economics of informed trading, including impatient informed trading, commonality in informed trading, and models of informed trading. Overall, learning from informed trading data can generate an effective informed trading measure.
summary: 本文通过在一类知情交易上训练机器学习方法，开发了一个新的知情交易测度——知情交易强度（ITI）。ITI在盈利公告、并购和新闻公告前增加，并对回报反转和资产定价有影响。ITI的有效性在于它捕捉了知情交易、交易量和波动率之间的非线性和交互作用。这种数据驱动方法能够揭示知情交易的经济学含义，包括不耐烦的知情交易、知情交易的共通性以及知情交易模型。总体而言，从知情交易数据中学习可以产生有效的知情交易测度。
ai_comment: 本文利用机器学习方法从交易数据中学习，构建了一个有效的知情交易测度，并揭示了其背后的经济学机制，为知情交易研究提供了新视角。

title: A q$q$ Theory of Internal Capital Markets
abstract: We propose a tractable model of dynamic investment, spinoffs, financing, and risk management for a multidivision firm facing costly external finance. Our analysis formalizes the following insights: (i) Within‐firm resource allocation is based not only on divisions' productivity, as in winner‐picking models, but also their risk; (ii) firms may voluntarily spin off productive divisions to increase liquidity; (iii) diversification can reduce firm value in low‐liquidity states, as it increases the spinoff cost and hampers liquidity management; (iv) corporate socialism makes liquidity less valuable; and (v) division investment is determined by the ratio between marginal and marginal value of cash.
summary: 本文提出了一个多部门公司在面临昂贵外部融资时的动态投资、分拆、融资和风险管理的可处理模型。模型形式化了以下洞见：(i) 公司内部资源配置不仅基于部门生产率（赢家挑选），还基于其风险；(ii) 公司可能自愿分拆高生产率部门以增加流动性；(iii) 多元化在低流动性状态下会降低公司价值，因为它增加了分拆成本并阻碍了流动性管理；(iv) 公司社会主义降低了流动性的价值；(v) 部门投资由边际现金与现金边际价值之比决定。
ai_comment: 该模型将风险、流动性与资源配置相结合，为内部资本市场的效率提供了新视角，尤其是对分拆决策和多元化成本的理论解释。

title: Fraud Power Laws
abstract: Using misstatement data, we find that the distribution of detected fraud features a heavy tail. We propose a theoretical mechanism that explains such a relatively high frequency of extreme frauds. In our dynamic model, a manager manipulates earnings for personal gain. A monitor of uncertain quality can detect fraud and punish the manager. As the monitor fails to detect fraud, the manager's posterior belief about the monitor's effectiveness decreases. Over time, the manager's learning leads to a slippery slope, in which the size of frauds grows steeply, and to a power law for detected fraud. Empirical analyses corroborate the slippery slope and the learning channel. As a policy implication, we establish that a higher detection intensity can increase fraud by enabling the manager to identify an ineffective monitor more quickly. Further, nondetection of frauds below a materiality threshold, paired with a sufficiently steep punishment scheme, can prevent large frauds.
summary: 本文利用错报数据发现，已检测欺诈的分布呈现厚尾特征，即极端欺诈事件出现频率相对较高。作者提出一个动态理论模型解释该现象：模型中，经理为个人收益进行盈余操纵，监控者质量不确定且能检测欺诈并惩罚经理。当监控者未能检测到欺诈时，经理对监控者有效性的后验信念逐渐下降，导致欺诈规模随时间陡增（滑坡效应），并形成已检测欺诈的幂律分布。实证分析验证了滑坡效应和学习渠道的存在。政策启示方面，更高的检测强度可能使经理更快识别出无效监控者，从而反而增加欺诈；而低于重要性阈值的未检测欺诈，若配合足够陡峭的惩罚方案，可有效预防大规模欺诈。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将学习机制与欺诈的极端分布联系起来，并揭示了检测强度可能适得其反的政策悖论，对监管设计有重要启示。

title: Fee Variation in Private Equity
abstract: We study how investment fees vary within private equity funds. Net‐of‐fee return clustering suggests that most funds have two tiers of fees, and we decompose differences across tiers into both management‐ and performance‐based fees. Managers of venture capital funds and those in high demand are less likely to use multiple fee schedules. Some investors consistently pay lower fees relative to others within their funds. Investor size, experience, and past performance explain some but not all of this effect, suggesting that unobserved traits like negotiation skill or bargaining power materially impact the fees that investors pay to access private markets.
summary: 本文研究私募股权基金中投资费用的变化情况。通过净费用收益聚类分析，发现大多数基金存在两层费用结构，并将不同层级之间的差异分解为管理费用和绩效费用。风险资本基金经理和需求旺盛的基金经理更少采用多重费用表。基金内部，部分投资者始终支付较低费用。投资者规模、经验和历史业绩部分解释了这一现象，但未观察到的特质（如谈判技巧或议价能力）也对投资者为获取私募市场准入所支付的费用产生实质性影响。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了私募股权基金费用中的隐性分层，并强调了议价能力等不可观测因素的重要性，为理解投资者异质性和费用谈判提供了新的视角。

title: The Dark Side of Circuit Breakers
abstract: Market‐wide circuit breakers are trading halts aimed at stabilizing the market during dramatic price declines. Using an intertemporal equilibrium model, we show that a circuit breaker significantly alters market dynamics and affects investor welfare. As the market approaches the circuit breaker, price volatility rises drastically, accelerating the chance of triggering the circuit breaker—the so‐called “magnet effect,” returns exhibit increasing negative skewness, and trading activity spikes up. Our empirical analysis supports the model's predictions. Circuit breakers can affect overall welfare negatively or positively, depending on the relative significance of investors' trading motives for risk sharing versus irrational speculation.
summary: 本文研究市场熔断机制的负面影响。使用跨期均衡模型，发现熔断机制显著改变市场动态并影响投资者福利。随着市场接近熔断，价格波动急剧上升，加速触发熔断的可能性（即磁吸效应），收益表现出负偏斜增加，交易活动飙升。实证分析支持模型预测。熔断机制对整体福利的影响可以是负面或正面，取决于投资者交易动机的相对重要性：风险分担与非理性投机。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了熔断机制的阴暗面，即磁吸效应导致波动加剧，并指出福利影响取决于交易动机，挑战了传统认为熔断稳定市场的观点。

title: Bank Competition and Information Production
abstract: We show that bank competition diminishes banks’ incentives to produce information about prospective borrowers. We exploit the deregulation of U.S. interstate branching as a shock to competition and use borrowers’ stock returns after loan announcements to measure bank information production. Positive loan announcement returns are reduced in states that deregulate interstate branching, especially for opaque and bank-dependent firms and smaller banks that rely on soft information. Existing (i.e., inside) banks reduce information production more than new (i.e., outside) banks after deregulation, suggesting that they do so to deter borrower poaching. Furthermore, the probability of a covenant violation increases following deregulation.
summary: 本文研究银行竞争对银行信息生产（即收集和处理潜在借款人信息）的影响。利用美国州际分行放松管制作为竞争的外生冲击，以贷款公告后的借款公司股票回报衡量银行的信息生产水平。实证发现：放松管制后，贷款公告的正回报显著下降，尤其对于信息不透明、银行依赖型公司以及依赖软信息的小型银行。相比新进入的银行，现有（内部）银行在放松管制后信息生产减少更多，表明它们可能通过减少信息生产来阻止竞争对手挖墙角。此外，放松管制后贷款契约违反的概率也上升。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验设计，识别了银行竞争对信息生产的因果效应，揭示了竞争可能通过减少信息生产损害信贷配置效率，具有重要的政策含义。

title: Loss-Driven Activism
abstract: I show that hedge funds react to unrealized losses on their passive positions by engaging with the management. The hedge fund managers’ psychological response is consistent with cognitive dissonance: They blame the firms’ management and switch to activism. The loss, which is hedge fund-investment specific, is distinct from economic factors such as the firm’s industry-adjusted performance. Loss-driven activism is more likely to be unfocused on specific issues and results in worse firm performance. This study shows that an overlooked consequence of unrealized losses is to trigger an active engagement with the firm.
summary: 本文研究对冲基金如何对被动头寸的未实现损失做出反应，转而进行积极主义（activism）。对冲基金经理的心理反应符合认知失调（cognitive dissonance）：他们将损失归咎于公司管理层，并转向积极主义。这种损失是对冲基金投资特定的，与公司行业调整绩效等经济因素不同。损失驱动的积极主义更可能缺乏对特定问题的聚焦，并导致公司绩效更差。研究表明，未实现损失的一个被忽视的后果是引发与公司的积极互动。
ai_comment: 文章从行为金融角度揭示了未实现损失的心理效应如何驱动对冲基金积极主义，为解释积极主义动机提供了新视角。

title: Wrong Kind of Transparency? Mutual Funds’ Higher Reporting Frequency, Window Dressing, and Performance
abstract: This study examines whether mandatory increase in reporting frequency exacerbates agency problems. Utilizing the setting of the 2004 SEC mandate on increased reporting frequency of mutual fund holdings, we show that increased reporting frequency elevates window dressing (buying winners or selling losers shortly before the end of the reporting period). This effect is driven by low‐skill fund managers’ incentives to generate mixed signals. Funds managed by low‐skill managers experience lower returns, more outflows, and a higher collapse rate when their window dressing is elevated after the 2004 rule change. These results suggest that, although higher reporting frequency on agents’ actions can exacerbate signal manipulations, the related manipulation costs improve sorting among agents in the longer term.
summary: 本研究利用2004年SEC强制提高共同基金持股报告频率的规定，考察了强制增加报告频率是否加剧代理问题。研究发现，提高报告频率增加了基金窗饰行为（即在报告期末前买入赢家或卖出输家），这一效应由低技能基金经理的动机驱动，他们试图发出混合信号。在2004年规则变化后，低技能经理管理的基金在窗饰行为增加的同时，经历了更低的回报、更多的资金外流和更高的崩溃率。这些结果表明，虽然提高对代理人行为的报告频率会加剧信号操纵，但相关的操纵成本在长期内改善了对代理人的筛选。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验揭示了提高报告频率的意外后果，并区分了不同技能经理的异质性影响，为信息披露监管提供了新视角。

title: Can Human Capital Explain Income-Based Disparities in Financial Services?
abstract: Research shows that access to high-quality financial services varies with local income and wealth. We study how financial firms’ internal allocation of human capital contributes to these disparities. Using a near-comprehensive panel of over 350,000 U.S. mortgage loan officers, we document large and persistent differences in productivity and performance. We find that firms’ hiring and promotion practices allocate workers with less experience or poor track records to branches serving low-income customers. Further, the consequences of poor performance differ by location: low sales, bad loans, and misconduct are more tolerated in low-income branches, exacerbating income-based disparities in financial services.
summary: 该研究探讨金融公司内部人力资本分配如何导致基于收入水平的金融服务差异。利用美国超过35万名抵押贷款官员的近乎完整的面板数据，发现贷款官员的生产力和绩效存在巨大且持续的差异。研究表明，公司的招聘和晋升实践会将经验较少或业绩记录不佳的员工分配到服务低收入客户的支行。此外，低销售、不良贷款和不当行为在低收入支行受到更多容忍，从而加剧了金融服务中的收入差异。
ai_comment: 论文利用大规模面板数据揭示了人力资本分配在金融服务不平等中的关键作用，为理解金融歧视提供了新视角。

title: Choosing to Disagree: Endogenous Dismissiveness and Overconfidence in Financial Markets
abstract: The psychology literature documents that individuals derive current utility from their beliefs about future events. We show that, as a result, investors in financial markets choose to disagree about both private information and price information. When objective price informativeness is low, each investor dismisses the private signals of others and ignores price information. In contrast, when prices are sufficiently informative, heterogeneous interpretations arise endogenously: most investors ignore prices, while the rest condition on it. Our analysis demonstrates how observed deviations from rational expectations (e.g., dismissiveness, overconfidence) arise endogenously, interact with each other, and vary with economic conditions.
summary: 本文基于心理学文献中关于个体从对未来事件的信念中获得当前效用的观点，研究金融市场上投资者如何选择性地不同意关于私有信息和价格信息的看法。当价格的信息含量较低时，每个投资者都会忽视他人的私有信号并忽略价格信息；而当价格信息足够充分时，投资者之间会出现内生的异质解释：大多数投资者忽视价格，而少数投资者则依据价格做出决策。分析表明，观察到的对理性预期的偏离（如忽视信息、过度自信）是内生的，它们相互影响并随着经济条件的变化而变化。
ai_comment: 通过将心理学中的信念效用引入金融模型，揭示了投资者主动选择分歧的内生机制，为市场中的过度自信和忽视信息行为提供了统一解释。

title: Leverage Is a Double‐Edged Sword
abstract: We use proprietary data on intraday transactions at a futures brokerage to analyze how implied leverage influences trading performance. Across all investors, leverage is negatively related to performance, due partly to increased trading costs and partly to forced liquidations resulting from margin calls. Defining skill out‐of‐sample, we find that relative performance differentials across unskilled and skilled investors persist. Unskilled investors' leverage amplifies losses from lottery preferences and the disposition effect. Leverage stimulates liquidity provision by skilled investors, and enhances returns. Although regulatory increases in required margins decrease skilled investors' returns, they enhance overall returns, and attenuate return volatility.
summary: 本文利用某期货经纪公司的专有日内交易数据，分析了隐含杠杆如何影响交易表现。研究发现，对于所有投资者而言，杠杆与表现呈负相关，部分原因在于交易成本增加以及追加保证金导致的强制平仓。通过样本外定义技能水平，发现不熟练和熟练投资者之间的相对表现差异具有持续性。不熟练投资者的杠杆会放大由彩票偏好和处置效应导致的损失；而熟练投资者的杠杆则能刺激流动性提供并提升收益。尽管监管上调最低保证金要求会降低熟练投资者的收益，但能提高整体收益并减弱收益波动性。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的高频数据揭示了杠杆对不同技能投资者的双刃剑效应，为监管政策提供了微观基础。

title: Mutual Funds’ Conditional Performance Free of Data Snooping Bias
abstract: We introduce a test to assess mutual funds’ “conditional” performance that is based on updated information and corrects data snooping bias. Our method, named the functional false discovery rate “plus” ( $ {\mathrm{fFDR}}^{+} $ ), incorporates fund characteristics in estimating fund performance free of data snooping bias. Simulations suggest that the $ {\mathrm{fFDR}}^{+} $ controls well the ratio of false discoveries and gains considerable power over prior methods that do not account for extra information. Portfolios of funds selected by the $ {\mathrm{fFDR}}^{+} $ outperform other tests not accounting for information updating, highlighting the importance of evaluating mutual funds from a conditional perspective.
summary: 本文提出了一种用于评估共同基金“条件性”表现的新测试方法，该方法基于更新信息并修正数据窥察偏差。新方法名为功能性错误发现率“plus”（fFDR+），通过纳入基金特征来估计无数据窥察偏差的基金表现。模拟实验表明，与未利用额外信息的先前方法相比，fFDR+能够更好地控制假发现率，并显著提高检验功效。基于fFDR+选择的基金组合表现优于其他不考虑信息更新的测试，突显了从条件性角度评估共同基金的重要性。
ai_comment: 该方法创新性地结合条件信息与多重假设检验纠正，为基金业绩评估提供了更准确的工具，具有重要实践意义。

title: The Equilibrium Size and Value‐Added of Venture Capital
abstract: I model positive sorting of entrepreneurs across the high and low value‐added segments of the venture capital market. Aiming to attract high‐quality entrepreneurs, inefficiently many venture capitalists (VCs) commit to provide high value‐added by forming small portfolios. This draws the marginal entrepreneur away from the low value‐added segment, reducing match quality in the high value‐added segment too. There is underinvestment. Multiple equilibria may emerge, and they differ in aggregate investment. The model rationalizes evidence on VC returns and value‐added along fundraising “waves” and when the cost of entrepreneurship falls, and generates untested predictions on the size and value‐added of venture capital.
summary: 本文建立了一个模型，研究风险投资（VC）市场中企业家在高附加值（high value-added）和低附加值（low value-added）两个细分市场之间的正向匹配。为了吸引高质量的企业家，过多的风险投资家（VCs）通过组建小型投资组合来承诺提供高附加值，这导致边际企业家被从低附加值细分市场吸引过来，从而也降低了高附加值细分市场的匹配质量。结果导致投资不足。模型可能出现多重均衡，这些均衡在总投资水平上有所不同。该模型解释了VC回报和价值增值在筹资“浪潮”以及创业成本下降时的经验证据，并生成了关于风险投资规模和价值增值的未经检验的预测。
ai_comment: 该模型通过引入正向匹配机制，揭示了风险投资市场中规模与价值增值之间的均衡关系，为理解VC市场的无效性和多重均衡提供了新的理论视角。

title: Economics of Information Search and Financial Misreporting
abstract: I examine how investors’ search for different types of information affects managers’ reporting decisions. I distinguish investors’ search for information about firm fundamentals (“fundamental search”) from their search for information about managers’ incentives (“incentive search”). Based on a parsimonious model of misreporting, I predict that fundamental search reduces the earnings response coefficient, which reduces managers’ benefits from misreporting, resulting in less misreporting. In contrast, incentive search increases the earnings response coefficient, which increases the benefits from misreporting, resulting in more misreporting. I test these predictions using an empirical technique that classifies EDGAR downloads as fundamental search or incentive search. Consistent with my theoretical predictions, I find that fundamental (incentive) search is negatively (positively) related to the earnings response coefficients and intentional restatements. I confirm my findings in two distinct empirical settings where the costs of information search exogenously changed: the adoption of XBRL and the electronic filing mandate of Form 4s. Collectively, the results show that investors’ information demand can shape managers’ reporting decisions, and its effects can vary depending on the type of information investors search for.
summary: 本文研究投资者对不同类型信息的搜索如何影响管理者的财务报告决策。作者将投资者对基本面信息（基本搜索）与对管理者激励信息（激励搜索）的搜索区分开来，基于一个简洁的误报模型预测：基本搜索会降低盈余反应系数，从而减少管理者从误报中获得的收益，导致误报减少；而激励搜索则提高盈余反应系数，增加误报收益，导致误报增加。作者利用一种将EDGAR下载分类为基本搜索或激励搜索的实证技术检验了这些预测，结果与理论一致：基本搜索与盈余反应系数和故意重述负相关，激励搜索则与之正相关。作者还在两个信息搜索成本外生变化的环境（XBRL的采用和Form 4电子文件强制提交）中确认了这些发现。总之，结果表明投资者的信息需求可以塑造管理者的报告决策，且其影响因投资者搜索的信息类型而异。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地区分了两种信息搜索类型，揭示了投资者信息需求对管理者报告行为的非对称影响，为理解盈余管理动机提供了新视角。

title: How Does Labor Mobility Affect Corporate Leverage and Investment?
abstract: I develop a dynamic model to investigate how labor mobility impacts firms’ decisions. In the model, firms make investment and financing decisions, hire labor with different skill and mobility levels, and set wages through bargaining. The model predicts that, in response to an increase in labor mobility, high-skill firms operate with lower financial leverage, become less responsive to investment opportunities, and invest at lower rates, while low-skill firms remain unaffected. I confirm these predictions in the data using shocks to workers’ mobility across firms. The results are useful in understanding the effects of labor mobility changes driven by government policies or technological shocks, such as the rise of remote work.
summary: 本文构建了一个动态模型，研究劳动力流动性如何影响企业的杠杆和投资决策。模型中，企业做出投资和融资决策，雇佣不同技能和流动性水平的劳动力，并通过谈判设定工资。模型预测：面对劳动力流动性增加，高技能企业会降低财务杠杆、减少对投资机会的敏感性并降低投资率，而低技能企业不受影响。作者利用工人跨企业流动性的冲击在数据中验证了这些预测。研究结果有助于理解政府政策或技术冲击（如远程工作普及）导致的劳动力流动性变化对企业行为的影响。
ai_comment: 论文通过动态模型和实证检验，揭示了劳动力流动性对不同技能企业杠杆和投资的异质性影响，为理解远程工作等趋势提供了新视角。

title: Who Pays a Visit to Brussels? Firm Value Effects of Cross-Border Political Access to European Commissioners
abstract: This study analyzes meetings of firms with policymakers at the European Commission (EC). Meetings with Commissioners are associated with positive abnormal equity returns for U.S. firms. Firms of the European Union (EU), however, do not experience significant value increases. We identify regulatory outcomes as a channel that can rationalize this difference in value effects of political access. U.S. firms with meetings are more likely to receive favorable decisions in their EC merger decisions than their EU peers. The results suggest that cross-border political access can alleviate uncertainties and alleged discriminatory behavior of regulators in foreign markets.
summary: 该研究分析了企业与欧盟委员会政策制定者的会面。研究发现，与美国公司会面与正的异常股票收益相关，而欧盟公司则没有显著的价值增加。通过识别监管结果作为渠道，发现与美国公司会面在欧盟委员会的并购决策中更可能获得有利决定，而欧盟公司则不然。结果表明，跨境政治接触可以缓解外国市场中监管机构的不确定性和所谓的歧视性行为。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的数据集揭示了跨境政治接触的差异性价值效应，为国际政治经济学提供了新见解。

title: Overconfidence and Preferences for Competition
abstract: We study when preferences for competition are a positive economic trait among high earners and the extent to which this trait can explain the gender gap in income among a master's degree in business administration (MBAs). Consistent with the experimental evidence, preferences for competition are a positive economic trait only for individuals who are not overconfident. Preferences for competition correlate with income only at graduation when bonuses are guaranteed and not a function of performance. Overconfident competition‐loving MBAs observe lower compensation and income growth, and experience greater exit from high‐reward industries and more frequent job interruptions. Preferences for competition do not explain the gender pay gap among MBAs.
summary: 本文研究了竞争偏好是否构成高收入者的积极经济特质，以及该特质在多大程度上能够解释MBA毕业生中的性别收入差距。与实验证据一致，竞争偏好仅对非过度自信的个体而言是积极经济特质。竞争偏好仅与毕业时的收入相关，此时奖金是保证的且不取决于绩效。过度自信且热爱竞争的MBA观察到较低的薪酬和收入增长，更频繁地退出高回报行业，并经历更多的工作中断。竞争偏好无法解释MBA中的性别薪酬差距。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分过度自信与非过度自信群体，揭示了竞争偏好作为经济特质的条件性，为理解性别薪酬差距提供了新的微观基础。

title: Does CFO Board Membership Benefit Shareholders? The Case of Corporate Acquisitions
abstract: We investigate whether chief financial officers (CFOs) serving on U.S. corporate boards benefit shareholders in M&A transactions. We find that acquisitions made by firms with CFOs on boards have significantly better acquirer announcement returns. This is due to the CFO director’s ability to select targets with better strategic and financial fit. CFO board membership can create shareholder value if there are effective governance regimes restraining managerial entrenchment and CFOs’ interests are closely aligned with those of shareholders through equity ownership. Furthermore, sitting on boards enables CFOs to secure more and cheaper financing for their acquisitions.
summary: 本文研究美国公司中首席财务官（CFO）在董事会任职是否有利于股东，聚焦于并购交易。发现CFO在董事会的公司进行的并购公告回报显著更高，这是因为CFO能选择战略和财务契合度更好的目标。当存在有效治理机制抑制管理层固守且CFO通过股权与股东利益一致时，CFO董事会成员身份更能创造股东价值。此外，董事会席位使CFO能为其并购获得更多且更便宜的融资。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统论证CFO在董事会中的价值，揭示了其通过目标选择和融资优势提升并购绩效的机制，对董事会构成与公司治理实践有重要启示。

title: Financing Negative Shocks: Evidence from Hurricane Harvey
abstract: We examine the effects of a severe climate event on local firms. Our data include 8,218 business credit reports and a detailed survey of 273 businesses in the area affected by Hurricane Harvey. Delinquent credit balances doubled in areas with the worst flooding, although nonflooded areas also had significant credit impairments. Only independent businesses showed signs of distress; subsidiaries of larger firms did not. Firms were largely uninsured and often were denied credit postdisaster. Many funded recovery informally, such as through friends and family. Our findings suggest that several financial frictions compound the challenges posed by a severe climate event.
summary: 本文研究了严重气候事件（飓风哈维）对当地企业的影响。基于8,218份企业信用报告和对273家企业的详细调查，发现洪水最严重地区的企业逾期信用余额翻倍，但非洪水地区也出现显著的信用损害。只有独立企业表现出财务困境，而大型企业的子公司未受影响。企业普遍缺乏保险，灾后常被拒绝信贷，许多企业通过非正式渠道（如亲友借款）恢复。研究表明，多种金融摩擦加剧了气候冲击带来的挑战。
ai_comment: 利用独特的企业信用报告和调查数据，实证揭示了气候冲击通过金融摩擦加剧企业困境的机制，对理解灾难后企业融资约束具有重要价值。

title: Retail Trading and Return Predictability in China
abstract: Using comprehensive account-level data, we separate Chinese retail investors into 5 groups and document strong heterogeneity in trading dynamics and performances. Retail investors with smaller account sizes cannot predict future returns correctly, display daily momentum patterns, fail to process public news, and show overconfidence and gambling preferences, while retail investors with larger account balances predict future returns correctly, display contrarian patterns, and incorporate public news in trading. Using performance measures established in previous literature, we find that smaller retail investors suffer from poor stock selection abilities and trading costs, while large retail investors’ stock selection abilities are offset by trading costs.
summary: 利用全面的账户级数据，将中国散户投资者分为5组，并记录了交易动态和表现的显著异质性。账户规模较小的散户无法正确预测未来收益，表现出日度动量模式，未能处理公开新闻，并显示出过度自信和赌博偏好；而账户余额较大的散户能够正确预测未来收益，表现出反转模式，并在交易中融入公开新闻。基于已有文献中的表现指标，发现小散户因选股能力差和交易成本高而受损，而大散户的选股能力被交易成本抵消。
ai_comment: 该论文利用独特的高频账户数据揭示了投资者异质性，为行为金融学提供了中国市场的证据。

title: Book-to-Market, Mispricing, and the Cross Section of Corporate Bond Returns
abstract: Corporate bonds’ book-to-market ratios predict returns computed from transaction prices. Senior bonds (even investment grade) with the 20% highest ratios outperform the 20% lowest by 3%–4% annually after non-parametrically controlling for numerous liquidity, default, microstructure, and priced-risk attributes: yield-to-maturity, bid–ask spread, duration/maturity, credit spread/rating, past returns, coupon, size, age, industry, and structural model equity hedges. Spreads for all-bond samples are larger. An efficient bond market would not exhibit the observed decay in the ratio’s predictive efficacy with implementation delays, small yield-to-maturity spreads, or similar-sized spreads across bonds with differing risks. A methodological innovation avoids liquidity filters and censorship that bias returns.
summary: 本文研究公司债券的账面市值比（book-to-market ratio）对基于交易价格计算的债券回报的预测能力。实证发现，即使对于投资级高级别债券，账面市值比最高的20%债券的年回报比最低的20%高出3%-4%，这一结果在非参数控制流动性、违约、微观结构及定价风险（如到期收益率、买卖价差、久期/期限、信用利差/评级、历史回报、票息、规模、年龄、行业以及结构性模型股权对冲）后仍然稳健。全样本债券的回报利差更大。一个有效的债券市场不会观察到该比率的预测能力随实施延迟而衰减、低的到期收益率利差或不同风险债券间相似大小的利差等现象。本文的方法创新在于避免了可能使回报产生偏差的流动性过滤和审查机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过非参数控制多种风险因素，证实了账面市值比对债券回报的预测能力，为市场非有效性提供了新证据。方法上避免流动性过滤的创新提高了结果可靠性。

title: Political Polarization Affects Households' Financial Decisions: Evidence from Home Sales
abstract: Political identity and partisanship are salient features of today's society. Using deeds records and voter rolls, we show that current residents are more likely to sell their homes when opposite‐party neighbors move in nearby than when unaffiliated or same‐party neighbors do. This is especially true when the new neighbors are politically active, consistent with an animosity between parties mechanism. We conclude that affective polarization is not limited to purely political settings and affects one of the household's most important financial decisions, their home transactions.
summary: 本文利用契约登记和选民登记数据，研究政治极化如何影响家庭的房屋出售决策。结果显示，当对立党派的新邻居搬入时，现有居民比无党派或同党派邻居搬入时更可能出售房产。这种效应在新邻居政治活跃时尤为显著，支持两党之间敌意机制的解释。结论表明，情感极化不仅局限于政治环境，还会影响家庭最重要的金融决策之一——房屋交易。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙地将政治极化与家庭金融决策联系起来，利用新颖的数据发现邻里党派构成对房屋交易行为的影响，为理解非经济因素在金融决策中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Does Central Bank Tone Move Asset Prices?
abstract: This article shows that changes in the tone of central bank communication have a significant effect on asset prices. Tone captures how the central bank frames economic fundamentals and its monetary policy. A positive tone surprise is associated with increases in stock prices and interest rates, whereas credit spreads and volatility risk premia decrease. These tone effects are robust to controlling for policy actions as well as for conventional measures of monetary policy shocks. Our results suggest that communication tone is a powerful instrument of monetary policy, which affects risk premia embedded in asset prices.
summary: 本文研究央行沟通语气的意外变化如何影响资产价格。语气指央行描述经济基本面和货币政策的方式。研究发现，正面语气意外导致股价和利率上升，同时信用利差和波动率风险溢价下降。这些效应在控制政策行动和传统货币政策冲击度量后仍然稳健。结果表明，沟通语气是货币政策的有力工具，影响资产价格中的风险溢价。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从语气角度考察央行沟通的资产价格效应，为货币政策传导机制提供了新证据。

title: Estimating Stock Market Betas via Machine Learning
abstract: Machine learning-based stock market beta estimators outperform established benchmark models both statistically and economically. Analyzing the predictability of time-varying market betas of U.S. stocks, we document that machine learning-based estimators produce the lowest forecast and hedging errors. They also help to create better market-neutral anomaly strategies and minimum variance portfolios. Among the various techniques, random forests perform the best overall. Model complexity is highly time-varying. Historical stock market betas, turnover, and size are the most important predictors. Compared to linear regressions, allowing for nonlinearity and interactions significantly improves predictive performance.
summary: 该论文基于机器学习方法估计股票市场贝塔，发现其在统计和经济上均优于传统基准模型。通过分析美国股票时变市场贝塔的可预测性，证明机器学习估计器能产生更低的预测误差和对冲误差，并有助于构建更优的市场中性异常策略和最小方差投资组合。在多种技术中，随机森林整体表现最佳，且模型复杂性具有高度时变性。历史贝塔、换手率和规模是最重要的预测因子，而允许非线性和交互作用相比线性回归显著提升了预测性能。
ai_comment: 本文系统性地将机器学习引入贝塔估计，不仅验证了其优越性，还揭示了随机森林的重要性以及非线性交互的关键作用，为资产定价领域提供了新的方法论视角。

title: Earnings News and Over‐the‐Counter Markets
abstract: We document significant increases in bond market liquidity around earnings announcements. These increases are attributed to decreased search and bargaining costs, which arise from the over‐the‐counter (OTC) nature of bond markets and outweigh increases in information asymmetry during these periods. Our evidence traces reductions in search and bargaining costs to two sources around earnings announcements: (1) improved access to dealers and (2) increased participation from institutional investors, who can more easily transact with multiple dealers. Overall, our findings highlight a novel channel through which firm‐specific information affects asset prices.
summary: 本文研究了盈利公告对债券市场流动性的影响，发现公告期间债券流动性显著增加。这一现象归因于场外交易（OTC）市场特有的搜索和议价成本降低，尽管同时信息不对称程度上升。具体而言，成本降低来自两个渠道：一是投资者更容易接触交易商，二是机构投资者参与增加，他们能更便捷地与多个交易商交易。总体而言，研究揭示了公司特定信息通过降低OTC市场摩擦影响资产价格的新机制。
ai_comment: 本文创新地结合了OTC市场微观结构与信息披露研究，揭示了盈利公告通过降低搜索和议价成本提升流动性的新渠道，为理解信息如何影响资产价格提供了新视角。

title: Payment Practices Transparency and Customer‐Supplier Dynamics
abstract: We exploit the introduction of the Payment Practices Disclosure Regulation in the United Kingdom (UK) to examine the effects of mandating disclosure of customer‐supplier payment practices. We find that nondisclosing small and medium‐sized enterprises (SMEs) experience a reduction in their accounts receivable by 8.3%, consistent with an acceleration of their trade credit collections. Further, SMEs exhibit fewer financial constraints after the regulation. We survey managers from large firms and SMEs to understand the underlying mechanisms. The required disclosures raise large firms’ reputational concerns and shift the bargaining power between large firms and SMEs. Additionally, the new disclosures compel executives at large firms to scrutinize their own firms’ payment practices, leading to increased accountability and a stronger focus on timely payment among senior managers.
summary: 本文利用英国《支付实践披露法规》的引入，研究强制披露客户-供应商支付实践的影响。研究发现，未披露的中小企业（SMEs）应收账款平均减少8.3%，表明其贸易信贷回收加速；同时，财务约束有所缓解。通过对大型企业和SMEs管理者的问卷调查，揭示潜在机制：强制披露引发大企业的声誉担忧，并改变大企业与SMEs之间的议价能力；此外，新披露要求促使大企业高管审视自身支付实践，增强了高管对及时付款的责任感和关注度。
ai_comment: 本文利用准自然实验设计，巧妙结合实证分析与问卷调查，揭示了支付实践披露法规对供应链中议价能力和企业行为的因果影响，为监管政策效果提供了微观证据。

title: On the Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks on Income and Consumption Heterogeneity
abstract: In this paper we use the functional vector autoregression (VAR) framework of Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024) to study the effects of monetary policy shocks (conventional and informational) on the cross-sectional distribution of U.S. earnings (from the Current Population Survey), consumption, and financial income (both from the Consumer Expenditure Survey).We find that a conventional expansionary monetary policy shock reduces earnings inequality, in large part by lifting individuals out of unemployment.There is a weakly positive effect on consumption inequality and no effect on financial income inequality, but credible bands are wide.
summary: 本文使用Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024)的功能性向量自回归（VAR）框架，研究常规和信息性货币政策冲击对美国收入、消费和金融收入横截面分布的影响。数据来自当前人口调查（CPS）和消费者支出调查（CE）。研究发现，常规扩张性货币政策冲击通过使个体脱离失业来降低收入不平等；对消费不平等有微弱的正向影响，对金融收入不平等无显著影响，但置信区间较宽。
ai_comment: 论文利用功能性VAR方法刻画货币政策冲击对分布的影响，为理解货币政策传导机制提供了新视角，但估计结果的不确定性值得关注。

title: ChatGPT and Corporate Policies
abstract: We create a firm-level ChatGPT investment score, based on conference calls, that measures managers' anticipated changes in capital expenditures.We validate the score with interpretable textual content and its strong correlation with CFO survey responses.The investment score predicts future capital expenditure for up to nine quarters, controlling for Tobin's q and other determinants, implying the investment score provides incremental information about firms' future investment opportunities.The investment score also separately forecasts future total, intangible, and R&D investments.High-investment-score firms experience significant negative future abnormal returns.We demonstrate ChatGPT's applicability to measure other policies, such as dividends and employment.
summary: 本文构建了一个基于公司电话会议文本的ChatGPT投资得分，用以衡量管理者对资本支出变化的预期。通过可解释的文本内容以及与CFO调查回复的高度相关性，验证了该得分的有效性。在控制Tobin's q等其他因素后，该投资得分能预测未来长达九个季度的资本支出，表明其提供了关于企业未来投资机会的增量信息。此外，该得分还能分别预测未来总投资、无形资产投资和研发投资。高投资得分的公司在未来会出现显著的负异常收益。最后，本文展示了ChatGPT在衡量其他企业政策（如股利和就业）方面的适用性。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用ChatGPT从文本中提取企业预期投资信息，为衡量管理者预期提供了新工具；实证表明其预测能力强于传统变量，且具有跨领域的适用性。

title: Misallocation and Asset Prices
abstract: We develop an endogenous growth model with heterogeneous firms facing financial frictions, where misallocation emerges explicitly as a crucial endogenous state variable and plays a significant role in driving economic growth through the valuation channel.The model illustrates that transient macroeconomic shocks affecting misallocation can yield persistent effects on aggregate growth.In equilibrium, slow-moving misallocation endogenously generates long-run uncertainty about economic growth by distorting innovation decisions.When agents hold recursive preferences, misallocation-driven low-frequency growth fluctuations result in substantial risk premia in capital markets and large losses in consumer welfare.Employing a misallocation measure motivated by the model, we substantiate our findings with empirical evidence showing that misallocation effectively captures low-frequency fluctuations in both aggregate growth and asset returns.
summary: 我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和金融摩擦的内生增长模型，其中错配（misallocation）被明确作为关键内生状态变量，并通过估值渠道显著影响经济增长。模型表明，影响错配的暂时性宏观经济冲击可以产生对经济增长的持续性影响。在均衡状态下，缓慢变动的错配通过扭曲创新决策，内生地生成关于经济增长的长期不确定性。当代理人具有递归偏好时，由错配驱动的低频增长波动导致资本市场中大量风险溢价和消费者福利的巨大损失。通过使用一个由模型激发的错配度量，我们提供了实证证据，表明错配有效地捕捉了总增长和资产收益的低频波动。
ai_comment: 本文通过将错配内生化作为关键状态变量，创新地连接了宏观经济波动与资产定价，理论模型与实证证据相结合，展示了错配在解释长期增长和资产收益低频波动中的核心作用。

title: Applying AI to Rebuild Middle Class Jobs
abstract: While the utopian vision of the current Information Age was that computerization would flatten economic hierarchies by democratizing information, the opposite has occurred.Information, it turns out, is merely an input into a more consequential economic function, decision-making, which is the province of elite experts.The unique opportunity that AI offers to the labor market is to extend the relevance, reach, and value of human expertise.Because of AI's capacity to weave information and rules with acquired experience to support decision-making, it can be applied to enable a larger set of workers possessing complementary knowledge to perform some of the higher-stakes decision-making tasks that are currently arrogated to elite experts, e.g., medical care to doctors, document production to lawyers, software coding to computer engineers, and undergraduate education to professors.My thesis is not a forecast but an argument about what is possible: AI, if used well, can assist with restoring the middle-skill, middle-class heart of the US labor market that has been hollowed out by automation and globalization.
summary: 本文认为，信息时代的乌托邦愿景——计算机化通过民主化信息来扁平化经济等级——并未实现，因为信息只是更重要的经济功能（决策）的输入，而决策目前由精英专家掌控。AI提供的独特机会在于扩展人类专业知识的关联性、覆盖范围和价值。通过将信息、规则与经验结合以支持决策，AI可以使更多具备互补知识的工人执行目前由精英专家垄断的高风险决策任务，例如医疗（医生）、文件制作（律师）、软件编码（计算机工程师）和本科教育（教授）。作者的观点并非预测，而是论证一种可能性：如果善加利用，AI可以帮助恢复美国劳动力市场中因自动化和全球化而空心化的中等技能、中产阶级核心岗位。
ai_comment: 本文从劳动市场角度出发，提出AI赋能中等技能工人的新愿景，而非传统替代论，视角独特且具有政策启示。

title: Monetary Policy Wedges and the Long-term Liabilities of Households and Firms
abstract: We examine the transmission of monetary policy shocks to the long-duration liabilities of households and firms using high-frequency variation in 10-year swap rates around FOMC announcements.We find that four weeks after the announcement mortgage rates move one-forone with 10-year swap rates, leaving little explanatory power for mortgage concentration, bank market power, or credit risk.Variation in credit risk does materially affect monetary policy transmission to corporate bonds.Expected future short rates and term premia play a significant role in driving both mortgage rates and corporate bond yields, which explains the Federal Reserve's increased focus on these quantities.
summary: 本文利用FOMC公告前后10年期互换利率的高频变动，研究货币政策冲击对家庭和企业的长期负债的传导。结果显示，公告四周后抵押贷款利率与10年期互换利率一对一变动，而抵押集中度、银行市场势力或信用风险的解释力很小；信用风险显著影响货币政策向公司债券的传导。此外，预期未来短期利率和期限溢价在驱动抵押贷款利率和公司债券收益率方面均发挥重要作用，这解释了美联储对这两项指标的日益关注。
ai_comment: 该研究通过高频识别方法清晰区分了货币政策冲击的不同传导渠道，并强调了预期短期利率和期限溢价的关键作用，对理解美联储政策框架有重要启示。

title: The Role of International Financial Integration in Monetary Policy Transmission
abstract: Motivated by empirical evidence, we propose an open-economy New Keynesian model with financial integration that allows financial intermediaries to hold foreign long-term bonds.We find financial integration features an amplification for a domestic monetary policy shock and a negative spillover for a foreign shock.These results hold for conventional and unconventional monetary policies.Among various aspects of financial integration, the bond duration plays a major role, and our results cannot be replicated by a standard model of perfect risk sharing between households.Finally, we observe an important interaction between financial integration and trade openness, and demonstrate trade alone does not have an economically meaningful impact on monetary policy transmission.
summary: 基于实证证据，本文构建了一个包含金融一体化的开放经济新凯恩斯模型，其中金融中介可以持有外国长期债券。研究发现，金融一体化会放大国内货币政策冲击，并对国外冲击产生负向溢出效应，这些结果在常规和非常规货币政策下均成立。在金融一体化的各个方面，债券期限起主要作用，且标准家庭风险分担模型无法复制这些结果。最后，本文观察到金融一体化与贸易开放度之间存在重要交互作用，并证明仅贸易本身对货币政策传导没有经济意义上的显著影响。
ai_comment: 该模型通过引入金融中介持有外国长期债券，揭示了金融一体化对货币政策的放大和溢出机制，超越了标准风险分担模型，具有理论创新性。

title: Copyright Policy Options for Generative Artificial Intelligence
abstract: New generative artificial intelligence (AI) models, including large language models and image generators, have created new challenges for copyright policy as such models may be trained on data that includes copy-protected content.This paper examines this issue from an economics perspective and analyses how different copyright regimes for generative AI will impact the quality of content generated as well as the quality of AI training.A key factor is whether generative AI models are small (with content providers capable of negotiations with AI providers) or large (where negotiations are prohibitive).For small AI models, it is found that giving original content providers copyright protection leads to superior social welfare outcomes compared to having no copyright protection.For large AI models, this comparison is ambiguous and depends on the level of potential harm to original content providers and the importance of content for AI training quality.However, it is demonstrated that an ex-post `fair use' type mechanism can lead to higher expected social welfare than traditional copyright regimes.
summary: 这篇论文从经济学视角分析了生成式人工智能（如大语言模型和图像生成器）带来的版权政策挑战。核心问题在于AI模型可能基于受版权保护的数据进行训练。论文区分了小型AI模型（内容提供者能与AI提供者谈判）和大型AI模型（谈判成本过高）两种情境。研究发现，对于小型AI模型，对原创内容提供者给予版权保护比无版权保护能带来更高的社会福利；而对于大型AI模型，两者的比较不明确，取决于对原创内容提供者的潜在损害程度以及内容对AI训练质量的重要性。然而，论文证明了一种事后“合理使用”机制相比传统版权制度能带来更高的预期社会福利。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分模型规模来细化分析，并提出了事后合理使用机制作为更优方案，为生成式AI版权政策设计提供了经济学依据。

title: How Learning About Harms Impacts the Optimal Rate of Artificial Intelligence Adoption
abstract: This paper examines recent proposals and research suggesting that AI adoption should be delayed until its potential harms are properly understood.It is shown that conclusions regarding the social optimality of delayed AI adoption are sensitive to assumptions regarding the process by which regulators learn about the salience of particular harms.When such learning is by doing --based on the real-world adoption of AI --this generally favours acceleration of AI adoption to surface and react to potential harms more quickly.This case is strengthened when AI adoption is potentially reversible.The paper examines how different conclusions regarding the optimality of accelerated or delayed AI adoption influence and are influenced by other policies that may moderate AI harm.
summary: 本文研究关于延迟人工智能采纳直到其潜在危害被充分理解的提议和研究的合理性。结果表明，延迟采纳的社会最优性结论对监管者学习特定危害显著性的过程假设敏感。当学习是通过实践——基于人工智能在现实世界的实际采纳——进行时，通常支持加速采纳以更快地暴露和应对潜在危害。如果人工智能采纳具有潜在可逆性，这一论点会得到加强。论文还探讨了加速或延迟采纳的最优性如何影响其他可能缓和人工智能危害的政策，以及如何被这些政策所影响。
ai_comment: 本文的关键贡献在于揭示了学习机制（特别是干中学）对AI采纳最优时间选择的重要影响，挑战了简单延迟政策的普遍适用性。

title: Protective Behavior and Life Insurance
abstract: We study life insurance market responses to Covid-19 using unique national administrative data from Israel on purchases and cancellations of life insurance policies, and an internet survey of Americans' life insurance choices, risk attitudes, Covid-19 perceptions, and vaccination behavior.We see no evidence that life insurance purchases or cancellations were consistent with adverse selection during the pandemic, while we do find advantageous selection.Moreover, life insurance policyholders were more likely to get vaccinated, thus taking ex-post preventive action reducing their pandemic risk.Such positive reactive behavior has not been previously reported in the life insurance setting.
summary: 本研究利用以色列全国行政数据（涵盖寿险保单购买和取消）以及美国互联网调查（关于寿险选择、风险态度、新冠认知和疫苗接种行为），分析了新冠疫情期间寿险市场的反应。未发现寿险购买或取消与逆向选择一致的现象，反而观察到有利选择（advantageous selection）。此外，寿险保单持有人更可能接种疫苗，从而采取事后预防行为降低疫情风险。这种积极的反应性行为此前在寿险领域未被报道。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特数据揭示了寿险市场中有利选择的存在以及投保人的预防性行为，为保险市场在危机中的反应提供了新见解。

title: Human and Machine: The Impact of Machine Input on Decision Making Under Cognitive Limitations
abstract: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies by many organizations has recently raised concerns that AI may eventually replace humans in certain tasks. In fact, when used in collaboration, machines can significantly enhance the complementary strengths of humans. Indeed, because of their immense computing power, machines can perform specific tasks with incredible accuracy. In contrast, human decision makers (DMs) are flexible and adaptive but constrained by their limited cognitive capacity. This paper investigates how machine-based predictions may affect the decision process and outcomes of a human DM. We study the impact of these predictions on decision accuracy, the propensity and nature of decision errors, and the DM’s cognitive efforts. To account for both flexibility and limited cognitive capacity, we model the human decision-making process in a rational inattention framework. In this setup, the machine provides the DM with accurate but sometimes incomplete information at no cognitive cost. We fully characterize the impact of machine input on the human decision process in this framework. We show that machine input always improves the overall accuracy of human decisions but may nonetheless increase the propensity of certain types of errors (such as false positives). The machine can also induce the human to exert more cognitive efforts, although its input is highly accurate. Interestingly, this happens when the DM is most cognitively constrained, for instance, because of time pressure or multitasking. Synthesizing these results, we pinpoint the decision environments in which human-machine collaboration is likely to be most beneficial. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4744 .
summary: 本文研究机器预测输入对人类决策者的影响，特别是当人类存在认知限制时。采用理性不注意框架建模人类决策过程，其中机器提供准确但有时不完整的信息，且不消耗认知成本。完全刻画了机器输入对人类决策过程的影响，发现机器输入总是提升整体决策准确性，但可能增加某些类型错误（如假阳性）的发生倾向。机器还可能促使人类付出更多认知努力，即使其输入高度准确，且这种情况在人类认知最受限（如时间压力或多任务）时更为显著。综合这些结果，研究指出了人机协作最受益的决策环境。
ai_comment: 本文通过理性不注意框架揭示了机器输入对人类决策的双刃剑效应：提升准确性但可能增加特定错误和认知负荷，为人机协作的优化设计提供了理论指导。

title: Fiscal Limits and the Pricing of Eurobonds
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology to price bonds jointly issued by a group of countries—Eurobonds in the euro-area context. We consider two types of bonds; the first is backed by several and joint guarantees (SJGs), and the second features several but not joint guarantees (SNJGs). The pricing of SJG and SNJG bonds reflects different assumptions regarding the pooling of debtors’ fiscal resources. We estimate fiscal limits for the six largest euro-area economies over 2008–2021 and deduce counterfactual Eurobond prices. For the five-year maturity, SNJG bond yield spreads would have been about three times larger than SJG ones over the estimation sample. Hence, issuing SJG bonds could result in gains at the aggregate level. Notwithstanding, our model also predicts that gains may temporarily vanish in periods of acute fiscal stress. We finally envision postissuance redistribution schemes, whereby gains stemming from the issuance of SJG bonds could be shared among participating countries; we argue that these schemes may alleviate the reduction in market discipline resulting from common bonds issuance. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work has benefited from financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [Grant 182293]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4740 .
summary: 本文提出了一种对多个国家联合发行的债券（欧元区背景下的欧元债券）进行定价的方法。作者考虑了两种类型的债券：第一种由多项联合担保（SJGs）支持，第二种具有多项但非联合担保（SNJGs）。SJG和SNJG债券的定价反映了对债务国财政资源池化程度的不同假设。文章估计了2008-2021年间六个最大欧元区经济体的财政限制，并推导出反事实的欧元债券价格。对于五年期债券，在估计样本期内，SNJG债券的收益率利差大约是SJG债券的三倍。因此，发行SJG债券可能在总体层面上带来收益。不过，该模型也预测，在财政紧张时期，这些收益可能暂时消失。文章最后设想了发行后的再分配方案，通过该方案，发行SJG债券产生的收益可以在参与国之间共享；作者认为这些方案可以缓解因共同债券发行而导致的市场纪律削弱。
ai_comment: 本文为欧元区联合债券提供了创新性的定价框架，并基于财政限制进行了实证分析，同时讨论了收益再分配对市场纪律的影响，具有重要的政策参考价值。

title: Liquidity Requirements and Central Bank Interventions During Banking Crises
abstract: This paper evaluates liquidity requirements and public liquidity injections in the context of financial crises, using a model that includes near-money assets. Some key effects are transmitted through liquidity premia and the price of liquid assets, producing a heterogeneous impact that depends on an agent’s holdings of liquid assets. In addition, some agents prefer policies that do not fully relax their liquidity constraints because these policies are associated with higher prices. Liquidity requirements and liquidity injections have the opposite impact on liquidity premia and combining them leads to Pareto improvements that cannot be achieved by each policy separately. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Wisconsin Alumni Research Foundation. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4737 .
summary: 本文评估了金融危机背景下流动性要求与公共流动性注入的效果，使用包含近似货币资产的模型。研究发现，这些政策的关键效应通过流动性溢价和流动资产价格传递，对不同流动资产持有量的代理人产生异质性影响。部分代理人偏好不完全放松流动性约束的政策，因为这类政策会导致更高的流动资产价格。流动性要求和流动性注入对流动性溢价具有相反的影响，且两者组合使用能实现单独政策无法达到的帕累托改进。
ai_comment: 该论文通过模型揭示了流动性政策在不同代理人间的异质性影响，并发现组合政策优于单一政策，对危机管理有重要启示。

title: On the Nature of (Jump) Skewness Risk Premia
abstract: Market skewness risk is priced, but the components of its premium are not fully understood. We propose new trading strategies decomposing the skewness risk premium into jump and leverage effect components, and we analyze the skewness risk premia in the market for S&P 500 index options. We find that the skewness premium is higher when markets are closed than during trading hours, consistently with uncertainty resolution patterns by non-U.S investors; that it increases after left-tail market events; and that it is distinct from the variance premium. Moreover, during trading hours, the skewness premium is dominated by priced jump risk. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: P. Orłowski acknowledges financial support from the Doc.Mobility program of the Swiss National Science Foundation [Project P1TIP1_161875 “Option portfolio returns and dispersion”]. P. Schneider acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [Projects 169582 “Model-free asset pricing” and 189086 “Scenarios”]. F. Trojani and P. Orłowski acknowledge financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [Project 150198 “Higher order robust resampling and multiple testing methods”] and the Swiss Finance Institute [Project “Term structures and cross-sections of asset risk premia”]. F. Trojani gratefully acknowledges support from the AXA Chair in Socioeconomic Risks of Financial Markets at the University of Turin. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4734 .
summary: 这篇论文研究了市场偏度风险溢价的组成成分，发现其定价机制尚未被完全理解。作者提出了新的交易策略，将偏度风险溢价分解为跳跃风险（jump risk）和杠杆效应（leverage effect）两部分，并基于S&P 500指数期权市场数据进行分析。主要发现包括：偏度溢价在闭市时高于交易时段，这与非美国投资者的不确定性解决模式一致；偏度溢价在左尾市场事件后增加；偏度溢价与方差溢价（variance premium）具有不同的特征。此外，在交易时段内，偏度溢价主要由定价的跳跃风险主导。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将偏度风险溢价分解为跳跃和杠杆效应成分，并揭示了其在不同市场条件下的动态特征，为理解期权市场风险定价提供了新视角。

title: Lending Relationships and the Pricing of Syndicated Loans
abstract: Using a dataset on syndicated loan primary market pricing adjustments, we examine whether relationship banks’ information advantage facilitates price discovery in loan issuances. We find that the lead bank makes fewer adjustments to the initial pricing terms of a syndicated loan and shortens the syndication time when it has a stronger relationship with the borrower. A stronger relationship also reduces loan underpricing. A relationship lead bank relies less on information from syndicate members. Exogenous shocks to relationships caused by bank mergers and closures confirm our findings. We contribute to the literature by showing that relationship lending improves loan pricing efficiency. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4730 .
summary: 使用银团贷款一级市场定价调整数据集，研究关系银行的信息优势是否促进贷款发行的价格发现。研究发现，当牵头银行与借款人关系更强时，其对初始定价条款的调整更少，且缩短了银团贷款时间；更强的关系也减少了贷款定价过低。关系牵头银行较少依赖银团成员的信息。利用银行合并和关闭造成的对关系的外生冲击，验证了上述发现。论文表明关系贷款提高了贷款定价效率。
ai_comment: 利用外生冲击识别因果关系，为关系贷款效率提供了新证据。

title: Social Media Alleviates Venture Capital Funding Inequality for Women and Less Connected Entrepreneurs
abstract: Start-ups are increasingly using social media to signal quality and provide information to potential investors. However, the effectiveness of social media on venture capital (VC) financing is likely to be heterogeneous, differing by demographic and network characteristics of the founders. In this paper, we examine whether social media use can improve funding outcomes for firms founded by women and by other people also lacking connections to the investor network, two groups that face greater difficulties in securing VC financing. Using Twitter data and data on VC investment in start-ups from Crunchbase, we explore the interaction effect between Twitter usage and gender and between Twitter usage and the network constraint measure. Overall, we show that social media can mitigate some disparities in financing experienced by these firms through improving information access. We find that this effect is stronger for first-time entrepreneurs than for experienced ones, stronger for attracting new investors than repeat ones, and stronger in more competitive markets. Collectively, these results suggest that social media could primarily help women and less connected individuals obtain financing by alleviating information asymmetry between founders and investors. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: The authors thank Wharton Mack Institute of Innovation Management for funding support. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4728 .
summary: 本研究探讨社交媒体能否缓解女性及缺乏网络关系的创业者在风险投资（VC）融资中面临的不平等。利用Twitter数据和Crunchbase的VC投资数据，分析Twitter使用与创始人性别及网络约束的交互效应。结果表明，社交媒体通过改善信息获取，能够缓解这些企业在融资中的部分差异，且效果对首次创业者、吸引新投资者以及在竞争更激烈的市场中更为显著。总体而言，社交媒体主要通过减轻创始人-投资者间的信息不对称，帮助女性和缺乏联系的个人获得融资。
ai_comment: 研究创新性地将社交媒体信号与融资不平等结合，揭示了信息机制在缓解结构性融资障碍中的作用，对政策制定和创业实践有启示。

title: Predictive Analytics and Ship-Then-Shop Subscription
abstract: This paper studies an emerging subscription model called ship-then-shop. Leveraging its predictive analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) capability, the ship-then-shop firm curates and ships a product to the consumer, after which the consumer shops (i.e., evaluates product fit and makes a purchase decision). The consumer first pays the up-front ship-then-shop subscription fee prior to observing product fit and then pays the product price afterward if the consumer decides to purchase. We investigate how the firm balances the subscription fee and product price to maximize its profit when consumers can showroom. A key finding is the ship-then-shop firm’s nonmonotonic surplus extraction strategy with respect to its prediction capability. As prediction capability increases, the firm first switches from ex ante to ex post surplus extraction (by lowering fees and raising prices). However, if the prediction capability increases further, the firm reverts to ex ante surplus extraction (by raising fees and capping prices). We also find that the ship-then-shop model is most profitable when (i) the prediction capability is advanced, (ii) the search friction in the market is large, or (iii) the product match potential is large. Finally, we show that the marginal return of AI capability on the firm’s profit decreases in search friction but increases in product match potential. Taken together, we provide managerially relevant insights to help guide the implementation of the innovative subscription model. This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4723 .
summary: 本文研究了一种新兴的订阅模式——先发后购（ship-then-shop）。该模式利用预测分析和人工智能能力，由企业策划并寄送产品给消费者，之后消费者再评估产品匹配度并做出购买决定。消费者首先支付先发后购的订阅费（在产品匹配度未知前），如果决定购买，随后支付产品价格。我们研究了当消费者可以展示商品（showroom）时，企业如何平衡订阅费和产品价格以最大化利润。关键发现是，先发后购企业的剩余提取策略相对于其预测能力是非单调的：随着预测能力提升，企业先从事前剩余提取转向事后剩余提取（降低费用、提高价格）；但如果预测能力进一步提升，企业又恢复到事前剩余提取（提高费用、限制价格）。我们还发现，当（i）预测能力先进、（ii）市场搜索摩擦较大或（iii）产品匹配潜力较大时，先发后购模式利润最高。最后，我们证明AI能力对企业利润的边际回报随搜索摩擦递减，但随产品匹配潜力递增。综合而言，我们提供了管理相关的见解，以指导这一创新订阅模式的实施。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了预测能力与定价策略之间的非单调关系，为订阅模式设计提供了新颖的管理洞见，并量化了AI能力在不同市场条件下的回报。

title: How Does Competition Affect Exploration vs. Exploitation? A Tale of Two Recommendation Algorithms
abstract: Through repeated interactions, firms today refine their understanding of individual users’ preferences adaptively for personalization. In this paper, we use a continuous-time bandit model to analyze firms that recommend content to multihoming consumers, a representative setting for strategic learning of consumer preferences to maximize lifetime value. In both monopoly and duopoly settings, we compare a forward-looking recommendation algorithm that balances exploration and exploitation to a myopic algorithm that only maximizes the quality of the next recommendation. Our analysis shows that, compared with a monopoly, firms competing for users’ attention focus more on exploitation than exploration. When users are impatient, competition decreases the return from developing a forward-looking algorithm. In contrast, development of a forward-looking algorithm may hurt users under monopoly but always benefits users under competition. Competing firms’ decisions to invest in a forward-looking algorithm can create a prisoner’s dilemma. Our results have implications for artificial intelligence adoption and for policy makers on the effect of market power on innovation and consumer welfare. This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4722 .
summary: 本文使用连续时间bandit模型分析企业向多归属消费者推荐内容时的战略学习行为，比较了垄断和双寡头下前瞻性算法（平衡探索与利用）与短视算法（最大化下一次推荐质量）的效果。研究发现，与垄断相比，竞争使得企业更注重利用而非探索；当用户不耐烦时，竞争降低前瞻性算法的回报。垄断下前瞻性算法可能损害用户利益，但竞争下总是有利于用户。此外，竞争企业投资前瞻性算法的决策可能产生囚徒困境。该结果对人工智能采用和政策制定者关于市场力量对创新和消费者福利的影响有意义。
ai_comment: 论文通过严谨的模型揭示了竞争环境下推荐算法探索与利用的权衡，并指出投资前瞻性算法可能引发囚徒困境，对理解AI竞争与消费者福利有重要启示。

title: Asymmetric Information and R&D Disclosure: Evidence from Scientific Publications
abstract: We examine how asymmetric information in financial markets affects voluntary research and development (R&D) disclosure, considering scientific publications as a disclosure channel. Difference-in-differences regressions around brokerage house mergers and closures, which increase information asymmetry through reductions in analyst coverage, indicate a quick and sustained increase in scientific publications from treated firms relative to the number of publications from control firms. The treatment effects are concentrated among firms with higher information asymmetry and lower investor demand, firms with greater financial constraints, and firms with lower proprietary costs. We do not find evidence of changes in financial disclosure, nor do we find changes in patenting. Results from ordinary least squares regressions show that scientific publications by firms are positively associated with investor attention toward those firms. We complement these results with qualitative evidence from conference calls. Our results highlight the limitations and trade-offs R&D firms face in their financial market disclosure policies. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Danish Independent Research Fund [Grant 0133-00119B] and the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities [Grant PGC2018-094418-B-I00]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4721 .
summary: 本文研究金融市场信息不对称如何影响企业自愿的研发（R&D）披露，以科学出版物作为披露渠道。利用券商合并和关闭导致的分析师覆盖减少作为信息不对称增加的外生冲击，采用双重差分回归发现，处理组企业的科学出版物数量相对控制组出现快速且持续的上升。处理效应集中于信息不对称较高、投资者需求较低、财务约束较强以及专有成本较低的企业。未发现财务披露或专利数量发生变化。普通最小二乘回归结果表明，企业的科学出版物与投资者关注度正相关。研究还通过电话会议提供了定性证据。结论揭示了研发企业在金融市场披露政策中面临的限制与权衡。
ai_comment: 本文巧用券商合并与关闭的自然实验，为信息不对称影响企业披露行为提供了因果证据，并发现科学出版物作为一种替代披露渠道的重要性，丰富了会计与信息披露领域的研究。

title: The (Limited) Power of Blockchain Networks for Information Provision
abstract: We investigate the potential and limits of privacy-preserving corporate blockchain applications for information provision. We provide a theoretical model in which heterogeneous firms choose between adopting a blockchain application or relying on traditional third-party intermediaries to inform the capital market. The blockchain’s ability to generate information depends on each firm’s data profile and all firms’ endogenous adoption decisions. We show that blockchain technology can improve the information environment and outperform traditional institutions with firms’ adoption decisions serving as a credible value signal and the application uncovering firm values by analyzing all participating firms’ data. However, we also characterize an adverse mixed-adoption equilibrium in which neither of the two channels realizes its full potential and information provision declines not only for individual firms, but also in aggregate. The equilibrium is a warning sign that has broad implications for policymakers’ regulatory effort and investors’ assessment of corporate blockchain applications. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: B. Franke and Q. Gao Fritz gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) Project-ID 403041268–TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency. A. Stenzel gratefully acknowledges financial support from the DFG through CRC TR 224 (Project C03) during prior employment at the University of Mannheim. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4718 .
summary: 本文通过理论模型研究了隐私保护的企业区块链应用在信息提供方面的潜力与局限。模型中，异质性企业选择采用区块链应用或依赖传统第三方中介向资本市场传递信息。区块链的信息生成能力取决于每个企业的数据画像以及所有企业的内生采用决策。研究发现，区块链技术可以通过企业的采用决策作为可信的价值信号，并分析所有参与企业的数据来揭示企业价值，从而改善信息环境并优于传统机构。然而，模型还刻画了一个不利的混合采用均衡，其中两种渠道均未能充分发挥潜力，导致不仅个别企业甚至整体的信息提供下降。这一均衡对政策制定者的监管努力和投资者对企业区块链应用的评估具有广泛启示。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了区块链在信息提供中可能出现的混合采用均衡问题，为理解其实际效果提供了重要理论警示，对监管与投资决策有指导意义。

title: Dark Knights: The Rise in Firm Intervention by Credit Default Swap Investors
abstract: There have been several cases in recent years where credit default swap (CDS) buyers and sellers intervene in the restructuring of a distressed firm. We show theoretically that this can increase firm value. Intervention by CDS buyers solves the commitment problem between equity and debt holders but increases the probability of inefficient liquidation. Intervention by CDS sellers reduces the issue of excessive liquidation while keeping the benefits of CDS buyer intervention. Having both types of intervention decouples the commitment problem from the liquidation problem. Under certain assumptions, the so-called empty creditor problem can be solved, and firm value reaches first best. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4717 .
summary: 本文从理论上研究信用违约互换（CDS）买方和卖方干预困境企业重组的影响。模型表明，CDS买方的干预可以解决股权与债权人之间的承诺问题，但会增加低效清算的概率；而CDS卖方的干预能够减少过度清算并保留买方干预的收益。当两种干预同时存在时，承诺问题与清算问题得以分离。在某些假设下，所谓的“空债权人”问题可以被解决，企业价值达到一阶最优。
ai_comment: 通过理论模型系统剖析了CDS买方和卖方干预对企业价值的双重作用机制，为理解CDS市场对实体经济的影响提供了新视角。

title: Labor Unemployment Risk and CEO Incentive Compensation
abstract: Unemployment risk influences workers’ incentives to invest in firm-specific human capital. This paper investigates the impact of unemployment risk on chief executive officers (CEOs)’ risk-taking incentive compensation. Exploiting state-level changes in unemployment benefits, we find that after unemployment insurance benefits become more generous, boards increase the convex payoff structure of CEO pay to encourage risk taking. The increase in CEOs’ convexity payoff is stronger in firms with more independent and diverse boards, higher ownership of long-term shareholders, and in industries requiring highly skilled labor. Our findings suggest that boards internalize workers’ interests in firms’ risk-taking decisions and executive compensation is one mechanism used. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Funding: K. Zhang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72272099 and 71902115]. Supplemental Material: Data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4714 .
summary: 本文研究失业风险对CEO风险激励薪酬的影响。利用美国州层面失业救济金变化的准自然实验，发现当失业救济金更慷慨时，董事会会增加CEO薪酬的凸性（如股票期权）以鼓励风险承担。这种效应在董事会更独立和多元化、长期股东持股比例更高以及高技能劳动密集型行业中更为显著。结论表明，董事会内化工人的利益于企业风险决策中，而高管薪酬是其中一种实现机制。
ai_comment: 利用外部政策冲击识别因果关系，揭示了员工利益通过薪酬设计影响企业风险承担的机制，为利益相关者理论提供了实证证据。

title: Predicting Bond Return Predictability
abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence on predictable time variations in out-of-sample bond return predictability. Bond return predictability is associated with periods of high (low) economic activity (uncertainty), which implies that violations of the expectations hypothesis are state dependent and linked to features of the business cycle. These state dependencies in predictability, established by introducing a new multivariate test for equal conditional predictive ability, can be used in real time to improve out-of-sample bond risk premia estimates and investors’ economic utility through a novel dynamic forecast combination scheme that uses predicted forecasting performance to identify the best set of methods to include in the combined forecast. Dynamically combined forecasts exhibit strong countercyclical behavior and peak during recessions. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: This work was supported by the Danish Council of Independent Research [Grants DFF 7024–00020B and DFF 9033–00003B] and the Danish Finance Institute. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4713 .
summary: 本文实证研究了样本外债券回报可预测性的时变模式。债券回报可预测性与经济高（低）活动（不确定性）时期相关，表明预期假设的违背具有状态依赖性，并与商业周期特征相关。通过引入一种新的多变量检验方法（用于条件预测能力相等），这些可预测性的状态依赖性可以被实时利用，通过一种新颖的动态预测组合方案来改进样本外债券风险溢价估计和投资者的经济效用，该方案使用预测的预测表现来识别纳入组合预测的最佳方法集。动态组合预测表现出强烈的反周期行为，并在衰退期间达到峰值。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将债券回报可预测性与经济状态联系，并提出了一个实时可用的动态预测组合方法，显著提升了样本外预测表现。其多变量检验方法也为后续研究提供了新工具。

title: The Effect of Managers on Systematic Risk
abstract: Tracking the movement of top managers across firms, we document the importance of manager-specific fixed effects in explaining heterogeneity in firm exposures to systematic risk. In equilibrium, manager fixed effects on systematic risk are positively related with manager fixed effects on stock returns. These differences in systematic risk are partially explained by managers’ corporate strategies, such as their preferences for internal growth and financial conservatism. The early career experiences of managers starting their first job in a recession also contribute to differential loadings on systematic risk. These effects are more pronounced when managers wield more influence, as in smaller firms and firms that do not have an independent board. Overall, our results suggest that managers play an important role in shaping a firm’s systematic risk. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Funding: A. Schoar acknowledges financial support from the MIT Sloan School of Management. K. Yeung acknowledges financial support from City University of Hong Kong and the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business. L. Zuo acknowledges financial support from the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business and the University of Toronto Roger Martin Award for Emerging Leaders. Supplemental Material: Data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4710 .
summary: 通过追踪高级经理在公司的流动，本文发现经理人个体固定效应在解释公司系统性风险敞口异质性中具有显著重要性。在均衡中，经理人系统性风险的固定效应与股票回报的经理人固定效应正相关。这些系统性风险的差异部分由经理人的公司战略（如内部增长偏好和财务保守主义）解释，而经理人在衰退期开始第一份工作的早期职业经历也导致了系统性风险载荷的差异。当经理人影响力更大时（如在小公司或没有独立董事会的公司中），这些效应更为显著。总体而言，结果表明经理人在塑造公司系统性风险中发挥了重要作用。
ai_comment: 通过经理人跨公司流动识别固定效应，巧妙分离了经理人个体特征与公司特征的影响，为高管异质性与资产定价的联系提供了更严谨的证据。

title: High-Speed Internet, Financial Technology, and Banking
abstract: Exploiting the staggered arrival of fiber-optic submarine cables, we show that high-speed internet promotes the role of banks and credit in Africa. Variation within country and across multicountry bank networks indicates that high-speed internet induced a 22% expansion in credit supply. We investigate the role of plummeting telecommunication costs in promoting the bank adoption of new financial technologies and study a specific technology used in the interbank market, the real-time gross settlement system (RTGS). We find that upon connecting to high-speed internet, banks adopt the RTGS more extensively, reduce inside liquidity, and increase interbank transactions and lending. We also observe that high-speed internet particularly strengthens firms in countries with weak preexisting interbank markets. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: This work was supported by a Private Enterprise Development in Low Income Countries (PEDL) of the Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR) grant and Università Bocconi. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4703 .
summary: 本文利用光纤海底电缆在不同时间点登陆非洲各国所产生的准自然实验，实证研究了高速互联网对银行信贷供给的影响。研究发现，高速互联网显著促进了银行的作用和信贷扩张，使得信贷供给增加了约22%。进一步的分析表明，电信成本的急剧下降促使银行采用新的金融技术，特别是银行间市场中的实时全额结算系统（RTGS）。具体而言，连接高速互联网后，银行更广泛地采用RTGS，减少了内部流动性，并增加了银行间交易和贷款。此外，高速互联网对原先银行间市场薄弱国家的企业尤其有利。
ai_comment: 该研究利用外生的基础设施冲击识别了高速互联网对银行信贷的因果效应，弥补了相关领域的实证空白，尤其关注了非洲这一特殊情境。

title: Do Differences in Analyst Quality Matter for Investors Relying on Consensus Information?
abstract: This study investigates whether investors can reap economic benefits from analyzing differences in analyst quality. Although high-quality analysts’ average forecast is more accurate than the consensus forecast for firms with a large analyst following, the benefits of using high-quality analysts’ average forecasts are not economically significant. In contrast, the value of analyst quality differentiation exists in the second moment of forecasts. High-quality analysts’ forecast dispersion gives investors an advantage in dealing with uncertainty by predicting return volatility and providing opportunities for economically significant returns using option straddle and post-earnings announcement drift investment strategies. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivassan, accounting. Funding: A. Rubin and A. Vedrashko thank the financial support of the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada (SSHRC). Supplemental Material: The data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4699 .
summary: 本研究探讨投资者能否从分析分析师质量差异中获益。尽管对于拥有大量分析师跟踪的公司，高质量分析师的预测均值比共识预测更准确，但使用高质量分析师预测均值的收益在经济上不显著。相反，分析师质量差异的价值体现在预测的二阶矩（即预测离散度）上。高质量分析师的预测离散度通过预测回报波动性为投资者在应对不确定性时提供优势，并利用期权跨式策略和盈余公告后漂移策略创造经济显著的收益机会。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地发现分析师预测的离散度而非均值具有经济价值，并提出了可实施的交易策略，为会计与信息披露领域提供了新视角。

title: Deep Learning in Asset Pricing
abstract: We use deep neural networks to estimate an asset pricing model for individual stock returns that takes advantage of the vast amount of conditioning information, keeps a fully flexible form, and accounts for time variation. The key innovations are to use the fundamental no-arbitrage condition as criterion function to construct the most informative test assets with an adversarial approach and to extract the states of the economy from many macroeconomic time series. Our asset pricing model outperforms out-of-sample all benchmark approaches in terms of Sharpe ratio, explained variation, and pricing errors and identifies the key factors that drive asset prices. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4695 .
summary: 该论文利用深度神经网络估计个股收益的资产定价模型，该模型能够充分利用大量条件信息、保持完全灵活的形式并考虑时间变化。关键创新在于：一是使用基本的无套利条件作为准则函数，通过对抗性方法构建最具信息量的测试资产；二是从大量宏观经济时间序列中提取经济状态。该资产定价模型在夏普比率、解释变异和定价误差方面均超越所有基准方法（样本外），并识别出驱动资产价格的关键因素。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将对抗性方法引入资产定价模型构建，为利用深度网络处理高维条件信息提供了新范式，且实证表现优异。

title: Cashflow Timing vs. Discount-Rate Timing: An Examination of Mutual Fund Market-Timing Skills
abstract: We measure the ability of professional investment managers in timing cashflow versus discount-rate news, the two components of market returns. We find that the average U.S. equity mutual fund exhibits cashflow-timing skills of 1.77%/year, but discount-rate timing of −0.87%/year; furthermore, cashflow-timing skills, but not discount-rate timing skills, strongly persist over future quarters. Our evidence indicates that misspecification of market-timing abilities accounts for the failure of prior research to locate talented timing funds. Importantly, we find that value funds outperform growth funds in timing cashflow news, which provides new evidence on the unique skills of value-oriented mutual funds. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4693 .
summary: 本文研究了专业投资经理在把握现金流消息与贴现率消息（市场收益的两个组成部分）的市场时机能力。研究发现，美国股票型基金平均每年在现金流时机上获得1.77%的收益，而在贴现率时机上损失0.87%；此外，现金流时机技能在未来季度中表现出强烈的持续性，而贴现率时机技能则不具备持续性。证据表明，先前研究未能发现具备时机能力的基金，原因在于对市场时机能力的错误设定。重要的是，价值型基金在把握现金流时机方面优于成长型基金，这为价值导向型基金的独特技能提供了新证据。
ai_comment: 该论文通过区分现金流时机和贴现率时机，揭示了先前研究未能发现基金市场时机能力的原因，并提供了价值型基金具备独特现金流时机技能的新证据。

title: Independent regulators and financial stability evidence from gubernatorial election campaigns in the Progressive Era
abstract: Regulatory independence forms a foundation for modern financial systems. The institutions’ value is illuminated by a Progressive Era policy experiment when independent state-bank regulators came under governors’ supervision. Afterwards, bank resolution rates declined during gubernatorial election campaigns for banks supervised by state but not national authorities. This gubernatorial-campaign effect diminished by two orders of magnitude, but did not disappear, after the FDIC became the independent resolver for all insured banks in 1935. In addition, during the Progressive Era, declines in bank resolutions led to declines in business bankruptcy rates, an effect that is not observed in the FDIC era. Our findings indicate regulatory independence can dramatically reduce but may not eliminate politics’ impact on banks and the economy.
summary: 本文利用美国进步时代（Progressive Era）的一项政策实验，考察监管独立性对金融稳定的影响。当时，原本独立的州银行监管机构被置于州长监督之下，导致在州长竞选期间，受到州监管的银行（而非联邦监管的银行）的清算率下降。这种选举效应在1935年FDIC成为所有受保存款的独立清算机构后大幅减弱（降低了两个数量级），但并未完全消失。此外，进步时代银行清算率的下降还导致了企业破产率的下降，而这一现象在FDIC时代并未出现。研究表明，监管独立性可以显著减少但可能无法完全消除政治对银行和经济的干预。
ai_comment: 本文通过历史自然实验揭示了政治周期对银行监管的影响，为监管独立性的重要性提供了有力证据。其对FDIC时代与非FDIC时代的对比分析，深化了对监管制度设计的理解。

title: Quantifying the impact of red tape on investment: A survey data approach
abstract: An important strand of research in macro-finance investigates which factors impede enterprise investment, and what is their aggregate economic cost. In this paper, we make two contributions to this literature. The first contribution is methodological: we introduce a novel framework to calibrate macroeconomic models with firm-level distortions using enterprise survey micro-data. The core of our innovation is to explicitly model the firms' decisions to report in the survey the distortions they face. Our second contribution is to apply our method across seven countries to characterize the distribution of these distortions and estimate the gross domestic product (GDP) loss induced by distortionary red tape. Our estimates are based on a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms whose capital investment decisions are distorted by red tape. We find that the aggregate cost of red tape varies widely across the countries in our dataset, with an average cost of 0.8% of annual GDP. Our framework opens up a new range of applications for enterprise surveys in macro-financial modeling and policy analysis.
summary: 本文研究繁文缛节（red tape）对企业投资的影响及其宏观经济成本。作者提出一种新颖的框架，利用企业调查微观数据校准包含企业层面扭曲的宏观经济模型，核心创新是显式建模企业在调查中报告所面临扭曲的决策。将该方法应用于七个国家，基于异质性企业动态一般均衡模型，刻画扭曲分布并估计扭曲性繁文缛节导致的GDP损失。估计结果显示，繁文缛节的总体成本在国家间差异很大，平均为年GDP的0.8%。该框架为宏观金融建模和政策分析中的企业调查应用开辟了新途径。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将微观调查数据与宏观模型结合，量化了制度性摩擦的经济成本，为政策评估提供了新工具。

title: Disagreement about public information quality and informational price efficiency
abstract: Investors often hold differing opinions on public information quality. This paper shows that such investor disagreement provides a novel explanation for financial market dynamics around earnings announcements. We propose a rational expectations equilibrium model where investors disagree about the precision of a public signal, which separates a pre-news trading period from a post-news trading period. In equilibrium, investor disagreement about public signal precision diminishes informational price efficiency before the news, but enhances it afterward. Consequently, investor disagreement leads to a notable jump in informed trading around the news, a decline in abnormal trading volume before the news and a surge immediately after the news, and underreaction of stock price to announced earnings.
summary: 投资者对公共信息质量常持有不同观点。本文发现这种分歧为盈利公告前后的金融市场动态提供了新解释。作者构建了一个理性预期均衡模型，其中投资者对公共信号精度存在分歧，模型将交易分为新闻前和新闻后两个时期。均衡状态下，投资者对公共信号精度的分歧削弱了新闻前的价格信息效率，但增强了新闻后的效率。因此，投资者分歧导致新闻前后知情交易显著跳跃，新闻前异常交易量下降而新闻后激增，以及股价对公告盈利反应不足。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将投资者对公共信息质量的分歧引入价格效率分析，揭示了其对市场动态的非对称影响，为理解公告前后的交易特征提供了理论依据。

title: Why did shareholder liability disappear?
abstract: Why did shareholder liability disappear? We address this question by looking at its use by British insurance companies until its complete disappearance. We explore three possible explanations for its demise: (1) regulation and government-provided policyholder protection meant that it was no longer required; (2) it had become de facto limited; and (3) shareholders saw an opportunity to expunge something they disliked when insurance companies grew in size. Using hand-collected archival data, our findings suggest investors attached a risk premium to companies with shareholder liability, and it was phased out as insurance companies expanded, which meant that they were better able to pool risks.
summary: 本文研究了股东责任为何消失，以英国保险公司直至完全消失的过程为对象。作者探讨了三种可能的解释：监管与政府提供的保单持有人保护使其不再必要、股东责任事实上已变为有限责任、以及股东在保险公司规模扩张时借机消除他们不喜欢的责任。通过手工收集的档案数据，研究发现投资者对承担股东责任的公司要求风险溢价，而随着保险公司规模扩大、风险分散能力增强，股东责任逐渐被淘汰。
ai_comment: 利用手工收集的历史数据，为责任形式的演变提供了实证证据，补充了法律与金融交叉领域的文献。

title: Stress tests and model monoculture
abstract: We study whether regulators should reveal stress test results that contain imperfect information about banks' financial health. Although disclosure restores market confidence in banks, it misclassifies some healthy banks as risky. This encourages banks to choose portfolios deemed safe by regulators, leading to model monoculture and making the financial system less diversified. Under the ex-ante optimal disclosure policy, the regulator addresses this tradeoff by fully revealing stress test results when adverse selection is very severe or very mild, but never disclosing the results otherwise.
summary: 本文研究监管者是否应披露包含银行财务健康不完美信息的压力测试结果。虽然披露能恢复市场对银行的信心，但也会错误地将一些健康银行归类为高风险。这促使银行选择监管者视为安全的投资组合，导致模型单一化，降低金融系统的多样性。在事前最优披露政策下，监管者会权衡这一取舍：当逆向选择非常严重或非常轻微时，完全披露压力测试结果；否则，从不披露。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将模型单一化成本纳入压力测试披露决策的权衡分析，为监管透明度设计提供了新的理论视角，对防范系统性风险具有重要政策含义。

title: Learning about the consumption risk exposure of firms
