abstract: We structurally estimate an investment-based asset pricing model, in which firms' exposure to macroeconomic risk is unknown. Bayesian beliefs about this parameter are updated from firms' and industry peers' comovement between their productivity and consumption growth. The model implies that discount rates rise endogenously with the perceived risk exposure of firms, thereby depressing investment and valuation ratios. We test these predictions in the data and find strong support for them. We also confirm that cross-sectional learning from peers is crucial and that alternative Bayesian risk estimates, which ignore peer observations, do not predict firm variables.
summary: 本文通过结构估计一个基于投资的资产定价模型，其中公司对宏观经济风险的暴露是未知的。贝叶斯信念关于这一参数从公司和行业同行的生产率与消费增长之间的联动中更新。模型隐含折现率随感知风险暴露内生上升，从而抑制投资和估值比率。数据检验支持这些预测。研究还确认了跨部门从同行学习至关重要，而忽略同行观察的替代贝叶斯风险估计不能预测公司变量。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构估计和贝叶斯学习刻画公司风险暴露的动态更新，并强调同行信息的关键作用，为理解公司投资和估值提供新视角。

title: Delayed crises and slow recoveries
abstract: We present a rational expectations model of credit-driven crises, providing a new perspective to explain why credit booms can lead to severe financial crises and aftermath slow economic recoveries. In our model economy, banks can operate in two types of business. They are sequentially aware of the deterioration of fundamentals of the speculative business and decide whether to continue credit extension in that business or liquidate capital and move into the traditional business. However, because individual banks face uncertainty about how many of their peers have been aware, they rationally choose to extend credit in the speculative business for a longer time than is socially optimal, leading to an over-delayed crisis and consequently more banks being caught by the crisis. This in turn renders the financial crisis more severe and the subsequent economic recovery slower. Extending to a standard textbook macroeconomic growth setting, our model also generates rich dynamics of economic booms, slowdowns, crashes, and recoveries.
summary: 本文提出了一个信贷驱动危机的理性预期模型，为解释信贷繁荣为何导致严重金融危机及随后的缓慢经济复苏提供了新视角。模型中，银行可经营投机性和传统两种业务，它们逐步意识到投机业务基本面的恶化，并决定是继续信贷还是清算资本转向传统业务。由于个别银行面临其他银行是否已意识到问题的信息不确定性，它们理性地选择比社会最优水平更长时间地延长投机信贷，导致危机过度延迟，进而使更多银行陷入危机，加剧金融危机严重性并拖慢复苏。将该模型拓展至标准教科书宏观经济增长框架后，还能生成经济繁荣、放缓、崩溃和复苏的丰富动态。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入银行间的信息不确定性，创新地解释了危机延迟和严重性加剧的内在机制，为理解信贷繁荣后的经济衰退与复苏提供了新洞见。

title: Factor Model Comparisons with Conditioning Information
abstract: We develop methods for testing factor models when the weights in portfolios of factors and test assets can vary with lagged information. We derive and evaluate consistent standard errors and finite sample bias adjustments for unconditional maximum squared Sharpe ratios and their differences. Bias adjustment using a second-order approximation performs well. We derive optimal zero-beta rates for models with dynamically trading portfolios. Factor models’ Sharpe ratios are larger but standard test asset portfolios’ maximum Sharpe ratios are larger still when there is dynamic trading. As a result, most of the popular factor models are rejected.
summary: 本文开发了在因子和测试资产组合权重可随滞后信息变动时，比较因子模型的方法。推导并评估了无条件最大平方夏普比率及其差异的一致标准误和有限样本偏差调整，发现使用二阶近似的偏差调整效果良好。进一步推导了动态交易组合模型的最优零贝塔率。实证结果表明，动态交易下因子模型的夏普比率更大，但标准测试资产组合的最大夏普比率更大，导致大多数流行因子模型被拒绝。
ai_comment: 该文为因子模型比较提供了处理条件信息的稳健方法，揭示了动态交易对模型检验的关键影响，挑战了现有因子模型的有效性。

title: Missing Data in Asset Pricing Panels
abstract: We propose a simple and computationally attractive method to deal with missing data in in cross-sectional asset pricing using conditional mean imputations and weighted least squares, cast in a generalized method of moments (GMM) framework. This method allows us to use all observations with observed returns; it results in valid inference; and it can be applied in nonlinear and high-dimensional settings. In simulations, we find it performs almost as well as the efficient but computationally costly GMM estimator. We apply our procedure to a large panel of return predictors and find that it leads to improved out-of-sample predictability.
summary: 本文提出了一种简单且计算高效的方法来处理截面资产定价中的缺失数据问题，该方法基于条件均值插补和加权最小二乘，并嵌入广义矩估计（GMM）框架。该方法允许使用所有观测到回报的样本，保证推断的有效性，并适用于非线性和高维设定。模拟结果表明，该方法的性能与高效但计算成本高昂的GMM估计量几乎相当。将该方法应用于一个大型回报预测因子面板数据后，样本外可预测性得到改善。
ai_comment: 本文提出的方法兼具简单性和计算优势，为资产定价中常见的缺失数据问题提供了实用的解决方案，尤其在处理大规模面板数据时表现出色。

title: Foreign Exchange Fixings and Returns around the Clock
abstract: The U.S. dollar appreciates in the run‐up to foreign exchange (FX) fixes and depreciates thereafter, tracing a W ‐shaped return pattern around the clock. Return reversals for the top nine traded currencies over a 21‐year period are pervasive and highly statistically significant, and they imply daily swings of more than one billion U.S. dollars based on spot volumes. Using natural experiments, we document the existence of a published reference rate determines the timing of intraday return reversals. We present evidence consistent with an inventory risk explanation whereby FX dealers intermediate unconditional demand for U.S. dollars at the fixes.
summary: 该论文研究了外汇定盘（FX fixes）前后美元汇率的变化，发现美元在定盘前升值、定盘后贬值，形成全天候的W型收益模式。基于21年间九种主要交易货币的数据，这种收益逆转现象普遍存在且统计上高度显著，根据即期交易量计算，每日波动超过十亿美元。通过自然实验，作者证明了公布的参考利率决定了日内收益逆转的时间。证据与一种库存风险解释一致，即外汇交易商在定盘时为应对美元的无条件需求而进行中介操作。
ai_comment: 该论文通过大样本数据揭示了外汇定盘前后稳定且显著的美元收益反转模式，并结合自然实验和库存风险理论提供了机制解释，对理解外汇市场微观结构和定价具有重要贡献。

title: Lender Automation and Racial Disparities in Credit Access
abstract: Process automation reduces racial disparities in credit access by enabling smaller loans, broadening banks' geographic reach, and removing human biases from decision making. We document these findings in the context of the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), where private lenders faced no credit risk but decided which firms to serve. Black‐owned firms obtained PPP loans primarily from automated fintech lenders, especially in areas with high racial animus. After traditional banks automated their loan processing procedures, their PPP lending to Black‐owned firms increased. Our findings cannot be fully explained by racial differences in loan application behaviors, preexisting banking relationships, firm performance, or fraud rates.
summary: 本文研究贷款处理自动化对信贷获取中种族差异的影响。利用薪酬保护计划（PPP）的数据，其中私人贷款机构不承担信用风险但决定服务哪些企业，发现自动处理小额贷款、扩大银行地理覆盖范围、消除人为偏见能减少种族差异。黑人拥有的企业主要从自动化金融科技贷款机构获得PPP贷款，尤其在种族敌意高的地区。传统银行自动化贷款处理流程后，向黑人企业的PPP贷款增加。这些发现不能用种族差异的贷款申请行为、既有银行关系、企业绩效或欺诈率来完全解释。
ai_comment: 本文利用PPP的自然实验，巧妙区分了信用风险和人为偏见的影响，为自动化如何缓解种族不平等提供了有力证据。

title: Holding Period Effects in Dividend Strip Returns
abstract: We estimate short-term dividend strip prices from 27 years of S&P 500 index options data (1996-2022). We use option-implied interest rates when estimating strip prices and longer holding period returns to mitigate measurement error. We find that Sharpe ratios for short-term strips are similar to or higher than Sharpe ratios for the market. Short-term strips also have a low market beta and a positive alpha. Over the business cycle, realized term premiums (ie, the difference between market and strip returns) and the term structure of Sharpe ratios move countercyclically, whereas the term structure of alphas moves procyclically.
summary: 该论文利用27年（1996-2022）的S&P 500指数期权数据估计短期股息剥离价格。在估计过程中，采用期权隐含利率来计算剥离价格和长期持有期收益率，以减轻测量误差。研究发现，短期股息剥离的夏普比率与市场整体相似或更高，同时具有低市场贝塔和正阿尔法。此外，实现期限溢价（即市场收益率与剥离收益率之差）和夏普比率期限结构呈现逆周期变化，而阿尔法期限结构则表现出顺周期特征。
ai_comment: 利用期权隐含利率改进测量误差，揭示了短期股息剥离独特的风险收益特征及其与商业周期的关系，为资产定价文献提供了新证据。

title: Construction, Real Uncertainty, and Stock-Level Investment Anomalies
abstract: We show that the negative relation between real investments and future stock returns is primarily driven by the subsample of firms building additional capacity. We develop a real options model to rationalize that evidence based on the premise that firms need to learn how to best operate modern capacity vintages, inducing idiosyncratic uncertainty in that capacity’s production costs over the learning period. Conversely, the uncertainty lowers the expected return of firms with newly built capacity until it is resolved. Further evidence based on profit sensitivities to aggregate conditions; analyst forecast-error volatilities; and high- versus low-tech industry subsamples supports our uncertainty explanation.
summary: 论文发现实际投资与未来股票收益之间的负相关关系主要由增加产能的公司子样本驱动。作者构建了一个实物期权模型，基于一个前提：企业需要学习如何最优地操作现代产能，导致产能生产成本的异质性不确定性在学习期内存在。这种不确定性降低了新产能公司的预期收益，直到不确定性被消除。进一步的证据基于利润对宏观条件的敏感性、分析师预测误差波动以及高技术与低技术行业子样本，支持了不确定性解释。
ai_comment: 本文从学习不确定性角度解释了实际投资与股票收益的负向关系，丰富了实物期权理论的应用，并提供了强有力的实证支持。

title: Using Social Media to Identify the Effects of Congressional Viewpoints on Asset Prices
abstract: We use a high-frequency identification approach to document that individual politicians affect asset prices. We exploit the regular flow of viewpoints contained in Congress members’ tweets. Supportive (critical) tweets increase (decrease) the stock prices of the targeted firm and the corresponding industry in minutes around the tweet. The bulk of the stock price effects is concentrated in the tweets revealing news about future legislative action. The effects are amplified around committee meeting days, especially when the tweet originates from committee members and influential politicians. Overall, we show that Congress members’ social media accounts are an important source of political news.
summary: 本文采用高频识别方法，系统性地研究了美国国会议员的推文如何影响资产价格。通过分析推文内容，发现支持性推文在发布后数分钟内会推高目标公司及其所在行业的股价，而批评性推文则导致股价下跌。这种价格效应主要集中在对未来立法行动透露信息的推文中，且在委员会会议日、尤其是当推文来自委员会成员或具有影响力的政治家时更为显著。研究结果表明，国会议员的社交媒体账号是政治新闻的重要来源，能够直接影响金融市场。
ai_comment: 该论文利用高频数据创新地识别了政治观点对资产价格的因果效应，揭示了社交媒体作为政治新闻传播渠道的金融市场影响力，为政治经济与资产定价交叉领域提供了新视角。

title: The Effect of Carbon Pricing on Firm Emissions: Evidence from the Swedish CO2 Tax
abstract: Sweden was one of the first countries to introduce a carbon tax back in 1991. We assemble a unique data set tracking CO2 emissions from Swedish manufacturing firms over 26 years to estimate the impact of carbon pricing on firm-level emission intensities. We estimate an emission-to-pricing elasticity of around two, with substantial heterogeneity across subsectors and firms, where higher abatement costs and tighter financial constraints are associated with lower elasticities. A simple calibration suggests that 2015 CO2 emissions from Swedish manufacturing would have been roughly 30% higher without carbon pricing.
summary: 瑞典于1991年率先引入碳税。本文利用覆盖瑞典制造业企业26年二氧化碳排放的独特数据集，估计碳定价对企业排放强度的影响。研究发现排放对定价的弹性约为2，且不同子行业和企业之间存在显著异质性：减排成本较高和财务约束较紧的企业弹性较低。简单校准表明，如果没有碳定价，2015年瑞典制造业的二氧化碳排放量将高出约30%。
ai_comment: 利用长达26年的企业级面板数据提供了碳税减排效果的直接证据，弹性估计和异质性分析对政策设计具有重要参考价值。

title: Corporate Climate Risk: Measurements and Responses
abstract: This paper conducts a textual analysis of earnings call transcripts to quantify climate risk exposure at the firm level. We construct dictionaries that measure physical and transition climate risks separately and identify firms that proactively respond to climate risks. Our validation analysis shows that our measures capture firm-level variations in respective climate risk exposure. Firms facing high transition risk, especially those that do not proactively respond, have been valued at a discount in recent years as aggregate investor attention to climate-related issues has been increasing. We document differences in how firms respond through investment, green innovation, and employment when facing high climate risk exposure.
summary: 本文通过对财报电话会议记录进行文本分析，量化企业层面的气候风险暴露。作者构建了分别衡量物理风险和转型风险的词典，并识别出主动应对气候风险的企业。验证分析表明，这些测量指标能够捕捉企业在各自气候风险暴露上的差异。近年来，随着投资者对气候问题的整体关注度上升，面临高转型风险的企业，尤其是那些没有主动应对的企业，其估值出现折价。此外，本文还揭示了企业在面对高气候风险暴露时，在投资、绿色创新和就业方面作出不同应对方式的差异。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地通过文本分析构建了企业层面的气候风险度量，区分了物理和转型两种风险类型，并提供了投资者关注影响企业估值的实证证据，对ESG投资和风险管理具有重要参考价值。

title: Occupational Licensing and Minority Participation in Professional Labor Markets
abstract: We examine the staggered adoption of additional educational requirements (“150‐hour rule”) for Certified Public Accountants (“CPAs”) to understand the effects of occupational licensing on minority participation in professional labor markets. The 150‐hour rule increased the educational requirement for CPAs from 120 to 150 credit hours, effectively adding a fifth year of study. We find a 13% greater entry decline following the requirement's enactment for minority than nonminority CPA candidates. Our analyses of parental income and financial aid availability point to a socioeconomic status channel explaining the differential entry declines. Studying exam passing patterns, professional misconduct, and job postings we find a deterioration, or at best, no change in CPA quality following enactment.
summary: 该论文研究了职业许可对少数族裔在专业劳动力市场中参与的影响，以注册会计师（CPA）的150小时规则为例。该规则将CPA的教育要求从120学分增加到150学分，实际上增加了第五年的学习。研究发现，规则实施后，少数族裔CPA候选人的进入率比非少数族裔下降了13%更多。通过对父母收入和财政援助可获得性的分析，揭示了社会经济地位渠道解释了这种差异性的进入下降。进一步研究考试通过模式、职业不当行为和招聘信息，发现规则实施后CPA质量下降或没有变化。
ai_comment: 本文通过交错采用规则的自然实验，清晰揭示了职业许可对少数族裔的不成比例影响，并提供了社会经济地位机制的解释，对政策制定有重要启示。

title: How Integrated are Credit and Equity Markets? Evidence from Index Options
abstract: We study the extent to which credit index (CDX) options are priced consistent with S&P 500 (SPX) equity index options. We derive analytical expressions for CDX and SPX options within a structural credit‐risk model with stochastic volatility and jumps using new results for pricing compound options via multivariate affine transform analysis. The model captures many aspects of the joint dynamics of CDX and SPX options. However, it cannot reconcile the relative levels of option prices, suggesting that credit and equity markets are not fully integrated. A strategy of selling CDX volatility yields significantly higher excess returns than selling SPX volatility.
summary: 本文研究信用指数(CDX)期权与标普500(SPX)股票指数期权的定价整合程度。利用包含随机波动率和跳跃的结构信用风险模型，通过多变量仿射变换分析推导出CDX和SPX期权的解析表达式。该模型能捕捉两者联合动态的许多特征，但无法解释期权价格的相对水平，表明信用市场和股票市场并未完全整合。此外，卖出CDX波动率的策略相比卖出SPX波动率能获得显著更高的超额收益。
ai_comment: 该论文通过模型与实证分析，提供了信用和股票市场不完全整合的新证据，并发现了跨市场波动率溢价差异，对资产定价和风险管理有重要启示。

title: Household Financial Decision-Making After Natural Disasters: Evidence from Hurricane Harvey
abstract: We study household credit responses to Hurricane Harvey using new, geographically granular data on credit cards, mortgages, and flooding. Estimates from a differences-in-differences design that exploits the flooding gradient show that affected households only borrow at low-interest rates, often using promotional (zero interest) cards and that they quickly pay down balances. We also document that take-up of forbearance (borrowing by missing mortgage payments without penalty) increases with flooding. These results are attenuated in floodplains, particularly in structures subject by code to physical hardening. Our results indicate that credit acts as a substitute for the lack of physical hardening.
summary: 本文利用飓风哈维后信用卡、抵押贷款和洪水的新地理精细数据，采用差异中的差异设计，利用洪水梯度估计家庭信贷反应。研究发现，受影响的家庭只以低利率借款，常使用促销（零利息）信用卡并迅速偿还余额。同时，忍耐（通过错过抵押贷款付款而不受惩罚的借款）的采用随洪水严重程度增加而增加。这些效应在洪泛区有所减弱，特别是在受物理加固规范约束的建筑物中。结果表明，信贷充当了缺乏物理加固的替代品。
ai_comment: 利用高分辨率数据揭示了家庭在自然灾害后理性且审慎的借贷行为，并发现信贷与物理加固的替代关系，为灾害风险管理提供了新视角。

title: The Decline of Secured Debt
abstract: The share of secured debt issued (as a fraction of total corporate debt) declined steadily in the United States over the twentieth century. This stems partly from financial development giving creditors greater confidence that high‐quality borrowers will respect their claims even if creditors do not obtain security upfront. Consequently, such borrowers prefer retaining financial flexibility by not giving security up front. Instead, security is given contingently—when a firm approaches distress. This also explains why, superimposed on the secular decline, the share of secured debt issued is countercyclical.
summary: 该论文研究了美国二十世纪担保债务在企业总债务中占比持续下降的现象。作者认为，这一趋势部分源于金融发展，使得债权人即使未事先获得担保，也更相信高质量借款人会履行债务。因此，这类借款人倾向于通过不事先提供担保来保留财务灵活性，而仅在面临财务困境时提供担保。此外，该论文还发现，在这一长期下降趋势之上，担保债务占比具有反周期性，即在经济衰退时上升。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了一个新颖的视角来解释担保债务长期下降的微观机制，并揭示了其反周期特性，对理解企业融资决策和债务市场结构具有重要贡献。

title: Credit Freezes, Equilibrium Multiplicity, and Optimal Bailouts in Financial Networks
abstract: We analyze how interdependencies in financial networks can lead to self-fulfilling insolvencies and multiple possible equilibrium outcomes. Multiplicity arises if a certain type of dependency cycle exists in the network. We show that finding the cheapest bailout policy that prevents self-fulfilling insolvencies is computationally hard, but that the optimal policy has intuitive features in some typical network structures. Leveraging indirect benefits ensures systemic solvency at a cost that never exceeds half of the overall shortfall. In core-periphery networks, it is optimal to bail out peripheral banks first as opposed to core banks.
summary: 本文分析了金融网络中相互依存关系如何导致自我实现的破产以及多重均衡结果。当网络中存在特定类型的依赖循环时，就会出现多重均衡。研究发现，寻找防止自我实现破产的最廉价救助策略在计算上是困难的，但在一些典型网络结构中，最优策略具有直观特征。通过利用间接收益，可以在总成本不超过总体资金缺口一半的情况下确保系统偿付能力。在核心-边缘网络中，优先救助边缘银行而非核心银行是最优的。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了网络结构对救助策略的重要影响，并提出了优先救助边缘银行这一反直觉的结论，为系统风险防控提供了新视角。

title: How Do Foreign Labor Regulations Affect Firms’ Operating Strategies?
abstract: We examine how changes in foreign labor regulations affect U.S. multinationals’ operating strategies. We show that firms with integrated operations in countries where labor regulations become tighter tend to establish arm’s-length relations with local business partners in that nation. The substitution between integrated and arm’s-length operations is stronger toward joint ventures than suppliers and weaker in the presence of financial constraints. Our findings are consistent with the idea that when firms find it harder to terminate their workers in integrated operations, they change to an operating model where it is easier to replace or discontinue business partners instead of employees.
summary: 本文研究外国劳动法规变化如何影响美国跨国公司的经营策略。结果显示，当跨国公司在劳动法规收紧的国家拥有整合业务时，它们倾向于与当地商业伙伴建立保持距离的关系（arm's-length relations）。这种替代效应在合资企业（joint ventures）中比在供应商关系中更显著，并且在公司面临财务约束（financial constraints）时减弱。结论支持以下观点：当公司难以在整合运营中解雇员工时，会转向更容易更换或终止商业伙伴而非雇员的运营模式。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了劳动法规对跨国公司组织形式选择的因果影响，为理解制度环境与企业边界决策提供了新的实证证据。

title: The Effect of Takeover Protection in Quiet Life and Bonding Firms
abstract: Antitakeover measures are controversial because the evidence of their net effect on shareholders is mixed. We propose that, for many firms, the potential bonding benefits outweigh the agency costs of the quiet life, explaining the mixed results. We study business combination and poison pill laws as exogenous shocks to takeover vulnerability and use shareholder valuation of internal slack as an indicator of the net effect of takeover protection. Firms susceptible to quiet life agency problems exhibit a decrease in the market-assessed value of internal slack. Conversely, cash appreciates at companies where takeover protection bonds commitments with major counterparties.
summary: 该论文研究反收购保护对公司的不同影响，提出对于许多公司而言，潜在的绑定收益超过安静生活带来的代理成本，这解释了为何关于反收购措施净效应的证据不一。作者利用商业合并法和毒丸计划法律作为对收购脆弱性的外生冲击，并以股东对内部松弛的估值作为衡量反收购保护净效应的指标。研究发现，易受安静生活代理问题影响的公司，其内部松弛的市场估值下降；而在反收购保护有助于绑定与主要交易对手承诺的公司中，现金反而增值。
ai_comment: 该文通过区分反收购保护的两种效应（安静生活代理成本与绑定收益）并利用法律变化作为外生冲击，为反收购措施净效应的混合证据提供了新的解释。

title: The Predictive Power of the Term Spread and Financial Variables for Economic Activity across Countries
abstract: In recent years, there has been renewed interest in the moments of the yield curve (or alternatively, the term spread) as a predictor of future economic activity, defined as either recessions, or industrial production growth.In this paper, we re-examine the evidence for this predictor for the United States, other high-income countries, as well as selected emerging market economies (Brazil, India, China, South Africa and South Korea), over the 1995-2023 period.We examine the sensitivity of the results to the addition of financial variables that measure other dimensions of financial conditions both domestically and internationally.Specifically, we account for financial conditions indexes (Arrigoni, et al., 2022), the debt service ratio (Borio, et al., 2020), and foreign term spreads (Ahmed and Chinn, 2023).We find that foreign term spreads and the debt service ratio in many cases yield substantially better predictive power, in terms of insample fit using proportion of variance explained.Overall, the predictive power of the yield curve, as well as other financial variables, varies across countries, with particularly little explanatory power in emerging market economies.
summary: 本文重新检验了期限利差（term spread）和其他金融变量对不同国家经济活动的预测能力，涵盖美国、其他高收入国家以及巴西、印度、中国、南非和韩国等新兴市场经济体，样本期为1995-2023年。研究纳入国内和国际金融状况指标，包括金融状况指数（Arrigoni et al., 2022）、债务服务比率（Borio et al., 2020）和外国期限利差（Ahmed and Chinn, 2023）。以方差解释比例衡量样本内拟合优度，发现外国期限利差和债务服务比率在许多情况下显著提高了预测能力。总体而言，收益率曲线及其他金融变量的预测能力存在国别差异，尤其在新兴市场经济体中解释力较弱。
ai_comment: 该研究系统比较了多国金融变量对经济活动的预测能力，强调了外国期限利差和债务服务比率的增量信息，为跨国预测提供了新视角。

title: Capital, Ideas, and the Costs of Financial Frictions
abstract: We study the role of financial frictions in determining the allocation of investment and innovation.Empirically, we find that firms are investment-intensive when they have low net worth but become innovation-intensive as they accumulate more net worth.To interpret these findings, we develop an endogenous growth model with heterogeneous firms and financial frictions.In our model, low net worth firms are investment-intensive because their returns to capital are high.Financial frictions slow the rate at which firms exhaust the returns to capital and shift towards innovation.Calibrating to the US economy, we find that the resulting lower growth implies large GDP losses even though capital misallocation is small.In other words, financial markets effectively fund the implementation of existing ideas, but do not adequately fund the discovery of new ideas.If innovation has positive spillovers, a planner would not only raise innovation but also lower investment expenditures among constrained firms.
summary: 本文研究金融摩擦如何影响企业投资与创新的资源配置。实证发现，企业净资产较低时更倾向于投资，而净资产较高时更倾向于创新。为解释这一现象，作者构建了一个包含异质性企业和金融摩擦的内生增长模型。模型表明，低净资产企业因资本回报率高而更注重投资；金融摩擦减缓了企业从投资向创新转型的速度。基于美国经济的校准分析显示，尽管资本错配程度较小，但由此引发的增长率下降会导致显著的GDP损失。换言之，金融市场能有效资助现有创意的实施，但未能充分支持新创意的发现。若创新具有正外部性，社会规划者不仅会提升创新水平，还会降低受约束企业的投资支出。
ai_comment: 本文通过将金融摩擦与内生增长模型结合，揭示了其对投资与创新动态分配的关键影响，并量化了长期GDP损失，为政策干预提供了理论依据。

title: Central Banks, Stock Markets, and the Real Economy
abstract: This article summarizes empirical research on the interaction between monetary policy and asset markets, and reviews our previous theoretical work that captures these interactions.We present a concise model in which monetary policy impacts the aggregate asset price, which in turn influences economic activity with lags.In this context: (i) the central bank (the Fed, for short) stabilizes the aggregate asset price in response to financial shocks, using large-scale asset purchases if needed ("the Fed put"); (ii) when the Fed is constrained, negative financial shocks cause demand recessions, (iii) the Fed's response to aggregate demand shocks increases asset price volatility, but this volatility plays a useful macroeconomic stabilization role; (iv) the Fed's beliefs about the future aggregate demand and supply drive the aggregate asset price; (v) macroeconomic news influences the Fed's beliefs and asset prices; (vi) more precise news reduces output volatility but heightens asset market volatility; (vii) disagreements between the market and the Fed microfound monetary policy shocks, and generate a policy risk premium.
summary: 本文总结货币政策与资产市场互动的实证研究，并回顾作者先前捕获这些互动的理论工作。作者提出一个简洁模型，其中货币政策影响总资产价格，进而滞后影响经济活动。模型包含七个关键结论：(i) 美联储通过大规模资产购买（如有需要）稳定总资产价格以应对金融冲击（即“美联储看跌期权”）；(ii) 当美联储受约束时，负面金融冲击导致需求衰退；(iii) 美联储对总需求冲击的响应增加了资产价格波动，但这种波动发挥了有用的宏观经济稳定作用；(iv) 美联储对未来总需求和总供给的信念驱动总资产价格；(v) 宏观经济新闻影响美联储信念和资产价格；(vi) 更精确的新闻降低产出波动但加剧资产市场波动；(vii) 市场与美联储之间的分歧构成货币政策冲击的微观基础，并产生政策风险溢价。
ai_comment: 本文以简洁模型整合了货币政策与资产市场互动的多维机制，突出美联储在稳定经济和金融中的关键角色，以及市场分歧对政策冲击和风险溢价的影响，为理解央行与市场互动提供了清晰框架。

title: Fiscal Stimulus, Deposit Competition, and the Rise of Shadow Banking: Evidence from China
abstract: The rise of shadow banking and attendant financial fragility in China can be traced to intensified deposit competition following the global financial crisis (GFC). Deposit competition intensified after the GFC because the GFC slowed down banks’ deposit growth from cross-border money inflows and simultaneously led to fiscal stimulus supported by banks’ credit expansion. Exploiting the fact that one big state-owned bank was particular affected by the GFC through these two channels, we document—by exploring small and medium-sized banks’ branch-level overlap with this big bank—that deposit competition increased banks’ reliance on shadow banking. In particular, exposed banks issued Wealth Management Products (WMPs)—short-maturity, off-balance-sheet substitutes for deposits—creating rollover risks for the issuers, as reflected by higher yields on new WMPs, higher borrowing rates in the interbank market, and lower stock-market performance during liquidity stress.
summary: 本文研究中国影子银行体系崛起及其金融脆弱性的根源，发现全球金融危机（GFC）后存款竞争加剧是关键驱动因素。GFC通过两个渠道加剧存款竞争：一是减缓了银行来自跨境资金流入的存款增长，二是同时催生了依赖银行信贷扩张的财政刺激。利用一家大型国有银行在GFC中受这两个渠道影响尤为严重这一事实，通过考察中小银行与该大银行的分支机构重叠程度，实证发现存款竞争促使银行更多依赖影子银行业务。具体而言，受影响的银行大量发行财富管理产品（WMPs）——作为短期、表外的存款替代品，这给发行方带来展期风险，表现为新发WMP收益率上升、银行间市场拆借利率提高以及流动性压力期间股市表现恶化。
ai_comment: 本文通过分支网络重叠构建识别策略，巧妙揭示了GFC与财政刺激如何通过存款竞争渠道催生影子银行，对理解中国金融体系结构变迁有重要贡献。

title: Refinancing Frictions, Mortgage Pricing and Redistribution
abstract: There are large cross-sectional differences in how often US borrowers refinance mortgages.In this paper, we develop an equilibrium mortgage pricing model with heterogeneous borrowers and use it to show that equilibrium forces imply important cross-subsidies from borrowers who rarely refinance to those who refinance often.Mortgage reforms can potentially reduce these regressive cross-subsidies, but the equilibrium effects of these reforms can also have important distributional consequences.For example, many policies that lead to more frequent refinancing also increase equilibrium mortgage rates and thus reduce residential mortgage credit access for a large number of borrowers.
summary: 本文研究了美国借款人再融资频率的横截面差异，并开发了一个包含异质性借款人的均衡抵押贷款定价模型。研究发现，均衡力量导致从不经常再融资的借款人向频繁再融资的借款人提供重要的交叉补贴。抵押贷款改革可能减少这些累退性的交叉补贴，但改革的均衡效应也可能产生重要的分配后果。例如，许多促进更频繁再融资的政策也会提高均衡抵押贷款利率，从而减少大量借款人的住宅抵押贷款信贷可及性。
ai_comment: 该论文通过均衡模型揭示了抵押贷款市场中隐性的再分配效应，并指出了改革政策的潜在权衡，对理解抵押贷款市场的效率和公平有重要启示。

title: EXIM’s Exit: The Real Effects of Trade Financing by Export Credit Agencies
abstract: We study the role of Export Credit Agencies—the predominant tool of industrial policy—on firm behavior by using the effective shutdown of the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) from 2015–2019 as a natural experiment. We document sizable real effects of the shutdown: a $1 reduction in EXIM trade financing reduces exports by approximately $4.50. EXIM-dependent firms also experience a contraction in total revenues, investment, and employment. EXIM’s shutdown has the largest effects for exporters facing financing frictions and selling to markets with high contractual frictions, indicating that even in well-developed financial markets, trade financing can be under-supplied by private banks. Consistent with the idea that EXIM support can help to address market frictions, we find that the shutdown increased capital misallocation, as firms with a higher ex-ante marginal revenue product of capital contracted more. These results provide a framework for the conditions under which Export Credit Agencies can boost exports and firm growth, and can act as a tool of industrial policy without necessarily leading to a misallocation of resources.
summary: 本文利用2015-2019年美国进出口银行（EXIM）有效关闭这一自然实验，研究出口信贷机构（Export Credit Agencies）作为产业政策主要工具对企业行为的影响。研究发现，该关闭带来了显著的实际效应：EXIM贸易融资每减少1美元，出口下降约4.50美元；依赖EXIM的企业总收入、投资和就业也出现收缩。这种效应在面临融资摩擦的出口商以及向合同摩擦较高的市场销售时最为显著，表明即使在发达的金融市场中，私人银行也可能不足够提供贸易融资。与EXIM支持有助于解决市场摩擦的观点一致，关闭加剧了资本错配，因为事前资本边际收入产品较高的企业收缩更多。这些结果提供了一个框架，说明出口信贷机构在什么条件下能够促进出口和企业增长，并且可以作为产业政策工具而不必然导致资源错配。
ai_comment: 利用美国EXIM银行关闭这一独特自然实验，识别了出口信贷机构对企业出口和经营的因果效应，并分析了其缓解市场摩擦的机制，为产业政策设计提供了重要证据。

title: Ownership Structure, Incentives, and Asset Returns
abstract: We develop a dynamic equilibrium model to derive the endogenous relations among firms’ ownership structures, managerial incentives, and asset returns. Ownership concentration is positively related to managerial incentives (PPS) but is negatively related to its expected stock (dollar) return, and volatility. If initial block ownership is above (below) its steady-state level, block ownership and managerial PPS decrease (increase) over time to their steady-state levels, whereas the expected stock returns, return volatilities, and the price impacts of block trades increase (decrease). The convergence of these variables to their respective steady-state levels is faster for firms that are less productive, that are riskier, and whose earnings are more sensitive to managerial actions. The price impact of block trades is larger in firms that are more productive and smaller in firms whose earnings are more sensitive to managerial actions. Changes in the expected stock return over time are negatively affected by changes in block ownership but positively affected by changes in managerial incentives. Relative to owner-managed firms, more widely owned firms have lower expected stock returns and volatilities, faster dispersion of block ownership, and smaller but more variable price impacts of block trades. Compared with diffusely owned firms, firms with significant blockholdings have lower expected stock returns, higher return volatilities, and less powerful managerial incentives. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: H. W. (H.) Jung and Q. Zeng received an internal research grant (AUD 15,000) in 2015 from the Faculty of Business and Economics at the University of Melbourne. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4696 .
summary: 本文构建了一个动态均衡模型，以推导企业所有权结构、管理层激励与资产收益之间的内生关系。研究发现，所有权集中度与管理层激励（Pay-Performance Sensitivity, PPS）正相关，但与预期股票收益（美元计价）和波动率负相关。若初始块状所有权高于（低于）稳态水平，则块状所有权和管理层PPS随时间递减（递增）至稳态，而预期股票收益、收益波动率和块交易的价格冲击则递增（递减）。对于生产率较低、风险较高、盈利对管理层行动更敏感的企业，这些变量向稳态收敛的速度更快。块交易的价格冲击在生产率更高的企业更大，在盈利对管理层行动更敏感的企业更小。预期股票收益随时间的变化受块状所有权变化的负向影响，但受管理层激励变化的正向影响。与所有者管理的企业相比，更广泛拥有的企业预期股票收益和波动率较低，块状所有权分散更快，价格冲击更小但波动性更大。与分散拥有的企业相比，拥有重要块状所有权的企业预期股票收益较低、收益波动率较高、管理层激励较弱。
ai_comment: 本文通过动态均衡模型系统性地揭示了所有权结构、管理层激励与资产收益之间的内生关系，为理解企业治理与资产定价的交互提供了新的理论视角。

title: Fair Value Accounting, Illiquid Assets, and Financial Stability
abstract: In this paper, I analyze the joint design of capital requirements and fair value reporting rules for financial institutions with illiquid assets. I specifically examine how prudential regulation aimed at solving agency problems affects financial institutions’ incentives to use Level 2 versus Level 3 fair value reporting, as well as financial stability. Crucially, Level 3 reporting allows financial institutions to use their private information, whereas Level 2 fair values are only measured with public information. Interestingly, my analysis shows regulators may leave to financial institutions the discretion to report illiquid assets at Level 2 or Level 3. Financial institutions then report at Level 3 only if they have good private information about the assets’ quality. Moreover, prudential rules that only rely on Level 2 fair values may be efficient at solving agency problems within financial institutions but may also decrease financial stability. By contrast, prudential rules that leave to financial institutions the discretion to report illiquid assets at Level 2 or Level 3 while relaxing capital requirements may increase financial stability. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the H2020 European Research Council [Grant 669217]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4692 .
summary: 本文分析了针对持有非流动性资产的金融机构的资本要求与公允价值报告规则的联合设计。研究特别关注审慎监管（旨在解决代理问题）如何影响金融机构在二级和三级公允价值报告之间的选择，以及这种选择对金融稳定性的影响。关键区别在于：三级报告允许金融机构使用其私有信息，而二级公允价值仅基于公开信息测量。有趣的是，分析表明监管机构可能保留金融机构自行决定以二级或三级报告非流动性资产的权力。金融机构只有在拥有关于资产质量的良好私有信息时才选择三级报告。此外，仅依赖二级公允价值的审慎规则可以有效解决金融机构内部的代理问题，但可能降低金融稳定性。相比之下，允许金融机构自行选择报告级别并放松资本要求的审慎规则可能增强金融稳定性。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型揭示了监管机构允许金融机构自主选择公允价值报告级别的权变最优性，为会计规则与金融稳定性的交互提供了新的洞见。

title: Financial Contagion in Network Economies and Asset Prices
abstract: This paper studies intertemporal asset pricing in network economies when distress shocks can propagate through the network, similarly to epidemic outbreaks. Two classes of equilibria exist. In the first, idiosyncratic shocks are diversifiable and do not affect valuations; the consumption capital asset pricing model applies. In the second, idiosyncratic shocks generate nondiversifiable long-run cascades of shocks (financial pandemics) that introduce a new risk premium component unexplained by traditional systematic factors. We derive closed solutions for asset prices as a function of the network properties and discuss their properties. After a structural break (1984), we find evidence of a network risk premium that is statistically and economically significant. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Ministero dell’Istruzione, dell’Università e della Ricerca [Grant PRIN-2017TA7TYC] and Baffi CAREFIN. C. Tebaldi is a fellow of Baffi CAREFIN and Innocenzo Gasaprini Institute for Economic Research Centers. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4687 .
summary: 本文研究网络经济中的跨期资产定价，当困境冲击可以像流行病爆发一样通过网络传播时。存在两类均衡：第一类中，特质冲击可分散，不影响估值，消费资本资产定价模型适用；第二类中，特质冲击产生不可分散的长期冲击级联（金融大流行），引入传统系统因素无法解释的新风险溢价成分。我们推导了资产价格作为网络属性函数的闭式解，并讨论了其性质。在1984年结构断点后，我们发现网络风险溢价在统计和经济上均显著。
ai_comment: 该论文提出了网络风险溢价的新概念，并通过理论闭式解和实证证据表明其在传统因素之外的重要性，为理解金融传染的系统性影响提供了新视角。

title: Search and Predictability of Prices in the Housing Market
abstract: We develop a new housing search index (HSI) extracted from online search activity on a limited set of keywords related to the house-buying process. We show that HSI has strong predictive power over subsequent changes in house prices, both in-sample and out-of-sample and after controlling for the effect of commonly used predictors, and relate our findings to models of search-induced frictions. Our results imply that search data can be used as an early indicator of where the market is going. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Funding: We acknowledge support from the Danish Finance Institute and from the Independent Research Fund Denmark [Grants DFF 7024-00020B and DFF 7015-00017B]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4672 .
summary: 本文开发了一个新的住房搜索指数（HSI），该指数来源于一组与购房过程相关的有限关键词的在线搜索活动。研究表明，无论是在样本内还是样本外，HSI 对房价后续变化都具有显著的预测能力，并且这一预测能力在控制了常用预测变量的影响后依然稳健。本文将这一发现与搜索摩擦模型联系起来，表明搜索数据可以作为市场走向的早期指标。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地利用在线搜索数据构建预测指标，为房地产市场预测提供了新的视角和实证证据，具有实际应用价值。

title: The Economic Value of Blockchain Applications: Early Evidence from Asset-Backed Securities
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the economic value of a blockchain application. In the context of asset-backed securities (ABS) issuance in China, where some ABS are issued with blockchain technology and others are not, we find that the use of blockchain significantly reduces the coupon yield at issuance. Compared with other ABS, those issued using blockchain technology experience a decrease of 31.4 basis points in the yield spread, which corresponds to a relative decrease of 13%. We further document that the effect of blockchain is more pronounced for ABS deals rated by less reputable credit rating agencies and agencies that rely more on issuers for their rating business, for revolving ABS, and for ABS with a larger number of underlying assets. We also find that the use of blockchain can reduce the level of retained interest and number of credit enhancement mechanisms. This paper contributes to the literature by providing a small-sample analysis of the economic value of a blockchain application in financial markets. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: X. Chen and Q. Cheng acknowledge funding provided by the Lee Kong Chian Professorship at Singapore Management University. This work was supported by Singapore Ministry of Education [Grant MOE-T2EP40120-0005]. Supplemental Material: Data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4671 .
summary: 本文评估了区块链应用的经济价值。基于中国资产支持证券（ABS）发行市场，其中部分ABS使用区块链技术而其他未使用，研究发现使用区块链显著降低了发行时的票面利率。与未使用区块链的ABS相比，使用区块链技术的ABS的收益率价差下降了31.4个基点，相对降低13%。进一步发现，区块链的效果在以下情况下更为显著：由声誉较低的信用评级机构评级的ABS、评级机构更依赖发行人获取评级业务的ABS、循环型ABS以及基础资产数量较多的ABS。此外，使用区块链还可以降低风险留存水平和信用增级机制的数量。本文通过金融市场上区块链应用的小样本分析，为该领域的经济价值文献做出了贡献。
ai_comment: 利用中国ABS市场的独特制度环境，提供了区块链技术降低融资成本的经验证据，并揭示了评级机构声誉等调节因素，对金融科技应用于资产证券化具有重要启示。

title: Winners from Winners: A Tale of Risk Factors
abstract: Starting from twelve distinct factors from the recent literature, plus twelve principal components (PCs) of anomalies unexplained by the initial factors, a Bayesian comparison of approximately seventeen million models in terms of marginal likelihoods and posterior model probabilities shows that {Mkt, MOM, IA, ROE, MGMT, PERF, PEAD, FIN}, plus the nonconsecutive principal components, {[Formula: see text]} are the best supported risk factors. Pricing tests and annualized out-of-sample Sharpe ratios for tangency portfolios suggest that this asset pricing model should be used for computing expected returns, assessing investment strategies and building portfolios. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4668 .
summary: 本文从近期文献中选取12个不同的因子，加上12个未被初始因子解释的异常主成分，通过贝叶斯方法比较约1700万个模型的边际似然和后验模型概率，发现最佳支持的因子集为{Mkt, MOM, IA, ROE, MGMT, PERF, PEAD, FIN}以及非连续的主成分。定价检验和切线组合的年化样本外夏普比率表明，该资产定价模型可用于计算预期收益、评估投资策略和构建投资组合。
ai_comment: 通过大规模贝叶斯模型比较，系统性地筛选出最关键的风险因子，为实证资产定价提供了强有力的模型选择依据。

title: Time Inconsistency and Financial Covenants
abstract: Financial covenants influence firm behavior by state-contingently allocating decision rights. I develop a quantitative model with long-term debt where shareholders cannot commit to not dilute existing lenders with new debt issuances. Lenders intervene on covenant violations but cannot commit either to any debt restructuring plan ex ante. Counterfactual experiments suggest that financial covenants significantly reduce default probability and increase firm value. However, the value creation is limited by lenders’ limited commitment. A hump-shaped relation between covenant tightness and firm value emerges, reflecting a balance between limited commitment on two sides. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4667 .
summary: 本文构建了一个长期债务的定量模型，研究财务契约如何通过状态依赖地分配决策权影响企业行为。模型中，股东无法承诺不通过新债发行稀释现有贷款人，而贷款人在契约违约时干预，但也不能事先承诺任何债务重组计划。反事实实验表明，财务契约显著降低了违约概率并增加了企业价值；然而，价值创造受到贷款人有限承诺的限制。进一步发现，契约紧度与企业价值之间存在驼峰形关系，反映了股东和贷款人双方有限承诺之间的平衡。
ai_comment: 该文通过定量模型揭示了财务契约在缓解债务稀释中的关键作用，并创新性地指出了双方有限承诺导致的驼峰形最优契约紧度，为公司债务契约设计提供了重要理论参考。

title: Private Debt and the Role of Venture Capital and Private Equity Sponsors
abstract: This is the first study examining the key role played by venture capital and private equity (VCPE) firms in the private debt market. Private debt funds invest in companies owned (sponsored) by VCPEs and in other companies without VCPE sponsors. Using novel data, we find that private debt without VCPE sponsors generates a premium. Further analysis shows that this sponsorless premium compensates for higher risk and costs of risk mitigation as sponsorless lenders adopt a more hands-on approach emulating VCPE sponsors’ roles. Our results are robust and provide important lessons for investors and investee firms in private debt, venture lending, and VCPE. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4664 .
summary: 本文首次研究了风险投资和私募股权（VCPE）公司在私人债务市场中的关键作用。私人债务基金投资于VCPE支持的公司（赞助商背景）和无赞助商的公司。利用新数据集，研究发现无VCPE赞助的私人债务存在溢价。进一步分析表明，这种无赞助商溢价补偿了更高的风险和风险缓解成本，因为无赞助商的贷款人采取更亲力亲为的方式，模仿VCPE赞助商的角色。结果稳健，为私人债务、风险贷款和VCPE领域的投资者及投资公司提供了重要启示。
ai_comment: 该研究首次揭示了VCPE在私人债务市场中的作用，发现了无赞助商溢价及其背后的风险补偿机制，为理解私人债务定价提供了新视角。

title: Tick Size, Competition for Liquidity Provision, and Price Discovery: Evidence from the U.S. Treasury Market
abstract: This paper studies how a tick size change affects market quality, price discovery, and the competition for liquidity provision by dealers and high-frequency trading firms (HFTs) in the U.S. Treasury market. Using difference-in-differences regressions around the November 19, 2018, tick size reduction in the 2-year Treasury note and a similar change in the 2-year futures eight weeks later, we find significantly improved market quality. Moreover, dealers become more competitive in liquidity provision and price improvement, consistent with the hypothesis that HFTs find liquidity provision less profitable in the smaller tick size environment. Last, we find a significant shift in short-run price discovery toward the cash market, which then reverses when the futures market tick size is reduced, suggesting that the finer pricing grid in the cash market allows traders to act on small information signals that are not profitable to exploit in the larger-tick futures market. Our findings suggest that reducing the tick size in tick-constrained and highly liquid markets like the Treasury market is on balance beneficial. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Funding: F. Ruela acknowledges support from the National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program [Grant DGE-1746045]. Any opinions, findings, and conclusions or recommendations expressed in this material are those of the author(s) and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Science Foundation. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4663 .
summary: 本文利用美国国债市场中的自然实验，研究了最小报价单位（tick size）变化对市场质量、价格发现以及流动性提供者（经销商和高频交易公司）之间竞争的影响。通过双重差分法，分析了2018年11月19日2年期国债的最小报价单位降低以及八周后2年期期货的类似变化，发现市场质量显著改善。同时，经销商在流动性提供和价格改善方面变得更具竞争力，这与高频交易公司在更小最小报价单位环境下发现流动性提供盈利性下降的假设一致。此外，短期价格发现在现货市场中显著增加，并在期货市场最小报价单位降低后逆转，表明现货市场中更精细的定价网格允许交易者利用在较大最小报价单位期货市场中无法获利的小信息信号。总体而言，降低最小报价单位对于像国债市场这样报价单位受限且高流动性的市场是有益的。
ai_comment: 本文利用自然实验揭示了最小报价单位减少对市场微观结构的复杂影响，特别是高频交易者与经销商之间竞争的动态变化，为监管提供了重要启示。

title: RegTech Adoption and the Cost of Capital
abstract: This paper studies the cost of capital effect of a major regulatory technology, or RegTech, event: the staggered implementation of the Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval (EDGAR) system of the Securities and Exchange Commission in the period from 1993 to 1996. This event represents a largely exogenous shock to corporate information dissemination technologies, resulting in a considerable reduction in information acquisition costs for investors. Using a difference-in-differences research design, we show that the cost of equity capital declines substantially after a firm switches from paper filing to mandatory electronic filing in EDGAR. The effect is stronger for small firms and firms with low analyst coverage and low institutional ownership. We identify three channels through which EDGAR affects a firm’s cost of capital: the liquidity, risk-taking, and corporate governance channels. EDGAR implementation also improves a firm’s investment efficiency significantly. We find evidence that the marginal value of a firm’s capital investment and cash is higher during the post-EDGAR period. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: C. Lin acknowledges financial support from the National Science Foundation of China [Grant 72192841] and the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administration Region, China [Project HKU R7054-18 and T35/710/20R]. S. Lai acknowledges financial support from the Ministry of Science and Technology, Taiwan [Grants 107-2410-H-002-038-MY3 and 110-2410-H-002-079-MY2] and the E. Sun Academic Award. X. Ma acknowledges research support from the University of Macau [Grants SRG2019-00158-FBA and MYRG2020-00259-FBA]. Supplemental Material: Data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4660 .
summary: 本文研究监管科技（RegTech）采纳对资本成本的影响，以美国证券交易委员会（SEC）在1993至1996年间分阶段实施电子数据收集、分析和检索系统（EDGAR）作为外生冲击，该系统大幅降低了投资者的信息获取成本。采用双重差分法，发现公司从纸质文件转向EDGAR强制电子申报后，股权资本成本显著下降，且对小公司、分析师覆盖低和机构持股低的公司影响更强。通过流动性、风险承担和公司治理三个渠道，EDGAR降低了资本成本。此外，EDGAR实施还显著提高了公司的投资效率，并提升了资本投资和现金的边际价值。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验巧妙识别信息传播技术对资本成本的因果效应，并揭示了多重作用渠道，对金融科技与公司金融文献有重要贡献。

title: The Number of Estimates in Footnotes and Accruals
abstract: This study quantifies the number of estimates involved in firms’ accruals and examines whether it is informative about the relation between accruals and future earnings. We measure the number of estimates using the frequency of the use of the word estimate in the qualitative portions of a firm’s Notes to the Financial Statements (footnotes). Motivated by arguments regarding the impact of estimation errors in accruals, we hypothesize and find that the accruals of firms that have more estimates have a lower relation with future earnings (i.e., lower persistence) and a lower association with their past, current, and future cash flows. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by Zijiang Endowment. H. Chen acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72150710550, 71790591, and 72121002]. J. V. Chen acknowledges the financial support from the University of Michigan, University of Illinois at Chicago, Paton Accounting Fellowship, and Harry Jones Endowment. F. Li acknowledges the financial support from SJTU SAIF Zijiang Discipline Development Fund, sponsored by the Zijiang Foundation. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4659 .
summary: 本研究通过量化公司财务报表附注（脚注）中“estimate”一词的出现频率，来衡量应计项目所涉及的估计数量，并检验该数量是否影响应计项目与未来盈利之间的关系。基于估计误差对应计项目影响的论点，作者假设并发现，估计数量较多的公司，其应计项目与未来盈利的关联性（即持久性）较低，同时与过去、当前及未来现金流的关联也较弱。该论文被《Management Science》接受，并得到了多项基金资助。
ai_comment: 该研究通过文本分析创新性地量化了会计估计的强度，为理解应计项目质量提供了新视角。

title: Recovering Implied Volatility
abstract: We propose a methodology for estimating option-implied, forward-looking variances and covariances of assets and portfolios, which may not possess actively traded options. Our approach relies on the observation that, if asset returns follow a factor structure, then the variances and covariances of the factors span the systematic variances and covariances of assets. We implement the methodology empirically and show that our forward-looking moment estimates provide useful implications for the prediction of jumps and for portfolio choice. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4653 .
summary: 本文提出一种估计期权隐含的前瞻性方差和协方差的方法，适用于那些没有活跃交易期权的资产和投资组合。该方法基于资产收益遵循因子结构的观察，即因子的方差和协方差可以概括资产系统性的方差和协方差。通过实证实施，作者表明这些前瞻性矩估计对跳跃预测和投资组合选择具有重要启示。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用因子结构将期权的隐含信息扩展到非活跃交易资产，实证结果对风险管理和资产配置有直接应用价值。

title: The Utilization Premium
abstract: We study the interaction of flexible capital utilization and depreciation for expected returns and investment of firms. Empirically, an investment strategy that buys (sells) equities with low (high) utilization rates earns 5% per annum. Utilization predicts excess returns beyond other production-based variables. We reconcile this novel utilization premium quantitatively using a production model. The model suggests that flexible utilization is important for matching the cross-sectional distribution of investment and stock prices jointly. A model without flexible utilization yields many counterfactuals that flexible utilization addresses by making depreciation fluctuate endogenously. Overall, utilization tightens the link between firms’ production and valuations. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4647 .
summary: 本文研究资本利用率与折旧的灵活调整如何影响企业的预期收益和投资。实证发现，买入低利用率公司股票、卖出高利用率公司股票的投资策略可获得每年5%的超额收益，且利用率对其他生产基础的变量具有增量预测能力。作者通过一个生产模型量化解释了这一“利用率溢价”，模型表明灵活的资本利用率对于同时匹配投资和股票价格的横截面分布至关重要。相比之下，不考虑灵活利用率的模型会产生许多与数据不符的结论，而灵活利用率通过内生折旧波动解决了这些问题。总体而言，利用率加强了企业生产与市场估值之间的联系。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将资本利用率引入资产定价框架，不仅发现了新的定价因子，还通过结构模型揭示了其作用机制，对生产基础资产定价领域有重要贡献。

title: Customer Liquidity Provision: Implications for Corporate Bond Transaction Costs
abstract: The convention when calculating corporate bond trading costs is to estimate bid–ask spreads that customers pay, implicitly assuming that dealers always provide liquidity to customers. We show that, contrary to this assumption, customers increasingly provide liquidity following the adoption of post-2008 banking regulations, and thus, conventional bid–ask spread measures underestimate the cost of dealers’ liquidity provision. Among large trades wherein dealers use inventory capacity, customers pay 40%–60% wider spreads than before the crisis. Customers’ balance-sheet capacity and their trading relationships with dealers are important determinants of customer liquidity provision. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4646 .
summary: 传统计算公司债券交易成本的方法是通过估计客户支付的买卖价差，隐含假设做市商总是向客户提供流动性。本文发现，与该假设相反，在2008年后银行监管改革（如沃尔克规则）的推动下，客户越来越多地成为流动性的提供方，因此传统价差指标低估了做市商提供流动性的真实成本。对于需要利用做市商库存能力的大额交易，客户支付的价差比危机前宽40%-60%。客户的资产负债表容量及其与做市商的交易关系是决定客户是否提供流动性的重要因素。该论文发表于《Management Science》，并附有网络附录和数据。
ai_comment: 本论文挑战了公司债券交易成本度量的传统假设，揭示了后危机时代市场微观结构的重要变化，对监管政策评估和投资者交易成本理解具有显著贡献。

title: The Economics of Security Analysis
abstract: The investment capital asset pricing model, in which expected returns vary cross-sectionally with investment, profitability, and expected growth, provides an equilibrium foundation for Graham and Dodd’s security analysis. The q 5 model is a good start to explaining prominent security analysis strategies, such as Abarbanell and Bushee’s fundamental signals, Frankel and Lee’s intrinsic to market, Greenblatt’s “magic formula,” Asness et al.’s quality minus junk, Bartram and Grinblatt’s agnostic analysis, operating cash flow to market, and Penman and Zhu’s expected-return strategy as well as best performing active discretionary funds, such as Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4640 .
summary: 本文提出投资资本资产定价模型，该模型通过投资、盈利能力和预期增长的横截面差异来解释预期收益，为Graham和Dodd的安全分析提供了均衡理论基础。q5模型能够较好地解释多种著名的安全分析策略，包括Abarbanell和Bushee的基本面信号、Frankel和Lee的内在价值与市场比、Greenblatt的“神奇公式”、Asness等人的质量减垃圾、Bartram和Grinblatt的不可知分析、经营现金流与市场比、Penman和Zhu的预期收益策略，以及表现最佳的主动管理型基金（如巴菲特旗下的伯克希尔·哈撒韦）。
ai_comment: 本文为安全分析提供了严谨的均衡理论基础，将经典的价值投资策略与现代资产定价模型相联系，展示了q5模型在解释多种异象和主动策略中的强大能力。

title: The Beta Anomaly and Mutual Fund Performance
abstract: We find evidence for the beta anomaly in mutual fund performance. This anomaly is not accounted for in the standard four-factor framework, nor by the addition of a betting-against-beta factor to the benchmark model. We identify the active component of alpha (active alpha) not attributable to the passive effects related to beta. Active alpha is persistent and associated with superior portfolio performance. We find that, although many investors use standard alpha to allocate capital, a subset of sophisticated investors allocate their money based on active alpha. Our procedure is useful across the commonly used benchmark models for measuring performance and can be extended to accommodate other potential factor beta anomalies. This paper was accepted by Karl Diether, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4639 .
summary: 本文研究了共同基金绩效中的beta异常现象。标准四因子模型以及加入betting-against-beta因子后的基准模型均无法解释该异常。作者识别出基金alpha中不受beta被动效应影响的主动成分（active alpha），发现该主动alpha具有持续性，并与优异的组合绩效相关。尽管许多投资者使用标准alpha进行资本配置，但一部分成熟投资者（sophisticated investors）根据主动alpha分配资金。该方法适用于常见的基准绩效衡量模型，并可扩展至其他潜在因子beta异常。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分主动alpha和被动beta效应，揭示了共同基金绩效中的beta异常，并发现成熟投资者依据主动alpha进行资金配置，为理解基金绩效和投资者行为提供了新视角。

title: In Art We Trust
abstract: Whereas trust is the cornerstone of any market’s functioning, it is of particular importance in markets that are unregulated, illiquid, and opaque, such as the art market. This study examines the role of authenticity, as captured by provenance information in auction catalogs, on the probability of auctioned oil paintings, watercolors, and prints being sold; their price formation; and returns. Auction catalogs include four authenticity dimensions: pedigree (ownership “blockchain,” descendance information; type of past owners, such as renowned collectors; and past sales records), exhibition history (e.g., in famous museums or galleries), literature coverage (e.g., in catalogues raisonnés or authoritative press), and certification (e.g., artist’s physical testimonial, expert opinions). We find that trust, proxied by provenance information, increases the probability of a work being sold by up to 4%, leads to hammer price premiums up to 54%, and increases annualized returns by 5%–16%. To address potential endogeneity problems between the provision of provenance and past prices/price expectations, we perform quasi-natural experiments in difference-in-differences settings on auction houses’ provenance policy changes following authenticity litigation and on a contamination effect of the discovery of fakes and forgeries on the oeuvre of forged artists. We also test transactions less affected by past prices, such as estate sales following the death of a collector. The findings on the relation between provenance and prices are robust to artist reputation, artistic style, auction house reputation, art market liquidity, and artist career timing. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: Y. Li gratefully acknowledges supports from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72204257] and the Area Studies Fund of Renmin University of China [Grant AS2022002]. This study is partially funded by the Tilburg Alumni Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4633 .
summary: 该论文研究艺术市场中信任（以来源信息衡量）的作用，分析了拍卖目录中四种真实性维度（传承记录、展览历史、文献覆盖和认证）对拍卖成功概率、价格形成和回报的影响。基于艺术拍卖数据发现：来源信息使作品售出概率提高最多4%，锤价格溢价最高达54%，年化回报率提高5%-16%。为克服来源信息与历史价格/价格预期之间的内生性，作者利用拍卖行在真实性诉讼后的政策变化和伪造品发现对艺术家作品的污染效应进行准自然实验，并检验了受历史价格影响较小的遗产拍卖等场景。结论在控制艺术家声誉、艺术风格、拍卖行声誉、市场流动性和艺术家职业生涯时机后依然稳健。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用艺术市场的高度信息不对称性来研究信任的经济价值，并通过多重准自然实验有效处理内生性问题，为文化资产定价提供了严谨的实证证据。

title: Accounting-Driven Bank Monitoring and Firms’ Debt Structure: Evidence from IFRS 9 Adoption
abstract: International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) 9 is of practical relevance to banks because it requires intense monitoring of borrowers to record timely loan losses. Using data from 50 countries, we find that accounting-driven bank monitoring due to IFRS 9 adoption reduces firms’ reliance on bank debt relative to public debt. This finding is consistent with firms experiencing more costly bank monitoring after a shift in regulatory reporting that requires banks to monitor borrowers more intensely. In further analyses, we find that the negative effect of IFRS 9 adoption on bank debt reliance is more pronounced with more stringent regulatory supervision of banks, consistent with regulatory stringency exacerbating costly bank monitoring for firms. We also find that the negative effect is stronger when firms can more easily switch from bank debt to public debt financing, consistent with the relevance of switching costs in firms’ decisions to avoid costly bank monitoring. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71802205], the Program for Innovation Research, and the Program for Young Talents Cultivation [Grant QYP202103] in Central University of Finance and Economics. Supplemental Material: Data and the online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4628 .
summary: 本文研究国际财务报告准则第9号（IFRS 9）的采用如何影响企业的债务结构。IFRS 9要求银行对借款人进行更严格的监控以及时记录贷款损失。利用50个国家的数据，作者发现IFRS 9导致的会计驱动的银行监控减少了企业对银行债务相对于公共债务的依赖。这一结果与企业在监管报告变化后因银行更密集监控而承担更高成本相一致。进一步分析表明，当银行监管更严格时，IFRS 9对银行债务依赖的负面效应更加显著，且当企业更容易从银行债务转向公共债务融资时，该效应也更强。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了会计准则变更对实体经济融资结构的重大影响，为会计信息在银行监控和公司融资决策中的角色提供了新证据。

title: The Importance of Separating the Probability of Committing and Detecting Misstatements in the Restatement Setting
abstract: This study demonstrates the importance of separating the probabilities of misstatement occurrence and detection when examining financial statement restatements. Despite the many benefits of examining the probability of restatements using traditional logistic models, interpretations of these models are clouded by partial observability—only subsequently detected misstatements are observable. We propose addressing this often overlooked issue by implementing a bivariate probit model with partial observability. We demonstrate the importance of separating these latent probabilities by re-examining three prior restatement studies and show the importance of separating the occurrence and detection probabilities. Our evidence suggests that future studies interested in restatements as a measure of accounting quality should consider implementing bivariate probit models as one way to address the partial observability inherent in this setting. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: B. P. Miller gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Sam Frumer Professorship. Supplemental Material: Data and the internet appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4627 .
summary: 本研究旨在证明在分析财务报表重述时，区分错报发生概率和检测概率的重要性。传统逻辑回归模型虽然被广泛用于估计重述概率，但其结果受限于部分可观察性问题——只有事后被检测到的错报才能被观察到，而未被发现的错报无法纳入分析。作者提出采用部分可观察的双变量Probit模型来解决这一被忽视的问题，并通过重新检验三项已有的重述研究，展示了分离这两种潜在概率的关键作用。研究结果表明，未来以重述作为会计质量衡量指标的研究，应考虑应用双变量Probit模型来应对部分可观察性带来的偏误。
ai_comment: 本研究巧妙地将双变量Probit模型引入重述分析，有效解决了部分可观察性这一长期被忽略的方法论问题，为会计质量研究提供了更准确的推断工具。

title: Financial returns to household inventory management
abstract: Households tend to hold substantial amounts of non-financial assets in the form of consumer goods inventories that are unobserved by traditional measures of wealth, about $725 on average for products covered by our sample. Such holdings can eclipse total financial assets among households in the lowest income quintile. Households can obtain significant financial returns from strategically shopping and managing these inventories. In addition, they choose to maintain liquid savings—household working capital—not just for precautionary motives but also to support this inventory management. We demonstrate that households earn high marginal returns from investing in household working capital, well above 20% at low levels of inventory, though these marginal returns decline rapidly as inventory increases. Nevertheless, average returns from inventory management are high—about 50% for the typical household—and affect household portfolio returns substantially for all but the top income and asset quintiles. We provide evidence from scanner and survey data that supports this conclusion. For many households, working capital is therefore an important asset class that has been largely ignored by the household finance literature, and inventory management provides them with an alternative to investing in risky financial markets at low levels of liquid wealth.
summary: 该论文研究家庭在消费品存货管理中的财务回报。家庭持有大量未计入传统财富的非金融资产（消费品存货），样本家庭平均约725美元，最低收入群体的这种持有可能超过总金融资产。家庭可通过策略性购物和管理存货获得显著财务回报，并选择持有流动性储蓄（家庭营运资本）不仅出于预防性动机，还为了支持存货管理。研究发现，家庭从营运资本投资中获得高边际回报，低存货水平时超过20%，但随存货增加迅速下降。典型家庭的平均存货管理回报约50%，对除最高收入和资产五分之一群体外的所有家庭的投资组合回报有实质性影响。基于扫描和调查数据的证据支持这一结论。对于许多家庭，营运资本是一个重要的资产类别，但家庭金融文献长期忽视；存货管理为低流动财富家庭提供了投资风险金融市场的替代方案。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将家庭存货管理视为一种投资活动，揭示了其高回报特征，并强调了营运资本作为被忽视的资产类别，丰富了家庭金融理论。

title: Liquidity regulation and banks: Theory and evidence
abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically investigates the effects of liquidity regulation on the banking system. We document that the current quantity-based liquidity rule has reduced banks' liquidity risks. However, the mandated liquidity buffer appears to crowd out bank lending and lead to a migration of liquidity risks to banks that are not subject to liquidity regulation. These findings motivate a model of liquidity regulation with endogenous liquidity premiums and heterogeneous banks. The model shows that the current liquidity rule can improve upon the unregulated equilibrium but can also have distortionary effects because of the dual role of the liquidity buffer as an implicit tax and a costly mitigator of liquidity risks. The fixed quantity mandate can interact with the uncertain liquidity demand, amplifying the volatility in the liquidity premium. A central bank committed liquidity facility could improve the current quantity-based regulation by introducing a price-based mechanism.
summary: 本文从理论和实证两方面研究流动性监管对银行系统的影响。我们发现，现行的基于数量的流动性规则降低了银行的流动性风险。然而，强制性的流动性缓冲似乎挤出了银行贷款，并导致流动性风险转移到不受流动性监管约束的银行。这些发现启发我们构建了一个包含内生流动性溢价和异质性银行的流动性监管模型。模型表明，当前的流动性规则可以改善无监管的均衡状态，但由于流动性缓冲兼具隐性税收和昂贵的风险缓解工具的双重角色，也可能产生扭曲效应。固定数量要求与不确定的流动性需求相互作用，可能加剧流动性溢价的波动性。央行承诺的流动性便利可以通过引入价格机制来改进当前的基于数量的监管。
ai_comment: 本文同时考虑流动性缓冲的正面与负面效应，并通过模型揭示数量型规则与价格型工具的互补性，对监管设计具有重要启示。

title: The use of asset growth in empirical asset pricing models
abstract: We show that the performance of the new factor models of Hou et al. (2015) and Fama and French (2015) depends crucially on how their investment factor is constructed. Both models use growth in total assets to measure investment. Their ability to price the cross-section of returns decreases significantly when the investment factor is constructed using traditional investment measures, or measures that also account for investment in intangibles. In contrast, we find that factors based on growth in inventory and accounts receivable contain the bulk of the pricing information in the asset growth factor. We show evidence that the superior performance of the asset growth factor seems to be attributable to its ability to capture aggregate shocks to equity financing costs.
summary: 论文探讨了Hou et al. (2015)和Fama and French (2015)提出的新因子模型的表现如何关键依赖于其投资因子的构造方式。这两种模型都采用总资产增长来衡量投资。研究发现，当投资因子采用传统投资度量或包含无形资产投资的度量时，这些模型对股票横截面收益的定价能力显著下降。相反，基于存货增长和应收账款增长的因子包含了资产增长因子中大部分的定价信息。证据表明，资产增长因子的优越表现似乎归因于其能够捕捉股权融资成本的总体冲击。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了资产增长因子优越性的关键来源，指出存货和应收账款增长在定价中的核心作用，对资产定价模型的构建具有重要启示。

title: Artificial intelligence, firm growth, and product innovation
abstract: We study the use and economic impact of AI technologies. We propose a new measure of firm-level AI investments using employee resumes. Our measure reveals a stark increase in AI investments across sectors. AI-investing firms experience higher growth in sales, employment, and market valuations. This growth comes primarily through increased product innovation. Our results are robust to instrumenting AI investments using firms' exposure to universities' supply of AI graduates. AI-powered growth concentrates among larger firms and is associated with higher industry concentration. Our results highlight that new technologies like AI can contribute to growth and superstar firms through product innovation.
summary: 本文研究人工智能技术的使用及其经济影响。通过员工简历构建企业级AI投资的新衡量指标，发现各行业AI投资显著增加。投资AI的企业在销售、就业和市场估值方面实现更高增长，这种增长主要源于产品创新的增加。在使用大学AI毕业生供应量作为工具变量后，结果依然稳健。AI驱动的增长集中于大型企业，并与行业集中度上升相关。结论表明，AI等新技术能够通过产品创新促进企业增长并催生超级明星企业。
ai_comment: 利用简历数据构建企业AI投资指标具有创新性，揭示了AI通过产品创新促进企业增长的机制，为理解AI对经济结构和企业绩效的影响提供了新视角。

title: Monetary policy transmission in segmented markets
abstract: Repo markets are an important first stage of monetary policy transmission. In the European repo market, the majority of participants, including non-dealer banks and non-banks, do not have access to centralized trading platforms. Rather, they rely on OTC intermediation by a small number of dealers that exert significant market power. Dealer market power causes the passthrough of the ECB's policy rate to be inefficient and unequal. Allowing market participants access to centralized trading platforms, or a secured deposit facility with the central bank, could improve the transmission efficiency of monetary policy while reducing the dispersion in repo rates across customers.
summary: 该论文研究欧洲回购市场中货币政策传导的效率问题。由于大多数参与者（包括非交易商银行和非银行机构）无法接入集中交易平台，只能依赖少数具有显著市场势力的交易商进行场外（OTC）中介，导致欧洲央行（ECB）政策利率的传导低效且不平等。论文提出，允许市场参与者接入集中交易平台或设立中央银行的有担保存款便利，可以改善货币政策传导效率，同时减少不同客户之间回购利率的差异。
ai_comment: 该文聚焦于回购市场这一货币政策传导的第一阶段，揭示了市场分割和交易商市场势力对传导效率的负面影响，并给出了具体的政策建议，对理解欧元区货币政策操作具有重要参考价值。

The Narrow Channel of Quantitative Easing: Evidence from YCC Down Under
abstract: We study the recent Australian experience with yield curve control (YCC) as perhaps the best evidence of how this policy might work in other developed economies. YCC seemingly worked well in 2020, when the market expected short rates to stay at zero for a long period of time. As the global recovery and inflation gained momentum in 2021, liftoff expectations moved up, the Reserve Bank of Australia purchased most of the targeted government bond outstanding, and the target bond's yield dislocated from other financial market instruments. The evidence suggests that central bank bond purchase programs can operate more narrowly than previously considered.
summary: 本文研究澳大利亚近期实行收益率曲线控制（YCC）的经历，认为这可能是该政策在其他发达经济体如何运作的最佳证据。YCC在2020年看似运作良好，当时市场预期短期利率将长期维持零水平。随着2021年全球复苏和通胀势头增强，加息预期上升，澳大利亚储备银行购买了大部分目标政府债券，导致目标债券收益率与其他金融工具脱节。证据表明，央行债券购买计划可以比之前认为的更狭窄地运作。
ai_comment: 本文通过澳大利亚的独特自然实验，提供了YCC政策在特定市场环境下有效性的直接证据，并揭示了其运作的狭窄渠道，对量化宽松政策研究有重要贡献。

title: Currency Carry, Momentum, and Global Interest Rate Volatility
abstract: Returns to currency carry and momentum compensate for the risk of global interest rate volatility (IRV), with risk exposures explaining 92% of the cross-sectional return variations. This unified explanation stems from its impact on foreign exchange intermediaries. An intermediary-based exchange rate model shows that a higher global IRV increases the uncertainty of future risk-taking and tightens current financial constraints. Position unwinding triggers loss of carry and momentum. Additional empirical results confirm this economic channel. Global IRV risk is also negatively priced in other currency strategies and momentum. The explanatory power is not driven by existing measures of uncertainty or intermediary constraints.
summary: 本文研究货币利差和动量策略的回报，发现它们补偿了全球利率波动（IRV）风险，且风险敞口解释了92%的截面收益变化。作者提出一个基于外汇中介的汇率模型，其中更高的全球IRV增加了未来风险承担的不确定性并收紧当前金融约束，导致头寸平仓从而引发利差和动量损失。实证结果支持这一经济渠道，并显示全球IRV风险在其他货币策略和动量中也得到负定价。这种解释力并非由现有的不确定性或中介约束指标所驱动。
ai_comment: 该论文为货币利差和动量策略提供了统一的风险解释，通过中介渠道揭示了全球利率波动作为系统性风险因子的重要性，实证证据充分且稳健。

title: Systemic Risk and Monetary Policy: The Haircut Gap Channel of the Lender of Last Resort
abstract: We show that lender of last resort (LOLR) policy exacerbates bank interconnectedness. Using novel micro-level data, we analyze LOLR’s haircut gaps: the differences between the private market and central bank haircuts. LOLR policy incentivizes banks to increase pledging and holdings of higher haircut-gap bonds, especially those issued by domestic and systemically important banks. Effects only apply to banks, not to nonbanks without LOLR access. LOLR funding revives bank bond issuance associated with higher haircut gaps and increases the subsequent correlation between pledging and issuing banks’ bond prices, in particular during periods of low-market returns and for domestic, systemically important banks.
summary: 本文研究了最后贷款人（LOLR）政策对银行互联性的影响。利用新颖的微观数据，分析了LOLR的haircut gaps，即私人市场与央行haircut之间的差异。结果表明，LOLR政策激励银行增加质押和持有更高haircut gap的债券，特别是由国内系统重要性银行发行的债券。这种效应仅适用于拥有LOLR准入权的银行，而不适用于非银行机构。LOLR融资重新激活了银行债券发行，且这些发行与更高的haircut gaps相关，并随后增加了质押银行与发行银行债券价格之间的相关性，尤其在市场回报率低的时期和国内系统重要性银行中更为显著。
ai_comment: 论文通过新颖的微观数据揭示了LOLR政策通过haircut gap渠道加剧银行互联性的机制，对理解最后贷款人政策的系统性风险含义具有重要贡献。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Education, and Entrepreneurship
abstract: We document an unprecedented brain drain of Artificial Intelligence (AI) professors from universities from 2004 to 2018. We find that students from the affected universities establish fewer AI startups and raise less funding. The brain‐drain effect is significant for tenured professors, professors from top universities, and deep‐learning professors. Additional evidence suggests that unobserved city‐ and university‐level shocks are unlikely to drive our results. We consider several economic channels for the findings. The most consistent explanation is that professors' departures reduce startup founders' AI knowledge, which we find is an important factor for successful startup formation and fundraising.
summary: 本文记录了2004至2018年间人工智能（AI）教授从大学向业界的空前人才流失现象，发现受影响大学的学生创立的AI初创企业数量减少、融资额降低。这一影响对于终身教授、顶尖大学教授以及深度学习方向的教授尤为显著。通过额外证据排除了城市和大学层面的未观测冲击，并考察了多种经济渠道，最终最一致的解释是教授离职减少了创业者的AI知识，而AI知识是成功创办企业并筹集资金的重要因素。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统量化了AI教授人才流失对创业生态的负面影响，强调了高校知识传递在创新中的关键作用，为政策制定者提供了重要参考。

title: Are Analyst “Top Picks” Informative?
abstract: Following the Global Settlement, analysts extensively use a top pick designation allowing for greater granularity of information among buy recommended stocks, but conflicts of interest can potentially influence this designation. Examining a novel sample of top picks, we find that a calendar-time portfolio of top picks generates an abnormal performance of 17.6% per year. Top picks have greater investment value than do buy recommendations and alternative analyst investment strategies. Both institutional and retail investors trade in response to top picks. However, only institutional investors appear to identify top picks that have greater investment value when they are announced.
summary: 论文研究分析师'首选'（top picks）是否具有信息含量。在全球和解之后，分析师广泛使用top pick设计，允许在买入推荐股票中提供更精细的信息，但利益冲突可能影响这一设计。通过考察一个新颖的top picks样本，发现日历时间组合的年度异常收益率达到17.6%。Top picks比买入推荐和其他分析师投资策略具有更大的投资价值。机构投资者和散户投资者都会对top picks作出交易反应，但只有机构投资者似乎能在top picks公布时识别出那些具有更高投资价值的股票。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的数据集揭示了分析师'首选'推荐具有显著的超额收益，并发现机构投资者能更有效地甄别其中的价值信息，对理解分析师信息传递和市场效率有重要贡献。

title: Prestige, Promotion, and Pay
abstract: We develop a theory in which financial (and other professional services) firms design career structures to “sell” prestigious jobs to qualified candidates. Firms create less prestigious entry‐level jobs, which serve as currency for employees to pay for the right to compete for the more prestigious jobs. In optimal career structures, entry‐level employees (“associates”) compete for better‐paid and more prestigious positions (“managing directors” or “partners”). The model provides new implications relating job prestige to compensation, employment, competition, and the size of the financial sector.
summary: 本文构建了一个理论模型，解释金融及其他专业服务公司如何设计职业结构，以向合格候选人“出售”有声望的工作。公司设立声望较低的入门级职位，员工以此作为“货币”支付竞争更高级别有声望职位的权利。在最优职业结构中，入门级员工（“associates”）竞争收入更高、声望更高的职位（如“managing directors”或“partners”）。该模型为理解工作声望与薪酬、就业、竞争以及金融部门规模之间的关系提供了新的启示。
ai_comment: 该模型将职业声誉视为一种可交易商品，创新性地解释了金融行业内部竞争与薪酬结构的形成机制，为理解高薪行业中的晋升竞争提供了理论框架。

title: Legal Risk and Insider Trading
abstract: Do illegal insiders internalize legal risk? We address this question with hand‐collected data from 530 SEC (the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission) investigations. Using two plausibly exogenous shocks to expected penalties, we show that insiders trade less aggressively and earlier and concentrate on tips of greater value when facing a higher risk. The results match the predictions of a model where an insider internalizes the impact of trades on prices and the likelihood of prosecution and anticipates penalties in proportion to trade profits. Our findings lend support to the effectiveness of U.S. regulations' deterrence and the long‐standing hypothesis that insider trading enforcement can hamper price informativeness.
summary: 本文研究非法内幕交易者是否会内化法律风险。利用从530起美国证券交易委员会调查中手工收集的数据，通过两个理论上外生的预期惩罚冲击，发现当面临更高法律风险时，内幕交易者会降低交易激进程度、提前交易时间，并集中于价值更高的内幕消息。结果与一个模型预测一致，该模型中内幕交易者内化了交易对价格的影响、被起诉的概率以及预期惩罚与交易利润成比例。研究结论支持美国监管威慑的有效性，以及内幕交易执法会削弱价格信息性的长期假说。
ai_comment: 该文利用外生冲击识别因果效应，量化了法律风险对内幕交易行为的真实影响，为监管有效性提供了微观证据。

title: The Virtue of Complexity in Return Prediction
abstract: Much of the extant literature predicts market returns with “simple” models that use only a few parameters. Contrary to conventional wisdom, we theoretically prove that simple models severely understate return predictability compared to “complex” models in which the number of parameters exceeds the number of observations. We empirically document the virtue of complexity in U.S. equity market return prediction. Our findings establish the rationale for modeling expected returns through machine learning.
summary: 这篇论文质疑了现有文献中普遍使用少数参数的“简单”模型来预测市场回报的做法。作者从理论上证明，与参数数量超过观测数量的“复杂”模型相比，简单模型会严重低估回报的可预测性。论文在美国股票市场回报预测的实证研究中证实了复杂性的优势，从而为通过机器学习建模预期收益率提供了理论依据。
ai_comment: 该文从理论和实证两个层面颠覆了传统简单模型的认知，为机器学习在资产定价中的应用提供了强有力的支持。

title: Place Your Bets? The Value of Investment Research on Reddit’s Wallstreetbets
abstract: We examine the value of due diligence recommendations on Reddit’s Wallstreetbets (WSB) platform. Before the Gamestop (GME) short squeeze, recommendations are significant predictors of returns and cash-flow news. This predictability is eliminated post-GME. Post-GME, the fraction of reports emphasizing price-pressure or attention-grabbing stocks dramatically increases, and the decline in informativeness is concentrated in these reports. Similarly, retail trade informativeness is particularly strong following DD reports in the pre-GME period, but not post-GME. Our findings are consistent with the view that the Gamestop event altered the culture of WSB, leading to a deterioration in investment quality that adversely affected smaller investors.
summary: 本研究考察了Reddit Wallstreetbets（WSB）平台上尽职调查推荐的价值。在Gamestop（GME）轧空事件之前，这些推荐能显著预测股票回报和现金流新闻，但该预测能力在GME事件后消失。GME之后，强调价格压力或吸引眼球股票的报告比例急剧增加，信息含量的下降主要集中于此。同样，零售交易的信息含量在GME前时期紧随尽职调查报告后尤为明显，但在GME后不再如此。研究结果支持GME事件改变了WSB文化、导致投资质量恶化并对小投资者产生不利影响的观点。
ai_comment: 利用GME轧空作为自然实验，揭示社交媒体投资推荐文化变迁对市场信息效率的深远影响，为行为金融与市场微观结构交叉领域提供了实证证据。

title: The Impact of Credit Market Development on Auditor Choice: Evidence from Banking Deregulation
abstract: We exploit the staggered state‐level adoption of the Riegle‐Neal Interstate Banking and Branching Efficiency Act (IBBEA) to examine how banking deregulation and the resulting increase in bank competition affect firms’ auditor choices. We find that an exogenous increase in the degree of interstate branch banking deregulation leads to a reduction in firms’ propensity to engage a Big N or industry expert auditor. This main result, when combined with our cross‐sectional analyses, offers evidence suggesting that deregulation leads to less demand for higher quality auditors because (1) firms have increased access to credit, which reduces the benefits of higher audit quality; (2) entering banks’ lending expertise substitutes for higher quality financial statements; (3) incumbent banks with less lending expertise seek to protect their rents by preferring that borrowers provide lower quality financial statement information; and (4) external stakeholders delegate their monitoring to banks to a greater degree, resulting in less demand for higher quality financial statements. As such, our study sheds light on how the U.S. credit market's infrastructure shapes firms’ auditor choice decisions.
summary: 利用美国各州逐步采纳《里格尔-尼尔州际银行与分行效率法案》（IBBEA）的准自然实验，研究银行放松监管及随之而来的银行竞争加剧如何影响企业的审计师选择。发现跨州分行银行放松监管的外生增加导致企业聘请“四大”或行业专家审计师的倾向下降。结合横截面分析，证据表明放松监管降低了对高质量审计师的需求，因为：(1) 企业信贷可得性增加，降低了高质量审计的收益；(2) 新进入银行的贷款专长替代了高质量财务报表；(3) 缺乏贷款专长的在位银行通过偏好借款人提供较低质量的财务报表信息来保护租金；(4) 外部利益相关者更多地依赖银行监督，从而减少对高质量财务报表的需求。研究揭示了美国信贷市场基础设施如何影响企业的审计师选择决策。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验巧妙识别因果关系，揭示了信贷市场竞争对审计需求的替代效应。

title: Aversion to Student Debt? Evidence from Low‐Wage Workers
abstract: We combine state minimum wage changes with individual‐level income and credit data to estimate the effect of wage gains on the debt of low‐wage workers. In the three years following a $0.88 minimum wage increase, low‐wage workers experience a $2,712 income increase and a $856 decrease in debt. The entire decline in debt comes from less student loan borrowing among enrolled college students. Credit constraints, buffer‐stock behavior, and other rational channels cannot explain the reduction in student debt. Our results are consistent with students perceiving a utility cost of borrowing student debt arising from mental accounting.
summary: 本文利用州最低工资变化与个人收入和信用数据，估计工资增长对低工资工人债务的影响。在最低工资上涨0.88美元后的三年内，低工资工人收入增加2,712美元，债务减少856美元。全部债务下降来自于在校大学生学生贷款借款的减少。信用约束、缓冲存货行为等理性渠道无法解释学生债务的下降。结果与心理账户导致的学生对学生贷款借款的效用成本感知一致。
ai_comment: 利用最低工资变化作为外生冲击，识别了工资增长对低工资工人债务的因果效应，并揭示了心理账户在学生贷款决策中的重要作用。

title: Disclosing to Informed Traders
abstract: We develop a model in which a firm's manager can voluntarily disclose to privately informed investors. In equilibrium, the manager only discloses sufficiently favorable news. If the manager is known to be informed but disclosure is costly, the probability of disclosure increases with market liquidity and the stock trades at a discount relative to expected cash flows. However, when investors are uncertain about whether the manager is informed, disclosure can decrease with market liquidity and the stock can trade at a premium relative to expected cash flows. Moreover, contrary to common intuition, public information can crowd in more voluntary disclosure.
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，研究公司经理如何向拥有私人信息的投资者进行自愿披露。在均衡状态下，经理仅会披露足够有利的消息。当经理已知具有信息优势但披露存在成本时，披露概率随市场流动性的增加而上升，且股票价格相对于预期现金流存在折价。然而，当投资者不确定经理是否知情时，披露概率可能随市场流动性增加而下降，股票价格则可能相对于预期现金流出现溢价。此外，与常见直觉相反，公共信息可能会促使更多自愿披露。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入投资者对经理信息状态的不确定性，得出了与标准模型相反的结论，揭示了信息披露与市场流动性之间的复杂关系，对自愿披露理论有重要贡献。

title: The Corporate Investment Benefits of Mutual Fund Dual Holdings
abstract: Mutual fund families increasingly hold bonds and stocks from the same firm. We present evidence that dual ownership allows firms to increase valuable investments and refinance by issuing bonds with lower yields and fewer restrictive covenants, especially when firms face financial distress. Dual holders also prevent overinvestment by firms with entrenched managers. Overall, our results suggest that mutual fund families internalize the agency conflicts of their portfolio companies, highlighting the positive governance externalities of intra-family cooperation.
summary: 本文研究共同基金家族同时持有同一公司债券和股票（双重所有权）对企业投资和融资的影响。利用实证分析发现，双重所有权使企业能够增加有价值的投资，并通过发行收益率较低、限制性契约较少的债券进行再融资，特别是在企业面临财务困境时效果更显著。此外，双重持有者还能防止具有根深蒂固管理者的企业过度投资。总体而言，结果表明共同基金家族会内化其投资组合公司的代理冲突，凸显了家族内部合作带来的积极治理外部性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从双重持有视角揭示共同基金家族内部合作对实体企业治理的正外部性，并区分了促进投资与抑制过度投资的双重机制。

title: Refinancing Inequality During the COVID-19 Pandemic
abstract: During the first half of 2020, the difference in savings from mortgage refinancing between high- and low-income borrowers was 10 times higher than before. This was the result of two factors: high-income borrowers increased their refinancing activity more than otherwise comparable low-income borrowers and, conditional on refinancing, they captured slightly larger improvements in interest rates. Refinancing inequality increases with the severity of the COVID-19 pandemic and is characterized by an underrepresentation of low-income borrowers in the pool of applications. We estimate a difference of $5 billion in savings between the top income quintile and the rest of the market.
summary: 该研究分析了2020年上半年COVID-19疫情期间美国抵押贷款再融资市场中的不平等现象。研究发现，高收入借款人与低收入借款人之间的再融资储蓄差异比疫情前扩大了10倍。这一差异主要由两个因素驱动：一方面，高收入借款人的再融资活动增幅显著高于可比低收入借款人；另一方面，在成功再融资的群体中，高收入借款人获得的利率降幅略大。再融资不平等程度随疫情严重性上升而加剧，且低收入借款人在再融资申请中的代表性不足。研究估计，收入最高五分位借款人相对于其余市场节省的利息总额高达50亿美元。
ai_comment: 该论文通过详实数据揭示了疫情期间再融资市场中低收入群体被系统性边缘化的现象，量化了高达50亿美元的储蓄鸿沟，为理解经济冲击下金融不平等机制提供了关键证据。

title: Brokers and Finders in Startup Offerings
