We consider a model in which the board can acquire costly information about the firm's optimal strategic direction. The board not only advises the CEO on strategy, but also must approve it, and the CEO exerts effort to implement the strategy. We find that the board gathers less information when the CEO believes more strongly in his vision. Further, depending on the strength of the CEO's belief bias, the board either plays an advisory role, a monitoring role, or a rubberstamping role. The model predicts that in firms that are led by highly visionary CEOs, boards are passive in that they acquire little information and rubberstamp the visionary's proposal. Nevertheless, shareholders prefer the visionary over an unbiased manager in industries in which obtaining information about the correct course of action is difficult and costly.
summary: 该论文构建了一个理论模型，研究当CEO对自己的愿景抱有强烈信念时，董事会应如何提供建议和监督。董事会可以获取关于公司最佳战略方向的昂贵信息，并向CEO提供建议并批准其战略，同时CEO付出努力来实施战略。研究发现，当CEO对其愿景信念越强时，董事会收集的信息越少；并且根据CEO信念偏见的强度，董事会分别扮演咨询、监督或橡皮图章的角色。模型预测，在高度有远见的CEO领导的公司中，董事会十分被动，几乎不获取信息且轻易批准CEO的提案。然而，在获取正确行动方向的信息困难且成本高昂的行业中，股东更偏好有远见的CEO而非无偏见的经理。
ai_comment: 该模型揭示了CEO信念强度如何影响董事会的角色转变，为实际中董事会行为的差异化提供了理论解释。

title: Nonregular Employment and Payout Policy: Evidence from the Massachusetts Independent Contractor Law
abstract: Compared with regular employees, independent contractors (ICs) offer labor flexibility and cost savings to their employers. Using a difference-in-differences design around the 2004 Massachusetts law that discourages IC usage, we find that this exogenous decrease in IC usage makes treated firms’ earnings more sensitive to changes in sales, increases labor-related expenses, and reduces profitability. Firms subsequently reduce share repurchases. The decrease is more pronounced for firms with high operating leverage and financial constraints. Our results are robust to entropy balancing. We conclude that IC usage affects firms’ operating leverage and profitability, which in turn, influence payout policy. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00103 .
summary: 本文利用2004年马萨诸塞州一项抑制独立承包商（Independent Contractors, ICs）使用的法律作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法（difference-in-differences），研究了IC使用减少对企业支付政策的影响。研究发现，该法律导致企业IC使用下降，进而使得企业盈利对销售收入变化的敏感度增加、劳动相关支出上升、盈利能力下降，并最终促使企业减少股票回购。这种效应在高经营杠杆和财务约束的企业中更为显著。通过熵平衡（entropy balancing）检验，结果保持稳健。结论表明，IC使用通过影响企业的经营杠杆和盈利能力，进而影响其支付政策。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用法律变化作为自然实验，揭示了非正规雇佣对企业财务决策的重要影响，为理解劳动市场与公司金融的交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: Are Third-Party Fundamental Valuations Relevant in Public Company Takeovers?
abstract: In U.S. mergers and acquisitions, target directors are required to consider third-party financial valuations, summarized in a “fairness opinion” before accepting a takeover offer. Critics argue (1) that these valuations are not relevant for public companies, which can assess the desirability of the deal based on the market premium, and (2) that the investment bank providers cater to management by “rationalizing” the deal price rather than providing an independent valuation check. I find that fairness valuations can provide valid information about the target’s value, incremental to its predeal stock price. They can impound expected transaction synergies, unravel rumor-driven stock price runups, and may signal ex ante fundamental mispricing. I also find evidence of the alleged catering, which I distinguish from “legitimate” valuation disagreements. This suggests that third-party fundamental valuation could play a useful role in the governance of public company takeovers, but there are flaws in its current implementation. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4959 .
summary: 本文研究美国上市公司并购中目标公司董事必须考虑的第三方估值（公平性意见）的相关性。批评观点认为，上市公司可通过市场溢价评估交易，且投行可能迎合管理层而非提供独立估值。作者发现，公平性估值能提供增量于交易前股价的有效信息，包括预期交易协同效应、揭示谣言驱动的股价上涨，并可能信号事前基本错误定价。同时，存在迎合行为的证据，需与合法估值分歧区分。这表明第三方估值在上市公司收购治理中有用，但当前实施存在缺陷。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证揭示了第三方估值的双重角色：既有信息增量价值，又存在迎合管理层的局限，为监管和改进实施提供了重要启示。

title: The Global Determinants of International Equity Risk Premiums
abstract: We examine the commonalities in international equity risk premiums by linking empirical evidence for the ability of U.S. downside and upside variance risk premiums (DVP and UVP, respectively) to predict international stock returns with implications from an empirical model featuring asymmetric economic uncertainty and risk aversion. We find that DVP and UVP predict international stock returns through U.S. bad and good macroeconomic uncertainties, respectively. Sixty percent to 80% of the dynamics of the global equity risk premium for horizons under seven months are driven by economic uncertainty, whereas risk aversion appears more relevant for longer horizons. The predictability patterns of DVP and UVP vary across countries depending on those countries’ financial and economic exposure to global shocks. In those with higher economic exposure, investors demand higher compensation for bad macroeconomic uncertainty but lower compensation for good macroeconomic uncertainty, whereas the compensation for bad macroeconomic uncertainty is lower for countries with high financial exposure. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4958 .
summary: 本文研究了国际股票风险溢价的共同决定因素。通过将美国下行方差风险溢价（DVP）和上行方差风险溢价（UVP）对国际股票回报的预测能力与一个包含非对称经济不确定性和风险厌恶的实证模型相联系，发现DVP和UVP分别通过美国坏的和好的宏观经济不确定性来预测国际股票回报。在7个月以下的期限，全球股票风险溢价的60%-80%由经济不确定性驱动，而风险厌恶在更长期限中作用更大。不同国家的预测模式差异取决于它们对全球冲击的经济和金融暴露：经济暴露高的国家，投资者对坏宏观经济不确定性要求更高补偿，对好宏观经济不确定性要求更低补偿；金融暴露高的国家则对坏宏观经济不确定性的补偿更低。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将美国方差风险溢价分解为下行和上行两部分，并揭示其通过不同宏观经济不确定性渠道预测国际股票回报的机制，为理解全球风险溢价的结构性驱动因素提供了新视角。

title: Nominal U.S. Treasuries Embed Liquidity Premiums, Too
abstract: A novel arbitrage-free model of nominal U.S. Treasuries that decomposes yields into frictionless expected rates, frictionless term premiums, and liquidity premiums produces four key results from Jan. 1987 to Aug. 2023. First, liquidity loadings are larger than for the slope and higher-order principal components. Second, the countercyclicality of required nominal Treasury returns owes to liquidity, if anything, not frictionless term premiums. Third, Federal Reserve large-scale asset purchases generally work through expected rates and frictionless term premiums, not liquidity premiums. Fourth, given similar estimates using TIPS, inflation expectations are less moored around the Federal Reserve’s price objectives than other models say.
summary: 该论文提出一个新颖的无套利模型，将名义美国国债收益率分解为无摩擦预期利率、无摩擦期限溢价和流动性溢价。基于1987年1月至2023年8月的数据，得到四个关键结果：第一，流动性载荷大于斜率和高阶主成分的载荷；第二，名义国债收益率的反周期性归因于流动性而非无摩擦期限溢价；第三，美联储大规模资产购买主要通过预期利率和无摩擦期限溢价起作用，而非流动性溢价；第四，利用类似方法对TIPS的估计表明，通胀预期与美联储价格目标的挂钩程度低于其他模型所显示的水平。
ai_comment: 该模型将流动性溢价与期限溢价明确区分，为理解国债收益率的周期性特征和货币政策传导提供了新视角。

title: Firm Size, Capital Investment, and Debt Financing over Industry Business Cycles
abstract: We find that capital investment and net debt issuance of large firms are, on average, more sensitive to industry business cycles than those of small firms, in stark contrast to the effect of size on investment sensitivity to macroeconomic cycles. We theoretically examine the role of firm size on firms’ responses to industry shocks. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, we find that large firms exhibit greater sensitivity to industry cycles than small firms in their investment and net debt issuance only in industries with low cyclical variability of markups and production growth, high fixed cost intensity, high market-to-book, and high markups.
summary: 本研究考察了企业规模如何影响资本投资和债务融资对行业商业周期的敏感性。实证发现，大公司的投资和净债务发行对行业周期的平均敏感性高于小公司，这与规模对宏观经济周期投资敏感性的影响形成鲜明对比。作者从理论上分析了企业规模对行业冲击响应的影响，实证结果与理论预测一致：只有在行业周期性波动（如加成率和生产增长的低波动性、高固定成本密集型、高市值账面比和高加成率）较低的行业中，大公司才表现出比小公司更高的投资和净债务发行对行业周期的敏感性。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了企业规模对行业周期响应的重要不对称性，并提供了理论解释和实证证据，对理解企业融资和投资决策有贡献。

title: Peer Versus Pure Benchmarks in the Compensation of Mutual Fund Managers
abstract: We examine the role of peer (e.g., Lipper manager indices) versus pure (e.g., S&P 500) benchmarks in fund manager compensation. We model their impact on manager incentives and then test those predictions using novel data. We find that 71% of managers are compensated based on peer benchmarks. Consistent with the model, peer-benchmarked fund managers exhibit higher effort generating higher gross performance and collect higher fee income. Analyzing advisors’ choice between benchmark types, we show that peer-benchmarking advisors cater to more sophisticated and performance-sensitive investors, and are more likely to sell through direct channels, consistent with investor heterogeneity and market segmentation.
summary: 本文研究了共同基金经理薪酬中同行基准（如Lipper经理指数）与纯基准（如标普500）的作用。通过建立模型分析两种基准对经理激励的影响，并利用新数据进行实证检验。研究发现，71%的基金经理基于同行基准获得薪酬。与模型预测一致，同行基准基金经理表现出更高的努力水平，产生更高的总业绩，并收取更高的费用收入。进一步分析顾问选择基准类型的行为表明，采用同行基准的顾问更倾向于迎合更成熟、对业绩更敏感的投资者，且更可能通过直接渠道销售，这支持了投资者异质性和市场细分的观点。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特数据揭示了基金薪酬实践中同行基准的普遍性及其对经理行为和业绩的显著影响，为理解基金行业激励机制提供了新见解。

title: Information Complementarities and the Dynamics of Transparency Shock Spillovers
abstract: We show that information complementarities play an important role in the spillover of transparency shocks. We exploit the revelation of financial misconduct by S&P 500 firms, and in a “Stacked Difference‐in‐Differences” design, find that the implied cost of capital increases for “close” industry peers of the fraudulent firms relative to “distant” industry peers. The spillover effect is particularly strong when the close peers and the fraudulent firm share common analyst coverage and common institutional ownership, which have been shown to be powerful proxies for fundamental linkages and information complementarities. We provide evidence that increase in the cost of capital of peer firms is due, at least in part, to “beta shocks.” Disclosure by close peers—especially those with co‐coverage and co‐ownership links—also increases following fraud revelation. Although disclosure remains high in the following years, the cost of equity starts to decrease.
summary: 本文研究信息互补性在透明度冲击溢出中的作用。通过利用标普500公司财务不当行为的揭露，采用堆叠双重差分设计，发现相对于“远”行业同行，欺诈公司的“近”行业同行的隐含资本成本上升。溢出效应在近同行与欺诈公司共享分析师覆盖和共同机构所有权时尤为显著，这些变量是基本面联系和信息互补性的有力代理变量。证据表明，同行公司资本成本上升部分归因于“贝塔冲击”。欺诈揭露后，近同行的信息披露也增加，尽管后续年份信息披露保持高位，但权益成本开始下降。
ai_comment: 论文利用自然实验揭示了信息互补性在同行溢出中的关键机制，为理解信息披露对资本成本的影响提供了新视角。

title: Are Financial Statements More Comparable When GAAP Restricts Managers’ Discretion?
abstract: I examine whether financial statements are more comparable when accounting standards restrict managers’ discretion. My evidence suggests that restricting managers’ discretion is associated with reduced comparability, on average. This effect is strongest when transactions are dissimilar. To explore this relation, I develop novel measures of two distinct types of incomparability. I find that restricting managers’ discretion is associated with an increase in incomparability stemming from dissimilar transactions appearing overly similar. Together, these findings suggest that restricting managers’ discretion may be more harmful to comparability than is too much diversity in practice. However, I also find evidence that restricting managers’ discretion may enhance comparability in two scenarios. Specifically, I find that restricting managers’ discretion is associated with improved comparability when standards (1) restrict manipulation of financial reports and (2) eliminate dissimilar accounting treatments that do not reflect differences in the underlying transactions. Overall, these findings nuance our understanding of how the requirements imposed by standard setters influence financial statement comparability. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Funding: Financial support from The School of Accountancy at the University of Arizona and the John T. Steed School of Accounting at the University of Oklahoma is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4961 .
summary: 本文研究了会计准则限制管理者自由裁量权是否增强了财务报表的可比性。证据表明，限制管理者自由裁量权总体上降低了可比性，尤其是在交易不相似的情况下。为探索这一关系，作者开发了两种不同不可比性的新度量指标，发现限制管理者自由裁量权会导致因不相似交易显得过于相似而产生的不可比性增加。这些发现表明，限制自由裁量权可能比实践中过多的多样性对可比性更有害。然而，在两种情况下限制自由裁量权可能增强可比性：当准则（1）限制财务报告操纵和（2）消除不反映潜在交易差异的不相似会计处理时。总体而言，这些发现细化了我们对准则制定者要求如何影响财务报表可比性的理解。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分两种不可比性，揭示了限制自由裁量权对可比性的复杂影响，为准则制定提供了细致入微的见解。

title: The Impact of AI and Cross-Border Data Regulation on International Trade in Digital Services: A Large Language Model
abstract: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) and of cross-border restrictions on data flows has created a host of new questions and related policy dilemmas.This paper addresses two questions: How is digital service trade shaped by (1) AI algorithms and (2) by the interplay between AI algorithms and cross-border restrictions on data flows?Answers lie in the palm of your hand: From London to Lagos, mobile app users trigger international transactions when they open AI-powered foreign apps.We have 2015-2020 usage data for the most popular 35,575 mobile apps and, to quantify the AI deployed in each of these apps, we use a large language model (LLM) to link each app to each of the app developer's AI patents.(Thislinkage of specific products to specific patents is a methodological innovation.)Armed with data on app usage by country, with AI deployed in each app, and with an instrument for AI (a Heckscher-Ohlin cost-shifter), we answer our two questions.(1) On average, AI causally raises an app's number of foreign users by 2.67 log points or by more than 10-fold.(2) The impact of AI on foreign users is halved if the foreign users are in a country with strong restrictions on cross-border data flows.These countries are usually autocracies.We also provide a new way of measuring AI knowledge spillovers across firms and find large spillovers.Finally, our work suggests numerous ways in which LLMs such as ChatGPT can be used in other applications.
summary: 本研究利用2015-2020年35575款热门移动应用的跨国使用数据，通过大型语言模型（LLM）将每款应用与其开发者的AI专利进行关联（方法创新），并采用赫克歇尔-俄林成本变动因素作为AI的工具变量，考察了AI和跨境数据流动限制对数字服务贸易的影响。研究发现：(1) AI平均使应用的外国用户数量增加2.67对数点，即超过10倍；(2) 若外国用户所在国实施严格的跨境数据流动限制，AI的促进作用减半，而这些国家通常是威权国家。此外，研究还提出了测量企业间AI知识溢出的新方法，并发现存在显著溢出效应。
ai_comment: 通过专利-产品链接创新地量化了AI在具体应用中的部署，并揭示了跨境数据监管显著削弱AI带来的贸易促进效应，为数字贸易政策提供了重要实证依据。

title: Federal Reserve Structure and the Production of Monetary Policy Ideas
abstract: We evaluate the decentralized structure of the Federal Reserve System as a mechanism for generating and processing new ideas on monetary policy over the 1960 -2000 period.We document the introduction of monetarism, rational expectations, credibility, transparency, and other monetary policy ideas by Reserve Banks into the Federal Reserve System.We argue that the Reserve Banks were willing to support and develop new ideas due to internal reforms to the FOMC that Chairman William McChesney Martin implemented in the 1950s and the increased ties with academia that developed in this period.Furthermore, the Reserve Banks were able to succeed at this because of their private-public governance structure.We illustrate this with a time-consistency model in which a decentralized organization is better at producing new ideas than a centralized one.We argue that this role of the Reserve Banks is an important benefit of the Federal Reserve's decentralized structure by allowing for more competition in formulating ideas and by reducing groupthink.
summary: 本文评估了美联储系统分散化的结构在1960-2000年间作为生成和处理货币政策新思想的机制。论文记录了储备银行将货币主义、理性预期、可信度、透明度等货币政策思想引入美联储系统。作者认为，储备银行之所以愿意支持和发展新思想，是因为1950年代威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁主席实施的联邦公开市场委员会内部改革，以及在此期间与学术界联系的加强。此外，储备银行凭借其公私治理结构得以成功。论文通过一个时间一致性模型说明，分散化组织比集中化组织更擅长产生新思想。作者强调，储备银行的作用是美联储分散化结构的一个重要好处，因为它允许在思想形成中更多竞争，并减少群体思维。
ai_comment: 本文从思想生产的新视角论证了美联储分散结构的优势，为理解中央银行组织设计提供了有价值的历史和理论分析。

title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds
Learning by Investing: Entrepreneurial Spillovers from Venture Capital
Supply and Demand and the Term Structure of Interest Rates
abstract: We survey the growing literature emphasizing the role that supply-and-demand forces play in shaping the term structure of interest rates.Our starting point is the Vayanos and Vila (2009, 2021) model of the term structure of default-free bond yields, which we present in both discrete and continuous time.The key friction in the model is that the bond market is partially segmented from other financial markets: the prices of short-rate and bond supply risk are set by specialized bond arbitrageurs who must absorb shocks to the supply and demand for bonds from other "preferred-habitat" agents.We discuss extensions of this model in the context of default-free bonds and other asset classes.
summary: 本文综述了日益增长的关于供需力量在塑造利率期限结构中的作用的文献。起点是Vayanos和Vila（2009, 2021）的无违约债券收益率期限结构模型，并以离散时间和连续时间两种形式呈现。模型的关键摩擦在于债券市场与其他金融市场部分分割：短期利率和债券供给风险的价格由专业债券套利者设定，这些套利者必须吸收来自其他“偏好栖息地”代理人的债券供需冲击。文章还讨论了该模型在无违约债券和其他资产类别中的扩展。
ai_comment: 该综述系统梳理了供需视角下的期限结构理论，强调了市场分割和套利者行为在定价中的作用，为后续研究提供了坚实的理论框架。

title: Recent Developments in Financial Risk and the Real Economy
abstract: This paper reviews recent developments in macro and finance on the relationship between financial risk and the real economy.We focus on three specific topics: the term structure of uncertainty, time variation -and specifically the long-term decline -in the variance risk premium, and time variation in conditional skewness.We also introduce two new data series: implied volatility from one-day options on grains for the period 1906-1936, and on cliquet options, which provide insurance against single-day crashes on the S&P 500, both of which give some context to the recent rise in trade in extremely short-dated options.Finally, we discuss new avenues for future research.
summary: 本文综述了宏观金融领域关于金融风险与实体经济关系的最新进展。重点讨论了三个主题：不确定性的期限结构、方差风险溢价的时间变化（尤其是长期下降）以及条件偏度的时间变化。此外，本文还引入了两个新的数据序列：1906-1936年谷物一日期权的隐含波动率，以及为标普500单日暴跌提供保险的cliquet期权，这些数据为近期极短期期权交易的增加提供了背景。最后，文章探讨了未来研究的新方向。
ai_comment: 该文通过回顾最新进展并引入两个独特的历史数据序列，为理解金融风险与实体经济之间的动态关系提供了新视角，特别是极短期期权市场的兴起。

title: Financial Windfalls, Portfolio Allocations, and Risk Preferences
abstract: We investigate the impact of financial windfalls on household portfolio choices and risk exposure. Exploiting the randomized assignment of lottery prizes in three Swedish lotteries, we find a windfall gain of $100K leads to a 5-percentage-point de- crease in the risky share of household portfolios. We show theoretically that negative wealth effects are consistent with both constant and decreasing relative risk aversion and analyze how our empirical estimates help distinguish between competing models of portfolio choice. We further show our results are quantitatively aligned with the predictions of a calibrated dynamic portfolio choice model with nontradable human capital and consumption habits.
summary: 本文利用瑞典三次彩票中奖的随机分配作为金融意外之财的自然实验，研究其对家庭投资组合选择与风险敞口的影响。实证发现，10万美元的意外之财导致家庭投资组合中风险资产占比下降5个百分点。理论分析表明，负财富效应既与常数相对风险厌恶（CRRA）一致，也与递减相对风险厌恶（DRRA）一致，并通过实证估计帮助区分不同的投资组合选择模型。进一步地，我们的结果与包含不可交易人力资本和消费习惯的校准动态投资组合选择模型的预测在数量上吻合。
ai_comment: 本文利用彩票中奖的随机性识别因果效应，并结合理论模型解释负财富效应，为理解财富变化对风险偏好的影响提供了有力证据。

title: Are Swedish House Prices Too High? Why the Price-to-Income Ratio Is a Misleading Indicator
abstract: Appropriate indicators of housing valuation are important for macroprudential policy and assessments of risks to financial stability. Overvalued housing may result in a correction and a fall in house prices, which if large could threaten financial and macroeconomic stability. According to ECB (2023) and European Systemic Risk Board (2022), Swedish owner-occupied housing (OOH) was overvalued by about 55% in 2021q2, the largest overvaluation in the EU and EEA; according to European Commission (2023c), by about 30% in 2022. These assessments affect warnings and recommendations issued for Swedish economic policy and the shocks in EBA stress tests of Swedish banks. But these assessments are due to the use of misleading indicators: the deviations of price-to-income (PTI) and price-to-rent ratios from their historical averages. They disregard mortgage rates and other housing costs and lack scientific support. According to a large housing literature, it is not the purchase price but the user cost that is the appropriate measure of the cost of living in OOH, the cost of the housing services that the OOH delivers. From this point of view, “Are house prices too high?” is the wrong question. The right question is, “Are user costs too high?” New improved estimates of an upper bound of the user cost are constructed, including an adjustment for a preference shift during the coronavirus crisis in favor of larger and better housing. The upper bound results from a conservative lower bound on house-price expectations below the few existing data points—regular time-series expectations data are not available. According to the user-cost-to-income (UCTI) ratio, Swedish owner-occupied houses have since 2010 instead become increasingly undervalued (not overvalued), by about 30% in 2019q4. Due to higher mortgage rates, they are less undervalued in 2025q1, but still about 25%. For Sweden, the UCTI and PTI indicators are in fact strongly negatively correlated, with opposite signs. If the UCTI indicator is the right one, the PTI indicator is consistently wrong. The valuation assessments of the ECB, the ESRB, the Commission, the OECD, and the IMF are scrutinized and compared. The problem of misleading indicators and overvaluation assessments—and resulting distorted warnings and recommendations—is not restricted to Sweden but concerns several other countries in the European Union.
summary: 本文批判了用价格收入比（PTI）和价格租金比衡量住房估值的方法，指出这些指标忽视了抵押贷款利率和其他住房成本，缺乏科学依据。以瑞典为例，尽管ECB、ESRB等机构基于PTI认为瑞典自住住房在2021年第二季度被高估约55%，但作者认为应使用使用者成本（user cost）指标。本文构造了使用者成本的上限估计，并纳入疫情期间对更大更好住房的偏好变化，得到使用者成本-收入比（UCTI）。结果显示，瑞典自住住房自2010年以来实际上是越来越被低估，2019年第四季度低估约30%，2025年第一季度仍低估约25%。UCTI与PTI呈强负相关，PTI指标持续错误。文章还审视了ECB、ESRB、欧盟委员会、OECD和IMF的估值评估，指出误导性指标和估值高估问题不仅限于瑞典，还涉及其他欧盟国家。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了主流机构对瑞典房价高估的共识，提出使用者成本指标比PTI更合理，对宏观审慎政策有重要启示。

title: Implications of Asset Market Data for Equilibrium Models of Exchange Rates
abstract: We characterize the relation between exchange rates and their macroeconomic fundamentals without committing to a specific model of preferences, endowment or menu of traded assets.When investors can trade home and foreign currency risk-free bonds, the exchange rate appreciates in states that are worse for home investors than foreign investors.This prediction is at odds with the empirical evidence and can only be overturned if the deviations from U.I.P. are large and exchange rates are highly predictable.Without bond Euler equation wedges, it is impossible to match the empirical exchange rate cyclicality (the Backus-Smith puzzle) and the deviations from U.I.P. (the Fama puzzle) as well as the lack of predictability (the Meese-Rogoff puzzle).To relax this trade-off, we need Euler equation wedges consistent with a home currency bias, home bond convenience yields or financial repression.
summary: 本文刻画了汇率与其宏观经济基本面之间的关系，而不依赖于特定的偏好、禀赋或可交易资产菜单模型。当投资者可以交易本币和外币无风险债券时，汇率在本国投资者状况比外国投资者更差的时期升值。这一预测与实证证据相悖，只有当无抛补利率平价（U.I.P.）偏差很大且汇率高度可预测时才能被推翻。在没有债券欧拉方程楔子的情况下，不可能同时匹配实证汇率周期（Backus-Smith谜题）、U.I.P.偏差（Fama谜题）以及缺乏可预测性（Meese-Rogoff谜题）。要放松这一权衡，需要与本币偏好、本币债券便利收益或金融压制相一致的欧拉方程楔子。
ai_comment: 本文通过一般化框架揭示了汇率模型在匹配多个实证谜题时面临的根本性权衡，强调了欧拉方程楔子的关键作用，为后续研究提供了理论基准。

title: Daily Momentum and New Investors in an Emerging Stock Market
abstract: Despite the dominance of retail investors in the Chinese stock market, there's a conspicuous absence of price momentum in weekly and monthly returns.This study uncovers the presence of price momentum in daily returns and, through a systematic analysis of trading heterogeneity among investors, links daily momentum to the attention and trading activities of new investorsa phenomenon particularly significant in emerging stock markets.Furthermore, our findings indicate the existence of daily price momentum in various other emerging markets, contrasting with its relative scarcity in developed ones.
summary: 该论文研究了中国股市的动量效应，发现尽管周度和月度回报缺乏动量，但日度回报存在显著的动量现象。通过对投资者交易异质性的系统分析，作者将日度动量归因于新投资者的关注和交易活动，这一现象在新兴市场中尤为突出。进一步研究表明，日度动量在其他新兴市场中也广泛存在，而在发达市场中相对稀缺。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统揭示了新兴市场中日度动量现象及其与新投资者行为的紧密联系，为理解行为金融中的过度反应和反应不足提供了新颖视角。

title: Advances in Blockchain and Crypto Economics
abstract: Over the past decade, blockchains and cryptocurrencies have taken a central stage in financial technology (FinTech) innovation. In 2020–2021, as the academic finance and management community began actively investigating this domain, we issued a call for papers for a special issue to encourage interdisciplinary research in this emerging area. This section of Management Science presents the first systematic collection of knowledge, both theoretical and empirical, focusing on blockchain economics, crypto assets, decentralized finance, and Web3 ecosystems. We describe the editorial protocol employed for this special issue (now included in this volume as a special section), summarize what we learn about the field, and introduce the 15 articles included in the special section. We also offer several observations to highlight foundational issues in the new field and to guide future research in this exciting new area at the intersection of technology and finance.
summary: 本特刊系统收集了区块链经济学、加密资产、去中心化金融和Web3生态系统的理论与实证知识。随着区块链和加密货币在金融科技创新中占据核心地位，学术界自2020-2021年开始积极研究此领域。特刊介绍了编辑协议，收录了15篇文章，并提出了该新兴领域的基础性问题和未来研究方向。
ai_comment: 作为特刊导言，本文为跨学科研究区块链与加密经济学提供了系统性框架和重要参考。

title: Why Fixed Costs Matter for Proof-of-Work–Based Cryptocurrencies
abstract: We assess how the cost structure of cryptocurrency mining affects the response of miners to exchange rate fluctuations and the immutability of cryptocurrency ledgers that rely on proof-of-work. We show that the amount of mining power supplied to currencies that rely on specialized hardware, such as Bitcoin, responds less to adverse exchange rate shocks than other currencies respond to such shocks, a fact that is instrumental to avoiding double-spending attacks. The results may change if mining equipment used for one cryptocurrency can be transferred to another. For smaller currencies with low exchange rate correlation, transferability eliminates the protection that fixed costs provide. Our results weaken doomsday predictions for Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with declining block rewards. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4901 .
summary: 本文评估了工作量证明加密货币的挖矿成本结构如何影响矿工对汇率波动的响应以及账本的不可变性。研究发现，依赖专用硬件（如比特币）的货币，其挖矿算力对负面汇率冲击的反应较小，这有助于防止双花攻击。然而，如果挖矿设备可跨币种转移（尤其对于汇率相关性低的小型货币），固定成本提供的保护将消失。结论削弱了对比特币等区块奖励递减货币的末日预测。
ai_comment: 该研究通过成本结构视角揭示了固定成本在保障区块链安全中的关键作用，并为比特币等主流加密货币的长期稳定性提供了理论支持。

title: The Impact of Derivatives on Spot Markets: Evidence from the Introduction of Bitcoin Futures Contracts
abstract: Cryptocurrencies provide a unique opportunity to identify how derivatives impact spot markets. They are fully fungible and trade across multiple spot exchanges at different prices, and futures contracts were selectively introduced on Bitcoin (BTC) exchange rates against the U.S. dollar (USD) in December 2017. Following the futures introduction, we find a significantly greater increase in cross-exchange price synchronicity for BTC–USD relative to other exchange rate pairs as demonstrated by an increase in price correlations and a reduction in arbitrage opportunities and volatility. We also find support for an increase in price efficiency, market quality, and liquidity. The evidence suggests that futures contracts allowed investors to circumvent arbitrage frictions associated with short-sale constraints, arbitrage risk associated with block confirmation time, and market segmentation. Overall, our analysis supports the view that the introduction of BTC–USD futures was beneficial to the Bitcoin spot market by making the underlying prices more informative. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Global Risk Institute. P. Augustin acknowledges financial support from the Canadian Derivatives Institute and from the Canada Research Chair Program of the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council Canada. The paper has benefited significantly from a fellow visit of P. Augustin at the Center for Advanced Studies Foundations of Law and Finance funded by the German Research Foundation, project FOR 2774, and from a visiting position of P. Augustin at the finance department of the University of Luxembourg facilitated through the Inter Mobility Programme of the Luxembourg National Research Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4900 .
summary: 本研究利用加密货币的独特性质来识别衍生品对现货市场的影响。加密货币具有完全可互换性，并在多个现货交易所上以不同价格交易，而比特币对美元汇率（BTC–USD）的期货合约于2017年12月被选择性引入。研究发现，期货引入后，BTC–USD的跨交易所价格同步性显著增加，表现为价格相关性上升、套利机会减少和波动性降低。同时，价格效率、市场质量和流动性也有所改善。证据表明，期货合约使投资者能够规避卖空限制相关的套利摩擦、区块确认时间相关的套利风险以及市场分割。总体而言，引入BTC–USD期货有利于比特币现货市场，使基础价格更具信息性。
ai_comment: 该论文利用比特币期货的自然实验，为衍生品对现货市场的影响提供了因果证据，尤其突出了期货在消除套利摩擦和提升市场效率方面的积极作用。

title: Mortgage Servicing Fees and Servicer Incentives During Loss Mitigation
abstract: We study incentive problems associated with the compensation of servicers during default remediation. First, we fill a gap in the literature by identifying stylized facts about servicing fees. Next, we present evidence showing that servicing fees drive mortgage modifications and foreclosures, likely to the detriment of investors. Servicers modify loans paying high servicing fees and delay their foreclosure to protect servicing cash flows. These effects are causal. Voluntary mortgage renegotiation by servicers is unlikely to reduce foreclosures. In addition to ex post government intervention, special servicing and innovative mortgage contracts allowing for affordable modifications that benefit investors may improve renegotiation outcomes. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance.
summary: 本文研究抵押贷款服务商在违约补救期间的补偿激励问题。首先，填补了文献空白，识别了服务费的行事风格事实。接着，提供证据表明服务费驱动贷款修改和止赎，可能损害投资者利益：服务商会修改支付高服务费的贷款，并延迟止赎以保护服务现金流。这些影响是因果性的。自愿的抵押贷款重新谈判不太可能减少止赎。除了事后政府干预，特殊服务和允许可负担修改的创新抵押合同可能改善重新谈判结果。
ai_comment: 本文通过因果识别揭示了服务费对服务商行为的扭曲效应，对抵押贷款市场政策和合同设计有重要启示。

title: Brokerage House Initial Public Offerings and Analyst Forecast Quality
abstract: We examine how brokerage firm initial public offerings (IPOs) influence the research quality of sell-side analysts employed by the brokerage. Our main results focus on earnings forecast bias and absolute forecast errors as proxies for research quality. Using a staggered difference-in-differences analysis, we document significant decreases in forecast bias and absolute forecast error during the two-year period centered on the analysts’ brokerage house IPO. In additional analyses, we explore several potential explanations for the short-term benefits of brokerage house IPOs. We find some evidence that IPOs delay the departure of more talented analysts and that the effects are more concentrated among analysts and brokers that face more scrutiny. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Supplemental Material: Data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4610 .
summary: 本文研究券商IPO如何影响其雇佣的卖方分析师的研究质量。以盈利预测偏差和绝对预测误差作为研究质量的代理指标，采用交错双重差分分析，发现以券商IPO为中心的两年的期间内，预测偏差和绝对预测误差显著下降。进一步分析表明，IPO延缓了更有才华的分析师的离职，且对受到更多审查的分析师和券商影响更集中。
ai_comment: 利用券商IPO事件作为准自然实验，揭示了IPO对分析师质量的短期正面影响，并探讨了人才留存和外部监督机制。

title: Conflicted Analysts and Initial Coin Offerings
abstract: This paper studies the contribution of analysts to the functioning and failure of the market for initial coin offerings (ICOs). The assessments of freelancing analysts exhibit biases because of reciprocal interactions of analysts with ICO team members. Even favorably rated ICOs tend to fail raising some capital when a greater portion of their ratings reciprocate prior ratings. Ninety days after listing on an exchange, the market capitalization relative to the initial funds raised is smaller for tokens with more reciprocal ratings. These findings suggest that conflicts of interest help explain the failure of ICOs. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Funding: A. Barth acknowledges financial support from the Chaire Fintech at University Paris Dauphine - PSL. A. F. Wagner acknowledges financial support from the University of Zurich Research Priority Program “Financial market regulation.” This paper was initiated when A. F. Wagner was visiting the Center for Advanced Studies on the Foundations of Law and Finance, funded by the German Research Foundation under the project FOR 2774 at Goethe University Frankfurt. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02928 .
summary: 本文研究了分析师对首次代币发行（ICO）市场运作与失败的影响。自由职业分析师对ICO的评估存在偏见，这种偏见源于分析师与ICO团队成员之间的互惠互动。当ICO的评级中有较大比例是对先前评级的互惠时，即使获得有利评级的ICO也往往无法筹集到足够的资金。在交易所上市90天后，具有更多互惠评级的代币的市值相对于初始筹集资金更小。这些发现表明，利益冲突有助于解释ICO的失败。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证证据揭示了分析师评级中的利益冲突对ICO市场失败的显著影响，为理解加密货币融资中的信息不对称和代理问题提供了新视角。

title: The Conceptual Flaws of Decentralized Automated Market Making
abstract: Decentralized exchanges (DEXs) are an essential component of the nascent decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem. The most common DEXs are so-called automated market makers (AMMs): smart contracts that pool liquidity and process trades as atomic swaps of tokens. AMMs price transactions with a deterministic liquidity invariance rule that only uses the AMM’s token deposits as inputs and that has no precedent in traditional finance. Yet, in the context of transparent and open blockchain operations, any liquidity invariance pricing function allows so-called sandwich attacks (akin to front running) that increase the cost of trading and threaten the long-term viability of the DeFi ecosystem. Invariance pricing is also not regret free. Linear pricing rules have similar problems except for uniform pricing, which has regret-free prices and limits sandwich attack profits but which invites excessive order splitting. Comparing trading costs using a model of liquidity provision, constant product pricing is often cheaper except when the variance of the underlying asset is small or when the order is large. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Funding: A. Park received financial support from the Global Risk Institute and the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2017-0647]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02802 .
summary: 本文揭示了去中心化自动做市商（AMM）在概念上的缺陷。虽然AMM是去中心化交易所（DEX）的核心组件，但其基于流动性不变规则的定价函数仅依赖代币存款作为输入，这种定价方式在透明区块链上容易遭受夹击攻击（类似抢先交易），从而增加交易成本并威胁DeFi生态系统的长期生存。此外，该定价也不是后悔自由的。线性定价规则除了统一定价外也存在类似问题，统一定价虽能实现后悔自由并限制夹击攻击利润，但会导致过度订单拆分。通过流动性提供模型比较交易成本，常数乘积定价通常更便宜，除非基础资产方差较小或订单规模较大。
ai_comment: 本文系统性地指出了AMM核心机制的设计缺陷，对DeFi领域的健康发展具有重要警示意义。

title: Central Bank Digital Currency and Banking: Macroeconomic Benefits of a Cash-Like Design
abstract: Many central banks are considering issuing a central bank digital currency (CBDC). How will the CBDC affect the macroeconomy? Will its design matter? To answer these questions, we theoretically and quantitatively assess the effects of a CBDC on consumption, banking, and welfare. Our model captures the competition between different means of payments and incorporates a novel general equilibrium feedback effect from transactions to deposits creation. The general equilibrium effects of a CBDC are decomposed into three channels: payment efficiency, price effects, and bank funding costs. We show that a cash-like CBDC is more effective than a deposit-like CBDC in promoting consumption and welfare. Interestingly, a cash-like CBDC can also crowd in banking, even in the absence of bank market power. In a calibrated model, at the maximum, a cash-like CBDC can increase bank intermediation by 10.2% and welfare by 0.059%, and it can capture up to 23.3% of the payment market. We also discuss some lessons for designing a CBDC. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02763 .
summary: 本研究理论和定量评估央行数字货币（CBDC）对消费、银行业和福利的影响，模型捕捉不同支付手段之间的竞争，并纳入从交易到存款创造的一般均衡反馈效应。将CBDC的一般均衡效应分解为三个渠道：支付效率、价格效应和银行融资成本。研究发现，现金型CBDC比存款型CBDC更能促进消费和福利，甚至在银行没有市场势力的情况下也能挤入银行业。校准模型显示，现金型CBDC最多可使银行中介增加10.2%，福利提高0.059%，并占据23.3%的支付市场份额。文章还讨论了CBDC设计的启示。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地区分了现金型和存款型CBDC，并发现前者具有宏观优势，甚至能增强银行中介，为CBDC设计提供了重要参考。

title: Crypto Wash Trading
abstract: We present the first systematic approach to detect fake transactions on cryptocurrency exchanges by exploiting robust statistical and behavioral regularities associated with authentic trading. Our sample consists of 29 centralized exchanges, among which the regulated ones feature transaction patterns consistently observed in financial markets and nature. In contrast, unregulated exchanges display abnormal first significant digit distributions, size rounding, and transaction tail distributions, indicating widespread manipulation unlikely driven by a specific trading strategy or exchange heterogeneity. We then quantify the wash trading on each unregulated exchange, which averaged more than 70% of the reported volume. We further document how these fabricated volumes (trillions of dollars annually) improve exchange ranking, temporarily distort prices, and relate to exchange characteristics (e.g., age and user base), market conditions, and regulation. Overall, our study cautions against potential market manipulations on centralized crypto exchanges with concentrated power and limited disclosure requirements and highlights the importance of fintech regulation. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, Special Section of Management Science: Blockchains and Crypto Economics. Funding: This research was partly funded by the Ewing Marion Kauffman Foundation [Grant G-201907-6995], the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72192802, 72192800, and 72192801], Ripple’s University Blockchain Research Initiative (UBRI), and the FinTech at Cornell Initiative. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02709 .
summary: 本文首次提出系统性方法检测加密货币交易所的虚假交易，利用真实交易中稳定存在的统计和行为规律。样本涵盖29家中心化交易所，其中受监管交易所的交易模式与金融市场及自然界的常见规律一致；而未受监管交易所则显示首位数字分布、规模取整及交易尾部分布异常，表明存在广泛操纵，且不能由特定交易策略或交易所异质性解释。进一步量化每个未受监管交易所的冲洗交易量，平均占报告交易量的70%以上。研究发现这些虚构交易量（每年数万亿美元）会提升交易所排名、暂时扭曲价格，并与交易所特征（如成立时间、用户基础）、市场条件及监管相关。研究警示了权力集中且披露要求有限的中心化加密交易所的市场操纵风险，强调金融科技监管的重要性。
ai_comment: 该论文提供了首个系统性检测加密货币交易所虚假交易的方法，揭示了监管的重要性，并为金融科技监管提供了实证依据。

title: When Myopic Managers Must Mark to Market
abstract: Although prior research suggests strict, fair value–based securities accounting rules cause banks to sell securities into negative liquidity shocks, a value-destroying behavior called “liquidity feedback trading,” the mechanism is uncertain. We find the sooner chief executive officers (CEOs) are permitted to cash out of their stock and option grants, the more prone are their banks to feedback trading. Furthermore, the sooner CEOs can cash out, the more positive their banks’ stock price reaction to news of accounting rule relaxation. We conclude incentives for managerial short-term focus are a mechanism by which stricter accounting rules cause feedback trading. We also find evidence that regulatory compliance concerns play a role. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Funding: A. Kolasinski is grateful for financial support from Mays Business School at Texas A&M University. N. Yang thanks the School of Accounting and Finance at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University for financial support. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.03249 .
summary: 本研究探讨严格的公允价值会计准则如何导致银行在负流动性冲击时卖出证券（即“流动性反馈交易”）。尽管已有文献表明此类会计规则会引发价值破坏行为，但其具体机制尚不明确。通过分析CEO可兑现股票和期权的时间，发现CEO越早被允许兑现，其所在银行越容易进行流动性反馈交易；同时，这些银行股价对会计准则放宽消息的反应也更为积极。结论表明，管理者短期主义激励是严格会计准则导致反馈交易的机制，此外监管合规担忧也起到一定作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地从管理者短期激励视角揭示了公允价值会计规则影响银行行为的具体机制，为理解金融机构的非理性交易行为提供了新证据。

title: The labor effects of judicial bias in bankruptcy
abstract: We study the effect of judicial bias favoring firm continuation in bankruptcy on the labor market outcomes of employees by exploiting the random assignment of cases across courts in the State of São Paulo in Brazil. Employees of firms assigned to courts that favor firm continuation are more likely to stay with their employer, but they earn, on average, lower wages three to five years after bankruptcy. We discuss several potential mechanisms that can rationalize this result, and provide evidence that imperfect information about outside options in the local labor market and adjustment costs associated with job change play an important role.
summary: 本文利用巴西圣保罗州破产案件在法院之间的随机分配，研究法官在破产案件中偏向企业存续（即让企业继续运营而非清算）对员工劳动力市场结果的影响。研究发现，分配到偏向存续法院的员工更可能留在原雇主处，但在破产后3到5年平均工资更低。文章讨论了多种可能的机制，并提供了证据表明，当地劳动力市场关于外部选择的不完全信息以及换工作的调整成本是重要解释因素。
ai_comment: 利用随机分配法院的准自然实验，有效识别了破产法官偏好对员工长期工资的因果效应，揭示了司法制度对劳动力市场的深远影响。

title: Cross-stock momentum and factor momentum
abstract: Cross-stock momentum builds on the asymmetry in lead-lag linkages and the difference between long-run and short-run contemporaneous co-movements. Data-driven cross-stock linkages generate a monthly alpha of 1.62% ( t -stat=10.03). The asymmetry distinguishes cross-stock momentum from factor momentum, and industry momentum is not subsumed by factor momentum. Factor momentum profit is mostly due to the high cross-stock links. The data-driven linkages vary faster over time than those in previous studies because short-run co-movements incorporate persistent linkages.
summary: 本文研究跨股票动量（cross-stock momentum）与因子动量（factor momentum）的关系。跨股票动量基于领先-滞后关系的非对称性以及长期与短期同期联动的差异而构建。利用数据驱动的跨股票联系，该策略实现了每月1.62%的alpha（t统计量=10.03）。这种非对称性将跨股票动量与因子动量区分开来，并且行业动量并未被因子动量所包含。因子动量的利润主要来源于高的跨股票联系。与以往研究相比，数据驱动的联系随时间变化更快，因为短期联动包含了持久的联系。
ai_comment: 本文通过揭示跨股票动量与因子动量的本质区别，并指出因子动量的利润来源于跨股票联系，为动量策略研究提供了新的视角。

title: Do the rich gamble in the stock market? Low risk anomalies and wealthy households
abstract: Contrary to the theoretical principle that higher risk is compensated with higher expected return, the literature shows that low-risk stocks outperform high-risk stocks. Using a large-scale household dataset, we provide an explanation for this puzzling result that the anomalous negative risk-return relation is only confined to those stocks predominantly held by rich households, whereas the anomaly disappears for stocks held by non-rich households and institutional investors. We find that social status concern of rich households and the induced lottery preference explain wealthy investors’ demand for high-risk stocks, leading to overpricing and low future returns for such stocks.
summary: 本文使用大规模家庭数据集，发现股市中低风险股票跑赢高风险股票的低风险异常现象仅局限于由富户家庭持有的股票，而对于非富户家庭和机构投资者持有的股票，该异常并不存在。研究进一步表明，富户家庭的社会地位关切及其引发的彩票偏好解释了他们对高风险股票的需求，导致这些股票被高估并产生较低的未来回报。
ai_comment: 从家庭层面切入解释低风险异常，为行为金融学提供了实证支持，揭示了社会地位关切在资产定价中的作用。

title: Dynamics of subjective risk premia
abstract: We examine subjective risk premia implied by return expectations of individual investors and professionals for portfolios of stocks, bonds, currencies, and commodity futures. While in-sample predictive regressions with realized excess returns suggest that objective risk premia vary countercyclically with business-cycle and asset-valuation measures, subjective risk premia extracted from survey data are largely acyclical. Out-of-sample forecasts of excess returns exhibit a similar lack of cyclicality, which suggests that investors’ learning of forecasting relationships in real time may help explain the cyclicality gap. There is a subjective risk-return tradeoff, with subjective risk premia increasing in subjective perceptions of risk quantity.
summary: 该论文利用调查数据，研究个人投资者和专业人士对股票、债券、货币和大宗商品期货投资组合回报预期所隐含的主观风险溢价。结果显示，基于已实现超额收益的样本内预测回归表明客观风险溢价随商业周期和资产估值指标呈现反周期变化，而调查数据中提取的主观风险溢价基本无周期性。样本外预测同样缺乏周期性，表明投资者实时学习预测关系可能有助于解释这种周期性差异。此外，存在主观风险-收益权衡，主观风险溢价随主观风险感知增加而上升。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地使用调查数据直接衡量主观风险溢价，揭示了客观与主观风险溢价周期性的显著差异，并引入实时学习机制进行解释，为理解风险溢价形成提供了新视角。

title: Disaster resilience and asset prices
abstract: Using the COVID-19 pandemic as a laboratory, we show that asset markets assign a time-varying price to firms’ disaster risk exposure. The cross-section of stock returns reflected firms’ different exposure to the pandemic, as measured by their vulnerability to social distancing. As predicted by theory, realized and expected return differentials moved in opposite directions, initially widening and then narrowing. When inferred from market outcomes, firm resilience correlates mainly with exposure to social distancing: vulnerability to social distancing is priced in changes of firms’ expected returns, while measures of financial and environmental resilience are not.
summary: 本文以COVID-19疫情为研究情境，考察资产市场如何对公司灾难风险暴露进行时变定价。研究发现，股票回报的横截面差异反映了公司对疫情的不同暴露程度，该暴露通过公司受社交距离措施影响的脆弱性来衡量。与理论预测一致，已实现和预期回报差异经历了先扩大后缩小的相反变动。通过市场结果推断的公司韧性主要与社交距离暴露相关：社交距离脆弱性在预期回报变化中被定价，而财务韧性和环境韧性则未被定价。
ai_comment: 本文利用COVID-19这一外生冲击，为灾难风险定价理论提供了有力的实证支持，并区分了不同维度的韧性。

title: International trade and the risk in bilateral exchange rates
abstract: Exchange rate volatility falls after a trade deal, driven by a decline in the systematic component of risk. The average trade deal increases trade by 50 percent over five years, reducing systematic risk by a third of a standard deviation across countries. We examine this connection in an Armington model where the structure of trade networks determines the risk in exchange rates. We estimate our model to current data and find i) that countries at the periphery of the world trade network benefit the most from lower trade barriers and ii) that a counterfactual experiment of a trade war between the US and China shows a global increase in currency risk, with effects concentrated among peripheral countries.
summary: 本文研究国际贸易对双边汇率风险的影响，发现贸易协定完成后汇率波动性下降，主要由系统性风险成分减少驱动。平均而言，贸易协定在五年内使贸易量增加50%，并将跨国系统性风险降低三分之一标准差。作者构建了一个Armington模型，其中贸易网络结构决定汇率风险。利用当前数据估计模型，发现：i) 位于全球贸易网络外围的国家从降低贸易壁垒中获益最大；ii) 反事实模拟中美贸易战显示全球货币风险上升，且影响集中在外围国家。
ai_comment: 本文通过结构模型揭示了贸易网络与汇率风险的内在联系，为理解贸易政策对金融稳定的影响提供了新视角，反事实实验具有现实意义。

title: Competition and selection in credit markets
abstract: Screening in consumer credit markets is often associated with large fixed costs. We present both theory and evidence that, when lenders use fixed-cost technologies to screen borrowers, increased competition may increase rather than decrease interest rates in subprime consumer credit markets. In more competitive markets, lenders have lower market shares, and thus lower incentives to invest in screening. Thus, when markets are competitive, all lenders face a riskier pool of borrowers, which can lead interest rates to be higher. We provide evidence for the model’s predictions in the auto loan market using administrative credit panel data.
summary: 本文研究消费信贷市场中使用固定成本技术筛选借款人的情况，提出了理论和证据表明竞争加剧可能提高次级消费信贷市场的利率。竞争更激烈的市场中，贷款人市场份额较低，投资于筛选的激励下降，导致所有贷款人面临更风险的借款人群体，从而推高利率。利用行政信用面板数据，在汽车贷款市场中找到了支持模型预测的实证证据。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了竞争加剧可能提高次级信贷市场利率的反直觉现象，为理解信贷市场结构提供了新视角，理论与实证结合增强了结论的说服力。

title: When large traders create noise
abstract: We consider a market where large investors do not only trade on information about asset fundamentals. When they trade more aggressively, the price becomes less informative. Other investors who learn from prices, in turn, are less concerned about adverse selection and provide more liquidity, causing large investors to trade even more aggressively. This trading complementarity can engender three unconventional results: i) increased competition among large investors makes all investors worse off, ii) more precise private information reduces price informativeness, creating complementarities in information acquisition, and iii) multiple equilibria emerge. Our results have implications for competition and transparency policies in financial markets.
summary: 本文研究大型投资者不仅基于资产基本面信息进行交易的场景。当这些投资者交易更激进时，价格的信息含量降低。通过从价格中学习的其他投资者因逆向选择担忧减少而提供更多流动性，这反过来又促使大型投资者更激进地交易。这种交易互补性导致三个非传统结果：i) 大型投资者间的竞争加剧使所有投资者境况变差；ii) 更精确的私人信息降低价格信息含量，形成信息获取的互补性；iii) 出现多重均衡。研究结果对金融市场的竞争政策和透明度政策具有启示意义。
ai_comment: 本文通过揭示交易互补性机制，挑战了传统金融学中关于信息与市场效率的认知，为市场监管政策提供了新的理论视角。

title: Self-imposed liquidity constraints via voluntary debt repayment
abstract: Debt-repayment flexibility should help temporarily liquidity-constrained households but not necessarily households struggling to save. In a natural experiment in which households can apply for free mortgage-repayment flexibility, I find that two-thirds of liquidity-constrained applicants with high-cost debt voluntarily restrict flexibility and forgo, on average, 4,070 EUR of low-cost liquidity. An overconsumption tendency reflecting self-control problems can explain the voluntary liquidity restrictions as well as the persistent liquidity constraints, the consumption drop at the predictable end of flexibility, and saving in other illiquid assets. Self-imposed liquidity constraints reflect characteristics instead of circumstances and reduce the potency of debt-forbearance offers in recessions.
summary: 本文研究自愿偿还债务导致的流动性约束。理论上，债务偿还灵活性应帮助临时流动性受限的家庭，但未必帮助储蓄困难的家庭。通过一个自然实验，家庭可以申请免费的抵押贷款偿还灵活性，结果发现三分之二的流动性受限且负有高成本债务的申请人自愿限制还款灵活性，平均放弃4,070欧元的低成本流动性。这种自愿限制可由过度消费倾向（自我控制问题）解释，并导致持续的流动性约束、可预测的灵活性结束时消费下降以及在其他非流动性资产中储蓄。研究表明，自我施加的流动性约束反映个体特征而非环境，这降低了经济衰退中债务豁免提议的有效性。
ai_comment: 论文通过巧妙设计的自然实验揭示了自我控制问题对家庭财务决策的深层影响，挑战了债务减免政策的普遍有效性。

title: Priced risk in corporate bonds
abstract: Recent studies document strong empirical support for multifactor models that aim to explain the cross-sectional variation in corporate bond expected excess returns. We revisit these findings and provide evidence that common factor pricing in corporate bonds is exceedingly difficult to establish. Based on portfolio- and bond-level analyses, we demonstrate that previously proposed bond risk factors, with traded liquidity as the only marginal exception, do not have any incremental explanatory power over the corporate bond market factor. Consequently, this implies that the bond CAPM is not dominated by either traded- or nontraded-factor models in pairwise and multiple model comparison tests.
summary: 近期研究为多因子模型提供了强有力的实证支持，这些模型旨在解释公司债券预期超额收益的横截面变化。本文重新审视了这些发现，并提供了证据表明，在公司债券中建立共同因子定价极为困难。基于组合和债券层面的分析，我们证明，除了交易流动性这一唯一的边际例外，先前提出的债券风险因子对公司债券市场因子没有任何增量解释力。因此，这意味着在成对和多模型比较检验中，债券CAPM并未被交易因子或非交易因子模型所超越。
ai_comment: 该论文挑战了已有文献中多因子模型解释力的观点，通过严谨的检验强调市场因子的主导地位，为债券定价模型的选择提供了重要启示。

title: Market Discipline in the Direct Lending Space
abstract: Using the exclusion of business development companies (BDCs) from stock indexes, this paper studies the effectiveness of market discipline in the direct lending space. Amid share sell-offs by institutional investors, a drop in BDCs’ valuations limits their ability to raise new equity capital. Following this funding shock, BDCs do not adjust their capital structure. At the same time, they are reducing the risk exposure of their portfolios. We document a greater reduction in risk for BDCs subject to stronger market discipline from their debtholders. BDCs pass through the capital shock to their portfolio firms by reducing their investment intensity.
summary: 本文利用商业发展公司（BDCs）被排除出股票指数的外生事件，研究直接贷款领域的市场纪律有效性。机构投资者抛售导致BDC股价下跌，限制其股权融资能力。面对资本冲击，BDC不调整资本结构，而是降低投资组合的风险敞口。尤其受债券持有人市场纪律约束更强的BDC，风险降低幅度更大。BDC将资本冲击传导至其投资组合公司，表现为降低投资强度。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用指数排除事件识别市场纪律的因果效应，揭示了股权和债权市场纪律的不同作用渠道，对理解金融中介的风险行为有重要贡献。

title: News and Markets in the Time of COVID-19
abstract: The onset of COVID-19 was characterized by voluminous, negative news. Higher narrativity news topics (measured by textual proximity to articles describing the 1987 stock market crash and textual distance from Federal Reserve communications) were systematically associated with contemporaneous market responses, which were larger on high volatility days (hypersensitivity), and with markets–news feedback. Hypersensitive news topic-market pairs were associated with next-day reversals. A test using the news–markets relationship identifies a mid-March 2020 structural break, which was knowable by the end of April. Post break, markets and news became considerably less coupled, and hypersensitivity and reversals abated.
summary: 该论文研究COVID-19期间新闻对市场的影响。发现疫情初期负面新闻量大且叙事性强，高叙事性新闻主题（通过文本与1987年股市崩盘文章相似度及与美联储通讯距离测量）与市场同期反应显著相关，且在高波动日反应更大（超敏性），并存在市场与新闻的反馈效应。超敏的新闻主题-市场对在次日出现反转。基于新闻-市场关系检验识别出2020年3月中旬的结构性断裂，该断裂在4月底即可获知。断裂后，市场与新闻的耦合显著减弱，超敏性和反转现象也相应缓解。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地利用文本分析量化新闻叙事性，并揭示了市场对新闻的超敏反应与结构突变，为理解危机期间信息传递与市场动态提供了新视角。

title: Stakeholder Value: A Convenient Excuse for Underperforming Managers?
abstract: Firms falling short of earnings expectations are more likely to cite stakeholder-focused objectives in their public communications following earnings announcements. This behavior is consistent with managers preferring to be evaluated by subjective stakeholder-based performance criteria when falling short on objective shareholder-based measures. This increased use of stakeholder language is most evident among firms narrowly missing earnings estimates and appears unrelated to a firm’s actual environmental, social, and governance (ESG)-related activity. Stakeholder language appears to influence the evaluation of CEOs; turnover–performance sensitivity is lower for managers citing stakeholder value. Collectively, our findings are consistent with concerns that stakeholder objectives reduce managerial accountability for poor performance.
summary: 这篇论文研究企业在未达到盈利预期后，是否更倾向于在公开沟通中引用利益相关者目标（stakeholder value）。通过对财报电话会议等公开沟通的分析，发现那些未达到盈利预期的公司，尤其是勉强未达预期的公司，更频繁地使用利益相关者语言。这种语言使用与公司实际的环境、社会和治理（ESG）活动无关，表明管理者可能将利益相关者目标作为业绩不佳的借口。进一步分析表明，使用利益相关者语言的CEO在业绩不佳时离职率更低，即业绩-离职敏感性（turnover–performance sensitivity）降低。整体来看，研究结果支持对利益相关者目标可能削弱管理者对不佳业绩问责的担忧。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证证据揭示了管理者可能策略性地利用利益相关者语言来规避客观业绩问责，对理解ESG浪潮下的公司治理实践具有重要启示。

title: Credit Default Swaps and Firm Cyclicality
abstract: We find firm cyclicality decreases by 40% after the inception of credit default swap (CDS) trading. The effect stems from CDS firms’ less aggressive asset growth in good times and is stronger for firms facing a more severe empty creditor problem. Important identification issues are addressed. The result cannot be explained with debt overhang, bank lending cyclicality, or the cyclicality of firms’ business fundamentals. It holds for the cyclicality of various corporate outcomes (inventories, cash, and employment). Importantly, CDS trading impedes unhealthy growth and enhances profitability and firm value. Our finding indicates an important positive real effect of financial innovation.
summary: 研究发现，信用违约互换（CDS）交易开始后，企业的周期性下降了40%。这一效应源于CDS公司在经济繁荣时期资产增长不再那么激进，并且对于面临更严重空头债权人问题的企业更为显著。通过多种识别策略解决了内生性问题。该结果无法用债务积压（debt overhang）、银行信贷周期性或企业基本面周期性来解释。该效应适用于多种企业结果（如存货、现金和就业）的周期性。重要的是，CDS交易阻碍了不健康的增长，提高了盈利能力和企业价值。这一发现表明金融创新具有重要的积极实际效应。
ai_comment: 本文利用CDS交易作为自然实验，揭示了金融创新通过缓解空头债权人问题降低企业周期性的新机制，并证实了其提升企业价值的正面作用，对理解金融衍生品的实体经济后果具有重要贡献。

title: The Real Effects of Financing and Trading Frictions
abstract: I develop a model revealing the interplay between a stock’s liquidity and the policies and value of the issuing firm. The model shows that bid-ask spreads increase not only the firm’s cost of capital but also the opportunity cost of cash, then lowering cash reserves, increasing liquidation risk, and reducing firm value. These outcomes are stronger when internalized by liquidity providers, simultaneously leading to a wider bid-ask spread. A two-way relation between the firm and the liquidity of its stock arises, implying that shocks arising within the firm or in the stock market have more complex implications than previously understood.
summary: 该论文构建了一个理论模型，揭示股票流动性与发行公司政策及价值之间的相互作用机制。模型表明，买卖价差不仅提高了公司的资本成本，还增加了现金持有的机会成本，从而降低现金储备，加剧清算风险，最终减少公司价值。当流动性提供者将这种影响内在化时，上述效应更为显著，并同时导致买卖价差进一步扩大。因此，公司与其股票流动性之间存在双向关系，意味着源于公司内部或股票市场的冲击会产生比以往理解更为复杂的影响。
ai_comment: 该模型创新性地提出了流动性与公司决策之间的双向因果链条，拓展了经典流动性定价理论对公司现金管理政策的解释力。

title: High-Frequency Tail Risk Premium and Stock Return Predictability
abstract: We propose a novel measure of the market return tail risk premium based on minimum-distance state price densities recovered from high-frequency data. The tail risk premium extracted from intra-day S&P 500 returns predicts the market equity and variance risk premiums and expected excess returns on a cross section of characteristics-sorted portfolios. Additionally, we describe the differential role of the quantity of tail risk, and of the tail premium, in shaping the future distribution of index returns. Our results are robust to controlling for established measures of variance and tail risk, and of risk premiums, in the predictive models.
summary: 本文提出一种基于高频数据的最小距离状态价格密度恢复新方法，构建了市场回报尾部风险溢价度量。利用日内S&P 500指数收益率提取的尾部风险溢价，能够有效预测市场权益风险溢价、方差风险溢价以及特征排序投资组合的预期超额收益。此外，文章区分了尾部风险数量与尾部溢价在塑造指数未来收益率分布中的不同作用。在控制了已知的方差风险、尾部风险以及风险溢价度量后，预测结果依然稳健。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地利用高频数据实现尾部风险溢价的高频提取，并系统验证了其对多重风险溢价和横截面预期收益的预测力，为风险溢价预测提供了新工具。

title: The Macroeconomic Uncertainty Premium in the Corporate Bond Market—Corrigendum
abstract: In this corrigendum, we address three issues in Bali, Subrahmanyam, and Wen (BSW) (2021).First, we included in BSW an inaccurate description of the database employed, which we now correct.Second, we correct the description of one of the control variables, bond illiquidity, employed in BSW.Finally, in light of the shortcomings of the Bai, Bali, and Wen (BBW) (2019) factors that are highlighted by Dickerson, Mueller, and Robotti (2023), we replace the 4-factor model of BBW with alternative factor models.Turning first to the description of the database employed in BSW (2021), in addition to the enhanced version of TRACE and Mergent FISD described in BSW, the data set was compiled from the following sources: Datastream, the National Association of Insurance Commissioners database (NAIC), and Bloomberg.Among these databases, the Datastream provides prices based on dealer quotes; NAIC reports transaction information by insurance companies; Bloomberg provides daily bond prices; the enhanced TRACE records prices based on real transactions.The corporate bond datasets cover different sample periods; from July 2002 to Dec. 2017 for enhanced TRACE with 937,947 observations, from July 2002 to June 2014 for Datastream with 168,052 observations, from July 2002 to July 2013 for NAIC with 154,026 observations, and from July 2002 to Dec. 2014 for Bloomberg with 133,571observations, for a total of 1,393,596 unique observations.We employed data in BSW beyond that available from TRACE to allow for a more comprehensive analysis, because TRACE initially applied to only a subset of corporate bonds.Turning next to the description of the bond illiquidity control variable, we provide a more accurate description of ILLIQ used in BSW (2021).Specifically, ILLIQ in BSW was described as the bond-level illiquidity computed as the autocovariance of the daily price changes within each month following Bao et al. ( 2011), when at least 5 daily return pairs (each separated by no more than 5 trading days) are available (the part after the comma was inadvertently omitted).
summary: 本更正说明了Bali, Subrahmanyam, and Wen (BSW) (2021)中的三个问题。第一，BSW中使用的数据库描述不准确，现更正为：数据来源包括增强版TRACE、Mergent FISD、Datastream、NAIC和Bloomberg，覆盖了不同的样本期间，总共有1,393,596个独特观测值。第二，对控制变量bond illiquidity（ILLIQ）的描述进行了修正，指出ILLIQ是按Bao et al. (2011)方法计算的债券层面非流动性，即每月内日价格变化的自协方差（在至少有5个日收益率对且每个对间隔不超过5个交易日时计算）。第三，鉴于Dickerson, Mueller, and Robotti (2023)指出的BBW (2019)因子的缺陷，用替代因子模型替换了原4因子模型。
keywords: 宏观经济不确定性溢价
ai_comment: 本文是对先前研究的严谨更正，特别关注数据来源的准确性和因子模型的稳健性，对实证金融研究具有方法上的参考价值。

title: Innovation Under Ambiguity and Risk
abstract: We view innovation investments as real options and explore the implications of risk (volatility) as well as a newly defined outcome independent measure of ambiguity (Knightian uncertainty) for innovation decisions. The empirical analysis uses stock returns to compute an implementable measure of ambiguity. We also control for risk and other determinants of innovation. We find a consistently significant negative effect of ambiguity on R&D, patents, and citations, as predicted. The effect of risk on R&D is positive and significant, but the corresponding effect on patents and citations is negative and significant. Ambiguity matters more for high-tech firms, consistent with intuition.
summary: 本文将创新投资视为实物期权，探讨风险（波动性）以及一种新定义的、与结果无关的模糊性（奈特不确定性）对创新决策的影响。实证分析利用股票收益率计算一个可实现的模糊性度量，并控制风险及其他创新决定因素。研究发现，模糊性对研发投入、专利数量和引用次数具有一致的显著负效应，符合理论预测；风险对研发投入有显著正效应，但对专利和引用次数的效应显著为负。模糊性对高科技企业的影响更大，这与直觉一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建与结果无关的模糊性度量，为创新决策中的不确定性研究提供了新视角，并实证区分了模糊性与风险的不同影响。

title: Do Underwriters Short-Change Corporations Issuing Bonds?
abstract: We confirm prior evidence that bonds on average are offered at prices below their immediate post-offer secondary market prices. However, in cases where banks lead–manage their own bond offerings the underpricing is significantly less as compared with other non-self-marketed offerings. These findings are robust across various matched samples and selection models. Our results suggest that the bond offering process is characterized by substantive agency conflicts between shareholders of corporations (issuers) and underwriters.
summary: 本文首先确认了已有证据，即债券在发行时的价格通常低于发行后立即交易的二级市场价格。然而，当银行自行管理其发行的债券时，与其他非自我营销的发行相比，低估程度显著降低。这一发现在多种匹配样本和选择模型中保持稳健。结果表明，债券发行过程存在公司（发行人）股东与承销商之间的实质性代理冲突。
ai_comment: 该研究通过对比银行自营债券与普通债券的定价差异，揭示了承销商行为中的利益冲突，为理解债券发行定价机制提供了新视角。

title: Bandits atop Reinforcement Learning: Tackling Online Inventory Models with Cyclic Demands
abstract: Motivated by a long-standing gap between inventory theory and practice, we study online inventory models with unknown cyclic demand distributions. We design provably efficient reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that leverage the structure of inventory problems to achieve optimal theoretical guarantees that surpass existing results. We apply the standard performance measure in online learning literature, regret, which is defined as the difference between the total expected cost of our policy and the total expected cost of the clairvoyant optimal policy that has full knowledge of the demand distributions a priori. This paper analyzes, in the presence of unknown cyclic demands, both the lost-sales model with zero lead time and the multiproduct backlogging model with positive lead times, fixed joint-ordering costs and order limits. For both models, we first introduce episodic models where inventory is discarded at the end of every cycle, and then build upon these results to analyze the nondiscarding models. Our RL policies HQL and FQL achieve [Formula: see text] regret for the episodic lost-sales model and the episodic multiproduct backlogging model, matching the regret lower bound that we prove in this paper. For the nondiscarding models, we construct a bandit learning algorithm on top that governs multiple copies of the previous RL algorithms, named Meta-HQL. Meta-HQL achieves [Formula: see text] regret for the nondiscarding lost-sales model with zero lead time, again matching the regret lower bound. For the nondiscarding multiproduct backlogging model, our policy Mimic-QL achieves [Formula: see text] regret. Our policies remove the regret dependence on the cardinality of the state-action space for inventory problems, which is an improvement over existing RL algorithms. We conducted experiments with a real sales data set from Rossmann, one of the largest drugstore chains in Europe, and also with a synthetic data set. For both sets of experiments, our policy converges rapidly to the optimal policy and dramatically outperforms the best policy that models demand as independent and identically distributed instead of cyclic. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: X.-Y. Gong was partially supported by an Accenture Fellowship. The work of X.-Y. Gong and D. Simchi-Levi was partially supported by the MIT Data Science Lab. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4947 .
summary: 本文研究具有未知循环需求分布的在线库存模型，旨在弥补库存理论与实践的差距。通过设计高效的强化学习（RL）算法，利用库存问题的结构，在零提前期的lost-sales模型和具有正提前期、固定联合订货成本及订货限制的多产品backlogging模型中，实现了与下界匹配的最优遗憾界。首先分析每个模型的周期性版本（每个周期末丢弃库存），并基于此推广到非丢弃模型。对于周期性lost-sales和多产品backlogging模型，提出的HQL和FQL策略实现了匹配下界的遗憾界；对于非丢弃lost-sales模型，构建了顶层bandit学习算法Meta-HQL，通过控制多个RL副本达到匹配下界的遗憾；对于非丢弃多产品backlogging模型，Mimic-QL策略实现了匹配的遗憾。这些策略消除遗憾对状态-动作空间基数的依赖，优于现有RL算法。实验使用Rossmann真实销售数据和合成数据，表明策略快速收敛到最优，并显著优于将需求视为独立同分布的基准策略。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将bandit学习与强化学习结合，处理循环需求下的库存问题，理论遗憾界与下界匹配且消除状态-动作空间依赖，实验验证了快速收敛和优于传统独立同分布假设的方法。

title: Optimal Portfolio Choice with Unknown Benchmark Efficiency
abstract: When a benchmark model is inefficient, including test assets in addition to the benchmark portfolios can improve the performance of the optimal portfolio. In reality, the efficiency of a benchmark model relative to the test assets is ex ante unknown; moreover, the optimal portfolio is constructed based on estimated parameters. Therefore, whether and how to include the test assets becomes a critical question faced by real world investors. For such a setting, we propose a combining portfolio strategy, optimally balancing the value of including test assets and the effect of estimation errors. The proposed combining strategy can work together with some existing estimation risk reduction strategies. In both empirical data sets and simulations, we show that our proposed combining strategy performs well. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01767 .
summary: 论文研究在基准模型效率未知的情况下，投资者如何最优地决定是否以及如何将测试资产纳入投资组合。当基准模型无效时，加入测试资产可提升最优组合表现，但效率未知和参数估计误差使决策复杂。为此，作者提出了一个组合投资策略，该策略在包含测试资产带来的收益和估计误差造成的成本之间进行最优权衡，并能与现有估计风险降低策略协同使用。通过实证数据和模拟分析，该组合策略展现出良好的绩效。
ai_comment: 论文针对基准效率未知的现实问题，提出了一种兼具理论优雅性和实用性的组合策略，并且兼容现有降估计风险方法，对资产配置实践有重要参考价值。

title: Capital Structure with Information about the Upside and the Downside
abstract: I introduce two dimensions of uncertainty, about the upside and the downside of an asset, in a model of asset valuation under asymmetric information. This justifies capital structures with equity and risky debt for information revelation purposes. However, a capital structure with only one information-sensitive security, equity, can be optimal when investors are less informed about the dimension that matters more for valuation. This is relevant for innovative firms with a large upside subject to strong information asymmetries, which often have abnormally low leverage, and for firms at an intermediate stage of their life cycle that do not issue risky debt.
summary: 本文在不对称信息下的资产估值模型中引入关于资产上行和下行两个维度的不确定性，以此证明包含股权和风险债务的资本结构有助于信息揭示。然而，当投资者对估值更重要的维度了解较少时，仅包含一种信息敏感证券（即股权）的资本结构可能是最优的。这一结论适用于具有巨大上行潜力且面临强烈信息不对称的创新企业（这些企业通常具有异常低的杠杆率），以及处于生命周期中间阶段、不发行风险债务的企业。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入上行和下行的双重不确定性，丰富了资本结构理论，为创新企业低杠杆现象提供了新的解释。

title: Dynamic Information Regimes in Financial Markets
abstract: We develop a model of investor information choices and asset prices in which the availability of information about fundamentals is time-varying and responds to investor demand for information. A competitive research sector produces more information when more investors are willing to pay for that research. This feedback, from investor willingness to pay for information to more information production, generates two regimes in equilibrium, one having high prices and low volatility, the other the opposite. The low-price, high-volatility regime is associated with greater information asymmetry between informed and uninformed investors. Information dynamics move the market between regimes, creating large price drops even with no change in fundamentals. In our calibration, the model suggests an important role for information dynamics in financial crises. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01213 .
summary: 本文构建了一个模型，研究投资者信息选择与资产价格之间的关系，其中基本面信息的可用性随时间变化，并对投资者的信息需求做出响应。一个竞争性的研究部门在更多投资者愿意为研究付费时生产更多信息，这种从投资者支付意愿到信息生产的反馈机制导致均衡中出现两种状态：一种是高价格、低波动性，另一种是低价格、高波动性。低价格、高波动性状态与知情和不知情投资者之间更大的信息不对称相关。信息动态推动市场在这些状态之间切换，即使基本面没有变化，也会导致价格大幅下跌。校准结果表明，信息动态在金融危机中扮演重要角色。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将信息供给的内生性与市场状态切换联系起来，为金融危机中的价格暴跌提供了基于信息动态的微观解释，具有重要的理论价值和现实意义。

title: Overlapping Ownership Along the Supply Chain
abstract: I find overlapping institutional ownership (OIO) in a customer and supplier increases the duration of their supply chain relationship. Results are stronger when vertical holdup is more severe. A quasi-natural experiment around mergers of financial institutions provides causal evidence of OIO improving relationship survival rates. Concurrent with longer-lived relationships, valuations and innovation increase, consistent with OIO effects on relationship longevity being beneficial. I find evidence of OIO strengthening relationships via an internalization channel: With more OIO, partners cooperate more, with the supplier extending more trade credit. Overall, results indicate OIO strengthens vertical relationships by alleviating holdup problems.
summary: 本文研究供应链中的重叠机构所有权（OIO）如何影响客户与供应商的关系持续时间。实证发现，OIO显著延长了供应链关系的存续期，且在垂直劫持问题更严重时效果更明显。通过金融机构合并的准自然实验，提供了OIO提高关系生存率的因果证据。与关系延长相伴的是公司估值和创新增加，表明OIO对关系持久性的影响是有益的。进一步证据显示，OIO通过内化渠道加强合作，供应商会提供更多贸易信贷。总体结论是，OIO通过缓解劫持问题来强化垂直关系。
ai_comment: 该文利用准自然实验提供了因果证据，揭示了机构所有权通过缓解劫持问题强化供应链关系的内在机制，对理解机构投资者在实体经济中的作用有重要贡献。

title: The Valuation of Collateral in Bank Lending
abstract: We study the valuation of collateral by comparing spreads on loans by the same bank, to the same borrower, at the same origination date, but backed by different types of collateral. Pledging collateral reduces borrowing costs by 23 BPS on average. The effect varies across different types of collateral, with marketable securities being most valuable, and real estate and accounts receivables and inventory being more valuable than fixed assets and a blanket lien. Further, the rate reduction from pledging collateral is sensitive to the value of the underlying collateral, and collateral tends to be more valuable for smaller and private firms and for loans with longer maturity.
summary: 本文通过比较同一银行在同一放款日对同一借款人发放的、但由不同类型抵押品担保的贷款利差，研究抵押品的估值。研究发现，提供抵押品平均降低23个基点的借款成本，且不同抵押品类型影响差异显著：有价证券（marketable securities）的降幅最大，房地产（real estate）、应收账款和存货（accounts receivables and inventory）的降幅高于固定资产（fixed assets）和总括留置权（blanket lien）。此外，抵押品带来的利率下降对基础抵押品价值敏感，抵押品对于规模较小和私人企业以及期限较长的贷款价值更高。
ai_comment: 本文利用同一银行-同一借款人-同一放款日的独特样本设计，有效控制借款人信用风险，从而准确识别不同抵押品的价值差异，对抵押品定价机制提供了重要实证证据。

title: Spanning Analysis of Stock Market Anomalies Under Prospect Stochastic Dominance
abstract: We develop and implement methods for determining whether introducing new securities or relaxing investment constraints improves the investment opportunity set for prospect investors. We formulate a new testing procedure for prospect spanning for two nested portfolio sets based on subsampling and linear programming. In an application, we use the prospect spanning framework to evaluate whether well-known anomalies are spanned by standard factors. We find that of the strategies considered, a few of them expand the opportunity set of the prospect type investors and thus have real economic value for them and involve absence of loss aversion. Those are the net stock issue anomaly under the FF-5 model, the momentum and net stock issue anomalies under the M-4 model, and the momentum anomaly under the q model. In-sample and out-of-sample results prove remarkably consistent in identifying genuine anomalies for prospect investors. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Supplemental Material: The data and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4953 .
summary: 该论文开发并实现了一种基于前景随机占优（Prospect Stochastic Dominance）的方法，用于判断引入新证券或放宽投资约束是否改善了前景投资者的投资机会集。作者基于子抽样（subsampling）和线性规划（linear programming）提出了一个新的前景跨越（prospect spanning）检验程序，并应用于评估已知的股票市场异常是否被标准因子模型（如FF-5、M-4、q模型）所跨越。研究发现，在考察的策略中，只有少数异常（如FF-5模型下的净股票发行异常、M-4模型下的动量与净股票发行异常、q模型下的动量异常）能够扩展前景投资者的机会集，具有真实经济价值且涉及无损失厌恶。样本内和样本外结果高度一致，验证了这些异常对前景投资者的真实性。
ai_comment: 该研究将行为金融中的前景理论引入资产定价的跨越分析框架，为识别对特定投资者具有真实价值的异常提供了新方法，样本内外的一致性增强了结论的可靠性。

title: Contrarians, Extrapolators, and Stock Market Momentum and Reversal
abstract: We document considerable cross-investor variation in survey expectations about aggregate stock market returns. Although most investors are extrapolators who expect higher returns after a good market performance, some are contrarians who expect lower returns after a good performance. More notably, compared with extrapolators, contrarians have less persistent expectations that are corrected more quickly. We then develop a dynamic equilibrium model accounting for these differences in expectations and find that the equilibrium stock price exhibits short-term momentum and long-term reversal as in the data. Furthermore, we test the key predictions of our model linking the observable differences in extrapolators’ and contrarians’ expectations to aggregate stock market momentum and future stock performance and find supportive evidence for our model mechanism. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4960 .
summary: 本文记录了投资者对股市总体回报的调查预期存在显著差异。大多数投资者是外推者（extrapolators），即在市场表现良好后预期更高回报；而少数是逆向投资者（contrarians），即在市场表现良好后预期更低回报。值得注意的是，与外推者相比，逆向投资者的预期持续性较低且修正更快。随后，本文构建了一个动态均衡模型来解释这些预期差异，发现均衡股价呈现出如数据所示的短期动量（short-term momentum）和长期反转（long-term reversal）。此外，本文检验了模型的关键预测，将外推者与逆向者预期的可观测差异与整体股市动量及未来股票表现联系起来，结果支持模型机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过调查数据揭示了投资者预期的异质性，并构建模型统一解释了动量和反转现象，为行为金融提供了新视角。

title: Virtual Shareholder Meetings
abstract: We examine determinants and consequences of virtual shareholder meetings (VSMs) using a sample of voluntary (precoronavirus disease 2019) and forced (i.e., because of coronavirus disease 2019) VSM adopters. Voluntary adopters are tech firms and firms traditionally more engaged with shareholders, consistent with the stated objective to increase shareholder participation. In contrast, we do not find that firms choose the virtual format to avoid shareholders’ scrutiny. Textual analysis of transcripts suggests that in VSMs, business presentations by management are less frequent, shorter, and more generic but only among voluntary adopters, suggesting that these properties reflect a firm’s choice rather than are a by-product of the virtual format per se. VSMs are more likely to exhibit no questions during the question and answer period, but conditioned upon having one question, they exhibit the same number of questions; such questions are more negative in tone, inconsistent with managers using the virtual format to filter out hostile questions. Finally, there is some evidence of greater abnormal absolute returns around VSMs, supporting the notion that greater attendance translates into greater information content. Overall, VSMs exhibit less activity on average, consistent with critics’ concerns, but such reduced activity does not appear to cause a loss in information content nor does it appear to reflect an attempt to avoid scrutiny. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4946 .
summary: 本文研究了虚拟股东大会（VSM）的采用决定因素及其后果。样本包括自愿采用者（疫情前）和强制采用者（因疫情）。自愿采用者多为科技公司和传统上更注重股东参与的公司，这与增加股东参与的目标一致；未发现公司为逃避股东监督而选择虚拟形式。对会议记录的文本分析显示，管理层业务演示在VSM中更少、更短且更泛泛，但仅限自愿采用者，表明这些特征反映公司选择而非虚拟格式自身。VSM在问答环节更可能出现无问题的情况，但若有问题，数量相同；问题语气更负面，与管理者利用虚拟格式过滤敌对问题不符。最后，VSM周围异常绝对回报更大，支持更高参与度带来更多信息含量的观点。总体而言，VSM平均活动较少，符合批评者的担忧，但这种活动减少似乎不会导致信息含量损失，也不反映逃避监督的尝试。
ai_comment: 本文利用疫情前后的自然实验区分自愿与强制采用，为虚拟会议的实际影响提供了因果证据，尤其是揭示了管理层行为与信息内容的非预期特征。

title: The Effects of a Short-Term Corporate Social Impact Activity on Employee Turnover: Field Experimental Evidence
abstract: Short-term corporate social impact activities, wherein employees participate in firm-sponsored prosocial initiatives, are becoming increasingly common. However, it remains unclear whether short-term social impact activities affect employee behavior in a manner of relevance to the firm. Theoretically, arguments could be made in favor of or against the likelihood that such short-term activities would increase firm-benefitting employee behavior. We utilized data from a randomized field experiment implemented at a large Latin American bank to examine whether a short-term social impact activity can be beneficial for firms, focusing on one important outcome: turnover. Newly hired employees were randomly assigned to a short-term social impact activity as part of the new employee onboarding process or not. Notably, we find causal evidence that a day-long, short-term engagement reduced employee turnover almost a year later. We explore potential mechanisms behind this effect and find that employees’ perceptions of organizational justice help to explain the effects of the intervention on turnover. We also explore heterogeneous treatment effects and find more substantial effects for male, rather than female, employees. This paper advances the literature on the implications of corporate social responsibility (CSR) practices by shedding light on the causal mechanisms through which a theoretically underexplored and practically relevant type of CSR activity can benefit organizations and their employees. This paper was accepted by Lamar Pierce, organizations. Funding: The authors acknowledge funding from NSF through the Learning the Earth with Artificial intelligence and Physics (LEAP) Science and Technology Center (STC) (Award #2019625). Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01517 .
summary: 本文通过随机田野实验，研究了短期企业社会影响活动（员工参与公司赞助的亲社会活动）对员工离职率的影响。实验在拉丁美洲一家大型银行进行，将新入职员工随机分配到入职培训中的一天短期社会影响活动或对照组。结果发现，该活动在近一年后显著降低了员工离职率。机制分析表明，员工的组织公正感是解释该效应的关键因素。异质性分析显示，该效应在男性员工中比女性员工更显著。本文为理解企业社会责任（CSR）的因果机制提供了新证据，特别是对理论探索不足但实践相关的短期CSR活动如何有益于组织及其员工。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严格的随机田野实验提供了短期CSR活动降低员工离职率的因果证据，并深入探讨了组织公正感的中介作用和性别异质性，对CSR实践有重要启示。

title: Pay-As-You-Go Insurance: Experimental Evidence on Consumer Demand and Behavior
abstract: Pay-as-you-go contracts reduce minimum purchase requirements, which may increase market participation. This paper randomizes the introduction and price(s) of a novel pay-as-you-go contract to the California auto insurance market, where 17% of drivers are uninsured. The pay-as-you-go contract increases take-up by 10.8 p.p. (89%) and days with coverage by 4.6 days over the 3-month experiment (27%). Demand is relatively inelastic, and pay-as-you-go increases insurance coverage in part by relaxing liquidity requirements: most drivers’ purchasing behavior is consistent with a cost of credit in excess of payday lending rates, and 19% of drivers have a purchase rejected for insufficient funds.
summary: 本文通过随机实验研究了一种新型的按需付费（pay-as-you-go）汽车保险合约对消费者需求和行为的影响。在加州汽车市场（17%的司机无保险）引入并定价了这种合约，发现它使参保率提高了10.8个百分点（89%），实验期间（3个月）内保障天数增加了4.6天（27%）。需求相对缺乏弹性，且pay-as-you-go通过放松流动性约束来增加保险覆盖：大多数司机的购买行为表明其隐含的信贷成本高于发薪日贷款利率，19%的司机因资金不足被拒付。
ai_comment: 利用田野实验直接检验流动性约束对保险需求的影响，为理解低收入群体保险不足提供了有力证据。

title: The Effect of Language on Income Smoothing: Cross-Country Evidence
abstract: We examine whether and how the time-oriented tendency embedded in languages influences income smoothing. Separating languages into weak- versus strong-future time reference (FTR) groups, we find that firms in weak-FTR countries tend to smooth earnings more. We also find that relationships with major stakeholders (i.e., debtholders, suppliers, and employees) amplify the effect of the FTR of languages on income smoothing.
