Additional analyses suggest that income smoothing driven by the FTR of languages enhances earnings informativeness. These findings provide new insights on the role that language plays in financial reporting decisions and on how relationships with major stakeholders influence the relation between an important feature of language and corporate income smoothing behavior. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Funding: L. A. Myers acknowledges financial support from the University of Tennessee [the Haslam Chair of Business and the Haslam Family Faculty Research Fellowship]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.01753 .
summary: 本文研究了语言的时间导向倾向如何影响企业盈余平滑行为。通过将语言分为弱未来时间参考（weak-FTR）和强未来时间参考（strong-FTR）两组，发现弱FTR国家的企业更倾向于平滑盈余。此外，与主要利益相关者（如债权人、供应商和员工）的关系会放大语言FTR对盈余平滑的影响。进一步分析表明，由语言FTR驱动的盈余平滑增强了盈余的信息含量。这些发现为语言在财务报告决策中的作用以及主要利益相关者关系如何影响语言特征与企业盈余平滑行为之间的联系提供了新见解。
ai_comment: 从语言文化视角切入财务报告决策，视角独特，拓展了盈余平滑影响因素的研究边界。

title: Directors: Older and Wiser, or Too Old to Govern?
abstract: An unintended consequence of recent governance reforms in the United States is firms’ greater reliance on older director candidates, resulting in noticeable board aging. We investigate this phenomenon’s implications for corporate governance. We document that older independent directors exhibit poorer board meeting attendance, are less likely to serve on or chair key board committees, and receive less shareholder support in annual elections. These directors are associated with weaker board oversight in acquisitions, CEO turnovers, executive compensation, and financial reporting. However, they can also provide particularly valuable advice when they have specialized experience or when firms have greater advisory needs.
summary: 美国近期的治理改革导致公司更依赖年长的董事候选人，董事会年龄明显增大。研究发现，年长的独立董事在董事会会议出席率上表现较差，较少担任或主持关键委员会，且在年度选举中获得的股东支持较少。这些董事在收购、CEO更替、高管薪酬和财务报告方面的监督较弱。然而，当他们拥有特定专业经验或公司咨询需求较大时，他们也能提供特别有价值的建议。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了公司治理改革的意外后果，并区分了老年董事在监督与咨询角色上的差异，为董事会构成提供了新的视角。

title: Current Account Uncertainty and Currency Premia
abstract: We empirically study the relationship between currency excess returns and current account uncertainty, measured as forecast dispersion. We find that investment currencies deliver low returns, whereas funding currencies offer a hedge when current account uncertainty is unexpectedly high. Moreover, an increase in current account uncertainty is associated with higher expected future excess returns on investment currencies. This mechanism is consistent with the recent advances in exchange rate theory based on capital flows in imperfect financial markets. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Funding: A. Krecetovs thanks the Brevan Howard Centre at Imperial College London for financial support. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4949 .
summary: 本文实证研究了货币超额收益与经常账户不确定性（以预测离散度衡量）之间的关系。研究发现，投资货币在经常账户不确定性意外升高时提供低回报，而融资货币则提供对冲。此外，经常账户不确定性的增加与投资货币未来预期超额收益的上升相关。这一机制与基于不完美金融市场中资本流动的汇率理论最新进展一致。
ai_comment: 该文从经常账户不确定性角度揭示了货币溢价的新机制，为汇率决定理论提供了实证支持，具有创新性。

title: Information Spillover and Corporate Policies: The Case of Listed Options
abstract: Information production associated with derivatives markets is not a sideshow; rather, it has significantly positive spillover effects on an array of corporate decisions of underlying firms. Using a regression-discontinuity design based on exogenous variation in options availability as an instrument for changes in the information environment, we show that options introductions have causal effects on corporate policies on both sides of the balance sheet. Through improved information efficiency, options availability reduces the need for debt and payout, increases efficient investment, and yields superior innovation. We conduct two independent experiments demonstrating that our instrument’s impact is not derived from alternative channels.
summary: 本文研究衍生品市场信息生产对标的公司公司政策的溢出效应。利用期权上市的外生变化作为信息环境变化的工具变量，采用断点回归设计，发现期权引入对资产负债表两边的公司政策具有因果影响。通过提高信息效率，期权上市减少了公司对债务和股利支付的需求，增加了有效投资，并带来卓越的创新表现。两个独立实验排除其他渠道的影响，证实了工具变量的有效性。
ai_comment: 该文利用断点回归设计识别因果效应，并通过实验排除替代解释，提供了衍生品市场对实体经济影响的严谨证据。

title: Exchange Rate Dynamics and Monetary Spillovers with Imperfect Financial Markets
abstract: We develop a quantitative model with imperfections in domestic and international financial markets that generates strong effects of U.S. monetary policy on emerging markets (EMs). Financial imperfections prevent arbitrage both between local EM lending and borrowing rates, and between local-currency and dollar borrowing rates. An adverse feedback effect between financial health and external conditions amplifies the domestic “financial accelerator,” leading to large cross-border spillovers of U.S. monetary policy shocks. The model implies a link between uncovered interest parity violations and local credit spreads, a prediction we show the data strongly supports. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含国内和国际金融市场缺陷的定量模型，以解释美国货币政策对新兴市场的强烈影响。金融缺陷阻止了本地借贷利率与美元借贷利率之间的套利，同时本地贷款与存款利率之间的套利也受到阻碍。金融健康状况与外部条件之间的负面反馈效应放大了国内的“金融加速器”，导致美国货币政策冲击产生显著的跨境溢出效应。模型揭示了无抛补利率平价偏离与本地信用利差之间的关联，这一预测得到了数据的有力支持。作者还提供了在线附录。
ai_comment: 该模型将金融摩擦与跨境溢出机制巧妙结合，揭示了美国货币政策影响新兴市场的新渠道，实证检验增强了结论的可信度。

title: Borrowing Stigma and Lender of Last Resort Policies
abstract: How should the lender of last resort provide liquidity to banks during periods of financial distress? During the 2008–2010 crisis, banks avoided borrowing from the Fed’s long-standing discount window but actively participated in its special monetary program, the Term Auction Facility, although both programs had the same borrowing requirements. Using an adverse selection model with endogenous borrowing decisions, we explain why the two programs suffer from different stigma costs and how the introduction of TAF incentivized banks’ borrowing. We discuss the empirical relevance of the model’s predictions. [Banks] deliberately did not ask for the liquidity they needed for fear of damaging their reputation—the ‘stigma’ problem… I do not think we were conscious of this before the crisis started and I do not think central banks have a convincing answer to it… This is, I think, still a challenge in how to manage the process of central bank provision of liquidity support. This is one of the big intellectual issues that has not been fully resolved. (Governor Mervyn King, Bank of England (2016)) For various reasons, including the competitive format of the auctions, [Term Auction Facility] has not suffered the stigma of conventional discount window lending and has proved effective for injecting liquidity into the financial system… Another possible reason that [Term Auction Facility] has not suffered from stigma is that auctions are not settled for several days, which signals to the market that auction participants do not face an immediate shortage of funds. (Ben Bernanke, testimony to U.S. House of Representatives (2010))
summary: 本文研究最后贷款人政策中的借贷污名问题，比较美联储的贴现窗口（Discount Window）和定期拍卖便利（Term Auction Facility, TAF）两种流动性供给工具。利用一个包含内生借款决策的逆向选择模型，解释了为何在相同借款条件下，银行因声誉担忧避免使用贴现窗口而积极参与TAF，即两种工具面临不同的污名成本。模型进一步揭示了TAF的引入如何激励银行借款，并讨论了模型预测的实证相关性。文章引用了英国央行行长默文·金和美联储主席本·伯南克的评论，强调借贷污名是危机前未被充分认识的问题，而TAF因拍卖形式和结算延迟减轻了污名效应。
ai_comment: 通过逆向选择模型系统解释了不同流动性工具污名差异的成因，并引用央行高层观点增强了实践启发性。

title: Why Naive $ 1/N $ Diversification Is Not So Naive, and How to Beat It?
abstract: We show theoretically that the usual estimated investment strategies will not achieve the optimal Sharpe ratio when the dimensionality is high relative to sample size, and the $ 1/N $ rule is optimal in a 1-factor model with diversifiable risks as dimensionality increases, which explains why it is difficult to beat the $ 1/N $ rule in practice. We also explore conditions under which it can be beaten, and find that we can outperform it by combining it with the estimated rules when $ N $ is small, and by combining it with anomalies or machine learning portfolios, conditional on the profitability of the latter, when $ N $ is large.
summary: 本文从理论上证明，当资产维度相对于样本量较高时，传统的估计投资策略无法达到最优夏普比率，而1/N等权分散化策略在1因子模型且风险可分散的情况下，随着维度增加是渐近最优的，这解释了为何在实践中难以打败1/N规则。进一步研究哪些条件可以打败该规则：当资产数量N较小时，将1/N与估计规则结合可提升表现；当N较大时，结合异常交易策略或机器学习投资组合（取决于后者的盈利能力）可以超越1/N。
ai_comment: 本文为等权组合的优越性提供了严谨的理论基础，并提出了可操作性的改进方向，对投资实践和量化研究具有重要参考价值。

title: Credit Provision and Stock Trading: Evidence from the South Sea Bubble
abstract: This article studies the relationship between credit provision and stock trading behavior. We collect every stock transaction of the three major British companies during the 1720 South Sea Bubble and link stock trading to margin loan positions with the Bank of England. We give insights in the selection of traders into the loan facility by comparing the trading behavior and realized returns of borrowers to other traders. We find that loan holders are more likely to buy following high returns and document strong underperformance of borrowers.
summary: 本文研究了信贷提供与股票交易行为之间的关系。我们收集了1720年南海泡沫期间英国三大公司的每一笔股票交易，并将股票交易与英格兰银行的保证金贷款头寸联系起来。通过比较借款者与其他交易者的交易行为和已实现收益，我们深入了解了交易者选择进入贷款机制的情况。我们发现，贷款持有者更倾向于在高回报后买入，并且借款者的表现明显不佳。
ai_comment: 利用历史自然实验，揭示了信贷扩张与投机行为之间的微观机制，为理解泡沫期间杠杆交易者的行为提供了独特证据。

title: Retail Trading in Options and the Rise of the Big Three Wholesalers
abstract: We document a rapid increase in retail trading in options in the United States. Facilitated by payment for order flow (PFOF) from wholesalers executing retail orders, retail trading recently reached over 60% of total market volume. Nearly 90% of PFOF comes from three wholesalers. Exploiting new flags in transaction‐level data, we isolate wholesaler trades and build a novel measure of retail options trading. Our measure comoves with equity‐based retail activity proxies and drops significantly during U.S. brokerage platform outages and trading restrictions. Retail investors prefer cheaper, weekly options with average bid‐ask spread of 12.6%, and lose money on average.
summary: 本文研究了美国零售期权交易的快速增长现象。通过支付流（PFOF）机制，批发商执行零售订单，使零售交易量近期达到总市场成交量的60%以上，其中近90%的PFOF来自三大批发商。利用交易级数据中的新标志，作者隔离了批发商交易，并构建了新颖的零售期权交易度量。该度量与基于股票的零售活动代理指标共同变动，并在美国经纪平台故障和交易限制期间显著下降。零售投资者偏好更便宜的、每周到期的期权，其平均买卖价差为12.6%，且平均而言亏损。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的数据标志构建了零售期权交易的直接度量，揭示了批发商在零售交易中的主导作用以及零售投资者的亏损模式，对理解市场微观结构和监管政策具有重要价值。

title: The Legal Origins of Financial Development: Evidence from the Shanghai Concessions
abstract: The primary challenge to assessing the legal origins view of comparative financial development is identifying exogenous changes in legal systems. We assemble new data on Shanghai's British and French concessions between 1845 and 1936. Two regime changes altered British and French legal jurisdiction over their respective concessions. By examining the changing application of different legal traditions to adjacent neighborhoods within the same city and controlling for military, economic, and political characteristics, we offer new evidence consistent with the legal origins view: the financial development advantage in the British concession widened after Western legal jurisdiction intensified and narrowed after it abated.
summary: 本文利用1845年至1936年间上海英租界和法租界的新数据，通过两次制度变迁（英国和法国法律管辖权的变化）作为法律体系的外生冲击，检验法律起源对金融发展的影响。研究发现，在英国租界，西方法律管辖权的加强扩大了其相对于法租界的金融发展优势，而法律管辖权的减弱则缩小了这一优势。该结果在控制军事、经济和政治特征后依然稳健，为法律起源观点提供了新证据。
ai_comment: 利用历史自然实验（上海租界法律管辖权变化）识别因果关系，为法律起源理论提供了可靠证据，设计精巧。

title: Booms, Busts, and Common Risk Exposures
abstract: I present a dynamic general equilibrium model in which commonality in bank assets endogenously changes over the business cycle and shapes systemic risk. To reduce individual risks, banks diversify, increasing portfolio overlap and hence the similarity of their exposures to fundamental shocks. Systemic financial crises burst at the end of credit booms when productive investment opportunities are exhausted, banks' diversification incentives are strong, and their portfolios are highly correlated. A calibrated model is able to match key moments related to frequency, severity, and the economy's behavior around systemic crises.
summary: 本文提出了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中银行资产的共性（commonality）内生地随经济周期变化并塑造系统性风险。为降低个体风险，银行进行多样化投资，导致投资组合重叠增加，从而使其对基本面冲击的暴露更加相似。系统性金融危机在信贷繁荣结束时爆发，此时生产性投资机会耗尽、银行的多样化激励最强、投资组合高度相关。校准后的模型能够匹配关于系统性危机频率、严重程度以及危机前后经济行为的关键矩。
ai_comment: 模型将银行资产共性的内生变化嵌入经济周期，解释了信贷繁荣后系统性风险积聚的机制；校准结果与现实数据吻合良好，为理解金融危机的周期性提供了理论框架。

title: Discount Rates, Debt Maturity, and the Fiscal Theory
abstract: This paper examines how the transmission of government portfolio risk arising from maturity operations depends on the stance of monetary/fiscal policy. Accounting for risk premia in the fiscal theory allows the government portfolio to affect expected inflation, even in a frictionless economy. The effects of maturity rebalancing on expected inflation in the fiscal theory depend directly on the conditional nominal term premium, giving rise to an optimal debt‐maturity policy that is state‐dependent. In a calibrated macrofinance model, we demonstrate that maturity operations have sizable effects on expected inflation and output through our novel risk transmission mechanism.
summary: 本文研究政府通过期限操作产生的投资组合风险传导如何依赖于货币/财政政策立场。在财政理论中引入风险溢价后，即使在无摩擦经济中，政府投资组合也能影响预期通胀。期限再平衡对预期通胀的影响直接取决于条件名义期限溢价，从而产生状态依赖的最优债务期限政策。在一个校准的宏观金融模型中，我们证明了通过这种新的风险传导机制，期限操作对预期通胀和产出产生显著影响。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将风险溢价纳入财政理论，揭示了政府债务期限管理影响宏观经济的风险传导渠道，为理解货币政策与财政政策的交互提供了新视角。

title: Attention Spillover in Asset Pricing
abstract: Exploiting a screen display feature whereby the order of stock display is determined by the stock's listing code, we lever a novel identification strategy and study how the interaction between overconfidence and limited attention affect asset pricing. We find that stocks displayed next to those with higher returns in the past two weeks are associated with higher returns in the future week, which are reverted in the long run. This is consistent with our conjectures that investors tend to trade more after positive investment experience and are more likely to pay attention to neighboring stocks, both confirmed using trading data.
summary: 本文利用股票屏幕显示特征（以股票上市代码决定显示顺序）作为自然实验，研究过度自信与有限注意力的交互作用如何影响资产定价。通过识别策略发现，过去两周收益率较高的股票在屏幕上相邻的股票，其未来一周的收益率也更高，但长期存在反转。交易数据证实了投资者的两种行为：在获得正投资经验后更倾向于交易，且更可能关注邻近股票。
ai_comment: 该研究通过屏幕显示顺序这一独特视角，为注意力溢出效应提供了因果证据，并揭示了过度自信与有限注意力的联动机制，对行为资产定价文献有重要贡献。

title: Gender Bias in Promotions: Evidence from Financial Institutions
abstract: We test for gender bias in promotions at financial institutions using two central predictions of Becker’s (1957, 1993) model: firms with bias will (1) raise the promotion bar for marginally promoted female workers, and (2) incur costs from forgoing efficient employment practices. We find support for both of these predictions using a new nationwide panel of mortgage loan officers and their managers encompassing approximately 72,000 workers from over 1,000 shadow banks from 2014 to 2019. Overall, our findings provide evidence that gender bias is an important factor in gender gaps at financial institutions.
summary: 本文利用Becker（1957, 1993）模型的两个核心预测来检验金融机构晋升中的性别偏见：存在偏见的公司会（1）提高边际晋升女性的晋升门槛，以及（2）因放弃高效雇佣实践而承担成本。通过使用2014年至2019年间涵盖美国1000多家影子银行约72,000名抵押贷款官员及其经理的新全国性面板数据，本文为这两个预测提供了支持。总体而言，研究结果表明性别偏见是金融机构性别差距的重要因素。
ai_comment: 利用大规模数据集和经典歧视理论，为金融机构晋升中的性别偏见提供了因果证据，具有较强的政策启示。

title: Friend or Foe? Teaming Between Artificial Intelligence and Workers with Variation in Experience
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) applications become more pervasive, it is critical to understand how knowledge workers with different levels and types of experience can team with AI for productivity gains. We focus on the influence of two major types of human work experience (narrow experience based on the specific task volume and broad experience based on seniority) on the human-AI team dynamics. We developed an AI solution for medical chart coding in a publicly traded company and conducted a field study among the knowledge workers. Based on a detailed analysis performed at the medical chart level, we find evidence that AI benefits workers with greater task-based experience, but senior workers gain less from AI than their junior colleagues. Further investigation reveals that the relatively lower productivity lift from AI is not a result of seniority per se but lower trust in AI, likely triggered by the senior workers’ broader job responsibilities. This study provides new empirical insights into the differential roles of worker experience in the collaborative dynamics between AI and knowledge workers, which have important societal and business implications. This paper was accepted by Kartik Hosanagar, information systems. Funding: This work was supported by Inovalon [Sponsor of the Health Insights AI Laboratory]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00588 .
summary: 随着人工智能（AI）应用日益普及，理解不同经验和类型知识工作者如何与AI协作以提高生产力至关重要。本研究聚焦于两种主要的人类工作经验：基于特定任务量的狭义经验和基于资历的广泛经验，对人与AI团队动态的影响。作者在一家上市公司开发了一个用于医疗图表编码的AI解决方案，并在知识工作者中进行了实地研究。基于医疗图表级别的详细分析，发现AI对任务经验更丰富的工人有益，但资深工人从AI中获得的收益少于初级同事。进一步研究表明，资深工人生产力提升较低并非源于资历本身，而是因为对AI的信任度较低，这可能源于其更广泛的职位责任。该研究为AI与知识工作者协作动态中工作经验的不同作用提供了新的实证见解，具有重要的社会和商业意义。
ai_comment: 本文通过实地研究揭示了不同类型工作经验对AI协作效果的影响，并发现信任机制是导致差异的关键，为AI部署提供了实践指导。

title: Corporate R&D Investments Following Competitors’ Voluntary Disclosures: Evidence from the Drug Development Process
abstract: This paper examines the role of peer firm disclosures in shaping corporate research and development (R&D) investments. Drawing on models of two‐stage R&D races, I hypothesize that a firm could be either deterred or encouraged by peer disclosure of interim R&D success, depending on peer firms’ R&D strength in the race. Using granular, project‐level data on clinical trials in the drug development process, I find that a firm's R&D investments in a specific therapeutic area are deterred by disclosures of early‐phase trial initiation from strong rivals in the same area but encouraged by disclosures from weak rivals. Cross‐sectional analyses show that focal firm strength and disclosure relevance moderate the effects of peer firm disclosure. Overall, my evidence suggests that peer firms’ R&D disclosures can have both proprietary costs and deterrence benefits.
summary: 本文研究同行公司披露如何影响企业研发投资。基于两阶段研发竞赛模型，作者假设同行披露中期研发成功可能抑制或鼓励企业研发，取决于同行在竞赛中的研发实力。利用药物开发过程中临床试验的细粒度项目级数据，作者发现：在特定治疗领域，强对手披露早期试验启动会抑制公司研发投资，而弱对手披露则会鼓励公司投资。横截面分析表明，公司自身实力和披露相关性会调节这些效应。总体证据表明，同行研发披露同时具有专有成本和威慑收益。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的临床试验数据，实证揭示了竞争对手披露对自身研发投资的双向影响，为披露的专有成本和威慑收益提供了微观证据。

title: Breadth of Ownership and the Cross-Section of Corporate Bond Returns
abstract: Using breadth of corporate bond fund ownership to proxy for the combination of short-sale constraints and divergence of opinions in the corporate bond market, this paper investigates whether and to what extent Miller’s overpricing theory holds for corporate bonds. Consistent with the theory, we document a significant and positive relation between changes in breadth and the cross-section of future corporate bond returns. Because of the bounded upside of debt, the ability of changes in breadth to predict returns appears to be less pronounced for corporate bonds relative to stocks. Furthermore, this predictability is stronger among bonds with higher credit risk, indicating that the effect of short-sale constraints and divergence of opinions on bond mispricing tends to be larger for riskier bonds with more upside potential and, thus, more scope for overvaluation. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4950 .
summary: 本文利用公司债券基金持股广度作为卖空限制和意见分歧的代理变量，检验Miller的过度定价理论是否适用于公司债券市场。研究发现，持股广度的变化与未来公司债券收益的横截面之间存在显著的正相关关系，支持Miller理论。但由于公司债券的上行空间有限，这种预测能力相对于股票较弱。此外，对于信用风险较高的债券，这种预测能力更强，表明卖空限制和意见分歧对风险更高、上行潜力更大的债券的定价错误影响更大。
ai_comment: 首次将Miller的过度定价理论应用于公司债券市场，并揭示了信用风险在其中的调节作用，丰富了债券定价行为理论。

title: The Cost of Bank Regulatory Capital
abstract: Basel I introduced capital requirements for undrawn commitments, but only for revolvers with an original maturity greater than one year. We use this regulatory discontinuity to estimate the impact of capital regulation on the cost and composition of credit. Following Basel I, short-term commitment fees declined relative to long-term commitments and issuance of short-term facilities increased. Our results highlight the sensitivity of credit provision to capital regulation, particularly for banks with less capital. We are able to infer that low-capital banks are willing to forego twice as much income from fees to reduce required regulatory capital by a dollar.
summary: 本研究利用Basel I资本监管对未提取承诺的不连续处理：只对原始期限超过一年的循环贷款设定资本要求，而短期承诺则免于监管。通过这种监管断点，论文估计了资本监管对信贷成本和构成的影响。研究发现，Basel I实施后，短期承诺的费用相对于长期承诺有所下降，且短期贷款设施的发行量增加。结果凸显了资本监管对信贷供给的敏感性，尤其是对资本不足的银行。进一步推断，低资本银行愿意放弃两倍的费用收入来减少一美元的监管资本要求。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙利用监管规则中的断点进行准自然实验，提供了资本监管影响银行信贷行为的直接因果证据。

title: Debtors at Play: Gaming Behavior and Consumer Credit Risk
abstract: Exploiting a unique high-frequency, individual-level database, we (1) construct individual-level, incentive-compatible proxies of impulsivity based on video gaming behavior and (2) use these proxies to evaluate predictions concerning how impulsivity shapes individuals’ responses to a relaxation of credit constraints as captured by receiving a credit card. We discover that precard gaming intensity—as measured by the frequency and amount of game expenditures—is strongly and positively associated with (a) the probability of defaulting on credit card debt in the future, (b) postcard expenditures on luxury and addictive items, (c) surges in consumption spending immediately after receiving the credit card, and (d) rapid debt accumulation after obtaining the card. Differences in financial literacy, income, income variability, education, and demographics do not drive the results. The results are consistent with (1) neurological and psychological studies stressing that excessive gaming is associated with impulse control deficiencies and (2) behavioral theories stressing that impulsivity, i.e., time-inconsistent preferences for immediate gratification and ineffective strategies for avoiding myopic cues and temptations, substantially influence individual expenditure patterns and borrowing decisions when liquidity constraints are relaxed. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: C. Lin acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Project 72192841] and the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China [Project T35-710/20-R]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4931 .
summary: 利用独特的高频个人层面数据库，本文基于电子游戏行为构建了个人层面、激励相容的冲动性代理指标，并用于评估冲动性如何影响个体对信用约束放松（如获得信用卡）的反应。研究发现，信用卡发放前的游戏强度（通过游戏频率和消费金额衡量）与未来信用卡债务违约概率、获得信用卡后奢侈品和成瘾性物品支出、消费支出激增以及债务快速积累呈强烈正相关。金融素养、收入、收入波动、教育和人口统计差异无法解释这一结果。这与神经科学和心理学研究中过度游戏与冲动控制缺陷相关的结论一致，也支持行为理论中冲动性（即时间不一致的即时满足偏好和避免短视诱惑的低效策略）在流动性约束放松时显著影响个体支出模式和借贷决策的观点。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用游戏行为数据作为冲动性的代理变量，揭示了非金融行为对信用风险的预测力，为消费者信贷风险评估提供了新视角。

title: Overcoming Arbitrage Limits: Option Trading and Momentum Returns
abstract: Momentum profits depend mainly on the short leg and therefore on barriers to short sales. Our research indicates that the decline in momentum profitability in the past 2 decades is driven partly by a contemporaneous growth in stock options trading. Stock options offer an alternative to short selling, augmenting the stock lending market, and thereby contributing to improved pricing efficiency. The resulting reduction in barriers to short sales contributes to lower returns to momentum trading from the short leg. Our results persist after matching stocks with and without options based on different firm-level characteristics.
summary: 该论文研究股票期权交易如何影响动量策略的盈利能力。动量利润主要依赖于空头腿（short leg）和卖空障碍。作者发现，过去20年间动量盈利能力的下降部分源自同期股票期权交易的快速增长。股票期权提供了卖空的替代方式，增强了股票借贷市场，从而提高了定价效率。卖空障碍的减少导致动量交易中空头腿的回报降低。该结果在基于不同公司特征匹配有期权和无期权的股票后依然稳健。
ai_comment: 该研究为动量利润衰减提供了新颖解释，即期权市场的增长通过降低卖空壁垒削弱了动量策略的可获利性，对理解金融市场效率演化具有重要启示。

title: Ambiguous Dynamic Treatment Regimes: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: A main research goal in various studies is to use an observational data set and provide a new set of counterfactual guidelines that can yield causal improvements. Dynamic Treatment Regimes (DTRs) are widely studied to formalize this process and enable researchers to find guidelines that are both personalized and dynamic. However, available methods in finding optimal DTRs often rely on assumptions that are violated in real-world applications (e.g., medical decision making or public policy), especially when (a) the existence of unobserved confounders cannot be ignored, and (b) the unobserved confounders are time varying (e.g., affected by previous actions). When such assumptions are violated, one often faces ambiguity regarding the underlying causal model that is needed to be assumed to obtain an optimal DTR. This ambiguity is inevitable because the dynamics of unobserved confounders and their causal impact on the observed part of the data cannot be understood from the observed data. Motivated by a case study of finding superior treatment regimes for patients who underwent transplantation in our partner hospital (Mayo Clinic) and faced a medical condition known as new-onset diabetes after transplantation, we extend DTRs to a new class termed Ambiguous Dynamic Treatment Regimes (ADTRs), in which the causal impact of treatment regimes is evaluated based on a “cloud” of potential causal models. We then connect ADTRs to Ambiguous Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (APOMDPs) proposed by Saghafian (2018) , and consider unobserved confounders as latent variables but with ambiguous dynamics and causal effects on observed variables. Using this connection, we develop two reinforcement learning methods termed Direct Augmented V-Learning (DAV-Learning) and Safe Augmented V-Learning (SAV-Learning), which enable using the observed data to effectively learn an optimal treatment regime. We establish theoretical results for these learning methods, including (weak) consistency and asymptotic normality. We further evaluate the performance of these learning methods both in our case study (using clinical data) and in simulation experiments (using synthetic data). We find promising results for our proposed approaches, showing that they perform well even compared with an imaginary oracle who knows both the true causal model (of the data-generating process) and the optimal regime under that model. Finally, we highlight that our approach enables a two-way personalization; obtained treatment regimes can be personalized based on both patients’ characteristics and physicians’ preferences. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, data science. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00883 .
summary: 本文针对在观察性数据中寻找动态治疗机制（DTRs）时，因存在随时间变化的未观测混杂因素而导致因果模型不确定性的问题，提出了一类新的模糊动态治疗机制（ADTRs）。通过将ADTRs与模糊部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（APOMDPs）相联系，将未观测混杂因素视为具有模糊动力学和因果效应的潜变量。在此基础上，开发了两种强化学习方法——直接增强V学习（DAV-Learning）和安全增强V学习（SAV-Learning），以从观察数据中有效学习最优治疗机制。作者建立了这些学习方法的理论性质，包括（弱）一致性和渐近正态性。通过基于梅奥诊所移植后新发糖尿病病例的临床数据和合成数据的模拟实验，评估了所提方法的性能，结果表明它们即使与知道真实因果模型和最优机制的虚构预言家相比也表现良好。此外，该方法实现了双向个性化，即治疗机制可同时根据患者特征和医生偏好进行个性化。
keywords: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将模糊集思想引入动态治疗机制，有效应对了现实应用中常见的未观测混杂因素随时间变化的挑战，且方法具有理论保证和实证优势。

title: Entrepreneurial Wealth and Employment: Tracing Out the Effects of a Stock Market Crash
abstract: Using the dispersion in stock returns during the financial crisis as a source of exogenous variation in the wealth of Norwegian entrepreneurs who held listed stocks, I show that adverse shocks to the wealth of business owners had large effects on their firms' financing, employment, and investment. The effects on investment and employment are driven by young firms, that obtain differentially less bank financing following an owner wealth shock. The effects on employment operate primarily through reduced hiring. My findings highlight that equity‐financing frictions and the procyclicality of entrepreneurial wealth are important channels that can amplify economic shocks.
summary: 本文利用金融危机期间股票回报的分散性作为挪威企业家持有上市股票财富的外生变动来源，研究企业家财富的负面冲击对其企业融资、就业和投资的巨大影响。研究发现，企业家财富冲击对年轻企业的影响尤为显著，这些企业在所有者财富冲击后获得的银行融资显著减少。就业效应主要通过减少招聘实现。研究结果强调了股权融资摩擦和企业家财富的顺周期性是放大经济冲击的重要渠道。
ai_comment: 利用外生冲击识别因果效应，揭示了企业家财富对企业行为的显著影响，为理解经济周期中企业融资与就业的动态提供了新视角。

title: How Forced Switches Reveal Switching Costs: Evidence from the Loan Market
abstract: This article proposes a novel way to estimate consumer switching costs and uses Lithuanian credit register data and two bank closures to provide this estimate for the loan market. I show that when a distressed bank’s closure forced firms to switch, they started borrowing at lower interest rates instantly and permanently and that this drop revealed the lower bound of firms’ ex ante switching costs. A healthy bank’s closure showed no such effect. The article’s findings suggest that distressed banks hold up and overcharge firms and that by closing and resolving such banks with good-bank/bad-bank separation regulators can improve firm financing.
summary: 本文提出了一种估计消费者转换成本的新方法，并利用立陶宛信贷登记数据以及两次银行关闭事件，对贷款市场中的转换成本进行了估计。研究发现，当一家陷入困境的银行被迫关闭并迫使企业更换贷款银行时，企业立即且永久性地以较低的利率借款，这一利率下降揭示了企业事前转换成本的下限。而一家健康银行的关闭则没有显示出这种效应。研究结论表明，陷入困境的银行会对企业进行“绑架”并收取过高的费用，监管机构通过关闭这些银行并采用“好银行/坏银行”分离的方式来解决，可以改善企业的融资条件。
ai_comment: 该研究利用独特的自然实验（银行关闭）来识别转换成本，提供了对银行市场力量和政策干预效果的新见解。

title: Housing Cycles and Exchange Rates
abstract: This paper documents that the ratio of residential-to-nonresidential investment is a strong in-sample and out-of-sample predictor for the dollar up to 12 quarters. The predictability is robust to a battery of additional checks and holds for other G10 currencies. We explain the predictability in an analytical model with time-varying housing preference, productivity, and volatility. In the model, the U.S. housing investment share is higher during periods with higher growth and lower uncertainty, corresponding to lower future nontradable prices, dollar index, and excess returns. We find strong empirical support for the channel. Alternative explanations, including the business and financial cycle, find less empirical support. This paper was accepted by David Sraer, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4932 .
summary: 本文记录了住宅投资与非住宅投资之比是美元汇率的一个强预测指标，在样本内和样本外均可预测未来12个季度的美元走势，且该预测能力对G10其他货币同样成立。作者构建了一个包含时变住房偏好、生产率和波动性的理论模型来解释这一现象：在美国经济高增长和低不确定性时期，住房投资份额较高，这对应于未来非贸易品价格下降、美元指数走弱以及超额回报降低。实证结果强烈支持该渠道，而商业周期和金融周期等替代解释则缺乏实证支持。
ai_comment: 该文从住房投资结构入手，发现了对汇率有强劲预测力的新指标，并提供了完整的理论模型和实证检验，具有重要的学术和实践价值。

title: Option Momentum
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of option investments across different stocks by computing monthly returns on at‐the‐money straddles on individual equities. We find that options with high historical returns continue to significantly outperform options with low historical returns over horizons ranging from 6 to 36 months. This phenomenon is robust to including out‐of‐the‐money options or delta‐hedging the returns. Unlike stock momentum, option return continuation is not followed by long‐run reversal. Significant returns remain after factor risk adjustment and after controlling for implied volatility and other characteristics. Across stocks, trading costs are unrelated to the magnitude of momentum profits.
summary: 本文研究不同股票期权投资的绩效，通过计算个股平价跨式期权的月度收益，发现历史收益高的期权在6至36个月的时间范围内持续显著优于历史收益低的期权。这一现象在考虑虚值期权或进行Delta对冲后依然稳健。与股票动量不同，期权收益的持续性之后没有长期反转。在因子风险调整后以及控制隐含波动率和其他特征后，显著收益仍然存在。不同股票之间，交易成本与动量利润的大小无关。
ai_comment: 发现了期权市场中显著的动量效应，且与股票动量相比无长期反转，为资产定价和交易策略提供了新视角。

title: Desperate House Sellers: Distress among Developers
abstract: I identify the effect of financial constraints on product prices using granular data on home-builder housing developments from the 2006–2009 housing crisis. Builders who experience losses in one area subsequently sell homes in unaffected areas at a discount to raise cash quickly. When builders cut prices, they sell homes faster and builders cut prices more in areas in which price cuts produce larger declines in time-to-sale. Financially constrained firms are more likely to cut prices of homes in healthy areas following losses elsewhere. Firms cut prices following losses in other projects only during the crisis, not during the boom.
summary: 本文利用2006-2009年住房危机期间房屋建筑商开发项目的微观数据，识别金融约束对产品价格的影响。研究发现，建筑商在一个地区遭受损失后，会在未受影响的地区折价销售房屋以快速筹集现金。降价后房屋销售速度加快，且建筑商在降价导致销售时间减少更大的地区降价更多。财务受约束的公司更可能在健康地区降价，且这种降价行为仅在危机期间而非繁荣期间出现。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特微观数据揭示了金融约束对住房市场定价行为的因果关系，对理解危机期间资产折价销售现象有重要贡献。

title: Target Setting in Hierarchies: The Role of Middle Managers
abstract: We explore how a supervisor's hierarchical rank affects the extent to which employees’ targets reflect their past performance. Literature documents that supervisors do not fully ratchet targets for past performance, arguably because the commitment not to penalize successful employees with more difficult targets alleviates the severity of the ratchet effect. We argue that commitment is less credible in organizational hierarchies where a middle manager sets employees’ targets. Using data from an organization comprised of three hierarchical layers, we consistently find that a middle manager's exposure to performance pressure is positively associated with the ratcheting of the employees’ targets. Moreover, we show that management at headquarters reduces a middle manager's performance pressure when most of her employees missed their targets in the previous period. Overall, the results imply that the hierarchical rank is an important determinant of the credibility of a supervisor's commitment to deemphasize past performance in target setting.
summary: 本文研究主管的层级如何影响员工目标对过去绩效的调整程度。文献表明主管不会完全根据过去绩效上调目标（棘轮效应），因为不惩罚成功员工的承诺可缓解棘轮效应。但本文认为，在组织层级中，由中层经理设定员工目标时，这种承诺的可信度较低。利用包含三个层级的组织数据，作者发现中层经理面临的绩效压力与员工目标的棘轮效应正相关。此外，当多数员工未达前期目标时，总部管理层会降低中层经理的绩效压力。总体而言，结果暗示层级是影响主管在目标设定中淡化过去绩效的承诺可信度的重要因素。
ai_comment: 本文通过实地数据揭示了中层经理在目标棘轮效应中的关键作用，丰富了关于层级与承诺可信度的理论。

title: Semiparametric Conditional Factor Models: Estimation and Inference
Economic Growth under Transformative AI
abstract: Recent advances in AI may herald the near arrival of systems that can automate essentially all work. We review the macroeconomic implications of this scenario, in a framework synthesizing several strands of the relevant literature. Robustly, fully automating production alone (so that machines can self-replicate) would dramatically raise the growth rate and lower the labor share, breaking the Kaldor Facts that have long characterized frontier growth. Automating R&D (so that machines can self-improve) would accelerate the transformation, but may not produce it in isolation. Wages—multiplying exploding output and a plummeting labor share—may rise or fall, depending on the returns to scale, the importance of natural resources, and the direction of technical change.
summary: 本文探讨了变革性人工智能（AI）可能带来的经济影响，特别是当AI系统能够自动化几乎所有工作时。研究综合了相关文献的多个分支，构建了一个分析框架。主要结论包括：完全自动化生产（使机器能够自我复制）将显著提高经济增长率并降低劳动份额，打破长期以来的Kaldor事实；自动化研发（使机器能够自我改进）会加速这一转变，但单独作用可能不足以产生这种效果。工资方面，由于产出爆炸性增长和劳动份额急剧下降，工资可能上升或下降，取决于规模报酬、自然资源的重要性以及技术变革的方向。
ai_comment: 本文前瞻性地分析了AI全面自动化对宏观经济的颠覆性影响，为理解未来经济增长模式提供了重要理论框架。

title: AI Adoption in America: Who, What, and Where
abstract: We study the early adoption and diffusion of five AI-related technologies (automated-guided vehicles, machine learning, machine vision, natural language processing, and voice recognition) as documented in the 2018 Annual Business Survey of 850, 000 firms across the United States. We find that fewer than 6% of firms used any of the AI-related technologies we measure, though most very large firms reported at least some AI use. Weighted by employment, average adoption was just over 18%. AI use in production, while varying considerably by industry, nevertheless was found in every sector of the economy and clustered with emerging technologies such as cloud computing and robotics. Among dynamic young firms, AI use was highest alongside more educated, more-experienced, and younger owners, including owners motivated by bringing new ideas to market or helping the community. AI adoption was also more common alongside indicators of high-growth entrepreneurship, including venture capital funding, recent product and process innovation, and growth-oriented business strategies. Early adoption was far from evenly distributed: a handful of “superstar” cities and emerging hubs led startups’ adoption of AI. These patterns of early AI use foreshadow economic and social impacts far beyond this limited initial diffusion, with the possibility of a growing “AI divide” if early patterns persist.
summary: 本研究基于2018年美国年度商业调查中85万家企业数据，考察了五种AI相关技术（自动导引车、机器学习、机器视觉、自然语言处理和语音识别）的早期采用与扩散。研究发现，不到6%的企业使用了任何测量的AI技术，但绝大多数大型企业报告至少有一些AI使用；按就业加权，平均采用率略高于18%。AI在生产中的使用在不同行业间差异显著，但遍及经济每个部门，并与云计算和机器人等新兴技术集群出现。在动态年轻企业中，AI使用率最高的是那些所有者教育水平更高、经验更丰富且更年轻的企业，包括以将新想法推向市场或帮助社区为动力的所有者。AI采用在高增长创业指标（如风险资本融资、近期产品和流程创新以及增长导向的商业战略）中更为常见。早期采用远非均匀分布：少数“超级明星”城市和新兴中心引领了初创企业的AI采用。这些早期AI使用模式预示着远超出这一有限初始扩散的经济和社会影响，如果早期模式持续，可能形成日益扩大的“AI鸿沟”。
ai_comment: 利用大规模调查数据全面刻画了美国企业AI采用的早期图景，揭示了技术扩散的不平等性及其潜在社会影响，为后续研究提供了重要基准。

title: Why Do Index Funds Have Market Power? Quantifying Frictions in the Index Fund Market
abstract: The number of index funds increased drastically from 2000 to 2020, partially fueled by the emergence of exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Despite the growing availability of similar products, price dispersion persists, with many expensive funds still available, indicating significant market power among index funds. One explanation is that investor inertia limits the adoption of new products and interacts with other market frictions to restrict competition. To understand the sources and implications of market power, we develop a tractable quantitative dynamic model of demand for and supply of index funds that accounts for information frictions and heterogeneous preferences, in addition to inertia. These frictions on the demand side create market power for index fund managers, which fund managers can further exploit by price discriminating and charging higher expense ratios to retail investors. We find that inertia is high, with only 13% of households updating their portfolio at least once yearly. Although inertia is high, its impact on the investment behavior of households is limited because they struggle to optimize investment decisions due to information frictions. Thus, there is an interaction between the two frictions—inertia is more costly for investors when information frictions are low. We show that although the introduction of ETFs lowered expense ratios through both the cost advantage of ETFs and increased competition, demand-side frictions limited product adoption.
summary: 本文研究指数基金市场中的市场势力来源，尽管基金数量激增（尤其ETF的兴起），但价格分散持续存在，许多高费率基金仍在运营，表明指数基金拥有显著市场势力。作者构建了一个可量化的动态供需模型，考虑信息摩擦、异质性偏好以及投资者惰性（仅13%的家庭每年至少调整一次投资组合）。模型显示，需求侧的摩擦（尤其是信息摩擦与惰性的相互作用）为指数基金管理公司创造市场势力，使其能够通过价格歧视向零售投资者收取更高费率。虽然惰性很高，但由于信息摩擦导致投资者难以优化决策，因此惰性的实际影响有限；当信息摩擦较低时，惰性的成本更高。研究发现，ETF的引入通过成本优势与竞争降低了费率，但需求侧摩擦限制了产品的普及。
ai_comment: 该论文将惰性和信息摩擦纳入统一的动态框架，揭示了需求侧摩擦如何塑造基金市场的定价权，对理解金融中介的竞争格局具有重要启示。

title: Living Up to Expectations: Central Bank Credibility, the Effectiveness of Forward Guidance, and Inflation Dynamics Post-Global Financial Crisis
abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness of forward guidance when central banks have imperfect credibility.Exploiting unique survey-based measures of expected inflation, output growth, and interest rates, we estimate a small-scale New Keynesian model for the United States and other G7 countries plus Spain allowing for deviations from full information rational expectations.In our model, the key parameter that aggregates heterogeneous expectations captures the central bank's credibility and affects the overall effectiveness of forward guidance.We find that the central banks of the U.S., the U.K., Germany, and other major advanced economies have similar levels of credibility (albeit far from full credibility); however, Japan's central bank credibility is much lower.For each country, our measure of credibility has declined over time, making forward guidance less effective.In a counterfactual analysis, we document that inflation would have been significantly higher, and the zero lower bound on short-term interest rates much less of an issue, in the wake of the Global Financial Crisis had the public perceived central bank forward guidance statements to be perfectly credible.Moreover, inflation would have declined more, and somewhat faster, with perfect credibility in the wake of the inflation surge post-COVID-19.
summary: 本文研究央行不完全可信度下前瞻指引的有效性。利用基于调查的通胀预期、产出增长和利率的独特度量，估计了美国、其他G7国家及西班牙的小型新凯恩斯模型，允许偏离完全信息理性预期。模型中的关键参数聚合异质预期，捕捉央行可信度并影响前瞻指引效果。发现美国、英国、德国等主要经济体的央行可信度类似但远非完全可信，日本央行可信度更低；各国可信度随时间下降，使前瞻指引效果减弱。反事实分析表明，若全球金融危机后公众认为前瞻指引完全可信，通胀将显著更高，零下限问题更少；而COVID-19后通胀飙升时，完全可信将使通胀更快下降。
ai_comment: 本文通过调查数据量化央行可信度，为评估前瞻指引效果提供新工具；反事实分析揭示了可信度对通胀和零下限约束的重要性。

title: Contagion Effects of the Silicon Valley Bank Run
abstract: This paper analyzes the contagion effects associated with the failure of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) and identifies bank-specific vulnerabilities contributing to the subsequent declines in banks' stock returns.We find that uninsured deposits, unrealized losses in held-to-maturity securities, bank size, and cash holdings had a significant impact, while better-quality assets or holdings of liquid securities did not help mitigate the negative spillovers.Interestingly, banks whose stocks performed worse post-SVB also experienced lower returns in the previous year, following Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.Stock investors appeared to anticipate risks associated with uninsured deposit reliance, but did not foresee the realization of implied losses.While mid-sized banks experienced particular stress immediately after the SVB failure, over time negative spillovers became widespread except for the largest banks.
summary: 本文分析了硅谷银行（SVB）倒闭引发的传染效应，识别了导致银行股价下跌的关键脆弱性因素。研究发现，未保险存款、持有至到期证券的未实现损失、银行规模和现金持有量对股价下跌有显著影响，而更高质量的资产或流动性证券未能缓解负面溢出效应。有趣的是，SVB事件后表现较差的银行在前一年美联储加息周期中也经历了更低的回报。股票投资者似乎预期到了未保险存款依赖的风险，但未能预见到隐含损失的实现。中型银行在SVB倒闭后立即承压，但随着时间的推移，负面溢出效应变得普遍，仅最大银行除外。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了市场对银行脆弱性的风险认知偏差，突出了未保险存款和未实现损失在传染中的关键作用，对监管具有重要启示。

title: The Labor Demand and Labor Supply Channels of Monetary Policy
abstract: Monetary policy is conventionally understood to influence labor demand, with little effect on labor supply. We estimate the response of labor market flows to high-frequency changes in interest rates around FOMC announcements and Fed Chair speeches and find evidence that, in contrast to the consensus view, a contractionary monetary policy shock leads to a significant increase in labor supply: workers reduce the rate at which they quit jobs to non-employment, and non-employed individuals increase their job-seeking behavior. These effects are quantitatively important: holding supply-driven labor market flows constant, the decline in employment from a contractionary monetary policy shock would be twice as large. To interpret our findings, we estimate a heterogeneous agent model with frictional labor markets and an active labor supply margin. The model rationalizes existing estimates of small labor supply responses to idiosyncratic transfers with our new evidence of a large labor supply response to an aggregate shock.
summary: 传统观点认为货币政策主要通过影响劳动力需求发挥作用，对劳动力供给影响很小。本文利用联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告和美联储主席演讲期间利率的高频变化，估计了货币政策冲击对劳动力市场流动的影响。结果发现，紧缩性货币政策冲击会导致劳动力供给显著增加：工人减少辞职转向非就业的比率，非就业者增加求职行为。这些效应在数量上很重要：若保持供给驱动的劳动力市场流动不变，紧缩性货币政策冲击导致的就业下降幅度将是实际的两倍。为了解释这些发现，本文估计了一个包含摩擦性劳动力市场和主动劳动力供给边际的异质性代理模型。该模型将现有关于个体转移支付对劳动力供给影响较小的估计，与本文发现的总体冲击对劳动力供给影响较大的证据进行了统一解释。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了传统货币政策仅影响劳动力需求的观点，通过高频识别发现劳动力供给渠道的重要作用，并用量化分析和异质性代理模型提供了机制解释。

title: The Turing Transformation: Artificial Intelligence, Intelligence Augmentation, and Skill Premiums
abstract: We ask whether a technical objective of using human performance of tasks as a benchmark for AI performance will result in the negative outcomes highlighted in prior work in terms of jobs and inequality. Instead, we argue that task automation, especially when driven by AI advances, can enhance job prospects and potentially widen the scope for employment of many workers. The neglected mechanism we highlight is the potential for changes in the skill premium where AI automation of tasks exogenously improves the value of the skills of many workers, expands the pool of available workers to perform other tasks, and, in the process, increases labor income and potentially reduces inequality. We label this possibility the “Turing Transformation.” As such, we argue that AI researchers and policymakers should not focus on the technical aspects of AI applications and whether they are directed at automating human-performed tasks or not and, instead, focus on the outcomes of AI research. In so doing, our goal is not to diminish human-centric AI research as a laudable goal. Instead, we want to note that AI research that uses a human-task template with a goal to automate that task can often augment human performance of other tasks and whole jobs. The distributional effects of technology depend more on which workers have tasks that get automated than on the fact of automation per se.
summary: 本文探讨了以人类任务表现作为AI性能基准的技术目标是否会导致先前研究中强调的负面就业和不平等后果。作者认为，任务自动化，尤其是由AI进步驱动的自动化，可以增强就业前景并可能扩大许多工人的就业范围。他们强调的忽视机制是技能溢价的变化，即AI对任务的自动化外生地提高了许多工人技能的价值，扩大了可执行其他任务的工人池，从而增加了劳动收入并可能减少不平等。作者将此可能性称为“图灵转变”。因此，他们主张AI研究人员和政策制定者不应关注AI应用的技术方面以及是否旨在自动化人类任务，而应关注AI研究的结果。其目标不是贬低以人为中心的AI研究，而是指出以人类任务模板为目标自动化该任务的AI研究往往可以增强其他任务和整体工作的人类表现。技术的分配效应更多地取决于哪些工人的任务被自动化，而不是自动化本身。
ai_comment: 本文提出了一个新颖观点，即AI自动化可以通过提升工人技能价值来改善就业和不平等，挑战了传统对技术替代的担忧。其强调关注结果而非技术路径的分配效应，对AI政策制定具有启示意义。

title: Chronicle of a Dollarization Foretold: Inflation and Exchange Rates Dynamics
abstract: We study the effects of an anticipated dollarization, announced today but planned to be implemented at some future date, in a simple open-economy model.Motivated by the profile of countries considering dollarization we make the following assumptions.First, the government faces a scarcity of dollars to pledge for the future conversion of domestic currency.Second, without dollarization monetary policy finances a deficit via seignorage.We focus on the predollarization period.Our results are as follows.First, the announcement leads to a discrete devaluation on impact.Second, after this jump the devaluation rate also rises relative to the no dollarization benchmark.Finally, the devaluation and inflation rate may rises over time.
summary: 本文在一个简单的开放经济模型中研究预期美元化（即今日宣布但计划未来实施）对汇率和通货膨胀的动态影响。受考虑美元化国家的特征启发，模型假设政府面临美元储备稀缺，无法为未来本币兑换提供充分担保；同时，若无美元化，货币政策通过铸币税为财政赤字融资。分析聚焦于美元化实施前的过渡时期。主要发现：首先，美元化宣布导致本币即期出现离散性贬值；其次，在此次跳贬之后，贬值率相对于无美元化基准情形进一步上升；最后，贬值率和通货膨胀率可能随时间推移而持续攀升。
ai_comment: 本文通过前瞻性预期机制解释了美元化宣布后汇率与通胀的动态变化，对理解新兴经济体货币替代政策具有重要启示。

title: Optimizing Patient-Specific Medication Regimen Policies Using Wearable Sensors in Parkinson’s Disease
abstract: Effective treatment of Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a continual challenge for healthcare providers, and providers can benefit from leveraging emerging technologies to supplement traditional clinic care. We develop a data-driven reinforcement learning (RL) framework to optimize PD medication regimens through wearable sensors. We leverage a data set of n = 26 PD patients who wore wrist-mounted movement trackers for two separate six-day periods. Using these data, we first build and validate a simulation model of how individual patients’ movement symptoms respond to medication administration. We then pair this simulation model with an on-policy RL algorithm that recommends optimal medication types, timing, and dosages during the day while incorporating human-in-the-loop considerations on medication administration. The results show that the RL-prescribed medication regimens outperform physicians’ medication regimens, despite physicians having access to the same data as the RL agent. To validate our results, we assess our wearable-based RL medication regimens using n = 399 PD patients from the Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative data set. We show that the wearable-based RL medication regimens would lead to significant symptom improvement for these patients, even more so than training RL policies directly from this data set. In doing so, we show that RL models from even small data sets of wearable data can offer novel, generalizable clinical insights and medication strategies, which may outperform those derived from larger data sets without wearable data. This paper was accepted by Carri Chan, healthcare management. Funding: This research is partially supported by the Science Alliance, University of Tennessee and by the Laboratory Directed Research and Development Program, Oak Ridge National Laboratory managed by UT-Battelle, LLC for the U.S. Department of Energy. Data used in this article were obtained from the Parkinson Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) database, which is sponsored by the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson’s Research (MJFF). Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4747 .
summary: 该论文针对帕金森病（PD）治疗中用药方案优化的挑战，提出一种基于可穿戴传感器的数据驱动强化学习（RL）框架。利用26名患者佩戴腕部运动追踪器采集的两段六天数据，首先构建并验证了患者运动症状对用药反应的仿真模型，然后将该模型与同策略RL算法结合，在考虑人机交互因素的情况下，推荐最优的药物类型、服药时间和剂量。结果表明，RL推荐的用药方案优于医生方案，即使医生拥有相同数据。进一步使用帕金森进展标志物倡议（PPMI）数据集的399名患者验证，发现基于可穿戴的RL方案能显著改善症状，甚至比直接在大数据集上训练的RL策略效果更好，说明小样本可穿戴数据训练的RL模型可提供具有泛化能力的临床见解和用药策略。
ai_comment: 亮点在于利用小规模可穿戴传感器数据训练的强化学习模型，不仅优于医生决策，还能迁移至更大数据集，展示了数据驱动方法在个性化医疗中的潜力。

title: Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning: The Blessing of (More) Optimism
abstract: Motivated by operations research applications, such as inventory control and real-time bidding, we consider undiscounted reinforcement learning in Markov decision processes under model uncertainty and temporal drifts. In this setting, both the latent reward and state transition distributions are allowed to evolve over time, as long as their respective total variations, quantified by suitable metrics, do not exceed certain variation budgets. We first develop the sliding window upper confidence bound for reinforcement learning with confidence-widening (SWUCRL2-CW) algorithm and establish its dynamic regret bound when the variation budgets are known. In addition, we propose the bandit-over-reinforcement learning algorithm to adaptively tune the SWUCRL2-CW algorithm to achieve the same dynamic regret bound but in a parameter-free manner (i.e., without knowing the variation budgets). Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to show that our proposed algorithms achieve superior empirical performance compared with existing algorithms. Notably, under nonstationarity, historical data samples may falsely indicate that state transition rarely happens. This thus presents a significant challenge when one tries to apply the conventional optimism in the face of uncertainty principle to achieve a low dynamic regret bound. We overcome this challenge by proposing a novel confidence-widening technique that incorporates additional optimism into our learning algorithms. To extend our theoretical findings, we demonstrate, in the context of single-item inventory control with lost sales, fixed cost, and zero lead time, how one can leverage special structures on the state transition distributions to achieve improved dynamic regret bound in time-varying demand environments. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: The authors acknowledge support from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Data Science Laboratory and the MIT–IBM partnership in artificial intelligence. W. C. Cheung acknowledges support from the Singapore Ministry of Education [Tier 2 Grant MOE-T2EP20121-0012]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4704 .
summary: 本文考虑在模型不确定性和时间漂移下的无折扣强化学习马尔可夫决策过程，其中潜在奖励和状态转移分布都允许随时间演化，只要它们的总变差（通过适当度量量化）不超过特定变化预算。首先提出滑动窗口置信上限强化学习算法（SWUCRL2-CW），并建立其已知变化预算下的动态遗憾界。随后提出bandit-over-reinforcement learning算法来自适应调整SWUCRL2-CW，在无需知道变化预算的情况下实现相同的动态遗憾界。数值实验表明所提算法相比现有算法具有优越的实证性能。针对非平稳性导致的历史数据可能错误指示状态转移罕见的问题，通过提出新颖的置信度加宽技术引入额外乐观主义来克服挑战。最后，在单物品库存控制（有丢失销售、固定成本和零前置时间）背景下，展示如何利用状态转移分布的特殊结构在时变需求环境中获得改进的动态遗憾界。
ai_comment: 本文通过置信度加宽技术巧妙地将乐观主义引入非平稳环境，理论分析与实际应用结合紧密，对运筹学中的动态决策问题具有重要参考价值。

title: Distributionally Robust Batch Contextual Bandits
abstract: Policy learning using historical observational data are an important problem that has widespread applications. Examples include selecting offers, prices, or advertisements for consumers; choosing bids in contextual first-price auctions; and selecting medication based on patients’ characteristics. However, existing literature rests on the crucial assumption that the future environment where the learned policy will be deployed is the same as the past environment that has generated the data: an assumption that is often false or too coarse an approximation. In this paper, we lift this assumption and aim to learn a distributionally robust policy with incomplete observational data. We first present a policy evaluation procedure that allows us to assess how well the policy does under worst-case environment shift. We then establish a central limit theorem type guarantee for this proposed policy evaluation scheme. Leveraging this evaluation scheme, we further propose a novel learning algorithm that is able to learn a policy that is robust to adversarial perturbations and unknown covariate shifts with a performance guarantee based on the theory of uniform convergence. Finally, we empirically test the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm in synthetic datasets and demonstrate that it provides the robustness that is missing using standard policy learning algorithms. We conclude the paper by providing a comprehensive application of our methods in the context of a real-world voting data set. This paper was accepted by Hamid Nazerzadeh, data science. Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant CCF-2106508] and the Air Force Office of Scientific Research [Award FA9550-20-1-0397]. Z. Zhou also gratefully acknowledges the JP Morgan AI Research Grant and the New York University’s Center for Global Economy and Business faculty research grant for support on this work. Additional support is gratefully acknowledged from the National Science Foundation [Grants 1915967 and 2118199]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4678 .
summary: 本文研究基于历史观测数据的策略学习问题，传统方法假设未来部署环境与数据生成环境相同，但这一假设常不成立。作者提出一种分布鲁棒的批量上下文赌博机方法，首先设计策略评估程序以评估最坏环境偏移下的策略表现，并给出该评估方案的中心极限定理型保证。在此基础上，提出一种新颖的学习算法，能够学习应对对抗性扰动和未知协变量偏移的鲁棒策略，并基于一致收敛理论提供性能保证。通过在合成数据集和真实投票数据集上的实验，验证了所提算法的有效性，并展示了其相比标准策略学习算法具有更好的鲁棒性。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统性地处理了策略学习中环境不匹配的鲁棒性问题，提供了理论保证与实证验证，对实际应用（如定价、广告推荐）具有重要价值。

title: The Opposing Effects of Complexity and Information Content on Uncertainty Dynamics: Evidence from 10-K Filings
abstract: We evaluate the impact of complexity and information content of 10-K filings on uncertainty dynamics following the filings. We have three main findings. First, the option-implied volatility on average increases in the first four weeks after the filings, followed by a net decrease in the subsequent six weeks. Second, this hump-shaped volatility dynamic is more pronounced for firms with larger 10-K file sizes. Third, we provide a novel decomposition of 10-K file size based on the individual sections’ disclosure amount and topic analysis and find that the discussions on topics in the “risk factors” section mainly capture the complexity aspect, whereas the discussions on topics in the “managerial discussion and analysis” section mainly capture the information content aspect of the 10-K filings. Our findings highlight the importance of timing for understanding the opposing effects of complexity and information content on asset prices. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4615 .
summary: 该研究评估了10-K文件的复杂性和信息内容对文件发布后不确定性动态的影响。主要发现有三点：首先，期权隐含波动率在文件发布后前四周平均上升，随后六周净下降，呈现驼峰形波动；其次，这种波动模式在10-K文件规模较大的公司中更为显著；第三，通过基于各章节披露量和主题分析对10-K文件大小进行新颖分解，发现“风险因素”部分的讨论主要反映了复杂性方面，而“管理层讨论与分析”部分的讨论主要反映了信息内容方面。这些发现强调了时机对于理解复杂性和信息内容对资产价格相反作用的重要性。
ai_comment: 该论文通过分解10-K文件的不同部分，揭示了复杂性和信息内容对不确定性动态的相反作用，为理解财务披露的市场影响提供了新视角。

title: A Theory of Liquidity in Private Equity
abstract: We develop a model of private equity capturing two fundamental features of this market: the fund structure and illiquidity. A fund structure with sequential capital calls arises as an optimal solution to fund managers’ (GPs) moral hazard problem but exposes investors (LPs) to illiquidity risk. Funds with more illiquidity-tolerant LPs realize higher returns, leading to different expected returns across both funds and LPs in equilibrium. GPs may inefficiently accelerate drawdowns to avoid default by LPs on capital commitments. With a secondary market for LP claims, differences in fund returns are attenuated but differences in LP returns remain. The model can rationalize several empirical findings on primary and secondary private equity markets. This paper was accepted by Bruno Biais, finance. Funding: V. Maurin thanks the Swedish House of Finance for financial support. P. Strömberg thanks the NASDAQ Nordic Foundation, Söderberg Professorship in Economics, and Swedish House of Finance for financial support. D. Robinson thanks the Bertil Danielsson Professorship and Erling Persson Professorship for financial support. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4612 .
summary: 本文构建了一个私募股权市场模型，捕捉了该市场的两个基本特征：基金结构和非流动性。具有连续资本承诺的基金结构作为解决基金管理人（GP）道德风险问题的最优方案出现，但使投资者（LP）面临流动性风险。流动性容忍度较高的LP所投资基金的回报更高，导致不同基金和LP在均衡状态下预期回报存在差异。GP可能低效地加速资本提取以避免LP违约。LP份额的二级市场会减弱基金回报的差异，但LP回报的差异依然存在。该模型能够合理解释关于私募股权一级和二级市场的多个实证发现。
ai_comment: 该理论模型同时解释了私募股权市场中基金回报和LP回报的横截面差异，并揭示了二级市场的作用，具有较强的整合解释力。

title: Executives in Politics
abstract: We study the involvement of corporate executives in U.S. politics over the last 40 years. First, we document that the share of business politicians in federal elected office increased from 13.3% in 1980% to 22.6% in 2018, with most of the increase occurring over the last two decades. Second, we find that business politicians enjoy an early fundraising advantage over their opponents, both because they are more likely to self-fund their campaigns and because they receive more campaign contributions from their firms. Third, the election of business politicians benefits their industries and firms, which experience positive abnormal stock returns when their executives win political office. We also show that business politicians, once elected, vote for policies that shift the balance of power toward corporate interests. Using close elections for identification, we show that this policy shift cannot be attributed solely to the changes in the underlying preferences of the electorate. Overall, our results indicate that corporate executives have become more involved in U.S. politics and that this involvement has benefited business interests and affected aggregate legislative outcomes. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Funding: The authors thank the Digital Age Management Research Area at the China Europe International Business School (CEIBS) and Centre for Applied Research on International Markets, Banking, Finance and Regulation (BAFFI CAREFIN) at Bocconi University for financial support. The Area and the Center played no role in study design, data collection and analysis, or preparation of the manuscript. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4595 .
summary: 本文研究了过去40年美国企业高管参与政治的情况。首先，发现联邦民选职位中商业政治家的比例从1980年的13.3%上升至2018年的22.6%，增长主要发生在最近20年。其次，商业政治家在竞选中具有早期筹资优势，既因为他们更可能自掏腰包资助竞选，也因为他们从所在公司获得更多竞选捐款。第三，商业政治家的当选对其所在行业和公司有利，当高管赢得政治职位时，其公司股票出现正异常回报。此外，一旦当选，商业政治家会投票支持有利于企业利益的政策。通过利用票数接近的选举进行识别，证明这种政策转向不能完全归因于选民偏好的变化。总体结果表明，企业高管越来越多地参与美国政治，这种参与有利于商业利益并影响整体立法结果。
ai_comment: 本文通过长期数据揭示了企业高管政治参与的增加及其对企业和市场的显著影响，并利用接近选举识别出因果效应，提供了政治与金融交叉领域的重要证据。

title: Active trading and (poor) performance: The social transmission channel
abstract: We study the influence from social interactions on equity trading. Using unique data on stock transactions, we exploit the quasi-random assignment of students to classrooms in a financial training program to identify how peer experience affects investor behavior. We find that individuals react more to peer gains than to peer losses. Students enrolled in courses where peers have positive outcomes: (i) are more likely to start trading, (ii) purchase similar stocks as their classmates, and (iii) are disproportionally attracted to stocks with extreme returns. These stocks have low subsequent returns, and new investors reacting to peer gains underperform other investors.
summary: 本文研究社会互动对股票交易的影响。利用金融培训项目中学生被准随机分配到班级的数据，识别同伴经验如何影响投资者行为。研究发现，个体对同伴收益的反应强于对同伴损失的反应。当同伴获得正收益时，学生更可能开始交易、购买与同学相似的股票，并且被具有极端回报的股票吸引。这些股票后续回报较低，且受同伴收益影响的新投资者表现劣于其他投资者。
ai_comment: 本文通过准自然实验识别社会互动对交易行为的因果影响，揭示了同伴收益驱动的非理性投资行为及其绩效后果，为行为金融中的社会传染渠道提供了有力证据。

title: The short- and long-run effects of remote work on U.S. housing markets
abstract: Remote work has increased the demand for housing and changed the demand for the location of that housing. Because housing supply is heterogeneous across space and more elastic in the long-run, the effects on rents and populations may differ over time. We use the lens of a spatial housing model with heterogeneous housing supply elasticities to identify the housing and location demand changes from 2020–2022, and show that the same shocks will have different effects in the long run. Even though rents and prices increased significantly in the short-run, we estimate that in the long-run, increased housing demand will increase rents by only 1.8 percentage points, and that changing location demand will decrease rents by 0.3 percentage points, with a more negative impact on cities in which CPI is measured and cities that were initially expensive.
summary: 本文研究了远程工作对美国住房市场的短期和长期影响。远程工作增加了住房总需求并改变了住房位置偏好。由于住房供给弹性在空间上存在异质性且长期供给弹性更大，租金和人口的影响在时间维度上有所不同。作者利用一个带有异质性住房供给弹性的空间住房模型，识别了2020-2022年间住房需求和位置需求的变化，并展示了相同的冲击在长期会产生不同的效应。尽管短期租金和价格显著上涨，但估计表明，长期而言，住房需求增加仅使租金上升1.8个百分点，而位置需求变化使租金下降0.3个百分点，且对CPI所覆盖的城市和初始高房价城市的负面影响更大。
ai_comment: 该论文通过区分长短期供给弹性，揭示了远程工作冲击对住房市场的动态影响，为理解疫情后住房市场变化提供了重要见解。

title: Machine-learning the skill of mutual fund managers
abstract: We show, using machine learning, that fund characteristics can consistently differentiate high from low-performing mutual funds, before and after fees. The outperformance persists for more than three years. Fund momentum and fund flow are the most important predictors of future risk-adjusted fund performance, while characteristics of the stocks that funds hold are not predictive. Returns of predictive long-short portfolios are higher following a period of high sentiment. Our estimation with neural networks enables us to uncover novel and substantial interaction effects between sentiment and both fund flow and fund momentum.
summary: 本文利用机器学习方法，证明基金特征能够一致地区分高表现与低表现共同基金（无论是否扣除费用），且这种优异表现可持续超过三年。其中，基金动量（fund momentum）和基金流量（fund flow）是预测未来风险调整后基金表现的最重要变量，而基金持有的股票特征则无预测能力。基于这些特征构建的多空组合收益率在投资者情绪高涨时期后更高。通过神经网络估计，本文还发现了情绪与基金流量、基金动量之间显著的交互效应。
ai_comment: 创新性地运用神经网络捕捉变量间的非线性交互，揭示了情绪与基金流量/动量的联合预测能力，对理解基金业绩持续性和投资者行为具有重要价值。

title: Cleansing by tight credit: Rational cycles and endogenous lending standards
abstract: Endogenous cycles emerge through the two-way interaction between lending standards and production fundamentals. Lax lending standards in booms lead to low interest rates and high output but the deterioration of future loan quality. Low borrower quality in turn precipitates tight standards: the economy enters a recession with high credit spreads and low output but a gradual improvement in the quality of loans. This eventually triggers a shift back to a boom with lax lending, and the cycle continues. The capitalization of expert investors determines the strength of capital reallocation in recessions. Furthermore, although the constrained efficient economy is often cyclical, it features both a static and a dynamic externality in credit supply, hence differing from the decentralized equilibrium.
summary: 这篇论文构建了一个内生经济周期模型，其中贷款标准与生产基本面通过双向互动产生周期性波动。在繁荣期，宽松的贷款标准导致低利率和高产出，但未来贷款质量恶化；低质量的借款人随后引发贷款标准收紧，经济进入衰退，信用利差上升、产出下降，但贷款质量逐步改善，最终再次转向宽松贷款标准的繁荣期。专家投资者的资本化程度决定了衰退时期资本重新配置的强度。此外，尽管受约束的有效经济通常具有周期性，但信贷供给存在静态和动态外部性，从而与分散均衡产生差异。
ai_comment: 本文通过内生贷款标准解释了经济周期的自我实现机制，并揭示了信贷市场中的双重外部性，为理解信用周期的驱动因素提供了新视角。

title: Temperature shocks and industry earnings news
abstract: Climate scientists project rising average temperatures and increasing frequency of temperature extremes. We study how extreme temperatures affect corporate profitability across different industries and whether sell-side analysts understand these relationships. We combine granular daily data on temperatures across the continental U.S. with locations of public companies’ establishments and build a panel of quarterly firm-level temperature exposures. Extreme temperatures significantly impact earnings in over 40% of industries, with bi-directional effects that harm some industries while others benefit. Analysts and investors do not immediately react to observable intra-quarter temperature shocks, though earnings forecasts account for temperature effects by quarter-end in many industries.
summary: 该论文研究了极端温度冲击如何影响不同行业的企业盈利能力，并探讨卖方分析师是否能理解这些关系。作者将美国大陆的每日温度数据与上市公司所在地相结合，构建了季度层面的企业温度暴露面板数据。研究发现，极端温度显著影响超过40%的行业的盈利，且影响具有双向性：一些行业受损，另一些则受益。分析师和投资者不会立即对季度内可观测的温度冲击做出反应，但在许多行业中，盈利预测在季度末已纳入温度效应。
ai_comment: 该研究利用精细的地理和气象数据，揭示了极端温度对企业盈利的异质性影响，并检验了市场参与者的信息处理效率，为气候经济学与公司金融交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: Cheapest-to-deliver pricing, optimal MBS securitization, and welfare implications
abstract: We study optimal securitization in the agency mortgage-backed securities (MBS) market. Many MBS are traded in the liquid to-be-announced (TBA) market, which however induces adverse selection due to cheapest-to-deliver pricing. We find that lenders pool high-value loans separately and trade them in a less liquid market. We estimate a model of MBS pooling and trading to study welfare implications of pooling policies. TBA market structure produces a trade-off between efficiency and equity; broader pooling increases liquidity and average welfare, but results in a larger cross-subsidy from smaller loans to larger loans. Minimizing costs or limiting strategic pooling results in a more regressive redistribution.
summary: 本文研究机构抵押贷款支持证券（MBS）市场中的最优证券化问题。许多MBS在流动性强的待公布（TBA）市场交易，但由于最便宜交割（cheapest-to-deliver）定价，导致逆向选择。我们发现，贷款机构将高价值贷款单独打包并在流动性较低的市场交易。我们估计了一个MBS打包和交易模型，以研究打包政策的福利含义。TBA市场结构产生了效率与公平之间的权衡：更广泛的打包提高了流动性和平均福利，但导致从小贷款到大贷款的更大交叉补贴。最小化成本或限制战略性打包会导致更累进的再分配。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了MBS市场中TBA市场结构带来的效率与公平权衡，对理解证券化政策设计有重要启示。

title: By What Criteria Do We Evaluate Accounting? Some Thoughts on Economic Welfare and the Archival Literature
abstract: The economic role of an accounting regime is to increase welfare through its effects—in conjunction with complementary institutions—on firm and household behavior. I review three major streams of the archival literature (real effects; price effects, including value relevance; and costly contracting), in terms of what they can and cannot reveal as proxies for welfare effects. One conclusion is that the partial correlations and average effects that predominate in this literature have provided valuable insights into the role of accounting in the economy, but provide limited and misleading proxies for welfare effects. A major concern is that teachers, students, and researchers—indeed, regulators and standard setters—raised on this literature could lose sight of, and underestimate, the fundamental contribution of accounting to aggregate welfare.
summary: 该论文探讨了会计制度的经济作用，即通过影响企业和家庭行为并与互补制度协同，提高社会福利。作者回顾了档案文献中的三大主流研究流派——实际效应、价格效应（包括价值相关性）和成本契约——并评估它们作为福利效应代理指标的潜力与局限。结论指出，这些文献中占主导的部分相关性和平均效应虽然为理解会计在经济中的作用提供了宝贵见解，但作为福利效应的代理指标既有限又容易产生误导。主要担忧是，受此类文献熏陶的教师、学生、研究人员以及监管者和准则制定者，可能会忽视甚至低估会计对总福利的基础性贡献。
ai_comment: 论文深刻反思了档案文献在衡量会计福利效应方面的不足，提醒学界和实务界不应忽视会计对整体经济的根本性贡献，具有重要的方法论启示。

title: Big Banks, Household Credit Access, and Intergenerational Economic Mobility
abstract: Consolidation in the U.S. banking industry has led to larger banks. I find that low-income households face reduced access to credit when local banks are large. This result appears to stem from large banks’ comparative disadvantage using soft information, which is particularly important for lending to low-income households. In contrast, the size of local banks has little or no effect on high-income households. Consistent with low-income parents’ credit constraints limiting investment in their children’s human capital, areas with larger banks exhibit a greater sensitivity of educational attainment to parental income, and less intergenerational economic mobility.
summary: 本文研究美国银行业整合导致银行规模扩大对家庭信贷可得性和代际经济流动性的影响。发现低收入家庭在本地银行规模较大时面临信贷可得性降低，这归因于大型银行在利用软信息方面的比较劣势，而软信息对低收入家庭的贷款尤为重要。相反，高收入家庭几乎不受影响。进一步分析表明，大型银行所在地区教育程度对父母收入的敏感性更高，代际经济流动性更低，这与低收入父母的信贷约束限制其对子女人力资本投资的解释一致。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙地将银行组织结构与代际经济流动性联系起来，揭示了金融摩擦放大不平等的新渠道，对理解银行规模的社会经济后果有重要贡献。

title: Price Rigidities and the Value of Public Information
abstract: Firms' inflexibility in adjusting output prices to economic shocks exacerbates information asymmetry with respect to firms' profits, but public information on firms' cost structure mitigates this problem. We construct a novel form of public information from economic statistics disclosed by the government and find that such public information significantly reduces inflexible‐price firms' bid–ask spreads, the probability of informed trading, and analyst forecast dispersions, but these results do not hold for flexible‐price firms. Security analysts seek more cost‐related information during conference calls about inflexible‐price firms, but such a phenomenon is observed less frequently if a firm's input cost is more publicly observable. In addition, stock markets react more strongly to earning news announced by inflexible‐price firms, consistent with our intuition.
summary: 论文研究价格刚性（即企业无法灵活调整产出价格以应对经济冲击）如何加剧利润信息不对称，以及公开信息能否缓解这一问题。作者利用政府披露的经济统计数据构建了一种新型公开信息，发现这种信息显著降低了价格刚性企业的买卖价差、知情交易概率和分析师预测分歧，但对价格弹性企业无此效果。分析师在电话会议中更倾向于询问价格刚性企业的成本相关信息，但若企业投入成本公开可观察，则这一现象减弱。此外，股票市场对价格刚性企业盈利公告的反应更为强烈。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用政府经济统计作为公开信息的代理变量，揭示了价格刚性在信息环境中的独特作用，为理解企业定价行为与市场微观结构提供了新视角。

title: Operating Hedge and Gross Profitability Premium
abstract: We show theoretically that variable production costs reduce systematic risk of firms' cash flows if capital and variable inputs are complementary in firms' production and input prices are procyclical. In our dynamic model, this operating hedge effect is weaker for more profitable firms, giving rise to a gross profitability premium. Moreover, gross profitability and value factors are distinct and negatively correlated, and their premia are not captured by the capital asset pricing model (CAPM). We estimate the model by simulated method of moments, and find that its main implications for stock returns and cash flow dynamics are quantitatively consistent with the data.
summary: 本文从理论上证明，如果资本与可变投入在生产中互补且投入价格顺周期，则可变生产成本会降低企业现金流的系统性风险。在动态模型中，这种运营对冲效应对于盈利能力更强的企业更弱，从而产生总盈利能力溢价。此外，总盈利能力因子与价值因子不同且负相关，其溢价无法被资本资产定价模型（CAPM）捕获。通过模拟矩估计（SMM）估计模型，发现模型对股票收益和现金流动态的主要含义与数据定量一致。
ai_comment: 本文从运营对冲角度为盈利能力溢价提供了新的理论解释，并通过结构性估计验证了模型与数据的一致性，深化了对跨截面收益成因的理解。

title: Common Lender, Ex-Banker Director, and Corporate Investment
abstract: Due to the government-driven mergers of large banks, many competing firms in Japan ended up borrowing from a common lender. Using firm-level data, we find that the capital investments of competing firms that share a common lender decrease by 15% of the mean. When a common lender can exercise its voice through its former employees serving as firms’ executive directors, investments fall significantly further. Competing firms that share a common lender increase markups and profitability ratios, suggesting that the lender induces strategic coordination among its borrowers to reduce their competitive pressures. Firms use saved resources from weaker competition for cash cushions.
summary: 本研究利用日本企业数据，考察政府推动的大型银行合并导致许多竞争企业拥有共同贷款人的经济后果。研究发现，共享共同贷款人的竞争企业资本投资平均减少15%。当共同贷款人通过其前员工担任企业的执行董事来行使话语权时，投资进一步显著下降。这些企业提高了加成率和盈利能力，表明贷款人诱导借款人之间进行战略协调以降低竞争压力。企业将竞争减弱所节省的资源用于增加现金储备。
ai_comment: 本文利用日本银行合并的自然实验，揭示了共同贷款人对企业投资和竞争行为的因果影响，并强调了前银行家董事作为传导机制的重要性，为银行治理与产业组织交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: Stress Testing Banks’ Digital Capabilities: Evidence from the COVID-19 Pandemic
abstract: Banks’ information technology (IT) capabilities affect their ability to serve customers during the COVID-19 pandemic, which generates an unexpected and unprecedented shock that shifts banking services from in-person to digital. Amid mobility restrictions, banks with better IT experience larger reductions in physical branch visits and larger increases in website traffic, implying a larger shift to digital banking. Stronger IT banks are able to originate more Paycheck Protection Program loans to small business borrowers, especially in areas with more severe COVID-19 outbreaks, higher internet use, and higher bank competition. Those banks also attract more deposit flows and receive better mobile customer reviews during the pandemic.
summary: 本研究利用COVID-19大流行作为外生冲击，探讨银行信息技术（IT）能力如何影响其服务客户的能力。疫情期间移动限制迫使银行服务从线下转向线上。研究发现，IT能力更强的银行物理分支访问量减少更多，网站流量增加更多，表明数字银行转型更大。这些银行能够向小企业借款人发放更多薪资保护计划（PPP）贷款，尤其是在疫情更严重、互联网使用率更高和银行竞争更激烈的地区。此外，IT能力更强的银行在疫情期间吸引了更多存款流入，并获得了更好的移动客户评价。
ai_comment: 利用疫情作为自然实验，实证检验了银行IT能力对数字化转型和贷款发放的关键作用，揭示了技术能力在危机中的重要性。

title: Neglected Risks in the Communication of Residential Mortgage‐Backed Securities Offerings
abstract: Examining the contractual disclosures during the sale of private‐label residential mortgage‐backed securities before the 2008 financial crisis, we find that textual contents in the risk‐factor section predict subsequent losses and yet were not reflected in pricing. Insurance companies, especially life insurers and insurers with low regulatory capital ratios, are more exposed to textual risks. Consistent with issuers hedging litigation risks with disclosure, we find that textual contents are associated with second‐lien underreporting and preissuance written communications. Overall, we find that investors neglected risks in the purportedly safe assets before the crisis.
summary: 本文研究了2008年金融危机前私人标签住房抵押贷款支持证券（RMBS）销售过程中的合同披露。通过分析风险因素部分的文本内容，发现这些文本能够预测后续的损失，但并未在证券定价中得到反映。保险公司，尤其是寿险公司和监管资本比率较低的保险公司，对文本风险更为暴露。进一步分析表明，文本内容与二次留置权低报和发行前书面沟通相关，这与发行人利用披露对冲诉讼风险的动机一致。总体而言，投资者在危机前忽视了这些被视为安全资产中的风险。
keywords: 住宅抵押贷款支持证券
ai_comment: 该论文通过文本分析揭示了RMBS发行中披露信息的预测能力以及市场定价的失效，为金融危机前的资产误定价提供了新的证据。

title: Household Liquidity Constraints and Labor Market Outcomes: Evidence from a Danish Mortgage Reform
abstract: We study the causal effect of liquidity constraints on individual labor market outcomes by exploiting the 1992 mortgage reform in Denmark, which for the first time allowed homeowners to borrow against housing equity for nonhousing purposes. Following the reform, liquidity‐constrained homeowners increased debt levels and had higher earnings growth and lower employment rates. The option to borrow against housing equity enabled liquidity‐constrained individuals to move to high‐wage jobs and invest in valuable human and physical capital. The results imply that relaxing household liquidity constraints during recessions can create better job matches, potentially increasing earnings and output in the longer run.
summary: 本文利用丹麦1992年抵押贷款改革这一自然实验，研究流动性约束对个人劳动力市场结果的因果效应。该改革首次允许房主将房屋净值用于非住房目的借款。改革后，流动性受限的房主增加了债务水平，并表现出更高的收入增长和更低的就业率。借款能力使流动性受限的个体能够转向高工资工作，并在人力资本和物质资本上进行有价值的投资。结果表明，在经济衰退期间放松家庭流动性约束可以创造更好的工作匹配，从而在长期内可能提高收入和产出。
ai_comment: 本文利用丹麦独特的抵押贷款改革作为自然实验，为流动性约束影响劳动力市场的因果机制提供了清晰证据，对理解宏观政策与微观行为的关系具有重要价值。

title: Interest Rate Skewness and Biased Beliefs
abstract: Conditional skewness of Treasury yields is an important indicator of the risks to the macroeconomic outlook. Positive skewness signals upside risk to interest rates during periods of accommodative monetary policy and an upward‐sloping yield curve, and vice versa. Skewness has substantial predictive power for future bond excess returns, high‐frequency interest rate changes around Federal Open Market Committee announcements, and survey forecast errors for interest rates. The estimated expectational errors, or biases in beliefs, are quantitatively important for statistical bond risk premia. These findings are consistent with a heterogeneous‐beliefs model in which one of the agents is wrong about consumption growth.
summary: 本文研究美国国债收益率的条件偏度对宏观经济前景风险的指示作用。研究发现，在宽松货币政策和收益率曲线陡峭化时期，正偏度预示利率上行风险，反之亦然。偏度对未来债券超额收益、联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后的高频利率变动以及利率调查预测误差具有显著预测能力。估计的预期误差（或信念偏差）对统计债券风险溢价具有定量重要性。这些发现与一个异质信念模型一致，在该模型中，其中一个主体对消费增长的看法是错误的。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将国债收益率偏度与宏观风险及调查预测偏差联系起来，提供了基于偏度的新预测因子，并支持了异质信念模型。

title: Macroprudential Policy, Mortgage Cycles, and Distributional Effects: Evidence from the United Kingdom
abstract: We analyze the distributional effects of macroprudential policy on mortgage cycles by exploiting the U.K. mortgage register and a 2014 15% limit imposed on lenders’ high loan-to-income (LTI) mortgages. Constrained lenders issue fewer and more expensive high-LTI mortgages, with stronger effects on low-income borrowers. Unconstrained lenders strongly substitute high-LTI loans in local areas with higher constrained lender presence, but not high-LTI loans to low-income borrowers—consistent with adverse selection problems—implying lower overall credit to low-income borrowers. Consistently, policy-affected areas experience lower house price growth postregulation and, following the Brexit referendum (negative aggregate shock), better house price growth and lower mortgage defaults for low-income borrowers.
summary: 本文利用英国抵押贷款登记数据，分析2014年对贷款机构高贷款收入比（LTI）抵押贷款实施15%限额的宏观审慎政策的分配效应。研究发现，受约束的贷款机构减少了高LTI贷款的发放并提高了利率，对低收入借款人的影响更为显著。不受约束的贷款机构在受约束贷款机构市场份额较高的地区大幅增加了高LTI贷款的发放，但并未增加对低收入借款人的此类贷款，这与逆向选择问题一致，导致低收入借款人的总体信贷减少。政策影响地区的房价增长在监管后放缓，但在英国脱欧公投（负面总体冲击）后，低收入借款人的房价增长表现更好且抵押贷款违约率更低，表明政策在不利冲击下对低收入群体具有保护作用。
ai_comment: 该研究利用高精度微观数据揭示了宏观审慎政策的非对称分配效应，尤其突出了不受约束贷款机构的替代行为中的逆向选择问题，并发现政策有助于缓解负面冲击对低收入借款人的影响。

title: Flight to Safety: How Economic Downturns Affect Talent Flows to Startups
abstract: Using proprietary data from AngelList Talent, we study how startup job seekers’ search and application behavior changed during the COVID-19 downturn. We find that workers shifted their searches and applications away from less-established startups and toward more-established ones, even within the same individual over time. At the firm level, this shift was not offset by an influx of new job seekers. Less-established startups experienced a relative decline in the quantity and quality of applications, ultimately affecting their hiring. Our findings uncover a flight-to-safety channel in the labor market that may amplify the procyclical nature of entrepreneurial activities.
summary: 本文利用AngelList Talent的专有数据，研究了COVID-19经济衰退期间初创企业求职者的搜索和申请行为变化。研究发现，求职者将搜索和申请从不成熟的初创企业转向更成熟的企业，这种转变甚至在同一个体随时间推移中也存在。在公司层面，这种转变并未被新求职者涌入所抵消。不成熟的初创企业经历了申请数量和质量相对下降，最终影响了其招聘。研究结果揭示了劳动力市场中一个“flight-to-safety”渠道，可能放大创业活动的顺周期性。
ai_comment: 该研究通过独特的微观数据揭示了经济衰退期间人才向更成熟初创企业流动的“安全迁移”现象，为理解创业活动的周期性提供了新视角。

title: The Market Inside the Market: Odd-Lot Quotes
abstract: We show current market practices relating to odd-lot quotes create a large “inside” market where better prices routinely exist relative to the National Best Bid or Offer.
