We show that odd-lot quotes play a price discovery role, and these quotes provide valuable information to traders with access to proprietary data feeds. Using a XGBoost machine learning algorithm that uses odd-lot data to predict future prices, we demonstrate a simple and profitable trading strategy. We argue the SEC’s proposed round-lot redefinition reduces—but does not eliminate—the high incidence of superior odd-lot quotes within the NBBO.
summary: 这篇论文研究了美国股市中零碎报价（odd-lot quotes）的市场实践。作者发现，零碎报价形成了一个“内部”市场，其中经常存在比全国最优买卖报价（NBBO）更好的价格。通过分析，论文展示了零碎报价在价格发现中的作用，并指出这些报价为能够获取专有数据流的交易者提供了有价值的信息。利用XGBoost机器学习算法对零碎报价数据进行建模以预测未来价格，论文构建了一个简单且盈利的交易策略。此外，论文指出美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提出的整手重新定义（round-lot redefinition）虽然能减少但无法完全消除NBBO内出现优势零碎报价的高发生率。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地揭示了零碎报价在形成更好价格方面的作用，并利用机器学习验证了其预测价值，对市场微观结构和监管政策有重要启示。

title: Choosing Investment Managers
abstract: Investment managers connected to plans sponsors are more likely to be hired than not-connected managers. The magnitude of the selection effect is comparable to that of prior performance. Ex post, connections do not result in higher post-hiring returns. Relationships are thus conducive to asset gathering by investment managers but do not generate commensurate pecuniary benefits for plan sponsors.
summary: 该论文研究投资经理与计划发起人之间的关联关系对雇佣决策及后续表现的影响。通过分析发现，与计划发起人有关联的投资经理更可能被雇佣，其选择效应的大小与历史业绩相当。然而，在雇佣之后，关联关系并未带来更高的投资回报。因此，尽管关系有助于投资经理吸引资产，但并未为计划发起人带来相应的货币收益。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了投资管理行业中人脉关系的作用，但指出关系并不能带来超额收益，对投资者有警示意义。

title: Long-Run Labor Costs of Housing Booms and Busts
abstract: We show large flows of workers into the real estate agent (REA) occupation during the early 2000s from virtually all parts of the skill, wage, and education spectrums. We find those entering REA in Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs) with house price bubbles end up in occupations paying significantly less in the long-run as compared to similar REA entrants in non-bubble areas. Even in 2017, when house prices and employment return to their pre-crisis levels, REA entrants in Bubble MSAs are in occupations earning about 6% less. These results point to lasting effects of labor allocation decisions in response to distorted price signals.
summary: 本文研究了2000年代初房地产繁荣与萧条期间的长期劳动力成本。研究发现，在2000年代初，来自不同技能、工资和教育背景的工人大量涌入房地产经纪人职业。与处于非泡沫地区的类似房地产经纪人进入者相比，在存在房价泡沫的大都市统计区（MSAs）中进入该职业的工人，长期从事的职业收入显著更低。即使在2017年房价和就业恢复到危机前水平时，泡沫MSA中的房地产经纪人进入者仍在从事收入约低6%的职业。这些结果表明，劳动力配置决策受到扭曲价格信号的持久影响。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证证据揭示了房地产周期对劳动力市场的长期负面影响，强调了扭曲价格信号对职业选择的持久后果，为理解泡沫经济的社会成本提供了新视角。

title: How Does Carbon Footprint Information Affect Consumer Choice? A Field Experiment
abstract: This paper reports the results of a field experiment investigating how attributes of carbon footprint information affect consumer choice in a large dining facility. Our hypotheses and research methods were preregistered via the Journal of Accounting Research ’s registration‐based editorial process. Manipulating the measurement units and visualizations of carbon footprint information on food labels, we quantify effects on consumers’ food choices. Treated consumers choose less carbon‐intensive dishes, reducing their food‐related carbon footprint by up to 9.2%, depending on the treatment. Effects are strongest for carbon footprint information expressed in monetary units (“environmental costs”) and color‐coded in the familiar traffic‐light scheme. A postexperimental survey shows that these effects obtain although few respondents self‐report concern for the environmental footprint of their meal choices. Our study contributes to the accounting literature by using an information‐processing framework to shed light on the information usage and decision‐making processes of an increasingly important user group of accounting information: consumers.
summary: 本文通过现场实验，研究碳足迹信息属性如何影响消费者在大型餐饮设施中的食品选择。实验利用预注册的假设和方法，操纵食品标签上碳足迹信息的计量单位和可视化方式，量化其对消费者选择的影响。结果显示，受处理的消费者倾向于选择碳强度较低的菜肴，使其食品相关碳足迹最多减少9.2%，具体取决于处理方式。效果最强的处理是以货币单位（“环境成本”）表示，并采用熟悉的交通灯方案进行颜色编码的信息。后期实验调查表明，尽管很少受访者自我报告关心其餐食选择的环境足迹，这些效果仍然存在。本研究通过信息处理框架，揭示了日益重要的会计信息用户群体——消费者的信息使用和决策过程，为会计文献做出了贡献。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严格的现场实验设计，提供了消费者对碳足迹信息反应的有力证据，强调了信息呈现方式（货币单位和交通灯配色）的关键作用。

title: Out of Site, Out of Mind? The Role of the Government‐Appointed Corporate Monitor
abstract: We study the role of a relatively new type of external firm monitor, an on‐site government‐appointed Corporate Monitor, and assess whether such appointments reduce firms' propensity to violate laws. Using a sample of deferred and nonprosecution agreements, we first document the determinants of Monitor appointment. We find firms that voluntarily disclose wrongdoing and have more independent directors are less likely to have Corporate Monitors, whereas those with more severe infractions, mandated board changes, and increased cooperation requirements are more likely to have Monitors. We find such appointments are associated with an 18%–25% reduction in violations while the Monitor is on site, however, the effect does not persist after the Monitorship ends. Using a semisupervised machine learning method to measure changes in firms' ethics and compliance norms, we find that the reduction in violations is associated with changes in ethics and compliance that also do not persist. Finally, we document that firms under Monitorship experience a persistent reduction in innovation, highlighting a previously unexplored cost of these interventions. Overall, our results suggest that, although Corporate Monitors on site are associated with fewer violations, firms revert to previous levels of violations following Monitors' departure.
summary: 本文研究政府任命的企业监察员（Corporate Monitor）的作用，评估其是否降低企业的违规倾向。基于延期起诉和不起诉协议样本，首先发现监察员任命的决定因素：自愿披露违规和拥有更多独立董事的公司较少被任命监察员，而违规更严重、被强制更换董事会及需要更高合作程度的公司更可能被任命。在监察员驻场期间，违规行为减少18%–25%，但这种效应在监察结束后不再持续。通过半监督机器学习方法测量企业道德与合规规范的变化，发现违规减少与道德合规的短期改善相关，但同样不持续。此外，监察期间企业的创新活动持续减少，揭示了此前未被充分关注的干预成本。总体而言，虽然企业监察员驻场与违规减少相关，但监察员离开后企业违规水平会恢复至原有水平。
ai_comment: 本文通过半监督机器学习量化道德合规变化，并揭示了监察员对创新的长期负面影响，丰富了对政府监控机制成本与效果的理解。

title: The Effect of Political Frictions on the Pricing and Supply of Insurance
abstract: Political frictions significantly affect both pricing and supply in the long-term care insurance (LTCI) market. Comparing the same insurer’s requests submitted for the same policy at the same time to different state regulators, we find that they are 13% more likely to be approved and receive 4% more of the requested amount after an election year. Over time, regulatory pushback on premium increase requests leads to persistently lower cash reserves and increases the probability of company dropout. An insurer who receives one-standard-deviation less of their requested increase is 20% more likely to leave the market next year.
summary: 本文研究政治摩擦对长期护理保险（LTCI）市场定价和供给的影响。通过比较同一保险公司向不同州监管机构同时提交的相同保单申请，发现选举年后申请获批概率提高13%，获批金额增加4%。随时间推移，对保费增长申请的监管阻力导致保险公司现金储备持续下降，并增加公司退出市场的概率。具体而言，获得批准涨幅比均值少一个标准差的保险公司，次年退出市场的可能性增加20%。
ai_comment: 该文巧妙利用州级监管差异和选举周期，揭示了政治因素对保险市场的重要影响，为理解监管摩擦的经济后果提供了实证证据。

title: Adverse Selection and Climate Risk: A Response to
abstract: We identify two issues in the work of Ouazad and Kahn (2022). Correcting either reverses the original result. The two changes are to use the correct FHFA conforming loan limits for each county and year and to compare the individual loan amount to that limit correctly. There is no evidence that lenders transfer climate risk by altering loan origination and securitization behavior. None of our results calls into question the value and importance of the O&K model as a test for adverse selection. The question addressed and the setup of the test are important and should be replicated over time.
summary: 本文指出了Ouazad和Kahn（2022）研究中的两个问题：未正确使用每个县和年份的FHFA合规贷款限额，以及未正确比较个人贷款金额与该限额。纠正任何一个问题都会颠覆原结果。研究表明，没有证据表明贷款人通过改变贷款发放和证券化行为来转移气候风险。同时，本文并不质疑O&K模型作为逆向选择测试的价值和重要性，并认为该问题及其测试设置值得在未来重复验证。
ai_comment: 本文通过纠正数据错误，颠覆了既有结论，凸显了实证研究中数据准确性对结果可靠性的关键影响。

title: Subsidizing Failing Firms: Evidence from Chinese Restaurants
abstract: Using data on nearly 20,000 restaurants in China during the COVID-19 outbreak, we find evidence that the government-sponsored rent reduction program reduced debt overhang problems. Rent reductions, which averaged 36,000 RMB per restaurant, increase the open rate of restaurants by 3.7%, revenue by 11,000 RMB, and the number of employees by 0.36. Larger restaurants with higher committed costs benefit more from the rent reduction. The stimulus has a positive spillover effect that boosts the revenue of restaurants in the immediate vicinity of subsidized restaurants. The treatment effect varies with organizational structure in a manner consistent with an information frictions hypothesis.
summary: 本文利用中国新冠肺炎疫情期间近2万家餐馆的数据，研究了政府补贴的租金减免项目对餐馆债务积压问题的影响。研究发现，平均每家餐馆获得3.6万元人民币的租金减免后，餐馆的开业率提高了3.7%，收入增加了1.1万元人民币，员工人数增加了0.36人。租金减免对承诺成本更高的大型餐馆效果更显著，并对周边餐馆的收入产生正向溢出效应。此外，处理效应随组织结构变化，与信息摩擦假说一致。
ai_comment: 本文利用自然实验和微观数据，为政府补贴如何缓解企业债务问题提供了因果证据，并揭示了溢出效应和信息摩擦的作用，具有重要的政策启示。

title: The Deterrent Effect of Whistleblowing on Insider Trading
abstract: I study whether the Dodd–Frank whistleblower program reduced informed trading by corporate insiders. To identify the effect, I partition firms based on the extent to which this program affected the likelihood of whistleblowing at each firm. I find a relative reduction in trading profits on purchases made by insiders at more affected firms after the program was initiated. I analyze insider sales in settings where they are more likely to be informed and find a reduction in the number of sales before negatively perceived events. The results suggest that whistleblower protections and rewards can effectively deter insider trading.
summary: 本文研究Dodd-Frank举报人计划是否减少了企业内幕人士的知情交易。为识别因果效应，作者根据该计划对每家公司的举报可能性影响程度对公司进行分组。研究发现，在计划启动后，受影响较大公司的内幕人士在买入交易中的交易利润相对下降。此外，对更可能涉及知情交易的内幕卖出进行分析，发现负面事件发生前的卖出次数减少。结果表明，举报人保护与奖励机制能够有效威慑内幕交易。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验设计，为举报人制度对内幕交易的威慑效应提供了因果证据，补充了法律经济学与市场微观结构交叉领域的研究。

title: CEO Political Ideology and Voluntary Forward-Looking Disclosure
abstract: This study investigates whether the management earnings forecasts of Republican and Democratic CEOs differ due to systematic differences in their information disclosure preferences. We find that Republican CEOs prefer a less asymmetric information environment than Democrat CEOs, and thus make more frequent, timelier, and more accurate disclosures than Democrat CEOs. Results using the propensity score matched sample and difference-in-differences analysis show that our results are unlikely to be driven by potential endogeneity. Our results are robust to controlling for various CEO characteristics and are stronger for firms with higher levels of institutional ownership and litigation risk.
summary: 本研究探讨了共和党与民主党CEO在管理层盈利预测方面的差异，源于其信息偏好系统的不同。研究发现共和党CEO比民主党CEO更偏好较低的信息不对称环境，因此他们比民主党CEO更频繁、更及时、更准确地披露信息。使用倾向得分匹配样本和双重差分分析的结果表明，研究结果不太可能由潜在内生性驱动。在控制各种CEO特征后结果依然稳健，并且在机构持股和诉讼风险较高的公司中结果更强。
ai_comment: 该研究首次系统地将CEO政治意识形态与信息披露偏好联系起来，通过多种因果识别方法增强了结论可靠性，为理解管理者特质对信息披露的影响提供了新视角。

title: Revisiting Family Firms
abstract: I propose a novel measure to identify family firms based on the number of family links between high-ranking coworkers. Leveraging this measure, I reexamine previous findings in the literature and derive four novel facts: i) Measures of stock ownership misclassify firms with a large family presence. ii) Family-run firms exhibit value stock characteristics, whereas founder-CEO firms display growth stock characteristics. iii) Family-run firms pay lower costs. iv) Family managers behave myopically. I conclude that failing to consider family links can lead to highly misleading results in the study of family firms.
summary: 这篇论文提出一种基于高管同事之间家庭联系数量的新型度量方法来识别家族企业，并利用该度量重新检验了文献中的既有发现。研究发现四个新事实：第一，基于股权的传统度量会错误分类大量实际存在家族影响的公司；第二，家族经营的公司呈现价值股特征，而创始人CEO的公司则呈现成长股特征；第三，家族经营的公司支付较低的成本；第四，家族管理者表现出短视行为。作者得出结论：如果忽视家族联系，家族企业研究的结果可能高度误导。
ai_comment: 该研究通过构造基于家庭联系的新型度量，挑战了传统家族企业定义的准确性，并揭示了家族经营与创始人CEO企业在股票特征和管理行为上的显著差异，为家族企业研究提供了更精确的分析工具。

title: Common Venture Capital Investors and Startup Growth
abstract: We exploit the staggered introduction of liability waivers when investors hold stakes in conflicting business opportunities as a shock to venture capital (VC) investment and director networks. After the law changes, we find increases in within-industry VC investment and common directors serving on startup boards. Despite the potential for rent extraction, same-industry startups inside VC portfolios benefit by raising more capital, failing less, and exiting more successfully. VC directors serving on other startup boards are the primary mechanism associated with positive outcomes, consistent with common VC investment facilitating informational exchanges in VC portfolios. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用责任豁免的逐步引入作为外部冲击，研究风险投资（VC）投资者在持有冲突商业机会股份时的法律责任变化对创业公司成长的影响。研究发现，法律变化后，行业内VC投资增加，共同董事在创业公司董事会中的席位增多。尽管存在潜在的租金提取，同一行业内的创业公司仍通过筹集更多资本、降低失败率和提高成功退出率而受益。机制分析表明，VC董事在其他创业公司董事会中提供服务，促进了VC投资组合内的信息交流，这是正面结果的主要驱动力。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用法律变动作为自然实验，为VC共同投资对创业公司绩效的因果效应提供了有力证据，并揭示了信息交流机制的重要性。

title: Selling Fast and Buying Slow: Heuristics and Trading Performance of Institutional Investors
abstract: Are market experts prone to heuristics, and do these heuristics transfer across buying and selling domains? We investigate this question using a unique data set of institutional investors with portfolios averaging $573 million. A striking finding emerges: While there is evidence of skill in buying, selling decisions underperform substantially, even relative to random‐selling strategies. This holds despite the similarity between the two decisions in frequency, substance, and consequences for performance. Evidence suggests an asymmetric allocation of cognitive resources such as attention can explain the discrepancy: We document a systematic, costly heuristic process for selling but not for buying.
summary: 本文利用一个独特的机构投资者数据集（平均投资组合规模5.73亿美元）研究市场专家是否容易受到启发式的影响，以及这些启发式是否在买入和卖出决策中一致存在。结果显示，尽管买入决策表现出技巧，但卖出决策的表现显著不佳，甚至低于随机卖出策略。尽管两类决策在频率、实质和对绩效的影响上相似，但证据表明认知资源（如注意力）的不对称分配可以解释这一差异：卖出决策中存在系统性且成本高昂的启发式过程，而买入决策中则没有。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了机构投资者在买卖决策中的显著不对称性，并通过认知资源分配提供了新颖解释，对行为金融和市场微观结构研究具有重要贡献。

title: Audit Partners’ Role in Material Misstatement Resolution: Survey and Interview Evidence
abstract: Auditors are expected to identify and resolve material misstatements (MMs) in management's financial statements. However, beyond the audit opinion, the audit process is opaque. To address this, we independently survey 462 audit partners and interview 24 audit partners, CFOs, and audit committee members on how partners assess and address MM risk, resolve MMs, and the consequences of MMs. Partners identify MMs in approximately 9% (15%) of public (private) engagements and use qualitative factors to waive apparent MMs. Loan covenant and going‐concern issues increase MM risk more than earnings benchmark issues. Partners point to a variety of both auditor and client factors as threats to audit effectiveness. Partners often rely on rapport with management and involve the national office and audit committee in resolving MMs. Partner incentives around restatements are context specific. Our results provide new insights into the auditor's role in financial reporting that are relevant to academics, practitioners, and regulators.
summary: 该论文通过独立调查462名审计合伙人和访谈24名审计合伙人、CFO及审计委员会成员，研究审计合伙人在识别和解决重大错报（MMs）中的角色。研究表明，合伙人在约9%的公众公司审计和15%的私人公司审计中识别出MMs，并使用定性因素放弃明显的MMs。贷款契约和持续经营问题比盈利基准问题更显著地增加MM风险。合伙人指出多种审计师和客户因素威胁审计有效性，在解决MMs时通常依赖与客户经理的融洽关系，并涉及国家办公室和审计委员会。重述相关的合伙人激励是情境特定的。结论为学术界、从业者和监管者提供了关于审计师在财务报告中作用的新见解。
ai_comment: 该论文通过一手调查和访谈数据，深入揭示了审计合伙人处理重大错报的实践和决策过程，弥补了审计过程不透明的缺口，对审计监管和实务有重要启示。

title: Population Aging and Bank Risk-Taking
abstract: What are the implications of an aging population for financial stability? To examine this question, we exploit geographic variation in aging across U.S. counties. We establish that banks with higher exposure to aging counties increase loan-to-income ratios. Laxer lending standards lead to higher nonperforming loans during downturns, suggesting higher credit risk. Inspecting the mechanism shows that aging drives risk-taking through two contemporaneous channels: deposit inflows due to seniors’ propensity to save in deposits; and depressed local investment opportunities due to seniors’ lower credit demand. Banks thus look for riskier clients, especially in counties where they operate no branches.
summary: 论文利用美国各县人口老龄化的地理差异，研究老龄化对银行风险承担的影响。发现银行在老龄化程度更高的县提高贷款收入比，宽松的贷款标准导致经济下行期间不良贷款增加，表明信用风险上升。机制在于两个渠道：老年人倾向于储蓄导致存款流入，以及老年人信贷需求降低导致当地投资机会减少，从而促使银行寻找风险更高的客户，尤其是在没有分支机构的县。
ai_comment: 本文创新地利用地理差异识别人口老龄化对银行风险承担的影响，并揭示了存款流入和投资机会下降的双重机制，为理解人口结构变化与金融稳定的关系提供了新证据。

title: The Central Bank's Dilemma: Look Through Supply Shocks or Control Inflation Expectations?
abstract: When countries are hit by supply shocks, central banks often face the dilemma of either looking through such shocks or reacting to them to ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored. In this paper, we propose a tractable framework to capture this dilemma and explore optimal policy under a range of assumptions on how expectations are formed, including a form of bounded rationality involving level-k thinking (LKT). Despite modelling LKT in a way that nests both adaptive and rational expectations as special cases, we show that the optimal policy under LKT is qualitatively different and involves abrupt pivots in the policy stance. In particular, it is optimal for the central bank to initially look through supply shocks until a threshold is reached, then pivot discontinuously to a more hawkish anti-inflationary stance. We find that such pivots can, if optimally executed, be compatible with soft landings in the sense that most (or even all) of the reduction in inflation occurs through re-anchoring of expectations rather than economic slack. We also discuss risks and why policy errors in terms of tightening too late or too slowly can be especially costly in such an environment.
summary: 本文研究央行面临供应冲击时的政策困境：是选择忽略（look through）供应冲击还是主动应对以锚定通胀预期。作者构建了一个易处理的框架，在多种预期形成假设下（包括一种有限理性形式——水平-k思维（LKT））探索最优政策。尽管LKT模型嵌套了适应性和理性预期作为特例，但最优政策在LKT下性质不同，表现为政策立场的突然转向：央行起初忽略供应冲击直至达到某个阈值，然后不连续地转向更鹰派的抗通胀立场。研究发现，若最优执行，这种转向可与软着陆兼容，即大部分通胀下降通过预期重新锚定而非经济疲软实现。文章还讨论了延迟紧缩或行动过慢的政策错误在此环境下可能代价高昂的风险。
ai_comment: 将有限理性（水平-k思维）引入央行政策困境分析，揭示了最优政策中非连续转向的特征，为理解软着陆机制提供了新视角。

title: Financial Aid and Upward Mobility: Evidence from Colombia’s Ser Pilo Paga
abstract: The paper studies the impact of financial aid on long-term educational attainment and labor market outcomes in Colombia.In 2014, the government launched a large-scale and generous student loan program called "Ser Pilo Paga."It offered full tuition coverage to students admitted to one of 33 government-certified high-quality universities known for superior test scores, graduation rates, and per-student spending.Notably, completing a bachelor's degree converted the loan into a grant.To qualify, students must score in the top 10% of the standardized high school exit exam and have below-median household wealth.Using RD and DD methodologies, we use nationwide administrative microdata linking all high school test takers, postsecondary attendees, and formal workers to estimate impacts up to eight years after high school.Financial aid improves college enrollment, quality, and attainment, particularly in STEM-related fields.The earnings gains are substantial, growing, and driven partly by high-quality universities improving students' skills, as demonstrated by their performance on Colombia's college graduation exam.A welfare analysis using the MVPF yields over $4.8 per dollar of government spending.Lastly, the program narrowed socioeconomic gaps in college attainment, skill development, and earnings among academically similar students without adversely affecting non-recipients, thereby promoting equity and efficiency.
summary: 该论文研究了哥伦比亚2014年启动的大规模学生贷款项目“Ser Pilo Paga”对长期教育成就和劳动市场结果的影响。该项目为进入33所政府认证的高质量大学的学生提供全额学费，并在完成学士学位后将贷款转为赠款；资格要求为高中毕业考试排名前10%且家庭财富低于中位数。利用断点回归（RD）和双重差分（DD）方法，结合全国行政微观数据（涵盖所有高中考生、大学就读者和正式工人），估计了高中后八年内的效应。结果显示：财政援助提高了大学入学率、教育质量和毕业率，尤其在STEM领域；收入收益显著且持续增长，部分由高质量大学提升学生技能驱动（通过大学毕业考试表现衡量）。福利分析（MVPF）表明每美元政府支出产生超过4.8美元的收益。最后，该项目缩小了学业相似学生中的社会经济差距，且未对非受益者产生负面影响，从而促进了公平与效率。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的准实验方法和大规模行政数据，全面评估了哥伦比亚学生贷款项目的长期影响，尤其突出了其高福利乘数和公平性改善，为教育资助政策提供了重要实证依据。

title: Credit Supply Shocks and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Brazil
abstract: We explore how financial constraints distort the entry decisions among otherwise productive entrepreneurs and limit growth of promising young firms.A model of liquidity-constrained entrepreneurs suggests that the easing of credit constraints can induce more entry of firms with greater long-run growth potential than the easing of conventional entry barriers would bring about.We explore this growth mechanism using a large-scale program to expand the supply of credit to small and medium enterprises in Brazil.Local credit supply shocks generate greater firm entry but also greater exit with no effect on short-run employment growth in the formal sector.However, credit expansions increase average capability among entering firms, which enter at larger size, survive longer, and grow faster.These firm dynamics are more pronounced in areas with weaker credit markets ex ante and consistent with local bank branches using cheap targeted credit lines to expand lending more broadly.Our findings provide new evidence on the general equilibrium effects of credit supply expansions.
summary: 本文研究金融约束如何扭曲高生产率企业家的进入决策并限制有潜力年轻企业的增长。通过建立一个流动性约束企业家模型，作者发现放松信贷约束比放松传统进入壁垒更能诱导具有长期增长潜力的企业进入。利用巴西一项大规模信贷扩张计划，研究发现地方信贷供给冲击导致更多企业进入和退出，但对正规部门的短期就业增长没有影响。然而，信贷扩张提高了进入企业的平均能力，这些企业进入时规模更大、存活时间更长且增长更快。这些企业动态在信贷市场较弱的地区更为显著，并与当地银行分行利用低成本定向信贷额度扩大贷款的行为一致。研究提供了信贷供给扩张的通用均衡效应新证据。
ai_comment: 该文通过巴西自然实验揭示了信贷供给对企业进入质量的提升效应，而非仅关注数量，为理解信贷市场如何影响创业和增长提供了新视角。

title: High-Dimensional Factor Models and the Factor Zoo
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to the “factor zoo” conundrum. Instead of applying dimension-reduction methods to a large set of portfolio returns obtained from sorts on characteristics, I construct factors that summarize the information in characteristics across assets and then sort assets into portfolios according to these “characteristic factors”. I estimate the model on a data set of mutual fund characteristics. Since the data set is 3-dimensional (characteristics of funds over time), characteristic factors are based on a tensor factor model (TFM) that is a generalization of 2-dimensional PCA. I find that parsimonious TFM captures over 90% of the variation in the data set. Pricing factors derived from the TFM have high Sharpe ratios and capture the cross-section of fund returns better than standard benchmark models.
summary: 本文针对因子动物园问题提出新方法。传统方法对按特征排序的资产组合进行降维，而本文则先构造汇总跨资产特征信息的特征因子，再根据这些特征因子对资产排序构建组合。模型采用共同基金特征的三维数据集（基金特征随时间变化），特征因子基于张量因子模型（TFM），后者是二维PCA的推广。估计发现，简约的TFM能捕获数据集90%以上的变异；基于TFM导出的定价因子具有高夏普比率，并且在捕获基金收益横截面方面优于标准基准模型。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地利用张量分解处理三维数据结构，有效解决了因子选择中的维度灾难问题，实证结果展示了强劲的解释力。

title: The International Monetary System and International Financial System as an Analogy to the Copernican Heliocentric system: A simple multi-layers network model with simultaneous regime changes
abstract: The evolution of the IMS and IFS in the past several hundred years can be viewed through the lens of the Copernican heliocentric system developed over 500 years ago. We trace out the evolution across regimes of the IMS and IFS in terms of network representations of the Copernican system. We provide a simple, fully testable theoretical model whose assumptions are based on these representations. The IMS and IFS are described by a two-layer graph whose three key features (hub, core, distances) are affected by nonlinear joint regime changes linked to a technological, institutional, geopolitical and regulatory environment variable. We conclude with a discussion of some perspectives of the future of the international monetary and financial systems. Our analysis is based on economic history, theory and some resonant concepts from astrophysics.
summary: 本文借用500多年前哥白尼日心说的类比，将过去数百年国际货币体系（IMS）和国际金融体系（IFS）的演变视为类似哥白尼体系的网络结构变化。作者用两层图来描述IMS和IFS，并识别出三个关键特征：中心节点、核心和距离。这些特征受到技术、制度、地缘政治和监管环境变量的非线性联合制度转换的影响。基于这些表示，文章提出了一个简单、完全可检验的理论模型。最后讨论了国际货币和金融体系未来的一些前景。分析结合了经济史、理论以及来自天体物理学的共振概念。
ai_comment: 将天体物理学概念引入国际金融体系分析，提供了新颖的跨学科视角，但类比可能过于抽象，实证检验有待展开。

title: Minimum Lot Size Restrictions:  Impacts on Urban Form and House Price at the Border
abstract: We estimate the impact of more stringent minimum lot size restrictions across small border areas of neighboring communities using data from the Wharton Residential Land Use Regulatory Index (WRLURI) surveys.Economically meaningful effects are found on the built environment, not just house prices.Within 100 meters of the borders, housing density as reflected in the number of single family homes per acre is about 11% lower on average in the most restricted communities compared to the least restricted communities in terms of minimum lot sizes.Individual homes are bigger by about 80 square feet, an amount equal to about 4% of typical unit square footage.Lots are over 3,000 square feet larger in the most restricted compared to the least restricted communities' border areas, an increase equal to 28% of the sample mean lot size.Hence, among the smaller number of homes that exist in the most regulated places, their physical structures are modestly bigger and they sit on appreciably larger lots.Finally, house prices are nearly $30,000 higher in the more regulated border areas compared to the least regulated border areas.This price impact can be accounted for by differences in house quality, structure and lot size specifically, on the two sides of a border.
summary: 本文利用沃顿住宅土地利用监管指数（WRLURI）调查数据，估计了相邻社区边界小范围内更严格的最小地块面积限制对城市形态和房价的影响。在边界100米内，与限制最少的社区相比，限制最严格的社区中单户住宅每英亩数量平均低约11%，房屋面积大约大80平方英尺（约典型面积的4%），地块面积大超过3000平方英尺（约样本均值的28%）。房价在限制更严格的边界区域高出近30000美元，这一价格影响可通过边界两侧房屋质量、结构和地块面积的差异来解释。
ai_comment: 该研究通过边界对比设计，有效识别了最小地块面积限制的因果效应，并量化了对住房密度、房屋面积和房价的显著影响，为土地利用政策评估提供了新证据。

title: Monetary Policy and Innovation
abstract: We document that monetary policy has a substantial impact on innovation activities.After a tightening shock of 100 basis points, research and development (R&D) spending declines by about 1 to 3 percent and venture capital (VC) investment declines by about 25 percent in the following 1 to 3 years.Patenting in important technologies, as well as a patent-based aggregate innovation index, declines by up to 9 percent in the following 2 to 4 years.Based on previous estimates of the sensitivity of output to innovation activities, these magnitudes imply that output could be 1 percent lower after another 5 years.Monetary policy can influence innovation activities by changing aggregate demand and correspondingly the profitability of innovation, and by changing financial market conditions.Both channels appear relevant in the data.Our findings suggest that monetary policy may affect the productive capacity of the economy in the longer term, in addition to the well-recognized near-term effects on economic outcomes.
summary: 本文研究了货币政策对创新活动的影响，发现紧缩性货币政策显著抑制了创新。具体而言，在100个基点的紧缩冲击后，研发支出在随后的1至3年内下降约1%-3%，风险投资下降约25%；重要技术专利和基于专利的总体创新指数在随后的2至4年内下降高达9%。基于先前对产出与创新活动敏感性的估计，这些幅度意味着产出可能在再经过5年后下降1%。货币政策通过改变总需求进而影响创新盈利能力，以及改变金融市场条件这两个渠道影响创新活动，且数据表明这两个渠道均起作用。研究结果提示，除了短期经济影响外，货币政策还可能长期影响经济的生产能力。
ai_comment: 该论文首次系统量化了货币政策对创新的长期影响，并指出渠道机制，为货币政策的长期成本评估提供了新视角。

title: Consumer Surveillance and Financial Fraud
abstract: Companies near constantly surveil their customers to collect, analyze, and profit from their private information.A prevailing concern is that the market for private data and security breaches expose consumers to financial fraud.In this study, we exploit Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) policy, which greatly limited the tracking and sharing of personal information on the iOS platform, providing a major shock to the data industry.Using a difference-in-differences design and granular variations in iOS user shares across the US, we find that if 10% more people disallow tracking, the number of financial fraud complaints in the average zip code decreases by approximately 3.21%.We then show that the effects are concentrated in complaints related to lax data security and privacy, identified using keyword searches and machine learning on complaint narratives, and in complaints about firms that engage in intensive consumer surveillance and lack data safeguards.Our evidence quantifies one of the main consumer costs of lax data security standards.
summary: 该研究利用苹果应用追踪透明度（ATT）政策作为对数据行业的冲击，该政策极大限制了iOS平台上的个人信息追踪与共享。采用双重差分法，利用美国各邮编区iOS用户份额的细粒度变化，发现若禁用追踪的用户比例增加10%，平均邮编区的金融欺诈投诉数量约减少3.21%。进一步通过关键词搜索和机器学习对投诉文本进行分析，表明效果集中在与数据安全和隐私松懈相关的投诉，以及那些进行密集消费者监控且缺乏数据保护措施的企业。该证据量化了松懈的数据安全标准对消费者造成的主要成本之一。
ai_comment: 利用苹果ATT政策的自然实验，为消费者监控与金融欺诈之间的因果关系提供了有力证据，量化了数据安全标准的经济成本。

title: Selection into Financial Education and Effects on Portfolio Choice
abstract: To examine how financial education affects financial outcomes, one must evaluate whether and how sample selection may bias inferences regarding program impacts. Our incentivized experiment reveals how such selection influences estimated financial education effects. The more financially literate and those expecting higher gains pay more to purchase education, while those who consider themselves very financially literate pay less. Using portfolio allocation tasks, we show that the financial education increases portfolio efficiency and welfare by almost 20 and 3 percentage points, respectively. In our setting, selection does not greatly influence estimated program effects, comparing those participating and those who do not.
summary: 该研究通过激励实验考察金融教育对财务结果的影响，并探讨样本选择偏差是否会干扰对项目效果的推断。研究发现，金融素养更高且预期收益更大的个体更愿意付费接受教育，而自认为金融素养很高的个体付费更少。基于投资组合分配任务，结果显示金融教育使投资组合效率提高近20个百分点，福利提高近3个百分点。在本实验设定下，参与者和非参与者之间的选择偏差并未显著影响估计的项目效果。
ai_comment: 通过实验设计直接量化了选择偏差对金融教育效果评估的影响，并提供了教育对投资组合效率提升的因果证据。

title: Generation Next: Experimentation with AI
abstract: We investigate the potential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance scientific practice within experimentation by identifying key areas, directions, and implications.First, we discuss how these models can improve experimental design, including improving the elicitation wording, coding experiments, and producing documentation.Second, we delve into the use of LLMs in experiment implementation, with an emphasis on bolstering causal inference through creating consistent experiences, improving instruction comprehension, and real-time monitoring of participant engagement.Third, we underscore the role of LLMs in analyzing experimental data, encompassing tasks like pre-processing, data cleaning, and assisting reviewers and replicators in examining studies.Each of these tasks improves the probability of reporting accurate findings.Lastly, we suggest a scientific governance framework that mitigates the potential risks of using LLMs in experimental research while amplifying their advantages.This could pave the way for open science opportunities and foster a culture of policy and industry experimentation at scale.
summary: 该论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在提升科学实验实践中的潜力。首先，讨论了如何利用LLM改进实验设计，包括优化措辞、编码实验和生成文档。其次，深入分析了LLM在实验实施中的应用，强调通过创建一致的体验、提高指令理解和实时监控参与者参与度来增强因果推断。第三，强调了LLM在分析实验数据中的作用，涵盖预处理、数据清洗以及协助审稿人和复制者检查研究。这些任务均提高了报告准确发现的可能性。最后，提出了一个科学治理框架，以减轻在实验研究中使用LLM的潜在风险，同时放大其优势，为开放科学机遇和大规模政策与产业实验文化铺平道路。
ai_comment: 该文系统性地阐述了LLM在科学实验全流程中的潜在应用，并提出了配套治理框架，兼具前瞻性与实用性。

title: Exporting the Surveillance State via Trade in AI
abstract: We document three facts about the global diffusion of surveillance AI technology, and in particular, the role played by China.First, China has a comparative advantage in this technology.It is substantially more likely to export surveillance AI than other countries, and particularly so as compared to other frontier technologies.Second, autocracies and weak democracies are more likely to import surveillance AI from China.This bias is not observed in AI imports from the US or in imports of other frontier technologies from China.Third, autocracies and weak democracies are especially more likely to import China's surveillance AI in years of domestic unrest.Such imports coincide with declines in domestic institutional quality more broadly.To the extent that China may be exporting its surveillance state via trade in AI, this can enhance and beget more autocracies abroad.This possibility challenges the view that economic integration is necessarily associated with the diffusion of liberal institutions.
summary: 本文记录了全球监控人工智能技术扩散的三个事实，特别关注中国的作用。首先，中国在这一技术领域具有比较优势，相比其他国家和其他前沿技术，更有可能出口监控AI。其次，专制和弱民主国家更可能从中国进口监控AI，而从美国进口AI或从中国进口其他前沿技术时则没有这种偏向。第三，专制和弱民主国家在国内动荡的年份尤其更可能从中国进口监控AI，这些进口与国内制度质量的广泛下降同时发生。如果中国通过AI贸易输出其监控国家模式，这可能会在国外增强并催生更多的专制政权。这一可能性挑战了经济一体化必然与自由主义制度扩散相关联的观点。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了AI技术贸易的政治影响，特别是中国监控AI出口与进口国政治制度之间的关联，对传统经济一体化促进自由制度的假说提出了挑战。

title: Portfolio Management in Private Equity
abstract: General Partners (GPs) in private equity face a trade-off between focusing their skills and effort on fewer investments to earn higher returns, or investing more broadly to reduce risk through diversification.Using a novel, deal-level dataset of 5,925 global investments from 1999 to 2016, we show that these portfolio considerations are important for understanding fund-level private equity returns.The largest investments in PE funds typically have the lowest returns on average, but are also the least risky.Returns and risk are both increasing in industry or geographic concentration.And while GP-specific return variation (e.g., skill) only accounts for 4%-6% of the total return variation of a typical investment, it accounts for around 40% of the return variation at the fund level.These findings show that GPs use portfolio construction, and not just deal selection, to seek risk-adjusted fund-level returns.
summary: 本文研究私募股权投资中普通合伙人（GP）面临的集中投资与分散投资之间的权衡。利用1999年至2016年间5,925笔全球投资的交易级数据集，发现投资组合考虑因素对理解基金层级的私募股权回报至关重要。私募股权基金中最大的投资通常平均回报最低，但风险也最小。回报和风险均随行业或地理集中度的提高而增加。尽管GP特定的回报变异（如技能）仅占典型投资总回报变异的4%-6%，但在基金层级却占约40%的回报变异。这些发现表明，GP通过投资组合构建（而非仅交易选择）来追求风险调整后的基金层级回报。
ai_comment: 通过独特的大规模交易级数据，揭示了投资组合构建在私募股权基金回报中的关键作用，为理解GP行为提供了新视角。

title: The Importance of Sound Monetary Policy: Some Lessons for Today from Canada’s Experience with Floating Exchange Rates Since 1950
abstract: In this paper we revisit the Canadian experience with floating exchange rates since 1950.Canada was a pioneer in successfully adopting a floating exchange rate during the Bretton Woods pegged exchange rate regime.Since then, most advanced countries have followed the Canadian example.A key finding of our paper based on historical narrative and econometric analysis is that economic performance under floating depended on its monetary policy performance as Milton Friedman originally argued in his seminal 1953 article.Canadian monetary policy achieved low and stable inflation once it adopted inflation targeting as a nominal anchor.Also, as Friedman argued, Canada's floating exchange rate provided it with a modicum of insulation from external shocks, especially commodity price shocks that influenced both the level and volatility of the real exchange rate over the past three decades.The Canadian experience with floating (along with that of other small open economies such as Australia, New Zealand and Sweden) and inflation targeting became a model for the conduct of monetary policy in emerging countries.
summary: 本文重新审视了加拿大自1950年以来实行浮动汇率制度的经验。加拿大是在布雷顿森林体系固定汇率制下成功采用浮动汇率的先驱，此后大多数发达国家效仿了加拿大的做法。基于历史叙述和计量分析，本文的关键发现是，浮动汇率下的经济表现取决于货币政策的绩效，正如米尔顿·弗里德曼在1953年的开创性文章中所述。加拿大货币政策在采用通胀目标制作为名义锚后实现了低而稳定的通胀。此外，正如弗里德曼所言，加拿大的浮动汇率使其在一定程度上免受外部冲击，特别是过去三十年中影响实际汇率水平和波动性的大宗商品价格冲击。加拿大浮动汇率（以及其他小型开放经济体如澳大利亚、新西兰和瑞典的经验）和通胀目标制成为了新兴国家实施货币政策的典范。
ai_comment: 本文通过历史与实证结合，证实了弗里德曼关于浮动汇率与货币政策绩效关系的论断，并凸显了加拿大经验对新兴国家的借鉴意义。

title: Price Discrimination and Mortgage Choice
abstract: We characterize the large number of mortgage offers for which people qualify in the United Kingdom.Very few pick the cheapest option, nonetheless the one selected is not usually noticeably more expensive.A few borrowers make very expensive choices.These are most common when the menu they face has many expensive options, and are most likely for high loanto-value and loan-to-income borrowers.Young people and first-time buyers are more prone to making expensive choices.The dispersion in the mortgage menu is consistent with banks price discriminating for borrowers who might pick poorly, while competing for others who shop more effectively.
summary: 本文研究了英国抵押贷款市场中借款人面临的大量报价及其选择行为。研究发现，尽管很少有人选择最便宜的选项，但所选贷款通常不会显著更贵。然而，少数借款人会做出非常昂贵的选择，这种情况在借款人面临较多高价选项时最为常见，且高贷款价值比（LTV）和高贷款收入比（LTI）的借款人更容易做出昂贵选择。年轻人和首次购房者更倾向于选择昂贵的抵押贷款。贷款菜单的分散化与银行对可能做出糟糕选择的借款者进行价格歧视、同时对更有效比价的借款者进行竞争的行为是一致的。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了英国抵押贷款市场中借款人非理性选择与银行价格歧视的共存现象，对理解零售金融市场的定价机制具有重要启示。

title: Indoor Air Quality and Strategic Decision Making
abstract: Decision making on the job is becoming increasingly important in the labor market, in which there is an unprecedented rise in demand for workers with problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. This paper investigates how indoor air quality affects the quality of strategic decision making based on data from official chess tournaments. Our main analysis relies on a unique data set linking the readings of air-quality monitors inside the tournament room to the quality of 30,000 moves, each of them objectively evaluated by a powerful artificial intelligence–based chess engine. The results show that poor indoor air quality hampers players’ decision making. We find that an increase in the indoor concentration of fine particulate matter (PM[Formula: see text]) by 10 [Formula: see text] (corresponding to 75% of a standard deviation in our sample) increases a player’s probability of making an erroneous move by 26.3%. The decomposition of the effects by different stages of the game shows that time pressure amplifies the damage of poor air quality to the players’ decisions. We implement a number of robustness checks and conduct a replication exercise with analogous move-quality data from games in the top national league showing the strength of our results. The results highlight the costs of poor air quality for highly skilled professionals faced with strategic decisions under time pressure. This paper was accepted by Prof. Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the financial support from the Graduate School of Business and Economics at Maastricht University as well as the Institute of Labor Economics Bonn. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4643 .
summary: 基于国际象棋比赛数据，研究了室内空气质量对战略决策质量的影响。利用智能象棋引擎客观评估了30,000步棋的质量，并将之与比赛房间内的空气质量监测读数相关联。结果发现，细颗粒物（PM2.5）浓度每增加10 μg/m³（样本标准差的75%），棋手犯错概率上升26.3%。时间压力加剧了空气污染对决策的损害。通过一系列稳健性检验和顶级联赛数据复制验证了结论，揭示了糟糕空气质量对时间压力下高技能专业人士决策的成本。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验和客观棋步质量数据，提供了空气质量影响认知决策的因果证据，尤其发现了时间压力的放大效应，对办公环境政策有启示。

title: Artificial Intelligence: Can Seemingly Collusive Outcomes Be Avoided?
abstract: Strategic decisions are increasingly delegated to algorithms. We extend previous results of the algorithmic collusion literature to the context of dynamic optimization with imperfect monitoring by analyzing a setting where a limited number of agents use simple and independent machine-learning algorithms to buy and sell a storable good. No specific instruction is given to them, only that their objective is to maximize profits based solely on past market prices and payoffs. With an original application to battery operations, we observe that the algorithms learn quickly to reach seemingly collusive decisions, despite the absence of any formal communication between them. Building on the findings of the existing literature on algorithmic collusion, we show that seeming collusion could originate in imperfect exploration rather than excessive algorithmic sophistication. We then show that a regulator may succeed in disciplining the market to produce socially desirable outcomes by enforcing decentralized learning or with adequate intervention during the learning process. This paper was accepted by Gabriel Weintraub, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4623 .
summary: 本文研究在动态优化与不完全监控背景下，多个独立使用简单机器学习算法的智能体（如电池操作商）基于过去市场价和收益最大化利润时，能否避免看似合谋的市场结果。通过模拟电池存储买卖场景，发现算法无需沟通即可快速学会达成看似合谋的定价策略。进一步揭示这种合谋表象源于算法的不完美探索（imperfect exploration）而非过度复杂的算法能力。最后证明监管者可通过强制分散学习（decentralized learning）或在学习过程中适当干预来引导市场达到社会最优结果。
ai_comment: 将算法合谋研究拓展至不完全监控的动态环境，并识别出不完美探索而非算法复杂性的关键作用，为监管干预提供了具体路径。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Targeting
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has opened up many unprecedented opportunities in revolutionizing the digital marketing field. In this study, we designed a DRL-based personalized targeting strategy in a sequential setting. We show that the strategy is able to address three important challenges of sequential targeting: (1) forward looking (balancing between a firm’s current revenue and future revenues), (2) earning while learning (maximizing profits while continuously learning through exploration-exploitation), and (3) scalability (coping with a high-dimensional state and policy space). We illustrate this through a novel design of a DRL-based artificial intelligence (AI) agent. To better adapt DRL to complex consumer behavior dimensions, we proposed a quantization-based uncertainty learning heuristic for efficient exploration-exploitation. Our policy evaluation results through simulation suggest that the proposed DRL agent generates 26.75% more long-term revenues than can the non-DRL approaches on average and learns 76.92% faster than the second fastest model among all benchmarks. Further, in order to better understand the potential underlying mechanisms, we conducted multiple interpretability analyses to explain the patterns of learned optimal policy at both the individual and population levels. Our findings provide important managerial-relevant and theory-consistent insights. For instance, consecutive price promotions at the beginning can capture price-sensitive consumers’ immediate attention, whereas carefully spaced nonpromotional “cooldown” periods between price promotions can allow consumers to adjust their reference points. Additionally, consideration of future revenues is necessary from a long-term horizon, but weighing the future too much can also dampen revenues. In addition, analyses of heterogeneous treatment effects suggest that the optimal promotion sequence pattern highly varies across the consumer engagement stages. Overall, our study results demonstrate DRL’s potential to optimize these strategies’ combination to maximize long-term revenues. This paper was accepted by Kartik Hosanagar, information systems. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4621 .
summary: 本文设计了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的顺序目标营销个性化策略，旨在解决前瞻性（平衡当前与未来收入）、边赚边学（在探索与利用中持续学习并最大化利润）和可扩展性（应对高维状态与策略空间）三大挑战。通过新颖的DRL人工智能代理设计，并引入基于量化的不确定性学习启发式方法实现高效探索与利用，模拟结果表明，该DRL代理平均比非DRL方法多产生26.75%的长期收入，且学习速度比第二快的基准模型快76.92%。可解释性分析揭示了最优策略在个体和群体层面的模式，如连续价格促销可吸引价格敏感消费者，促销间适当间隔的冷却期能调整消费者参考点；过度关注未来收入反而可能抑制收益。异质处理效应分析显示最优促销序列模式随消费者参与阶段而变化。研究展示了DRL在优化策略组合以最大化长期收入方面的潜力。
ai_comment: 本文将DRL应用于营销领域的顺序目标问题，创新性地结合了不确定性学习机制，在模拟中取得显著收益提升，并通过可解释性分析提供了可操作的管理洞察。

title: Estimating and Exploiting the Impact of Photo Layout: A Structural Approach
abstract: Host-generated property images as a visual channel reveal substantial information about properties. Selecting proper images to display can lead to higher demand and increased rental revenue. In this paper, we define, estimate, and optimize the impacts of Airbnb photos on customers’ renting decisions. We apply ResNet-50, a convolutional neural network model, to build two separate, supervised learning models to evaluate the image quality and room types posted by Airbnb hosts. Then, we characterize the overall impacts of photo layout by the room type featured in the photo, photo quality, and order of display on the listings’ web pages. To address two estimation challenges in the Airbnb setting, namely, censored demand and changing consideration sets, we propose a novel pairwise comparison model that utilizes customers’ booking sequence data to consistently estimate the impact of photo layout on customers’ renting decisions. Our estimation results suggest that the cover image has a significantly larger impact than noncover photos and a high-quality bedroom cover image leads to the largest increase in demand. Furthermore, we build a nonlinear integer programming optimization problem and develop an algorithm to determine the optimal photo layout. Our counterfactual analysis suggests that a listing’s unilateral adoption of optimal photo layout leads to 11.0% more bookings on average. Moreover, depending on the neighborhood and market size, when listings simultaneously switch to the optimal photo layout, they get booked for two to five additional days in a year on average, which boosts revenue by $500 to $1,100. This paper was accepted by Swaminathan, Jayashankar, operations management. Funding: This research was partially sponsored by the MIT Data Science Lab and also benefited from generous support provided by Zalando. Supplemental Material: The online companion and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4616 .
summary: 论文研究Airbnb平台上房源照片布局对顾客租房决策的影响。使用ResNet-50卷积神经网络构建两个监督学习模型，分别评估照片质量和房间类型。通过照片展示的房间类型、照片质量以及显示顺序来刻画照片布局的整体影响。针对Airbnb场景中的需求审查和考虑集变化两个估计挑战，提出一种利用顾客预订序列数据的成对比较模型来一致估计照片布局的影响。估计结果表明封面照片的影响显著大于非封面照片，高质量卧室封面照片带来的需求增加最大。进一步建立非线性整数规划优化问题，并开发算法确定最优照片布局。反事实分析显示，房源单方面采用最优照片布局平均可增加11.0%的预订量；当所有房源同时切换至最优布局时，每年平均增加2至5天预订，收入增加500至1100美元。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地将深度学习与结构计量模型结合，解决平台经济中的视觉信息优化问题，反事实分析提供了可量化的商业价值。

title: Institutional Investor Attention, Agency Conflicts, and the Cost of Debt
abstract: Using a new measure of shareholder inattention constructed from exogenous industry shocks to institutional investor portfolios, we find that firms with distracted shareholders are associated with a higher cost of debt. This effect is stronger for firms with more powerful CEOs, firms with higher information asymmetry, and those operating in less competitive product markets. Further testing suggests that the inattention-cost of debt relation is driven primarily by dual holders directly observing shareholder distraction. Our results are robust to controlling for inattention at the retail investor level and to other external monitors, including credit rating agencies, financial analysts, and Big 4 auditors. Overall, our evidence suggests that institutional shareholder inattention has an incrementally negative effect on bond pricing. This paper was accepted by Brian Bushee, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4593 .
summary: 本文利用由机构投资者投资组合的外生行业冲击构建的一个新指标来衡量股东注意力分散，研究发现股东注意力分散的公司债务成本更高。这一效应在CEO权力更大的公司、信息不对称程度更高的公司以及产品市场竞争较弱的公司中更为显著。进一步检验表明，注意力分散与债务成本之间的关系主要由双重持有人（同时持有债权和股权）直接观察股东分散所驱动。结果在控制散户投资者注意力分散以及其他外部监督者（包括信用评级机构、金融分析师和四大审计师）后依然稳健。整体证据表明，机构股东注意力分散对债券定价具有增量负面效应。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生冲击构建新颖的股东注意力分散指标，有效识别了因果关系，并深入探讨了背后的代理冲突机制，对债券定价文献有重要贡献。

title: The Information in Asset Fire Sales
abstract: Asset prices remain depressed for years following mutual fund fire sales, but little is known about the causes of these price drops. We show that asymmetric information generates price pressure during fire sales. We separate trades into expected trades, which assume fund managers scale down their portfolio, and discretionary trades. We find that discretionary trades contain fundamental information, whereas expected trades do not. Moreover, other traders cannot distinguish between discretionary and expected trades. Our findings help explain the magnitude and persistence of fire sale discounts: fund managers choose which assets to sell, and information asymmetries make it difficult for arbitrageurs to disentangle price pressure from fundamental information. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Supplemental Material: Data and the internet appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4585 .
summary: 这篇论文研究共同基金抛售（fire sales）后资产价格长期低迷的原因。作者提出信息不对称是产生抛售价格压力的关键机制。他们将基金交易分为预期交易（expected trades，假设基金经理按比例减持组合）和自由裁量交易（discretionary trades），发现自由裁量交易包含基本面信息，而预期交易不包含。此外，其他交易者无法区分这两类交易。这一发现解释了抛售折扣的幅度和持续性：基金经理选择出售哪些资产，信息不对称使套利者难以将价格压力与基本面信息区分开。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分交易类型揭示了信息不对称在资产抛售中的核心作用，为理解抛售折扣的持续性和幅度提供了新视角。

title: Part-Time Bayesians: Incentives and Behavioral Heterogeneity in Belief Updating
abstract: Decisions in management and finance rely on information that often includes win-lose feedback (e.g., gains and losses, success and failure). Simple reinforcement then suggests to blindly repeat choices if they led to success in the past and change them otherwise, which might conflict with Bayesian updating of beliefs. We use finite mixture models and hidden Markov models, adapted from machine learning, to uncover behavioral heterogeneity in the reliance on difference behavioral rules across and within individuals in a belief-updating experiment. Most decision makers rely both on Bayesian updating and reinforcement. Paradoxically, an increase in incentives increases the reliance on reinforcement because the win-lose cues become more salient. This paper was accepted by Gustavo Manso, finance. Funding: C. Alós-Ferrer gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft under [Grant AL1169/4], part of the research unit “Psychoeconomics” (FOR 1882). Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4584 .
summary: 本研究探讨在管理金融决策中，决策者如何根据包含输赢反馈（如得失、成功失败）的信息更新信念。简单强化规则（重复成功选择、改变失败选择）可能与贝叶斯信念更新相冲突。作者采用机器学习中的有限混合模型和隐马尔可夫模型，在一个信念更新实验中揭示跨个体和个体内部对不同行为规则依赖的行为异质性。结果表明，大多数决策者同时依赖贝叶斯更新和强化。悖论的是，增加激励反而增加对强化的依赖，因为输赢线索变得更加显著。
ai_comment: 利用机器学习方法揭示微观行为机制，发现激励强化悖论，对理解决策偏差有重要贡献。

title: Privacy-Preserving Network Analytics
abstract: We develop a new privacy-preserving framework for a general class of financial network models, leveraging cryptographic principles from secure multiparty computation and decentralized systems. We show how aggregate-level network statistics required for stability assessment and stress testing can be derived from real data without any individual node revealing its private information to any outside party, be it other nodes in the network, or even a central agent. Our work bridges the gap between established theories of financial network contagion and systemic risk that assume agents have full network information and the real world where information sharing is hindered by privacy and security concerns. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4582 .
summary: 本文针对金融网络模型中的隐私保护问题，提出了一种新的隐私保护框架，该框架利用安全多方计算和去中心化系统的密码学原理。研究证明，可以从真实数据中推导出用于稳定性评估和压力测试的聚合级网络统计信息，而无需任何单个节点向其他节点或中央代理泄露其私人信息。这项工作弥合了金融网络传染和系统性风险理论（假设代理拥有完整网络信息）与现实（信息共享受隐私和安全问题阻碍）之间的鸿沟。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地将密码学技术应用于金融网络分析，解决了信息共享与隐私保护之间的核心矛盾，具有重要的实践意义和理论价值。

title: Debt dynamics and credit risk
abstract: We investigate how the dynamics of corporate debt policy affect the pricing of corporate bonds. We find empirically that debt issuance has a significant stochastic component that is imperfectly correlated with shocks to asset value. As a consequence, the volatility of leverage is significantly higher than asset volatility over short horizons. At long horizons, the relation between leverage and asset volatility is reversed due to mean reversion in leverage. We incorporate these stochastic debt dynamics into structural models of credit risk, both standard diffusion models as well as newer models with stochastic volatility and jumps. Including stochastic debt gives more accurate predictions of credit spreads in both the cross-section and the time series.
summary: 本文实证研究公司债务政策动态如何影响公司债券定价。发现债务发行存在显著的随机成分，且与资产价值冲击不完全相关，导致短期杠杆波动率显著高于资产波动率，而长期因均值回复效应两者关系反转。将随机债务动态纳入标准扩散模型以及含随机波动和跳跃的信用风险结构模型后，模型对信用利差的横截面和时间序列预测均更准确。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地将债务发行的随机性引入传统信用风险模型，显著提升了定价准确性，为理解杠杆动态与信用利差的关系提供了新视角。

title: Fire sale risk and expected stock returns
abstract: We measure a stock’s exposure to fire sale risk through its ownership links to mutual funds that anticipate significant outflows during periods of systematic outflows from the fund industry. We find that stocks with higher exposure to this risk earn higher average returns: a portfolio that buys (shorts) stocks with the highest (lowest) exposure outperforms by 3-7% annually. Our findings cannot be explained by several known determinants of average returns and support the ex-ante pricing of the risk of fire sales. We conclude that stocks’ exposures to risks inherited from the constraints of shareholders have important implications for stock prices.
summary: 本文通过股票与共同基金的所有权联系来度量股票对火售风险的暴露程度，这些基金在行业系统性流出期间预计会出现大量赎回。研究发现，暴露程度较高的股票获得更高的平均收益：买入暴露最高股票、卖空暴露最低股票的投资组合年化超额收益为3-7%。这一发现无法被已知的平均收益决定因素所解释，支持了火售风险的事前定价。结论表明，股票因股东约束而继承的风险暴露对股价具有重要影响。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用共同基金的流动性约束来刻画个股的火售风险暴露，并实证了该风险被定价，为理解机构投资者行为对资产价格的影响提供了新视角。

title: Collateral competition: Evidence from central counterparties
abstract: We analyze competition and risk management at central counterparties (CCPs) using a granular transaction-level dataset, and find that CCPs decrease collateral in response to lower collateral at their competitors, an effect that becomes stronger as the correlation between positions increases. To interpret our findings, we derive a model in which collateral is driven by risk and CCP competition. Our results are consistent with the model and suggest that a single monopolistic CCP would require more collateral. We also show that amid the substantial increase in collateral during the Covid-19 pandemic, the probability of a margin breach did not significantly change.
summary: 本文利用高粒度交易数据集分析中央对手方（CCPs）之间的竞争与风险管理，发现CCPs会因竞争对手降低抵押品要求而相应减少自身抵押品，且当不同头寸之间的相关性上升时，这一效应会增强。为了解释这些发现，作者构建了一个理论模型，其中抵押品水平由风险因素和CCP之间的竞争共同决定。实证结果与模型预测一致，表明若市场由单一垄断CCP运营，则其要求的抵押品将更高。此外，研究显示，尽管新冠疫情期间抵押品规模大幅增长，但保证金违约的概率并未出现显著变化。
ai_comment: 该研究首次利用交易级数据量化了CCP之间的竞争对抵押品设置的传导效应，并为垄断性CCP可能带来更高抵押品成本提供了经验证据。

title: Deputizing financial institutions to fight elder abuse
abstract: Permissive laws deputize financial professionals to screen for misbehavior without providing explicit incentives. These are very common in financial markets. To evaluate their effectiveness, we exploit the staggered adoption of the 2016 Model Act provisions intended to curb elder abuse. We find a drop in reports of abuse by financial professionals to the Department of Treasury and, separately, in financial crimes against the elderly as monitored by the FBI. The effect is stronger where the elderly are more isolated. Our results highlight the role financial professionals play in combating social problems and the impact of permissive policies.
summary: 本文研究宽松法律（即授权但未提供明确激励的法规）对金融专业人员筛查不当行为的影响。利用美国各州2016年《模范法案》反老年人虐待条款的逐步实施，发现该法案导致金融专业人员向财政部报告的虐待案件下降，同时FBI监测的针对老年人的金融犯罪也下降。这种效应在老年人更孤立的地区更为显著。结果表明，金融专业人员在社会问题中发挥重要作用，且宽松政策具有实际效果。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验识别因果关系，揭示了金融专业人员在预防老年人金融虐待中的角色，为政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Index providers: Whales behind the scenes of ETFs
abstract: Most ETFs replicate indexes licensed by index providers. We show that index providers wield strong market power and charge large markups to ETFs that are passed on to investors. We document three stylized facts: ( i ) the index provider market is highly concentrated; ( i i ) investors care about the identities of index providers, although they explain little variation in ETF returns; and ( i i i ) over one-third of ETF expense ratios are paid as licensing fees to index providers. A structural decomposition attributes 60% of licensing fees to index providers’ markups. Counterfactual analyses show that improving competition among index providers reduces ETF expense ratios by up to 30%.
summary: 本文研究指数供应商在ETF市场中的角色。指数供应商拥有强大的市场力量，向ETF收取高额加成，这些成本最终转嫁给投资者。论文总结了三个典型事实：指数供应商市场高度集中；投资者关心指数供应商的身份，尽管其对ETF回报的解释力很小；超过三分之一的ETF费用率用于支付指数供应商的许可费。结构性分解表明，许可费中60%来自指数供应商的加成。反事实分析显示，改善指数供应商之间的竞争可使ETF费用率降低高达30%。
ai_comment: 该文首次系统量化了指数供应商在ETF成本结构中的隐性市场势力，为理解ETF高费用成因和监管政策提供了关键证据。

title: A credit-based theory of the currency risk premium
abstract: This paper uncovers a novel component for exchange rate predictability based on the price difference between sovereign credit default swaps denominated in different currencies. This new forecasting variable – the credit-implied risk premium – captures the expected currency depreciation conditional on a severe but rare credit event. Using data for 16 Eurozone countries, we find that the credit-implied risk premium positively forecasts the dollar-euro exchange rate return at various horizons. Moreover, a currency strategy that exploits the informative content of our predictor generates substantial out-of-sample economic value against the naïve random walk benchmark.
summary: 本文基于不同货币计价的主权信用违约互换价格差异，发现了一种新的汇率可预测性成分——信用隐含风险溢价，该变量捕捉了在严重但罕见的信用事件条件下预期的货币贬值。利用16个欧元区国家的数据，研究发现信用隐含风险溢价能在多个预测期正向预测美元-欧元汇率收益。此外，基于该预测因子构建的货币策略相对于朴素随机游走基准，在样本外产生了显著的经济价值。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将信用衍生品市场信息引入汇率预测，提出了一个具有实际投资价值的预测因子。

title: Creditor rights, collateral reuse, and credit supply
abstract: Securities dealers receive mortgages as collateral for credit lines provided to mortgage companies and reuse the same collateral to borrow money. Exploiting the 2005 BAPCPA rule change, which granted mortgage collateral preferred bankruptcy treatment, I find that strengthening creditor rights increases dealers’ collateral reuse. Increasing collateral reuse creates a money multiplier that increases credit supply. Using a novel dataset linking dealers to the mortgage companies they fund reveals that post-BAPCPA, dealers supply additional credit to mortgage companies by increasing credit lines and relaxing restrictions on collateral securing them. In response, mortgage companies increase origination volume and shift into riskier products.
summary: 本文研究加强债权人权利对证券经销商抵押品重复使用和信贷供给的影响。利用2005年BAPCPA法案变更（该法案给予抵押贷款破产优先处理待遇）作为准自然实验，发现加强债权人权利增加了经销商的抵押品重复使用，从而通过货币乘数效应扩大信贷供给。通过连接经销商及其融资的抵押贷款公司的新数据集，发现法案后经销商增加了对抵押贷款公司的信用额度，并放松了对抵押品的限制。抵押贷款公司因此增加了贷款发放量，并转向风险更高的产品。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验识别因果效应，独特数据集揭示了抵押品再使用渠道对信贷供给的放大机制，丰富了法律与金融关系的文献。

title: Momentum turning points
abstract: We use slow and fast time-series momentum to characterize four stock market cycles—Bull, Correction, Bear, and Rebound. The steep market declines of Bears concentrate in high-risk states, yet predict negative expected returns, which is difficult to rationalize by most models of time-varying risk premia. Using a model to analyze slow and fast momentum strategies, we estimate both relatively high mean persistence and realization noise in U.S. stock market returns. Intermediate-speed momentum portfolios, formed by blending slow and fast momentum strategies, translate predictive information in market cycles into positive unconditional alpha, for which we propose a novel decomposition.
summary: 本文利用慢速和快速时间序列动量来刻画四个股票市场周期——牛市、修正、熊市和反弹。研究发现，熊市期间的急剧市场下跌集中在高风险状态，但却预测负的预期收益，这一现象难以被大多数时变风险溢价模型所解释。通过构建模型分析慢速和快速动量策略，作者估计出美国股票市场收益具有相对较高的均值持久性和实现噪声。此外，通过混合慢速和快速动量策略形成的中间速度动量组合，能够将市场周期中的预测信息转化为正的无条件阿尔法，并为此提出了一种新的分解方法。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用慢速和快速动量划分市场周期，并提出中间速度动量组合的阿尔法分解，对理解动量收益的来源有重要贡献。

title: Systematic default and return predictability in the stock and bond markets
abstract: We construct a measure of systematic default defined as the probability that many firms default at the same time. We account for correlations in defaults between firms through exposures to common shocks. Systematic default spikes during recessions, is correlated with macroeconomic indicators, and predicts future realized defaults. More importantly, it predicts future equity and corporate bond index returns both in- and out-of-sample. Finally, we find that the cross-section of average stock returns is related to firm-level exposures to systematic default risk.
summary: 本文构建了一个系统性违约指标，定义为许多公司同时发生违约的概率。通过引入共同冲击的暴露来刻画公司间违约的相关性。研究发现，系统性违约在经济衰退期间显著上升，与宏观经济指标高度相关，并能有效预测未来的实际违约事件。更重要的是，该指标在样本内和样本外均能预测未来股票和公司债券指数收益。此外，股票横截面平均收益率与公司对系统性违约风险的暴露程度相关。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建系统性违约概率指标，将其与资产定价联系起来，为理解违约风险的系统性影响提供了新视角，并实证了其对股票和债券收益的预测能力。

title: The limits of multi-dealer platforms
abstract: On many important multi-dealer platforms, customers mostly request quotes from very few dealers. I build a model of multi-dealer platforms, where dealers strategically choose to respond to or ignore a request. If the customer contacts more dealers, each dealer responds with a lower probability and offers a stochastically worse price when responding. Dealers’ strategic avoidance of competition overturns the customer’s benefit from potentially receiving more quotes, worsening her best-overall price. In equilibrium, the customer contacts only two dealers. Multi-dealer platforms have limited ability to promote price competition: No design of information disclosure can improve the customer’s payoff above this outcome.
summary: 本文研究多交易商平台中客户仅向少数交易商询价的现象。作者构建了一个模型，其中交易商策略性地选择是否回应询价。如果客户联系更多交易商，每个交易商回应的概率降低，且提供的价格随机变差。交易商战略性地避免竞争，抵消了客户因潜在获得更多报价而获得的收益，导致其最优整体价格恶化。均衡状态下，客户只联系两个交易商。多交易商平台促进价格竞争的能力有限：没有信息披露设计能改善客户在此结果之上的收益。
ai_comment: 本文通过模型揭示了多交易商平台竞争有限的根本原因，即交易商策略性回避竞争，对平台设计有重要启示。

title: Existence of the Wealth-Consumption Ratio in Asset Pricing Models with Recursive Preferences
abstract: Modern asset pricing models combine recursive preferences with complex dynamics for the underlying consumption process. The existence of solutions is for many of these models an unsettled question. This paper introduces a novel technique to prove existence and nonexistence, as well as uniqueness for models with recursive preferences. The approach applies to many models of interest, including those with long-run consumption risks, with stochastic volatility and jumps, with time-varying consumption disasters, and with smooth ambiguity aversion and learning. Collectively, the proven results settle the existence question for many of today’s leading asset pricing models.
summary: 本文针对现代资产定价模型中结合递归偏好与复杂消费过程（如长期消费风险、随机波动与跳跃、时变灾难、平滑模糊厌恶及学习等）的解的存在性问题，提出了一种新技术来证明解的存在性、不存在性以及唯一性。该技术适用于多种主流模型，并最终解决了这些模型的存在性问题。
ai_comment: 该论文通过创新性的技术方法，系统性地解决了资产定价领域长期存在的解的存在性问题，为后续理论研究和实证应用奠定了坚实基础。

title: Scale or Yield? A Present-Value Identity
abstract: We propose a loglinear present-value identity in which investment (“scale”), profitability (“yield”), and discount rates determine a firm’s market-to-book ratio. Our identity reconciles existing influential market-to-book decompositions and facilitates novel insights from three empirical applications: (1) Both investment and profitability are important contributors to the value spread and stock return news variance. (2) Any cross-sectional return predictability has a mirror image in cash-flow fundamentals, providing asset pricing theories with additional moments to match. (3) The investment spread significantly improves the predictability of time-series variation in the value premium and justifies the poor performance of value in recent years.
summary: 本文提出了一个对数线性现值恒等式，其中投资（scale）、盈利能力（yield）和折现率共同决定企业的市场-账面价值比。该恒等式统一了现有有影响力的市场-账面比分解，并通过三个实证应用提供了新见解：第一，投资和盈利能力都是价值利差和股票回报新闻方差的重要贡献者；第二，任何横截面回报可预测性在现金流基本面中都有镜像，为资产定价理论提供了额外的矩条件；第三，投资利差显著提高了时间序列中价值溢价的可预测性，并解释了近年来价值策略表现不佳的原因。
ai_comment: 该文通过一个简洁的恒等式统一了市场-账面比的多种分解，并揭示了投资和盈利能力在价值溢价中的关键作用，为理解价值策略的表现提供了新视角。

title: Initial Margin Requirements and Market Efficiency
abstract: We examine the association between margin requirements and the market’s efficiency in incorporating firm-specific and market-level public news. Combining the Fed’s 22 changes in margin requirements with a hand-collected sample of earnings announcements between 1934 and 1975, we show that higher margin requirements induce greater delay in incorporating earnings information into prices. We draw similar conclusions when we analyze the Hou and Moskowitz (2005) price delay measure, as well as indirect measures of leverage constraints over recent years. Further tests suggest that, despite the Fed’s expressed intent to curtail excess speculation, higher margin requirements restrict trading by arbitrageurs more than noise traders.
summary: 本文研究了初始保证金要求与市场将公司特定和整体市场公开新闻纳入价格效率之间的关系。通过将美联储22次保证金要求变动与1934-1975年间手工收集的盈利公告样本相结合，发现更高的保证金要求导致盈利信息融入股价的延迟更大。当分析Hou and Moskowitz (2005)价格延迟指标以及近年来的杠杆约束间接指标时，也得出了类似结论。进一步检验表明，尽管美联储意图抑制过度投机，但更高的保证金要求对套利者的交易限制大于对噪声交易者的限制。
ai_comment: 利用历史制度变迁识别保证金要求对信息效率的因果效应，揭示其通过抑制套利者而非噪声交易者影响市场，对监管设计具有重要启示。

title: Optimal Forbearance of Bank Resolution
abstract: This paper analyzes a regulator's optimal strategic delay of resolving banks when the regulator's announcement of the intervention delay endogenously affects the depositors' run propensity. Given intervention, the regulator either liquidates the remaining illiquid assets (“prompt corrective action”) or continues managing the assets at a reduced skill level (“resolution under receivership”). In either case, I show that if the regulator tolerates fewer withdrawals until intervention, the depositors may react by preempting the regulator: they run on the bank more often ex ante. A policy of never intervening can leave the bank more stable than a conservative intervention policy.
summary: 本文分析监管者在解决银行问题时最优策略延迟，其中监管者宣布干预延迟会内生地影响存款人的挤兑倾向。监管者可以选择在干预时清算剩余的非流动资产（“及时纠正措施”）或继续以较低的技能水平管理资产（“接管下的解决方案”）。研究表明，如果监管者在干预前容忍较少的提款，存款人可能会先发制人：他们在事前更频繁地挤兑银行。完全不干预的政策可能比保守的干预政策更能保持银行稳定。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入存款人行为的内生反应，展示了监管政策可能产生反直觉的稳定性影响，为银行监管的时机选择提供了新视角。

title: Expropriation Risk and Investment: A Natural Experiment
abstract: This article uses the enactment of China’s 2007 Property Law (the Law), which reduces the risk of expropriation by local governments, as the setting to investigate the importance of property rights protection for private firm investment. Using propensity score matching and a difference-in-differences design, we find that firms facing weaker property rights protection prior to the Law significantly increase their investment and investment efficiency after the Law. Cross-sectional analyses document evidence consistent with a decrease in firms’ perceived expropriation risk as the main mechanism underlying the Law’s effect. Finally, we show that the Law improves local economic outcomes and employment.
summary: 本文利用中国2007年《物权法》的实施作为自然实验，该法律降低了地方政府征用风险，从而研究产权保护对私营企业投资的重要性。采用倾向得分匹配和双重差分法，发现《物权法》实施后，之前产权保护较弱的企业显著增加了投资并提高了投资效率。横截面分析表明，企业感知的征用风险降低是法律效应的主要机制。此外，法律还改善了地方经济结果和就业。
ai_comment: 利用外生政策冲击识别因果效应，为产权保护促进投资提供了强有力的微观证据。

title: Externalities of Financial Statement Fraud on the Incoming Accounting Labor Force
abstract: Financial statement fraud generates many negative effects, including reducing people's willingness to participate in the stock market. If it also stigmatizes accounting, it may similarly adversely affect the quantity and quality of workers willing to become accountants, thereby potentially creating negative effects for years to come. We examine the impact of fraud on the labor force entering the accounting profession, which is a key input into the production of accounting information (i.e., the output). Using data describing millions of college students across the United States, we find incoming students are actually more likely to major in accounting when local frauds occur during their formative years. These students are also more likely to have attributes desired by the accounting profession (e.g., high academic aptitude) and are more likely to subsequently serve in public accounting and become Certified Public Accountants. In the context of other fields (i.e., all college majors), we find that fraud similarly spurs interest in other business disciplines, but not in majors outside of business schools. Those attracted to other business disciplines, however, generally possess different traits. Specifically, students entering accounting are distinctively more likely to exhibit values espoused by the accounting profession, including a predisposition to public service and less commercial orientation. Thus, nonpecuniary motives appear to uniquely drive accounting student enrollment following fraud. Collectively, our findings suggest that, while fraud is unmistakably bad, it appears to have the positive unintended consequence of attracting labor into business disciplines and, in accounting, increasing the prevalence of desirable traits among entrants.
summary: 财务舞弊不仅减少人们参与股市的意愿，还可能污名化会计行业，影响未来会计劳动力的数量和质量。本文利用美国数百万大学生的数据，研究财务舞弊对进入会计行业劳动力的影响。结果发现，在舞弊发生期间及之后，本地学生更倾向于主修会计，且这些学生更具备会计行业渴望的特质（如高学术能力），后续更可能进入公共会计行业并成为注册会计师。与其他商科专业相比，舞弊同样激发了学生对其他商科的兴趣，但会计专业学生独特地表现出更多公共服务倾向和较少的商业导向，表明非金钱动机驱动了舞弊后的会计专业入学。总体而言，尽管舞弊有害，但它意外地吸引了劳动力进入商科领域，并在会计行业中增加了具有理想特质学生的比例。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了财务舞弊的一个意外正面效应：吸引具备公共服务业特质的优秀学生进入会计行业。这为理解舞弊的广泛社会影响提供了新视角，并挑战了仅关注负面后果的传统观点。

title: Informational Black Holes in Financial Markets
abstract: We show that information aggregation in primary financial markets fails precisely when investors hold socially useful information for screening projects. Being wary of the Winner's Curse, less optimistic investors refrain from making financing offers, since their offers would be accepted only when a project is unviable. Their information is therefore lost. The Winner's Curse and associated information loss grow with the number of informed market participants, so that larger markets can lead to worse financing decisions and higher cost of capital for firms seeking financing. Precommitment to ration fundraising allocations, collusive club bidding, and shorting markets can mitigate the inefficiency.
summary: 论文显示当投资者持有对社会有用的项目筛选信息时，初级金融市场的信息聚合会失败。由于担心赢家的诅咒，不太乐观的投资者避免提供融资报价，因为他们的报价只有在项目不可行时才会被接受，导致其信息丢失。赢家的诅咒和相关信息损失随着知情市场参与者数量的增加而增大，因此更大的市场可能导致更差的融资决策和更高的企业融资成本。预先承诺分配配给、合谋俱乐部投标和做空市场可以缓解这种低效率。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了市场参与度提高反而加剧信息效率问题的反直觉现象，并提出了创新的缓解机制。

title: Global Pricing of Carbon‐Transition Risk
abstract: The energy transition away from fossil fuels exposes companies to carbon‐transition risk. Estimating the market‐based premium associated with carbon‐transition risk in a cross section of 14,400 firms in 77 countries, we find higher stock returns associated with higher levels and growth rates of carbon emissions in all sectors and most countries. Carbon premia related to emissions growth are greater for firms located in countries with lower economic development, larger energy sectors, and less inclusive political systems. Premia related to emission levels are higher in countries with stricter domestic climate policies. The latter have increased with investor awareness about climate change risk.
summary: 本文研究全球范围内碳转型风险的市场定价。通过分析来自77个国家14,400家公司的横截面数据，发现所有行业和大多数国家中，较高的碳排放水平和排放增长率均与更高的股票收益相关。排放增长率相关的碳溢价在经济发展水平较低、能源部门规模较大、政治体系包容性较低的国家更为显著；而排放水平相关的溢价则在国内气候政策更严格的国家更高，且该溢价随着投资者对气候变化风险意识的增强而上升。
ai_comment: 该论文利用全球大样本数据系统性地估计了碳转型风险的溢价，并揭示了国家特征（经济发展、能源结构、政治制度、气候政策）对碳溢价的调节作用，为理解气候变化风险定价提供了重要跨国证据。

title: The Effect of Client Industry Agglomerations on Auditor Industry Specialization
abstract: Prior research on auditor industry specialization documents fee premiums for local audit offices that are industry specialists. This research assumes that the effects of specialization are uniform across markets. We examine industry specialization based on the economic theory of industry agglomeration (geographic areas with high industry concentration). Agglomeration economies can facilitate access to knowledge for auditors serving a specific industry in those locations. We find that industry specialists in agglomerations earn a fee premium in excess of specialists in other markets. We find that nonspecialist offices in agglomerations also earn fee premiums in that industry when compared to nonspecialists in other markets even when controlling for these groups’ absolute share of the national market. We also address whether or not this expertise can be shared among offices in an agglomeration specialist's firm. We find that audit offices that have easy connections to a within‐firm office in an agglomerated market can earn a fee premium relative to more distant offices, suggesting a benefit from knowledge transfer. This fee premium accrues to offices that would not be considered a specialist using traditional market share measures in a given industry. These findings indicate that the benefit of industry specialization depends on more than local market share.
summary: 该论文研究客户行业集聚对审计师行业专长的影响。基于行业集聚的经济理论，研究发现位于集聚区的行业专长审计师比其他市场的行业专长审计师获得更高的费用溢价。同时，即使控制了这些事务所的全国市场绝对份额，集聚区内的非专长审计师也比其他市场的非专长审计师在此行业中赚取费用溢价。论文进一步探讨了集聚区专长审计师所在事务所内部的知识共享，发现与集聚区市场内的事务所办公室有便捷联系的审计办公室能够比距离较远的办公室获得费用溢价，这表明知识转移带来的收益。这些费用溢价会累积到那些在传统市场份额衡量下不被视为某一行业专长的事务所。研究结论表明，行业专长的收益不仅取决于当地市场份额。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将产业集聚理论引入审计研究，揭示了审计师行业专长收益的非均匀性以及知识在审计公司内部的空间溢出效应，对审计定价和审计市场结构研究具有重要启示。

title: Ethnic Minority Analysts’ Participation in Public Earnings Conference Calls
abstract: We investigate ethnic minority and nonminority sell‐side analysts’ participation in public earnings conference calls. We find that minority analysts are underrepresented in conference call Q&A sessions, and minority analysts who do participate on the calls experience lower levels of prioritization than do nonminority analysts. Minority analysts’ lower participation rates are partially but not fully mediated by characteristics such as experience, work environment, and stock rating favorability. Additionally, firm and conference call fixed effects mediate approximately half the magnitude of lower minority participation rates. Extroverted minority analysts participate at higher rates, but the negative association between minority status and conference call participation is exacerbated when calls are more time constrained, when executive teams are less diverse, and when analysts are from less prestigious brokerage houses. Overall, we document the underrepresentation of minority analysts on earnings conference calls and provide evidence suggesting both analysts’ and managers’ choices influence minority analysts’ participation rates.
summary: 本文研究少数民族与非少数民族卖方分析师在公开财报电话会议中的参与情况。研究发现，少数民族分析师在电话会议问答环节的代表性不足，即使参与，其被优先考虑的程度也低于非少数民族分析师。少数民族分析师参与率较低的部分原因可由经验、工作环境和股票评级偏好等特征中介，但并非完全解释。公司固定效应和电话会议固定效应大约中介了少数民族参与率较低的一半幅度。外向性格的少数民族分析师参与率较高，但当电话会议时间更紧迫、管理团队多样性更低、分析师来自声望较低的经纪公司时，少数民族身份与电话会议参与率的负相关关系会加剧。总体而言，本文记录了少数民族分析师在财报电话会议中的代表性不足，并提供了分析师和管理者的选择如何影响少数民族分析师参与率的证据。
ai_comment: 本文从种族多样性角度切入分析师行为研究，揭示了电话会议中潜在的不平等现象，并提供了组织和个人层面因素的深入分析。

title: Local Effects of Global Capital Flows: A China Shock in the U.S. Housing Market
abstract: This paper studies the real effects of foreign real estate capital inflows. Using transaction-level data, we document (i) a “China shock” in the U.S. housing market characterized by surging foreign Chinese housing purchases after 2008, and (ii) “home bias” in these purchases, as they concentrate in neighborhoods historically populated by ethnic Chinese. Exploiting their temporal and spatial variation, we find that these capital inflows raise local employment, with the effect transmitted through a housing net worth channel. However, they displace local lower-income residents. Our results show that real estate capital inflows can both stimulate the real economy and induce gentrification.
summary: 本文研究外国房地产资本流入对美国当地经济的实际影响。利用交易层面数据，作者发现2008年后中国人在美国购房呈现“China shock”现象，且具有“home bias”，集中在历史上华裔聚居区。通过利用时间和空间变化，发现这些资本流入通过住房净值渠道（housing net worth channel）提高了当地就业，但排挤了当地低收入居民。结果表明，房地产资本流入既能刺激实体经济，也会引发绅士化（gentrification）。
ai_comment: 本文利用微观交易数据揭示了外国资本流入的本地经济效应，特别是通过住房净值渠道传导的就业促进与低收入居民排挤并存的现象，为全球化与区域不平等提供了新证据。

title: Option-Implied Dependence and Correlation Risk Premium
abstract: We propose a novel model-free approach to obtain the joint risk-neutral distribution among several assets that is consistent with options on these assets and their weighted index. We implement this approach for the nine industry sectors comprising the S&P 500 index and find that their option-implied dependence is highly asymmetric and time-varying. We then study two conditional correlations: when the market moves down or up. The risk premium is strongly negative for the down correlation but positive for the up correlation. Intuitively, investors dislike the loss of diversification when markets fall, but they actually prefer high correlation when markets rally.
summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的无模型方法，用于获取多个资产的联合风险中性分布，且该分布与这些资产及其加权指数的期权价格一致。作者将该方法应用于构成S&P 500指数的九个行业板块，发现期权隐含的依赖关系具有高度不对称性和时变性。进一步研究两种条件相关性：市场下跌时和市场上涨时的相关性。结果显示，下跌相关性的风险溢价强烈为负，而上涨相关性的风险溢价为正。直观上，投资者不喜欢市场下跌时分散化效应减弱，但在市场上涨时却偏好高相关性。
ai_comment: 本文的亮点在于提出了一种无需模型假设就能从期权价格中提取多资产联合分布的方法，并揭示了相关性风险溢价的非对称性，对资产定价和风险管理有重要启示。

title: Discontinued Positive Feedback Trading and the Decline of Return Predictability
abstract: We show that demand effects generated by institutional frictions can influence systematic return predictability patterns in stocks and mutual funds. Identification relies on a reform to the Morningstar rating system, which we show caused a structural break in style-level positive feedback trading by mutual funds. As a result, momentum-related factors in stocks, as well as performance persistence and the “dumb money effect” in mutual funds, experienced a sharp decline. Consistent with the proposed channel, return predictability declined right after the reform, was limited to the U.S. market, and was concentrated in factors and mutual funds most exposed to the mechanism.
summary: 本文研究机构摩擦产生的需求效应如何影响股票和共同基金的系统性收益可预测性模式。通过利用Morningstar评级系统的改革作为外生冲击，发现该改革导致共同基金在风格层面上的正反馈交易出现结构性断裂。进而，股票的动量相关因子以及共同基金中的业绩持续性和“傻钱效应”均经历了急剧下降。这些下降在改革后立即发生，仅局限于美国市场，并集中体现在最受该机制影响的因子和共同基金中，从而证实了机构摩擦通过正反馈交易渠道影响收益可预测性的因果机制。
ai_comment: 利用外生的评级改革识别因果，为机构摩擦影响市场效率提供了干净证据；同时揭示了动量衰减与基金业绩持续下降的内在联系。

title: Informational Holdup by Venture Capital Syndicates
abstract: We argue that syndicates associate venture capitalists (VCs) with uneven skill levels in order to lower their expected gains from threatening to stop financing: Non-continued participation would send a milder negative signal to alternative financiers. This can explain the empirical observations that i) early-round syndicates regularly associate VCs with different levels of experience and ii) follow-on syndicates often involve none of the early-round VCs. Consistent with the theory, we find empirically that the heterogeneity of VC experience levels in a syndicate is i) negatively related to the extent to which the founders of the VC-backed firm are professionally well connected and ii) positively related to the likelihood of syndicate switching in a later round.
summary: 本文提出，风险投资辛迪加会组合不同技能水平的风险投资机构，以降低他们威胁停止融资的预期收益：非持续参与会向其他融资方发出较弱的负面信号。这可以解释两个实证观察：早期轮次的辛迪加经常组合不同经验水平的风险投资机构，以及后续轮次辛迪加通常不包含早期轮次的风险投资机构。与理论一致，实证研究发现辛迪加中风险投资机构经验的异质性与被投公司创始人的专业网络联系程度负相关，与后期轮次辛迪加更换的概率正相关。
ai_comment: 本文从信息摩擦角度为风险投资辛迪加的结构和动态提供了新颖的理论解释，并通过实证验证了其核心预测。

title: Dynamic Equilibrium with Costly Short-Selling and Lending Market
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of costly stock short-selling and lending market and obtain implications that simultaneously support many empirical regularities related to short-selling. In our model, investors’ belief disagreement leads to shorting demand, whereby short-sellers pay shorting fees to borrow stocks from lenders. Our main novel results are as follows. Short interest is positively related to shorting fee and predicts stock returns negatively. Higher short-selling risk can be associated with lower stock returns and less short-selling activity. Stock volatility is increased under costly short-selling. An application to GameStop episode yields implications consistent with observed patterns.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含昂贵卖空和借贷市场的动态均衡模型，研究卖空行为的经济学含义。模型假设投资者信念分歧产生卖空需求，卖空者需向出借人支付卖空费用。主要发现包括：卖空兴趣与卖空费用正相关，且卖空兴趣对股票收益有负向预测能力；更高的卖空风险可能导致更低的股票收益和更少的卖空活动；卖空成本会加剧股票波动。模型对GameStop事件的案例分析结果与观察到的市场模式一致。
ai_comment: 模型统一解释了多项卖空相关的实证异象，并对GameStop事件提供了理论支持，具有理论与实践价值。

title: Investor Tax Credits and Entrepreneurship: Evidence from U.S. States
