abstract: Angel investor tax credits are used globally to spur high‐growth entrepreneurship. Exploiting their staggered implementation in 31 U.S. states, we find that they increase angel investment yet have no significant impact on entrepreneurial activity. Two mechanisms explain these results: crowding out of alternative financing and low sensitivity of professional investors to tax credits. With a large‐scale survey and a stylized model, we show that low responsiveness among professional angels may reflect the fat‐tailed return distributions that characterize high‐growth startups. The results contrast with evidence that direct subsidies to firms have positive effects, raising concerns about promoting entrepreneurship with investor subsidies.
summary: 该研究利用美国31个州交错实施的天使投资者税收抵免政策，发现这些税收抵免增加了天使投资，但对创业活动（如新企业创建、就业等）没有显著影响。两种机制解释了这一结果：一是税收抵免挤出了替代融资来源（如风险投资）；二是专业投资者对税收抵免的敏感度较低。通过大规模调查和简约模型，研究表明专业天使投资者的低响应可能源于高增长初创企业收益分布的厚尾特征。这一结果与直接补贴企业能产生积极效应的证据形成对比，引发对通过投资者补贴促进创业的担忧。
ai_comment: 该研究利用准自然实验设计严谨识别了投资者税收抵免的因果效应，揭示了其与直接企业补贴效果的显著差异，为创业激励政策设计提供了重要警示。

title: (Re‐)Imag(in)ing Price Trends
abstract: We reconsider trend‐based predictability by employing flexible learning methods to identify price patterns that are highly predictive of returns, as opposed to testing predefined patterns like momentum or reversal. Our predictor data are stock‐level price charts, allowing us to extract the most predictive price patterns using machine learning image analysis techniques. These patterns differ significantly from commonly analyzed trend signals, yield more accurate return predictions, enable more profitable investment strategies, and demonstrate robustness across specifications. Remarkably, they exhibit context independence, as short‐term patterns perform well on longer time scales, and patterns learned from U.S. stocks prove effective in international markets.
summary: 本文重新审视了基于趋势的可预测性，通过灵活的机器学习方法识别对收益具有高度预测性的价格模式，而非预先定义如动量或反转等模式。使用股票层面的价格图表作为预测数据，并运用机器学习图像分析技术提取最具预测力的价格模式。这些模式显著不同于常见的趋势信号，能产生更准确的收益预测，实现更盈利的投资策略，并在不同规格下表现出稳健性。值得注意的是，它们具有上下文独立性：短期模式在更长时间尺度上同样有效，且从美国股票学到的模式在国际市场上也表现出预测能力。
ai_comment: 创新性地将图像分析技术应用于价格模式挖掘，发现了超越传统动量/反转的鲁棒性模式，且跨时间尺度和市场均有效，为技术分析提供了新的方法论视角。

title: Shareholder Monitoring through Voting: New Evidence from Proxy Contests
abstract: We present the first comprehensive study of mutual fund voting in proxy contests. Among contests where voting takes place, passive funds are 10 percentage points less likely than active funds to vote for dissidents. The gap shrinks significantly when accounting for votes withheld from management nominees, settled contests, and votes by non-“Big-Three” fund families. Passive and active funds are equally informed about firm fundamentals, although passive funds view contest-related SEC filings more often than active funds during contests, in absolute levels and incrementally relative to noncontest periods. We conclude that passive funds are engaged shareholders in high-stakes voting events. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文首次对委托书争夺中共同基金的投票行为进行全面研究。在发生投票的争夺中，被动基金投票支持异议者的可能性比主动基金低10个百分点。当考虑对管理层提名人的弃权票、和解争夺以及非“三大”基金家族的投票时，这一差距显著缩小。被动基金和主动基金在公司基本面方面的信息掌握程度相当，但在争夺期间，被动基金查看争夺相关SEC文件的频率高于主动基金（绝对水平和相对于非争夺时期的增量）。结论是被动基金在高风险投票事件中是积极参与的股东。
ai_comment: 通过区分被动与主动基金在委托书争夺中的投票差异，细致地修正了以往认为被动基金消极的刻板印象，并利用SEC文件查看频率等独特数据，为股东积极主义研究提供了新证据。

title: The Rise of Star Firms: Intangible Capital and Competition
abstract: The large divergence in the returns of top-performing star firms and the rest of the economy is substantially reduced when we account for the mismeasurement of intangible capital. Star firms produce and invest more per dollar in invested capital, have more valuable innovations as measured by the market value of patents, and are as exposed to competitive shocks as nonstars. Star firms have higher markups that are predicted early in their life cycle at a time when they are small. Overall, after we correct for the mismeasurement of intangibles, the evidence points to the superior ability of star firms.
summary: 本文研究明星企业（star firms）与其余企业在回报上的巨大差异，通过调整无形资产（intangible capital）的测量误差，发现这一差异大幅缩小。明星企业每单位投资资本产生更多产出和投资，其创新价值（以专利市场价值衡量）更高，且对竞争冲击的暴露程度与非明星企业相同。明星企业拥有更高的加成率（markups），且在其生命周期早期（规模较小时）即可预测。总体而言，纠正无形资产测量问题后，证据指向明星企业的卓越能力。
ai_comment: 该研究通过纠正无形资产的测量误差，重新审视了明星企业与经济整体的回报差异，揭示了无形资本在解释企业异质性和竞争动态中的关键作用。

title: Diverse Hedge Funds
abstract: Hedge fund teams with heterogeneous educational backgrounds, academic specializations, work experiences, genders, and races, outperform homogeneous teams after adjusting for risk and fund characteristics. An event study of manager team transitions, instrumental variable regressions, and an analysis of managers who simultaneously operate solo- and team-managed funds address endogeneity concerns. Diverse teams deliver superior returns by arbitraging more stock anomalies, avoiding behavioral biases, and minimizing downside risks. Moreover, diversity allows hedge funds to circumvent capacity constraints and generate persistent performance. Our results suggest that diversity adds value in asset management. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 该论文研究了对冲基金团队多样性（教育背景、专业领域、工作经验、性别、种族）对基金业绩的影响。通过调整风险和基金特征后，发现多样性团队表现优于同质团队。为处理内生性问题，采用了经理团队变更的事件研究、工具变量回归以及分析同时管理个人和团队基金的经理。多样性团队通过套利更多股票异常、避免行为偏差以及降低下行风险来获得超额收益。此外，多样性帮助对冲基金规避容量限制并产生持续业绩。结果表明多样性在资产管理中具有价值。
ai_comment: 论文通过多种因果识别方法证明了团队多样性对业绩的促进作用，为资产管理行业的人力资本配置提供了重要启示。

title: Seller Debt in Acquisitions of Private Firms: A Security Design Approach
abstract: We propose a security design model in which a potential acquirer approaches a firm with a value-add plan. The target has a single owner, who possesses private information: he alone knows whether his firm is compatible with the plan. The owner agrees that the acquirer will add value but believes that the value-add will not be as much as what the acquirer expects. Although the acquirer can choose any monotone limited liability security to offer along with cash, we show that, under general conditions, any security that is employed always takes the form of nonrecourse debt provided by the seller. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文提出一个证券设计模型，其中潜在收购方接触一家具有增值计划的私人公司。目标公司由单一所有者控制，该所有者拥有私人信息：他知晓自己的公司是否与收购方的增值计划兼容。所有者同意收购方能增加价值，但认为增值幅度低于收购方的预期。尽管收购方可以选择任何单调有限责任证券与现金一起提供，但模型表明，在一般条件下，任何被采用的证券都表现为卖方提供的无追索权债务。论文提供了互联网附录。
ai_comment: 该论文通过理论模型揭示了在信息不对称下，卖方无追索权债务作为最优融资工具的机制，为私人企业收购中的证券设计提供了新见解。

title: Reciprocity in Corporate Tax Compliance—Evidence from Ozone Pollution
abstract: In a tax—public goods reciprocity framework between citizens and the state, managers view taxes as a payment to the government in exchange for public goods, and hence they adjust their willingness to pay taxes as public good quality changes. We show that corporate tax planning intensity increases with ground‐level ozone pollution. Revisions in ozone pollution regulations cause counties that failed the revised and more stringent standards to reduce ozone pollution. Consequently, firms headquartered in these counties reduced corporate tax planning intensity relative to firms in other counties. The ozone‐tax link varies in the predicted directions with public attention to pollution, potential welfare loss due to ozone, managers’ stakeholder orientation, taxpayers’ polluting status, political preferences, and civic norms. We also find consistent results for Superfund cleanups of hazardous waste sites. Our research sheds light on reciprocity as a potential mechanism influencing corporate tax compliance.
summary: 本文在公民与国家之间的税收-公共物品互惠框架下，将管理者对税收的认知视为对政府提供公共物品的支付，从而随公共物品质量变化调整纳税意愿。利用美国地面臭氧污染数据，研究发现企业税务规划强度随臭氧污染水平上升而增加。臭氧污染法规修订导致未达到更严格标准的县减少臭氧污染，这些县的企业税务规划强度相对其他县下降。臭氧-税收关系在预测方向上受公众对污染的关注、臭氧潜在福利损失、管理者利益相关者导向、纳税人污染状态、政治偏好和公民规范的影响。在超级基金清理有害废物站点中也得到一致结果。研究揭示了互惠作为影响企业税务合规的潜在机制。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地将环境政策与公司税务行为联系起来，为税收互惠假说提供了大样本经验证据。

title: Cross-Selling in Bank-Household Relationships: Mechanisms and Implications for Pricing
abstract: We show that banks cross-sell future deposits and loans to existing household depositors. A bank is 20-percentage-points more likely to sell a loan to an existing depositor than to an otherwise comparable household. Existing depositors pay a premium when borrowing, and we find no indication that banks obtain an informational advantage on such borrowers, suggesting that the cross-selling is driven more by demand than by supply complementarities. These demand complementarities are in turn driven more by stickiness rather than by unobserved persistent preferences. Finally, banks internalize future cross-selling potential when setting deposit rates. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文研究银行与家庭客户关系中的交叉销售行为，发现银行向现有家庭存款客户销售贷款的概率比向其他可比家庭高出20个百分点。现有存款人在借款时需支付溢价，但银行并未因此获得信息优势，表明交叉销售更多由需求互补性（而非供给互补性）驱动。进一步分析显示，需求互补性主要由客户粘性（而非未观察到的持久偏好）解释。此外，银行在设定存款利率时会内化未来的交叉销售潜力。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证揭示了银行向现有存款人交叉销售贷款的机制，并指出需求互补性（特别是粘性）是主要驱动因素，对银行定价策略有重要启示。

title: Complex Asset Markets
abstract: Investors' individual arbitrage models introduce idiosyncratic risk into complex asset strategies, driving up average returns and Sharpe ratios. However, despite the attractive risk‐return trade‐off, participation is limited. This is because effective Sharpe ratios in complex asset markets vary with investors' expertise. Investors with higher expertise, better models, and lower resulting idiosyncratic risk exposures realize higher Sharpe ratios. Their demand deters entry by less sophisticated investors. As predicted by our model, market dislocations are characterized by an increase in idiosyncratic risk, investor exit, and persistently elevated alphas and Sharpe ratios. The selection effect from higher expertise agents' more favorable Sharpe ratios is unique to our model and key to our main results.
summary: 本文研究复杂资产市场中投资者异质套利模型的影响。由于每个投资者使用不同的套利模型，这会引入异质风险，从而推高复杂资产策略的平均收益和夏普比率。然而，尽管风险收益权衡具有吸引力，但参与该市场的投资者数量有限，因为有效夏普比率随投资者专业水平而变化：专业水平高、模型更优的投资者面临较低的异质风险暴露，从而获得更高的夏普比率，他们的需求抑制了不成熟投资者的进入。模型预测，市场混乱时异质风险增加、投资者退出，且阿尔法和夏普比率持续处于高位。关键结论是，高专业水平投资者带来的选择效应（即他们实现更优夏普比率）是模型独有且驱动主要结果的核心机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入投资者模型异质性，为复杂资产市场中高收益与低参与并存的现象提供了新解释，凸显了选择效应的关键作用。

title: Do Governments Hide Resources from Unions? The Influence of Public Sector Unions on Reported Discretionary Fund Balance Ratios
abstract: We explore whether municipalities with public sector unions exploit aspects of governmental (or “fund”) accounting to obscure the availability of discretionary resources in fund balance accounts, relative to municipalities without public sector unions. We first investigate whether governments with unions report higher proportions of discretionary resources outside of the general fund, a primary measure of financial health, and instead within less prominent fund types. Second, we explore whether governments with unions report lower ratios within accessible general fund balance account categories – that is, report lower proportions of unreserved fund balance. Primary findings are consistent with both hypotheses. Although somewhat mixed, cross‐sectional analyses reveal that effects are magnified when unions have more bargaining power, as proxied by the ability to strike or the absence of state right‐to‐work laws. Further analysis corroborates cross‐sectional findings by examining difference‐in‐differences specifications surrounding the quasi‐exogenous shock of Wisconsin's 2011 weakening of state public sector union laws and Ohio's time‐varying union contract negotiations. Overall, the evidence suggests that governments with unions shelter resources to avoid the appearance of large discretionary amounts available.
summary: 本文研究市政当局中公共部门工会的存在是否影响基金会计报告，从而隐藏可自由支配资源。首先，发现有工会的政府更倾向于将可自由支配资源报告在总基金之外（如较少突出的基金类型），而非总基金内。其次，这些政府报告的总基金内无保留基金余额比例更低。主要结果支持这两个假设。横截面分析显示，当工会议价能力更强（如罢工权或缺乏州工作权利法）时，效应更显著。进一步通过威斯康星州2011年削弱工会法律的准外生冲击和俄亥俄州随时间变化的工会合同谈判，采用双重差分法验证了横截面发现。总体证据表明，有工会的政府隐藏资源以避免显得拥有大量可自由支配资金。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地结合公共部门工会与会计信息披露，通过多重实证方法揭示了政府隐藏资源的动机，对公共财政和治理研究有重要贡献。

title: The Financially Material Effects of Mandatory Nonfinancial Disclosure
abstract: Complaints from institutional investors suggest that principles‐based disclosure regimes that rely on financial materiality standards produce inadequate nonfinancial environmental and social (E&S) information. Using the staggered introduction of 40 country‐level regulations that mandate disclosure, I document that reporting E&S information relates to increased investment from institutional owners and has material effects on firms’ investment and financing decisions. Firms mandated to disclose E&S information allocate more investment toward long‐term, innovative projects and raise more equity capital. Evidence indicates that disclosure attracts long‐term–oriented institutional clientele with E&S preferences, which then feeds back on firm decision making. Although the effects of nonfinancial disclosure are similar to those of improved financial disclosure, this clientele mechanism is unique. Taken together, these results suggest that jurisdictions that rely solely on financial materiality disclosure standards create nonfinancial information frictions with material effects on investors and firm decision making.
summary: 本文研究强制非财务披露法规对机构投资者和企业决策的财务实质性影响。利用40个国家逐步引入强制披露法规的准自然实验，发现强制披露环境和社会（E&S）信息能显著增加机构投资者的投资，并引导企业将更多投资转向长期创新项目、增加股权融资。机制表明，披露吸引了具有E&S偏好的长期机构投资者，这些投资者的反馈效应进一步影响企业决策。结果表明，仅依赖财务实质性的披露原则会导致非财务信息摩擦，对投资者和企业产生实质影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过跨国法规差异识别了非财务披露的因果效应，揭示了其通过改变投资者结构影响企业决策的独特机制，为披露标准设计提供了重要政策启示。

title: Contracting Costs, Covenant-Lite Lending, and Reputational Capital
abstract: Using a large sample of leveraged loans, we provide evidence that, despite having fewer creditor control rights, covenant-lite (Cov-Lite) loans have similar recovery rates and significantly lower spreads than loans with maintenance covenants. We find that the propensity to borrow Cov-Lite is related to various proxies for the reputational capital of a borrowing firm’s private equity sponsor. We construct a simple model to illustrate the relationship between reputational capital, covenants, and loan spreads in the leveraged loan market. Our model illustrates how reputational capital can substitute for covenants in mitigating agency costs of debt, leading to lower loan spreads for Cov-Lite loans.
summary: 本文使用大样本杠杆贷款数据，发现尽管契约宽松（Covenant-Lite, Cov-Lite）贷款赋予债权人更少的控制权，但其回收率与包含维护契约的贷款相似，且利差显著更低。借款人采用Cov-Lite贷款的倾向与借款公司的私募股权（PE）发起人的声誉资本代理变量相关。作者构建了一个简单模型，阐述杠杆贷款市场中声誉资本、契约和贷款利差之间的关系，表明声誉资本可以替代契约来缓解债务的代理成本，从而降低Cov-Lite贷款的利差。
ai_comment: 本文将声誉资本引入债务契约设计，为Cov-Lite贷款的较低利差提供了新颖的理论解释，具有重要的实践和理论意义。

title: The Changing Economics of Knowledge Production
abstract: Big data technologies change the way in which data and labor combine to create knowledge. Is this a modest innovation or a data revolution? Using hiring and wage data, we estimate firms’ data stocks and their knowledge production functions. Quantifying changes in production functions informs us about the likely long-run changes in output, in factor shares, and in the distribution of income, due to big data technologies. For the investment management industry, our structural estimates predict a 5% decline in the labor share of income; that change is comparable to similar estimates for the industrial revolution. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文研究大数据技术如何改变数据与劳动力结合以创造知识的方式。通过使用招聘和工资数据，作者估计了企业的数据存量及其知识生产函数，并量化了生产函数的变化，以揭示大数据技术对产出、要素份额和收入分配的长期影响。以投资管理行业为例，结构估计预测劳动收入份额将下降5%，这一变化幅度与工业革命时期的估计相当。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用微观数据估计知识生产函数，量化技术进步对收入分配的影响，为理解大数据经济效应提供了严谨的实证证据。

title: Keep Calm and Bank On: Panic-Driven Bank Runs and the Role of Public Communication
abstract: Using a survey with information treatments conducted in the aftermath of SVB's collapse, we study households' perspectives on bank stability, the potential for panic-driven bank runs, and the role of public communication. When informed about SVB's collapse, households become more likely to withdraw deposits, due to both a higher perceived risk of bank failure and higher expected losses on deposits in case of bank failure. Leveraging hypothetical questions and the exogenous variation in beliefs generated by the information treatments, we show that households reallocate deposit withdrawals primarily into other banks and cash, with little passthrough into spending. Information about FDIC insurance and communication about bank stability by the Federal Reserve can reassure depositors, while communication from political leaders only influences their electoral base.
summary: 在美国硅谷银行（SVB）倒闭后，通过一项包含信息处理的调查，研究家庭对银行稳定性的看法、恐慌性银行挤兑的可能性以及公共沟通的作用。当被告知SVB倒闭时，家庭更可能提取存款，原因是他们感知到更高的银行倒闭风险和更大的存款预期损失。家庭主要将提取的存款重新配置到其他银行和现金，很少转化为支出。关于联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）保险的信息和美联储关于银行稳定性的沟通能够安抚储户，而政治领导人的沟通只影响其选举基础。
ai_comment: 该研究通过实验方法揭示了不同沟通渠道对储户行为的差异化影响，强调了FDIC保险和美联储沟通在稳定银行体系中的关键作用，为危机管理提供了实证依据。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Scientific Discovery: A Model of Prioritized Search
abstract: We model a key step in the innovation process, hypothesis generation, as the making of predictions over a vast combinatorial space. Traditionally, scientists and innovators use theory or intuition to guide their search. Increasingly, however, they use artificial intelligence (AI) instead. We model innovation as resulting from sequential search over a combinatorial design space, where the prioritization of costly tests is achieved using a predictive model. The predictive model's ranked output is represented as a hazard function. Discrete survival analysis is used to obtain the main innovation outcomes of interest – the probability of innovation, expected search duration, and expected profit. We describe conditions under which shifting from the traditional method of hypothesis generation, using theory or intuition, to instead using AI that generates higher fidelity predictions, results in a higher likelihood of successful innovation, shorter search durations, and higher expected profits. We then explore the complementarity between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing; potential gains from AI may not be realized without significant investment in testing capacity. We discuss the policy implications.
summary: 该论文将创新过程中的关键步骤——假设生成——建模为在巨大组合空间中进行预测。传统上，科学家和创新者使用理论或直觉来指导搜索，但越来越多地使用人工智能。作者将创新建模为在组合设计空间中的顺序搜索，其中利用预测模型对昂贵测试进行优先级排序。预测模型的排序输出表示为风险函数，通过离散生存分析得到主要创新结果：创新概率、预期搜索时长和预期利润。论文描述了从使用理论或直觉的传统假设生成方法转向使用更高保真度预测的AI时，哪些条件下会导致更高的创新成功概率、更短的搜索时长和更高的预期利润。此外，探讨了假设生成与假设测试之间的互补性——如果没有对测试能力进行大量投资，AI的潜在收益可能无法实现。最后讨论了政策含义。
ai_comment: 该论文通过形式化模型清晰展示了AI在科学发现中的比较优势，并强调了测试能力对实现AI潜力的关键作用，对R&D政策制定具有启发意义。

title: Managing an Energy Shock: Fiscal and Monetary Policy
abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic effects of energy price shocks in energy-importing economies using a heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model. When MPCs are realistically large and the elasticity of substitution between energy and domestic goods is realistically low, increases in energy prices depress real incomes and cause a recession, even if the central bank does not tighten monetary policy. Imported energy inflation can spill over to wage inflation through a wage-price spiral, but this does not mitigate the decline in real wages. Monetary tightening has limited effect on imported inflation when done in isolation, but can be powerful when done in coordination with other energy importers by lowering world energy demand. Fiscal policy, especially energy price subsidies, can isolate individual energy importers from the shock, but it has large negative externalities on other economies.
summary: 本文使用异质性代理人新凯恩斯模型研究能源进口经济体面临能源价格冲击的宏观经济效应。当边际消费倾向（MPC）较大且能源与国内商品之间的替代弹性较低时，能源价格上涨会压低实际收入并引发经济衰退，即使央行不采取紧缩货币政策。进口能源通胀会通过工资-价格螺旋传导至工资通胀，但这并不能缓解实际工资的下降。单独实施货币紧缩对进口通胀影响有限，但若与其他能源进口国协调行动，通过降低全球能源需求则可有效控制通胀。财政政策，尤其是能源价格补贴，能够使单个能源进口国免受冲击，但会对其他经济体产生较大的负外部性。
keywords: 异质性主体新凯恩斯模型
ai_comment: 本文系统分析了财政与货币政策在应对能源冲击中的相互作用及国际协调效应，突出了MPC和替代弹性的关键作用，对政策制定具有重要参考价值。

title: How do Financial Crises Redistribute Risk?
abstract: We examine how financial crises redistribute risk, employing novel empirical methods and micro data from the largest financial crisis of the 20th century -the Great Depression.Using balancesheet and systemic risk measures at the bank level, we build an econometric model with incidental truncation that jointly considers bank survival, the type of bank closure (consolidations, absorption, and failures), and changes to bank risk.Despite roughly 9,000 bank closures, risk did not leave the financial system; instead, it increased.We show that risk was redistributed to banks that were healthier prior to the financial crisis.A key mechanism driving the redistribution of risk was bank acquisition.Each acquisition increases the balance-sheet and systemic risk of the acquiring bank by 25%.Our findings suggest that financial crises do not quickly purge risk from the system, and that merger policies commonly used to deal with troubled financial institutions during crises have important implications for systemic risk.
summary: 本文利用20世纪最大金融危机——大萧条期间的银行层面微观数据，通过构建带有偶然截断的计量模型，综合考虑银行生存、关闭类型（合并、吸收和破产）以及银行风险的变化，研究了金融危机如何重新分配风险。研究发现，尽管约有9000家银行倒闭，但风险并未从金融体系中消失，反而有所增加。风险被重新分配给了那些在危机前更为健康的银行。其中一个关键机制是银行收购：每次收购会使收购银行的资产负债表风险和系统性风险增加25%。这些结果表明，金融危机并不会迅速清除系统中的风险，而危机期间常用于处理问题金融机构的合并政策对系统性风险具有重要影响。
ai_comment: 本文利用大萧条时期的独特微观数据，揭示了金融危机中风险通过银行收购机制向健康银行转移的现象，对危机管理中的合并政策提出了警示。

title: Research and/or Development? Financial Frictions and Innovation Investment
abstract: U.S. firms have reduced their investment in scientific research (“R”) compared to product development (“D”), raising questions about the returns to each type of investment, and about the reasons for this shift. We use Census data that disaggregates “R” from “D” to study how US firms adjust their innovation investments in response to an external increase in funding cost. Companies with greater demand for refinancing during the 2008 financial crisis, made larger cuts to R&D investment. This reduction in R&D is achieved almost entirely by reducing investment in research. Development remains essentially unchanged. If other firms patenting similar technologies must refinance, however, then Development investment declines. We interpret the latter result as evidence of technological competition: firms are reluctant to cut Development expenditures when that could place them at a disadvantage compared to potential rivals.
summary: 利用美国人口普查数据区分科学研究和产品开发，研究融资成本上升如何影响企业创新投资。在2008年金融危机期间，再融资需求大的公司大幅削减研发投资，且削减几乎全部来自研究，而开发投资基本不变。然而，如果持有相似技术的其他专利公司需要再融资，开发投资也会下降，这表明技术竞争的存在：企业不愿在可能落后于竞争对手时削减开发支出。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地将研发细分为研究和开发，揭示了融资约束对不同创新活动的不对称影响，并引入技术竞争解释开发投资的策略性行为。

title: Treatment Effect Risk: Bounds and Inference
abstract: Because the average treatment effect (ATE) measures the change in social welfare, even if positive, there is a risk of negative effect on, say, some 10% of the population. Assessing such risk is difficult, however, because any one individual treatment effect (ITE) is never observed, so the 10% worst-affected cannot be identified, whereas distributional treatment effects only compare the first deciles within each treatment group, which does not correspond to any 10% subpopulation. In this paper, we consider how to nonetheless assess this important risk measure, formalized as the conditional value at risk (CVaR) of the ITE distribution. We leverage the availability of pretreatment covariates and characterize the tightest possible upper and lower bounds on ITE-CVaR given by the covariate-conditional average treatment effect (CATE) function. We then proceed to study how to estimate these bounds efficiently from data and construct confidence intervals. This is challenging even in randomized experiments as it requires understanding the distribution of the unknown CATE function, which can be very complex if we use rich covariates to best control for heterogeneity. We develop a debiasing method that overcomes this and prove it enjoys favorable statistical properties even when CATE and other nuisances are estimated by black box machine learning or even inconsistently. Studying a hypothetical change to French job search counseling services, our bounds and inference demonstrate a small social benefit entails a negative impact on a substantial subpopulation. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: This work was supported by the Division of Information and Intelligent Systems [Grant 1939704]. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4819 .
summary: 本文聚焦于平均处理效应（ATE）为正时，仍可能对特定子群体（如最差的10%）产生负面效应的风险评估。由于个体处理效应（ITE）不可观测，无法直接识别受影响最严重的子群体，而传统分布处理效应仅比较各组内分位数，不对应实际子总体。作者利用预处理协变量，推导出由协变量条件平均处理效应（CATE）函数给出的ITE条件风险价值（CVaR）的最紧上下界，并进一步研究如何高效估计这些界限并构建置信区间。即使在随机实验中，由于需要理解复杂的CATE函数分布（尤其当使用丰富协变量时），估计仍具挑战。作者提出一种去偏方法，即使在CATE及其他干扰项由黑箱机器学习估计甚至不一致估计时，也能保证良好的统计性质。通过对法国求职咨询服务的假设性变化进行实证分析，发现小的社会收益伴随着对大量子群体的负面影响。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将金融风险度量工具CVaR引入因果推断，为评估处理效应的个体异质性风险提供了严谨的统计推断框架，且方法适用于复杂机器学习模型，实用性强。

title: The Impact of Management on Clinical Performance: Evidence from Physician Practice Management Companies
abstract: Mergers and acquisitions in healthcare are increasingly leading to changes in firm management. This paper studies how a change in firm management impacts clinical performance using data on an understudied phenomenon: medical practice acquisitions by physician practice management companies (PPMCs). PPMCs market themselves as offloading the administrative burden of running a medical practice without compromising physician autonomy over clinical decisions. However, a PPMC’s management strategy and practices, such as performance monitoring and financial incentives, could influence physician behavior. For example, some PPMCs advertise increasing revenue through better financial management, whereas others also advertise improving quality through better clinical management. In this paper, I collect data on three large PPMCs that manage the practices of more than 40% of obstetricians and gynecologists (Ob-Gyns) in Florida between 2006 and 2014. An Ob-Gyn’s main clinical decision in childbirth involves a tradeoff between financial and clinical outcomes: cesarean sections (C-sections) are often more highly reimbursed than vaginal births but pose risks to maternal and infant health when not medically necessary. Using difference-in-differences methods, I find heterogeneous effects on C-sections depending on a PPMC’s publicized management strategy. Physicians acquired by PPMCs that focus on financial management increase the use of C-sections, resulting in less clinically appropriate care and worse patient outcomes. The opposite result is found when PPMCs focus on clinical management. I provide qualitative and quantitative evidence that differences in firm management are the most likely driver of changes in C-sections. This paper informs how the corporatization of medicine can alter clinical performance outcomes. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Funding: This project was supported by grants from the Agency for Healthcare Research (AHRQ), the National Science Foundation (NSF), and Wharton’s Mack Institute for Innovation [Mack Institute Research Fellowship]. The analysis was conducted using data from the State of Florida’s Agency for Healthcare Administration (AHCA). The content is solely the responsibility of the author and does not necessarily represent the official views of AHRQ, NSF, Mack Institute, or AHCA. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4571 .
summary: 本文研究医生执业管理公司 (PPMC) 收购医疗实践后，其管理策略如何影响临床绩效。利用 2006-2014 年佛罗里达州三家大型 PPMC 的数据，这些公司管理着超过 40% 的产科和妇科医生 (Ob-Gyns)。产科医生面临的主要临床决策是剖宫产与阴道分娩之间的权衡：剖宫产报销更高，但非必要时会危害母婴健康。采用双重差分方法，发现效果因 PPMC 公开的管理策略而异：专注于财务管理的 PPMC 导致剖宫产率上升，从而降低临床适宜性和患者预后；而专注于临床管理的 PPMC 则产生相反效果。定性和定量证据表明，公司管理差异是剖宫产变化的最可能驱动因素。该研究揭示了医疗公司化如何改变临床绩效。
ai_comment: 该论文通过实证区分了不同管理策略对临床结果的异质性影响，为医疗管理变革的绩效后果提供了新证据。

title: Financing the litigation arms race
abstract: Using a dynamic real-option model of litigation, we show that the increasingly popular practice of third-party litigation financing has ambiguous implications for total ex-post litigant surplus. A defendant and a plaintiff bargain over a settlement payment. The defendant takes costly actions to avoid deadweight losses associated with large transfers to the plaintiff. Litigation financing bolsters the plaintiff, leading to larger deadweight losses. However, by endogenously deterring the defendant from taking costly actions, litigation financing can nonetheless improve the joint surplus of the plaintiff and defendant. In contrast to popular opinion, litigation financing does not necessarily encourage high-risk frivolous lawsuits.
summary: 这篇论文利用动态实物期权诉讼模型，分析了第三方诉讼融资对事後诉讼总盈余的复杂影响。模型设定被告与原告就和解支付进行谈判，被告需采取代价高昂的行动以避免因向原告支付大额转移支付而产生的无谓损失。研究发现，第三方诉讼融资在增强原告谈判地位的同时，会加剧无谓损失；然而，这种融资方式可以通过内生地阻止被告采取代价高昂的行动，反而改善原告与被告的联合盈余。此外，与普遍观点相反，第三方诉讼融资并不必然鼓励高风险的无谓诉讼。
ai_comment: 论文通过动态模型揭示了第三方诉讼融资的权衡效应，挑战了其必然引发滥诉的传统看法，为理解诉讼融资的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Economic uncertainty and investor attention
abstract: This paper develops a multi-firm equilibrium model of information acquisition based on differences in firms’ characteristics. The model shows that heightened economic uncertainty amplifies stock price reactions to earnings announcements via increased investor attention, which varies by firm characteristics. Firms with higher systematic risk or more informative announcements attract more attention and exhibit stronger reactions to earnings announcements. Moreover, heightened investor attention caused by high economic uncertainty leads to a steeper CAPM relation and higher betas for announcing firms. Empirical analyses using firm-level attention measures and CAPM tests on high- versus low-attention days support the model’s predictions.
summary: 本文构建了一个基于公司特征差异的多公司均衡信息获取模型。模型表明，经济不确定性加剧通过提高投资者注意力放大股票价格对盈利公告的反应，且这种效应因公司特征而异。具体而言，具有更高系统性风险或提供更丰富信息的公司会吸引更多投资者注意力，并对盈利公告表现出更强的价格反应。此外，高经济不确定性导致的投资者注意力增加会使得CAPM关系更陡峭，并提高公告公司的贝塔值。利用公司层面的注意力度量和基于高注意力日与低注意力日的CAPM检验，实证结果支持了模型的预测。
ai_comment: 该文将投资者注意力异质性引入资产定价模型，从理论上解释了经济不确定性如何通过注意力渠道影响股价反应，为理解市场对宏观信息的反应提供了新视角。

title: Firm-bank linkages and optimal policies after a rare disaster
abstract: We study optimal government support following a rare disaster that creates heterogeneous firm liquidity needs. Firms’ increase in debt reduces their output due to moral hazard. Banks are subject to a minimum capital requirement that limits deposit insurance costs upon bad aggregate shocks. Without government support, firms’ moral hazard and banks’ funding frictions reinforce each other amplifying output losses. Optimal support is implemented with firm-specific transfers combined with the provision of aggregate risk insurance through a capital requirement relaxation and a public preferred equity stake in banks. Our results shed light on suboptimality features in the actual policy responses to Covid-19 lockdowns.
summary: 本文研究在罕见灾难（如COVID-19疫情）后，针对企业流动性需求异质性，政府如何实施最优支持政策。模型中，企业增加债务会因道德风险降低产出；银行面临最低资本要求，以限制不良宏观冲击下的存款保险成本。无政府支持时，企业的道德风险与银行的融资摩擦相互强化，放大产出损失。最优支持政策结合了企业特定转移支付，以及通过放松资本要求和向银行提供公共优先股来提供总体风险保险。研究发现，实际政策应对COVID-19封锁时存在次优特征。
ai_comment: 论文构建了罕见灾害后企业与银行互动的宏观金融模型，为疫情中政策评估提供了理论框架。

title: Angel investment and first impressions
abstract: We examine the role of first impressions in angel investor decision-making. Video stills of entrepreneurs pitching on the Shark Tank show and in Startup Battlefield competitions yield six measures of first impressions of entrepreneurs’ facial traits and two principal components: one that captures general ability and the other that contrasts charm and managerial ability. We find positive associations between both components and the likelihood of entrepreneurs receiving an investment offer or winning a competition round. Post-event business outcome analyses reveal that investors internalize entrepreneurs’ general ability rationally but exhibit irrational tendencies when internalizing entrepreneurs’ charm and managerial ability. Investment experience mitigates investors’ irrational use of charm and managerial ability cues.
summary: 本文研究第一印象在天使投资决策中的作用。通过截取《Shark Tank》和Startup Battlefield竞赛中企业家演讲的视频静态图像，获得关于企业家面部特征的六项第一印象指标，并提取两个主成分：一个捕捉一般能力，另一个对比魅力与管理能力。研究发现，这两个成分与企业家获得投资邀约或赢得竞赛轮次的概率正相关。后续业务成果分析表明，投资者在吸收企业家的“一般能力”时是理性的，但在吸收“魅力与管理能力”时表现出非理性倾向；投资经验能够减轻投资者对魅力与管理能力线索的非理性使用。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用视频静态图像量化第一印象，并区分理性的能力判断与非理性的魅力判断，为天使投资决策中的认知偏差提供了新颖证据。

title: Loan guarantees, bank underwriting policies and financial stability
abstract: Loan guarantees represent a form of government intervention to support bank lending. However, their use raises concerns as to their effect on bank risk-taking incentives. In a model of financial fragility that incorporates bank capital and a bank incentive problem, we show that loan guarantees reduce depositor runs and improve bank underwriting standards, except for the most poorly capitalized banks. We highlight a novel feedback effect between banks’ underwriting choices and depositors’ run decisions, and show that the effect of loan guarantees on banks’ incentives is different from that of other types of guarantees, such as deposit insurance.
summary: 本文通过构建一个包含银行资本和银行激励问题的金融脆弱性模型，研究贷款担保对银行风险承担动机的影响。模型发现，贷款担保减少了存款人挤兑，并改善了银行的承销标准，但这一效应不适用于资本化程度最差的银行。论文还强调了银行承销选择与存款人挤兑决策之间的反馈效应，并指出贷款担保对银行激励的影响与其他类型的担保（如存款保险）不同。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了贷款担保对银行风险承担动机的异质性影响，并区分了与存款保险的不同机制，为政策制定提供了重要启示。

title: Implicit guarantees and the rise of shadow banking: The case of trust products
abstract: Implicit guarantees provided by financial intermediaries are a key component of China's shadow banking sector. We show theoretically that project screening by intermediaries, accompanied by their implicit guarantees to investors, can be the second-best arrangement and mitigate capital misallocation that favors state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Using a dataset of trusts’ investment products, we find, consistent with our model, that ex ante expected yields reflect borrower risks and implicit guarantee strength, and risk sensitivity is reduced by strong guarantees. Regulations in 2018 restricting implicit guarantees lead to a weaker relationship between yield spread and guarantee strength, and more credit rationing of non-SOEs.
summary: 本文研究了金融中介提供的隐性担保在中国影子银行中的关键作用。理论模型表明，中介的项目筛选伴随对投资者的隐性担保可以成为次优安排，有助于缓解偏向国有企业的资本错配。利用信托投资产品数据集，实证结果与模型一致：事前预期收益率反映借款人风险和隐性担保强度，且强担保降低了风险敏感性。2018年限制隐性担保的监管导致收益率差与担保强度之间的关系减弱，并加剧了对非国有企业的信贷配给。
ai_comment: 该论文结合理论与实证，系统揭示了隐性担保在中国影子银行中的作用机制，并评估了监管政策的影响，对理解中国金融体系有重要贡献。

title: Market power in wholesale funding: A structural perspective from the triparty repo market
abstract: I model and structurally estimate the equilibrium rates and volume in the Triparty repo market to study imperfect competition in wholesale funding. Even in this systemically important market, where seemingly homogeneous repos trade, I document persistent rate differences paid by dealers. I characterize the Triparty market as cash-lenders allocating their portfolios among differentiated dealers who set repo rates. I find that cash-lenders’ aversion to portfolio concentration and preference for stable lending grant dealers substantial market power: between 2011 and 2017, dealers borrowed at rates that were 26 bps lower than their marginal value from intermediating the borrowed repo funds. Dealers’ market power makes the observed wholesale repo rate understate the financing rate available to market participants who rely on repo funding, and offers a novel explanation for funding spreads such as the Treasury cash-futures basis and the Treasury swap spread.
summary: 本文通过结构模型估计了三边回购市场的均衡利率和成交量，研究批发融资中的不完全竞争。即使在这个系统重要性市场中，交易商之间也存在持久的利率差异。模型将三边回购市场描述为现金贷款人在差异化交易商之间分配投资组合，交易商设定回购利率。研究发现，现金贷款人对投资组合集中的厌恶以及对稳定贷款的偏好赋予交易商显著的市场势力：2011至2017年间，交易商的借款利率比其中介回购资金的边际价值低26个基点。交易商的市场势力导致观察到的批发回购利率低估了依赖回购融资的市场参与者的融资成本，为国债现金-期货基差和国债互换利差等融资利差提供了新的解释。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地运用结构模型量化了回购市场中的市场势力，并揭示了其对利率解读的重要影响，为理解批发融资成本偏差提供了新视角。

title: Can the changes in fundamentals explain the attenuation of anomalies?
abstract: The existing literature attributes the recent decay of stock market anomalies to increased arbitrage activities (e.g., Chordia, Subrahmanyam, and Tong, 2014; McLean and Pontiff, 2016; Green, Hand, and Zhang, 2017). In this paper, we present evidence that the apparent demise of several prominent classes of stock market anomalies is better explained by changes in underlying fundamentals. The attenuation of anomalies in the Momentum, Investment, and Profitability categories are accompanied by a reduced difference in fundamental performance between the long- and short-leg portfolios, as measured by the fundamental return from a two-capital investment CAPM. After accounting for the change in fundamental return, the attenuation of Investment and Profitability anomalies decreases to statistically insignificant levels. These results are consistent with the q-theory of investment, which attributes the attenuation of stock returns and fundamental returns of anomalies to the time variation in discount rates implied by fundamentals. We also show that neither academic publication nor proxies for increased arbitrage activities can explain the attenuation of these anomalies.
summary: 已有文献将股票市场异象的衰减归因于套利活动增加，但本文提出新证据表明，动量、投资和盈利类异象的衰减主要由基础面变化解释。通过两资本投资CAPM衡量多空组合的基本面回报差异，发现异象衰减伴随该差异缩小。控制基本面回报变化后，投资和盈利异象的衰减在统计上不显著，与q理论一致——即异象回报与基本面回报的衰减源于基础面隐含贴现率的时变。此外，学术发表和套利活动代理变量均无法解释这些异象的衰减。
ai_comment: 该文挑战了异象衰减的主流解释，从基础面角度结合q理论提供了新机制，对理解市场效率和异象演化有重要意义。

title: The Big Three and board gender diversity: The effectiveness of shareholder voice
abstract: In 2017, “The Big Three” institutional investors launched campaigns to increase gender diversity on corporate boards. We estimate that their campaigns led American corporations to add at least 2.5 times as many female directors in 2019 as they had in 2016. Firms increased diversity by identifying candidates beyond managers’ existing networks and by placing less emphasis on candidates’ executive experience. Firms also promoted more female directors to key board positions, indicating firms’ responses went beyond tokenism. Our results highlight index investors’ ability to effectuate broad-based governance changes and the impact of investor buy-in in increasing corporate-leadership diversity.
summary: 本文研究“三大”机构投资者（The Big Three）在2017年发起的增加董事会性别多样性的运动。研究发现，该运动导致美国公司在2019年新增的女性董事数量至少是2016年的2.5倍。公司通过扩大候选人网络（超越管理层现有关系）以及降低对候选人高管经验的要求来增加多样性。此外，公司还将更多女性董事提拔至关键董事会职位，表明公司的回应并非象征性的。结果凸显了指数投资者能够推动广泛的治理变革，以及投资者支持对企业领导多样性增长的影响。
ai_comment: 该研究通过分析“三大”机构投资者的积极行动，为股东声音如何有效促进公司治理变革提供了有力证据，揭示了指数投资者在推动企业领导层多样性中的关键作用。

title: Who Mismanages Student Loans, and Why?
abstract: Many financially distressed students who qualify for federal assistance plans with interest moratorium and principal forgiveness instead accrue interest over long periods of nonpayment. This loan mismanagement is associated with higher delinquency. Mismanagement varies significantly across student gender and race: it is more prominent among male and non-white students. Mismanagement also varies across loan servicers, depending on proxies for student-adverse servicer policies. We consider explanations based on student selection and servicer treatment for loan mismanagement. Student financial literacy plays an important role but variation in treatment on the part of loan servicers appears more important. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 许多符合联邦援助计划（提供利息暂停和本金减免）的财务困难学生，却长期处于非还款状态并累积利息，这种贷款管理不善与更高的违约率相关。管理不善在性别和种族间差异显著：男性与非白人学生中更为突出。不同贷款服务商之间的管理不善程度也因服务商对学生不利的政策代理变量而异。研究考虑了基于学生选择和服务商处理两种解释，发现学生金融素养虽重要，但贷款服务商处理方式的差异更为关键。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了贷款服务商行为对学生贷款违约的重要影响，超越了传统的借款人特征分析，为政策干预提供了新视角。

title: Pledgeability and Asset Prices: Evidence from the Chinese Corporate Bond Markets
abstract: We provide causal evidence on the value of asset pledgeability by exploiting a unique feature of Chinese corporate bond markets: bonds with identical fundamentals are traded on two segmented markets with different rules for repo transactions. Using a policy shock that rendered AA+ and AA bonds ineligible for repo on one market only, we compare how bond prices changed across markets and rating classes around this event. When the haircut increases from 0% to 100%, bond yields increase by 39 bps to 85 bps. These estimates help us infer the magnitude of the shadow cost of capital in China.
summary: 本文利用中国公司债券市场的一个独特特征——相同基础的债券在两个分割市场交易，且回购交易规则不同，为资产可质押性的价值提供了因果证据。通过一个政策冲击，AA+和AA级债券在一个市场上不再符合回购条件（折扣率从0%变为100%），作者比较了事件前后不同市场和评级等级之间的债券价格变化。研究发现，当折扣率从0%增加到100%时，债券收益率上升了39到85个基点。这些估计有助于推断中国影子资本成本的规模。
ai_comment: 本文利用市场分割和政策冲击的准自然实验，创新性地量化了资产可质押性对债券价格的影响，为理解中国金融市场中的影子资本成本提供了重要实证。

title: Dynamic Contracting with Intermediation: Operational, Governance, and Financial Engineering
abstract: Private equity funds intermediate investment and affect portfolio firm performance by actively engaging in operational, governance, and financial engineering. We study this type of intermediation in a dynamic agency model in which an active intermediary raises funds from outside investors and invests in a firm run by an agent. Optimal contracting addresses moral hazard at the intermediary and firm levels. The intermediary's incentives to affect firm performance are strongest after poor performance, while the agent's incentives are strongest after good performance. We also show how financial engineering, that is, financial contracting with outside investors, interacts with operational and governance engineering.
summary: 本文研究了私募股权基金作为活跃中介，通过运营工程、治理工程和金融工程影响组合公司绩效的机制。作者构建了一个动态委托代理模型，其中活跃中介从外部投资者筹集资金并投资于由代理人经营的公司。最优契约设计需要同时解决中介和公司层面的道德风险问题。研究发现，中介在业绩表现差时对影响公司绩效的激励最强，而代理人则在业绩表现好时激励最强。此外，金融工程（即与外部投资者的金融契约）与运营工程和治理工程之间存在交互作用。
ai_comment: 该论文整合了运营、治理与金融三类工程在动态契约中的作用，揭示了中介与代理人激励的非对称性，为理解私募股权基金价值创造机制提供了新视角。

title: Do Credit Markets Respond to Macroeconomic Shocks? The Case for Reverse Causality
abstract: The response of corporate bond credit spreads to three exogenous macro shocks—oil supply, investment‐specific technology, and government spending—is large, significant, and a mirror image of macroeconomic activity. This countercyclicality is driven largely by credit risk premia and translates into significant return predictability. Equity risk premia exhibit similar responses, providing external validity. Information rigidities and leverage play a key role in the transmission of the shocks. Since causal evidence linking macro shocks to credit markets is scarce and recent work highlights the real effects of credit fluctuations, our findings contribute to understanding the joint dynamics of credit markets and the macroeconomy.
summary: 本文研究企业债券信用价差对三种外生宏观冲击（石油供应冲击、投资特定技术冲击、政府支出冲击）的反应。结果发现，信用价差的反应幅度大且统计显著，并且呈现宏观经济活动的镜像模式——即反周期性。这种反周期性主要由信用风险溢价驱动，并转化为显著的回报可预测性。此外，权益风险溢价也表现出类似反应，提供了外部有效性验证。信息刚性和杠杆在冲击传导过程中起到关键作用。由于此前关于宏观冲击对信用市场因果影响的证据较为稀缺，而近期研究强调了信用波动对实体经济的反馈效应，本文的发现有助于理解信用市场与宏观经济的联合动态。
ai_comment: 本文通过外生冲击识别了信用市场对宏观经济的反向因果关系，并揭示了信用风险溢价和信息摩擦在传导中的核心角色，为宏观金融领域提供了新的因果证据。

title: Moral Hazard versus Liquidity in Household Bankruptcy
abstract: This paper studies the role of moral hazard and liquidity in driving household bankruptcy. First, I estimate that increases in potential debt forgiveness have a positive, but small, effect on filing using a regression kink design. Second, exploiting quasi‐experimental variation in mortgage payment reductions, I estimate that filing is five times more responsive to cash‐on‐hand than relief generosity. Using a sufficient statistic, I show the estimates imply large consumption‐smoothing benefits of bankruptcy for the marginal filer. Finally, I conclude that 83% of the filing response to dischargeable debt comes from liquidity effects rather than a moral hazard response to financial incentives.
summary: 本文研究道德风险和流动性在家庭破产决策中的作用。首先，利用断点回归设计估计潜在债务减免对破产申请的影响，发现虽为正但效应较小。其次，利用抵押贷款支付减少的准实验变化，估计破产申请对现金的敏感度是对减免慷慨程度的五倍。基于充分统计量，结果表明边缘破产申请者的消费平滑收益很大。最后，结论显示83%的破产申请对可免除债务的反应来自流动性效应，而非道德风险。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证设计将流动性效应与道德风险效应分离，量化了流动性在家庭破产中的主导作用，为政策制定提供了重要参考。

title: Contracting in Peer Networks
abstract: We consider multiagent multifirm contracting when agents benchmark their wages to those of their peers, using weights that vary within and across firms. When a single principal commits to a public contract, optimal contracts hedge relative wage risk without sacrificing efficiency. But compensation benchmarking undoes performance benchmarking, causing wages to load positively on peer output, and asymmetries in peer effects can be exploited to enhance profits. With multiple principals, a “rat race” emerges: agents are more productive, with effort that can exceed the first best, but higher wages reduce profits and undermine efficiency. Wage transparency and disclosure requirements exacerbate these effects.
summary: 本文研究多主体多企业合约中，代理人将其工资与同行比较（使用公司内外部变化的权重）时的最优合约设计。当单一委托人承诺公开合约时，最优合约能对冲相对工资风险而不牺牲效率，但薪酬比较会抵消绩效比较的激励作用，导致工资与同行产出正相关。同行效应的不对称性可被委托人利用以增加利润。当存在多个委托人时，出现“rat race”现象：代理人努力程度可能超过一阶最优，但更高工资减少企业利润并损害整体效率。工资透明度和披露要求会加剧这些负面影响。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了薪酬比较在多重委托代理关系中的意外后果，特别是对效率的扭曲，对薪酬透明政策有重要的警示意义。

title: Monetary Policy and Inequality
abstract: We analyze the distributional effects of monetary policy on income, wealth, and consumption. We use administrative household‐level data covering the entire population in Denmark over the period 1987 to 2014 and exploit a long‐standing currency peg as a source of exogenous variation in monetary policy. We find that gains from softer monetary policy in terms of income, wealth, and consumption are monotonically increasing in ex ante income. The distributional effects reflect systematic differences in exposure to the various channels of monetary policy, especially nonlabor channels (e.g., leverage and risky assets). Our estimates imply that softer monetary policy increases income inequality.
summary: 本文利用丹麦1987年至2014年覆盖所有人口的行政家庭层面数据，并利用长期货币挂钩作为货币政策外生变化的来源，分析了货币政策对收入、财富和消费的分配效应。研究发现，宽松货币政策带来的收入、财富和消费增益随事前收入单调递增，即高收入家庭获益更多。这种分配效应源于不同家庭对货币政策传导渠道（尤其是非劳动渠道，如杠杆和风险资产）的暴露程度存在系统性差异。估计结果表明，宽松货币政策会加剧收入不平等。
ai_comment: 利用高质量行政数据和准自然实验识别货币政策对不平等的因果效应，为理解货币政策分配效应提供了坚实证据。

title: Deep Learning in Characteristics-Sorted Factor Models
abstract: This article presents an augmented deep factor model that generates latent factors for cross-sectional asset pricing. The conventional security sorting on firm characteristics for constructing long–short factor portfolio weights is nonlinear modeling, while factors are treated as inputs in linear models. We provide a structural deep-learning framework to generalize the complete mechanism for fitting cross-sectional returns by firm characteristics through generating risk factors (hidden layers). Our model has an economic-guided objective function that minimizes aggregated realized pricing errors. Empirical results on high-dimensional characteristics demonstrate robust asset pricing performance and strong investment improvements by identifying important raw characteristic sources.
summary: 本文提出了一种增强的深度因子模型，用于横截面资产定价中的潜在因子生成。传统的基于公司特征进行证券排序以构建多空因子组合权重的方式是非线性建模，而因子在线性模型中仅作为输入。作者提供了一个结构化的深度学习框架，通过生成风险因子（隐藏层）来泛化拟合横截面收益的完整机制。模型采用经济导向的目标函数，最小化加总的实现定价误差。基于高维特征的实证结果表明，该模型具有稳健的资产定价表现，并通过识别重要的原始特征来源，显著改善了投资绩效。
ai_comment: 该论文创新性地将深度学习与因子模型结合，提出了端到端的结构框架，不仅改进了定价性能，还提供了对特征重要性的可解释性分析。

title: Earnings Autocorrelation and the Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift: Experimental Evidence
abstract: Post-earnings-announcement drift (PEAD) is one of the most solidly documented asset pricing anomalies. We use the controlled conditions of the experimental lab to investigate whether earnings autocorrelation is the driving cause of this anomaly. We observe PEAD in settings with uncorrelated and correlated earnings surprises, confirming that earnings autocorrelation is not a necessary condition for PEAD. Instead, it acts as an accelerator: PEAD is stronger when earnings surprises are correlated. We further show that market prices underadjust to fundamental value changes, and that trading strategies can profitably exploit the PEAD.
summary: 本文通过实验室实验，研究盈利自相关是否是盈利公告后漂移（PEAD）现象的根本原因。实验结果表明，在盈利意外不相关和相关的情况下均观察到PEAD，证明盈利自相关并非PEAD的必要条件，但会加速PEAD（即当盈利意外相关时PEAD更强）。此外，市场价格对基本价值变化调整不足，交易策略可以盈利地利用PEAD。
ai_comment: 利用实验方法分离因果机制，首次证明盈利自相关并非PEAD的必要条件而是加速因子，丰富了行为金融对价格异常的理解。

title: Business Group Spillovers
abstract: We compare the investment of standalone firms across regions after a positive shock to the investment opportunities generated by a large-scale highway development project. We show that the standalones’ investment sensitivity is lower in regions with a higher density of business groups in the local area. We investigate mechanisms driving our results and find support for a financing mechanism whereby banks allocate capital preferentially to group-affiliated firms in responding to the increase in credit demand. Overall, our study documents that business groups have spillover effects on standalone firms. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本研究利用大规模高速公路开发项目带来的投资机会正向冲击，比较了不同地区独立公司的投资情况。研究发现，在当地商业集团密度较高的地区，独立公司的投资敏感性较低。进一步探讨了其作用机制，发现银行在应对信贷需求增加时，会优先将资本分配给集团附属公司，这支持了融资机制的解释。总体而言，该研究证明了商业集团对独立公司存在溢出效应。
ai_comment: 本文通过准自然实验揭示了商业集团对独立公司的融资挤出效应，为理解企业间交互作用提供了新视角。

title: The Human Factor in Acquisitions: Cross-industry Labor Mobility and Corporate Diversification
abstract: The benefits of internal labor markets are largest when they include industries that utilize similar worker skills, thereby facilitating cross-industry worker reallocation and collaboration. We show that diversifying acquisitions occur more frequently among industry pairs with higher human capital transferability. Such acquisitions result in larger labor productivity gains and are less often undone in subsequent divestitures. Moreover, acquirers retain more high-skill workers and more often transfer workers to jobs in other industries inside the merged firm. Overall, our results link human capital reallocation with the value created by corporate diversification and provide an explanation for seemingly unrelated acquisitions. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究内部劳动力市场的益处，特别是跨行业劳动力流动如何影响企业多元化并购。通过分析人力资本可转移性（human capital transferability）指标，发现多元化并购更频繁发生在人力资本可转移性高的行业对之间。这类并购带来更大的劳动生产率（labor productivity）增益，且更少被后续剥离。此外，收购方保留更多高技能工人，并更频繁地将工人转移到合并公司内的其他行业工作。结果表明，人力资本再配置与企业多元化创造的价值密切相关，为看似不相关的并购提供了新的解释。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将人力资本再配置与多元化并购的价值创造联系起来，为理解看似不相关的并购提供了微观基础。

title: Currency Redenomination Risk
abstract: A eurozone exit or breakup exposes bondholders to currency redenomination risk. I quantify redenomination risk since the sovereign debt crisis: It contributes substantially to credit spreads around changes in government in France and Italy. Bond prices suggest that markets have priced a potential Italian exit as isolated, and a French one as a breakup. Unlike conventional default risk, redenomination risk can be negative depending on the strength of the national “shadow” currency. Countries with strong shadow currencies earn breakup-insurance premia from the eurozone analog of “exorbitant privilege.” Yield effects are quantitatively large for implied exit probabilities as low as 1%.
summary: 本研究量化了欧元区退出或解体带来的货币重计风险（currency redenomination risk），发现自主权债务危机以来，该风险在法国和意大利政府换届期间对信用利差（credit spreads）有显著贡献。债券价格显示，市场认为意大利的潜在退出是孤立的，而法国的退出则意味着解体。与常规违约风险不同，重计风险可能为负，取决于国家“影子货币”（shadow currency）的强弱。影子货币强的国家从欧元区的“过高特权”（exorbitant privilege）中获得解体保险溢价。即使隐含退出概率低至1%，收益率影响在数量上也是巨大的。
ai_comment: 本文首次将货币重计风险与常规违约风险区分开来，并揭示了负风险的存在，深化了对欧元区主权债务风险的理解。

title: Hiring High-Skilled Labor Through Mergers and Acquisitions
abstract: Using random H-1B visa lotteries as a natural experiment, we find that firms respond to shortages of high-skilled workers by acquiring firms that employ such workers. The effect is stronger among firms with high human capital and more senior workforces, firms facing tight labor markets and legal barriers to poaching workers, and firms lacking foreign affiliates. The acquired workers are highly educated, sharing skills and occupations similar to those of the acquirer’s existing workers. Our findings suggest skilled labor is an important driver of acquisitions and acquiring is an effective means of obtaining skilled labor.
summary: 利用随机H-1B签证抽签作为自然实验，研究发现企业通过收购拥有高技能工人的公司来应对高技能劳动力短缺。这种效应在人力资本高、员工年龄较大、面临紧俏劳动力市场和法律挖角障碍的企业中更为显著；此外，缺乏海外分支机构的企业也表现更强。被收购工人受教育程度高，其技能和职业与收购方现有员工相似。结果表明，技能劳动力是并购的重要驱动因素，而并购是获取技能劳动力的有效手段。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用签证抽签的外生冲击，因果识别出劳动力短缺对企业并购决策的驱动作用，丰富了并购动机文献。

title: Friends During Hard Times: Evidence from the Great Depression
abstract: Using a novel data set of over 3,500 public and private firms, we construct the network of executive and director connections prior to the 1929 financial market crash. We find that more connected firms have 17% higher 10-year survival rates. Consistent with a working capital channel, the results are strongest for small, private, cash-poor firms, and firms located in counties with high bank suspension rates. Moreover, connections to cash-rich firms that increase accounts receivable matter the most. Our results suggest that network connections can play a stabilizing role during a financial crisis by easing the flow of capital to constrained firms.
summary: 本文利用大萧条前夕超过3500家上市和私营企业的高管与董事连接网络数据，研究网络连接对企业在1929年股市崩盘后生存率的影响。研究发现，连接度更高的企业10年生存率高出17%，该效应对于小型、私营、现金匮乏的企业以及位于银行停业率较高县的企业最为显著。进一步分析表明，与现金充裕企业的连接（通过增加应收账款）对生存率影响最大。结论表明，网络连接可以通过缓解资本向受限企业的流动，在金融危机中发挥稳定作用。
ai_comment: 利用独特的历史数据集，揭示了社会网络在金融危机中的资本缓冲作用，对理解大萧条时期企业韧性及危机传导机制具有重要贡献。

title: What Private Equity Does Differently: Evidence from Life Insurance
abstract: This paper studies how private equity creates value and its consequences for consumer welfare in the insurance industry, where PE investments grew tenfold following the financial crisis. PE firms add value through regulatory and tax arbitrage that increases profits relative to their non-PE counterparts. Crucially, the impact on consumer welfare is nuanced: in the short run, consumers benefit from more favorably priced products. But the arbitrage strategy also exposes them to more risk, as annual expected losses scaled by capital buffers rise by 50 percentage points. This creates the possibility of consumer harm in the event of a downturn. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究私募股权（PE）在保险行业如何创造价值及其对消费者福利的影响。利用金融危机后PE投资增长十倍的现象，作者发现PE通过监管和税收套利增加利润，相对于非PE同行。短期消费者从更优惠的定价产品中受益，但套利策略也使其面临更高风险：年度预期损失与资本缓冲之比上升50个百分点，这可能在市场下行时损害消费者利益。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了PE在保险业的双刃剑效应，短期收益与长期风险并存，为监管提供了重要视角。

title: The Impact of Restricting Labor Mobility on Corporate Investment and Entrepreneurship
abstract: This paper examines how labor mobility restrictions like noncompete agreements affect firms’ investment decisions. Using matched employee-employer data from LinkedIn, I show that increases in the enforceability of noncompete agreements lead to widespread declines in employee departures, specifically in knowledge-intensive occupations. Established firms that rely more on these knowledge-intensive occupations increase their investment rate in physical capital. However, new firm entry in corresponding sectors declines. I provide evidence for different mechanisms to explain these patterns. Together, the findings show that labor frictions play an important role in investment decisions. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用LinkedIn的员工-雇主匹配数据，研究劳动流动性限制（如非竞争协议）对企业投资决策的影响。发现非竞争协议可执行性的增强导致知识密集型职业的员工离职率普遍下降，而更依赖这些职业的老牌企业增加了对实物资本的投资，但相应行业的新企业进入减少。作者提供了不同机制来解释这些模式，表明劳动摩擦在投资决策中的重要作用。
ai_comment: 本文利用LinkedIn微观数据，从劳动流动性角度揭示了非竞争协议对企业投资和创业的异质性影响，为劳动摩擦影响投资决策提供了新颖证据。

title: Economic Consequences of Transparency Regulation: Evidence from Bank Mortgage Lending
abstract: We examine the economic consequences of a rule designed to improve consumers' understanding of mortgage information. The 2015 TILA‐RESPA Integrated Disclosures rule (TRID) simplifies the mortgage disclosures provided to consumers. As a consequence, TRID‐affected mortgages become a less attractive investment opportunity to banks. Our main results document that mortgage applications affected by TRID are less likely to be approved following the rule's effective date. We find evidence consistent with both a decrease in consumers' information processing costs and an increase in banks' secondary market frictions, providing insight into the potential channels through which this reduction in mortgage credit operates. We also find that banks partially compensate for reduced mortgage lending by increasing small business lending, and that fintechs absorb mortgage demand in areas with reduced mortgage lending by banks. Our study documents real actions that firms take in response to disclosure transparency regulation and contributes to the literature on the economic consequences of such regulation.
summary: 本文研究了2015年TILA-RESPA综合披露规则（TRID）的经济后果。TRID旨在简化抵押贷款披露信息，以提高消费者理解。研究发现，受TRID影响的抵押贷款申请在规则生效后获批可能性降低。这既源于消费者信息处理成本的下降，也归因于银行二级市场摩擦的增加，揭示了抵押贷款减少的潜在渠道。此外，银行通过增加小企业贷款部分弥补了抵押贷款业务的缩减，而金融科技公司则吸收了银行抵押贷款减少地区的需求。本文记录了企业对披露透明度监管的实际反应，为相关文献做出贡献。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证揭示了披露监管可能带来的非预期后果，并发现了银行和金融科技在信贷市场上的替代效应，为监管评估提供了重要视角。

title: (Why) Do Central Banks Care about Their Profits?
abstract: We document that central banks are discontinuously more likely to report slightly positive profits than slightly negative profits, especially when political pressure is greater, the public is more receptive to extreme political views, and central bank governors are eligible for reappointment. The propensity to report small profits over small losses is correlated with higher inflation and lower interest rates. We conclude that there are agency problems at central banks, which give rise to discontinuous profit incentives that correlate with central banks’ policy choices and outcomes. These findings inform the debate about the political economy of central banking and central bank design.
summary: 本文通过实证分析发现，中央银行在报告利润时存在明显的间断性：报告微小正利润的概率显著高于报告微小负利润，尤其是在政治压力较大、公众更易接受极端政治观点以及央行行长具备连任资格的情况下。这种报告微小利润而非微小损失的倾向与更高的通货膨胀率和更低的利率水平相关。研究表明，中央银行存在代理问题，导致了这种不连续的利润激励，并与央行的政策选择和结果相关联。这些发现为关于中央银行业的政治经济学和央行设计的争论提供了依据。
ai_comment: 该文从央行利润报告的小缺口切入，揭示了政治因素与央行行为之间的微妙关系，为理解央行的独立性与代理问题提供了新的实证视角。

title: TAXI! Do Mutual Funds Pursue and Exploit Information on Local Companies?
abstract: We use New York City (NYC) taxi data to identify trips between mutual fund offices and local firm headquarters. NYC funds overweight the stocks of local firms they visit via taxi, and firm visits are associated with superior investment performance. Firm visits are elevated prior to earnings announcements, and mutual fund trades that are associated with firm taxi visits predict earnings surprises. The results are generally stronger when fund and firm executives share educational connections. Additional tests support the conclusion that funds’ local bias and investment performance are driven by portfolio managers’ efforts and ability to actively gather material information.
summary: 本文利用纽约市出租车数据，识别共同基金办公室与当地公司总部之间的出租车行程，以此衡量基金经理对公司的实地访问。研究发现，纽约市基金倾向于超配他们通过出租车访问的当地公司股票，且这些访问与显著更优的投资绩效相关。访问频率在盈余公告前增加，与出租车访问相关的共同基金交易能够预测盈余惊喜。当基金与公司高管之间存在教育背景上的联系时，上述结果更为显著。进一步测试支持了结论：基金的本地偏好和投资绩效源于投资组合经理积极收集重要信息的努力和能力。
ai_comment: 创新地使用出租车数据作为实地访问的代理变量，为信息优势驱动本地偏好提供了直接证据，且揭示了教育联系在信息传递中的强化作用。

title: Fast-Moving Habit: Implications for Equity Returns
abstract: We find that the Campbell–Cochrane external-habit model can generate a value premium if the persistence of the consumption surplus is sufficiently low. Such low persistence is supported by micro evidence on consumption. If the mean and conditional volatility of consumption growth are highly persistent, as in the Bansal–Yaron long-run risk model, then fast-moving habit can also generate, without eroding the value premium: i) empirically sensible long horizon return predictability; and ii) a price–dividend ratio for market equity that exhibits the high autocorrelation found in the data. Fast-moving habit also delivers several empirical properties of market-dividend strips.
summary: 本文基于Campbell-Cochrane外部习惯模型，发现当消费剩余（consumption surplus）的持久性足够低时，模型能够生成价值溢价（value premium），且该低持久性得到了微观消费证据的支持。进一步，在消费增长均值和条件波动率高度持久（如Bansal-Yaron长期风险模型）的设定下，快速移动的习惯（fast-moving habit）不仅未侵蚀价值溢价，还额外产生了两个关键经验特征：1）经验上合理的长期回报可预测性（long horizon return predictability）；2）市场权益的股息价格比（price-dividend ratio）呈现出数据中观察到的高自相关性。此外，快速移动的习惯还解释了市场股息剥离（market-dividend strips）的若干经验性质。
ai_comment: 本文通过降低习惯模型中消费剩余的持久性，巧妙地将价值溢价、长期可预测性和股息价格比自相关等核心现象统一于一个框架，为习惯模型的实证表现提供了新见解。

title: Optimal Monetary Policy with r*<0
abstract: We study the optimal monetary policy problem in a New Keynesian economy with a zero lower bound (ZLB) on the nominal interest rate, when the steady state natural rate (r*) becomes permanently negative.We show that the optimal policy aims to approach gradually a new steady state with positive average inflation.Around that steady state, the optimal policy implies well defined (second-best) paths for inflation and output in response to shocks to the natural rate.Under plausible calibrations, the optimal policy implies that the nominal rate remains at its ZLB most of the time.Despite the latter feature, the central bank can implement the optimal outcome as a unique equilibrium by means of an appropriate nonlinear interest rate rule.In order to establish that result, we derive sufficient conditions for local determinacy in a general model with endogenous regime switches.
summary: 本文研究在名义利率存在零下限（ZLB）的新凯恩斯经济中，当稳态自然利率（r*）永久为负时的最优货币政策问题。研究表明，最优政策旨在逐步趋近于一个具有正平均通胀的新稳态，并且在该稳态附近，最优政策针对自然利率冲击给出了明确的通胀和产出路径（次优）。在合理的校准下，名义利率大多数时间保持在ZLB。尽管存在这一特征，中央银行可以通过适当的非线性利率规则将最优结果作为唯一均衡实施。为此，论文推导了具有内生制度转换的一般模型中局部确定性的充分条件。
ai_comment: 本文在永久负自然利率的背景下重新审视最优货币政策，提出了通过非线性利率规则实现唯一均衡的充分条件，具有重要的理论贡献。

title: Financial Machine Learning
abstract: We survey the nascent literature on machine learning in the study of financial markets.We highlight the best examples of what this line of research has to offer and recommend promising directions for future research.This survey is designed for both financial economists interested in grasping machine learning tools, as well as for statisticians and machine learners seeking interesting financial contexts where advanced methods may be deployed.
summary: 本文综述了机器学习在金融市场研究中的新兴文献，重点展示了该研究领域的最佳范例，并为未来研究提供了有前景的方向。该调查旨在帮助金融经济学家掌握机器学习工具，同时也为统计学家和机器学习从业者寻找可以应用先进方法的有趣金融背景。
ai_comment: 这篇综述架起了金融经济学与机器学习之间的桥梁，为跨学科合作提供了清晰的路线图。

title: Housing, Household Debt, and the Business Cycle: An Application to China and Korea
abstract: China and South Korea both experienced substantial increases in household debt through 2021, and now both countries face a weakening economy. This essay gleans lessons from the “credit-driven household demand channel” (e.g., Mian and Sufi 2018) to explore how the two economies will fare in the years ahead. On the positive side, neither country is at risk of a severe financial crisis, and both countries have a strong current account position. On the negative side, consumer spending in both countries could be quite weak in the years ahead. For China, the biggest risk is that distortions in the production sector aimed at boosting the property market were a major driver of growth during the boom, and it is unclear how growth can continue to be sustained with the property market stumbling.
summary: 本文以中国和韩国家庭债务在2021年前大幅增长、随后经济疲软为背景，运用Mian和Sufi（2018）提出的“credit-driven household demand channel”（信贷驱动家庭需求渠道）理论，分析两国未来经济走势。积极方面：两国均无严重金融危机风险，且经常账户状况良好。消极方面：未来数年两国消费支出可能相当疲弱。对中国而言，最大风险在于繁荣期生产部门为提振地产市场而形成的扭曲曾是增长主因，而地产市场受挫后，增长可持续性不明。
ai_comment: 该文为理解中韩两国经济前景提供了清晰的理论框架，并指出中国生产部门扭曲这一独特风险，对政策制定有重要参考价值。

title: Aggregate Lending and Modern Financial Intermediation:  Why Bank Balance Sheet Models are Miscalibrated
abstract: Existing macroeconomic models focused on bank balance sheet lending are deficient because they do not account for the modern industrial organization of financial intermediation.Utilizing publicly available micro-level lending data, we investigate two increasingly significant margins of adjustment in credit markets: banks' ability to sell loans and shadow bank activity.These adjustment margins are substantial and vary across time and regions with different incomes.We examine these margins in a parsimonious dynamic quantitative model featuring banks with balance sheet adjustment through loan sales and shadow banks.Using the calibrated model, we illustrate that these margins significantly dampen the immediate contraction following bank capital shock.Recovery is also faster, because profitable loan sales (e.g., securitization) allow banks to build capital faster and because shadow banks pick up lending slack.Failure to account for adjustment margins leads to significant errors when studying policies which rely on financial intermediation pass-through in the level of aggregate lending, its direction, and composition.Our model highlights the tension between bank balance sheet models and data.The model, which forces total lending to depend strongly on bank balance sheet health, must reconcile the weak correlation between bank capital and aggregate lending.These issues can be reconciled with now available data from bank balance sheets, overall bank lending, and aggregate lending, in conjunction with a model of modern financial intermediation.
summary: 现有基于银行资产负债表的宏观经济模型未能反映现代金融中介的产业组织特征，存在校准缺陷。本文利用公开的微观贷款数据，研究了信贷市场中两个日益重要的调整边际：银行出售贷款的能力和影子银行活动。这些调整边际在不同时间和不同收入水平的地区存在显著差异。作者构建了一个包含银行贷款销售和影子银行调整的简约动态定量模型，并通过校准模型发现：这些调整边际显著缓解了银行资本冲击后的立即信贷收缩，且复苏更快，因为盈利的贷款销售（例如证券化）使银行更快积累资本，同时影子银行填补了贷款缺口。忽视调整边际会导致在依赖金融中介传导的政策研究中出现显著错误，尤其是对总贷款水平、方向和组成的影响。模型凸显了银行资产负债表模型与数据之间的张力：迫使总贷款强烈依赖银行资产负债表健康状况的模型，必须调和银行资本与总贷款之间的弱相关性。这些问题可以通过结合银行资产负债表、银行总贷款、总贷款的新数据以及现代金融中介模型来解决。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入贷款销售和影子银行两大调整边际，显著改进了传统银行资产负债表模型，更准确地刻画了信贷市场的动态调整机制，对宏观金融政策分析具有重要启示。

title: Bank Branch Density and Bank Runs
abstract: Bank branch density, defined as the number of bank branches to total deposits, has significantly declined over the past decade, fueled by a confluence of branch closings and the almost doubling of deposits between 2016 and 2022. During this period, banks with low branch density benefited from large deposits inflows, leading to even lower density. But the virtuous cycle of deposits growth in these banks stopped spinning when investors became wary about their financial health. Stock prices of banks with low branch density plummeted during the 2023 Banking Crisis as these banks experienced larger outflows of uninsured deposits. Our results suggest that digital banking enabled banks to grow faster and attract uninsured deposits, but those large deposits inflows took the form of “hot money” that changed its course when economic conditions worsened.
summary: 论文定义了银行分支机构密度（银行分支机构数量与总存款之比），发现该指标在过去十年显著下降，原因是分支机构关闭和2016年至2022年间存款几乎翻倍。在此期间，低分支密度银行受益于大量存款流入，导致密度进一步降低。但当投资者对这些银行的财务状况产生担忧时，存款增长的良性循环中断。2023年银行危机期间，低分支密度银行的股价暴跌，因为这些银行经历了更大的未保险存款外流。结果表明，数字银行使银行能够更快增长并吸引未保险存款，但这些存款流入是“热钱”，在经济恶化时迅速转向。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了数字银行的双刃剑效应，即吸引不稳定的存款可能加剧银行脆弱性，为监管提供了新视角。

title: Sparse Modeling Under Grouped Heterogeneity with an Application to Asset Pricing
abstract: Sparse models, though long preferred and pursued by social scientists, can be ineffective or unstable relative to large models, for example, in economic predictions (Giannone et al., 2021). To achieve sparsity for economic interpretation while exploiting big data for superior empirical performance, we introduce a general framework that jointly clusters observations (via new decision trees) and locally selects variables (with Bayesian priors) for modeling panel data with potential grouped heterogeneity. We derive analytical marginal likelihoods as global split criteria in our Bayesian Clustering Model (BCM), to incorporate economic guidance, address parameter and model uncertainties, and prevent overfitting. We apply BCM to asset pricing and estimate uncommon-factor models for data-driven asset clusters and macroeconomic regimes. We find (i) cross-sectional heterogeneity linked to (non-linear interactions of) return volatility, size, and value, (ii) structural changes in factor relevance predicted by market volatility and valuation, and (iii) MKTRF and SMB as common factors and multiple uncommon factors across characteristics-managed-market-timed clusters. BCM helps explain volatility- or size-related anomalies, exploit within-group tests, and mitigate the “factor zoo” problem. Overall, BCM outperforms benchmark common-factor models in pricing and investments in U.S. equities, e.g., attaining out-of-sample cross-sectional R2s exceeding 25% for multiple clusters and Sharpe ratio of tangency portfolios tripling built from ME-B/M 5 × 5 portfolios.
summary: 该论文针对稀疏模型在经济预测中可能不如大型模型有效的问题，提出一个结合新决策树聚类观测和贝叶斯先验局部变量选择的通用框架（贝叶斯聚类模型，BCM），用于建模存在分组异质性的面板数据。通过推导解析边际似然作为全局分裂准则，BCM可融入经济指引、处理参数和模型不确定性并防止过拟合。将BCM应用于资产定价，为数据驱动的资产聚类和宏观体制估计稀有因子模型，发现：(i) 截面异质性与收益波动率、规模和价值及其非线性交互相关；(ii) 因子相关性随市场波动率和估值发生结构性变化；(iii) MKTRF和SMB是常见因子，而多个稀有因子存在于特征管理-市场时机聚类中。BCM有助于解释波动率或规模相关异常、利用组内检验并缓解“因子动物园”问题。总体而言，BCM在美国股票定价和投资中优于基准常见因子模型，例如多个聚类的样本外截面R²超过25%，且由ME-B/M 5×5投资组合构建的切点组合夏普比率提高了三倍。
ai_comment: 通过将聚类与变量选择统一在贝叶斯框架下，BCM兼顾了解释性与预测性能，在资产定价中显著优于传统常见因子模型，为处理高维异质性数据提供了新思路。

title: Combining Human Expertise with Artificial Intelligence: Experimental Evidence from Radiology
abstract: Full automation using Artificial Intelligence (AI) predictions may not be optimal if humans have information not available to the AI (contextual information). We study human-AI collaboration using an information experiment with professional radiologists. Results show that providing (i) AI predictions does not improve performance on average, whereas (ii) contextual information does. Radiologists do not realize the gains from AI assistance because of errors in belief updating – they underweight AI predictions and treat their own information and AI predictions as statistically independent. Unless these mistakes can be corrected, the optimal human-AI collaboration design delegates cases either to humans or to AI, but rarely to AI assisted humans.
summary: 这篇论文通过一项针对专业放射科医生的信息实验，研究人类与AI的协作。实验发现，提供AI预测并未平均提升放射科医生的诊断表现，而提供上下文信息（如临床背景）则显著改善了表现。放射科医生未能从AI辅助中获益，是因为他们在信念更新上存在系统性错误：他们低估了AI预测的权重，并错误地将自身信息与AI预测视为统计独立。除非这些偏差能被纠正，否则最优的人机协作设计应将病例直接分配给人类专家或单独由AI处理，而不是采用AI辅助人类的方式。
ai_comment: 论文通过严谨的实验揭示了人类在整合AI预测时的认知偏差，挑战了“AI辅助必能提升表现”的直觉，为实际部署人机协作系统提供了重要设计指针。

title: Incomplete Information, Debt Issuance, and the Term Structure of Credit Spreads
abstract: We derive a firm’s debt issuance policy when managers have an informational advantage over creditors and face debt restructuring costs. In our model, regardless of how poor their private signal is, managers of firms that can access the credit market avoid default by issuing new debt to service existing debt. Therefore, only bonds of firms that have exhausted their ability to borrow are subject to jump-to-default risk because of incomplete information and, in turn, command a jump-to-default risk premium. We document that our model captures many salient features of the corporate bond market. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4529 .
summary: 本文构建了一个理论模型，其中管理者相对于债权人具有信息优势，并面临债务重组成本，推导出公司的债务发行政策。模型表明，无论私有信号多差，能够进入信贷市场的公司管理者通过发行新债偿旧债避免违约。因此，只有那些已耗尽借贷能力的公司债券才因不完全信息而面临跳跃至违约风险，并因此要求跳跃至违约风险溢价。作者证明该模型能够捕捉公司债券市场许多显著特征。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入信息不对称和债务重组成本，为理解信用利差期限结构中的跳跃风险溢价提供了新视角，具有重要的理论贡献。

title: Product market competition with crypto tokens and smart contracts
abstract: This paper models benefits of quoting output price in units of crypto token under duopolistic product market competition with switching costs. Pricing output in tokens provides a firm with a de facto second-mover advantage, raising its equilibrium profit. In addition, the firm can further increase its equilibrium profit by committing via a smart contract to the number of tokens sold. By focusing on utility tokens used at the product market competition stage, the paper highlights potential benefits of issuing crypto tokens that extend beyond the advantages of issuing security tokens at the venture financing stage.
summary: 本文通过一个双寡头产品市场竞争模型，研究了在存在转换成本的情况下，以加密代币作为报价单位的益处。模型表明，以代币定价赋予企业事实上的后发优势，从而提高其均衡利润。此外，企业可以通过智能合约承诺代币销售数量，进一步增加均衡利润。论文聚焦于产品市场竞争阶段使用的实用代币，强调了发行加密代币的潜在收益，这些收益超越了在风险融资阶段发行证券代币的优势。
ai_comment: 本文为加密代币的经济学分析提供了新视角，揭示了代币在产品市场竞争中的战略价值，而不仅仅是融资工具。

title: What matters in a characteristic?
abstract: We investigate how different components in firm characteristics affect expected returns and comovements in international stock markets. We decompose characteristics into country, industry, and country- and industry-adjusted (i.e., orthogonal) components. Then, we use these components to capture time-series and cross-sectional variations in stock-level alphas and factor exposures. Decomposing characteristics is crucial to explain jointly expected returns and comovements: (i) adjusted (country) components are the most important determinant of alphas (comovements), (ii) component-based models outperform benchmark models, and (iii) alphas are statistically significant. However, alphas have been trending down over time, and alpha-chasing strategies are not profitable once we account for estimation risk and trading costs.
summary: 该论文研究了公司特征的不同组成部分如何影响国际股票市场的预期收益和共同运动。作者将特征分解为国家、行业以及国家和行业调整（正交）成分，然后使用这些成分捕捉股票层面alpha和因子载荷的时间序列及横截面变化。主要发现包括：调整后的（国家）成分是alpha（共同运动）的最重要决定因素；基于成分的模型优于基准模型；alpha统计显著。然而，alpha随时间呈下降趋势，且考虑估计风险和交易成本后，追逐alpha的策略不再盈利。
ai_comment: 本研究通过细致的特征分解揭示了国家成分在解释收益和风险中的核心作用，为资产定价模型提供了新视角。实证结果对实际投资策略有重要启示。

title: When and how are rule 10b5-1 plans used for insider stock sales?
abstract: SEC Rule10b5-1 plans are intended to limit the ability of insiders to trade opportunistically. We study insider stock sales by CEOs both under and outside of these plans. While both groups exhibit opportunism, this behavior is more limited in plan sales and non-plan sales in well-governed firms. Furthermore, opportunism in plan sales is greater for transactions representing a larger fraction of the CEO's firm-related wealth. CEOs can circumvent the intent of Rule 10b5-1 by exercising their discretion over financial reporting and real earnings management and appear to benefit from material nonpublic information by selectively cancelling plans or using limit orders.
summary: 本文研究CEO在SEC Rule 10b5-1计划内和计划外进行股票销售的行为。尽管两组均表现出机会主义，但计划销售以及治理良好公司的非计划销售中机会主义行为更为有限。此外，当交易占CEO公司相关财富比例较高时，计划销售中的机会主义更显著。CEO通过行使财务报告和真实盈余管理的裁量权来规避Rule 10b5-1的意图，并通过选择性取消计划或使用限价订单从重大非公开信息中获益。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了Rule 10b5-1计划的漏洞，表明CEO仍可通过盈余管理和交易策略进行机会主义交易，为监管改进提供了重要证据。

title: When can the market identify old news?
abstract: What drives the puzzle of market reactions to old news? Motivated by theories of correlation neglect, we conduct an experiment on finance professionals and show that even sophisticated investors have difficulty identifying old information that recombines content from multiple sources. We evaluate the market implications of this mechanism using a unique dataset of 17 million news articles from the Bloomberg terminal. Recombination of old information prompts larger price moves and subsequent reversals than direct reprints. This effect persists across news sentiment, ambiguity, and investor attention. Furthermore, while overall reactions to old information decline over time, differential reactions to recombinations increase.
summary: 本文探究市场为何会对旧新闻产生反应这一谜题。受相关忽视理论的启发，作者对金融专业人士进行了实验，发现即使是经验丰富的投资者也难以识别出将多个来源内容重新组合的旧信息。利用彭博终端1700万条新闻的独特数据集，作者评估了该机制的市场影响。结果表明，与直接转载旧信息相比，信息重组会引发更大的价格变动及随后的反转。该效应在新闻情绪、模糊性和投资者关注度下均持续存在。此外，尽管对旧信息的整体反应随时间减弱，但对信息重组的不同反应却有所增强。
ai_comment: 通过实验和大数据揭示了信息重组对市场反应的重要影响，为行为金融学提供了新证据。

title: Micro uncertainty and asset prices
abstract: Size and value premia comove strongly with one another at low frequencies, but they are both negatively related to long-run movements in the equity premium. We explain these patterns in an investment-based asset pricing model featuring persistent micro and macro uncertainty. Micro uncertainty generates size and value premia waves, while macroeconomic uncertainty produces equity premium waves. The negative correlation between micro and macro uncertainty at low frequencies explains why the equity premium is a long-term hedge for size and value premia. Persistent micro uncertainty is also a source of instability for size and value factors in short samples.
summary: 本文研究了规模溢价和价值溢价在低频上强烈正相关，但两者都与股权溢价的长期运动负相关的现象。作者构建了一个基于投资的资产定价模型，其中包含持续的微观不确定性和宏观不确定性。微观不确定性驱动规模溢价和价值溢价的波动，而宏观不确定性产生股权溢价的波动。微观与宏观不确定性在低频上的负相关解释了为什么股权溢价是规模溢价和价值溢价的长期对冲。此外，持续的微观不确定性也是短期样本中规模和价值因子不稳定的来源。
ai_comment: 该文通过区分微观与宏观不确定性，为规模和价值溢价的长期波动模式及与股权溢价的关系提供了统一的解释框架，具有重要的理论贡献。

title: Credit Default Swaps, Fire-Sale Risk, and the Liquidity Provision in the Bond Market
abstract: We study the effect of credit default swaps (CDSs) on the bond market. Using a comprehensive sample of U.S. corporate bonds, we document that the presence of CDSs significantly increases bond liquidity and reduces yield spreads for investment grade bonds. We show that CDSs influence the bond market by lowering the impact of fire sales of institutional bondholders and facilitating inventory management for bond dealers who absorb fire sale shocks. However, the liquidity provision role of CDSs gets weakened after the CDS Big Bang in 2009, potentially because of the requirement of large upfront payments.
summary: 本文利用美国公司债券的全面样本，研究信用违约互换（CDS）对债券市场的影响。结果显示，CDS的存在显著提高了投资级债券的流动性并降低了其收益率利差。其作用机制在于：CDS降低了机构债券持有人发生抛售（fire sales）时对市场的冲击，并帮助债券交易商管理库存以吸收抛售压力。然而，2009年CDS大爆炸（CDS Big Bang）之后，由于要求大额首付，CDS的流动性提供功能有所减弱。
ai_comment: 本文实证揭示了CDS通过缓解抛售风险和辅助交易商库存管理来提升债券流动性的渠道，并关注到了制度变化（CDS大爆炸）对流动性提供功能的削弱，为CDS与债券市场互动提供了新证据。

title: Gender and Managerial Job Mobility: Career Prospects for Executives Displaced by Acquisitions
abstract: We investigate how men and women fare in the managerial labor market in the plausibly exogenous circumstance of their firms being acquired when most target-firm managers (about 90%) are displaced. These career disruptions result in a larger drop in rank and compensation for female managers, despite similar job search attributes. Gender differences are mitigated when hiring firms have more women in upper-echelon positions. Rich managerial experience and external board service also reduce gender-related differences. Overall, results point to a (implicit) “gender penalty” in terms of managerial job mobility, but also indicate contexts in which penalty is alleviated, and even reversed.
summary: 本文利用公司被收购这一外生冲击（约90%的目标公司经理被解雇），研究男女经理在管理层劳动力市场上的职业前景差异。发现女性经理在职位等级和薪酬上的下降幅度显著大于男性，尽管她们的求职特征相似。这种性别差异在雇佣公司高管层中有更多女性时会减弱；丰富的管理经验和外部董事会服务也能缩小性别差距。总体而言，研究揭示了管理层职业流动性中存在一种隐性的“性别惩罚”，但也指出了惩罚减轻甚至逆转的情境。
ai_comment: 利用并购这一外生事件有效识别性别在职业流动性中的因果效应，并发现缓解性别差异的特定条件，为促进职场性别平等提供了实证依据。

title: The Real Effects of Modern Information Technologies: Evidence from the EDGAR Implementation
abstract: Using the implementation of the Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval (EDGAR) system from 1993 to 1996 as a shock to information dissemination technologies, we examine how a significant reduction in disclosure processing costs affects the real economy.
