We find that the EDGAR implementation leads to an increase in corporate investment and that this effect is concentrated in value firms. We provide evidence that improved equity financing and enhanced managerial incentives are likely the underlying mechanisms. Specifically, the EDGAR implementation leads to an increase in a firm's stock liquidity, a decrease in the cost of equity capital, and an increase in the level of equity financing. Consistent with the monitoring effect of broad information dissemination, the EDGAR implementation leads to an increase in a firm's operating performance. Our findings suggest that it is important to consider information dissemination beyond information production when examining the real effects of corporate disclosures.
summary: 本文利用1993至1996年间电子数据收集、分析与检索（EDGAR）系统的实施作为信息传播技术的外生冲击，研究披露处理成本显著降低对实体经济的影响。研究发现，EDGAR实施导致企业投资增加，且该效应集中在价值型公司。证据表明，改善股权融资和增强管理层激励是潜在机制：EDGAR实施提高了股票流动性，降低了权益资本成本，并增加了股权融资水平。与广泛信息传播的监督效应一致，EDGAR实施还提升了企业运营绩效。结果表明，在考察公司披露的实际影响时，除了信息生产外，还必须考虑信息传播。
ai_comment: 该研究利用自然实验识别了信息技术对实体经济的因果效应，突破了以往仅关注信息生产的局限，强调了信息传播渠道的重要性。

title: Retail Financial Innovation and Stock Market Dynamics: The Case of Target Date Funds
abstract: Target date funds (TDFs) are designed to provide unsophisticated or inattentive investors with age‐appropriate exposures to different asset classes like stocks and bonds. The rise of TDFs has moved a significant share of retirement investors into macrocontrarian strategies that sell stocks after relatively good stock market performance. This rebalancing drives contrarian flows across equity mutual funds held by TDFs, stabilizing their funding, and reduces stock returns for stocks disproportionately held by these funds when stock market returns are relatively high. Continued growth in TDFs and similar investment products may dampen stock market volatility and increase the transmission of shocks across asset classes.
summary: 本文研究目标日期基金（TDFs）对股票市场动态的影响。TDFs旨在为不成熟或注意力不集中的投资者提供与年龄相适应的股票和债券等资产类别的风险敞口。TDFs的兴起使大量退休投资者转向宏观逆势策略，即在股市表现相对较好时卖出股票。这种再平衡行为导致TDFs持有的股票型共同基金产生逆势资金流，稳定了这些基金的资金来源，并在股市回报较高时降低了对这些基金过度持有的股票的回报。TDFs及类似投资产品的持续增长可能抑制股市波动，并增加跨资产类别的冲击传导。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了TDFs通过逆势策略稳定股市的机制，为理解零售金融创新对市场微观结构的影响提供了新视角。

title: Stealth Acquisitions and Product Market Competition
abstract: We examine whether and how firms structure their merger and acquisition deals to avoid antitrust scrutiny. There are approximately 40% more mergers and acquisitions (M&As) than expected just below deal value thresholds that trigger antitrust review. These “stealth acquisitions” tend to involve financial and governance contract terms that afford greater scope for negotiating and assigning lower deal values. We also show that the equity values, gross margins, and product prices of acquiring firms and their competitors increase following such acquisitions. Our results suggest that acquirers manipulate M&As to avoid antitrust scrutiny, thereby benefiting their own shareholders but potentially harming other corporate stakeholders.
summary: 本文研究企业是否以及如何通过构造并购交易来规避反垄断审查。利用并购交易价值阈值（触发反垄断审查的临界值）附近的数据，发现约有40%的额外并购交易恰好低于该阈值，这些被称为“隐形收购”。此类交易通常包含财务和治理合同条款，允许更大的谈判空间和更低的交易价值分配。进一步研究发现，在这些隐形收购后，收购方及其竞争对手的股权价值、毛利率和产品价格均有所上升。结论表明，收购方通过操纵并购交易结构以逃避反垄断审查，从而为其股东创造收益，但可能损害其他企业利益相关者（如消费者或供应商）。
ai_comment: 本文利用交易价值阈值附近的异常分布，揭示了企业规避反垄断审查的隐蔽策略，并实证了其对产品市场的积极影响，为并购监管提供了重要启示。

title: Networking Frictions in Venture Capital, and the Gender Gap in Entrepreneurship
abstract: We find that male participants in Harvard Business School’s New Venture Competition who were randomly exposed to more venture capital (VC) investors on their panel were substantially more likely to start a VC-backed startup post-graduation, indicating that access to investors impacts fundraising independent of the quality of ideas. However, female participants experience no benefit from exposure to male or female venture capitalists (VCs), which appears related to a reduced propensity to reach out to VCs to whom they were exposed. Our results therefore also demonstrate gender-based differences in the degree to which increased exposure to investors can address networking frictions in venture capital.
summary: 利用哈佛商学院新创企业竞赛中随机分配评审的准实验，研究发现男性参与者若被随机分配到更多风险投资（VC）评审的组别，毕业后创办VC支持初创企业的概率显著更高，表明接触投资者有助于融资，且这一影响独立于创意质量。然而，女性参与者无论接触男性还是女性VC均未获得类似好处，这似乎与她们主动联系所接触VC的倾向较低有关。结果揭示了在风险投资中，投资者接触缓解网络摩擦的效果存在性别差异。
ai_comment: 该研究利用自然实验设计，为风险投资网络中的性别差异提供了因果证据，揭示了女性创业者未能从投资者接触中获益的关键机制。

title: Employee Costs of Corporate Bankruptcy
abstract: An employee's annual earnings fall by 13% in the first full calendar year after her firm's bankruptcy, and the present value of lost earnings from bankruptcy to six years following bankruptcy is 87% of pre‐bankruptcy annual earnings. More worker earnings are lost in thin labor markets and among small firms. Ex ante compensating wage differentials for this “bankruptcy risk” are up to 2% of firm value for a firm whose credit rating falls from AA to BBB, comparable in magnitude to debt tax benefits. Thus, wage premia for expected costs of bankruptcy are sufficiently large to be an important consideration in capital structure decisions.
summary: 这篇论文研究了公司破产对员工收入的影响。实证发现，员工在其公司破产后的第一个完整日历年内，年收入下降13%；从破产到破产后六年的收入损失现值相当于破产前年收入的87%。在劳动力市场薄弱以及小公司中，员工的收入损失更大。事前补偿性工资差异（即员工为承担“破产风险”而要求的额外报酬）对于一家信用评级从AA降至BBB的公司，可达公司价值的2%，其规模与债务的税收优惠相当。因此，论文指出，与破产预期成本相关的工资溢价足够大，应在资本结构决策中作为重要考量因素。
ai_comment: 该论文首次系统量化了公司破产对员工的长期收入冲击，并揭示了破产风险通过补偿性工资差异影响公司资本结构决策的重要机制，具有理论和实践意义。

title: Specialization in Bank Lending: Evidence from Exporting Firms
abstract: We develop a novel approach for measuring bank specialization using granular data on borrower activities and apply it to Peruvian exporters and their banks. We find that borrowers seek credit from banks that specialize in their export destinations, both when expanding exports and when exporting to new countries. Firms experiencing country‐specific export demand shocks adjust borrowing disproportionately from specialized banks. Specialized bank credit supply shocks affect exports disproportionately to countries of specialization. Our results demonstrate that firm credit demand is bank‐ and activity‐specific, which reduces banking competition and affects the transmission and amplification of shocks through the banking sector.
summary: 论文开发了一种基于借款人活动细粒度数据测量银行专业化的新方法，并将其应用于秘鲁出口企业及其银行。研究发现，企业在扩大出口或进入新市场时，会向专注于其出口目的地的银行寻求信贷。当面临特定国家的出口需求冲击时，企业会不成比例地调整从专业银行的借款；同时，专业银行的信贷供给冲击也对专门化国家的出口产生不成比例的影响。结果表明，企业的信贷需求具有银行和活动特异性，这降低了银行业竞争，并影响冲击通过银行部门的传导与放大。
ai_comment: 本文利用出口目的地数据构建银行专业化度量，揭示了信贷需求的银行-活动特异性对竞争和冲击传导的重要影响，为银行信贷与国际贸易的互动提供了新的微观证据。

title: Is Carbon Risk Priced in the Cross Section of Corporate Bond Returns?
abstract: This article examines the pricing of a firm’s carbon risk in the corporate bond market. Contrary to the “carbon risk premium” hypothesis, bonds of more carbon-intensive firms earn significantly lower returns. This effect cannot be explained by a comprehensive list of bond characteristics and exposure to known risk factors. Investigating sources of the low carbon alpha, we find the underperformance of bonds issued by carbon-intensive firms cannot be fully explained by divestment from institutional investors. Instead, our evidence is most consistent with investor underreaction to the predictability of carbon intensity for firm cash-flow news, creditworthiness, and environmental incidents.
summary: 本文研究了企业碳风险在公司债券市场中的定价问题。与“碳风险溢价”假说相反，碳密集度更高的企业发行的债券回报显著更低。这一现象无法由债券特征或已知风险因子暴露充分解释。进一步探究低碳阿尔法的来源发现，机构投资者的撤资并不能完全解释碳密集型企业债券的低表现。相反，证据最支持投资者对碳强度预测企业现金流消息、信用状况和环境事件的反应不足。
ai_comment: 本文颠覆了传统碳风险溢价观点，揭示了债券市场中碳风险的负向定价，并指出投资者对碳相关信息的反应不足是关键机制。

title: Reintermediation in FinTech: Evidence from Online Lending
abstract: We document the unique structure of the peer-to-peer lending market. Originally designed as decentralized, the market has become highly, but not fully, reintermediated. The platforms’ software now performs essentially all tasks related to loan evaluation, whereas most lenders are passive and automatically fund most applications on offer. Yet unlike banks, and in contrast to theories predicting full reintermediation, the platforms provide detailed loan information, and some active loan pickers coexist with passive investors. We argue that while intermediation attracts unsophisticated passive investors, transparency in the presence of active investors resolves the lending platform’s moral hazard problem inherent in intermediated markets.
summary: 本文研究了P2P借贷市场的独特结构。原本设计为去中心化的市场，现已高度但非完全重新中介化。平台软件执行所有贷款评估任务，大多数贷款人被动自动资助申请。然而，与银行不同，平台提供详细的贷款信息，一些活跃的贷款选择者与被动投资者共存。作者认为，中介化吸引不成熟的被动投资者，而透明度与活跃投资者共存解决了中介市场固有的贷款平台道德风险问题。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了P2P借贷市场中介化的独特结构，强调透明度与活跃投资者在缓解平台道德风险中的关键作用，对理解金融科技中介化具有重要贡献。

title: Presidential Address: Sustainable Finance and ESG Issues—ValueversusValues
abstract: In this address, I discuss differences across investor and manager motivations for considering sustainable finance— value versus values motivations—and how these differences contribute to misunderstandings about environmental, social, and governance investment approaches. The finance research community has the ability and responsibility to help clear up these misunderstandings through additional research, which I suggest.
summary: 这篇主席致辞探讨了投资者和管理者在考虑可持续金融时动机上的差异，即价值（value）动机与价值观（values）动机之间的区别，并指出这些差异如何导致对环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资方法的误解。作者认为金融研究界有能力和责任通过进一步研究来澄清这些误解。
ai_comment: 论文清晰区分了ESG投资的两种动机，为理解该领域的争议提供了框架，并呼吁学术界承担澄清角色。

title: Banks as Liquidity Multipliers
abstract: We characterize the interaction between banks’ liquid assets purchases and deposit issuance decisions. Using global games, we derive a liquidity multiplier: the amount of deposits a bank can create when endowed with one additional unit of liquid asset to maintain a given level of liquidity risk. In our central theorem, we prove it is larger than unity. This entails that banks have a special role in enhancing liquidity provision, “multiplying” liquid assets into a larger quantity of deposits. Our theory has implications for banks’ balance sheet choices, the pricing of liquid securities, and the role of public liquidity provision.
summary: 本文通过全球博弈理论模型，研究银行在保持给定流动性风险水平下，流动资产购买与存款发行决策之间的相互作用。核心发现是流动性乘数：银行每增加一单位流动资产所能创造的存款量，该乘数被证明大于1，意味着银行能够将流动资产“乘数”放大为更大数量的存款，从而在流动性供给中发挥特殊作用。该理论对银行资产负债表选择、流动性证券定价以及公共流动性供给政策具有重要启示。
ai_comment: 创新性地提出流动性乘数概念并严格证明其大于1，为解释银行在流动性创造中的独特角色提供了理论基础，对银行监管和货币政策具有潜在应用价值。

title: Mandatory Financial Disclosure and M&A Activity
abstract: Taking advantage of the implementation of the 2003 European Commission (EC) directive on financial reporting, we explore the impact of mandatory financial disclosure on mergers and acquisitions (M&A). We find robust evidence that the number (and volume) of private firms becoming an M&A target increases with mandatory disclosure. Analyses of cross-industry differences, deal-level data, and post-deal performance indicate that financial disclosure increases M&A activity by reducing information frictions in the market for corporate control. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 利用2003年欧盟委员会财务报告指令的实施作为准自然实验，本文研究了强制财务披露对并购活动的影响。研究发现，强制披露显著增加了私人企业成为并购目标的数量和交易额。通过跨行业差异分析、交易层面数据以及并购后绩效检验，结果表明强制披露通过降低公司控制权市场中的信息摩擦促进了并购活动。
ai_comment: 利用欧盟指令实施的外生冲击，为强制披露对并购的因果效应提供了可靠证据，并深入机制分析。

title: Committee-Based Blockchains as Games between Opportunistic Players and Adversaries
abstract: We study consensus in a protocol capturing in a simplified manner the major features of the majority of Proof of Stake blockchains. A committee is formed; one member proposes a block; and the others can check its validity and vote for it. Blocks with a majority of votes are produced. When an invalid block is produced, the stakes of the members who voted for it are “slashed.” Profit-maximizing members interact with adversaries seeking to disrupt consensus. When slashing is limited, free-riding and moral-hazard lead to invalid blocks in equilibrium. We propose a protocol modification producing only valid blocks in equilibrium. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究基于委员会的区块链共识协议，以简化方式捕捉大多数权益证明区块链的主要特征。协议中形成一个委员会，其中一名成员提议区块，其他成员检查其有效性并投票。获得多数票的区块被生产；若产生无效区块，投票成员的权益会被“削减”。利润最大化的委员会成员与试图破坏共识的对手进行博弈。研究表明，当削减机制有限时，搭便车和道德风险会导致均衡中出现无效区块。作者提出了一种协议修改，使得在均衡中只产生有效区块。论文包含在线附录。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地将博弈论引入区块链共识机制设计，揭示了有限削减下的道德风险和搭便车问题，并提出了一个简单的修改来保证均衡中只生产有效区块，对实际协议设计有重要参考价值。

title: The Downstream Impact of Upstream Tariffs: Evidence from Investment Decisions in Supply Chains
abstract: We study how U.S. manufacturing firms’ investment responds to tariff reductions in supplier industries. Our estimates, based on tariff reductions following multinational trade agreements, suggest that a hypothetical 10% reduction of all upstream tariffs would increase downstream investment by 4% to 6%. This estimate is not explained by decreasing uncertainty and stems from tariff reductions for homogeneous and low-R&D inputs, consistent with the investment response resulting from cost reductions rather than superior foreign technology embodied in imported inputs. Evidence from an instrumental variable estimation using the sudden increase in Chinese import penetration suggests that import competition also increases downstream investment.
summary: 本文研究美国制造业企业的投资如何响应上游供应商行业的关税削减。基于多边贸易协议后的关税削减数据，估计显示上游关税每降低10%，下游企业投资增加4%至6%。这一效应并非源于不确定性下降，而主要来自同质性和低研发投入的中间品关税削减，表明投资增长是由成本降低而非进口中包含的外国先进技术驱动。此外，利用中国进口渗透率突然上升进行的工具变量估计也证实，进口竞争会促进下游投资。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分成本降低和技术溢出渠道，深化了对关税传导机制的理解，为贸易政策与投资决策的关系提供了实证证据。

title: Media Sentiment and Currency Reversals
abstract: Analyzing 48 foreign exchange (FX) rates and 1.2 million FX-related news articles over a 35-year period, using digital textual analysis, we find that a currency reversal investment strategy that buys (sells) currencies with low (high) media sentiment offers strong positive and statistically significant returns and Sharpe ratios. The results are robust and the strategy adds value over other currency premia determinants. Analysts’ forecasts systematically mispredict the reversal strategy. This is the first article to show that price reversals based on media sentiment are a well-defined feature of the FX market.
summary: 该研究基于35年间48种外汇汇率和120万篇相关新闻文章，利用数字文本分析构建媒体情绪指标。发现买入媒体情绪低而卖出媒体情绪高的货币的反转投资策略能产生显著的正回报和夏普比率，且结果稳健，优于其他货币溢价决定因素。分析师预测系统性地未能捕捉该反转策略。论文首次证明基于媒体情绪的价格反转是外汇市场的明确特征。
ai_comment: 首次系统揭示外汇市场中媒体情绪驱动的反转效应，并指出分析师预测的系统性偏差，丰富了行为金融在外汇领域的实证证据。

title: Does Public Firms’ Mandatory IFRS Reporting Crowd Out Private Firms’ Capital Investment?
abstract: We investigate how the mandatory adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) by publicly listed firms in the European Union affects peer private firms. We find that private firms’ capital investment decreases significantly after the IFRS mandate, relative to public firms. Private firms also display decreased investment when benchmarked against firms relatively insulated from the impact of the IFRS mandate, but the magnitude of the effect is smaller in this case. These results are consistent with the hypothesis that mandatory IFRS reporting (combined with other reforms), while increasing public firms’ financing and investment, crowds out funding for private firms. The effect is more pronounced for larger private firms and in industries where public peers have greater external financing needs. Our evidence suggests that financial reporting regulations cause shifts in resource allocation in an economy.
summary: 本文研究欧盟上市公司强制采用国际财务报告准则（IFRS）对同行私营公司的影响。研究发现，强制采用IFRS后，私营公司的资本投资显著下降，且这种下降相对于上市公司更明显。即使与受IFRS影响较小的公司比较，私营公司投资也有所减少，但效应较小。结果支持假设：强制IFRS报告（结合其他改革）在增加上市公司融资和投资的同时，挤出了私营公司的资金。这一效应在大型私营公司和上市公司外部融资需求较高的行业中更为显著。证据表明，财务报告法规导致经济中资源分配的转变。
ai_comment: 本文提供了会计监管溢出效应的新证据，揭示了强制IFRS可能对私营部门产生非预期的负向影响，对政策制定有重要启示。

title: Measuring “State-Level” Economic Policy Uncertainty
abstract: We develop 50 indices of state-level economic policy uncertainty (SEPU) based on newspaper coverage frequency using 204 million newspaper articles from Mar. 1984 to Dec. 2019. We assess the validity of our measures. Our SEPU indices vary counter-cyclically with respect to state-specific economic conditions, rise before close gubernatorial elections, and exhibit a large cross-sectional variation. We demonstrate that SEPU indices are associated with the cross-sectional variation in state-level GDP, employment, income as well as industry investment decisions. Our findings highlight the importance of economic policy uncertainty at the state level in addition to the nationwide level.
summary: 本文构建了50个美国州级经济政策不确定性（SEPU）指数，基于1984年3月至2019年12月期间2.04亿篇报纸文章的报道频率。通过实证验证，这些SEPU指数与各州特定经济条件呈逆周期变化，在州长选举临近前上升，并表现出显著的横截面差异。进一步研究发现，SEPU指数能够解释州级GDP、就业、收入以及行业投资决策的横截面变化，从而凸显了除全国层面外，州级经济政策不确定性的重要性。
keywords: 州级经济政策不确定性
ai_comment: 该研究的贡献在于首次系统性地构建了州级经济政策不确定性指数，为理解地方层面政策不确定性的经济影响提供了重要工具和实证证据。

title: In the CEO We Trust: Negative Effects of Trust Between the Board and the CEO
abstract: In this study, we investigate whether and how trust between board members and the CEO (board–CEO trust) affects the performance of mergers and acquisitions. Contrary to conventional wisdom, we find that firms with higher levels of board–CEO trust exhibit poor M&A performance. High trust is associated with low acquisition announcement returns, long-term stock return performance, and post-deal operating performance. This negative effect of board–CEO trust is more pronounced among acquiring companies prone to agency problems. Our results suggest that, in the institutional setting of corporate boards, high trust can be too much of a good thing.
summary: 本研究探讨董事会与CEO之间的信任（董事会-CEO信任）对并购绩效的影响。与常规认知相反，研究发现董事会-CEO信任水平较高的公司并购绩效较差。高信任与较低的并购公告回报、长期股票回报表现以及交易后经营业绩相关。这种负面效应在易发生代理问题的收购公司中更为显著。结果表明，在公司董事会制度背景下，高信任可能过犹不及。
ai_comment: 本文挑战了信任在治理中总是有益的常规观点，揭示了信任可能导致的代理成本，对董事会治理实践有重要启示。

title: Fast Filtering with Large Option Panels: Implications for Asset Pricing
abstract: The cross section of options holds great promise for identifying return distributions and risk premia, but estimating dynamic option valuation models with latent state variables is challenging when using large option panels. We propose a particle Markov Chain Monte Carlo framework with a novel filtering approach and illustrate our method by estimating index option pricing models. Estimates of variance risk premiums, variance mean reversion, and higher moments differ from the literature. We show that these differences are due to the composition of the option sample. Restricting the option sample’s maturity dimension has the strongest impact on parameter inference and option fit in these models.
summary: 本文提出了一种基于粒子马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（particle Markov Chain Monte Carlo）框架的新滤波方法，用于处理大规模期权面板数据，并估计动态期权定价模型中的潜在状态变量。通过估计指数期权定价模型，作者发现估计得到的方差风险溢价、方差均值回归和高阶矩与现有文献存在差异，并证明这些差异主要源于期权样本的构成，尤其是限制期权的到期期限维度对参数推断和模型拟合影响最大。
keywords: 粒子马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛
ai_comment: 该论文提出了一种高效处理大期权面板的滤波方法，并揭示了样本构成（特别是期限维度）对参数估计的重要影响，为后续研究提供了方法论基础。

title: Is There a Replication Crisis in Finance?
abstract: Several papers argue that financial economics faces a replication crisis because the majority of studies cannot be replicated or are the result of multiple testing of too many factors. We develop and estimate a Bayesian model of factor replication that leads to different conclusions. The majority of asset pricing factors (i) can be replicated; (ii) can be clustered into 13 themes, the majority of which are significant parts of the tangency portfolio; (iii) work out‐of‐sample in a new large data set covering 93 countries; and (iv) have evidence that is strengthened (not weakened) by the large number of observed factors.
summary: 该论文探讨了金融经济学中是否存在复制危机的问题。此前有研究指出，大多数金融研究无法被复制，或者是因为对过多因子进行多重检验所致。作者开发并估计了一个贝叶斯因子复制模型，得出了不同结论。研究发现，大多数资产定价因子（i）可以被复制；（ii）可以聚类为13个主题，其中大部分是切点组合的重要组成部分；（iii）在覆盖93个国家的新大数据集中具有样本外表现；（iv）大量观测到的因子的存在反而增强了（而非削弱了）这些因子的证据。
ai_comment: 论文通过贝叶斯方法挑战了金融领域存在复制危机的观点，对因子复制和多重检验问题提供了新的视角，实证范围广泛且结论有力。

title: Do Robots Increase Wealth Dispersion?
abstract: We document significant negative effects of exposure to increased automation at work on household wealth accumulation. Beyond the income and savings channels, we uncover a novel mechanism contributing to the negative wealth effects of automation that arises through the endogenous optimal portfolio decisions of households. We show that households rebalance their financial wealth away from the stock market in response to increased human capital risk induced by pervasive automation, thereby attaining lower wealth levels and relative positions in the wealth distribution. Our evidence suggests that the portfolio channel amplifies the inequality-enhancing effects of increased automation. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究了自动化（工业机器人和人工智能）对家庭财富积累的负面影响。除了收入和储蓄渠道外，作者发现了一个新机制：家庭通过内生最优投资组合决策来应对自动化带来的更高人力资本风险。具体而言，家庭会减少股票市场投资，从而降低财富水平和在财富分布中的相对位置。证据表明，投资组合渠道放大了自动化加剧不平等的作用。论文提供了在线附录。
ai_comment: 本文创新地揭示了投资组合渠道是自动化影响财富不平等的重要传导机制，拓展了劳动力市场冲击与家庭金融决策交叉领域的研究。

title: Retail Derivatives and Sentiment: A Sentiment Measure Constructed from Issuances of Retail Structured Equity Products
abstract: We use retail structured equity product (SEP) issuances to construct a new sentiment measure for large capitalization stocks. The SEP sentiment measure predicts negative abnormal returns on the SEP reference stocks based on a variety of factor models, and also predicts returns in Fama‐MacBeth regressions that include a wide range of covariates. Consistent with our interpretation that SEP issuances reflect investor sentiment, aggregate SEP issuances are highly correlated with the Baker‐Wurgler sentiment index. Tobit regressions reveal that proxies for attention and sentiment predict SEP issuance volumes, providing additional evidence consistent with the hypothesis that SEP issuances reflect sentiment.
summary: 本文利用零售结构性权益产品（SEP）的发行量构建了一个针对大型市值股票的新情绪指标。研究发现，该SEP情绪指标能够基于多种因子模型预测SEP参考股票的负异常收益，并且在包含大量协变量的Fama-MacBeth回归中同样具有预测能力。与SEP发行反映投资者情绪的解释一致，总体SEP发行量与Baker-Wurgler情绪指数高度相关。进一步的Tobit回归分析表明，注意力和情绪代理变量能够预测SEP发行量，为SEP发行反映情绪提供了额外证据。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用零售衍生品发行数据构建情绪指标，为行为金融学提供了新的实证工具。

title: Reusing Natural Experiments
abstract: After a natural experiment is first used, other researchers often reuse the setting, examining different outcome variables. We use simulations based on real data to illustrate the multiple hypothesis testing problem that arises when researchers reuse natural experiments. We then provide guidance for future inference based on popular empirical settings including difference‐in‐differences, instrumental variables, and regression discontinuity designs. When we apply our guidance to two extensively studied natural experiments, business combination laws and the Regulation SHO pilot, we find that many results that were statistically significant using single hypothesis testing do not survive corrections for multiple hypothesis testing.
summary: 本文探讨了自然实验在首次使用后被其他研究者重复利用以检验不同结果变量时出现的多重假设检验问题。作者基于真实数据进行模拟，展示了该问题在常见实证设置（如差分法、工具变量和断点回归设计）中的影响，并为未来在这些设置下的推断提供了指导。将指导应用于两个被广泛研究的自然实验（商业合并法和SHO试点法规）时，发现许多原本通过单假设检验显著的结果在多重假设检验校正后不再显著。
ai_comment: 该研究揭示了实证金融中一个被忽视的重要问题，为自然实验的重复使用提供了统计严谨性的指导，有助于减少虚假发现。

title: Barter Credit: Warehouses as a Contracting Technology
abstract: A large Brazilian agribusiness lender introduces a new contracting technology: grain warehouses. Using runner‐up warehouse locations as a control group, I find that construction of these warehouses permits a new debt contract, namely, barter credit repayable in grain. This contract increases borrowers' debt capacity and reduces borrowing costs. The effects are stronger when grain price risk is higher, for municipalities with weaker courts, and for financially constrained borrowers. These findings are consistent with barter credit reducing financial market imperfections by mitigating borrowers' output price risk.
summary: 本文研究巴西一家大型农业贷款机构引入的一种新合同技术：粮仓。通过将亚军仓库选址作为对照组，作者发现粮仓的建设允许一种新的债务合同，即以谷物偿还的易货信贷。这种合同提高了借款人的债务能力并降低了借贷成本。当谷物价格风险更高、所在地区法院较弱以及借款人面临财务约束时，这些效应更为显著。研究结果一致表明，易货信贷通过缓解借款人的产出价格风险来减少金融市场的不完善。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地利用仓库选址的自然实验识别了易货信贷的因果效应，揭示了实物抵押品在缓解价格风险中的作用，对农业金融和合同设计有重要启示。

title: Liquidity, Volume, and Order Imbalance Volatility
abstract: We examine the dynamics of liquidity using a comprehensive sample of U.S. stocks in the post‐decimalization period. Motivated by a continuous‐time inventory model, we compute a high‐frequency measure of order imbalance volatility to proxy for the inventory risk faced by liquidity providers. We show that high‐frequency order imbalance volatility is an important driver of liquidity and explains the often positive time‐series relation between spread and volume for large stocks, which seems to run counter to most theoretical models. Furthermore, order imbalance volatility is priced in the cross‐section of stock returns.
summary: 该论文利用后十进制化时期的美国股票综合样本，研究流动性的动态变化。基于连续时间库存模型，论文计算了高频订单失衡波动性作为流动性提供者所面临的库存风险的代理变量。结果表明，高频订单失衡波动性是流动性的重要驱动因素，并解释了大型股票中价差与成交量之间常见的正时间序列关系，这一关系似乎与大多数理论模型相悖。此外，订单失衡波动性在股票回报的横截面中具有定价能力。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地引入高频订单失衡波动性作为库存风险的代理变量，为流动性动态提供了新的解释，并发现了其横截面定价效应，对市场微观结构理论和实证研究有重要贡献。

title: Friendly Investing and Information Sharing in the Asset Management Industry
abstract: Do asset managers engage in friendly investing to obtain privileged investment information? We test this hypothesis in the context of mutual fund connections to financial groups. Using brokers as the source of connections, we find that funds overweight the stock of connected financial groups and side with management in contested votes. We also find that fund performance improves with the extent of friendly investing. The improvement stems from trading the stock of companies that borrow from connected financial groups. Brokerage commissions do not drive the results. Our findings suggest that funds can obtain valuable information by acting as friendly shareholders.
summary: 该论文研究资产管理公司是否通过友好投资（friendly investing）获取特权投资信息。以共同基金与金融集团之间的关联为背景，利用经纪商作为连接渠道，发现基金超配关联金融集团的股票，并在有争议的投票中支持管理层。基金业绩随友好投资程度提高而改善，这种改善源于交易与关联金融集团有借贷关系的公司的股票。经纪佣金不能解释该结果。研究结论支持基金通过充当友好股东获取有价值信息的假说。
ai_comment: 本文从关系网络视角揭示了资产管理行业信息传递的非公开渠道，为理解基金业绩来源提供了新证据，且排除了佣金驱动等替代解释。

title: Currency Risk Premiums Redux
abstract: We study a large currency cross-section using asset pricing methods that account for omitted-variable and measurement-error biases. First, we show that the pricing kernel includes at least three latent factors that resemble (but are not identical to) a strong U.S. “dollar” factor and two weak high Sharpe ratio “carry” and “momentum” slope factors. Evidence for an additional “value” factor is weaker. Second, using this pricing kernel, we find that only a small fraction of the over 100 nontradable candidate factors considered have a statistically significant risk premium, mostly relating to volatility, uncertainty, and liquidity conditions, rather than macro variables. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文采用考虑遗漏变量和测量误差偏误的资产定价方法，研究大型货币横截面。首先，发现定价核至少包含三个潜在因子：一个强劲的美元因子、两个高夏普比率的弱因子——利差因子和动量斜率因子，而价值因子的证据较弱。其次，利用该定价核，在超过100个不可交易的候选因子中，只有少数具有统计显著的风险溢价，这些因子主要与波动率、不确定性和流动性状况相关，而非宏观变量。
ai_comment: 本文通过控制遗漏变量和测量误差，系统性地检验了货币风险溢价的多因子结构，并揭示了非交易因子的有限解释力，为汇率定价提供了新视角。

title: Nowcasting World Trade with Machine Learning: a Three-Step Approach
abstract: We nowcast world trade using machine learning, distinguishing between tree-based methods (random forest, gradient boosting) and their regression-based counterparts (macroeconomic random forest, linear gradient boosting). While much less used in the literature, the latter are found to outperform not only the tree-based techniques, but also more "traditional" linear and non-linear techniques (OLS, Markov-switching, quantile regression). They do so significantly and consistently across different horizons and real-time datasets. To further improve performances when forecasting with machine learning, we propose a flexible three-step approach composed of (step 1) pre-selection, (step 2) factor extraction and (step 3) machine learning regression. We find that both pre-selection and factor extraction significantly improve the accuracy of machine-learning-based predictions. This three-step approach also outperforms workhorse benchmarks, such as a PCA-OLS model, an elastic net, or a dynamic factor model. Finally, on top of high accuracy, the approach is flexible and can be extended seamlessly beyond world trade.
summary: 本文利用机器学习方法对世界贸易进行即时预测（nowcasting），特别区分了基于树的模型（随机森林、梯度提升）和回归型对应模型（宏观经济随机森林、线性梯度提升）。研究发现，尽管回归型机器学习方法在文献中较少使用，但其不仅优于树型方法，还显著且一致地超越了传统线性与非线性技术（如OLS、马尔可夫转换、分位数回归），在不同预测时域和实时数据集上表现稳健。为进一步提升机器学习预测性能，本文提出一个灵活的三步方法：第一步预筛选（pre-selection）、第二步因子提取（factor extraction）、第三步机器学习回归。结果表明，预筛选和因子提取均能显著提高基于机器学习的预测准确性。该三步方法还优于常用的基准模型，如PCA-OLS模型、弹性网和动态因子模型。此外，该方法除高精度外，还具有灵活性，可无缝扩展到世界贸易以外的其他领域。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将回归型机器学习方法（宏观经济随机森林、线性梯度提升）应用于世界贸易即时预测，并引入三步法显著提升预测精度，为经济预测领域提供了实用且可扩展的框架。

title: Currency Risk Premiums: A Multi-horizon Perspective
abstract: We review the literature on multi-horizon currency risk premiums.We show how the multihorizon implications arise from the classic present-value relationship.We further show how these implications manifest themselves in the interaction between bond and currency risk premiums.This link is strengthened by explicitly accounting for stochastic discount factors.Information about currency risk premiums at different horizons presents a wealth of new evidence and challenges for existing models.
summary: 本文回顾了关于多期货币风险溢价的文献，展示了多期视角下经典现值关系如何产生。进一步揭示了这种多期含义如何体现在债券与货币风险溢价的相互作用中，并通过明确考虑随机贴现因子（SDF）加强了这种联系。关于不同期限货币风险溢价的信息为现有模型提供了丰富的新证据和挑战。
ai_comment: 系统性地整合了多期视角下的货币风险溢价文献，强调了跨资产溢价的联系和SDF的作用，为后续模型发展提供了方向。

title: Production, Trade, and Cross-Border Data Flows
abstract: We build a two-country general equilibrium model to analyze the effects of cross-border data flows and pre-existing development gaps in data economies on each country's production and international trade.Raw data as byproducts of consumption can be transformed into various types of working data (information) to be used by both domestic and foreign producers.Because data constitute a new production factor for intermediate goods, a large extant divide in data utilization can reduce or even freeze trade.Cross-border data flows mitigate the situation and improve welfare when added to international trade.Data-inefficient countries where data are less important in production enjoy a "latecomer's advantage'' with international trade and data flows, contributing more raw data from which the data-efficient countries generate knowledge for production.Furthermore, cross-border data flows can reverse the cyclicity of working data usage after productivity shocks, whereas shocks to data privacy or import costs have opposite effects on domestic and foreign data sectors.The insights inform future research and policy discussions concerning data divide, data flows, and their implications for trade liberalization, the data labor market, among others.
summary: 本文构建了一个两国一般均衡模型，用于分析跨境数据流以及数据经济中现存的发展差距对各国生产和国际贸易的影响。模型将原始数据视为消费的副产品，这些数据可以转化为多种类型的工作数据（信息），供国内外生产者使用。由于数据成为中间品的新生产要素，数据利用方面的显著鸿沟可能会减少甚至冻结贸易。跨境数据流能够缓解这一状况，并在国际贸易中提升福利。数据低效国家（数据在生产中重要性较低）在国际贸易和数据流中享有“后发优势”，它们贡献更多原始数据，供数据高效国家生成生产所需的知识。此外，跨境数据流可以在生产率冲击后逆转工作数据使用的周期性，而数据隐私或进口成本的冲击对国内外数据部门产生相反影响。这些见解为未来关于数据鸿沟、数据流及其对贸易自由化、数据劳动力市场等影响的研究和政策讨论提供了参考。
ai_comment: 该模型创造性地将数据作为独立生产要素引入国际贸易理论框架，揭示了数据鸿沟的双重影响和数据低效国家的后发优势，为数据流动与贸易政策的互动提供了新视角。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission Through Online Banks
abstract: Financial technology has the potential to alter the transmission of monetary policy by lowering search costs and expanding banking markets.This paper studies the reaction of online banks to changes in the federal funds rate.We find that a 100 basis points increase in the federal funds rate leads to a 30 basis points larger increase in the deposit rates of online banks relative to traditional banks.Consistent with the rate movements, online bank deposits experience inflows, while traditional banks experience outflows.Results are similar across markets with differing competitiveness and demographics, but vary with the stickiness of depositors.
summary: 本文研究金融科技如何通过降低搜索成本和扩大银行市场来改变货币政策的传导。具体而言，分析了在线银行对联邦基金利率变化的反应。研究发现，联邦基金利率每上升100个基点，在线银行的存款利率上升幅度比传统银行高出30个基点。与利率变动一致，在线银行经历存款流入，而传统银行则面临存款流出。这些结果在不同竞争程度和人口特征的市场中相似，但会因存款者的粘性而有所不同。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用在线银行与传统银行的差异，揭示了金融科技对货币政策传导机制的影响，为理解数字化时代的货币政策和银行行为提供了新视角。

title: Monetary Policy Operations: Theory, Evidence, and Tools for Quantitative Analysis
abstract: We formulate a quantitative dynamic equilibrium theory of trade in the fed funds market, calibrate it to fit a comprehensive set of market-wide and micro-level cross-sectional observations, and use it to make two contributions to the operational side of monetary policy implementation. First, we produce global structural estimates of the aggregate demand for reserves—a crucial decision-making input for modern central banks. Second, we propose diagnostic tools to gauge the central bank’s ability to track a given fed funds target, and the heterogeneous incidence of policy actions on the shadow cost of funding across banks.
summary: 本文构建了一个联邦基金市场交易的定量动态均衡理论模型，通过校准使其匹配全面的市场层面和微观层面横截面观测数据。该模型有两个主要贡献：第一，提供了准备金总需求的全局结构性估计——这是现代中央银行决策的关键输入；第二，提出了诊断工具，用于评估中央银行跟踪特定联邦基金目标利率的能力，以及政策行动对不同银行影子融资成本的异质性影响。
ai_comment: 该论文将理论建模与实证校准相结合，为央行实际操作提供了可量化的工具，尤其在对准备金需求的全局估计和政策传递异质性方面有重要应用价值。

title: Avoiding Idiosyncratic Volatility: Flow Sensitivity to Individual Stock Returns
abstract: Despite positive and significant earnings announcement premia, we find that institutional investors reduce their exposure to stocks before earnings announcements.A novel result on the sensitivity of flows to individual stock returns provides a potential explanation.We show that extreme announcement returns for an individual holding lead to substantial outflows, controlling for overall performance, and they increase the probability of managers leaving the fund.Reducing the exposure to these stocks before the announcement mitigates the outflows.We build a model to describe and quantify this tradeoff.Overall, the paper identifies a new dimension of limits to arbitrage for institutions.
summary: 尽管盈余公告溢价显著为正，但机构投资者在盈余公告前会减少对个股的暴露。该研究揭示了资金流动对个股收益的敏感性：极端公告收益率导致资金大幅外流（控制整体业绩后），并增加基金经理离职的概率。通过在公告前减少这些股票的暴露，可以缓解资金外流。作者构建了一个模型来描述并量化这一权衡。总体而言，该论文识别了机构套利限制的一个新维度。
ai_comment: 论文创新性地从资金流动对个股收益敏感性的角度解释机构投资者在盈余公告前的减持行为，丰富了套利限制的理论。实证与模型结合，揭示了极端收益导致的资金外流对投资决策的影响。

title: Finance and Climate Resilience: Evidence from the long 1950s US Drought
abstract: We study how the availability of credit shapes adaptation to a climatic shock, specifically, the long 1950s US drought.We find that bank lending, net immigration, and population growth decline sharply in drought exposed areas with limited initial access to bank finance.In contrast, agricultural investment and long-run productivity increase more in drought-exposed areas when they have access to bank finance, even allowing some of these areas to leapfrog otherwise similar areas in the subsequent decades.We also find unequal access to finance can drive migration from drought-hit finance-poor communities to finance-rich communities.These results suggest that broadening access to finance can enable communities to adapt to large adverse climatic shocks and reduce emigration.
summary: 本文利用1950年代美国长期干旱作为气候冲击，研究信贷可得性如何影响社区对气候变化的适应。研究发现，在干旱暴露且初始银行融资有限的地区，银行借贷、净移民和人口增长显著下降；相反，在能够获得银行融资的干旱暴露地区，农业投资和长期生产率提升更多，甚至使部分地区在随后几十年中超越其他相似地区。此外，融资渠道的不平等会促使人口从受干旱冲击的金融贫困社区流向金融富裕社区。结论表明，拓宽融资渠道有助于社区适应大规模不利气候冲击，并减少人口外迁。
ai_comment: 论文利用历史自然实验，为金融在气候适应中的因果作用提供了有力证据，并揭示了金融不平等对人口迁移和长期经济表现的重要影响。

title: Firm Investments in Artificial Intelligence Technologies and Changes in Workforce Composition
abstract: We study the shifts in U.S. firms' workforce composition and organization associated with the use of AI technologies.To do so, we leverage a unique combination of worker resume and job postings datasets to measure firm-level AI investments and workforce composition variables, such as educational attainment, specialization, and hierarchy.We document that firms with higher initial shares of highly-educated workers and STEM workers invest more in AI.As firms invest in AI, they tend to transition to more educated workforces, with higher shares of workers with undergraduate and graduate degrees, and more specialization in STEM fields and IT skills.Furthermore, AI investments are associated with a flattening of the firms' hierarchical structure, with significant increases in the share of workers at the junior level and decreases in shares of workers in middle-management and senior roles.Overall, our results highlight that adoption of AI technologies is associated with significant reorganization of firms' workforces.
summary: 本文利用美国企业的简历和职位招聘数据，衡量企业层面的AI投资与劳动力组成变量（如教育程度、专业化和层级结构），研究AI投资与企业劳动力组成及组织变革的关系。研究发现，初始拥有高比例高学历和STEM员工的企业更倾向于投资AI。随着企业投资AI，其劳动力逐渐转向更高教育水平（本科和研究生学历占比增加），更多专业化于STEM领域和IT技能。此外，AI投资与组织层级扁平化相关，表现为初级员工比例显著上升，中层管理和高级职位比例下降。总体而言，AI技术的采用与企业劳动力和组织的重大重组相关。
ai_comment: 该研究通过独特的简历和招聘数据，从微观层面量化了AI对企业劳动力结构的实际影响，特别是层级扁平化这一发现对理解技术变革的组织后果具有重要价值。

title: Using Machine Learning to Construct Hedonic Price Indices
abstract: This paper uses machine learning (ML) to estimate hedonic price indices at scale from item-level transaction and product characteristics. The procedure uses state-of-the-art approaches from hedonic econometrics and implements them with a neural network ML approach. Applying the methodology to Nielsen Retail Scanner data leads to a large hedonic adjustment to the Tornqvist index for food product groups: Cumulative food inﬂation over the period from 2007 through 2015 is reduced by half—from 5.9% to 2.8%—owing to quality adjustment. These results suggest that quality improvement via product turnover is important even in product groups that are not normally considered to feature rapid technological progress. The approach in the paper thus demonstrates the feasibility and importance of implementing hedonic adjustment at scale.
summary: 本文利用机器学习方法（尤其是神经网络）从商品层面交易数据和产品特征中大规模估计特征价格指数。该方法结合了特征计量经济学的前沿技术，并应用于Nielsen零售扫描数据，对食品产品组的Tornqvist指数进行了大幅特征调整：2007年至2015年期间，累计食品通胀率因质量调整从5.9%降至2.8%。结果表明，即使在通常被认为技术变革不快的产品组中，产品更替带来的质量改进也至关重要。该研究展示了大规模实施特征调整的可行性和重要性。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将神经网络应用于大规模特征价格指数构建，揭示了食品通胀中质量调整的显著低估效应，具有重要的政策与实证价值。

title: Trade Wars, Nominal Rigidities and Monetary Policy
abstract: This paper shows that the outcome of trade wars for tariffs and welfare will be affected by the monetary policy regime.The key message is that trade policy interacts with monetary policy in a way that magnifies the welfare costs of discretionary monetary policy in an international setting.If countries follow monetary policies of flexible inflation targeting, trade wars are relatively mild, with low equilibrium tariffs and small welfare costs.Discretionary monetary policies imply much higher tariffs, high inflation rates, and substantially larger welfare costs.We quantify the effects of a global trade war among major economies using estimates of trade elasticities, economic size, net foreign assets and trade openness.We find large welfare benefits of an inflation targeting monetary policy for all countries.
summary: 本文研究货币政策体制如何影响贸易战的结果——包括关税水平和福利损失。关键发现是，贸易政策与货币政策之间存在相互作用，在国际环境中这种相互作用会放大相机抉择货币政策的福利成本。如果各国采用灵活的通胀目标制货币政策，贸易战相对温和，均衡关税较低，福利损失较小；而相机抉择的货币政策则会导致更高的关税、高通胀率以及显著的更大福利损失。作者利用贸易弹性、经济规模、净外国资产和贸易开放度的估计，量化了全球主要经济体之间爆发全球贸易战的影响，并发现对所有国家而言，采用通胀目标制货币政策能带来巨大的福利收益。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地揭示货币政策体制对贸易战结果的塑造作用，为贸易摩擦中的政策协调提供了新视角，量化结果具有重要政策启示。

title: Specialization Trends in Economics Research: A Large-Scale Study Using Natural Language Processing and Citation Analysis
abstract: This article conducts a comprehensive analysis of specialization trends within and across fields of economics research. We collect data on 24, 273 articles published between 1970 and 2016 in general research economics outlets and employ machine learning techniques to enrich the collected data. Results indicate that theory and econometric methods papers are becoming increasingly specialized, with a narrowing scope and steady or declining citations from outside economics and from other fields of economics research. Conversely, applied papers are covering a broader range of topics, receiving more extramural citations from fields like medicine, and psychology. Trends in applied theory articles are unclear.
summary: 本文对经济学研究领域的专业化趋势进行了全面分析。研究者收集了1970年至2016年间发表在综合经济学期刊上的24,273篇文章，并运用机器学习技术对数据进行了丰富。结果表明，理论和计量方法论文日益专业化，范围趋于狭窄，来自经济学外部及其他经济学领域的引用数量稳定或下降；而应用论文涵盖的主题范围更广，从医学、心理学等领域获得更多外部引用。应用理论论文的趋势则不明确。
ai_comment: 该研究利用大规模文献数据和机器学习方法，为经济学研究专业化提供了量化证据，尤其揭示了理论与应用论文的差异化发展趋势，对理解学科演化有重要意义。

title: An Analysis of Carbon-Reduction Pledges of U.S. Oil and Gas Companies
abstract: We study carbon-reduction pledges of publicly traded U.S. oil exploration and production (E&P) companies. Of the 69 firms in the sample, 18 have committed to net-zero carbon targets, 14 have announced significant emissions cuts, whereas the remaining 37 firms have not announced any formal commitment to reduce emissions. We find that a firm’s energy production and ownership by BlackRock is positively associated with its decision to announce a net-zero pledge or significant emission cuts. E&P firms are likely to announce such commitments after Engine No. 1 proposed its slate of directors for Exxon’s board. The stock market reacts more negatively to net-zero pledges relative to emission-reduction pledges on average. However, the market reaction is related to the quality and credibility of these pledges. In particular, we find that the negative market reaction to net-zero pledges is mainly driven by firms with post-2030 target years relative to firms that commit to achieving net zero by 2030. We also find that the market reacts more negatively to net-zero pledges when the firm does not show the strength of its commitment via the presence of a board-level committee to monitor the company’s progress toward its emission goals or when the top management’s pay is not linked to specific emission reduction goals. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: The research was funded by Columbia Business School. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4765 .
summary: 本文研究美国上市油气勘探与生产（E&P）公司的碳减排承诺。在69家样本公司中，18家承诺实现净零碳排放目标，14家宣布显著减排，其余37家未做出正式承诺。研究发现，公司的能源产量和贝莱德持股比例与其宣布净零承诺或显著减排决策正相关。E&P公司在Engine No.1提名Exxon董事会候选人后更可能宣布此类承诺。平均而言，股市对净零承诺的反应比减排承诺更负面，但市场反应与承诺的质量和可信度相关：负反应主要由承诺在2030年后实现净零的公司驱动，此外，若公司未设立董事会级委员会监督排放进展或高管薪酬未与具体减排目标挂钩，市场对净零承诺的负面反应更显著。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证分析揭示了减排承诺的市场评估机制，强调了承诺可信度与治理结构的关键作用，对理解企业气候承诺的经济后果具有重要价值。

title: Welfare Consequences of Sustainable Finance
abstract: We model the welfare consequences of mandates that restrict investors to hold firms with net-zero carbon emissions. To qualify for these mandates, value-maximizing firms have to accumulate decarbonization capital. Qualification lowers a firm’s required return by its decarbonization investments divided by Tobin’s q, that is, the greenium or the dividend yield shareholders forgo to address the global-warming externality. The welfare-maximizing mandate approximates the first-best solution, yielding welfare gains compared to laissez-faire by mitigating the weather disaster risks resulting from carbon emissions. Our model generates optimal transition paths for decarbonization that we use to evaluate proposed net-zero targets. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文构建了一个理论模型，研究限制投资者仅持有净零碳排放企业的授权（mandate）对福利的影响。价值最大化企业为符合授权要求，需积累脱碳资本。符合授权条件通过脱碳投资与托宾q的比值降低企业的要求回报率，即产生绿色溢价（greenium），该溢价是股东为应对全球变暖外部性而放弃的股息收益率。福利最大化授权近似于第一最佳（first-best）解决方案，通过减轻碳排放导致的天气灾害风险，相比自由放任（laissez-faire）产生福利收益。模型还生成了最优脱碳转型路径，用于评估提出的净零目标。
ai_comment: 本文通过严谨的理论模型首次量化了可持续投资授权的福利效应，并提供了最优转型路径，为政策制定提供了重要参考。

title: Reaching for yield and the housing market: Evidence from 18th-century Amsterdam
abstract: Do investors reach for yield when interest rates are low and does this behavior affect the housing market? Using the unique setting and data of 18th-century Amsterdam, I show that reach-for-yield behavior of wealthy investors resulted in a large boom and bust in house prices and major changes in rental yields. Exploiting changes in the supply of bonds, I show that investors living off capital income shifted their portfolios towards real estate and other higher-yielding assets when bond yields were low and decreasing. This behavior exacerbated house price volatility and increased housing wealth inequality.
summary: 论文利用18世纪阿姆斯特丹的独特历史数据和自然实验，研究低利率环境下投资者是否追逐收益（reach for yield）及其对住房市场的影响。通过债券供给变化，发现依赖资本收益的富裕投资者在债券收益率低且下降时，将投资组合转向房地产和其他高收益资产，导致房价大起大落和租金收益率显著变化，并加剧了住房财富不平等。
ai_comment: 利用历史自然实验，揭示了低利率环境下投资者追逐收益行为对房市的影响，为理解泡沫形成和财富不平等提供新证据。

title: Why is dollar debt Cheaper? Evidence from Peru
abstract: In emerging markets, a significant share of corporate loans are denominated in dollars. Using novel data that includes loan-level currency and the cost of credit, in addition to several other transaction-level characteristics, we re-examine the reasons behind dollar credit popularity. We find that a dollar-denominated loan has an interest rate that is 2 percentage points lower per year than a loan in local currency. Expectations of exchange rate movements do not explain this difference. We show that this interest rate differential for lending rates is closely matched by the differential in the deposit market. Our results suggest that the preference for dollar loans is rooted in the local depositors preference for dollar savings, and a banking sector that is strongly incentivized to closely match its foreign-currency assets and liabilities. Cross-borrower variation points to competitive pressure among banks to explain the significant pass-through of this differential.
summary: 本文利用秘鲁企业贷款的新型数据，包含贷款货币、信贷成本及其他交易特征，重新审视美元信贷流行的原因。研究发现，美元贷款的年利率比本币贷款低2个百分点，且汇率变动预期无法解释这一差异。利率差异与存款市场的利差紧密匹配，表明美元贷款偏好源于本地储户对美元储蓄的偏好，以及银行强烈激励匹配其外汇资产和负债。借款人之间的差异还显示，银行之间的竞争压力是这一利差显著传导的重要原因。
ai_comment: 本文通过独特的数据集和实证设计，揭示了美元债务利率优势的根源在于存款端偏好与银行资产负债匹配，而非汇率预期，为理解新兴市场美元化信贷现象提供了新的视角。

title: Asset holders’ consumption risk and tests of conditional CCAPM
abstract: We test the conditional consumption-CAPM using asset holders’ consumption and find that the time variation in the prices of asset holders’ consumption risk is procyclical. This puzzling time variation is at odds with the implication of existing consumption-based equilibrium asset pricing models. We show that our finding is a salient feature of the data observed in multiple asset classes (aggregate equity market, equity portfolios, bond portfolios, and commodities portfolios), using different measures of consumption (household survey data and high-frequency retail shopping data) and alternative empirical methodologies.
summary: 本文使用资产持有者的消费数据检验条件消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM），发现资产持有者消费风险的价格随时间呈顺周期变化。这一与现有消费型均衡资产定价模型预测相悖的发现，在多个资产类别（如整体股票市场、股票组合、债券组合和商品组合）、不同的消费度量方式（家庭调查数据和高频零售购物数据）以及多种实证方法下均稳健成立。
ai_comment: 该文通过引入资产持有者的消费数据，揭示了条件CCAPM中消费风险价格的顺周期特征，对现有消费型资产定价模型构成挑战，且实证稳健性强。

title: Insurance and portfolio decisions: Two sides of the same coin?
abstract: We study insurance and portfolio decisions, two opposite risk retention tradeoffs. Using household level data, we identify the first joint determinants (e.g. subjective expectations, risk attitude) and frictions (e.g. liquidity constraints, financial literacy) in the literature. We also find key differences between the two decisions. Notably, contrary to economic intuition, risky asset holding and insurance coverage both increase with wealth. We show that this apparent puzzle is driven in part by a specific behavioral pattern (the poor invest too conservatively, while the rich over-insure), and can be explained by two factors: regret avoidance and nonperformance risk.
summary: 本研究联合考察保险购买与投资组合决策这两种相反的风险保留权衡。利用家庭层面数据，首次在文献中识别出两者的共同决定因素（如主观预期、风险态度）与摩擦（如流动性约束、金融素养）。同时发现二者存在关键差异：与经济学直觉相反，财富增加时风险资产持有和保险覆盖均上升。这一表观谜团部分由特定行为模式导致（穷人投资过于保守，富人过度保险），并可由后悔规避和不履约风险两个因素解释。
ai_comment: 本文首次在同一框架下研究家庭保险与投资决策的联合决定因素，并通过行为机制（后悔规避、不履约风险）解释了财富与两者正相关的矛盾现象，对家庭金融理论具有重要意义。

title: Heterogeneous liquidity providers and night-minus-day return predictability
abstract: We present and test a model to understand the puzzling fact that characteristics-sorted stock portfolios tend to earn opposite-signed overnight and intraday expected returns. Heterogeneous arbitrageurs – “fast” arbitrageurs with informational advantages and “slow” arbitrageurs with low inventory costs – compete to determine the price of liquidity. High information asymmetry around market open allows fast arbitrageurs to demand large price deviations for absorbing order imbalances, as cream-skimming risk discourages competition from slow arbitrageurs. Despite persistent order imbalances, these deviations attenuate when cream-skimming risk subsides, leading to opposite-signed overnight and intraday returns. Our model identifies novel determinants that empirically explain substantial variations in predictable overnight-minus-intraday returns.
summary: 本文提出并检验了一个模型，以解释特征排序的股票组合往往具有相反符号的隔夜预期收益和日内预期收益这一令人困惑的事实。模型中，异质性套利者——具有信息优势的“快速”套利者和具有低库存成本的“慢速”套利者——竞争决定流动性价格。市场开盘时信息不对称程度高，使得快速套利者能够通过要求大的价格偏差来吸收订单不平衡，因为撇脂风险阻碍了慢速套利者的竞争。尽管订单不平衡持续存在，但当撇脂风险消退时，这些价格偏差会减弱，从而导致相反符号的隔夜和日内收益。该模型识别了新的决定因素，这些因素在实证上解释了可预测的隔夜减日内收益的显著变化。
keywords: 隔夜-日内收益可预测性
ai_comment: 该模型通过异质性套利者竞争视角，为隔夜与日内收益的反向关系提供了新颖的理论解释，并识别了实证上重要的新决定因素。

title: Private Equity and Local Public Finances
abstract: We study the economic impact of private equity (PE) investments on local governments, which are important corporate stakeholders. Examining over 11,000 deals and private firm data in Europe, we document that target firms' effective tax rates and total tax expenses decrease by 15% and 13% after PE deals. At the same time, target firms expand their capital expenditures and firm boundaries, but do not increase employment. Using administrative data on the public finances of German municipalities and exploiting the geographical and time‐series variation in PE deals, we document that PE activity is negatively associated with local governments' tax revenues and spending. This result is likely driven by reduced tax payments of PE portfolio firms, accompanied by only modest positive spillovers of PE investments on regional economic growth. Collectively, our findings suggest that corporate tax efficiency serves as a cost‐cutting channel in the PE sector and constrains the finances of local governments.
summary: 本文研究私募股权（PE）投资对地方政府的经济影响，地方政府是重要的企业利益相关者。基于欧洲超过11,000笔交易和私营企业数据，发现目标企业的有效税率和总税收支出在PE交易后分别下降15%和13%。同时，目标企业扩大资本支出和企业边界，但未增加就业。利用德国市政当局的公共财政行政数据，并结合PE交易的地理和时间序列变化，发现PE活动与地方政府的税收收入和支出呈负相关。这一结果很可能由PE投资组合企业税负减少驱动，而PE投资对区域经济增长的正向溢出效应有限。总体而言，企业税收效率是PE部门削减成本的渠道，并约束了地方政府的财政。
ai_comment: 本文通过微观与宏观数据的结合，揭示了PE投资对地方政府财政的负面外部性，挑战了PE仅有利于企业效率的传统观点，具有重要的政策启示。

title: ES Risks and Shareholder Voice
abstract: We examine whether shareholder votes in environmental and social (ES) proposals are informative about firms’ ES risks. ES proposals are unique in that they nearly always fail. We examine whether mutual funds’ support for these failed proposals contains information about the ES risks that firms face. Higher support in failed ES proposals predicts subsequent ES incidents and the effects of these incidents on shareholder value. Examining the detailed records of fund votes, we find that agency frictions between a group of shareholders contribute to proposal failure. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文研究股东在环境和社会（ES）提案上的投票是否包含公司ES风险的信息。由于ES提案几乎总是失败，作者考察共同基金对这些失败提案的支持是否蕴含公司面临的ES风险。结果表明，失败ES提案中更高的支持度能够预测后续的ES事件以及这些事件对股东价值的影响。通过分析基金投票的详细记录，研究发现股东群体之间的代理摩擦是导致提案失败的原因之一。
ai_comment: 该论文利用失败的ES提案中基金支持度来预测未来ES风险，视角新颖，并揭示了代理摩擦在提案失败中的作用。

title: More Risk, More Information: How Passive Ownership Can Improve Informational Efficiency
abstract: We identify a novel economic mechanism through which passive ownership positively affects informational efficiency in the cross-section of firms. Passive investors’ inelastic demand lowers a firm’s cost-of-capital, inducing it to take more risk. The higher cash flow variance, in turn, incentivizes active investors to acquire more precise private information, pushing up price informativeness for firms with high passive ownership. High passive ownership also implies higher stock prices and higher stock-return variances. An increase in the aggregate size of passive investors amplifies these cross-sectional differences. We also document complementarities in firms’ real investment and investors’ information choices that can cause information crashes. Received May 31, 2020; editorial decision January 4, 2023 by Editor Holger Mueller. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文识别了一个新的经济机制，通过该机制被动所有权正向影响公司横截面上的信息效率。被动投资者的无弹性需求降低了公司的资本成本，促使公司承担更多风险。更高的现金流方差进而激励主动投资者获取更精确的私有信息，从而提高了被动所有权较高公司的价格信息性。高被动所有权也意味着更高的股票价格和更高的股票收益方差。被动投资者总规模的增加放大了这些横截面差异。本文还记录了公司实际投资与投资者信息选择之间的互补性，这可能导致信息崩溃。
ai_comment: 本文从公司风险承担角度揭示了被动所有权影响信息效率的新渠道，具有理论创新性，并发现了投资与信息选择的互补性，丰富了被动投资对市场影响的理解。

title: Minimum Wage Hikes and Technology Adoption: Evidence from U.S. Establishments
abstract: This article studies the effects of state minimum wage increase on information technology (IT) adoption at the establishment level in the United States. Our results show that treatment establishments on average allocate between $10,328 and $66,808 more per year to their IT budgets during the first 3 years after experiencing significant state minimum wage increases. Additional evidence shows that state minimum wage increases on average lead to an economically small decrease in employment. The estimated employment effect is larger for establishments that have more incentives to automate labor. Our results suggest that establishments adopt technology to countervail increased labor costs.
summary: 本文研究美国各州最低工资上涨对信息技术（IT）采用的影响，基于企业层面的数据。结果显示，在经历显著的最低工资上涨后的前三年内，受影响的企业的IT预算平均每年增加10,328至66,808美元。此外，最低工资上涨平均导致就业小幅下降，且这一就业效应在更有动力实现自动化的企业中更为显著。研究结论表明，企业通过采用技术来应对劳动力成本的上升。
ai_comment: 本文利用企业层面数据揭示了最低工资上涨对技术采用的影响，为理解劳动力成本与自动化之间的关系提供了微观证据。

title: Inflation and Individual Investors’ Behavior: Evidence from the German Hyperinflation
abstract: We analyze how individual investors respond to inflation. We introduce a unique data set containing information on local inflation and security portfolios of more than 2,000 clients of a German bank between 1920 and 1924, covering the German hyperinflation. We find that individual investors buy fewer (sell more) stocks when facing higher local inflation. This effect is more pronounced for less sophisticated investors. Moreover, we document a positive relation between local inflation and forgone returns following stock sales. Our findings are consistent with individual investors suffering from money illusion. Alternative explanations, such as consumption needs, are unlikely to drive our results. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文利用德国恶性通胀时期（1920-1924）超过2000名银行客户的独特数据集，结合本地通胀率与证券投资组合信息，研究个人投资者如何应对通胀。结果发现，当面临更高的本地通胀时，个人投资者会减少股票买入或增加卖出，且该效应在非成熟投资者中更为显著。此外，本地通胀与股票出售后放弃的回报之间存在正相关关系。这些发现与投资者遭受货币幻觉的假设一致，而消费需求等替代解释不太可能驱动结果。
ai_comment: 利用罕见的历史微观数据为货币幻觉理论提供实证支持，并区分了投资者成熟度的影响，具有独特贡献。

title: Flu Fallout: Information Production Constraints and Corporate Disclosure
abstract: Using influenza epidemic data, we examine how constraints on corporate information production affect disclosure policies. We find that firms in areas with higher flu activity are less likely to issue short‐run earnings forecasts and more likely to issue long‐run earnings forecasts. These results are more pronounced when the information production process is more complex, when managers face a greater reputational loss for issuing low‐quality short‐run forecasts, and when firms’ costs of switching the forecast horizon are lower. Further analysis implies that the effect of flu activity on these forecast issuance decisions is not driven by firm performance or information uncertainty. Our results suggest that managers do not simply avoid issuing forecasts in response to information production constraints. Instead, they shift the forecast horizon from short‐run to long‐run, appearing to balance the costs of issuing low‐quality forecasts with those of not issuing forecasts at all.
summary: 本研究利用流感疫情数据，考察企业信息生产约束对披露政策的影响。研究发现，位于流感活动较高地区的企业更不可能发布短期盈利预测，而更可能发布长期盈利预测。这种效应在信息生产过程更复杂、管理者因发布低质量短期预测面临更大声誉损失以及企业转换预测期限成本较低时更为显著。进一步分析表明，流感活动对预测发布决策的影响并非由企业业绩或信息不确定性驱动。结果表明，管理者不会因信息生产约束而简单避免发布预测，而是将预测期限从短期转向长期，似乎在发布低质量预测的成本与完全不发布预测的成本之间进行权衡。
ai_comment: 该论文利用流行病学数据作为外生冲击，识别信息生产约束对企业披露策略的因果影响，并揭示了管理层通过调整预测期限而非完全回避披露的权衡行为，为信息披露理论提供了新视角。

title: How Do Firms Respond to Political Uncertainty? Evidence from U.S. Gubernatorial Elections
abstract: We examine the joint response to political uncertainty along two margins: changes in real activity and voluntary disclosure. We focus on within‐firm variation in exposure to ex ante competitive U.S. gubernatorial elections using data on preelection poll margins and firms’ state exposures. Despite real activity falling in the years leading up to a close election, we find that voluntary disclosure increases both in frequency and content, including mentions of risk in filings that reference states holding elections. Our tests use a decomposition of 8‐K filings into real activity and voluntary disclosure to address the endogenous complementarity between these two responses. These results hold when using alternative ex ante measures of political uncertainty based on term‐limited incumbents, historically competitive offices, or state legislature gridlock. Both effects of political uncertainty are stronger for firms in highly regulated industries and weaker for those least exposed to the local market, linking the real activity and disclosure responses to uncertainty.
summary: 本文研究企业如何沿实际活动和自愿披露两个维度共同应对政治不确定性，利用美国州长选举的内生变化。通过选举前民调差距和企业对各州的经济暴露度，衡量企业面临的选举不确定性。研究发现，尽管在竞争激烈的选举前几年实际活动下降，但自愿披露在频率和内容上均增加，包括在提及相关州选举的文件中增加风险讨论。使用8-K文件的分解方法解决这两种反应的内生互补性。结果在基于任期限制、历史竞争性或州立法僵局等替代政治不确定性度量下依然稳健。对于高度监管行业的企业，政治不确定性的这两种效应更强；而对于当地市场暴露较低的企业则更弱，从而将实际活动和披露反应与不确定性联系起来。
ai_comment: 该研究的独特贡献在于同时考察企业实际活动和自愿披露两种应对政治不确定性的机制，并利用州长选举的外生变化进行因果识别。

title: Can Security Design Foster Household Risk‐Taking?
abstract: This paper shows that securities with nonlinear payoff designs can foster household risk‐taking. We demonstrate this effect by exploiting the introduction of capital guarantee products in Sweden between 2002 and 2007. Their fast and broad adoption is associated with an increase in expected financial portfolio returns. The effect is especially strong for households with low‐risk appetite ex ante. These empirical facts are consistent with a life‐cycle model in which households have pessimistic beliefs or preferences combining loss aversion and narrow framing. Our results illustrate how security design can mitigate behavioral biases to increase mean household portfolio returns.
summary: 本文利用瑞典2002年至2007年间引入本金担保产品的自然实验，实证发现具有非线性收益设计的证券能够促进家庭风险承担。这类产品的快速普及与家庭预期金融投资组合回报的提升显著相关，尤其对事前风险厌恶程度较低的家庭影响更为明显。这些实证结果与包含悲观信念或兼具损失厌恶与窄框架偏好的生命周期模型预测一致，表明证券设计可通过缓解行为偏差来提高家庭平均投资组合回报。
ai_comment: 本文首次利用准自然实验证据揭示了证券设计在纠正行为偏差、提升家庭风险承担方面的积极作用，为行为金融与家庭金融交叉领域提供了重要洞见。

title: Firm-Level Exposure to Epidemic Diseases: COVID-19, SARS, and H1N1
abstract: We construct text-based measures of the primary concerns listed firms associated with the spread of COVID-19 and other epidemic diseases. We identify which firms perceive to lose or gain from a given epidemic and textually decompose the epidemic’s effect on the firm’s demand and supply. We find that the effects of COVID-19 manifest as a simultaneous shock to demand and supply, with both shocks affecting firms’ market valuations in equal measure on average. By contrast, demand-related impacts appear more important in accounting for the observed collapse in firm-level investment during the COVID-19 crisis. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文构建了基于文本的度量方法，用于衡量上市公司在COVID-19及其他流行病传播期间的主要关注点。通过分析企业文本，识别哪些企业认为自身会因特定流行病受损或受益，并从文本中分解流行病对企业需求和供给的影响。研究发现，COVID-19的影响表现为需求和供给的同时冲击，两者在平均意义上等量影响企业的市场估值。相比之下，在解释COVID-19危机期间企业层面投资的崩溃时，需求相关冲击更为重要。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用文本分析量化了企业层面的流行病暴露及其供需分解，为理解疫情对企业金融的影响提供了新方法。

title: Private Renegotiations and Government Interventions in Credit Chains
abstract: We propose a model of strategic renegotiation in which businesses are sequentially interconnected through their liabilities. This financing structure, which we refer to as a credit chain, gives rise to externalities, as each lender’s willingness to provide concessions to its borrower depends on how this lender’s own liabilities are expected to be renegotiated. We highlight how government interventions aimed at preventing default waves should account for private renegotiation incentives and interlinkages. In particular, we contrast the consequences of targeted subsidy and debt reduction programs following economic shocks, such as pandemics and financial crises.
summary: 本文提出了一个战略重新谈判模型，其中企业通过负债形成顺序互联的信用链。这种融资结构产生外部性，因为每个贷款人对其借款人提供让步的意愿取决于该贷款人自身的负债如何被预期重新谈判。研究强调了旨在防止违约浪潮的政府干预应考虑私人重新谈判激励和相互联系，特别对比了经济冲击（如流行病和金融危机）后针对性补贴和债务削减计划的后果。
ai_comment: 该模型巧妙地将信用链中的外部性纳入政府干预设计，为政策制定提供了微观基础，对理解危机后债务重整具有重要启示。

title: Narrative Asset Pricing: Interpretable Systematic Risk Factors from News Text
abstract: We estimate a narrative factor pricing model from news text of The Wall Street Journal. Our empirical method integrates topic modeling (LDA), latent factor analysis (IPCA), and variable selection (group lasso). Narrative factors achieve higher out-of-sample Sharpe ratios and smaller pricing errors than standard characteristic-based factor models and predict future investment opportunities in a manner consistent with the ICAPM. We derive an interpretation of the estimated risk factors from narratives in the underlying article text. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文从《华尔街日报》的新闻文本中估计了一个叙事因子定价模型。实证方法整合了主题模型（LDA）、潜在因子分析（IPCA）和变量选择（group lasso）。叙事因子在样本外实现了比标准特征因子模型更高的夏普比率和更小的定价误差，并且以与ICAPM一致的方式预测未来的投资机会。作者还从底层文章文本中对估计的风险因子进行了解释。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地将文本挖掘与资产定价结合，构建了可解释的叙事因子，展示了超越传统因子的样本外表现，并为ICAPM提供了新证据。

title: Measuring Firm Complexity
abstract: In business research, firm size is both ubiquitous and readily measured. Complexity, another firm-related construct, is also relevant, but difficult to measure and not well-defined. As a result, complexity is less frequently incorporated in empirical designs. We argue that most extant measures of complexity are one-dimensional, have limited availability, and/or are frequently misspecified. Using both machine learning and an application-specific lexicon, we develop a text solution that uses widely available data and provides an omnibus measure of complexity. Our proposed measure, used in tandem with 10-K file size, provides a useful proxy that dominates traditional measures.
summary: 在商业研究中，公司规模既普遍又易于测量，而另一个公司相关构念——复杂性，同样重要但难以测量且定义不清，因此较少被纳入实证设计。摘要指出大多数现有的复杂性测量是单维度的、可用性有限或经常被错误指定。利用机器学习和应用特定词典，作者开发了一个文本解决方案，使用广泛可用的数据，提供了一个综合的复杂性测量。他们提出的测量与10-K文件大小配合使用，提供了一个优于传统测量方法的有用代理。
ai_comment: 该论文通过机器学习和特定词典从文本中测量公司复杂性，提供了一种比传统方法更全面的代理变量，具有广泛的数据可用性。

title: Fintech Lending and Credit Market Competition
abstract: This article studies how the rise of financial technology (Fintech) lending affects credit access, interest rates, and social welfare. We consider a lending competition model with two incumbent banks and a Fintech lender, which use different information and technologies to assess borrower creditworthiness. We show that Fintech lending could negatively affect high-quality borrowers’ access to credit when the Fintech lender’s screening accuracy is superior to that of the banks. Furthermore, Fintech lending may worsen the allocative efficiency of credit and reduce social welfare under some conditions. Analytical and numerical results suggest that Fintech lending mostly reduces the expected interest rates.
summary: 本文研究了金融科技贷款的兴起如何影响信贷获取、利率和社会福利。构建了一个包含两家现有银行和一家金融科技贷款机构的借贷竞争模型，它们使用不同的信息和技术来评估借款人信用。研究发现，当金融科技贷款机构的筛选准确性优于银行时，金融科技贷款可能对高质量借款人的信贷获取产生负面影响。此外，在某些条件下，金融科技贷款可能恶化信贷的配置效率并降低社会福利。分析和数值结果表明，金融科技贷款大多降低了预期利率。
ai_comment: 本文通过构建竞争模型揭示了金融科技贷款对信贷市场的双面影响，特别指出其可能损害高质量借款人和降低社会福利，挑战了传统认知。

title: Optimal Sequential Selling Mechanism and Deal Protections in Mergers and Acquisitions
abstract: We study the dynamic profit‐maximizing selling mechanism in a merger and acquisitions (M&A) environment with costly bidder entry and without entry fees. Depending on the parameters, the optimal mechanism is implemented by a standard auction or by a two‐stage procedure with exclusive offers to one bidder followed by an auction potentially favoring that bidder. The optimal mechanism may involve common deal protections like termination fees, asset lockups, or stock option lockups. Our proposed procedures resemble sales of targets filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy or M&A involving public targets, and they shed light on how to use deal protections in practice.
summary: 本文研究了在并购（M&A）环境中，投标者进入成本高昂且无入场费时的动态利润最大化销售机制。研究发现，最优机制取决于参数，可通过标准拍卖或两阶段程序实现：先向一个投标者提供独家报价，随后进行可能偏向该投标者的拍卖。该机制可能涉及常见的交易保护条款，如终止费、资产锁定或股票期权锁定。所提出的程序类似于破产法第11章目标的出售或涉及公开目标的并购，并揭示了如何在实践中运用交易保护。
ai_comment: 本文从机制设计视角系统解释了并购中常见交易保护条款的理论合理性，为实务操作提供了理论依据。

title: Freeze! Financial Sanctions and Bank Responses
abstract: Using regulatory data, we study German bank lending in countries targeted by financial sanctions. We find that domestic banks in Germany reduce lending in sanctioned countries, whereas their foreign bank affiliates outside Germany increase lending. In some cases, this is because the bank affiliates’ host countries have not imposed sanctions themselves. However, even German bank affiliates in host countries that enact sanctions like Germany increase lending if these host countries lack strong institutions and anticrime policies. These findings suggest that even universally adopted sanctions distort bank capital flows and competition if the level of their enforcement varies across bank locations. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 这篇论文利用监管数据，研究了受金融制裁国家的德国银行贷款情况。研究发现，德国国内银行在受制裁国家减少了贷款，而它们在德国境外的外国银行附属机构则增加了贷款。在某些情况下，这是因为银行附属机构所在的东道国本身没有实施制裁。然而，即使东道国实施了与德国类似的制裁，如果这些东道国缺乏强有力的制度和反犯罪政策，德国银行的附属机构也会增加贷款。这些发现表明，即使普遍采用的制裁也会扭曲银行资本流动和竞争，如果其执行水平在不同银行地点之间存在差异。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特监管数据揭示了金融制裁的意外后果，即银行通过境外附属机构规避制裁，并强调了东道国制度质量在制裁效果中的关键作用。

title: The Design of Macroprudential Stress Tests
abstract: We study the design of stress tests that provide information about aggregate and idiosyncratic risk in banks’ portfolios and impose contingent capital requirements. In the optimal static test, an adverse scenario fails all weak and some strong banks, limiting the stigma of failure. Sequential tests outperform static tests. Under natural conditions, the optimal sequential test consists of a precautionary recapitalization, followed by a scenario that fails only weak banks, similar to TARP in 2008, followed by SCAP in 2009. Our results also shed light on the Federal Reserve’s decision to test the banks twice in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究了宏观审慎压力测试的设计，该类测试旨在提供银行投资组合中聚合风险和特质风险的信息，并施加或有资本要求。研究发现，在最优静态测试中，不利情景会使所有弱银行和部分强银行失败，从而限制失败的污名效应。顺序测试（sequential tests）优于静态测试：在自然条件下，最优顺序测试包括一个预防性资本重组阶段，随后是一个仅淘汰弱银行的情景，这与2008年问题资产救助计划（TARP）和2009年监管资本评估计划（SCAP）的顺序类似。研究结果还揭示了美联储在2020年COVID-19疫情期间对银行进行两次测试的决策依据。作者提供了互联网附录。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型严谨地分析了压力测试设计中的权衡，特别是顺序测试相对于静态测试的优势，并结合历史经验（TARP和SCAP）进行验证，对监管实践具有重要启示。

title: Racial Diversity Exposure and Firm Responses Following the Murder of George Floyd
abstract: George Floyd's murder caused many firms to reveal how exposed they are to racial diversity issues. We examine investor and firm behaviors after this socially significant event to provide evidence on the valuation effects of the exposure and ensuing corporate responses. We develop a text‐based measure of a firm's exposure to racial diversity issues from conference call transcripts and find that, after the murder of George Floyd, firms with diversity exposure experience a stock price decrease of approximately 0.7% around the date of the conference call. We provide evidence that this effect is attributable to race‐related exposure and not gender‐related exposure. Initiatives taken by firms mitigate the negative market reaction. We document that firms with racial diversity exposure respond by appointing Black directors. The stock market views appointments of Black directors more favorably after George Floyd's murder, except when they are perceived as symbolic. We also find that firms with greater exposure to racial diversity are more likely to establish diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) departments, appoint DEI leaders, specify diversity goals, increase supply chain diversity, and donate to racial justice causes. Our paper provides evidence that exposure to racial diversity issues adversely affects firm value, and companies address the exposure by taking actions.
summary: 本文以乔治·弗洛伊德遇害事件为背景，研究企业暴露于种族多样性问题后的投资者反应和企业应对措施。作者通过构建基于电话会议文本的种族多样性暴露度量指标，发现事件发生后，暴露程度高的企业在电话会议日附近股价平均下跌约0.7%，且该效应主要由种族相关而非性别相关暴露驱动。企业采取的积极举措（如任命黑人董事、设立DEI部门等）能够缓解市场负面反应。市场对黑人董事任命的反应在事件后更为积极，但象征性任命除外。本文揭示了种族多样性暴露对企业价值的负面影响，并记录企业通过具体行动应对暴露的事实。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地利用电话会议文本量化企业种族多样性暴露，并结合事件研究方法，为理解社会事件如何影响企业价值及企业应对策略提供了因果证据。

title: Standing Out from the Crowd via CSR Engagement: Evidence from Non-Fundamental-Driven Price Pressure
abstract: We test the signaling view of corporate social responsibility (CSR) engagement using two complementary quasi-natural experiments that impose exogenous negative pressure on stock prices. Firms under such adverse price pressure increase CSR activities compared to otherwise similar firms. This effect concentrates among firms with stronger signaling incentives, namely, those facing greater information asymmetry, more product market competition, higher shareholder litigation risk, and higher stock price crash risk. Firms under the exogenous negative price pressure mainly improve CSR strengths, including costly environmental investments. We also find that CSR engagement attracts socially responsible investors and lowers the cost of capital for signaling firms.
summary: 本文检验企业社会责任（CSR）参与的信号假说，利用两个互补的准自然实验，这些实验对股票价格施加了外生的负面压力。面临这种不利价格压力的公司相对于其他类似公司会增加CSR活动。这种效应集中在信号动机更强的公司中，即那些面临更高信息不对称、更激烈的产品市场竞争、更高的股东诉讼风险和更高的股价崩盘风险的公司。面临外生负面价格压力的公司主要改善CSR优势，包括成本高昂的环境投资。我们还发现，CSR参与吸引了社会责任投资者，并降低了信号公司的资本成本。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生冲击识别CSR的信号作用，方法严谨，为CSR动机提供了因果证据，并揭示了其降低资本成本的机制。

title: The Smart Beta Mirage
abstract: We document and explain the sharp performance deterioration of smart beta indexes after the corresponding exchange-traded funds (ETFs) are launched for investment. While smart beta is purported to deliver excess returns through factor exposures, the market-adjusted return of smart beta indexes drops from about 3% “on paper” before ETF listings to about −0.50% to −1% after ETF listings. This performance decline cannot be explained by variation in factor premia, strategic timing, or diminishing returns to scale. Instead, we find strong evidence of data mining in the construction of smart beta indexes, which helps ETFs attract flows, as investors respond positively to backtests.
summary: 本文研究了智能贝塔指数在对应的交易所交易基金（ETF）上市后的表现急剧恶化现象。尽管智能贝塔据称能通过因子暴露带来超额收益，但智能贝塔指数的市场调整回报在ETF上市前约为3%（“纸上”收益），上市后降至约-0.50%至-1%。这种业绩下降不能由因子溢价变化、战略时机选择或规模收益递减来解释。相反，研究发现智能贝塔指数构建中存在明显的数据挖掘证据，这有助于ETF吸引资金流入，因为投资者对回测结果反应积极。
ai_comment: 本文通过揭示智能贝塔指数在ETF上市后的业绩反转，有力证明了数据挖掘在金融产品设计中的普遍性，对投资者和监管层具有重要警示意义。

title: Labor Mobility and Loan Origination
abstract: We find that mortgage loans originated after the adoption of the inevitable disclosure doctrine (IDD; a mechanism discouraging loan officers’ labor mobility) have a lower default probability, a higher loan modification rate, and a lower foreclosure rate. These effects are unaccompanied by any reduction in loan supply and contribute to more stable housing prices. Using the adoption of the Uniform Trade Secrets Act as an alternative identification generates consistent results. Overall, our findings suggest that restricting loan officers’ labor mobility leads to better ex ante screening and ex post monitoring, improving the origination efficiency for U.S. residential mortgage loans.
summary: 本文利用美国各州采纳“不可避免披露原则”（IDD）作为限制贷款官员劳动流动性的外生冲击，发现该原则通过降低贷款官员的跳槽可能性，促使他们进行更严格的事前筛选和事后监控，从而显著降低了抵押贷款的违约概率，提高了贷款修改率并降低止赎率。同时，贷款供给并未减少，且房价更加稳定。采用“统一商业秘密法”作为替代识别策略也得到了一致结果。研究表明，限制劳动流动性有助于提升住宅抵押贷款的发放效率。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙利用法律变革作为自然实验，揭示了劳动流动性对贷款质量的因果影响，且发现限制流动性不损害信贷供给，为金融监管提供了新视角。

title: Pockets of Predictability
abstract: For many benchmark predictor variables, short‐horizon return predictability in the U.S. stock market is local in time as short periods with significant predictability (“pockets”) are interspersed with long periods with no return predictability. We document this result empirically using a flexible time‐varying parameter model that estimates predictive coefficients as a nonparametric function of time and explore possible explanations of this finding, including time‐varying risk premia for which we find limited support. Conversely, pockets of return predictability are consistent with a sticky expectations model in which investors slowly update their beliefs about a persistent component in the cash flow process.
summary: 本文研究美国股市中短期回报可预测性的时间局部性现象。使用灵活时变参数模型（非参数函数估计预测系数）进行实证分析，发现许多基准预测变量仅在短暂时间窗口（称为“口袋”）内具有显著预测能力，而较长时期则无预测性。论文还探索了可能解释，包括时变风险溢价（但支持证据有限），而粘性预期模型（投资者缓慢更新对现金流持久成分的信念）能更好地解释这一现象。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统刻画回报可预测性的时间局部性，并以粘性预期理论提供新颖解释，对资产定价实证模型提出挑战。

title: Auditors’ Use of In‐House Specialists
abstract: Using Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) inspection data from 2006 to 2018, we examine the use of auditor‐employed specialists in audit engagements. First, we find that the use of specialists is increasingly prevalent and related to clients’ size and complex accounting estimates. Second, the use of specialists is positively associated with the incidence of audit process deficiencies (identified by PCAOB inspections) but is not associated with output‐based audit‐quality proxies (restatements or absolute discretionary accruals). Hence, although process deficiencies are more likely to occur in engagements with higher use of specialists, financial reporting quality is not negatively impacted. Third, the use of specialists is positively associated with the likelihood of goodwill impairments and negatively associated with engagement profitability. Finally, cross‐sectional tests suggest that board accounting expertise is a salient condition for more effective use of specialists. Collectively, our findings align with concerns noted by the PCAOB and prior experimental and survey studies. Although specialists assist auditors with the audit of complex estimates, engagements with comparatively high specialist use entail an incremental risk of audit process deficiencies.
summary: 本文利用2006年至2018年美国公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）的检查数据，研究了审计师在审计业务中使用内部专家的现象。研究发现：第一，专家使用日益普遍，且与客户规模和复杂会计估计相关；第二，专家使用与PCAOB检查发现的审计过程缺陷发生率正相关，但与基于产出（如重述或绝对可操控应计利润）的审计质量代理变量无关，表明虽然过程缺陷在专家使用较多的业务中更易发生，但财务报告质量并未受到负面影响；第三，专家使用与商誉减值可能性正相关，与业务盈利能力负相关；第四，横截面检验表明，董事会会计专长是更有效使用专家的显著条件。总体而言，研究结果与PCAOB及之前实验和调查研究所关注的担忧一致：尽管专家帮助审计师审计复杂估计，但专家使用相对较多的业务存在审计过程缺陷的增量风险。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的PCAOB检查数据，从过程和产出两个维度全面评估审计专家使用的效果，并发现董事会会计专长的调节作用，为监管和实务提供了重要启示。

title: Modeling Corporate Bond Returns
abstract: We propose a conditional factor model for corporate bond returns with five factors and time‐varying factor loadings. We have three main empirical findings. First, our factor model excels in describing the risks and returns of corporate bonds, improving over previously proposed models in the literature by a large margin. Second, our model recommends a systematic bond investment portfolio whose high out‐of‐sample Sharpe ratio suggests that the credit risk premium is notably larger than previously estimated. Third, we find closer integration between debt and equity markets than found in prior literature.
summary: 本文提出了一个包含五个因子且因子载荷时变的条件因子模型来刻画公司债收益。主要实证发现有三点：第一，该因子模型在描述公司债的风险和收益方面表现优异，大幅改进文献中先前提出的模型；第二，模型推荐的系统性债券投资组合具有很高的样本外夏普比率，表明信用风险溢价比先前估计的显著更大；第三，发现债务市场与股票市场之间的融合程度高于以往文献的发现。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入时变因子载荷的条件模型，为公司债收益提供了更精准的风险描述，并揭示了更大的信用风险溢价，对资产定价和投资实践有重要启示。

title: Sea-Level Rise Exposure and Municipal Bond Yields
abstract: Municipal bond markets began pricing sea-level rise (SLR) exposure risk in 2013, coinciding with upward revisions to worst-case SLR projections and accompanying uncertainty around these projections. The effect is larger for long-maturity bonds and not solely driven by near-term flood risk. We use a structural model of credit risk to quantify the implied economic impact and distinguish between the effects of underlying asset values and of uncertainty. The SLR exposure premium exhibits a trend different from house prices and is unaffected by house price controls. Together, our results highlight the importance of climate uncertainty in driving municipal bond prices. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文研究市政债券市场对海平面上升（SLR）暴露风险的定价行为。自2013年起，随着SLR最坏情景预测的上调及伴随的不确定性，市场开始对SLR风险进行定价。这种效应在长期债券中更为显著，且并非仅由短期洪水风险驱动。作者采用信用风险结构模型量化经济影响，区分了基础资产价值下降与不确定性增加两种渠道。SLR暴露溢价的变化趋势与房价不同，且不受房价控制的影响。综合结果表明，气候不确定性是驱动市政债券价格的重要因素。
ai_comment: 本文首次系统论证了气候不确定性在市政债券定价中的独立作用，并通过结构模型区分了资产价值与不确定性影响，为气候金融研究提供了新视角。

title: Shocked by Bank Funding Shocks: Evidence from Consumer Credit Cards
abstract: Using the near universe of U.S. consumer credit cards, we show that banks transmit their wholesale funding shocks to consumers by reducing their credit card limits. Credit-constrained consumers who are unable to hedge against the transmitted shock by accessing other credit cards experience a stronger and more persistent reduction in aggregate credit card limits at the consumer level. Consequently, these credit-constrained consumers reduce their aggregate credit card borrowing. Our results document a credit card lending channel for the transmission of adverse bank shocks and show who bears the costs of fragile bank funding structures. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用美国消费者信用卡近乎全样本的数据，研究了银行批发融资冲击如何通过信用卡渠道传导至消费者。研究发现，当银行遭受批发融资冲击时，会降低其信用卡额度。受信贷约束的消费者由于无法通过其他信用卡对冲这一冲击，其总信用卡额度下降幅度更大且更持久，进而导致这些消费者减少总信用卡借款。该研究揭示了信用卡借贷渠道在银行负面冲击传导中的作用，并指出脆弱的银行融资结构的成本承担者。
ai_comment: 本文首次利用全样本信用卡数据实证了银行融资冲击通过信用卡限额传导至消费者的机制，并识别了信贷约束消费者的脆弱性，对理解银行风险传导和消费者金融具有重要贡献。

title: Government Stock Purchase Undermines Price Informativeness: Evidence from China’s “National Team”
abstract: We use the 2015 Chinese stock market crash to study the effects of government stock purchases.
