The Chinese government purchased stocks to stabilize the markets through state-owned financial institutions known as the “National Team.” We find that the intervention led to reduced volatility and price informativeness. These impacts are driven by the disclosure of government portfolios. Consistent with investors having a stronger incentive to acquire government intervention information instead of fundamental news, we find reduced information production and information asymmetry following intervention disclosure. The article suggests that government stock purchases involve a trade-off between stability and informational efficiency.
summary: 本文利用2015年中国股市崩盘，研究政府通过国有金融机构（即“国家队”）购买股票的市场干预效应。发现该干预降低了市场波动性和价格信息性，且影响主要由政府投资组合的公开披露驱动。投资者获取政府干预信息的动机增强，替代了对基本面信息的搜集，导致干预披露后信息生产和信息不对称程度下降。研究表明，政府股票购买在稳定性与信息效率之间存在权衡。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的中国“国家队”干预事件，清晰揭示了政府托市行为在稳定市场的同时削弱信息效率的机制，为政策权衡提供了实证证据。

title: Rents and Intangible Capital: A Q+ Framework
abstract: In recent years, U.S. investment has been lackluster, despite rising valuations. Key explanations include growing rents and growing intangibles. We propose and estimate a framework to quantify their roles. The gap between valuations—reflected in average Q —and investment—reflected in marginal q —can be decomposed into three terms: the value of installed intangibles; rents generated by physical capital; and an interaction term, measuring rents generated by intangibles. The intangible related terms contribute significantly to the gap, particularly in fast‐growing sectors. Our findings suggest care in a pure‐rents interpretation, given the rising role of intangibles.
summary: 针对近年来美国投资低迷而估值上升的现象，本文提出了一个量化租金和无形资产作用的框架（Q+框架）。该框架将平均Q（反映估值）与边际q（反映投资）之间的差距分解为三个部分：已安装无形资产的价值、实物资本产生的租金、以及无形资产与实物资本交互产生的租金。研究发现，无形资产相关项对差距贡献显著，尤其在高增长行业。结论建议在解释纯租金观点时应谨慎，因为无形资产的作用日益增强。
ai_comment: 本文通过分解Q与q的差距，创新地量化了无形资产和租金对投资-估值谜题的贡献，为理解现代经济中的投资动态提供了新视角。

title: Financial Reporting Quality and Wage Differentials: Evidence from Worker‐Level Data
abstract: We examine whether financial reporting quality affects worker wages using employer‐employee matched data in the United States. We find that low financial reporting quality is associated with a compensating wage differential—that is, a risk premium—using three distinct approaches while controlling for worker characteristics by (1) regressing wages on firm‐year–level and firm‐level reporting quality, (2) documenting wage changes when workers switch firms, and (3) estimating a structural approach that separates reporting quality from performance‐related volatility. We find evidence consistent with two channels: performance pay and turnover risk, where workers bear risks from noise in performance measurement and unemployment, respectively. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we show that—after the accounting scandals in 2002 and after the announcements of an internal control weakness (ICW)—former Arthur Andersen clients and ICW firms pay wage premiums to employees, with magnitudes between 0.9% and 2.8% of annual wages.
summary: 本文利用美国雇主-雇员匹配数据，通过三种方法（工资对报告质量的回归、工人换公司时的工资变化、以及分离报告质量与绩效波动的结构估计）研究财务报告质量对工人工资的影响。发现低财务报告质量与补偿性工资差异（即风险溢价）相关，其渠道包括绩效薪酬和离职风险。为缓解内生性问题，利用2002年会计丑闻及内部控制缺陷(ICW)公告作为外生冲击，发现前安达信客户和ICW公司支付的工资溢价约为年工资的0.9%至2.8%。
ai_comment: 该文利用丰富的微观数据和多种识别策略，稳健地揭示了财务报告质量对劳动力市场的影响，并量化了风险溢价，为会计信息的经济后果提供了新证据。

title: Uncovering Financial Constraints
abstract: We use a random forest model to classify firms’ financial constraints using only financial variables. Our methodology expands the range of classified firms compared to text-based measures while maintaining similar levels of informativeness. We construct two versions of our constraint measures, one using many firm characteristics and the other using a small set of more primitive characteristics. Using our measures, we find that institutional investors hold a lower percentage of shares in equity-focused constrained firms, while retail investors show a preference for them. Equity issuance and investment of constrained firms also increases during periods of high investor sentiment.
summary: 本文使用随机森林模型，仅基于财务变量对公司金融约束进行分类。该方法相比文本度量扩大了分类公司的范围，同时保持相似的信息量。作者构建了两个版本的约束度量：一个使用多个公司特征，另一个使用少量更基础的特征。利用这些度量，研究发现机构投资者在股权集中的约束公司中持股比例较低，而散户投资者则偏好这类公司。此外，在投资者情绪高涨期间，约束公司的股权发行和投资增加。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将随机森林应用于金融约束分类，在扩大样本覆盖范围的同时保证了信息含量，并揭示了机构与散户投资者对约束公司截然不同的持股偏好。

title: Resolving a Paradox: Retail Trades Positively Predict Returns but Are Not Profitable
abstract: Retail order imbalance positively predicts returns, but on average retail investor trades lose money. Why? Order imbalance tests equal-weighted stocks, but retail purchases concentrate on attention-grabbing stocks that subsequently underperform. Long–short strategies based on extreme quintiles of retail order imbalance earn dismal annualized returns of −14.8% among stocks with heavy retail trading but earn 6.6% among other stocks. Our results reconcile the literatures on the performance of retail investors, the predictive content of retail order imbalance, and attention-induced trading and returns. Smaller retail trades concentrate more on attention-grabbing stocks and perform worse.
summary: 该论文解决了零售投资者交易中的一个悖论：零售订单不平衡正向预测未来收益，但零售投资者平均却亏损。原因在于，订单不平衡检验是等权重的，而零售购买集中在吸引注意力的股票上，这些股票随后表现不佳。基于零售订单不平衡极端五分位数构建的多空策略，在零售交易活跃的股票中年化收益为-14.8%，而在其他股票中收益为6.6%。研究结果调和了关于零售投资者表现、零售订单不平衡的预测能力以及注意力驱动交易和收益的相关文献。较小的零售交易更集中在吸引注意力的股票上，表现更差。
ai_comment: 通过揭示订单不平衡等权加权与零售交易集中偏差的矛盾，巧妙解释了零售投资者亏损之谜，为行为金融和市场效率提供了新见解。

title: Measuring the Expected Effects of the Global Tax Reform
abstract: Over 140 countries agreed on a fundamental corporate tax reform in 2021 to be implemented in 2023 and beyond. To measure its potential effects, we study asset price changes within minutes of the reform announcements. We construct proxies for the reform’s costs regarding U.S. companies’ tax burdens and countries’ public finances. Likely exposed companies exhibit significant negative stock returns. Our lower-bound estimates indicate total shareholder value losses of $112.6 billion one day after the reform announcements. Further, likely exposed countries experience increases in sovereign debt credit risk. Our findings inform the cost-benefit analysis of a historical international tax reform. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用2021年全球企业税改革公告后几分钟内的资产价格变化，衡量该改革的潜在影响。作者构建了衡量改革对美国公司税负和各国公共财政成本的代理变量，发现可能受影响的公司在公告后一天内股东价值损失总计1126亿美元（下界估计），且可能受影响的国家主权债务信用风险上升。研究为这一历史性国际税收改革的成本效益分析提供了依据。
ai_comment: 利用高频事件研究法直接量化全球税收改革的市场影响，提供了重要的成本估算，为政策评估贡献了实证证据。

title: Reference Points Spillovers: Micro-Level Evidence from Real Estate
abstract: Homeowners who originally bought when marketwide price levels were high (low) fetch high (low) sales prices and rents, even decades later. We study the propagation of reference-dependence to neighboring listings. The “spillover” reference point effect is about one-half as large as the “own” reference point effect. Neither house quality nor location appears capable of explaining the result. Using a simple model to provide empirical predictions, we find support for a competition-based mechanism. We quantify the aggregate effect of own and spillover reference point effects on aggregate prices and/or rents at the ZIP code level. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 论文研究了房地产市场中由参考依赖引发的价格溢出效应。具体而言，当房主最初在市场价格水平较高（低）时购房，即使多年后他们仍会以较高（低）的价格出售或出租房产。这种“自身”参考点效应还会向邻近的房源传播，形成“溢出”参考点效应，其强度约为自身效应的一半。房屋质量或地理位置无法解释这一现象。通过一个简单模型提供经验预测，作者发现竞争机制可以解释该结果。最后，作者量化了自身和溢出参考点效应在邮政编码层面对总价格和/或租金的总影响。
ai_comment: 本文利用房地产市场数据揭示了参考依赖的溢出效应，量化了自身与邻居效应的影响，并支持竞争机制的解释，丰富了行为金融对市场价格的微观理解。

title: Financial Crises and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Consumer Credit Markets
abstract: How does creditor health affect the pass-through of monetary policy to households? Using data on the universe of U.S. credit unions, I document that creditor asset losses increase the sensitivity of consumer credit to monetary policy. Identification exploits plausibly exogenous variation in asset losses and high-frequency identification of monetary policy shocks. Weaker lenders can respond more if they face financial frictions that easing alleviates. The estimates imply constraints on monetary policy become more costly in financial crises featuring creditor asset losses and that an additional benefit of monetary easing is that it weakens the causal, contractionary effect of asset losses. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
summary: 本文研究债权人健康状况如何影响货币政策向家庭信贷的传导。利用美国全部信用合作社的数据，发现债权人资产损失增加了消费者信贷对货币政策的敏感性。识别策略利用了资产损失的外生变化和货币政策冲击的高频识别。较弱的贷款人如果面临宽松政策可以缓解的金融摩擦，其反应可能更大。估计表明，在债权人资产损失严重的金融危机中，货币政策的约束成本更高，并且货币宽松的一个额外好处是削弱了资产损失导致的紧缩效应。
ai_comment: 该文利用美国信用合作社的微观数据，巧妙识别了债权人健康对货币政策传导的影响，为金融危机中货币政策效果提供了新的视角。

title: Adjusting to Macroprudential Policies: Loan-to-Value Limits and Housing Choice
abstract: This study provides novel evidence regarding the effects of loan-to-value (LTV) limits on housing choices. Using a detailed loan-level dataset, I exploit the introduction of LTV limits in Israel. I find that the LTV limits led borrowers to choose housing units that were more affordable, farther from the central business district, and in lower socioeconomic neighborhoods. Additionally, these LTV limits increase interest rates and decrease loan amounts. The findings of this study indicate that macroprudential policies, which focus on the stability of the financial system, have micro implications on location choices, commuting costs, and movement to less-advantaged areas.
summary: 本研究利用以色列引入贷款价值比（LTV）限制的准自然实验，基于详细的贷款级数据集，提供了关于LTV限制对住房选择影响的新证据。研究发现，LTV限制导致借款人选择更可负担的住房单元，这些单元距离中央商务区更远，位于社会经济地位较低的社区。此外，LTV限制还提高了贷款利率并降低了贷款金额。研究结果表明，旨在维护金融体系稳定的宏观审慎政策，在微观层面影响了选址决策、通勤成本以及向弱势地区的迁移。
ai_comment: 本文利用准实验设计，首次系统揭示LTV限制对住房选址和社区选择的微观影响，为宏观审慎政策的非预期后果提供了重要证据。

title: Beyond Performance: Does Assessed Potential Matter to Employees’ Voluntary Departure Decisions?
abstract: Firms are increasingly implementing performance–potential assessment systems, whereby supervisors evaluate employees’ current performance and future‐oriented potential (i.e., promotion prospects). Whether retention is greatest for high performance–high potential (HiPo) employees under such a system is an empirical question—while the “promise” of a promotion may aid retention, these employees likely face attractive outside options. Using data from a multinational firm, I find that HiPos generally depart at a lower rate than lower performing non‐HiPos. Among shorter tenured employees, I find the strongest evidence that potential matters to departures, above and beyond performance. In several instances, the rate of departure is lower when assessed potential is higher, holding performance constant. This is the case both among higher performers, where high potential leads to HiPo status, and among lower performers where high potential affords no such status. My findings suggest that HiPo status and potential ratings may help in facilitating employees’ early sorting decisions.
summary: 论文研究绩效-潜力评估系统对员工自愿离职决策的影响，特别是高绩效-高潜力（HiPo）员工。使用一家跨国公司的数据，发现HiPo员工整体离职率低于低绩效非HiPo员工。在短期员工中，潜力对离职的影响超越绩效：当绩效不变时，评估潜力越高，离职率越低。这种关系存在于高绩效者（高潜力使其成为HiPo）和低绩效者（高潜力不赋予HiPo地位）中。结论表明，HiPo地位和潜力评级有助于促进员工的早期分类决策。
ai_comment: 利用实际企业数据揭示了HiPo状态对员工离职的复杂影响，强调了潜力在短期员工决策中的关键作用，对人力资源管理实践有重要启示。

title: Field of Study and Financial Problems: How Economics Reduces the Risk of Default
abstract: This paper documents how extensive economic education can reduce the risk of getting into financial trouble by comparing people who enter business and economics programs with people who enter other higher education programs. To identify the causal effect, I exploit GPA admission thresholds that quasi-randomize applicants near the thresholds into different higher education programs. I find that admission to an economics program reduces the probability of loan default and delinquency by one half. This large reduction is associated with changes in financial behavior, but it is not associated with differences in the level or stability of people’s income. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文通过比较进入商业与经济学专业的学生与其他高等教育专业的学生，记录了广泛的经济学教育如何降低陷入财务困境的风险。为了识别因果效应，作者利用GPA录取门槛，使接近门槛的申请者被准随机分配到不同高等教育专业。研究发现，进入经济学专业使贷款违约和拖欠的概率降低了一半。这一大幅降低与金融行为的变化相关，但与人们收入水平或稳定性无关。
ai_comment: 利用断点回归设计识别因果效应，发现经济学教育能显著降低违约风险，且该效应独立于收入水平，为金融素养研究提供了有力证据。

title: Bank Influence at a Discount
abstract: In a general equilibrium framework, we show that banks may “buy” political influence at a discount: They offer disproportionately small campaign contributions compared to the influence they exert, thus generating abnormal returns. We distinguish between the direct effect of contributions which, as a cost, reduce bank returns, and the indirect effect of contributions which boost returns via inducing bank-favoring policies. Therefore, abnormal returns may or may not increase with the amount of contributions, depending on which effect dominates: Stricter capital requirements decrease contributions and abnormal returns. When politicians attach more weight to households’ welfare, contributions increase and abnormal returns decrease.
summary: 论文在一个一般均衡框架下研究银行如何以“折扣”价格购买政治影响力：银行提供的竞选捐款数额与其所施加的政治影响力相比不成比例地小，从而产生异常收益。作者区分了捐款的直接效应（作为成本会降低银行收益）和间接效应（通过诱导偏袒银行的政策提升收益）。因此，异常收益是否随捐款增加而增加取决于哪个效应占主导。更严格的资本要求会减少捐款和异常收益；当政治家更重视家庭福利时，捐款增加而异常收益减少。
ai_comment: 本文的亮点在于通过一般均衡模型揭示了政治捐款对银行收益的双重效应，并解释了异常收益与捐款之间的非线性关系，为理解银行政治行为的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Public Disclosure and Consumer Financial Protection
abstract: The U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau has released a database of consumer complaints about banks’ financial products to the public since 2013. We find a greater reduction in mortgage applications to banks that receive more mortgage complaints in local markets after the disclosures. The effect is stronger in areas with more sophisticated consumers and higher credit competition, and for banks receiving more severe complaints. The number of monthly mortgage complaints per bank exhibits faster mean reversion after the publication of the database. These findings suggest that the public disclosure of mortgage complaints enhances product market discipline and consumer financial protection.
summary: 该论文研究美国消费者金融保护局（CFPB）自2013年起公开的消费者投诉数据库对抵押贷款市场的影响。实证发现，在投诉信息公开后，收到更多抵押贷款投诉的银行在当地市场的抵押贷款申请数量显著减少。这一效应在消费者更成熟、信贷竞争更激烈的地区以及投诉更严重的银行中更为明显。此外，数据库发布后，银行每月抵押贷款投诉数量的均值回归速度加快。这些结果表明，抵押贷款投诉的公开披露增强了产品市场纪律，从而有助于消费者金融保护。
ai_comment: 该研究利用真实投诉数据验证了公开信息披露的市场纪律效应，为消费者金融保护政策提供了实证支持，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Corporate Financial Frictions and Employee Mental Health
abstract: This article argues that corporate financial frictions can have an adverse effect on employee mental health, an important determinant of employee productivity. To identify the causal effects of financial frictions, we exploit variation in firms’ need to refinance their long-term debt in 2008, a period when refinancing became more difficult due to the credit crunch. Using administrative microdata, we find that antidepressant use grows significantly more among employees of firms in higher need of debt refinancing. Much of this effect occurs at employees keeping their jobs, pointing to decreased perceptions of job security as a transmission channel.
summary: 本文研究企业财务摩擦对员工心理健康的因果影响，利用2008年信贷紧缩期间企业长期债务再融资需求的差异作为外生冲击。基于行政微观数据，发现需要更多债务再融资的公司的员工中，抗抑郁药使用量显著增加，且这一效应主要集中在保住工作的员工中，表明工作安全感下降是重要的传导渠道。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生冲击识别了财务摩擦对员工心理健康的因果影响，并揭示了工作安全感这一传导机制，为理解企业融资困境的社会成本提供了新视角。

title: The Economics of Financial Stress
abstract: We study the psychological costs of financial constraints and their economic consequences.Using a representative survey of U.S. households, we document the prevalence of financial stress in U.S. households and a strong relationship between financial stress and measures of financial constraints.We incorporate financial stress into an otherwise standard dynamic model of consumption and labor supply.We emphasize two key results.First, a psychology-based theory of poverty traps requires two equally important components: financial stress itself and naivete about financial stress.Specifically, sophisticates save enough to escape high-stress states, because they understand that doing so alleviates the economic consequences of financial stress.On the other hand, naifs dis-save, fall into a poverty trap, and incur high welfare losses.Second, the financial stress channel can reverse the counterfactual negative wealth effect on labor supply because relieving stress frees up cognitive resources for productive work.Financial stress also has macroeconomic implications on wealth inequality and fiscal multipliers.
summary: 本文研究金融约束的心理成本及其经济后果。利用美国代表性家庭调查，记录了金融压力在美国家庭中的普遍性，并发现金融压力与金融约束指标之间存在强相关关系。作者将金融压力纳入一个标准的动态消费和劳动力供给模型，强调两个关键结果：第一，基于心理学的贫困陷阱理论需要两个同等重要的成分——金融压力本身以及个人对金融压力的天真性（naivete）。具体而言，老练者（sophisticates）通过储蓄足以逃离高压状态，因为他们明白这样做能缓解金融压力的经济后果；而天真者（naifs）则减少储蓄，陷入贫困陷阱，并承受巨大的福利损失。第二，金融压力渠道可以逆转反事实的负财富效应对劳动力供给的影响，因为缓解压力会释放认知资源用于生产性工作。此外，金融压力还对财富不平等和财政乘数产生宏观影响。
ai_comment: 该文创新地将心理认知因素（金融压力及对其的天真态度）引入标准宏观模型，揭示了贫困陷阱的新机制，并挑战了传统劳动力供给理论的财富效应，具有理论深度和政策启示。

title: Do You Even Crypto, Bro? Cryptocurrencies in Household Finance
abstract: Using repeated large-scale surveys of U.S. households, we study the cryptocurrency investment decisions and motives of households relative to other financial assets.Cryptocurrency holders tend to be young, white, male and more libertarian relative to non-crypto holders.They expect much higher rates of returns for crypto and perceive it as relatively safer than do other households.They also view it as a better hedge against inflation.For those holding cryptocurrencies, changes in Bitcoin prices translate into their purchases of durable goods.Finally, exogenously-provided information about historical returns of cryptocurrencies leads individuals to increase their desired crypto holdings and makes them more likely to actually purchase cryptocurrency subsequently.We compare these views and behaviors to those of households toward other financial assets and argue that cryptocurrency is unique in many of these respects.
summary: 基于对美国居民的多次大规模调查，本文研究了家庭在加密货币投资中的决策与动机，并与其他金融资产进行对比。结果发现：加密货币持有者通常更年轻、白人、男性且具有更强的自由意志主义倾向；他们预期加密货币的回报率远高于其他资产，并认为其相对更安全，同时视其为更好的通胀对冲工具。对于持有者而言，比特币价格波动会传导至其耐用品消费。此外，向被试者提供加密货币的历史收益外生信息，会提升其期望持有量，并增加后续实际购买的可能性。通过与家庭对其他金融资产的态度和行为比较，作者认为加密货币在多个维度上具有独特性。
ai_comment: 利用大规模重复调查数据，系统揭示了加密货币持有者的人口统计特征和信念，并发现了比特币价格对实际消费的传导效应，为理解加密货币在家庭资产配置中的角色提供了新颖证据。

title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Exchange Rate Depreciations
abstract: We study the consequences of “regime-induced” exchange rate depreciations by comparing outcomes for peggers versus floaters to the US dollar in response to a dollar depreciation. Pegger currencies depreciate relative to floater currencies and these depreciations are strongly expansionary. The boom is associated with a fall in net exports, and (if anything) an increase in interest rates in the pegger countries. This suggests that expenditure switching and domestic monetary policy are not the main drivers of the boom. We show that a large class of existing models cannot match our estimated responses and develop a model with imperfect financial openness that can. Following a depreciation, UIP deviations lower the costs of borrowing from abroad and stimulate the economy, as in the data. The model is consistent with (unconditional) exchange rate disconnect and the Mussa facts, even though exchange rates have large effects on the economy.
summary: 本文研究“制度诱导”的汇率贬值对宏观经济的影响，通过比较钉住美元国家与浮动汇率国家在美元贬值时的表现。钉住国货币相对浮动国货币贬值，且这种贬值具有强烈的扩张效应，伴随净出口下降和利率（可能）上升。这表明支出转换和国内货币政策并非繁荣的主要驱动因素。现有模型无法匹配估计的反应，作者因此构建了一个具有不完美金融开放度的新模型。在贬值后，UIP偏差降低了国外借贷成本，刺激了经济，与数据一致。尽管汇率对经济有较大影响，该模型仍与（无条件）汇率脱节和Mussa事实一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过识别制度诱导的汇率贬值，揭示了金融渠道（而非传统贸易渠道）在汇率传导中的核心作用，并提供了一个能同时匹配汇率脱节和实际效应的新模型。

title: When Do Cross-Sectional Asset Pricing Factors Span the Stochastic Discount Factor?
abstract: When expected returns are linear in asset characteristics, the stochastic discount factor (SDF) that prices individual stocks can be represented as a factor model with GLS cross-sectional regression slope factors.Factors constructed heuristically by aggregating individual stocks into characteristics-based factor portfolios using sorting, characteristics-weighting, or OLS crosssectional regression slopes do not span this SDF unless the covariance matrix of stock returns has a specific structure.These conditions are more likely satisfied when researchers use large numbers of characteristics simultaneously.Methods to hedge unpriced components of heuristic factor returns allow partial relaxation of these conditions.We also show the conditions that must hold for dimension reduction to a number of factors smaller than the number of characteristics to be possible without having to invert a large covariance matrix.Under these conditions, instrumented and projected principal components analysis methods can be implemented as simple PCA on characteristics-based portfolios.
summary: 本文研究当预期收益率与资产特征线性相关时，随机贴现因子（SDF）如何被跨截面资产定价因子所张成。研究发现，仅当股票收益的协方差矩阵具有特定结构时，通过排序、特征加权或OLS截面回归斜率等启发式方法构建的特征因子组合才能张成SDF；当研究者同时使用大量特征时，这些条件更可能被满足。对冲启发式因子收益中未定价成分的方法允许部分放宽这些条件。此外，本文展示了在特征数量大于因子数量时，无需对大协方差矩阵求逆即可实现降维的条件，在此条件下，工具化和投影主成分分析方法可简化为对基于特征的组合进行简单PCA。
ai_comment: 本文严格推导了启发式因子张成SDF的条件，为理解多特征定价模型提供了理论基础，并简化了高维情形下的降维方法。

title: Interbank Networks and the Interregional Transmission of Financial Crises: Evidence from the Panic of 1907
abstract: This paper provides quantitative evidence on interbank transmission of financial distress in the Panic of 1907 and ensuing recession.Originating in New York City, the panic led to payment suspensions and emergency currency issuance in many cities.Data on the universe of interbank connections show that i) suspension was more likely in cities whose banks had closer ties to banks at the center of the panic, ii) banks with such links were more likely to close in the panic and recession, and iii) banks responded to the panic by rearranging their correspondent relationships, with implications for network structure.
summary: 本文利用1907年恐慌及随后衰退期间的全样本银行间连接数据，定量研究了银行间网络在金融困境跨区域传导中的作用。恐慌起源于纽约市，导致许多城市出现支付暂停和紧急货币发行。研究发现：i) 与恐慌中心银行联系更紧密的城市更可能发生支付暂停；ii) 具有此类联系的银行在恐慌和衰退期间更易倒闭；iii) 银行通过重新安排代理行关系来应对恐慌，这影响了网络结构。
ai_comment: 该研究利用历史事件和独特数据，为银行间网络在危机传导中的重要性提供了有力的因果证据，丰富了我们对金融恐慌传播机制的理解。

title: Oil Prices, Monetary Policy and Inflation Surges
abstract: We develop a simple quantitative New Keynesian model aimed at accounting for the recent sudden and persistent rise in inflation, with emphasis on the role of oil shocks and accommodative monetary policy.The model features oil as a complementary good for households and as a complementary input for firms.It also allows for unemployment and real wage rigidity.We estimate the key parameters by matching model impulse responses to those from identified money and oil shocks in a structural VAR.We then show that our model does a good job of explaining unemployment and inflation since 2010, including the recent inflation surge that began in mid 2021.We show that mainly accounting for this surge was a combination oil price shocks and "easy" monetary policy, even after allowing for demand shocks and shocks to labor market tightness.Important for the quantitative impact of the oil price shock is a low elasticity of substitution between oil and labor, which we estimate to be the case.
summary: 本文构建了一个包含石油作为家庭和厂商互补品的简单新凯恩斯定量模型，并引入失业和实际工资刚性，旨在解释近期通胀的突然且持续上升，特别是石油冲击和宽松货币政策的作用。通过匹配结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别的货币和石油冲击的脉冲响应来估计模型关键参数，结果表明该模型能够很好地拟合2010年以来的失业和通胀数据，包括2021年中开始的通胀激增。主要发现是，即使考虑了需求冲击和劳动力市场紧张冲击，石油价格冲击与“宽松”货币政策的结合仍是解释通胀激增的主要原因，而石油与劳动之间的低替代弹性（估计证实了这一点）对石油冲击的定量影响至关重要。
ai_comment: 该论文通过构建包含石油互补品的新凯恩斯模型，并利用结构VAR进行参数估计，定量揭示了石油冲击与宽松货币政策对近期通胀激增的主导作用，强调了石油与劳动低替代弹性的关键性，为理解通胀动态提供了新的视角。

title: Debt Moratoria: Evidence from Student Loan Forbearance
abstract: We evaluate the effects of the 2020 student debt moratorium that paused payments for student loan borrowers.Using administrative credit panel data, we show that the payment pause led to a sharp drop in student loan payments and delinquencies for borrowers subject to the debt moratorium, as well as an increase in credit scores.We find a large stimulus effect, as borrowers substitute increased private debt for paused public debt.Comparing borrowers whose loans were frozen with borrowers whose loans were not frozen due to differences in whether the government owned the loans, we show that borrowers used the new liquidity to increase borrowing on credit cards, mortgages, and auto loans rather than avoid delinquencies.The effects are concentrated among borrowers without prior delinquencies, who saw no change in credit scores, and we see little effects following student loan forgiveness announcements.The results highlight an important complementarity between liquidity and credit, as liquidity increases the demand for credit even as the supply of credit is fixed.
summary: 本文利用管理信用面板数据，评估了2020年学生债务暂停还款政策（student debt moratorium）的影响。研究发现，该政策导致学生贷款支付和违约率急剧下降，信用评分提高，并产生了显著的刺激效应：借款人通过增加信用卡、抵押贷款和汽车贷款等私人债务来替代暂停的公共债务。效应主要集中在无先前违约的借款人中，这类人群的信用评分未发生变化，而学生贷款减免公告后几乎没有影响。结果强调了流动性与信贷之间的重要互补性，即流动性在信贷供给固定的情况下增加了信贷需求。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验（贷款所有权差异）识别因果效应，揭示了流动性对信贷需求的互补作用，为债务暂停政策的宏观经济影响提供了微观证据。

title: Central Bank Credibility and Fiscal Responsibility
abstract: We consider a New Keynesian model with strategic monetary and fiscal interactions.The fiscal authority maximizes social welfare.Monetary policy is delegated to a central bank with an antiinflation bias that suffers from a lack of commitment.The impact of central bank hawkishness on debt issuance is non-monotonic because increased hawkishness reduces the benefit from fiscal stimulus while simultaneously increasing real debt capacity.Starting from high levels of hawkishness (dovishness), a marginal increase in the central bank's anti-inflation bias decreases (increases) debt issuance.
summary: 该论文构建了一个具有战略货币和财政互动的新凯恩斯模型，其中财政当局最大化社会福利，而货币政策被委托给一个具有反通胀偏见且缺乏承诺的中央银行。研究发现，中央银行的鹰派态度对债务发行的影响是非单调的：鹰派态度的增加一方面减少了财政刺激的收益，另一方面却增加了实际债务容量。因此，从高鹰派水平出发，中央银行反通胀偏见的边际增加会减少债务发行；而从高鸽派水平出发，同样的边际增加则会增加债务发行。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入战略互动，揭示了中央银行偏见对财政政策效果的复杂影响，为理解货币-财政协调提供了新视角。

title: Cross-border Spillovers: How US Financial Conditions affect M&As Around the World
abstract: We find that financial conditions in the core have significant spillover effects on cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&As).On average, a 1 percentage point easing of the IMF US Financial Conditions Index is associated with approximately a 10% higher volume of crossborder M&As.The spillovers are stronger for countries with more liabilities denominated in foreign currency (or in US dollars).We find that the spillovers are driven by changes in US financial conditions, rather than changes in Euro Area conditions.Deals that happen when financial conditions in the US are tighter (and therefore acquisitions fewer) add more value for the acquirers, as reflected in higher acquirer excess stock returns around the announcement.
summary: 本文研究了美国金融状况对全球跨境并购（M&A）的溢出效应。使用IMF美国金融状况指数，发现该指数每宽松1个百分点，跨境并购交易量平均增加约10%。这一溢出效应在以外币（尤其是美元）计价的负债较多的国家更为显著。进一步分析表明，溢出效应主要由美国金融状况变化驱动，而非欧元区金融状况。此外，在美国金融状况较紧张时期发生的并购交易（此时收购活动较少）为收购方创造了更多价值，表现为公告期间收购方超额股票回报更高。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了美国金融状况对全球并购活动的显著影响，并区分了不同货币负债结构下的异质性效应，为国际金融溢出效应研究提供了新证据。

title: Central Bank Communication and House Price Expectations
abstract: We use a series of online surveys to study how US consumers' house price expectations respond to interest rate expectations. Communication about interest rates has little effect on average house price expectations, since households have heterogeneous beliefs about the relationship between interest rates and house prices. When coupled with an explanation of the mortgage rate channel, communication about interest rates has much larger effects on house price expectations. We also show that audio and visual communication have additional effects on expectations beyond the effects of text-based communications. Consumers' personal experiences appear to shape their mental models of the housing market and the responsiveness of their house price expectations to interest rate expectations.
summary: 本文通过一系列在线调查研究美国消费者房价预期如何响应利率预期。研究发现，仅沟通利率对平均房价预期影响较小，原因是家庭对利率与房价的关系存在异质性信念。然而，当结合抵押贷款利率渠道的解释时，沟通利率对房价预期的影响显著增大。此外，音频和视觉沟通方式对预期的影响超出纯文本沟通。消费者的个人经历塑造了他们对住房市场的心理模型，并影响其房价预期对利率预期的敏感度。
ai_comment: 论文通过实验设计揭示了沟通内容与渠道对预期形成的差异化作用，为央行沟通策略提供了微观基础，尤其强调了抵押贷款利率渠道的解释和多媒体沟通的重要性。

title: Generative AI and Firm Values
abstract: What are the effects of recent advances in Generative AI on the value of firms? Our study offers a quantitative answer to this question for U.S. publicly traded companies based on the exposures of their workforce to Generative AI. Our novel firm-level measure of workforce exposure to Generative AI is validated by data from earnings calls, and has intuitive relationships with firm and industry-level characteristics. Using Artificial Minus Human portfolios that are long firms with higher exposures and short firms with lower exposures, we show that higher-exposure firms earned excess returns that are 0.4% higher on a daily basis than returns of firms with lower exposures following the release of ChatGPT. Although this release was generally received by investors as good news for more exposed firms, there is wide variation across and within industries, consistent with the substantive disruptive potential of Generative AI technologies.
summary: 本文研究了生成式AI（Generative AI）最新进展对美国上市公司价值的影响，基于公司劳动力对生成式AI的暴露程度。作者构建了公司层面的劳动力暴露度量，并通过财报电话会议数据验证其有效性。该度量与公司及行业特征存在直观关联。利用做多高暴露公司、做空低暴露公司的“人工智能减人力”（Artificial Minus Human）投资组合，发现ChatGPT发布后，高暴露公司每日超额收益比低暴露公司高0.4%。尽管投资者普遍将ChatGPT发布视为对高暴露公司的利好消息，但行业内部及行业间存在显著差异，这与生成式AI技术的颠覆性潜力一致。
ai_comment: 该研究利用ChatGPT发布作为自然实验，为生成式AI对公司价值的量化影响提供了有力证据，且构建的暴露度量具有较强的实证有效性。

title: Information Flows, Organizational Structure, and Corporate Governance
abstract: This survey provides an overview of theoretical and empirical research on information flows in corporations. It highlights key frictions preventing effective information flows and discusses how organizational structure and corporate governance can alleviate these frictions, focusing on three broad topics: 1) organizational design, such as the choice between centralized and decentralized decision-making; 2) composition and decision-making process of the board of directors; and 3) communication among shareholders and between shareholders and management in the context of shareholder activism. The goal of the survey is to draw connections between theoretical and empirical work and point out directions for future research.
summary: 这篇综述概述了关于公司信息流的理论和实证研究。它强调了阻碍有效信息流的关键摩擦，并讨论了组织结构和公司治理如何缓解这些摩擦，重点关注三个广泛的主题：1) 组织设计，例如集中决策与分散决策之间的选择；2) 董事会的组成和决策过程；以及 3) 在股东积极主义背景下股东之间以及股东与管理层之间的沟通。该综述的目标是建立理论与实证工作之间的联系，并指出未来研究的方向。
ai_comment: 这是一篇系统性的综述，对信息流在公司治理中的作用进行了全面梳理，有助于明确未来研究方向。

title: Monetary Policy without Commitment
abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard non-linear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, the inflation response is large, as is the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting.
summary: 本文研究中央银行缺乏承诺对长期通胀和通胀动态的影响。在标准非线性新凯恩斯经济中，引入中央银行缺乏承诺，其中包含粘性价格和垄断竞争企业。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境的相互作用驱动。研究表明，在未预期的劳动力楔形永久性增加或品种间替代弹性下降后，长期通胀上升。在转型过程中，通胀先过度然后逐渐下降。定量上，通胀反应强烈，与通胀目标制相比，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失很大。
ai_comment: 该论文通过引入中央银行缺乏承诺来拓展新凯恩斯模型，揭示了承诺缺失对通胀动态的显著影响，并量化了福利损失，为理解中央银行可信度的重要性提供了新的视角。

title: Investor Behavior Under Epistemic vs. Aleatory Uncertainty
abstract: We provide evidence that investor behavior is sensitive to two dimensions of subjective uncertainty concerning future asset values. Investors vary in the extent to which they attribute market uncertainty to (1) missing knowledge, skill, or information (epistemic uncertainty) and (2) chance or stochastic processes (aleatory uncertainty). Investors who view stock market uncertainty as higher in epistemicness (knowability) are more likely to reduce uncertainty by seeking guidance from experts and are more responsive more responsive to available information when choosing whether to invest. In contrast, investors who view stock market uncertainty as higher in aleatoriness (randomness) are more likely to reduce uncertainty through diversification, and their risk preferences better predict whether they choose to invest. We show, further, that attributions of uncertainty can be perturbed by the format in which historical information is presented: charts displaying absolute stock prices promote perceptions of epistemicness and greater willingness to pay for financial advice, whereas charts displaying the change in stock prices from one period to the next promote perceptions of aleatoriness and a greater tendency to diversify. This paper was accepted by Yuval Rottenstreich, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant SES-1427469] to C. R. Fox and Gülden Ülkümen. Additional support for this work was provided by INSEAD and UCLA Anderson School of Management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4489 .
summary: 本文研究投资者在面临股票市场不确定性时，如何根据其对不确定性来源的归因（认知不确定性 vs. 偶然不确定性）表现出不同的行为。通过实验和调查，作者发现：认为市场不确定性主要源于知识或信息缺失（认知不确定性）的投资者，更倾向于通过寻求专家建议来减少不确定性，并且对可用信息更敏感；而认为不确定性主要源于随机性（偶然不确定性）的投资者，则更倾向于通过分散投资来降低风险，其风险偏好更能预测投资决策。此外，历史信息的呈现形式会影响投资者的不确定性归因：展示绝对股价的图表会增强认知不确定性感知，增加为金融建议付费的意愿；而展示股价变化的图表则会增强偶然不确定性感知，增加分散投资的倾向。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地区分了两种不确定性维度对投资者决策的影响，并发现信息呈现方式可操纵归因，为行为金融和投资顾问实践提供了重要启示。

title: The Impact of Open Data on Public Procurement
abstract: We examine how open procurement data affect the competitiveness of award procedures and the execution of government contracts. The European Union recently made its historical procurement notices available for bulk download in a cohesive and user‐friendly database. Comparing government contracts above and below EU procurement size thresholds, we find that, after the open data initiative, procurement officials are more likely to award treated contracts through open bidding. In cross‐sectional analyses, we document variation in the open bidding effect consistent with two underlying mechanisms: (1) increased scrutiny by NGOs and investigative journalists and (2) learning by national procurement regulators. However, treated contracts are also more likely to experience costly modifications because the shift to open bidding introduces rigidity that limits officials’ discretion in selecting suppliers based on private information. Overall, our evidence indicates that open procurement data promote competitive bidding but lead to contracts with weaker execution performance. These inferences also hold in an alternative open data setting.
summary: 本文研究开放采购数据对招标竞争性和合同执行的影响。利用欧盟将历史采购通知整合为便于访问的数据库这一自然实验，比较欧盟采购门槛之上和之下的政府合同，发现开放数据倡议后，采购官员更倾向于通过公开招标授予受影响的合同。横截面分析表明，该效应存在异质性，与两个潜在机制一致：(1) 非政府组织和调查记者的监督加强，(2) 国家采购监管机构的学习效应。然而，受影响的合同也更容易发生代价高昂的修改，因为转向公开招标引入了刚性，限制了官员根据私有信息选择供应商的自由裁量权。总体而言，证据表明开放采购数据促进了竞争性招标，但导致合同执行绩效下降。这些结论在另一个开放数据环境中也成立。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了开放数据的双刃剑效应：促进竞争但损害执行绩效，为政策制定提供了重要启示。

title: Flexibility costs of debt: Danish exporters during the cartoon crisis
abstract: We study how firms respond to an unexpected demand shock, exploiting the 2006 boycott of Danish products after publication of Muhammad caricatures. On average, affected firms lose the majority of their exports to Muslim countries and experience a significant decrease in total sales. However, firms with low financial leverage redirect sales to new and existing product-destination markets in non-Muslim countries, which allows them to fully offset their losses. In contrast, high-leverage firms do not enter new markets and instead actively downsize. Our results highlight the importance of financial flexibility in times of crisis, consistent with declarations of practitioners.
summary: 基于2006年穆罕默德漫画引发的丹麦产品抵制事件，研究企业如何应对意外的需求冲击。平均而言，受影响企业损失了对穆斯林国家的大部分出口，总销售额显著下降。但财务杠杆低的企业通过将销售转向非穆斯林国家的新市场和现有市场，完全抵消了损失。而高杠杆企业则未进入新市场，反而积极缩减规模。结果强调了财务灵活性在危机中的重要性。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验揭示了财务杠杆对企业应对需求冲击的异质性影响，为财务灵活性成本提供了实证证据。

title: Political ideology and international capital allocation
abstract: Does investors’ political ideology shape international capital allocation? We provide evidence from two settings—syndicated corporate loans and equity mutual funds—to show ideological alignment with foreign governments affects the cross-border capital allocation by U.S. institutional investors. Ideological alignment on both economic and social issues plays a role. Our empirical strategy ensures direct economic effects of foreign elections or government ties between countries are not driving the result. Ideological distance between countries also explains variation in bilateral investment. Combined, our findings imply ideological alignment is an important, omitted factor in models of international capital allocation.
summary: 本文研究投资者的政治意识形态是否影响国际资本配置。利用美国机构投资者的银团贷款和股票共同基金两个场景，发现投资者与外国政府在经济和社会议题上的意识形态一致性显著影响跨境资本配置。实证设计排除了外国选举或政府间经济联系的直接影响，并进一步表明国家间的意识形态距离也能解释双边投资差异。结论指出意识形态一致性是现有国际资本配置模型中重要的遗漏因素。
ai_comment: 亮点在于将政治意识形态引入国际资本配置分析，通过双重场景和稳健的识别策略揭示了软因素的重要作用，是对传统经济因素模型的补充。

title: Loan spreads and credit cycles: The role of lenders’ personal economic experiences
abstract: We provide evidence that changes in lender optimism can lead to excessive fluctuations in credit spreads across the credit cycle. Using data on the real estate properties of loan officers originating large corporate loans, we find that credit spreads overreact to sophisticated lenders’ recent local economic experiences, captured by local housing price growth. These effects are only present when borrowers own real estate assets and during times of greater uncertainty about real estate values, i.e., boom-and-bust cycles in housing prices. Our analysis suggests that recent personal experiences shape sophisticated lenders’ beliefs about real estate values, which affect their pricing decisions.
summary: 本文研究贷款机构乐观情绪变化如何导致信用利差在信贷周期中的过度波动。利用大型企业贷款官员的房地产持有数据，以当地房价增长作为其近期经济经历的代理变量，发现信用利差对这些经历存在过度反应，且该效应仅在借款人拥有房地产资产以及房价处于繁荣-萧条周期等房地产价值不确定性较高时显著。分析表明，贷款机构最近的个人经历会塑造其关于房地产价值的信念，进而影响其定价决策。
ai_comment: 本文通过微观数据（贷款官员房产）巧妙捕获机构信念，揭示了个人经历对信贷定价的显著影响，为理解信用周期波动提供了新的行为视角。

title: Gaming the IRS’ Third‐Party Reporting System: Evidence from Pari‐Mutuel Wagering
abstract: This study examines whether taxpayers intentionally avoid Internal Revenue Service (IRS) third‐party reports. In 2017 an IRS amendment created a quasi‐exogenous shock that reduced third‐party tax reporting of pari‐mutuel gambling winnings from certain types of wagers. I consider the effect that this rule change had on taxpayer behavior. Using a difference‐in‐differences research design comparing thoroughbred racing in the United States to Canada, I find a 27% increase in gambler's investment into wager‐types that became less likely to trigger third‐party reports. Further, I provide evidence that this effect was because of third‐party reporting, not withholding, and was stronger in more informed gambling populations. These findings suggest that taxpayers knowingly avoid third‐party reports, enabling underreporting of income to the IRS. This has important policy implications because underreported individual income is the largest driver of the $496 billion annual gap between legal tax liability and actual tax collections in the United States.
summary: 该研究利用2017年美国国税局（IRS）一项修正案作为准外生冲击，该修正案减少了对某些类型赌博奖金（即parimutuel wagering）的第三方税务报告要求。通过对比美国与加拿大纯种赛马投注行为的双重差分（difference-in-differences）分析，发现投注者将资金更多地转向那些不太可能触发第三方报告的赌注类型，增幅达27%。进一步证据表明，这一效应源于第三方报告本身而非预扣税机制，且在信息更充分的赌博人群中更为显著。结论表明，纳税人会主动规避IRS的第三方报告系统，从而导致收入少报行为；这具有重要政策含义，因为个人收入少报是美国每年约4960亿美元法定税负与实际税收之间缺口的主要来源。
ai_comment: 该论文利用准自然实验提供了纳税人主动规避第三方报告的直接因果证据，对理解税收合规行为及设计有效监管具有重要启示。

title: Does the Federal Reserve Obtain Competitive and Appropriate Prices in Monetary Policy Implementation?
abstract: Many of the Federal Reserve’s (the Fed’s) monetary policy operations involve trading with primary dealers. We find that, for agency MBS, dealers charge 2.5 cents (per $100 face value) higher selling to the Fed than to non-Fed customers. Controlling for the same dealer, same security, and same trading time, this discriminatory pricing likely arises from dealers’ market power rather than inventory costs. Further, matching trade size reduces the price differential by more than half, implying that dealers’ market power greatly relates to the Fed’s purchases in large amounts, whereas the Fed’s limited breadth of counterparty choice also plays some role.
summary: 本文研究美联储在货币政策操作中与一级交易商交易时是否获得竞争性价格。通过分析机构MBS交易数据，发现交易商出售给美联储的价格比出售给非美联储客户平均高出每100美元面值2.5美分。在控制了同一交易商、同一证券、同一交易时间后，这种歧视性定价仍然存在，表明其源于交易商的市场势力而非库存成本。进一步发现，匹配交易规模可使价格差异减少超过一半，说明交易商的市场势力与美联储的大额购买需求密切相关，同时美联储有限的交易对手选择也起到一定作用。
ai_comment: 本文通过精细的交易数据揭示了美联储在货币政策操作中因对手方市场势力而面临的定价劣势，并量化了交易规模与对手方选择的影响，为优化操作策略提供了实证依据。

title: Convertible Debt Arbitrage Crashes Revisited
abstract: This article examines the severity of the 2008 arbitrage crash in the convertible bond market by estimating how expensive it would have been to liquidate portfolio securities immediately. We consider whether funds actually demanded immediate liquidity or were able to delay trades. Our results indicate that the cost of immediacy was high, but that convertible bond sellers could largely avoid selling at fire sale prices. These results can be explained by dealers recognizing when trades are liquidity-motivated rather than information-based and by a shift to riskless principal trading, allowing dealers to avoid taking bonds into inventory.
summary: 本文重新审视了2008年可转换债券市场套利崩溃的严重性，通过估计立即清算投资组合证券的成本，考察基金是否实际要求即期流动性或能否延迟交易。研究发现，即时性成本很高，但可转换债券卖方基本能够避免以甩卖价出售。这些结果可解释为交易商识别出流动性驱动的交易而非基于信息的交易，以及转向无风险本金交易，使交易商避免将债券纳入库存。
ai_comment: 本文通过分析交易商行为和市场机制，揭示了在极端市场压力下流动性提供的重要性和交易商缓解价格下跌的机制，为理解套利崩溃的实际影响提供了新视角。

title: Does Shareholder Litigation Risk Cause Public Firms to Delist? Evidence from Securities Class Action Lawsuits
abstract: Using three exogenous shocks to ex ante litigation risk, including federal judge ideology and two influential judicial precedents, we find that lower shareholder litigation risk reduces a firm’s propensity to delist from the U.S. stock markets. The effect is at least partially driven by indirect costs of litigation and that being a private firm can significantly reduce the threat of litigation. Overall, the results suggest that mitigating excessive litigation costs for public firms is crucial to ensure the continued vibrancy of the U.S. stock market.
summary: 这篇论文利用联邦法官意识形态和两个有影响力的司法判例作为事前诉讼风险的外生冲击，研究发现较低的股东诉讼风险会降低公司从美国股市退市的倾向。该效应至少部分由诉讼的间接成本驱动，且作为私营公司可以显著减少诉讼威胁。总体结果表明，减轻上市公司的过度诉讼成本对于确保美国股市的持续活力至关重要。
ai_comment: 本文通过外生冲击识别了诉讼风险与退市决策的因果关系，为理解诉讼成本对上市公司存续的影响提供了有力证据。

title: Did the FASB Codification Reduce the Complexity of Applying U.S. GAAP?
abstract: We examine whether the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) Codification made it easier for preparers and auditors to locate relevant accounting guidance. We find that areas of U.S. GAAP with more dispersed and voluminous guidance before the Codification experience a larger post‐Codification reduction in restatements. We find a similar decline in SEC comment letter questions referencing areas of U.S. GAAP with more dispersed and voluminous pre‐Codification guidance. Our results suggest that before the Codification, preparers and auditors had difficulty in locating the appropriate accounting guidance and that the Codification mitigated this difficulty.
summary: 本文检验了美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）的会计准则汇编是否使编制者和审计师更容易找到相关的会计指南。研究发现，在汇编实施之前，美国公认会计原则（U.S. GAAP）中指南更为分散且数量庞大的领域，在汇编之后经历了更大程度的财务重述减少。同样，SEC意见函中引用这些领域的提问也出现了类似下降。结果表明，在汇编之前，编制者和审计师在定位适当会计指南方面存在困难，而汇编缓解了这一困难。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证证据表明FASB会计准则汇编有效降低了会计指南定位的复杂性，为准则简化的实际效果提供了有力支持。

title: Executive Partisanship and Corporate Investment
abstract: I show that an alignment in partisan affiliation, between a firm’s management and the president, is associated with higher levels of investment. Using insider trading data, I find that managers become more optimistic about their companies’ prospects when their preferred party is in power. This optimism-driven increase in investment is amplified by herding and associated with both lower profitability and stock returns. Overall, managers’ political beliefs produce heterogeneous expectations about future cash flows and distort investment decisions.
summary: 研究考察公司管理层与总统间的党派一致性对企业投资的影响。利用内部交易数据衡量管理层乐观情绪，发现当管理层偏好的政党执政时，他们更看好公司前景，从而增加投资。这种乐观驱动的投资行为会被羊群效应进一步放大，但同时也与更低的盈利能力和股票回报相关。结论表明，管理层的政治信念会导致对未来现金流的异质性预期，并扭曲投资决策。
ai_comment: 利用内部交易数据作为管理层乐观情绪的代理变量，揭示了政治信念对投资行为的非理性影响，具有现实意义。

title: Financing Competitors: Shadow Banks’ Funding and Mortgage Market Competition
abstract: Using novel shadow bank funding data, I find that shadow banks are funded by the very banks they compete with when originating mortgages. Evidence suggests that banks have market power in the upstream market for shadow banks’ funding, which in turn softens mortgage market competition through their strategic behaviors in both markets. I build and calibrate a quantitative model of vertical integration and competition to show that those consumers who would most benefit from shadow bank services are the ones to bear the costs. Secondary market innovation could increase downstream competition by reducing shadow banks’ reliance on their competitors. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用新颖的影子银行融资数据，发现影子银行实际上是由其在抵押贷款发放中的竞争对手——传统银行提供资金的。证据表明，银行在影子银行融资的上游市场拥有市场势力，并通过在两个市场的战略行为削弱了抵押贷款市场的竞争。作者构建并校准了一个垂直整合与竞争的量化模型，表明那些最受益于影子银行服务的消费者承担了成本。二级市场创新可以通过减少影子银行对竞争对手的依赖来增强下游竞争。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了银行通过上游市场势力间接削弱下游竞争的机制，并量化了消费者福利损失，对理解影子银行与传统银行的关系具有重要政策启示。

title: Connected Funds
abstract: Mutual funds often invest in other funds. In this paper, we analyze the economics behind such cross-fund investments and investigate their financial stability implications. Using granular data for the German fund sector, our main findings are that cross-fund investments (a) are becoming increasingly important over time, (b) were heavily liquidated during March 2020, and (c) display measurable contagion effects. Overall, cross-fund investments can elevate structural fund sector vulnerabilities. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究共同基金投资于其他基金（交叉基金投资）的经济学动机及其对金融稳定的影响。利用德国基金部门的精细数据，主要发现包括：（a）交叉基金投资随时间推移变得越来越重要；（b）在2020年3月市场动荡期间，这些投资被大量清算；（c）存在可衡量的传染效应。总体而言，交叉基金投资可能加剧基金部门的结构脆弱性。
ai_comment: 本文利用精细的德国基金数据，首次系统地揭示了交叉基金投资在时间上的增长趋势、危机期间的清算行为及其传染效应，为监管防范基金部门系统性风险提供了重要实证依据。

title: The Partisanship of Financial Regulators
abstract: We analyze the partisanship of Commissioners at the SEC and Governors at the Federal Reserve Board. Using recent advances in machine learning, we identify partisan phrases in Congress, such as “red tape” and “climate change,” and observe their usage among regulators. Although the Fed has remained relatively nonpartisan throughout our sample period (1930–2019), we find that partisanship among SEC Commissioners rose to an all-time high during the 2010-2019 period, driven by more-partisan Commissioners replacing less-partisan ones. Partisanship at the SEC appears in both the language of new SEC rules and the voting behavior of SEC Commissioners. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文分析了美国证券交易委员会（SEC）委员和美联储理事会（Fed）州长的党派性。利用机器学习的最新进展，首先识别出国会中存在的党派性短语（如“繁文缛节”和“气候变化”），随后观察监管者对这些短语的使用情况。研究样本覆盖1930至2019年，发现美联储在整个样本期内保持相对非党派性，而SEC委员的党派性在2010-2019年间达到历史最高水平，这主要是因为更党派化的委员取代了较少党派化的委员。SEC的党派性不仅体现在新制定的规则语言中，也反映在委员的投票行为上。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将机器学习方法应用于分析监管者的语言和投票行为，揭示了SEC党派性的显著上升趋势，对理解金融监管的政治化有重要贡献。

title: Executive Compensation Tied to ESG Performance: International Evidence
abstract: Using a wide sample of international publicly traded firms, this paper studies the rapidly increasing practice of incorporating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics in executive compensation contracts. Our evidence suggests that this compensation practice varies at the country, industry, and firm levels in ways that are consistent with efficient incentive contracting. We also observe that reliance on ESG metrics in executive compensation arrangements is associated with engagement, voting, and trading by institutional investors, which suggests that firms could be adopting this practice to align their management's objectives with the preferences of certain shareholder groups. Finally, we find that the adoption of ESG Pay is accompanied by improvements in key ESG outcomes, but not by improvements in financial performance.
summary: 本文利用广泛的国际公开上市公司样本，研究了将环境、社会和治理（ESG）指标纳入高管薪酬合同这一快速增长的做法。证据表明，这种薪酬实践在国家、行业和公司层面的差异与有效激励合同一致。同时，ESG薪酬的采用与机构投资者的参与、投票和交易相关联，暗示公司可能通过此实践使管理层目标与特定股东群体的偏好保持一致。最后，研究发现采用ESG薪酬伴随着关键ESG结果的改善，但并未带来财务绩效的提升。
ai_comment: 该研究利用大规模国际样本，系统揭示了ESG薪酬实践的驱动因素及其对企业ESG绩效的积极影响，为理解非财务激励的全球趋势提供了重要实证依据。

title: Independent Director Tenure and Corporate Governance: Evidence from Insider Trading
abstract: Executives trade more profitably and opportunistically over the course of the tenure of independent directors (IDs). IDs’ increased connections with and hence allegiance to executives are likely the channel through which ID tenure can affect executive trading. Executive opportunism is mitigated by disciplinary factors that include the presence of a firm’s internal trading policy, blockholders, and IDs with legal expertise as well as the risk of shareholder-initiated derivative lawsuits. These results point to an association between long-tenured IDs and weakened corporate governance.
summary: 摘要研究独立董事任期如何影响高管内幕交易。利用高管在独立董事任职期间交易的数据，发现高管交易更具盈利性和机会主义，其机制在于独立董事与高管之间的关联和忠诚度随任期增加而增强。这种机会主义行为受到公司内部交易政策、大股东、具备法律专长的独立董事以及股东派生诉讼风险等惩戒因素的抑制。结果表明，长任期独立董事与公司治理弱化相关联。
ai_comment: 该研究实证揭示了独立董事长期任职可能削弱其监督职能，为董事会治理和任期限制提供了重要证据。

title: Is COVID Revealing a Virus in CMBS 2.0?
abstract: Commercial loan valuations crucially depend on accurate loan income, but underwritten income on commercial mortgage‐backed securities (CMBS) loans is commonly overstated relative to actual property income. Consistent with these differences being originator‐specific, income overstatement in CMBS 2.0 deals varies widely and persistently across originators, is priced by originators, is related across property types within an originator, is predictable ex ante, and is accompanied by inflation of past financials. Risk retention and associated regulation had no discernible effect on income overstatement. Originator income overstatement is highly predictive of pre‐ and COVID‐period loan distress. Overall, recent market stresses reveal large systemic differences in underwriting standards across originators.
summary: 商业贷款估值准确依赖于贷款收入，但商用抵押贷款支持证券（CMBS）贷款中承保收入通常被高估。研究发现，在CMBS 2.0交易中，收入高估因发起人而异，在不同发起人间具有广泛且持续的差异，被发起人定价，同一发起人内不同物业类型间相关，可事前预测，并伴随过去财务数据的膨胀。风险留存及相关监管对收入高估没有明显影响。发起人的收入高估能高度预测COVID前后期间的贷款困境。整体上，近期市场压力揭示了不同发起人之间承销标准的系统性巨大差异。
ai_comment: 论文通过实证揭示了CMBS市场中发起人承销标准的系统性差异，并指出风险留存监管的无效性，为市场风险和监管政策提供了重要洞见。

title: When Do Low-Frequency Measures Really Measure Effective Spreads? Evidence from Equity and Foreign Exchange Markets
abstract: We present evidence that several popular low-frequency measures of effective spread suffer from a volatility-induced bias and that volatility is the primary driver of the variation of these liquidity proxies. Using data for U.S. equities and major foreign exchange rates, we show that the bias arises when the effective spread is small relative to volatility. We document that the bias has become more acute over time and show that volatility-biased measures fail to replicate some well-known results in empirical finance. We conclude by providing guidance on the choice of low-frequency measures in empirical applications. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 文章证明了几个常用的低频率有效价差度量存在由波动率引起的偏差，并且波动率是这些流动性代理变量变化的主要驱动因素。利用美国股票和主要外汇汇率的数据，作者展示了当有效价差相对于波动率较小时，偏差就会出现。文章指出，这种偏差随时间推移变得更加严重，并表明受波动率影响的度量无法复制实证金融中一些众所周知的结果。最后，文章为实证应用中低频率度量的选择提供了指导。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了低频率流动性度量中一个被忽视的偏差来源，对实证金融研究具有重要的方法论意义。

title: Corporate Hiring Under COVID-19: Financial Constraints and the Nature of New Jobs
abstract: Big data on job postings reveal multiple facets of the impact of COVID-19 on corporate hiring. Firms disproportionately cut new hiring for high-skill positions, with financially constrained firms reducing skilled hiring the most. Applying machine learning methods to job-ad texts, we find that firms have skewed their hiring toward operationally-core functions. New positions display greater flexibility regarding schedules and tasks. While job posting levels show signs of recovery starting in late-2020, changes to job descriptions and skill profiles persist through early-2022. Financial constraints amplify these changes, with constrained firms’ new hires witnessing greater adjustments to job roles and employment arrangements.
summary: 本文利用大数据职位发布，分析了COVID-19对企业招聘的多方面影响。研究发现，企业不成比例地削减了高技能职位的招聘，其中财务约束较强的企业削减幅度最大。通过将机器学习方法应用于职位发布文本，作者发现企业将招聘转向运营核心职能，新职位在时间和任务安排上表现出更大的灵活性。尽管职位发布水平从2020年底开始出现复苏迹象，但职位描述和技能要求的变化一直持续到2022年初。财务约束加剧了这些变化，受约束企业的新员工在职位角色和就业安排方面经历了更大的调整。
ai_comment: 利用大数据和机器学习方法深入分析疫情下企业招聘行为的动态变化，揭示了财务约束对招聘结构和职位特征的放大效应，为理解疫情经济后果提供了微观证据。

title: Impact of Regulations on Firm Value: Evidence from the 2016 U.S. Presidential Election
abstract: Using the 2016 U.S. presidential election result as a shock to the expectations about the future regulatory environment, I find that most regulated firms earned approximately 4% higher cumulative abnormal stock returns than least regulated firms during the first 10 trading days after the election. Exploring economic mechanisms, I find evidence consistent with the explanation that more regulations disproportionately harm high-growth firms and allow incumbent firms to extract rents through lower competition and political favoritism. Stock returns are also followed by a shift in firm fundamentals over 3 years after 2016, consistent with the economic mechanisms.
summary: 利用2016年美国总统大选结果作为对未来监管环境预期的冲击，研究发现大多数受监管企业在选举后前10个交易日的累积异常股票收益率比最不受监管的企业高出约4%。通过探索经济机制，发现证据支持以下解释：更多监管不成比例地损害高增长企业，并允许现有企业通过降低竞争和政治偏袒获取租金。此外，股票回报之后伴随着2016年后3年内企业基本面的变化，与经济机制一致。
ai_comment: 利用自然实验识别监管对企业价值的因果效应，并揭示了监管影响企业价值的两种潜在渠道（竞争与政治偏袒），视角新颖。

title: Information in Financial Contracts: Evidence from Securitization Agreements
abstract: We introduce a novel application of machine learning to compare pooling and servicing agreements (PSAs) that govern commercial mortgage-backed securities. In contrast to the view that the PSA is largely boilerplate text, we document substantial variation across PSAs, both within- and across-underwriters and over time. A part of this variation is driven by differences in loan collateral across deals. Additionally, we find that differences in PSAs are correlated with ex post loan and bond performance. Collectively, our analysis suggests the importance of examining the entire governing document, rather than specific components, when analyzing complex financial securities.
summary: 本文创新性地应用机器学习方法，对比分析商业抵押贷款支持证券（CMBS）中的集合与服务协议（PSAs）。与传统认为PSA主要为标准化模板文本的观点不同，研究发现PSA在不同承销商之间、同一承销商内部以及不同时间段均存在显著差异。这种差异部分源于各交易中贷款抵押品的不同。此外，PSA的差异与事后贷款和债券表现相关。整体上，分析表明在评估复杂金融证券时，应检查整个管理文件而非仅关注特定组成部分。
keywords: 商业抵押贷款支持证券
ai_comment: 该研究通过机器学习对合同文本进行系统性比较，突破了先前仅关注合同特定条款的研究范式，揭示了法律条款与资产绩效之间的关联，为金融合同设计提供了新视角。

title: International Portfolio Choice with Frictions: Evidence from Mutual Funds
abstract: Using data on international equity portfolio allocations by U.S. mutual funds, we estimate a portfolio expression derived from a standard mean-variance portfolio model extended with portfolio frictions. The optimal portfolio depends on the previous month and the buy-and-hold portfolio shares, and a present discounted value of expected excess returns. We estimate expected return differentials and use them in the portfolio regressions. The estimates imply significant portfolio frictions and a modest rate of risk aversion. While mutual fund portfolios significantly respond to expected returns, portfolio frictions lead to a weaker and a more gradual portfolio response to changes in expected returns. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文使用美国共同基金的国际股票组合配置数据，估计了一个在标准均值-方差组合模型基础上扩展了组合摩擦（portfolio frictions）的最优组合表达式。最优组合依赖于前一个月和买入并持有的组合份额，以及预期超额收益的现值。作者估计了预期收益差异并将其用于组合回归。结果表明存在显著组合摩擦和适度的风险厌恶系数。尽管共同基金组合对预期收益有显著响应，但组合摩擦导致其对预期收益变化的响应更弱、更缓慢。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地在标准资产组合模型中引入摩擦，并利用实际数据进行了量化估计，揭示了摩擦在减缓组合调整中的重要作用，为理解国际组合投资行为提供了新视角。

title: Remote Board Meetings and Board Monitoring Effectiveness: Evidence from China
abstract: Using Chinese data, we examine whether synchronous remote board meetings, which facilitate status equalization among directors and alleviate their pressure for conformity, affect board monitoring effectiveness. We find that compared to face-to-face meetings, synchronous remote meetings are associated with directors’ better meeting attendance behavior, a higher likelihood of director dissent on monitoring-related proposals, higher forced CEO turnover-performance sensitivity, and more effective investments. These results hold when we use remote meetings that include both synchronous and asynchronous remote meetings. Proposal-director level analysis further shows that remote meetings reduce the pressure to conform faced by young first-term directors and socially connected directors. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用中国数据，研究同步远程董事会会议是否通过促进董事间的地位平等和缓解从众压力来影响董事会监督有效性。结果发现，与面对面会议相比，同步远程会议与董事更好的参会行为、更高的董事对监督相关提案投反对票的可能性、更强的强制CEO更替-业绩敏感性以及更有效的投资显著相关。当同时考虑同步和异步远程会议时，结果依然稳健。进一步的提案-董事层面分析表明，远程会议降低了年轻首任董事和社会关系董事所面临的从众压力。
ai_comment: 本文利用中国独特的远程会议实践，揭示了技术手段如何通过缓解社会压力机制改善公司治理，为数字化时代董事会效率研究提供了新颖视角。

title: Transmission Effects of ESG Disclosure Regulations Through Bank Lending Networks
abstract: This paper studies whether and how environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosure regulations imposed on banks generate transmission effects along the lending channel. I use a setting of U.S. firms borrowing from non‐U.S. banks and exploit the staggered adoption of ESG disclosure regulations in banks’ home countries. I find that exposed borrowers of affected banks improve their environmental and social (E&S) performance following the disclosure mandate. Consistent with banks enhancing both their engagement and selection activities, affected banks impose more environmental action covenants in loan contracts, and they are more likely to terminate a borrower with bad E&S records following the regulation. Further evidence shows that the transmission effects are stronger when a disclosure regulation is well‐enforced (as indicated by a greater increase in banks’ disclosure) and among borrowers with greater switching costs. Collectively, the findings document the role of lending relationships in transmitting the real effect of ESG disclosure regulations from banks to borrowing firms.
summary: 本文研究ESG披露监管如何通过银行贷款渠道产生传导效应。以美国企业向非美国银行借款为样本，利用各国分批实施ESG披露法规的外生变化，发现受法规影响的银行所借款企业在环境与社会（E&S）绩效上显著提升。机制上，受影响的银行在贷款合同中增加环境行动条款，并更可能终止与E&S记录差的借款人的合作关系。传导效应在法规执行力度强（表现为银行披露显著增加）以及借款人转换成本较高的情况下更为明显。整体表明，借贷关系在将ESG披露监管的真实效应从银行传导至借款企业中起关键作用。
ai_comment: 利用跨国银行借贷网络识别因果关系，为ESG监管的溢出效应提供了稳健证据，并揭示了银行通过契约和筛选机制传导压力的具体路径。

title: The Effects of Antitrust Laws on Horizontal Mergers: International Evidence
abstract: This study examines how antitrust law adoptions affect horizontal merger and acquisition outcomes. Using the staggered introduction of competition laws in 20 countries, we find antitrust regulation decreases acquirers’ 5-day cumulative abnormal returns surrounding horizontal merger announcements. A decrease in deal value, target book assets, and industry peers’ announcement returns are consistent with the market power hypothesis. Exploiting antitrust law adoptions addresses a downward bias to an estimated effect of antitrust enforcement. The potential bias from heterogeneous treatment effects does not nullify our results. Overall, antitrust policies seem to deter post-merger monopolistic gains, potentially improving customer welfare.
summary: 使用20个国家竞争法分阶段引入的数据，研究反垄断法通过如何影响横向并购结果。发现反垄断法规降低了收购方在横向并购公告前后5天的累计异常收益。交易价值、目标账面资产和行业同行公告收益的下降与市场力量假说一致。利用反垄断法通过解决了反垄断执行估计效应的向下偏差，且异质性处理效应的潜在偏差不会使结果无效。总体而言，反垄断政策似乎阻止了合并后的垄断收益，可能改善消费者福利。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验设计有效识别反垄断法的因果效应，并揭示了市场力量假说在解释并购收益下降中的作用。

title: One Vol to Rule Them All: Common Volatility Dynamics in Factor Returns
abstract: We show that a common component governs volatility dynamics across a wide range of traded equity factors. This “common factor volatility” (CFV) exists even among orthogonal factors. CFV occurs in both cash-flow and discount-rate components of factor returns and derives from market responses to fundamental news rather than underlying commonality in news volatility. Incorporating CFV improves factor volatility forecasts relative to models that include only own-factor volatility. CFV allows us to characterize stochastic discount factor (SDF) volatility dynamics in a very general sense and we show that many popular models imply SDFs with time-varying volatility that correlates strongly with CFV.
summary: 本文发现，在广泛交易股票因子中，一个共同成分主导了波动性动态。该“共同因子波动性”（CFV）在正交因子中依然存在，且同时出现在因子收益的现金流和折现率成分中，其来源于市场对基本面新闻的反应，而非新闻波动性的潜在共同性。将CFV纳入模型能显著提升因子波动性预测，优于仅包含自身因子波动性的模型。CFV使得在非常普遍的意义上刻画随机贴现因子（SDF）的波动性动态成为可能，并且许多流行模型隐含的时变波动SDF与CFV强相关。
ai_comment: 该文揭示因子波动存在共同成分，为资产定价中波动性建模提供了新视角，且对SDF波动性具有重要解释力。

title: Competition and Misconduct
abstract: Misconduct is widespread. Practices such as misselling, pump and dump, and money laundering cause harm while raising profits. This paper presents a mechanism that can determine what sorts of misconduct can be sustained in competitive equilibrium in concentrated markets, oligopoly settings, and markets with many small competing firms. The model studied allows general demand and distinguishes types of ethical dilemma using current psychological understanding. The paper shows, for example, that markets with many small competing firms are not vulnerable to misconduct if firms respond to entry with niche strategies or if the ethical dilemma draws an emotional response.
summary: 不当行为（如误导销售、拉高出货、洗钱）普遍存在，在增加利润的同时造成危害。本文提出一个机制，用以确定在集中市场、寡头市场以及有许多小企业竞争的市场中，何种类型的不当行为能在竞争均衡中持续存在。该模型允许一般需求，并利用当前心理学理解来区分道德困境的类型。论文表明，例如，如果企业对市场进入采取利基策略，或者道德困境引发情绪反应，那么有许多小企业竞争的市场不易发生不当行为。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将心理学与产业组织理论结合，揭示了不同市场结构下不当行为的可持续条件，为监管政策提供了新视角。

title: Model Comparison with Transaction Costs
abstract: Failing to account for transaction costs materially impacts inferences drawn when evaluating asset pricing models, biasing tests in favor of those employing high‐cost factors. Ignoring transaction costs, Hou, Xue, and Zhang (2015, Review of Financial Studies , 28, 650–705) q ‐factor model and Barillas and Shanken (2018, The Journal of Finance , 73, 715–754) six‐factor models have high maximum squared Sharpe ratios and small alphas across 205 anomalies. They do not, however, come close to spanning the achievable mean‐variance efficient frontier. Accounting for transaction costs, the Fama and French (2015, Journal of Financial Economics , 116, 1–22; 2018, Journal of Financial Economics , 128, 234–252) five‐factor model has a significantly higher squared Sharpe ratio than either of these alternative models, while variations employing cash profitability perform better still.
summary: 本文研究了交易成本对资产定价模型评估的影响。忽略交易成本会偏向使用高成本因子的模型，导致推断偏差。在忽略交易成本的情况下，Hou, Xue, Zhang (2015) 的 q 因子模型和 Barillas & Shanken (2018) 的六因子模型在 205 个异常现象中表现出高最大平方夏普比率和小 alpha，但并不能接近可达到的均值方差有效前沿。当考虑交易成本后，Fama & French (2015, 2018) 的五因子模型具有显著更高的平方夏普比率，而采用现金盈利能力的变体表现更优。
ai_comment: 本文通过纳入交易成本重新评估主流因子模型，揭示了忽略交易成本会导致严重的高估偏差，对实证资产定价研究具有重要方法论意义。

title: Stock Market Stimulus
abstract: We study the stock market effects of the arrival of the three rounds of “stimulus checks” to U.S. taxpayers and the single round of direct payments to Hong Kong citizens. The first two rounds of U.S. checks appear to have increased retail buying and share prices of retail-dominated portfolios. The Hong Kong payments increased overall turnover and share prices on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. We cannot rule out that these price effects were permanent. The findings raise novel questions about the role of fiscal stimulus in the stock market. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究了美国三轮“刺激支票”发放和香港一次性直接支付对股市的影响。发现前两轮美国刺激支票增加了散户购买行为并提升了散户主导型投资组合的股价；香港的直接支付则提高了股市整体成交量和股价。这些价格效应可能具有持久性。研究结果对财政刺激在股市中的作用提出了新的问题。
ai_comment: 通过自然实验识别财政刺激对股市的影响，揭示散户行为的关键传导作用，且发现价格效应可能持久，为财政政策与资产定价互动提供新视角。

title: Liquidity Constraints, Consumption, and Debt Repayment: Evidence from Macroprudential Policy in Turkey
abstract: Using account-level credit card data from a large Turkish bank, we study the impact of a unique credit card policy that increases minimum payment on consumption and debt repayment. We show that the policy reduces credit card spending and debt, boosts existing debt repayment, and reduces credit card delinquency. The credit card debt of affected consumers falls on average by 50$\%$ two years into the policy’s implementation. An increase in minimum payment has a stronger effect than does a decrease of a similar magnitude. We build a benchmark life cycle model with soft liquidity constraint to explain the reduction in credit card spending. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 利用一家土耳其大型银行的账户级信用卡数据，研究了一项独特的信用卡政策（提高最低还款额）对消费和债务偿还的影响。结果表明，该政策减少了信用卡支出和债务，促进了现有债务的偿还，并降低了信用卡违约率。受影响的消费者信用卡债务在政策实施两年后平均下降50%。提高最低还款额的效果比同等幅度的降低更强。作者构建了一个具有软流动性约束的基准生命周期模型来解释信用卡支出的减少。
ai_comment: 利用微观账户级数据实证检验宏观审慎政策效果，并结合结构模型进行机制解释，具有较高的政策参考价值和学术贡献。

title: Inferring Aggregate Market Expectations from the Cross Section of Stock Prices
abstract: We introduce a new approach to estimating long-term aggregate discount rates using the cross section of earnings and book values to explain current stock prices and extract expected market returns. The proposed discount rate measure is countercyclical. Shocks to it account for nearly half of historical market return variation; in contrast, shocks to other discount rate measures account for no more than 2%. It dominates other measures in explaining time-series variation in returns on duration-sorted portfolios and delivers out-of-sample predictability that exceeds that afforded by other expected return measures and predictive variables. It also performs well in international equity markets.
summary: 本文提出一种新方法，利用盈余和账面价值的横截面来估计长期总贴现率，并从当前股价中提取预期市场回报。该贴现率指标表现出逆周期性，其冲击解释了近一半的历史市场回报变化，而其他贴现率指标的解释力不超过2%。该指标在解释久期排序投资组合回报的时间序列变化上优于其他指标，并提供了超过其他预期回报指标和预测变量的样本外预测能力。在国际股票市场中同样表现良好。
ai_comment: 本文创新的横截面贴现率估计方法在解释力和预测能力上显著优于传统指标，并在国际市场中具有稳健性，为资产定价研究提供了有力工具。

title: Corporate Leadership and Inherited Beliefs About Gender Roles
abstract: Some U.S. firms have women directors and executives, while many do not. We seek to explain this heterogeneity. Using U.S. Census data from 1900, we find that U.S. counties with populations originating from countries with stronger gender-egalitarian beliefs have more women in the labor market and in STEM occupations, and lower gender-pay gaps. Firms headquartered in such counties have more women executives and directors. When firms move to more gender-egalitarian counties, the representation of women on board increases. Our findings are consistent with the idea that inherited beliefs about gender roles impact the labor market and corporate leadership.
summary: 这篇论文研究美国公司女性董事和高管比例的异质性。利用1900年美国人口普查数据，发现来自性别平等信念更强国家的移民聚居的县，其劳动力市场中女性参与率更高、STEM职业女性比例更高、性别薪酬差距更小。总部位于这些县的公司拥有更多女性高管和董事。当公司搬迁到更性别平等的县时，董事会女性比例会上升。这些发现支持继承的性别角色信念影响劳动力市场和企业领导层的观点。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙利用历史移民数据作为外生变量识别文化信念的因果影响，为性别多样性研究提供了新颖的证据。

title: ETF Ownership and Seasoned Equity Offerings
abstract: This article investigates the impact of exchange-traded fund (ETF) ownership on seasoned equity offerings (SEOs). We find that increases to firms’ ETF ownership is positively related to their propensity to conduct an SEO. ETF ownership is also associated with less negative SEO announcement returns, smaller discounts, and better long-run stock returns. Our evidence is consistent with equity issuance following investor demand for stocks driven by greater participation in ETFs, suggesting a possible alternative source of market timing opportunity.
summary: 本文研究了交易所交易基金（ETF）所有权对增发（SEO）的影响。发现公司ETF所有权的增加与进行SEO的倾向正相关。ETF所有权还与更低的负面公告回报、更小的折扣以及更好的长期股票回报相关。证据表明，股权发行跟随投资者因更多参与ETF而产生的股票需求，暗示了市场时机选择的另一种可能来源。
ai_comment: 本文从ETF所有权角度揭示了企业增发决策的新驱动因素，为市场时机理论提供了实证支持，具有创新性。

title: Can Capital Adjustment Costs Explain the Decline in Investment–Cash Flow Sensitivity?
abstract: It is well documented that since at least the 1970s investment-cash flow (I-CF) sensitivity has been decreasing over time to disappear almost completely by the late 2000s. Based on a neoclassical investment model with costly external financing, we show that this pattern can be explained by the gradual increase of capital adjustment costs, attributable to the accumulation of knowledge capital. The result is robust to a variety of approaches, including Euler equation estimation and the simulated method of moments. More generally, our findings demonstrate that I-CF sensitivity should only be interpreted as a joint measure of financial and real frictions.
summary: 自20世纪70年代以来，投资-现金流（I-CF）敏感性随时间持续下降，到2000年代末几乎完全消失。本文基于一个包含昂贵外部融资的新古典投资模型，证明这一模式可由资本调整成本的逐渐增加来解释，而资本调整成本的上升归因于知识资本的积累。该结果在多种方法下保持稳健，包括欧拉方程估计和模拟矩方法。更一般地，研究结果表明I-CF敏感性应被解释为金融摩擦和实际摩擦的联合度量。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入知识资本积累导致的资本调整成本上升，为投资-现金流敏感性的长期下降趋势提供了理论解释，并强调了将其视为金融与真实摩擦联合度量的重要性。

title: An Experiment in Tight Monetary Policy: Revisiting the 1920–1921 Depression
abstract: Is there a trade-off between the short-run and long-run real effects of monetary policy “leaning against the wind”? We provide novel evidence on this question from the United States in 1920–1921. Our identification strategy exploits county-level variation in access to the Federal Reserve’s discount window, and hand-collected data on banking and agriculture in Illinois. In the short term, tightened conditions at the discount window decreased bank lending and lowered crop prices and farm revenues. In the long term, however, they lowered debt-to-output levels and led to greater farmland utilization, suggesting an avoidance of debt overhang problems.
summary: 本研究探讨了货币政策“逆风干预”在短期和长期实际效果之间的权衡，以美国1920–1921年大萧条为背景提供新证据。识别策略利用县级层面在获取美联储贴现窗口上的差异，并结合手工收集的伊利诺伊州银行与农业数据。短期来看，贴现窗口条件收紧减少了银行贷款，降低了作物价格和农场收入；但长期来看，这些紧缩政策降低了债务产出比，并提高了农田利用率，表明避免了债务积压问题。
ai_comment: 利用历史自然实验和手收集微观数据，为货币政策短期成本与长期收益之间的权衡提供了独特见解，对当代政策制定具有参考价值。

title: The Use of Peer Groups in Setting Director Compensation: Competition for Talent Versus Self-Serving Behavior
abstract: Recent Delaware Chancery Court decisions that boards are self-interested in setting director compensation have focused scrutiny on the pay-setting process used by corporations. We examine the effect of peer benchmarking on director compensation decisions. Director pay relates positively to peer director pay, and firms paying their directors highly are selected as peers. Moreover, firm performance and board advising performance are positively related to the talent component and are generally unrelated to the self-serving component of the peer pay effect. The evidence indicates that firms use peer benchmarking to justify high compensation mainly to attract talented directors to enhance board quality.
summary: 基于最近特拉华州衡平法院关于董事会在设定自身薪酬时存在自利行为的判决，本文研究了同行基准（peer benchmarking）对董事薪酬决策的影响。研究发现，董事薪酬与同行董事薪酬正相关，且向董事支付高薪酬的公司更可能被选为同行。此外，公司业绩和董事会建议绩效与人才成分正相关，而与同行薪酬效应中的自利成分基本无关。证据表明，公司使用同行基准来证明高薪酬的合理性，主要是为了吸引有才华的董事以提升董事会质量。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙地区分了同行基准在董事薪酬设定中的两种动机，并通过实证分析支持了人才竞争假说，为薪酬激励和公司治理研究提供了新视角。

title: Lending Next to the Courthouse: Exposure to Adverse Events and Mortgage Lending Decisions
abstract: Adverse market events can affect credit supply not only by hurting financial fundamentals but also by changing the risk-taking behaviors of individual decision-makers. We provide micro-level evidence of this individual decision-making channel in the U.S. mortgage market. We find that mortgage application rejection rates are more sensitive to foreclosure intensity when loan officers are more exposed to foreclosure news, despite the same housing market and bank fundamentals. Loans originated from the affected branches have lower ex post default rates, consistent with higher lending standards being applied. In the aggregate, this effect results in tighter credit supply during housing market downturns.
summary: 本文研究不利市场事件如何通过改变个体决策者的风险承担行为影响信贷供给。利用美国抵押贷款市场的微观数据，发现当贷款官员更多地暴露于止赎新闻时，抵押贷款申请拒绝率对止赎强度的敏感度更高，尽管房屋市场和银行基本面相同。受影响分支机构的贷款事后违约率较低，表明贷款官员实施了更高的贷款标准。总体而言，这种效应在房地产市场低迷期间导致信贷供给收紧。
ai_comment: 论文从个体决策者视角揭示了不利市场事件通过改变风险认知影响信贷供给的微观机制，丰富了行为金融与金融中介交叉领域的研究。

title: CLO Performance
abstract: We study the performance of collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) to understand the market imperfections giving rise to these vehicles and their corresponding economic costs. CLO equity tranches earn positive abnormal returns from the risk‐adjusted price differential between leveraged loans and CLO debt tranches. Debt tranches offer higher returns than similarly rated corporate bonds, making them attractive to banks and insurers that face risk‐based capital requirements. Temporal variation in equity performance highlights the resilience of CLOs to market volatility due to their closed‐end structure, long‐term funding, and embedded options to reinvest principal proceeds.
summary: 本文研究了杠杆贷款担保债务凭证（CLO）的表现，旨在理解产生这些工具的市场不完美及其相应的经济成本。研究发现，CLO的股权层因杠杆贷款与CLO债务层之间的风险调整价差而获得正异常收益。债务层提供的收益高于同等评级的公司债券，因此对面临基于风险的资本要求的银行和保险公司具有吸引力。股权表现的时间变化凸显了CLO因封闭式结构、长期融资以及将本金收益再投资的内嵌期权而对市场波动具有韧性。
ai_comment: 该研究系统揭示了CLO各层级收益来源及其对市场波动的韧性，为理解结构化产品在金融中介中的作用提供了新证据。

title: The Pollution Premium
abstract: This paper studies the asset pricing implications of industrial pollution. A long‐short portfolio constructed from firms with high versus low toxic emission intensity within an industry generates an average annual return of 4.42%, which remains significant after controlling for risk factors. This pollution premium cannot be explained by existing systematic risks, investor preferences, market sentiment, political connections, or corporate governance. We propose and model a new systematic risk related to environmental policy uncertainty. We use the growth in environmental litigation penalties to measure regime change risk and find that it helps price the cross section of emission portfolios' returns.
summary: 本文研究工业污染的资产定价含义。通过构建行业内高与低有毒排放强度公司的多空投资组合，产生年均4.42%的回报，该回报在控制风险因子后仍然显著。这种污染溢价无法用现有系统性风险、投资者偏好、市场情绪、政治联系或公司治理来解释。作者提出并建模了一个与环境政策不确定性相关的新系统性风险，使用环境诉讼罚金的增长来衡量制度变迁风险，并发现它有助于定价排放组合横截面回报。
ai_comment: 论文创新地提出了环境政策不确定性这一新的系统性风险因素，并实证发现了显著的污染溢价，对ESG投资与资产定价领域具有重要启示。

title: Naïve Buying Diversification and Narrow Framing by Individual Investors
abstract: We provide the first tests to distinguish whether individual investors equally balance their overall portfolios (naïve portfolio diversification, NPD) or, in contrast, equally balance the values of same‐day purchases of multiple assets (naïve buying diversification, NBD). We find NBD in purchases of multiple stocks, and in mixed purchases of individual stocks and funds. In contrast, there is little evidence of NPD. Evidence suggests that NBD arises due to stock picking behavior and neglect of diversification. These findings suggest that behavioral finance theory should incorporate transaction, as well as portfolio, framing.
summary: 本文首次通过实证测试区分个人投资者是采取幼稚投资组合分散化（NPD，即整体投资组合均衡）还是幼稚购买分散化（NBD，即同一天购买多种资产时均衡购买金额）。研究发现，投资者在购买多只股票以及混合购买个股和基金时表现出NBD行为，而几乎没有NPD的证据。证据表明NBD源于选股行为和对分散化的忽视。这些结果建议行为金融理论应同时纳入交易框架和投资组合框架。
ai_comment: 论文通过区分购买层面和组合层面的分散化行为，揭示了投资者在交易时而非整体组合层面的狭隘框架，对行为金融理论有细化贡献。

title: Options Trading and Stock Price Informativeness
abstract: We document the causal effects of single-name options trading on the absolute level of information content of prices (stock price informativeness) by exploiting the Penny Pilot Program as an exogenous shock to options trading volume. We find that options trading increases underlying stock price informativeness and information acquisition by both option and stock investors, consistent with the framework of Goldstein and Yang (2015). The findings are driven by firms for which options are more important sources of information and firms with more efficiently priced options. Options market introduction in a sample of 25 other economies also leads to higher price informativeness.
summary: 本文利用Penny Pilot Program作为外生冲击，研究个股期权交易对股价信息含量的因果效应。发现期权交易显著提高了标的股票的价格信息含量，并促进了期权和股票投资者的信息获取，这一结果与Goldstein and Yang (2015)的理论框架一致。该效应在期权作为重要信息渠道以及期权定价更有效的公司中更为显著。此外，在25个其他经济体的期权市场引入案例中，也观察到类似的价格信息含量提升。
ai_comment: 通过准自然实验方法识别因果效应，并结合跨国证据增强了结论的外部有效性，为衍生品市场对信息效率的影响提供了有力证据。

title: Integrating Factor Models
abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive framework to address uncertainty about the correct factor model. Asset pricing inferences draw on a composite model that integrates over competing factor models weighted by posterior probabilities. Evidence shows that unconditional models record near‐zero probabilities, while postearnings announcement drift, quality‐minus‐junk, and intermediary capital are potent factors in conditional asset pricing. Out‐of‐sample, the integrated model performs well, tilting away from subsequently underperforming factors. Model uncertainty makes equities appear considerably riskier, while model disagreement about expected returns spikes during crash episodes. Disagreement spans all return components involving mispricing, factor loadings, and risk premia.
summary: 本文提出了一个综合框架来处理关于正确因子模型的不确定性。资产定价推断基于一个复合模型，该模型通过后验概率加权对多个竞争的因子模型进行集成。实证结果显示，无条件模型的后验概率接近零，而盈余公告后漂移、质量减垃圾和中介资本是条件资产定价中的有效因子。在样本外，综合模型表现良好，倾向于避开随后表现不佳的因子。模型不确定性使得股票看起来风险更高，而关于预期收益的模型分歧在崩盘期间急剧上升，这种分歧涵盖了错误定价、因子载荷和风险溢价等所有回报组成部分。
ai_comment: 该框架通过贝叶斯模型平均整合因子模型，系统性地处理了模型不确定性，并揭示了因子选择对风险感知和预期收益分歧的影响，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: Visibility Bias in the Transmission of Consumption Beliefs and Undersaving
abstract: We model visibility bias in the social transmission of consumption behavior. When consumption is more salient than nonconsumption, people perceive that others are consuming heavily, and infer that future prospects are favorable. This increases aggregate consumption in a positive feedback loop. A distinctive implication is that disclosure policy interventions can ameliorate undersaving. In contrast with wealth‐signaling models, information asymmetry about wealth reduces overconsumption.
