VS can occur under simple no-arbitrage conditions for American options when volatility is time-varying, suggesting that the VS-return predictability could be an artifact of firms’ sensitivities to aggregate volatility. Examining this empirically, we find that the predictability changes systematically with aggregate volatility and is positively related to the firms’ sensitivities to volatility risk. The alpha generated by VS hedge portfolios can be explained by aggregate volatility risk factors. Our results cannot be explained by firm-specific informed trading, transaction costs, or liquidity.
summary: 本文研究使用个股（非指数）期权的隐含波动率价差（VS）来预测股票收益。在波动率时变的条件下，美式期权的简单无套利条件可能导致VS，这表明VS与收益之间的可预测性可能是公司对总体波动敏感性的伪像。通过实证检验，我们发现这种可预测性会随总体波动系统性变化，并且与公司对波动风险的敏感度正相关。VS对冲组合产生的alpha可以用总体波动风险因子来解释。结果无法被公司特定知情交易、交易成本或流动性所解释。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了隐含波动率价差与收益预测之间的关系实际上源于总体波动风险，而非知情交易，为解释期权市场信息含量提供了新视角。

title: Did FinTech Lenders Facilitate PPP Fraud?
abstract: In the $793 billion Paycheck Protection Program, we examine metrics related to potential misreporting including nonregistered businesses, multiple businesses at residential addresses, abnormally high implied compensation per employee, and large inconsistencies with jobs reported in another government program. These measures consistently concentrate in certain FinTech lenders and are cross‐verified by seven additional measures. FinTech market share increased significantly over time, and suspicious lending by FinTechs in 2021 is four times the level at the start of the program. Suspicious loans are being overwhelmingly forgiven at rates similar to other loans.
summary: 该论文研究了在7930亿美元的薪资保护计划中，金融科技（FinTech）贷款人是否助长了潜在的错误报告行为。作者通过多个指标衡量可疑贷款，包括未注册企业、住宅地址的多个企业、每名员工异常高的薪酬，以及与其他政府计划中报告的工作岗位存在重大不一致。这些指标一致地集中在某些FinTech贷款人，并通过七个额外指标交叉验证。FinTech的市场份额随时间显著增加，2021年FinTech的可疑贷款水平是项目开始时的四倍。然而，可疑贷款与其他贷款一样，绝大多数被豁免。
ai_comment: 该研究通过多维度指标系统性地揭示了FinTech贷款中潜在的欺诈行为，并指出其快速增长与豁免的普遍性，为监管提供了重要证据。

title: Option Return Predictability with Machine Learning and Big Data
abstract: Drawing upon more than 12 million observations over the period from 1996 to 2020, we find that allowing for nonlinearities significantly increases the out-of-sample performance of option and stock characteristics in predicting future option returns. The nonlinear machine learning models generate statistically and economically sizable profits in the long-short portfolios of equity options even after accounting for transaction costs. Although option-based characteristics are the most important standalone predictors, stock-based measures offer substantial incremental predictive power when considered alongside option-based characteristics. Finally, we provide compelling evidence that option return predictability is driven by informational frictions and option mispricing. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 基于1996年至2020年间超过1200万条观测数据，研究发现允许非线性关系显著提高了期权和股票特征在预测未来期权回报时的样本外表现。非线性机器学习模型在考虑交易成本后，仍能通过股票期权的多空组合产生统计和经济上显著可观的利润。尽管基于期权的特征是最重要的独立预测因子，但与期权特征结合时，基于股票的度量提供了显著的增量预测能力。最后，有力证据表明期权回报的可预测性由信息摩擦和期权错误定价驱动。
ai_comment: 本文结合大规模数据和机器学习方法，特别是非线性模型，显著提升了期权回报预测能力，并考虑了交易成本的实际影响，为期权定价和套利策略提供了新见解。

title: Monetary Policy, Business Liquidity and Survival: Evidence from the Refinancing Channel
abstract: We study the impact of the refinancing channel of monetary policy on very small and medium-sized businesses. Using data covering the near universe of these businesses, we find that increased household refinancing reduces the probability that a business exits or exhausts its debt capacity in the calendar year, as well as 6 years after the first exposure. It also helps younger businesses maintain credit relationships. Financial factors, like business liquidity, as well as local demand dependence, amplify these effects, especially for very small businesses. These results suggest that the refinancing channel of monetary policy can have large long-run effects on local economies. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究货币政策再融资渠道对非常小型和中小型企业的影响。利用覆盖几乎所有这类企业的数据，发现家庭再融资增加会降低企业在当年以及首次暴露后6年内退出或耗尽债务能力的概率，同时帮助年轻企业维持信贷关系。企业流动性等财务因素和本地需求依赖性会放大这些效应，尤其是对非常小型企业。结果表明货币政策的再融资渠道对地方经济具有显著的长期影响。
ai_comment: 该论文利用全样本数据揭示了再融资渠道对小型企业的长期影响，强调了流动性和本地需求的作用，为货币政策的微观传导机制提供了新证据。

title: Joining Forces: The Spillover Effects of EPA Enforcement Actions and the Role of Socially Responsible Investors
abstract: We find that firms reduce toxic emissions at their local plants following EPA enforcement actions against nearby plants operated by peer firms that compete in the same product market. These reductions are more pronounced for plants located near socially responsible mutual funds (SRMFs) that hold these plants’ parent firms’ shares. Close proximity to SRMFs is associated with real investment in abatement measures to mitigate emissions. While plants increase emissions again in the long run, such reversals do not occur in plants located near SRMFs. Taken together, our results suggest that local SRMFs complement EPA enforcement in influencing plants’ emissions. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究发现，当美国环保署（EPA）对同一产品市场的竞争对手工厂采取执法行动后，企业会减少其本地工厂的有毒排放。这种减排效应在位于社会责任共同基金（SRMFs）附近的工厂更为显著，这些SRMFs持有这些工厂母公司股份。靠近SRMFs的工厂进行了实际减排投资，以降低排放。尽管长期来看，工厂的排放会再次增加，但靠近SRMFs的工厂没有出现这种反弹。综合结果表明，本地SRMFs在影响工厂排放方面对EPA执法起到了补充作用。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将地理位置邻近性纳入ESG研究，揭示了社会责任投资者对企业环境行为的实际影响，为理解非正式监管机制提供了新视角。

title: The Effect of Firms' Information Exposure on Safeguarding Employee Health: Evidence from COVID‐19
abstract: We show that information exposure through international business networks enables firms to take proactive measures that benefit employees and potentially the local community. Specifically, in the early days of COVID‐19, firms that have business networks with China and Italy are more likely to be aware of the severity of the disease, and proactively implement work‐from‐home (“WFH”) policies that can protect their employees. Using Safegraph foot traffic data, we find a higher stay‐at‐home ratio before local governments impose lockdowns in zip codes where firms have a larger information exposure. These areas are also associated with a lower spread of COVID‐19. Our main findings are more pronounced when local governments face constraints in quickly responding to COVID‐19 and when firms have a higher WFH capability or have more investors with socially responsible preferences. Collectively, we present evidence on the role of private corporations in mitigating the negative effects of a public health crisis before government intervention.
summary: 本文研究了企业通过国际商业网络的信息暴露如何影响其在新冠疫情早期采取保护员工健康的措施。研究发现，与中国和意大利有业务网络的企业更早意识到疫情的严重性，并主动实施居家办公政策。利用Safegraph的脚流数据，发现在地方政府实施封锁之前，企业信息暴露程度更高的邮政编码区域居民居家比例更高，且这些区域的COVID-19传播率较低。这一效应在地方政府应对疫情受限、企业居家办公能力更强或拥有更多社会责任导向投资者时更为显著。研究揭示了私营企业在政府干预前减轻公共卫生危机负面作用的角色。
ai_comment: 论文利用脚流数据创新性地展示了企业信息网络在公共卫生危机中的积极作用，强调了私营部门作为政府补充的重要性。

title: Local Experiences, Search, and Spillovers in the Housing Market
abstract: Recent local price growth explains differences in search behavior across prospective homebuyers. Those experiencing higher growth in their postcode of residence search more broadly across locations and house characteristics, without changing attention devoted to individual sales listings, and have shorter search duration. Effects are stronger for homeowners, in particular those living in less wealthy areas and looking for a new primary residence. We use reduced‐form analysis and a quantitative equilibrium model to show that the expansion of search breadth translates into widespread spillovers onto house sales prices and inventories of listings across postcodes within a metropolitan area.
summary: 本文研究近期地方房价增长如何影响潜在购房者的搜索行为。发现经历过较高居住地邮政编码区域房价增长的购房者会进行更广泛的搜索（包括不同地点和房屋特征），但不会改变对单个交易列表的关注度，且搜索持续时间更短。这种效应在房主中更为显著，尤其是居住在较不富裕地区且寻求新主要住所的人。通过简化形式分析和定量均衡模型，证明搜索广度的扩展会在都市区内不同邮政编码之间对房屋销售价格和上市库存产生广泛溢出效应。
ai_comment: 本文通过微观行为分析揭示房价增长对搜索决策的影响，并结合均衡模型量化溢出效应，为理解房地产市场动态提供了新视角。

title: How ETFs Amplify the Global Financial Cycle in Emerging Markets
abstract: We study how the growth of exchange-traded funds (ETFs) affects the sensitivity of international capital flows to the global financial cycle. Using comprehensive fund-level data on investor flows, we show that their sensitivity to global financial conditions for equity (bond) ETFs is 2.5 (2.25) times higher than for equity (bond) mutual funds. This higher sensitivity can be directly linked to ETFs underlying shorter-trading-horizon clientele that trades more often in response to shocks. Using country-level data, we find that where ETFs hold a larger share of financial assets, equity inflows and prices become more sensitive to global risk. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究交易所交易基金（ETF）的增长如何影响国际资本流动对全球金融周期的敏感性。利用全面的基金层面投资者流动数据，发现股票（债券）ETF对其敏感性是股票（债券）共同基金的2.5（2.25）倍。这种更高的敏感性可直接归因于ETF的短线交易客户群体，他们对冲击做出更频繁的交易反应。利用国家层面数据，发现ETF在金融资产中占比较大时，权益流入和价格对全球风险的敏感性更高。
ai_comment: 论文通过微观基金数据与宏观国家数据的结合，揭示了ETF作为新兴市场资本流动放大器的新机制，对理解全球金融周期传导具有重要政策含义。

title: Corporate Patenting, Customer Capital, and Financial Market Outcomes
abstract: We study how patenting enhances customer capital and creates financial value in a product market characterized by information asymmetry between firm insiders and customers. We find that firms with more and higher quality patents develop greater customer capital, as measured by more positive customer perceptions of product novelty and quality. To establish causality, we exploit the exogenous variation in the random assignment of patent examiners to review applications and use the average examiner leniency as an instrument for patent grants. Our mediation analysis documents a positive impact of patenting on firm performance and financial market valuation through enhanced customer capital.
summary: 本文研究在信息不对称的产品市场中，专利如何增强客户资本并创造财务价值。研究发现，拥有更多高质量专利的企业能够积累更多的客户资本，具体表现为客户对产品新颖性和质量的正面感知提升。为建立因果关系，研究利用专利审查员随机分配申请的外生差异，以平均审查员宽松度作为专利授权的工具变量。中介分析表明，专利通过增强客户资本对企业绩效和金融市场估值产生积极影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过巧妙的工具变量设计（专利审查员宽松度）识别了专利对客户资本的因果效应，并揭示了客户资本在专利创造价值中的中介作用，为无形资产的金融价值研究提供了新视角。

title: The Impact of Uncertainty on Investment: Empirical Challenges and a New Estimator
abstract: This article proposes a new method for examining the impact on a firm’s investment of uncertainty reflected in its stock-return volatility. We simultaneously address the endogeneity of uncertainty and mismeasurement in Tobin’s Q , but earlier empirical work often neglects one of the two issues. Our nonparametric estimates further suggest that the relation between investment and uncertainty is significantly decreasing and strongly concave. This result contrasts with the existing literature that widely adopts linear regressions. Ignoring nonlinearity or measurement error in Q can lead to a substantial estimation bias. However, the bias due to the endogeneity of uncertainty is small.
summary: 本文提出一种新方法，同时处理不确定性的内生性和托宾Q的测量误差，以研究股票收益波动反映的不确定性对企业投资的影响。非参数估计表明，投资与不确定性之间存在显著递减且强凹的非线性关系，这与现有文献广泛采用的线性回归结果相反。忽略非线性或托宾Q的测量误差会导致较大的估计偏差，但不确定性内生性导致的偏差较小。
ai_comment: 该方法同时解决两个关键实证问题（内生性和测量误差），并揭示出非线性的投资-不确定性关系，对传统线性模型进行了重要修正。

title: What Can Volatility Smiles Tell Us About the Too Big to Fail Problem?
abstract: We exploit the information content of option prices to construct a novel measure of bank tail risk. We document a persistent increase in tail risk for the U.S. banking industry following the global financial crisis, except for banks designated as systemically important by the Dodd–Frank Act. We show that this post-crisis difference in tail risk for large and small banks is consistent with the too-big-to-fail (TBTF) status of large banks being reinforced by the Dodd–Frank designation: Naming the banks whose failure could threaten the financial stability of the U.S. gave investors a list of banks the government deemed as TBTF.
summary: 本文利用期权价格信息构建了一个新的银行尾部风险度量指标。研究发现，在全球金融危机之后，美国银行业的尾部风险持续上升，但根据多德-弗兰克法案被指定为系统重要性银行（SIBs）的银行除外。这种危机后大型银行与小型银行尾部风险的差异表明，多德-弗兰克法案的指定强化了大型银行的“大而不倒”（TBTF）地位：向投资者明确列出了政府认为不能倒闭的银行名单。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用期权价格信息构建银行尾部风险度量，为评估'大而不倒'政策效果提供了新的实证证据。

title: Anomaly Discovery and Arbitrage Trading
abstract: We analyze a model in which an anomaly is unknown to arbitrageurs until its discovery, and test the model implications on both asset prices and arbitrageurs’ trading activities. Using data on 99 anomalies documented in the existing literature, we find that the discovery of an anomaly reduces the correlation between the returns of its decile-1 and decile-10 portfolios. This discovery effect is stronger if the aggregate wealth of hedge funds is more volatile. Finally, hedge funds increase (reverse) their positions in exploiting anomalies when their aggregate wealth increases (decreases), further suggesting that these discovery effects operate through arbitrage trading.
summary: 论文分析了一个模型，其中异常现象在未被发现之前对套利者而言是未知的，并检验了该模型对资产价格和套利者交易活动的含义。利用现有文献中记录的99个异常数据，研究发现一个异常的发现会降低其十分位1和十分位10投资组合收益率之间的相关性。这种发现效应在对冲基金总财富波动更大时更为显著。此外，对冲基金在其总财富增加时增加利用异常的头寸，在总财富减少时反向操作，这进一步表明这些发现效应是通过套利交易发挥作用的。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型与实证检验揭示了异常发现对套利者行为和市场相关性的影响，特别强调了对冲基金财富波动的作用，提供了关于套利限制的新视角。

title: Double Machine Learning: Explaining the Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
abstract: We demonstrate the benefits of merging traditional hypothesis-driven research with new methods from machine learning that enable high-dimensional inference. Because the literature on post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD) is characterized by a “zoo” of explanations, limited academic consensus on model design, and reliance on massive data, it will serve as a leading example to demonstrate the challenges of high-dimensional analysis. We identify a small set of variables associated with momentum, liquidity, and limited arbitrage that explain PEAD directly and consistently, and the framework can be applied broadly in finance.
summary: 本文展示了将传统假设驱动研究与利用机器学习实现高维推断的新方法相结合的优势。由于盈利公告后漂移（PEAD）文献中存在大量解释的“动物园”、缺乏模型设计的学术共识以及对大型数据的依赖，因此本文以PEAD作为典型例子来论证高维分析的挑战。通过使用Double Machine Learning方法，本文识别出一小部分与动量、流动性和有限套利相关的变量，这些变量直接且一致地解释了PEAD现象，并且该框架可广泛应用于金融领域。
ai_comment: 本文巧妙融合传统计量与机器学习，为处理金融中高维混淆变量提供了范式，且实证结论简洁有力地总结了PEAD的核心驱动因素。

title: Discount‐Rate Risk in Private Equity: Evidence from Secondary Market Transactions
abstract: Measures of private equity (PE) performance based on cash flows do not account for a discount‐rate risk premium that is a component of the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) alpha. We create secondary market PE indices and find that PE discount rates vary considerably. Net asset values are too smooth because they fail to reflect variation in discount rates. Although the CAPM alpha for our index is zero, the generalized public market equivalent based on cash flows is large and positive. We obtain similar results for a set of synthetic funds that invest in small cap stocks. Ignoring variation in PE discount rates can lead to a misallocation of capital.
summary: 本文研究了私募股权（PE）业绩度量中贴现率风险溢价的影响。基于现金流的标准指标（如CAPM alpha）未考虑这一风险溢价。作者通过构建二级市场PE指数，发现PE贴现率变化显著，而净资产价值（NAV）因未能反映贴现率变化而过于平滑。尽管PE指数的CAPM alpha为零，但基于现金流的广义公开市场等价物（GPME）却大且为正，且在投资小盘股票的综合基金中得到了类似结果。研究表明，忽略PE贴现率的变化可能导致资本错配。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地构建了二级市场PE指数，揭示了传统现金流业绩度量忽略贴现率风险的关键缺陷，对PE绩效评估和资本配置具有重要启示。

title: The Design of a Central Counterparty
abstract: This article analyzes the optimal allocation of losses via a Central Clearing Counterparty (CCP) in the presence of counterparty risk. A CCP can hedge this risk by mutualizing losses among its members. This protection, however, weakens members’ incentives to manage counterparty risk. Delegating members’ risk monitoring to the CCP alleviates this tension in large markets. To discipline the CCP at minimum cost, members offer the CCP a junior tranche and demand capital contribution. Our results endogenize key layers of the default waterfall and deliver novel predictions on its composition, collateral requirements, and CCP ownership structure.
summary: 本文分析了中央对手方（CCP）在存在对手方风险情况下损失的最优分配。CCP通过成员间风险共担来对冲对手方风险，但这种保护会削弱成员管理对手方风险的激励。将风险监控委托给CCP可以在大市场中缓解这一张力。为了以最小成本约束CCP，成员向CCP提供次级层并要求资本贡献。研究结果内生化了违约瀑布的关键层级，并对违约瀑布的构成、抵押要求以及CCP所有权结构提供了新的预测。
ai_comment: 本文通过内生违约瀑布层级，为CCP的风险管理机制提供了新视角，并对其抵押要求和所有权结构给出了可检验的预测。

title: Heterogeneity of Beliefs and Trading Behavior: A Reexamination
abstract: Combining experimental data sets from seven individual studies, including 255 asset markets with 2,031 participants, and 36,326 short-term price forecasts, we analyze the role of heterogeneity of beliefs in the organization of trading behavior by reproducing and reconsidering earlier experimental findings. Our results confirm prior evidence that price expectations affect trading behavior. However, heterogeneity in beliefs does not seem to drive overpricing and asset market bubbles, as suggested by earlier studies, and we find no indication of short-term beliefs being better determinants of trading behavior than longer-term beliefs.
summary: 本文通过整合七项实验研究的数据，涵盖255个资产市场、2031名参与者和36326个短期价格预测，重新审视了信念异质性在交易行为组织中的作用。研究确认了价格预期影响交易行为，但发现信念异质性并非如先前研究所表明的那样驱动过度定价和资产市场泡沫，同时并未发现短期信念比长期信念更能决定交易行为的证据。
ai_comment: 该研究通过大规模元分析修正了先前关于信念异质性与市场泡沫关系的结论，具有重要的实证贡献。

title: EPS Sensitivity and Mergers
abstract: Announcements of mergers very often discuss the immediate impact of the deal on the acquirer’s earnings per share (EPS). We argue that the focus on EPS reflects the difficulty of evaluating and communicating deal synergy in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) practice and provide supporting evidence. We show that the acquirer’s EPS focus affects how deals are structured, the premium that is paid, and the types of deals that are done. EPS-driven M&A decisions are also associated with costly distortions in the acquirer’s financial and investment policies.
summary: 该论文研究并购公告中收购方对每股收益（EPS）即时影响的关注。作者认为这种EPS关注反映了评估和沟通并购协同效应的困难，并提供了支持证据。研究发现，收购方的EPS关注会影响交易结构、支付的溢价以及交易类型。此外，EPS驱动的并购决策还与收购方财务和投资政策中的昂贵扭曲相关。
ai_comment: 该论文揭示了EPS关注在并购决策中的重要作用，并指出了其导致的扭曲成本，对于理解并购实践中的非理性因素有贡献。

title: The Information in Industry-Neutral Self-Financed Trades
abstract: We identify Industry-Neutral Self-Financed Informed Trading (INSFIT) as stock trades financed by offsetting, equivalent dollar-denominated stock trades in the same industry. Approximately 37% of short-term mutual fund trading profits can be attributed to these trade pairs. Consistent with informed trading, INSFIT precedes unusually high media coverage for the underlying stocks. The trades underlying INSFIT are also larger as the release of stock-level news becomes more imminent. Both relative valuation and the hedging of industry exposure motivate INSFIT’s industry neutrality. While INSFIT positively impacts fund performance, active fund managers who execute INSFIT more aggressively obtain smaller trading profits per execution.
summary: 本文识别了行业中性自我融资知情交易（INSFIT），即通过在同一行业中进行等额美元的对冲交易来融资的股票交易。研究发现，短期共同基金交易利润中约有37%可归因于这类交易对。与知情交易一致，INSFIT 在相关股票获得异常高媒体关注之前发生。随着股票层面新闻发布时间的临近，构成 INSFIT 的交易规模也更大。相对估值和对行业暴露的对冲动机促成了 INSFIT 的行业中性特征。虽然 INSFIT 对基金业绩有正向影响，但更激进执行 INSFIT 的主动基金经理每笔交易获得的交易利润反而更小。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙地将行业对冲与知情交易结合起来，揭示了共同基金利用行业内对冲交易获取信息优势的新机制，对理解机构交易策略有重要贡献。

title: Withholding Bad News in the Face of Credit Default Swap Trading: Evidence from Stock Price Crash Risk
abstract: Credit default swaps (CDSs) are a major financial innovation related to debt contracting. Because CDS markets facilitate bad news being incorporated into equity prices via cross-market information spillover, CDS availability may curb firms’ information hoarding. We find that CDS trading on a firm’s debt reduces the future stock price crash risk. This effect is stronger in active CDS markets, when the main lenders are CDS market dealers with securities trading subsidiaries, or when managers have more motivation to hoard information. Our findings suggest that debt market financial innovations curtail the negative equity market effects of firms withholding bad news.
summary: 本研究探讨信用违约互换（CDS）交易对股票价格崩盘风险的影响。利用CDS市场通过跨市场信息溢出促进坏消息纳入股价的特点，检验CDS是否抑制公司信息隐藏行为。研究发现，CDS交易显著降低了公司未来的股价崩盘风险，且该效应在CDS市场更活跃、主要贷款人为CDS市场交易商且拥有证券交易子公司、或管理者有更强信息隐藏动机时更为显著。结论表明，债务市场的金融创新能够遏制公司隐瞒坏消息对股权市场造成的负面影响。
ai_comment: 本文从跨市场信息溢出视角揭示了CDS对股权市场信息环境的积极影响，拓展了金融创新与公司信息透明度关系的边界。

title: Patent Trolls and the Market for Acquisitions
abstract: I study the effect of patent-infringement claims by patent trolls on acquisitions of small firms. Exploiting staggered adoption of state anti-patent troll laws, I find that the laws have two effects. First, the number of acquisitions of small firms declines after these laws are adopted. Second, the anti-troll laws increase the acquisition price for acquirers. The market reflects the increased cost of acquisition as measured by lower acquisition announcement returns. Large firms increase R&D after the adoption of state laws, replacing external innovation. Using a sample of acquisitions that are plausibly unaffected by the laws, I disentangle alternative explanations.
summary: 本文研究专利流氓（patent trolls）的专利侵权索赔对小型企业收购的影响。利用美国各州反专利流氓法律的分阶段采纳，发现这些法律产生了两个效果：首先，小型企业的收购数量下降；其次，收购价格上升。市场通过较低的收购公告回报反映了收购成本的增加。大公司在州法律通过后增加了研发支出，以替代外部创新。通过使用可能不受法律影响的收购样本，本文排除了替代性解释。
ai_comment: 利用法律变化的自然实验，揭示了专利流氓对并购市场的双重影响，并发现大公司通过增加研发来应对外部创新获取成本的上升，具有重要的政策启示。

title: Designing Securities for Scrutiny
abstract: We investigate the effect of scrutiny (e.g., credit ratings, analyst reports, or mandatory disclosures) on the security design problem of a privately informed issuer. We show that scrutiny has important implications for both the form of security designed and the amount of inefficient retention of cash flows. The model predicts that issuers will design informationally sensitive securities (i.e., levered equity) when scrutiny is sufficiently intense. Otherwise, issuers opt for a standard debt contract. Scrutiny increases efficiency by decreasing issuers’ reliance on retention to signal quality and, perhaps counterintuitively, decrease price informativeness.
summary: 本文研究审查（如信用评级、分析师报告或强制披露）对知情发行人的证券设计问题的影响。通过模型分析，发现审查对证券形式及低效现金保留程度具有重要影响。当审查强度足够时，发行人倾向于设计信息敏感型证券（即杠杆股权），否则选择标准债务合同。审查通过减少发行人以保留现金流来传递质量的依赖，从而提高效率，并且反直觉地降低了价格信息性。
ai_comment: 论文提出了审查强度与证券设计之间的新关联，并揭示了审查可能降低价格信息性的反直觉结论，丰富了信息不对称下的资本结构理论。

title: Equilibrium Bitcoin Pricing
abstract: We offer a general equilibrium analysis of cryptocurrency pricing. The fundamental value of the cryptocurrency is its stream of net transactional benefits, which depend on its future prices. This implies that, in addition to fundamentals, equilibrium prices reflect sunspots. This in turn implies multiple equilibria and extrinsic volatility, that is, cryptocurrency prices fluctuate even when fundamentals are constant. To match our model to the data, we construct indices measuring the net transactional benefits of Bitcoin. In our calibration, part of the variations in Bitcoin returns reflects changes in net transactional benefits, but a larger share reflects extrinsic volatility.
summary: 本文提出了加密货币定价的一般均衡分析。加密货币的基础价值是其净交易收益流，而净交易收益取决于未来价格，这意味着除基本面外，均衡价格还反映太阳黑子（sunspots）。这导致了多重均衡和外在波动（extrinsic volatility），即即使基本面不变，加密货币价格也会波动。为将模型与数据匹配，作者构建了衡量比特币净交易收益的指数。校准结果显示，比特币收益的部分变动反映了净交易收益的变化，但更大份额来自外在波动。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将太阳黑子理论引入加密货币定价，揭示了比特币价格波动中非基本面因素的主导作用，为理解加密货币市场的高波动性提供了新的理论视角。

title: What Drives Firms’ Hiring Decisions? An Asset Pricing Perspective
abstract: We document that the aggregate hiring rate of publicly traded firms in the U.S. economy negatively predicts stock market returns and long-term cash flows, and positively predicts short-term cash flows. In addition, through a variance decomposition, we show that the time-series variation in the aggregate hiring rate is mainly driven by changes in discount rates and short-term expected cash flows, with no contribution from variation in long-term expected cash flows. We estimate a neoclassical dynamic model with labor market frictions and show that labor adjustment costs and time-varying risk are essential for the model to replicate the empirical patterns. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文从资产定价视角研究企业招聘决策的驱动因素。实证发现，美国上市公司总招聘率负向预测股票市场回报和长期现金流，正向预测短期现金流。通过方差分解，招聘率的时间序列变化主要由贴现率和短期预期现金流变动驱动，长期预期现金流无贡献。作者进一步估计了一个包含劳动力摩擦的新古典动态模型，表明劳动力调整成本和时变风险是复制这些实证规律的关键。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将资产定价视角引入劳动力市场，通过实证与理论模型结合，揭示了贴现率和短期预期现金流在招聘决策中的核心作用，为理解企业雇佣行为提供了新机制。

title: Financial Reporting and Employee Job Search
abstract: We investigate the effects of financial reporting on current employee job search, that is, whether firms' public financial reports cause their employees to reevaluate their jobs and consider leaving. We develop theory for why current employees use earnings announcements (EAs) to inform job search decisions, and empirically investigate job search based on employees' activity on a popular job market website. We find that job search by current employees increases significantly during EA weeks, especially when employees are more mobile and when their information frictions are greater. We also find that employees use EAs to update their expectations about their employers' economic prospects, consistent with learning, and some evidence that positive announcements elicit less search. Our paper contributes to the burgeoning labor and accounting literature by providing among the first evidence closely linking financial reports to employee learning and job search.
summary: 我们研究了财务报告对当前员工求职行为的影响，即公司的公开财务报告是否会导致员工重新评估其工作并考虑离职。我们建立了理论来解释为什么当前员工会利用盈利公告来指导求职决策，并基于员工在一个热门求职网站上的活动进行实证研究。我们发现，在盈利公告周，当前员工的求职活动显著增加，尤其是当员工流动性更高、信息摩擦更大时。我们还发现，员工利用盈利公告更新对其雇主经济前景的预期，这符合学习行为，并且有证据表明，积极的公告会减少求职活动。本文通过提供将财务报告与员工学习和求职紧密关联的首批证据之一，为日益增长的劳动与会计文献做出了贡献。
ai_comment: 该研究首次直接实证了财务报告对在职员工求职行为的因果影响，将会计信息与劳动力市场动态连接起来，填补了相关文献空白。

title: Information Aggregation via Contracting
abstract: When a group of investors with dispersed private information jointly invest in a risky project, how should they divide the project's profit? We show that a simple contract dividing profits in proportion to investors' risk tolerances may facilitate information aggregation by altering investors' risk‐taking incentives when they decide on how investment strategies respond to private information. Our results provide a contracting‐based approach for information aggregation, which is an alternative to learning from endogenous market variables (e.g., prices) via contingent schedules as seen in well‐known rational expectations equilibrium models.
summary: 一群拥有分散私人信息的投资者共同投资于一个风险项目时，如何分配利润是一个关键问题。本文证明，一个简单的合同——按照投资者的风险容忍度比例分配利润——能够通过改变投资者在决定投资策略如何响应私人信息时的风险承担激励，从而促进信息聚合。该结果提供了一种基于合同的信息聚合方法，作为对理性预期均衡模型中通过条件计划从内生市场变量（如价格）学习的替代方案。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地提出通过合同设计而非市场价格机制实现信息聚合，为团队投资决策提供了新视角。

title: Biased Auctioneers
abstract: We construct a neural network algorithm that generates price predictions for art at auction, relying on both visual and nonvisual object characteristics. We find that higher automated valuations relative to auction house presale estimates are associated with substantially higher price‐to‐estimate ratios and lower buy‐in rates, pointing to estimates' informational inefficiency. The relative contribution of machine learning is higher for artists with less dispersed and lower average prices. Furthermore, we show that auctioneers' prediction errors are persistent both at the artist and at the auction house level, and hence directly predictable themselves using information on past errors.
summary: 本文构建了一个神经网络算法，利用艺术品拍卖的视觉和非视觉特征来生成价格预测。研究发现，与拍卖行的预售估价相比，模型生成的自动化估值越高，实际成交价格与估价的比率越高，流拍率越低，这表明拍卖行的估价存在信息效率不足。机器学习的相对贡献在价格分散度较低、平均价格较低的艺术家作品中更高。此外，拍卖行的预测误差在艺术家和拍卖行层面均具有持续性，因此这些误差可以直接通过历史误差信息进行预测。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地结合视觉特征与机器学习，揭示了拍卖行估价的信息效率问题，并指出预测误差的可预测性，为拍卖市场微观结构研究提供了新视角。

title: RIM-Based Value Premium and  Factor Pricing Using Value-Price Divergence
Optimal Monetary Policy with Heterogeneous Agents: Discretion, Commitment, and Timeless Policy
abstract: This paper characterizes optimal monetary policy in a canonical heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with wage rigidity. Under discretion, a utilitarian planner faces the incentive to redistribute towards indebted, high marginal utility households, which is a new source of inflationary bias. With commitment, i) zero inflation is the optimal long-run policy, ii) time-consistent policy requires both inflation and distributional penalties, and iii) the planner trades off aggregate stabilization against distributional considerations, so Divine Coincidence fails. We compute optimal stabilization policy in response to productivity, demand, and cost-push shocks using sequence-space methods, which we extend to Ramsey problems and welfare analysis.
summary: 本文在一个具有工资刚性的标准异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）模型中刻画最优货币政策。在相机抉择下，功利主义计划者面临向负债高边际效用家庭再分配的激励，这成为通胀偏差的新来源。在承诺下，零通胀是最优长期政策，时间一致政策需要同时引入通胀惩罚和分配惩罚，且计划者需要在总稳定与分配考量之间权衡，导致神圣巧合失效。本文利用序列空间方法计算了生产率、需求和成本推动冲击下的最优稳定政策，并将该方法扩展到拉姆齐问题和福利分析。
ai_comment: 本文将异质性主体引入传统货币政策分析，揭示了新通胀偏差和分配权衡，丰富了新凯恩斯框架；序列空间方法的应用为求解大型模型中的最优政策提供了有效工具。

title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
Language Models and Cognitive Automation for Economic Research
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have the potential to revolutionize research in economics and other disciplines. I describe 25 use cases along six domains in which LLMs are starting to become useful as both research assistants and tutors: ideation, writing, background research, data analysis, coding, and mathematical derivations. I provide general instructions and demonstrate specific examples for how to take advantage of each of these, classifying the LLM capabilities from experimental to highly useful. I hypothesize that ongoing advances will improve the performance of LLMs across all of these domains, and that economic researchers who take advantage of LLMs to automate micro tasks will become significantly more productive. Finally, I speculate on the longer-term implications of cognitive automation via LLMs for economic research.
summary: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）如ChatGPT在经济研究中的潜在革命性影响。作者描述了LLMs在研究助手和导师角色中开始变得有用的25个用例，涵盖六个领域：构思、写作、背景研究、数据分析、编程和数学推导。提供了通用指令和具体示例，说明如何利用这些能力，并将LLM能力从实验性到高度有用进行分类。作者假设持续进展将提升LLMs在所有领域的性能，利用LLMs自动化微任务的经济研究者将显著提高生产力。最后，推测了通过LLMs实现认知自动化对经济研究的长期影响。
ai_comment: 本文系统性地分类了LLMs在经济研究中的具体应用场景，为研究者提供了实用指南，并对未来生产力提升和认知自动化趋势进行了前瞻性分析。

title: Unsupervised Machine Learning for Explainable Health Care Fraud Detection
abstract: The US federal government spends more than a trillion dollars per year on health care, largely provided by private third parties and reimbursed by the government. A major concern in this system is overbilling, waste and fraud by providers, who face incentives to misreport on their claims in order to receive higher payments. In this paper, we develop novel machine learning tools to identify providers that overbill Medicare, the US federal health insurance program for elderly adults and the disabled. Using large-scale Medicare claims data, we identify patterns consistent with fraud or overbilling among inpatient hospitalizations. Our proposed approach for Medicare fraud detection is fully unsupervised, not relying on any labeled training data, and is explainable to end users, providing reasoning and interpretable insights into the potentially suspicious behavior of the flagged providers. Data from the Department of Justice on providers facing anti-fraud lawsuits and several case studies validate our approach and findings both quantitatively and qualitatively.
summary: 该论文针对美国联邦医疗保险（Medicare）中医疗服务提供者的过度收费、浪费和欺诈问题，提出了完全无监督的机器学习检测方法。利用大规模Medicare住院索赔数据，该方法无需任何标记训练数据，能够识别与欺诈或过度收费一致的异常模式，并且具备可解释性，向终端用户提供可疑行为的推理和可理解洞见。通过司法部反欺诈诉讼数据及多个案例研究，论文从定量和定性两个层面验证了该方法的有效性。
ai_comment: 创新性地将无监督机器学习与可解释性相结合，解决了医疗欺诈检测中标记数据稀缺和模型透明度不足的实际问题，具有重要的政策应用价值。

title: On the Effectiveness of Foreign Exchange Reserves During the 2021-22 U.S. Monetary Tightening Cycle
abstract: This paper examines whether the size of foreign exchange (FX) reserves explains cross-country differences in foreign currency depreciation realized over the 2021-22 Federal Reserve monetary policy tightening that led to a sharp appreciation of the US dollar. Across a broad sample of countries, we document that an additional 10 percentage points of FX reserves/GDP held ex-ante were associated with 1.5 to 2 percent less exchange rate depreciation against the US dollar and this buffer effect was larger among less financially developed economies. Effects were more pronounced for large-reserve countries that sold reserves to intervene than for large-reserve countries that did not intervene, supporting the presence of both balance sheet and intervention channels. Higher ex-ante policy rates were also associated with less depreciation especially among financially open economies. An analysis of daily currency movements following the June 2021 FOMC meeting corroborates the main results. These findings suggest that FX reserves may promote monetary policy independence in the presence of global spillovers.
summary: 本文研究2021-22年美联储货币政策紧缩导致美元大幅升值期间，外汇储备规模能否解释各国货币对美元贬值幅度的差异。基于跨国样本，发现事前外汇储备/GDP每增加10个百分点，汇率贬值幅度减少1.5-2%，这一缓冲效应在金融欠发达经济体更为显著。效应在储备大国且实际进行干预的国家中更明显，支持资产负债表渠道和干预渠道的同时存在。此外，事前政策利率较高也与贬值较小相关，尤其在金融开放经济体。对2021年6月FOMC会议后日度汇率波动的分析进一步证实了主要结论。这些结果表明，在全球溢出效应下，外汇储备可能促进货币政策独立性。
ai_comment: 利用美联储紧缩周期这一准自然实验，清晰区分了外汇储备的缓冲效应渠道，并揭示了金融发展水平的异质性影响，对新兴市场政策制定具有重要参考价值。

title: Financial Crisis in a Socialist Setting: Impact on Political Behavior, Social Trust, and Economic Values
abstract: Research on the political and social impacts of financial crises has focused chiefly on free market economies, hindering our understanding of their effects in other settings. We exploit an episode of a financial crisis that hit the Israeli kibbutzim to study its impact in a socialist context. Contrary to findings in capitalistic economies, the crisis led to increased support of liberalized labor markets and reduced support for leftist political parties. These effects persisted in the long run, especially among the young. The crisis also reduced trust in leadership, but trust was restored shortly after agreements to settle the debt were signed, relieving the severity of the crisis. Our findings suggest that economic shocks may have different effects in a free market and socialist systems, in both cases leading individuals to question their current system.
summary: 该论文研究社会主义背景下金融危机的政治与社会影响。以往研究主要关注自由市场经济，而本文利用以色列基布兹（kibbutzim）金融危机作为自然实验，发现在社会主义环境中，危机反而导致个体更支持劳动市场自由化，减少对左翼政党的支持，且这些长期影响在年轻人中尤为显著。此外，危机短期内降低了社会信任，但在债务协议签署后迅速恢复。结论表明，经济冲击在自由市场和社会主义体制下可能产生截然不同的效应，均促使个体质疑现有体系。
ai_comment: 论文通过对比不同经济体制下的危机效应，填补了社会主义情境下的研究空白；利用基布兹的独特制度设计，提供了因果推断的清晰证据。

title: A Practical End-to-End Inventory Management Model with Deep Learning
abstract: We investigate a data-driven multiperiod inventory replenishment problem with uncertain demand and vendor lead time (VLT) with accessibility to a large quantity of historical data. Different from the traditional two-step predict-then-optimize (PTO) solution framework, we propose a one-step end-to-end (E2E) framework that uses deep learning models to output the suggested replenishment amount directly from input features without any intermediate step. The E2E model is trained to capture the behavior of the optimal dynamic programming solution under historical observations without any prior assumptions on the distributions of the demand and the VLT. By conducting a series of thorough numerical experiments using real data from one of the leading e-commerce companies, we demonstrate the advantages of the proposed E2E model over conventional PTO frameworks. We also conduct a field experiment with JD.com, and the results show that our new algorithm reduces holding cost, stockout cost, total inventory cost, and turnover rate substantially compared with JD’s current practice. For the supply chain management industry, our E2E model shortens the decision process and provides an automatic inventory management solution with the possibility to generalize and scale. The concept of E2E, which uses the input information directly for the ultimate goal, can also be useful in practice for other supply chain management circumstances. This paper was accepted by Hamid Nazerzadeh, big data analytics. Funding: This research was supported by the National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2018YFB1700600] and National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 71991462 and 91746210]. Supplemental Material: The online data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4564 .
summary: 本文研究数据驱动的多周期库存补货问题，考虑不确定需求和供应商交货时间，并利用大量历史数据。不同于传统的两步预测-优化框架，作者提出一种端到端框架，使用深度学习模型直接从输入特征输出建议补货量，无需中间步骤。该端到端模型通过历史观测数据学习最优动态规划解的行为，无需对需求和供应商交货时间的分布做先验假设。基于一家领先电商公司的真实数据进行的数值实验表明，该端到端模型优于传统框架。此外，在京东进行的现场实验结果显示，与京东当前实践相比，新算法大幅降低了持有成本、缺货成本、总库存成本和周转率。该端到端模型缩短了决策流程，提供了可推广和扩展的自动库存管理解决方案，其概念也可应用于其他供应链管理场景。
ai_comment: 本文提出实用的端到端库存管理模型，通过深度学习直接优化补货决策，并在实际电商平台中验证了显著的成本降低效果，具有较好的工业应用价值。

title: Monetary Stimulus amidst the Infrastructure Investment Spree: Evidence from China's Loan‐Level Data
abstract: We study how a fiscal expansion via infrastructure investment influences the dynamic impacts of monetary stimulus on credit allocation. We develop a two‐stage approach and apply it to the Chinese economy with a confidential loan‐level data set that covers all sectors. We find that infrastructure investment significantly weakened monetary policy's transmission to credit allocated to private firms, while reinforcing the monetary effects on loans to state‐owned firms. This fiscal‐monetary interaction channel is key to understanding the preferential credit access enjoyed by state‐owned firms during the stimulus period. Consequently, monetary stimulus crowded out private investment and decreased capital allocation efficiency.
summary: 该论文研究基础设施投资驱动的财政扩张如何影响货币刺激对信贷分配的动态效应。作者采用两阶段方法，利用涵盖所有部门的中国机密贷款级数据进行分析。主要发现包括：基础设施投资显著削弱了货币政策向私营企业信贷的传导，同时强化了对国有企业贷款的货币效应。这一财政-货币政策互动渠道是理解刺激期间国有企业享有优惠信贷的关键。最终，货币刺激挤出私人投资，降低了资本配置效率。
ai_comment: 利用独特的贷款级数据揭示了财政与货币政策互动的微观机制，为理解中国刺激政策中的信贷歧视提供了新视角。

title: Open banking: Credit market competition when borrowers own the data
abstract: Open banking facilitates data sharing consented to by customers who generate the data, with the regulatory goal of promoting competition between traditional banks and challenger fintech entrants. We study lending market competition when sharing banks’ customer transaction data enables better borrower screening for fintechs. Open banking promotes competition if it helps level the playing field for all lenders in screening borrowers; however, if it over-empowers fintechs, it can also hinder competition and leave all borrowers worse off. Due to the credit quality inference from borrowers’ sign-up decisions, this remains true even if borrowers have the control of whether to share their banking data. We also study extensions with fintech affinities and data sharing on borrower preferences.
summary: 研究开放银行制度下，银行客户交易数据共享对信贷市场竞争的影响。当金融科技公司能通过共享数据更好地筛选借款人时，开放银行既可能通过拉平所有贷款机构的筛选条件来促进竞争，也可能因过度赋能金融科技公司而阻碍竞争，损害所有借款人。这一结论在借款人有权决定是否共享数据时仍然成立，因为借款人的注册决策会透露其信用质量。文章还拓展考虑了金融科技偏好以及基于借款人偏好的数据共享机制。
ai_comment: 该文揭示了开放银行的双刃剑效应，即使借款人拥有数据控制权，竞争结果也可能恶化，对监管有重要启示。

title: Pirates without borders: The propagation of cyberattacks through firms’ supply chains
abstract: This paper examines the supply chain effects of the most damaging cyberattack in history so far. The attack propagated from the directly hit firms to their customers, causing a four-fold amplification of the initial drop in profits. These losses were larger for affected customers with fewer alternative suppliers. Internal liquidity buffers and increased borrowing, mainly through bank credit lines, helped firms navigate the shock. Nonetheless, the cyberattack led to persistent adjustments to the supply chain network, with affected customers terminating trading relations with directly hit firms and forming new ones with alternative suppliers with a stronger cybersecurity posture.
summary: 本文研究了史上破坏力最大的网络攻击通过供应链的传播效应。该攻击从直接受创企业向其客户扩散，导致初始利润损失放大四倍。替代供应商较少的受影响客户损失更大。内部流动性缓冲和增加借贷（主要通过银行信贷额度）帮助企业应对冲击。然而，网络攻击导致供应链网络发生持续调整：受影响客户终止与直接受创企业的交易关系，转而与网络安全更强的替代供应商建立新关系。
ai_comment: 论文首次量化了网络攻击通过供应链的放大效应，并揭示了企业利用流动性缓冲和信贷渠道缓解冲击的机制，对供应链风险管理具有重要启示。

title: Dynamic asset (mis)pricing: Build-up versus resolution anomalies
abstract: We classify asset pricing anomalies into those exacerbating mispricing (build-up anomalies) and those resolving it (resolution anomalies). We estimate the dynamics of price wedges for well-known anomaly portfolios and map them to firm-level mispricings. We find that several prominent anomalies like momentum and profitability further dislocate prices. Multi-factor models designed to eliminate one-month alphas still produce large price wedges. Our estimates yield a novel decomposition of Tobin’s q , revealing that q ’s mispricing component has substantial explanatory power for firm investment. Overall, our results suggest that financial intermediaries chasing build-up anomalies negatively affect price efficiency and associated real capital allocation.
summary: 本文将资产定价异常分为两类：加剧错误定价的建造异常（build-up anomalies）和解决错误定价的解决异常（resolution anomalies）。通过估计知名异常组合的价格楔子（price wedges）动态并将其映射到公司层面的错误定价，发现动量（momentum）和盈利能力（profitability）等若干显著异常会进一步扭曲价格。旨在消除一个月阿尔法的多因子模型仍会产生较大的价格楔子。估计结果给出了对托宾q（Tobin's q）的新分解，揭示出q的错误定价成分对公司投资具有显著的解释力。总体而言，追逐建造异常的金融中介会损害价格效率和相关的真实资本配置。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地提出了异常的双向分类框架，并深入分析了错误定价的动态及其对真实经济的影响，为理解资产定价异常的经济后果提供了新视角。

title: Institutional investors, heterogeneous benchmarks and the comovement of asset prices
abstract: We study the equilibrium implications of a multi-asset economy in which asset managers performance is tied to different benchmarks, reflecting heterogeneity in their investment mandates. Fluctuations in the capital asset managers invest for benchmarking purposes, scaled by the size of the economy, induce price pressure that results in negative spillovers across assets. We characterize a rich structure of asset price comovement within and across benchmarks by analyzing shock elasticities and cross-elasticities of price-dividend ratios. Evidence on the heterogeneity of mutual fund mandates and the benchmarking-induced return comovement across cap-style and industry-sector portfolios corroborates the model assumptions and predictions.
summary: 本文研究一个多资产经济中，资产经理的业绩与不同基准挂钩（反映其投资授权的异质性）的均衡含义。用于基准化投资的资本资产波动（按经济规模缩放）会引起价格压力，导致资产间的负溢出。通过分析股息-价格比的冲击弹性和交叉弹性，刻画了资产价格在基准内和跨基准之间的丰富联动结构。基于共同基金授权的异质性以及由基准引发的市值风格和行业板块组合收益联动的证据，验证了模型假设和预测。
ai_comment: 本文创新地将基准异质性纳入资产定价模型，从理论上揭示了基准驱动资产联动的微观机制，并提供了实证支持，对理解机构投资者行为与市场联动有重要贡献。

title: The fundamental-to-market ratio and the value premium decline
abstract: Recent evidence indicates the value premium declined over time. We argue this decline happened because book equity, B E , is no longer a good proxy for fundamental equity, F E , defined as the present value of cash flows under a common discount rate across firms. Specifically, we estimate F E for public US firms over time and find that the premium associated with the fundamental-to-market ratio, F E / M E , subsumes the B E / M E premium and has been relatively stable while the cross-sectional correlation between F E / M E and B E / M E decreased over time, inducing an apparent decline in the value premium. We also show that F E / M E captures the value premium better than several alternative value signals beyond B E / M E .
summary: 本文探讨了价值溢价随时间下降的现象，并指出其原因是账面权益（BE）已不再是基础权益（FE）的良好代理变量。其中，FE被定义为在共同折现率下各公司现金流现值的总和。通过对美国上市公司进行FE估算，研究发现基础权益与市值比（FE/ME）所对应的溢价完全吸收了BE/ME的溢价，且该溢价相对稳定。同时，随着时间的推移，FE/ME与BE/ME之间的横截面相关性减弱，导致价值溢价表面上呈现下降趋势。此外，FE/ME在捕捉价值溢价方面优于BE/ME以外的其他价值信号。
ai_comment: 该研究通过引入基础权益的新概念，有效解释了价值溢价衰减现象，并提供了更稳健的价值信号FE/ME，对于理解价值投资的演变具有重要意义。

title: Empirical evaluation of overspecified asset pricing models
abstract: Empirical asset pricing models with possibly unnecessary risk factors are increasingly common. Unfortunately, they can yield misleading statistical inferences. Unlike previous studies, we estimate the identified set of SDFs and risk prices compatible with a given model’s asset pricing restrictions. We also propose tests that detect problematic situations with economically meaningless SDFs unrelated to the test assets. Empirically, we estimate linear subspaces of SDFs compatible with popular extensions of the traditional and consumption versions of the CAPM, which are typically two-dimensional. Moreover, we often find that all the SDFs in those linear spaces are uncorrelated with the test assets’ returns.
summary: 本文实证评估了含有不必要风险因子的过度设定资产定价模型。作者提出了估计与给定模型资产定价约束兼容的随机贴现因子（SDF）和风险价格识别集的方法，并开发了检验程序以检测SDF与测试资产收益无经济关联的问题情况。实证分析中，作者估计了传统和消费CAPM流行扩展模型所兼容的SDF线性子空间，发现这些子空间通常是二维的，且所有SDF均与测试资产收益不相关。
ai_comment: 该论文从识别角度出发，对过度设定的资产定价模型进行了严格的实证评估，揭示了流行的CAPM扩展模型可能存在的根本性缺陷。

title: Do Corporate Disclosures Constrain Strategic Analyst Behavior?
abstract: We show that analyst behavior changes in response to a randomly assigned shock that exogenously varies the timeliness and cost of accessing mandatory disclosures in the cross-section of investors: analysts reduce coverage and issue less optimistic, more accurate, less bold, and less informative forecasts. Our evidence indicates that analysts reduce a strategic component of their behavior: the changes are stronger among analysts with more strategic incentives like affiliated or retail-focused analysts. We conclude that mandatory disclosure can substitute for analyst information production, which is constrained by investors’ ability to verify forecasts using corporate filings. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用一个随机分配的冲击（外生地改变投资者获取强制性披露的及时性和成本）来研究分析师行为的变化。结果显示，分析师减少了覆盖，并发布更不乐观、更准确、更不大胆、信息量更少的预测。这种变化在具有更强策略性激励的分析师（如关联分析师或零售导向分析师）中更为显著。研究表明，强制性披露可以替代分析师的信息生产，因为投资者利用公司文件验证预测的能力约束了分析师的策略性行为。
ai_comment: 本文通过巧妙的自然实验识别了强制性披露对分析师策略性行为的因果影响，并区分了不同激励类型的分析师，为披露与分析师信息生产之间的替代关系提供了有力证据。

title: Is There Smart Money? How Information in the Commodity Futures Market Is Priced into the Cross Section of Stock Returns with Delay
abstract: We document a new empirical phenomenon in which the aggregate positions of money managers, who are sophisticated speculators in the commodity futures market, as disclosed by the Disaggregated Commitments of Traders reports, can predict the cross section of commodity producers’ stock returns in the subsequent week. We employ a number of cross-sectional methods, including calendar-time regression analysis, single-sort, double-sort, and Fama–MacBeth regressions, to confirm the predictability results. The results are more pronounced in firms with higher information asymmetry. We thus add more empirical evidence to the literature on costly information processing, which leads to gradual information diffusion across asset markets.
summary: 该论文发现，商品期货市场中资金管理者（专业投机者）的总头寸（来自Disaggregated Commitments of Traders报告）能够预测商品生产商股票在随后一周的横截面收益。通过日历时间回归、单排序、双排序和Fama-MacBeth回归等多种横截面方法验证了这种可预测性，且该效应在信息不对称程度较高的公司中更为显著。研究为“信息处理成本导致资产市场间信息逐渐扩散”的文献提供了新的实证证据。
ai_comment: 论文巧妙利用商品期货市场的持仓数据，揭示了跨市场信息传导机制，为有限注意力和信息处理成本理论提供了新颖的实证支持。

title: Taking Over the Size Effect: Asset Pricing Implications of Merger Activity
abstract: We show that merger announcement returns account for virtually all of the measured size premium. An empirical proxy for ex ante takeover exposure positively and robustly relates to cross-sectional expected returns. The relation between size and expected returns becomes positive or insignificant, rather than negative, conditional on this takeover characteristic. Asset pricing models that include a factor based on the takeover characteristic outperform otherwise similar models that include the conventional size factor. We conclude that the takeover factor should replace the conventional size factor in benchmark asset pricing models.
summary: 本文发现并购公告回报几乎解释了所有已测量的规模溢价。作者构建了一个基于事前并购暴露的实证代理变量，该变量与横截面预期回报呈稳健的正相关关系。在控制该并购特征后，规模与预期回报之间的关系变为正相关或不显著，而非负相关。包含基于并购特征的因子的资产定价模型优于包含传统规模因子的类似模型。结论是，并购因子应取代传统规模因子作为基准资产定价模型中的因子。
ai_comment: 本文通过实证揭示并购活动是规模溢价的根本驱动因素，提出用并购因子替代传统规模因子，对资产定价模型有重要修正意义。

title: Trust, Transparency, and Complexity
abstract: This paper develops a theory that generates an equilibrium relationship between product complexity, transparency, and trust in firms. Complexity, transparency, and the evolution of trust are all endogenous, and equilibrium transparency is nonmonotonic. The least-trusted firms choose the lowest product complexity, remain opaque, and substitute ex ante third-party verification for information disclosure and trust. Firms with an intermediate level of trust choose an intermediate level of complexity and transparency through disclosure, with more trusted firms choosing greater complexity and lower transparency. The most-trusted firms choose maximum complexity while remaining opaque, eschewing both verification and disclosure.
summary: 本文构建了一个理论模型，研究企业产品复杂性、透明度与信任之间的均衡关系。模型中，复杂性、透明度以及信任的演化都是内生的，且均衡透明度呈非单调变化。最不受信任的企业选择最低的产品复杂性，保持不透明，并以事前的第三方验证替代信息披露和信任。信任度中等的企业通过信息披露选择中等程度的复杂性和透明度，其中更受信任的企业会选择更高的复杂性和更低的透明度。最受信任的企业选择最大复杂性并保持不透明，既不寻求验证也不进行信息披露。
ai_comment: 本文提出了一个内生化的信任-透明度-复杂性均衡框架，揭示了透明度与信任之间的非单调关系，对企业信息披露策略有重要理论启示。

title: Is There Investment Value in the Soft-Dollar Arrangement? Evidence from Mutual Funds
abstract: Combining novel data on analyst employment history and mutual fund commission payments, we show that client funds generate higher returns on stocks for which they have access to research by industry expert analysts. The outperformance is greater when funds are more important clients and cannot be attributed to tipping. Client funds place modestly higher weights on stocks covered by industry expert analysts and allocate more commissions to brokers providing such coverage. For identification, we exploit exogenous analyst coverage disruptions. Our findings contribute to the debate on whether mutual funds obtain any investment value from access to analysts through the soft-dollar arrangement. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文结合分析师就业历史和共同基金佣金支付的新数据，研究软美元安排是否为共同基金带来投资价值。研究发现，客户基金在可以获得行业专家分析师研究的股票上获得更高回报，且这种超额表现当基金是更重要的客户时更大，不能归因于信息泄漏。客户基金在行业专家分析师覆盖的股票上配置略高的权重，并向提供此类覆盖的经纪人分配更多佣金。为识别因果关系，利用外生分析师覆盖中断作为工具。结论表明，共同基金通过软美元安排从分析师获取研究服务具有投资价值。
ai_comment: 利用独特数据集和外生冲击识别因果关系，为软美元安排的价值提供了有力证据，弥补了相关文献的空白。

title: The Leading Premium
abstract: In this paper, we consider conditional measures of lead-lag relations between aggregate growth and industry-level cash flow growth in the United States. Our results show that firms in leading industries pay an average annualized return 3.6$\%$ higher than that of firms in lagging industries. Using both time-series and cross-sectional tests, we estimate an annual pure timing premium ranging from 1.2$\%$ to 1.7$\%$. This finding can be rationalized in a model in which (a) agents price growth news shocks, and (b) leading industries provide valuable resolution of uncertainty about the growth prospects of lagging industries. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究了美国总体经济增长与行业现金流增长之间的领先-滞后关系的条件度量。结果显示，领先行业的公司平均年化收益率比滞后行业的公司高出3.6%。通过时间序列和横截面检验，估计出年度纯时机溢价在1.2%到1.7%之间。该发现可以通过一个模型合理化：其中（a）代理人对增长新闻冲击进行定价，（b）领先行业为滞后行业的增长前景提供了有价值的不确定性消除。
ai_comment: 论文实证发现了领先行业相对于滞后行业的显著溢价，并精确定位了时机溢价的范围，为增长新闻冲击的资产定价效应提供了新证据。

title: Precautionary Saving in a Financially Constrained Firm
abstract: For a firm that cannot raise external funds, cash on hand serves as precautionary saving. We derive a closed-form expression for the target level of cash on hand in the presence of persistent cash flows. Contrary to conventional wisdom, a mean-preserving increase in the volatility of cash flow can decrease this target. Over the set of admissible parameter values, the average impact of volatility on the target is zero. Endogenous selection, reflecting termination of firms that run out of cash, leads to a positive average impact of volatility on the target level of cash, consistent with empirical findings.
summary: 本文研究了一家无法从外部融资的公司的预防性储蓄行为，即手头现金作为预防性储蓄。在考虑现金流具有持续性的情况下，推导出了公司目标现金持有水平的闭式解。研究发现，与传统观点不同，现金流的均值保持的波动性增加可能会降低目标现金持有水平。在参数值允许的范围内，波动性对目标现金水平的平均影响为零。然而，内生选择（即耗尽现金的公司被终止）导致波动性对目标现金持有水平的平均影响为正，这与实证发现一致。
ai_comment: 本文通过理论模型揭示了波动性与公司现金持有之间复杂的关系，特别是内生选择机制在解释实证结果中的关键作用，为理解财务受限公司的现金管理提供了新视角。

title: CEO Compensation Incentives and Playing It Safe: Evidence from FAS 123R
abstract: This article uses FAS 123R regulation to examine how reduction in CEO compensation incentives affects managerial “playing it safe” behavior. Using proxies reflecting deliberate managerial efforts to change firm risk, difference-in-difference tests show that affected firms drastically reduce both systematic and idiosyncratic risks, leading to an 8% decline in total firm risk. These reductions in risk are achieved by shifting to safer, but low-Q, segments while closing the riskier ones, without significant changes in investment levels. Our findings suggest that decrease in risk-taking incentives provided by option compensation, when not compensated for by alternative incentives or governance mechanisms, exacerbates risk-related agency problem.
summary: 利用FAS 123R法规作为外生冲击，本文研究CEO薪酬激励的削减如何影响管理层的“安全行事”行为。通过代表管理层主动改变企业风险的代理变量，进行双重差分检验，发现受监管影响的企业显著降低了系统风险和特质风险，导致总风险下降8%。这种风险降低是通过将业务转向更安全但低托宾Q的部门，同时关闭高风险部门实现的，而投资水平没有显著变化。结果表明，期权薪酬提供的风险激励减少，若未由其他激励或治理机制补偿，会加剧风险相关的代理问题。
ai_comment: 本文利用自然实验识别了薪酬激励与风险行为之间的因果关系，揭示了激励削减在缺乏替代机制时可能加剧代理问题，对薪酬设计具有重要启示。

title: Insurance Pricing, Distortions, and Moral Hazard: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Deposit Insurance
abstract: Pricing is integral to insurance design, directly influencing firm behavior and moral hazard, though its effects are insufficiently understood. I study a quasi-experiment in which deposit insurance premiums were changed for U.S. banks with unequal timing, generating differentials between banks in both levels and risk-based “steepness” of premiums. I find evidence that differentials in premiums resulted in distortions, including regulatory arbitrage, but also provided strong incentives to curb moral hazard. I find that firms that faced stronger pricing incentives to become (or remain) safer were more likely to subsequently do so than similar firms that faced weaker pricing incentives.
summary: 本文研究存款保险定价对银行行为和道德风险的影响。通过一个准实验，美国银行的存款保险费率在不同时间点发生变更，导致银行之间在保费水平和风险敏感度（‘陡峭度’）上产生差异。发现保费差异引发了扭曲，包括监管套利，但也提供了抑制道德风险的强烈激励。面临更强定价激励（以变得更安全或保持安全）的银行，比面临较弱激励的类似银行，更有可能后续确实变得更安全。
ai_comment: 利用准实验设计巧妙识别了存款保险定价的因果效应，揭示了定价既可能引发扭曲也能抑制道德风险的双刃剑特性。

title: Standard Error Biases When Using Generated Regressors in Accounting Research
abstract: We analyze the standard error bias associated with the use of generated regressors—independent variables generated from first‐step regressions—in accounting research settings. Under general conditions, generated regressors do not affect the consistency of coefficient estimates. However, commonly used generated regressors can cause standard errors to be understated. Problematic generated regressors include predicted values, coefficient estimates, and measures derived from these estimates. Widely used generated regressors in accounting include measures of earnings persistence, normal accruals, litigation risk, and conditional conservatism. Using simple regression models and simulation, we demonstrate how generated regressors can produce understated standard errors in accounting research settings. We also demonstrate how the magnitude of the standard error bias is inversely related to the precision of the generated regressor. Finally, we discuss bootstrapping as a correction for the bias and demonstrate the pairs cluster bootstrap as a tool to improve inferences in common accounting settings involving generated regressors.
summary: 本文分析了在会计研究中使用生成回归元（即从第一步回归中产生的自变量）时相关的标准误偏误。在一般条件下，生成回归元不影响系数估计的一致性，但常用的生成回归元（如预测值、系数估计值及其派生度量，包括盈余持续性、正常应计、诉讼风险和条件稳健性）会导致标准误被低估。通过简单回归模型和模拟，本文展示了生成回归元如何导致会计研究中的标准误低估，并说明标准误偏误的程度与生成回归元的精度成反比。最后，讨论了使用bootstrap方法（特别是配对聚类bootstrap）来纠正偏误，以改进常见会计情境中的推断。
ai_comment: 本文系统揭示了会计研究中广泛使用的生成回归元的标准误偏误问题，并提供了实用的修正方法，对提升实证研究的推断可靠性具有重要价值。

title: Boosting Foreign Investment: The Role of Certification of Corporate Governance
abstract: This paper studies the economic consequences of certification of corporate governance practices. For identification, we exploit a recent cross‐country initiative by a coalition of key institutions in Southeast Asia; the periodic publication of a “Top List” of companies in the region selected based on an independent assessment of corporate governance practices. Our results suggest that being included in the list induces an increase in foreign investment and changes in corporate governance practices. The announcement of the Top List elicits a positive stock market response among constituents and is followed by higher accounting performance. Overall, the evidence suggests that the certification of governance practices is a meaningful tool to boost foreign investment.
summary: 本文研究公司治理实践认证的经济后果，利用东南亚关键机构联盟的一项跨境倡议作为识别方法，该倡议定期发布基于独立公司治理评估的“Top List”。研究发现，入选该名单会促进外国投资增加、引发公司治理实践的改变、公告时股价正面反应以及后续更高的会计业绩。总体证据表明，治理认证是促进外国投资的有意义工具。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验设计有效识别了公司治理认证的因果效应，为新兴市场政策制定提供了坚实的实证依据。

title: Factor Momentum
abstract: Factors display strong cross-sectional momentum that subsumes momentum in industries and other portfolio characteristics. The profits of all these momentum strategies—based on factors, industries, and other characteristics—significantly correlate with each other and therefore likely emanate from the same source. If factors display momentum, so will any set of portfolios with cross-sectional variation in factor loadings. Consistent with factors being at the root of momentum, we find that momentum in industry-neutral factors explains industry momentum, but industry momentum explains none of the factor momentum. Cross-sectional factor momentum concentrates in the first few highest-eigenvalue factors and is distinct from time-series factor momentum. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究因子动量，发现因子在横截面上表现出强劲的动量，这种动量超越了行业和其他投资组合特征的动量。不同动量策略（基于因子、行业和其他特征）的利润显著相关，可能源自同一来源。研究进一步表明，如果因子表现出动量，那么任何在因子载荷上有横截面变化的投资组合集也会表现出动量。通过分析行业中性因子动量解释了行业动量，但行业动量不能解释因子动量，支持因子是动量根源的观点。横截面因子动量集中在几个最高特征值因子上，并且与时间序列因子动量存在区别。
ai_comment: 论文揭示了因子动量作为动量现象的根本来源，并区分了横截面与时间序列因子动量，对理解动量效应提供了新视角。

title: The Design and Welfare Implications of Mandatory Pension Plans
abstract: In a rich, calibrated life-cycle model, we show that well-designed mandatory pension plans significantly improve the welfare of individuals procrastinating on savings, and even improve most rational individuals’ welfare through a return tax advantage and fair annuitization. For a group of heterogeneous savers, in terms of preferences and sophistication, the best plan has contributions of 10% of income from age 30, a glidepath investment strategy, payouts following a variable lifelong annuity, and options to choose a different investment strategy and to modify the annuitization feature. This plan generates an average welfare gain of $175,000 per individual.
summary: 在一个丰富的、校准的生命周期模型中，论文研究了强制养老金计划的设计及其福利影响。结果显示，设计良好的强制养老金计划能显著提高储蓄拖延者的福利，并通过回报税收优势和公平的年金化改善大多数理性个体的福利。针对一组在偏好和成熟度上异质的储蓄者，最优计划要求从30岁开始缴纳收入的10%，采用滑翔路径投资策略，支付采用可变终身年金，并允许选择不同投资策略和修改年金化特征。该计划平均为每个个体带来175,000美元的福利收益。
ai_comment: 论文通过精细校准的生命周期模型，综合考虑了行为偏差（拖延）和异质性，为养老金计划设计提供了量化依据，具有重要政策参考价值。

title: Director Job Security and Corporate Innovation
abstract: In this article, we show that firms can become conservative in innovation when their directors face job insecurity. We find that after the staggered enactment of majority voting legislation that strengthens shareholders’ power in director elections, firms produce fewer patents, particularly exploratory patents, and fewer forward citations. This effect is stronger for directors facing higher dismissal costs or threats and for firms with greater needs for board expertise and is mitigated by institutional investors’ expertise in innovation. Overall, our results suggest that heightened job insecurity induces director myopia, which leads to a reduction in investment in risky, long-term innovation projects.
summary: 本文研究董事工作不安全感如何影响公司创新。通过利用各州交错实施的多数投票立法（该立法增强了股东在董事选举中的权力）作为外生冲击，发现法案通过后，企业专利数量减少，尤其是探索性专利（exploratory patents）减少，且专利的前向引用（forward citations）也下降。这种效应在面临更高解雇成本或威胁的董事以及更依赖董事会专业知识的企业中更为显著，并受到机构投资者创新专业知识的缓解。总之，结果说明增强的工作不安全感导致董事短视（director myopia），从而减少对高风险、长期创新项目的投资。
ai_comment: 本文利用外生立法冲击识别董事工作不安全感对创新的因果效应，为董事会治理与创新的关系提供了新证据，并揭示了董事短视这一机制。

title: Trader Competition in Fragmented Markets: Liquidity Supply Versus Picking-Off Risk
abstract: By employing a dynamic model with two limit order books, we show that fragmentation is associated with reduced competition among liquidity suppliers and lower picking-off risk of limit orders. Due to these countervailing channels, the impact of fragmentation on liquidity and welfare differs with asset volatility: When volatility is high (low), liquidity and aggregate welfare in a fragmented market are higher (lower) than in a single market. However, fragmentation always shifts welfare away from agents with exogenous trading motives and toward intermediaries. We empirically corroborate our model’s predictions about liquidity. Our model reconciles the mixed results in the empirical literature.
summary: 本文通过构建包含两个限价订单簿的动态模型，研究市场碎片化对流动性和交易者福利的影响。模型揭示了碎片化的双重效应：一方面降低了流动性供给者之间的竞争，另一方面减少了限价订单的被抢单风险。由于这两种相反渠道的作用，碎片化对流动性和福利的影响取决于资产波动率：当波动率高（低）时，碎片化市场中的流动性和总福利高于（低于）单一市场。然而，碎片化始终将福利从外生交易动机的代理转移到中介机构。作者利用数据实证验证了模型关于流动性的预测，并调和了实证文献中存在的混合结果。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地通过动态模型揭示了碎片化对流动性的双重影响渠道，解释了实证文献中的矛盾结论，并为市场监管提供了理论依据。

title: Dollar and Exports
abstract: The strength of the U.S. dollar has attributes of a barometer of dollar credit conditions, with a stronger dollar associated with tighter dollar credit conditions. We find that following dollar appreciation, exporters that are more reliant on dollar-funded bank credit suffer a greater decline in credit and slowdown in exports, including those exporting to the United States. Our findings shed light on the role of the U.S. dollar in the interaction between financial globalization and international trade and show a novel channel of exchange rate transmission that goes in the opposite direction to the competitiveness channel. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文研究美元强势与美元信贷条件的关系，发现美元升值意味着美元信贷条件收紧。美元升值后，更依赖美元融资银行信贷的出口商面临信贷减少和出口放缓，包括对美出口商。研究揭示了美元在金融全球化与国际贸易互动中的作用，并展示了与竞争力渠道相反的汇率传导新渠道。
ai_comment: 论文提出了一个新颖的汇率传导机制，与传统的竞争力渠道相反，强调了美元信贷条件的作用，对理解汇率与国际贸易关系有重要贡献。

title: Does Main Street Benefit from What Benefits Wall Street?
abstract: Yes. We show that aggregate stock returns predict aggregate U.S. employment, despite the industrial composition of publicly traded firms differing markedly from that of all firms, and the representativeness of public firms declining over time. We also show that appropriately reweighted stock returns predict industry and local labor market outcomes. We find the strongest evidence of an alignment of interests between shareholders and workers in the manufacturing sector, despite its declining labor share of output. Our findings suggest that at quarterly frequencies, product demand shocks are more important drivers of industry- and city-level stock returns than technology shocks.
summary: 本文研究股市回报是否能够预测实体经济中的就业情况。尽管公开交易公司的行业构成与所有公司存在显著差异，并且其代表性随时间下降，但研究发现总体股票回报仍能预测美国总体就业。进一步地，通过适当重新加权，股票回报能够预测行业和地方劳动力市场的结果。在制造业中，尽管其劳动份额下降，但股东与工人利益的一致性最强。结果表明，在季度频率上，产品需求冲击比技术冲击更能驱动行业和城市层面的股票回报。
ai_comment: 该论文创新地解决了公开公司代表性下降的问题，通过重新加权方法揭示了股市与实体经济的联系，尤其在制造业中提供了股东与工人利益一致的证据。

title: Neglected Peers in Merger Valuations
abstract: Using novel merger valuation data, we show that firms selected by investment banks as “comparable peers” are more than twice as likely to later become takeover targets themselves compared to matched control firms. Peer firms not subsequently acquired attract more institutional ownership and analyst coverage, deliver strong operating performance, reduce investments, and increase payouts. Investors are inattentive, though, to peer identification at the time of merger filings’ public disclosure. A portfolio that longs peers and shorts controls earns up to 15.6$\%$ alpha annually, which mainly comes from the long leg and is difficult to explain by short-sale constraints. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用新颖的并购估值数据，发现投资银行在并购中选定的“可比公司”比匹配的控制公司后来成为收购目标的概率高出两倍以上。那些未被收购的可比公司吸引了更多的机构持股和分析师覆盖，运营表现强劲，减少投资并增加派息。然而，投资者在并购文件公开披露时对可比公司的识别并不关注。一个做多可比公司、做空控制公司的投资组合每年可产生高达15.6%的alpha，该收益主要来自多头头寸，且难以用卖空约束解释。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地利用并购估值中的可比公司数据，揭示了市场对同行信息定价的偏差，为行为金融和公司金融交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: Small Business Equity Returns: Empirical Evidence from the Business Credit Card Securitization Market
abstract: We present a new approach for estimating small business equity returns. This approach applies the Merton (1974) credit model to the returns on entrepreneurial business credit card debt securitizations and solves for the implied equity returns for the small businesses owned by the cardholders. The estimated small business equity premium is 10.74%. The standard deviation of small business equity returns is 56.37%. We validate the methodology by applying it to investment‐grade corporate bonds and recovering a public equity premium of 6.17%.
summary: 本文提出了一种估计小企业股权回报的新方法，该方法应用Merton (1974)信用模型于企业家商业信用卡债务证券化的回报，从而推导出信用卡持有者所拥有小企业的隐含股权回报。估计的小企业股权溢价为10.74%，股权回报标准差为56.37%。通过将该方法应用于投资级公司债券并恢复出6.17%的公共股权溢价，验证了方法的有效性。
ai_comment: 利用信用卡证券化市场数据创新性地估计小企业股权回报，弥补了数据缺失的空白。

title: The (Un)Controllability Principle: The Benefits of Holding Employees Accountable for Uncontrollable Factors
abstract: The controllability principle suggests that employees should not be held accountable for factors outside their control. This study develops novel theory to challenge that thinking. According to the theory, holding employees accountable for uncontrollable factors like peer performance can lead to improved decision‐making by increasing how much employees learn from those uncontrollable factors. I expect this effect to occur because goal‐focused employees only consider information that seems goal‐relevant, and uncontrollable factors only seem goal relevant when employees are held accountable for them. Results from a decision‐making experiment support the theory. In particular, paying participants based on uncontrollable factors improves their decision‐making despite providing them with weaker economic incentives. This positive effect is more pronounced when the uncontrollable factors are more informative and when individuals are more goal‐focused. These findings reveal a previously unexplored benefit of disregarding the controllability principle that can help explain why broad, uncontrollable metrics are so prevalent and successful in practice.
summary: 本研究挑战了传统的可控性原则，即员工不应为超出其控制范围的因素负责。作者提出新理论，认为让员工对不可控因素（如同事绩效）负责，可以通过增加员工从这些因素中学习来改善决策。这一效应源于目标导向的员工只考虑与目标相关的信息，而当他们对不可控因素负责时，这些因素才显得与目标相关。决策实验的结果支持该理论：尽管基于不可控因素支付薪酬提供了更弱的经济激励，但能改善参与者的决策。当不可控因素信息量更大、个体更目标导向时，这种正向效应更显著。这些发现揭示了忽视可控性原则的一个此前未被探索的好处，有助于解释为何广泛、不可控的指标在实践中如此普遍且成功。
ai_comment: 该研究创新性地挑战了管理学中的传统可控性原则，揭示了让员工对不可控因素负责的潜在好处，为实践中广泛使用不可控指标提供了理论解释。

title: Climate Risk Disclosure and Institutional Investors
abstract: Through a survey and analyses of observational data, we provide systematic evidence that institutional investors value and demand climate risk disclosures. The survey reveals the investors have a strong demand for climate risk disclosures, and many actively engage their portfolio firms for improvements. Empirical analyses of holdings data corroborate this evidence by showing a significantly positive association between climate-conscious institutional ownership and better firm-level climate risk disclosure. We establish further evidence of institutional investors’ influence on firms’ climate risk disclosures by examining a shock to the climate risk disclosure demand of French institutional investors (French Article 173). Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文通过问卷调查和观测数据分析，系统性地证明了机构投资者重视并要求气候风险披露。调查显示投资者对气候风险披露需求强烈，许多投资者积极与投资组合公司互动以推动改进。对持仓数据的实证分析进一步证实了这一证据，显示气候意识机构持股与企业层面更好的气候风险披露之间存在显著正相关。通过考察法国机构投资者气候风险披露需求的冲击（法国第173条），我们建立了机构投资者对企业气候风险披露影响的进一步证据。作者提供了在线附录。
ai_comment: 本文结合调查和实证数据，从需求侧和供给侧揭示了机构投资者对气候风险披露的影响，独特的法国政策冲击为因果识别提供了有力支持。

title: Regulatory Intensity and Firm-Specific Exposure
abstract: Building on administrative data and machine-learning models, I develop a firm-specific measure of regulatory intensity: cost of compliance with all federal paperwork regulations. Regulatory intensity increases the cost of goods sold and overhead spending (SGA). It also incentivizes companies to reduce capital investment, hire fewer employees, and lobby more. The effects are particularly strong among financially constrained firms and those with irreversible investment opportunities, suggesting that regulation affects companies through budgetary pressures and heightened uncertainty. The findings highlight the real effects of regulation and the underlying mechanisms. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用行政数据和机器学习模型，开发了一个公司层面的监管强度度量指标，即遵守所有联邦文书工作法规的成本。研究发现，监管强度会提高公司的销售成本和间接费用，促使公司减少资本投资、减少雇佣员工并增加游说行为。这些影响在财务受限公司和投资具有不可逆性的公司中尤为显著，表明监管通过预算压力和不确定性渠道影响企业行为。研究结果揭示了监管的实际经济效应及其背后的机制。
ai_comment: 创新性地利用行政数据和机器学习构建精细的监管强度度量，为量化监管对企业行为的影响提供了新工具，并揭示了预算压力和不确定性这两个关键机制。

title: Human Capital Investment after the Storm
abstract: How does household exposure to a natural disaster affect higher education investments? Using variation in flooding from Hurricane Harvey (2017), we find that college-aged adults from flooded blocks in Houston are 7% less likely than counterparts to have student loans after Harvey, with larger effects in areas with more potential first-generation students. We find a similar relative decline in enrollment at more exposed Texas universities and colleges and a shift toward majors with higher expected earnings. Our results highlight a decrease in the quantity but an increase in the intensity of investments in human capital after the storm. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用2017年飓风哈维导致的洪水变化，研究家庭遭受自然灾害对高等教育投资的影响。研究发现，休斯顿受洪水影响的街区中，大学适龄成年人获得学生贷款的可能性比未受影响街区低7%，且在潜在第一代大学生比例较高的地区，该效应更为显著。同时，受洪水影响更严重的德克萨斯州高校入学率相对下降，学生倾向于选择预期收入更高的专业。结果表明，飓风后人力资本投资数量减少但强度增加。
ai_comment: 利用准自然实验揭示了自然灾害对高等教育投资的因果影响，并区分了投资数量与强度的替代效应，为理解家庭应对极端事件的决策提供了新视角。

title: Monetary Policy and Bond Prices with Drifting Equilibrium Rates
abstract: We study the drift and cyclical components in U.S. Treasury bonds. We find that bond yields are drifting because they reflect the drift in monetary policy rates. Empirically, modeling the monetary policy drift using demographics and productivity trends, plus long-term inflation expectations, leads to cyclical deviations of bond prices from their drift that predict bond returns in- and out-of-sample. These bond cycles can be interpreted as term premia or/and temporary deviations from rational expectations in a behavioral framework. Through the lens of our model, we detect a significant role of the latter in determining the cyclical properties of yields with short maturities.
summary: 本文研究了美国国债收益率的漂移和周期成分，发现债券收益率的漂移反映了货币政策利率的漂移。实证上，利用人口统计、生产率趋势以及长期通胀预期来建模货币政策漂移，导致债券价格相对于漂移的周期性偏离能够预测样本内和样本外的债券回报。这些债券周期可被解释为期限溢价或行为框架中理性预期的暂时偏离。通过模型，作者发现后者在决定短期收益率周期性中扮演重要角色。
ai_comment: 结合宏观变量与行为金融视角，为债券收益率周期性提供了新的解释框架，并强调了非理性预期的作用。

title: The Demise of the NYSE and Nasdaq: Market Quality in the Age of Market Fragmentation
abstract: U.S. equity exchanges have experienced a dramatic increase in competition from new entrants, resulting in the fragmentation of trading across venues. While market quality has generally improved over this period, we show most of the improvements have accrued to the largest stocks. We then show this bifurcation in market quality is related to the fragmentation of trading. Theoretically, more exchange competition should reduce trading costs, yet it may also increase adverse selection for liquidity providers, leading to higher spreads. We document evidence of both effects (fragmentation improves market quality for large stocks while small stocks experience relatively worse quality).
summary: 本文研究美国交易所（NYSE和Nasdaq）面临新进入者竞争导致的交易分散化对市场质量的影响。尽管总体市场质量有所改善，但改善主要集中在最大型的股票上，而小型股票的市场质量相对恶化。理论上，交易所竞争应降低交易成本，但可能增加流动性提供者的逆向选择，从而扩大价差。作者实证发现这两种效应并存：分散化改善了大股票的市场质量，但小股票的市场质量则有所下降。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了交易分散化对不同规模股票市场质量的不对称影响，为监管政策提供了重要参考。

title: Short Squeezes and Their Consequences
abstract: A short squeeze occurs if borrowed shares are recalled and the short seller is unable to find another source of shares. This forces the short seller to terminate a position early. For most stocks, the probability of a short squeeze is very low. Short squeezes, however, are not unusual for the hardest to borrow stocks. For these stocks, trading costs from squeezes are high and have a significant impact on the returns to short selling. For hard-to-borrow stocks, short sellers also miss out on significant abnormal returns because squeezes force them to close positions.
summary: 本文研究卖空挤压（short squeeze）现象及其后果。卖空挤压发生在借入的股票被召回且卖空者无法找到其他股票来源时，迫使卖空者提前平仓。对于大多数股票，卖空挤压的概率很低，但对于最难借入的股票（hard-to-borrow stocks），挤压并不罕见。这些股票因挤压产生的交易成本很高，对卖空收益有显著影响。此外，对于难借入的股票，卖空者还会因挤压被迫平仓而错失显著的超额回报。
ai_comment: 本文聚焦于卖空挤压对最难借入股票的影响，揭示了其高概率和高成本，并指出卖空者因此错失超额回报，丰富了卖空市场微观结构的研究。

title: How Risky Are U.S. Corporate Assets?
abstract: We use market data on corporate bonds and equities to measure the value of U.S. corporate assets and their payouts to investors. In contrast to equity dividends, total corporate payouts are highly volatile, turn negative when corporations raise capital, and are acyclical. At the same time, corporate asset returns are similar to returns on equity, and both are exposed to fluctuations in economic growth. To reconcile this evidence, we argue that acyclical but volatile net repurchases mask the exposure of total payouts' cash components to economic growth risks. We develop an asset pricing framework to quantitatively illustrate this economic channel.
summary: 本文利用公司债券和股票的市场数据，测度了美国公司资产的价值及其对投资者的支付。研究发现，与股息相比，公司总支付（包括股息和净回购）波动性更大，在融资时为负，且呈现非周期性特征。同时，公司资产回报与股票回报相似，两者均暴露于经济增长波动之中。为了解释这一现象，本文提出非周期性但高波动的净回购掩盖了总支付中现金部分对经济增长风险的暴露，并构建了一个资产定价框架来定量说明这一经济机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过区分总支付和股息，揭示了净回购行为在资产定价中的关键作用，为理解公司资产风险提供了新视角。

title: The Market for CEOs:  Evidence from Private Equity
abstract: Most research on the CEO labor market studies public company CEOs while largely ignoring CEOs in private equity (PE) funded companies.We fill this gap by studying the market for CEOs among U.S. companies purchased by PE firms in large leveraged buyout transactions.71% of those companies hired new CEOs under PE ownership.More than 75% of the new CEOs are external hires with 67% being complete outsiders.These results are strikingly different from studies of public companies, particularly, Cziraki and Jenter (2022) who find that 72% of new CEOs in S&P 500 companies are internal promotions.The most recent experience of 67% of the outside CEOs was at a public company with almost 50% of external hires having some previous experience at an S&P 500 firm.We estimate the total compensation of buyout CEOs and find that it is much higher than that of CEOs of similarly sized public companies and slightly lower than that of S&P 500 CEOs.Overall, our results suggest that the broader market for CEOs is active and that, at least for PE funded portfolio companies, firm-specific human capital is relatively unimportant.
summary: 该论文研究了私募股权（PE）收购的美国公司中的CEO劳动力市场，基于大型杠杆收购交易的数据。主要发现：71%的公司在PE所有权下更换了CEO，其中超过75%的新CEO是外部招聘，67%是完全的外部人，这与上市公司（如S&P 500公司72%内部晋升）形成鲜明对比。67%的外部CEO最近经验来自上市公司，近50%有S&P 500公司经验。PE收购公司CEO的总薪酬远高于规模相似的上市公司CEO，略低于S&P 500公司CEO。结果表明，CEO的广泛市场活跃，且对PE投资组合公司而言，公司特定人力资本相对不重要。
ai_comment: 该论文填补了PE公司CEO劳动力市场研究的空白，通过对比上市公司揭示了外部招聘的主导地位，并对公司特定人力资本的重要性提出质疑。

title: Real Exchange Rate and International Reserves in the Era of Financial Integration
abstract: The global financial crisis has brought increased attention to the consequences of international reserves holdings.In an era of high financial integration, we investigate the relationship between the real exchange rate and international reserves using nonlinear regressions and panel threshold regressions over 110 countries from 2001 to 2020.Our study shows the level of financialinstitution development plays an essential role in explaining the buffer effect of international reserves.Countries with a low development of their financial institutions may manage the international reserves as a shield to deal with the negative consequences of terms-of-trade shocks on the real exchange rate.We also find the buffer effect is stronger in countries with intermediate levels of financial openness.
summary: 本文研究金融高度整合时代国际储备与实际汇率之间的关系。基于2001年至2020年110个国家的数据，采用非线性回归和面板阈值回归方法，发现金融制度发展水平在解释国际储备的缓冲效应中起关键作用。低金融制度发展水平的国家会将国际储备作为抵御贸易条件冲击对实际汇率负面影响的盾牌；此外，缓冲效应在金融开放程度处于中等水平的国家更为显著。
ai_comment: 该论文利用非线性方法揭示了金融发展水平和金融开放度对国际储备缓冲效应的门槛特征，为理解新兴经济体储备积累提供了新视角。

title: International Capital Flow Pressures and Global Factors
abstract: The risk sensitivity of international capital flow pressures is explored using a new Exchange Market Pressure index that combines pressures observed in exchange rate adjustments with model-based estimates of incipient pressures that are masked by foreign exchange interventions and policy rate adjustments.The sensitivity of capital flow pressures to risk sentiment including for so-called safe haven currencies, evolves over time, varies significantly across countries, and differs between normal time and extreme stress events.Across countries, risk sensitivities and safe haven status are associated with self-fulfilling exchange rate expectations and carry trade funding currencies.In contrast, association with more traditional macroeconomic country characteristics is weak.
summary: 本文使用一种新的汇率市场压力指数，该指数结合了汇率调整中观察到的压力与通过外汇干预和政策利率调整掩盖的潜在压力的模型估计，探讨了国际资本流动压力的风险敏感性。研究发现，资本流动压力对风险情绪的敏感性（包括所谓的避险货币）随时间演变，在不同国家间差异显著，并且在正常时期与极端压力事件期间表现不同。跨国来看，风险敏感性和避险货币地位与自我实现的汇率预期和套利交易融资货币相关，而与更传统的宏观经济国家特征关联较弱。
ai_comment: 本文通过创新的压力指数揭示了资本流动风险敏感性的动态和跨国差异，并强调了自我实现预期的作用，对理解全球资本流动有重要贡献。

title: The Potential Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Healthcare Spending
abstract: The potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to simplify existing healthcare processes and create new, more efficient ones is a major topic of discussion in the industry. Yet healthcare lags other industries in AI adoption. In this paper, we estimate that wider adoption of AI could lead to savings of 5 to 10 percent in US healthcare spending—roughly $200 billion to $360 billion annually in 2019 dollars. These estimates are based on specific AI-enabled use cases that employ today’s technologies, are attainable within the next five years, and would not sacrifice quality or access. These opportunities could also lead to nonfinancial benefits such as improved healthcare quality, increased access, better patient experience, and greater clinician satisfaction. We further present case studies and discuss how to overcome the challenges to AI deployments.
