We conclude with a review of recent market trends that may shift the AI adoption trajectory toward a more rapid pace.
summary: 这篇论文探讨了人工智能（AI）在美国医疗保健领域的潜在影响，尽管医疗行业在AI采用方面落后于其他行业。通过分析基于当前技术且可在未来五年内实现的特定AI用例，作者估计广泛采用AI可使美国医疗支出节省5%至10%，相当于每年约2000亿至3600亿美元（2019年美元），且不会牺牲质量或可及性。此外，AI还能带来非财务收益，如提高医疗质量、增加可及性、改善患者体验和提升临床医生满意度。论文还提供了案例研究，讨论了克服AI部署挑战的方法，并回顾了可能加速AI采用的市场趋势。
ai_comment: 该研究为AI在医疗领域的成本节约提供了具体量化估计，并结合现实案例，具有较强的实用性和前瞻性。

title: Market Incompleteness and Exchange Rate Spill-over
abstract: Financial variables in third countries explain a significant fraction of bilateral exchange rate movements, even after local variables and common factors are controlled for. This paper proposes an explanation of this exchange rate spill-over pattern based on market incompleteness, which arises when agents in different countries bear different exposures to foreign risks, while the asset space is not complete enough to hedge out these risks. This mechanism weakens the link between exchange rates and local fundamentals, and generates additional exchange rate variations and comovements. To study bilateral exchange rates, it is not sufficient to consider only the local conditions.
summary: 本文研究第三国金融变量如何解释双边汇率波动，即使控制了本地变量和共同因子后仍显著。作者提出基于市场不完整性的解释机制：不同国家主体面临不同的外国风险暴露，而资产空间不足以完全对冲这些风险。该机制削弱了汇率与本地基本面的联系，并产生额外的汇率波动和联动。结论认为，仅考虑本地条件不足以研究双边汇率。
ai_comment: 本文从市场不完整性角度为汇率溢出效应提供了新颖的理论解释，有助于理解汇率联动中超越基本面因素的部分。

title: Fixed and Variable Longevity Annuities in Defined Contribution Plans: Optimal Retirement Portfolios Taking Social Security into Account
abstract: This paper investigates retirees' optimal purchases of fixed and variable longevity income annuities using their defined contribution (DC) plan assets and given their expected Social Security benefits.As an alternative, we also evaluate using plan assets to boost Social Security benefits through delayed claiming.We determine that including deferred income annuities in DC accounts is welfare enhancing for all sex/education groups examined.We also show that providing access to well-designed variable deferred annuities with some equity exposure further enhances retiree wellbeing, compared to having access only to fixed annuities.Nevertheless, for the least educated, delaying claiming Social Security is preferred, whereas the most educated benefit more from using accumulated DC plan assets to purchase deferred annuities.
summary: 本文研究了退休人员在确定缴费（DC）计划中，利用计划资产和预期社会保障福利，最优化购买固定和可变长寿收入年金的问题。作为替代方案，还评估了通过延迟领取社会保障来增加福利的效果。研究发现，将递延收入年金纳入DC计划对所有性别和教育群体的福利都有提升。与仅提供固定年金相比，提供具有股权敞口的可变递延年金能进一步改善退休人员福祉。然而，教育程度最低的群体更倾向于延迟领取社会保障，而教育程度最高的群体则更受益于使用DC计划资产购买递延年金。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了不同教育背景退休人员在年金选择上的异质性，为个性化退休规划提供了重要启示。研究将社会保障延迟领取与DC计划年金化策略进行对比，具有现实指导意义。

title: Target Retirement Fund: A Variant on Target Date Funds that uses Deferred Life Annuities rather than Bonds to Reduce Risk as Retirement Approaches
abstract: This paper evaluates a new variant of the popular target date funds used in employer-based retirement savings plans. We call this new variant a “target retirement plan.” Instead of increasing the allocation to bond funds as retirement approaches, a target retirement fund gradually purchases deferred life annuities beginning at age 50. In the particular straw model target retirement fund examined in the paper, the defined contribution participant makes deferred life annuity purchases at ages 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60 and 62. We compare how a target retirement fund participant would fare compared with someone who stays with a traditional TDF until retirement and then buys an immediate life annuity. We examine 1, 000 possible 30-year futures for stock returns, bond fund returns and Treasury interest rates. The main result from this paper is that buying a retirement annuity in advance (by accumulating deferred life annuities) is superior to sticking with a Target Date Fund until retirement and then buying an immediate annuity in most scenarios of future stock returns, interest rates and bond returns.
summary: 本文评估了雇主支持的退休储蓄计划中流行的目标日期基金（TDF）的一种新变体，称为“目标退休计划”。与传统TDF在退休临近时增加债券基金配置不同，目标退休基金从参与者50岁开始逐步购买延期生命年金（deferred life annuities），具体在50、52、54、56、58、60和62岁购买。通过模拟1000种可能的30年股票收益、债券基金收益和国债利率情景，比较了目标退休基金参与者与传统TDF参与者（退休后购买即期年金）的养老结果。主要发现是，在大多数未来股票收益、利率和债券收益情景下，提前积累延期生命年金（即退休前分期购买）优于持有传统TDF直至退休后再购买即期年金。
ai_comment: 该研究提出了一种创新的退休储蓄策略，通过提前购买年金替代债券来管理长寿风险，模拟结果显示出显著优势，为退休计划设计提供了新思路。

Bayesian Solutions for the Factor Zoo: We Just Ran Two Quadrillion Models
abstract: We propose a novel framework for analyzing linear asset pricing models: simple, robust, and applicable to high‐dimensional problems. For a (potentially misspecified) stand‐alone model, it provides reliable price of risk estimates for both tradable and nontradable factors, and detects those weakly identified. For competing factors and (possibly nonnested) models, the method automatically selects the best specification— if a dominant one exists—or provides a Bayesian model averaging–stochastic discount factor (BMA‐SDF), if there is no clear winner. We analyze 2.25 quadrillion models generated by a large set of factors and find that the BMA‐SDF outperforms existing models in‐ and out‐of‐sample.
summary: 本文提出一个新颖的框架用于分析线性资产定价模型，该框架简单、稳健且适用于高维问题。对于可能误设的独立模型，它能提供可交易和不可交易因子的可靠风险价格估计，并检测弱识别因子。对于竞争因子和可能非嵌套的模型，该方法能自动选择最优规格（若存在主导模型），或提供贝叶斯模型平均-随机贴现因子（BMA-SDF）当没有明确胜者时。作者分析了由大量因子产生的2.25千万亿个模型，发现BMA-SDF在样本内和样本外均优于现有模型。
ai_comment: 提出了一种应对‘因子动物园’问题的贝叶斯解决方案，能够处理极高维度的因子模型，并通过模型平均获得稳健的定价核，方法简单且鲁棒。

title: Principal Portfolios
abstract: We propose a new asset pricing framework in which all securities' signals predict each individual return. While the literature focuses on securities' own‐signal predictability, assuming equal strength across securities, our framework includes cross‐predictability—leading to three main results. First, we derive the optimal strategy in closed form. It consists of eigenvectors of a “prediction matrix,” which we call “principal portfolios.” Second, we decompose the problem into alpha and beta, yielding optimal strategies with, respectively, zero and positive factor exposure. Third, we provide a new test of asset pricing models. Empirically, principal portfolios deliver significant out‐of‐sample alphas to standard factors in several data sets.
summary: 这篇论文提出了一个新的资产定价框架，其中所有证券的信号都能预测每个个体收益，而现有文献通常只关注证券自身信号的可预测性，并假设各证券的预测强度相同。新框架引入了交叉预测，从而得到三个主要结果：第一，推导出最优策略的闭式解，该策略由“预测矩阵”的特征向量构成，称为主成分投资组合；第二，将问题分解为alpha和beta部分，分别得到零因子敞口和正因子敞口的最优策略；第三，提供了一种新的资产定价模型检验方法。实证结果表明，在多个数据集中，主成分投资组合对标准因子产生了显著的样本外alpha。
ai_comment: 该文通过交叉预测扩展了资产定价框架，主成分投资组合方法在实证中表现出色，为因子模型提供了新视角和有效工具。

title: Beliefs Aggregation and Return Predictability
abstract: We study return predictability using a model of speculative trading among competitive traders who agree to disagree about the precision of private information. Although traders apply Bayes' Law consistently, returns are predictable. In addition to trading on long‐term fundamental value, traders also trade on perceived short‐term opportunities arising from foreseen future disagreement, as in a Keynesian beauty contest. Contradicting conventional wisdom, this short‐term speculation dampens price fluctuations and generates time‐series momentum. Model calibration shows quantitatively realistic patterns of return dynamics. Consistent with empirical evidence, our model predicts more pronounced momentum for stocks with higher trading volume.
summary: 我们研究了一个投机交易模型，其中竞争性交易者对私人信息精度存在分歧，尽管他们都一致应用贝叶斯法则，但收益仍具有可预测性。除了基于长期基本面价值交易外，交易者还像凯恩斯选美比赛那样，基于预期的未来分歧而感知的短期机会进行交易。与常规观点相反，这种短期投机抑制了价格波动，并产生了时间序列动量。模型校准展示了定量上现实的收益动态模式。与经验证据一致，我们的模型预测，交易量较高的股票具有更显著的动量。
ai_comment: 本文通过引入交易者对信息精度的分歧，解释了收益可预测性和动量效应的产生机制，挑战了传统观点，并提供了与实证一致的预测。

title: Investor Behavior at the 52-Week High
abstract: This study uncovers how household investors intensify the effect of the 52-week high (52WH): increased volume and momentum-like returns at the 52WH price. Using daily household and institutional trading data, we find that households sharply increase their selling, particularly with limit orders at the 52WH price. This behavior is indicative of anchoring, as it is robust to past returns and intensified by proximity, market uncertainty, and salience of the 52WH. This uninformed limit order selling at and prior to the 52WH leads to a doubling of unconditional 52WH anomaly returns. Post-event returns benefit institutions, which act as counterparties.
summary: 本文利用每日散户和机构交易数据，研究了散户投资者在52周高点（52WH）价格处的行为及其对市场的影响。研究发现，散户在股价达到52周高点时会显著增加卖出行为，尤其倾向于使用限价单。这种卖出行为源于锚定效应，且该效应在股价接近52周高点、市场不确定性高以及52周高点显著性增强时更为强烈。这种无信息的限价单卖出导致52周高点异常收益翻倍，而机构投资者作为对手方则从后续的收益中获利。
ai_comment: 论文通过高频交易数据揭示了散户锚定行为对市场异常的放大作用，并明确了机构如何利用这一行为获利，为行为金融领域提供了新的实证证据。

title: Beyond Basis Basics: Liquidity Demand and Deviations from the Law of One Price
abstract: Deviations from the law of one price between futures and spot prices—the futures‐cash basis—capture information about liquidity demand for equity market exposure in global markets. We show that the basis comoves with dealer and investor futures positions, is contemporaneously positively correlated with futures and spot market returns, and negatively predicts futures and spot returns. These findings are consistent with the futures‐cash basis reflecting liquidity demand that is common to futures and cash equity markets. We find persistent supply‐demand imbalances for equity index exposure reflected in the basis, giving rise to an annual premium of 5% to 6%.
summary: 本文研究期货与现货价格之间的价差（期货-现金基差）如何反映全球市场对股票市场敞口的流动性需求。我们发现基差与交易商和投资者的期货头寸共同变动，与期货和现货市场回报同时期正相关，并负向预测期货和现货回报。这些发现表明基差反映了期货和现金股票市场共同的流动性需求。我们还发现指数暴露的持续供需失衡反映在基差中，产生了每年5%到6%的溢价。
ai_comment: 该论文通过基差揭示流动性需求，连接了期货与现货市场，贡献在于明确供需失衡对溢价的影响。

title: How Large Are Bequest Motives? Estimates Based on Health Shocks
abstract: I analyze the inter vivo transfers and bequest decisions of 700,000 individuals during a period when the decision maker receives negative news regarding their life expectancy. The event that initiates the news is a health outcome. Expected mortality increases both the likelihood of transferring wealth to the next generation and the amount transferred. The size of the inter vivo transfer and bequest are positively related to the wealth of the parent and the severity of the diagnosis, regardless of diagnosis-specific demand for informal care. Using a structural life cycle model, I estimate the bequest parameters that are consistent with the causal effect estimates. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用约70万个体在收到负面健康新闻（即健康冲击）时的生前转移和遗产决策数据，分析遗产动机的大小。研究发现，预期死亡率增加会显著提高财富转移给下一代的可能性和金额，且转移规模与父母财富和诊断严重程度正相关，而与诊断特定非正式护理需求无关。作者进一步构建结构生命周期模型，估计与因果效应一致的遗产参数。
ai_comment: 该论文利用健康冲击作为自然实验，因果识别了遗产动机的大小，方法严谨，为理解代际财富转移提供了重要实证证据。

title: Do Corporations Retain Too Much Cash? Evidence from a Natural Experiment
abstract: Corporations have accumulated record amounts of cash. We study whether firms’ cash retention has been excessive by examining a Korean reform that introduced a new tax on earnings retained as cash. Difference-in-differences tests show that treated firms reduce cash retention and instead increase payouts and investments. Market participants react favorably to the reform, consistent with excessive cash retention. The valuation effects and the alternative uses of the cash are associated with behavioral and agency frictions. Firms that are more subject to behavioral biases increase payouts and experience higher valuations, while poorly governed firms allocate more to investment and experience relatively lower valuations. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用韩国一项对留存现金征税的改革作为自然实验，采用双重差分方法研究企业是否保留过多现金。研究发现，受改革影响的公司减少了现金留存，转而增加派息和投资。市场参与者对该改革反应积极，表明此前现金保留过度。估值效应及现金的替代使用与行为偏差和代理摩擦相关：更易受行为偏差影响的公司增加派息并获得更高估值，而治理较差的公司更多投资但估值相对较低。
ai_comment: 该文通过自然实验提供了企业现金保留过度的因果证据，并巧妙区分了行为偏差与代理问题对现金分配的不同影响。

title: Getting Back to the Source: A New Approach to Measuring Ex Ante Litigation Risk Using Plaintiff-Lawyer Views of SEC Filings
abstract: This study introduces a new measure of ex ante litigation risk using scrutiny of SEC filings by the source of securities litigation (plaintiffs’ lawyers) to reduce measurement error, relative to existing measures. We show that plaintiff-lawyer views proxy for the largely unobservable factors that make firms more likely to face litigation risk. Lagged views precede the public bad news revelation that triggers litigation and predicts future realized litigation risk (i.e., securities class actions filings and plaintiff-lawyer investigations) and stock market outcomes. Finally, we provide new insights into the plaintiff-lawyer case selection process that otherwise cannot be observed.
summary: 本研究提出了一种新的诉讼风险事前度量方法，利用证券诉讼的源头——原告律师对SEC文件的审查来减少测量误差。研究发现，原告律师的观点可以代理那些使公司更可能面临诉讼风险的、难以观测的因素。滞后的原告律师观点先于触发诉讼的公共坏消息披露，并能预测未来的已实现诉讼风险（即证券集体诉讼的提起和原告律师的调查）以及股票市场结果。此外，研究还提供了关于原告律师案件选择过程的新见解，这些过程此前无法被观测。
ai_comment: 该研究通过独特的原告律师视角构建了新的诉讼风险度量，有效降低了传统度量的测量误差，并揭示了案件选择的内部机制，具有重要的实证贡献。

title: A Liberalization Spillover: From Equities to Loans
abstract: The opening of equity markets to foreign investment by developing countries appears to generate an enormously large positive growth effect (see Bekaert, Harvey, and Lundblad (2005), Journal of Financial Economics 77, 3–55) in spite of a relatively small role of such markets for financing investment in most economies. We propose a spillover channel from equity market opening to lower costs of bank loans, which helps to explain this puzzle. From analyzing bank loan data associated with China’s introduction of the Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors program, we find significant support for this channel. Furthermore, we show that a reduction in the risk premium in loans is an important mechanism.
summary: 论文探讨了发展中国家开放股市对外投资产生巨大经济增长效应但股市融资作用相对较小的悖论，提出了股市开放通过降低银行贷款成本产生溢出效应的渠道。通过分析中国引入合格境外机构投资者（QFII）制度相关的银行贷款数据，找到了支持该渠道的显著证据，并进一步表明贷款风险溢价的降低是其中的重要机制。
ai_comment: 该研究为理解股市开放如何通过银行信贷渠道影响实体经济提供了新机制，实证设计巧妙且具有政策启示。

title: Measuring and Improving Stakeholder Welfare Is Easier Said than Done
abstract: While corporate social responsibility by firms aims at improving welfare for different social groups, whether it achieves this is often difficult to measure. After Apr. 2018 protests, Starbucks enacted policies that anybody could sit in their stores and use the bathroom without making a purchase. Using anonymized cellphone location data, we estimate this led to a 7.0% decline in attendance relative to other nearby coffee shops. The effect is 84% larger near homeless shelters and larger for Starbucks’ wealthier customers. The average time spent per visit declined by 4.1%. Public urination citations decreased near Starbucks locations, but other minor crimes were unchanged.
summary: 本文研究公司社会责任政策对利益相关者福利的影响是否易于衡量。以星巴克2018年4月抗议后实施的政策为例（允许任何人无需消费即可进入店铺和使用卫生间），利用匿名手机位置数据估计该政策导致星巴克客流量相对于附近其他咖啡店下降了7.0%。靠近收容所的星巴克门店客流量下降幅度增大84%，且下降主要来自较富裕的顾客。平均每次访问时间减少了4.1%。政策实施后，星巴克附近因公共小便被罚的数量减少，但其他轻微犯罪没有变化。这些结果表明，旨在改善福利的CSR政策可能产生复杂的、非预期的后果，且其福利影响难以衡量。
ai_comment: 该文利用高粒度手机定位数据量化了CSR政策的意外后果，揭示了政策对不同群体影响的异质性，对CSR效果评估具有方法论贡献。

title: Deposit Insurance and Depositor Behavior: Evidence from Colombia
abstract: This paper studies the effect of deposit insurance on depositor behavior. Our theoretical framework integrates insights from public and financial economics and predicts that (1) deposit insurance induces bunching at the threshold in the deposit distribution and (2) an increase in the insurance threshold promotes deposit growth, particularly higher for individuals bunching at the initial limit. We exploit a large and unexpected increase in the Colombian insurance together with monthly depositor-level records from a major bank to test these predictions. We validate the existence of bunching in deposits and quantify the heterogeneous effect of deposit insurance on individual deposit growth. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 该论文研究存款保险对存款人行为的影响。理论框架融合公共经济学和金融经济学，预测(1)存款保险会导致存款分布在阈值处出现聚集，(2)提高保险阈值会促进存款增长，对初始限额附近的个人影响更大。利用哥伦比亚一次大型意外增加的存款保险变革以及一家主要银行的月度存款人级别数据，验证了存款聚集的存在，并量化了存款保险对个人存款增长的异质性效应。
ai_comment: 该研究巧妙利用自然实验，结合理论预测与微观数据，为存款保险的因果效应提供了可信证据。

title: Finding Fortune: How Do Institutional Investors Pick Asset Managers?
abstract: We propose and test a framework of private information acquisition and decision timing for asset allocators hiring outside investment managers. Using unique data on due diligence interactions between an institutional allocator and 860 hedge fund managers, we find that the production of private information complements public information. The allocator strategically chooses how much proprietary information to collect, reducing due diligence time by 18 months and improving outcomes. Funds selected by the manager outperform those not selected by 9$\%$ over 20 months. The outperformance relates to the allocator learning about fund return-to-scale constraints and manager skill before other investors.
summary: 本文提出了一个关于资产配置者（机构投资者）在雇佣外部投资经理（对冲基金管理人）时获取私有信息和决定时机的框架。利用一个机构配置者与860家对冲基金管理人之间尽职调查交互的独特数据，研究发现私有信息的产生对公开信息具有互补作用。配置者策略性地选择收集多少专有信息，将尽职调查时间缩短18个月并提高了结果。被选中的基金在20个月内的表现比未被选中的基金高出9%。这种优异表现与配置者了解基金的规模回报约束和管理人技能有关。
ai_comment: 利用独特的尽职调查数据集，揭示了机构投资者在选择资产管理人时的信息生产策略，为理解私有信息与公开信息如何互补提供了新视角。

title: International Yield Spillovers
abstract: This article investigates spillovers from foreign economies to the U.S. through changes in long-term Treasury yields. We document a decline in the contribution of U.S. domestic news to the variance of long-term Treasury yields and an increased importance of overnight yield changes, a proxy for foreign shocks’ contribution to U.S. yields. A model that identifies U.S., Euro area, and U.K. shocks that move global yields suggests that foreign shocks account for at least 20% of the daily variation in long-term U.S. yields in recent years. We also document the predictability of long-term U.S. yields by the U.S.–foreign yield spread.
summary: 本文研究外国经济通过长期国债收益率变化对美国产生的溢出效应。我们记录了美国国内新闻对长期国债收益率方差的贡献下降，以及隔夜收益率变化（作为外国冲击对美国收益率贡献的代理变量）的重要性上升。一个识别美国、欧元区和英国冲击的全球收益率模型表明，近年来外国冲击至少解释了美国长期国债收益率日变动的20%。我们还发现了美国长期国债收益率可通过美国与外国收益率价差进行预测的证据。
ai_comment: 该文通过量化外国冲击对美国国债收益率的贡献，创新地揭示了全球金融联动的微观机制，对理解国际宏观金融传导具有重要价值。

title: The Impact of Risk Cycles on Business Cycles: A Historical View
abstract: We investigate the effects of financial risk cycles on business cycles, using a panel spanning 73 countries since 1900. Agents use a Bayesian learning model to form their beliefs about risk. We construct a proxy of these beliefs and show that perceived low risk encourages risk-taking, augmenting growth at the cost of accumulating financial vulnerabilities, and, therefore, a reversal in growth follows. The reversal is particularly pronounced when the low-risk environment persists and credit growth is excessive. Global risk cycles have a stronger effect on growth than local risk cycles via their impact on capital flows, investment, and debt-issuer quality. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用1900年以来73个国家的面板数据，研究金融风险周期对商业周期的影响。代理人通过贝叶斯学习模型形成对风险的信念，作者构建了这些信念的代理变量，发现低风险感知会鼓励风险承担，从而在积累金融脆弱性的同时促进增长，但随后会导致增长逆转。这种逆转在低风险环境持续且信贷过度增长时尤为显著。全球风险周期通过影响资本流动、投资和债务发行者质量，对经济增长的影响强于本地风险周期。
ai_comment: 该论文通过长期跨国数据和贝叶斯学习模型，实证揭示了风险感知与经济周期之间的动态因果关系，并强调了全球风险周期的传导机制，对于理解金融稳定与经济增长的平衡具有重要价值。

title: Exporting Uncertainty: The Impact of Brexit on Corporate America—CORRIGENDUM
abstract: An abstract is not available for this content so a preview has been provided. As you have access to this content, a full PDF is available via the ‘Save PDF’ action button.
summary: 本论文是《Exporting Uncertainty: The Impact of Brexit on Corporate America》的更正说明。由于是更正，不涉及新的研究内容，仅对原论文的错误或遗漏进行修正。原论文研究英国脱欧对英国企业不确定性传递至美国企业的影响。
ai_comment: 作为更正，本文仅修正前作中的错误，无新发现。

title: Hedging Commodity Price Risk
abstract: We present an equilibrium model of hedging for commodity processing firms. We show the optimal hedge ratio depends on the convexity of the firm’s cost function and the elasticity of the supply of the input and the demand for the output. Our calibrated model suggests that hedging tends to be ineffective. When uncertainty comes exclusively from either the supply or from the demand side, updating the hedge dynamically, and using nonlinear contracts improves hedging effectiveness. However, with both supply and demand uncertainty, hedging effectiveness can be low even with option-based and dynamic hedging strategies.
summary: 本文提出了一个商品加工企业的对冲均衡模型。研究发现，最优对冲比率取决于企业成本函数的凸性以及投入品供给和产出需求的弹性。校准模型表明，对冲往往效果不佳。当不确定性仅来自供给或需求单方面时，动态调整对冲和使用非线性合约能提高对冲有效性。然而，当供给和需求都存在不确定性时，即使采用基于期权的和动态对冲策略，对冲有效性也可能较低。
ai_comment: 该文通过均衡框架揭示了商品加工企业对冲效果的理论边界，校准结果对实务有警示意义。

title: Cash Induced Demand
abstract: I show that cash distributions through cash mergers, dividend payments, and stock buybacks are, in principle, similar to investor fund flows in generating demand for investable assets. Abnormal returns on certain assets can be forecasted because delegated investors predictably reinvest cash returns toward certain holdings. Novel measures of stock-level demand constructed using proportional reinvestments by mutual funds predict abnormal returns and issuances in noncash-paying stocks. These results highlight an alternative and substantial source of price fluctuations in the cross section of equities.
summary: 本文证明，通过现金并购、股息支付和股票回购进行的现金分配，本质上类似于投资者资金流，能够产生对可投资资产的需求。由于委托投资者可预测地将现金回报再投资于特定持仓，某些资产的异常回报可以被预测。利用共同基金按比例再投资构建的股票层面需求新指标，能够预测非现金支付股票的异常回报和股票发行。这些结果突显了横截面股票价格波动的一个替代且重要的来源。
ai_comment: 从现金分配角度构建需求指标，为理解股票价格波动提供了新颖视角，实证结果稳健且具有实践意义。

title: Identifying the Effects of Macroeconomic Attention Through Foreign Investor Distraction
abstract: While the causal impact of limited attention to macroeconomic news is difficult to detect, this article proposes one solution: exploiting when foreign investors are “distracted” by risk factors in their home markets. I demonstrate that financial activity in the average foreign investor’s home market decreases foreign attention paid to 21 emerging economies, measured using Google search volume for economy-specific financial terms that emanate from outside each economy’s border. Exploiting this effect using an instrumental variables approach, I find that an exogenous increase in foreign attention preceding a scheduled monetary policy rate announcement raises preannouncement stock returns and announcement day turnover.
summary: 本文研究宏观经济新闻关注度的因果影响，提出利用外国投资者因本国市场风险因素而分心的现象作为解决方案。通过测量来自21个新兴经济体以外的Google搜索量，发现外国投资者所在国的金融市场活动会减少其对新兴经济体的关注。采用工具变量方法，结果表明：在预定货币政策利率公告之前，外国关注度的外生增加会提高公告前的股票回报和公告日的交易量。
ai_comment: 巧妙利用外国投资者分心作为自然实验，解决了注意力因果识别难题，方法新颖且实证结果清晰。

title: Determinants of Capital Structure: An Expanded Assessment
abstract: Using a standardized methodology, we empirically evaluate 55 proposed determinants of capital structure in terms of statistical significance, economic significance, and identification. We find that robust and economically important determinants of debt ratios are relatively few in number. Nevertheless, because each determinant relates to one of five market imperfections—taxes, distress costs, information asymmetry, agency costs, or supply frictions—we draw conclusions from the evidence as a whole regarding the explanatory power of different capital structure theories. We find greater support for pecking order theory and supply-related theories, with less support for traditional tradeoff theory and agency theory.
summary: 本文采用标准化方法，实证评估了55个资本结构决定因素在统计显著性、经济显著性和识别性方面的表现。研究发现，稳健且经济重要的债务比率决定因素数量相对较少。每个决定因素与五种市场不完美之一相关：税收、财务困境成本、信息不对称、代理成本或供给摩擦。基于整体证据，本文对不同资本结构理论的解释力进行了评估，发现优序融资理论和供给相关理论获得了更强支持，而传统权衡理论和代理理论的支持较弱。
ai_comment: 该论文通过大规模实证比较，系统揭示了资本结构理论的有效性边界，尤其强调了供给因素和优序融资行为的重要性，为后续研究提供了扎实的基准。

title: Bank Lines of Credit as a Source of Long-Term Finance
abstract: Hand-collecting credit line drawdowns that firms classify as long-term debt, we first document how long-term drawdowns rise with high investment needs or weak external capital market conditions. Nearly all drawdown proceeds finance long-term investment, including M&A activity. Unrated and lower-rated firms rely more on long-term drawdowns than high or very poorly rated firms. We further find that credit lines have tighter covenants than terms loans. Drawdowns are repaid fairly quickly and often refinanced with other long-term debt. Our findings support the monitored liquidity insurance theory of credit lines and highlight that long-term drawdowns act as a valuable bridge financing mechanism.
summary: 通过手工收集企业归类为长期债务的信用额度提取数据，本文首先记录了长期提取如何随着高投资需求或外部资本市场条件疲软而上升。几乎所有提取资金用于长期投资，包括并购活动。未评级和低评级公司比高评级或极低评级公司更依赖长期提取。进一步发现，信用额度比定期贷款有更严格的契约。提取后资金偿还速度较快，且常被其他长期债务再融资。研究结果支持了信用额度的监控流动性保险理论，并突显了长期提取作为有价值的过渡融资机制。
ai_comment: 本文通过手工收集数据揭示了信用额度作为长期融资工具的新证据，强调了其监控和过渡融资功能。

title: Watch What They Do, Not What They Say: Estimating Regulatory Costs from Revealed Preferences
abstract: We show that distortion in the size distribution of banks around regulatory thresholds can be used to identify costs of bank regulation. We build a structural model in which banks can strategically bunch their assets below regulatory thresholds to avoid regulations. The resultant distortion in the size distribution of banks reveals the magnitude of regulatory costs. Using U.S. bank data, we estimate the regulatory costs imposed by the Dodd-Frank Act. Although the estimated regulatory costs are substantial, they are significantly lower than banks’ self-reported estimates. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 本文利用银行规模分布在监管阈值附近出现的扭曲来识别银行监管成本。作者构建了一个结构模型，其中银行可以策略性地将其资产控制在监管阈值以下以规避监管，由此导致的银行规模分布扭曲揭示了监管成本的大小。利用美国银行数据，本文估计了《多德-弗兰克法案》所带来的监管成本。结果显示，虽然监管成本相当可观，但显著低于银行自行报告的估计值。
ai_comment: 本文利用揭示偏好方法，通过观察银行的实际行为而非自报数据来估计监管成本，提供了更客观的估计结果，对政策评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Labor Force Demographics and Corporate Innovation
abstract: Firms in younger labor markets produce more innovation. We establish this by instrumenting the current labor force with historical births in each local labor market in the United States. Analyses of firms and inventors allow us to rule out unobservable heterogeneity across local labor markets and firms, life cycles, and other effects. Corporate innovation in younger labor markets reflects the innovative characteristics of younger labor forces, and its market value is higher. Younger workers as a group, not merely inventors by themselves, produce more innovation for firms through the labor force channel rather than through a financing or consumption channel. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 论文研究美国劳动力市场年龄结构对企业创新的影响。利用历史出生率作为工具变量，分析各地方劳动力市场数据，发现劳动力年龄越年轻的地区，企业创新产出更多。通过企业和发明人层面的分析，排除了地区异质性、企业生命周期等干扰因素。年轻劳动力市场的企业创新更具市场价值，且这一效应通过劳动力渠道传导，而非融资或消费渠道。研究揭示了劳动力人口结构对企业创新的因果作用。
ai_comment: 利用历史出生率作为工具变量，有效识别了劳动力年龄结构对企业创新的因果效应，为人口经济学与公司金融交叉领域提供了新证据。

title: The Insurance Implications of Government Student Loan Repayment Schemes
abstract: We use new administrative data that links detailed information on Canadian student loan recipients with their repayment and income histories from the Canada Student Loans Program (CSLP), income tax filings, and post-secondary schooling records to measure the extent to which student borrowers adjust loan repayments to insure against income variation. Several mechanisms are available for students to adjust loan repayments in response to income fluctuations: formal, like CSLP's Repayment Assistance Plan; and informal, such as delinquency or default. Borrowers can also make larger payments than required should they experience unexpectedly high income. Indeed, loan payments are shown to increase in income, more so in early years and for individuals with higher initial debt. More formally, we estimate that on average, an unexpected $1,000 change in year-over-year income is associated with a $30 change in loan payment: from a $50 change the year after graduation, declining to a $20 change 5 years after graduation. Loan repayments are also used to absorb income variation that is more permanent in nature: for borrowers whose income is consistently below or above expected income at graduation, the magnitude of average repayment adjustment is similar to the average yearly response.
summary: 使用加拿大学生贷款计划（CSLP）的新行政数据，结合贷款接受者的还款历史、收入档案、税收记录和高等教育信息，衡量学生借款人通过调整贷款还款来对冲收入波动的程度。借款人可利用正式机制（如CSLP的还款援助计划）和非正式机制（如拖欠或违约）调整还款，也可在收入意外高时超额还款。研究发现，贷款还款随收入增加而增加，尤其在毕业初期和初始债务较高的借款人中更为显著。正式估计表明，年收入每意外变化1,000美元，平均还款变化约30美元：毕业当年为50美元，五年后降至20美元。此外，还款调整也用于吸收更持久的收入变动，对于收入持续低于或高于毕业预期收入的借款人，其平均调整幅度与年度平均响应相似。
ai_comment: 利用独特行政数据实证揭示学生贷款还款的保险功能，为理解公共贷款项目的家庭金融影响提供了新证据。

title: Central Banks as Dollar Lenders of Last Resort: Implications for Regulation and Reserve Holdings
abstract: This paper explores how non-U.S. central banks behave when firms in their economies engage in currency mismatch, borrowing more heavily in dollars than justified by their operating exposures. We begin by documenting that, in a panel of 53 countries, central bank holdings of dollar reserves are significantly correlated with the dollar-denominated bank borrowing of their non-financial corporate sectors, controlling for a number of known covariates of reserve accumulation. We then build a model in which the central bank can deal with private-sector mismatch, and the associated risk of a domestic financial crisis, in two ways: (i) by imposing ex ante financial regulations such as bank capital requirements; or (ii) by building a stockpile of dollar reserves that allow it to serve as an ex post dollar lender of last resort. The model highlights a novel externality: individual central banks may tend to over-accumulate dollar reserves, relative to what a global planner would choose. This is because individual central banks do not internalize that their hoarding of reserves exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated safe assets, which lowers dollar interest rates and encourages firms to increase the currency mismatch of their liabilities. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer stricter financial regulation (e.g., higher bank capital requirements) and reduced holdings of dollar reserves.
summary: 本文研究非美国央行在其经济体中企业存在货币错配（即借款中美元占比超过经营敞口所需）时的行为。首先，基于53个国家面板数据，发现央行美元储备持有量与非金融企业部门的美元银行贷款显著相关，且控制住储备积累的已知协变量后依然成立。随后构建模型，央行可通过两种方式应对私人部门货币错配及由此引发的国内金融危机风险：一是事前实施金融监管（如银行资本要求）；二是积累美元储备作为事后最后贷款人。模型揭示了一种新的外部性：个体央行可能过度积累美元储备（相对于全球规划者的选择），因为它们未内化其储备囤积会加剧全球美元安全资产的稀缺性，从而压低美元利率并鼓励企业增加负债的货币错配。与分散决策结果相比，全球规划者可能更偏好更严格的金融监管（如更高银行资本要求）并减少美元储备持有。
ai_comment: 该文将央行储备积累与全球安全资产稀缺性联系起来，揭示了个体理性导致全球失衡的机制，为国际金融监管合作提供了新视角。

title: Nothing Propinks Like Propinquity: Using Machine Learning to Estimate the Effects of Spatial Proximity in the Major League Baseball Draft
abstract: Recent models and empirical work on network formation emphasize the importance of propinquity in producing strong interpersonal connections. Yet, one might wonder how deep such insights run, as thus far empirical results rely on survey and lab-based evidence. In this study, we examine propinquity in a high-stakes setting of talent allocation: the Major League Baseball (MLB) Draft. We examine draft picks from 2000-2019 across every MLB club of the nearly 30, 000 players drafted (from a player pool of more than a million potential draftees). Our findings can be summarized in three parts. First, propinquity is alive and well in our setting, and spans even the latter years of our sample, when higher-level statistical exercises have become the norm rather than the exception. Second, the measured effect size is important, as MLB clubs pay a real cost in terms of inferior talent acquired due to propinquity bias: for example, their draft picks appear in 25 fewer games relative to teams that do not exhibit propinquity bias. Finally, the effect is found to be the most pronounced in later rounds of the draft (after round 15), where the Scouting Director has the greatest latitude.
summary: 该论文研究空间邻近性（propinquity）在高风险的人才分配环境——美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）选秀中的影响。使用机器学习方法估计效应，基于2000-2019年所有MLB球队对近30,000名选秀球员（从超过100万潜在候选人中）的选择数据。主要发现：（1）邻近性效应显著存在，甚至在后期样本年份（高级统计分析已成为常态）仍然持续；（2）效应量重要：受邻近性偏见影响的球队为获取低劣人才付出了实际代价，例如其选秀球员比其他球队少出场25场比赛；（3）效应在选秀后期（第15轮之后，球探总监权限最大时）最为显著。
ai_comment: 将网络形成理论中的邻近性概念应用于体育经济学，用大样本数据和机器学习方法量化了决策偏见的实际成本，为行为决策研究提供了自然实验证据。

title: Refining Public Policies with Machine Learning: The Case of Tax Auditing
abstract: We study the extent to which ML techniques can be used to improve tax auditing efficiency using administrative data, without the need of randomized audits. Using Italy's population data on sole proprietorship tax returns, audits and their outcome, we develop a new approach to address the so called selective labels problem - the fact that a ML algorithm must necessarily be trained on endogenously selected data. We document the existence of substantial margins for raising revenue from audits by improving the selection of taxpayers to audit with ML. Replacing the 10% least productive audits with an equal number of taxpayers selected by our trained algorithm raises detected tax evasion by as much as 38%, and evasion that is actually payed back by 29%.
summary: 本文研究如何利用机器学习（ML）技术提高税务审计效率，无需随机审计即可从行政数据中优化纳税人选择。作者利用意大利个体经营者税收申报、审计及其结果的全面数据，提出一种新方法解决选择性标签问题（即ML算法必须基于内生选择的数据进行训练）。结果表明，用训练好的算法替换实际中效率最低的10%的审计，可将检测到的逃税金额提升38%，实际追回的逃税金额提升29%。
ai_comment: 创新性地解决了选择性标签问题，并通过真实数据验证了ML在公共政策中的显著改进潜力，具有重要实践意义。

title: The Stench of Failure: How Perception Affects House Prices
abstract: In Australian real estate markets, about a third of properties are sold at auction. We show that properties that fail auctions sell later for a 2.6% discount. This effect increases for properties failing multiple auctions and when no bids are made. Consistent with a causal channel, the effect holds when auction failure is instrumented by the tendency of owners to anchor on nearby better properties (and thus set reserve prices too high). Prices cluster just below salient round numbers, and the discount fades over time, inconsistent with our effects reflecting unobserved property characteristics. We test for several mechanisms and conclude that most of the pricing discounts reflect stigma, which reduces potential buyers' willingness to pay.
summary: 该论文研究澳大利亚房地产市场中拍卖失败对房产价格的负面影响。约三分之一的房产通过拍卖出售，其中失败拍卖的房产后续出售时平均折扣为2.6%，且折扣随拍卖失败次数增加和无出价情况而加大。通过工具变量（业主因锚定附近更好房产而设定过高保留价）支持因果效应。价格在醒目整数处聚集，折扣随时间消退，排除了未观察特征的解释。机制检验表明折扣主要源于“污名效应”，即失败拍卖降低买家支付意愿。
ai_comment: 巧妙利用工具变量和价格聚类、时间衰减等证据，严谨区分因果与特征解释，并揭示行为因素在资产定价中的作用。

title: Using Machine Learning for Efficient Flexible Regression Adjustment in Economic Experiments
Non-Fundamental Flows and Foreign Exchange Rates
abstract: Frequent, yet uninformed, fund flows in Chilean pension plans generate substantial trading in currency markets due to the high allocation to international securities. These non-fundamental flows have a significant impact on the Chilean peso, which is estimated to have a relatively low price elasticity of 0.81. Hedging by the banking sector propagates the price pressure to currency forward markets and results in violations of the covered interest rate parity. Using trading data and bank balance sheet data, we confirm that regulatory requirements and banks’ risk bearing constraints create limits of arbitrage.
summary: 本文研究智利养老金计划中频繁但非信息驱动的资金流动如何影响外汇市场。由于养老金计划大量配置国际证券，这些非基本面流动在外汇市场上产生大量交易，并对智利比索产生显著影响，估计其价格弹性较低，为0.81。银行业通过套期保值将价格压力传导至远期外汇市场，导致抛补利率平价条件被违反。利用交易数据和银行资产负债表数据，研究确认监管要求和银行的风险承担约束构成了套利限制。
ai_comment: 本文利用独特的智利养老金和银行微观数据，实证揭示了非基本面资金流动对外汇市场及利率平价的显著影响，为理解国际金融中的套利限制提供了新证据。

title: Monetary Policy When the Central Bank Shapes Financial-Market Sentiment
A Theory of Gross and Net Capital Flows over the Global Financial Cycle
abstract: We develop a theory to account for changes in gross and net capital flows over the global financial cycle (GFC). The theory relies critically on portfolio heterogeneity among investors within and across countries, related to risky portfolio shares and portfolio shares allocated to foreign assets. A global drop in risky asset prices during a downturn of the GFC changes relative wealth within and across countries due to portfolio heterogeneity. This leads to changes in gross and net capital flows that are consistent with the stylized facts: all countries experience a decline in gross capital flows (retrenchment), while countries that have a net debt of safe assets experience a rise in net outflows of safe assets (reduced accumulation of safe debt). This is accomplished through a rise in total net outflows and a drop in net outflows of risky assets. The model is applied to 20 advanced countries and calibrated to micro data related to within country portfolio heterogeneity, as well as cross country heterogeneity of net foreign asset positions of safe and risky assets. The implications of the calibrated model for gross and net capital flows are quantitatively consistent with the data.
summary: 本文提出了一个理论来解释全球金融周期中总资本流动和净资本流动的变化。该理论关键依赖于国内外投资者在投资组合上的异质性，特别是风险资产份额和外国资产份额的差异。全球金融周期下行期风险资产价格下跌，通过投资组合异质性改变了国内外相对财富，导致总资本流动和净资本流动的变化，符合典型事实：所有国家总资本流动下降（紧缩），而安全资产净债务国的安全资产净流出增加（即安全债务积累减少）。这一过程通过总净流出增加和风险资产净流出下降来实现。模型应用于20个发达国家，并使用与国内投资组合异质性及安全与风险资产净外国资产头寸跨国异质性相关的微观数据进行校准。校准模型对总资本流动和净资本流动的预测在数量上与数据一致。
ai_comment: 该论文从投资组合异质性视角构建了一个统一的资本流动理论，成功解释了全球金融周期中的典型事实，并通过微观数据校准提供了定量支持，是国际金融领域的重要贡献。

title: Do Foreign Yield Curves Predict U.S. Recessions and GDP Growth?
abstract: This paper shows that foreign term spreads constructed from bond yields of non-U.S. G-7 constituents predict future U.S. recessions and that foreign term spreads are stronger predictors of U.S. recessions occurring within the next year than U.S. term spreads. U.S. and foreign term spreads are both informative of the U.S. economy but over different horizons and for different components of economic activity. Smaller U.S. term spreads lead to smaller foreign term spreads and U.S. Dollar appreciation. Smaller foreign term spreads do not lead to significant U.S. Dollar depreciation but do lead to persistent declines in U.S. exports and FDI flows into the United States. These findings are consistent with the proposition that foreign term spreads embed growth spillovers from the U.S. and the resulting Dollar strength and slowdown abroad spill back to the United States.
summary: 本文利用非美国G-7国家的债券收益率构建的外国期限利差（foreign term spreads），研究其对美国经济衰退和GDP增长的预测能力。研究发现，外国期限利差能够预测美国未来的经济衰退，且对未来一年内美国经济衰退的预测能力比美国期限利差（U.S. term spreads）更强。美国和外国期限利差均对美国经济有信息含量，但影响的时间和成分不同：较小的美国期限利差导致较小的外国期限利差和美元升值，而较小的外国期限利差虽不会导致美元显著贬值，但会导致美国出口和流入美国的外国直接投资（FDI）持续下降。这些发现支持了外国期限利差包含从美国增长溢出以及由此产生的美元强势和海外放缓回溢到美国的观点。
ai_comment: 该文创新性地将外国收益率曲线信息用于预测美国经济，发现外国期限利差比美国利差更有预测力，强调了国际金融传导机制的重要性，对政策制定和风险预警有参考价值。

title: Productivity and Wages: What Was the Productivity-Wage Link in the Digital Revolution of the Past, and What Might Occur in the AI Revolution of the Future?
abstract: Wages have been spreading out across workers over time -or in other words, the 90th/50th wage ratio has risen over time. A key question is, has the productivity distribution also spread out across worker skill levels over time? Using our calculations of productivity by skill level for the U.S., we show that the distributions of both wages and productivity have spread out over time, as the right tail lengthens for both. We add OECD countries, showing that the wage-productivity correlation exists, such that gains in aggregate productivity, or GDP per person, have resulted in higher wages for workers at the top and bottom of the wage distribution. However, across countries, those workers in the upper income ranks have seen their wages rise the most over time. The most likely international factor explaining these wage increases is the skill-biased technological change of the digital revolution. The new AI revolution that has just begun seems to be having a similar skill-biased effects on wages. But this current AI, called "supervised learning," is relatively similar to past technological change. The AI of the distant future will be "unsupervised learning," and it could eventually have an effect on the jobs of the most highly skilled.
summary: 本文探讨了生产率与工资之间随时间变化的关系，特别关注数字革命和未来AI革命的影响。研究发现，在美国，工资和生产率分布均随时间拉大，即90/50工资比率上升，且生产率分布也出现右尾延长。跨国分析显示，生产率（人均GDP）增长与工人工资正相关，但高收入阶层工资增长最为显著。数字革命的技能偏向型技术变革是工资增长的主要国际因素。当前基于监督学习的AI革命对工资也有类似技能偏向效应，而未来无监督学习的AI可能最终影响高技能工人就业。
ai_comment: 该文通过历史数据对比数字革命与AI革命的工资效应，为理解技术变革对收入不平等的影响提供了实证基础。

title: Are Retirement Planning Tools Substitutes or Complements to Financial Capability?
abstract: We conduct a randomized controlled trial to understand how a web-based retirement saving calculator affects workers' retirement-savings decisions. In both conditions, the calculator projects workers' retirement income goal. In the treatment condition, it also projects retirement income based on defined-contribution savings, prominently displays the gap between projected goal and actual retirement income, and allows users to interactively explore how alternative, future contribution choices would affect the gap. The treatment increased average annual retirement contributions by $174 (2.3 percent). However, effects were larger for those with greater financial knowledge, suggesting this type of tool complements, rather than substitutes for, underlying financial capability.
summary: 本文通过一项随机对照试验，评估基于网络的退休储蓄计算器对工人退休储蓄决策的影响。在控制条件下，计算器仅预测退休收入目标；在处理条件下，计算器额外基于确定供款储蓄预测退休收入，突出显示目标与实际收入之间的差距，并允许用户交互探索不同未来供款选择如何影响这一差距。结果显示，处理组平均每年退休供款增加174美元（2.3%）。然而，效果在金融知识水平较高的工人中更为显著，表明这种工具与潜在金融能力呈互补而非替代关系。
ai_comment: 该研究通过严谨的实验设计揭示了退休规划工具与金融能力的互补性，为政策制定和金融教育提供了有力证据。

title: Mutual Fund Revenue Sharing in 401(k) Plans
Corporate Governance Implications of the Growth in Indexing
abstract: Passively managed funds have grown to become some of the largest shareholders in publicly traded companies, but there is considerable debate about the effects of this growth on corporate governance. The goal of this paper is to review the literature on the governance implications of passive fund growth and discuss directions for future research. In particular, we present a framework to understand the incentives of passive and actively managed funds to engage in governance, review the empirical evidence in the context of this framework, and highlight the questions that remain unanswered.
summary: 本文综述了被动管理基金增长对公司治理影响的文献，并讨论未来研究方向。作者提出了一个框架，用于理解被动和主动管理基金参与公司治理的激励差异，在此框架下回顾了相关实证证据，并指出了尚未解决的关键问题。
ai_comment: 一篇系统性的综述论文，清晰梳理了被动基金增长与公司治理之间的复杂关系，并为后续研究提供了有价值的框架和方向。

title: Central Bank Digital Currencies, an Old Tale With a New Chapter
abstract: We consider the debut of a new monetary instrument, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs). Drawing on examples from monetary history, we argue that a successful monetary transformation must combine microeconomic efficiency with macroeconomic credibility. A paradoxical feature of these transformations is that success in the micro dimension can encourage macro failure. Overcoming this paradox may require politically uncomfortable compromises. We propose that such compromises will be necessary for the success of CBDCs.
summary: 本文探讨央行数字货币（CBDC）的引入，借鉴货币历史中的例子，论证成功的货币转型必须同时实现微观经济效率和宏观经济可信度。作者指出一个悖论：微观层面的成功可能诱发宏观层面的失败，而克服这一悖论需要政治上不讨好的妥协。文章认为，这些妥协对于CBDC的成功至关重要。
ai_comment: 从历史视角剖析CBDC的潜在矛盾，强调政治维度的重要性，为政策制定提供了新的理论视角。

title: The Regulation of Medical AI: Policy Approaches, Data, and Innovation Incentives
abstract: For those who follow health and technology news, it is difficult to go more than a few days without reading about a compelling new application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to health care. AI has myriad applications in medicine and its adjacent industries, with AI-driven tools already in use in basic science, translational medicine, and numerous corners of health care delivery, including administrative work, diagnosis, and treatment. In diagnosis and treatment, a large and growing number of AI tools meet the statutory definition of a medical device or that of an in-vitro diagnostic. Those that do are subject to regulation by local authorities, resulting in both practical and strategic implications for manufacturers, along with a more complex set of innovation incentives. This chapter presents background on medical device regulation-especially as it relates to software products-and quantitatively describes the emergence of AI among FDAregulated products. The empirical section of this chapter explores characteristics of AI-supported/ driven medical devices ("AI devices") in the United States. It presents data on their origins (by firm type and country), their safety profiles (as measured by associated adverse events and recalls), and concludes with a discussion of the implications of regulation for innovation incentives in medical AI.
summary: 本文探讨医疗人工智能（AI）的监管问题，包括政策方法、数据及创新激励。背景部分介绍了医疗器械监管框架，特别是针对软件产品的规定，并定量分析了FDA监管产品中AI的出现情况。实证部分研究了美国AI支持/驱动的医疗设备（AI设备）的特征，包括其来源（按企业类型和国家）、安全概况（通过相关不良事件和召回衡量），最后讨论了监管对医疗AI创新激励的影响。
ai_comment: 本文通过定量数据揭示了AI医疗器械的监管现状与安全特征，为理解监管如何塑造创新激励提供了实证基础。

title: How Has COVID-19 Impacted Research Production in Economics and Finance?
abstract: Following the onset of COVID-19, research production in economics and finance (measured by the posting of working papers) increased by 29$\%$. Production increases were widespread across geographies, job titles, departments, and ages with larger increases in top departments and for people under the age of 35. Men and women both experienced production increases with the exception of women between the age of 35 and 49, who experienced no production gains despite large increases for men in the same age group. COVID-19 increased reliance on past coauthorship networks, with larger production gains for authors that are more central to the network. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
summary: 该研究探讨了COVID-19疫情对经济学和金融学研究生产的影响，以工作论文的发布量作为衡量指标。研究发现，疫情后研究产量增加了29%，增长广泛分布于不同地理区域、职位、院系和年龄段，其中顶尖院系和35岁以下研究者增幅更大。男性和女性均出现产量增长，但35至49岁女性除外，她们没有产量提升，而同年龄段男性则有大幅增长。此外，疫情加强了对过去合作者网络的依赖，处于网络中心位置的作者获得了更大的产量增长。
ai_comment: 本文揭示了疫情下学术生产的不平等现象，尤其关注了性别差异和合作网络的影响，为理解危机时期的科研动态提供了新视角。

abstract: We estimate the potential gains of life-extending treatments to life insurance companies and apply it to immunotherapy.These treatments promise to dramatically raise durable survival rates for a growing number of cancer patients but are often prohibitively expensive for patients and governments alike.Our main insight is that life insurance companies have a direct benefit from such treatments as they lower the insurer's liabilities by pushing the death benefit further into the future and raise future premium income.Using detailed survival data from clinical studies, we quantify the insurers' benefit from immunotherapy for melanoma patients.Extrapolating to 17 other cancer sites, we estimate the insurance sector's benefit to equal $6.8 billion a year.We discuss various financing mechanisms that exploit this value creation, which depend on the relative bargaining power of insurers and consumers.Moreover, the potential gains for life insurers, which could only accrue if health insurers cover the cost of the treatments and households finance the out-of-pocket expenditure, may warrant some exploration of new boundaries between life and health insurance.We discuss the broader implications for medical innovation and long-term care insurance markets.
summary: 本文估计了延长寿命的癌症治疗对人寿保险公司的潜在收益，并以免疫疗法为例进行分析。免疫疗法能显著提高多种癌症患者的长期生存率，但治疗费用高昂，患者和政府难以承受。核心洞察在于，人寿保险公司能从这些治疗中直接获益：一方面，死亡赔付被推迟，降低了保险公司的负债；另一方面，未来的保费收入增加。利用临床研究的详细生存数据，作者量化了免疫疗法对黑色素瘤患者的保险公司收益，并外推到其他17种癌症，估计保险行业每年总收益达68亿美元。文章进一步讨论了利用这一价值创造的不同融资机制，这些机制取决于保险公司与消费者的相对议价能力。此外，人寿保险公司的潜在收益只有在健康保险公司承担治疗费用且家庭支付自付费用时才能实现，这可能促使人们探索人寿保险与健康保险之间的新边界。最后，文章讨论了这些发现对医疗创新和长期护理保险市场的广泛启示。
ai_comment: 本文创新性地将医疗技术的经济价值与人寿保险公司的利益联系起来，为癌症治疗的高昂成本提供了新的融资视角，具有重要的政策与商业启示。

title: Psychology-based Models of Asset Prices and Trading Volume
abstract: Behavioral finance tries to make sense of financial data using models that are based on psychologically accurate assumptions about people's beliefs, preferences, and cognitive limits.I review behavioral finance approaches to understanding asset prices and trading volume, with particular emphasis on three types of models: extrapolation-based models, models of overconfident beliefs, and models of gain-loss utility inspired by prospect theory.The research to date shows that a few simple assumptions about investor psychology capture a wide range of facts about prices and volume and lead to concrete new predictions.I end by speculating about the form that a unified psychology-based model of investor behavior might take.
summary: 本文综述了行为金融学中基于心理学假设的资产定价与交易量模型。重点分析了三类模型：基于外推的模型（投资者根据过去价格变化推断未来走势）、过度自信信念模型（投资者高估自身信息精度或能力）以及受前景理论启发的得失效用模型（投资者对收益和损失的非对称敏感性）。研究表明，这些简单的心理学假设能够解释价格和交易量的一系列经验事实（如动量、反转、过度波动、交易量聚集等），并产生具体的新预测。最后，作者推测了未来可能形成的统一心理学投资者行为模型的形式。
ai_comment: 该综述系统梳理了行为金融学中三类核心心理学模型，清晰展示了简单假设如何解释复杂金融现象，并为后续统一理论构建提供了方向。

abstract: Building on a textbook description of associative memory (Kahana 2012), we present a model of choice in which a choice option cues recall of similar past experiences. Memory shapes valuation and decisions in two ways. First, recalled experiences form a norm, which serves as an initial anchor for valuation. Second, salient quality and price surprises relative to the norm lead to large adjustments in valuation. The model unifies many well documented choice puzzles including the attribution and projection biases, inattention to hidden attributes, background contrast effects, and context-dependent willingness to pay. Unifying these puzzles on the basis of selective memory and attention to surprise yields multiple new predictions.
summary: 本文基于联想记忆的教科书描述（Kahana 2012），提出了一个选择模型，其中选项会触发对相似过往经历的回忆。记忆通过两种方式塑造估值和决策：首先，回忆的经历形成规范，作为估值的初始锚定；其次，相对于规范的显著质量和价格惊喜会导致估值的较大调整。该模型统一了多个已知的选择难题，包括归因偏差、投射偏差、对隐蔽属性的忽视、背景对比效应以及情境依赖的支付意愿。基于选择性记忆和对惊喜的关注来统一这些谜题，产生了多项新预测。
ai_comment: 该模型通过记忆和注意力的机制，为多个行为偏差提供了一个统一的解释框架，具有较强的理论整合能力。

abstract: We use a newly assembled sample of 1,503 regions from 82 countries to compare the speed of per capita income convergence within and across countries. Regional growth is shaped by similar factors as national growth, such as geography and human capital. Regional convergence is about 2.5% per year, not more than 1% per year faster than convergence between countries. Regional convergence is faster in richer countries, and countries with better capital markets. A calibration of a neoclassical growth model suggests that significant barriers to factor mobility within countries are needed to account for the evidence.
summary: 该研究利用新汇编的来自82个国家共1503个区域的数据集，比较了区域内部和区域之间人均收入收敛的速度。研究发现，区域增长受地理和人力资本等与国家增长相似的因素影响。区域收敛速度约为每年2.5%，比国家间收敛速度快不超过1个百分点。区域收敛在更富裕的国家和资本市场更发达的国家更快。通过校准新古典增长模型，研究表明需要国家内部存在显著的要素流动障碍才能解释这一证据。
ai_comment: 该论文利用大规模区域数据，为理解区域经济收敛提供了新的跨国证据，并强调了要素流动障碍在解释收敛速度中的关键作用。
